items.title: My Dear Secretary (2014)
items.description: Owen Waterbury, bestselling novelist, recruits aspiring writer Stephanie 'Steve' Gaylord as his latest of many secretaries.

items.title: Pot O' Gold
items.description: Jimmy, the owner of a failed music shop, goes to work with his uncle, the owner of a food factory.

items.title: Jungle Book (2014)
items.description: A boy raised by wolves tries to adapt to human village life.

items.title: Angel and the Badman (2014)
items.description: Quirt Evans, an all round bad guy, is nursed back to health and sought after by Penelope Worth, a Quaker girl. He eventually finds himself having to choose between his world and the world Penelope lives in.

items.title: Dementia 13
items.description: When her husband John has a heart attack while out in a rowboat on the lake, Louise Haloran throws his body overboard and later tells the family that he has left on an urgent business trip.

items.title: Dick Tracy Meets Gruesome
items.description: Dick Tracy goes up against a villain who robs banks using a nerve gas.

items.title: Kansas City Confidential
items.description: An ex"con trying to go straight is framed for a million dollar armored car robbery and must go to Mexico in order to unmask the real culprits.

items.title: My Favorite Brunette
items.description: Shortly before his execution on the death row in San Quentin, amateur sleuth and baby photographer Ronnie Jackson, tells reporters how he got there.

items.title: Hollow Triumph
items.description: Pursued by the big-time gambler he robbed, John Muller takes a new identity, with ironic results.

items.title: Life with Father (2014)
items.description: A financier from New York rules his numerous family, consisting of his wife and his four sons, with the meticulousity of a bookkeeper.

items.title: Love Laughs at Andy Hardy
items.description: Andy Hardy goes to college after returning from World War II. He is in love with Kay Wilson this time.

items.title: Nancy Drew Reporter
items.description: Nancy Drew, reporter for the school newspaper, clears a girl of murder charges.

items.title: Basic Instinct
items.description: San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.

items.title: Wayne's World 2
items.description: Having achieved godlike status as a late-night TV personality, Wayne now confronts the question that has plagued man for centuries: Is there life after cable?

items.title: Aeon Flux
items.description: Academy Award-winner Charlize Theron stars as Aeon Flux, the underground operative fighting totalitarian rule in 25th-century Earth's last living city.

items.title: An American Christmas Carol (1979)
items.description: A retelling of Charles Dickens' beloved A Christmas Carol in which Henry Winkler is a heartless finance company president in Depression era New England.

items.title: The Duke Is Tops
items.description: A theatrical producer puts aside his own success to boost the career of a talented singer.

items.title: Dick Tracy Detective (1945)
items.description: Police detective Dick Tracy must identify and apprehend a serial killer known as Splitface.

items.title: Beyond Tomorrow (1940)
items.description: The ghosts of three elderly industrialists killed in an airplane crash return to earth to help reunite a young couple whom they initially brought together.

items.title: Algiers (1938)
items.description: Beautiful Gaby meets a romantic jewel thief in the mysterious Casbah.

items.title: The Terror
items.description: A young officer in Napoleon's army pursues a mysterious woman to the castle of an elderly Baron.

items.title: They Made Me a Criminal (1939)
items.description: A boxer flees, believing he has committed murder while he was drunk.

items.title: Stage Door Canteen (1943)
items.description: "Dakota," a young soldier on a pass in New York City, visits the famed Stage Door Canteen, where famous stars of the theatre and films appear and host a recreational center for servicemen during the war.

items.title: Smash Up (1947)
items.description: Angie Evans, fast-rising nightclub singer, interrupts her career to marry struggling songwriter Ken Conway.

items.title: Something to Sing About (1937)
items.description: A New York bandleader journeys to Hollywood when he is offered a contract with a studio, but he is determined to do things his way and not theirs.

items.title: Salt of the Earth (1954)
items.description: Mexican workers at a Zinc mine call a general strike. It is only through the solidarity of the workers, and importantly the indomitable resolve of their wives, mothers and daughters, that they eventually triumph.

items.title: Royal Wedding (1951)
items.description: Tom and Ellen Bowen are a brother-and-sister dance act whose show closes in New York. Their agent books them in London for the same period as the Royal Wedding.

items.title: Nothing Sacred (1937)
items.description: Hazel Flagg of Warsaw, Vermont receives the news that her terminal case of radium poisoning from a workplace incident was a complete misdiagnosis with mixed emotions.

items.title: Jack and the Beanstalk (1952)
items.description: Abbott & Costello's version of the famous fairy tale, about a young boy who trades the family cow for magic beans.

items.title: House on Haunted Hill (1959)
items.description: A millionaire offers ten thousand dollars to five people who agree to be locked in a large, spooky, rented house overnight with he and his wife.

items.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Movie
items.description: The Wraparound Story concerns a little boy who spins all the tales to distract a witch who wants to pop him in the oven!

items.title: West of the Divide (1934)
items.description: Ted Hayden impersonates a wanted man and joins Gentry's gang only to learn later that Gentry was the one who killed his father. He saves Virginia Winters' dad's ranch from Gentry and also rescues his long-lost brother Spud.

items.title: The Vampire Bat
items.description: When the villagers of Klineschloss start dying of blood loss, the town fathers suspect a resurgence of vampirism.

items.title: Three Came Home (1950)
items.description: The true story of Agnes Newton Keith's imprisonment in several Japanese prisoner-of-war camps from 1941 to the end of WWII.

items.title: Topper Returns (1941)
items.description: A sassy girl finds herself dead after trading bedrooms with her heiress friend. Her ghost seeks aid from banker Cosmo Topper to find out why and by whom.

items.title: Till the Clouds Roll By (1947)
items.description: Light biopic of American Broadway pioneer Jerome Kern, featuring renditions of the famous songs from his musical plays by contemporary stage artists, including a condensed production of his most famous: 'Showboat'.

items.title: This is the Army (1943)
items.description: In WWI dancer Jerry Jones stages an all-soldier show on Broadway, called Yip Yip Yaphank. Wounded in the war, he becomes a producer.

items.title: Riders of the Whistling Skull
items.description: A supernatural western! The Three Mesquiteers accompany an archeological expedition to a lost Indian city of gold called Lukachuke.

items.title: Phantom Ranger
items.description: A Treasury Department engraver is being held captive by a counterfeiting gang that wants him to make counterfeit plates for them. A lawman is sent to rescue him.

items.title: Penny Serenade (1941)
items.description: A couple's big dreams give way to a life full of unexpected sadness and unexpected joy.

items.title: My Man Godfrey
items.description: A scatterbrained socialite hires a vagrant as a family butler...but there's more to Godfrey than meets the eye.

items.title: I'm from Arkansas (1944)
items.description: The national spotlight falls on Pitchfork, Arkansas when a local farmer's sow has 18 piglets. How the townspeople relate to city folk and handle fame is the ingredient for laughs.

items.title: Ghosts on the Loose (1943)
items.description: The East Side Kids try to fix up a house for newlyweds, but find the place next door "haunted" by mysterious men.

items.title: Heartbeat (1946)
items.description: A young female escapee from a reform school joins a pickpocket academy in Paris.

items.title: The Fabulous Dorseys
items.description: The rise and rise of the Fabulous Dorsey brothers is charted in this whimsical trip down memory lane.

items.title: Dick Tracy's Dilemma
items.description: Dick Tracy investigates the theft of a fortune of fur coats, a possible insurance swindle and several murders, all linked to a huge thug who wears a hook in place of his right hand.

items.title: All American Co-ed (1941)
items.description: All-girl school Mar Brynn tries to get more pupils and publicity by making fun of the Quincton college.

items.title: Wayside Special (2005)
items.description: Join the new kid Todd as he enters a school where cows roam free, class elections are decided by a game of dodge ball, and falling asleep in class is not only okay, but encouraged.

items.title: Little Bear the Movie (2000)
items.description: Little Bear and Father Bear are camping when Little Bear meets a new friend named Cub.

items.title: Heaven Can Wait
items.description: Heaven Can Wait is a romantic fantasy about Joe Pendleton, a Los Angeles Rams quarterback who is accidentally summoned to Heaven by an overly zealous celestial escort.

items.title: The Foot Fist Way
items.description: Danny McBride stars in his breakout comedic performance as Fred Simmons, an outrageous Tae Kwon Do Master who rules his mini-mall dojo with an iron fist.

items.title: Stephen King's Thinner
items.description: An obese attorney accidentally runs down and kills an old gypsy woman. After her ancient father puts a curse on him, he starts losing weight, and cannot stop. Based on the Stephen King novel, written under the pseudonym Richard Bachman.

items.title: Blue Chips
items.description: Pete Bell, a college basketball coach is under a lot of pressure. His team isn't winning. The stars of the future are being paid by other teams. This practise is forbidden in the college game, but Pete is desperate and has pressures from all around.

items.title: Head Games (2012)
items.description: From Oscar nominated director Steve James ("Hoop Dreams") comes this revealing documentary about the concussion crisis in sports.

items.title: The Perfect Human Diet (2012)
items.description: The Perfect Human Diet is the unprecedented global exploration for a solution to our epidemic of overweight, obesity and diet-related diseases - the #1 killer in America.

items.title: Jug Face (2013)
items.description: Jug Face tells the story of a pregnant teen trying to escape a backwoods community who discovers that she may be sacrificed to a creature in a pit.

items.title: Apartment 1303 (2013)
items.description: The truth behind Janet's sister's episodes is far more frightening and unexplainable than she had fathomed possible.

items.title: Black Web (2013)
items.description: "Black Web" is a time travel movie set in 1997, a year when computer technology was just taking off. A computer programmer named Easton has been tracking the growth of the internet phenomenon since the beginning.

items.title: Cropsey (2010)
items.description: Filmmakers uncover a reality that is more terrifying than any urban legend.

items.title: Craigslist Joe
items.description: Joe will live entirely off the alms of America's new town square: Craigslist. From transportation to food, shelter and companionship, Joe depends solely on the generosity of people he meets through this massive digital swap meet. Will America help Joe?

items.title: Buying Sex
items.description: Buying Sex looks at the contentious debate over pending reforms to Canadian prostitution laws, and in the process asks us to rethink and review our attitudes toward the oldest profession, a.k.a. the oldest oppression.

items.title: Alien Crash at Roswell (2013)
items.description: The most enigmatic UFO incident in history exposed. Join Philip Coppens, star of History Channel's "Ancient Aliens" series in this and unprecedented expose on the Roswell Incident revealing that there is much more to this case than previously believed.

items.title: The Woman in Green (1945)
items.description: Sherlock Holmes investigates when young women around London turn up murdered, each with a finger severed off. Scotland Yard suspects a madman, but Holmes believes the killings to be part of a diabolical plot.

items.title: The Terror of Tiny Town (1938)
items.description: An evil gunslinging midget comes to terrorize the good little people of Tiny Town. The townspeople organize to defeat him, and zany antics ensue.

items.title: A Study in Scarlet (1933)
items.description: In London, a secret society collects the assets of any of its deceased members and divides them among the remaining members. Sherlock Holmes is approached by member James Murphy's widow, who is miffed at being left penniless by her husband.

items.title: Steamboat Bill Jr. (1928)
items.description: The effete son of a cantankerous riverboat captain comes to join his father's crew.

items.title: The Stork Club (1945)
items.description: A hat-check girl saves the life of a drowning man. The man decides to repay her by anonymously giving her a bank account, a luxury apartment, and a department store account. When her boyfriend returns from overseas, he thinks she is a kept woman.

items.title: The Second Woman (1950)
items.description: Ellen Foster visits her aunt on the California coast, and meets neighbor Jeff Cohalan. Ellen is strongly attracted to Jeff, who's being plagued by unexplainable accidents. Warned that Jeff could be dangerous, Ellen fears that he's in danger.

items.title: My Outlaw Brother (1952)
items.description: Tracy Powell gets the gold fever and heads for Stockton, California in 1849. Six years later, Powell returns to Indiana and his sweetheart, Julie. They marry, and, on the night their son is born, he takes off again searching for gold.

items.title: Port of New York (1949)
items.description: Two narcotics agents go after a gang of murderous drug dealers who use ships docking at the New York harbor to smuggle in their contraband.

items.title: Mr. Moto's Last Warning (1939)
items.description: Mr. Moto thwarts a ruthless band of international agents who try to foment an international incident by mining the entrance to the Suez Canal and blaming the British.

items.title: Made for Each Other
items.description: Newlyweds struggle in their first year of marriage, plagued by money problems, illness and a live-in mother-in-law. Their son, dying of pneumonia, can only be saved by a serum from across the country, when all flights have been grounded due to weather.

items.title: The Kennel Murder Case
items.description: Philo Vance, accompanied by his prize-losing Scottish terrier, investigates the locked-room murder of a prominent and much-hated collector whose broken Chinese vase provides an important clue.

items.title: Jigsaw (1949)
items.description: New York Assistant District Attorney Howard Malloy investigates a series of murders and uncovers an extremist group.

items.title: Go For Broke (1951)
items.description: Starring Van Johnson, this is the story of the Japanese Americans who formed the 442nd Regimental Combat Team in 1943 and served in Italy and France in WWII.

items.title: The Fast and the Furious (1955)
items.description: A man kidnaps a woman as he tries to get away from the police and cross the Mexican border. He is an escaped prisoner who wants to clear his name.

items.title: Dick Tracy vs. Cueball
items.description: Cueball takes gems from a thief and continues murdering people he believes are trying to swindle him. Dick Tracys girlfriend acts as a buyer for the gems, but Tracys plan backfires when Cueball captures her.

items.title: The Amazing Adventure
items.description: A bored millionaire wagers his doctor that he can support himself at a working class job for year without touching his inheritance.

items.title: Africa Screams (1949)
items.description: Abbott & Costello search for diamonds in Africa, along the way meeting a visually impaired gunner, a hungry lion, and a tribe of cannibals.

items.title: The Admiral Was a Lady (1950)
items.description: After the end of World War II, Jean Madison, a former WAVE ensign, encounters four fun-loving, work-hating men, all of whom want to marry her.

items.title: Vinyl (2013)
items.description: An aging rock group use a young fresh faced punk band to front new recordings to fool the music industry.

items.title: Metamorphosis (1990)
items.description: Evil spirits haunt a French anthropologist and inhabit the doctor who treats him.

items.title: Ghosthouse (1988)
items.description: Visions of a deceased girl and her doll bring doom to the visitors of a deserted house.

items.title: Something from Nothing: The Art of Rap (2012)
items.description: Ice-T travels coast to coast interviewing rap performers such as Q-Tip, Common and Kanye West to pay tribute to the musical art form.

items.title: Stolen Jools (1931)
items.description: The theft of Norma Shearer's jewelry sets the plot in motion for this star-studded promotional short.

items.title: Tarzan's Revenge (1938)
items.description: In his only turn as Tarzan, 1936 Olympic decathlon champion Glenn Morris cavorts in the jungle with another Olympian, swimming star Eleanor Holm. Neither athlete pursued a movie career, so this film is a rarity in that we see them together!

items.title: Speak Easily
items.description: The films Buster Keaton starred in at MGM during the 1930s are often dismissed as inferior to the work he did during the silent era, but the truth is that many of them are delightful.

items.title: The Private Life of Henry the VIII (1933)
items.description: The film that made Charles Laughton a star tells the story of King Henry VIII and his stormy personal life.

items.title: Palooka
items.description: Jimmy Durante stars as Knobby Walsh, the opportunistic trainer of boxing contender Joe Palooka (Stuart Erwin). Joe manages to knock out the champ (William Cagney) and wins his girlfriend in the process.

items.title: Of Human Bondage (1934)
items.description: W. Somerset Maugham's novel is the basis for this melodrama about a young medical student who loves a heartless, unfeeling waitress.

items.title: My Pal Trigger (1946)
items.description: Roy Rogers goes to jail after hes wrongly accused of killing Gabby Hayes horse in this action packed yarn from Republic Pictures.

items.title: The Milky Way
items.description: This was Harold Lloyd's most highly regarded talkie, and also one of the last films he would appear in. He plays Burleigh Sullivan, a timid milkman who finds himself in the seedy world of prizefighting.

items.title: Li'l Abner (1940)
items.description: Oh, Happy Day! It's Li'l Abner and Daisy Mae and Mammy and Pappy Tokum right out of your favorite cartoon strip! Jeff York plays the title role in director Albert S. Rogell's version of the famous Al Capp comic series.

items.title: He Walked by Night (1948)
items.description: This iconic film noir stars Richard Basehart as a cold-hearted cop killer. This feature from director Alfred Werker is generally considered one of the great police dramas of all time, and a forerunner of TV's Dragnet.

items.title: Gulliver's Travels
items.description: In 1939 the brilliant animation team of Max and Dave Fleischer took a break from Popeye and Betty Boop cartoons to tackle Gulliver's adventures in Lilliput.

items.title: Glorifying the American Girl
items.description: Mary Eaton stars in this feature about the rise of a showgirl. This early talkie includes cameos by many top names of the day. Listen for period hits like 'Bye Bye Blackbird' and 'Baby Face.' This movie is like a time machine and will take you back!

items.title: The Dawn Express (1942)
items.description: In this daring World War II-era spy thriller, a Nazi spy ring attempts to get their hands on a top-secret chemical formula that increases the power of ordinary gasoline for U.S. Army aviation use.

items.title: Creature from the Haunted Sea
items.description: In this spoof of horror and spy thrillers, American gangster Renzo Capetto decides to kill members of his bungling crew and blame their deaths on a legendary sea creature. What he doesnt know is that the creature is actually out there!

items.title: Cheers for Miss Bishop (1941)
items.description: Adapted from Bess Streeter Aldrich's novel Miss Bishop, Cheers for Miss Bishop is a sweeping, tragic epic of lost love and missed opportunities spanning the course of nearly fifty years in the life of the eponymous Ella Bishop.

items.title: Behave Yourself (1951)
items.description: A well-meaning husband adopts a stray pet for his wife's anniversary present - but when it turns out the dog is on the lam from the mob - it spells four-legged trouble!

items.title: Attack of the Giant Leeches
items.description: Massive bloodsucking monsters are at large in this Drive-in schlock classic from producers Roger and Gene Corman. Basically, its a bunch of actors in plastic costumes, but director Bernard Kowalski made the most of his small budget.

items.title: Angel on My Shoulder (1946)
items.description: Angel on My Shoulder is the darkly comic tale of a murdered gangster who arrives in Hell, only to be sent back to Earth to make up for his sins.

items.title: Alice of Wonderland in Paris
items.description: Young Alice, now a celebrity thanks to her famous adventures in Wonderland, sits in her bedroom dreaming about visiting the magical city of Paris, France. Her fantasy is swiftly fulfilled, thanks to a talking mouse named Francois and his magical cheese.

items.title: Abraham Lincoln
items.description: 100% Rating on Rotten Tomatoes. D.W. Griffith's Abraham Lincoln is one of the earliest film biographies of America's 16th president. Lincoln is shown from his early days, to his presidency, to his assassination at age 56.

items.title: Dark Mountain (2014)
items.description: No sign of the filmmakers themselves has been found to date. Dark Mountain is the chilling reconstruction from their footage of what are believed to be their last days. Inspired by actual events.

items.title: Silent Retreat
items.description: Janey is sent to a silent meditation retreat in the middle of the woods for rehabilitation, only to discover that the men who run it are brainwashing women to be quiet and submissive...

items.title: Occupant
items.description: Danny Hill's grandmother just died giving him the opportunity to live in her rent controlled apartment in Manhattan. But as Danny quickly discovers, he may not be the only OCCUPANT.

items.title: Nightmares in Red, White, and Blue
items.description: Horror and sci-fi veteran Lance Henriksen (Alien) narrates this fascinating look at the history of the American horror film. Includes interviews with genre masters Roger Corman, John Carpenter and George A. Romero.

items.title: Fat, Sick & Nearly Dead (2011)
items.description: Overweight, loaded up on steroids and suffering from a debilitating autoimmune disease, Joe Cross was at the end of his rope and the end of his hope.

items.title: Beer Wars (2009)
items.description: With her entertaining documentary, Anat Baron ushers viewers into the backrooms and breweries of the ultra competitive beer industry and reveals what it takes for independent brewers to compete with the corporate giants who dominate the business.

items.title: Ancient Alien Question (2012)
items.description: Join Philip Coppens, star of the History Channel's "Ancient Aliens" series, as he provides proof that UFO's helmed by Extraterrestrials from other worlds came to Earth millennia ago.

items.title: Alien Encounter at Loch Ness
items.description: The Loch Ness Monster has been encountered by locals since the 7th Century, but no scientific investigation has fully explained the mystery until now. Prepare for a mind-blowing revelation as experts reveal the Alien of Loch Ness.

items.title: A World Ruled by Evil (2014)
items.description: A group of extremely powerful people control the world through manipulation, marketing, propaganda and force. These are not the people you're thinking of. These are not always the politicians who are so often pawns themselves.

items.title: Casino Jack (2010)
items.description: A hot shot Washington DC lobbyist and his protégé go down hard as their schemes to peddle influence lead to corruption and murder.

items.title: The Last Time I Committed Suicide (1997)
items.description: Beat Poet Neal Cassady is pulled between two women, Mary (Gretchen Mol), a teen temptress and Joan (Forlani), his first true love.

items.title: Me and the Mob (1982)
items.description: Jimmy Corona is a struggling writer who takes a job with the mob to make ends meet. His wise guy uncle takes him under his wing but then hes nabbed by the cops to rat out his shady associates. Features a young Sandra Bullock as Jimmy's sexy girlfriend.

items.title: Under Our Skin (2009)
items.description: In the 1970s, a mysterious and deadly illness began infecting children in a samll town in Connecticut. Today it's a global epidemic.

items.title: The Elephant in the Living Room (2011)
items.description: Praised by critics as one of the best films of the year, The Elephant in the Living Room takes viewers deep inside the controversial subculture of raising the most dangerous animals in the world, as common household pets.

items.title: Looking for Lenny
items.description: Looking for Lenny is an in-depth, controversial documentary that uses Lenny Bruce's legacy to explore the present condition of the fear of words and expression.

items.title: Kennedy Curse (2012)
items.description: The Kennedy family has long been plagued by tragedy and scandal. Despite this, they have brought major positive change to the world, in often difficult times.

items.title: Farmageddon
items.description: The story of a mom whose son was healed from all allergies and asthma after consuming raw milk, and real food from farms.

items.title: Conspiracy of Lies (2015)
items.description: We have now discovered the NSA can and does spy on every American citizen and we only need the national media to see that many of the New World Order plans are already in place.

items.title: American Grindhouse (2010)
items.description: Filmmaking legends look back at the hidden history of the American "exploitation" film business from which many movie stars emerged or were formed after starring in these low-budget, but creative horror films.

items.title: American Ghost Hunter (2012)
items.description: Unlike fictional mockumentaries, AMERICAN GHOST HUNTER provides the most compelling and shocking REAL paranormal activity ever documented, while also delivering an overwhelmingly emotional story of what a son is willing to do to save his family.

items.title: After Porn Ends (2012)
items.description: After Porn Ends is a documentary that not only examines the lives and careers of some of the biggest names in the history of the adult entertainment industry, but what happens to them after they leave the business.

items.title: Alien from Area 51 (2015)
items.description: Footage of a dead alien from a crashed UFO in Roswell, NM and moved to Area 51 shocked the world. The time is coming for alien intervention on Earth whether we are ready or not.

items.title: The Devil Bat
items.description: A deranged scientist develops an aftershave lotion that incites his gigantic bats to kill!

items.title: Indestructible Man
items.description: Lon Chaney Jr. stars as Butcher Benton, a con who goes to his execution vowing to kill his former partners in crime. When his corpse is inadvertently brought back to life during a scientific experiment, he makes good on his deadly promises!

items.title: The Monster Walks (1932)
items.description: After her father dies, Ruth Earlton inherits and moves into her father's estate with her fiancé.

items.title: The Giant Gila Monster (1959)
items.description: Only Hell could breed such an enormous beast. Only God could destroy it! Well, if not God, how about a heroic hot-rodding teenager?

items.title: The Body Beneath (1970)
items.description: Inbreeding is destroying a family of vampires in this gem from Andy Milligan. This film includes vampires disguised as ministers, ghouls, hunchbacks, and a diabolical plot to abduct a mortal woman and use her as a breeder for vampire babies.

items.title: Killer Shrews
items.description: Maybe theyre just dogs wearing fake snouts and tails, in a low budget movie filmed in Texas by the same group that gave us The Giant Gila Monster. But suspend your disbelief, and theyll become mutant, killer shrews, created by a mad scientist.

items.title: Billy the Kid Returns
items.description: Rogers arrives on the scene shortly after Billy the Kid dies. Though Billy was a killer, he was on the side of the homesteaders against a coterie of big time ranchers. Roy poses as Billy to continue the fight against the ranchers without the bloodshed.

items.title: Tom Brown's School Days (1940)
items.description: Cedric Hardwicke and Freddie Bartholomew star in this adaptation of Thomas Hughes famous novel. To say this film has an impressive pedigree is an understatement!

items.title: The Star Packer (1934)
items.description: John Travers (John Wayne) takes on a mysterious gang leader known as The Shadow in this vintage western from Hollywood's Poverty Row.

items.title: The Scarlet Letter (1934)
items.description: Bearing a child out of wedlock was punishable in 17th century Massachusetts by being forced to wear a scarlet letter 'A,' but unwed mother Hester, who was born to a noble family, is determined to rise above her situation.

items.title: The Phantom from 10,000 Leagues (1955)
items.description: You know the story: A radioactive rock at the bottom of the ocean causes a sea creature to mutate into a horrible, amphibious monster. This seemed to happen a lot in the 1950s. Director Dan Milner hits all the right notes here.

items.title: That Uncertain Feeling (1941)
items.description: A woman who visits a psychoanalyst to cure her hiccups. From there, she realizes that shes fallen out of love with her husband. When she becomes interested in a neurotic pianist, it seems her marriage is truly doomed. But in a funny way

items.title: The Son of Monte Cristo (1940)
items.description: Louis Hayward, Joan Bennett and George Sanders headline this Oscar-nominated adventure set in the Balkans. Revered director Rowland V. Lee keeps the action brisk as the Count tries to defeat a bullying dictator, and win a beautiful woman in the process.

items.title: Silver Blaze (1937)
items.description: Sherlock Holmes takes a vacation and visits his old friend Sir Henry Baskerville. His vacation ends when he suddenly finds himself in the middle of a double-murder mystery.

items.title: Revolt of the Zombies
items.description: An international expedition is sent into Cambodia to destroy an ancient formula that turns men into zombies.

items.title: Never Wave at a WAC (1953)
items.description: Rosalind Russell stars as a divorced socialite who joins the Army to be near her boyfriend, only to learn that military life isn't for everybody. They don't make comedies like this anymore!

items.title: Maniac (1934)
items.description: A former vaudevillian gifted at impersonation assists a mad scientist in reanimating corpses and soon goes mad himself.

items.title: Lady of Burlesque (1943)
items.description: Barbara Stanwyck stars in one of her sassiest roles as Dixie Daisy, a brassy burlesque performer who is suspected of murder. Based on a novel by the queen of burlesque, this feature earned an Oscar nomination for best music and will keep you guessing!

items.title: Invisible Ghost
items.description: Bela Lugosi headlines this creepy thriller about an influential man who becomes a bloodthirsty maniac after his wife deserts him. It was the first of nine films made by Lugosi for Sam Katzman of Monogram Pictures.

items.title: High School Caesar (1960)
items.description: Matt comes from a wealthy family, but at school he leads a gang of thugs. When he's not shaking down kids for money, he's rigging the election for class president. Eventually, the kids grow tired of Matt's harassment and decide to fight back!

items.title: Anatomy of a Psycho (1961)
items.description: Ronnie Burns stars as Chet, a delusional young man boiling with rage after his brother is sentenced to death for murder. As his paranoid feelings increase, Chet decides to create some mayhem of his own, including arson!

items.title: Quadrophenia (1979)
items.description: Fueled by amphetamines and teen angst, Jimmy speeds around London on his scooter with his Mod friends getting into trouble.

items.title: The Strange Case of Alice Cooper: Live 1979 (1979)
items.description: The Strange Case Of Alice Cooper is the warped tale of one man's descent into madness, a theatrical rock n' roll spectacle that could only emerge from the twisted imagination of Alice Cooper.

items.title: The Kentucky Fried Movie
items.description: Series of short, highly irreverent, and quite often tasteless skits.

items.title: Stella: Live in Boston (2009)
items.description: Stella is the unique comedy trio known for their critically acclaimed TV series, their long-running nightclub show and their wildly popular series of shorts on the Web. Now Stella are captured live in concert in all of their uncensored glory.

items.title: Neon Maniacs (1986)
items.description: A group of teenagers in San Francisco discover a nest of homicidal monsters living in a tower of the Golden Gate Bridge, but when they try to tell authorities, no one believes them.

items.title: Arnold's Wrecking Company
items.description: A student tries pot for the first time, loves it and decides to distribute it in a big business kind of way. Soon he has the police and the mafia on his tail.

items.title: Mike Birbiglia: What I Should Have Said Was Nothing (2008)
items.description: A few years ago, Mike Birbiglia's therapist suggested he keep a journal of the awkward moments occurring in his life. Audiences were demanding more material, so he started sending this journal to his mailing list and then telling those stories onstage.

items.title: Jeffrey Ross: No Offense (2008)
items.description: Respected and feared as a result of his show-stopping performances at the Comedy Central

items.title: Festival Express (2004)
items.description: The filmed account of a large Canadian rock festival train tour.

items.title: Dana Gould: Let Me Put My Thoughts in You (2009)
items.description: Stand-Up comedian Dana Gould performs his one-hour comedy special at Chicago's famed Second City theatre.

items.title: Cannibal Girls (1973)
items.description: Eugene Levy and Andrea Martin star in this Canadian horror spoof as a couple on a romantic holiday who settle into a quaint little bed-and-breakfast run by a trio of flesh-eating ladies who fancy them for tomorrow's menu.

items.title: Candy (1968)
items.description: Candy, an innocent high-schooler, encounters numerous colorful characters and humorous sexual situations while attempting to find meaning in life.

items.title: Dear Santa
items.description: A young woman who comes from a life of privilege falls for the owner of a soup kitchen after discovering a Dear Santa letter written by his seven year old daughter.

items.title: Is This El Chapo? (2014)
items.description: This documentary probes the truth behind the 2014 arrest of Joaquin "El Chapo" Guzman, the world's most notorious drug lord.

items.title: Assault on Precinct 13 (1976)
items.description: The isolated inhabitants of an abandoned police station are under attack by the overwhelming numbers of a seemingly unstoppable street gang.

items.title: Comic Relief: The Greatest (2008)
items.description: This collection plays host to the best 20 years of Comic Relief. Join Billy, Whoopi, Robin and the rest of the greatest comedians on Earth as they throw their best stuff at a national disaster.

items.title: Comic Relief: The Latest (2008)
items.description: This collection plays host to the best 20 years of Comic Relief. Join Billy, Whoopi, Robin and the rest of the greatest comedians on Earth as they throw their best stuff at a national disaster.

items.title: Hollywood Ghost Stories (1985)
items.description: An investigation into the reports of houses in Hollywood that are supposedly haunted by the ghosts of dead movie stars.

items.title: Christmas Crush (2013)
items.description: Twenty-eight-year-old Georgia is convinced the man of her dreams is the one "that got away" back in high school. Though she's tried dating other men, they just never seem to compare to her high school flame.

items.title: Holiday Breakup
items.description: A couple falls crazy in love, only to break up right before all the big holiday parties. It's Suckville, so they pretend to still be mad for each other instead of mad at each other. It's the perfect if they don't fall back in love.

items.title: Plastic Galaxy (2014)
items.description: Plastic Galaxy explores the groundbreaking world of Star Wars toys. Through interviews with former Kenner employees, toy experts, and collectors, it looks at the toys' history, their influence, and the feelings they elicit today.

items.title: Roller Town
items.description: When a roller-skating-obsessed town is overrun by video game shilling gangsters, only one man has the funk deep enough to boogie them back to oblivion.

items.title: Institute, The (2013)
items.description: Many San Franciscans take part in an elaborate alternate-reality game created by Jeff Hull, but as more players become involved, the game begins to spin out of control.

items.title: Bet Raise Fold
items.description: The Story of Online Poker is a feature documentary that follows a new generation of internet poker professionals during the meteoric rise and sudden crash of the multibillion dollar online poker industry of the 2000s.

items.title: The Rise and Rise of Bitcoin (2014)
items.description: Join us as we take a journey through the rapidly growing world of Bitcoin. Along the way, we'll follow the stories of entrepreneurs and start-ups that are helping shape the new financial frontier.

items.title: Neurons to Nirvana (2013)
items.description: A stylish, in depth look at the renaissance in psychedelic drug research in light of current scientific, medical and cultural knowledge.

items.title: The Source Family
items.description: The Source Family's outlandish lifestyle made them the darlings of Hollywood; but their outsider ideals and spiritual leader, Father Yod, caused controversy with local authorities.

items.title: Mexicos Bravest Man (2016)
items.description: This doc chronicles the life of Julian Leyzaola Perez, a former police chief who made it his life's duty to take down powerful drug cartels in Tijuana and Juarez, Mexico.

items.title: The Legend of Cool "Disco" Dan
items.description: This is the story of black Washington DC told from the perspective of Cool Disco Dan starting with his birth during the civil rights era and follows his life parallel with the rise of Go-Go music through the 1980s.

items.title: Hotline (2014)
items.description: Filmmaker Tony Shaff eavesdrops on the inner workings of hotlines to put a face to the voice on the other end of the line.

items.title: Hell Baby
items.description: Jack and Vanessa are an expectant couple that moves into the most haunted fixer-upper in New Orleans, a house with a deadly demonic curse.

items.title: Bitter Buddha (2013)
items.description: Cult-Comic Eddie Pepitone's life is on display in this unhinged portrait of creativity, enlightenment and rage.

items.title: American: The Bill Hicks Story
items.description: A captivating animated documentary on the rollercoaster life of legendary comedian Bill hicks, whose profound and hilarious observations on American life changed the face of modern comedy.

items.title: Goodbye Bruce Lee
items.description: A kung fu expert is approached by the director of the late Bruce Lee's unfinished film and asked to help in bringing the film to the silver screen.

items.title: Knightriders
items.description: A medieval reenactment troupe find it increasingly difficult to keep their family-like group together, with pressure from local law enforcement, interest from entertainment agents and a growing sense of delusion from their leader.

items.title: Portrait of Wally (2012)
items.description: The story of a Nazi-looted painting, Egon Schiele's Portrait of Wally, that was discovered on the walls of the Museum of Modern Art in 1997.

items.title: Mile ...  Mile And a Half
items.description: In an epic snow year, a group of artists leave their daily lives behind to hike and record the historic John Muir Trail.

items.title: Minds in the Water (2012)
items.description: Pro surfer Dave Rastovich went from observer to activist when he embarked on a personal mission to help dolphins, whales and the oceans they all share.

items.title: Love and Terror On the Howling Plains of Nowhere
items.description: Author Poe Ballantine investigates the disappearance of a brilliant mathematics professor, who then is found tied to a tree and burned beyond recognition.

items.title: Going Attractions: The Definitive Story of the American Drive-In Movie
items.description: The history of the American drive-in theater and its continual decline.

items.title: Danny Greene: The Rise and Fall of the Irishman
items.description: A documentary on the life and death of Cleveland's legendary gangster and his battle with the Italian Mob. This documentary spotlight's the gangster whose life was famously extinguished by a car bomb in Lyndhurst parking lot.

items.title: At the Edge of the World (2008)
items.description: The story of the controversial Sea Shepherd Antarctic Campaign against a Japanese whaling fleet. The international volunteer crew, under-trained and under-equipped, develop a combination of bizarre and brilliant tactics with which to stop the whalers.

items.title: Birth of the Living Dead (2013)
items.description: Released in 1968, George A. Romero's low-budget shocker Night of the Living Dead becomes a landmark horror movie.

items.title: Carbon Nation
items.description: An optimistic, solutions-based, non-preachy, big tent film that shows tackling climate change boosts the economy, increases national security and promotes health and a clean environment.

items.title: Comix Beyond
items.description: An exciting new documentary about the world of comic books told through interviews of the creators, artists, writers, collectors, store owners, indie publishers, and the passionate fans who have made it the phenomenon that it is today.

items.title: I'll Be Homeless for Christmas
items.description: When a petty thief learns that his latest mark is a struggling single mother who works at a homeless shelter, he decides to use his savvy street smarts to make this Christmas one to remember for her and her young son.

items.title: The Fantastical World of Hormones (2014)
items.description: Leading endocrinologist Professor John Wass tells the fascinating story of hormones, the well-known but little-understood chemicals that govern our bodies. From our appetite to how we grow and reproduce, hormones are a crucial part of what makes us human.

items.title: The Wolf Marine Mammal (2015)
items.description: The wolf of British Columbia is on a quest to master water, fishing and swimming. According to several specialists, the wolf is at the first stage of a process that could turn it into a marine mammal.

items.title: The Wild Pacific
items.description: The Pacific Ocean covers one third of our planet, more than all the continents combined. For over 200 Million years, it has teemed with life, built new species, powered weather systems and affects every animal on earth.

items.title: On the Yeti Trail
items.description: For the first time in over a century, the sometimes far-fetched Yeti legends and personal accounts have become the subject of state-of-the-art scientific studies. Does the Yeti really exist?

items.title: Oasis Earth (2008)
items.description: Ever imagine what it feels like to look at Earth from space? Join the crew of the space shuttle Endeavour and take a thrilling journey to experience the beauty  in awesome High Definition  of our planet from 150 miles above Earth.

items.title: Mystery of the Pink Dolphin (2015)
items.description: The Amazon Pink River Dolphin is one of the most mysterious species of the animal kingdom. For a long time, Not much was known about the dolphin, but now thanks to a recent discovery, scientists are finally able to understand more.

items.title: Life in the Reeds
items.description: Welcome to a strange territory, one where man isn't welcome and feels uneasy to enter: the swamps. Home to numerous species that replay everyday the eternal game of life and death in which the hunter so easily becomes the hunted.

items.title: How to Colonize the Stars
items.description: Leading physicists and engineers in the field of interstellar travel discuss some of the deep issues we face when considering the problem of sending spacecraft to other stars. Will mankind ever truly become a space fairing civilization?

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Werewolf of Washington
items.description: While on assignment in Hungary, a young reporter is attacked by a mysterious animal.

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The House That Screamed
items.description: Headmistress Madame Fourneau runs her French boarding school for troubled girls with an iron fist. Still, one by one, her students are going missing without a single trace of evidence left behind.

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Maneater of Hydra
items.description: While vacationing in the Mediterranean, a group of tourists pays to spend a weekend exploring a lush island occupied by the botanist Baron von Weser.

items.title: Even Dwarfs Started Small
items.description: The inhabitants of an institution in a remote country rebel against their keepers. Their acts of rebellion are by turns humorous, boring and alarming.

items.title: Excavating the 2000 Year Old Man
items.description: A documentary that explores the origin and influence of The 2000 Year Old Man, the classic comedy routine created by Mel Brooks and Carl Reiner.

items.title: City Hunter
items.description: Extremely silly comedy about a self-indulgent private investigator who winds up on a cruise ship full of rich patrons, gorgeous women, murderous terrorists, and scarce food.

items.title: Aguirre The Wrath Of God (1972)
items.description: In the 16th century, the ruthless and insane Don Lope de Aguirre leads a Spanish expedition in search of El Dorado.

items.title: 10 Most Evil Serial Killers (2015)
items.description: Explore the dark and twisted world of the Top Ten Victorian Serial Killers. From evil gangs with their hearts set on vengeance to sick and twisted doctors who used their knowledge to take numerous lives, the world of the serial killer knows no bounds.

items.title: Black Magic (1949)
items.description: Based on a novel by Alexander Dumas, Black Magic stars Orson Welles as the 18th century master hypnotist and charismatic charlatan Cagliostro.

items.title: Day of the Dead
items.description: A small group of military officers and scientists dwell in an underground bunker as the world above is overrun by zombies.

items.title: Chu and Blossom
items.description: Joon Chu, a Korean exchange student finds himself marooned in small-town USA, where he is irrevocably swept up into the brave new world and bizarre philosophies of Butch Blossom, a touchingly militant performance artist.

items.title: Bloodsworth An Innocent Man (2016)
items.description: Charged. Convicted. Sentenced to death. Innocent. The remarkable true story of the 1st death row inmate exonerated by DNA in the US.

items.title: Alien Agenda: Planet Earth
items.description: Alien Agenda Planet Earth reveals the shocking truth about UFOs and Extraterrestrials, a truth that has been suppressed and hidden for centuries.

items.title: Tapped (2009)
items.description: Examines the role of the bottled water industry and its effects on our health, climate change, pollution, and our reliance on oil.

items.title: Kidnapped for Christ
items.description: A young evangelical filmmaker is granted unprecedented access inside a controversial Christian behavior modification program for teens, where she discovers shocking secrets and young students that change her life.

items.title: Coming of Age in Cherry Grove (2014)
items.description: Founded in 1869, Cherry Grove, Fire Island, NY, is considered by most to be the first openly LGBTQ community in the United States.

items.title: Along Recovery (2012)
items.description: Army veteran Justin Springer served two tours in Iraq where he witnessed dozens of Soldiers in his unit suffer from the signature wound of the war-traumatic brain injury TBI.

items.title: American Commune (2013)
items.description: In 1970, 1,500 hippies and their guru Stephen Gaskin founded a commune in rural Tennessee. Members forked over their savings, grew their own food, delivered their babies at home and built a self-sufficient society.

items.title: Valentine Road (2014)
items.description: Valentine Road is a feature documentary examining the emotionally devastating earthquake and powerful aftershock that occurred when 14-year-old Brandon McInerney fatally shot 15-year-old Lawrence King during first period English class in the 8th grade.

items.title: New York I Love You
items.description: In the city that never sleeps, love is always on the mind. Those passions come to life in New York, I Love You, a collaboration of storytelling from some of today's most imaginative filmmakers and featuring an all-star cast.

items.title: Ping Pong
items.description: A twinkly inspirational documentary about eight competitors in the World Over-80 Table Tennis Championships in Inner Mongolia. The ping-pongers are all in their 80s and 90s, one Australian woman is a centurion.

items.title: Afternoon Delight
items.description: In this sexy, dark comedy, a Silver Lake mom puts her idyllic life in jeopardy when she tries to rescue a stripper by taking her in as a live-in nanny.

items.title: Boogie Man: The Lee Atwater Story (2008)
items.description: The Murrow, Polk, and IDA Award-winning documentary Boogie Man is about Lee Atwater, a blues-playing rogue whose rise from the South to Chairman of the GOP made him a political rock star.

items.title: Make it in America: Empowering Global Fashion (2008)
items.description: Alma had dreams as a young girl of going to college. Her dreams shattered when the civil war in El Salvador started. Alma's mother sent her with Coyotes to cross the border in the United States.

items.title: Empire of Dirt
items.description: Going home was never an option for single mother Lena Mahikan. But when her 13-year-old Peeka overdoses in the streets of Toronto, she is forced to return home to her estranged mother and face a life-long legacy of shame and resentment.

items.title: Pussy Riot: A Punk Prayer
items.description: Three young women face seven years in a Russian prison for a satirical performance in a Moscow cathedral. But who is really on trial in a case that has gripped the nation and the world beyond, three young artists or the society they live in?

items.title: Last Call at the Oasis
items.description: Water. It's the earth's most valuable resource. Our cities are powered by it, countless industries depend on it, and all living things need it to survive.

items.title: Something's Gonna Live (2012)
items.description: Ten years in the making, this documentary is an intimate portrait of life, death, friendship, and the movies, as recalled by some of Hollywood's greatest cinema artists.

items.title: G-Dog (2015)
items.description: G-Dog tells the entertaining, hilarious and unlikely story of how a white Jesuit priest became an expert in gang lives and transformed the lives of thousands of Latino, Asian, and African American gang members.

items.title: One Day on Earth
items.description: One Day on Earth is the first film made in every country of the world on the same day. We see both the challenges and hopes of humanity from a diverse group of volunteer filmmakers assembled by a participatory media experiment.

items.title: Sharknado: Feeding Frenzy (2015)
items.description: What began as another Syfy creature feature has now become an important piece of pop culture, poised to take over the entire world.

items.title: The Art of McCartney
items.description: This documentary explores the making of a remarkable album: The Art of McCartney, features the finest artist of today paying their respect to the greatest.

items.title: Give Me The Banjo (2011)
items.description: A comprehensive look at a quintessential American musical instrument, the banjo, from its African roots to contemporary jazz and into the 21st century.

items.title: Age of Champions (2013)
items.description: This inspiring, award-winning documentary follows five senior competitors up to 100 years old who sprint, leap, and swim for gold at the National Senior Olympics.

items.title: Body Bags
items.description: Three short stories in the horror genre. The first about a serial killer. The second about a hair transplant gone wrong. The third about a baseball player.

items.title: Dirty Dancing
items.description: Patrick Swayze and Jennifer Grey star in this spirit-lifting story about a summer love affair between a naïve 17-year-old girl and a charismatic dance instructor at a Catskills hotel. Rated PG-13

items.title: May
items.description: May grew up as a lonely oddball whose only friend was a perfectly kept doll. When she moves to L.A., she takes up with a handsome filmmaker and then an alluring lesbian, but every connection she makes turns out deadly.

items.title: They Call It Myanmar: Lifting The Curtain (2012)
items.description: Shot clandestinely over a two year period, this film provides a rare look into the second most isolated country on the planet held in a stasis by a brutal military regime for almost a half century.

items.title: Miami Connection
items.description: Directed by 9th degree black belt philosopher/author/inspirational speaker Grandmaster Y.K. Kim, Miami Connection tells story of fearless synth rock band Dragon Sound as they embark on a roundhouse wreck-wave of crime-crushing justice in the streets.

items.title: My Dog: An Unconditional Love Story (2012)
items.description: Glenn Close, Richard Gere, Edie Falco, and other stars celebrate the bond with their canine companions in this uplifting documentary about our furry best friends.

items.title: Question One (2013)
items.description: On May 6, 2009, Maine became the first state to legislatively grant same-sex couples the right to marry. Seven months later, the decision was reversed. Question One chronicles the fierce and emotional battle that took place in Maine during that time.

items.title: Hot Coffee (2011)
items.description: Filmmaker Susan Saladoff directs this documentary that examines the case of Liebeck v. McDonald's Restaurants, the so-called "hot coffee lawsuit" in which a woman sued the fast-food giant after she spilled her coffee and burned herself.

items.title: Dark Tide
items.description: Kate accepts a lucrative opportunity to lead a thrill-seeking millionaire businessman on a shark dive in the most dangerous waters, outside the cage. PG-13

items.title: Amandla! (2003)
items.description: Interviews, archival footage, and filmed performances highlight the role of music in the South African struggle against apartheid.

items.title: Tamara
items.description: When Tamara's classmates play a practical joke that goes awry and results in her death, the once homely teenager comes back from the dead as a sexy seductress to exact revenge on her killers one by torturous one.

items.title: Vendetta
items.description: When his wife is killed, a detective goes to prison to seek vengeance. While inside, he discovers a secret that those in charge would kill to protect.

items.title: Fertile Ground
items.description: A woman is plagued by horrifying visions and haunted by the ghosts inhabiting her isolated new home.

items.title: Sorority Row
items.description: They're sisters to the bloody end! After a prank goes fatally wrong, party-hearty sorority girls hide the corpse. Months later, a mysterious killer won't let the past stay buried.

items.title: Soul Survivors
items.description: Following a horrible car accident, a beautiful college freshman finds herself trapped in a twilight world somewhere between life and death in this haunting supernatural thriller.

items.title: The Fruit Hunters
items.description: The Fruit Hunters travels across culture, history, and geography to show how intertwined we are with the fruits we eat.

items.title: The Woman Who Wasn't There
items.description: The Woman Who Wasn't There is a psychological thriller that goes inside the mind of history's most infamous 9/11 survivor.

items.title: Somewhere Between (2013)
items.description: Somewhere Between tells the intimate stories of four teenaged girls united by one thing: all four were adopted from China because they had birth parents who could not keep them, due to personal circumstances colliding with China's "One Child Policy."

items.title: My Trip to Al-Qaeda (2012)
items.description: My Trip to Al-Qaeda chronicles fundamentalist Islam's rise to power and explores Lawrence Wright's struggle to maintain his objectivity as a journalist writing about Islamic terror.

items.title: King Corn (2012)
items.description: Engrossing and eye-opening, King Corn is a fun and crusading journey into the digestive tract of our fast food nation where one ultra-industrial, pesticide-laden, heavily-subsidized commodity dominates the food pyramid from top to bottom, corn.

items.title: JFK: The Smoking Gun
items.description: Veteran Police Detective Colin McLaren spent four years on the forensic cold-case investigation of JFK's assassination. What he had, and other investigators did not, was modern technology and access to all the evidence, facts and eyewitness testimony.

items.title: Yes, Virginia
items.description: Based on a true story, this is a touching and uplifting holiday story about what it means to believe. In New York City, 1897, eight-year-old Virginia O'Hanlon has always loved Christmas until the day her classmates question the existence of Santa.

items.title: Bullhead (2014)
items.description: Nominated for Best Foreign Language Film at the 2012 Academy Awards, Michael R. Roskam's Bullhead is a harrowing tale of revenge, redemption and fate.

items.title: Three Kingdoms
items.description: Based on Romance of the Three Kingdoms by Luo Guangzhong. It ranks as one of China's four most important pieces of literature.

items.title: The Sword Identity
items.description: During the Ming Dynasty one man will request a competition when his weapon is rejected. After a series of fights he is determined to prove his sword is invincible

items.title: Stuck Between Stations
items.description: Former high school classmates reunite by chance during a chaotic party-filled evening.

items.title: All-Star Comedy Jam: Live From Dallas With Monique
items.description: Academy Award winner and one of the Original Queens of Comedy, Mo'Nique rules the stage as host of the 3rd installment in Shaquille O'Neal's All-Star Comedy Jam concert series.

items.title: Arctic Manhunt Hunt for the Mad Trapper (2009)
items.description: In 1931, a stranger appeared out of nowhere in the Canadian Arctic. Months later, the North's biggest manhunt was launched to find the elusive murderer and thief. The fugitive's unknown identity died with him, never to be discovered until now.

items.title: Texas Chainsaw Massacre 3D
items.description: A young woman inherits an isolated mansion from a distant relative, but an unspeakable horror awaits her in the mansion's dank cellars.

items.title: Mystical Volcano of Indonesia: Kawah Ijen (2014)
items.description: Kawah Ijen volcano, in East Java, Indonesia, is home to the largest acid crater lake on Earth. Photographer Olivier Grunewald and Vulcanologist Regis Etienne spend 30 nights in the crater to capture a unique and stunning volcanic event.

items.title: Life on Us: A Microscopic Safari (2015)
items.description: Just like planet Earth, our body is composed of fascinating landscapes, a scene of surprising wildlife. "Life On Us" offers a unique perspective, encountering the creatures that live, thrive, compete, feed, breed, are born or die on or in our bodies.

items.title: Shockwave: Surviving North America's Biggest Disaster (2010)
items.description: If you love a day at the beach, or if you live anywhere near the coast of California, Oregon, Washington or British Columbia, then brace yourself. The next big global earthquake could be your last.

items.title: The Gut: Our Second Brain (2014)
items.description: For a few years now, scientists have known about the existence of another brain within our bodies. This second brain, is none other than our stomach. The stomach's intelligence is a new avenue of research that is fascinating scientists the world over.

items.title: Everything and Nothing: The Amazing Science of Empty Space (2012)
items.description: Uncover the true size of everything and learn amazing science behind empty space. Part science, part philosophy, and part history, this film combines these elements into a gripping, spectacular narrative that is truly unforgettable.

items.title: Wishmaster
items.description: From executive producer Wes Craven comes this fantasy-horror cult classic that spawned three sequels. When a jewelry appraiser is given an ancient gem, she unwittingly unleashes an immortal spirit that grants humans wishes in exchange for their souls.

items.title: Wishmaster 2: Evil Never Dies (1999)
items.description: Evil has been summoned once again when the evil Djinn is awakened by a burglar named Morgana during a botched art heist. When the Djinn takes blame for the crime, he's sent to prison where he grants wishes to prisoners in return for their souls.

items.title: Trees Lounge
items.description: A man drifting through time desperately searches for some meaning to his life.

items.title: The Lucky Ones
items.description: A timely drama about life in America today, THE LUCKY ONES is a story of three soldiers on leave trying to make sense of their lives during an unexpected road trip across the United States.

items.title: The Flowers of War
items.description: An American attempts to save a group of women from marauding soldiers in 1937 Nanjing.

items.title: Suicide Kings
items.description: A group of youngsters kidnap a respected Mafia figure.

items.title: Shadow of the Vampire
items.description: During the filming of director Murnau's vampire movie, the cast and crew begin to disappear and suspect that the actor who plays the vampire may not be acting after all.

items.title: House of the Dead
items.description: A group of college students go to a rave on a mysterious island and find themselves stalked by killer zombies intending to feast on the flesh of the living.

items.title: Cyborg 2: Glass Shadow
items.description: In the year 2074 the PinWheel corporation creates cyborg Cash designed specifically to charm her way into a rival manufacturer's headquarters and then self-detonate. Things go awry when she starts to have feelings for a human, Colt 45.

items.title: Bug
items.description: A paranoid, unhinged war veteran who sees insects everywhere holes up with a lonely woman in a spooky Oklahoma motel room.

items.title: All Star Comedy Jam: Live From Atlanta (2013)
items.description: Shaquille ONeal presents todays most hilarious standup comedians LIVE from Atlanta.

items.title: Rock Jocks (2013)
items.description: A top secret band of overworked government employees spend their night shift fighting off boredom and a meddling bureaucrat hell-bent on shutting them down, while defending the world from an onslaught of asteroids.

items.title: Wild Bill
items.description: Out on parole after 8 years inside, Bil returns home to find his now 11 and 15-year old sons, Jimmy and Dean, abandoned by their mother and fending for themselves.

items.title: Twinkle Toes Lights Up New York
items.description: Twinkle Toes has been dreaming of the ultimate vacation, but when her dad is hired to direct a musical, Twinkle Toes is taken to Broadway instead! Now, with opening night coming, it's up to Twinkle Toes to turn her dad's show into a smash hit!

items.title: Elevate (2011)
items.description: Filmed over four years and across two continents, Elevate traces the extraordinary journeys of four exceptionally tall West African teenagers as they embark for US prep schools, where success can equal college and maybe even a shot at the NBA.

items.title: Patti Smith: Dream of Life
items.description: Patti Smith's music, poetry, and politics are fearless, funny, raw, and original. The film follows Patti Smith's punk-icon roots in the 70s through the trials of daily life and untimely deaths that have formed her life and art.

items.title: Money and Medicine (2012)
items.description: As rising health care costs threaten to bankrupt the country, Money and Medicine tackles the medical, ethical and financial challenges of containing runaway health care spending.

items.title: Remote Area Medical (2015)
items.description: Over three days in April 2012, Remote Area Medical, the pioneers of no-cost health care clinics, treated nearly 2000 patients on the infield of Bristol, Tennessee's massive NASCAR speedway.

items.title: Hell and Back Again (2014)
items.description: From his embed with US Marines Echo Company in Afghanistan, photojournalist and filmmaker Danfung Dennis reveals the devastating impact a Taliban machine-gun bullet has on the life of 25-year-old Sergeant Nathan Harris.

items.title: Following Sean (2006)
items.description: In Following Sean, filmmaker Ralph Arlyck tracks down Sean, the boy who had been the subject of his controversy-sparking 1969 documentary--to find out what he's like 30 years later.

items.title: Wishmaster 4: The Prophecy Fulfilled
items.description: The unspeakable evil of the soul-devouring djinn rises again. But now, as a host of new victims see their most nightmarish wishes come true, the world faces the ultimate demonic terror: an onslaught of multiple Djinns hell-bent on destroying everything!

items.title: Crips And Bloods: Made In America (2008)
items.description: In Made In America, renowned documentarian Stacy Peralta blends gripping archival footage and photos with in-depth interviews of current and former gang members, historians, and experts, documenting the emergence of the Bloods and the Crips.

items.title: Dean Slater: Resident Advisor
items.description: The boys battle viral video stigma, psychotic girlfriends, and hangovers on their way to creating a more analogue college experience.

items.title: Case 39 (2009)

items.title: Borderlands (2013)

items.title: Beyonce: Beyond the Glam (2013)

items.title: Archy: Built for Speed, Born to Ride (2012)
items.description: When Matt Archbold started surfing back in 1979 at age 11 the world had no idea that it was about to witness one of the most explosive surfers to ever set foot on a surfboard.

items.title: Some Thing Else (2014)
