items.title: Alien Mind Control: The UFO Enigma
items.description: This fascinating documentary offers an unprecedented look at a group of individuals who claim to have had life altering UFO encounters, and discovers the unique psychic abilities they unknowingly share.

items.title: Alien Contact: UFO Invaders
items.description: Hundreds of UFOs have crashed on Earth. Mankind has witnessed these crashes, communicated with the visitors, even left our planet with them once they are able to return to their worlds, but the most shocking revelation is the reason why they come.

items.title: Alien Crash Retrievals
items.description: Learn the shocking truth about Extraterrestrial beings on Planet Earth. World governments and military factions are not only aware of the Alien presence; they may be in communication with alien races.

items.title: 13 Times Evil
items.description: History is replete with psychotic killers with a horrific and utterly barbarous list of murders and slayings. Explore the darkness that haunts our souls and takes some over the precipice.

items.title: Why I'm Not On Facebook (2015)
items.description: One man's soul searching decision on whether or not he should join Facebook sets him off on an epic journey of self-discovery as he weighs the pros and cons of becoming a member of the world's largest social networking site.

items.title: Life in a Walk
items.description: Yogi Roth never wanted to say 'I wish I'd spent more time with my Dad.' After realizing he had not dealt with the emotion stemming from his father's battle with prostate cancer, Yogi invites his Dad on a walk along the Camino de Santiago.

items.title: Great Castles of Europe
items.description: Mankind has waged war against its own kind for millennia, developing weapons and devices of mass destruction in the continual quest for domination.

items.title: Fursonas
items.description: Approaching a community filled with so many rumors and misconceptions is no easy task. Director Dominic Rodriguez is not without his own biases, but instead of attempting to deny this fact, he faces it head on, unafraid to be shot down by his subjects.

items.title: Exorcist Chronicles (2013)
items.description: Demonic possessions are occurring at an alarming rate. The ultimate battle between good and evil commences with a perpetrator so ancient only the illuminated know of its existence.

items.title: End Times, California (2015)
items.description: The state of drought declared in California has persisted for years culminating in the state's driest year to date in 2015.

items.title: A Prison on Earth
items.description: In the shadows of other dimensions, there lies a nefarious force waging war upon humans for millennia from the space between spaces - a dark force that governs not just our thoughts and actions but our very souls.

items.title: Overfed and Undernourished
items.description: Overfed & Undernourished examines a global epidemic and our modern lifestyles through one boy's inspiring and personal journey to regain his health from the inside out.

items.title: Bunker of the Dead
items.description: In the picturesque Bavarian town of Oberammergau, two friends, Markus and Thomas, are using the instructions found in an old Jewish diary to gain access to a WW II underground military base.

items.title: All Out Dysfunktion
items.description: Futile aspirations collide for these D-level Hollywood Never-be's when sound reason succumbs to their infatuations with money, drugs, the red carpet, mainstream porn stardom, and getting into each other's pants.

items.title: Falsely Accused (2016)
items.description: SHELLY YATES desperately wants to find out who is responsible for the murders of her family members.

items.title: When Harry Tries to Marry (2011)
items.description: An Indian-American guy surprises his family when he announces his desire for an arranged marriage with an Indian woman, though his affection for a longtime American friend complicates his plan.

items.title: Holy Rollers
items.description: One of the largest blackjack teams in America is made up entirely of Christians. While they succeed at winning millions, how will they find a place for faith in card counting?

items.title: He's Way More Famous Than You (2013)
items.description: When an aspiring actress loses her support system in one fell swoop, she sets out with a stolen script, her brother, and his boyfriend to make a movie.

items.title: Ancient Alien Origins
items.description: Researchers discover that Aliens from another world assisted in the evolution of man and were the genesis of a very real bloodline that remains intact today.

items.title: The Killing
items.description: With fascinating detail, Stanley Kubrick lays bare the intricate inner-planning of a racetrack heist by a deadly mastermind (Sterling Hayden) and his crew. Co-stars Coleen Gray.

items.title: The Black Stallion
items.description: Teri Garr and Mickey Rooney star in this heartWarming Adventureture about a boy who forges a special friendship with a wild stallion after both are shipwrecked on a deserted island.

items.title: The Pit and the Pendulum (1961)
items.description: Vincent Price slowly goes crazy because he thinks his wife was buried alive (a plot between his wife and her lover to get his money). Now totally insane, he starts to murder.

items.title: Art School Confidential
items.description: A satirical look at the cult of celebrity in the story of a cop who goes undercover as an art student and gains critical acclaim for his work.

items.title: The Mechanik
items.description: Spetnaz veteran Nick Cherenko leaves Russia after his son and wife are killed in a gunfight by drug lord Aleksandr 'Sasha' Popov's mob men.

items.title: Redline (1998)
items.description: When a man is murdered in Moscow, experimental bionic research brings him back to life. He then sets out to find his murderers and money that was stolen during the crime.

items.title: Rats (2003)
items.description: The Brookdale Institute is a mysterious, hospital for the criminally insane. Brookdale has another, more lucrative facet; a safe harbor for the chronically drug-addicted rich and famous.

items.title: The Big Brass Ring
items.description: Blake Pellarin is on the campaign trail to become governor of the state of Missouri. While making a stop in St. Louis, a chance encounter brings his past back to haunt him. Will the truth ruin his chances for office or will he land the "Big Brass Ring"?

items.title: Flying Virus (2008)
items.description: A group of teenagers go on a excursion to the mountains. There, they are attacked by birds infected with a lethal virus. When the teens reach a nearby village, the haunting birds start passing their virus on to all the dwellers.

items.title: The Vans Warped Tour: No Room For Rockstars (2012)
items.description: With more than 300 hours of film shot during the 2010 tour, No Room For Rockstars documents the true stories of modern-era rock and roll from every possible angle.

items.title: Hoop Dreams
items.description: A film following the lives of two inner-city Chicago boys who struggle to become college basketball players on the road to going professional.

items.title: The Natural: The Best There Ever Was (2015)
items.description: Celebrating 30 years of The Natural directed by Academy Award Winning Director Barry Levinson and starred Academy Award Winners Robert Redford and Kim Basinger, featuring never before seen footage and exclusive interviews with original cast and crew.

items.title: On Angel's Wings
items.description: When the star soccer player is injured, Coach Carter plays the clumsy water girl. After a rocky start, she improves, but what her teammates and mom don't know is that she's not doing it alone.

items.title: Susie's Hope (2014)
items.description: Based on a true story, Susie's Hope portrays the inspirational relationship between a pit bull attack survivor and an abused pit bull-mix puppy as they learn to heal and forgive together.

items.title: Bed & Breakfast: Love is a Happy Accident
items.description: In this charming romantic comedy, Jake inherits a small bed and breakfast in California wine country. Problem is, so did sultry Brazilian Ana. Her life is complicated, his is worse.

items.title: The Insomniac (2016)
items.description: Believing he'll be robbed again, a burglary victim refuses to sleep until the thief is caught. Certain that the culprit is someone he knows, he grows increasingly unhinged as he scribbles accusations in his notepads.

items.title: Surf Party
items.description: JD is fresh out of high school and living it up in the sunny California. But, when his prized, custom surfboard from Mooney (Matthew Lillard) is stolen, he assembles a crew of stoner buddies to track down the thief.

items.title: Rock Story (2015)
items.description: Former teen pop-sensation Danielle Kelly, thought for dead by her manger arrives back on the scene. Only this time, handicapped in a wheelchair as an attorney to solve a family related murder.

items.title: Red Dirt Rising
items.description: Based on a story of love in the time of moonshine, as three of stock car racing's earliest heroes come of age, seeking escape from life's challenges on the track, shaping the future of their families and auto racing during the Fighting Forties.

items.title: Isle of Dogs (2014)
items.description: In this gritty crime thriller, a brutal London gangland boss discovers his new trophy-wife (Barbara Nedeljakova) is having an affair, hunts down her lover, issues a grim ultimatum, and a deadly game begins.

items.title: Identical (2012)
items.description: Despite the words of their father, when identical twins fall for the same woman, secrets are revealed, setting an irrevocable chain of events into motion. Now one of them has blood on his hands.

items.title: Fynbos (2012)
items.description: A real estate developer, on the brink of bankruptcy, travels with his wife to a lavish and remote property to close a prospective deal in a last ditch attempt to save his life as he knows it.

items.title: Hear Me Move (2016)
items.description: Muzi, the son of a famous street dancer tries to discover the truth about his father's tragic death 12 years prior. When he joins forces with his father's dance partner, he finds himself embroiled in a bitter rivalry that pushes him to his limit.

items.title: DisOrientation
items.description: An unapologetic, collegiate underachiever and his 15-year-old, brainiac roommate overcome their differences and team up to exact revenge on a posse of goons, who think they rule the school.

items.title: Beyond the Call of Duty
items.description: Five Special Ops, Alpha Squad, is set on one final recon mission that turns into an all out war for survival against a wave of undead experiments.

items.title: Aviator
items.description: Stranded aboard, an American pilot is forced to work with the Colombian drug cartel, to escape the country and tend to his ailing son.

items.title: American Bully (2012)
items.description: This gripping drama charts the evolution of a grisly hate crime when Brandon O'Leary, a teen seething with rage over terrorist attacks on Americans, gets kicked out of school and vents his fury by brutally attacking a helpless fellow student.

items.title: A Remarkable Life
items.description: Chelsea helps Leny overcome his life from a down-spin as his reality comes crashing down after discovering his wife in bed with another woman.

items.title: A Box for Rob (2016)
items.description: Rob is a troubled man whose world unravels when he is named a murder suspect. Haunted by a dark childhood secret, his life becomes a living nightmare. Could he be the killer after all?

items.title: The Palmer Supremacy
items.description: A genius, scientific entrepreneur, William Palmer, develops the IC-187 chip, a technology that would revolutionize the inner workings of the human brain. But with every great discovery comes risk.

items.title: Killers 2: The Beast
items.description: Trapped in a maximum security insane asylum, a girl must escape not only the psychological demons which inhabit her own mind, but also a band of killers determined to silence her forever.

items.title: War of the Worlds 2: The Next Wave
items.description: The aliens return to complete their plan of human domination, launching a second wave of attacks that threaten to destroy what is left of humanity

items.title: Transmorphers
items.description: Driven underground by alien robots, humanity's last hope for survival rests in a ragtag group of humans with a plan to destroy this mechanical horde once and for all.

items.title: Universal Soldiers
items.description: A government program to create genetically modified super soldiers goes awry when the unstable and unstoppable lab subjects excape from their maximum security holding cells.

items.title: The Surge
items.description: Four teenagers develop paranormal powers after channeling a mystical stone found deep in the woods. They go from outcasts to gods on campus, but soon learn that absolute power corrupts... With deadly consequences.

items.title: The Da Vinci Treasure
items.description: A thrill-seeking anthropologist must unravel the code locked within the works of Leonardo Da Vinci in his search for the greatest hidden treasure known to man. His hunt turns into a deadly chase around the world

items.title: The Apocalypse
items.description: When a Former Special Ops commando visits Pompeii, his family is trapped as Mt. Vesuvius erupts with massive force. While his family fights to survive, he enlists his former teammates in a daring operation beneath the ruins of Pompeii.

items.title: Sorority House Party
items.description: What happens when the coolest rock star in the world is held hostage by the hottest sorority babes on campus? The most outrageously rockin? seriously sexy Sorority House Party of all time!

items.title: Street Racer
items.description: After recovering from a tragic accident, a former street racer struggles to redeem himself and join the elite racing world.

items.title: Merlin and the War of the Dragons (2008)
items.description: An army of dragons invade the crippled English countryside and the apprentice wizard Merlin must confront the fire-breathing beasts.

items.title: Pirates of Treasure Island
items.description: An innkeeper's life of monotony suddenly changes when he comes into possession of a treasure map. Enlisting the help of Long John Silver and his band of cutthroat pirates, he sets off in search of the cursed Skeleton Island.

items.title: King of the Lost World (2005)
items.description: In this modern adaptation of Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's classic tale, a jetliner crashes into a land inhabited by mysterious creatures, including a giant ape.

items.title: Killers (1998)
items.description: The deal is simple. Buy the stolen drugs for almost nothing, sell them and make a killing. For Ray and the others, it?s the deal of their lives. For Heather, the rich girl, it?s a ride on the wild side.

items.title: I Am Omega (2007)
items.description: The lone survivor of a deadly plague is doomed to an eternal battle with the mutant creatures that now control the Earth.

items.title: Freakshow
items.description: When a gang of thieves, hiding out in a circus sideshow, decides to steal from the wealthy owner, there are horrific consequences!

items.title: Dragon (2006)
items.description: A princess must recruit the most brave and powerful swordsmen in the land with the sole purpose of vanquishing the dark wizard who terrorizes the kingdom with a giant, menacing dragon.

items.title: Death Valley: The Revenge of Bloody Bill
items.description: Rising from the dead as a demon from Hell, Bloody Bill preys on all who enter his ghost town. Now a group of college students must find a way to destroy the monster or be doomed to serve in his army of living dead.

items.title: AVH: Alien vs. Hunter
items.description: A galactic hunter chases the most dangerous alien creature in the universe to planet Earth, where humanity is caught between predator and prey.

items.title: Alien Abduction
items.description: Four friends lose consciousness when they are kidnapped by alien creatures. They awaken in a US Government facility for observation. That is when the nightmare begins.

items.title: 666: The Child (2006)
items.description: After a plane crash were a boy is the only survivor, a childless couple adopts him and soon discovers he is something very powerful, something very dark. This small boy is the Beast and with him he carries the Beginning of the End.

items.title: 30,000 Leagues Under the Sea
items.description: This modern retelling of the classic science-fiction tale, the charismatic sociopath Captain Nemo uses his high tech submarine to wreak vengeance on the surface world.

items.title: Assaulted - Civil Rights Under Fire (2013)
items.description: Dead Patriot Films presents Assaulted: Civil Rights Under Fire, a documentary that brings audiences to the center of the controversy over the issue that is dividing our nation gun control.

items.title: Plastic: The Real Sea Monster
items.description: Six million metric tons of plastic wind up in the world's ocean every year. Unlike other refuse, plastic can stay in the water forever without breaking down. How is this deadly killer affecting the world's oceans, and how will it affect humanity?

items.title: Species
items.description: She's beautiful, seductive, intelligent, and her charms could spell doom for the entire human race! Ben Kingsley, Forrest Whitaker, and Natasha Henstridge star in this adrenaline-charged sci-fi hit.

items.title: 2nd Serve (2013)
items.description: A former tennis pro (Josh Hopkins) forced to work at a public recreation center must regain his self-respect and lead his team of oddball amateurs to victory in a prestigious, annual tournament showdown.

items.title: Jane White is Sick and Twisted (2003)
items.description: This outrageous satire follows TV-obsessed Jane as she sets out to meet the tabloid talk show host she's convinced is her father.

items.title: P2
items.description: A woman who is the last to leave her office on Christmas Eve must rely on her wits to survive when she is trapped in a parking garage with a deranged security guard.

items.title: Film Crew: Hollywood After Dark
items.description: The Film Crew gives a commentary track to Walk the Angry Beach, aka Hollywood After Dark, featuring Rue McClanahan as a stripper.

items.title: Film Crew Killers From Space (2007)
items.description: Former Mystery Science Theater 3000 crew rip apart Killers from Space.

items.title: The Last Days of Frankie the Fly (1997)
items.description: Small-time hood Frankie the Fly teams with a porn filmmaker and porno actress to try to make a killing by running a high-risk scam of the big boss.

items.title: The Nature of Existence (2009)
items.description: In this uplifting, humorous, award-winning documentary, filmmaker Roger Nygard asks weighty questions of spiritual leaders, gurus, scientists, and a pizza chef, creating a witty study of the greatest mysteries of life.

items.title: The Flying Machine
items.description: Starring Heather Graham, during a performance of the 'Magic Piano,' Georgie and her kids are magically transported into an animated world.

items.title: Showrunners
items.description: Showrunners is the first ever feature length documentary film to explore the fascinating world of US television showrunners and the creative forces aligned around them.

items.title: Chely Wright: Wish Me Away (2012)
items.description: After a lifetime of hiding, Chely Wright became the first commercial country music singer to come out as gay, shattering cultural stereotypes within Nashville and within herself.

items.title: Alien Contact: Secret Societies
items.description: Thousands of years ago a special, genetically advanced race of beings came to Earth. They were seen as Gods by primitive man and worshipped. They set themselves apart.

items.title: Stephen King's Silver Bullet
items.description: Something is killing off townsfolk in Tarker's Mills. Something ingenious. Something remotely human. But the only person in town with courage to stop this lurking menace is a 13-year-old boy, confined to a wheelchair since birth.

items.title: Hellmouth
items.description: From the twisted mind of writer Tony Burgess comes a stunning, spectacular ode to classic horror and fantasy.

items.title: Red Corner
items.description: A savy entertainment lawyer awakes the morning after seducing a beautiful Chinese woman to find her dead and him accused of rape and murder.

items.title: Of Mice and Men
items.description: John Malkovich, Gary Sinise and Sherilyn Fenn shine in this contemporary remake of the beloved classic about a nomadic farm worker who looks after his dimwitted, gentle-giant friend.

items.title: Showgirls
items.description: Seduction, passion and power struggles unfold as the creators of Basic Instinct blow the lid off the seemingly glamorous world of Las Vegas showdancing in this controversial film that stars Elizabeth Berkley.

items.title: Sweet Smell of Success
items.description: A columnist and a press agent tear into the maelstrom of midtown Manhattan's night creatures in a sinister game that involves money, power and ultimately survival.

items.title: Man in the Moon
items.description: The heartwarming coming-of-age film set in the 1950s stars Reese Witherspoon as a 14-year-old girl who gets her first difficult lesson in love.

items.title: Moonstruck
items.description: In her Academy Award winning role, Cher, while waiting for her timid fiance to decide between her and his mother, falls in love with her fiance's estranged brother, a bakery worker with a love of opera and life.

items.title: Johnny Be Good (1988)
items.description: A comedy about a star high-school jock and how every major college in the United States attempts to recruit him and other promising football stars illegally by promising them free booze, willing cheerleaders, hard cash, lear jets and no homework.

items.title: Hackers
items.description: A neophyte hacker becomes the target of the FBI after he unknowingly taps into a high-tech embezzling scheme which could cause a horrific environmental disaster in this suspenseful drama.

items.title: Dark Blue
items.description: When the LAPD's Special Investigations Squad is assigned a quadruple homicide, veteran detective Eldon Perry takes the case. Known for his street tactics and a temper, he tutors rookie Bobby Keough in the realities of police intimidation and corruption.

items.title: A Shot in the Dark
items.description: Peter Sellers and Elke Sommer star in this successful sequel to The Pink Panther in which Inspector Clouseau tries to prove a beautiful parlor maid is innocent of killing her chauffer lover.

items.title: I Do (2013)
items.description: A gay Brit in New York loses his immigration status and risks losing his family and life in the U.S. so he marries his lesbian best friend to remain in the country.

items.title: Manny
items.description: World Champion. Congressman. Father. Manny Pacquiao fights any obstacle that comes his way. As his home country of 100 million people watches his every move, the question now is: what bridge is too far for Manny?

items.title: Bad Meat (2010)
items.description: Ordered to a delinquent camp by their exasperated parents, a group of wayward teens fall foul of a deadly virus that infects the guards and turns them into flesh-eating monsters!

items.title: Raven's Touch
items.description: Blaming herself for a tragic accident, Raven Michaels secludes herself at a remote family cabin. She wanders the woods on the verge of a breakdown, seeking peace in isolation.

items.title: The Big Gay Musical (2009)
items.description: Though musical numbers that feature scantily clad tap-dancing angels, a clever retelling of Genesis, creepy televangelists, and a camp that attempts to turn gay kids straight, everyone realizes that life gets better once they accept who they really are.

items.title: Being Evel
items.description: Academy Award-winning director Daniel Junge and producer Johnny Knoxville take a candid look at daredevil Evel Knievel, while reflecting on our voracious public appetite for heroes and spectacle.

items.title: Blood Out
items.description: In the vein of TRAINING DAY, STREET KINGS, and AMERICAN GANGSTER - Curtis Jackson, Val Kilmer, and Vinnie Jones star in a new action packed film filled with good cop/bad cop vengeance!

items.title: Child 44
items.description: Exiled secret police officer Leo Demidov (Tom Hardy) discovers a serial killer and suspects his superiors of covering it up. It is up to Leo to stop the killer before he strikes again.

items.title: Cooties
items.description: Teachers have the worst Monday ever when their students are turned into little killer savages in this horror comedy with unexpected laughs and unapologetic thrills.

items.title: Secretary
items.description: Before FIFTY SHADES OF GREY, there was this sexy and daring comedy starring James Spader and Maggie Gyllenhaal about a kinky affair between a lawyer and his secretary.

items.title: The Quiet Ones
items.description: Inspired by true events. A Professor and his students experiment on a girl who harbors unspeakable secrets, but the dark forces they uncover are more terrifying than ever expected.

items.title: Man on a Ledge
items.description: While a man teetering on a 21st-floor ledge diverts attention, the world's greatest diamond heist is underway. Hang on for thrills with Sam Worthington, Ed Harris and Elizabeth Banks.

items.title: Leprechaun 4: In Space
items.description: On a planet in a distant galaxy, a power hungry Leprechaun holds a beautiful alien princess hostage in order to marry her for her royal title and his beloved gold, he'll be able to rule the universe.

items.title: A Most Wanted Man
items.description: Phillip Seymour Hoffman stars in this action-thriller from spymaster John Le Carre. German and U.S. intelligence agencies race to uncover the identity of a mysterious man.

items.title: The Substitute
items.description: An ex-marine goes undercover as a substitute teacher and discovers a gang is terrorizing the high school. As lives are threatened, he sets out to clean up the crime-infested school.

items.title: Thanks For Sharing
items.description: An all-star cast in an unconventional romantic comedy about three obsessive characters in a support group.

items.title: 247°F
items.description: When four friends travel to a lakeside cabin for a carefree weekend, the fun turns into a nightmare when three of them end up locked in a hot sauna.

items.title: Fort Tilden
items.description: A comedy about Allie and Harper and their needlessly difficult journey to the beach.

items.title: Bandits
items.description: The suave Joe and his hypochondriac partner Terry have escaped from prison. Cutting a swath from Oregon through California, these fugitives rob banks in order to finance their scheme for a new life south of the Border.

items.title: Barbershop
items.description: Calvin, who inherited a struggling barbershop, views the shop as nothing but a burden and waste of his time. After selling the shop to a local loan shark, Calvin slowly begins to see his father's vision and legacy .

items.title: The Amityville Horror (1979)
items.description: Supposed true story about the Lutzm family whose dream house turns into a nightmare. The unsuspecting new tenants of a house whose previous occupants had been murdered in their sleep.

items.title: The Great Train Robbery
items.description: Sean Connery, Donald Sutherland and Lesley-Anne Down star in this true-life action thriller, based on director/screenwriter Michael Crichton's best-selling novel, about a daring gold heist that shocked Victorian society.

items.title: Once Bitten
items.description: A centuries-old vampiress comes to Los Angeles and stalks male virgins. She needs their blood to retain her youth and beauty. Her targets are left with an appetite for raw hamburgers and a tendency to sleep during the day so as to avoid sunlight.

items.title: Death at a Funeral
items.description: When Daniel's father dies, it is up to him to arrange the funeral. On this painful morning, Daniel prepares to welcome his father's friends and relatives. But preserving the dignity inherent in such circumstances will be a hard task.

items.title: Colors
items.description: As members of the Los Angeles Police Department's elite anti-gang unit, a veteran cop and his new partner are called in to assist with the crackdown against the mounting gang violence in the barrios and slums of East Los Angeles.

items.title: A Fish Called Wanda (1988)
items.description: Kevin Kline won the Best Supporting Actor Oscar for his role in this wildly popular comedy about an intricate diamond heist that's peppered with the comical antics of Jamie Lee Curtis and John Cleese.

items.title: Navy SEALs
items.description: When Middle-Eastern terrorists acquire some American stinger missiles, it's up to the U.S. Navy's elite commando unit, the Navy SEALS, to Ward off their challenge and blow them up.

items.title: Mystery Team
items.description: They were kid detectives. Now they're 18 and still solving child crimes. But when The Mystery Team is challenged to crack a murder case, they see an opportunity to finally prove themselves as real detectives once and for all.

items.title: The Mechanic
items.description: In a role that powered him to stardom, Charles Bronson is an underworld executioner who turns murder into an art form in this ultimate crime chiller.

items.title: Fiddler on the Roof
items.description: Tevye the Milkman, a Jewish peasant in pre-Revolutionary Russia trying to support his family and maintain his Jewish tradition under a Czar that would like to run his people out of town.

items.title: Return to Me
items.description: A man who falls in love with the woman who received his wife's heart must decide which woman it is who holds his heart.

items.title: The Town That Dreaded Sundown
items.description: 65 years after a masked serial killer terrorized the small town of Texarkana, the "moonlight murders" begin again. A lonely high school girl, with dark secrets of her own, may be the key to catching him.

items.title: Theory of Obscurity: A Film About The Residents
items.description: The story of the iconic renegade cult music and art collective known as The Residents who have achieved levels of fame most groups can only dream of, yet no one knows who they are.

items.title: The Mirror
items.description: Footage recovered by police shows what happened to three friends that bought an allegedly haunted mirror on eBay.

items.title: Still
items.description: After facing a devasting loss,To, finds himself embroiled in a violent feud with a dangerous teenage gang.

items.title: Broken
items.description: 11 year-old Skunk's innocence begins to vanish as her home, neighborhood and school all become treacherous environments where the happy certainties of childhood give way to fear-filled doubt.

items.title: Famous Nathan
items.description: Famous Nathan is the insider documentary about Nathan's Famous, the iconic Coney Island hot dog stand founded in 1916, told through exclusive clips, family archives and extensive interviews with dedicated friends and employees.

items.title: Arcadia
items.description: Tom (John Hawkes) crams his three kids into a station wagon for the 3,000 mile journey from New England to California. His mood shifts as often as the landscapes zip by, and the kids feel their mother's presence receding with every mile.

items.title: Ghost Town (2008)
items.description: A spirited romantic comedy, Ghost Town is the story of Bertram Pincus, a cranky Manhattan dentist who develops the unwelcome ability to see dead people.

items.title: The Eye
items.description: A blind girl receives a cornea transplant so that she is able to see again. However, she gets more than she bargains for when she realizes she can see disturbing ghosts.

items.title: Rollerball
items.description: James Caan stars as a rollerball champ in this fast-hitting, action- packed glimpse of a future where a brutal, no-holds-barred sport takes the place of war, and murder is just part of the game.

items.title: They Call Me Mister Tibbs!
items.description: Sidney Poitier, as Detective Virgil Tibbs, battles another puzzling murder in San Francisco in this exciting sequel with compelling performances from Martin Landau and Barbara McNair and music by Quincy Jones.

items.title: The Russia House
items.description: From the pen of master spy novelist John LeCarre comes this riveting tale in which a British publisher (Sean Connery) and a beautiful Russian editor (Michele Pfeiffer) are sucked into the deadly world of espionage.

items.title: The Last House on the Left
items.description: Two girls are tortured and left to die after they become captives of four prison escapees. The merciless criminals end up in the house of one of the girls and the mother tortures and kills them.

items.title: Some Like It Hot
items.description: This hysterical comedy from director Billy Wilder finds Tony Curtis and Jack Lemmon masquerading as women in order to elude irate Chicago mobsters while befriending a beautiful singer (Marilyn Monroe).

items.title: Saved!
items.description: Good girl Mary (Jena Malone) can't believe it when she gets pregnant by her newly-gay boyfriend. She also can't believe the actions of her popular, relentlessly devout best friend, Hilary Faye (Mandy Moore).

items.title: No Way Out
items.description: A morally upright naval hero accepts a position with the Secretary of Defense and his somewhat overzealous assistant. Things become a bit sticky when the Secretary of Defense becomes involved in the murder of a beautiful Washington, D.C. party girl.

items.title: Igby Goes Down
items.description: Igby Slocumb, a rebellious and sarcastic seventeen-year-old boy, is at war with the stifling world of "old money" privilege he was born into. Igby figures there must be a better life out there -- and sets about finding it.

items.title: Hollywood Shuffle
items.description: In the style of KENTUCKY FRIED MOVIE, writer-director Robert Townsend lampoons Hollywood's perception of blacks--and racial stereotypes in general.

items.title: F/X 2
items.description: Movie special-effects expert Rollie Tyler gets himself into trouble again when he agrees to help a police officer catch a serial killer. With the help of an ex-cop pal and some of his own movie magic, Tyler outwits the bad guys.

items.title: Bowling for Columbine
items.description: Michael Moore's "Bowling For Columbine" takes a somewhat humorous and oft-times serious look at firearms abuse in the U.S. Moore sets out to discover why Americans are so obsessed with their guns, which time and time again lead to violence.

items.title: Beauty Shop (2005)
items.description: Gina is a long way from the Barbershop - she's moved from Chicago to Atlanta and buys a rundown salon and inherits a motley group of stylists and a colorful clientele. It's a rocky road to fulfilling her dreams, but you can't keep a good woman down!

items.title: Barbershop 2: Back in Business (2004)
items.description: The Barbershop is threatened by the arrival of a hip, well-financed chain barbershop that's about to open next door.

items.title: Penelope
items.description: She's young, she's rich, she's available - too bad she has a pig's nose. Christina Ricci and James McAvoy team in a modern fairy tale about finding perfect love, imperfections and all.

items.title: The Hurt Locker
items.description: Jeremy Renner portrays the leader of a U.S. bomb-defusing squad in Iraq in this fierce tale of war. The film won 6 Oscars, including the 2009 Best Picture and Best Director (Kathryn Bigelow).

items.title: Salvador
items.description: Compelling drama based on the real experinces of journalist Richard Boyle in strife-ridden El Salvador in 1980-81.

items.title: Diggstown
items.description: Highlighted by suspenseful boxing sequences, this witty film casts James Woods, Bruce Dern and Louis Gossett, Jr. as offbeat characters who live for sparring, betting and swindling.

items.title: Stand Up Guys
items.description: Oscar winners Al Pacino, Christopher Walken, and Alan Arkin star in this action-comedy about retired gangsters who reunite for one last epic night.

items.title: Silent Night
items.description: A small-town sheriff (Malcolm McDowell) and his deputy (Jaime King) search for a killer Santa on Christmas Eve. A loose remake of the controversial cult-classic, SILENT NIGHT, DEADLY NIGHT.

items.title: Things You Can Tell Just By Looking At Her
items.description: A story comprised of five interweaving vignettes that focus on a particular group of women whose lives -- over the course of a few days -- become entangled, eroded, enriched and ultimately changed forever.

items.title: Thief
items.description: Michael Mann directs this stylishly photographed action-packed drama that stars James Caan as a master safe cracker who is planning his last heist for the sake of a woman (Tuesday Weld).

items.title: Walking Tall (2004)
items.description: Chris Vaughn, a retired soldier who returns to his hometown only to discover the place he grew up is now overrun with crime, drugs and violence. Enlisting the help of his old pal, Chris gets elected Sheriff and fights to clean up his hometown.

items.title: The Wedding Banquet
items.description: A Chinese Yuppie living in New York who decides that a marriage of convenience is the perfect way to prevent his parents back in Taiwan from discovering he is gay. But his plan backfires when his parents insist on coming to New York for the wedding.

items.title: The Dark Half
items.description: A writer undergoes an operation that reveals a twin in his brain. He begins a double writing life, using a pseudonym for his disreputable best-sellers. When the pseudonym discovers he is to be eradicated, he goes on a murderous rampage.

items.title: Stargate: The Ark of Truth
items.description: When the SG-1 crew discovers that a final assault on Earth is in the works and a double-agent is scheming among them, their mission takes on a new meaning as they travel to the Ori's home galaxy to overtake their arch enemy before it's too late.

items.title: Stanley & Iris
items.description: Jane Fonda and Robert De Niro star in a touching story of two people who escape their own private prisons -- he can't read, she's still grieving for her dead husband -- to explore a tender relationship.

items.title: Soul Plane
items.description: After a humiliating experience on an airplane, Nashawn sues the airline and is awarded a huge settlement. Determined to make good with the money, Nashawn creates the full service airline of his dreams, complete with sexy stewardesses & funky music.

items.title: Something Wild
items.description: A conservative executive accepts a ride with a wild, eccentric woman, who takes him on an outrageous odyssey that turns both their worlds upside down.

items.title: Robocop 3
items.description: In this second sequel to the 1987 hit, RoboCop leaves the force and joins the rebellion to battle the evil business corporation OCP, which uses a police-like group to remove the homeless people who populate the site of a future upscale development.

items.title: Sleepaway Camp II: Unhappy Campers
items.description: The grisly murders that terrorized Camp Arawak have become favorite ghost stories around Camp Rolling Hills six years later. As each of the campers learn the secrets about the murders, their carefree days at summer camp come to an end.

items.title: Robocop
items.description: Detroit in the near future. A cop who dies in the line of duty is transformed into a crime-fighting cyborg by the corporation which now runs the police department. The only hitch: this "perfect" cop still seeks revenge on the creeps who mutilated him.

items.title: Robocop 2
items.description: This first sequel pits Robocop against a gang of drug dealers and the title creature--a supposedly improved version of himself that has gone berserk.

items.title: Richard III
items.description: This cinematic triumph stars Ian McKellen as the ruthless younger brother of the newly crowned Kind Edward who will stop at nothing to claim the throne for himself.

items.title: Original Sin
items.description: A thriller about the dangerous and sometimes lethal power of love and passion. Luis and Julia are bound together by fierce love and desire. Luis and Julia adventure takes them across the landscape of Cuba, into obsession, eroticism and perhaps murder

items.title: Mystic Pizza
items.description: The coming-of-age of three best friends who work at a pizzeria in the seaside town of Mystic, Connecticut.

items.title: Married to the Mob
items.description: A mobster's wife hates her lifestyle, but gets a chance to change it when her husband is killed--if the Long Island mob and the FBI let her.

items.title: Manhattan
items.description: Woody Allen, Diane Keaton, Meryl Streep and Mariel Hemingway star in Woody Allen's extraordinary and funny film that explores the embattled life and loves of a successful New York comedy writer.

items.title: Henry V
items.description: A young and uncertain monarch, King Henry defeats the French, but sadly learns that victory takes its toll in bloodshed.

items.title: Ghost World
items.description: The story of neo-cool Enid and Rebecca who, faced with graduation from high school take a hard look at the world they wryly observe. When Rebecca focuses her attention on mutual romantic fixation Josh, the girls friendship is forever changed.

items.title: Flesh + Blood
items.description: Set in medieval Europe, FLESH + BLOOD follows the lives of two men--, a mercenary soldier and the son of a feudal lord--and their love for the same woman.

items.title: Clifford
items.description: A mischievous and obnoxious 10-year-old boy makes life pure hell for his bachelor uncle while his parents are in Hawaii.

items.title: Feast of Love
items.description: A meditation on love and its various incarnations, set within a community of friends in Oregon and is described as an exploration of the magical, mysterious and sometimes painful incarnations of love.

items.title: Blame It On Rio
items.description: While vacationing in Rio, a befuddled older fellow finds himself involved in a comedic affair with the teenage daughter of his best friend.

items.title: Baby Boom
items.description: J.C. has inherited a baby girl. An adoption falls through and the child becomes very attached to J.C., who keeps the baby. The child's mischief leads to J.C. losing her job and her boyfriend, but lead her to invent an applesauce recipe for children.

items.title: 8 Heads in a Duffel Bag
items.description: All gangster Tommy Spinelli wants to do is deliver his carry-on duffel bag to his boss. Unfortunately, the bag is switched with a Mexican-bound medical student...who has no idea that the bag contains the severed heads of eight Los Angeles gangsters!

items.title: Mississippi Burning
items.description: The summer of 1964... Two FBI agents--one a tight-jawed, by-the-book type, the other an experienced Southern lawman who knows how to handle people--head the government's investigation into the disappearance of three civil rights activists in Mississippi.

items.title: The Dog (2013)
items.description: An intimate portrait of John Wojtowicz, the inspiration behind Al Pacino's character in Sidney Lumet's Oscar Nominated Dog Day Afternoon.

items.title: The Big Picture
items.description: The Big Picture: Rethinking Dyslexia provides personal and uplifting accounts of the dyslexic experience from children, experts and iconic leaders, such as Sir Richard Branson and financier Charles Schwab.

items.title: Nick Cave's 20,000 Days on Earth
items.description: An inventive, lyrical ode to creativity featuring musician and cultural icon Nick Cave.

items.title: A Turtle's Tale: Sammy's Adventures
items.description: Dive into adventure with Sammy the sea turtle as he swims the ocean searching for the love of his life, Shelly. Based on the course of a sea turtle's life, this story of Sammy's breathtaking journey is a thrilling voyage the whole family will love!

items.title: Olympic Pride, American Prejudice
items.description: In 1936, 18 African American athletes, dubbed the "black auxillary" by Hitler, participated in the Berlin Olympic Games, defying Nazi Aryan Supremacy and Jim Crow Racism, history forgot all except one. This is the story of the other 17.

items.title: Wedding Palace
items.description: After being abandoned at the altar, Jason courts the girl of his dreams in cyberspace. When she arrives in LA for their wedding, she turns out to be completely different than expected.

items.title: The Believers
items.description: March 1989: two respected chemists from the University of Utah stand in front of a wall of reporters. Flashbulbs pop as they announce they have solved the world's energy problems using seawater, batteries and a mysterious glass contraption.

items.title: Dying Laughing
items.description: Featuring the world's greatest stand-up comedians, DYING LAUGHING is a candid and heartfelt look inside the agony and ecstasy of making people laugh for a living.

items.title: 2 Jennifer
items.description: Two filmmakers attempt to make the perfect sequel of a hit cult film, but a dark secret threatens the lives of everyone involved.

items.title: The Motel
items.description: Puberty sucks, and nobody knows it better than 13-year-old Ernest. As he watches guests come and go, Ernest finds himself forever stuck at his family's hourly-rate motel and longing for the girl of his dreams, 15-year-old Christine.

items.title: High Tension
items.description: Hoping to prepare for their college exams in peace, two best friends spend a weekend in the country. But in the dead of night, a stranger knocks and with the first swing of his knife, the girls' quiet weekend turns into an endless night of horror.

items.title: Short Term 12
items.description: Short Term 12 follows Grace (Brie Larson), a twenty-something staff member at a foster care facility as she reckons with caring for the teens in her charge and her own past. This lovingly realized film finds truth and humor in unexpected places.

items.title: The Horde
items.description: Ex-Navy SEAL John Crenshaw accompanies his fiance and her students on a photo trip deep into the woods. A fun trip turns to horror as they are besieged by a horde of mutated humans. Things worsen and Crenshaw is their only hope to survive.

items.title: The Hammer
items.description: On day three of the toughest race in the world, rookie cyclist, Jason The Hammer Lane, gets run over by a car. Feuding with his crew and the documentarians following him, he must fight against all odds to win The Race Across America.

items.title: The Business of Amateurs
items.description: The NCAA was founded on the worthy principals of protecting student athletes. The Business of Amateurs tells the story of the NCAA through the lens of former student athletes, many whose futures were compromised by the institution.

items.title: A Gamer's Life (2016)
items.description: Gaming can be a fun hobby, but for some it can be a way of living. Follow this story about professional gamers as well as a few amateurs trying to reach that goal.

items.title: Friends Effing Friends Effing Friends
items.description: A post-modern romantic comedy about sex amongst friends, missed opportunities, unrequited love and how the grass always appears to be greener on the other side...

items.title: Alaska: Spirit of the Wild
items.description: Witness a poetic story of survival in the harsh conditions of Alaska.

items.title: Ancient Angkor
items.description: Join us as we venture through the jungles of Cambodia to bring face to face with the cryptic mysteries of the temples of Angkor Wat.

items.title: Amazing Journeys
items.description: Experience the world's greatest animal migrations from zebras in East Africa, to millions of red crabs on Christmas Island, to gray whales in Mexico's beautiful lagoons and monarch butterflies in the Mexican highlands.

items.title: Antarctica
items.description: For the first time in history the mysterious icy expanse of the highest, driest and coldest continent has been captured in the giant screen format. Experience the life and drama of Antarctica like never before.

items.title: Amazon
items.description: Follow the breathtaking Amazon River from its source in the high Andes through the dense rain forest, and journey with two "medicine men" on a quest for new miracles.

items.title: Africa: The Serengeti
items.description: Chronicles a spectacle that few humans have ever witnessed, the Great Migration, taking viewers on a journey with over 1.5 million animals as they travel more than 500 miles across the Serengeti plains in Tanzania and Kenya.

items.title: Adventures in Animation
items.description: Adventures in Animation introduces the "stars" of tomorrow, by taking viewers on a journey through the world of computer-generated virtual actors.

items.title: Narco Cultura (2014)
items.description: Narco Cultura (Spanish, English subtitles) takes viewers behind the scenes of narcocorridos, the most explosive and violent music subculture in America.

items.title: Wonders of the Arctic
items.description: Our ongoing quest to explore and come to terms with the Arctic is presented in the context of the crucial role that ice plays in the north. It is the underpinning of the ecosystem, the foundation upon which the animals and plants of the north depend.

items.title: The Ultimate Wave Tahiti
items.description: The Ultimate Wave follows eleven-time World Champion surfer Kelly Slater and Tahitian surfer Raimana Van Bastolear as they explore the nature of waves and hunt for the ultimate wave-riding experience at the famed Pacific surf site of Teahupoo, Tahiti.

items.title: Wild Ocean
items.description: Plunge into an underwater feeding frenzy, an epic struggle for survival where whales, sharks, dolphins, seals, gannets and billions of fish collide with mankind during one of nature's greatest migration spectacles.

items.title: Welcome to the Cave of Wonders (2015)
items.description: A visual documentary that strives to show a glimpse into one of the most beautiful creations on earth from its unfathomable beginning millions of years ago to what it has become today.

items.title: Volcanoes of the Deep Sea
items.description: Plunge into the ocean 12,000 feet deep for an unprecedented experience of this vast and little-explored dimension of our planet. The film follows a team of scientists as they dive to research mysterious hydrothermal vents on the mid-ocean ridge.

items.title: Rocky Mountain Express
items.description: Rocky Mountain Express propels audiences on a steam train journey through the breathtaking vistas of the Canadian Rockies and relates the epic adventure of building the nation's first transcontinental railway.

items.title: Mysteries of the Great Lakes
items.description: Through several interlocking stories, Mysteries of the Great Lakes will take you on a journey through the greatest lake system in the world, and showcase the amazing geography, ecology, science, and history of the region.

items.title: Mystery of the Nile
items.description: On Christmas day of 2003, Pasquale Scaturro and a team of explorers set out on an epic quest to become the first to complete a full descent of the world's greatest river, the Blue Nile and the Nile, from source to sea.

items.title: Hurricane on the Bayou
items.description: Hurricane on the Bayou takes viewers on a breathtaking tour of one of the most vibrant places in America, the Louisiana bayou and the city of New Orleans, a place overflowing with life, music and natural beauty.

items.title: Greece: Secrets of the Past
items.description: Greece: Secrets of the Past features the beauty and grandeur of an ancient civilization. The birthplace of democracy comes alive through an exciting archaeological adventure.

items.title: Dolphins
items.description: Examines the lives of dolphins in beautiful tropical locales, their remarkable intelligence, and their relationships with some unique humans who are close to them.

items.title: Flight of the Aquanaut
items.description: Flight of the Aquanaut is set against startling undersea vistas and tells a gripping tale of a diver's voyage into danger. Equipped with a self-propelled, one-atmosphere "hard suit," the aquanaut sweeps viewers along on a dramatic science adventure.

items.title: Fighter Pilot: Operation Red Flag
items.description: At Red Flag, the international training exercise for air forces of allied countries, many of the world's best pilots meet for the most challenging flying of their careers.

items.title: Coral Reef Adventure
items.description: Coral Reef Adventure follows the real-life expedition of ocean explorers and underwater filmmakers Howard and Michele Hall. The Halls guide us to the islands and sun-drenched waters of the South Pacific to document the health and beauty of coral reefs.

items.title: Australia: Land Beyond Time
items.description: Stunning inside look at a land more like another planet than another country. Includes a rare natural event that happens only once every hundred years: the formation of a giant inland ocean out of nowhere in the middle of the harshest desert outback.

items.title: The Living Sea
items.description: From the tropical waters of Palau in the South Pacific, to the barreling waves of Oahu's North Shore and Nova Scotia's major tidal swings, The Living Sea celebrates the beauty, power and importance of the ocean.

items.title: Super Speedway (1997)
items.description: The film catapults audiences into the heart of world championship auto racing action at mind-bending speeds in excess of 230 miles per hour. An inside look through the eyes of real-life racing legends Mario & Michael Andretti.

items.title: The Last Reef
items.description: The Last Reef is an uplifting, inspirational experience capturing one of nature's more vibrant and diverse wonderlands. These biodiversity hot spots are as vital to our lives as the rainforests.

items.title: Van Gogh: Brush with Genius
items.description: Van Gogh leads viewers on a journey through the surprisingly short 9-year period of the artist's career during which he painted more than 900 paintings.

items.title: Kilimanjaro: To the Roof of Africa
items.description: Join a band of trekkers as they journey through rugged terrain and extreme conditions to look out from Africa's highest point in David Breashears' mountain adventure, Kilimanjaro: To the Roof of Africa.

items.title: Space Junk
items.description: After 50 years of launching our dreams into space, we're left with a troubling legacy: a growing ring of orbiting debris that casts a shadow over the future of space exploration.

items.title: Mummies: Secrets of the Pharaohs
items.description: Journey to the royal tombs of Egypt and explore the history of ancient Egyptian society as told through the mummies of the past. The film follows explorers and scientists as they piece together the archeological and genetic clues of Egyptian mummies.

items.title: Search for the Great Sharks
items.description: From the coast of California to the remote reaches of South and Western Australia, this film pursues blue sharks, whale sharks, and the notorious great white to allow viewers an up-close experience.

items.title: Angry Kelly
items.description: Tanya is upset about her life when a coworker tells her a story about a former employee, Kelly Cage. Kelly Cage was a woman in free fall; a glumly average thirty-something desperately seeking an escape from her horrible life.

items.title: How To Love
items.description: How To Love tells a story about a man named Anthony who loses his wife Rachel, to a tragic illness and finds it hard to move on. Although Anthony is now single, he struggles with how to build a new relationship with a beautiful woman named Tiffany.

items.title: Truth Unspoken
items.description: Jay and Tracy are a couple at odds with one another. Jay had all intentions of proposing to Tracy until he learned about her infidelity. Tracy isn't the only one with a secret, Jay has one too.

items.title: Humanity's End
items.description: In the future humans will become extinct and hybrid races will begin to take over the universe. The year is 2820: An ancient race of aliens, known as the Nephilim, have systematically hunted down and destroyed every human in the galaxy.

items.title: Girls Like Us
items.description: Keisha is intimately involved in two relationships, one with a wonderful man and the other is a secret affair with a woman.

items.title: Endless Summer
items.description: Keith has spent his whole life dreaming about Alicia. On his last day in town he tries desperately to be noticed by her, but his plans get foiled by his embarrassing grandmother, bullying sister, demanding father, and Alicia's 'player' boyfriend.

items.title: Enter the Dominion
items.description: Media giant Jonathan Zander is known for his take no prisoners business attitude. Under suspicion, Zander must find a new, trustworthy person for his organization.

items.title: Yesterday Is Still Gone
items.description: Over the years, three friends have worked hard to conceal past secrets, hatred, and deceit. Using their families and friends to distract them from the pain will only last so long.

items.title: Why She Cries
items.description: Sisters are trying to patch up their relationship whilst one is keeping a dark secret from the other.

items.title: Watch Phoenix Rise
items.description: Phoenix, a young girl from humble beginnings is destined to be just another pretty face until she becomes a fashion model. She soon realizes that the industry is full of users and abusers, so she starts a modeling agency with her best friend Angel.

items.title: Tryst
items.description: A sexually-charged thriller about Franklin and Bridget, a married couple in trouble.

items.title: Married Men and Single Women
items.description: When three married men decide to step out on their marriages they get more than they bargained for. As each settle into lustful and emotional affairs with their mistresses, they soon find that infidelity has devastating consequences.

items.title: Love in Tokyo
items.description: Tom is an American who moves to Tokyo on what he thinks is to be a temporary situation. He struggles to fit into the Japanese culture and hides behind the Internet. He meets Saki, a free-spirited Japanese woman who changes the way he views the world.

items.title: Basketball 316
items.description: When you're a child, you speak as a child, think as a child and reason as a child... when you become a man you put away childish things. The question of the day is... "How many shots does a man need to get it right, or does he ever get it right?"

items.title: Bachelorette's Degree
items.description: Dennie is a publicist for a national television personality. Jasmine has just finished law school and Kerra Carter is a seasoned middle school teacher. Join them on their hilarious, heart-touching journey.

items.title: A Troubled Mind
items.description: Tragic times occur in young Richard's life when he witnesses a murder committed by his father. The good times he's known change dramatically as family matters escalate. An awakening follows him as he matures and changes for the best - or for the worst?

items.title: 81 Days
items.description: 81 DAYS is based on true life social media cheating events that sadly happens to many of us, each and every day.

items.title: #LoveSwag
items.description: Bronson, a legendary-mogul, is able to bed women at will. Will he have to run-out on the only woman eager to stay by his side and nurse him back to health?

items.title: 20 Year Old Virgins (2011)
items.description: A coming-of-age story about two dim witted 20-year-old roommates, Gene & Eugene, and their quest to lose their virginity. Will their persistence pay off or lead them back to the drawing board?

items.title: Taboo
items.description: In the wake of a tragic emotional event, Angie Dobson is lead to do the unthinkable.

items.title: Sunday School
items.description: Rachel, the new girl in town, is urged to attend Sunday School, but when she agrees she gets more than she bargained for.

items.title: Sunday Morning Rapture
items.description: Riley and Katrina Kilgore are a wealthy married couple bound together by love. All the others fatefully come to discover that they just weren't ready to face the rapture.

items.title: Subspiral
items.description: Subspiral is a dark and gritty urban tale of a young man who tries to avoid following the path of his wayward brother. Seeking a better life for his two children, Tru lands a 9 to 5 where he meets Nadine.

items.title: Sons of the City
items.description: Sons of the City tells the story of Joe Young, an inner city college student with a bright future thrown into a war he does not want to fight yet cannot find the courage to leave.

items.title: Running on Empty Dreams
items.description: Sydney has played the part of a devoted wife to her husband for years, but her world is shattered when she meets Jane and is instantly attracted to her. Sydney is faced with a choice between the forbidden love and the undying love of her husband.

items.title: Robbin' in Da Hood
items.description: Two unsuspecting and rather inexperienced crews plan to rob the same wealthy drug dealer. As luck would have it the two crews plan their robberies for the very same day, and consequently collide at the scene of the robbery.

items.title: Nothing Without God
items.description: This story is a true tale of a young man accepted to college and struggling to achieve against heavy odds.

items.title: Nocturnal Agony
items.description: A highly successful woman with a loving family has her perfect world turned upside down when the hidden secrets from her past suddenly resurfaces.

items.title: No Body Found
items.description: Young adults are missing in Orlando. Gone, vanished, just as they embark on their lives with all their hopes and dreams. The latest to disappear is Todd Blackridge, the only son of a wealthy land developer.

items.title: Mississippi Shakedown
items.description: Business deals in Mississippi are conducted through gun toting, double crossing strippers, who will do anything for money. Sip,(Mando Allen), a born hustler, leaves remains of those who cross The Sip Boyz.

items.title: Mexican Sunrise
items.description: MEXICAN SUNRISE is a gripping thriller that follows five friends on a south-of-the-border bachelor party. It turns out that Derek owes him some money so Paco decides to hold the bachelor hostage while he finds money to pay his debt.

items.title: Life 101: Angel's Secret
items.description: Young, beautiful, and naive Angel soon realizes that sometimes the most dangerous place to be is in the bed of a lover. After one night with her boyfriend Angel is quickly caught in a whirlwind of uncontrollable events and unforeseeable consequences.

items.title: Incomplete
items.description: Incomplete is a captivating story of one woman's longing to complete her family through love and desire but unearths an elusive weave of deception.

items.title: The States
items.description: Juice (Jah) is an ambitious Belizean immigrant, who flees to the US. After committing a crime in his country. After a string of unfortunate events and violent acts, Juice finally realizes what is most important in life and in The States.

items.title: The Shop
items.description: The Shop is an urban drama about two young men, Shawn and Robbie. While running an auto repair shop, Shawn inherits his uncles' '66 Mustang and finds millions of dollars-worth of diamonds stashed in the car.

items.title: The Lawless
items.description: Two undercover cops are compromised and now are faced with a choice; kill or watch their loved ones be killed. Taking on the personas of cold blooded murderers these two cops prove that there is evil inside of everyone.

items.title: Reunited
items.description: Angel Adams is independent, beautiful and successful and has everything a woman wants, except a man. Could that change when her high school crush returns to town?

items.title: Queen Pin
items.description: The drug game is tough but Rhanni has decided to pick up where her dead lover left off. While recruiting a solid team and implementing her plan she discovers she's not the only game in town.

items.title: One Night In Vegas
items.description: James Foster, a man at a crossroads with himself and his marriage. After the end of a successful high profile case, James decides a trip to Vegas with his wife Genie.

items.title: On the Court
items.description: Jordan, a mysterious figure who plays basketball by himself at night, decides to join a men's basketball league.

items.title: Just A Measure of Faith
items.description: Husband Jacob handles all the challenges alone, refusing to allow God to help. His wife, Kayla, a strong believer tries to help overcome both of their problems and lead him in the direction of Faith.

items.title: Jump IN
items.description: Troy Alexander returns to her roots, armed with a plan, to pass the bar and start her own practice. Although, her love of the law takes a back seat to her young son,Jordan, it provides an escape from realities.

items.title: Jeremy Brooks
items.description: A rip-roaring saga of runaway ambition stars Chicago's own Simeon Henderson as an arrogant would-be news anchor whose after-word dalliance with the wrong alluring intern sets off a chain of fateful events.

items.title: Jack Squad
items.description: Looking for some quick cash three women band together and decide to drug and jack every rich man they can find.

items.title: Intuition
items.description: Intuition takes place with workaholic relationship therapist, Dr. David Francis, who tries to help Kenny deal with his trust issues. The Doctor fails to realize his patient is having an affair with his finance Karen.

items.title: Flesh
items.description: Brothers Alonzo and Casper run their city from different points of the spectrum with Alonzo serving as the Chief of Police and Casper the biggest street king in the city.

items.title: Imprisoned By Love
items.description: Tracie, a devoted wife and mother, lives every day in fear at the hands of her abusive drunk husband Gerald. She does everything in her power to make a lifeless marriage work for the sake of her two loving children Jordan and Brittany.

items.title: Entangled
items.description: Meet Danielle,a young,vibrant African American woman. She has a vision of having her own business, home, two children, and a loving husband. No one who knew her dream could turn into a horrible nightmare.

items.title: Dangerous Obsession
items.description: The story of 26 year old Brandi Seaton. She is attractive, smart and single. After breaking off her engagement the day before her wedding, she decides to test the waters of the singles dating scene.

items.title: Interludes
items.description: Interludes is based on the real life events of three incarcerated women as they detail traumatic events from their love lives.

items.title: Bachelor Games
items.description: When five friends embark on a bachelor weekend in Argentina, everyone expects the usual hedonistic business.

items.title: Already Tomorrow in Hong Kong
items.description: Ruby and Josh spent an unforgettable night together in Hong Kong a year ago, and now their brief encounter is about to get a second chance.

items.title: Pet Fooled
items.description: An indepth look at the commercial pet food inductry, the total lack of oversight, and what nutritional requirements cat and dogs actually have, compared to what they are being served.

items.title: Paparazzi (2016)

items.description: Whoopi Goldberg stars as a witty, street-smart L.A. narcotics cop who goes undercover to investigate a poisoned drug shipment in this explosive, romantic action-comedy. Co-stars Sam Elliott.

items.title: Evelyn
items.description: Based on the true story of Desmond Doyle, who after losing his job and watching his wife leave with another man, has his children taken away by an arcane custody law. Doyle cleans up his act and wages an unlikely legal battle to regain custody.

items.title: Eureka
items.description: Set in the Canadian wilderness, about a gold prospector (Hackman) who, after a gold strike, moves to a Caribbean island where his reward will be misery and paranoia and pursuit by killers.

items.title: Erik the Viking
items.description: A Monty Pythonesque farce about a Viking who grows dissatisfied with his barbaric way of life, and decides to set out to find the mythical Asgard--where the Norse gods dwell.

items.title: Eight Men Out
items.description: A dramatization about the infamous 1919 "Black Sox Scandal," in which eight members of the Chicago White Sox conspired with gamblers to throw the World Series in return for cash.

items.title: Cutter's Way
items.description: This intriguing film features John Heard as a boozy, belligerent Vietnam vet who seeks passionate revenge on a murderer after his aimless friend (Jeff Bridges) is falsely accused of the crime.

items.title: Bulletproof Monk
items.description: For many years a mysterious monk with no name (Chow Yun-Fat) has zigzagged the globe to protect an ancient scroll -- a scroll that holds the key to unlimited power. Now the Monk must look for a new scrollkeeper.

items.title: Bull Durham
items.description: The story of a minor-league North Carolina baseball team (the Triple A Durham Bulls) and its attentive, intelligent groupie who feels it is her mission to live with one young player per season and help him mature.

items.title: Agent Cody Banks 2: Destination London
items.description: Traveling to London, Agent Cody Banks attends a prestigious school where he gets close to a man who is working with his arch villain Molay.

items.title: A Home of Our Own
items.description: A single mother leaves Los Angeles with her six children and moves to Idaho. She buys a broken-down house without a roof, doors or windows. Weathering natural disasters and personal conflict, they rebuild the house and their lives.

items.title: 24 Hour Party People
items.description: Graphically depicting the music and dance heritage of Manchester from the late 70s to the early 90s, the movie documents the vibrancy that made Manchester the place in the world that you would most like to be.

items.title: The Bounty
items.description: The story of a 1789 mutiny on the H.M.S. Bounty in which a voyage to Tahiti turns a crew against it's Captain when they find tropical paradise and unlimited sex, but the Captain decides to leave and take his crew on a perilous voyage around Cape Horn.

items.title: Desperate Hours
items.description: In this suspenseful thriller, Mickey Rourke is an escaped killer who forces his way into a family's home while waiting for his accomplice (Kelly Lynch) to take him to Mexico. Also featuring Mimi Rogers and Anthony Hopkins.

items.title: Child's Play
items.description: When serial killer Charles Lee Ray is mortally wounded in a police shoot-out, he uses a voodoo spell to transfer his soul into Chucky, a Good Guys doll. Young Andy receives the doll as a birthday gift, and Chucky soon resumes his killing spree.

items.title: A Dry White Season
items.description: A white South African schoolteacher, ignorant about racism in his country, becomes involved when his black gardener is killed.

items.title: Miracle Mile
items.description: Good natured musician learns that the U.S. has fired a nuclear warhead which means that the end of the world is about an hour away.

items.title: Hart's War
items.description: War hero Col. McNamara is imprisoned in a German POW camp. As the camp's highest-ranking American officer, he commands his fellow inmates. Never giving up the fight to win the war, McNamara is planning, waiting for his moment to strike back at the enemy.

items.title: A Family Thing
items.description: Robert Duvall and James Earl Jones portray long-lost brothers in this compelling and poignant family drama about a white Southerner whose identity is shaken after he learns that his natural mother was black.

items.title: Megeti: Africa's Lost Wolf (2017)
items.description: Megeti is a lone wolf who lost her pack and is suddenly left to fend for herself. It is vital for the young wolf to find a new family and this quest pushes her into foreign territory, occupied by cattle breeders and other wolves.

items.title: Kalahari: The Flooded Desert (2004)
items.description: The Kalahari Desert in Southern Africa is a world of extremes. Its apparent emptiness is punctuated by explosions of life. Its harsh cycles of dry and wet, scarcity and plenty, dictate which creatures can live here, and which will die.

items.title: Hugo's Brain (2012)
items.description: Despite rapid scientific growth, much of how the brain works remains a mystery. Through the moving story of Hugo - an autistic young man suffering from Asperger's syndrome - we will explore the extraordinary sophistication of our own brain.

items.title: Chasing the Giant Croc (2013)
items.description: On the Island of Mindanao in the Philippines, Agusan Marsh is paradise. But under the surface lurks a man-eating monster. 20 feet 3 inches long, 1,15 tons. Discover the story of Lolong, the world's largest crocodile ever captured!

items.title: Sopranos: Behind The Scenes, Vol. 1
items.description: This show is not produced or released by HBO & includes rare never seen footage! See bloopers, retakes, & candid videos! Visit filming locations & watch fights, crashes & whackings!

items.title: The House That Dripped Blood
items.description: Robert Bloch, the author of Psycho, presents a quartet of terrifying tales.

items.title: The Glory Days Of Wrestling (2008)
items.description: For more than a half-century, professional wrestling has captivated audiences around the world. The glory days of professional wrestling are presented here in rare classic matches involving the stars who started it all!

items.title: The Glen Campbell Goodtime Hour Christmas Special December 20 1970
items.description: Celebrate the holiday season with country music superstar Glen Campbell and his pals on The Glen Campbell Goodtime Hour Christmas Special!

items.title: The Decline Of Western Civilization
items.description: The Los Angeles punk music scene circa 1980 is the focus of this film. With Alice Bag Band, Black Flag, Catholic Discipline, Circle Jerks, Fear, Germs, and X.

items.title: The Crush
items.description: A journalist becomes the unwanted center of attention for a 14-year-old girl, who proceeds to sabotage his life after he refuses her sexual advances.

items.title: StarCrash
items.description: An outlaw smuggler and her alien companion are recruited by the Emperor of the Galaxy to rescue his son and destroy a secret weapon by the evil Count Zarth Arn.

items.title: Peter, Paul & Mary: The Holiday Concert
items.description: What began in 1981 as a benefit for the New York Choral Society has now become a decades-long holiday music tradition. Join Peter, Paul and Mary in their spectacular live concert PBS special, with symphony orchestra and a 200-voice chorus.

items.title: One Down, Two To Go
items.description: A pair of tough cops go after the mob who jinxed the martial arts tournament and injured their buddy.

items.title: Nightbreed: The Director's Cut
items.description: Boone may be a troubled young man, but his troubles are just beginning. Set up as the fall guy in a string of slasher murders, he decides he'll hide by crossing the threshold that separates from them.

items.title: Los Lobos: Kiko Live (2006)
items.description: Los Lobos celebrates the 20th anniversary of their album Kiko with the release of Kiko Live, which captures their February 24, 2006, performance at the House Of Blues in San Diego, CA.

items.title: Korn: Live
items.description: To celebrate the release of their tenth studio album, The Path Of Totality, legendary rockers performed live to a sold-out crowd, at the famed Hollywood Palladium.

items.title: Fired!
items.description: Annabelle Gurwitch's first-person take on getting the axe.

items.title: Classic Wrestling: Lone Star Shootout (2017)
items.description: The wrestlers are big and bright in Texas in the "Lone Star Shootout". The legendary "Mean Gene" Okerlund hosts this classic look back at professional wrestling history as we relive matches and the events of Southwest Championship Wrestling.

items.title: Classic Wrestling: Brawlin' Beauties GLOW (2017)
items.description: Brawlin' Beauties: The Gorgeous Ladies of Wrestling highlights a bevy of the beautiful and feisty femme fatales who wrestled for G.L.O.W.

items.title: Classic Wrestling: Brawlin' Beauties 2 (2017)
items.description: The legendary stars of women's professional wrestling history are presented in Brawlin' Beauties 2. This Classic Wrestling documentary takes a look back at the women who helped to pave the way for today's professional wrestling sports entertainer.

items.title: Classic Wrestling: Blood, Sweat & Bruises (2017)
items.description: The bloodiest battles, the fiercest moments and the most suspenseful incidents of the Universal Wrestling Federation is presented in "Blood, Sweat and Bruises", a Classic Wrestling documentary featuring some of the best action of the UWF.

items.title: Chicago Cab
items.description: A nameless Chicago cab driver picks up more than 30 different passengers over the course of a typical December day. The driver tries to maintain his calm even as the passengers drive him crazy.

items.title: Bushido Man
items.description: Upon returning from a pilgrimage across Japan, the warrior Toramaru arrives with tales of seven epic battles against Japan's most legendary fighters.

items.title: Barenaked Ladies: Talk To The Hand Live In Michigan
items.description: Stand up and speak to the hand! Canada's favorite sons, Barenaked Ladies, cross the border.

items.title: Capote
items.description: In 1959, Truman Capote, learns about the horrific and senseless murder of a family of four in Kansas. As he digs deeper into the story, he is inspired to expand the project into what would be his greatest work, In Cold Blood.

items.title: Tower Block
items.description: The residents of Tower Block 31 are terrified after witnessing the brutal murder of a young man. A year later the witnesses begin to find themselves picked off one by one by a mysterious sniper out for justice.

items.title: The Decline Of Western Civilization, Part III
items.description: The Decline of Western Civilization III is a 1998 documentary film that follows the gutter punk lifestyle of homeless teenagers.

items.title: The Decline Of Western Civilization, Part II: The Metal Years
items.description: Documentary showcase, what life was like for the music artists living during the Los Angeles Heavy Metal scene in the mid and late 1980s.

items.title: Megadeth: Rust In Peace
items.description: In March 2010, Megadeth hit the road in celebration of the 20th anniversary of their classic 1990 album, Rust In Peace.

items.title: Avalanche: Man vs. Earth (2011)
items.description: Tumbling snow can be a massively destructive force, but is this destruction avoidable? With scientific understanding growing all the time, is it possible to gain the upper hand and control this awesome power of nature?
