items.title: Odd Thomas
items.description: Small-town fry cook Odd Thomas (Anton Yelchin) is an ordinary guy with a paranormal secret: he sees dead people, everywhere.

items.title: Lucy's Really Lost Moments
items.description: The legendary Lucille Ball as you've never seen her before! Laugh along with Lucy and Desi in these extremely rare television appearances, beautifully restored and in color!

items.title: Scrooge (1935)
items.description: The legendary tale adapted by Charles Dickens in which a miser is confronted by his past, present and future to discover the true meaning of Christmas.

items.title: Holy Motors
items.description: From dawn to dusk, a few hours in the shadowy life of a mystic man named Monsieur Oscar.

items.title: Immortal Demon Slayer
items.description: The Legend of Wu Kong and the myth of the Monkey King explodes on to the screen in this dazzling epic adventure from the director of Journey to the West.

items.title: The Congress
items.description: More than two decades after catapulting to stardom with The Princess Bride, an aging actress (Robin Wright, playing a version of herself) decides to take her final job.

items.title: Song One
items.description: Estranged from her family, Franny returns home when an accident leaves her brother comatose. Retracing his life as an aspiring singer-songwriter.

items.title: Scorched Earth
items.description: The planet has suffered an environmental collapse; the air became dangerous to breathe, the water became toxic, and billions of people died.

items.title: Mars
items.description: A new space race is born between NASA and the ESA when Charlie Brownsville, Hank Morrison, and Dr. Casey Cook compete against an artificially intelligent robot to find out what's up there on the red planet.

items.title: Midrange
items.description: Fresh off a stellar collegiate basketball career, aspiring professional player Damon Sharp returns to his hometown of Chicago and quickly discovers a more challenging game off the court.

items.title: Prayer Never Fails
items.description: An inspiring story about an up-and-coming high school basketball coach, on his way to a record number of wins, who is fired for praying with one of his players.

items.title: Chasing 3000
items.description: Mickey (Ray Liotta) recounts the cross-country journey of his 15-year-old self (Trevor Morgan) and his young brother, Roger (Rory Culkin), who suffers from muscular dystrophy, to see baseball player Roberto Clemente's 3,000th hit.

items.title: Airships: Back to the Future (2016)
items.description: Just 80 years after the fire that destroyed the legendary zeppelin, Hindenburg, airships enter a new era where power, ecology and technology come together.

items.title: The Ninth Gate
items.description: Roman Polanski directs and Johnny Depp stars in this supernatural thriller about a rare-book dealer who discovers a demonic manuscript.

items.title: Solitary Man
items.description: A car magnate (Michael Douglas of WALL STREET) watches his personal and professional life hit the skids because of his business and romantic indiscretions.

items.title: Frailty
items.description: A man confesses to an FBI agent his family's story of how his religious fanatic father's visions lead to a series of murders to destroy supposed "demons."

items.title: Buffalo '66
items.description: Billy Brown just got out of jail. Now he's going to serve some real time. He's going home.

items.title: Blood Ties
items.description: Clive Owen & Billy Crudup star in a gritty crime thriller about two brothers on opposite sides of the law. Loyalties are tested when they face off over organized crime in 1974 Brooklyn.

items.title: Bad Lieutenant
items.description: A disturbing character study of a corrupt N.Y.C. cop's slide into insanity.

items.title: Leaving Las Vegas
items.description: Nicolas Cage garnered a Best Actor Oscar for his hauntingly disturbing portrayal of a suicidal alcoholic who falls for a compassionate Las Vegas prostitute (Elisabeth Shue) in one of the year's most critically acclaimed films.

items.title: La Cage Aux Folles
items.description: One of the most successful comedies of all time, this Best Foreign Film Award winner inspired "The Birdcage" and stars Michel Serrault and Ugo Tognazzi as two partners torn between cross-dressing and chaos!

items.title: De-lovely
items.description: Biography of composer and songwriter Cole Porter, a kid from Indiana who became a legend. The focus is how Porter, a gay man, found his inspiration from the woman he married, socialite Linda Lee Porter. Features some of the composer's most famous music.

items.title: Hair
items.description: A country boy and Vietnam draftee embark on an adventure of a lifetime when he meets a group of counterculture hippies and his eyes are opened to the darker side of class, race, and big city life in this adaptation of the Broadway sensation.

items.title: Love Chronicles
items.description: Through the unbelievable stories of callers, a disc jockey and his guest therapist explore the struggles of relationships in L.A. In the process of listening to their stories, the disc jockey discovers his own issues about love.

items.title: How to Succeed in Business Without Really Trying (1967)
items.description: This hilarious musical stars Robert Morse as a charming and scheming window washer who climbs to the top of the corporate ladder by way of a self-help book.

items.title: The Jackie Robinson Story
items.description: The legendary Jackie Robinson stars as himself in this inspiring biopic that traces his remarkable ascent from poverty to becoming the first black American to play major league baseball.

items.title: Paris Blues
items.description: Ram (Paul Newman) and Eddie (Sidney Poitier) are two expatriate jazz musicians living in Paris, where their music is celebrated. When they fall in love with two vacationing American girls, they must decide if they should move back to America with them.

items.title: Coffy
items.description: Pam Grier stars as Coffy, a one-woman vigilante force, out to even the score with those who have hooked her sister on drugs. Coffy uses her sex appeal and an assortment of weapons to rid the streets of society's scum in this cult classic.

items.title: Posse
items.description: There's action galore in this off-beat western that features a group of mostly black infantrymen who return from the Spanish-American War with a cache of gold. The men travel to the West where their leader searches for the men who lynched his father.

items.title: Day of the Outlaw
items.description: Two rival cattlemen forget their differences to fight six outlaws who take over the isolated Western town.

items.title: Six Degrees of Separation
items.description: When compassionate Manhattan art dealers (Stockard Channing and Donald Sutherland) take in a young man (Will Smith) who has been stabbed in Central Park, their world turns amusingly upside down.

items.title: The Big Country
items.description: Burl Ives earned a Best Supporting Actor Oscar for his portrayal of a family patriarch involved in a bitter land feud in this explosive western drama that also features a sumptuous musical score.

items.title: The Children's Hour (1962)
items.description: In this provocatively daring film, an attention-seeking schoolgirl vengefully spreads rumors that her teachers (Audrey Hepburn and Shirley MacLaine) are lesbians.

items.title: Boxcar Bertha
items.description: Set in the Depression era of the 1930s, a young woman and three men rob trains and plan a kidnapping. The men are caught and the woman becomes a prostitute. Based on "Sister of the Road" by Boxcar Bertha Thomson as told to Ben L. Reitman.

items.title: The Crocodile Hunter: Collision Course
items.description: The Crocodile Hunter (Steve Irwin) is trying to save a feisty croc from poachers. What he doesn't know is that the crocodile has swallowed a top secret U.S. satellite beacon, and the poachers are actually American special agents sent to retrieve it.

items.title: The Dogs of War
items.description: This riveting adaptation of Frederick Forsyth's bestseller stars Christopher Walken and Tom Berenger as mercenaries hired by a shadowy cartel to dethrone an African dictator.

items.title: Blown Away
items.description: Jeff Bridges and Tommy Lee Jones team up for this action-filled, edge-of-your-seat thriller about a mad bomber terrorizing Boston. Forest Whitaker and Lloyd Bridges co-star.

items.title: The French Lieutenant's Woman
items.description: Film actors Anna (Meryl Streep) and Mike (Jeremy Irons) portray movie characters who have a short but passionate affair in 19th century England. During the shooting of the film, the two actors have a relationship that parallels that of their characters.

items.title: Beach Blanket Bingo
items.description: When a publicity stunt to promote the singing career of Sugar Kane (Linda Evans) balloons out of control, Frankie (Frankie Avalon), Dee Dee (Annette Funicello) and the gang are pulled into the ensuing comic adventures.

items.title: The Long Riders
items.description: Four theatrical families of the 1980s re-create the saga of the 1860s James Gang: Stacy and James Keach, David, Keith and Robert Carradine, Randy and Dennis Quaid and Christopher and Nicholas Guest.

items.title: Attack
items.description: Eddie Albert is a cowardly captain, Lee Marvin a crooked colonel, and Jack Palance a diligent lieutenant as a small platoon fights its way back from the front in director Robert Aldrich's searing WWII drama.

items.title: The Missouri Breaks
items.description: Marlon Brando and Jack Nicholson ignite the screen in this rousing story of a wealthy Montana rancher who hires a professional killer to track down a gang of horse thieves.

items.title: The Organization
items.description: The dangerous world of international heroin trafficking is exposed in this elaborate and suspenseful crime thriller which reprises Sidney Poitier's role as Lt. Virgil Tibbs.

items.title: At Close Range
items.description: A son wants to be like his father and earn himself a place in the family crime syndicate. Together with his brother, he forms his own gang to gain his dad's respect. Efforts backfire as the father fears that he is losing control.

items.title: The Russians Are Coming, The Russians Are Coming
items.description: Alan Arkin and Jonathan Winters lead an all-star cast (Carl Reiner, Eva Marie Saint, Brian Keith, Theodore Bikel) in this outrageous comedy about a Russian submarine that runs aground off the New England coast.

items.title: Uptown Girls
items.description: Molly Gunn is the daughter of a late rock legend, and the toast of New York City. But when her inheritance is stolen, Molly is forced to do something she's never done before - get a job. Molly becomes a nanny to a girl, who is "eight going on forty."

items.title: Zookeeper
items.description: The animals at one particular zoo decide to break their code of silence in order to help their lovable zookeeper gain the attention of one particular woman.

items.title: White Lightning
items.description: In one of his most memorable roles, Burt Reynolds portrays a moonshine whiskey runner who turns state's witness to avenge the murder of a boy no one understood.

items.title: A Guy Thing
items.description: Paul (Jason Lee) is a good guy. When his friends throw him a wild bachelor party, he's shocked when he wakes up in bed with a beautiful girl named Becky (Julia Stiles) and can't remember the night before. She also happens to be his fiancée's cousin.

items.title: Wish Upon a Star
items.description: In this cult classic, younger sister Hayley Wheaton (Danielle Harris) wishes to switch places with her popular older sister Alexia (Katherine Heigl) and the two bickering siblings awaken to find the wish has come true.

items.title: Waiting for Lightning (2012)
items.description: A documentary on pro skateboarder Danny Way's tough childhood and his contributions to the sport, including footage of his jump over the Great Wall of China.

items.title: Wait for Your Laugh (2018)
items.description: Rose Marie's rise to fame began at the age of four with her own NBC radio show. As she grew, she went from the stages of Vaudeville to the bright lights of Vegas, to some of the most iconic television shows.

items.title: Tortilla Soup
items.description: A Mexican-American master chef and father to three daughters has lost his taste for food but not for life.

items.title: Me Without You
items.description: Two best friends grow up on the Isle of Wight and in Brighton in the 1970s and 1980s.

items.title: Havana Motor Club
items.description: Reforms have offered opportunity in Cuba but the children of the Revolution are unsure of the best route forward.

items.title: Diana Vreeland: The Eye Has to Travel
items.description: A look at the life and work of the influential fashion editor of Harpers Bazaar, Diana Vreeland.

items.title: Tangerines
items.description: War in Georgia, Apkhazeti region in 1990. An Estonian man Ivo has stayed behind to harvest his crops of tangerines. In a bloody conflict at his door, a wounded man is left behind, and Ivo is forced to take him in.

items.title: Romper Stomper
items.description: A group of skinheads become alarmed at the way their neighborhood is changing.

items.title: Chicken People (2016)
items.description: Chicken People is a funny and uplifting look at the world of show chickens and the people who love them.

items.title: A Year in Port
items.description: With renowned wine importer Martine Saunier as our guide, we journey into Portugal's spectacular Douro Valley to explore the mystery and complexity of the world of port.

items.title: 2 Days in Paris
items.description: Marion and Jack try to rekindle their relationship with a visit to Paris, home of Marion's parents -- and several of her ex-boyfriends.

items.title: Penitentiary II
items.description: Back in prison, an inmate channels his anger into boxing and gets a chance at becoming welterweight champion of the world.

items.title: Penitentiary
items.description: In this gritty prison drama, Leon Issac stars as "Too Sweet", a convict who uses his wits and fists to survive his harrowing existence. Quickly discovering that only the strong survive, Too Sweet must distinguish himself as a boxer, taking on all comers.

items.title: Prom Night 2: Hello Mary Lou
items.description: Thirty years after her accidental death at the 1957 senior prom, the tortured spirit of prom queen Mary Lou Maloney returns to seek revenge.

items.title: Prom Night (1980)
items.description: In this classic slasher starring Jamie Lee Curtis (Halloween), a masked killer stalks four teenagers who were responsible for the death of a local girl six years earlier.

items.title: Hollow Creek
items.description: Trying to find inspiration for his next horror novel, Blake retreats to the Appalachian Mountains with his mistress, Angelica. When she disappears, Blake becomes a prime suspect.

items.title: Dioses
items.description: Elisa, la que muy pronto será esposa de un rico empresario, está ansiosa por ocultar su pasado de clase trabajadora en favor de la opulencia del estilo de vida elitista de su prometido.

items.title: Borrowed Hearts
items.description: During the holidays, a struggling mother and her daughter pose as the family of her bachelor boss (Eric McCormack, ?Will & Grace?) to help him impress a tradition-minded industrialist interested in acquiring the company.

items.title: American Virgin
items.description: "The 40-Year-Old Virgin" meets "American Pie" in this hysterical comedy. At college on a sponsorship from a sexual abstinence group, pure-as-snow virgin Priscilla White stands to lose it all after drinking and getting filmed performing wild sexual antics.

items.title: A Bear Named Winnie
items.description: Michael Fassbender stars in the extraordinary true story of the black bear who would become the inspiration for the stories of A.A. Milne, and the heroic man who saved her life.

items.title: Ninja
items.description: A Westerner named Casey, studying Ninjutsu in Japan, is asked by the Sensei to return to New York to protect the legendary Yoroi Bitsu, an armored chest containing the weapons of the last Koga Ninja.

items.title: Stardom
items.description: In this spellbinding drama, Jessica Paré (“Mad Men”) stars as a young girl who is plucked from small-town obscurity and thrust into the glamorous world of supermodels.

items.title: Sodbusters
items.description: In this parody of western tropes, a mysterious stranger (Oscar nominee Kris Kristofferson, “Blade”) rolls into town to help local farmers defend their property from a land-grabbing cattle rancher.

items.title: Superfish: Bluefin Tuna
items.description: Narrated by David Attenborough. It is a giant among fish, yet few have filmed it in the wild. Rick Rosenthal sets off to uncover the secrets of the legendary bluefin tuna, while documenting its place in the grand scheme of the vast marine ecosystem.

items.title: Superfish: Billfish
items.description: Narrated by David Attenborough. The Marlin is the biggest, fastest, and most dangerous gamefish in the sea. Award-winning filmmaker, Rick Rosenthal, spend two years traveling the globe in a quest to document the lives of these awe-inspiring predators.

items.title: Troy: The Odyssey
items.description: In the aftermath of the Trojan War, Odysseus must face even greater peril, battling gods and monsters as he journeys home.

items.title: Trolland
items.description: Fenn the Troll hates the Troll pastime of pranking, and is teased so much for it that he runs away. But when a long-suffering park ranger starts capturing the other Trolls, it’s up to Fenn to rescue his family and friends - without pranking.

items.title: The Fast and The Fierce
items.description: When terrorists plant a bomb on a commercial flight, the passengers aboard the plane must fight to keep the plane in the air and all the passengers alive: the bomb is rigged to detonate whenever the plane dips below 800 feet.

items.title: Santa Claws
items.description: Tommy leaves his kittens out for Santa to take back to the North Pole, but after a major allergic reaction Santa can't deliver presents anymore, so the kittens have to deliver the rest of the presents to all the boys and girls.

items.title: Operation Dunkirk
items.description: A band of soldiers tasked with staying behind during the Battle of Dunkirk to rescue a scientist with information that could turn the tide of the war must battle their way through dangerous Nazi territory to complete their mission.

items.title: CarGO
items.description: A young car learns the importance of family when he embarks on a mission to rescue his father – who’s been sent to Clunker Island to be repurposed as junk metal.

items.title: Android Cop
items.description: In this futuristic, action-packed thriller, a cop and his robotic partner enter the Zone, a forbidden section of the city inhabited by a disease-stricken populace. Together, they discover the real reason everyone is sick, and attempt to stop the illness.

items.title: Alien Convergence
items.description: When flying reptilian creatures wreak havoc all over the world, the survivors’ only hope of stopping them is a new, state-of-the-art fighter jet piloted by the only team that knows how use the technology.

items.title: Independents' Day
items.description: After aliens invade earth and destroy all our nuclear arsenal, they give us a choice: either emigrate to a new, better planet or be killed.

items.title: Vintage Tomorrows
items.description: VINTAGE TOMORROWS examines Steampunk's origins, explosive growth, and cultural significance. Is the Steampunk movement a homogenized, privileged subculture or a reclamation of technology from the hands of Silicon Valley?

items.title: The Island President
items.description: After bringing democracy to his country, President Mohamed Nasheed of the Maldives, the lowest-lying country in the world, takes up the fight to keep his homeland from disappearing under the sea.

items.title: That Sugar Film
items.description: Damon Gameau embarks on an experiment to document the effects of a high sugar diet on a healthy body.

items.title: Somm: Into the Bottle
items.description: The history, politics, pleasure, and BS of wine told through opening ten very different bottles.

items.title: Somm
items.description: Four sommeliers attempt to pass the prestigious Master Sommelier exam, a test with one of the lowest pass rates in the world.

items.title: Nerdland
items.description: The story of two best friends whose dreams of success and stardom have fizzled, so they decide to become famous in one day - at all costs.

items.title: Coming Through the Rye
items.description: In 1969, the Holden Caulfield-obsessed Jamie Schwartz runs away from boarding school to find the reclusive author J.D. Salinger. Inspired by actual events, Jamie's search becomes a journey of sexual awakening, love and loss.

items.title: Cold Souls
items.description: Paul is an actor who feels bogged down by his participation in a production of Chekov's play, Vanya.

items.title: At the Fork
items.description: Filmmaker and omnivore John Papola, together with his vegetarian wife Lisa, offer up a timely and refreshingly unbiased look at how farm animals are raised for our consumption.

items.title: A Year in Champagne
items.description: With renowned wine importer Martine Saunier as our guide, we get a rare glimpse behind the scenes into the real Champagne through six houses, from small independent makers to the illustrious houses of Gosset and Bollinger.

items.title: Public Sex Private Lives
items.description: Public Sex, Private Lives is an intimate look into the lives of porn performers Lorelei Lee, Princess Donna, and Isis Love. These women are asked to defend their choices to their families, communities, and the U.S. Government.

items.title: Living on One Dollar
items.description: In rural Guatemala, four friends battle illness, parasites and hunger as they experiment with living on just $1 a day for eight weeks.

items.title: Coast Modern
items.description: Travelling along the Pacific North West coastline from LA to Vancouver, the film showcases the pioneers of West Coast Modernist Architecture, and the homes that have become their legacies.

items.title: The Lazarus Effect
items.description: A group of medical researchers discover a way to bring dead patients back to life.

items.title: Swallows and Amazons
items.description: Four children (the Swallows) on holiday in the Lake District sail on their own to an island and start a war with rival children (the Amazons). In the meantime, a mysterious man on a houseboat accuses them of a crime they did not commit.

items.title: Prom Night 4: Deliver Us from Evil
items.description: Four students ditch their high school prom to party at a summer home. However, there is a psychotic priest on the loose determined to punish sinners.

items.title: Pirates of the Plain
items.description: With few friends and little to do besides his chores, eight-year-old Bobby entertains himself by retreating into a world of fantasy. After a storm, he discovers that reality has caught up with his imagination. Featuring Tim Curry (“Clue”).

items.title: National Lampoon's Robodoc
items.description: When a health care company unveils RoboDoc — an android physician programmed to make no medical mistakes — a greedy medical malpractice lawyer sees a threat to his livelihood.

items.title: Gardens of the Night
items.description: "Gardens of the Night" is a harrowing story of survival on the mean streets of San Diego, starring Gillian Jacobs (“Community”), John Malkovich (“In the Line of Fire”) and Tom Arnold (“True Lies”).

items.title: The Woman in Black 2: Angel of Death
items.description: 40 years after the first haunting at Eel Marsh House, a group of children evacuated from WWII London arrives, awakening the house's darkest inhabitant.

items.title: Sparks
items.description: In the critically praised superhero noir thriller, masked vigilante Ian Sparks discovers the dark side of heroism when his pursuit of the world’s most notorious super criminal leaves his life and reputation in ruins.

items.title: Michael Jackson: Life, Death, and Legacy
items.description: In this film we take an intimate look into life of one of the worlds most successful entertainers of all time, a man dubbed as the King of Pop.

items.title: Turn It Up
items.description: A history of the electric guitar, hosted by Kevin Bacon. This celebration features interviews and performances by B.B. King, Slash, Les Paul, Robby Krieger, John 5, Paul Stanley, Skunk Baxter, Jerry Cantrell, Nancy Wilson, and many more.

items.title: Kill or Be Killed
items.description: Two former ranking figures of the Axis powers schedule a deadly martial arts tournament in an isolated locale. The two rivals then race to assemble the top competitors from around the world, with Steve Hunt being the most sought after fighter.

items.title: Joysticks
items.description: Joysticks is a controversial social spot for the teenagers of a small suburban sprawl. When the town gets embroiled in a contentious fight over the establishment's right to operate, the employees of Joysticks band together to save their second home.

items.title: Honor Diaries
items.description: Nine leading women advocates fight back against gender-based honor violence. Notions of shame and honor are challenged, and a dialogue that goes beyond assumptions emerges in their efforts to create change.

items.title: Gipsy Kings Live at the Kenwood House
items.description: High Definition video recorded performance by the Gipsy Kings, trailblazers in the flamenco genre. Enjoy their set of selected hit songs in this live concert from the Kenwood House in London in 2004.

items.title: Freeway II
items.description: A teenage prostitute escapes from juvenile prison with a 16-year-old serial killer and both go on a destructive road trip to Mexico. Though initially the complete antithesis of each other, their travels bring them closer than they ever could've imagined.

items.title: Best of Michael Bolton Live
items.description: Bringing down the house in his first concert release, Michael Bolton is the Grammy-winning music giant with more than 40 million records sold and the recipient of five "Million Performance Song Awards".

items.title: Beneath the Helmet
items.description: This documentary tells the story of five Israeli high school graduates who are drafted into the army to defend their country. At just 18, these young individuals embark on a demanding journey, revealing the core of who they are and who they want to be.

items.title: Basil
items.description: A lonely young aristocrat in turn-of-the-century England struggles to gain the approval of his over-bearing, class-conscious father. Tension rises when he falls in love with a woman whom his father will never accept.

items.title: City of Dead Men
items.description: Michael, an American tourist, meets a mob of misfits who reside in an abandoned children's psychiatric hospital. He begins to uncover the horror that occurred there, and is pulled into the mob's dangerous dynamic of supposed immortality.

items.title: Chronic Con, Episode 420: A New Dope
items.description: In response to Morgan Spurlock's COMIC-CON: A FAN'S HOPE, comedian Doug Benson (SUPER HIGH ME) stars in this doc that looks at San Diego Comic-Con from his hazy perspective.

items.title: Christmas in the Heartland
items.description: Kara and Jessie strike up an unlikely friendship when seated next to each other on a plane headed to the heartland. With both girls visiting family they've never met, they devise a plan to switch places for Christmas.

items.title: Bleeding Heart
items.description: BLEEDING HEART follows the story of May, a yoga instructor who finds herself behaving in ways she'd never imagined herself capable of in an effort to protect her newly discovered biological sister, Shiva, from a dangerous boyfriend.

items.title: Falcon Song
items.description: Falcon Song is a whimsical, 1980's style contemporary western in which a guitar playing drifter helps a rancher's granddaughter find her true calling. They soon find themselves in the middle of an age old land war.

items.title: God is Alive
items.description: Did we come from the mind of a creator or from nothing? Many create concepts of what God actually means and believe it to be the one defined by Christians, Jews or Muslims. It's a simple question of faith.

items.title: Anatomy of a Love Seen
items.description: From Writer/Director Marina Rice Bader (Executive Producer Elena Undone, A Perfect Ending) comes this film within a film that explores love in all its painful and messy glory.

items.title: Maravilla
items.description: "Maravilla" can drop the world's best boxers with his lightning strikes and floor the most beautiful women with his devastating looks. But speaking truth to power has left him a virtual pariah in the unjust world of professional boxing.

items.title: Wild Window: Whales
items.description: Imagine yourself floating freely in a clear, tropical ocean. Through this liquid universe moves Earth’s largest, most majestic and graceful creatures. You are immersed in the mystical blue world of humpback whales, sperm whales, and blue whales.

items.title: Wild Window: Flow of Time
items.description: Our world is graced by dynamic swirling skies, swept by clouds, painted in the orange hues of a dying sun. All around us, the flow of time beckons us to drink its inspiration and marvel at its force.

items.title: Wild Window: Coral Kingdoms
items.description: Dive down into the shallow world of the most pristine coral reefs left on the planet, in Indonesia, Fiji, the Philippines, and the Maldives Islands. The crystalline waters fracture the sunlight into a kaleidoscopic wonder of life and geology.

items.title: Love Ain't Supposed To Hurt II - The Wedding
items.description: Tracie has decided to take the plunge and walk down the aisle, but an unexpected accident causes her to face yet another issue from her past.

items.title: Blood Diamond
items.description: Academy Award nominees Leonardo DiCaprio and Djimon Hounsou join Academy Award winner Jennifer Connelly in this action drama from Ed Zwick, the filmmaker behind The Last Samurai.

items.title: Blade Runner: The Final Cut
items.description: Harrison Ford stars in this fascinating, dark vision of the near future as a policeman who tracks engineered humans — a Blade Runner.

items.title: The Last Airbender
items.description: Air, Water, Earth, Fire. Four nations are tied by destiny when Fire launches war against the others. Caught between the war, one Avatar discovers he's able to manipulate all four elements.

items.title: The Brady Bunch Movie
items.description: Mike and Carol have just one week to come up with $20,000 in back taxes, or they’ll lose their house to a neighbor. Even worse, Marcia gets a swollen nose on date night, Cindy’s addicted to tattling, and Jan’s hearing a psychotic inner voice.

items.title: Popeye
items.description: The legendary, beloved anvil-armed sailor of the seven seas comes magically to life in this delightful musical, starring Robin Williams as Popeye, who meets all challenges with the unshakable philosophy, "I yam what I yam and that's all that I yam."

items.title: Zodiac
items.description: Based on Robert Graysmith's books about the real-life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

items.title: Starfish Throwers
items.description: "Worlds apart, a five-star chef, a twelve year-old girl, and a retired schoolteacher discover how their individual efforts to feed the poor ignite a movement in the fight against hunger.

items.title: The Competition
items.description: A woman inspires millions with her "PIG Theory" blog promoting a formula that keeps you safe from cheating until she meets a handsome lawyer who challenges her to a competition to prove her theory wrong. It's a competition! Who will win?

items.title: The Coming Convergence
items.description: Can we truly know the day of our demise? Jesus chastised religious leaders in ancient Jerusalem for not knowing the time of His first arrival. Will the prophesied "final generation" today make the same mistake?

items.title: The Arctic Expedition: A Historic Journey To Find The Truth
items.description: The ice cutter Amundsen overwinters in the Arctic, supporting the research of over 250 scientists from 26 countries while facing some of the harshest conditions imaginable. This historic journey will be forever remembered…

items.title: More Art Upstairs
items.description: A quirky contest that's a mash up of Art Basel and American Idol attracts four blue chip artists to leave NYC's insular art world for a month in the Midwest, where the public votes to decide who wins much of $500,000 in prize money.

items.title: Mind Control: MK Ultra
items.description: A CIA program studying the effects of drugs on unwitting civilians in order to create and interrogate spies during the Cold War goes horribly wrong. Experts report on the MK Ultra experiments and the effects they have had on our culture.

items.title: Impossible Dreamers
items.description: Impossible Dreamers is an inspirational documentary that follows a number of Senior Athletes, ranging from ages 60-94.The Emmy award-winning filmmakers spent over three years capturing the ups and downs that define the human spirit.

items.title: Guys Reading Poems
items.description: A resourceful boy creatively uses poetry to survive when his mother, a disturbed avant garde painter, locks him in a puppet box and builds an art installation around his imprisonment.

items.title: Cassette: A Documentary Mixtape
items.description: Cassette inventor Lou Ottens digs through his past to figure out why the format won’t die. Musicians like Henry Rollins and Thurston Moore join a new generation of bands releasing tapes to help Lou remember the importance of his creation.

items.title: Big Men
items.description: Executive produced by Brad Pitt, Big Men is a real-life Treasure of the Sierra Madre about ambitious people who uncover oil in one of the poorest places on earth. An international suspense story with extraordinary access.

items.title: Western World
items.description: When US Marshal Moses White is called to the Wyoming Territory town of Dogwood Pass to track a known killer, he runs into more than he bargained for.

items.title: The Cara Project
items.description: Cara Delevingne. She is unquestionably a public icon. She’s the girl who has it all. This fun and eye popping doc about the rad and sexy Cara will have any fan on the verge of tears and is sure to pump some mega fun into your home viewing pleasure.

items.title: Road to Hell
items.description: A stranger arrives in a small town in the Wild West with an unknown agenda. Liz and Anne, alone after their father's death, know him only as the Colonel. The trouble he's about to bring is nothing they could have prepared for…

items.title: Political Animals
items.description: Political Animals is a powerful, award winning documentary about four California lawmakers -- all women -- who took the fight for equality from the streets into the halls of government to create lasting social justice and equality.

items.title: The Patent Scam
items.description: The corruption runs deeper than you'd ever think. A multi-billion dollar industry you've never heard of. This is the world Patent Trolls thrive in: created for them by the U.S. Patent system.

items.title: A One World Agenda: The Illuminati
items.description: There is an elite group that controls the world. They run governments, companies and religions. They have controlled what you perceive for centuries and while their names and faces have changed, their bloodlines remain the same.

items.title: The Night Watchmen
items.description: Four inept night watchmen and a fearless tabloid journalist, fight a a horde of hungry vampires to save themselves but also the City of Baltimore. Some men were born heroes but not these guys.

items.title: Ogar: Will of Steel
items.description: Kevin Ogar, an athlete destined for greatness, suddenly finds himself paralyzed, his dreams shattered. He fights to survive, then to build a new life, even daring to pursue his dream job–a job nobody in a wheelchair has ever attained.

items.title: The Longest Week
items.description: When Conrad (Jason Bateman) is kicked out and cut off at the age of forty, he crashes with his only friend (Billy Crudup) and falls in love with his friend's girlfriend (Olivia Wilde).

items.title: The Incomparable Rose Hartman
items.description: With a career spanning decades Photographer Rose Hartman is known for her Iconic Photos from Studio 54 and the fashion world, her boisterous personality and ever presence capturing the New York social scene.

items.title: Forces of Nature
items.description: Ben is trying to get to Savannah for his wedding. A seagull flies into the engine as the plane is taking off. All later flights are canceled because of an approaching hurricane, so he hitches a ride in with an attractive woman named Sara.

items.title: What We Did On Our Holiday
items.description: GONE GIRL's Rosamund Pike stars with David Tennant and Billy Connolly in this heart-warming story about one family's hilarious journey through an unforgettable vacation.

items.title: Walled In
items.description: Based on Serge Broselot's bestselling French novel "Les Emmeures," about a demolition company rep who supervises the razing of a mysterious building and discovers horrifying secrets and past inhabitants entombed within its walls by a vicious murderer.

items.title: State Property
items.description: Beans decides that the only way to grasp the American Dream is to take it. STATE PROPERTY follows Beans and his crew, as they take over the city creating mayhem as their empire builds.

items.title: Disaster Movie
items.description: DISASTER MOVIE lampoons the blockbuster movie, pop culture icons and public figures along the way as Jason Friedberg and Aaron Seltzer satirize everything as only they can.

items.title: Requiem for the American Dream
items.description: In Requiem for the American Dream Noam Chomsky, widely recognized as the most influential intellecutal alive, makes plain the principles perpetuating the concentration of wealth and power in the hands of a select few.

items.title: From Fat to Finish Line
items.description: From Fat To Finish Line documents the journey of 12 formerly obese people who run a 200 mile Ragnar Relay Race. The film examines the trials, obstacles and triumphs that occur when tackling big mental and physical challenges.

items.title: Adele and Everything After
items.description: Marty battled with a heart condition that made her faint every day, until she met Adele, a cardiac alert service dog. As the time comes for Adele to retire, Marty struggles to let go of the constant companion who saved her life.

items.title: Abe & Phil's Last Poker Game
items.description: Dr. Abe Mandelbaum has just moved into a new retirement home with his ailing wife. After forming an unlikely friendship with another resident, their relationship is tested as they each try to convince a mysterious nurse that they are her long-lost father.

items.title: A Song for You: The Austin City Limits Story
items.description: From Willie Nelson to Wilco, Ray Charles to Radiohead, A Song For You: The Austin City Limits Story offers the ultimate backstage pass and front row seat to 40 years of incredible music from the longest running music show in TV history.

items.title: 5 Doctors
items.description: Convinced that he's dying from a bizarre array of symptoms, a struggling comedian returns home to visit his five childhood doctors in a single day, all while desperately trying to avoid the friends and family that he left behind.

items.title: 1 Million Happy Nows
items.description: The story of Lainey and Eva’s changing relationship as they struggle to deal with the diagnosis of Lainey’s Early Onset Alzheimer’s.

items.title: 6 Models in Hell
items.description: 6 Models arrive at a warehouse to audition for a fashion show being hosted by the biggest talent agency in the city. Little do they know, the MC hosting the audition knows their innermost demons and intends to judge them for past sins.

items.title: Open Water 2
items.description: A weekend cruise on a luxurious party yacht goes horribly wrong for a group of old high-school friends.

items.title: Nurse 3D
items.description: When a friendship turns to obsession, a nurse unleashes a rampage of terror.

items.title: Ryde
items.description: A new ride share app because a popular alternative to taking a taxi, but you never know who will be getting in a car with. Or if you'll ever get out.

items.title: Misconduct
items.description: An ambitious lawyer is caught between a corrupt pharmaceutical executive and his firm's senior partner. When the case turns deadly, he must find the truth or lose everything.

items.title: Horsemen
items.description: A recently widowed detective still grieving over his wife's death discovers a shocking connection between himself and the suspects in a serial killing spree linked to the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse.

items.title: Gallowwalkers
items.description: A cursed gunman (Wesley Snipes) whose victims come back from the dead recruits a young warrior to help in the fight against a gang of zombies.

items.title: After Life
items.description: After a horrific car accident, Anna (Christina Ricci) wakes up to find the funeral director (Liam Neeson) preparing her body for her funeral.

items.title: The Pearl
items.description: The Pearl is a cinematic and intimate profile of 4 transgender women that come out in their senior years. Set in logging towns in the Pacific NW the visceral, observational story explores what it means to leave behind living as a man.

items.title: The Gateway Bug
items.description: Over 2 billion people on earth eat insects for protein. The Gateway Bug explores how changing daily eating habits can feed humanity in an uncertain age, one meal at a time.

items.title: Son of Rambow
items.description: A hilariously fresh take on friendship, family, film heroes and the death-defying adventures of growing up in the video age.

items.title: Milius
items.description: The life story of controversial film director John Milius. Featuring interviews with Steven Spielberg, George Lucas, Arnold Schwarzenegger, Francis Ford Coppola, Kathleen Kennedy, Harrison Ford, Robert Zemeckis, Oliver Stone and many more.

items.title: Gone Tomorrow
items.description: Five years after taking the fall for his brother, a tormented ex-con flees parole to find his kidnapped niece. One step ahead of the police, and one behind an unraveling criminal syndicate, he must once again sacrifice everything in the name of family.

items.title: Dark Beacon
items.description: An abandoned paramour tracks her lover down to a distant lighthouse. When she finds her beyond hope she must find a way to save a child from the malignant spirit of her deceased father and the madness of her mother.

items.title: Behind Some Dark Cloud
items.description: An aimless suburban girl faces her fears of growing up!

items.title: Ballerina
items.description: With intimate interviews, dance sequences, and archival material, this documentary follows Ella as she explores her identity and offers a glimpse into her life as an elite ballet dancer in the largest company in the southern hemisphere

items.title: As Far as the Eye Can See
items.description: Jack Ridge is a former piano prodigy living on his family’s north Texas farmland. But his first public performance in years is threatened when he punches his fist into a wall. Jack is living in the past, but the future is coming for him.

items.title: Alpha Gateway
items.description: A particle physicist grieving over the loss of her husband in a car crash travels to a parallel world to find him again, with dire consequences for her family.

items.title: Always Watching: A Marble Hornet's Story
items.description: A small town news team discovers a box of video tapes where a faceless figure dressed in a dark suit, haunts and torments a family... slowly driving them insane. Soon after, they realize that the "Operator" has begun to stalk them as well.

items.title: Alienween
items.description: Four friends spend Halloween night partying in a country house with call girls. While the party is raging, strange meteors begin falling from the sky and horribly mutating and melting those who come in contact with them.

items.title: Addicted to Sexting
items.description: Addicted to Sexting is a compelling (and sometimes humorous) look at the rise and proliferation of this social phenomenon from several varying perspectives and how the lives of those engaged in it are affected.

items.title: Above Ground Level: Dubfire
items.description: With unprecedented access to Grammy award-winning DJ Dubfire and interviews with some of the world's biggest DJs, Above Ground Level is an insider's look at the world of dance music and what it takes to reach the top of the DJ game.

items.title: 1 Buck
items.description: Shifting from one pocket to another, from one man's drama to another, a lowly dollar bill, 'one buck' takes us on an odyssey through the heart of a forgotten town in Louisiana.

items.title: Passion
items.description: The rivalry between the manipulative boss of an advertising agency and her talented protégée escalates from stealing credit to public humiliation to murder.

items.title: Oddball
items.description: An eccentric chicken farmer, with the help of his granddaughter, trains his mischievous dog Oddball to protect a penguin sanctuary from fox attacks in an attempt to reunite his family and save their seaside town.

items.title: Miss Meadows
items.description: Schoolteacher Miss Meadows is not entirely what she appears. Well-mannered, sweet, and caring; but underneath the candy-sweet exterior hides the soul of a vigilante, taking it upon herself to right the wrongs in this world by whatever means necessary.

items.title: Hick
items.description: Small-town teenager Luli escapes to Las Vegas, leaving behind her alcoholic and abusive parents. Along the way, Luli crosses paths with Eddie, an unstable rebel with questionable motives, and Glenda, a cocaine-snorting drifter on the run.

items.title: Gameplay
items.description: From "Pong" to "Pac Man" and "Super Mario" to "Lara Croft", "Doom", "Grand Theft Auto" and everything in between - it's the story of the videogame revolution.

items.title: All-Stars
items.description: A veteran softball coach is saddled with a team of inexperienced 10-year-olds and their overly ambitious, entirely delusional parents whose ridiculous behavior is more suited to five-year-olds than adults in the hilarious comedy, ALL-STARS.

items.title: Firehead
items.description: RiffTrax, the guys who make movies funny, bring their comedic riffing treatment to this "so bad it's still bad" movie where Estonian cyborgs shoot lasers out of their eyes!

items.title: The Seawolf
items.description: The Seawolf is the latest from awarded filmmaker Ben Gulliver who follows seven professional surfers on a two-year, jaw-dropping, cinematic journey in search of remote, frigid waves.

items.title: Nervous Laughter
items.description: When winter swells collide with a chunk of reef off the north shore of Maui, massive waves up to 60 feet rise and crash to create the best big wave on earth. It's called Peahi, or “Jaws,” and every year it attracts dozens of elite surfers.

items.title: Like Air
items.description: Every year, Dance Makers, Inc hosts regional dance competitions across the US for all age groups. The competition is fierce and the pressure that young boys and girls put on themselves is intense.

items.title: Taylor Swift: America's Sweetheart
items.description: The country/pop superstar has taken the music scene by storm, going multi-platinum on her first album, earning four Grammy Awards for her second and being listed in the 2013 Forbes list of top-earning celebs under 30.

items.title: Shakira: Hits Don't Lie
items.description: Follow the rise of one of the most successful Latin-American pop artists of all time. Known for her catchy lyrics and hip shaking dance moves, Shakira has swept up millions of fans around the globe.

items.title: Selena Gomez: On Cloud 9
items.description: Selena Gomez landed a role in the classic children's TV show Barney & Friends in 2002, and since then she's gone to achieve fame and fortune beyond her wildest dreams.

items.title: Miley Cyrus: Xplicit
items.description: Singer, actress, controversial pop star. Miley Cyrus has become one of the most talked about celebrities in the world. From Disney's Hanna Montana to her latest single 'Wrecking Ball', Miley has transformed her image radically.

items.title: Michael Jackson: Unmasked
items.description: So much has now been said about the turbulent life and phenomenal career of Michael Jackson that it has become almost impossible to disentangle the man from the myth.

items.title: Lady Gaga: One Sequin at a Time
items.description: Lady Gaga- the worlds most talented and controversial pop star. Born and raised in New York City, Gaga started as an aspiring pianist and songwriter, having taught herself to play the piano at a very young age.

items.title: Justin Timberlake: Dressed to Thrill
items.description: Justin Timberlake is the greatest musician of his generation. With millions of album sales world wide, and over 500 million hits on YouTube, The man from Tennessee has established himself as the biggest star of the 21st century.

items.title: J. Lo: Let's Get Real
items.description: Her talents go from acting, to fashion, dancing and singing. With a net worth over 250 million dollars, J.Lo has conquered the Latin American and pop music scene.

items.title: Dark Meridian
items.description: A corrupt New Orleans detective gets caught up in a fight between two criminal gangs while on a stake out. To survive the night, he must find a killer on the run and take him out before the killer reaches his other targets.

items.title: Blueprint
items.description: A young black man searches for his identity in the aftermath of a fatal shooting in South Side, Chicago. Inspired by a true story, this timely and important film tackles the issue of racial injustice and what it takes to overcome grief.

items.title: Blue World Order
items.description: After a nuclear war decimated the northern hemisphere, the surviving population was infected with a deadly bacterium. In an attempt to rebuild civilization, a self appointed government called 'The ORDER' distributed an immunization to the bacteria.

items.title: Beyoncé: Queen B
items.description: One of the most recognizable figures in contemporary music, Beyoncé rose to fame as the central member of pop-R&B group Destiny's Child before embarking on a multi-platinum, record-breaking solo career in 2001.

items.title: UFO Chronicles: Aliens and War
items.description: Revelations about the UFO and alien presence on Earth and how military and government factions are aware of this potential threat. Top experts reveal the extent of which US Presidents past and present are made aware of the UFO situation.

items.title: The Mystery of Britannic
items.description: A historical docudrama that reveals a unique scenery on the terrible fate of the sister ship of the famous Titanic, whose final destiny was to be lost while at sea.

items.title: Relentless
items.description: An American mother searches for her daughter who was kidnapped by human traffickers in El Salvador, the murder capital of the world. The trail takes her through Central America and Mexico via “The Train of Death”. Inspired by true events.

items.title: Queen of Ireland
items.description: The Queen of Ireland follows drag queen Panti Bliss, created by Rory O’Neill. Since the Pantigate scandal in 2014, Panti has become a figurehead for LGBT rights in Ireland and her fight for equality has become recognised across the world.

items.title: Passing Through
items.description: For decades, the poor and dispossessed have been herded and confined to Skid Row. In Passing Through, the seemingly lost find a new sense of community. Directed by 2-time winner and 13-time nominee DGA Director of the Year, Leslie Dektor.

items.title: Mind Control: HAARP Conspiracy
items.description: Dr. Nick Begich explores the HAARP array system that may be able to employ extremely low frequency signals that can affect the human brain, influencing how people think and feel creating stress, confusion, and the sensation of psychosis.

items.title: Mind and Machine
items.description: Set in 2024 where humanoid robots are common in society, the mob reprograms a female android to think and feel so they can use it as a contract killer.

items.title: Bluefin
items.description: In North Lake, Canada, Local fishermen swear the spectacular Atlantic bluefin tuna are so plentiful they eat out of people’s hands. Meanwhile, scientific evidence shows the species is on the brink of collapse. Can both claims be true?

items.title: Bieber Generation
items.description: This documentary film attempts to analyze the dynamics of a massive fan-base; it focuses on the Beliebers (fans of Justin Bieber).

items.title: Amigo Undead
items.description: Kevin Ostrowski attempts to reconcile with his estranged, underachieving brother Norm on a camping trip. They're accompanied by several of Norm's unusual friends.

items.title: 59 Seconds
items.description: ZayVian, a teenager, guilty over the death of his twin brother, commits negative acts in order to gain the attention of his parents. He seeks absolution for the murder. His ultimate decision causes an impact on eight troubled teens.

items.title: UFO Chronicles: The Aliens Arrive
items.description: Dr. Michael E. Salla explores the socio political ramifications of extraterrestrial life on Earth. Learn about the diversity of alien species currently visiting us, the role of the "greys", and the agenda of the industrial military complex.

items.title: Dog by Dog
items.description: DOG BY DOG is a documentary that aims to wake up the American public to the horrible realities of puppy mills by following the money trail across the US and confronting those that have maintained this corrupt and irresponsible system.

items.title: Attack of the Southern Fried Zombies
items.description: Lonnie, a crop duster pilot, must lead a mismatched group of survivors to escape the deadly zombie horde after an experimental chemical, intended to control the invasive kudzu vine, transforms the citizens of Charleston, MS into zombies.

items.title: Alienate
items.description: A man separated from his wife fights to return home while the Earth falls to invasion.

items.title: The Scarehouse
items.description: When Corey and Elaina open a Halloween fun house on devil's night, it's all fun and games until their former sorority sisters begin to arrive.

items.title: The Green Girl
items.description: Susan Oliver, the original Star Trek's iconic Green Girl, has appeared in the end credits of re-runs of this series on a near-daily basis since the late 1960's.

items.title: Streets of Hope
items.description: Inspired by a True Story. Over 2,000 gang youth taken off our streets. The year is 1993 and street gangs are running out of control.

items.title: Sholem Alecheim: Laughing in the Darkness
items.description: A riveting portrait of the great writer whose stories became the basis of the Broadway musical Fiddler on the Roof. Sholem Aleichem: Laughing in the Darkness tells the tale of the rebellious genius who created an entirely new literature.

items.title: Wicked City
items.description: A secret police force known as the Black Guard protects the boundary between the human world and the demon world.

items.title: Sugar Sisters
items.description: Follow three sisters enter the world of "sugar dating" in this provocative doc. Hannah, Amalia, and Caroline go on the search for a Sugar Daddy to help pay the bills and give them a glamorous lifestyle.

items.title: William and Kate: A Royal Love Story
items.description: Awaiting the lavish royal wedding of Prince William and Kate Middleton, this documentary focuses on their love story and the royal romance that is yet to come.

items.title: Diana: The Night She Died
items.description: The tragic death of Diana, Princess of Wales, left the world stunned and shaken. In the wake of the tragedy, a series of conspiracy theories surrounding that fateful August 1997 night were unveiled.

items.title: Zara: The World's Richest Man
items.description: One of the world's iconic fashion moguls is explored in this documentary. Armancio Ortega, founder of Zara, is profiled in a doc that delves into the secret to Zara's success in the French fashion world and beyond.

items.title: The Jade Pendant
items.description: The Old West becomes a battleground for power and revenge in this gripping epic based on true events. A young Chinese woman, Ying-Ying, finds herself on a boat to America after escaping the clutches of a bad arranged marriage.

items.title: World's Most Powerful Telescopes
items.description: Featuring interviews with leading scientists at the European Southern Observatory, and 4K HDR space photography, uncover how instruments four billion times more sensitive than the human eye are revolutionizing our understanding of the cosmos.

items.title: The Next Great Extinction Event
items.description: Has the industrialization of the planet and the release of carbon and other pollutants into the atmosphere brought us to the tipping point of another great extinction event or is this an unavoidable planetary phenomenon intrinsic to our planet's DNA?

items.title: Blood, Sand & Gold
items.description: When an archaeologist discovers Sir Francis Drake's lost treasure in the Sahara Desert, it is promptly stolen and sets off a global quest to steal it back.

items.title: Jack Hammer
items.description: A shy struggling actor is dragged into the world of professional male stripping by his egotistical brother.

items.title: Fastball
items.description: Hank Aaron and Derek Jeter, with Kevin Costner narrating, lead a cast of baseball legends & scientists who explore the magic within the 396 milliseconds it takes a fastball to reach home plate, and decipher who threw the fastest pitch ever.

items.title: Ace the Case
items.description: While her mother is away on business, a young girl home alone with her older brother witnesses her neighbor's kidnapping. But no one believes her. So she takes matters into her own hands putting her life at risk to save her neighbor.

items.title: 2020 Nostradamus
items.description: Nostradamus predicted the rise of Hitler, the nuclear destruction of Hiroshima and 9/11. New research reveals further predictions that indicate more peril is on the horizon.

items.title: Rise Up
items.description: Jamaica – the island that gave birth to the worldwide phenomenon of Reggae. In a society of plentiful talent but scarce opportunity, three distinct and courageous artists fight to rise up from obscurity and write themselves into the pages of history.

items.title: Path to Glory: Spirit of the Arabian Horse
items.description: This is the unexpected story of far-flung lands coming together in war and in peace, influencing one another through the living history written on the backs of the Arabian horse. Filmed on location with footage and photographs previously lost to history

items.title: My African Safari
items.description: Hearing the word "Africa" can conjure a myriad of images- herds of animals roaming the plains, Maasai warriors with their swords and spears, romantic African sunsets, or regions of tribal conflict. It is all this and more.

items.title: First Flight: A Mother Hummingbird's Story
items.description: Join ornithologist and nature enthusiast Ken Dial as he travels to several birding hot spots filled with the most spectacular species of birds imaginable!

items.title: In Country
items.description: With striking historical accuracy, rare archival footage and a deeply personal inspection on the effects of PTSD, In Country artfully activates the similarities between past wars and the military conflicts of today.

items.title: G.B.F.
items.description: A story of two best friends, Tanner and Brent. One longs for the spotlight, convinced coming out will make him instantly popular. All seems to go according to plan as the girls in school battle for their newest must-have Gay Best Friend!

items.title: Don't Hang Up
items.description: An evening of drunken prank calls becomes a nightmare for a pair of teenagers when a mysterious stranger turns their own game against them...with deadly consequences.

items.title: The Little Ghost
items.description: The Little Ghost lives in the castle over looking a small town and awakens for precisely one hour after the clock strikes midnight. Follow him on this adventure to see his first sunrise ever!

items.title: The Last Keepers
items.description: When the teenage daughter of a reclusive family of artists falls in love with an unusual boy at school, she awakens mysterious powers and discovers ancient family secrets that will change her life forever.

items.title: The Hot Flashes
items.description: Brooke Shields stars in this raunchy comedy that proves that women over 40 know how to do it better.

items.title: The Great Bear
items.description: When Sophie is kidnapped by a giant, 1000-year-old bear, he brother Jonathan must venture into the heart of the forest in an attempt to save her.

items.title: The Adventures of Pepper and Paula
items.description: Based on the true life adventures of Pistol Packin Paula and her dog, Pepper.

items.title: Robot Carnival
items.description: Robots good and evil star in this '80s sci-fi anime anthology. Stories include evil techno overlords intent on destruction, to a cyborg on a mission to save a young girl, to the story of a beautiful robot creation that haunts its creator, and beyond.

items.title: Nameless Gangster
items.description: When a corrupt official finds a large package of drugs, he joins forces with a dangerous mobster to take over the criminal underworld, one bullet at a time. Starring Choi Min-sik, leading man in iconic action film "Oldboy".

items.title: Ribbit
items.description: Ribbit is a frog stuck in an identity crisis. He hates hopping, water and pretty much anything a normal frog likes to do! Together with his best friend, a flying squirrel, Ribbit embarks on a journey in search of his rightful place in this world.

items.title: Pixies
items.description: Joe Beck (Bill Paxton) has lost the love of his life, Michelle Meyers (Alexa Vega), thanks to a Pixie's curse. To figure out how to get his girl back, Joe must learn more about the mysterious Pixies to undo a bad deed from long ago.

items.title: Out of the Dark
items.description: A couple and their daughter moves to Colombia to take over a family business, only to realize their new home is haunted by children whose death was caused by a horrible accident over twenty years ago.

items.title: Hunted
items.description: Rufus is a shy and lonely boy determined to make a new start. Sure he has some quirks..so what if he likes the taste of blood? It's not like he's addicted.

items.title: Harbinger Down
items.description: While studying the effects of global warming on a pod of whales, graduate students on the ship Harbinger uncover a frozen Soviet space shuttle. After 30 years of thawing from the ice, a once trapped monstrous organism is unleashed on the students.

items.title: Dark Hearts
items.description: In underground Los Angeles three struggling artists lives collide when a painter Colson and younger brother meet musical seductress Fran. Colson begins a passionate and forbidden love affair with Fran while his brother looks on.

items.title: Behaving Badly
items.description: Young and in love, Rick is willing to do whatever it takes to win the heart of Nina. To land the girl of his dreams, he'll have to deal with his best friend's horny mom, a drug abusing boss and even the mob, proving that love is never easy!

items.title: Anna
items.description: A man with the ability to enter peoples' memories takes on the case of a brilliant, troubled sixteen-year-old girl to determine whether she is a sociopath or a victim of trauma.

items.title: A Horse For Summer
items.description: When a family emergency forces a troubled teen to do the wrong thing for the right reason, a community discovers the meaning of forgiveness.

items.title: A Fine Step
items.description: When an expert horseman suffers a traumatic accident with his top horse, he overcomes his injury with the help of a young girl who helps rehabilitate him and the horse.

items.title: Wild Window: Forest in the Sea
items.description: The undersea kelp forests that line the North American coastline, from Alaska to Southern California, are among Earth’s great natural wonders. Rays of light streaming into the deep illuminate the playgrounds of sea lions, sharks, whales, and otters.

items.title: Past Life
items.description: Two sisters try to unravel a disturbing wartime mystery that has cast a foreboding shadow on their entire lives. They realize that freedom from the shackles of the past requires painful sacrifices, as does the struggle to discover one’s unique voice.

items.title: Message From a Mistress
items.description: Longtime best friends Renee, Aria, Jaime and Jessa have shared just about everything. All hell breaks loose when Jessa sends them a message via DVD with a shocking message!

items.title: It Had To Be You
items.description: Surprised by a sudden proposal and subsequent ultimatum from her boyfriend, Sonia embarks on a bumpy, raunchy journey of self-discovery.

items.title: Harry Brown
items.description: An elderly ex-serviceman and widower looks to avenge his best friend's murder by doling out his own form of justice.

items.title: Finding Altamira
items.description: Life and events of the man who realized one of the most important discoveries of the 19th century: Altamira's caves.

items.title: The Benefactor
items.description: A philanthropist meddles in the lives of a newly-married couple in an attempt to relive his past.

items.title: The Assassin Next Door
items.description: A woman forced to work for the Russian Mafia as an assassin agrees to help her next-door neighbor kill her abusive husband.

items.title: Barista
items.description: Five top baristas find themselves pushing the limits of coffee perfection to win the National Barista Championship - a surreal competition where even one mistake is far too many.

items.title: Bang Gang
items.description: George, a pretty teen girl, falls in love with Alex. To get his attention, she initiates a game with their friends, discovering, testing and pushing the limits of their sexuality.

items.title: 17 Miracles
items.description: The pioneer trek across the plains of the Mormon pioneers.

items.title: 1000 Kook Surfing Slamzz and Bangerz
items.description: See it, don't be it! 1000 Kook Surfing Slamzz and Bangerz shows you the good, the bad, and the ugly of surfing. A funny look at surfing wipeouts with some cameos by the world's best surfers and the kooks that clog the surfing lineup. As a bonus there a...

items.title: 100 Foot Surfing Days
items.description: "All men are made of water. If they leak out, they die." 100 Foot Surfing Days is a surfing film showcasing some of the biggest waves ever ridden. Also included are interviews with the surfers willing to risk it all for the ride of a lifetime. This is...

items.title: Patriot Games
items.description: Jack Ryan is caught in the middle of a terrorist attack. Ryan helps to thwart Holmes’ assailants and becomes a local hero. But Ryan’s act marks him as a target. Now he must return to action to save his family.

items.title: Nebraska
items.description: From Academy Award® winner Alexander Payne, comes the story of a father and his adult son who embark on a journey to claim a million-dollar prize. What begins as a fool’s errand becomes a search for the road to redemption.

items.title: Love Story
items.description: The story of a young couple who cross social barriers, marry and ultimately face the greatest crisis of all.

items.title: Murder on the Orient Express
items.description: Famous detective Hercule Poirot is on the Orient Express, but the train is caught in the snow. When one of the passengers is discovered murdered, Poirot immediately starts investigating.

items.title: Enemy at the Gates
items.description: Two Russian and German snipers play a game of cat-and-mouse during the Battle of Stalingrad.

items.title: Cloverfield
items.description: Five young New Yorkers face a life-or-death struggle to escape from the city when a monster the size of a skyscraper suddenly appears.

items.title: Bringing Out the Dead
items.description: Frank Pierce, a paramedic, is on the brink of madness from too many years of saving and losing lives. One fateful night, Frank meets Mary Burke, the daughter of a man Frank tried to save. Together, Frank and Mary confront the ghosts of the past.

items.title: Young Sherlock Holmes
items.description: When a plague of bizarre, puzzling murders grip London, young Holmes and his new found friend Watson find themselves unwittingly entangled in the dark mystery.

items.title: The Prize Winner of Defiance, Ohio
items.description: In order to support her ten children, Evelyn Ryan (Moore) enters a commercial jingle-writing contest. Based on a true story.

items.title: The Lovely Bones
items.description: When 14-year-old Susie Salmon was murdered, she left unfinished life behind. But now from her place in a strange but beautiful in-between world, she must help her father catch her killer.

items.title: Saturday Night Fever
items.description: John Travolta performs as the troubled Tony Manero - Brooklyn paint store clerk by day and undisputed king of the dance floor by night. A powerful and provocative urban tragedy that carries as much significance today as it did in 1977.

items.title: I.Q.
items.description: All the world knows about Einstein the scientific genius. But what about Einstein the matchmaker? I.Q. puts this notion to the test and comes up with winning results in this “fun, warmhearted romantic comedy” that has critics and audiences cheering.

items.title: Men, Women & Children
items.description: A provocative new drama from acclaimed director Jason Reitman, that looks at our world through five interconnected families in a small town and examines the question of whether the technology meant to connect us is actually drawing us further apart.

items.title: Will You Still Love Me Tomorrow?
items.description: In this lighthearted comedy, shy Weichung begins to question his marriage and sexuality after bumping into an old friend who’s living the life of a younger, single gay man.

items.title: Dogs on the Inside
items.description: "Dogs on the Inside" looks into the transformative relationships between prison inmates and abused dogs during an 8-week training program.

items.title: The Cup
items.description: The inspirational true story of horse racing legend Damien Oliver, who overcame incredible odds to win the 2002 Melbourne Cup Trophy.

items.title: Dudes & Dragons
items.description: When the powerful wizard, Lord Tensley, is jilted by Princess Ennogard, he vows to rid the land of love. He commands his fire-breathing dragon to destroy any sign of affection seen throughout the kingdom. Camilan, a brave arrogant warrior marries.

items.title: Cowgirls 'n Angels: Dakota's Summer
items.description: Dakota's Summer tells the story of Dakota Rose's personal journey navigating life and the rodeo circuit after she receives surprising news about her birth almost 18 years ago.

items.title: Cowgirls 'n Angels
items.description: Story of Ida, a feisty and rebellious young girl, who has fantasies of finding her father, a rodeo rider. While searching for her dad, she connects with the Sweethearts of the Rodeo, a team of young female rodeo riders run by former rodeo star Terence

items.title: Cinderella
items.description: A sparkling fantasy of music, magic and romance, Rodgers & Hammerstein’s Cinderella captivates from overture to finale with a delightful score and stunning flittering performances from an all-star cast. Cinderella will waltz into the hearts of families.

items.title: Boynton Beach Club
items.description: Residents of an adult community in Florida turn to one another for support and companionship after the deaths of their spouses. Lois has a rejuvenating affair with a younger man while acting as best friend to recently widowed Marilyn.

items.title: Adam Resurrected
items.description: In the aftermath of WWII, a former circus entertainer spared from the gas chamber becomes ringleader at an asylum for Holocaust survivors.

items.title: A Brilliant Young Mind
items.description: A socially awkward teenage math prodigy finds new confidence and new friendships when he lands a spot on the British squad at the International Mathematics Olympiad.

items.title: The Gambler
items.description: Jim Bennett (Mark Wahlberg) is a professor leading a double life as a high-stakes gambler. When he borrows money from dangerous gangsters, he places the lives of his loved ones in mortal danger and must risk everything to keep from losing it all.

items.title: Panic
items.description: Troubled journalist Deeley is obsessed with Kem, his beautiful neighbour. But when Kem is kidnapped Deeley must confront inner demons while searching for a woman the world has forgotten about.

items.title: You Don't F*** in the Woods
items.description: A group of friends are going on a camping trip to celebrate graduating college. But once they enter the woods, the proverbial shit starts to hit the fan!

items.title: Arbor Demon
items.description: An adventurous married couple and an injured hunter are held captive inside a claustrophobic tent by a supernatural threat. For an unknown reason, the tent has become their only safe haven. Soon tensions rise inside the Arbor Demon.

items.title: The Cup (1999)
items.description: World Cup soccer fever hits a remote Himalayan monastery and centuries-old traditions are threatened - the young monks will do just about anything to watch the final match.

items.title: A Good Day to be Black and Sexy
items.description: A between-the-sheets peek at Black Love and Sexuality.

items.title: The Proud Rebel
items.description: A Confederate veteran (Alan Ladd of 'Shane') living in the Yankee North struggles with his son's shock induced muteness and the hatred of the Northern town led by Best Actress Academy Award, Olivia de Havilland.

items.title: The Persian Connection
items.description: After being wrongly accused of stealing from his former boss, an Iranian gangster with girl problems must hunt down stolen drugs in this neon-noir fever dream set in the bizarre Persian and Russian Los Angeles underworld where obscene reigns supreme.

items.title: The Farewell Party
items.description: THE FAREWELL PARTY is a unique, compassionate, and unlikely funny story of a group of friends at a Jerusalem retirement home who build a machine for self-euthanasia in order to help their terminally ill friend. When rumors of the machine begin to spread.

items.title: Rommel
items.description: ‘Rommel’ recounts the futile efforts of the Field Marshal Erwin Marshall to gain Hitler's backing for the Western Front. Faced with Hitler's rigid hope of fulfilling a final victory combined with increasingly absurd military orders.

items.title: Renoir
items.description: The Côte d’Azur. 1915. In his twilight years, Auguste Renoir is tormented by the loss of his wife, the pains of arthritic old age and the terrible news that his son Jean has been wounded in action. But when a young girl miraculously enters his world.

items.title: Raising Victor Vargas
items.description: On New York City's Lower East Side, Dominican teen and aspiring ladies' man Victor Vargas has nothing but girls on his mind. Though he talks a big game at the local pool, Vargas' true experience amounts to nothing more than a string.

items.title: Psychopaths
items.description: Psychopaths' follows the soul of a recently executed serial killer as it descends back to earth and possesses his many followers beneath the full moon. Official Selection of Tribeca Film Festival 2017, The Overlook 2017, and Popcorn Frights 2017.

items.title: No Men Beyond This Point
items.description: Imagine a world where, since 1953, women have been able to reproduce without men and they are no longer giving birth to male babies. Now, over 60 years later, this deadpan mockumentary follows the youngest man still alive – 37 years-old Andrew Myers.

items.title: Most Beautiful Island
items.description: An undocumented woman struggling in NYC is offered an opportunity she can’t refuse, but soon discovers she’s involved in a dangerous game. Grand Jury Award Winner of SXSW 2017. Official Selection of BAMCinemaFest, Fantasia Fest, and Sidewalk.

items.title: Love, Kennedy
items.description: Kennedy Hansen is a funny, loving child but inexplicably she begins to fall. It takes years for the diagnosis; Juvenile Batten Disease, an extremely rare, terrible and terminal prognosis. There is no cure for Batten Disease and after living only sixteen.

items.title: Little Secrets
items.description: Emily Lindstrom, a gifted 14-year-old violinist, skips summer camp in order to prepare for an audition with the prestigious San Francisco Youth Orchestra. Emily has also set up a side business as a "secret keeper", charging a 50-cent fee.

items.title: Ladies In Lavender
items.description: Aging spinster sisters Ursula (Judi Dench) and Janet (Maggie Smith) discover a young man (Daniel Brühl) near death on the beach by their home in a small Cornish fishing village. Taking him in, they discover that he is Andrea, a violinist from Krakow.

items.title: Identicals
items.description: The organization Brand New-U identifies networks of Identicals, people who live better lives, and helps their customers make a life upgrade: eliminating the better-life donor, and relocating their client to that brand new life.

items.title: I Capture the Castle
items.description: After his successful first novel, James Mortmain has been unable to write for 12 years, retreating to his decrepit family castle with his second wife, Topaz, and daughters Rose and Cassandra. With the family in desperate straits.

items.title: Hyena Road
items.description: Three men, three different paths, caught in conflict but brought together to save lives: a highly skilled sniper who can’t think of his targets as human, an intelligence officer who has never killed while on duty.

items.title: He Loves Me... He Loves Me Not
items.description: A talented art student named Angélique is passionately in love with Dr. Loïc Le Garrec, a handsome married man whom she believes will leave his wife, Rachel. Loïc does leave Rachel after she miscarries.

items.title: Greenfingers
items.description: Inmate Colin Briggs (Clive Owen) is introduced to gardening and when the thriving prison garden attracts the attention of flamboyant gardening expert, Georgina Woodhouse (Helen Mirren), she offers to sponsor the inmates in an upcoming flower show.

items.title: Rabbit Hole
