items.description: This is the extraordinary love story of Becca and Howie. Just 8 months ago, they had a picture-perfect life with their young son. Now, they are posing as normal in the wake of an enormous loss; blindly looking for footing in a sea of new emotions.

items.title: Sinister
items.description: Ethan Hawke is a crime novelist who moves his family into a home with a horrific past. But when he uncovers a box of mysterious home movies that seem to point to unspeakable terrors, he unlocks a nightmare that threatens his entire family.

items.title: Requiem for a Dream
items.description: Darren Aronofsky directs Oscar winners Jared Leto, Jennifer Connelly, and Ellen Burstyn in this hypnotic tale about addiction.

items.title: Love & Mercy
items.description: John Cusack and Paul Dano star as Beach Boys genius Brian Wilson in “the best musical biopic in decades” (CHICAGO TRIBUNE). Also starring Elizabeth Banks and Paul Giamatti.

items.title: Alien Psychosis
items.description: A veteran returns home to his pregnant wife after being wounded in combat. Suffering from PTSD, Ryan begins to see strange beings in his house at night, caused by a sinister presence, which has been haunting him in his nightmares.

items.title: The Great Buck Howard
items.description: Once upon a time, Buck Howard (John Malkovich) spent his days in the limelight as a mentalist extraordinaire! Nowadays, it’s clear to everyone except Buck that his act has lost its luster. Convinced his comeback is imminen.

items.title: Mr. Untouchable
items.description: This is the true-life story of a junkie turned multimillionaire drug lord. With the first hand testimony of the Godfather himself, Nicky Barnes, who was the most powerful black drug kingpin in New York City history.

items.title: Journey To The West
items.description: In a world plagued by demons who cause great human suffering, young demon hunter Xuan Zang risks his all to conquer a water demon, a pig demon and the demon of all demons, Sun Wukong.

items.title: I Am Love
items.description: I Am Love tells the story of the wealthy Recchi family, whose lives are undergoing sweeping changes. At the heart of the family is Tancredi Recchi's wife Emma (Tilda Swinton), a Russian immigrant who has adopted the culture of Milan.

items.title: How I Live Now
items.description: Set in the near-future UK, Saoirse Ronan plays Daisy, an American teenager sent to stay with relatives in the English countryside. Initially withdrawn and alienated, she begins to warm up to her charming surroundings and strikes up a romance.

items.title: Stopping Traffic: The Movement to End Sex Trafficking
items.description: With 27 million victims worldwide, Stopping Traffic starts the conversation on a taboo topic through the eyes of survivors, activists, and front-line rescue teams to launch a movement to end modern-day slavery in the U.S. and abroad.

items.title: Bending Steel
items.description: An intimate documentary exploring the lost art of the oldetime strongman and one man's struggle to overcome limitations of body and mind.

items.title: Atheist America
items.description: The Atheist Experience is the only atheist TV show in the United States. Every Sunday afternoon, two atheists debate people on the phone for one hour - on camera.

items.title: An Art That Nature Makes: The Work of Rosamond Purcell
items.description: Finding unexpected beauty in the discarded and decayed, photographer Rosamond Purcell has developed an oeuvre of work that has garnered international acclaim.

items.title: Naughty & Nice
items.description: A cynical city DJ is exiled to a remote radio station where small-town charm, holiday cheer, and his pretty co-host begin to melt his icy demeanor.

items.title: Holly's Holiday
items.description: Ad exec Holly sells perfection. But when she gets a chance for her own Christmas fantasy, it turns out perfection might not be perfect after all.

items.title: Girlfriends of Christmas Past
items.description: This Christmas three women plot revenge on the guy who cruelly dumped them all. But will vengence be worth risking a chance at new love?

items.title: Christmas Belle
items.description: It's "Beauty & the Beast" at Christmas when Belle meets cantankerous Hunter, but soon he begins to warm…putting their work and Belle's heart at risk.

items.title: Back to Christmas
items.description: Ali wakes realizing she's reliving a past Christmas allowing her to change the path of her love life with her ex or with someone entirely unexpected!

items.title: Angels in the Snow
items.description: A blizzard traps the dysfunctional Montgomerys in the family cabin at Christmas with the wholesome Tuckers, reminding the Montgomerys how to love.

items.title: 12 Dog Days Till Christmas
items.description: A troubled teen sentenced to community service at a dog shelter helps find homes for strays and in the process discovers a family for himself.

items.title: All Is Bright
items.description: Starring Paul Rudd and Oscar-nominee Paul Giamatti. Two low-level con men attemp to pull off one last job: selling Christmas trees in New York City.

items.title: Saint Ralph
items.description: The year 1954 finds teen outcast Ralph Walker getting in trouble at the Catholic school he attends in Ontario, Canada. When the headmaster catches Ralph smoking, he puts the boy on the school's cross-county team to force him to put his time.

items.title: Mao's Last Dancer
items.description: From a desperately poor village in northeast China, at Li Cunxin was chosen by Madame Mao's cultural delegates at age eleven to be taken from his rural home and brought to Beijing, where he would study ballet. In 1979, the young dancer goes to Texas.

items.title: Mambo Italiano
items.description: Angelo Barberini lives at home and harbors a secret from his Italian parents, Gino and Maria: He's gay. Angelo's decision to move out surprises Gino and Maria. They believe that Angelo should only leave home if he's getting married.

items.title: Manlife
items.description: For 80 years, Merle Hayden dedicated his life to crusading for the utopian movement Lawsonomy and preserving the legacy of its leader, Alfred Lawson. Merle’s high school sweetheart, Betty Kasch, wishes Merle instead would devote himself to her.

items.title: Festival: A Documentary
items.description: Against the backdrop of the United States’ latest music festival surge, “Festival” captures a moment in time. It follows the stories of Jill, Travis, Austin, Kenneth, Barbara and Tracy as they navigate their demons, relationships and dilemmas.

items.title: A Christmas Tree Miracle
items.description: A warm-hearted Christmas tale to remind us that in the holiday season, the best gifts in life are the simple ones, and that miracles do happen, if you believe.

items.title: Dead End
items.description: It is Christmas Eve and the Harringtons take a trip to their in-laws to celebrate the holidays. Taking an unfamiliar shortcut, Mr. Harrington makes the biggest mistake of his life and leads his family down a terror-filled road with no end.

items.title: The March Sisters at Christmas
items.description: A modern retelling of Louisa May Alcott's "Little Women" follows four sisters who attempt to restore and keep their home before their mom sells it.

items.title: My Santa
items.description: Single mother Jen starts to rediscover the magic of Christmas after meeting a mall Santa, Chris, not knowing he is the son of the real Santa.

items.title: My Dad is Scrooge
items.description: "A Christmas Carol" turns into "A Christmas Corral" as the animals of Woodsley Farm help Oliver shock his Dad into embracing the holiday spirit.

items.title: Married By Christmas
items.description: Workaholic Carrie plans to elope before her sister’s Christmas Eve wedding to keep control of the family business. But Carrie forgot to plan on love.

items.title: A Puppy for Christmas
items.description: Holiday romance is in the air when Noelle and her new puppy join Liam on his family's farm, leaving Noelle to choose between two suitors.

items.title: MST3K: Teenagers From Outer Space
items.description: A group of aliens land on Earth and decide to use the planet as a farm for their livestock. One of the aliens rebels and flees to a small town, where he is pursued by another alien who kills anyone in his path.

items.title: MST3K: Time Chasers
items.description: A college professor and a reporter go through time in a modified light plane to stop a corporation from using his invention to accidentally create a dystopian future.

items.title: Whitey: United States of America V. James J. Bulger
items.description: From Academy Award®-nominated director Joe Berlinger, WHITEY: UNITED STATES OF AMERICA V. JAMES J. BULGER is a sweeping and revelatory documentary film that follows the trial of the infamous gangster James “Whitey” Bulger.

items.title: The ABCs Of Death
items.description: This explosive film is comprised of 26 individual “chapters” on the topic of death, each helmed by a different director assigned to a specific letter of the alphabet. Provocative, funny and shocking.

items.title: Sick Nurses
items.description: A group of sexy nurses who harvest organs are haunted by the vengeful spirit of one of their dead patients - a fellow nurse.

items.title: Red
items.description: After his 14-year-old dog, Red, is senselessly murdered by three thrill-seeking teenagers, an aging recluse sets out seeking justice for his four-legged companion and finds himself gradually pushed to take extreme measures.

items.title: Mutant Chronicles
items.description: In the year 2707, war rages between Earth’s four giant corporations as they battle over the planet’s dwindling resources. Amid heavy combat, an ancient buried seal shatters, releasing a horrific mutant army from its eternal prison.

items.title: Cowboys and Indians
items.description: J.J. Harper, a First Nations chief, is gunned down by police constable Robert Cross on his way home one snowy night in downtown Winnipeg.

items.title: This Beautiful Fantastic
items.description: Set against the backdrop of a beautiful London garden, this contemporary fairy tale centers on the unlikely friendship between a reclusive young woman who dreams of writing children’s books and a cranky widower.

items.title: Spirit of the Game
items.description: In the lead up to the 1956 Olympic games, a group of missionaries are tasked with helping the fledgling Australian basketball team compete in their first ever Olympics, and in doing so, unite a nation still coming to grips after the war.

items.title: Fresh Dressed
items.description: Fresh Dressed chronicles the history of Hip-Hop <> Urban fashion and its rise from southern cotton plantations to the gangs of 1970s in the South Bronx, to corporate America, and everywhere in-between.

items.title: Christmas With the Andersons
items.description: The Anderson family always goes all out for Christmas, but this year will be different when Michael loses his job just before the holidays. With wacky Aunt Katie visiting, though, she helps remind them Christmas can be fun with no money.

items.title: A Cinderella Christmas
items.description: The Christmasquerade Ball gives hardworking Angie a chance to let loose. She quickly charms Nicholas but has to go suddenly, leaving him only one clue to find her in this modern, holiday take on the classic fairytale.

items.title: 3 Times a Charm
items.description: Studious Emma is given a magic necklace that grants her three chances to see the consequences of her actions after she’s asked to cheat on an exam.

items.title: 1 Chance 2 Dance
items.description: When Gabby is uprooted during senior year, she finds herself split between two boys while having one last shot to make her dance dreams come true.

items.title: The Christmas Calendar
items.description: When Emily, a small town baker, receives a Christmas Calendar from a secret admirer, it attracts the attention of the locals. With financial problems looming, the calendar turns out to be a Christmas miracle for Emily and the bakery.

items.title: Winter Wedding
items.description: When things don't go as planned for the perfect wedding destination, a couple does everything they can to get married happily ever after… and survive their families in the process.

items.title: Yakuza Apocalypse
items.description: Fearsome yakuza boss Kamiura is also a bloodsucking vampire. One day, men arrive from a competing clan and deliver him an ultimatum: Play nice or die. Kamiura refuses and, during a fierce battle, is torn limb from limb.

items.title: Walk On Water
items.description: Following the suicide of his wife, an Israeli intelligence agent is assigned to befriend the grandchildren of a Nazi war criminal.

items.title: There Be Dragons
items.description: Arising out of the horror of the Spanish Civil War, a candidate for canonization is investigated by a journalist who discovers his own estranged father had a deep, dark and devastating connection to the saint's life.

items.title: The King's Choice
items.description: “The King’s Choice” is based on the true the story about the three dramatic days in April 1940, where the King of Norway is presented with an unimaginable ultimatum from the German armed forces: Surrender or die.

items.title: Priceless
items.description: Irène loves nice things and loves to have wealthy men pay for them. One night, she mistakes Jean, a poor bartender, for a potential client and spends the night with him. The next morning, Irène realizes her mistake and leaves, but poor Jean is smitten

items.title: Marilyn Hotchkiss' Ballroom Dancing & Charm School
items.description: A widowed man's life turns upside down when he embarks on a journey to find a dying man's long lost love.

items.title: A Year in Burgundy
items.description: The film follows seven wine-making families in the Burgundy region of France through the course of a full year, and delves into the cultural and creative process of making wine, as well as its deep ties to the land.

items.title: Righteous Kill
items.description: Two veteran New York City detectives (Academy-Award-winners Robert De Niro and Al Pacino) hunt a vigilante who may be one of their own.

items.title: Delta Farce
items.description: Three hapless guys are mistaken for Army Reservists and loaded onto an army plane headed for Iraq and then mistakenly ejected in a Humvee somewhere over Mexico.

items.title: Soundies: A Musical History
items.description: Classic sound films remain as glorious time capsules of music, social history, popular culture, and tell the story of a crossroads in our country.

items.title: Merlin: The Return
items.description: The evil sorcerer Mordred and his dark forces are pitted against the mythical sorcery of Merlin. Under Merlin's spell, Mordred and his mother have been imprisoned for 1500 years, but a meddlesome scientist from the present creates a gateway to escape.

items.title: Brian Epstein: Inside the Fifth Beatle
items.description: Brian Epstein, frequently acknowledged as the fifth driving force behind the Beatles' artistic and financial success, ascended from a small Liverpool wannabe actor to the manager of the most iconic musical act in the history of popular music.

items.title: The Gold Retrievers
items.description: A 12-year-old boy attempts to save his family home with his mischievous golden retriever, Marley. When Marley digs up a golden medallion with the help of a map, Josh and town newcomer Ana set out to save the town.

items.title: The Convent
items.description: When a group of college students break into an abandoned convent, they discover demons that are intent on possessing them. As the group dwindles in numbers those who remain learn of the convent's long history with malevolent demonic forces.

items.title: Swing (1999)
items.description: When Martin gets out of prison, the guards warn him to get a job or end up back in jail. Martin decides to start his own band. The band is a smashing success until the police find out that it was backed with stolen money.

items.title: Star Games
items.description: Forced from his home planet by a hostile alien take-over, a young prince takes intergalactic flight. He finds refuge on Earth and befriends an earthling named Brian. Now, the two must come together and fight for the freedom of the galaxy.

items.title: One Dark Night
items.description: Karl Raymar, is mysteriously found dead in his home with the bodies of six dead women. Meanwhile, student Julie Wells is being initiated into an exclusive club where she must spend a night in the town's mausoleum. Where Karl has just been interred.

items.title: Wes Craven's Mind Ripper
items.description: A top secret experiment intended to produce a superhuman has gone terribly wrong. Now the creators, trapped in a remote desert outpost, are being pursued ruthlessly by their creation.

items.title: Mask Masters
items.description: When the evil Muspel curses twelve creatures with masks that gravely endanger humankind, it's up to the Four Guardians to defend the four parts of the world and conquer evil.

items.title: Love Is the Drug
items.description: Scholarship student Jonah becomes infatuated with a wealthy drug user at his private school, stealing drugs for her friends in order to get closer to her.

items.title: Livin' for Love: The Natalie Cole Story
items.description: One song launched Natalie Cole into stardom, but the harrowing secret of her heroin addiction threatened her acclaim, and ultimately, her life.

items.title: Liberace: Behind the Music
items.description: Fueled by the intense poverty of his youth, Liberace was determined to become the world's greatest entertainer. While we all know of the opulent lifestyle and grandiose stage shows, this account explores the underside of his meteoric rise to stardom.

items.title: After the Sun Fell
items.description: Adam unwillingly accompanies his friend on a visit to his childhood home only to find himself uncovering a dark family secret that becomes a catalyst for healing and resolution.

items.title: Christmas in Hollywood
items.description: Charlie, a young boy from China travels all the way from Shanghai to find his fathers restaurant in Hollywood is in trouble. He must convince 3 people to believe in the Spirit of Christmas in order to save his family's dream.

items.title: The Christmas Reunion
items.description: The mid-west town of Cave City, Kentucky is preparing for its annual Christmas festival, when festivities are disrupted by a sudden snowstorm.

items.title: Lords of Salem
items.description: From the singular mind of horror maestro Rob Zombie comes a nightmare world where evil forces from a Salem, Massachusetts legend unleash terror upon the modern-day town.

items.title: Another Christmas Kiss
items.description: A passionate, mistletoe-fueled kiss inspires a millionaire playboy and his sister’s workaholic assistant to take a romantic leap for Christmas.

items.title: Holiday Road Trip
items.description: Two feuding business associates fall for each other while escorting a celebrity dog on a Christmas promotional tour.

items.title: A Royal Christmas Ball
items.description: It's a fairy tale come true for Allison, and her daughter, Lily, when Lily's estranged father, Charles, makes a visit to California. Charles may have come on official business, but his real mission is to find Allison and make amends for lost time.

items.title: A Prince for Christmas
items.description: Wanting to escape an arranged marriage, a European prince flees to the United States. There, he meets a struggling young waitress who may just be his one true love.

items.title: A Husband for Christmas
items.description: Two co-workers agree to a loveless marriage of convenience, but as they become acquainted, an unrealized chemistry grows between them.

items.title: A Christmas Mystery
items.description: When a reporter discovers that her late mother had been receiving Christmas cards from a secret admirer, she decides to track him down. In the process, she'll discover a family secret more dangerous than she could have ever imagined.

items.title: A Christmas Cruise
items.description: When her best friend invites her along on a holiday-themed sail, an aspiring novelist unexpectedly finds the love of her life onboard.

items.title: A Christmas Wish
items.description: A heartwarming holiday classic about a family who is down on their luck at Christmas time - and has their fortunes change by a little guardian angel. Now in vibrant color!

items.title: Beyond Christmas
items.description: This charming 1940 holiday classic is prefect for the Christmas season. Restored and in Color for the first time! Every love has a guardian angel.

items.title: Gumby's Christmas Capers
items.description: Join everybody s favorite playmates as they bring a world of Christmas adventure to life in these wonderful, stop-action holiday stories…

items.title: Santa Claus Presents A Children's Christmas
items.description: A Christmas collection designed especially with children in mind. Stories like Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer, The Night Before Chirstmas and more!

items.title: Santa's Magic Toy Bag
items.description: Sherman, an apprentice Elf, tries his best to fit in but can't seem to do anything right! Santa tries to bolster his self-esteem by entrusting him with a special task. From the creator of the character Alf!

items.title: Santa's Christmas Circus
items.description: Whizzo the clown takes a bunch of kids on a magic carpet ride to North Pole to see Santa Claus, but not before the kids perform as circus animals in "Whizzoland."

items.title: Rudolph the Red Nosed Reindeer
items.description: Rudolph the Red Nosed Reindeer is a timeless family holiday classic.

items.title: Entre Nos
items.description: Mariana (Paola Mendoza) is determined to keep her family together. Her children, Gabriel (Sebastian Villada Lopez), 10, and Andrea (Laura Montana Cortez), 6, have grown up in Colombia without their father.

items.title: Old Cats
items.description: Isadora and Enrique live a comfortable life. They have a modest apartment in Santiago's old downtown district. Well into their 80's, they both maintain their independence and live happily with their books, their eclectic art, and their cats.

items.title: Tales from the Organ Trade
items.description: A gritty and unflinching descent into the shadowy world of black-market organ trafficking: the street-level brokers, the rogue surgeons, the impoverished men and women who are willing to sacrifice a slice of their own bodies for a quick payday.

items.title: Battle of the Somme: The True Story
items.description: In 1916, The Battle of the Somme became the bloodiest day in British history. Since then the debate has raged over the only combat footage of the battle. Now a team of investigators uses forensic science to find out the truth.

items.title: The Little Unicorn
items.description: After her favorite mare dies while giving birth on her grandfather's farm, Polly's spirits are lifted when she discovers that the foal is a magical baby unicorn.

items.title: Above All Things
items.description: Bobby just needs to deal with his wife's death, so he retreats to an old family cottage. His grief is disrupted when she comes back to haunt him, forcing him to confront what it really means to live, love, and lose.

items.title: One for the Money
items.description: An expansive and illustrious glimpse into the formative years of rock'n'roll's beginnings, with colorful commentary and exceptional footage of the heroes who pioneered rock from a niche southern tradition to a global phenomenon.

items.title: Mekonen: The Journey of an African Jew
items.description: This film follows the backstory of Mekonen Abebe, a new commander in the Israeli Defense Forces, as he returns to Africa to explore his roots, make peace with his past, and embrace his future in Israel.

items.title: Marilyn and Me
items.description: Robert Slatzer wakes to a phone call explaining that Marilyn Monroe has died. He recounts the story of meeting and immediately hitting it off with Norma Jean Baker as she navigated through the early stages of her acting career.

items.title: Dorothy Dandridge: An American Beauty
items.description: A biography of pioneering black American singer/actress Dorothy Dandridge, featuring clips from her films and interviews with friends and co-workers.

items.title: Pearl Harbor: A Day of Infamy
items.description: December 7th, 1941 Pearl Harbor was attacked by the Empire of Japan. Now the people who were there share their memories of that fateful day.

items.title: What Ever Happened to Baby Jane
items.description: Long-forgotten child star Baby Jane Hudson berates and abuses her wheelchair-bound sister Blanche after Blanche's fame sees a resurgence when her movies are played on TV.

items.title: The Whole Wide World
items.description: Set in the 1930s, a Texas schoolteacher falls in love with pulp writer Robert H. Howard. The two couldn't be more opposite; sharing almost nothing, but their uniquely passionate romance.

items.title: The Passions of Howard Hughes
items.description: Howard was business, but not all business... The Passions of Howard Hughes is a fascinating look at how power, possessions, and personality created a lifetime of passionate affairs with the most desirable women in the world.

items.title: The Last Leprechaun
items.description: Ethel and Tommy reluctantly travel to Ireland to spend the summer with their new stepmother, Laura. They soon realize that she's even more sinister than they had imagined: she's a menacing witch who uses her powers for her own greedy ends.

items.title: Oscar's Black Odyssey: From Hattie to Halle
items.description: This retrospective explores the struggles of African American performers, and their road to winning an Academy Award, during the first 73 years of the Award's existence.

items.title: Dawn On The Great Divide
items.description: Buck Roberts is leading a wagon train of railroad supplies and Jim Corkle and his henchman Loder are out to stop them by using white men dressed as Indians for the attacks.

items.title: Arizona Days
items.description: Tex and sidekick Grass join McGill's traveling show. When Price has McGill's wagons burned, Tex becomes the county tax collector to earn money. This leads to trouble as one of those owing money is Price who says he will not pay.

items.title: Wah-Wah
items.description: Set at the end of the '60s, as Swaziland is about to receive independence from Great Britain, the film follows the young Ralph Compton, at 12, through his parents' traumatic separation, till he's 14. It is written and directed by Richard E Grant.

items.title: National Lampoon's Snatched
items.description: A nice guy goes into the hospital for surgery and through a series of mishaps suffers every man's worst nightmare.

items.title: National Lampoon's Another Dirty Movie
items.description: Two college film students set out to make an homage to Charlie LaRue, not for art or for money. They're doing it to get a hot chick.

items.title: Ephraim's Rescue
items.description: By listening to and following his heart, Ephraim Hanks finds his way in life and eventually provides relief and rescue to the suffering Martin Handcart Company. Based on a true story.

items.title: Bad Ass 3: Bad Asses on the Bayou
items.description: Frank Vega (Danny Trejo) and Bernie Pope (Danny Glover) return, this time to Louisiana, in an attempt to find a kidnapped friend.

items.title: Bad Ass 2: Bad Asses
items.description: Frank Vega (Danny Trejo) teams up with grumpy old agoraphobic Bernie Pope (Danny Glover) to kick ass and clean up the streets of L.A.

items.title: Royal Deceit
items.description: This re-telling of Hamlet goes back to the original Danish source material. The opening scenario remains the same: Hamlet's father murdered by his brother who then weds the widowed mother. Hamlet must discover his strength and leadership that will allow

items.title: Bad Ass
items.description: A Vietnam veteran who becomes a local hero after saving a man from attackers on a city bus decides to take action when his best friend is murdered and the police show little interest in solving the crime.

items.title: Alien Code
items.description: After deciphering a message found in a satellite, brilliant cryptographer Alex Jacobs finds himself being stalked by government agents and otherworldly beings.

items.title: East Side Sushi
items.description: Single mom Juana can slice and dice anything with great speed and precision. After working at a fruit-vending cart for years, she decides to take a job at a local Japanese restaurant.

items.title: Yellow Rose of Texas
items.description: After a band of robbers strike, insurance investigator Roy tries to solve the riddle of the missing money.

items.title: The Trail Beyond
items.description: Rod Drew (John Wayne) is in search of a missing miner and his daughter in this Lone Star Picture. Along the way, Drew rescues his pal Wabbi (Noah Beery Jr.) from card cheats who have framed him for murder.

items.title: The Mystery of the Hooded Horsemen
items.description: Tex is up against a group of hooded outlaws. When he shoots one, he uses the hood to infiltrate the gang. Almost caught by them, he escapes only to be arrested by the Sheriff, who thinks he's one of the gang.

items.title: The Hurricane Express
items.description: When his father is killed in a train wreck, Larry Baker vows to unmask a mysterious criminal called "The Wrecker," who has targeted the L&M Railroad for deadly "accidents."

items.title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
items.description: Roy Rogers finds himself elected U+000Asheriff in a wild Texas town after the Civil War.

items.title: Public Cowboy No. 1
items.description: Gene Autry and Smiley Burnette are back, facing off a new type of criminal who has stolen the latest technologies to outsmart the authorities, including shortwave radios and airplanes!

items.title: Lawless Frontier
items.description: John Wayne stars as John Tobin, who seeks to avenge his parents death, and chase the outlaw who killed them.

items.title: In Old Cheyenne
items.description: Roy Rogers plays a newspaper reporter sent to Cheyenne to investigate a reputed troublemaker. While on the scene, he discovers who the real bad guys are, and sets out to right some wrongs.

items.title: Home in Oklahoma
items.description: Roy Rogers and his gang are all involved in a murder mystery involving the death of a wealthy ranch owner.

items.title: Daniel Boone, Trailblazer
items.description: Daniel Boone (Bruce Bennett) battles Shawnee warriors as he leads a band of settlers into Kentucky.

items.title: Daniel Boone
items.description: In 1775, Daniel Boone leads thirty colonial families to Kentucky, where they face the threats of Native American marauders led by rebel Simon Girty.

items.title: Border Phantom
items.description: Barbara Hartwell is about to be arrested for the murder of her uncle. It's up to Larry O'Day and his sidekick Lucky to find the real killer and clear Barbara of the charges.

items.title: Boots and Saddles
items.description: When a young Englishman inherits a ranch, none other than Gene Autry takes up the challenge of turning the Brit into a real westerner. He convinces the Brit to use the ranch to raise horses, but things quickly grow complicated.

items.title: Billy the Kid Trapped
items.description: Billy (Buster Crabbe) thinks luck is on his side when he and two buddies are rescued from the gallows. Unfortunately, Jim Stanton (Glenn Strange), the boss of Mesa City, plans to frame them for a series of robberies and murders.

items.title: Abilene Town
items.description: Ablaze with guns and guts and glory! Randolph Scott headlines as a star-studded cast in this yarn about battling homesteaders. Director Edwin L. Marin spins this dramatic post-Civil War tale that takes place in the legendary cowtown of Abilene, Kansas.

items.title: Bill & Ted's Bogus Journey
items.description: In this sequel to BILL & TED'S EXCELLENT ADVENTURE, the dimwitted duo travel to Heaven, Hell and points in between as they meet (among others) Albert Einstein, the Easter Bunny and the Grim Reaper.

items.title: John Wayne: Stolen Goods
items.description: A town is repeatedly victimized by "The Polka Dot Bandit" and it's up to the Marshall to save the day. In Vibrant Color!

items.title: John Wayne: Stagecoach Run
items.description: A man runs afoul of the villain who attempts to cheat him out of a lucrative mail delivery contract. In Vibrant Color!

items.title: John Wayne: Guns Along The Trail
items.description: A government agent goes undercover in a traveling medicine show to infiltrate a gang of counterfeiters. In Vibrant Color!

items.title: John Wayne: Gold Strike River
items.description: A tough guy and cranky friend strike it rich on a gold claim and become the target of ruthless assayers. In Vibrant Color!

items.title: John Wayne: Cold Vengeance
items.description: When his father is gunned down by bandits, John Mason (Wayne) hatches a plot to catch the killer. In Vibrant Color!

items.title: John Wayne: An Innocent Man
items.description: Wrongly imprisoned for murder, a man escapes and infiltrates a gang of outlaws to find the real killer. In Vibrant Color!

items.title: Fist of Fury
items.description: A Bruce Lee Classic! Lee plays Chen Zhen, a student of Huo Yuanjia, who fights to defend the honor of the Chinese in the face of foreign aggression, and to bring to justice those responsible for his master's death.

items.title: She
items.description: A group of explorers search for the legendary "flame of life," a mysterious force that bestows immortality. In Vibrant Color designed by Ray Harryhausen!

items.title: Plan 9 from Outer Space
items.description: Aliens from outer space reanimate the Earth's dead in an attempt to save the human race. Ed Wood's cult classic - Restored and In Color!

items.title: Last Man on Earth
items.description: Vincent Price is the only survivor after a plague wipes out the human race, and struggles with loneliness. Restored and In Color!

items.title: Spun
items.description: A drug dealer introduces one of his customers, a 'speed freak', to the man who runs the meth lab. A crazy three-day adventure ensues.

items.title: Hell Town
items.description: In Hell Town (aka Born to the West) John Wayne is back in the saddle as two-fisted Dare Rudd, a roaming cowhand trying to prove he can win a woman's love and outwit a crooked saloon owner.

items.title: The Crime of Father Amaro
items.description: Politics and sexual passions threaten to corrupt a young, newly-ordained priest in a small Mexican town.

items.title: The Hive
items.description: Array

items.title: The Man Who Saved Christmas
items.description: This heartwarming Christmas movie tells the incredible true story of how a disillusioned toy inventor, A.C. Gilbert changes the minds and hearts of Congress when they threaten to cancel the holiday due to WW1.

items.title: Charles Dickens' A Christmas Carol
items.description: Charles Dickens’ classic tale of the stingy Ebenezer Scrooge in a full-length animated musical.

items.title: Colorado
items.description: It’s the Civil War, and the Union needs troops back east to defend itself. Roy Rogers stars as Lieutenant Jerry Burke, who is sent to investigate why the returning troops are being stalled in Colorado.

items.title: Blue Steel (1934)
items.description: Undercover US Marshal John Carruthers (John Wayne) is investigating a rash of robberies by a character known as "The Polka Dot Bandit" in this B-movie gem.

items.title: Greaser's Palace
items.description: A parable based on the life of Christ. This ain't your father's Bible story, full of references about the destruction of the world through massive constipation and a New Mexican setting.

items.title: Barbarosa
items.description: A young cowboy hooks up with a legendary outlaw, and before long both are on the run from the law.

items.title: Tucker: The Man and His Dream
items.description: A car designer goes up against the whole auto industry with his revolutionary car designs.

items.title: The Skeleton Twins
items.description: “Saturday Night Live” alumni Kristen Wiig and Bill Hader reunite as estranged twins Milo and Maggie, who are brought back together after 10 years of being apart.

items.title: The Possession
items.description: When a young girl buys an antique wooden box, she has no idea of the terror living inside—until the malicious spirit takes possession of her in this gripping tale of horror.

items.title: The Brothers Bloom
items.description: The con is on when two swindlers (Adrien Brody, Mark Ruffalo) make an heiress (Rachel Weisz) the target of their next scheme.

items.title: Lovelace
items.description: Follows the life of reluctant porn star Linda Lovelace.
Jack O’Connell is “mesmerizing” (VANITY FAIR) as a British soldier accidentally abandoned on the streets of Belfast in 1971. Alone, he must survive the night within enemy lines.

items.title: Gotta Catch Santa Claus
items.description: Every kid knows that Santa Claus isn’t real. That’s baby stuff, right? Well, not to 12-year-old Trevor. Join him on a mission to catch Santa in this adventure-filled special!

items.title: Bait 3D
items.description: A freak tsunami traps a group of people inside a supermarket, and soon they find they are not alone. Their company, besides each other, is a pack of hungry killer sharks.

items.title: Texas Killing Fields
items.description: In the Texas bayous, a local homicide detective (Worthington) teams up with a cop from New York City (Morgan) to investigate a series of unsolved murders. Based on true events.

items.title: Seeking Justice
items.description: Nicolas Cage (CON AIR) is Will Gerard, a family man whose wife, Laura (January Jones of MAD MEN), is attacked. A stranger, Simon (Guy Pearce of THE KING'S SPEECH) offers revenge on the attacker in exchange for a favor from Will.

items.title: Mary of Nazareth
items.description: In Nazareth in Galilee, at the time of Roman emperor Augustus, lives a simple young woman, Mary, between the love of her parents, of her fiancé Joseph the carpenter, and of her fellow citizens.An angel, tells Mary that she will give birth to a son, Jesus.

items.title: Winter Passing
items.description: Actress Reese Holden has been offered a small fortune by a book editor if she can secure for publication the love letters that her father, a reclusive novelist, wrote to her mother, who has since passed away.

items.title: Trigger Point
items.description: After her father is laid off by a ruthless corporation, college student Callie Banner joins a campus activist group campaigning to prevent the corporation from ruining the lives of countless others.

items.title: The Maiden Heist
items.description: A comedy centered on three museum security guards who devise a plan to steal back the artworks to which they have become attached after they are transferred to another museum.

items.title: The Illusionist
items.description: In turn-of-the-century Vienna, a magician uses his abilities to secure the love of a woman far above his social standing.

items.title: The Accidental Husband
items.description: When talk radio host Emma Lloyd advises one of her listeners to break up with her boyfriend, the jilted ex sets about getting his revenge.

items.title: Shortcut to Happiness
items.description: A down-and-out writer sells his soul to the devil in exchange for fame and fortune.

items.title: Resurrecting the Champ
items.description: An up-and-coming sports reporter rescues a homeless man, only to discover that he is, in fact, a boxing legend believed to have passed away.

items.title: Haven
items.description: Fritz owes money to the dangerous drug dealer Richie Rich and tells him about the fortune Carl has. Along a Friday 13th night, their lives entwine in a chain of tragic events.

items.title: Gray Matters
items.description: They finish each other's sentences, dance like Fred and Ginger and share the same downtown loft--the perfect couple? Not exactly. Gray and Sam, are a sister and brother so compatible and inseparable that people actually assume they are dating.

items.title: Find Me Guilty
items.description: In the late 1980s, a low level gangster named Jackie DiNorscio defends himself in court in what became the longest criminal trial in American judicial history.

items.title: The Snows of Kilimanjaro
items.description: Writer Harry Street reflects on his life as he lies dying from an infection while on safari in the shadow of Mount Kilimanjaro.

items.title: Rise of the Great White Shark
items.description: The Great White Shark. How did it become one of the world's most dominant predators? With spectacular footage and animations, Rise of the Great White Shark takes an in depth look into the specific events and adaptations that help sharks dominate the sea.

items.title: The Dark Side of the Ocean
items.description: The ocean is a vast and powerful realm. At night, billions of strange creatures rise from the deep. One man plans to do what no man has done before; enter the dangerous nighttime world, and attempt to film the hidden secrets of the dark side of the ocean.

items.title: Sherlock Holmes: Prelude to Murder (in Color)
items.description: A trio of music boxes contains the hidden secret to riches, and a group of criminals will kill for them. In Vibrant Color!

items.title: Sherlock Holmes and The Secret Weapon (in Color)
items.description: Kidnappers of the inventor of a new wartime bombsight threaten to sell the invention to the Nazis. In Color!

items.title: Abbott and Costello: Jack and the Beanstalk
items.description: Follow Jack up the beanstalk and into a magical land running rampant with amusing gags and delightful musical numbers.

items.title: La vida útil
items.description: Un empleado de cine se ajusta a su nueva vida después de que el cine en el que trabajó por más de 25 años se ve obligado a cerrar. Subtitulada.

items.title: Whisky
items.description: Una comedia inspirada y hermosamente trágica sobre Jacobo, el dueño de sesenta años de una pequeña y anticuada fábrica de calcetines, es iluminado con detalle inexpresivo, repetitivo y monótono. Subtitulada.

items.title: El fantástico mundo de Juan Orol
items.description: Maestro medio olvidado del cine de bajo presupuesto mexicano, surrealista involuntario Juan Orol, recibe un homenaje en punto en esta irresistible carta de amor a un emprendedor del mundo del espectáculo, cuya carrera se extiende a lo largo de casi

items.title: La vida me mata
items.description: La vida y la muerte vienen envueltos en un abrazo mutuo, tanto absurdo como punzante, en esta inteligente comedia acerca de la inusual amistad entre un director de fotografía en luto y un vagabundo mórbidamente obsesionado. Subtitulada.

items.title: 2 Years of Love
items.description: Samantha has a great marriage, until the pressure to have a baby comes up. Things get tricky when she starts falling for one of her clients, not realizing it is secretly her husband. Will they be able to make it through this rough patch?

items.title: Zapped
items.description: Zoey is having a hard time with her new step-family and new school, but suddenly a dog training app gives her control of all the boys around her.

items.title: The Night Is Young
items.description: In one unexpected night, two pairs of unhappy LA clichés discover new friends, old bars, and a city full of characters.

items.title: Raising the Bar
items.description: Swearing off gymnastics after moving to Australia, Kelly is drawn back in to help a new friend and regains her confidence and love of the sport.

items.title: Cowboys vs. Dinosaurs
items.description: Dinosaurs emerge from the rubble of a mining explosion, and a disgraced bull-rider must lead a group of gunslingers against the rampaging reptiles.

items.title: Beyond Paradise
items.description: Haunted by a tragic past, Shahrzad encounters a passionate and forbidden romance which has the potential to destroy her new life.

items.title: A Fish Tale
items.description: When Emma decides to board a bus for the west coast, she has no idea she’s headed toward her long-lost little sister or that she’s embarking on the magical adventure of a lifetime.

items.title: 10,000 Days
items.description: In the future, Earth has entered a new Ice Age and the survivors are trapped in an epic struggle of life or death.

items.title: 10.0 Earthquake
items.description: Los Angeles is about to be hit by a devastating earthquake, and time is running out to save the city from imminent danger.

items.title: Lila Says
items.description: Two inner-city teenagers engage in an obsessive, innocent flirtation fueled by Lila's sexually explicit overtures.

items.title: Hideous Kinky
items.description: An Englishwoman travels to Morocco with her two young daughters, where they deal with and adjust to the culture and people of the area. Told from the perspective of the youngest daughter, the story provides insight into the Moroccan atmosphere.

items.title: Revealed - Jack the Ripper: Tabloid Killer
items.description: Thanks to his gruesome deeds and chilling nickname, ‘Jack the Ripper’ is the most famous serial killer in history. And he was certainly the first to cause a media sensation when he terrorised the streets of East London back in 1888.

items.title: Prisoner Number A26188: Henia Bryer
items.description: Henia Bryer lost her father, brother and sister during the German occupation, survived four concentration camps including Auschwitz and the Death March and went on to bear witness to the creation of Israel in 1948.

items.title: Alexandria
items.description: Bettany Hughes looks at Alexandria past and present, unearthing archaeological gems and following in the footsteps of Hypatia, the city’s last great female philosopher and guardian of great Library of Alexandria.

items.title: Bride Of The Monster
items.description: Bela Lugosi is a mad scientist who, along with his servant Lobo, attempts to create superhuman mutants. Now in color!

items.title: Under Western Stars
items.description: Roy Rogers debuts in his starring role as the likable cowboy sent to Congress with a mission: let Washington know about the suffering of farmers in the wake of America's 1930s "Dustbowl."

items.title: Sing Cowboy Sing
items.description: Tex and his pal Duke square off against a ruthless gang trying to take over the territory’s freight hauling business.

items.title: Diving with Sharks: The Ultimate Guide
items.description: Filmmakers Emma and Andy Casagrande are on a quest to dive into the ocean with Nature's largest predatory sharks; from the great white as seen in the movie "Jaws" to sleek tigers, in the Caribbean Sea, the Wild Pacific ocean, Hawaii, and the Galapagos.

items.title: El dedo
items.description: Basada en hechos reales, esta encantadora comedia dramática se burla de las costumbres de los pueblos pequeños mientras celebra verdaderos valores democráticos. Subtitulada.

items.title: Regresa
items.description: Una mujer en la ciudad de México tiene problemas maritales y consulta a un terapeuta. Despierta de una hipnosis pensando que es una princesa vasca del siglo XV. Subtitulada en inglés.

items.title: Red Bull Romaniacs: The World's Toughest Hard Enduro Rallye
items.description: Because it has to be done. Welcome to the world of survival of the fittest on a dirt bike. Now in its sixth year, the Red Bull Romaniacs Hard Enduro Rallye has become synonymous with the word extreme.

items.title: Red Bull: Last Man Standing
items.description: Each year thousands descend upon Bulcher Texas, population six, to witness an extreme motocross race like no other. The event is called Last Man Standing and it’s just that, an all day battle on a dirt bike against some of the most brutal terrain known.

items.title: Red Bull Romaniacs: The 7th Edition
items.description: Let the games Begin! Deep in the heart of Transylvania, a mighty Extreme Enduro race exists. It's called the Red Bull Romaniacs Hard Enduro Rallye and it is pure madness on a dirtbike.

items.title: Red Bull Romaniacs: 5th Edition
items.description: The worlds toughest hard enduro rally. Hundreds of the finest extreme motocross riders stand on guard in front of the Carpathian Mountains of Romania.

items.title: Niall Horan: Inside Out
items.description: Niall Horan first rose to fame in 2010 when he auditioned as a solo artist on the British X factor. His X Factor journey led him on a path that would see him become a member of the boy band One Direction.

items.title: The Story of Rod Stewart
items.description: Rod Stewart's incredible career spans 5 decades and encompasses a string of number one albums and hit singles. With over 100 million records sold worldwide, Stewart ranks among the best selling artists of all time and with good reason.

items.title: The Kings of Yorktown
items.description: Ed and Richard are brothers. They’re also con artists. Not incredibly successful ones, but they get by. Ed’s the leader. Richard’s a bit slow. Their old pal Henry, who used to work with them, gave up the con life to work as a security guard.

items.title: Taylor Swift: Superstar
items.description: The singer-songwriter completed her transition from country star to pop superstar with the launch of her 5th studio album ‘1989’, the top album release of 2014 with over 3.5 million copies sold worldwide.

items.title: Red Bull Romaniacs 8
items.description: After his professional snowboarding career ended, Martin Freinademetz took to his passion to the world of Off-road racing. After spending years exploring the Carpathian mountains of Romania on a dirtbike, he decided to create an Extreme Enduro race.

items.title: Cheryl Cole: Northern Star
items.description: She's one of the most recognizable faces in the world of music today. After an amazing success with Girls Aloud, Cheryl became a star in her own right. Through fights in her personal life and her internal struggles, Cheryl has always came through.

items.title: Carrie Underwood: Country Idol
items.description: We are taken on a journey of Carrie Underwood’s fast track trip to superstardom. The multi award winning singer/songwriter came to fame from American Idol in 2005. She has now become one of the most popular female performers in country music.

items.title: Bruce Springsteen: On the Road
items.description: Coming from a poor background in New Jersey, Bruce Springsteen grew to become one of the most recognizable faces in rock music. Having released classic albums such as Born in the U.S.A and Born to Run, Bruce Springsteen's music is legendary.

items.title: The Story of the Rolling Stones
items.description: The Rolling Stones are one of the greatest and most influential rock bands of our time having sold in excess of 200 million records worldwide. This fascinating programme tells the story of the early days of the band and how they became The Stones.

items.title: Streetball
items.description: In Cape Town, there are two realities. Sixteen years after the end of apartheid, South Africa prepares to host the FIFA World Cup and the country is ripe with celebration. New hot spots, airports and stadiums were built to welcome travelers.

items.title: New Year
items.description: On Christmas Eve, Jason, Allison, and Peter witness a robbery, which culminates with Allison’s life being threatened at gunpoint. Jason is kicked out by his parents and must deal with Allison’s subsequent withdrawal and depression.

items.title: Adele: Someone Like Me
items.description: At such a young age Adele has received iconic status from fans and industry professionals alike. With sold out concerts around the world and multiple awards to her name Adele came from humble beginnings and has gone on to be one of the biggest Artists.

items.title: David Bowie: On the Rock Trail
items.description: Some say that youth is wasted on the young, but this could never be said of Rock icon David Bowie. His distinctive music, exotic appearance and wild boy lifestyle defined an entire generation through the glamorous, hedonistic 1970s.

items.title: Sin Memoria
items.description: Al despertarse un dia sin ningun tipo de memoria, Beto se embarca en una misión para descifrar la verdad sobre su pasado, con algunos descubrimientos impactantes en el camino.

items.title: 1000 Waves to Surfing Glory - Pop up Edition
items.description: This special edition travel film has pop-up bubbles containing trivia and witticisms throughout the movie. Explore your surfing dreams in Fiji, Mexico, and Chile and learn new and interesting facts about the places and surfers.

items.title: Minecraft: Into the Nether
items.description: Minecraft. The game that took the world by storm. Follow the story of how the Minecraft phenomenon has ploughed through the 21st century selling over 54 million copies worldwide on a multitude of platforms engaging an audience in the millions.

items.title: Rihanna: No Regrets
items.description: She has been referred to as one of the most powerful celebrities of our time and has been characterised as one of the most influential people in the world.

items.title: Tim Mcgraw: Southern Man
items.description: At 50 years old, Tim McGraw is still up in the game. With a number one album in 2013, two decades after the release of his debut album in 2013, two decades after the release of his debut album,and alongside his US tour.

items.title: Dr. Dre: Another Beat
items.description: Music producer, Apple executive and N.W.A. rapper recently announced that he would be releasing his first album since 1999, featuring guests such as Eminem, Kendrick Lamar, Ice Cube, Snoop Dogg amongst many others.

items.title: Kylie Minogue: Showtime
items.description: Kylie Minogue has been a household name for over the last three decades. The Australian bombshell has become a symbol for female independence. She is a true showbiz product and an incredibly successful woman.

items.title: Led Zeppelin: On the Rock Trail
items.description: When glam-rock took over the 70s music scene, Led Zeppelin danced to their own tune. Turning out wilder, raunchier and more powerful sounds on Rock classics like “Stairway to Heaven” and “Whole Lotta Love”.

items.title: First Snow
items.description: A psychic's ominous reading sends a man into a tailspin.

items.title: Can't Stand Losing You: Surviving the Police
items.description: A documentary about the rise of The Police.

items.title: The Assassination of a High School President
items.description: At a Catholic high school, the popular girl teams up with a sophomore newspaper reporter to investigate a case of stolen SAT exams. Once the duo target their suspects, a larger conspiracy is unearthed.

items.title: A Second Chance
items.description: A young girl and her coach overcome adversity to make their way into the National Australian Gymnastics Squad.

items.title: The Flying Deuces
items.description: Oliver is heartbroken when he finds that Georgette, the inkeeper's daughter he's fallen in love with, is already married to dashing Foreign Legion officer Francois. To forget her, he joins the Legion, taking Stanley with him.

items.title: Suddenly
items.description: In the city of Suddenly, three gangsters trap the Benson family in their own house, on the top of a hill nearby the railroad station, with the intention of killing the president of the USA.

items.title: Detour
items.description: Chance events trap hitch-hiker Al Roberts in a tightening net of film noir trouble.

items.title: The Man With The Golden Arm
items.description: A strung-out junkie deals with a demoralizing drug addiction while his crippled wife and card sharks pull him down.

items.title: DOA
items.description: Frank Bigelow, told he's been poisoned and has only a few days to live, tries to find out who killed him and why.

items.title: At War With The Army
items.description: Alvin Corwin is low man on the totem pole, and goes from one mishap to another at an army training camp in World War II.

items.title: The Strange Love of Martha Ivers
items.description: A man is reunited with his childhood friend and her husband, who believe he knows the truth about the death of her rich aunt years earlier.

items.title: Material Witness
items.description: The FBI suspects’ fraudulent business practices are linked to the mysterious disappearance of Candor Diamond Corporation president, Irwin Margolies. Weeks after Margolies turns up and begins cooperating with authorities.

items.title: The Longest Yard (1974)
items.description: In this rough-and tumble movie, actually filmed on-location at the Georgia State Prison, the cons are the heroes and the guards are the heavies.

items.title: North Dallas Forty
items.description: In a society in which major league sporting events have replaced Sunday worship as the religion of choice, North Dallas Forty appears like a desecration at the altar.

items.title: High Noon
items.description: Gary Cooper won the Oscar for Best Actor in this classic tale of a lawman who stands alone to defend a town of cowardly citizens against a gang of revenge-seeking criminals.

items.title: Chaplin
items.description: Directed by Sir Richard Attenborough and starring Robert Downey, Jr. and an extraordinary cast, CHAPLIN is a loving, grand scale portrait of the Little Tramp’s amazing life and times.

items.title: Bugsy Malone
items.description: Set in 1929 New York City, Bugsy Malone captures a flashy world of would-be hoodlums, showgirls, and dreamers - all played by child actors!

items.title: Anomalisa
items.description: Michael Stone - husband, father and noted author - travels to Cincinnati to speak at a customer service conference. But once he’s separated from the routine of his daily life, a chance encounter helps him to realize just what, and whom, he’s been missing.

items.title: Izzie's Way Home
items.description: A constantly picked-on aquarium fish escapes her yacht home, unaware of the dangers that await her in the open ocean. With the help of other misfit sea creatures, she learns not only how to brave the perils of the deep, but how to be true to herself.

items.title: Princess and the Pony
items.description: A sheltered young princess is sent to live with relatives in America, where she befriends a pony held captive by a shady carnival owner.

items.title: Alpha House
items.description: When the biggest party frat on campus (ALPHA HOUSE) is forced by the assistant dean to share their house with a sorority or face ejection from school, the boys wage an epic battle of the sexes to fight for their right to party.

items.title: Locked Up
items.description: When an American teenager gets bullied at her school in Southeast Asia, she fights back--and gets sent to a reform school. But the “school” is more like a prison, and the young teenager must fend off predatory guards and menacing gangs to survive.

items.title: Flight 666
items.description: Passengers and crew on an international flight are attacked by unseen forces that threaten all aboard and on the ground below them.

items.title: Atlantic Rim: Resurrection
items.description: Mech-bots, with even bigger and badder weapons than their predecessors, attempt to stop bio-mechanical monsters from descending on LA. But the monsters are strong too, leaving the pilots of the mech-bots scrambling to defeat the creatures.

items.title: Bound
items.description: Caesar’s a guy who launders money for the mob. What’s the last thing that would come between a sleazy wise guy like Caesar and that money? A couple of women with brains to die for and bodies to match.

items.title: The Iceman of Oetz Valley
items.description: Enter the mystery of the world's most investigated man - Otzi, an Austrian from the Alps whose corpse was uncovered in 1991, thousands of years after his death. Using modern technology, Kurt Mundl and his team of scientists examine Otzi for a glimpse.

items.title: Sleep Easy, Hutch Rimes
items.description: Small town insurance man and lovable lothario finds himself in the middle of a murder plot when he agrees to help one of his lovers kill her abusive husband.

items.title: Troy
items.description: Throughout time, men have waged war. Some for power, some for glory, some for honor ... and some for love.

items.title: Speed Racer
items.description: The Wachowski Brothers bring a classic anime to the big screen: Matthew Fox, John Goodman, Christina Ricci, and Susan Sarandon star with Emile Hirsch as Speed Racer!

items.title: Do Women Have A Higher Sex Drive?
items.description: For years men have thought women had a lower sexdrive? Can men be proven wrong again? The film explores the the scientific, historical, biological and social aspects behind the female sex drive and female gaze.

items.title: Dr. Feelgood
items.description: The story of Dr. William Hurwitz - a preeminent pain specialist sentenced to 25 years in prison - provides a window into the ethical dilemma of prescription painkillers.

items.title: Killer Bees
items.description: Produced by Shaquille O'Neal, Killer Bees tells the story of the legendary Bridgehampton High basketball team that wins titles while battling racism, gentrification and absurd income inequality in The Hamptons.

items.title: Bigfoot Encounters
items.description: Many believe Bigfoot does not exist but for those who have seen the creature face to face, there is no question.

items.title: Ancient Alien America
items.description: Native cultures have handed down shocking accounts for generations of Aliens from other worlds visiting Earth in the ancient past and their involvement with them.

items.title: An Artificial Reality
items.description: Big Brother knows everything, manipulates our emotions, manipulates our way of thinking and controls the masses. This is our new reality.

items.title: All At Once
items.description: A young artist in New York City accepts guardianship of his best friends' daughters after they perish on September 11, 2001. Eleven years later, he returns to his hometown to raise the two girls.

items.title: Afterlife
items.description: Is death the end? New research reveals a new world after this life that we can only imagine.

items.title: The Out-of-Towners (1999)
items.description: Neil Simon comedy that follows a couple's mishaps as they travel to New York for a job interview. A series of comedic disasters follows that might make one think twice before visiting the Big Apple.

items.title: Remarkable Women of the 20th Century
items.description: Celebrate 100 years of amazing progress made by remarkable women from all over the world in politics, sports, and the arts. Meet such heroic figures as Hilary Clinton, Eleanor Roosevelt, Rosa Parks, and other great women!

items.title: Me late chocolate
items.description: Después de que su prometido muere inesperadamente, una mujer decide aceptar la vida y seguir su sueño de trabajar con chocolate.

items.title: Leprechaun 2 (ESP)
items.description: El pequeño y malvado irlandés vuelve a causar estragos sangrientos en su interminable búsqueda por compañía femenina en esta secuela de LEPRECHAUN de 1993.

items.title: Amor, dolor & viceversa
items.description: Una película de crimen y suspenso sobre sueños inquietantes que se convierten en realidad para dos personas.

items.title: Bella
items.description: Tarde o temprano todos debemos enfrentar un momento irreversible que cambiará nuestras vidas para siempre. Si aún no te ha pasado... pronto sucederá. BELLA es una historia de amor verdadero sobre cómo un día en la ciudad de Nueva York.

items.title: Enfermiza obsesión
items.description: Cuando una amistad se convierte en obsesión, una enfermera desata una ola de terror.

items.title: Leprechaun (ESP)
items.description: Jennifer Aniston hizo su debut de cine en esta historia de terror acerca de un duende psicótico de seis siglos de antigüedad en una ola de asesinatos a través de Dakota del Norte.

items.title: The Many Faces of Dracula
items.description: The image of the infamous Dracula has become a staple of fictional narrative mastery, with its connections to the horror genre withstanding the test of time. Take an inside glance at the variant and various performers who have portrayed the character.

items.title: The Grave
items.description: While working in a prison yard, two convicts overhear an urban legend of a local millionaire who was buried with his fortune. They break out and enlist the help of friends to help them find the treasure. But they're not the only ones.

items.title: Liquid Bridge
items.description: Surfer Nick McCallum refrains from going pro in order to appease his dad, Bob, who was left permanently handicapped after a surfing accident. When Bob struggles to keep his business afloat, Nick independently enters a surfing competition to try to help.

items.title: Girl
items.description: Andrea Marr, a Portland teenager, is seduced by the city’s underground rock scene and gets involved with a local singer. A raw portrayal of a young woman’s self-discovery featuring Tara Reid, Portia de Rossi, Adam Scott and Selma Blair.

items.title: The UnPerfect Crime
items.description: The employees of a North Carolina armored car company fantasized about it all the time: what would it take to steal millions of dollars stashed in the company vault? But for one such employee, the dream became a reality...

items.title: The Boneyard (2000)
items.description: The discovery of a secret concrete bunker in the California Mountains launches a massive investigation into the bizarre world of two men obsessed with kidnapping, sexual enslavement and murder.

items.title: Escape From Death Row
items.description: Mecklenburg Penitentiary's Death Row is considered "escape proof". The men housed there are serial murderers and rapists. But on a cold spring night in 1984, six of them got out....

items.title: Dangerous Company
items.description: The life of an international drug trafficker is seedy and extremely dangerous, and exactly the kind of life a couple of Kentucky bluebloods decided to lead. They decided to team up to form “The Company,”

items.title: Angel of Death
items.description: Efren Saldivar always preferred the graveyard shift at Glendale Adventist Medical Center, where he worked as a respiratory therapist. It was during the late hours of the night, when Saldivar would inject his patients with a drug.

items.title: Bee Nation
items.description: Bee Nation follows the inspirational stories of Indigenous youth living on reserves in Saskatchewan as they participate in the first-ever First Nations Provincial Spelling Bee in Canada.

items.title: Under California Stars
items.description: Rancher Roy and his boys track down a gang who have stolen Trigger and are holding him for ransom.

items.title: Divina confusión
items.description: Comedia mexicana llena de estrellas donde el amor de hoy en día recibe un empujoncito por parte de poderes de lo más alto.

items.title: The Return of Swamp Thing
items.description: NEW HD TRANSFER. Everyone's favorite muck-encrusted plant-man falls in love with Dr. Arcane's sexy daughter and must rescue her from her father's nefarious and murderous plans.

items.title: The Riddle of Pompeii
items.description: This film reveals the terrible truth of what happened to the people of Pompeii. Building on cutting edge scientific theories and using very high production values to create beautiful dramatic reconstructions, it finally solves the riddle of Pompeii.

items.title: One Killer Punch
items.description: One Killer Punch explores the phenomenon of a one punch kill, a single hit that can have dire consequences.

items.title: The Entity
items.description: Throughout time and across cultures the entity: a dark, mysterious nocturnal visitation, has roamed. Its footsteps deliberate, its breathing loud and slow. And it comes in one of only three forms: as a shadowman, an old hag or a child-like demon.

items.title: 20 Kids and Counting
items.description: A super-sized holiday in the USA for a super-sized family!

items.title: Long Island Railroad Massacre
items.description: On December 7, 1993 a crazed gunman shot twenty-five people on the LIRR, killing six. This is the worst crime in New York history prior to the 9-11 attacks.

items.title: Living Dolls
items.description: This acclaimed doc explores the subculture of doll collecting. Portraying such collectors as a woman who spends big money to build her collection, a Barbie aficionado who never left his home, and a man involved romantically with a doll, "Living Dolls".

items.title: The Huntresses
items.description: When a mysterious assassin begins killing off royal messengers, three female bounty hunters, the Huntresses, are sent to foil the sinister plot. With a large reward on the table, Jin-ok, Hong-dan and Ga-bi team up to bring an end to the murders.

items.title: Scarlet Woman: The True Story of Mary Magdalene
items.description: Faith and art history cross paths in this documentary. Explore the artistic influence of Mary Magdalene, and how her image and story inspired artists such as Giotto, Caravaggio, Titian, Cezanne and Van Gogh.

items.title: My Wife is a Gangster 3
items.description: When Aryong, the daughter of a powerful triad boss, is accused of killing a rival gangster, she's forced into hiding. Hijinks ensue when Gi-chul and his bumbling crew are assigned to protect Aryong from danger.

items.title: Sinbad and the War of the Furies
items.description: On a treasure hunt gone wrong, modern-day adventurer Sinbad accidentally releases the Furies, three beautiful but terrible ancient beings powerful enough to threaten life on Earth.

items.title: In the Name of Ben Hur
items.description: A young gladiator enslaved in the Roman arena in 171 A.D. escapes by chariot towards the freedom of Hadrian's Wall. Fighting centurions and mercenaries along the way, he becomes a folk hero for all those struggling to fight Roman oppression.

items.title: Ghosthunters
items.description: When one of their own loses his wife and daughter at the hands of a serial killer, a team of ghost hunters is determined to capture the spirits of the loved ones so their spirits can finally rest in peace.

items.title: Oceans Rising
items.description: A scientist builds a massive ark after his warnings of an Earth-destroying flood are ignored. But when it’s evident the disaster will occur, those who maligned the scientist now turn to him in desperation, boarding the ark and seeking his answers.

items.title: King Arthur and the Knights of the Round Table
items.description: In medieval England, Merlin and King Arthur banish the evil enchantress Morgana and her son Mordred to the ends of the universe as Morgana vows revenge.

items.title: Jurassic School
items.description: Nerdy middle schooler Tommy is forced take care of a baby dinosaur after his cloned science fair project hatches early. He quickly begins to think of the creature not only as a pet, but also as a friend.

items.title: Code of Silence
items.description: In the late 1990’s, New England is hit by a crime wave, netting millions for a gang of sophisticated thieves. Though the FBI suspects the gang is based in Charlestown, Massachusetts, nobody in the quiet Boston will talk to police or the FBI.

items.title: Boys of H Company
items.description: In the war in the Pacific, Iwo Jima was crucial to the U.S. as an air base for long- range bombing missions against mainland Japan. The Japanese knew the island’s importance and spent years “digging in” in preparation for the inevitable U.S. attack.

items.title: The Search For Dracula
items.description: Many historians and archaeologist today feel that there is much factual evidence as folklore that points to the possible existence of vampires. Filmed on location in Romania, Canada and the United States.

items.title: Mercenaries
items.description: When a visiting dignitary is captured and imprisoned while touring a war zone, a team of elite female commandoes is assembled to infiltrate the women's prison and rescue her.

items.title: Yes: 35th Anniversary Concert - Songs from Tsongas
items.description: The classic Yes line-up perform a live concert on May 15, 2004 during their 35th Anniversary Tour. Featuring an interview with Roger Dean.

items.title: Toto: Falling in Between - Live in Paris
items.description: This 2007 concert, recorded in front of a sold-out crowd at Le Zenith in Paris, captures Toto rocking at their hardest and most powerful.

items.title: The Hollies: Look Through Any Window 1963-1975
items.description: This documentary explores the peak years of one of the most successful British pop-rock groups of the '60s and early '70s, The Hollies.

items.title: The Everly Brothers: Reunion Concert
items.description: The American rock 'n' roll duo The Everly Brothers perform their reunion concert at London's Royal Albert Hall in September 1983.

items.title: Classic Albums: Steely Dan's Aja
items.description: "Aja" was the biggest selling album of Steely Dan's career, reaching #3 on the U.S. Billboard chart. This is a portrait of the making of the 1977 jazz-rock album.

items.title: Classic Albums: Grateful Dead's Anthem of the Sun/American Beauty
items.description: This documentary is about the making of two classic Grateful Dead albums: 1968's "Anthem of the Sun" and 1970's "American Beauty."

items.title: Classic Albums: Deep Purple's Machine Head
items.description: This classic album features the seminal song "Smoke on the Water," which brought worldwide superstardom to Deep Purple, putting them at the peak of hard rock.

items.title: Alice Cooper: Live at Montreux 2005
items.description: Known for his ability to merge exhilarating hard rock with darkly theatrical stage shows, Alice Cooper reaches new heights in this July 2005 performance at the Montreux Festival.

items.title: Classic Albums: Don McLean's American Pie
items.description: This series focuses on the albums that have influenced the course of music. This edition looks at Don McLean's album "American Pie", crowned by its titular overture and the song Vincent.

items.title: Classic Albums: Duran Duran's Rio
items.description: A look at the behind-the-scenes creation of the iconic Duran Duran album "Rio," released in 1982.

items.title: Classic Albums: Frank Zappa's Apostrophe/Over-Nite Sensation
items.description: This behind-the-scenes film tells the story of the recording of Frank Zappa's solo album "Apostrophe (') and the Mothers of Invention's "Over-Nite Sensation."

items.title: Classic Albums: Motorhead's Ace of Spades
items.description: All the band members discuss life in the feisty and debauched world of Motorhead, and the band plays some of their legendary tracks specially for the documentary.

items.title: Classic Albums: The Who's Who's Next
items.description: A look at the production of The Who's critically acclaimed fifth release, “Who’s Next,” which became their first and only album to top the UK album chart.

items.title: Dream Theater: Live at Luna Park
items.description: This live concert footage of legendary rock band Dream Theater was filmed at Luna Park Stadium in Buenos Aires, Argentina, supporting their album, "A Dramatic Turn of Events."

items.title: Jeff Beck: Live in Tokyo
items.description: Filmed at the Tokyo Dome City Hall in 2014, "Live in Tokyo" captures the best of guitar legend Jeff Beck. This performance features new music and Beck's new backing band.

items.title: Jeff Beck: Performing This Week Live at Ronnie Scott's
items.description: This special captures the unique experience of Jeff Beck in concert at Ronnie Scott's Jazz Club. The setlist features classic tracks and guest appearances by Joss Stone and Eric Clapton.

items.title: Jeff Beck: Rock 'n' Roll Party Honoring Les Paul
items.description: This music special features Jeff Beck and other musicians as they honor the late, great Les Paul.

items.title: Bully (2001)
items.description: Acclaimed director Larry Clark delivers his most powerful film since KIDS. Marty (Brad Renfro) is a tormented surfer who, despite vicious abuse, relies on his longtime pal, Bobby (Nick Stahl), for rides to the beach and local South Florida bars.

items.title: Arena: Produced by George Martin
items.description: This profile of legendary music producer Sir George Martin, with the help of his son Giles and wife Judy, contains contributions from Sir Paul McCartney, Ringo Starr, Michael Palin, and Cilla Black.

items.title: His Girl Friday
items.description: A newspaper editor uses every trick in the book to keep his ace reporter ex-wife from remarrying.

Daring and undone. Describing both the film’s style and main character, 1/1 puts you into the mind of Lissa, as she grapples with sex, drugs, love and loss. When both Lissa and the film's structure mature, she finds a brighter path ahead.

items.title: The Soloist
items.description: A Los Angeles newspaper reporter discovers a brilliant and distracted street musician, with unsinkable passion, and a unique friendship and bond transforms both their lives.

items.title: The Peacemaker
items.description: When a train carrying atomic warheads crashes in the Soviet Union, nuclear specialist Dr. Kelly discovers the accident is really part of a plot to cover up the theft of the weapons.

items.title: The Mexican
items.description: A man tries to transport an ancient gun called The Mexican, believed to carry a curse, back across the border, while his girlfriend pressures him to give up his criminal ways.

items.title: The Legend of Bagger Vance
items.description: A disillusioned war veteran, Rannulph Junah, agrees to play a game of golf. He finds the game futile until his caddy, Bagger Vance, teaches him the secret of the authentic golf stroke.

items.title: The Golden Child
items.description: As ‘The Chosen One’, Murphy’s on a madcap mission to save The Golden Child, a youth with mystical powers who’s been abducted by an evil cult.

items.title: The Duchess
items.description: Chronicles the life of 18th century aristrocrat Georgiana, Duchess of Devonshire, an ancestor of Princess Di.

items.title: The Doors
items.description: Jim Morrison, one of the most sensual figures in the history of rock and roll, explodes on the screen in “THE DOORS,” the electrifying movie about a time called the sixties and a legendary outlaw who rocked America’s consciousness – forever.

items.title: How She Move
items.description: How She Move is an energetic and inspiring coming of age tale about a young woman step dances her heart out to achieve her dreams.

items.title: Explorers
items.description: In their makeshift laboratory, three boys use an amazing discovery and their ingenuity to build their own spaceship and launch themselves on a fantastic interplanetary journey.

items.title: Evolution
items.description: A firefighting cadet, two college professors, and a geeky-but-sexy government scientist work against an alien organism that has been rapidly evolving ever since its arrival on Earth inside a meteor.

items.title: Election
items.description: Reese Witherspoon plays Tracy Flick, a straight-A go-getter determined to be president of Carver High’s student body. Popular teacher Jim McAllister (Broderick) decides to derail Tracy’s obsessive overachieving by recruiting an opposition candidate.

items.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (2014)
items.description: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

items.title: VHS Lives: A Shlockumentary
