items.description: The VHS era rose quickly in the early 70's only to die off with the advent of the DVD in the early 2000s. But VHS is rising from the ashes like a Phoenix, being relived and retooled by the most dedicated fanbase of its kind.

items.title: UFO Chronicles: The Black Programs
items.description: Researcher Michael Schratt claims to have had first-hand experience with classified "Black Programs". Explore the ramifications of the alien presence on earth.

items.title: To the Moon and Back
items.description: The political murder of a Moscow lawyer, an American father’s tragic mistake and the cancellation of 259 pending U.S. adoptions of Russian orphans are seemingly disparate events found to have an insidious connection in this chilling expose.

items.title: The Sax Man
items.description: An aging, down-and-out street musician finds renewed purpose when he gets a surprise opportunity to play the big stage for the first time in 40 years.

items.title: The Ring Thing
items.description: When Sarah accidentally proposes to her girlfriend in Provincetown, the mixup turns their loving relationship into a minefield of marital exploration.

items.title: The Midnighters
items.description: An aging ex-con recently released from prison is asked to put his life on the line to save his son from a deadly debt.

items.title: Spitfire: The Plane that saved the World
items.description: Spitfire is the epic tale of the world's most famous fighter plane, told by the last surviving veterans who flew her in the white heat of combat. Some say she saved the world, and today she is an international icon.

items.title: PreCrime
items.description: Science fiction turns into disturbing fact as forecasting softwares, algorithms and databases quickly become the new fortune-tellers for future crimes, driving us to ask: how much are we willing to abandon for the sake of security?

items.title: New Chefs on the Block
items.description: Two chefs in DC struggle to open their first restaurants. Against all odds, one becomes the most famous new chef in America. Starring Aaron Silverman (Rose's Luxury) and Frank Linn (Frankly...Pizza!). Feat. Michel Richard & Danny Meyer.

items.title: Bad Blood
items.description: Everything in Lauren's life changes when the police come knocking on her door. and arrest her for murder. What Lauren doesn't know is that a serial killer has developed an obsession with her. And that he has an exact match for her DNA.

items.title: Even Money
items.description: Gambling addiction bring the stories of three otherwise unconnected people together as it destroys each of their lives.

items.title: The Big Short
items.description: Based on the true story of four outsiders who saw what the big banks, media, and government refused to: the global collapse of the economy. A bold investment leads them into the dark underbelly of banking, where everyone and everything is in question.

items.title: Locked Away
items.description: A high school senior seeks help from a pregnancy counselor who exploits the situation for her own gain.

items.title: Next Stop Murder
items.description: A woman discusses her family problems with a stranger she meets on a bus, but is horrified when her confidante suggests each of them kill the person making the other's life difficult.

items.title: Pitching Tents
items.description: A mysterious goddess, a vulgar guidance counselor and a no-nonsense father all want to help Danny figure out his future while he sneaks off to the woods with his buddies for a weekend of girls, beer and THE party of 1984.

items.title: Smother
items.description: After being fired from his job, an everyday guy faces pressure from his wife about having a baby, while having to deal with his suffocating mother, who has decided to move in with the couple.

items.title: The Real St. Nick
items.description: A pretty psychiatrist is saved from an accident by a man who, after hitting his head on a rock, believes he is Santa Claus. As she nurses him back to health at her institute, he brings the spirit of Christmas to the hospital.

items.title: The English Teacher
items.description: Julianne Moore stars as an English teacher who has her life turned upside down when a former student returns to town. Also starring Greg Kinnear and Nathan Lane.

items.title: Alone in the Dark 2
items.description: When the night falls, and the creatures of the dark are crawling out of the shadows, there is only one man who stands between us and evil: Edward Carnby.

items.title: A Brave Heart: The Lizzie Velasquez Story
items.description: A Brave Heart: The Lizzie Velasquez Story follows the inspiring journey of 26-year-old, 58-pound Lizzie from cyber-bullying victim to anti-bullying activist.

items.title: A Century of Black Cinema
items.description: This film highlights moments in the long and rich African American cinema history in relation to social and political events, and how it affected black viewers of the time.

items.title: Little Shop of Horrors
items.description: Seymour — an orphan and a nerd who works in a run-down flower shop on Skid Row — spends his time doing menial tasks and dreaming of his co-worker, Audrey. Then, one day, just after an eclipse of the sun, Seymour discovers a strange plant.

items.title: Risky Business
items.description: Meet Joel Goodsen, an industrious college-bound seventeen-year-old, a responsible and trustworthy son ... Meet Lana, young, hot, exquisite and street-smart.

items.title: Dunkirk: The Battle for France
items.description: This is a dramatized documentary about the evacuation of the British Expeditionary Force from Dunkirk in May 1940.

items.title: Hitler's Secret Weapons
items.description: Against a backdrop of the campaigns which led to his defeat, this film shows spectacular archive footage of Hitler's secret armory as it was being developed, tested and when it was too late, used in anger.

items.title: Hitler's War Part 1: 1940-1943
items.description: This account of Adolf Hitler's rise to power in Germany — and the subsequent downfall of the Nazi regime — is told with real footage taken from the period.

items.title: Killing Hitler: The True Story of the Valkyrie Plot
items.description: Driven by their hatred of Hitler and a desperate desire to keep the war out of Germany, Klaus von Stauffenberg and his co-conspirators hatched a plan that would have brought World War II to an end.

items.title: Signs: A Warning?
items.description: Our most sophisticated technology has yet to explain the appearance of the mysterious crop circles of England. Is it possible that these intricate creations are the work of beings from another world?

items.title: Take Me Home The John Denver Story
items.description: The chronicles the ups and downs of the professional and personal life of the world renowned singer John Denver. A story of triumph, anguish, success and a life of great potential, spiraling out of control.

items.title: Santa and Pete
items.description: It's the first Christmas without Grandma and a difficult time for the family, until Grandpa decides to share a story with his ten-year-old grandson Terence.

items.title: Warrior (LAS)
items.description: Warrior narra la historia de la familia Conlon, Brendan (Joel Edgerton), Tommy (Tom Hardy) y Paddy (Nick Nolte), quienes encuentran redención en la arena al luchar para remendarse a sí mismos y a su familia.

items.title: Al calor de las armas
items.description: Dos criminales secuestran a la mujer equivocada.

items.title: The Last Exorcism (LAS)
items.description: Un predicador carismático que se prepara para realizar un 'exorcismo' rutinario en un fanático religioso encuentra un verdadero mal más allá de todo lo que había imaginado.

items.title: Virago Women: Birth of the Women's Liberation Movement
items.description: Despite the ‘free-love’ mantra of the 1960s, many women found that their lives had barely altered. But, by the 1970s, the Women’s Liberation Movement was causing seismic shifts in world events and women’s creativity. Things began to change in 1973.

items.title: Pearl Islands: The Story of Bahrain's Natural Gems
items.description: Since 4000 BC the pearl has been revered as a treasure. As man's quest for the gem escalated, the islands of Bahrain became known as the source of the world's best pearls.

items.title: Muerte en la montaña
items.description: Un día típico en las laderas se convierte en una escalofriante pesadilla para tres amigos que pretenden patinar en la nieve cuando se quedan varados en la telesilla antes de su última bajada.

items.title: Missile To The Moon (in Color)
items.description: Escaped cons stowaway on a flight to the moon and discover alien women ruled by a sadistic queen. In Vibrant Color!

items.title: The Phantom Planet (in Color)
items.description: An astronaut investigates a mysterious asteroid and is shrunk down to the size of its tiny inhabitants. In Vibrant Color!

items.title: What's With Wheat
items.description: What's With Wheat?' is a hard hitting investigation into the growing epidemic of wheat & gluten intolerance, and why after eating wheat for thousands of years, it has been linked to so many health problems.

items.title: Cowboys Don't Cry
items.description: Josh Morgan and his son Shane struggle to make ends meet - and to accept a tragic past that haunts them — as bull riders on the rodeo circuit.

items.title: Black Fox
items.description: This wild Western tells of Alan Johnson (Christopher Reeve, "Superman") and his friend whom he freed from slavery as they settle with their families in Texas in the 1860s and begin a new life.

items.title: Living Forever
items.description: For millennia, mankind has sought the mythical substance known as the "Elixir of Life". The allure of immortality has changed the course of world power. Shocking new research reveals a clandestine secret hidden for centuries.

items.title: Little Stones
items.description: From a graffiti artist protesting domestic violence in Brazil to a dancer rehabilitating sex-trafficking survivors in India, LITTLE STONES takes viewers on a global journey inside the lives and studios of four women fighting for equality.

items.title: Dark Forces: Shadow People
items.description: Thousands of people are reporting dark, menacing apparitions lurking over them while sleeping, leaving them in a paralyzed state, frozen with fear. Is this some new psychological phenomenon or intruders from some other nefarious dimension?

items.title: Reefer Madness (in Color)
items.description: Teens partake of the "demon weed" and one puff plunges them into a web of murder, sex and lunacy. The 1930's cult classic - In Vibrant Color!

items.title: Elvis Thru The Years
items.description: The life of Elvis Presley through rare film footage, press conferences, behind-the-scenes, and news clips. A truly unique look back at the King.

items.title: Devil Bat
items.description: Bela Lugosi, a scientist, seeks revenge by breeding a race of Devil Bats to do his sinister bidding! Now in Color!

items.title: City Beneath The Sea
items.description: Two American divers are distracted by fair ladies and skulduggery while trying to salvage a gold ship off Jamaica.

items.title: At War With The Army with Dean Martin & Jerry Lewis
items.description: When former business & nightclub partners Dean Martin & Jerry Lewis enlist in the U.S. Army, (in their first starring film ) they have different ambitions. Martin wants to see action rather than the drudgery of his current post.

items.title: Alfred Hitchcock - Master of Suspense
items.description: Famed horror and suspense director Alfred Hitchcock. You'll see behind-the-scenes of some of his most famous films including Psycho, Vertigo and many more!

items.title: ¿Dónde Están?
items.description: Since 1993, hundreds of women have disappeared from the border town of Juarez, MX, just across the Rio Grande river from El Paso, TX. Acclaimed filmmaker Charlie Minn delves into these mysterious unsolved crimes that have sunk Juarez.

items.title: Sphinx: Nebuchadnezzar
items.description: One of history's most powerful and ruthless leaders is explored in this documentary. Lording over Babylon for over forty years, Nebuchadnezzar's reign remains one of history's most iconic centuries later.

items.title: Mermaids
items.description: MERMAIDS is a documentary about the transformative power of a universal myth as seen through the eyes of five tail-donning women who beckon us into their eccentric yet deeply poetic underwater worlds.

items.title: Classic Comedy Teams Hosted By Steve Allen
items.description: Noted comedian Steve Allen hosts this compilation of Classic Comedy Teams. This fun-filled tour is loaded with rare film footage such as original color Laurel & Hardy, the uncut version of Abbott & Costello's Who's On First?, a rare Marx Brothers comedy.

items.title: Green Is Gold
items.description: A thirteen-year-old boy is forced to live with his estranged brother after their father is sent to prison. Their relationship is soon tested when the older brother's occupation as a marijuana dealer infringes on his ability not only to raise his brother

items.title: Atlas Shrugged: Part III - Who Is John Galt?
items.description: Approaching collapse, the nation's economy is quickly eroding. As crime and fear take over the countryside, the government continues to exert its brutal force against the nation's most productive who are mysteriously vanishing.

items.title: Atlas Shrugged Part I
items.description: Railroad executive Dagny Taggart and steel mogul Henry Rearden form an alliance to fight the increasingly authoritarian government of the United States.

items.title: Atlas Shrugged II: The Strike
items.description: Railroad owner Dagny Taggart and steel mogul Henry Rearden search desperately for the inventor of a revolutionary motor as the U.S. government continues to spread its control over the national economy.

items.title: The Identical
items.description: The story of twin brothers separated at birth in the Great Depression. With different upbringings, one brother becomes a music legend while the other struggles to find a balance between his passion for music and trying to please his father.

items.title: Kindness Is Contagious
items.description: A film about being nice and the benefits of being nice. The film profiles cutting-edge scientists and best-selling authors as well as people from all walks of life; illustrating their incredible discovery: Nice guys finish first!

items.title: A Turtle's Tale 2: Sammy's Escape From Paradise
items.description: When Sammy and Ray find themselves trapped in The Tank, an underwater aquarium, they must hatch a plan to escape and reunite with their grandkids, Ricky and Ella, and protect them from the dangers of the ocean.

items.title: Speed Demons Killing for Attention
items.description: When a popular honors graduate becomes an unlikely campus gunman, citizen sleuths embark across the country to uncover a motive. Their investigation exposes a government cover-up, corporate greed, and a medical mystery linking multiple school shootings.

items.title: Shattering the Silence
items.description: When postpartum depression reawakens long-dormant memories of childhood rape by her father, Veronica takes her tormentor to court. She and her siblings must confront their father in order to stop the cycle of abuse and save the next generation.

items.title: Nitti The Enforcer
items.description: After Al Capone was sent to prison for tax evasion, Francesco Nitto took the Chicago Outfit to new heights, gaining control over labor unions. A proud Italian, Nitti refused to bow to the stigma that surrounded Italian Americans at the time.

items.title: Murder Without Motive
items.description: Edmund Perry has everything going for him after he graduates from Phillips Exeter Academy with a scholarship to attend Stanford. With his dedication through the years finally paying off, an encounter with a police officer senselessly ends Edmund's life.

items.title: Jazz Giants of the 20th Century
items.description: Here are some of the greatest jazz artists of the 20th century in 17 rare, vintage performances you will not soon forget.

items.title: In a Strangers Hand
items.description: Executive Jack Bauer unwittingly becomes embroiled in the search for a missing girl. When Jack sets out to return a doll that he found on the subway, he learns from a woman that the toy belonged to her missing daughter, Carla, and may be a vital clue.

items.title: Hummus the Movie
items.description: Restaurateurs, musicians, politicians—everyone loves hummus. A story of faith, community, and growth is told through the lens of a dietary staple and superfood, hummus! This documentary shows how food can bring people together.

items.title: How to Murder a Millionaire
items.description: Spoiled Beverly Hills housewife Irma Summers is convinced that her husband plans to kill her. She escapes from her mansion with an enterprising con-woman, and the pair soon finds themselves up to their elbows in action, intrigue, and misadventures.

items.title: Great Man The WC Fields
items.description: The legendary W.C. Fields is featured in rare behind-the-scenes footage and home movies at work and at play, along with hilarious scenes from some of his greatest films.

items.title: Children of the Bride
items.description: Middle-aged Margret Becker becomes engaged to a man who's only two years older than her oldest child. She must learn to deal with the doubts faced by each of her four children concerning her fiancé.

items.title: Baby of the Bride
items.description: John and Margret Hix receive the surprise of their life after returning home from their honeymoon. At age 53, Margret is pregnant, and, against Josh's wishes, decides to keep the baby. Turns out, she isn't the only one in the family who's expecting!

items.title: Bettie Page: The Girl in the Leopard Print Bikini
items.description: Featuring the vintage films and pictures that made her a phenomenon, this film focuses on the life and times of the legendary model Bettie Page. Though her time in the spotlight was brief, Bettie has now become a cult figure and cultural icon.

items.title: TV in Black The First Fifty Years
items.description: The black image on television changed American culture. This two-hour program includes rare footage, memorabilia, photographs and exclusive interviews from the actors, writers, and producers whose personal journeys shaped television history.

items.title: The Yellow Brick Road and Beyond
items.description: The history of "The Wonderful Wizard of Oz", from the original books by Frank L. Baum to the 1939 film to the successful stage play Wicked. This documentary covers one of the longest running and most successful entertainment franchises of all time.

items.title: The Killing Secret
items.description: A high school cheerleader suspects that her popular boyfriend is responsible for the brutal murder of a pregnant girl from the wrong side of the tracks. With the help of the dead girl's mother, she strives to bring him to justice.

items.title: The Fairy King
items.description: Two children discover fairies trapped at their grandmother's home. They are torn between the hostility of the local villagers who believe the fairies to be evil and the hope that they will save their father from a terminal illness.

items.title: Television The First 50 Years Part 2
items.description: This documentary retrospectively traces television's impact on audiovisual media. Interviews and archival footage from popular programs provide snapshots of different trends in popular TV and its increasing influence over the years.

items.title: Dwegons and Leprechauns
items.description: When the Fitzgerald family arrives at their new home, they find unexpected neighbors: the Dwegons. When a group of greedy businessmen attempt to destroy Dewgon-Land, the Fitzgerald family and their new friends must save the day!

items.title: Bomb City
items.description: The cultural aversion to a group of punks in a conservative Texas town leads to one of the most controversial hate crimes in American history. Based on the true story of Brian Deneke, Bomb City questions the morality of American justice.

items.title: Big Brother Volcano
items.description: Alan was supposed to be traveling to Nicaragua with his wife, but is joined by his clueless brother-in-law after she flakes. There they meet Barbara, an outspoken ex-pat. Alan and Mike come to see her as the solution to all of their problems back home.

items.title: Andover
items.description: A genetics professor clones his wife after she dies in a fire but the woman he creates is different than the woman he loved, so he tries over and over, in a desperate attempt to get her back exactly as she was.

items.title: Where the Red Fern Grows (2003)
items.description: After saving for two years, a 12-year-old boy (Joseph Ashton) buys two puppies and trains them to be hunting dogs.

items.title: Harry Price: Ghost Hunter
items.description: A TV movie about Britain's real-life ghost hunter and skeptic Harry Price, who investigated tales of the paranormal and supernatural.

items.title: In Search of Mozart
items.description: From an incredibly young age, Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart was able to play and compose the most complex and marvelous pieces in history. This is his story of love and hardship, and his unique, unparalleled genius.

items.title: In Search of Beethoven
items.description: If we had to choose ten great things about humanity, there would probably be several Beethoven works amongst them. This is the story of one of the gods of western music, Ludwig Van Beethoven.

items.title: Like a Country Song
items.description: Jake (Joel Smallbone), an up-and-coming country singer, ruins his budding career by hard-partying. As he works to rebuild it and win back an old flame (Jennifer Taylor), he meets his father (Billy Ray Cyrus) for the first time.

items.title: The Beatles Explosion
items.description: A documentary explores The Beatles with interviews, newsreels, press conferences, and TV appearances.

items.title: The John Wayne Story, The Later Years
items.description: He was a bigger-than-life star and a hero of the silver screen who is still just as famous today as he was at the height of his 40+ years in show business.

items.title: A Wing And a Prayer
items.description: Narrated by William Baldwin, the untold true story of WWII aviators who carried out a secret, illegal operation in 1948 to prevent a second Holocaust. Lead by former flight engineer Al Schwimmer, who eluded the FBI.

items.title: The Way Home
items.description: Based on an inspirational true story about how a rural community rallied around a distraught family.

items.title: American Promise
items.description: American Promise is a coming of age story exploring the lives of two African American boys and their families. Their hopes, struggles, achievements and failures are revealed as they make tough decisions to guarantee a better future for their boys.

items.title: Borgman
items.description: A vagrant enters the lives of an arrogant upper-class family, turning their lives into a psychological nightmare in the process.

items.title: Dream On
items.description: Is the American Dream alive or dead? Political comedian John Fugelsang hits the road to find out in DREAM ON. This epic road trip retraces the journey of Alexis de Tocqueville.

items.title: God's Club
items.description: Welcome to God’s Club. Following his wife’s death, public high-school teacher Michael Evens (Stephen Baldwin) re-launches the Bible Club she originally founded. When upset parents cite the separation of church and state and want the group disbanded.

items.title: Golf in the Kingdom
items.description: A soul-searching trip to India takes an unexpected turn of events in this sports drama based on the best-selling novel by author Michael Murphy. The year is 1956. American philosophy student Michael is traveling en route to India when he decides to stop.

items.title: Tad: The Lost Explorer
items.description: Tad's dreams of being a famous adventurer finally come true when he is mistaken for a real professor and whisked away to Peru!

items.title: Eden (2013)
items.description: When a US soccer team gets stranded on a deserted island after a plane crash they must face difficult choices to survive.

items.title: Boys of Abu Ghraib
items.description: An American soldier deployed at Abu Ghraib finds himself behind the walls of the infamous Hard Site, where he develops a secret friendship with an Iraqi detainee.

items.title: Eloise
items.description: Four friends break into an abandoned insane asylum in search of a death certificate which will grant one of them a large inheritance.

items.title: Ghost House
items.description: A young couple goes on an adventurous vacation in Thailand only to find themselves haunted by a malevolent spirit after naively disrespecting a Ghost House.

items.title: Infini
items.description: An elite Search and Rescue team transport onto an off-world minding-facility to rescue Whit Carmichael, the lone survivor of a biological outbreak.

items.title: Snow Queen
items.description: A girl named Gerda must save her brother Kai from the control of the Snow Queen's eternal winter.

items.title: Terminus
items.description: Following a near-fatal accident, a man makes an unprecedented discovery that will not only determine the fate of his family but of mankind.

items.title: Nothing But The Truth
items.description: Washington DC political journalist Rachel Armstrong writes an explosive story about a government scandal in which she reveals the name of a covert CIA agent.

items.title: The World Of Peter Sellers
items.description: Peter Sellers had everything, yet believed he had nothing at all. Acclaimed director Tony Palmer has made the definitive portrait of this enigmatic comic genius.

items.title: The World Of Hugh Hefner
items.description: An exploration of the larger than life personality of Hugh Hefner.

items.title: The World Of Liberace
items.description: Known for flamboyant excess on stage, Liberace dazzled the world and was the highest-paid entertainer in the world. Renown director Tony Palmer dives into the lifestyle, dreams, and fears, or Liberace.

items.title: The Man Who Saved The World
items.description: The Man Who Saved the World tells the gripping true story of Stanislav Petrov - a man who single-handedly averted a fullscale nuclear world war but now struggles to get his life back on track… before it is too late.

items.title: Samurai Of Fukushima
items.description: This documentary will follow five modern-day samurais who had suffered by the disaster and radiation since March 11, 2011. Now samurais are fighting against radiation which is the latest technology we human invented and risking their lives to maintain.

items.title: Mighty Good: The Beatles
items.description: No musical group has had as profound an impact on pop music as The Beatles. Tony Palmer’s groundbreaking documentary gives us an intimate look at one of the most influential groups in musical history.

items.title: I Am What I Play
items.description: I Am What I Play is a feature-length documentary about the heyday of rock radio. The film profiles four rock radio disc jockeys from four different markets while exploring the changing nature of radio.

items.title: Food Choices
items.description: This new ground-breaking documentary explores the impact that food choices have on people’s health, the health of our planet and on the lives of other living species. And also discusses several misconceptions about food and diet.

items.title: Citizen Soldier
items.description: CITIZEN SOLDIER is a modern day Band of Brothers. Using real footage, the film offers a first-hand look into combat, where the soldiers demonstrate extraordinary bravery and valor to honor a warrior code-never leave a fallen comrade behind.

items.title: Wacken
items.description: Wacken - the movie takes you on stage and behind the curtain of the biggest Metal festival in the world. Experience four days of music, mud and madness with Anthrax, Alice Cooper, Deep Purple, Motorhead, Rammstein and many other bands.

items.title: Agents Unknown
items.description: John Murphy, elite adviser and ops for South Vietnamese intelligence services, reveals the gray areas of critical on-the-ground intelligence work.

items.title: GM Concept and Classic Cars
items.description: Take home a preserved piece of auto history! No longer in existence, this unique collection was professionally curated, never open to the public and consisted of rare and original General Motors cars and models.

items.title: Texas Wildcats
items.description: Lightning Bill Carson and sidekick Magpie are after Burrows, the man that killed their friend. Burrows is after the Arden ranch and his gang is rustling the cattle. Bill is robbing Burrows while posing as the mysterious Phantom and soon the two collide.

items.title: The Frontiersman
items.description: The local school is causing Hoppy problems. When he investigates there, the Bar 20 gang strikes. Then the new teacher arrives and disrupts the routine of the Bar 20 hands. Later the rustlers are poised to strike again. Hoppy really needs a break…

items.title: The Painted Desert
items.description: Two men find an abandoned baby and fight over the ownership of the child resulting in a lifelong rivalry.

items.title: 9/11: The Falling Man
items.description: This film will tell the story of the most unforgettable image from 9/11 – a photograph of a falling man, a jumper from the North Tower of the World Trade Centre, frozen in midair, perfectly parallel against the lines of those sun-kissed buildings.

items.title: In From The Cold A Portrait Of Richard Burton
items.description: Drunk, uncontrollable, infinitely generous, and larger than life — director Tony Palmer lays bare the life of legendary actor Richard Burton.

items.title: Beasts of the Bible
items.description: The Bible is full of strange and fantastic creatures. Legendary and horrific beasts like the Behemoth and Leviathan have captivated our imagination for centuries - did they really exist, can they be found today or are they just myth?

items.title: Boots and Saddles
items.description: In this western, a prissy English lord takes over his newly-inherited western ranch. The stuffy greenhorn is in way over his head, but fortunately, Gene Autry and his sidekick are there to show him the ropes.

items.title: Matthews
items.description: Sir Stanley Matthews is considered by many to be the greatest athletes of the 20th century if not one of the greatest soccer players of all time. Stanley's footwork, sportsmanship and stardom were lightyears ahead of their time.

items.title: Doble golpe
items.description: La agente del FBI Kathleen Boyle busca a un asesino llamado Cypher que evadió la captura durante años. Pero, ella se pone en peligro de un implacable asesino de la mafia que quiere matarlos.

items.title: Television: The First 50 Years - Part 1
items.description: This documentary retrospectively traces television's impact on audiovisual media. Interviews and archival footage from popular programs provide snapshots of different trends in popular TV and its increasing influence over the years.

items.title: The Shootist
items.description: Afflicted with a terminal illness, John Bernard Books, the last of the legendary gunfighters, quietly returns to Carson City for medical attention from his old friend Dr. Hostetler.

items.title: The Honeymooners
items.description: Bus driver Ralph Kramden and sanitation engineer Ed Norton are best friends who dream of making it big. Their most recent “get-rich-quick” plan finds the boys out to make their fortune by hiring a dog trainer to race their pet greyhound.

items.title: An Officer and a Gentleman
items.description: Loner Zack Mayo (Richard Gere) enters Officer Candidate School to become a Navy pilot, and in thirteen torturous weeks, he learns the importance of discipline, love, and friendship.

items.title: Amistad
items.description: AMISTAD is about a 1839 mutiny onboard a slave ship that is traveling towards the Northeast Coast of America. Much of the story involves a court-room drama about the slave who led the revolt.

items.title: Top Five
items.description: Written, directed and starring Chris Rock, TOP FIVE tells the story of New York City comedian-turned-film star Andre Allen, whose unexpected encounter with a journalist forces him to confront the comedy career—and the past—that he’s left behind.

items.title: Vampire in Brooklyn
items.description: As the vampire Maximillian, the popular star is the most diabolical, dashing, and definitely undead dude in the ‘hood.

items.title: A.I. Artificial Intelligence
items.description: In a future world, humans share aspects of their lives with companion robots called Mechas. But when an advanced prototype robot child named David is programmed to show unconditional love, his human family isn't prepared for the consequences.

items.title: Chinatown
items.description: Jake Gittes, a private eye, uncovers a web of personal and political scandals while he is hired by a beautiful socialite to investigate her husband's extra marital affair.

items.title: Congo
items.description: When an expedition to the African Congo ends in disaster, a new team is assembled to find out what went wrong.

items.title: Night Of 1000 Cats
items.description: A Millionaire playboy flies around Acapulco in his private helicopter to pick up sexy young women. He whisks them away to his secluded old castle where he wines and dines them.

items.title: Robot Monster
items.description: A Schlock Classic! Ro-Man, an alien that looks remarkably like a gorilla in a diving helmet, has destroyed all but six people on the planet Earth.

items.title: The Little Rascals Boys Of Our Gang
items.description: Join the boys as they find themselves involved in some of their craziest schemes ever! 5 short films filled with the heartwarming antics of the Little Rascals.

items.title: Glen Or Glenda (in Color)
items.description: Glen loves Barbara, but he has a terrible secret which threatens to destroy all of his hopes for a happily-ever-after with his lady... A true cult classic by director Ed Wood.

items.title: Mata Hari: Spy or Femme Fatale?
items.description: Dancer, courtesan - spy? Margaretha MacLeod, known as Mata Hari on the stage, was executed in Paris for her alleged ties to German espionage in World War II. Explore the mysteries of Mata Hari's life, and her demise, in this documentary.

items.title: Who Was the Real Casanova?
items.description: Iconic adventurer and romancer Giacomo Casanova remains one of the most iconic figures of European history. But did the "Casanova" image go beyond just this man? Explore the mysteries behind the legend in this documentary.

items.title: The British UFO Files
items.description: Paranormal investigations by the British government since the 1940's are unveiled in this documentary. Military and government figures, eye witnesses, and alien experts unveil the secrets of UFOs in England.

items.title: It Happened Here
items.description: It Happened Here is a feature length documentary about the alarming pervasiveness of sexual assault on college campuses.

items.title: I Declare War
items.description: Armed with nothing more than twigs, their imaginations and a simple set of rules, a group of 12-year-olds engaged in a lively game of Capture the Flag in the neighborhood woods start dangerously blurring the lines between make-believe and reality.

items.title: Hero Quest
items.description: Hero Quest is an epic coming-of-age adventure story of a boy who sets out on the journey of a lifetime, forging unlikely friendships, facing his greatest fears, and discovering the hero that was inside him all along.

items.title: Delinquent
items.description: Delinquent is the dramatic exploration of a teenager's struggle to manage the fall-out of a robbery gone wrong.

items.title: Dating My Mother
items.description: DATING MY MOTHER follows the intimate and tumultuous relationship between a single mother and her gay son as they navigate the dizzying world of online dating.

items.title: 101 Seconds
items.description: The film follows individuals across a wide spectrum of political and philosophical beliefs as they engage in a debate concerning gun legislation in Oregon in the aftermath of a shooting at the Clackamas Town Center Mall in Oregon in 2012.

items.title: The Dictator
items.description: Featuring never-before-seen footage that's outrageously funny! The creators and star of Borat bring you the hilarious comedy about what happens when the world's worst dictator is stuck in New York.

items.title: The Adventures of Tintin
items.description: Tintin and his friends discover directions to a sunken ship commanded by Capt. Haddock's ancestor and go off on a treasure hunt.

items.title: High Spirits
items.description: When a castle-turned-hotel owned by Peter Plunkett falls on hard financial times, he comes up with an idea to turn the place into a tourist attraction by billing it as Europe's most haunted castle.

items.title: Home of the Brave
items.description: The story of four American soldiers nearing the end of their tours of duty in Iraq.

items.title: Miami Blues
items.description: An ex-con (Alec Baldwin) tiptoes on the borderline of psychotic behavior, playing cops and robbers on both sides of the law. He robs and kills one minute and poses as a cop the next in this thriller with a comic edge.

items.title: Stargate
items.description: When an ancient Egyptian artifact is discovered, two men unlock its secret power as a portal through time and space.

items.title: The Adventures of Buckaroo Banzai Across the 8th Dimension
items.description: Buckaroo Banzai is a rock-star/brain-surgeon/comic-book-hero/samurai who along with his group, the Hong Kong Cavaliers, must stop evil creatures from the 8th dimension (all named John) who are trying to conquer our dimension.

items.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
items.description: 23rd century: The Federation Starship U.S.S. Enterprise™ is on routine training maneuvers, and Admiral James T. Kirk seems resigned to the fact that this inspection may well be the last space mission of his career. But Khan is back...

items.title: Soapdish
items.description: Sally Field leads an all-star cast in this side-splittingly funny look at a scandal-ridden TV soap opera.

items.title: Margot At The Wedding
items.description: On the eve of her estranged sister Pauline’s wedding to unemployed musician/artist/depressive Malcolm at the family seaside home, Margot shows up to rekindle the sisterly bond and offer her own brand of “support.”

items.title: Breathless
items.description: A fugitive (Richard Gere) heads to L.A. to track down Monica, a beautiful French woman studying at UCLA. Drawn in by the magnetism of Jesse's dark world, Monica can't help but fall for him and soon finds herself swept up in his run from the law.

items.title: Body Of Evidence
items.description: Sizzingly sexy Madonna leads a star-filled cast in this erotic thriller as a woman accused of killing a wealthy, elderly man through her insatiable sexual prowess.

items.title: Back to School
items.description: Rodney Dangerfield plays self-made millionaire Thornton Mellon, owner of a chain of tall and fat clothing stores, who, after divorcing his philandering wife, enrolls in college to keep his son from dropping out.

items.title: Supernova
items.description: "Supernova" chronicles the search and rescue patrol of a deep space medical ship and its six-member crew.

items.title: The January Man
items.description: A killer comedy that has an ex-cop trailing a serial murderer... and the mayor's sexy daughter! Kevin Kline leads an all-star cast that includes Susan Sarandon, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio, Harvey Keitel and Rod Steiger.

items.title: The Pink Panther 2
items.description: Inspector Jacques Clouseau teams up with a squad of international detectives just as bumbling as he is. Their mission: Stop a globe-trotting thief who specializes in stealing historical artifacts.

items.title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre 2
items.description: For a decade, Texas Ranger Lefty Enright (Dennis Hopper) has sought to avenge the brutal murder of his kin by the cannibalistic Sawyer family – Leatherface, Chop-Top, The Cook and Grandpa.

items.title: True Confessions
items.description: Two of the finest actors of our time, Robert De Niro and Robert Duvall, star in this must-see tale of two brothers set on a collision course as the result of a brutal murder in 1940s Los Angeles.

items.title: The Woman in Red
items.description: A happily married advertising executive gets the 7-year itch and obsessively searches the streets of San Francisco for the gorgeous woman he saw in an underground garage.

items.title: Yellowbeard
items.description: A 17th-century pirate in search of treasure. He's accompanied by his son, who has the location of the treasure tattooed on his head. It is a parody on the pirate movies of earlier days.

items.title: Hide Away
items.description: Directed by Chris Eyre (Smoke Signals), Hide Away follows the story of a successful businessman (Josh Lucas, Sweet Home Alabama, The Firm) attempting to resurrect his life.

items.title: Altar
items.description: A family moves in to a beautiful Victorian-era house, only to discover that it's full of dark secrets...

items.title: Confessions of a Prodigal Son
items.description: It is a coming-of-age tale following Sean (Nathan Clarkson) as he rebels and leaves his home, family and father (Kevin Sorbo) to figure out life on his own.

items.title: Genius
items.description: Nicole Kidman and Colin Firth star in this stirring drama about the friendship between Thomas Wolfe and editor Maxwell Perkins (who discovered F. Scott Fitzgerald and Ernest Hemingway).

items.title: Hunt for the Labyrinth Killer
items.description: An assistant district attorney works with a detective to catch a serial killer who uses traps to lure his victims.

items.title: They Came Together
items.description: Joel (Paul Rudd) and Molly (Amy Poehler) fall in and out of love in this hilarious spoof on a romantic comedy from the director of WET HOT AMERICAN SUMMER and ROLE MODELS.

items.title: Kon Tiki
items.description: Based on the Academy Award-winning documentary, KON TIKI is the story of legendary explorer Thor Heyerdal's epic crossing of the Pacific on a balsa wood raft in 1947.

items.title: Bongwater
items.description: David is an aspiring artist and a pot dealer who falls in love with constantly smoking Serena. Serena gets jealous and goes off to New York with heroin-addicted Tommy. David wants her back.

items.title: Jens Pulver: Driven
items.description: JENS PULVER | DRIVEN follows the legendary mixed martial arts champion through an emotional roller coaster ride toward his do or die comeback after four losses in the cage.

items.title: Monster Camp
items.description: A rare and fascinating glimpse into a real-life version of "World of Warcraft", where gamer stereotypes are simultaneously shattered and confirmed.

items.title: Henry's Crime
items.description: Released from prison for a crime he didn't commit, an ex-con targets the same bank he was sent away for robbing. Starring an ensemble cast including Keanu Reeves ("John Wick").

items.title: It Ain't Pretty
items.description: This probing sports documentary explores the challenges and triumphs of female big wave surfers as they fight sexism in competition and in the media.

items.title: My Name is Water
items.description: In this powerful documentary, a disillusioned student travels the world in search of answers after a life-altering discussion with his grandfather, a Holocaust survivor.

items.title: Nazi Quest for the Holy Grail
items.description: In the final days of the Second World War, American troops discovered a vast hoard of mysterious Nazi files hidden in a cave in Southern Germany. Buried deep in these secret documents were the details of one of the Third Reich’s most shadowy projects.

items.title: The Space Shuttle's Last Flight
items.description: As Atlantis completes its 135th and final mission, this definitive documentary charts the rise and fall of the most ambitious space programme ever undertaken, the space shuttle. For the past three decades since its first launch in 1981.

items.title: Mandrill (English Subtitles)
items.description: Antonio is made an orphan when his parents are brutally murdered. As years of vengeance build up, he transforms into the relentless bounty hunter code-named “Mandrill.”

items.title: Paper Moon
items.description: Ryan O'Neal teams up with his daughter, Tatum, in this film, for which Tatum won an Oscar for her role. Con man Moses Pray drives through Depression-era Kansas with a carload of deluxe Bibles and a list of newly widowed prospects for his line.

items.title: Masters Of The Universe
items.description: The fantastic exploits of He-Man and his arch rival, the evil Skeletor, are brought to the big screen for the first time in this live-action adventure.

items.title: Prancer
items.description: A eight-year-old farm girl, who marches to her own beat--and whose widowed father is knuckling under to financial pressure--nurses a wounded reindeer she believes is one of Santa's own.

items.title: Love Field
items.description: A Dallas beautician and housewife is enthralled by President and Mrs. John F. Kennedy, and is like an excited schoolgirl at the thought of their visit to her hometown in November 1963.

items.title: The Package
items.description: A career Army sergeant is assigned to take a prisoner from Berlin to Washington, D.C. When his prisoner escapes, he finds himself in the middle of a conspiracy whose masterminds want him out of the way.

items.title: Class
items.description: When prep-school student Skip emboldens his shy roommate Jonathan to step outside of his dating comfort zone by dating older women he’s in for the surprise of his life when the older woman Jonathan picks up turns out to be Skip’s mother, Ellen.

items.title: Breakin' 2: Electric Boogaloo
items.description: The beat doesn't slow down in this slammin' sequel to "Breakin'.'" This fly follow-up finds our poppin' and lockin' trio Kelly, Ozone and Turbo trying to rescue a community center facing demolition at the hands of a greedy real-estate developer.

items.title: Bright Lights, Big City
items.description: Michael J. Fox plays a would- be writer who works as a fact checker for a Gotham magazine. He spends his nights as an active barfly in New York City's club scene. But after he is fired from the magazine, can the young fan find redemption?

items.title: Dream Lover
items.description: Architect Ray Reardon lives in a glittery dream world of upscale success. On the rebound from a recent divorce, Ray meets Lena Mathers and falls in love - but his dream turns to a nightmare as Lena leads him to the edge.

items.title: Into the Blue
items.description: Young vacationers, expecting to have a memorable time diving, find themselves in deep trouble with a druglord when they come upon the illicit cargo of a sunken airplane.

items.title: Peter's Friends
items.description: After ten years, a young aristocrat invites his college theatrical friends and mates for a New Year's reunion, BIG CHILL-style. As the eating and drinking proceed, all manner of former relationships, emotional traumas and secret agendas are revealed.

items.title: Quigley Down Under
items.description: A self-assured American sharpshooter moves to Australia in search of employment and finds work for a despotic land baron in the Australian outback.

items.title: Under Fire
items.description: A political thriller about three journalists on the line in 1979 Managua, Nicaragua (during the Samoza regime), how their lives intertwine and how two of them risk their professionalism by becoming involved in the revolutionary conflict.

items.title: Pebble And The Penguin
items.description: In love with Marina, the most beautiful penguin in all the land, hopeless romantic Hubie must thwart the plans of his evil rival, Drake, and win Marina’s heart in this charming, animated adventure from the creators of "All Dogs Go To Heaven."

items.title: Creator
items.description: Dr. Harry Wolper (Peter O'Toole, "Lawrence of Arabia"), an eccentric and lonely scientist, looks for a way to clone his deceased wife in this science-fiction comedy.

items.title: The Face of an Angel
items.description: A journalist and a documentary filmmaker chase the story of a murder and its prime suspect. Starring Kate Beckinsale ("Underworld").

items.title: Beta Test
items.description: When a gamer discovers that the events in a video game are happening in the real world, he must join forces with the game's protagonist to unravel the sinister plot before it overwhelms the city.

items.title: Full of Grace
items.description: Ten years after Christ's resurrection, Full of Grace sheds light on a critical moment in the history of Christianity.

items.title: Letters To God
items.description: Tyler Doherty is an extraordinary eight-year-old boy armed with strong faith and courage as he faces his daily battle against cancer.

items.title: Easy Money: Life Deluxe
items.description: JW (Joel Kinnaman, The Killing) now lives in exile and is more determined than ever to find out what happened to his missing sister Camilla. Every trace leads him to the world of organized crime in Stockholm.

items.title: Easy Money: Hard to Kill
items.description: JW (Joel Kinnaman, Robocop, The Killing), the promising business student who became an organized coke smuggler in Easy Money, is serving hard time in prison and struggling to get back on an honest path.

items.title: Safe Harbor
items.description: Doug and Robbie are about to set sail on a long trip when they unexpectedly find themselves foster parenting a group of troubled boys. It changes their lives for the better, and they decide to stay in town and run the foster home for boys permanently.

items.title: Rollerball
items.description: Jonathan Cross (Chris Klein) is an all-American hotshot, the most popular player in the fastest and most extreme sport of all time: Rollerball.

items.title: Diggers
items.description: A coming-of-age story about four working-class friends growing up in Long Island, New York, as clam diggers.

items.title: Being Canadian
items.description: A Canadian takes a cross-country journey to prove that his country is more than stereotypes. Includes interviews with famous Canadians including Cobie Smulders, Nathan Fillion, Michael J. Fox and Ben Stiller.

items.title: Aqui Entre Nos (LAS)
items.description: Cansado de ser dado por sentado por su esposa y sus 3 hijas, Rodolfo Guerra se levanta una mañana y decide no ir a trabajar. Entonces comienza la locura.

items.title: The Haunting
items.description: In this edge-of-your-seat supernatural thriller featuring Hollywood's hottest stars, a study in fear escalates into a heart-stopping nightmare for a professor and three subjects trapped in a mysterious mansion.

items.title: La máquina asesina
items.description: Un asesino entrenado en la Unión Soviética está decidido a escapar de su doble vida de asesino a sueldo y padre.

items.title: Harley Davidson and the Marlboro Man
items.description: Don Johnson and Mickey Rourke race onto the screen as two modern-day "Robin Hoods" in this futuristic adventure film that features high-speed motorcycles, daring stunts and explosive action.

items.title: Untamed Heart
items.description: Two of today's hottest young actors, Christian Slater and Marisa Tomei, star in this tender romance about lonely souls destined to find one another. Co-starring Rosie Perez.

items.title: Autumn In New York
items.description: Autumn in New York follows the sexual exploits of Will Keane (RICHARD GERE) until he runs into an unexpected dead end when he meets Charlotte Fielding (WINONA RYDER). Charlotte is half Will's age and twice his match.

items.title: Fighting the Red Baron
items.description: In World War 1, aerial warfare was born and with it a new breed of warrior. This is the story of the pioneering young fighter pilots of the Royal Flying Corp, most in their early twenties, who had to write the rules for this new form of fighting.

items.title: Hedgehog Hotel
items.description: The Hedgehog Hotel offers a rare and magical glimpse into the mysterious moonlit world of one of our best loved, but little-known animals.

items.title: Chattahoochee
items.description: An American war hero attempts a bizarre suicide and ends up in the nightmarish Chattahoochee State Mental Hospital. Once inside, he devotes himself to exposing the horrific treatment of the patients.

items.title: King Solomon's Mines
items.description: Experience wild stunts, romance and heart-pounding excitement with Richard Chamberlain as a soldier of fortune who unwittingly gets tied into a young woman's (Sharon Stone) search for her missing father.

items.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
items.description: Admiral Kirk’s defeat of Khan and the creation of the planet Genesis are empty victories. Spock is dead, and McCoy is inexplicably being driven insane. Then a surprise visit from Sarek, Spock’s father, provides a startling revelation.

items.title: Silence
items.description: Martin Scorsese’s Silence tells the story of two missionaries who travel to Japan in search of their missing mentor at a time when Christianity is outlawed. When they are captured, both men are plunged into an odyssey that will risk their lives.

items.title: Orange County
items.description: Shaun is content to be a bright but unfocused surf slacker until the day he discovers a novel by acclaimed author Martin Skinner. Inspired, he suddenly leaves Orange County to study creative writing at Stanford University.

items.title: Drillbit Taylor
items.description: Two bullied high school students place an ad for a bodyguard in a magazine and receive a response from a homeless verteran.

items.title: The Wood
items.description: Lots of guys have second thoughts about marriage. Three hours before his wedding, Roland is having third, fourth, and fifth thoughts. Good thing he’s got buddies Slim and Mike around to help.

items.title: The Running Man
items.description: A wrongly-convicted man must try to survive a public execution gauntlet staged as a TV game show.

items.title: Ordinary People
items.description: Ordinary People is an intense examination of a family being torn apart by tension and tragedy. Donald Sutherland and Mary Tyler Moore star as the upper-middle-class couple whose “ordinary” existence is irrevocably shattered by death.

items.title: Not Fade Away
items.description: Rock 'n' roll coming of age story about a group of suburban teens in a 60's rock band.

items.title: Atlantic City
items.description: For Lou, 40 years a bodyguard-boyfriend to aging beauty queen Grace, his numbers-running sideline escalates to mob involvement. A drug-related slaying leaves him with a small fortune.

items.title: Planes, Trains & Automobiles
items.description: Neal just wants to fly home to Chicago for Thanksgiving with his family. But all he gets is misery. Misery named Del Griffith, a loud-mouthed salesman who leads Neal on a wild goose chase.

items.title: All Creatures Big and Small
items.description: It's the end of the world. A flood is coming. Luckily for Dave and his son Finny, a couple of clumsy Nestrians, an Ark has been built to save all animals. But as it turns out, Nestrians aren't allowed.

items.title: Jack Goes Home
items.description: Jack Thurlowe's world is turned upside down when his beloved father is killed in a brutal car accident. When he returns to his childhood home Jack discovers nothing is what it seems. With devastating and terrifying results.

items.title: Johnny Frank Garrett's Last Word
items.description: When a young man is executed for committing a murder for which he always maintained his innocence, he leaves behind a curse letter in which he promises to take vengeance on all those connected to his trial.

items.title: Father Goose
items.description: Cary Grant stars in one of his funniest roles as a boozy beachcomber sitting out WWII in peace - until the Allies recruit him to be a lookout on the South Pacific isle.

items.title: To Catch a Thief
items.description: A famous cat burglar who has retired to the Riviera catches a thief imitating his old style.

items.title: Seconds
items.description: Desperate to escape his life, Arthur succumbs to a mysterious organization's offer of a new identity and a fresh start. Surgically transformed into the handsome, young Tony Wilson, he begins a jet-set existence among a community of "Reborns."

items.title: Artists and Models
items.description: A goonish young man receives telepathic top secret information in his nightmares, which are used by his artist friend in comic strips. Foreign agents and the CIA get interested.

items.title: Fear Strikes Out
items.description: True story of the life of Jimmy Piersall, who battled mental illness to achieve stardom in major league baseball.

items.title: Greatest Show On Earth
items.description: Charlton Heston stars as Brad Braden, the circus manager who lives and breathes to keep the show rolling. With the Big Top about to hit rock bottom, Braden hires The Great Sebastian, a daring trapeze legend, to revitalize the circus.

items.title: Operation Petticoat
items.description: A submarine captain and his supply officer are determined to get their dry-dock sub back into WWII action. However, a bevy of nurses comes aboard, causing hijinks in the hot pink sub.

items.title: A Place in the Sun
items.description: George Eastman is a poor young man determined to win a place in society and the heart of a beautiful socialite (Elizabeth Taylor). Shelley Winters plays the factory girl whose dark secret threatens Eastman’s professional and romantic prospects.

items.title: The Out of Towners
items.description: The top candidate for a prestigious promotion at his company’s corporate headquarters in New York City, George, accompanied by his wife Gwen is all set to take a bite out of The Big Apple.

items.title: Stalag 17
items.description: Laced with comedy and cynicism, this is the story of a group of GIs who are thrown together in the notorious German prison camp Stalag 17, their suspicions about one being a spy and their efforts to escape.

items.title: Terms of Endearment
items.description: Terms of Endearment dazzled critics and audiences alike with its believable, insightful story of two captivating people, mother and daughter, unforgettably played by Shirley MacLaine and Debra Winger.

items.title: American Beauty
items.description: Lester's life is far from perfect. As he makes a few changes in his life, the freer and the happier he gets. However, Lester is about to learn that the ultimate freedom comes at a price.

items.title: Hatari
items.description: Director Howard Hawks reteams with John Wayne, who heads a group of highly skilled professional game hunters in Africa. Only they don’t use bullets – they capture the ferocious big game with strong rope and cameras for zoos and circus attractions.

items.title: Romeo and Juliet
items.description: Italian director Franco Zeffirelli stunned the screen world when he cast two young unknowns to portray the star-crossed lovers in Romeo & Juliet, but it was a gamble that resulted in one of the most popular motion pictures of all time.

items.title: What's Eating Gilbert Grape
items.description: Taking care of Arnie is mostly Gilbert's task, which can be pretty demanding, at least while you are working at the local grocery store.

items.title: King Creole
items.description: Elvis Presley gives Bourbon Street a new beat in King Creole. He plays a troubled youth whose singing sets the French Quarter rockin’.

items.title: Hatched
items.description: Even the smallest creatures can make a big difference in this eggs-ceptionally funny adventure!

items.title: Come Out and Play
items.description: Beth (Vinessa Shaw) and Francis (Ebon Moss-Bachrach) decide to take a vacation before the birth of their child.

items.title: Final Girl
items.description: Veronica, a teenage girl who's new to town is lured out into the woods by a group of senior boys who hunt and kill girls for sport.

items.title: 2 Nights Till Morning
items.description: A casual romantic interlude takes a surprising turn in this drama. While away on business, a French architect meets a Finnish DJ, sparking a one-night stand.

items.title: Chronicles of a Haunted Castle
items.description: Two mediums visit home rumored to be France's most haunted, to uncover the supernatural mysteries inside.

items.title: 1000 to 1: The Cory Weissman Story
items.description: 1000 to 1 is the inspiring, true story of Cory Weissman, a high school basketball star who scored 1,000 points in high school and was expected to be a standout athlete at Gettysburg College.

items.title: Open Windows
items.description: Oscar-nominated writer-director Nacho Vigalondo (The ABCs of Death, Extraterrestrial, V/H/S Viral) creates an action-packed world of voyeurism and suspense in his thriller Open Windows.

items.title: National Parks Project
items.description: On the eve of Parks Canada’s centennial, over 52 of the country’s finest film and audio artists embark on a historic expedition to capture the majesty of the landscape in music and film.

items.title: ZZ Top: Live at Montreux 2013
items.description: ZZ Top has made a number of visits to Montreux over the years and this concert from the 2013 Festival is undoubtedly one of their finest live performances.

items.title: Faces in The Crowd
items.description: A woman living with the disorder "face-blindness," survives an attack by a serial killer but cannot identify her attacker's face. Starring Milla Jovovich, Jukian McMahon.

items.title: Finding Noah
items.description: Follow a group of intrepid explorers as they climb and live atop a 17,000 ft mountain in Turkey to determine the final resting place of Noah's Ark. Narrated by Gary Sinise ("Forrest Gump").

items.title: Eye See You
items.description: In this twisting cop thriller, an alcoholic detective (Sylvester Stallone) is sent to a remote detox clinic after a serial killer targets his friends and family.

items.title: Dinosaur Island
items.description: A boy and a girl find themselves stranded in a land of wonder and discover that throughout history things have mysteriously disappeared ino this long-lost world.

items.title: Black Fox 2: The Price of Peace
items.description: The western saga continues as Alan's family is caught in the deadly crossfire of a revenge plot against Britt. After Alan's wife is slain, he and Britt hunt the bigot responsible for her death.

items.title: Conquest of Everest Revisited 1952-2003
items.description: This documentary covers the famous and successful expedition of the Everest conquest by Tenzing Norgay and Edmund Hillary, the first climbers to reach its peak.

items.title: Sukiyaki Western Django
items.description: In this action-packed Western, a nameless gunfighter arrives in a town ripped apart by rival gangs and, though courted by both to join, chooses his own path.

items.title: Stuck in Love
items.description: An acclaimed writer, his ex-wife and their teenaged children come to terms with the complexities of love over the course of a year. Starring Jennifer Connelly, Kristen Bell, Greg Kinnear.

items.title: Stock Option
items.description: When a homeless ex-stockbroker rescues a famous model from a robbery attempt, she takes him home as an act of gratitude.

items.title: Rob the Mob
items.description: A Queens couple who specialize in robbing mafia social clubs stumble upon their biggest score — and become targets of the mob and the FBI. Starring Andy Garcia, Ray Romano and Michael Pitt.

items.title: Remember the Daze
items.description: In the teenage wasteland of 1999 suburbia, a group of seniors stumble through their last day of high school. Featuring Oscar winner Brie Larson, Leighton Meester and Amber Heard.

items.title: To Catch A Serial Killer
items.description: Spanning more than a decade, multiple murders, two much-publicised trials and one irreparably damaged career, it is a story of the dogged pursuit of a serial killer

items.title: The Spy Who Came in from the Cold
items.description: Oscar® nominee Richard Burton* is the burnt-out British agent who refuses to “come in from the cold” to take a desk job.

items.title: Runaway Hearts
items.description: Two kids on the run from a very scary present come across two adults who can't quite escape their past. They're four people in need of a miracle, and sometimes the miracles in life are the very people whose paths you cross.

items.title: Guardian of the Ancient Shadow Crown
items.description: Matthew finds a key that unlocks a magical shadow world with two Shadow Guardians that protect an ancient Shadow Crown that promises untold power. Matthew is forced to battle an evil sorceress and her dark magic, putting his real-world future in jeopardy.

items.title: Beware the Gonzo
items.description: When the rebel-minded Gonzo (Ezra Miller) is ousted from his school paper by very popular editor Gavin (Jesse McCartney), he teams with the mysterious Evie (Zoe Kravitz) to start his own paper and turn the social hierarchy on its head.

items.title: The Virgin Suicides
items.description: In the mid-1970s, in a Michigan community, live the Lisbon sisters, five teenagers who have bewitched a group of neighborhood boys.

items.title: The Bridges at Toko-Ri
items.description: This masterful story of a war-weary World War II veteran who must leave his family to fight again combines moving drama with surefire, bombs-away aerial action. Also starring Grace Kelly as his loving, luminescent wife.

items.title: Fun in Acapulco
items.description: Elvis heads south of the border, where he’s fired as a boat hand, hired as a lifeguard and singer, admired by local beauties and inspired to jump off a 136-foot cliff. Put another way: he overcomes a fear of heights in spectacular fashion.

items.title: Long Day's Journey into Night
items.description: This magnificent autobiographical account of Eugene O'Neill's early years tells the story of a mother with a drug addiction, an embittered alcoholic father, and two maladjusted brothers. Based on Eugene O'Neill's play "Long Day's Journey into Night."

items.title: No Way To Treat A Lady
items.description: A crafty serial killer plays a game of cat-and-mouse with a harried police detective trying to track him down.

items.title: The Rainmaker
items.description: Katharine Hepburn garnered an Oscar nomination as the "plain yet magnetically beautiful" tomboy rancher, with Burt Lancaster brilliantly cast in the role of the smooth-talking con man.

items.title: That Touch of Mink
items.description: Love arrives with a splash when a handsome and eligible tycoon and a beautiful working woman meet over a curbside mud puddle. He’s enchanted by her small town ways, she’s captivated by his romantic, debonair manner.

items.title: Dinosaur Extinction: Beyond the Asteroid
items.description: Did an asteroid mark the end of dinosaur life on Earth? "Dinosaur Extinction" takes a close look at the discovery of a gigantic crater deep in the ocean floor, one that is possibly tied to a theory about the end of dinosaur life.

items.title: Gorky Park
items.description: Three mutilated bodies are found in Moscow's Gorky Park, and it's up to Russian police officer Arkady Renko to find the maniacal killer. From the best-selling mystery novel by Martin Cruz Smith.

items.title: The Mighty Quinn
items.description: Xavier Quinn is the police chief of a tiny Caribbean island. He is on good terms with all. When a prominent businessman is murdered, Quinn, like everyone else, believes that the killer is Maubee--a local folk hero and Quinn's childhood friend.

items.title: Blue Sky
items.description: Uprooting his family after being assigned to a remote testing facility in Alabama, nuclear engineer Hank Marshall is faced with a moral decision as an opponent of the atmospheric tests he’s asked to complete.

items.title: Invasion U.S.A.
items.description: An army of terrorist mercenaries led by Soviet agent Rostov catches America unprepared and makes it a war zone from sea to shining sea. Only one man can stem the rising tide of violence: retired agent and martial arts expert Matt Hunter.

items.title: Dragon Guardians
items.description: Something spooky is happening in Dragon Hill, and a sudden change in climate has plunged the land into a deep freeze. The fate of the forest rests in the hands of its protector, a little elf named Robin, and his misfit dragon companions.

items.title: The Rose Tattoo
items.description: A neighborhood is disturbed when truck driver Rosario is killed by police. One day, his wife learns of Rosario's affair, and a new carefree, handsome Italian truck driver enters her life.

items.title: Another Time, Another Place
items.description: Mark Trevor, a World War II newsman with the British Broadcasting Corporation who's torn between two women. One is Sara Scott, the American reporter working in England. The two embark on a romance – but it's an affair destined for tragedy.

items.title: Ladies Book Club
items.description: Bunny and Carlyle are roommates and best friends, but keep their relationship platonic. Friends and families decide to use book club meetings to spark a love connection between them.

items.title: Patrick: Evil Awakens
items.description: When a young nurse begins work at an isolated psychiatric ward, she quickly becomes fascinated with Patrick, a brain dead patient who is the subject of a mad scientist's cruel and unusual experiments.

items.title: The Program
items.description: When sports journalist David Walsh becomes convinced that Armstrong's performances during the Tour de France victories are fueled by banned substances, he starts hunting for evidence that will expose Armstrong.

items.title: Intruders
items.description: Anna suffers from agoraphobia so crippling that when a trio of criminals break into her house, she cannot bring herself to flee. But what the intruders don't realize is that agoraphobia is not her only psychosis.

items.title: Jamesy Boy
items.description: Rage-filled teenager James is never one to back down from a fight. He jumps at the chance to run drugs and guns for a gang and quickly ends up behind bars.

items.title: 6 Ways To Die
items.description: John Doe, a man of mystery, wants Sonny 'Sundown' Garcia – a notorious drug kingpin – dead and 6 feet under. But before he exacts his vengeance, John wants Sundown to feel everything that he felt.

items.title: Intruders
items.description: A demon shadow seeks to take possession of two children living in different countries. With Clive Owen ("Closer"), Carice van Houten ("Game of Thrones") and Ella Purnell ("Maleficent").

items.title: A Little Trip To Heaven
items.description: A husband and wife tangle with an investigator over her dead brother's million-dollar insurance policy.

items.title: Plush
items.description: Emily Browning (“A Series of Unfortunate Events”) stars as a young songwriter who discovers that her new guitarist is harboring a dark and dangerous secret.

items.title: Ted Bundy
items.description: This shocking docu-drama explores the life of Ted Bundy, the infamous and charismatic serial killer who murdered at least 19 women in the 1970s.

items.title: Welcome to Me
items.description: When Alice Klieg (Kristen Wiig) wins the Mega Millions lottery, she quits her psychiatric meds and buys her own talk show. Featuring Wes Bentley, Linda Cardellini and Joan Cusack.

items.title: What Maisie Knew
items.description: In New York City, a young girl is caught in the middle of her parents' bitter custody battle. Starring Julianne Moore, Steve Coogan and Alexander Skarsgård.

items.title: The World Made Straight
items.description: In a rural Appalachian community haunted by the legacy of a Civil War massacre, a rebellious young man struggles to escape the violence that would bind him to the past.

items.title: Howl (2015)
items.description: Passengers on a night train are attacked by a vicious creature out of folklore, and must band together in order to survive until morning.

items.title: Dahmer
items.description: Jeffrey Dahmer (Jeremy Renner, "The Hurt Locker") was vilified when authorities discovered he had murdered, dismembered and even tried to consume the bodies of 15 young men in Milwaukee.

items.title: The Jimmy Show
items.description: Jimmy's (Frank Whaley, "Pulp Fiction") dead-end job in the grocery store has him feeling unfulfilled, but one night at a stand-up open mic gives him a glimpse into what could be.

items.title: Transsiberian
items.description: A Transsiberian train journey to Moscow becomes a thrilling chase of deception and murder when a couple encounters a pair of mysterious travelers. Starring Woody Harrelson and Kate Mara.

items.title: Trauma
items.description: After waking up from a coma and discovering that his wife has been killed in a car accident, Ben (Colin Firth) begins to turn his life around, but is haunted by visions of his dead wife.

items.title: White Coats
items.description: Dan Aykroyd ("The Blues Brothers") stars in this comedy about the madcap misadventures of a group of medical school interns.

items.title: Wilderness
items.description: In this gritty horror film, a group of juvenile delinquents is exiled to a small British island and must fight for survival.

items.title: Half Light
items.description: Real terror and the supernatural conspire to haunt grieving novelist Rachel Carlson (Demi Moore, "G.I. Jane") when she moves to a remote Scottish village after the death of her son.

items.title: Party Girl
items.description: In this raucous comedy, Parker Posey ("Scream 3") stars as a hard-partying NY club girl who takes a job as a librarian.

items.title: Paris, je t'aime
items.description: Set against a romantic Parisian backdrop, this delightful anthology explores the many faces of love. Featuring Natalie Portman, Elijah Wood, Maggie Gyllenhaal, Emily Mortimer.

items.title: Guncrazy
items.description: A trashy teen (Drew Barrymore, "Never Been Kissed") murders her sexually abusive step-father, helps her reformed prison pen-pal get released on good behavior and takes off on the run.

items.title: A Guide to Recognizing Your Saints
items.description: A coming-of-age drama about a young man (Shia LaBeouf) growing up in 1980s New York who believes he has been saved from the culture of violence and drugs by various so-called saints.

items.title: George And The Dragon
items.description: A knight (James Purefoy, "Rome") returning from the Crusades takes on a dragon after the disappearance of the kindly Princess Lunna (Piper Perabo, "Coyote Ugly"). With Patrick Swayze.

items.title: My Other Mother
items.description: When gruff and independent Candy meets her stubborn birth mother, will the two manage to open their hearts to each other?

items.title: The Breakout
items.description: The first ever all-women's mixed martial arts fight card features five exciting bouts with some of the industryÕs top-rated female MMA fighters.

items.title: Maniac Cop 2
items.description: The undead killer cop returns in this gory sequel, which sees maniac Officer Cordell (Robert Z'Dar, "Tango & Cash") team up with a serial killer to hunt down the criminals who murdered him.

items.title: Love Won't Let Me Wait
items.description: A charismatic playboy (Lamman Rucker, "Why Did I Get Married?") manages to juggle relationships with three sisters while convincing all of them Ð and their mother Ð that he is a nice guy.

items.title: Lyfe's Journey
items.description: A family man named David (Keith Robinson, "Dreamgirls") makes a terrible mistake that isolates him from the people he loves most in this heartfelt drama about forgiveness and redemption.

items.title: Cherry Crush
items.description: A privileged teenager finds himself expelled from school after taking provocative photos of his female classmates. Now enrolled in the local high school, he becomes blinded by the beauty of another.

items.title: Blunt Force Trauma
items.description: In the seedy underground dueling culture of South America, two opponents wearing Kevlar vests face each other, draw and shoot.

items.title: Chop Kick Panda
items.description: A lazy panda named Zibo dreams of becoming a martial arts master but is stuck as a cleaner for a dojo. Little does he know that an evil tiger has plans to take over the kingdom and only Zibo can stop him in this fun adventure!

items.title: Down to Earth
items.description: Struggling black comic Lance Barton (Chris Rock) knows what it's like to die on stage. But when his life takes an unexpected turn - straight to heaven - Lance is sure there's been a mistake.

items.title: Kate Middleton: Working Class to Windsor
items.description: Wife, mother, duchess; a journey from working class to Windsor. Kate Middleton’s rise to royalty and influences of international intrigue and admired the world over.

items.title: Enrique Iglesias: Latin Fever
items.description: Enrique Iglesias, an international Latin pop-star who was determined to find his own path to success and not be overshadowed by his world famous father, Julio Iglesias. In 1995 Enrique dropped out of University to debut his first album, which proved to...

items.title: Diana Story: Part III: Legacy of Love
items.description: A late night phone call from Paris brought news that would rock the world. The sudden and tragic death of Princess Diana devastated millions. Hear what it was really like to be at the eye of the storm, as Diana's closest friend and confidant s...

items.title: Diana Story: Part I: The Young Princess
items.description: In the summer of 1980 a shy young girl arrives at Balmoral Castle, two years later that girl becomes a royal Princess. At just 20 years old Lady Diana Spencer married HRH Prince Charles to become HRH Princess Of Wales. From her first steps int...

items.title: Lil Wayne: Bling
items.description: Releasing his first solo studio album at just the age of 15, Lil Wayne has shotthrough the ranks of the hip-hop scene. He has challenged societal ideas aboutimage and has really become the representative of modern hip-hop. Follow the story of the man...

items.title: Ragamuffin
items.description: This poignant biopic tells the true story of Rich Mullins, a musical prodigy who rose to fame as a Christian music artist only to walk away from it all to live on a Navajo reservation.

items.title: Sleepwalker
items.description: A graduate student plagued by bouts of sleepwalking begins to have trouble differentiating between her dreams and reality.

items.title: Tensa espera LAS
items.description: Susan Sarandon da vida a la madre de siete hijos, seis de los cuales ya están bastante crecidos. La angustia que le supone ver cómo su papel de madre está a punto de caducar crece cuando recibe la noticia de que uno de sus hijos puede estar muerto.

items.title: Cerca de tu casa
items.description: An evicted mother, a banker with a conscience, and a police officer who must do his job no matter what, sing and dance in this Brechtian musical drama about the economic crisis, people’s struggle with daily life, solidarity and hope.

items.title: Atlas de geografía humana
