items.description: Fran, Rosa, Ana y Marisa deben armar un atlas de geografía. Sus vidas predecibles están a punto de cambiar a partir de ahora. Mientras trabajan en el atlas, experimentan el amor, el desamor, la infidelidad y la reconciliación.

items.title: Cocodrilo Dundee
items.description: Michael J. "Cocodrilo" Dundee es un australiano de espíritu libre que caza cocodrilos con las manos, les clava la mirada a búfalos de agua y bebe hasta desmadrarse.

items.title: Control total
items.description: Shia LaBeouf y Michelle Monaghan protagonizan esta historia como dos extraños que tratan de escapar del peligro, cuando son arrancados de sus vidas normales y 'activados' en un complot de asesinado de alta tecnología.

items.title: La chica de rosa
items.description: Ella es una chica de la secundaria del lado equivocado de la ciudad. Él es el galán rico que la invita al baile de graduación. Pero con la misma velocidad que crece su romance, crece la amenaza de la dolorosa presión de los amigos.

items.title: Star Trek II: la ira de Khan
items.description: Es el siglo XXIII. La Federación Unida de Planetas Enterprise está haciendo maniobras de entrenamiento de rutina, y el almirante James T. Kirk parece resignado al hecho de que esta inspección puede ser la última misión espacial de su carrera.

items.title: Star Trek III: la búsqueda de Spock
items.description: La derrota del almirante Kirk sobre Khan y la creación del planeta Génesis son victorias vacías. Spock está muerto y McCoy se ha vuelto inexplicablemente loco. Luego, una visita sorpresa de Sarek, el padre de Spock, provee una revelación sorprendente.

items.title: Una guerra de película
items.description: Ben Stiller, Jack Black y Robert Downey Jr. encabezan un reparto singular en 'Una Guerra de Película', una comedia de acción sobre un grupo de actores que se disponen a realizar la película de guerra más cara.

items.title: Monster Trucks
items.description: When high school senior Tripp discovers a gas-guzzling creature named Creech, the unlikely duo team up for a fun-filled, hilarious and heartfelt adventure in a real-life super-powered Monster Truck to reunite Creech with his family.

items.title: Star Trek: sin límites
items.description: En una misión de rescate, el USS Enterprise es atacado por Krall, un caudillo militar que ha jurado destruir a la Federación. Estrelló en un mundo desconocido, la tripulación debe unir fuerzas con Jaylah, una guerrera alienígena, para detener Krall.

items.title: Second Chance Christmas
items.description: On her way to drop off divorce papers, Caroline gets hit by a car and wakes up without any memory. She doesn’t recognize the handsome face belonging to her nearly-ex-husband, Jack.

items.title: Edie and Pen
items.description: Two women head for Reno to get simultaneous quicky divorces and end up becoming friends.

items.title: Roustabout
items.description: Elvis is a karate-chopping biker who’s hired as a carnival Roustabout. At first he just provides muscle and a diversion for the beautiful carny girls. Then he picks up a guitar and gets the midway rockin’.

items.title: It Happened One Valentine's
items.description: When ambitious reporter Allie Rusch is recruited by music manager Vivian Cartwright to play cupid to famous pop musicians Caleb Greene and Carson Peet in return for an exclusive story over Valentine's weekend.

items.title: Diana: Conspiracy Theories
items.description: Since the tragic death of Princess Diana, it has been claimed that there was an orchestrated criminal conspiracy to end the life of Diana, Princess of Wales. But could the British Royal family really be behind the murder of a lady who became an interna...

items.title: Shaft (ESP)
items.description: Para detener a un asesino racista, Shaft tiene que rastrear al único testigo que puede dejarlo tras las rejas. Shaft se acerca a la par del peligro.

items.title: Running Scared
items.description: Lots of laughs and a great camaraderie is the recipe for two street-wise cops that have decided to quit the force and open a bar.

items.title: Blue Velvet
items.description: A sensual mystery thriller about strange happenings in a small North Carolina town. A college student stumbles across a bizarre mystery and wants to know more, perhaps too much more.

items.title: The Pope Of Greenwich Village
items.description: Daryl Hannah, Mickey Rourke and Eric Roberts star in this funny, high-voltage story of two small-time thieves after a big score in New York's Little Italy.

items.title: Criminal Law
items.description: Attorney Oldman successfully defends accused killer Kevin Bacon. It is only after proving his client's innocence by discrediting eyewitness, that Oldman discovers Bacon is guilty--and intends to kill again.

items.title: Double Impact
items.description: Identical twins are separated at six months and raised on different continents. They reunite twenty-five years later to avenge the murder of their parents and reclaim their stolen family fortune.

items.title: Alice
items.description: Alice (Mia Farrow) is trapped in a loveless marriage to Doug (William Hurt) when a chance encounter with handsome musician Joe (Joe Mantegna) leaves her conflicted.

items.title: F/X
items.description: Rollie Tyler, a movie special-effects man, accepts $30,000 from the Justice Department's Witness Relocation Program to stage the fake assassination of a mob figure who has agreed to name names.

items.title: A Midsummer's Hawaiian Dream
items.description: Married professors Helen and Demitri set out to find a tiki that will prove the land is sacred. Joining them is a young couple, Hermoine and Zander. The young love sparks a yearning for passion within Helen.

items.title: Road Less Traveled
items.description: Country music singer Charlotte comes back home to Tennessee a week before she's set to get married, hoping to borrow her late mother's wedding dress from her grandmother.

items.title: El lugar donde estuvo el paraíso
items.description: En Iquitos, el cónsul de un país sin nombre debe enfrentarse a una doble persecución. Por un lado, la de las autoridades locales en busca de un refugiado político y, por otro, la de los celos incontrolables de su hija Anna.

items.title: La corona partida
items.description: Tras la muerte de Isabel la Católica en 1504 comienzan tiempos de incertidumbre en los que se viven luchas de poder entre Fernando el Católico y Felipe el Hermoso, cuya principal víctima fue Juana la Loca, legítima heredera al trono de Castilla.

items.title: Raging Bull
items.description: RAGING BULL is director Martin Scorsese's lacerating film biography of middleweight boxing champion Jake LaMotta, who was known during his brief reign as "the Bronx Bull."

items.title: Book of Genesis
items.description: Based on the first book of the Bible,The Book of Genesisis a sweeping and poetic look at the beginning of man’s relationship with God.

items.title: Undeserved
items.description: Dawn is ready to finish her senior year of high school when her neglectful, party loving mother is tragically killed, forcing Dawn to go to live with her aunt Jamie who co-pastors a church with her husband.

items.title: One I Wrote for You
items.description: Ben Cantor is a talented singer/songwriter who walked away from a chance at stardom a decade ago. Burned by an industry that wanted to change him, he chose a simpler life, living with his wife and daughter while playing the occasional song.

items.title: Christmas Child
items.description: A heartwarming story of mystery and discovery based on Max Lucado's bestseller! As Christmas approaches, an enigmatic photograph draws journalist Jack Davenport to Clearwater, Texas, where he discovers an intricately carved nativity. Who made it and why?

items.title: The Adventures of Ociee Nash
items.description: Based on Milam McGraw Propst’s award-winning novel, A Flower Blooms on Charlotte Street The Adventures of Ociee Nash is a delightful and inspiring film. Although nine year old Ociee loves roaming Mississippi’s 1898 rural landscape

items.title: I Am Potential
items.description: “I Am Potential” is based on the inspiring true story of Patrick Henry Hughes. Patrick Henry was born without eyes and his joints didn’t form properly, keeping him from ever walking.

items.title: Hell and Mr. Fudge
items.description: Join one man’s persistent pursuit of the truth behind what the Bible says and doesn’t say about hell in this thought-provoking family film.

items.title: Roadmap Genesis
items.description: Roadmap Genesisis a film documentary that makes the case that the Book of Genesis is a roadmap containing guideposts on how to live a productive, fruitful, and fulfilling life that will help our society lift itself out of its current decline.

items.title: Steps Of Faith
items.description: Steps of Faith is a light-heart dramedy about Faith Houston an accountant, who is directed by God to move to a small town to work on a Hippotherapy farm helping children.

items.title: My Mother's Future Husband
items.description: In the five years since Headly’s father died, the 15-year-old and her mom, René (Lea Thompson,Back to the Future), have become best friends.

items.title: My Many Sons
items.description: My Many Sons follows the true story of legendary basketball coach, Don Meyer (Reinhold), who, despite becoming wheelchair-bound after a nearly fatal car wreck, passed Bobby Knight to become the most winning basketball coach in NCAA history.

items.title: Indescribable
items.description: Amid financial pressures and the uncertainties of World War I, Pastor Frederick Lehman begins to compose a song about the love of God.

items.title: Heaven Is Waiting
items.description: Though it’s been years since his wife died, Ned Stevens still cringes at the thought of dating. After all, why would he start seeing other women when he has to look out for his daughter Liz?

items.title: Healed By Grace 2
items.description: Jesse is approaching her 15th birthday and the only gift she desires is a horse. Unbeknownst to Jesse, her mother Brandy is in the throes of a cancer diagnosis which has Jesse’s father jumping through unexpected obstacles.

items.title: Forty Nights
items.description: Filled with simplistic clarity and truth, 40 Nights is an in-depth character story about one of the most known, questioned and mysterious figures in human history.

items.title: Clara's Ultimate Christmas
items.description: A savvy ten-year-old video blogger’s “Ultimate Christmas” unravels into chaos when her dad unexpectedly leaves for New York and her dog, Luke, runs away from home, two days before Christmas.

items.title: Camp New: Humble Pie
items.description: Penny, Nattie, Emmie, and Jess are best friends who are spending their summer working at a creative arts center called All Things New. Together, they stage Art in the Park, a festival created for children to experience the joy of the arts.

items.title: Chasing Star
items.description: Three Magi Priests journey the unforgiving desert in search of the new born King.

items.title: Altar Egos
items.description: Desperate to see their church grow, Pastor John (Robert Amaya) and wife Betsy (Erin Bethea) do the unthinkable and change their church Christmas pageant. Flabbergasted, elderly choir director Mary Margaret (Sallie Wanchisn) leads the choir to boycott.

items.title: Camp New: Dollar Days
items.description: Penny, Nattie, Emmie, and Jess are best friends who are spending their summer working at a creative arts center called All Things New. Together, they stage Art in the Park, a festival created for children to experience the joy of the arts.

items.title: Entre el amor y el engaño
items.description: Sydney Carpenter no puede evitar sentir que tiene la vida perfecta hasta que su esposo y su hijo desaparezcan. Mientras busca a su familia, se da cuenta de que su marido no era quien ella pensaba.

items.title: El Desfile (LAS)
items.description: La vida de Rachel Kirby se ve agitada cuando su ex marido Matt regresa después de pasar siete años en prisión.

items.title: Una mujer maltratada
items.description: Maryanne y sus hijos parecen tener la vida perfecta, pero, en realidad, están brutalmente atormentados por el esposo de Maryanne. Para escapar, Maryanne y los niños deben pelear una batalla de custodia contra su esposo.

items.title: Inocencia robada
items.description: Una adolecente huyendo se enamora de un camionero carismático que resulta ser un peligroso criminal. Cuando la secuestra por el dinero del rescate, sus padres deben poner sus vidas en riesgo para recuperar a su hija.

items.title: Rompiendo el silencio
items.description: Veronica y sus hermanos deben confrontar a su padre por los abusos sexuales que les infligió cuando eran niños.

items.title: Amor dividido
items.description: Una mujer reaparece después de 10 años para reclamar a sus dos hijos que han sido criados por la viuda de su ex esposo. Dos madres, una biológica y una madrastra, luchan por la custodia.

items.title: Scattered Dreams (LAS)
items.description: Basado en una historia real, en 1951, en Florida, una agricultora migrante es encarcelada injustamente por fraude. Tras su liberación, intenta recuperar la custodia de sus tres hijos al aprender a leer y representarse a sí misma ante el tribunal.

items.title: Elvira
items.description: La verdadera historia de Elvira Arellano, una inmigrante mexicana, que en 2006 se refugió durante un año en una iglesia de Chicago para evitar la deportación.

items.title: Secretos que matan
items.description: Una animadora de la escuela secundaria sospecha que su popular novio es responsable del brutal asesinato de una niña embarazada desde el lado equivocado de las pistas.

items.title: Hispanic Hollywood
items.description: Hispanic Hollywood celebrates the silver screen legacy of Latin American entertainers. From the Golden Era of Classical Hollywood Cinema through some of today’s top actors.

items.title: America Adrift
items.description: Along Long Island's 'Heroin Highway,' heroin use has reached epidemic proportions, devastating hundreds of unsuspecting and seemingly average middle-class families.

items.title: Ator: The Fighting Eagle
items.description: With training and guidance from a man named Griba, son of Torren learns of his heritage and purpose in life: to defeat the spider king.

items.title: El príncipe de Bel Air
items.description: Robin Prince es una soltera y una limpiadora de piscinas que se mantiene ocupada haciendo compañía a las mujeres mientras atienden sus piscinas.

items.title: Nuestros hijos
items.description: Julie Andrews y Ann-Margret son madres de dos hijos homosexuales en una relación, una de las cuales se está muriendo de SIDA.

items.title: La esposa de mi hermano
items.description: Cuando Barney se enamora de Eleanor en una fiesta familiar, sus esperanzas de estar con ella se rompen cuando su hermano la roba. Años más tarde, todos se reunieron en el funeral del padre de Barney, causando problemas para todos.

items.title: Cómo asesinar a un millonario
items.description: Joan Rivers interpreta a la ama de casa de Beverly Hills, Irma Summers, quien está convencida de que su esposo planea matarla.

items.title: Un bebé en casa
items.description: Para un hombre felizmente casado, la vida cambia completamente cuando su esposa decide tener un bebé después de varios años de matrimonio.

items.title: El corazón de Joshua
items.description: El joven Joshua ha visto a su padre tener muchas novias y ninguna ha podido llenar el vacío que dejó su madre hasta que conoció a Claudia. Cuando su padre termina con ella, Joshua tiene dificultades para dejar ir a la familia que cree que finalmente ganó.

items.title: Casadas con el mismo hombre
items.description: El matrimonio de Mitch con Candy se basa en una mentira. Su familia cree que es un agente de la CIA, pero en realidad está con otra familia.

items.title: Travesuras de un angel
items.description: La reina de baile Angela muere en 1962, pero cuando no puede entrar al cielo, la envían de regreso a la Tierra en una misión de redención.

items.title: El asesinato de Nancy Lyon
items.description: Cuando Nancy Lyon muere inesperadamente por envenenamiento por arsénico, su familia cree que su engañoso esposo lo hizo. Incluso con todas las pruebas que apuntan a su esposo, él puede presentar pruebas de que su esposa sufrió una depresión severa.

items.title: Papá
items.description: Bobby debe dejar de lado sus propias aspiraciones y aceptar la responsabilidad cuando descubre que su ex novia Stacy está embarazada de su hijo.

items.title: Los hijos de la novia
items.description: Cuando Margret Becker se compromete con un hombre más joven, sus hijos plantean algunas preocupaciones. Pero Margret tiene otras cosas en mente como planificar una boda y convertirse en abuela.

items.title: Llanto en el bosque
items.description: Es la historia del secuestro de una joven por un desquiciado solitario que llevó a la cacería humana más grande en la historia del estado de Pennsylvania.

items.title: Askari
items.description: Mientras tanto, Emma, una huérfana de 16 años, se esfuerza por adaptarse a la vida en una reserva de animales en África dirigida por sus tíos, ella desarrolla un fuerte vínculo con uno de los elefantes recién nacidos.

items.title: Did Robin Hood Really Exist?
items.description: An iconic outlaw of English history, Robin Hood is one of the most legendary figures of English cultural history from his 15th century roots. Stealing from the rich and giving to the poor, he has been a symbol of noble bravery.

items.title: Bárbara
items.description: Barbara es una reinona elegante que roba un maletín valioso y escapa a las llanuras. Ahí se conoce a Sixto, un granjero joven que corre de un capo de drogas.

items.title: Código Paz
items.description: Pedro Ruiz es un corredor de bienes raíces dominicano de día y un ladrón inteligente pero sin suerte por la noche. Sueña de una vida mejor y dinero fácil. Desesperado, se mete en la mansión equivocada en el momento equivocado.

items.title: Andrea y Lorenzo
items.description: Andrea es una periodista, pero siente que su vida está estática. Lorenzo, un compañero y amante pasado, se ha transformado en un rock star famoso y enseñará a Andrea sobre el amor, vida, y como ser fiel a sí misma.

items.title: Azotes de barrio
items.description: Donay es un joven que casi ha terminado su condena en prisión. Se conoce a Alicia y empieza a soñar de un futuro mejor. Pero cuando regresa a la sociedad, la banda de su barrio quiere traerlo de vuelta al mundo criminal.

items.title: Truth
items.description: A suspenseful, psychological thriller, "Truth" exposes the hidden demons buried deep inside each and every one of us.

items.title: Terminator 2: juicio final
items.description: La máquina no humana que domina la élite del futuro devastado por la guerra despacha un cíborg asesino al pasado para matar a un jovencito porque pronto será el líder de la resistencia en contra de la máquina.

items.title: Homeless For Holidays
items.description: Jack Baker was a successful marketing director on the fast track to the top of the corporate ladder. However, when a fellow employee changes a label at the pharmaceutical company, Jack is wrongfully accused and loses his job.

items.title: Mandie and the Forgotten Christmas
items.description: When Mandie Shaw is thrust into Miss Heathwood’s School for Girls at Christmastime, she struggles to grasp the boarding school’s new rules and the finer points of high society.

items.title: Red Lights
items.description: A psychologist (Sigourney Weaver) and her assistant (Cillian Murphy) investigate a renowned psychic (Robert De Niro) who has resurfaced years after his critic mysteriously passed away.

items.title: An American Crime
items.description: The true story of suburban housewife Gertrude Baniszewski, who kept a teenage girl locked in the basement of her Indiana home during the 1960s.

items.title: Goodbye, Columbus
items.description: Neil is a poor Bronx librarian and Brenda is a pampered Jewish princess from Westchester. Benjamin and MacGraw are superb in their film debuts as the lovers who try to cross class lines amidst kisses and her parents' stiff opposition.

items.title: El club de las divorciadas
items.description: Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn y Diane Keaton son amigas de toda la vida. Después de años de ayudar a sus maridos a trepar la escalera del éxito, cada una ha sido abandonada por una modelo más nueva y voluptuosa.

items.title: Alfie, el seductor irresistible
items.description: Cuando las consecuencias de su estilo de vida afectan a la mujer que ama y a su mejor amigo (Omar Epps), Alfie comienza a preguntarse si hay cosas más importantes que estos romances pasajeros. De ser así, ¿de qué se trata?

items.title: Impacto profundo
items.description: Cuando un par de jóvenes astrónomos descubren un cometa enorme en peligro de colisionar con la Tierra, empieza la cuenta regresiva hacia el apocalipsis y la raza humana se embarca en la lucha por la supervivencia.

items.title: Juego de honor
items.description: Basada en una increíble historia de la vida real, Juego de Honor es un inspirado retrato del polémico entrenador de baloncesto Ken Carter.

items.title: La invención de Hugo Cabret
items.description: Situada en París en 1930, un huérfano que vive entre los muros de una estación de trenes, se encuentra envuelto en un misterioso suceso que involucra a su padre y a un autómata.

items.title: The Proposition
items.description: In this gritty Western written by acclaimed songwriter Nick Cave, a lawman (Guy Pearce) apprehends a notorious outlaw and gives him nine days to kill his older brother.

items.title: The Love Guru
items.description: A hilarious comedy starring Mike Myers as guru Pitka in his first original character since the blockbuster hit Austin Powers.

items.title: Last Train From Gun Hill
items.description: Screen giants Kirk Douglas and Anthony Quinn star in this taut Western thriller directed by acclaimed filmmaker John Sturges (Gunfight at the O.K. Corral, The Great Escape).

items.title: Hamburger Hill
items.description: On the 11th May 1969, troops of the 101st Airborne Division engaged the enemy at the base of Hill 937 in the Ashau Valley. Ten days and eleven bloody assaults later, the troops who fought there called it Hamburger Hill.

items.title: Big Night (1996)
items.description: In a restaurant run by two Italian immigrants, the tables sit empty despite the extraordinary talents of Primo the chef (Tony Shalhoub, “Monk”) and the ambitious efforts of his brother Secondo (Stanley Tucci).

items.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider (ESP)
items.description: La ganadora del Oscar Angelina Jolie reinventa al héroe de acción moderno en la película Lara Croft: Tomb Raider. Lara Croft nació dentro de la opulencia y fue educada en las escuelas más exclusivas

items.title: A.I. Inteligencia artificial
items.description: En un mundo futuro, los humanos comparten aspectos de su vida con robots de compañía llamados "Mechas". Pero cuando un prototipo de niño-robot llamado David es programado para demostrar amor incondicional..

items.title: Small Soldiers
items.description: Joe Dante directed this satirical action-comedy about talking tech toys accidentally juiced-up with military microchips.

items.title: Surfer, Dude
items.description: Longboarding soul surfer Steve Addington (Matthew McConaughey) returns to Malibu for the summer to find his cool hometown vibe corrupted.

items.title: More Than A Game
items.description: Experience the riveting true story that documents future NBA superstar LeBron James and four talented teammates on their inspirational journey from humble beginnings to national acclaim.

items.title: Cementerio de mascotas
items.description: Para la mayoría de las familias, una mudanza es un nuevo comienzo. Pero para los Creeds será el inicio del fin. Se han mudado al lado del lugar que los niños construyen con sus sueños rotos, el Cementerio de mascotas.

items.title: Misión imposible
items.description: Ethan Hunt (Tom Cruise), un agente secreto, es incriminado por la muerte de su compañero de espionaje e intenta deshacerse de los asesinos del gobierno que lo persiguen. Corre contra el reloj mientras intenta descubrir la verdad.

items.title: El último cuerpo
items.description: El asesinato de un travesti despierta en el periodista Heriberto Camargo una sed de verdad. En su investigación, descubre que no es un delito aislado. Es parte de una serie de asesinatos brutales de agentes de policía.

items.title: Fuera De Tinieblas
items.description: José plans a weekend trip with his estranged son Joel , so they can amend. When they arrive to the camp, they are stalked relentlessly by a strange figure, someone who could be linked to the dark past that separated them 25 years ago.

items.title: Los fabulosos má mejores
items.description: A ragtag Dominican kid's baseball team and their nutty coach must find a way to use their charm and skills to raise the necessary funds to get into the first ever Little League Baseball Tournament and win the championship.

items.title: Wild Bill
items.description: Wild Bill focuses on the last days of gunfighter, Wild Bill Hickok, consorting in Deadwood with Calamity Jane, observed by a longtime friend, and haunted by the ghosts of his past, from an old flame to a young man who announces his intention to kill Bill.

items.title: The Nutty Professor
items.description: Jerry Lewis directed, co-wrote and starred in this riotously funny movie that set a new standard for screen comedy and inspired the hit remake.

items.title: Las aventuras de Tintín
items.description: De los ganadores del premio de la academia Steven Spielberg y Peter Jackson llega una historia épica Las Aventuras de Tintin quien empieza una carrera alrededor del mundo para descubir el misterio de un barco hundido.

items.title: Radio Rebel
items.description: Tara Adams is just an ordinary high school junior, except for one little thing. Tara has a secret identity-she's Radio Rebel, the most popular radio DJ in Seattle.

items.title: The Rolling Stones: Rock Royalty
items.description: The Rolling Stones are arguably one of the biggest rock and roll bands of our time, influencing society and music in ways that will never be forgotten.

items.title: Bruce Springsteen: Glory Days
items.description: Bruce Frederick Joseph Springsteen, more fondly known as 'The Boss' by his millions of fans, is widely regarded as one of the most influential songwriters of the 20th century and one of the greatest artists of all time. This is his remarkable story.

items.title: Paris When It Sizzles
items.description: Richard Quine directs George Axelrod's acerbic script (adapted from Julien Duvivier's La Fête à Henriette) in this romantic comedy that reunites William Holden and Audrey Hepburn for the first time since 1954's Sabrina.

items.title: Donovan's Reef
items.description: Acclaimed director John Ford and screen legend John Wayne team up for what would be their final collaboration in this boisterous, rowdy South Seas escapade.

items.title: Children of a Lesser God
items.description: One of the most critically-acclaimed films of the 80s, Children of a Lesser God garnered four Academy Award nominations and a Best Actress Oscar for Marlee Matlin.

items.title: Neil Young: Heart of Gold
items.description: Soon after completing his critically-acclaimed album “Prairie Wind,” rock legend Neil Young took the Ryman Auditorium – the historic home of Nashville’s Grand Old Opry – by storm, blowing away the audience.

items.title: The Duke
items.description: When his nephew tries to wrest control of his estate from him,the Duke of Dingwall removes the boy from his will and leaves everything to his dog.

items.title: Terremoto de San Andrés
items.description: Cuando una desacreditada sismóloga de Los Andeles advierte acerca de un inminente terremoto de 12.7, nadie la toma en serio. Sola, corre desesperadamente para poner a salvo a su familia antes de que el terremoto separe la ciudad del continente.

items.title: La princesa y el poni
items.description: Una princesa joven protegida es enviada a vivir con parientes en América, donde se hace amiga de un poni cautivo por un sombrío dueño de un carnaval.

items.title: El camino a casa de Izzie
items.description: Un pez de acuario constantemente recogido escapa de su yate a casa, sin darse cuenta de los peligros que la esperan en el océano abierto. Con la ayuda de otras criaturas marinas inadaptadas, aprende no solo a enfrentar los peligros de las profundidades.

items.title: La invasión de los secuestradores de cuerpos
items.description: En la línea de "Invasion of the Body Snatchers", después de que los amigos y compañeros de trabajo más cercanos de una mujer experimentan cambios extremos de personalidad, comienza a sospechar que han sido reemplazados por invasores extraterrestres.

items.title: El embrujo de la casa Whaley
items.description: Cuando un guía turística se mete en la casa más embrujada de los Estados Unidos, con amigos aficionados, la cacería de fantasmas se convierte en un horror del que jamás hubieran imaginado.

items.title: Golden Winter LAS
items.description: Un chico se hace amigo de una camada de Golden Retrievers sin hogar. Juntos, ayudan a detener un robo a un banco justo a tiempo para Navidad.

items.title: Colisión aérea
items.description: Cuando una tormenta solar destruye el sistema de control de tráfico aéreo, Air Force One y un avión de pasajeros están bloqueados en un curso de colisión en los cielos sobre el medio oeste.

items.title: 666: la bestia
items.description: Donald Lawson, el niño del diablo de .666: The Child ,. Ahora es un adulto y está decidido a cumplir su destino como el Anticristo.

items.title: Abraham Lincoln contra los zombis
items.description: Mientras continúa la Guerra Civil, el presidente Abraham Lincoln debe emprender una tarea aún más desalentadora: destruir a los muertos vivientes confederados.

items.title: 666: El niño Diablo
items.description: Un avión de pasajeros se precipita desde el cielo hasta la Tierra. De las brasas ardientes se levanta un sobreviviente solitario: un niño pequeño. La pareja sin hijos que lo adopte pronto descubrirá que no es un niño indefenso sino algo muy poderoso.

items.title: Honor y mentira
items.description: Dos novios de secundaria ingresan en academias militares separadas, lo que pone en peligro su relación cuando uno es infiel.

items.title: I'm A Stripper 3: Boylesque
items.description: James & the Giant Pasty has his very own harem of young men. He’s the ringmaster and snake charmer of Boylesque T.O., Canada’s first all-male burlesque troupe.

items.title: Mandie and the Secret Tunnel
items.description: Set in the early 1900s,Mandie and the Secret Tunneltells the story of a young girl whose life is changed after her father’s unexpected death. Left with a self-absorbed sister and a mean mother.

items.title: Pitching Love And Catching Faith
items.description: Heather (Lauryn Kent) is an attractive softball player, who is used to winning but tends to strike out with guys. Tyler (Derek Boone) is a charming baseball player, who has never kissed a girl.

items.title: Mandie and the Cherokee Treasure
items.description: Though Mandie Shaw is forbidden from interfering with Uncle John’s imminent journey to keep an old promise, travel plans change when Mandie’s long-lost mother, Elizabeth, shows up on the scene.

items.title: Miracle Of Cards
items.description: Eight-year-old cancer patient Craig Shergold (Thomas Sangster) tries to collect the world’s largest influx of greeting cards in this heartwarming true story that follows a British family’s quest to be recorded in the Guinness Book of World Records.

items.title: Bonhoeffer
items.description: Dramatic documentary about the young German pacifist and theologian Dietrich Bonhoeffer who resisted the Nazi regime and was hanged two weeks before World War II was over.

items.title: Divination
items.description: Spiritual forces collide in this supernatural battle between good and evil. Jason (D’angelo Midili) is a young, successful artist, whose wife, Jessica (Natasha Sims), is pregnant with their first child.

items.title: Healed By Grace
items.description: When a horrific accident shatters her dreams of becoming a world class dancer, Riley Adams (Natalie Weese) clings to her faith, determined to recover in time for the national competition.

items.title: Forever Strong
items.description: Hotshot rugby player Rick Penning (Sean Faris) was the star player of his Arizona high school team until a fateful brush with the law forces him to ponder the consequences of his actions in a Salt Lake City juvenile detention center.

items.title: Circle Of Iron
items.description: Aspiring-martial artist Cord lives in a desert-like world where nearly everyone he meets practices or has practiced a martial art. He seeks to find the place where the true inner spirit of the martial arts is being taught.

items.title: Crazy Mama
items.description: Several women begin an outlaws' lives in a desperate trip to their family farm, which was taken off them by corrupt authorities.

items.title: Dead Ringers
items.description: Twin gynecologists take full advantage of the fact that nobody can tell them apart, until their relationship begins to deteriorate over a woman.

items.title: Enigma
items.description: A C.I.A. Agent tries to infiltrate Soviet intelligence to stop a murderous diabolical plot.

items.title: Fear City
items.description: There’s a psychopath on the loose in Manhattan who is stalking and mutilating beautiful strippers employed by booking agents Matt Rossi (Tom Berenger – Platoon, Inception) and Nicky Parzeno (Jack Scalia).

items.title: Flight of the Butterflies
items.description: Scientist Fred Urquhart studies migration of the monarch butterfly for 40 years.

items.title: Howard Lovecraft and the Kingdom
items.description: After returning from his previous adventure, young Howard Lovecraft must lead an expedition including his father, Winfield, Uncle Randolph, and Miskatonic Universitys Dr. Henry Armitage to Antarctica, to prevent the awakening of Cthulhu!

items.title: Jane Eyre
items.description: Jane Eyre is a young woman whose will to overcome a life of hardship leads her into a passionate romance with a handsome -- and mysterious -- gentleman.

items.title: Last Resort
items.description: A Chicago salesman takes his wife and children to Club Sand, a hot spot surrounded by barbed wire.

items.title: Living In Oblivion
items.description: From award-winning writer/director Tom DiCillo (Johnny Suede) comes an inventive, hilarious look at the movie-making business.

items.title: Love Letters (1983)
items.description: A disc jockey's (Jamie Lee Curtis) affair with a married man (James Keach) is like the one in her mother's old love letters.

items.title: MST3K: Master Ninja II
items.description: Joel and the 'bots endure two equally bad episodes from the failed action seriesThe Master(1984).

items.title: MST3K: Star Force: Fugitive Alien II
items.description: Ken and the crew of the Bacchus 3 return in Star Force: Fugitive Alien II (1987) while Joel and the Bots make a Captain Joe action figure and stage a "name that puppet" quiz show.

items.title: Mysteries of China
items.description: Archeologists discover a pit filled with terracotta warriors buried to protect the grave of the First Emperor of China.

items.title: The Dirt Bike Kid
items.description: When his mother sends Jack off with money to buy groceries, he comes home with a magic supercharged dirt bike instead.

items.title: The Engagement Ring
items.description: A long-lost engagement ring still divides childhood sweethearts who are now in their golden years. Now, her daughter (Heaton) and his nephew meet and find that their attraction is hindered by the old feud.

items.title: The Exorcist III
items.description: A police Lieutenant uncovers more than he bargained for as his investigation of a series of murders, which have all the hallmarks of the deceased Gemini serial killer, leads him to question the patients of a psychiatric ward.

items.title: The Legend Of the Lone Ranger
items.description: The sole surviving Texas Ranger of an ambush arranged by the outlaw leader Butch Cavandish returns to fight back as a great masked western hero - The Lone Ranger.

items.title: The Stepfather
items.description: After murdering his entire family, a man remarries a widow with a teenage daughter in another town and prepares to do it all over again.

items.title: Where the Boys Are
items.description: Four college coeds travel to Fort Lauderdale for their Easter week of Spring Break, and become involved in a series of adventures and misadventures, which include the naive Jennie being pursued by musician drifter Scott.

items.title: Traveller
items.description: A con man teaches a novice the rules for membership in an Irish-American grifters gang.

items.title: Sophie's Choice
items.description: Sophie is the survivor of Nazi concentration camps, who has found a reason to live with Nathan, a sparkling if unsteady American Jew obsessed with the Holocaust. They befriend Stingo, the movie's narrator, a young American writer new to New York City.

items.title: To Russia With Elton
items.description: Footage of a concert given in Moscow, Russia, by rock singer Elton John.

items.title: Slumber Party Massacre II
items.description: A teen (Crystal Bernard) and her friends are terrorized by a rock star (Atanas Ilitch) whose guitar is fitted with a drill bit.

items.title: Night Of The Demons (1988)
items.description: On the night of Halloween, 10 teens decide to go to a party at an abandoned funeral parlor. While starting the party, the teens gather around a big mirror to perform a seance...BIG MISTAKE.

items.title: The Slumber Party Massacre
items.description: When Trish (Michele Michaels) decides to invite her high school girls' basketball teammates over for a slumber party, she has no idea the night is going to end with an unexpected guest.

items.title: MST3K: Master Ninja I
items.description: The crew watch a ninja and a drifter save an airport from thugs in "Master Ninja I" while building a model muscle car and experimenting with their ninja skills.

items.title: Fear of a Black Hat
items.description: A mockumentary chronicling the rise and fall of NWH, a not particularly talented--or particularly bright but always controversial--hip-hop group.

items.title: Class Of 1984
items.description: A new teacher at a troubled inner-city high school soon ends up clashing with the delinquent leader of a punk posse that runs the school.

items.title: Farewell, My Lovely
items.description: Los Angeles private eye Philip Marlowe is hired by paroled convict Moose Malloy to find his girlfriend Velma, former seedy nightclub dancer.

items.title: Caged Heat
items.description: In a women's prison, a group of inmates band together to combat the repressive and abusive policies of the warden.

items.title: Blackbelt
items.description: Ex-cop protects a singer from a psycho serial killer.

items.title: Big Bad Mama II
items.description: It's 1934, and the evil local land baron forecloses on Angie's place, and she and her two daughters must leave and continue their life of crime. A reporter witnesses their heist of a bank, and helps them become folk legends by writing a story about them.

items.title: Big Bad Mama
items.description: Mama and daughters get forced by circumstances into bootlegging and bank robbing, and travel across the country trailed by the law.

items.title: Battle Beyond The Stars
items.description: A young farmer sets out to recruit mercenaries to defend his peaceful planet, which is under threat of invasion by the evil tyrant Sador and his armada of aggressors.

items.title: Bertie and Elizabeth
items.description: A chronicle of the life of George VI, who was forced to become King following the abdication of his brother Edward VIII, and his relationship with his wife, Elizabeth.

items.title: Baffled!
items.description: A race car driver suffers from visions where he sees people killed. An ESP expert believes that his visions will really happen.

items.title: Attack Of The 50 Foot Cheerleader
items.description: Aspiring college cheerleader, Cassie Stratford consumes an experimental drug that grants her beauty and enough athletic ability to make the cheer squad. The drug has an unforeseen side effect - Cassie starts to grow and grow and grow.

items.title: A Very Unlucky Leprechaun
items.description: A very unlucky leprechaun over comes great adventures.

items.title: A Summer Story
items.description: A young lawyer from London, Mr. Ashton and his best friend are hiking when he twists his ankle, Ashton is forced to seek help at a nearby farmhouse and stay there for a few days. Innocent beauty Megan David catches the attention of Ashton.

items.title: All Quiet On The Western Front
items.description: A young soldier faces profound disillusionment in the soul-destroying horror of World War I.

items.title: Another Man's Poison
items.description: In an isolated house, mystery writer Janet Frobisher is involved in potentially murderous relationships.

items.title: A Boy And His Dog
items.description: World War IV has ravaged Earth, and its survivors must battle for food, shelter and companionship in a post-atomic wasteland.

items.title: Hype!
items.description: Drop into the Pacific Northwest in the early '90s and watch a vibrant underground music scene explode into a global "grunge" media frenzy.

items.title: The Plague Dogs
items.description: A stunning animated adaptation of Richard Adams' novel, The Plague Dogs follows a pair of dogs, Snitter and Rowf, who escape from a research laboratory and try to survive in the wild with the help of a cunning fox.

items.title: Exterminators Of The Year 3000
items.description: In a post-apocalyptic future where the earth is a desert and water is the most precious substance of all, a band of survivors must turn to a mysterious stranger to battle a ruthless gang of motorcycle psychos for control of the wasteland and the water.

items.title: Chopping Mall
items.description: Eight teenagers are trapped after hours in a high-tech shopping mall and pursued by three murderous security robots out of control.

items.title: We're No Angels
items.description: Humphrey Bogart plays one of his rare comedy roles in this jaunty excursion about three convicts - Joseph (Bogart), Albert (Aldo Ray) and Jules (Peter Ustinov) - who are plotting their escape from Devil's Island.

items.title: I'm A Stripper
items.description: I'm a Stripper follows the lives of male strippers in the sexiest cities in N. America - Montréal, Niagara Falls and Las Vegas.

items.title: Studlebrity
items.description: A Studlebrity is a guy who is famous for his looks. Today there seems to be a new Social Celebrity every time we go online. We are inundated with guys famous for.

items.title: Failure to Launch
items.description: Tripp is a 35-year-old who still lives with his parents. And who can blame him? It’s free, he’s got a great room, and Mom does the laundry. Desperate to get him out of the house, his parents hire a gorgeous woman, Paula, to give him a little…push.

items.title: I'm a Stripper, Too
items.description: I'm a Stripper Too is a follow up to the 2013 TV special 'I'm a Stripper' and follows the lives of male strippers in some of the sexiest cities in N. America.

items.title: Maniac Cop 3: Badge of Silence
items.description: Zombie cop Officer Matt Cordell's (Robert Z'Dar, "Tango & Cash") third ride from beyond the grave has him looking for a girlfriend Ð someone nice, tender and undead.

items.title: In Harm's Way
items.description: Producer-director Otto Preminger’s epic treatment of the bombing of Pearl Harbor details the devastating attack on the Hawaiian naval base as well as the explosive, behind-the-scenes stories.

items.title: Outrage (Kitano)
items.description: Boldly revealing the hidden lives of some of the United States' most powerful policymakers, Outrage takes a comprehensive look at the harm they've inflicted on millions of Americans, and examines the media's complicity in keeping their secrets.

items.title: Surviving the Lagoon
items.description: In the heart of the a vast ocean, the atolls of the Pacific are like oasis in a sprawling desert. Each one contains a unique and breathtaking environment. Where the reef breaks, the ecosystem of the lagoon flourishes.

items.title: Swimming with Legends
items.description: The largest creatures on Earth live underwater. Their sheer size has always triggered our imagination. In murky waters or inaccessible places, we ignored their true nature and created legends. How can we decipher their underwater secrets?

items.title: Girl Rising: Fifth Anniversary Edition
items.description: This special edition of Girl Rising commemorates the stories of nine incredible girls–striving beyond circumstance, pushing limits. Their dreams, their voices, their remarkable stories–captured in an unforgettable film about the power of education.

items.title: The Falling
items.description: It's 1969 at a strict English girls' school where charismatic Abbie and intense and troubled Lydia are best friends. After a tragedy occurs at the school, a mysterious fainting epidemic breaks out, threatening the stability of all involved.

items.title: Amateur Night
items.description: In an effort to provide for his growing family, an expectant father accepts a job as a chauffeur to three prostitutes. Over the course of one night, this dad-to-be finds he just may have the right stuff for fatherhood after all.

items.title: The Boys From Brazil
items.description: A Nazi hunter in Paraguay discovers a sinister and bizarre plot to rekindle the Third Reich.

items.title: Howard Lovecraft and the Frozen Kingdom
items.description: After visiting his father in Arkham Sanitarium, young Howard Lovecraft accidentally uses the legendary Necronomicon to open a portal to a strange frozen world filled with horrifying creatures and a great adventure.

items.title: Slash: Raised on the Sunset Strip
items.description: A Directv and Guitar Center documentary highlights the iconic rock guitarist, Slash. Featuring interviews with Dave Grohl, Joe Perry, Alice Cooper, Duff Mckagan and Nikki Sixx

items.title: The Boxcar Children: Surprise Island
items.description: The continuing adventures of Henry, Jessie, Violet, and Benny as they spend the summer on their grandfather's private island.

items.title: Elizabeth Taylor
items.description: For more than 60 years Elizabeth Taylor's dazzling beauty and scandalous life captured our fascination, provoked our envy, teased our curiosity and, at times aroused our pity. She was American royalty and the undisputed queen of the tabloids.

items.title: Any Bullet Will Do
items.description: Taking place during 1876 in Montana, a ruthless headhunter tracks his own brother through Big Sky country with the help of a young fur trapper.

items.title: Nobel Son
items.description: On the eve of Barkley Michaelson's father receiving the Nobel Prize, Barkley is kidnapped and the requested ransom is the $2,000,000 in Nobel Prize money.

items.title: Grey Owl
items.description: The story of the life and work of the Canadian fur trapper-turned-conservationist who claimed to be an aboriginal North American.

items.title: Flower Drum Song
items.description: A young woman arrives in San Francisco's Chinatown from Hong Kong with the intention of marrying a rakish nightclub owner, unaware he is involved with one of his singers.

items.title: CBGB
items.description: Alan Rickman stars as legendary NYC club owner Hilly Kristal, who during the 1970s, wanted to create a venue for country, bluegrass and blues music (thus the name CBGB).

items.title: The Boondock Saints
items.description: Two Irish Catholic brothers become vigilantes, wiping out Boston's criminal underworld in the name of God.

items.title: The Whistleblower
items.description: This ripped-from-the-headlines thriller is inspired by actual events. Kathy Bolkovac (Rachel Weisz), a Nebraskan police officer, takes a job as a peacekeeper in post-war Bosnia.

items.title: Super Size Me
items.description: Winner at Sundance, director Morgan Spurlock's social experiment in fast-food gastronomy sees him attempting to subsist uniquely on food from the McDonald's menu for an entire month.

items.title: A Royal Night Out
items.description: On V.E. Day in 1945, as peace extends across Europe, Princesses Elizabeth and Margaret are allowed out to join the celebrations. It is a night full of excitement, danger and the first flutters of romance.

items.title: Still Mine
items.description: A husband determined to build a more suitable house for his ailing wife meets with resistance from an overzealous government inspector in this love story based on actual events.

items.title: Meltdown
items.description: After failing to save his wife from 'The Doctor', Kit Li begins working as a bodyguard and secret stunt double for the cowardly martial arts film star Frankie Lane.

items.title: Legend of the Red Dragon
items.description: A young father and his infant son are beset by forces of evil and corruption. They wander China, upholding their sense of honor and protecting the weak. When they are forced into combat, spectacular and hilarious fast-motion kung fu sequences follow.

items.title: Absolutely Anything
items.description: In this hilarious sci-fi comedy, space aliens (voiced by the Monty Python team) bestow extraordinary powers upon an ordinary man (Simon Pegg) to determine the fate of our planet!

items.title: Zodiaco
items.description: La película está basada en los libros de Robert Graysmith sobre la vida real del famoso Zodiaco, un asesino serial que aterrorizó a San Francisco mediante aparentes homicidios aleatorios durante las décadas del 60 y 70.

items.title: El principe de las mujeres
items.description: Marcus Graham, un ejecutivo publicitario, es el soltero por antonomasia y siempre lleva a una mujer nueva del brazo. Cuando aparece en escena Jacqueline, su nueva jefa, Marcus recibe por primera vez su propia medicina.

items.title: Las Aventuras De Moriana
items.description: Después de un aviso de desalojo, Moriana, una madre con tres hijos, se adelanta a la vida y comienza un negocio de restaurante que no funciona.

items.title: El Último Minuto
items.description: Cuando Karla descubre que se está muriendo, decide volver a conectarse con Angie, una sobrina que no había conocido en años. La niña está siendo tratada después de un suicidio fallido.

items.title: Cosmética Terror
items.description: Catalina es una maquilladora de 35 años que trabaja en una funeraria y sueña con ser actriz. Aparece una hada madrina y le da la oportunidad de ser parte de su sueño: ser parte de su telenovela favorita: "Cosmética Terror".

items.title: Telling Lies In America
items.description: A job with a hip disc jockey (Kevin Bacon) shapes a teen's (Brad Renfro) life and that of his poor immigrant father (Maximilian Schell) in 1960s Cleveland.

items.title: Take Me To the River (2014)
items.description: Music legends from Stax records and Memphis mentor and pass on their musical knowledge to contemporary artists.

items.title: Keys To Tulsa
items.description: Eric Stoltz heads the ensemble as Richter, a young man maneuvering his way through a wonderfully bizarre array of characters in a town filled with wealth, greed, malice, and murder.

items.title: Eat My Dust!
items.description: Darlene's into going fast, Hoover's into Darlene, but when they both get into a red-hot race car, the reckless fun accelerates into a trunk-full of hot pursuits.

items.title: David And Lisa
items.description: The story of a young man in a mental institution for teens who begins to understand his psychosis and finds intimacy with Lisa, a young woman suffering from dissociative identity disorder.

items.title: Cockfighter
items.description: A man who trains fighting cocks vows to remain silent until one of his birds wins a championship.

items.title: Book Of Days
items.description: A grief-struck life insurance salesman rails at God for not stepping in to save his bride; but the tables are turned when a mysterious book is delivered to him, an ancient volume listing names and death dates, dates which are yet to occur.

items.title: Bloodfist
items.description: Don Wilson plays retired kickboxer Jake Raye, who travels to Manila, where his brother is favored to win a kickboxing competition.

items.title: Basmati Blues
items.description: A brilliant scientist is plucked out of the company lab and sent to India to sell the genetically modified rice she created - which she doesn't realize will destroy the farmers she thinks she's helping.

items.title: Paint Your Wagon
items.description: A Michigan farmer and a prospector form a partnership in the California gold country. Their adventures include buying and sharing a wife...

items.title: Hot Rod
items.description: A comedy about a stunt man who’s never successfully landed a jump without wiping out and his attempt to master the biggest stunt of his life.

items.title: Investigating Historical Jesus
items.description: This thought provoking documentary follows the historical path of Jesus from birth to his crucifixion. Created by a culturally and religiously diverse cast and crew, this film looks to explore the real locations behind the stories.

items.title: Meet John Doe
items.description: A man needing money agrees to impersonate a nonexistent person who said he'd be committing suicide as a protest, and a political movement begins.

items.title: Three On The Trail
items.description: An evil gang is involved in both cattle rustling and the robbing of stagecoaches. Hoppy must stop them without help from the sheriff who turns out be a major outlaw himself.

items.title: Phantom From Space (In Color)
items.description: When an asteroid crashes, the search begins to track down the mysterious aliens. In Vibrant Color!

items.title: Boy in the Plastic Bubble
items.description: The girl next door makes a teen (John Travolta) born with immune deficiencies want to leave his germ-free bubble.

items.title: Ninja War Lord
items.description: Japanese occupation of China breeds an ill wind which stirs the wrath of China's greatest kung fu killers.

items.title: Gene Autry, World's Greatest Cowboy
items.description: Gene Autry was one of the first "singing cowboys" & discovered by Will Rogers. Gene had a lengthy career including radio, records, films & TV.

items.title: Jackie Chan's 36 Crazy Fists
items.description: A young man decides to learn Kung Fu to avenge the death of his father, a peaceful shopkeeper who was murdered by Manchurian gangsters for not paying protection money

items.title: Bruce Lee and Kung-Fu Mania
items.description: Action highlights, featurettes, & original grindhouse trailers from 40 of the greatest martial arts films of the 70's. This kung-fu-fighting, karate-kicking compilation features the real Bruce Lee & his many clones.

items.title: My Generation
items.description: "My Generation" tells the story of the pop culture explosion in 1960s London through the eyes of Britain’s greatest living movie actor, Michael Caine. This was a generation that led the world into the most tumultuous decade of the century.

items.title: Diet Fiction
items.description: This film exposes the most popular diets on the planet as well as several misconceptions about weight loss and nutrition. The film follows the audacious filmmaker Michal Siewierski (Food Choices) in his treacherous journey.

items.title: King of Beasts
items.description: With unprecedented access and unique firsthand footage, KING OF BEASTS dives deep into an American hunter’s relentless pursuit of his 14th lion trophy. Where does savagery truly lie, and who is the true King of Beasts?

items.title: With a Kiss I Die
items.description: Centuries after Romeo’s death, Juliet Capulet falls in love with a young woman and is once again forced to choose between love and family obligation, terrified her past mistakes will once again lead to tragedy.

items.title: To Err is Human: A Patient Safety Documentary
items.description: Medical mistakes lead to as many as 440,000 preventable deaths every year, making it the #3 leading cause of death in the US. To Err Is Human is an in-depth documentary about this silent epidemic and those working hard to fix it.

items.title: The Pickle Recipe
items.description: Desperate for cash, a down-on-his-luck party emcee is corrupted by his shameless uncle to steal his grandmother’s top secret pickle recipe. It’s a recipe she has vowed to take to her grave.

items.title: The Insufferable Groo

items.title: Letter from Masanjia
items.description: An SOS note penned by a Chinese prisoner is found by a mom in Oregon, sparking a nail-biting chain of events that exposes appalling human rights violations and shuts down China’s labour camp system.

items.title: Grand Cru

items.title: California No
items.description: A listless writer finds out that he's in an open marriage.

items.description: An angry, crackling and defiantly disordered underclass of nowheresville punk-rock kids, see their band Surgeon General’s Warning (SGW) as their ticket out of small town Texas, as 1990 comes to a close.

items.description: Ben (Brian J. Smith, “Sense8”), an honest tow truck driver, turns to "chasing" car accidents to score the most expensive tows. Desperate for cash, Ben will stop at nothing to provide for his family and give them the life they deserve.

items.title: John Lennon: Hard to Imagine

items.description: Renowned as one of the greatest performers of the 20th century Freddie Mercury pushed the boundaries of art and music as he lead his band Queen to international stardom.

items.description: Eminem is one of the most influential rappers of all time. Spanning over 2decades, he has changed the sound of hip-hop and mainstream music everywhere. His notorious persona and explicit lyrics have caused controversy and offended millions.

items.title: Diana: The People's Princess
items.description: A princess so tragically taken in the prime of her life, who came into the British Royal family and the public eye as a shy young woman, grew into one of the most popular and adored woman in the world.

items.description: The Mississippi sound was explored by countless artists in Music, but only a few managed to get the sound across the globe and into the mainstream charts. One of those artists is Creedence Clearwater Revival.

items.description: Robert Nesta Marley, known across the globe as Bob Marley, was the first and debatably only superstar ever to emerge from the third world.

items.description: George Harrison was an English guitarist, singer, songwriter, and music and film producer who initially achieved international fame as the lead guitarist of the Beatles, but went on to sell millions of critically acclaimed solo records. Harrison was ...

items.description: Phil Lynott was Ireland's first rock and roll international superstar. His hard-man image helped him stand out to the world as one of the most influential rockers of the 1970s.

items.title: Pink: The Truth
items.description: Although initially seen as yet another act in the late 90’s crowd of teen pop acts, Pink quickly outgrew the tag with her combination of pop song craft and powerhouse, rock-influenced lyrics.

items.title: Michael Jackson: Remember the King
items.description: There are very few artists who have obsessed the world like Michael Jackson did. Now musical royalty, his singles topped the charts all over the globe, selling over 350 million records whilst holding the record for the best selling album of all time. ...

items.description: From Snoop Dog To Britney Spears, Pharrell Williams has worked alongside and produced songs for some of the hottest stars in the music industry.

items.title: Shred Bots The Movie
items.description: Less like robots and more like “bro-bots”, this epic ensemble of Norwegian and Canadian riders are about to present you with a serious lesson in Kinematics: That’s android terminology for “the study of motion, as applied to robots”.

items.title: Taylor Swift: Just for You
items.description: Known for lyrics about her personal relationships and heart warming smile, Taylor Swift has exploded on the music scene, creating a modern spin to pop country music. Learn how she came from a Christmas tree farm in Pennsylvania, to living the life of s...

items.description: Elvis Presley had a select group of friends he entrusted with his life.Through never seen before interviews, this documentary will explore Elvis’ life through the eyes of The Memphis Mafia, from the highs…To the lows.

items.description: When Katie (Kat Foster), an out of work actress, unexpectedly lands a starring role in the sexually explicit mini-series adaptation of a best selling, erotic chick lit novel, her boyfriend, Paul (Scott Rodgers), can barely muster a congratulations.

items.title: William Shakespeare

items.description: The marriage of Prince Charles and Princess Diana remains infamous for being one of the most turbulent royal weddings in modern history. As the cracks began to form the world watched.

items.title: Shania Twain: Empowerment
items.description: Considered as The Queen of Country Pop, she is one of the best-selling artists of all time, having sold over 85 million records. Her album ‘’Come on Over’’ being the best-selling album by a female artist and the top-selling country album of all.

items.description: Kanye West is a Grammy-winning rapper and in-demand producer who is known on a global scale for his outrageous statements and for his broad musical palette.

items.description: Con la esperanza de conquistar a una chica, Tristan le promete una estrella fugaz. Pronto descubre que la estrella es en realidad una belleza celestial llamada Yvaine. Cuando la vieja bruja Lamia intenta robar la juventud de Yvaine.

items.description: Roger is a charming scoundrel and Norway’s most accomplished headhunter. He lives a life of luxury well beyond his means and subsidizes his expensive lifestyle by stealing highly prized art. When his beautiful wife, an art gallery owner.

items.description: In the world-famous Alvin submersible, Deep-sea explorer Dr. Erik Cordes is searching for a 'Supercoral' on the bottom of the ocean that will survive Ocean Acidification and help prevent mass extinction. But is he too late?

items.title: Prince & Me II: The Royal Wedding

items.title: Coward Of the County part 1
