items.description: When Federal Officers Elizabeth Anderson (Julia Ormond) and Sam Hallaway (Bill Pullman) arrive at Captain Billing’s office, they have three sets of stories to figure out and a string of vicious murders to consider.

items.title: Dead Bodies
items.description: Tommy’s world is altered unexpectedly when his ex-girlfriend, Jean, returns to overtake him and his apartment. Leaving after a heated quarrel, Tommy returns to his apartment to find Jean dead. After concocting a plan and dragging his friend.

items.title: They Call Me Sirr
items.description: True story of Sirr Parker's challenging upbringing and his struggles in the face of adversity to become a national high school sports phenomenon.

items.title: Vipers
items.description: Genetically enhanced man-eating vipers overtake an idyllic island community, forcing the few survivors into a hissing, slithering stand-off.

items.title: The Line King: The Al Hirschfeld Story
items.description: The childhood, adolescence, and incredible adult years of Al Hirshfeld, celebrated creator of thousands of line drawings of famous people - many in the entertainment industry - over a span of more than sixty years. He is still drawing in his nineties.

items.title: The Twelve Days of Christmas Eve
items.description: Calvin Carter, a successful business executive, has it all, but neglects those closest to him. On Christmas Eve, all that changes when the sign on his office building falls on him.

items.title: Thunder and the House of Magic
items.description: A little lost cat discovers a marvelous and mystical new home in Thunder and The House of Magic, an enchanting animated film for the whole family!

items.title: On Golden Pond
items.description: Norman is a curmudgeon with an estranged relationship with his daughter Chelsea. At Golden Pond, he and his wife nevertheless agree to care for Billy, the son of Chelsea's new boyfriend, and a most unexpected relationship blooms.

items.title: MST3K: Tormented
items.description: In Tormented, jazz pianist Tom Stewart, soon to marry the woman he loves, watches former love Vi Mason fall from a lighthouse and does not save her. Vi’s spirit returns and begins to torment Tom at his every step.

items.title: Flying Swords Of Dragon Gate
items.description: A Ming Dynasty freedom fighter (Jet Li), a female warrior (Zhou Xun) and a corrupt eunuch (Kun Chen) are among those who converge on a remote desert hostel that sits atop a city of treasures.

items.title: Filly Brown
items.description: A promising hip-hop rhymer from Los Angeles finds herself in a gray area when a record producer offers her a compromising shot at stardom.

items.title: Bodyguards and Assassins
items.description: In 1905, revolutionist Sun Yat-Sen visits Hong Kong to discuss plans with Tongmenghui members to overthrow the Qing dynasty. But when they find out that assassins have been sent to kill him, they assemble a group of protectors to prevent any attacks.

items.title: Bloodfist III: Forced to Fight
items.description: An innocent half-Asian kickboxer (Don "The Dragon" Wilson) is caught between two other races at war in prison.

items.title: A Monster In Paris
items.description: A 3D-animated movie set in Paris in the year 1910 and centered on a monster who lives in a garden and his love for a beautiful, young singer.

items.title: Capricorn One
items.description: A NASA Mars mission won't work, and its funding is endangered, so they decide to fake it just this once. But then they have to keep the secret.

items.title: Detective Dee and the Mystery of the Phantom Flame
items.description: An exiled detective is recruited to solve a series of mysterious deaths that threaten to delay the inauguration of Empress Wu.

items.title: True Legend
items.description: Su Qi-Er retired from his life as a renowned Qing dynasty general in order to pursue his dream of a family and his own martial arts school.

items.title: Un amor
items.description: Los amigos de la infancia Bruno y Lalo son inseparables. Hasta que una joven hermosa y de espíritu libre llamada Lisa entra en sus vidas, girando rápidamente sus cabezas y encendiendo un triángulo apasionado pero desgarrador.

items.title: Tiempo de morir
items.description: Después de cumplir su condena, un ex pistolero regresa a su ciudad planeando vivir una vida tranquila, sin embargo, los hijos de un hombre que mató tienen otros planes.

items.title: The Seventh Fire
items.description: Terrence Malick presents this haunting and visually arresting nonfiction film about the Native American gang crisis.

items.title: Somewhere in the Middle
items.description: Four lovers find themselves caught in a tangle of intersecting relationships in this engaging, New York-set romantic drama that explores the ripple effects of love and obsession.

items.title: Second Coming
items.description: Busy parents Jackie and Mark are shocked when she inexplicably becomes pregnant. Jackie insists she has been faithful, but Mark reacts with rage, knowing the baby can't be his. Will this seeming miracle bring the family closer together or tear them apart?

items.title: Sea Fog (Haemoo)
items.description: Desperate to keep his fishing ship in business, a cash-strapped Korean sea captain and his crew agree to smuggle Chinese immigrants into the country. After their plan goes horribly wrong, violence erupts among the sailors as the ship is caught in sea fog.

items.title: Scarlet Diva
items.description: A young Italian actress embarks on a self-destructive spree of sex, drugs and other excess while doing some soul searching to find the path for redemption.

items.title: Men Go to Battle
items.description: A historical epic of intimate proportions, Men Go to Battle is a tale of fraternal dysfunction amid the backdrop of the Civil War.

items.title: Mad Tiger
items.description: Two best friends have spent the last fifteen years touring the country in their performance art punk band. When one of them decides to quit, they both face deeper challenges than expected.

items.title: Hitler's Children
items.description: A documentary looking into the lives of the descendants of the top Nazi officials who worked under Hitler's command.

items.title: Esclavo de Dios
items.description: Basado en hechos reales, un bombardeo de 1994 en Buenos Aires. "Esclavo de Dios" es la historia de Ahmed, un terrorista islámico asignado para ejecutar un atentado suicida en una sinagoga, y David, agente especial israelí que tratará de evitar el ataque.

items.title: Coby
items.description: Christian Sonderegger’s feature debut is a timely, award-winning, and inspiring family documentary set in a small Midwest town which intimately captures both Suzanna’s transition into COBY and their loved ones’ embrace of his metamorphosis.

items.title: Between Land and Sea
items.description: Set against the backdrop of Ireland’s stunning west coast, this observational documentary combines exhilarating footage with insightful, moving and often humorous portraits of the ocean-going natives of County Clare.

items.title: A Time For Dying
items.description: Bud Boetticher's western follows the desperate attempts of an aspiring bounty hunter as he faces off with Jesse James in a final showdown.

items.title: Matar a un hombre
items.description: Un hombre de clase trabajadora, cansado de ser víctima de delincuentes, decide tomar la justicia en sus propias manos.

items.title: King: rey de los simios
items.description: En este recuento moderno del clásico de fantasía y acción y aventura de Sir Arthur Conan Doyle, un avión comercial se estrella profundamente en el corazón de la Amazonía. A

items.title: La era de los dinosaurios
items.description: Usando una tecnología innovadora de regeneración de carne, una empresa de biotecnología crea un conjunto de dinosaurios vivos. Pero cuando las criaturas escapan de la exhibición de su museo y aterrorizan a Los Ángeles.

items.title: Ace in the Hole
items.description: A cave collapse traps a man, and all eyes turn toward the tragedy, including those of Charles "Chuck" Tatum (Kirk Douglas), a washed-up newspaper reporter who sees the incident as a ticket back to his former days at the top of the journalism heap.

items.title: What Just Happened
items.description: A movie producer desperately tries to save his two films from falling apart while managing the chaos of two marriages that already have.

items.title: Outrage: Way Of The Yakuza
items.description: In a ruthless battle for power, several yakuza clans vie for the favor of their head family in the Japanese underworld. The rival bosses seek to rise through the ranks by scheming and making allegiances sworn over saké.

items.title: Outlaw
items.description: A group of people who feel betrayed by their government and let down by their police force form a modern-day outlaw posse in order to right what they see as the wrongs of society.

items.title: Cara o sello
items.description: Carlos Mendoza es un policía honesto. Cuando no acepta un soborno y encarcela a los culpables, despierta la ira de un narcotraficante local, que secuestra a su familia y lo hace elegir entre su familia, su carrera y su compañero.

items.title: Bye Bye Birdie
items.description: Musical about a rock 'n roll singer about to be drafted, and his songwriter manager whose romantic complications are compounded by a small-town girl.

items.title: Surfwise The Amazing True Odyssey Of The Paskowitz Family
items.description: The inspiring and tumultuous story of 85-year old surfer, health advocate and sex guru, Dr. Dorian "Doc" Paskowitz, his wife Juliette, and their nine children, who were all home-schooled and raised in a small camper on the beach.

items.title: Kong: "King of Atlantis"
items.description: The ancient empire Atlantis is returning to Earth.

items.title: Lotoman 003
items.description: Miguel y Modesto Marchena están de vuelta en la pobreza. Un enfrentamiento con un par de ciclistas ladrones los convierte en héroes locales y los pone en contacto con una agencia secreta que los recluta para una tarea.

items.title: Resistance
items.description: After the failure of D-Day in 1944, the women of a remote British village awake to find their husbands gone to fight with the resistance.

items.title: The Magic Of Belle Isle
items.description: Morgan Freeman plays Monte Wildhorn, a famous Western novelist whose passion for writing hits an impasse. He takes a lakeside cabin for the summer in picturesque Belle Isle.

items.title: The Lost City
items.description: Veteran actor Andy Garcia steps into the director's chair for his first voyage into feature filmmaking with this heartfelt tribute to revolutionary, late-'50s-era Cuba and offering the director himself in the starring role.

items.title: Kiss Of The Damned
items.description: Beautiful vampire Djuna tries to resist the advances of the handsome, human screenwriter Paolo, but eventually gives in to their passion.

items.title: A Century of War
items.description: Director Sean Stone presents a story of America's expansion abroad through military interventions, at the expense of domestic industry. In looking to revive the American economy, Stone argues for innovations in energy and infrastructure.

items.title: Solteras indisponibles
items.description: Tres niñas pequeñas, mejores amigas, conocen a un hechicero que les concede un deseo: tener la misma suerte en el amor. Varios años después, cada una de ellas tiene su propia vida hasta que un día un evento inesperado cambia sus destinos

items.title: Papita, maní, tostón
items.description: Andrés, un fanático del club de béisbol Leones, obtiene por error las entradas para el área VIP de los Navegantes, su equipo rival. Cuando conoce a Julissa y se enamora, van a complacer a sus familias, fingiendo ser fanáticos de los otros equipos.

items.title: La Familia Reyna
items.description: Isaac es un empresario agricultor, jefe de dos casas. Está orgulloso de su éxito, casi como si fuera el propietario de todo el Valle de Costanza, a expensas de su propia familia. Todo cambia cuando Ismael, su hijo mayor y descarado, vuelve a casa.

items.title: Las caras del Diablo
items.description: Pedro Ramírez es un detective junior obsesionado con el asesinato de un menor. Tres años después del crimen, su hija Sarah es secuestrada en circunstancias muy similares, iniciando una imparable persecución para capturar al criminal.

items.title: Suburbia
items.description: Suburbia is director Penelope Spheeris's study of the Los Angeles punk rock scene in the early 1980s. Evan and his younger brother leave their broken home in an attempt to escape their alcoholic mother.

items.title: Bad Seed
items.description: When average guy Preston (Luke Wilson) finds out that his wife, Emily has been cheating on him, his life quickly spirals out of control. After leaving the house, Preston returns to discover that Emily has been killed.

items.title: Alone Yet Not Alone
items.description: ALONE YET NOT ALONE is based on the inspirational, true story of Barbara and Regina Leininger, two immigrant sisters forced to embark on a journey of faith that will lead them through the darkness of war into the light of freedom.

items.title: Cut Poison Burn
items.description: Cut Poison Burn is a searing film that illuminates the grim truth about America's so-called War on Cancer.

items.title: Between Heaven and Ground Zero
items.description: This powerful documentary focuses on Leslie Haskin's harrowing firsthand account of being one of the last to leave one of the crumbling Twin Towers.

items.title: Star Trek VII: Generations
items.description: Picard’s only hope for a future rests within the Nexus...and a legendary captain from the past.

items.title: Necessary Roughness
items.description: The Texas State Armadillos are fourth down and nowhere-to-go after a corruption scandal nearly ends the football program. Now upstanding coach Ed Gennero (Hector Elizondo) must put together a brand-new team.

items.title: Beavis and Butt-Head Do America
items.description: When their TV is stolen, Beavis and Butt-head hit the road in a hilarious film debut that proves what millions of fans already know: Beavis and Butt-head RULE!

items.title: Mercy's Girl
items.description: Mercy lives a double life. In one she is dating a sexual and loving college student named Jesse. In the other she is living by her family's religious standards. As her two world's begin to collide she must find her identity in both.

items.title: The Kids from 62-F
items.description: A group of kids find classified information from NASA and an object from another Planet and work to get it back to its Alien rightful owners.

items.title: Monsoon
items.description: In the hot desert monsoon season of Arizona, best friends John and Sarah have trouble letting go of each other after a tragedy rips them apart.

items.title: Rip It!
items.description: Witness the mischief of illegal street racing, pro surfing and skateboarding all in one new action sports packed film. Highlights include riots, burnouts, huge surfing airs, and tubes as well as downhill skateboarding.

items.title: The Yes Men Are Revolting
items.description: For 20 years, notorious activists the Yes Men (Mike Bonanno and Andy Bichlbaum) have staged outrageous hoaxes to hijack public dialogue about the issues of the day.

items.title: The World of Esports
items.description: With over 4000 tournaments worldwide, 17,000 professional players, and prize pools of up to $24million, the world of competitive gaming has become one of the biggest industries of the 21st century.

items.title: Severe Off-Road 1
items.description: Severe Off-Road 1 is a gritty thrill ride into the sport of off-road racing and features some of the best racing and personalities in off-road. The film features killer action from trick trucks, bikes, buggies, ATVs, trophy karts, rhinos and more.

items.title: Keedar Whittle: Hear Me Out
items.description: Dating is different, all exes are exes for a reason and crazy family members will always bring us together as one! This super funny, jam-packed comedy special, shot in LA, explores Keedar's big changes in life!

items.title: Joe Strummer: Cut the Clash
items.description: Joe Strummer was one of the most memorable figures of the punk era. His rebellious image, angry political statements, and on-stage energy made him stand out as one of the most inspiration frontmen of all time.

items.title: The Arena: North Shore
items.description: In the world of sports, there is a point in every young athletes career when they will be tested both physically and mentally to see if they are among the elite to make it into the professional arena.

items.title: Severe Off-Road 3
items.description: Severe Racing gets Down and Dirty with their 3rd film in the Red Hot sport of Off-Road Racing. Trophy Trucks, Buggies, MX Motorcycles, ATV's and UTV’s battle it out across Americas toughest terrains.

items.title: Fleetwood Mac: Their Own Way
items.description: Come with us as we explore the captivating story of one of the most successful and unique bands in history.

items.title: Finding Kim
items.description: Fifty-year-old Kim has made a decision. A decision a lifetime in the making: transitioning to a man.

items.title: Coldplay: Behind the Stage
items.description: Coldplay is one of the biggest British bands of all time. With their constantly developing sound, they have dominated the charts for almost 2 decades.

items.title: California Collection
items.description: California Collection is the ultimate compilation of four HD and 4K surf films on California starring John John Florence, Jordy Smith, Kelly Slater, and Dane Reynolds.

items.title: Clash of the Surfing Titans
items.description: The greatest rivalries and match ups in surfing history. Including surfing icons Tom Curren Versus Occy.

items.title: SK Gaming: The Journey
items.description: Follow the exciting story of five young men who rose from humble beginnings in Brazil to form the leading CS:GO (or Counter Strike: Global Offensive) team in the world, SKGaming.

items.title: Gold Goons
items.description: The Goons have escaped from the asylum and are now invading the streets. Witness the chaos and destruction that's unleashed by these unruly masked men in the new full-length video from Gold.

items.title: Return To Hell's Gate
items.description: God forgives, Hells Gate doesn't! It's considered one of the hardest extreme enduro races in the world. 80 riders will endure a day full of pain and suffering as they battle the harsh terrain of the Tuscany mountains on their dirt bikes.

items.title: The New York Hardcore Chronicles Film 1.5
items.description: Director Drew Stone's New York Hardcore series returns with The New York Chronicles Film 1.5. Featuring never before seen footage and brand new interviews with Sammy Siegler.

items.title: Bottle Shock
items.description: The story of the early days of California wine making featuring the now infamous, blind Paris wine tasting of 1976 that has come to be known as "Judgment of Paris".

items.title: The Snow Walker
items.description: A pilot and his passenger struggle for survival after crashing in the Arctic tundra.

items.title: Mrs Dalloway
items.description: In 1923 London, socialite Clarissa Dalloway's well-planned party is overshadowed by the return of an suitor from 33 years ago. Starring Oscar winner Vanessa Redgrave.

items.title: Women Who Kill
items.description: Commitment-phobic Morgan and her ex-girlfriend Jean are locally famous true crime podcasters who suspect Morgan's new love interest is a murderer.

items.title: Lover's Prayer
items.description: In 1800s Russia, a man falls in love with a tragic girl who flirts with and manipulates her older suitors. With Golden Globe and Emmy nominee Kirsten Dunst and Oscar nominee Julie Walters.

items.title: A Merry War
items.description: When a successful advertiser abruptly walks away from his career to become a poet, his path is much more difficult than expected. With Oscar nominee Helena Bonham Carter.

items.title: Unexpected
items.description: When an inner city high school teacher (Cobie Smulders) discovers that she is pregnant at the same time as one of her most promising students, they develop an unlikely friendship.

items.title: La hija de la luz
items.description: Con rasgos que rememoran al Sexto sentido y La profecía llega este fascinante thriller sobrenatural lleno de escalofríos y un gran suspenso.

items.title: El día de los inocentes
items.description: Cuando Muffy St. John invitó a sus amigos de universidad a la isla privada de sus padres para pasar un gran momento, olvidó decirles que podría ser el último momento de sus vidas.

items.title: Los ojos del mal 2
items.description: See No Evil 2 revive la pesadilla de la primera película, cuando Jacob Goodnight se levanta de entre los muertos en la morgue de la ciudad luego de su matanza en el hotel Blackwell.

items.title: El cubo
items.description: Un estudiante, un exconvicto, un ingeniero, un trabajador social, un policía y una persona mentalmente discapacitada quedan atrapadas como ratas en la trampa de un laberinto de cubos que se van engranando entre sí sin una salida clara.

items.title: The Librarian: Quest for the Spear
items.description: As a means of finding the legendary book known as the Key of Solomon, Flynn pairs with a brainy archaeologist to first acquire the map legend. Unfortunately, they must elude the sinister General Samir and the ulterior plans of Flynn's uncle.

items.title: The Librarian: Return to King Solomon's Mines
items.description: Mild-mannered scholar Flynn Carson, chosen to recover and protect priceless historical artifacts from around the world, must travel to the mysterious bayous of New Orleans to find the ancient Judas Chalice

items.title: The Librarian: The Curse of the Judas Chalice
items.description: When a brilliant student takes a job at the New York Public Library, he learns it actually involves safeguarding ancient mystic and historical treasures secretly warehoused there, protecting them from the forces of evil.

items.title: The Drowning
items.description: Tom Seymour, a child psychologist, is haunted by his testimony that sent a young boy to prison for a chilling murder. When the boy, now a young man, reappears in Tom’s life, Tom is drawn into a potentially destructive reinvestigation of the case.

items.title: Flyboys
items.description: Inspired by the true story of the legendary Lafayette Escadrille, this action-packed epic tells the tale of America’s first fighter pilots.

items.title: Blackway
items.description: Set amidst the rugged terrain of the Pacific Northwest, a logger, still grieving over the murder of his daughter, finds revenge when he comes to the aid of a young woman.

items.title: Ken Foster
items.description: A biographical documentary about Vancouver street artist Ken Foster. An enigmatic figure, a prolific street artist.

items.title: Turkey Town
items.description: Gobbles can't wait for the most magical day of the year to arrive! Thanksgiving! So Gobbles invites all his best friends together for a turkey-tastic Thanksgiving sing and dance party in Turkey Town.

items.title: The Rainbow Bridge Motel
items.description: After reserving an all-inclusive wedding package at Niagara Falls, Dean & Darren learn they’ve booked themselves in a run-down motor lodge sandwiched between two chemical plants run by some guy named Shibbawitz and a Burmese refugee family.

items.title: Threesomething
items.description: When a threesome takes an unexpected turn, three horny friends lose their minds and find love… or something like it.

items.title: The Guardians
items.description: An investigative documentary that examines the systemic abuse of elderly people in Las Vegas, Nevada exposing a cautionary tale where some of our society’s most vulnerable citizens are robbed of their life savings and freedom.

items.title: Space Explorers
items.description: When space explorers Nick and Sammy are sent on a mission they race against time to save Earth’s creatures and learn valuable lessons along the way.

items.title: Sea Monsters 2
items.description: The highly-anticipated Halloween Monster Burping Contest is threatened for all underwater creatures, when vengeful Barf joins forces with the dreaded sea monster Big Snot, to kidnap beloved teacher, The Maestro, and his new star-pupil, Corallina.

items.title: Sea Monsters
items.description: When the funniest Monster fish in the sea contest is announced in the town of Schmert, Charlie and his pals Mucus and Frankfish decide to enter the competition in hopes of comedic glory

items.title: Pup Scouts
items.description: When General Hotdog assembles his new pup recruits BooBear and Piper to learn all there is to know about the fascinating world of dogs, the two pups jump in their planes and go for a amazing learning adventure around the globe.

items.title: Planes with Brains
items.description: When Gumdrop and Vroomer, the latest members of the Plane Scout crew, are sent on a mission by commander Gumdrop, they take off on the greatest adventure of their lives.

items.title: Imaginationland
items.description: Barney the Owl is assigned to find the incredible duo known as Scout and Axle. When Barney finds the pair, they take off on an adventure into a land of magic known as Imagination Land

items.title: Haunted Transylvania 2
items.description: Turn your house into a Halloween haunted house party with Haunted Transylvania 2! Sing-Along and dance all night in this fun halloween celebration for kids of all ages.

items.title: Dance!
items.description: Join Kibit and his friends as they dance to kids’ favorite sing-a-longs.

items.title: Bible Prophecies
items.description: Explore bible prophecies and insights into prophetic revelations that will not only affect the chosen, but all of humanity.

items.title: Ladrón que roba a ladrón
items.description: Un par de ladrones profesionales hallan complicado su plan para robar a un millonario después de que los miembros hábiles del equipo regular rechazan el plan. Los ladrones se verán forzados a contratar a novatos para completar el trabajo.

items.title: La Cabeza De Buda (LAS)
items.description: Un drama mexicano protagonizado por Kuno Becker. Un actor famoso ve su vida perfecta de cabeza cuando mata accidentalmente a un intruso en su hogar. Batallando con la culpa, se halla en una espiral descendiente hasta que conoce a la madre del intruso...

items.title: Campamento del terror
items.description: En la búsqueda de diversión y nuevas experiencias, cuatro jóvenes se apuntan como monitores de un campamento. La noche anterior a la llegada de los niños y sin motivo aparente, comienzan a atacarse furiosamente entre ellos.

items.title: The Glass Menagerie
items.description: A son longs to escape from his stifling home, where his genteel mother worries about the future prospects of his lame, shy sister.

items.title: The Cold Equations
items.description: An ordinary space mission turns into a life or death struggle when a by-the-books military man discovers a young, desperate, female stowaway aboard his precisely pay-loaded space vehicle and must eliminate the added weight or perish.

items.title: A Christmas Carol (2018)
items.description: Billionaire Ebenezer Scrooge has made work his only focus since the passing of his childhood friend Marley. On Christmas Eve, after an eventful day of sackings, cancelled Christmas bonuses and even higher profits; Scrooge is visited by three ghosts.

items.title: Einstein's Universe
items.description: A fascinating exploration of Einstein's theory of relativity told by narrator actor Peter Ustinov, and a cadre of preeminent scientists. Produced on the centennial of Einstein’s birth in 1979 by WGBH and BBC, based on Nigel Calder’s titular book.

items.title: Glassland
items.description: A young Dublin taxi driver gets tangled up in the world of human trafficking while trying to save his mother from addiction and provide for his younger brother with Down syndrome.

items.title: The Nutcracker Sweet
items.description: The Silberhaus children are excited for their Christmas festivities to begin when their godfather arrives and presents them with an early Christmas gift. A nutcracker.

items.title: Shadow Government
items.description: Best-selling author Grant Jeffrey details how a system is in place to monitor humanity and how it ties into the Bible.

items.title: The River Within
items.description: A new law-school graduate begins to find a new purpose in life after taking a job as a youth director for his hometown church in this inspiring tale.

items.title: The First American
items.description: Join Newt and Callista Gingrich and discover why George Washington is central to understanding Americaâ€™s founding.

items.title: Accidental Love
items.description: In this star-studded rom-com starring Jessica Biel ("Next") and Jake Gyllenhaal, ("Nightcrawler") a small town waitress gets a nail accidentally lodged in her head, causing unpredictable behavior.

items.title: Bebe's Kids
items.description: When ladies' man Robin meets the beautiful Jamika at a funeral service, he feels he must have died and gone to heaven.

items.title: Sands of Iwo Jima
items.description: Tough-as-nails career Marine Sergeant John Stryker is greatly disliked by the men of his squad, particularly the combat replacements, for the rigorous training he puts them through.

items.title: King Kong (1976)
items.description: A petroleum exploration expedition comes to an isolated island and encounters a colossal giant gorilla.

items.title: El tesoro de Da Vinci
items.description: Un antropólogo forense aburrido debe desentrañar el misterioso código encerrado en las obras de Leonardo Da Vinci. Basada en hechos históricos.

items.title: Piratas de la isla del tesoro
items.description: La vida de monotonía de un posadero cambia repentinamente cuando toma posesión de un mapa del tesoro. Reclutando la ayuda de Long John Silver y su banda de piratas asesinos, se pone en marcha en busca de la maldita Isla Esqueleto.

items.title: Nazis en el centro de la tierra
items.description: Investigadores en la Antártida son secuestrados por un equipo de soldados de asalto enmascarados. Se arrastran profundamente a un continente oculto en el centro de la tierra.

items.title: Desastre aéreo
items.description: El Boeing Next Generation 797 es el nuevo estándar aeronáutico en lujo de pasajeros y tecnología de vuelo. Pero su viaje inaugural encuentra rápidamente la turbulencia cuando una banda violenta toma el control del avión.

items.title: Asesino por naturaleza
items.description: Sean, un joven pintor de casas, no tiene dirección ni apegos en su vida. Cuando Duke, su jefe, le pide que mate a un hombre que amenaza los negocios turbios en los que se involucran Duke y su empleador, Matthews, Sean está de acuerdo, por un precio.

items.title: Edad de hielo
items.description: Terremotos masivos abren la placa tectónica árabe, lo que produce temperaturas bajo cero que serán mortales al anochecer.

items.title: Edward II
items.description: Derek Jarman's adaptation of Christopher Marlowe's Elizabethan drama.

items.title: Street Smart
items.description: A down-on-his-luck journalist tells his editor that he has an exclusive interview with a Times Square pimp in order to get an assignment. He then fabricates a story identical to that of an infamous pimp wanted by the police for murder.

items.title: Vincent & Theo
items.description: An emotionally powerful look at the symbiotic relationship between Vincent Van Gogh and his brother Theo.

items.title: Clive Barker's Lord Of Illusions
items.description: Scott Bakula ("Sibling Rivalry") portrays Harry D’Amour, a private detective visiting Los Angeles on a routine investigation. Harry gets more than he bargains for when he encounters Philip Swan (Kevin J. O’Connor, "The Mummy").

items.title: Carrington
items.description: The true story of the relationship between the English painter Dora Carrington (Emma Thompson) and writer Lytton Strachey (Jonathan Pryce). Between 1915 and 1932, they experimented with a way of life beyond conventional standards.

items.title: Body and Soul
items.description: A poor, idealistic young boxer from the middle of nowhere contends with temptation, compromise and corruption in his rise to become the Welterweight Champion of the World.

items.title: The Other End Of The Line
items.description: An employee at an Indian call-center travels to San Francisco to be with a guy she falls for over the phone.

items.title: Teen Witch
items.description: One week before her sixteenth birthday, a girl realizes that she is the descendant from one of the witches of Salem. She uses her newfound powers to snag herself the football-hero as her boyfriend and to become the most popular girl in school.

items.title: Sword Of The Valiant
items.description: In the magical times of faraway Camelot, the handsome and noble Sir Gawain must resolve the mysterious riddle of the Green Knight or forfeit his life.

items.title: Sleepaway Camp III: Teenage Wasteland
items.description: This time, the camp set in the deep, dark woods is a camp for troubled youths. The psychotic killer that has roamed the woods and been the topic of many ghost stories, is still lurking about.

items.title: Revenge of the Ninja
items.description: Sho Kosugi ("Enter the Ninja") delivers a heart-pounding display of strength, speed and lethal Ninja know-how in this action-packed thriller that takes us back to the good old days of the Kung Fu extravaganza.

items.title: Personal Velocity
items.description: Three women's escapes from their afflicted lives. Each struggles to flee from the men who confine their personal freedom.

items.title: The Perez Family
items.description: A Cuban plantation owner, imprisoned for 20 years, is finally released in 1980 and allowed to join the boat migration to Florida where he yearns to see his wife and daughter.

items.title: Vampire's Kiss
items.description: Teetering on the edge of sanity, volatile literary agent Peter Loew (Nicolas Cage) tries to find purpose in his life through a cutthroat work ethic and a hedonistic nightlife.

items.title: Body Slam
items.description: A rock & roll wrestling comedy with an unscrupulous music promoter latching onto wrestling as his meal ticket.

items.title: Nutcracker: The Motion Picture
items.description: The colorful holiday classic is finally brought to the big screen, designed by famed children's story author and artist Maurice Sendak, and written for the first time to be as close as possible to the original story.

items.title: Music From Another Room
items.description: A man's search for his one true love, whose birth he assisted in as a five-year-old.

items.title: Mr. Mom
items.description: Michael Keaton plays a husband and father who loses his job as an engineer at the auto manufacturing plant. After struggling to find another job, his wife lands a high paying position at an advertising agency.

items.title: Motel Hell
items.description: Veteran actor Rory Calhoun stars as the delightfully fiendish Farmer Vincent in this deliciously ghoulish tale of the macabre that has now become a cult classic.

items.title: Modern Girls
items.description: Three young ladies who are looking for love realize that their friendship is more important than romance.

items.title: Masquerade
items.description: Rob Lowe and Meg Tilly star in this psychological drama about a wealthy young woman who becomes tangled in a web of passion, deceit and heart-stopping suspense after her stepfather wants her killed.

items.title: Love Bites
items.description: A 300-year old vampire (rock star Adam Ant) tries to "re-humanize" after falling in love with a beautiful "mortal." His attempts are thwarted, however, by his jealous vampire lover and his new love's jealous fiancee.

items.title: No Man's Land
items.description: A Los Angeles rookie cop goes undercover to trap a wealthy young auto buff who operates a hot-car ring, and finds he likes his target, the target's sister and stealing Porsches.

items.title: Impromptu
items.description: George Sands was perhaps the most celebrated novelist of the early nineteenth century and it most notorious Bohemian, better known in her own day that even Charles Dickens. Frederic Chopin was among the greatest musicians of his age.

items.title: Howling II: Your Sister Is A Werewolf
items.description: Ben White is investigating the death of his sister, a reporter killed with a silver bullet. At her funeral, Ben encounters an expert in the occult who says that Ben's sister planned her own execution after discovering that she was a werewolf.

items.title: Hercules
items.description: For his enemies, the sword! For his princess, devotion! Hercules, the mighty descended from the heavens half-god and half-mortal, unleashed against the forces of evil as he quests to find the woman he loves.

items.title: Griffin & Phoenix
items.description: Griffin and Phoenix is a poignantly funny love story about two people who face a seemingly insurmountable obstacle that may stand between them and a last chance at love.

items.title: 10 To Midnight
items.description: Charles Bronson plays a tough L.A. cop whose daughter is stalked by a cunning sex-killer in this riveting police thriller that offers a first-rate cast including Wilford Brimley.

items.title: Go Fish
items.description: A romantic tale about finding a soulmate. The only difference here is that both partners are women...in Chicago's lesbian community.

items.title: Enter the Ninja
items.description: The absorbing martial arts film that exposes Ninjutsu, the lethal, little-known "Art of Invisibility"... which includes the use of hypnotism, explosives, and super-human fighting skills.

items.title: Caveman
items.description: Leader of a rag-tag group of cavemen, Atouk has his work cut out for him when he sets his sights on the voluptuous cavewoman Lana (Barbara Bach). Trouble is…Lana belongs to Tonda (John Matuszak) the leader of a clan of “superior” cavemen.

items.title: Blizzard
items.description: An enchanting tale of Katie and her magical friendship with Blizzard, one of Santa's newest reindeer. Blizzard uses her special powers to help Katie realize her own inner, strength and potential.

items.title: Bigger than the Sky
items.description: Drama starring John Corbett, Amy Smart, Sean Astin, and Patty Duke. The story centers on a man stuck in a dead-end life who decides to audition for a small role in a local community theater's production of Cyrano de Bergerac.

items.title: Best Seller
items.description: A widowed Joseph Wambaugh-type cop who writes best-selling crime novels is approached by a former professional hitman to write his life story.

items.title: Bad Influence
items.description: In this Hitchcockian thriller, Rob Lowe stars as Alex, the mysterious drifter who manipulates himself into the drab life of Michael Boll (James Spader), an ambitious young businessman.

items.title: American Buffalo
items.description: A pair of crooks and their young intern plot the theft of a valuable Buffalo-head nickel. Most of the story takes place within the junky confines of Don Dubrow's second-hand store.

items.title: 52 Pick-up
items.description: Life is good for Los Angeles entrepreneur Harry Mitchell (Roy Scheider), great business, beautiful home and a gorgeous wife (Ann-Margret).

items.title: Randy Rides Alone
items.description: When Randy is jailed for murders that he did not commit, Sally Rogers breaks him out of jail, knowing he is innocent. On the run, he stumbles across the real murderer's hideout.

items.title: Humboldt County
items.description: A disillusioned medical student is stranded for a summer in a remote community of counterculture pot farmers, the last place in the world he imagined he would discover himself.

items.title: Invaders From Mars
items.description: In the middle of the night, 11-year old David Gardner awakens to find a spacecraft landing in the hills beyond his home.

items.title: Flawless
items.description: A tough, conservative security guard suffers a stroke during a bank robbery. His recovery requires voice lessons from his drag queen neighbor. The unlikely pair learn to look beyond their differences and find common ground in friendship.

items.title: No One Lives
items.description: The tables unexpectedly turn when a ruthless gang inadvertently kidnaps a seasoned killer who is determined that no one lives. Starring Luke Evans, Adelaide Clemens, and Brodus Clay.

items.title: Arbitrage
items.description: Robert Miller is a New York hedge-fund magnate who appears to have it all—money, power, a loving wife working by his side, and a devoted daughter. But his fortunes turn when a deadly error threatens to destroy his financial empire and his family.

items.title: Blindsided
items.description: On New Year's Eve, a woman faces a terrifying ordeal when two strange men break into her New York City apartment. Sent to recover the diamonds that her boyfriend stole, the psychotic men will stop at nothing to get the job done.

items.title: Just Before I Go
items.description: Courteney Cox makes her directorial debut with this bold and wild comedy following Ted (Seann William Scott), who goes to the extreme to settle unfinished business before ending it all.

items.title: 10 Years
items.description: A group of friends reunites at their high school reunion, each with their own unbelievable story. Starring Channing Tatum (MAGIC MIKE, 21 JUMP STREET) and Rosario Dawson (SIN CITY).

items.title: The Image Revolution
items.description: In 1992, Marvel Comics was the number-one publisher of comic books in the world, largely due to its dynamic artwork. But as a response to what was believed to be years of mistreatment toward creative talent by the industry's leading publishers.

items.title: The Legend of Naresuan: Part 2
items.description: As a follow up to Chatreechalerm Yukol’s The Legend of Suriyothai, Kingdom of War is an epic historical action film about King Naresuan the Great, who liberated the Siamese from the control of Burma, changing the destiny of a nation.

items.title: Alien Encounters: Roswell
items.description: Take a unique journey into the past to examine one of the greatest mysteries in recent history, the Roswell UFO crash. Hear the shocking testimonies of those who experienced the event first hand and delve deep into the evidence and footage that survive.

items.title: Hurt So Good
items.description: Skiing is a roller coaster of emotions. Nothing is comparable to the dream like feeling of being in the mountains, and nothing charges your soul like the buzz that comes with stomping a new trick or blazing your own line through deep snow.

items.title: Prime Wake Movie
items.description: From the creator of Defy, the Danny Harf Project… comes the next level of wakeboarding including a massive movement to bring the sport and it's riders to the top of the action sports world.

items.title: Rock in the Red Zone
items.description: On the edge of Israel’s Negev Desert lies Sderot, a city of factory workers and rock musicians – the children of refugees from North Africa and the Middle East. Despite being pummeled for years by homemade rockets, the people of Sderot persevere.

items.title: Bruno Mars: The Finest
items.description: Bruno Mars is an 11 times Grammy Award winner and 16 times Grammy Award nominee. His infectious and upbeat songs are a testament to his passion for music.

items.title: Beyond the Surface
items.description: Set against the rich hues of India, Beyond The Surface follows Ishita Malaviya, India’s first female surfer, and fellow wave riders Crystal Thornburg-Homcy, Liz Clark, Lauren Hill, Emi Koch, and Kate Baldwin.

items.title: Barn Burner
items.description: Some of the most prominent metal bands playing today started practicing in barns in Lancaster County, Pennsylvania. But Lancaster is still known more for horses and buggies than its music scene.

items.title: Attractive Distractions
items.description: In our film project Attractive Distractions, we take 10 of the most progressive young surfers today on a journey from their hometowns to far off destinations. We were on a mission to capture surfing at its highest level from paddling Jaws at 50 feet.

items.title: Good Company Two
items.description: Tom Wallisch an X-Games gold medalist, has teamed up with friends from all over the world to create something incredible. Based around the simple concept of good friends traveling and skiing together.

items.title: Severe Offroad 4
items.description: Severe Racing presents their 4th Off Road Racing film. Featuring Trophy Trucks, Buggies, Bikes, ATV's and UTV’s, all tearing it up through the deserts of America and Baja Mexico.

items.title: Eye Trip
items.description: Turn out, tune on, and drop in. Skiing’s counterculture continues to buck the trends of what’s come before them- this is a worldwide documentation of ski action as you’ve never seen it presented before!

items.title: After the Sky Falls
items.description: "After The Sky Falls" captures the skiing of Eric Pollard, Chris Benchetler and Pep Fujas. Two years in the making, the film is not an epic portrayal of the sport but is instead an attempt to relate to and inspire everyday skiers.

items.title: Unbroken: Life of Mark McMorris
items.description: Canada’s Mark McMorris has defied the odds since he began his snowboarding career in 2009. Filmmaker, and childhood friend, Adam Burwell follows Mark every step of the way as he competes with the world’s best in Big Air.

items.title: Red Bull Romaniacs Edition Nine
items.description: Red Bull Romaniacs - The toughest Hard Enduro Rallye on earth! This 5-day competition is infamous for being the most difficult, yet rewarding off-road experience one can imagine. This year, the world’s #1 hard enduro rider, Graham Ja...

items.title: Shakira: Latin Queen
items.description: Catchy lyrics and hip-shaking dance moves; Shakira is one of the greatest artists of our time. Her songs have been played all over the globe and have influenced audiences everywhere.

items.title: Uprising
items.description: Uprising is an all-action film with intense sequences of airs, carves and new maneuvers on the made for ripping walls of Lower Trestles. An epic battle from the best surfers in the world in a one hundred percent free surfing bonanza.

items.title: Yoga for Surfing
items.description: Two paths, destined to cross, their fates intertwined. Introducing Yoga for Surfing featuring three routines of varying lengths. Yoga for surfing will open and strengthen your body, increase your stamina, and improve your surfing experience.

items.title: Roll-Call
items.description: Watch as the best lineup of up-and-coming riders put their blood, and fears aside to get the shot again in the highly anticipated Roll Call.

items.title: Offroad Essentials
items.description: Join us on a Motorcycle Journey with Colton Udall, Rory Sullivan, Kyle Redmond, and Colton Haaker, as we explore the types of terrain that define today's off-road racer.

items.title: Man and Machine
items.description: Enter the world of Extreme Enduro where it's Man and Machine against impossible terrain on a time clock. It is pushing yourself beyond your limits and discovering who you really are. And no, this isn't Yoga.

items.title: Thunderstruck 17
items.description: From the tightest chutes in the world, shredded by Randy Swenson, Julio Eiguren and friends, to Linden Ladouceur’s amazing drone winter, to the sky-miles and back-flips of Shad Simmons and Cody Hunt.

items.title: Chasing Addictions
items.description: The next level in modern surfing seen spreading its infectious influences across the California coast and beyond. Chasing Addictions is the latest release from surf filmmaker David Parsa (LIVE: a music and surfing experience, Absolute Mexico).

items.title: 509 Films: Project Adventure
items.description: Project Adventure captures a lifestyle fueled by raw horsepower and intense authentic passion. An adventure told through the eyes of industry leading drivers, captured in world famous riding locations across North America. Project Adventure promises to...

items.title: Overwatch: Be the Hero
items.description: Prepare for battle! Jump straight into one of the fastest-growing game of all time, with over 40 million players, and many pro teams across the globe.

items.title: Tom Petty: Fallin' Free
items.description: Tom Petty was one of the most successful rockers of his generation; his unique blend of country, blues, rock, and psychedelia earned him and his bands a cult following from around the world, but his life wasn’t without suffering.

items.title: Trax Vol. 4: Domination
items.description: Snow biking has rapidly advanced in the past few years, not only in engineering but in its global presence as well. As this growth continues, so do the communities around the globe.

items.title: Meghan Markle: From Hollywood to Windsor
items.description: How do you go from Hollywood to Windsor? Just ask Meghan Markle. In the blink of an eye, the former film and television actress became the most talked-about woman on the planet when she joined the British Royal Family in May 2018.

items.title: 509 Films: Volume 9
items.description: 509, the three time SLEDFILM Festival winner for Best Snowmobile Film is back and better than ever.

items.title: 509 Films: Volume 8
items.description: 509 films is proud to announce the most anticipated snowmobile film in history, Volume 8. The 2012-13 snowmobile season marked a huge step up for 509 films.

items.title: 509 Films: Volume 13
items.description: Volume 13 is the latest installment from 509 and follows the industry’s top snowmobile athletes to the best locations throughout Europe, North America, and South America.

items.title: 509 Films: Volume 10
items.description: The four-time Sledfilm Festival winner, for Best Snowmobile Motion Picture, is back with a high-octane thrill ride.

items.title: 509 Films: Volume 12
items.description: Volume 12 is the latest installment from 509 and follows the industry’s top snowmobile athletes to the best locations throughout Northern America and Japan. Sit back and enjoy a wild thrill ride of backcountry riding starring athletes Brett Turcotte, C.

items.title: Babar King of the Elephants
items.description: Babar goes to live in the big city and learns all about the ways of people. Returning to the jungle, he uses his knowledge to end a war with the rhinoceroses and to build a beautiful city for the elephants.

items.title: Babar The Movie
items.description: It is the Annual Celestville Victory Day Parade to celebrate Babar's victory over Lord Rataxes.

items.title: Mike's Bravest Mission
items.description: Mike faces his most knightly challenge ever when his dad, the King, invites him to solve the Knight's Puzzle, a legendary puzzle that the best and bravest knights have been trying to solve for generations!

items.title: Mike the Knight Dragon Mountain
items.description: When Mike's Dad, the King sets off on a mission, Mike is determined to follow him!

items.title: Pippi Longstocking Feature
items.description: Pippi has lived all over the world and now she faces her greatest challenge, fitting in in a Swedish country village!

items.title: Rapture-palooza
items.description: A couple left behind after the rapture find their now miserable lives becoming even more of a nightmare when the anti-Christ moves in down the street and immediately takes a shine to the young woman.

items.title: The Arrival
items.description: Radio astronomer Zane Zaminsky believes he has picked up a cosmic noise that signals extraterrestrial intelligence. His desperate search for answers leads him to discover that aliens are already on Earth and in the process of preparing to take it over.

items.title: Submarine
items.description: 15-year-old Oliver Tate (Craig Roberts) has two objectives: lose his virginity before his next birthday, and smother the flame between his mother and an ex-lover.

items.title: The Lifeguard
items.description: A former valedictorian quits her reporter job in New York and returns to the place she last felt happy: her childhood home in Connecticut. She gets work as a lifeguard and starts a dangerous relationship with a troubled teenager.

items.title: Rio I Love You
items.description: The series that started 'Paris, je t'aime' and 'New York, I Love You" travels to Rio de Janeiro to tell tales of love from the filmmakers that brought you City of God, Babel, 21 Grams, Youth, The Great Beauty,and more!

items.title: Microbe and Gasoline
items.description: From acclaimed director Michel Gondry! When two young outcasts strike an unusual friendship, they build an unusual vehicle to carry them on a wild cross country adventure.

items.title: Lifted
items.description: Henry, a middle school student in Alabama, finds refuge in music from the challenges of his surroundings: a drug addicted mother, a father recalled to active service in Afghanistan, a racist grandfather, and bullying schoolmates.

items.title: Faults
items.description: Claire is under the grip of a mysterious new cult called Faults. Desperate to be reunited with their daughter, Claire's parents recruit one of the world's foremost experts on mind control, Ansel Roth.

items.title: Djinn
items.description: An Emirati couple return home from a trip and discover that their new apartment has been built on a site that is home to some malevolent beings.

items.title: Bad Hurt
items.description: A NYC family is overcome with chaos as a son returns from war and a handicapped daughter requires increasing care. But through their struggles shines a strong family bond that shows how determination can overcome even the darkest times.

items.title: Authors Anonymous
items.description: When a dysfunctional group of unpublished writers accept Hannah into their fold, the last thing they expect is her overnight success. Can these lovable misfits achieve their artistic dreams and avoid killing one another in the process?

items.title: All the Wilderness
items.description: A restless teenager explores the wilderness of his city while struggling with the absence of his father.

items.title: Alex of Venice
items.description: When a workaholic environmental attorney, Alex Vedder (Mary Elizabeth Winstead), is forced to reinvent herself after her husband (Chris Messina) suddenly leaves the family, Alex discovers her hidden vulnerability as well as her inner strength.

items.title: Los tentáculos de las Bermudas
items.description: Cuando Air Force One cae sobre el Triángulo de las Bermudas, la Marina envía el mejor equipo de rescate. Pero al salvar al presidente, el equipo despierta a un monstruo que amenaza a toda la costa este.

items.title: Apocalipsis Zombie (2011)
items.description: Meses después de que una plaga de zombis acabara con el 90 por ciento de la población estadounidense, un pequeño grupo de sobrevivientes luchó a través de su país a un refugio rumoreado en la isla de Catalina.

items.title: The Right to Remain Silent
items.description: Rookie cop Christine Paley has to learn quickly in her first shift since she has to make several arrests that even a veteran would find challenging.

items.title: The Elizabeth Smart Story
items.description: The true story of the teenager’s 2002 kidnapping from her Salt Lake City home and her remarkable return nine months later.

items.title: Blast
items.description: After terrorists hijack an oil rig off the coast of California, an ex-Navy SEAL (Eddie Griffin, "Undercover Brother") must prevent them from detonating an electromagnetic bomb over the US.

items.title: Babar and Father Christmas
items.description: Babar's children Arthur, Pom, Flora, and Alexander write a letter to Father Christmas to ask him to visit Celesteville at Christmas.

items.title: Fear, Inc.
items.description: Fear, Inc is a company that can be hired to bring your greatest fears to life. But when one man’s customized scare seemingly begins, he and his friends must figure out if this company is there to scare them or make them pawns in their own sick game.

items.title: Iron Brothers
items.description: Fur trappers Abel and Henry Iron live in the Rocky Mountains. An encounter with Shoshone Indians leaves one Indian dead and the Iron Brothers on the run. In the end, they will learn if the bond of brotherhood is enough to save them.

items.title: Northern Borders
items.description: Starring Academy Award Nominee Bruce Dern. When a young boy is sent to live on his grandparents' Vermont farm, he uncovers long-festering family secrets. Now, trapped in a household on a remote farm, Austen must plan his escape.

items.title: Private Lives of Pippa Lee
items.description: After nearly two decades caught under the wing of an aging husband, devoted mother and housewife Pippa Lee undergoes a midlife breakthrough.

items.title: Key Man
items.description: An insurance salesman gets mixed up with two gangsters in effort to make more money and provide for his family, but things don't go as he planned.

items.title: Beyond the Trek
items.description: A deep space mining vessel has been adrift for two years. It is suspected the crew brutally killed each other, but the reason for the bloodbath is unknown. A rescue crew is sent to find if there are any survivors, what happened and why.

items.title: Blood of The Vampire
items.description: Directed by William Cass. In the late 19th century, the anæmic Dr Callistratus serves as the governor of a brutal prison institution for the criminally insane, within a remote castle.

items.title: The Cat Girl
items.description: A young woman inherits a family curse that turns her into a murderous feline when she is angered.

items.title: Day The World Ended
items.description: In a post-apocalyptic world after an atomic war, seven disparate people find themselves in a protected valley in the home of a survivalist and his beautiful daughter.

items.title: Earth Vs. The Spider
items.description: Teenagers from a rural community and their high school science teacher join forces to battle a giant mutant spider.

items.title: Horror Hospital
items.description: Jason, a member of a 1960's pop group, decides he needs a break at a country retreat. On the train he meets Judy, niece of Aunt Harris who owns the place with her husband Dr Storm and who are using the guests for surgical mind-control experiments.

items.title: Jasper: Journey To The End Of The World
items.description: Between the icy South Pole and a colourful sea-port, plays the adventure of the penguin brothers Jasper and Junior, who, with the help of 9 year old Emma, retrieve the eggs of a threatened parrot species from the evil Dr. Block.

items.title: Machine Gun Kelly
items.description: The criminal exploits of Public Enemy number 1, George 'Machine-Gun' Kelly, during the 1930s.

items.title: Macon County Line
items.description: A vengeful Southern sheriff is out for blood after his wife is brutally killed by a pair of drifters. Low-budget film set in Georgia in 1953 and based on fact.

items.title: Slaughter Of The Vampires
items.description: On their wedding night, a newlywed couple find themselves menaced by a bloodthirsty vampirer.

items.title: Rock All Night
items.description: Cloud Nine, the local teen hangout, has been taken over by a pair of escaped killers, who hold the local teens' hostage. The bartender realizes it's up to him to save the kids.

items.title: Sorority Girl
items.description: A poor-little-rich-girl feels alienated by her mother and enacts a string of revenges on her fellow pupils at a girls' boarding school. However, she is outcast when one of her stunts nearly drives a girl to suicide.

items.title: Terror Beneath The Sea
items.description: While covering a test of guided torpedoes, two reporters believe they saw what appeared to be a strange-looking swimming creature. They investigate the matter further and discover that there is a race of fish-men living under the sea.

items.title: The Undead
items.description: A beautiful woman is sent back in time via hypnosis to the Middle Ages where she finds she is suspected of being a witch, and subject to being executed.

items.title: Top Of The Heap
items.description: A Washington D.C. cop is proud to be one of the few African-Americans on the force. He is not well loved by his peers or by street people. Trouble erupts when he is overlooked for a promotion.

items.title: Werewolves On Wheels
items.description: A biker gang visits a monastery where they encounter black-robed monks engaged in worshipping Satan. When the monks try to persuade one of the female bikers, Helen, to become a satanic sacrifice the bikers smash up the monastery and leave.

items.title: Zorro
items.description: In the New World, a new Spanish governor finds the province of Nueva Aragón under the iron fist of the corrupt Colonel Huerta and vows to bring justice under the guise of a masked avenger.

items.title: MST3K: Bloodlust
items.description: Mike and the Bots watch a cheap ripoff of The Most Dangerous Game, where a rich game hunter tricks a group of stranded college kids into becoming prey for his latest blood sport.

items.title: The Book of Love
items.description: To fulfill a promise he made to his late wife, an introverted architect pursues an unlikely friendship with an independent teenage girl. The architect uses his expertise to help the teen with her mysterious goals.

items.title: El santo
items.description: ¿Busca a alguien que pueda infiltrarse en una organización súper secreta o robar una fórmula científica que podría cambiar el mundo? Por el precio justo, el Santo es el indicado.

items.title: Bajo fuego
items.description: El Coronel Terry Childers es un patriota y un héroe de guerra. Pero cuando una misión de paz en Yemen liderada por él resulta mal, termina enfrentando una corte marcial.

items.title: Rambo III
items.description: Rambo se rehúsa a unirse a su amigo y antiguo mentor, el coronel Trautman en una misión en Afganistán. La misión falla y Trautman es capturado por tropas rusas. Ahora Rambo debe infiltrarse a la fortaleza rusa y salvar a su único amigo.

items.title: Misión  Imposible 2
items.description: El espía más grande del mundo, Ethan Hunt (Tom Cruise), regresa junto con la hermosa Nyah Hall para detener al agente renegado Sean Ambrose, antes de que este libere un nuevo tipo de terror en un mundo desprevenido.

items.title: Infinity
items.description: The story of the early life of genius and Nobel Prize-winning physicist Richard Feynman. Starring and directed by Matthew Broderick, with Patricia Arquette.

items.title: Ticks
items.description: A group of troubled teenagers is led by social workers on a California wilderness retreat, unaware that the woods they are camping in have become infested by mutated, blood-sucking ticks.

items.title: Strangerland
items.description: A couple finds its dull life rocked after their two teenagers disappear into the desert, sparking disturbing rumors of their past. Starring Nicole Kidman, Joseph Fiennes, Hugo Weaving.

items.title: People Places Things
items.description: When the mother of his children abruptly leaves him for another man, a graphic novelist must juggle dual careers, twin daughters and the daunting prospect of midlife dating.

items.title: DAZN Presents: GGG vs. Rolls - June 08, 2019
items.description: GGG vs. Rolls From June 08, 2019

items.title: Fortnite: Battle, Build, Survive!
items.description: With over 125million active players around the globe, Fortnite has taken the world by storm.

items.title: Severe Off-Road 2
items.description: Severe Racing Films is back at it with Severe Off-Road 2. The new film is an intense thrill ride into the sport of off-road racing, filmed at spectacular races all over the western U.S. and Mexico.

items.title: A Map of the World
items.description: Sigourney Weaver stars as a school nurse, who faces the scorn of her community; after a friend's child suffers an accident on her property. With Julianne Moore and Chloe Sevigny.

items.title: Madame Bovary
items.description: Bored in her marriage and stifled by small town life, the restless Emma Bovary (Mia Wasikowska, "Alice in Wonderland") pursues her dreams of passion and excitement, whatever they may cost.

items.title: Life of a King
items.description: An ex-felon (Academy Award-winner Cuba Gooding Jr., "Jerry Maguire") on a path of redemption defies convention and establishes a Chess Club for inner-city teenagers.

items.title: Grand Theft Parsons
items.description: A road-trip black comedy about a rock star manager (Johnny Knoxville) who promised to trek friend Gram Parsons's remains across California to the Joshua Tree National Monument.

items.title: Necromancer
items.description: Assaulted by classmates, an acting student looking for revenge makes contact with a necromancer in this bloodcurdling horror story.

items.title: Mee-Shee: The Water Giant

items.title: Princess Stallion

items.title: Victor

items.title: Crooked Arrows
items.description: A story centered on a Native American lacrosse team making its way through a prep school league tournament.

items.title: The Last Warrior
items.description: These are times when one civilization is replacing another. A new era is about to begin in CentralEurasia. Scythians, the proud warriors, are all but gone. The few of their descendants have become ruthless mercenary assassins, the "waves of Ares."

items.title: You, Me, and Him
items.description: In You, Me and Him we meet lesbian couple Olivia and Alex (Lucy Punch, Faye Marsay) who, despite their age difference, are very much in love. But as the question of pregnancy rears its head...

items.title: The Quiet
items.description: Following the unexpected death of her father, a deaf and mute teenager moves in with her godparents, where she discovers the cruel behavior of their daughter may be indicative of a dark secret within the family.

items.title: Red Dog
items.description: Based on the legendary true story of the Red Dog who united a disparate local community while roaming the Australian outback in search of his long lost master.

items.title: Jane and Emma

items.description: The Artificial Intelligence Revolution is happening, and America is watching it on their Living Wall flat screens and Genius Phones. Homeland Security's Cyber Crime Division is the only thing trying to stop the 'bots and 'borgs from taking over.

items.title: Beach House
items.description: The story follows Caretta "Cara" Rutledge, a woman who's tried to move beyond a difficult past but is forced to grapple with history head-on when she returns to fix the family beach house. ...

items.title: Maximum Impact
items.description: The agents of the Federal Security Service of Russia and the US Secret Service are forced to work together to prevent a full-scale international crisis.

items.title: Wendigo
items.description: George is a high-strung professional photographer who is starting to unravel from the stress of his work with a Manhattan advertising agency.

items.title: Congo (ESP)

items.title: El dentista 2
items.description: El sádico dentista asesino, Dr. Caine, ha escapado del asilo mental para llevar una vida normal. Pero cuando descubre que su nueva novia lo está engañando, se desemboca otra locura para rechinar los dientes.

items.title: Eye of the Beast
items.description: After several locals disappear off the coast on Fells Island, a small fishing community in the North Atlantic, terrified survivors claim the existence of a Giant Squid.

items.title: The Apple
items.description: Set in 1994, a record producer, Boogalow (Vladek Sheybal) seduces young folksinger duo Bibi (Catherine Mary Stewart) and Alphie (George Gilmour) into becoming part of his stable of musical stars kept in line with sex and drugs.

items.title: Over the Top
items.description: A Championship title, a huge cash award, and his son's love -- the greatest prize of all -- are at stake when Hawk battles his strongest enemy for everything he has ever wanted.

items.title: Assassination Tango
items.description: John J. is a seasoned hit man sent on a job to Argentina. When the General he's sent to kill delays his return to the country, John passes the time with Manuela, a beautiful dancer who becomes his teacher and guide into Argentina's world of the tango.

items.title: Enrique Iglesias: Latin Love
items.description: One of the biggest stars of recent history– Enrique Iglesias is the man who brought the sexy and exciting sound of Latin pop to audiences all over the world.

items.title: Mother's Day (2012)
items.description: Rebecca DeMornay is terrifying in this brutal gorefest. When her sons break into a home and take the owners hostage, she teaches them what real torture is all about. Costars Shawn Ashmore.

items.title: Thunderstruck 10
items.description: Certain realities exist. Certain lines must be taken. Certain ascents must fall. Certain powder must be shredded. And certain films drop you into a bliss-filled dreamland. This one does. This one confirms certainties. This is Thunderstruck 10.

items.title: Seasons

items.description: To infinity and beyond! The call has gone out to all snow lovers around the globe! Car Danchi has arrived at the magical number 8. The endless turn, the carve that continues, the lift that doesn’t stop, the road that never ends!

items.title: Car Danchi 9

items.description: Storm Show’s 2011 ski/ride adrenaline film promises to be its most adventurous undertaking to date. The record books were shattered with over 700 inches of snowfall having blasted the Teton Range of Jackson Hole, Wyoming.

items.title: Follow Your Nose
items.description: Another unusual Snowboard Film by PIRATE MOVIE PRODUCTION co-produced by RED BULL MEDIA HOUSE.

items.description: The Braaap film series has been around for many years now and we have continued to deliver fresh content from all aspects of the snow sports industry year after year.

items.description: The General Tire Mint 400 is the roughest, most spectacular off-road race in North America!

items.description: For two years the crew of 3 Minute Gaps have followed the world’s best mountain bike racers around the globe documenting them as they trained, prepared, rode, ate, traveled, raced, celebrated, commiserated, and made sacrifices.

items.description: From director Danny Glover comes a poignant film about one boy’s childhood summer in 1960 that tested friendships, changed lives, and made some of his dreams come true.

items.title: Power and Beauty
items.description: One of the most controversial chapters of John F. Kennedy's rise to power is seen through the eyes of his mistress in the riveting true story of Judith Campbell Exner (Natasha Henstridge).

items.title: Road to Bali
items.description: Hope and Crosby play a pair of Vaudeville performers in competition for Dorothy Lamour, pursuing her to the South Seas island of Bali, where they must content with all sorts of jungle dangers

items.title: Return of Rin Tin Tin
items.description: The bond between the boy and his dog is the only thing that could bring the boy out of his shell. A bad guy plans to steal Rin-tin-tin.

items.title: Vengeance of Rannah
items.description: Insurance Agent Ted Sanders has been called in to investigate a robbery and murder. A deputy also arrives to investigate. But unknown to Ted, the Deputy is a fake and actually part of the gang.

items.title: King of the Cowboys
items.description: Saboteurs are blowing up government warehouses (during World War II). Roy and his pals work undercover to put an end to their operations.

items.title: Caryl of the Mountains
items.description: Caryl is courageously trying to stop funds from being embezzled from her company by sending the stolen bank bonds to her fur trapper uncle. However, this course of action leads to her uncle's murder. Mounty and Rin, Tin, Tin Jr. arrive to investigate.

items.title: Bluebeard
items.description: In Paris, an artist hires portrait models, and after he finishes their portraits, he strangles them. He falls for smart-girl model, who vows to bring him to justice.

items.title: Against a Crooked Sky
items.description: When Charlotte Sutter is kidnapped by Apaches her brother Sam aided by an old drunk prospector goes searching for her.

items.title: Girl & Antihero: Beauty and the Beast 2
items.description: Girl and Antihero’s second annual tour of the Upper Northwest, including more parks, more dudes, more cities, more raging, and even more radicalness than last time.

items.title: Distorted Reality: A European Snowboard
items.description: We are proud to present our latest action snowboard film and want to invite you to join a surreal trip following a tight group of riders.

items.title: Slednecks Mix Tape Vol. 2
items.description: Almost two decades ago, before there were any other sled films or X Games, a small group of friends started running around the mountains of Wyoming with an old film camera and some snowmobiles. They called themselves Slednecks.

items.title: Small World - Level 1
items.description: Go out into the world, they say… see it for yourself! But in an age where any destination is in the palm of your hand, just a click away, what is left to truly explore?

items.title: Vurbmoto Platinum: Jeffrey Herlings
items.description: The bad boy of the World Motocross GP series, Jeffrey Herlings graces the screen in this 12-minute motocross spectacular. They call him “The Bullit”, with speed and natural ability that are only matched by his no-holds-barred reputation.

items.title: Bad Man of Deadwood
items.description: Roy Rogers and Gabby Hayes are together again in this Republic Pictures gem. This time they’re trying to set up a medicine show in Deadwood, a town known for dangerous entrepreneurs who don’t like competition.

items.title: Cattle Stampede
items.description: Buster Crabbe stars as Billy the Kid, and Billy's playin' it high wide and handsome as he shoots it out with some mesa toughs! But not even the baddest men in in Arizona can stop this trigger-quick legend of the trail!

items.title: Bar 20 Justice
items.description: Hopalong Cassidy is back in action, and this time he's running around in mine shafts trying to tackle some crooks! The action grows even more intense when Hoppy is kidnapped and left to die in a burning building!

items.title: Between Men
items.description: Johnny Mack Brown stars in this intriguing B-Western about a son separated from his father. Director Robert N. Bradbury, the man behind several of John Wayne's early movies, gets the most out of this tale of a man with a buried past.

items.title: Arizona Bound
items.description: The Rough Riders set out to help the Master's Stage Line in their fight against saloon-boss Steve Taggert.

items.title: Around the Block
items.description: AROUND THE BLOCK is about breaking cycles and building dreams. Set in a contemporary, tough, inner-city precinct, this is a story of revenge and triumph, as a teenage boy is torn between his unexpected love of theatre and the disintegration of his family

items.title: Bitten
items.description: A young paramedic falls in love with a beautiful vampire who’s looking for the perfect lover—one who can provide three decent feedings a day.

items.title: Legend Of The Lost Tomb
items.description: In a daring adventure, two teenagers brave the forbidding Egyptian desert, seeking to rescue John’s archaeologist father, Dr. Erich Leonhardt held prisoner by Dr. William Bent, his jealous rival.

items.title: Point Blank
items.description: Mickey Rourke and Danny Trejo star in this action-packed drama about a gang of psychotic criminals who break out of prison and take control of a Texas shopping mall.

items.title: Are You Here
items.description: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

items.title: Spinning Boris
items.description: A trio of elite American political consultants are hired by a group of Russian businessmen to manage Russian President Boris Yeltsin's election campaign in 1996.

items.title: Seventeen Again
items.description: When 17-year-old Sydney's divorced grandparents visit simultaneously, it seems there will be no end to the bickering. Then little brother's science experiment goes awry and instead of preserving roses, he sends both grandparents back to their youth.

items.title: The Ruby Ring
items.description: When 15-year-old Lucy is given a magic ring, she is transported 100 years back in time to the magnificent Langley Castle.

items.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch
items.description: Melissa Joan Hart plays the not-so-normal new girl in town who discovers on her sixteenth birthday that she possesses magical powers. But Sabrina's biggest challenge isn't just fitting-in, it's surviving high school.

items.title: The Prince and the Pauper
items.description: In Mark Twain’s timeless classic, a boy of meager means and a prince of exuberant wealth eagerly switch places, each envious of the other. However, the boys quickly discover that no one’s life is what it seems.

items.title: For One Night
items.description: A black high school senior from a small southern town fights to explode a divisive thirty-year tradition and finally desegregate her high school prom.

items.title: El Macro Cumbion Replay
items.description: Watch the first ever live-streamed Cumbia concert, El Macro Cumbion. A powerhouse concert for a great cause, helping to unite families in need with meals for Thanksgiving.

items.title: DAZN Presents: Taylor Vs. Connor-July 28, 2018
items.description: Replay Taylor Vs. Connor from July 28, 2018

items.title: DAZN Presents: Mosley vs. Margarito-January 24, 2009
items.description: Replay Mosley vs. Margarito From January 24, 2009

items.title: DAZN Fight Zone: De La Hoya vs. Whitaker-April 12, 2007
items.description: Replay De La Hoya vs. Whitaker From April 12, 2007 a professional boxing match for the WBC and lineal welterweight championships.

items.title: DAZN Fight Zone: Barrera vs.Pacquiao-October 06, 2007
items.description: Replay Barrera vs.Pacquiao From October 06, 2007

items.title: A Holiday Engagement
items.description: Jilted by her high-powered fiancé just before Thanksgiving, and terrified of disappointing her demanding mother, Hillary Burns hires an unemployed artist to pretend to be her fiancé over the holiday weekend.

items.title: NICK & NOEL
items.description: Nick and Noel is a story about feuding neighbors who work together to find a little girl a mother by Christmas.

items.title: KONG: RETURN TO THE JUNGLE
items.description: Kong is entered in the valley of konhi here he is forced to live like a monkey so he struggles his living.

items.title: The Bears Who Saved Christmas
items.description: Two teddy bears attempt to save Christmas for two children.

items.title: DOT & SPOT'S MAGICAL CHRISTMAS ADVENTURE
items.description: Christmas Eve… As the Marshall family settles into their new home in the woods, strong winds force Santa's sleigh to make an emergency landing nearby.

items.title: THE WEEK
items.description: THE WEEK is the story of Dick Romans - a washed up TV host whose wife leaves him the day before their week-long ten year anniversary celebration in wine country. Dick finds himself alone with his thoughts, a bunch of catered food and a ton of booze.

items.title: Paradise Canyon
items.description: Wayne is an undercover agent for the government, who is sent to round up a gang of counterfeiters operating near the Mexican border.

items.title: Yuma
