items.description: Marshal Harmon (Walker) is sent to clean up a frontier town, but soon becomes the target of a plot to discredit him. Harmon is forced to shoot one of two brothers in self defense, and then the other brother is murdered while in jail

items.title: Awful Nice
items.description: Estranged brothers Jim and Dave travel to Branson when their father dies and leaves them the lake home. A series of hilarious mishaps and costly misadventures follow as they attempt to restore the house and rebuild their relationship.

items.title: Deep Dark Canyon
items.description: After a hunting accident leaves a town’s beloved mayor dead, two teenage brothers break out of jail and go on the run. Handcuffed together with the whole town chasing down the fugitives, they must outrun police and survive the elements.

items.title: Food Chains
items.description: There is so much interest in food these days yet there is almost no interest in the hands that pick that food. In the US, farm labor has always been one of the most difficult jobs and has relied on some of the nation's most vulnerable people.

items.title: Young Ones
items.description: Set in the future when water is hard to find, a teenage boy sets out to protect his family and survive.

items.title: Shooting Fish
items.description: In their mid-twenties, Dylan and Jez are two orphans who are overqualified and underemployed. Dylan is a fast-talking Yank. Jez is a tongue-tied technical genius with a bad haircut. Tired of the 'rich get richer' syndrome they decide to exploit it.

items.title: Viernes 13
items.description: El campamento Lago Crystal ha estado cerrado durante más de 20 años debido a varios feroces asesinatos sin resolver.

items.title: Staying Alive
items.description: Staying Alive takes Saturday Night Fever’s Tony Manero out of Brooklyn to Broadway. As a wannabe dancer struggling to make it on the stage, John Travolta is at his sexy, sizzling best.

items.title: Viernes 13: El capítulo final
items.description: Después de su renacimiento en una morgue del hospital, el asesino enmascarado de hockey fija su atención vengativa en la familia Jarvis y un grupo de adolescentes hasta ahora despreocupados.

items.title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
items.description: Upon his uncle`s death, Sir Henry Baskerville returns from abroad and opens up the ancestral hall on the desolate moors and Sherlock Holmes uncovers a plot to have Sir Henry murdered by a terrible hound.

items.title: Morning Glory
items.description: The novel that millions of readers took to their hearts is a stirring film. Laconic drifter Will Parker (Christopher Reeve) is an ex-con trying to do right in rural Georgia, 1941. Reclusive homesteader Elly sees the good in Will.

items.title: Darling
items.description: A house sitting job will start a terrifying chain of events as a woman begins to have terrifying visions. From the producers of THE INNKEEPERS and HOUSE OF THE DEVIL comes what critics are calling “explosive” and “absolutely brilliant.”

items.title: A Little Bit of Heaven
items.description: A young woman (Kate Hudson) who uses her humor to avoid intimacy has a life-changing visit from her doctor in this divinely funny dramatic comedy. With Whoopi Goldberg and Peter Dinklage.

items.title: Different for Girls
items.description: Karl and Paul were best mates at school in the 70s, but when they meet again Karl is now Kim, a transsexual who has no desire to stir up the past while she's busy forging a neat new life.

items.title: Babar La Pelicula
items.description: La historia empieza con un desfile y despues cuando termina el desfile el ray Babar le cuenta a sus hijos que cuando fue su primer dia como rey.

items.title: Franklin y el Caballero Verde
items.description: En pleno invierno, una tortuga intrépida se embarca en una búsqueda para traer la primavera a su ciudad natal.

items.title: Babar el Rey de los Elefantes
items.description: Esta es la historia de Babar y su feliz infancia. Tiene una vida con muchas dificultades y aventuras, hasta convertirse en el gobernante de los elefantes.

items.title: Slugterra: Slug Fu Showdown
items.description: Junjie takes Eli into isolation to teach him the slugslinging art of Slug Fu, but their training is cut short when a new villain unleashes a scheme to reduce Slugterra to rubble!

items.title: Slugterra: Into The Shadows
items.description: After returning home, the Gang have their hands full dealing with the usual thugs, plus a quickly-escalating dispute with the Shadow Clan. So when a new arrival from the Surface lends a hand, Eli welcomes a new team member.

items.title: When Zachary Beaver Came to Town
items.description: Welcome to Granger, Texas, and into the life of 12 year-old Toby Wilson. This coming of age story finds Toby in the middle of an unforgettable summer in his normally sleepy Texas town.

items.title: The Best Bad Thing
items.description: Twelve-year-old Rinko is looking forward to her summer vacation. But when her mother asks her to spend months helping Mrs. Hata, a recently widowed friend, Rinko is sure her summer will be ruined.

items.title: Slugterra: Return of the Elementals
items.description: A new member joins Eli and the Shane Gang! His name is Junjie, and he is a master of the mysterious slugslinging art of Slug Fu.

items.title: Slugterra: Eastern Caverns
items.description: The time has come for Eli and the Shane Gang to take their new friend Junjie home to the strange and beautiful Eastern Caverns. But when they arrive, they are shocked to find a world darker and more dangerous than Junjie remembers.

items.title: Slugterra: Ghoul from Beyond
items.description: Eli and the Shane Gang have vanquished Dr. Blakk and the slugs he turned into feral, mindless weapons—ghouls! But a new threat emerges from beyond the 99 caverns of Slugterra: the Dark Slinger and his troop of Marauders.

items.title: In The Dark Half
items.description: In The Dark Half is a serious, soulful and scary, psychological horror film about a teenage girl’s journey through her own haunted imagination.

items.title: Who Is Cletis Tout?
items.description: Finch and Micah are fellow inmates who successfully escape together from prison.

items.title: One More Kiss
items.description: One More Kiss is a story about rediscovering love and how when perceptions are forced to change, life can hold an entirely different meaning.

items.title: The Devil's Double
items.description: This is the shocking true story of a common man whose life is turned upside down when he is forced to become the body double of the feared “Black Prince.”

items.title: La esperanza es eterna
items.description: Cuando la vida de la adolescente Hope Gracin cambia repentinamente, ella encuentra que el mundo le tiene poca simpatía y debe aprender a vivir su vida sin fecha de expiración.

items.title: Buffalo Boys
items.description: Dos hermanos exiliados que se criaron en las llanuras del Viejo Oeste Americano, retornan a su casa paterna para desenmarañar el misterio de su pasado y vengar la brutal muerte de sus padres.

items.title: The Son of No One
items.description: A rookie cop is assigned to the 118 Precinct in the same district where he grew up. The Precinct Captain starts receiving letters about two unsolved murders that happened many years ago in the housing projects when the rookie cop was just a kid.

items.title: Hope For Christmas
items.description: Trying to win over a skeptical congregation, recovered war veteran turned Pastor, gears up for his first Christmas sermon when chaos ensues

items.title: Apollo 16: The Men, The Moon
items.description: After 25 years the untold human side of the Apollo 16 moon mission is now made available to the public, as the crew members finally reveal their riveting experience.

items.title: Thomas Keating: A Rising Tide Of Silence
items.description: Thomas Keating: A Rising Tide of Silence is a reflective portrait of Father Thomas Keating, one of today's most influential spiritual leaders. Interweaving historical footage, interviews, and extensive conversations with Father Thomas.

items.title: The Space Movie
items.description: Produced at the request of NASA to celebrate the 10th anniversary of the Apollo 11 moon landing, Tony Palmer directs this astonishing tribute to one of mankind’s greatest achievements.

items.title: Apollo 17: Final Footprints on the Moon
items.description: The Apollo 17 mission was the final opportunity to collect first hand information about the history and origin of the Moon. This film looks at this historic mission through the eyes of those who participated in it.

items.title: Dark Fall
items.description: Experience Dark Fall, Alex DePhillipo's award-winning documentary as he follows a year in the life of New Jersey's best surfers as they tackle some of the best surf right in their own back yard.

items.title: Sopa de tortilla
items.description: Un master chef mexicanoamericano y padre de tres hijas ha perdido su gusto por la comida, pero no por la vida.

items.title: Havana Motor Club LAS
items.description: El cambio es correr por las calles de La Habana, donde los mejores corredores de arrastre subterráneos de Cuba luchan por preparar sus clásicos hot rods para la primera carrera oficial de autos desde la Revolución.

items.title: Frontera hostil
items.description: Luego de ser deportada, Claudia debe elegir entre reconciliarse con su padre, de quien está distanciada, o juntarse con un peligroso contrabandista para poder volver a Estados Unidos.

items.title: The Last 24 Hours: Jimi Hendrix
items.description: Jimi Hendrix became an overnight sensation during the late 60s, however, his fame didn’t last long after he tragically passed aged just 27.

items.title: Same Difference
items.description: Freeride, Freestyle and Alpine racing united! Legs of Steel presents the multi-discipline ski film 'Same Difference’. True to the credo –‘a film about skiers’, this documentary will provide a one-of-a-kind view into skiing’s diversity.

items.title: Solitaire (English Subtitles)
items.description: Inhospitable of lands, a handful of drifters emerge from the whiteout, ready to cast their lot on forsaken peaks both merciless and magnificent.

items.title: Dragons or Dinosaurs?
items.description: Dragons images, legends, and lore exist in many cultures. This fascinating documentary asks the question, "What if dragons were actually dinosaurs?"

items.title: A Wedding for Christmas
items.description: Haley escapes her small-town and builds a life in Los Angeles as a wedding planner. When her sister asks her to plan her wedding, Haley returns to her childhood town and reunites with a childhood flame.

items.title: The Last Fling
items.description: Phillip meets the woman of his dreams, Gloria, only to discover she's been dishonest and she's getting married in a week. Gloria refuses to call off her wedding, but Jason strives to prove his love.

items.title: Having It All
items.description: Thera Baylin owns a massive fashion empire, with divisions in New York and Los Angeles. In each of those cities, Thera's got a separate husband, each entirely unaware of the other's existence.

items.title: Cantonen Iron Kung Fu
items.description: A ruthless warlord has come to take control of Canton. However, Canton's hero, a local worker, has other Ideas. He creates the iron bridge style and seeks vengeance for the death of his friend.

items.title: Amityville: The Evil Escapes
items.description: The demonic forces that were lurking in Amityville escape to California by inhabiting a lamp. This evil latches onto a little girl living in the home by manifesting itself as her dead father.

items.title: Cardiac Arrest
items.description: A serial killer is plaguing San Francisco, surgically removing the hearts of his victims. Assigned to the case is a weak-stomached homicide detective who investigates black market organ transplants.

items.title: Sunset Strip
items.description: Mark agrees to help his friend Roger defend his night club against a handful of organized crime figures. Mark has an added incentive for becoming involved, because his ex-girlfriend sings at the club.

items.title: Dreams Don't Die
items.description: Ike is a New York City subway graffiti painter whose artistic talents are noticed by a concerned cop who becomes his surrogate father and urges him to help track down a drug kingpin.

items.title: Militant Eagle
items.description: The war may be over, but the fighting has just begun in this classic set in long-ago Imperial China. A soldier returning home from battle joins forces with villagers seeking justice after their families are brutally slain.

items.title: The Reluctant Agent
items.description: FBI agent Sharlene Cavanaugh is incapacitated during a dangerous mission. Her identical twin sister Linda, a waitress, is enlisted to take her place. Masquerading as a financial analyst, Linda is thrust into a perilous game of organized crime.

items.title: The Horseman
items.description: When Christian’s daughter dies, so does any sense of remorse as he searches for vengeance at all costs. Tracking down the men responsible one by one, he reaches a new level of brutality and discovers how far he has to go to settle the score.

items.title: Two Mothers for Zachary
items.description: In Virginia, a grandmother sues her lesbian daughter for custody of her grandson on the grounds her daughter is immoral for living a gay lifestyle.

items.title: El crimen del padre Amaro
items.description: La política y las pasiones sexuales amenazan con corromper a un joven sacerdote recién ordenado en un pequeño pueblo mexicano.

items.title: Sushi a la mexicana
items.description: Juana, una madre soltera y trabajadora, comienza a trabajar en un restaurante japonés. Luchando contra todas las expectativas, trabaja, se prepara, y alcanza su sueño de ser chef de sushi.

items.title: The Goal
items.description: After falling for a dangerous mobster's girlfriend (Gal Gadot, Wonder Woman), a famous athlete puts in motion a wild and comical ruse that will open his eyes to a reality to which stardom had previously blinded him.

items.title: The Over the Hill Gang Rides Again
items.description: Retired Texas Ranger Nash Crawford re-assembles his former Ranger outfit from the old days to fight crime in his hometown.

items.title: The Over the Hill Gang
items.description: A retired Texas Ranger and his three aging pals help to clean up a lawless town, run by a crooked mayor.

items.title: The Gatling Gun
items.description: Two backstabbing deserters steal a Gatling Gun from their cavalry unit to attack an Apache tribe and steal their gold. They get help from a naive pacifist pastor. Meanwhile, both the cavalry and the Apache go after them - and the Gun.

items.title: Sagebrush Trail
items.description: Wayne is wrongly convicted for a killing, but he escapes from prison and heads out west to find the real killer.

items.title: The Painted Hills (1951)
items.description: Lassie comes to the rescue when a boy's life is put at risk by the greed inflamed by a gold strike.

items.title: The Limey
items.description: Upon his release from prison, an extremely volatile and dangerous ex-con travels from England to Los Angeles to find the man he considers responsible for his estranged daughter's "accidental" death.

items.title: The Giver
items.description: Based on the beloved young adult novel. A young man (Brenton Thwaites), who lives in a seemingly ideal world, must escape after discovering the deadly truths of his community’s secret past.

items.title: The Beaver
items.description: After a failed suicide, Walter finds a rather unusual savior in the form of a beaver hand-puppet. He learns that he can speak through the persona of the puppet and re-engage with the world.

items.title: St. Vincent
items.description: Bill Murray and Melissa McCarthy star in this hilarious comedy about a war vet whose idea of after-school activities for his 12-year-old neighbor includes race tracks and strip clubs.

items.title: Repentance
items.description: A man struggling with his mother's death embarks on a sinister quest.

items.title: Reign Of Assassins
items.description: Elusive assassin Drizzle transforms herself into modest shop owner Zeng Jing (Michelle Yeoh) in order to transport the remains of an exalted Buddhist monk to their eternal resting place, but finds her mission unexpectedly complicated.

items.title: Pumping Iron
items.description: Scripted documentary following Arnold Schwarzenegger as he attempts to defend his bodybuilding title against several competitors.

items.title: Officer Down
items.description: A rogue police officer (Stephen Dorff of PUBLIC ENEMIES) seeks revenge against the men responsible for a string of attacks on the young women working at a local strip club.

items.title: In The Mix
items.description: All's fair in love and gangster warfare when Darrell (Usher), New York’s hottest DJ, saves a mob boss's (Chazz Palminteri) life and is rewarded with a gig protecting his beautiful daughter.

items.title: Hands Of Stone
items.description: HANDS OF STONE follows the life of Roberto Duran (Edgar Ramirez), the Panamanian fighter who made his professional debut in 1968 as a 16 year-old and retired in 2002 at the age of 50.

items.title: Frankie & Alice
items.description: A go-go dancer struggles with a split personality.

items.title: Dr. T and The Women
items.description: A wealthy gynecologist finds his perfect life turned upside down by a series of family dramas.

items.title: Burnt
items.description: When a rockstar chef’s (Bradley Cooper) bad attitude destroys his career, he finds a crew to help him battle the odds and open a new restaurant that could earn him a third Michelin Star.

items.title: Before We Go
items.description: Two strangers stuck in Manhattan for the night grow into each other's most trusted confidants when an evening of unexpected adventure forces them to confront their fears and take control of their lives.

items.title: August: Osage County
items.description: Meryl Streep and Julia Roberts lead an all-star cast. A family crisis unites a dispersed group of siblings at the Oklahoma house they grew up in with the dysfunctional woman who raised them.

items.title: Alpha and Omega
items.description: When a take-charge alpha wolf and a laidback omega wolf get relocated halfway across the country, the two must set off on an incredible journey home in this CGI-animated adventure.

items.title: The Penthouse (1989)
items.description: Dinah St. Clair lives a charmed life in a high-rise apartment. When she is paid a visit by an old childhood friend named Joe Dobson who, unbeknownst to her, recently escaped from mental ward things quickly escalate into a hostage situation.

items.title: Dirty Laundry
items.description: A young man and his girlfriend unwittingly come into possession of a bag containing a million dollars belonging to a drug smuggling ring. The mobsters try to catch the couple and retrieve their money.

items.title: A Christmas in Royal Fashion
items.description: Handsome prince and fashion assistant fall in love amidst a Christmas fashion show.

items.title: High Lonesome
items.description: When a series of murders occurs in a small west Texas town, the new young drifter in town, Cooncat (Barrymore), is immediately suspected of the murders. But Cooncat witnessed one of the murders, and his description of the murderers is met with disbelief.

items.title: The Prince & Me II: The Royal Wedding
items.description: Paige and Edvard find their relationship in jeopardy when an old law stating that the prince may only marry a woman of noble blood is brought to light.

items.title: Star Trek (2009) (ESP)
items.description: La mayor aventura de todos los tiempos comienza con Star Trek, la increíble historia de una joven tripulación en su viaje de bautismo sobre la más moderna nave espacial jamás creada: la U.S.S. Enterprise.

items.title: New Monuments Men
items.description: ISIS is waging a merciless war against Culture in Iraq, Syria, Libya, and soon Egypt. Its goal is to create a new world order by destroying the centuries-old libraries and great archaeological sites. Who will stop them? The New Monuments Men.

items.title: Real Monsters
items.description: Prepare to take a journey into the unexplained in this comprehensive program and hear incredible eyewitness reports that force us to face the fact that the monsters we relegate to fairytales, have indeed been quite real all along.

items.title: Starbucks Unfiltered
items.description: Starbucks is now a part of our daily lives. Like McDonald’s, its 22,000 coffeehouses present in 67 countries have made it a recognizable symbol of globalization. This investigative report explores the brand’s success story and their dark underside.

items.title: The Harlem Hellfighters Great War
items.description: The 15th regiment of the New York National Guard was exclusively made up of black soldiers, the Harlem Hellfighters. It was not only liberty and democracy that they came to defend with fieriness in the Second World War, but also racial equality.

items.title: Top 20 Mind Blowing UFO Cases
items.description: UFO’s are real and the government and military forces on Earth know it. Explore suppressed and hidden information about the strangest and most fantastic UFO incidents in history.

items.title: Mo'Nique: One Night Stand
items.description: Known for her sassy attitude and outrageous humor, Oscar winner Mo'Nique takes her side-splitting act to the stage in this hilarious stand-up comedy special.

items.title: Sheryl Underwood: Too Much Information
items.description: Sheryl Underwood brings her brutal honesty and side-splitting observations about life to the stage in this hilarious stand-up comedy special.

items.title: Interstate 60
items.description: Neal Oliver is turning 23, an age where everyone should know what they want to do with their life - right? At his birthday party he makes a wish to 'get an answer to his life for the new century'.

items.title: Another Life
items.description: Another Life is based on a true story. Set in Edwardian London, it is the colourful and intensely moving account of Edith Thompson, a woman wrongly accused of the murder of her husband, a case which became a major ‘cause célèbre’ of its time.

items.title: Body Count
items.description: From Italian horror maestro Ruggero Deodato, this brutal slasher film follows a group of college students as they are stalked by a terrifying figure in the Colorado wilderness.

items.title: Women In Cages
items.description: American women prisoners in a foreign country. Sex and action.

items.title: A Man Of No Importance
items.description: Alfie Byrne is a middle-aged bus conductor in Dublin in 1963. He would appear to live a life of quiet desperation: he's gay, but firmly closeted, and his sister is always trying to find him "the right girl".

items.title: Blood On The Land
items.description: In Greece, in the early part of the 20th century, two brothers from a wealthy landowning family have opposite views on how the poor workers who work on their land should be treated.

items.title: Ghosts Of Cité Soleil
items.description: In the slum of Cité Soleil, President Aristide's most loyal supporters were ruling as kings. The five major gang leaders were controlling heavily armed young men; the Chiméres.

items.title: Glastonbury
items.description: A documentary on the 30th anniversary of Britain's best-known music festival.

items.title: The Final Comedown
items.description: Black revolutionaries take action in the white suburbs.

items.title: First Man Into Space
items.description: The first pilot to leave Earth's atmosphere lands, then vanishes; but something with a craving for blood prowls the countryside...

items.title: Planets Against Us
items.description: An alien race sends cyborgs--made to look like the son of a famous scientist, whom they killed when he landed on their planet--to Earth to help pave the way for an invasion.

items.title: The Brain Eaters
items.description: The inhabitants of a small Illinois town begin disappearing after a strange cone is found sticking out of the ground nearby.

items.title: The Creation Of The Humanoids
items.description: In a post-holocaust society, robots take it on their own to help the dying human race by giving them android bodies.

items.title: War of the Colossal Beast
items.description: Glenn Manning, "The Amazing Colossal Man," believed dead after falling from the Hoover Dam, reemerges in rural Mexico, brain damaged, disfigured, and very hungry.

items.title: The Invisible War
items.description: From Oscar- and Emmy-nominated filmmaker Kirby Dick comes THE INVISIBLE WAR, a groundbreaking investigative documentary about one of America's most shameful and best-kept secrets: the epidemic of rape within the U.S. military.

items.title: Kinderblock 66 - Return to Buchenwald
items.description: On April 11, 1945, Buchenwald was liberated. Nearly 1000 boys survived. On April 11, 2010, sixty-five years later, several of the surviving boys from block 66 returned to Weimar and to Buchenwald. This is their story.

items.title: Logan's Syndrome
items.description: A painter coping with a rare genetic disorder comes to terms with his disability through his bold art.

items.title: Swell
items.description: When Tess (Spiro) runs away from home at 13, she was forced to leave behind her brother. Years later, the pain of the decision still haunts her and it's not until her grandfather (Bernsen) makes it his dying wish that she confronts her past and goes home.

items.title: Left Behind: The Movie
items.description: After learning that millions have completely vanished, an airline pilot, his daughter and others work together to unravel the mystery of those left behind in this film based on the hugely popular book series.

items.title: Left Behind 2: Tribulation Force
items.description: Two weeks after the Rapture, those left behind must band together to form the Tribulation Force, preparing themselves for the worst seven years the planet will ever see in this exciting sequel to Left Behind.

items.title: Bunyan & Babe
items.description: Travis falls through a magical portal that transports him to the world of American hero Paul Bunyan and his big, blue, talking ox, Babe!

items.title: LIFE
items.description: Inspired by the true story of photographer Dennis Stock and Hollywood's rebel actor James Dean, brought together for a LIFE Magazine assignment. Their journey leads to an unbreakable friendship and some of the most iconic images of the age.

items.title: Running Forever
items.description: After being estranged since her mother's death in the 9/11 attacks, both daughter and father must work together to re-establish their relationship.

items.title: The Bad Nun
items.description: A young woman staying at an isolated convent-turned-bed and breakfast is visited by a nun at the door who begins to show her true colors as the night unfolds.

items.title: The Collector
items.description: An ex-con plots a heist at his new employer's home, unaware that a second criminal has also targeted the property, and rigged it with deadly traps.

items.title: The Pastor's Daughters
items.description: A well-known minister is on his deathbed. His family must grapple with the realities of their dysfunction, and find peace.

items.title: The Steam Engines of Oz
items.description: 100 years after Dorothy clicked her ruby red slippers to leave the magical land of oz, Victoria, a young engineer who keeps the city gears moving, joins the Scarecrow and a not so cowardly lion to once again help the Tin Man find his heart

items.title: Bringing The Vibes
items.description: The Tenth Street Bros are Bill and George Bryan - two skimboarders who have seen and done it all.

items.title: FRUITION - The Life and Dreams of Nicolas Müller
items.description: We live in a world which demands us to obey things we might not believe in. But with intuition as his guide, Nicolas Mu?ller has tackled life's obstacles in order to find a true path as one of the most influential snowboarders of all time.

items.title: To End a War (English Subtitles)
items.description: The 52-year fight between the Colombian Government and the Marxist guerilla FARC-EP is the longest running civil war in Latin America.

items.title: The Story Of: Mersey Beat
items.description: Merseybeat, also known as beat music or British beat, took over the world in the early ’60s thanks to the rise of a little band from Liverpool called The Beatles.

items.title: We Are Blood: Bonus Edit
items.description: We Are Blood is a modern day skate epic featuring Paul Rodriguez and other top skateboarders as they travel the globe pushing the limits of what’s possible on a board and four wheels.

items.title: Snowsurf
items.description: Join award winning Australian photographer Shane Peel as he journeys to the mountains, beaches and silver birch forests of Japan's northern most island, Hokkaido to follow a unique pod of breakaway snowboarders and surfers.

items.title: Flying Blind
items.description: The passionate love story of an older woman and a young Muslim man, in a world where security is paramount and nothing is quite what it seems.

items.title: Star Trek X: Nemesis
items.description: Set a course for a galaxy of unparalleled action and adventure as Captain Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) and his Starship crew battle a chilling new adversary…that happens to hold a shocking link to Picard!

items.title: Star Trek VIII: First Contact
items.description: They call themselves the Borg – a half-machine collective with a sole purpose: to conquer and assimilate all races.

items.title: In Over My Head
items.description: In Over My Head is a Christian romance/comedy that tells the story of Nathan Edwards, a rich, spoiled college graduate who finds himself the guardian of his younger siblings after their parents’ untimely death.

items.title: Agatha Christie's Ten Little Indians
items.description: This classic whodunit by mystery maven Agatha Christie is played out in a remote African safari bush camp, where a diverse group of intriguing characters fall victim, one by one, to an unknown, unseen assailant.

items.title: All Or Nothing
items.description: Penny, a South London working mom, struggles to keep her wayward daughter, her lazy son and her disillusioned partner on the right path. But when tragedy befalls one of her loved ones, she finds that support comes from the most unexpected places.

items.title: American Friends
items.description: Stuffy academic gives it all up for love.

items.title: American Ninja
items.description: Michael Dudikoff stars as Joe Armstrong, a one-man fighting machine. Serving in the army to avoid prison, Joe finds himself battling the deadly Black Star Order, as well as corrupt military leaders in order to bring down an illegal arms sale.

items.title: Cellar Dweller
items.description: Thirty years have passed since the grisly death of a comic book artist. When an ardent devotee of the artist's work moves into his house she is unaware that her imagination has revived the grotesque murderer and that she might be the next victim.

items.title: Code 46
items.description: In the near future, an insurance investigator (Tim Robbins) assigned to track down and dismantle a passport forgery ring falls for the ringleader (Samantha Morton), leading to further complications when a secret (a Code 46 violation) is revealed.

items.title: Visitors (Cinedigm)
items.description: From director Godfrey Reggio (The Qatsi Trilogy), composer Philip Glass and filmmaker Jon Kane, presented by Steven Soderbergh. Visitors, a class of film all its own, takes us on an emotional journey to the moon and back.

items.title: Star Trek VIII: primer contacto
items.description: Se llaman a sí mismos los Borg, un colectivo mitad máquina con un solo propósito: Conquistar y asimilar todas las razas.

items.title: Avenging Angelo
items.description: A woman discovers she is the daughter of a murdered mafia chieftain and seeks revenge with the aid of her father's faithful bodyguard (Academy Award-nominee Sylvester Stallone, “Rocky”).

items.title: Death Zone: Cleaning Mount Everest
items.description: The dramatic self-documented story of 20 elite Nepali climbers who venture into the "Death Zone" of Mount Everest to restore their sacred mountain and a contaminated water source.

items.title: Dirty Filthy Love
items.description: In this touching and funny tale starring Michael Sheen ("Good Omens"), a man's life falls apart as he copes with obsessive–compulsive disorder and Tourette syndrome.

items.title: Drive (1997)
items.description: When a prototype 'enhanced human' on the run from hitmen hooks up with a dreadlocked bystander, the two elude their pursuers—starring Brittany Murphy ("8 Mile").

items.title: Edmond
items.description: A fortune teller's rumination sends a man into New York City's hellish underworld searching for his humanity. Starring William H. Macy ("Fargo") and Julia Stiles ("10 Things I Hate About You").

items.title: Freebird
items.description: Lynyrd Skynyrd left behind some of rock 'n' roll's most enduring classics. See classic live performances, interviews and vintage footage of the band’s original lineup.

items.title: Lily in Love
items.description: Iconic Broadway star Fitz (Christopher Plummer, "The Sound of Music") dons a gaudy disguise to secure the lead role in the controversial new film of his wife Lily (Maggie Smith, "Downton Abbey").

items.title: Manifesto
items.description: MANIFESTO features two-time Academy Award winner Cate Blanchett in 13 distinct, must-see vignettes that incorporate timeless manifestos from 20th century art movements.

items.title: Marjorie Prime
items.description: In 2050, 86-year-old Marjorie has a holographic companion who resembles her dead husband and is programmed to feed her the story of her life. With Lois Smith, Jon Hamm, Geena Davis.

items.title: One Small Hero
items.description: A young boy who has stowed away on a camping trip for the school wilderness club must use his wits in order to rescue the club from a pair of kidnappers.

items.title: Southern Comfort (1981)
items.description: During a routine exercise, a team of National Guards is threatened by angry and violent locals. Starring Academy Award-winner Keith Carradine and Powers Boothe.

items.title: The Great New Wonderful
items.description: Featuring an ensemble cast including Maggie Gyllenhaal, Will Arnett and Stephen Colbert, "The Great New Wonderful" weaves five stories from the anxious and uncertain post-9/11 New York City.

items.title: Truman
items.description: Diagnosticado con cáncer terminal, Julián decide no tratarse y pasar sus últimos días arreglando sus asuntos pendientes, cuando su mejor amigo de la niñez lo visita inesperadamente.

items.title: Testigo en Peligro
items.description: Cuando una joven Amish y su hijo se encuentran envueltos en el asesinato de un agente antinarcóticos encubierto, su salvador resulta ser el duro detective de Filadelfia John Book.

items.title: Star Trek IV: misión salvar la tierra
items.description: Es el siglo XXIII y un poder extraterrestre está evaporizando los océanos. Para salvar a la humanidad, Kirk y su tripulación deben viajar en el tiempo hasta 1986, donde encuentran un mundo de punk pizza.

items.title: Appointment With Death
items.description: Super-sleuth Hercule Poirot becomes friendly with a young psychiatrist, Sarah King, while on a cruise. Sarah becomes infatuated with another passenger, Raymond Boynton, who is totally dominated by his mother, and she discourages any notions of romance.

items.title: Death Warrant
items.description: Action superstar Jean-Claude van Damme ("Bloodsport", "Cyborg") is a veteran undercover cop posing as an inmate in a dangerously corrupt state prison.

items.title: Good Boy!
items.description: Twelve-year-old Owen has a new dog, Hubble, who can not only sit and stay, but also speak...literally! Turns out Hubble is an interplanetary agent, and Owen discovers that Hubble and all his canine buddies are on a mission to rule the world!

items.title: Hannah And Her Sisters
items.description: Woody Allen wrote, directed and stars in this comedy/drama about the amorous affiliations of three sisters and the men in their lives. Story touches on such universal themes as life, death, love, adultery, religion and family relations.

items.title: Harry And Son
items.description: This character study centers on the agonies and delights of a widower and his artistically inclined son, who try to salvage their relationship after the father gets fired from his construction job.

items.title: How To Beat The High Cost Of Living
items.description: A caper comedy about three suburban housewives who, in order to beat inflation and subsidize their alimony checks, plot to steal $1 million from a large plastic ball which is displayed in a local shopping center.

items.title: Kill Me Again
items.description: Private investigator Val Kilmer is looking to score some quick cash. Joanne Whalley-Kilmer is the femme fatale who just wants to disappear. Michael Madsen is her psychotic boyfriend. Fate will bring them all together in this clever, modern-day noir.

items.title: Killing Me Softly (2003)
items.description: A woman suspects her husband of murdering his previous lovers.

items.title: Kiss The Bride
items.description: Danni is about to be the first Sposato daughter to walk down the aisle, that is if her three wild sisters don't tear the family apart first. Niki, Chrissy, and Toni return home for the long overdue, Italian-style family reunion.

items.title: Larger Than Life
items.description: Bill Murray and Janeane Garofalo star in this heartwarming, madcap comedy about a son whose life changes forever when he inherits a live circus elephant. Jeremy Piven, Matthew McConaughey, Linda Fiorentino and Pat Hingle co-star.

items.title: Mannequin Two: On The Move
items.description: A modern-day descendant of royalty discovers that a department store mannequin is really alive.

items.title: Music Within
items.description: The true story of Richard Pimentel, a brilliant public speaker with a troubled past, who returns from Vietnam severely hearing impaired and finds a new purpose in his landmark efforts on the behalf of Americans with disabilities.

items.title: Mystery Date
items.description: In order to win the woman of his dreams, a young man pretends to be his older brother.

items.title: Platoon Leader
items.description: The gripping, true-life story of a young lieutenant, fresh out of military school, who must grow from innocent rookie to toughened warrior if he and his men are to survive.

items.title: Prick Up Your Ears
items.description: The true story of British playwright Joe Orton and how his skyrocket to fame ended in his own brutal, shocking murder by his longtime lover in 1967.

items.title: Rush (1991)
items.description: The harrowing story of two narcotics agents (Jason Patric, Jennifer Jason Leigh) who become horribly addicted to the very substance they are supposed to keep off the streets. Supporting cast includes Sam Elliott.

items.title: She-Devil
items.description: The author of 32 best-selling romance books takes her accountant away from his frumpy wife. And when this overweight suburban wife discovers what's been going on, she wreaks malicious and delicious revenge...

items.title: Slam Dance
items.description: A cartoonist and painter (Tom Hulce) must dig through the underbelly of the L.A. club scene when his ex-girlfriend (Virginia Madsen) is found dead and he is framed for the murder.

items.title: Sweet Land
items.description: When Lars' grandmother Inge dies in 2004, he is faced with a decision -- sell the family farm on which she lived since 1920, or cling to the legacy of the land. Seeking advice, he turns to the memory of Inge and the stories she had passed on to him.

items.title: The Adventures of Hercules
items.description: The saga of the Olympian hero continues as Hercules valiantly strives to intervene in a war between the gods and save the world from certain doom.

items.title: La hermandad
items.description: Edward Dalton (Ethan Hawke) es investigador en 2019, año en que una plaga convirtió en vampiros a la población. A medida que los humanos se extinguen, los vampiros deben encontrar un sustituto de la sangre. Un hallazgo puede salvar a la humanidad.

items.title: La casa de los mil cuerpos
items.description: Dos parejas de adolescentes que viajan por los bosques de Texas en busca de leyendas urbanas de asesinos en serie terminan siendo prisioneros de una extraña y sádica familia de asesinos seriales.

items.title: Amor a primera visa
items.description: Alejandro, un mariachi, y su mejor amigo, Canicas, aprovechan un encuentro casual como una oportunidad para hacer cambiar de opinión a la joven de la embajada, Rachel, que rechazó la solicitud de visa de su hija para visitar EE. UU.

items.title: 100 Streets
items.description: 100 Streets is a powerful ensemble drama, follows three contrasting and interwoven stories as they play out in one square mile of modern day London starring Idris Elba and Gemma Arteton.

items.title: Me Too: The Movement
items.description: Women around the world are breaking the silence. Taking to the streets and social media, in their millions. Demonstrating their anger at the deep-rooted culture of sexual predation that has reached epidemic proportions. To understand the battles of tod...

items.title: Tierra de vampiros
items.description: Cuando se desata una epidemia de vampirismo y su familia es asesinada, el joven Martin (Connor Paolo) se vuelve el protegido de un canoso y obstinado cazador (Nick Damici) cuya nueva presa son los muertos vivientes.

items.title: Michelle Obama: Hope Becomes Change
items.description: When Michelle Obama became First Lady of the United States in January of 2009 nobody knew that she would become one of the most important and magnetic voices of the 21st century.

items.title: Uphill Battle
items.description: Three years after a painful divorce due to her husband's addiction to pornography and subsequent infidelity. Torn between her broken past and an unknown future, will Erica find a way to heal?

items.title: The Current
items.description: Two boys become best friends and spend a fun-filled summer together on the river. Jake uses his new faith to help a friend through a tragedy.

items.title: The Mysterious Note
items.description: A reluctant family accompanies their businessman father to a small town. His mission is to repossess a hardware store that is run using “unusual financial practices”.

items.title: The Prophet's Son
items.description: The Prophet's Son combines action, drama, and romance as it addresses teen violence, dating, pregnancy, gangs, drug abuse, family conflict, and politics inviting nuclear war. As society crumbles, faith in God becomes the only path of hope.

items.title: The Rev
items.description: The African-American family loved Johnny as their own and raised him to reach for the stars and follow his dreams. Reverend Johnny Starr, half preacher and half rock ‘n’ roll legend

items.title: The Sound of the Spirit
items.description: “The Sound of the Spirit” is the never-before-told story of a young girl caught in the crossfire of strong feelings between two faith communities. It’s told with humor, compassion, and grace.

items.title: Cantinflas
items.description: Cantinflas es la historia jamás contada de la mayor y más adorada estrella mexicana de la comedia de todos los tiempos.

items.title: Out of Order
items.description: A screenwriting couple (Eric Stoltz and Felicity Huffman) struggles to keep their marriage intact as new lovers and chemical addictions threaten their happy life. With William H. Macy.

items.title: The Patriot (1998)
items.description: A deadly virus threatens to wipe out an entire Rocky Mountain town, forcing the town doctor (Steven Seagal) to escape the soldiers who enforce the town's quarantine and devise a cure.

items.title: Backwoods
items.description: A brash executive sees human survival as a skill to be honed — both in and out of the boardroom. When he takes his employees on a weekend getaway, they are plunged into a fight for survival.

items.title: Clive Barker's Book of Blood
items.description: A paranormal expert discovers a house that is at the intersection of so-called "highways" transporting souls in the afterlife.

items.title: Charms for the Easy Life
items.description: In the 1940s, a southern midwife is given a lucky charm. Soon, her husband skips town, leaving her happily in charge of the family. Starring Gena Rowlands and Mimi Rogers.

items.title: Color of Justice
items.description: F. Murray Abraham ("The Grand Budapest Hotel") stars in this topical film in which four young black men are on trial for the murder of a white woman. The result could cause a riot.

items.title: Columbus Day
items.description: Val Kilmer stars as a thief trying to fix the damage done during the biggest heist of his career.

items.title: Hidden in America
items.description: When a prideful patriarch won't accept aid from his sick daughter's doctor, he must prove to his kids that, despite the death of his wife, they will survive. Also starring Frances McDormand ("Fargo").

items.title: Johnny's Girl
items.description: When Johnny and his young daughter Amy move from L.A. to Alaska, Amy's wish for a normal life is made difficult when shady people begin to emerge from Johnny's past.

items.title: Losing Chase
items.description: Helen Mirren stars as a woman recovering from a nervous breakdown whose bond with her young caretaker (Kyra Sedgwick) arouses the suspicion of her husband (Beau Bridges).

items.title: My Louisiana Sky
items.description: A 12-year-old girl comes to grips with the fact that her parents are developmentally disabled in this coming-of-age drama. Starring Juliette Lewis.

items.title: My Old Man
items.description: Kristy McNichol and Warren Oates star in a touching adaptation of Ernest Hemingway’s short story about a young teenager reunited with her downtrodden father after fourteen years.

items.title: Not Quite an Angel
items.description: In this family comedy, a struggling single father hires a kind, mysterious woman to take care of his children. Soon they discover their new nanny is actually an angel!

items.title: Past the Bleachers
items.description: Bill and his wife have recently had to live through a tragedy. When Bill decides to coach a little league baseball team, a very mysterious child helps heal the wounds from his past.

items.title: Scorpion
items.description: When Thai ex-boxer Angelo gets drawn into the world of competitive kickboxing, the blows come fast and furiously as he seeks to redeem himself through the power of true love. Subtitled.

items.title: Sea Beast
items.description: The creature feature makes a bloody terrific comeback in "Sea Beast," a flesh-ripping thriller about a hideous amphibian creature that terrorizes an isolated Oregon fishing village.

items.title: Shark Killer
items.description: The services of shark killer Chase Walker have been requested by his brother Jake, the head of a South African crime ring. His job? Kill the black-finned shark that swallowed a valuable diamond.

items.title: Sharpshooter
items.description: A mercenary sniper is assigned a secret mission to assassinate a dangerous drug czar, but after completing the job he finds that he has an assassin assigned to kill him as well.

items.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
items.description: An American teenager (Kirsten Dunst, “Spider-Man”) with an apathetic view of her Jewish family history somehow finds herself transported to Nazi-occupied Poland in 1941.

items.title: The Devil's Ground
items.description: Driving on a deserted road through the forest, Carrie almost hits a frightened student, the only survivor of a massacre that killed her classmates during a field trip. With Daryl Hannah.

items.title: The Hot Potato
items.description: Kenny Smith and Danny Nash, a couple of local lads, try to find a buyer for a large lump of misappropriated Uranium, the so-called “hot potato.”

items.title: The Passion of Ayn Rand
items.description: In this riveting biopic, controversial “Atlas Shrugged” author Ayn Rand (Oscar winner Helen Mirren) faces scorn and ruin when she becomes involved with a younger married man.

items.title: The Reckoning
items.description: After his partner is murdered, a detective must track down two teenage runaways whose video footage contains the identity of the killer. Featuring Luke Hemsworth.

items.title: The Roman Spring of Mrs. Stone
items.description: This haunting adaptation of Tennessee Williams' novella stars Oscar winner Helen Mirren ("The Queen") as recently widowed Broadway star Karen Stone, who gets a fresh lease on life in Rome.

items.title: Deathgasm
items.description: Dos estudiantes metaleros tocan una pieza musical prohibida que abre las puertas del infierno. Ahora los dos y una doncella de metal deben unir fuerzas para salvar a su ciudad de un ataque demoníaco.

items.title: Ahí va el diablo
items.description: Después de desaparecer durante la noche en las montañas, dos hermanos regresan a casa, su comportamiento es extraño y desconcertante. La madre sospecha que han sido víctimas de algo oscuro e inhumano.

items.title: La casa del demonio
items.description: Desesperada por dinero fácil, la estudiante de segundo año Samantha Hughes (Jocelin Donahue) acepta trabajar como niñera en la apartada mansión de la extraña familia Ulman.

items.title: The Least Of These- A Christmas Story
items.description: A charming Christmas tale of hope, forgiveness and faith that centers around a single mom, her seven year old daughter and a Salvation Army Santa Claus.

items.title: A Man Called Jon
items.description: Jon loves to worship God, but his way of showing it is unconventional which creates conflict in his church. Jon's Bishop sends him to a new church.

items.title: A Perfect Chord
items.description: A Perfect Chord is an inspiring film about overcoming fears, living up to expectations, and using one’s gifts and talents to inspire others.

items.title: Victor Crowley
items.description: Diez años después de la terrible masacre, el único sobreviviente, Andrew Yong, se ve obligado a regresar al Pantano de la Isla Honey, pero por una de esas extrañas vueltas de la vida, Victor Crowley es resucitado por error.

items.title: Ace of Hearts
items.description: Officer Daniel Harding is a distinguished member of the K-9 police unit. His partner and best friend is Ace, a police dog. When Ace is accused of mauling a suspect, an overzealous DA convinces police authorities that Ace should be euthanized.

items.title: Adrenaline
items.description: A street racer's life is turned upside down after a near-fatal car crash, leaving him semi paraplegic. Forced to face his new circumstance, he struggles to walk, to trust, to love, and ultimately, race again.

items.title: Christmas in The Clouds
items.description: A surprise visit to the Sky Mountain Resort by a major travel guide sparks mayhem, romance, and comedy in this critically praised holiday feature.

items.title: Happiness is a Four Letter Word
items.description: Perfectionist Nandi seems to have the New South African Dream life in her grasp, black female partner in a major firm, marriage, the perfect house - but it all goes up in flames before the wedding.

items.title: The Babysitters
items.description: A teenager turns her babysitting service into a call-girl service for married guys after fooling around with one of her customers.

items.title: This is Christmas
items.description: Christmas is approaching, and best friends Harry, Jordan, Ben, and Dennis are at their annual get together before the holidays. As they share stories of their past year, it is clear they all still have a lot of growing to do.

items.title: Toast
items.description: Based on the bittersweet story of food writer Nigel Slater's childhood, this film is a delicious love letter to the tastes and smells which a young boy associates with his journey into adulthood.

items.title: Watching The Detectives
items.description: A film noir buff to the extreme (Cillian Murphy) is given a taste of his own medicine and has his life turned upside down by a kooky femme fatale (Lucy Liu) with a big adventure in mind. Sometimes love is stranger than fiction.

items.title: Willard: The Hermit of Gully Lake
items.description: In the 1940s American-born Willard MacDonald jumped his troop train heading to World War 2. Fearing authorities he lived as a hermit deep in the northern wilderness of Nova Scotia, Canada for more than 60 years inspiring folklore for generations.

items.title: Women Talking Dirty
items.description: A lively, outspoken single mother in Edinburgh, Scotland, develops an unlikely friendship with a shy cartoonist.

items.title: The Autobiography Of Miss Jane Pittman
items.description: Story of a black woman in the South who was born into slavery in the 1850s and lives to become a part of the civil rights movement in the 1960s.

items.title: The College Girl Murders
items.description: Police try to track down a hooded serial killer who murders his victims with a combination of acid and poison gas.

items.title: The Story Of O
items.description: The beautiful O is taken by her boyfriend, Rene, to a bizarre retreat, where she is trained in bondage and sexual perversion. Rene discharges a personal debt by transferring possession of O to his step-brother, Sir Stephen...

items.title: Lie With Me
items.description: An outgoing, sexually aggressive young woman meets and begins a torrid affair with an equally aggressive young man in which their affair begins to bring a strain on their personal lives.

items.title: Tito And The Birds
items.description: The film tells the story of a boy who is responsible, along with his father, for finding the cure for an illness that is contracted after the person takes a fright.

items.title: The Agronomist
items.description: The true story of Jean Dominique, a Haitian radio journalist and human rights activist.

items.title: Bloodsport
items.description: Ninjitsu master Frank Dux journeys to Hong Kong to enter the Kumite, the Olympics of martial arts, and meets a beautiful American reporter. Before long he must face Chong-Li, a vicious Korean master of Tae Kwan Do, in a climactic fight to the finish.

items.title: Stone
items.description: Academy-Award®-winner Robert De Niro and Academy-Award®-nominee Edward Norton deliver powerful performances as a seasoned corrections official and a scheming inmate whose lives become dangerously intertwined in this thought-provoking drama.

items.title: Johnny Cash: One Song at a Time
items.description: Retrace the remarkable story of America’s greatest country artist, one song at a time. Watch and experience the highs and lows of Johnny Cash’s career, the original man in black.

items.title: Anatomy of a Male Ballet Dancer
items.description: An intimate, behind-the-scenes portrait of Brazilian ballet star Marcelo Gomes. Widely considered the greatest partner of his generation, every ballerina in the world wants to dance with him.

items.title: Beauty Mark
items.description: Inspired by true events, this award-winning film tells the story of Angie (Auden Thornton, THIS IS US), a poverty-stricken young mother who must find a new home for her three-year-old son (Jameson Fowler) and her alcoholic mother (Catherine Curtin)

items.title: Gamble
items.description: Steel City Media and Creative Concept bring you the much anticipated new feature film 'GAMBLE', bringing some of Downhill Mountain Bike racing's most talented and charismatic riders together and releasing them from the confines of the tape.

items.title: Coming to My Senses
items.description: Up until a near-fatal crash in 1999, Aaron Baker soared 40-feet in the air on a roaring motocross bike. Now all he wants to do is walk.

items.title: Harry & Meghan: Your Royal Invitation
items.description: You are invited to the most anticipated royal event of the year. The long-awaited wedding of Great Britain's Prince Harry and American actress, activist, and sweetheart Meghan Markle. On November 27th, 2017 the couple will be in Windsor Castle.

items.title: 40 Years in the Making: The Magic Music Movie
items.description: Magic Music is one of the most fondly remembered bands of the Boulder Revolution. Living in a makeshift camp up in the mountains, they would delight local residents and university students with their original songs, acoustic instruments, and light harm...

items.title: Funeral Day
items.description: Funeral Day is the darkly funny story about Scott, a neurotic young man, who thinks he's found a lump on his testicles. Fearing he might be dying, he skips his friend's funeral in an attempt to start living life to the fullest.

items.title: Lambo
items.description: Aaron Lambert, a former bodybuilder with a troubled past, has gained a global following thanks to his colorful personality and rousing viral videos.

items.title: Freddie Mercury: The Ultimate Showman
items.description: Queen is one of the most iconic rock bands in the history of music but they didn’t earn their prestige overnight. Led by the eccentric visionary Freddie Mercury, Queen conquered the world.

items.title: My Friend Dahmer
items.description: Ross Lynch stars as the awkward, adolescent Jeffrey Dahmer before he became one of America's most infamous serial killers. Based on the acclaimed graphic novel, this is the haunting, sad, funny, true story of Dahmer in high school.

items.title: The Boy Downstairs
items.description: Diana (Zosia Mamet, "The Kids are All Right") moves back to New York City after a few years abroad and finds the perfect apartment. Yet on the first night in her new home, she discovers that her ex-boyfriend lives in the apartment below hers.

items.title: Mega Piranha (LAS)
items.description: Una cepa mutante de pirañas feroces gigantes escapan del Amazonas y se dirigen a Florida.

items.title: Glaciación 2012
items.description: Cuando una erupción volcánica en Islandia envía un glaciar a América del Norte, una familia lucha por escapar de la embestida de la próxima era glacial.

items.title: 7 Soles
items.description: Un "pollero" contratado para cruzar a un grupo de indocumentados decide que éste será su último viaje para la organización. Los jefes sospechan de él y mandan a El Gavilán a vigilarlo. Los polleros se traicionan, perdiendo parte de su "carga" humana.

items.title: Una vida mejor
items.description: Carlos Galindo, un jardinero mexicano en California, lucha por alejar a su hijo Luis de las pandillas. Tras el robo de su camioneta, la logran recuperar, pero la policía descubre que es indocumentado, poniendo en riesgo su futuro y su relación.

items.title: Fierce People
items.description: Cuando una familia rica le ofrece a Liz un trabajo como masajista personal, lo acepta. Pero la alta sociedad es una jungla, y su hijo cae en el mundo de los clubes de campo, del sexo, las drogas y los privilegios.

items.title: Rugrats en París: La película
items.description: Cuando Stu Pickles recibe una oferta de trabajo en EuroReptarland, el nuevo parque de atracciones de París, los Rugrats se unen. Ningún lugar está a salvo de los Rugrats, quienes descubren que divertirse es igual en cualquier idioma.

items.title: Star Trek VI: aquel país desconocido
items.description: Después de años de guerra, los imperios de la Federación y los klingon se encuentran al borde de conseguir la paz, cuando una nave klingon casi es destruida por un aparente ataque del Enterprise. Ambos mundos se preparan para un encuentro mortal.

items.title: Los fantasmas contraatacan
items.description: Antes de que la Nochebuena termine, Frank Cross sufra alucinaciones fantasmagóricas y recibirá la visita de un taxista neoyorquino del pasado, una estrafalaria hada del presente, y un sádico mensajero del futuro.

items.title: Justo a tiempo
items.description: Gene llega a su casa después de asistir al funeral de su exesposa. Al poco tiempo, secuestran a su hija. Recibe una pistola y la tarea de matar a una persona en una hora y quince minutos. De lo contrario, su hija será asesinada.

items.title: Fuera de control
items.description: La sociedad moderna traza líneas entre el bien y el mal, la furia y la redención. Un momento de ensimismamiento y una chispa de ira harán que dos hombres las atraviesen. La lucha se intensifica, y las vidas de ambos cambian para siempre.

items.title: Star Trek IX: insurrección
items.description: Desde el principio de la Federación, la Primera Directiva fue clara. Ninguna expedición de la Flota Estelar podrá interferir con el desarrollo natural de otras civilizaciones. Pero ahora Picard está enfrentado con órdenes que debilitan ese decreto.

items.title: Star Trek V: la última frontera
items.description: El Capitán Kirk y su tripulación están en una misión para liberar a los diplomáticos secuestrados; allí se encuentran cara a cara con Sybok, que está buscando obsesivamente a Dios.

items.title: Peligro Inminente
items.description: Cuando su mentor, el almirante James Greer, se enferma, Ryan es nombrado director en funciones de la CIA.

items.title: After StoneWall
items.description: The history of gay & lesbian life from the riots at Stonewall to the end of the century, including the hard work, struggles, tragic defeats, exciting victories and how AIDS dramatically changed the direction of the movement. Narrated by Melissa Etheridge.

items.title: Before Homosexuals
items.description: 4000 years of LGBT history in 90 minutes. In addition to the expansive time span, the film also covers expansive geographies and cultures, showcasing art and artifacts that have only recently come to light.

items.title: Dangerous Living
items.description: The first documentary to deeply explore the lives of gay and lesbian people in non-western cultures, we hear heartbreaking and triumphant stories from five different continents. Narrated by Janeane Garofalo

items.title: El mundo según Wayne 2
items.description: Los dos roqueros favoritos de Aurora, Illinois, están de vuelta en esta secuela de la comedia de 1992, El mundo de Wayne.

items.title: Sabrina (1954)
items.description: Bogie and Holden are the mega-rich Larrabee brothers of Long Island. Bogie’s all work, Holden’s all playboy. But when Sabrina (Hepburn), daughter of the family’s chauffeur, returns from Paris, the stage is set for some family fireworks.

items.title: The First Wives Club
items.description: Join the Club - The First Wives Club, the good-time battle-of-the-sexes satire sparked by snappy one-liners, great physical-comedy gags, and three unforgettable stars in top form, Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn, and Diane Keaton.

items.title: Flying Tigers
items.description: John Wayne adds luster to this early WWII film about the famous P-40 Flying Group who soared into battle against the Japanese in defense of China's freedom, Great dogfight scenes!

items.title: Grease 2
items.description: Return to rockin' Rydell High for a whole new term! It's 1961, two years after the original "Grease" gang graduated, and there's a new crop of seniors – and new members of the coolest cliques on campus.

items.title: House of Sand and Fog
items.description: Russian filmmaker Vadim Perelman makes his feature-film debut with the psychological drama House of Sand and Fog, based on the novel by Andre Dubus III, Ben Kingsley plays Massoud Amir Behrani, an Iranian immigrant living the United States.

items.title: A Night at the Roxbury
items.description: It seems like Steve and Doug will never be cool enough to make the Roxbury club’s guest list. Until they have a fender bender with their role model, club regular Richard Grieco. Eager to avoid litigation, Grieco befriends the starstruck pair.

items.title: Road to Perdition
items.description: Bonds of loyalty are put to the test when a hitman's son witnesses what his father does for a living.

items.title: Superstar
items.description: All Mary Katherine Gallagher wants in life is a kiss. Not just any kiss, mind you – a Hollywood-style kiss. But no matter how hard she tries, no one will kiss her. She decides that to get her kiss, she must become just like the people in the movies.

items.title: Kingpin
items.description: A star bowler whose career was prematurely "cut off" hopes to ride a new prodigy to success and riches.

items.title: Losing Isaiah
items.description: Jessica Lange plays an adoptive mother who gives an abandoned child a new chance at life. Halle Berry is the birth mother who cleans up her life and sets out to reclaim the child.

items.title: The Desperate Hours
items.description: Bogart plays an escaped con who has nothing to lose. March is a suburban Everyman who has everything to lose - his family is held hostage by Bogart.

items.title: Lemony Snicket's A Series of Unfortunate Events
items.description: A thrilling misadventure involving three ingenious orphans and a villainous actor named Count Olaf (Jim Carrey) who wants their enormous fortune.

items.title: The Sons of Katie Elder
items.description: The four rowdy sons of Katie Elder return home for her funeral and to avenge her death.

items.title: Strategic Air Command
items.description: Aviation and sports come together as a baseball player is recalled to Air Force duty.

items.title: What Lies Beneath
items.description: The wife of a professor investigates the murder of a beautiful college student who has been appearing to her.

items.title: True Grit (1969)
items.description: The cantankerous Rooster is hired by a headstrong young girl (Kim Darby) to find the man who murdered her father and fled with the family savings.

items.title: Some Kind of Hero
items.description: This fast moving comedy is laced with drama as Pryor assays one of the finest roles of his career as Eddie Keller, a man who returns home after six years as a P.O.W. to find his world changed.

items.title: The Quiet Man
items.description: An American ex-boxer returns to Ireland to win the hand of a spirited young woman. He is confronted by local customs and the woman's belligerent brother. Set in the verdant Irish countryside, this film has beautiful scenery and local charm.

items.title: The Ring
items.description: When four teenagers all meet with mysterious deaths exactly one week after watching a videotape, investigative reporter Rachel Keller tracks down the video... and watches it.

items.title: Shine a Light
items.description: Martin Scorsese and the world’s greatest rock n’ roll band, The Rolling Stones, unite to bring audiences the year’s most extraordinary film event, “Shine A Light.”

items.title: Kiss the Girls
items.description: Eight kidnapped women. All beautiful. All talented. All in danger of having their lives cut cruelly short if police detective Alex Cross and key witness Kate McTiernan can’t locate the elusive “collector” who calls himself Casanova.

items.title: On a Clear Day You Can See Forever
items.description: Daisy Gamble, a woman who hears phones before they ring wants to quit smoking, to please her fiancee, Warren. She goes to a doctor of hypnosis to do it. But once she's under, her doctor finds out that she can regress into past lives.

items.title: Boeing-Boeing
items.description: Boeing Boeing follows the lives of journalist Bernard and his friend Robert. Bernard is juggling romances with three different stewardesses but when Robert comes in for a visit and the airline carriers increase flights to Paris the comedy ensues!

items.title: Shaft (2000)
items.description: Who delivers ten times out of ten? Samuel L. Jackson is SHAFT, the man and the movie. John Singleton ("Boys 'n' the Hood") directs this gritty, action-packed thriller.

items.title: Ginger Baker in Africa
items.description: Rock legend and former Cream drummer Ginger Baker travels to Nigeria to build a recording studio.

items.title: Menuhin, A Family Portrait
items.description: A probing and in-depth portrait of violinist Yehudi Menuhin as a prodigy, musician, husband, father, and teacher.

items.title: Sound Of Torture
items.description: Live calls from the torture camps in Sinai: since Europe closed its borders in 2006, thousands of Eritrean refugees flee their military dictator-ruled country north to Israel, their gate to the west, crossing the Sinai desert.

items.title: The Guantanamo Trap
items.description: The Guantanamo Trap tells the stories of four people whose lives have been irrevocably changed by the Guantanamo Bay Detention Centre.

items.title: Wim Wenders: Early Years
items.description: In intimate conversations, Wim Wenders talks about his sheltered upbringing in post-war Germany.

items.title: Arrival
items.description: When mysterious spacecraft touch down across the globe, an elite team - led by expert translator Louise Banks (Academy Award® nominee Amy Adams) – races against time to decipher their intent.

items.title: Hair Brained
items.description: Eli, a 14-year-old genius outcast, attends Whittman College with Leo, a 41-year-old freshman with a gambling problem.

items.title: Hardball: The Girls of Summer
items.description: “Hardball: The Girls of Summer” follows the top female baseball players in the USA, all members of the globally ranked US Women’s National Baseball Team.

items.title: The Horse Dancer
items.description: When a promising young gymnast is cut from the Olympic team, she decides to follow her dreams of horseback riding by joining a girl’s horse camp.

items.title: Fuimos héroes
items.description: En 1965, Estados Unidos está en guerra con Vietnam del Norte, y el teniente coronel Hal Moore prepara a sus tropas para una de las batallas más violentas de la historia de EE. UU.: “El valle de la muerte”.

items.title: Friday the 13th Part - IV: The Final Chapter
items.description: After his revival in a hospital morgue, the hockey-masked murderer fixes his vengeful attention on the Jarvis family and a group of hitherto carefree teenagers.

items.title: Galaxy Quest
items.description: Nearly 20 years after the cult TV show Galaxy Quest was canceled, the cast is asked for help by an alien species to save the universe.

items.title: The Guilt Trip
items.description: "Barbra Streisand and Seth Rogen are the perfect comedy duo"* as they embark on one mother of a road trip! When Andy invites his mom on an 8-day, 3,000-mile journey across the country, the farther they go, the closer they get. *Jake Hamilton, FOX-TV

items.title: Star Trek Beyond
items.description: On a rescue mission, the USS Enterprise is attacked by Krall, a warlord sworn against the Federation. Crashed on an uncharted world, the crew must join forces with Jaylah, a rebellious alien warrior, to escape and stop Krall from triggering all-out war.

items.title: Friday the 13th - Part III
items.description: Ignoring Camp Crystal Lake’s bloody legacy, one by one they fall victim to the maniacal Jason who stalks them at every turn...

items.title: Canela (LAS)
items.description: Restaurant owner Tere has fallen into a state of depression after the tragic death of her daughter. With her eatery facing crisis, granddaughter Maria steps in to help Tere rediscover her love of good food and save the business from disarray.

items.title: El espectro
items.description: Jake es asesinado por matones del barrio, y regresa como una figura mística para vengarse.

items.title: Little Monsters
items.description: Maurice, the friendly but wacky monster that lives in the Under the Bed World, takes young Brian (Fred Savage) back to his world and teaches him all the secrets of the little monsters.

items.title: Deep Impact
items.description: When a couple of young astronomers discover an enormous comet on course to collide with Earth, the countdown to doomsday begins, and the human race embarks on the fight for survival.

items.title: Total Recall
items.description: It's 2084 A.D., and Doug Quaid is haunted by recurring dreams about journeying to Earth's closest planetary neighbor, Mars.

items.title: El Infierno
items.description: Benny es deportado de Estados Unidos a un México desgarrado por la guerra entre cárteles del narcotráfico. Se involucra en el negocio narco y asciende rápidamente, rodeado de dinero, mujeres, violencia y excesos.

items.title: Gloria
items.description: Una despreocupada mujer mayor descubre algo inesperado después de una breve aventura con un oficial naval retirado que conoció en un club nocturno.

items.title: La mujer de mi hermano
items.description: Zoe e Ignacio llevan 10 años casados y la pasión se ha enfriado. Una Zoe sexualmente frustrada se siente físicamente atraída por su cuñado. Las cosas se complican aún más después de que ella queda embarazada y descubre que su esposo puede ser gay.

items.title: Butter (2011)
items.description: In small-town Iowa, an adopted girl discovers her talent for butter carving and finds herself pitted against an ambitious local woman (Jennifer Garner) in their town's annual contest.

items.title: Clown
items.description: In an attempt to save his son’s birthday party, Kent dresses up in an old clown suit he finds but soon discovers that it’s not a suit at all - and there’s no way of removing it.

items.title: Dark Skies
items.description: As the Barret family's peaceful suburban life is rocked by an escalating series of disturbing events, they come to learn that a terrifying and deadly force is after them.

items.title: Everly
items.description: An intense action-thriller centered on a down-on-her-luck woman (Salma Hayek) trapped in her apartment.

items.title: Ghost in the Shell
items.description: 2029 – A female government cyber agent and the Internal Bureau of Investigations are hot on the trail of a "The Puppet Master" – a computer virus capable of invading cybernetic brains and altering its victim’s memory.

items.title: The Homesman
items.description: Tommy Lee Jones stars in “the best western since UNFORGIVEN” (BBC). A low-life drifter helps a headstrong woman (Hilary Swank) cross the frontier after she rescues him from hanging.

items.title: Let Me In
items.description: Owen, an overlooked and bullied boy, finds love and revenge through Abby (Chloë Grace Moretz of KICK-ASS), a beautiful but peculiar girl who turns out to be a vampire.

items.title: No Escape
items.description: Owen Wilson, Pierce Brosnan, and Lake Bell star in this action-packed thrill-ride about what one American family must do to survive when a violent coup overtakes Southeast Asia.

items.title: Only God Forgives
items.description: Only God Forgives reunites the vision of renowned director Nicolas Winding Refn (DRIVE) with Ryan Gosling in a gritty thriller set in the seedy underbelly of Bangkok.

items.title: Philomena
items.description: Academy Award®-Winner Judi Dench stars as Philomena, a woman who alongside a grumpy reporter (Steve Coogan) journeys to America to find the child she put up for adoption so many years ago.

items.title: Quartet
items.description: At a home for retired opera singers, the annual concert to celebrate Verdi is disrupted by the arrival of Jean (Maggie Smith), an eternal diva and the former wife of one of the residents.

items.title: Solomon Kane
items.description: Captain Solomon Kane (James Purefoy) is a brutally efficient 16th Century killing machine.

items.title: The Disappearance Of Eleanor Rigby
items.description: Jessica Chastain and James McAvoy dazzle in this drama hailed as "one of the most romantic love stories ever." A married couple torn apart by tragedy tries to reclaim the life they once shared.

items.title: The Immigrant
items.description: Marion Cotillard, Joaquin Phoenix, and Jeremy Renner star in the story of Ewa, a recent immigrant to America who falls prey to a charming but wicked man who forces her into prostitution.

items.title: The Railway Man
items.description: Colin Firth stars as a former army officer who sets out on a mission of revenge to confront the man who tormented him while he was a prisoner at a Japanese labor camp during World War II.

items.title: The Way Of The Gun
items.description: A pair of bumbling criminals kidnap a woman for ransom money, but they soon realize they've made a huge mistake when they learn she is a surrogate for a ruthless mob boss.

items.title: This Must Be The Place
items.description: Cheyenne (Sean Penn), a retired rock star living off his royalties in Dublin, returns to New York City to find the Nazi responsible for humiliating his recently deceased father during WWII.

items.title: Touchback
items.description: Former football star (Brian Presley) finds himself back in time before his career-ending injury. Seeking his mentor (Kurt Russell), he must decide whether to let fate unfold or change his future.

items.title: Tracks
items.description: From the producers of THE KING'S SPEECH comes this remarkable true story of Robyn Davidson, a young woman who leaves her urban life to trek through the sprawling Australian desert.

items.title: Vampire Academy
items.description: A half-vampire training at a secret academy must battle evil immortal vampires and protect her best friend from those who intend to use her secret power for their own gain.

items.title: While She Was Out
items.description: Della (Academy-Award®-winner Kim Basinger), a suburban housewife, is hell-bent on survival as she is mercilessly stalked by a group of teenage thugs led by a manipulative psychopath (Luke Haas of WITNESS).

items.title: All Is Lost
items.description: One of this year's most highly acclaimed and most-anticipated films, Academy Award® winner Robert Redford "gives the performance of his life" (ENTERTAINMENT WEEKLY) in a thrilling tale of one man's battle for survival at sea!

items.title: Dragon
items.description: Liu Jin-xi (Donnie Yen) is a village craftsman whose quiet life is irrevocably shattered by the arrival of two notorious gangsters in the local general store.

items.title: Grace Of Monaco
items.description: Academy Award®-winner Nicole Kidman captures the beauty and elegance of Grace Kelly in this true story of her transition from Hollywood starlet to Princess of Monaco.

items.title: Friday the 13th Part V: A New Beginning
items.description: This time, he seems to have set his sights on the young patients at a secluded halfway house. And more than a few of his teen targets end up in half, in quarters... You name it, Jason does it.

items.title: Friday the 13th, Part VI: Jason Lives
items.description: As a child, Tommy Jarvis did what many others died trying to do. He killed Jason Vorhees, the mass murderer who terrorized the residents of Crystal Lake. But now, years later, Tommy is tormented by the fear that maybe Jason isn’t really dead.

items.title: Friday the 13th Part VII: The New Blood
items.description: Ever since homicidal maniac Jason Voorhees got trapped in chains at the bottom of Crystal Lake, the nearby summer camp has operated without a hitch... without a murder. But one of this season’s happy campers has brought along a deadly secret.

items.title: Friday the 13th Part VIII: Jason Takes Manhattan
items.description: The Big Apple’s in big trouble, as indestructible psycho-fiend Jason Voorhees hits the road to New York City - and paints the town “red.”

items.title: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
items.description: Leslie Nielsen stars as Police Squad's own granite-jawed, rockbrained cop Frank Drebin, who bumbles across a mind control scheme to assassinate Queen Elizabeth.

items.title: The Naked Gun 2 1/2: The Smell of Fear
