items.description: Lt. Frank Drebin (Leslie Nielsen) loves a mystery. Why are we here? Is there life after sex? Yes, Drebin tackles the big issues— and the biggest of all is how to stop devious Quentin Hapsburg’s (Robert Goulet) plan to destroy the environment!

items.title: Friday the 13th
items.description: Camp Crystal Lake has been shuttered for over 20 years due to several vicious and unsolved murders. The camp's new owner and seven young counselors are preparing the property for reopening despite warnings from residents about a "death curse."

items.title: Friday the 13th Part II
items.description: Five years after the bloodbath at Camp Crystal, all that remains is the legend of Jason and his demented mother, who had murdered seven camp counselors. At a nearby summer camp, the new counselors are unconcerned about the warnings to stay away.

items.title: Dead Again
items.description: Oscar® nominee Kenneth Branagh (Henry V) and Oscar ® winner Emma Thompson (Howards End*) give dazzling dual-role performances in this supernatural-tinged romantic murder mystery. Mike Church (Branagh) is a L.A.

items.title: Houdini
items.description: Tony Curtis gives a winning performance as the great Houdini, the struggling circus performer who emerged as the world’s most captivating magician and escape artist.

items.title: Danger Diabolik
items.description: The suave thief called Diabolik can’t get enough of life’s good – or glittery – things. Not when there are currency shipments to steal from under the noses of government officials and priceless jewels to lift from the boudoirs of the rich.

items.title: It Takes Two
items.description: Outspoken Amanda and quiet refined Alyssa swap identities in a plan to bring Roger (Alyssa's father) and Diana (Amanda's social worker) closer together.

items.title: The Duellists
items.description: Keith Carradine and Harvey Keitel star in this dramatic film about two officers in Napoleon’s army who violently confront each other in a series of duels.

items.title: Indiscreet
items.description: Cary Grant is the suave American diplomat who pretends to be married in order to preserve his bachelor status. Ingrid Bergman is the glamorous leading lady of the London stage who has no scruples about having an affair with a married man.

items.title: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
items.description: Jimmy Stewart plays the bungling but charming big-city lawyer determined to rid the fair village of Shinbone of its number one nuisance and bad man: Liberty Valance.

items.title: Kill Command
items.description: Set in a near future, technology-reliant society that pits man against killing machines.

items.title: Airplane!
items.description: Voted “one of the 10 funniest movies ever made” by the American Film Institute, “Airplane!” is a masterpiece of off-the-wall comedy.

items.title: Bless the Child
items.description: Omens and concepts of good vs. evil have no place in Maggie O'Connor's well-ordered, practical universe. That is until she becomes the caregiver for mankind's last hope - a child who's just turned six.

items.title: Days of Heaven
items.description: A story of love and murder told through the jaded voice of a child and expressive images of nature. Bill, a fugitive from the slums of Chicago, finds himself pitted against a shy, rich Texan for the love of Abby.

items.title: Dear God
items.description: Special delivery for comedy fans! Greg Kinnear ( Auto Focus) stars in and Garry Marshall ( Pretty Woman) directs this spirit-lifter about a money-scamming con artist who goes from no-good to doing good.

items.title: Death Wish
items.description: In this explosive story of revenge and urban violence, Charles Bronson plays Paul Kersey, a bleeding-heart liberal who has a change of opinion after his wife and daughter are violently attacked by a gang of thugs in their apartment.

items.title: The Goods: Live Hard, Sell Hard
items.description: Smooth-talking salesman Don Ready (Jeremy Piven) and his crazy crew of closers have just one weekend to move over 200 cars and prove that when it comes to conning, conniving and all kinds of bad behavior, they’ve got the goods!

items.title: Head of State
items.description: When Washington desperately needs a presidential candidate just weeks before the election, they need someone sure to lose. They pick Mays Gilliam (Chris Rock), an unknown local politician from a down-and-out D.C. neighborhood, to be their puppet.

items.title: The High and the Mighty
items.description: John Wayne plays Dan Roman, a veteran pilot haunted by a tragic past. Now relegated to second-incommand cockpit assignments, he finds himself scheduled on a routine Honolulu-to-San Francisco flight – one that takes a terrifying turn.

items.title: Naked Gun 33 1/3: The Final Insult
items.description: Oscar® night. Will someone please kick that numbskull off-stage? Wait! That’s no ordinary numbskull. That’s Lt. Frank Drebin, crashing the ceremonies to stop a terrorist plot!

items.title: Rock-A-Bye Baby
items.description: A TV repairman marries a Mexican bullfighter. Unfortunately, he dies the day after their wedding; fortunately, he managed to impregnate her. Unfortunately, she is starring in the epic called The White Virgin on the Nile.

items.title: Roman Holiday
items.description: Audrey Hepburn's portrayal of a modern-day princess, rebelling against the royal obligations, who explores Rome on her own. This romantic comedy ranks as one of the most enjoyable films of all times.

items.title: Sorry, Wrong Number
items.description: Leona is confined to her bed. One night, whilst waiting for he husband to return home, she picks up the phone and accidentally overhears a conversation between two men planning a murder.

items.title: Death on the Matterhorn
items.description: Seven men stand on the summit of the Matterhorn, the last Alpine peak to be conquered. Their place in history is assured. Then, disaster strikes: a rope snaps. Four men die. But did the rope really just snap...or was it cut?

items.title: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
items.description: Brad Pitt and Cate Blanchett star in the adaption of F. Scott Fitzgerald's story about an elderly man who ages backward and the problems that arise when he falls in love with a woman.

items.title: Minority Report
items.description: In the future, a division of the police department has the technology to arrest killers before they commit crimes; however, the tables turn on one of the cops working within the division.

items.title: Once Upon a Time in the West
items.description: The epic story of a mysterious stranger with a harmonica who joins forces with a notorious desperado to protect a beautiful widow from a ruthless assassin working for the railroad.

items.title: Stephen King's Graveyard Shift
items.description: When a mill is reopened, several employees meet their deaths. The killings all occur between 11 p.m. and 7 a.m. the Graveyard Shift. Soon, the workers find a maze of tunnels leading to the cemetery and the horror that comes alive at night.

items.title: The Time Machine
items.description: Hoping to alter the events of the past, a 19th-century inventor instead travels 800,000 years into the future, where he finds humankind divided into two warring races.

items.title: Changing Lanes
items.description: Late for court, an attorney weaves in and out of traffic. In a different lane, a father whose right to see his children rests on getting to court on time. A minor accident will turn these two strangers into beasts.

items.title: Gallipoli
items.description: Two young men (Mel Gibson and Mark Lee) are brought together in the Australian army in 1915. They cross continents and great oceans, climb pyramids and walk through the ancient sands of Egypt to join their regiment at the fateful battle of Gallipoli.

items.title: Reds
items.description: The story of John Reed, American Communist, journalist and activist, whose love affair with writer/feminist Louise Bryant (Diane Keaton) unfolds against the explosive backdrop of the Russian Revolution.

items.title: Barbarella
items.description: The setting is the planet Lythion in the year 40,000, when Barbarella makes a forced landing while traveling through space. She vanquishes evil in the forms of robots and monsters. She also rewards the handsome men who assist her in the adventure.

items.title: Prince: Sign 'O' the Times
items.description: A concert film with theatrical staging, featuring live performances by Prince and his band.

items.title: The Sunshine Makers
items.description: A real-life "Breaking Bad" for the psychedelic set, "The Sunshine Makers" reveals the story of Nicholas Sand and Tim Scully, the unlikely duo at the heart of the 1960s American drug counterculture.

items.title: A Midsummer Night's Dream (1996)
items.description: The adventures of four young lovers, a group of amateur actors and their interactions with fairies come to light in a moonlit forest.

items.title: Chris Claremont's X-Men
items.description: Chris Claremont came to Marvel as a young man, and was assigned a book that no one else wanted, a book on the brink of cancellation: X-Men.

items.title: Enemies: A Love Story
items.description: A ghostwriter finds himself romantically involved with his current wife, a married woman and his long-vanished wife.

items.title: Grant Morrison: Talking With Gods
items.description: For the first time ever, Morrison recounts his own life story: his early days, growing up in Scotland; the start of his comics career; the crazy years of the '90s, as his life and his comics became enmeshed.

items.title: I'll Be There
items.description: An off-beat comedy about a former 80s pop star (Craig Ferguson) whose downward spiral is halted when he discovers he has a teenage daughter the product of a weekend love affair.

items.title: Too Much Johnson
items.description: A woman has two lovers. When one man finds out about the other, he acts as a villain and chases after the protagonist.

items.title: Warren Ellis: Captured Ghosts
items.description: This insightful documentary dives into the warped mind of the writer/futurist/philosopher behind groundbreaking comics "Transmetropolitan," "Iron Man: Extremis," and "RED."

items.title: Star Trek X: némesis
items.description: Elige la ruta para una galaxia de acción incomparable y aventura mientras el capitán Jean-Luc Picard y su tripulación de la Enterprise se enfrentan a un peligroso nuevo adversario… ¡Que parece tener un sorprendente lazo con Picard!

items.title: The Errand Boy
items.description: Morty S. Tashman, under the guise of studio mail clerk, is to roam the lot and then report back to the boss with any questionable or dishonest activities. But virtually all of the shenanigans and escapades Morty uncovers are ones of his own doing!

items.title: Star Trek VII: generaciones
items.description: La única esperanza de Picard para un futuro está en el Nexus… Y en un capitán legendario del pasado.

items.title: Don't Look Now
items.description: On a trip to Venice, a young couple whose daughter has just died meet a psychic who leads them into a frightening and suspenseful experience. Based on a novel by Daphne Du Maurier.

items.title: Concrete Blondes
items.description: Three girls discover $3 million in missing drug money and decide to steal it. All goes well until one of the girls' boyfriend concocts a plan to steal the money from the girls to pay off his debts to a vicious two-faced gangster.

items.title: Explicit Ills
items.description: A drama of four interconnecting stories revolving around love, drugs, and poverty in Philadelphia.

items.title: Fourplay
items.description: A story of friendship, love, marriage, secrets and lies that unfolds between two couples in one apartment during a Sunday brunch that will affect their lives forever.

items.title: The 5th Quarter
items.description: Driven by the tragic and fatal car crash that took the life of his fifteen year old brother Luke, and wearing Luke's number 5 jersey, Jon Abbate helps to lead the Wake Forest Demon Deacons to the most successful season in school history.

items.title: Born to Race
items.description: Born To Race is the story of Danny Krueger, a rebellious young street racer on a collision course with trouble. After an accident at an illegal street race, he is sent to a small town to live with his estranged father, a washed-up NASCAR racer.

items.title: Good Satan
items.description: A camera crew has the unique opportunity to record Satan in his natural habitat, and he seems happy. But after a surprise invitation to a divine party at God's place, Lucifer is hell-bent on earning God's respect and getting back into heaven for good.

items.title: Apocalypto
items.description: As the Mayan kingdom faces its decline, a young man is taken on a perilous journey to a world ruled by fear and oppression.

items.title: The Monster Squad
items.description: Algunos niños forman un club especializado en monstruos, pero pronto consiguen más de lo que esperaban cuando Drácula se traslada a la Tierra, con el monstruo de Frankenstein, el hombre lobo, la momia y el Gill-man.

items.title: Star Trek: la película
items.description: Cuando un alienígena no identificado destruye tres poderosos cruceros klingon, el capitán James T. Kirk (William Shatner) regresa al U.S.S. Enterprise™ para tomar el mando.

items.title: Violencia en la tempestad
items.description: Durante la evacuación de Huntingburg por inundación, el conductor de un auto de valores blindado se encuentra en peligro. Una banda de ladrones cree que la inundación es su oportunidad de robar los 3 millones de dólares que transporta.

items.title: Canelo v. Jacobs-May 04, 2019 (2020)
items.description: Replay of Canelo v. Jacobs from May 04, 2019

items.title: Catch Me If You Can
items.description: From three-time Oscar-winning director Steven Spielberg, Catch Me If You Can follows Frank W. Abagnale, Jr. as he successfully passes himself off as a pilot, a lawyer, and a doctor - all before his 21st birthday!

items.title: Crímenes ocultos
items.description: Un miembro de la policía militar investiga una serie de asesinatos infantiles que ocurren durante la era de Stalin en la Unión Soviética.

items.title: Braddock: Missing In Action III
items.description: When Colonel James Braddock (Chuck Norris, "Missing in Action") is told that his wife and 12-year-old son are still alive in Communist Vietnam, he mounts a one-man assault to free them…armed with the latest high-tech firepower, of course!

items.title: Firewalker
items.description: Two hapless soldiers of misfortune (Chuck Norris, Louis Gossett Jr.) meet a beautiful girl (Melody Anderson) with a map to a lost gold mine and decide to have one last shot at striking it rich. But the trail to the treasure is no yellow brick road!

items.title: Runaway Train
items.description: Jon Voight and Eric Roberts turn in Oscar®-nominated performances as a pair of escaped convicts who hop a freight train, but when the engineer dies of a heart attack, they find themselves trapped, alone and speeding toward certain disaster.

items.title: Death Wish 3
items.description: In this high-voltage thriller, Charles Bronson sets out to avenge the murder of an old friend who met his demise at the hands of a New York street hoodlum.

items.title: Death Wish 4: The Crackdown
items.description: Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) is on a mission to take down the L.A. drug trade after his girlfriend's teenage daughter tragically dies of an overdose. He's armed and dangerous...and mad as hell in this take-no-prisoners, pulse-pounding thriller.

items.title: D.A.R.Y.L.
items.description: A young boy is found wandering, with no memory of who he is. A family takes him in and begins to look for clues to help him find his way home.

items.title: The Buccaneer (1958)
items.description: General Andrew Jackson's dependence on the help of pirate Jean Lafitte to repel the British is complicated by the Governor's daughter. Set in New Orleans during the War of 1812.

items.title: The Grass is Greener
items.description: Victor and Hillary are down on their luck to the point that they allow tourists to take guided tours of their castle. But when a millionaire oil tycoon, visits, and takes a liking to more than the house, they soon get involved in a love triangle.

items.title: Hansel and Gretel: Witch Hunters
items.description: Get ready for a twisted take on the classic tale as Hansel and Gretel have turned pro, coping with the trauma of their childhood captivity by slaying witches for hire.

items.title: Star Trek IX: Insurrection
items.description: When the crew of the Enterprise learns of the Federation's plot against the inhabitants of a unique planet, Capt. Picard begins an open rebellion.

items.title: Win a Date with Tad Hamilton!
items.description: Rosalee, a star-struck small-town girl, wins a date with the Hollywood hunk Tad Hamilton. And while it may be Rosalee's dream come true, it means complete chaos for her best friend Pete.

items.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
items.description: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

items.title: Super Size Me 2: Holy Chicken!
items.description: Morgan Spurlock reignites his battle with the food industry - this time from behind the register - as he opens his own fast food restaurant.

items.title: A Healthy Diet for a Healthy Brain
items.description: Food goes straight to our brain. So, what do we eat to make sure our brain stays healthy? Many recent discoveries have shown that our mental health, our moods, and our intellectual ability are directly influenced by what we eat.

items.title: John Wayne America at All Costs
items.description: This is the story of a man who climbed the Hollywood ladder, one rung at a time, until he reached the top and became the most popular American actor of his era.

items.title: Hidden-Questar
items.description: Three athletes, three elements, three friends. All believing in their own path. Crossing the same road full of doubts, efforts and hunger for a sport, for a job, a fire that at this moment ceases to be hidden.

items.title: ¿Y dónde está el piloto?
items.description: Considerada "una de las 10 películas más divertidas de la historia" por el American Film Institute, "¿Y dónde está el piloto?" es una obra maestra de la comedia de disparate.

items.title: Ellis Island: History
items.description: About 12 million emigrants landed on Ellis Island; First outpost of the American federal immigration station in the New York Bay, the ultimate gateway to the United States of America. However, when they first arrive, their fates do not belong to them.

items.title: A Ripple of Hope
items.description: In the wake of the assassination of Martin Luther King, Robert F. Kennedy made a speech: a moving, off the cuff plea for peace and reconciliation. Risking his own life and defying city officials, Kennedy helped Indianapolis avert certain violence.

items.title: The Wheelchair President
items.description: At the height of war, President Franklin D. Roosevelt inspired millions with visions of a new and better post-war world. Set against the epic scale of World War II, Professor David Reynolds presents an intimate biography of a man who was burdened.

items.title: Nixon in the Den
items.description: David Reynolds takes a fresh look at the controversial career and presidency of Richard Nixon. Reynolds argues that Nixon was genuinely successful as an international statesman. Yet behind the scenes, Nixon's diplomacy was a story of intrigue and rivalry.

items.title: JFK's Women: The Scandals Revealed
items.description: John F. Kennedy, the charismatic president. However, with all that charm came a hidden life of reckless sexual adventure. He had a confirmed affair with Marilyn Monroe, and at least five of his endeavors posed a potential threat to national security.

items.title: Bad Lieutenant: Port of Call New Orleans
items.description: A drug-addled detective (Nicolas Cage) investigates the killing of 5 immigrants from Senegal in post-Katrina New Orleans. With Eva Mendes. Werner Herzog, director.

items.title: Blackjack
items.description: Marshal Jack Devlin attempts to protect a young woman from gangsters. Unfortunately, Devlin’s ability to do his job is restricted after an explosion temporarily blinds him.

items.title: Blitz
items.description: A tough cop (Jason Statham, “Fast & Furious 7”) is dispatched to take down a serial killer who is targeting police officers. With Paddy Considine, Aiden Gillen, Mark Rylance, Luke Evans.

items.title: Command Performance
items.description: When the Russian Premier is taken hostage at a rock concert in Moscow, it's up to ex-biker-turned-rock drummer (Dolf Lundgren, "Rocky IV") to save him.

items.title: Hard Cash
items.description: Released from prison, an infamous thief and his new crew pull off a brilliant robbery, but then become embroiled with a corrupt FBI agent when they discover the money is marked.

items.title: In Hell
items.description: Kyle Leblanc, a man serving a life's sentence for killing his wife's murderer, must survive in a prison where hardened criminals battle to the death for the wardens' entertainment.

items.title: Retrograde
items.description: Two opposing time travelers are sent back to the present to prevent a global biological disaster from occurring.

items.title: Shooting Gallery
items.description: A street-wise man (Freddie Prinze Jr.) gets mixed up in a scheme involving a pool shark (Ving Rhames) and a crooked lawman.

items.title: Sweepers
items.description: In this action-packed thriller, a humanitarian minesweeping operation in Angola uncovers a covert organization that is planting new and deadly mines.

items.title: The Code
items.description: A veteran thief (Morgan Freeman) recruits a younger crook (Antonio Banderas) to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

items.title: The Inquiry
items.description: In 35 A.D., a Roman tribune is sent to Palestine to investigate the death and possible resurrection of a certain Jesus from Nazareth.

items.title: The Peacekeeper
items.description: Dolph Lundgren ("Rocky IV") stars as Major Frank Cross. When a terrorist group steals the President's personal communications computer, only Major Cross has the key to prevent a nuclear holocaust.

items.title: Emperor
items.description: War drama. Set during the end of World War II, the film tells the true story of General Bonner Fellers, and the decision that shaped the course of history for Japan and the world.

items.title: Armed Response
items.description: The owners of a security firm begin conducting burglaries in their city to generate business. But they bite off far more than they can chew when they rob a mobster’s home.

items.title: Highlander 2: The Quickening - The Renegade Version
items.description: Prepare to experience one of the most spectacular cinematic adventures...It’s 2024 and MacLeod (Christopher Lambert) and Ramirez (Sean Connery) are back to save planet Earth.

items.title: Kill The Irishman
items.description: Oscar®-winner Christopher Walken, Val Kilmer, and Ray Stevenson star in KILL THE IRISHMAN, the true story of a tough Irish thug working for mobsters in Cleveland during the 1970s.

items.title: Mac & Devin Go to High School
items.description: Rappers Snoop Doog and Wiz Khalifa team up to create this ultimate stoner comedy with a star-studded hip hop soundtrack.

items.title: Traitor
items.description: When straight arrow FBI agent Roy Clayton (Guy Pearce of MOMENTO) heads up the investigation into a dangerous international conspiracy, all clues seem to lead back to former U.S. Special Operations officer, Samir Horn (Don Cheadle of CRASH).

items.title: Barefoot
items.description: Evan Rachel Wood and Scott Speedman star in an unusual comedy about the unlikely romance between two misfits, which turns into the perfect pairing!

items.title: Dragon Blade
items.description: Epic sword-and-sandal war thriller starring martial arts legend Jackie Chan starring alongside John Cusack and Adrian Brody.

items.title: Direct Action
items.description: Veteran cop Frank Gannon (Dolph Lundgren, "Rocky IV") is being hunted by his fellow police officers after they learn he has betrayed the LAPD by exposing its corruption.

items.title: Repo! The Genetic Opera
items.description: An epidemic of organ failures devastates the planet, and those who cannot afford their treatments are hunted by Repo Men in this unique production that modernizes the rock opera genre.

items.title: Spread
items.description: High-end lothario Nikki (Ashton Kutcher) sleeps his way into a life of privilege all while crashing at the Hollywood Hills home of a middle-aged female attorney (Anne Heche).

items.title: The Open Road
items.description: A minor leaguer (Justin Timberlake) hits the road to track down his estranged father, legendary baseball player Kyle Garret (Jeff Bridges), when his mother becomes sick.

items.title: The Red Violin
items.description: A musical-instrument appraiser gets caught up in a soul-wrenching moral conflict in this moving tale of mystery and obsession.

items.title: 24x36: A Movie About Movie Posters
items.description: A documentary exploring the birth, death, and resurrection of the illustrated movie poster.

items.title: Finding Oscar
items.description: From Executive Producer Steven Spielberg comes an inspiring documentary that sheds light on a forgotten massacre during Guatemala's civil war. Nearly 30 years later, a forensic scientist and prosecutor help bring justice to those responsible.

items.title: Vengeance: A Love Story
items.description: On the Fourth of July, single mother Teena is brutally assaulted by a local gang in front of her 12-year-old daughter. The defense hires a local hot-shot attorney to manipulate the law to their advantage.

items.title: Who We Are Now
items.description: Recently released from prison, Beth works with her public defender to get her son back from her sister, who was awarded legal custody while Beth was incarcerated for ten years.

items.title: The Vault
items.description: Two estranged sisters are forced to rob a bank in order to save their brother. The heist begins smoothly, but mayhem ensues when the defiant bank manager sends them to a basement-level vault — home to something truly evil.

items.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
items.description: Captain Kirk and his crew must deal with Mr. Spock's long-lost half-brother, who hijacks the Enterprise for an obsessive search for God at the center of the galaxy.

items.title: Queens Logic
items.description: A group of lifelong friends meets again in Queens for a bachelor party and wedding. Starring Kevin Bacon, Linda Fiorentino, and John Malkovich.

items.title: The Long Walk Home
items.description: One black and one white woman in 1955 Montgomery, Alabama must decide what they are going to do in response to the famous bus boycott lead by Martin Luther King. With Whoopi Goldberg and Sissy Spacek.

items.title: Highlander
items.description: An immortal Scottish swordsman must confront the last of his immortal opponent, a murderously brutal barbarian who lusts for the fabled "Prize".

items.title: Coach Carter
items.description: An inspirational account of basketball coach Ken Carter, who received both praise and criticism when he made headlines for benching his entire undefeated team for poor academic performance.

items.title: Harlem Nights
items.description: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray and his adopted son, Quick, run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. Gangster Bugsy Calhoune pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone to close Club Sugar Ray down.

items.title: The Fighting Seabees
items.description: The construction foreman of a fighting work battalion to be stationed near Japanese lines in the Pacific and a naval commander colleague compete in Washington for a journalist, while preparing to engage the enemy in a massive assault.

items.title: Serpico
items.description: A true-life drama of a cop whose revelations about the extent of bribery in the New York Police Department almost led to his death and resulted in the creation of the Knapp Commission.

items.title: The Heartbreak Kid (2007)
items.description: Ben Stiller stars as Eddie, the 40-year-old confirmed bachelor who finally says "I do" to the beautiful and Lila. But during their honeymoon, the woman of his dreams turns out to be a total nightmare.

items.title: Blame
items.description: A high school outcast's taboo relationship with her drama teacher strikes a vengeance in her jealous classmate that mirrors 'The Crucible'.

items.title: Dilili in Paris
items.description: Travel to the upper reaches and lower depths of Paris in the Belle Epoque with Dilili, a graceful young girl with the eagle-eyed smarts as she investigates the mysterious plot of the Male Masters.

items.title: Gook
items.description: Two Korean-American brothers strike up a friendship with a young African America girl. During the LA Riots they learn the meaning of family.

items.title: Little Pink House
items.description: A small-town paramedic flees a bad marriage, buys a cottage, and paints it pink. When politicians plan to bulldoze it for a giant corporation, she fights back, and helps millions protect their homes.

items.title: Making Babies
items.description: A couple puts their marriage to the ultimate test in an effort to have a child.

items.title: Passion Fish
items.description: After an accident leaves her a paraplegic, a former soap opera star struggles to recover both emotionally and mentally, until she meets her newest nurse, who has struggles of her own.

items.title: Prescription Thugs
items.description: In this follow-up to his film 'Bigger Stronger Faster,' director Chris Bell turns his camera on the abuse of prescription drugs and, ultimately, himself.

items.title: Trois 2: Pandora's Box
items.description: Mia is a successful therapist with an unsuccessful marriage. Hearing about the wild sex life of her new client Tammy, Mia accepts her invitation to the secret sex club Pandoras Box where she meets a handsome stranger named Hampton, but is he all he seems?

items.title: Trois 3: The Escort
items.description: When a hip-hop promoter is bailed out of a hefty debt by a club owner, he becomes one of her call boys and nearly loses his life in the process.

items.title: Kamen Rider Heisei Generations Forever
items.description: Sougo Tokiwa and Sento Kiryu fight an enemy in the Kuriogatake mountain.

items.title: April Fool's Day
items.description: When Muffy St. John invited her college friends up to her parents’ secluded island home for the time of their lives, she just forgot to tell them it might be the last time of their lives.

items.title: Emily Bronte's Wuthering Heights
items.description: Emily Brontë’s timeless tale of love and passion comes alive in this stirring film version starring Juliette Binoche and Ralph Fiennes.

items.title: Searching For Bobby Fischer
items.description: Josh is a typical seven-year-old who happens to be a chess prodigy. Josh’s father is determined to see his son become a champion. During their journey of discovery, they learn the one thing neither can afford to lose: their love for each other.

items.title: The Parallax View
items.description: Warren Beatty is a news reporter who, along with seven others, witnesses the assassination of a political candidate.

items.title: Shottas
items.description: Two young men from Jamaica climb to the top of the criminal world in Miami, with a constant presence of drugs, extortion, and deceit.

items.title: Las tortugas ninja
items.description: Las Tortugas Ninja están mejores que nunca en este éxito de taquilla cargado de acción y risas imparables. Cuando la ciudad de Nueva York está en problemas, le corresponde salvarla a estos cuatro hermanos ninja amantes de la pizza.

items.title: Cara a cara
items.description: Gracias a un nuevo procedimiento médico, un agente adquiere quirúrgicamente la misma apariencia que un criminal con el objetivo de desmantelar su organización terrorista.

items.title: Pale Red Dot
items.description: On the hunt for other solar systems, scientists have discovered an Earth-sized planet orbiting the star nearest to our Sun, Proxima Centauri. It's an important test of whether we are alone in the universe.

items.title: Buffalo Bill And The Indians
items.description: Buffalo Bill has fought Indians & Civil War battles, but nothing can prepare him for show business! When he signs Sitting Bull for a role in his Wild West Show, the clash of cultures reverberates far beyond the boundaries of their sprawling theater.

items.title: Killer's Kiss
items.description: This dazzling film noir from Stanley Kubrick is about a struggling New York boxer (Jamie Smith), whose life is imperiled when he protects a nightclub dancer (Irene Kane) from her gangster boss.

items.title: The Fall Of The House Of Usher (1960)
items.description: When a beautiful young woman's suitor arrives to ask her hand in marriage, the doors of the mysterious house of Usher fling open...and terror begins.

items.title: It Runs In The Family
items.description: A tender story of a relationship between a father and his son in a dysfunctional family.

items.title: Body of Deceit
items.description: Years ago, Alice (Kristanna Loken) was in an accident in Malta where she was staying with her husband (Antonio Cupo), leaving her in a coma. Upon waking up, Alice could not remember the accident.

items.title: Ghostheads
items.description: A look at the intense fandom that developed around the movie/cultural phenomenon "Ghostbusters."

items.title: Harry & Snowman
items.description: This is the Cinderella story of immigrant Harry DeLeyer and the plow horse he rescued from slaughter. Together, Harry and Snowman beat the odds, winning jumping competitions and worldwide fame.

items.title: Shooter
items.description: Determined to prove his innocence in a double-cross, Bob Lee Swagger is now in a high-tension race from every law enforcement agency in the US and a shadowy organization that wants him dead.

items.title: I Am Another You
items.description: Award-winning Chinese filmmaker Nanfu Wang follows a young drifter named Dylan on a journey that takes her across America, exploring the meaning of freedom.

items.title: It's Not Yet Dark
items.description: Narrated by Colin Farrell, this film follows Simon Fitzmaurice, a talented filmmaker with ALS, as he embarks on directing his first feature film through the use of eye gaze technology.

items.title: Magnus
items.description: This unique coming-of-age story follows Magnus Carlsen, a Norwegian chess prodigy who became a grandmaster at age 13 and world champion in 2013.

items.title: Reset
items.description: "Reset" depicts renowned choreographer and dancer Benjamin Millepied ("Black Swan") as he attempts to rejuvenate the Paris Opera Ballet in his new position as director. Subtitled.

items.title: Blitz (Broadcast Edit)
items.description: A tough cop (Jason Statham, “Fast & Furious 7”) is dispatched to take down a serial killer who is targeting police officers. With Paddy Considine, Aiden Gillen, Mark Rylance, Luke Evans.

items.title: A Cat and Mouse Game
items.description: Marcel the cat watches and attempts to capture Cheeky, the mischievous mouse who constantly eludes him. This game of chase takes us past a variety of farm animals and wildlife as we discover that, in the end, a cat and mouse can become friends.

items.title: Hackers for Freedom
items.description: A fascinating investigation to meet activists and industrials who struggle to defend the free code, not only in the computer business, but every industry such as automobiles or agriculture.

items.title: Sad People Factory
items.description: A worldwide investigation into the nature and epidemic scope of depression, shown from a societal view that challenges the individual notion of depression. Explore original points of view from: sociologists, philosophers, and neuropsychiatrists.

items.title: Stolen
items.description: A former thief frantically searches for his missing daughter, who has been kidnapped and locked in the trunk of a taxi. Starring Nicolas Cage and Malin Akerman.

items.title: Straight A's
items.description: Compelled by his mother’s ghost, a former addict (Ryan Phillippe, “Crash”) returns home to face his first love (Anna Paquin, “The Piano”), who happens to be his brother’s wife.

items.title: The Departure
items.description: Ittetsu Nemoto, a former punk-turned-Buddhist priest in Japan, has made a career out of helping suicidal people find reasons to live. But this work has come increasingly at the cost. Subtitled.

items.title: The Sum of All Fears
items.description: East-West tensions erupt when the CIA suspects that renegade Russian scientists are developing more nuclear weapons.

items.title: Gunfight At The O.K. Corral
items.description: Frontier lawman Wyatt Earp joins his three brothers in their feud against the villainous Clanton gang, a local clan of cattle thieves in Tombstone, Arizona.

items.title: El Dorado
items.description: Robert Mitchum plays to perfection an alcoholic but gutsy sheriff who relentlessly battles the dark side of the wild West, ruthless cattle barons and crooked “businessmen.”

items.title: Rules of Engagement
items.description: Colonel Terry Childers is a patriot and war hero. But when a peacekeeping mission he leads in Yemen goes terribly wrong, he finds himself facing a court-martial.

items.title: The Odd Couple
items.description: Two divorced men decide to share a New York apartment. Fussy Felix, fastidious to a fault. He proves that cleanliness is next to insanity. And Oscar, who wreaks havoc on a tidy room with the speed and thoroughness of a tornado.

items.title: The Dog Doc
items.description: A pioneer of integrative medicine, veterinarian Dr. Marty Goldstein attracts four-legged patients from around the world, providing holistic treatments for animals after other vets have given up hope.

items.title: The Poughkeepsie Tapes
items.description: When hundreds of videotapes showing torture, murder, and dismemberment are found in an abandoned house, they reveal a serial killer's decade-long reign of terror and become the most disturbing collection of evidence homicide detectives have ever seen.

items.title: The Trip (1967)
items.description: A TV-commercial director decides to turn to LSD, and experiences visions of sex, death, dancing girls, and a torture chamber.

items.title: Blue State
items.description: In this delightful romantic comedy, when his candidate loses the U.S. presidential election, a fervent liberal (Breckin Meyer) makes good on his promise to move to Canada and meets a sexy and mysterious young woman (Anna Paquin) along the way.

items.title: Best Men
items.description: Drew Barrymore, Luke Wilson and Sean Patrick Flannery star in this hilarious action-comedy wherein Drew Barrymore is a young woman determined to have the perfect wedding day, despite the fact that the groomsmen have decided to rob the local bank.

items.title: Article 99
items.description: "Article 99" is a fictitious hospital regulation at a Veterans' Administration hospital that promises full medical benefits...but, in fact, does not. A spunky surgeon and his compatriots try to thwart the bureaucracy.

items.title: Vanilla Sky
items.description: Young and wealthy, David can have anything his heart desires. But his life seems incomplete. One night, David meets the woman of his dreams and believes he may have found the missing piece.

items.title: A Midnight Clear
items.description: As the end of World War II approaches, a group of American soldiers is assigned to watch activity amidst the stark snow-covered landscape of the French-German border and soon discover a battle-weary enemy as reluctant to fight as they are.

items.title: The Devil's Rain
items.description: A satanist cult leader is burnt alive by the local church. He vows to come back to hunt down and enslave every descendant of his congregation, by the power of the book of blood contracts, in which they sold their souls to the devil.

items.title: The Beast Must Die
items.description: Eight people have been invited to an island estate for the weekend. One of them is a werewolf. Can you guess which one?

items.title: Asylum
items.description: In order to secure a job at a mental institution, a young psychiatrist must interview four patients inside the asylum.

items.title: And Now The Screaming Starts!
items.description: England, 1795: the young Catherine has just married Charles Fengriffen and moves into his castle. She becomes the victim of an old curse that lays on the family. On her wedding night, she is raped by a ghost and gets pregnant.

items.title: War on Witches
items.description: Discover how a single publication sparked a viral outbreak of witch-hunting, initially in Britain, and later spread across the world. Notably, it fueled the Salem witch trials which terrorized parts of the US a hundred years later.

items.title: Into the Blue 2: The Reef
items.description: Scuba professional Sebastian (Chris Carmack) and his aspiring treasure hunter girlfriend (Laura Vandervoort) are hired by a jet- setting European couple (David Anders and Marsha Thomason) to retrieve the sunken treasure.

items.title: Amongst Friends
items.description: A compelling study of youth-led astray. Andy, Billy, and Trevor are the picture of privilege, real Five Towns innocents wanting for nothing. But the professional lives of their parents do nothing for their dreams.

items.title: The Road To Wellville
items.description: Filled with outrageous methodology and hilarious hijinks, this "sumptuously photographed turn-of-the century comedy with a fine cast" (San Francisco Chronicle) will make you double over ... with laughter!

items.title: Boot Camp
items.description: In this white-knuckle thriller, "troubled" teens, including Sophie Bauer (Mila Kunis), are abducted and brought to Camp Serenity rehab where they finds themselves subjected to psychological torture at the hands of camp's deranged administrators.

items.title: Relative Strangers
items.description: On a mission to locate his birth parents, a tightly wound professional (Ron Livingston, "The Conjuring") is befuddled to find that his biological parents aren't exactly upper-class.

items.title: Comeback Season
items.description: Ray Liotta ("Goodfellas") stars as Walter Pearce, a married man trying to win back his wife after cheating on her. Soon after, Pearce enlists the local high school football star to help.

items.title: Christmas Story
items.description: In this touching family film, we see how an orphaned young boy became the iconic Santa Claus. Subtitled.

items.title: Black Sunday
items.description: Black Sunday is the powerful story of a Black September terrorist group attempting to blow up a Goodyear blimp hovering over the Super Bowl stadium with 80,000 people and the President of the United States in attendance.

items.title: Double Jeopardy
items.description: Libby Parsons discovers that the husband she’s convicted of murdering staged his own “death” and framed her for the crime. Released on parole, she skips town to find him–and that puts parole officer Travis Lehman on her trail.

items.title: RiffTrax: Kiss of the Tarantula
items.description: RiffTrax, the guys who make movies funny, bring their comedic riffing treatment to this twisted classic horror movie where a beautiful spider-loving mortician's daughter unleashes tarantula-filled revenge on all who wrong her! This feature is a parody.

items.title: RiffTrax: Retro Puppet Master
items.description: Fear not! No prior knowledge of the Puppet Master series is required. No, not even Puppet Master vs. Demonic Toys. Join Mike, Kevin, Chris R, and Bill for Retro Puppet Master.

items.title: The Good Neighbor
items.description: A pair of mischievous high school kids create the illusion of a haunting on an unsuspecting elderly neighbor while keeping his every reaction under surveillance. A series of coincidences leads to tragedy.

items.title: Katie Says Goodbye
items.description: A kindhearted seventeen-year-old in the American Southwest turns to prostitution to fulfill her dream of a new life in San Francisco.

items.title: Isabelle
items.description: After moving into the perfect New England neighborhood, an all-American couple's dream of starting a family shatters as they descend into the depths of paranoia and must survive a specter that wants nothing more than their own lives.

items.title: Happy Hunting
items.description: An alcoholic drifter must battle withdrawal and psychotic rednecks after he becomes the target of a deranged sporting event.

items.title: Cristiano Ronaldo: The World At His Feet
items.description: Ronaldo makes headlines wherever he goes. From winning his second Ballon d’or to heading a fashion line, he has the world at his feet. An intimate, behind-the-scenes look at the icon that will appeal to both ardent fans and football newbies!

items.title: Inseminoid
items.description: A crew of interplanetary archaeologists begins to be murdered one by one.

items.title: Seal Team VI
items.description: Inspired by actual events: This heroic saga depicts an elite counter-terrorism team's black ops incursion into Iraq four days prior to Operation: Desert Shield and the harrowing consequences its members faced when their covert mission was compromised.

items.title: Sharks
items.description: Exceptional imagery depicts these amazing sea dwellers in a new and different way, as they've been around long before dinosaurs. The white shark, the hammerhead shark, or the whale shark can all be seen at a first-hand experience.

items.title: Shirin In Love
items.description: Shirin's engagement to a successful Iranian plastic surgeon is threatened by the appearance of a mysterious young man who lives in a lighthouse. She finds herself breaking loyalty and tradition when she falls in love with the man.

items.title: RiffTrax: The Magic Sword
items.description: RiffTrax, the guys who make movies funny, bring their comedic riffing treatment to this cheesy 60's fantasy classic! Spells will be cast! Heroes will be born! Bones will be siezed!

items.title: RiffTrax: The Incredible Two Headed Transplant
items.description: Come for the mutant in overalls, stay for the wife in a cage, it’s all here in The Incredible 2-Headed Transplant! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from RiffTrax.

items.title: RiffTrax: Manos the Hands of Fate (SV)
items.description: Many years ago the people of El Paso, Texas gave their money to a local fertilizer salesman and said, “Go make us the best horror movie you can make.” The result is an object lesson in why you should never give your money to an El Paso fertilizer salesman

items.title: RiffTrax: Icebreaker
items.description: RiffTrax, the guys who make movies funny, bring their comedic riffing treatment to this cheesy action classic! It's Die Hard on Skis starring the legendary Bruce Campbell!

items.title: RiffTrax: Death Promise
items.description: RiffTrax, the guys who make movies funny, bring their comedic riffing treatment to this cheesy 70's karate classic! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin, and Bill from RiffTrax.

items.title: RiffTrax: Catwomen of the Moon
items.description: MST3K stars Bridget Nelson and Mary Jo Pehl, under the RiffTrax Presents banner, bring their comedic riffing treatment to this cheesy 1950's space adventure classic! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary

items.title: RiffTrax: Astro Zombies
items.description: Reuniting Tom “The Kid” Pace with his Girl in Gold Boots director Ted V. Mikels, Astro-Zombies are neither zombies nor the dog from The Jetsons. The film also stars John Carradine, who aged approximately 92 years in the 28 years.

items.title: RiffTrax Live: MST3K Reunion
items.description: Mike, Kevin and Bill were joined on stage by their MST3K colleagues at the State Theatre in Minneapolis to bring it back to their roots in an MST3K cast reunion the likes of which have never been seen before!

items.title: RiffTrax: The Hideous Sun Demon
items.description: RiffTrax, the guys who make movies funny, bring their comedic riffing treatment to this cheesy 50's sci-fi classic! It's a tale of a man who transforms into a violent lizard creature whenever he is in the sun too long!

items.title: RiffTrax: Radical Jack
items.description: RiffTrax, the guys who make movies funny, bring their comedic riffing treatment to this cheesy Road House ripoff from the year 2000! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin, and Bill.

items.title: RiffTrax: Ruby
items.description: RiffTrax, the guys who make movies funny, bring their comedic riffing treatment to this cheesy 70's horror classic where a series of brutal supernatural murders at Ruby's drive-in are keeping everyone on edge! This feature is a parody.

items.title: RiffTrax: The Last Shark
items.description: RiffTrax, the guys who make movies funny, bring their comedic riffing treatment to this cheesy 80's horror classic! Thrill as you watch some Italian filmmakers rip off Jaws!

items.title: RiffTrax: Hillbillys in a Haunted House
items.description: RiffTrax, the guys who make movies funny, bring their comedic riffing treatment to this cheesy 60's non-scary horror classic! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill.

items.title: RiffTrax: Kill and Kill Again
items.description: It’s your standard South African martial arts extravaganza based around root vegetable gasoline. You’re gonna love it, and love it again, with Mike, Kevin and Bill! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie.

items.title: RiffTrax: Mind Ripper
items.description: In a remote bunker in the desert, unthinkable experiments are taking place. Experiments where horror legend Wes Craven sells his name and credibility to a movie in exchange for a writing credit for his son Jonathan! This feature is a parody.

items.title: RiffTrax: Birdemic
items.description: Birdemic: Shock and Terror is what you’d get if the Ice Cream Bunny starred in The Happening as directed by Tommy Wiseau. Mike, Kevin and Bill invite you to join them for this must-see RiffTrax. This feature is a parody.

items.title: RiffTrax Short: Damaged Goods
items.description: RiffTrax, the guys who make movies funny, bring their comedic riffing treatment to this short that is a cautionary tale about a couple of young men who go on a harmless adventure in search of beer and girls and end up finding exactly that!

items.title: RiffTrax Short: Are You Popular
items.description: The short Are You Popular? will help you solve the question once and finally: the question, "Are you popular?" There are no easy answers, friends (that is, the answer is "no", of course, which is not always easy to hear) but Mike, Kevin and Bill are…

items.title: RiffTrax Short: A Case of Spring Fever
items.description: The stars of MST3K bring their comedic riffing treatment to this short about the importance of springs. Join Mike, Kevin, Bill and Coily for A Case Of Spring Fever!

items.title: Touch
items.description: Juvenal, whose touch can heal, is not what people expect a saint to be like, and when stories of his powers start to leak out, he finds himself keeping company with con men, fanatics, and hustlers of every persuasion in this sharply funny satire.

items.title: Storefront Hitchcock
items.description: Filmmaker Jonathan Demme showcases the music of British singer-songwriter Robyn Hitchcock in a New York storefront setting with a live audience.

items.title: Sheba, Baby
items.description: Pam Grier ("Foxy Brown") plays Sheba Shayne, a private eye based in Chicago who is called back to her Louisville, Kentucky, hometown to stop the local mob boss (D’Urville Martin, "Black Caesar") from moving in on her father’s loan business.

items.title: Mr. Majestyk
items.description: Charles Bronson stars as an ex-con and Vietnam vet whose efforts to run a straight business soon have him locking horns with both the law and the mafia in this explosive tale of backwoods revenge.

items.title: Friday Foster
items.description: No sooner has photojournalist Friday Foster (Pam Grier) been warned that her personal involvement in stories will not end happily, than she witnesses the attempted assassination of a prominent African-American figure. Now Friday is a target!

items.title: Bloody Mama
items.description: Ma Barker (Shelley Winters) and her sons (including Don Stroud and Robert De Niro) leave the poverty of the Ozarks for a life of violence. Bruce Dern co-stars as a homicidal maniac who joins Ma Barker's gang as they take on the Great Depression.

items.title: 1 Billion Orgasms
items.description: A middle-aged engineer decides to prove his worth by inventing a device he dreams will make him responsible for one billion orgasms.

items.title: The Call Up
items.description: A group of online gamers are invited to try a state-of-the-art virtual reality video game but things take a turn for the sinister when these masters of the shoot 'em up discover they will literally be fighting for their lives.

items.title: The Reef 2
items.description: Trained in the skills of sea power, Pi the fish can fight a shark, sink a squid, or batter any random predator that ever threatens his friends and neighbors on the reef. Unfortunately, being the only hero in town can take its toll.

items.title: Trumbo (2007)
items.description: Trumbo documents the rise of Dalton Trumbo's career in Hollywood, and his subsequent public humiliation from being among the "Hollywood Ten" blacklisted by the House Un-American Activities Committee in the 1940s for communist associations.

items.title: Thirst Street
items.description: Gina, an American flight attendant, falls in with a Parisian bartender on a layover only to find herself tangled in a web of deception, delusion, and unrequited amour fou.

items.title: The Double Hour
items.description: A chambermaid and an ex-cop meet at a speed dating event and a romance develops. But during a romantic getaway things suddenly take a dark turn.

items.title: Shark Bait
items.description: One fish must find his destiny to save his home and the love of his life from a bullying shark.

items.title: Reserved to Fight
items.description: Living among loved ones who don't yet understand how they have changed and suffering from a psychological disorder that is difficult to acknowledge, these young veterans grapple to find purpose and healing.

items.title: Rage and Glory
items.description: An avowed anarchist and Stern Gang hitman is sent to Jerusalem to assassinate a senior British officer creating much tension within the already troubled cell and almost brings its collapse, as the British operatives are closing in.

items.title: No Greater Love
items.description: No Greater Love explores a combat deployment through the eyes of an Army chaplain, as he and his men fight their way through a hellish tour in one of the most dangerous places in Afghanistan and then as they struggle to reintegrate home.

items.title: National Lampoon's Repli-kate
items.description: A scientist and his sidekick accidentally clone a journalist and decide to turn the mistake into Repli-Kate, their idea of the perfect woman, who loves, beer, football, and frat parties.

items.title: Legend of Halloween Jack
items.description: On Halloween night, a serial killer returns from the dead to take revenge on the vigilantes who put him to death one year earlier.

items.title: Desert Blue
items.description: An academic obsessed with "roadside attractions" and his tv-star daughter finally discover the world's largest ice cream cone, the centerpiece for an old gold-rush town struggling to stay on the map.

items.title: Big Legend
items.description: Following the trail of his missing fiance, one man finds more than he bargained for when teaming up with a local hunter who has his eyes set on the ultimate prize: finding Bigfoot.

items.title: 30 Nights of Paranormal Activity...
items.description: After a stint in a psychiatric hospital, a young woman returns to the house where her father killed the entire cast of The Artist during his exorcism.

items.title: 40 Days and 40 Nights
items.description: After a brutal break-up, a young man vows to stay celibate during the forty days of Lent, but finds the girl of his dreams and is unable to do anything about it.

items.title: Ella Enchanted
items.description: Oscar-winner Anne Hathaway stars in an unforgettable, modern fairy tale in which a girl's given the gift of obedience by her Fairy Godmother. An amazing, magical adventure bursting with colorful characters, music, wit, and whimsy.

items.title: Happy Go Lucky
items.description: A look at a few chapters in the life of Poppy, a cheery, colorful, North London schoolteacher whose optimism tends to exasperate those around her.

items.title: Iris
items.description: True story of the lifelong romance between novelist Iris Murdoch and her husband John Bayley, from their student days through her battle with Alzheimer's disease.

items.title: The Return Of A Man Called Horse
items.description: Richard Harris stars in this superior sequel which follows the plight of a horribly wronged tribe of Sioux Indians and the white man who would join in their revenge.

items.title: The Secret Life of Walter Mitty
items.description: A clumsy daydreamer gets caught up in a sinister conspiracy.

items.title: The Pride of the Yankees
items.description: The story of the life and career of famed baseball player Lou Gehrig.

items.title: The Bishop's Wife
items.description: An angel in human form enters the life of a bishop in order to help him build a new cathedral and repair his fractured marriage.

items.title: Stella Dallas
items.description: A working-class woman is willing to do whatever it takes to give her daughter a socially promising future.

items.title: Mad to be Normal
items.description: During the 1960s, a renegade Scottish psychiatrist courts controversy within his profession for his approach to the field, and for the unique community he creates for his patients to inhabit.

items.title: Hans Christian Andersen
items.description: The opening scene of the movie describes it best: "Once upon a time there lived in Denmark a great storyteller named Hans Christian Andersen. This is not the story of his life, but a fairy tale about the great spinner of fairy tales."

items.title: Black Cop
items.description: A black police officer is pushed to the edge, taking out his frustrations on the privileged community he's sworn to protect.

items.title: The Music of Silence
items.description: Born with a serious eye condition that eventually leads to his blindness, Bocelli nevertheless rises above the challenges, driven by great ambitions towards his passion. The silent pursuit of his daily mission continues.

items.title: The Miracle Maker
items.description: The story of Jesus Christ.

items.title: The Best Years of Our Lives
items.description: Three World War II veterans return home to small-town America to discover that they and their families have been irreparably changed.

items.title: Sweet Country
items.description: Australian western set on the Northern Territory frontier in the 1920s, where justice itself is put on trial when an aged Aboriginal farmhand shoots a white man in self-defense and goes on the run as a posse gathers to hunt him down.

items.title: Not the Messiah: He's a Very Naughty Boy
items.description: A comic oratorio inspired by Monty Python's Life of Brian (1979) filmed at its only European performance at the Royal Albert Hall in October 2009 to celebrate forty years of Monty Python.

items.title: Night Comes On
items.description: Angel LaMere is released from juvenile detention on the eve of her 18th birthday. Haunted by her past, she embarks on a journey with her 10 year-old sister that could destroy their future.

items.title: Nancy
items.description: Nancy becomes increasingly convinced she was kidnapped as a child. When she meets a couple whose daughter went missing thirty years ago, reasonable doubts give way to willful belief.

items.title: Love Stinks
items.description: Seth Winnick has it all: a successful career in television, good friends, and a passionate relationship with beautiful Chelsea. However, when he fails to make a timely marriage proposal, Chelsea tries to make his life hell.

items.title: Itzhak
items.description: A look at the life, work, and religious heritage of violinist Itzhak Perlman.

items.title: Head Count
items.description: A group of college students on a weekend getaway accidentally summon a supernatural entity intent on using them for its deadly ritual.

items.title: The Stranger Beside Me
items.description: While working at a women's clinic, aspiring crime writer Ann Rule (Barbara Hershey, "Black Swan") unwittingly becomes friends with serial killer Ted Bundy (Billy Campbell, "The Killing").

items.title: Mother Teresa: In the Name of God's Poor
items.description: Geraldine Chaplin ("Doctor Zhivago") delivers a moving performance as Mother Teresa, from her early years as a caregiver in war-torn Calcutta to her fame as a celebrated humanitarian.

items.title: In His Father's Shoes
items.description: When Clay puts on a pair of his late father's shoes, he is magically transported back in time to his dad's early life. Will visiting the past help his present grief or disrupt his future?

items.title: Glitch
items.description: Three geeks invent a cellphone chip that will allow users to telepathically access other people's minds. When they try them out on themselves, the prototypes reveal a very dangerous side effect.

items.title: Crash and Burn
items.description: Michael Madsen ("Reservoir Dogs") stars as a car thief, known as a chopper, in this raw, authentic and fast-paced thriller that brakes for no one.

items.title: Ascension
items.description: A troubled teenage girl’s life begins to unravel as she discovers the dark power that drove her mother to suicide has infected her older sister, driving her to do horrible and terrifying things.

items.title: The Last Descent
items.description: A caver begins exploring an unmapped section of Nutty Putty Cave and becomes stuck 150 feet underground.

items.title: The King of Masks
items.description: Wang Bianlian, known as the King of Mask, is an aging street performer and a master of the rare Sichuan Change Art. When his protégé reveals a desperate secret, Wang must choose between tradition and the fatherly love he feels for his heir.

items.title: The Fighting Preacher
items.description: When Willard and Rebecca Bean are called on a mission to a town that's hostile towards them, they must choose whether to fight for their right to live there or love their hostile neighbors.

items.title: Submergence
items.description: Clinging to life in a cell in Africa, James is brutally interrogated by jihadis. Worlds away, Danielle prepares to descend into the Arctic Sea. Facing life-or-death ordeals, they must rely on their deep emotional connection.

items.title: So Undercover
items.description: A tough, street-smart private eye is hired by the FBI to go undercover in a college sorority.

items.title: Saturday Church
items.description: A 14 year-old-boy, struggling with gender identity and religion, begins to use fantasy to escape his life in the inner city and find his passion in the process.

items.title: Out of Liberty
items.description: n the winter of 1839, a jailer in Liberty, Missouri, has to watch over the most dangerous men in the state while they await trial. He faces two dangers: the one that comes from the prisoners and the one that lurks behind the walls of the prison.

items.title: Jack and Jill vs. The World
items.description: Jack is a slick N.Y.C. advertising executive. Jill is a hopeless romantic with a fiery personality. Opposites attract, and together they author their own manifesto of "rules to live by.” But Jill betrays Jack by violating rule one - Be Honest.

items.title: Henri Dauman: Looking Up
items.description: Henri Dauman spent his career photographing the likes of Marylin Monroe, Elvis Presley, & JFK. But few know his remarkable origin story rebuilding his life after being orphaned in WWII to become one of the greatest photojournalists of the 20th century.

items.title: Allure
items.description: A house cleaner meets a teenaged girl and convinces her to run away and live with her in secret.

items.title: 5B
items.description: Documentary about the staff and patients of San Francisco General Hospital's AIDS ward during the early years of the epidemic.

items.title: Sticky: A (Self) Love Story
items.description: Delve deep into this candid portrayal of masturbation and our cultural relationship with this activity we all take part in, but don't discuss. Interviews with sexologists, authors, religious figures, and porn stars.

items.title: The Hybrids Family
items.description: Two teenage siblings have a secret—they’re the world’s first vampire/witch hybrids! Their supernatural parents have kept them hidden away for years, but when they move to Florida to start a new normal life, a family-filled adventure ensues.

items.title: The Last Rescue
items.description: When stranded American soldiers take a high-ranking German officer as their prisoner during WWII, an elaborate, tense and adrenaline-fueled escape ensues. An action-packed thriller that will keep audiences on the edge of their seats.

items.title: The Man Who Saved Ben Hur
items.description: Johnny Alarimo spent a dazzling career as an assistant director on films such as Ben-Hur during Hollywood's Golden Age.He shares private phtographs and intimate stories about legends Rock Hudson, Elizabeth Taylor, Sandra Dee and more.

items.title: The Quiet Hour
items.description: In post-apocalyptic Earth, a feisty teenage girl must defend her blind brother and their home from the alien invaders who now occupy the world as well as the rogue cannibal survivors who try to attack them.

items.title: UFO Conclusion
items.description: What is the alien agenda? And why has the government gone to such great lengths to stifle the overwhelming evidence that otherworldly creatures exist? Some of our greatest minds unveil the truth behind this massive cover-up.

items.title: Valentina
items.description: Valentina and her friends are fun-loving, teenage girls. They shop, they have sleepovers and they dream about their first true love. When they decide to throw a spring bonfire party, they never expected it would turn into such an adventure!

items.title: When the World Breaks
items.description: "When the World Breaks" is a film about creativity and survival during the Great Depression of the 1930s, with striking parallels to today. Depression-era life and art come alive with rare film clips and personal stories from survivors.

items.title: Wonderful World
items.description: The Earth is home to over 2 million plants and animals with great biodiversity. The result of evolution over billions of years is a beautiful composition of changing landscapes: mountains, deep forests, vast oceans, and arctic ice fields.

items.title: The Adventures of Mark Twain
items.description: Based on elements from the stories of Mark Twain, this feature-length Claymation fantasy follows the adventures of Tom Sawyer, Becky Thatcher, and Huck Finn as they stowaway aboard the interplanetary balloon of Mark Twain.

items.title: Union Bound
items.description: Sargent Hoover went to war to preserve the Union. After being captured and sent to a prisoner of war camp, he understood what it was to be kept against his will. Together with a friend he escaped and aided by slaves made it to freedom.

items.title: Take
items.description: The lives of two strangers - a struggling mother and a gambling addict - who meet in tragedy. Years pass and they must come to terms with themselves and one another.

items.title: Along Came a Spider
items.description: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

items.title: Beowulf
items.description: After Beowulf, the mightiest warrior of all, destroyes the overpowering demon Grendel, he incurs wrath of the beast's mother to seek out revenge.

items.title: Houseboat
items.description: This Oscar®-nominated film has the legendary Cary Grant as a government attorney who can't seem to shake his bad fortune. Living on a houseboat, widowed and left with three unruly kids, he hires Sophia Loren as a governess.

items.title: Major League
items.description: The new owner of the Cleveland Indians threatens to move the team unless the team delivers immediate results. She then fills the roster with has-beens to guarantee their failure. But the team miraculously rallies and starts winning.

items.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
items.description: It’s the 23rd century, and an alien power is evaporating the oceans. To save mankind, Kirk and his crew must time-travel back to 1986, where they find a world of punk, pizza, and exact-change buses that are as alien as anything they’ve ever encountered.

items.title: Sobibor
items.description: Soviet officer Alexander Pechersky organizes a revolt and mass escape of prisoners from the Sobibór extermination camp in October 1943.

items.title: Guys and Dolls
items.description: In New York, a gambler is challenged to take a cold female missionary to Havana, but they fall for each other, and the bet has a hidden motive to finance a crap game.

items.title: Spirit Riders
items.description: Kacie witnesses the death of her younger brother, and she gets arrested and sentenced to a work-release program at Spirit Riders. Kacie finds Blaze, a horse, and learns how to let go of the past, forgive herself, and set her spirit free.

items.title: Yellow Day
items.description: The Yellow Day at Camp Grace celebrates miracles, faith, and community—but for one young man, it’s the chance to locate the elusive girl he’s fallen for. With the help of a friendly little girl, he learns wonderful stories about the camp.

items.title: El mega tiburón contra Kolossus
items.description: La aparición de un nuevo Mega Shark amenaza la tierra. Rusia vuelve a despertar accidentalmente al Kolossus, un gigantesco dispositivo construido durante la Guerra Fría. Ahora el mundo debe detener a las dos criaturas antes de que destruyan el planeta.

items.title: El mega tiburón contra el  mecha tiburón
items.description: Cuando un nuevo Mega Shark amenaza a la humanidad, el gobierno desata al Mecha Shark para derrotar al monstruo en una batalla campal que amenaza al planeta entero.

items.title: Man On Wire
items.description: On August 7, 1974, a young Frenchman named Philippe Petit stepped out on a wire illegally rigged between the World Trade Center's twin towers in New York.

items.title: Lemon
items.description: Lemon: a person or thing that proves to be defective, imperfect, or unsatisfactory. Isaac Lachmann is a lemon. His career is going nowhere. His girlfriend of ten years is leaving him. Isaac Lachmann now just watches as his life unravels.

items.title: Let The Right One In
items.description: Lonely, 12-year-old Oskar is bullied by his classmates. A new friendship develops when Eli, a pale young girl who only comes out at night, moves in next door. Coinciding with her arrival is a series of inexplicable disappearances and murders.

items.title: Harry Benson: Shoot First
items.description: The illustrious career of the renowned photographer who has taken some of the most vibrant and intimate portraits of The Beatles, Muhammad Ali, Michael Jackson, Dr. Martin Luther King Jr., Winston Churchill and many more.

items.title: Gridlocked
items.description: Former SWAT leader David Hendrix is forced to babysit Brody Walker, a celebrity on probation. When a police training facility comes under attack by a team of ruthless mercenaries, Hendrix and Walker must band together to fight back and stay alive.

items.title: Experimenter
items.description: Stanley Milgram (Peter Sarsgaard) conducts an experiment in which people think they’re delivering electric shocks to strangers. Ignoring pleas for mercy, most subjects don't stop because they’ve been told to go on. With Winona Ryder and Jim Gaffigan.

items.title: Best Of Enemies
items.description: In 1968 William F. Buckley Jr. a leading light of the new conservative and Gore Vidal a Democrat, leftist novelist and polemicist come armed with deep-seated distrust and enmity as they pummeled out policy and personal insult live on ABC.

items.title: The Christmas Candle
items.description: A pastor who's suffered a personal loss accepts a position in a town that believes in a Christmas miracle candle, which he strives to abolish.

items.title: Eye of the Beholder
items.description: A private eye shadows a female serial killer of men all over the U.S. without her knowing as he, strangely enough, occasionally acts as her guardian angel.

items.title: Drowning Mona
items.description: When a woman drives a car into the river to her death, everyone in town becomes a suspect.

items.title: Beautiful
items.description: Mona sacrifices everything, including family, in pursuit of a beauty pageant victory. Her friend Ruby helps her to an amazing degree.

items.title: Bats
items.description: Genetically mutated bats escape, and it's up to a bat expert and the local sheriff to stop them.

items.title: Blame (ESP)
items.description: La relación tabú de un profesor de teatro de secundaria con una estudiante marginada provoca la ira de una compañera de clase celosa. La situación refleja la obra "Las Brujas de Salem"

items.title: Across The Ice
items.description: Polar explorers Sebastian Copeland and Eric McNair Landry set a Guinness world record kite skiing the 2300 km length of Greenland's south-north axis, braving storms, exhaustion, and complete isolation.

items.title: Glastonbury: The Movie In Flashback
items.description: A no-holds-barred trip through the music, magic and midsummer madness of the legendary Glastonbury Festival. Featuring The Orb, Spiritualized, The Verve, Lemonheads, Porno for Pyros and more! A must-see for all festival fans.

items.title: Hamilton: One Shot To Broadway
items.description: The story of the hit musical that changed Broadway forever and brought the genius of Lin Manuel Miranda to the attention of legions of fans across the world. Featuring interviews with Miranda, as well as the cast and crew of Hamilton.

items.title: Hollows Grove
items.description: A TV crew of ghost-hunting pranksters set up scares in abandoned houses and claim they are caused by real specters. The prank turns horrifyingly real when a routine investigation escalates into a nightmare that they can't escape.

items.title: Hope Dances
items.description: A multi-talented young girl has a chance to win the lead role in the Nutcracker Ballet, and must choose between pursuing her mother’s dream of her becoming a prima ballerina and her father’s aspirations of making her a sports champion.

items.title: I Think My Babysitter is an Alien
items.description: When a world-famous astronaut returns home from his latest mission, he brings a souvenir to his family: a piece of an asteroid. But soon, strange things start to happen and nine-year-old Katie becomes convinced that aliens have moved in.

items.title: Inside the Fifty Shades
items.description: An exploration of the dominance and submission lifestyle as revealed in the best-selling book trilogy “Fifty Shades of Grey.” In this film, real women and men reveal their experiences, wants and desires as dominant and submissive participants.

items.title: Lady You Shot Me
items.description: Uncover the mystery surrounding the death of Sam Cooke, an influential African American at the height of his career as a musician and producer, shot dead in a seedy motel, as linked to greed and corruption within the music industry.

items.title: Machine Gun Preacher (2014)
items.description: Real life "Machine Gun Preacher", Sam Childers overcame a life of drugs and violence to become a symbol of hope for the children of Africa. Explore the life of this missionary who preaches justice with compassion and an iron fist.

items.title: Madagascar
items.description: Experience Madagascar, home to unique Fauna and Flora with a high percentage of endemic species and due to the lack of predators extraordinary animal species like the funny lemurs were able to develop in a unique way.

items.title: Range 15
items.description: A group of veterans find that the zombie apocalypse has spread across the United States. Together, they must fight their way across the country and find a cure for the outbreak and restore freedom before it's too late.

items.title: Reclaiming the Blade
items.description: Medieval and Renaissance blades are a profound and beautiful objects handcrafted by master artisans. The truth of the sword has been shrouded in antiquity, and the Renaissance martial arts that brought it to being are long forgotten.

items.title: Red Sea
items.description: Explore the impressive underwater landscapes and fascinating species of one of the biggest wonders on our planet. Filmed in stunning 4K, this nautical journey features many of the sea creatures that have made the coral reefs their home.

items.title: Rise Of The Superheroes
items.description: This is the story of how comic book superheroes were brought to life in cinema, from Tim Burton’s Batman films to The Avengers, Black Panther and beyond, and how they first took over Hollywood and then conquered the world.

items.title: Ronaldo VS Messi: Face Off!
items.description: Experts compare football stars Cristiano Ronaldo and Lionel Messi - their upbringing, progression into the world of sports, skills, talent, influence and marketability on and off the field. Hear it all to decide which player is the best!

items.title: Hitler's Women
items.description: Women have been among the strongest pillars of Hitlerism from its very inception. If some historians underline the complicity between women and the government, others present them as victims of propaganda and Nazi Population Policy.

items.title: Hunting Down The Nazis
items.description: Simon Wiesenthal, a survivor of the death camps, is hunting down his torturers, from the camp Kapos to Mengele, the mad doctor of Auschwitz.

items.title: Lost Army of King Cambyses
items.description: While escaping the Egyptians 2,500 years ago, the Persian King Cambyses led his army into the desert and disappeared forever. Despite efforts in the 1930s to discover what happened to him, no clues were found until 1996.

items.title: Medal Of Honor: The History
items.description: Narrated by Gary Sinise, this documentary showcases the medal itself and how it rose from a decoration no one wanted, to become the nation's highest honor.

items.title: Project 949
