items.description: The mysterious sinking, the causes, and the salvage operations are revealed of the K-141, Kursk. The Kursk was a Project 949A submarine of the Oscar-class. During the Cold War, The Soviet Navy had to face the challenge of NATO's powerful maritime fleets.

items.title: Story of the Lancaster Bomber
items.description: Reliable, versatile, and readily available, the Avro Lancaster's arrival in 1942 made way for a new calibre of the four-engined bomber that would become Bomber Command's primary weapon during WWII.

items.title: The Boer War: 1899-1902
items.description: Journey back in time to a different age, when the sun never set on the British Empire and her armies were great. The Boer War was a turning point in British military history, revolutionizing tactics, battlefield strategy, equipment, and training.

items.title: Vuelo mortal
items.description: Cuando un avión comercial queda atrapado dentro de un anillo de volcanes en erupción, los pasajeros y la tripulación deberán encontrar una forma de sobrevivir sin aterrizar.

items.title: Transpecos
items.description: For three Border Patrol agents working a remote desert checkpoint, the contents of one car will reveal an insidious plot within their own ranks. The next 24 hours will take them on a treacherous journey that could cost them their lives.

items.title: Lake Effects
items.description: After the loss of their father, two estranged sisters reunite with their mother at their enchanting family lake house and find that the secret to overcoming tragedy and rebuilding hope lies in their ability to look deeper at themselves.

items.title: Robot Jox
items.description: This thrilling sci-fi adventure will satisfy your burning desire for robot-on-robot action when the world's disputes are settled using massive battling 'bots! But when tragedy and treachery rear their ugly heads, one 'bot pilot is out for revenge!

items.title: Pathology
items.description: A pathology student (Milo Ventimiglia) finds himself seduced into a dangerous game of deceit and murder with a group of fellow interns. But as the danger becomes far too real, he must stay one step ahead of the game before he is the next victim!

items.title: China Moon
items.description: In this moody film noir, a small-town Florida detective's romance with a wealthy widow spins a web of deceit, betrayal and murder. His official investigation of the crime backfires as the trial begins to point to him.

items.title: American Ninja 2: The Confrontation
items.description: On a remote Caribbean island, Army Ranger Joe Armstrong saves an old friend from the clutches of "The Lion," an evil super-criminal who has kidnapped a local scientist and mass-produced an army of mutant Ninja warriors.

items.title: The Magic of Houdini
items.description: Having been fascinated with magic since he was a boy, Alan Davies explores the life of illusionist and stunt performer, Harry Houdini, who became one of the most successful entertainers in the world.

items.title: In Search of the Last Action Heroes
items.description: A documentary detailing the action genre over the past 50 years from the early westerns to the contemporary movies of today. Loaded with interviews with stars who helped influence and shape the films we grew up on.

items.title: Dead End
items.description: The lives of a young man and woman, an infamous gangster, and a group of street kids converge one day in a volatile New York City slum.

items.title: The Sisterhood of Night
items.description: Based on the short story by Pulitzer Prize-winning author Steven Millhauser, THE SISTERHOOD OF NIGHT is a story of friendship and loyalty set against the backdrop of a modern-day Salem witch trial.

items.title: DeadHeads
items.description: DEADHEADS is a "zombedy" that is sure to impress--pleasing both horror and action-adventure fans alike. Yup, you heard it first. Horror, meets comedy, meets action adventure!

items.title: The Playroom
items.description: Oscar-nominee John Hawkes and Molly Parker star in THE PLAYROOM, an unnerving family drama that captures the exhilaration and perversity of the freewheeling ‘70s.

items.title: Mr. Pip
items.description: When the children of a war-torn island need hope, Mr. Watts (Hugh Laurie) brings them "Great Expectations". Fiction can be dangerous in times of war but the power of the imagination wins.

items.title: Last Man Club
items.description: "Last Man Club" is a heartwarming, road trip adventure of four military veterans facing their later years. Stuck in a VA Hospital, Pete (Barry Corbin) asks a kind nurse to track down Eagle (Jim Mackrell), the Captain of his B-17 crew during World War II.

items.title: Landline
items.description: Ted Gout is a public relations executive at Sanders PR. Just after securing the account for the upcoming season for the Chicago Cubs, Ted is passed over for a big promotion that would have supplied the finances for Ted and his pro-bono working.

items.title: Fashionista
items.description: A woman who uses clothes as an emotional crutch discovers her life isn’t as ideal as she thought...

items.title: Friends and Romans
items.description: Set in a predominantly Italian-American neighborhood in Staten Island, a classic comedy farce that follows Nick DeMaio, a frustrated actor who is determined to rise above the typecasting that perpetually finds him playing the role of Mobster Number 3.

items.title: Jake Squared
items.description: Jake Klein, 50, sets out to make a movie. He hires an actor to play himself and throws a big party. His idea is to shoot the heck out of it and see what he gets. But, everything spins out of control as different, unexpected people show up.

items.title: Being Black Enough
items.description: A Young Black Man, raised in a White neighborhood, ridiculed for not being “Black Enough” goes to the hood to hang with his gangster cousin to discover what it means to be “Black.” He faces the harsh reality of gang violence, drugs, and the police.

items.title: Dope Fiend
items.description: Crooked business developers take advantage of warring drug factions, with their own fiendish plans to take over the neighborhood through gentrification, starting with those very same housing projects.

items.title: Dance-Off
items.description: Jasmine is the star of the wealthy Diamond Dance. She wins titles while dealing with the demands of her crazy “dance mom” Jo-Ann.

items.title: A Bird of the Air
items.description: A stray parrot brings together Rachel Nichols and Jackson Hurst in an adaptation of Joe Coomer’s romantic novel The Loop.

items.title: Autumn Lights
items.description: An American photographer adrift in a remote Icelandic community is implicated in a local investigation after discovering a deserted crime scene.

items.title: Miss Snake Charmer
items.description: Miss Snake Charmer contestants are not your typical high school beauty queens. The teens must show they are more than just pretty faces-that they have the guts and grit to win America's toughest beauty pageant.

items.title: Good Luck Chuck
items.description: A handsome but slightly self-involved dentist (Dane Cook) discovers that he is a walking good-luck charm, as women inevitably find their soul mate right after dating him.

items.title: Woman in Gold
items.description: Helen Mirren and Ryan Reynolds star in the remarkable true story of one woman's battle against the establishment to recover her family possessions that had been seized by Nazis during WWII.

items.title: Escape from Planet Earth
items.description: When a hero astronaut from the blue-alien planet Baab (Brendan Fraser) gets trapped on a notoriously dangerous planet called Earth, his risk-averse brother (Rob Corddry) must save him.

items.title: When Stand-Up Stood Out
items.description: Documentary covering what came to be known as "The Boston Gold Rush" of the late 1970s and early 1980s, when Boston stand-up comedians like Dennis Leary, Steven Wright and Colin Quinn burst upon the national scene.

items.title: War Between The Planets
items.description: Scientists try to prevent a collision between Earth and a planet that is heading for it.

items.title: Three Of Hearts: A Postmodern Family
items.description: Sam Cagnina, oldest son of a Mafia hit man, meets Steven, a handsome college student and they fall in love. After a few years they have a "visionary" idea to find a woman who would fall in love with both of them and agree to live in a "trio" relationship.

items.title: The Trials Of Darryl Hunt
items.description: A feature documentary about a brutal rape/murder case and a wrongly convicted man, Darryl Hunt, who spent nearly twenty years in prison for a crime he did not commit. Both a social justice story and a personally driven narrative.

items.title: The Ninth Configuration
items.description: A military psychiatrist takes charge of an army mental hospital situated in a secluded castle. Among his many eccentric patients is a troubled astronaut in the midst of an existential crisis.

items.title: The Losers
items.description: A quintet of CIA-trained Hells Angels take their specially armored hogs to Cambodia and head across southeast Asia to rescue a captured presidential advisor.

items.title: The King (2005)
items.description: A troubled man, recently discharged from the Navy, goes to Corpus Christi, Texas, in search of the father he's never met.

items.title: The Imposter
items.description: A documentary centered on a young man in Spain who claims to a grieving Texas family that he is their 16-year-old son who has been missing for 3 years.

items.title: The Human Factor
items.description: After his family is brutally murdered for an unknown reason, a computer engineer sets out to find those responsible.

items.title: The Horror Of Party Beach
items.description: Sea creatures created from radioactive sludge terrorize a beach community.

items.title: The Glen Campbell Goodtime Hour: Country Special
items.description: Join music superstar Glen Gampbell for a spectacular celebration of down-home music with The Glen Campbell Goodtime Hour Country Special! You''ll have a grand old time filled with music, laughter and a roster of guest stars.

items.title: The Gambler III: Part 1)
items.description: Brady Hawkes and Billy Montana join forces once again in this new adventure. This time around their goal is to help the Sioux fight the government and get the supplies they need.

items.title: The Gambler III: (Part 2)
items.description: Brady Hawkes and Billy Montana join forces once again in this new adventure. This time around their goal is to help the Sioux fight the government and get the supplies they need.

items.title: The Gambler II: (Part 2)
items.description: Brady Hawkes, Billy Montana, and Jeremiah Hawkes are on a train bound for a huge gambling event when the train is taken over by a gang of vicious killers in search of money. As ransom, the gang takes young Jeremiah hostage.

items.title: The Gambler II: (Part 1)
items.description: Brady Hawkes, Billy Montana, and Jeremiah Hawkes are on a train bound for a huge gambling event when the train is taken over by a gang of vicious killers in search of money. As ransom, the gang takes young Jeremiah hostage.

items.title: The Event
items.description: An intense relationship drama that takes the form of a mystery, The Event centers around a series of unexplained deaths that occur among the gay community in New York's fashionable Chelsea district.

items.title: The Curse Of The Living Corpse
items.description: Relatives gather in an old house for the reading of a will, but the "dead" man comes back to life and starts killing.

items.title: The Bonnie Parker Story
items.description: In the 1930s, amoral blonde tommy-gun girl Bonnie Parker cut a swath of bodies across the South-West. Starting out on gas stations and bars with side-kick Guy Darrow she graduated to bank hold-ups with Darrow's brother.

items.title: The Big Bird Cage
items.description: Grier and Haig are thieving mercenaries who engineer a prison break from the outside.

items.title: Tess Of The D'Urbervilles
items.description: A free-spirited yet naive country girl is caught between her wealthy, manipulative "cousin" Alec and the handsome, educated farmer Angel Clare in this Victorian tragedy from novelist Thomas Hardy.

items.title: Tell Them Who You Are
items.description: The son of acclaimed cinematographer Haskell Wexler confronts his complex father by turning the camera on him. What results is a portrait of a difficult genius and a son's path out of the shadow of a famous father.

items.title: Teenage Caveman
items.description: A young man defies tribal laws and searches for answers. The result of his quest yields knowledge of past generations.

items.title: Taxi To The Dark Side
items.description: Alex Gibney exposes the haunting details of the USA's torture and interrogation practices during the War in Afghanistan.

items.title: Starstruck
items.description: A Sydney teen tries to make it as a rock singer, with help from her odd 14-year-old cousin.

items.title: Shake, Rattle & Rock!
items.description: A group of concerned adults tries to ban rock and roll music in their town because they think that music promotes juvenile delinquency.

items.title: Santana: Live At US Festival
items.description: From award-winning filmmaker and rockumentarian Glenn Aveni, Santana: Live At US Festival offers a tremendous performance from the legendary Carlos Santana, rivaling his set at Woodstock for its energy, excitement, and inspiring musicianship

items.title: Runaway Daughters
items.description: Three teenagers with troubled families are unable to adjust at home and in high-school. Tempted with an easy, carefree life they soon pass from misdemeanors into serious crime - and will suffer for it.

items.title: Reform School Girl
items.description: A young man steals a car and ends up involved in a pedestrian fatality. He threatens a witness's life if she talks, so when she refuses to tell what she knows she is sent to reform school.

items.title: Q: The Winged Serpent
items.description: NYPD detectives Shepard and Powell are working on a bizarre case of a ritualistic Aztec murder. Meanwhile, something big is attacking people of New York and only greedy small time crook Jimmy Quinn knows where its lair is.

items.title: Poldark
items.description: Ross Poldark returns from war to right wrongs and reunite with the love of his life.

items.title: Peter, Paul And Mary: 25th Anniversary
items.description: Taped before a live audience at the Tennessee Performing Arts Center in Nashville, Peter, Paul & Mary celebrate their twenty-fifth anniversary with performances of their own songs and those of other great folk artists.

items.title: Overnight
items.description: A documentary on the rise and stumble of Troy Duffy, the bartender-cum-filmmaker who was swept up by Miramax's Harvey Weinstein to turn his script for The Boondock Saints into a feature film.

items.title: Mondovino
items.description: A documentary on the impact of globalization on the world's different wine regions.

items.title: Mel Brooks: The Ceasar Years
items.description: Mel takes us back to his colorful days as a writer for Your Show Of Shows. It features vintage sketches and clips from the 1996 PBS program Caesar's Writers.

items.title: Matilda
items.description: A small-time talent agent discovers an amazing boxing kangaroo and figures to use it as his stepping-stone into the big time.

items.title: Kontroll
items.description: A tale about a strange young man, Bulcsu, the fellow inspectors on his team, all without exception likable characters, a rival ticket inspection team and racing along the tracks - and a tale about love.

items.title: Jack's Back
items.description: A serial killer in Los Angeles celebrates Jack the Ripper's 100th birthday by committing similar murders and only one has a chance of stopping him.

items.title: Human Rights Concerts: The Struggle Continues
items.description: The concert titled The Struggle Continues... took place on December 10, 1998 - the exact 50th anniversary of the signing of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights.

items.title: Human Rights Concerts: Human Rights Now!
items.description: Human Rights Now! was a worldwide tour of twenty benefit concerts on behalf of Amnesty International that took place over six weeks in 1988.

items.title: Human Rights Concerts: An Embrace of Hope
items.description: The An Embrace Of Hope concert was a de facto post-script to the Human Rights Now! tour. It took place in Chile - a country that for political reasons it was not possible for the Human Rights Now! tour to visit during the 1988 world tour.

items.title: Human Rights Concerts: A Conspiracy of Hope
items.description: On January 21, 1989, on the evening following the presidential inauguration, some of the biggest names in classic rhythm and blues performed at the Washington Convention Center at the Presidential Inaugural Concert.

items.title: Girls In Prison
items.description: Anne Carson, meeting the seamy side of prison life, finds that everyone thinks she knows where un-recovered bank loot is.

items.title: Gerry
items.description: A friendship between two young men is tested when they go for a hike in a desert and forget to bring any water or food with them.

items.title: George Burns In Concert
items.description: This 1982 concert shows the great George Burns at his absolute funniest, as he entertains a live audience.

items.title: Frankenstein Meets The Space Monster
items.description: When an atomic war on Mars destroys the planet's women, it's up to Martian Princess Marcuzan and her right-hand man Dr. Nadir to travel to earth and kidnap women for new breeding stock.

items.title: Female Jungle
items.description: Several persons, including an off-duty policeman and a weird rich guy, are suspects in the murder of a beautiful actress.

items.title: Down in the Valley
items.description: Set in the present-day San Fernando Valley, the project revolves around a delusional man who believes he's a cowboy and the relationship that he starts with a rebellious young woman.

items.title: Dog Eat Dog!
items.description: Three thieves rip off a shipment of used money being sent back to the US. As they are escaping the robbery (after having taken a hostage), they wind up on an island in a hotel full of demented residents.

items.title: Candy
items.description: A poet falls in love with an art student who gravitates to his bohemian lifestyle -- and his love of heroin. Hooked as much on one another as they are on the drug, their relationship alternates between states of oblivion, self-destruction, and despair.

items.title: Bloodfist II
items.description: The world kickboxing champion (Don "The Dragon" Wilson) retreats to Manila, lands in a mess, and fights his way out.

items.title: Blood On The Arrow
items.description: In 1871 Arizona, an escaped outlaw survives an Indian attack and helps a trading-post family retrieve their kidnapped son from marauding Apaches.

items.title: Black Christmas (1974)
items.description: During their Christmas break, a group of sorority girls is stalked by a stranger.

items.title: Big Doll House
items.description: Beautiful women prisoners are abused in a Philippine prison until 5 of them plot an escape by taking the evil female warden hostage with the reluctant help of 2 male fruit vendors.

items.title: Adrenalin: Fear The Rush
items.description: The Russian government has collapsed. Amidst the chaos, riots, and struggle for power, a terrible weapon has leaked out. A deadly germ of the cold war has begun to spread across Eastern Europe, killing massive numbers of people.

items.title: A Swingin' Summer
items.description: Beach party escapade features a bookworm with glasses who learns to "groove", as she attempts to sing "Ready to Groove."

items.title: 5x2
items.description: Five stages in the romance between a woman and a man.

items.title: 2017 World Series Champions
items.description: The Houston Astros thrilled fans with a riveting and fearless Postseason run through the Red Sox, Yankees, and Dodgers. That's strong.

items.title: 2016 World Series Champions
items.description: This historic official film from Major League Baseball presents the exciting story of the Chicago Cubs 2016 World Series championship run through comprehensive highlights, exclusive access, interviews, and breathtaking footage.

items.title: The Carol Burnett Show: Show Stoppers
items.description: The cast of the CBS variety show, "The Carol Burnett Show," gets together and revisits some of their favorite moments throughout the course of the show.

items.title: Sinatra In Palm Springs
items.description: During his brief marriage to Ava Gardner, Sinatra's Palm Springs home was center stage.

items.title: MST3K: Quest Of The Delta Knights
items.description: Pearl sits in on part of this week's experiment as part of her annual review, and Leonardo da Vinci stops by.

items.title: Exorcism At 60,000 Feet
items.description: We all know that air travel can be hell, but on the last flight of a transatlantic passenger airliner, things turn positively demonic when a pandemic of infernal possessions breaks out, spreading from passenger to passenger and eventually to the pilot.

items.title: Two Buddies And A Badger
items.description: A crazy, musical movie based on two old friends and a badger who go on a great adventure together.

items.title: The Seventh Dwarf
items.description: Bobo, the youngest of the seven dwarves, accidentally pricks Princess Rose (a.k.a. Sleeping Beauty) and sends the kingdom into a century-long slumber.

items.title: Snowtime!
items.description: When winter break arrives, a boy and his friends are joined by the new girl in town for a prolonged snowball fight.

items.title: Quackerz
items.description: The battle between ducks and humans for the place under the sun.

items.title: Kurt Cobain: About A Son
items.description: In this visual essay style documentary, intimate audio of journalist Michael Azerrad's interviews with Kurt Cobain is played over more recently photographed footage of Cobain's Washington state homes and haunts.

items.title: Jungle Bunch
items.description: Maurice may look like a penguin - but he's a real tiger inside! Raised by a tigress, he's the clumsiest Kung-Fu master ever. The Jungle Bunch intends to maintain order and justice in the jungle.

items.title: Itsy Bitsy
items.description: Based on the centuries old poem, a family moves into a secluded mansion where they soon find themselves being targeted by an entity taking the form of a giant spider.

items.title: Blinky Bill: The Movie
items.description: A young koala adventures across the wild Australian outback in the hope of finding his missing father.

items.title: Rupture
items.description: A single mom tries to break free from a mysterious organization that has abducted her.

items.title: The Cowboy and the Lady
items.description: A lonely socialite masquerades as a maid and meets an unpretentious, plain-spoken cowboy who is unaware of her true identity.

items.title: Bad Santa
items.description: Arguably the most outrageous Christmas tale ever told, Billy Bob Thornton is a thieving Santa who doesn't care if you've been naughty or nice. Hot on his trail are a security guard, a sexy bartender, and the one kid who's convinced he's the real deal.

items.title: Finding Neverland
items.description: Both fantasy and everyday reality meld in this unforgettable acclaimed drama exploring the origins of one of the greatest fables of all time—PETER PAN. Nominated for seven Academy Awards, including Best Picture.

items.title: Christmas In New York
items.description: In the vein of Love Actually, the story follows six different couples in a posh Manhattan hotel over the course of one night just before Christmas.

items.title: The Christmas Kid
items.description: Struggling former child actor (Craig Roberts) arrives home in Wales for Christmas. He soon has to decide what is more important, bluffing his way through putting on a show for the gullible locals or reconnecting with his loved ones.

items.title: Trash Fire
items.description: When Owen (Adrian Grenier) is forced to confront the past he's been running from his whole adult life, he and his girlfriend become entangled in a horrifying web of lies, deceit and murder.

items.title: The Oranges
items.description: The enduring friendship between the Walling and Ostroff families is tested when Nina, the prodigal Ostroff daughter, returns home for the holidays after a five-year absence and enters into an affair with David, head of the Walling family.

items.title: Terri
items.description: The story of a bullied fifteen-year-old boy in a small town as he struggles to adjust to his difficult life.

items.title: Never Here
items.description: Disturbing events lead an artist who photographs strangers to suspect that someone out there is watching HER. Boundaries blur between real and imaginary, crime and art, the watcher and the watched.

items.title: Brother's Nest
items.description: With their Mother dying of cancer, two brothers go to extreme lengths to protect their inheritance from being signed away to their stepfather.

items.title: Time Trial
items.description: Experience the world of professional cycling through the eyes of David Millar, the only British rider to have won all of the Tour de France jerseys

items.title: The Secret Scripture
items.description: A woman keeps a diary of her extended stay at a mental hospital.

items.title: See You Soon
items.description: A U.S. soccer star suffers a career-threatening injury in the run-up to the World Cup, and during his recovery, embarks on an epic romance with a Russian single mom.

items.title: Rodeo Girl
items.description: Shipped off to her American dad's ranch for the summer, a teen and her horse Lucky Lass compete for a spot at the National Youth Rodeo.

items.title: The Last Waltz
items.description: On Thanksgiving Day, 1976, The Band gave its farewell concert at Winterland in San Francisco. On hand to help say goodbye to this influential rock group were some of the most acclaimed Musicians of the late 1960s and '70s.

items.title: Nina
items.description: NINA is an LGBTQ debut feature, painting a sensitive portrait of a strong yet confused woman trapped in her role as a wife and daughter.

items.title: Winning Of The West
items.description: Gene Autry protects a publisher and printer from some crooks who are using Indian raids to cover their bandit activities. When Gene's brother kills the publisher, Gene’s integrity is in question.

items.title: Whirlwind
items.description: Gene Autry arrives in Red Bluff to work on the investigation of mail robberies. U.S. Bonds are stolen, and Smiley finds burned fragments of them. A henchman confesses who the guilty party is.

items.title: Wagon Team
items.description: Gene Autry jails himself to work on the suspected thief of an Army payroll, who escapes, but Gene catches up with him at the medicine show. It's a showdown when Gene goes after the missing payroll.

items.title: Valley Of Fire
items.description: Gene Autry is the new mayor of a lawless town. He has to rid the town of its gambling king and to import a group of gals to settle the men. Gene must out-gun renegades who want to kidnap the gals.

items.title: Twilight On The Rio Grande
items.description: Gene Autry's investigation of the murder of his partner, leads him to Mexico, where he becomes involved with the beautiful singer whose father has also been killed, and finds a jewelry smuggling ring.

items.title: Trail To San Antone
items.description: Gene Autry tries to help a young jockey get back on track after an “accident” arranged by a horse trainer ruins his career. Action-packed adventure with fantastic stunts, and Gene Autry's Champion.

items.title: The Ticket
items.description: A blind man who regains his vision finds himself becoming metaphorically blinded by his obsession for the superficial.

items.title: The Strawberry Roan
items.description: Gene’s first color film stars Champion in the title role as a wild outlaw stallion, branded a killer, and the two-fisted cowboy who fights off a gun-crazed posse to win justice for the noble animal.

items.title: The Return Of Hunter
items.description: Rick Hunter is back. Now a lieutenant, he is considering marrying his girlfriend. But before he could, she is murdered.

items.title: The Old West
items.description: Gene Autry tames and sells wild horses to a stagecoach line. His only competitor ambushes and shoots Gene, who is nursed back to health. A wild stagecoach race to test Gene's horses is arranged.

items.title: The Last Round-Up
items.description: Gene Autry is a cattle rancher determined to protect the interests of neighboring ranchers and Indians against unscrupulous land manipulators when local authorities plan to build an aqueduct.

items.title: The Cowboy And The Indians
items.description: Gene Autry runs in to opposition when he tries to aid starving Navajos. The Chief is found unconscious and his necklace gone. Lakohna, the successor, is blamed. Gene and Lakohna join to seek justice.

items.title: The Blazing Sun
items.description: Gene Autry and pal Mike hunt bank robbers Al Bartlett and Trot Lucas. To throw off his pursuers, Bartlett kills his own twin brother and Lucas hoping that Gene and the Sheriff will believe him dead.

items.title: The Big Sombrero
items.description: Gene heads South in a fiesta of melody and a jamboree of romance. He fights for the right of rancheros to live on their rancho. Outlaws fear him and senoritas cheer him, and his famous horse Champion.

items.title: Sons Of New Mexico
items.description: Gene Autry becomes the guardian of a wayward boy who is in debt. Gene sends him to the New Mexico Military Institute, where he falls in with bad companions and is framed for a murder of an ex-jockey.

items.title: Sioux City Sue
items.description: A talent scout searches for a cowboy singer to do the voice for a cartoon character happens upon Gene Autry, who reluctantly takes the job, not knowing he is to be the voice of an animated donkey!

items.title: Silver Canyon
items.description: Gene Autry and Pat Buttram are sent by the cavalry to bring in raiders who are interfering with supply lines. Gene traces them to a small Army outpost where the outlaws set out to ravage the town.

items.title: Saginaw Trail
items.description: Gene Autry is sent to investigate the murders of settlers with the help of Smiley Burnette and two young homesteaders. Gene soon discovers that rich fur trader is behind the staged Indian raids.

items.title: Saddle Pals
items.description: Gene Autry goes to the home of hypochondriac landowner, who gets Gene to switch identities while he takes a vacation, giving Gene power-of-attorney. Gene has to raise $50,000 to save the properties.

items.title: Robin Hood Of Texas
items.description: Gene Autry and the Cass County Boys are unjustly arrested as bank bandits. Released by police as decoys to locate the loot, Gene and the boys find themselves in trouble with the real bank robbers.

items.title: Rim Of The Canyon
items.description: Gene Autry, playing a dual role as his father and himself, is stranded by thieves who are searching for a stolen $30,000. A schoolteacher aids Gene with his search for the outlaws and the treasure.

items.title: Riders Of The Whistling Pines
items.description: Gene Autry believes he has accidentally shot a man, but learns that the guilt lies with men trying to stop a destructive moth infestation. Will modern chemicals be used to save the day, against Gene?

items.title: Riders In The Sky
items.description: Gene Autry helps a gal clear her father's name who is accused of murdering a gambler. When the leader of the gamblers gets involved, it's up to Gene and his comic pal Pat Buttram to outwit the badmen.

items.title: Pack Train
items.description: Gene Autry sets out to aid frontier settlers, threatened by a shortage of food and medicine. When storekeepers divert the supplies to gold miners, Gene and Smiley Burnette must ride to the rescue.

items.title: On Top Of Old Smoky
items.description: Gene Autry, who is mistaken for a Texas Ranger, helps the owner of a toll road, while she is being pressured by bad characters to relinquish her property, which contains valuable mica deposits.

items.title: Night Stage To Galveston
items.description: Gene Autry and Pat Buttram work for a newspaper publisher, and find evidence of corruption in the Texas State Police. The publisher’s daughter is kidnapped to prevent the story from being published.

items.title: Mule Train
items.description: When natural cement is discovered by two prospectors, one is murdered during a claim jump attempt. Marshal Gene Autry befriends the lone prospector and tries to help him promote his cement discovery.

items.title: MST3K: Women Of The Prehistoric Planet
items.description: Our intrepid hosts are trapped between Isaac Asimov's Literary Doomsday Device and Robert Ito from Quincy M.E. (1976) in a fur caveman outfit.

items.title: MST3K: The Skydivers
items.description: The villains of Deep 13 force Mike and the 'bots to watch Why Study Industrial Arts? (1956) and The Skydivers (1963) after challenging them to a swing choir contest.

items.title: MST3K: The Sinister Urge
items.description: Two laid back detectives crack down on an underground porn ring while Frank threatens to blow up Deep 13.

items.title: MST3K: The Dead Talk Back
items.description: Metaphysics helps to solve a murder case while Mike and the Bots impersonate the Grateful Dead.

items.title: MST3K: The Creeping Terror
items.description: Mike and the 'bots watch The Creeping Terror (1964), with its infamous walking-carpet monster, and parody Love, American Style (1969).

items.title: MST3K: The Crawling Hand
items.description: Joel and the Bots have a tough time agreeing on how to spend their free time between segments of the teen sci-fi thriller "The Crawling Hand".

items.title: MST3K: Project Moonbase
items.description: Joel and the Bots watch two more Commando Cody episodes and a film about a sabotaged space station. They also introduce their new product SPACOM to the Mads.

items.title: MST3K: Prince Of Space
items.description: A wimpy space hero kicks tyrannical aliens off of Earth while the Widowmaker and the SOL are sucked through a wormhole.

items.title: MST3K: Parts: The Clonus Horror
items.description: Scientists run a clone farm for VIPs while Pearl and her goons are forced into babysitting omnipotent Space Children.

items.title: MST3K: Invasion Of The Neptune Men
items.description: Our heroes discover just how boring an alien attack on Tokyo can be when they view an anti-vehicle for Sonny Chiba.

items.title: MST3K: Hobgoblins
items.description: Mike and the Bots suffer through the 1988 B movie "Hobgoblins," the story of tiny goblin-like creatures who attack a group of teenagers.

items.title: MST3K: Hercules
items.description: Joel and the Bots have a casual day on the SOL and endure another incoherent Hercules movie (Hercules (1958)).

items.title: MST3K: Deathstalker
items.description: A hero on a quest to gather magical stones battles an evil sorcerer and learns the benefits of a potato diet in Deathstalker and the Warriors from Hell (1988). Tom and Crow put on a Renaissance Fair for Mike and Crow reads a trashy romance novel

items.title: MST3K: Being From Another Planet
items.description: Joel and the Bots watch a re-edited version of Time Walker (1982) called "Being From Another Planet" in which a mummy awakened by a university team goes on a killing spree.

items.title: Loaded Pistols
items.description: Seeking a man who has killed his best friend in a poker game, Gene Autry finds a cowboy hiding from a posse. The young man's gun is the murder weapon yet Gene is convinced of his innocence.

items.title: Last Of The Pony Riders
items.description: Gene Autry tries to set up a stage line to carry government mail. Schemers try to get the government assignment for their own stage line, and plan to discredit the Pony Express by causing accidents.

items.title: Jack And The Cuckoo-Clock Heart
items.description: A 19th-century drama about a man whose heart was replaced with a clock when he was born. The situation dictates that he should avoid feeling strong emotions -- love, most of all -- but he just can't keep his feelings under wraps.

items.title: Indian Territory
items.description: Following the Civil War, Cavalry Sergeant Gene Autry is sent to break up a series of Indian raids upon settlers, led by a renegade Austrian, who wishes to use the Indians to build an empire.

items.title: Humor Me
items.description: With an interminable case of writer's block and a personal family crisis, playwright Nate is forced to move into his father's retirement community.

items.title: Howard And The Undersea Kingdom
items.description: After conquering R'yleh and the Frozen Kingdom young Howard Lovecraft must now travel to the Undersea Kingdom in order to free his captured family and prevent the impending wrath of Cthulhu.

items.title: Hills Of Utah
items.description: Gene Autry returns to the town where his father was murdered and finds a mine owner and cattleman feuding. Things get complicated when a boy dies and the mine owner comes gunning for Gene.

items.title: Heart Of The Rio Grande
items.description: Gene Autry tames a spoiled teenage shrew sent to a Dude Ranch for the summer and in the process humanizes her father into being a better parent. Action includes stampeding horses, and a bold rescue!

items.title: Digimon Adventure tri. 6: Future
items.description: The DigiDestined must stand together to prevent the digital world from swallowing the real world.

items.title: Digimon Adventure tri. 5: Coexistence
items.description: Meicoomon rampages after witnessing Meiko Mochizuki being injured by the man bearing Gennai's likeness. "It would have been better if you hadn't been born..." Meicoomon disappears into the Real World, which has since become distorted

items.title: Digimon Adventure tri. 4: Loss
items.description: Upon arriving at the Digital World after the "reboot", the digidestined are hunted by a new villain. Meanwhile, Sora is troubled by her partner digimon's indifference towards her.

items.title: Digimon Adventure tri. 3: Confession
items.description: After seeing Meicoomon's abrupt transformation and killing of Leomon, Agumon and the other Digimon are kept isolated in Koushiro's office in order to prevent them from infection, but signs of infection begin to appear in Patamon.

items.title: Digimon Adventure tri. 2: Determination
items.description: The DigiDestined go to a nearby hot springs theme park and everyone has a good time, but Joe doesn't show up because he wants to study for his exams. Another infected Digimon, Ogremon, attacks Odaiba.

items.title: Digimon Adventure tri. 1: Reunion
items.description: After years of inactivity, the DigiDestined regroup with their Digimon to save their world, but have the years changed their characters too much?

items.title: Cow Town
items.description: Barbed wire is brought to the open range in a secret plan is to bring sheep into the territory, and the ranchers are urged to fight against it. Gene Autry makes certain that nothing shady is going on.

items.title: Call Of The Canyon
items.description: Gene Autry leads cattlemen in rebellion when a packing company rep cheats them. A gal’s future depends on the company's radio spots for her show! It gets exciting when the owner appears incognito.

items.title: Boots And Saddles
items.description: A British youngster inherits a ranch so burdened with taxes that he struggles to keep the property. Gene Autry befriends the boy, and becomes involved with an Army colonel's daughter and others.

items.title: Blue Montana Skies
items.description: Gene Autry heads North to apprehend fur smugglers plundering the trappers' pelts, and then return to the U.S. When the trail leads to the H-H dude ranch owned by a beautiful gal, the action heats up.

items.title: Blue Canadian Rockies
items.description: Gene Autry encounters mayhem on a dude ranch in the heart of timber country. When a Mountie is murdered, Gene and Pat Buttram must find the real culprit and bring peace to the Blue Canadian Rockies.

items.title: Beyond The Purple Hills
items.description: Gene Autry becomes the new Sheriff after bank robbers kill the former sheriff. When Judge Beaumont is murdered, evidence points to the judge's wild son. Believing the young man, Gene tries to help.

items.title: Bells Of Capistrano
items.description: A feud between rodeo companies accelerates when both want Gene Autry, as a crowd-drawing added attraction. This film features Gene singing five hits, including "In Old Capistrano" and "Forgive Me."

items.title: Barbed Wire
items.description: In 1878, Gene Autry is a cattle buyer who tries to settle a battle between the cattlemen and homesteaders, when the latter are worked up into a feverish pitch by unscrupulous landowner Steve Rutledge.

items.title: Back In The Saddle
items.description: When pollution poisons hundreds of cattle, Gene Autry, faces trouble from all sides. Originally released in 1941, this film features Gene's signature song and his lovable sidekick, Smiley Burnette.

items.title: Apache Country
items.description: Cavalry scouts Gene Autry & Pat Buttram are ordered to break up a ring which uses raids to cover up its activities. Carolina Cotton assists Gene and Pat, while seeking revenge against the gang leader.

items.title: A Dark Place
items.description: When a young boy goes missing in a sleepy backwoods town, a local sanitation truck driver, Donald, plays detective, embarking on a precarious and obsessive investigation.

items.title: 2019 World Series Champions
items.description: The 2019 World Series was loaded with surprises, comebacks, superstars, and a few new records. The white-hot Washington Nationals were fighting for the first Commissioner's Trophy in franchise history.

items.title: My Foolish Heart
items.description: After being visited by an old friend, a woman recalls her true love, the man she met and lost years ago.

items.title: Moonwalkers
items.description: After failing to locate the legendary Stanley Kubrick, an unstable CIA agent must instead team up with a seedy rock band manager to develop the biggest con of all time-staging the moon landing.

items.title: I Want You
items.description: In 1950, small-town Americans try to deal with military conscription.

items.title: Wonder Man
items.description: After being murdered by gangsters, an exuberant nightclub entertainer returns as a ghost to persuade his meek twin brother to help bring his killers to justice.

items.title: Tiger Raid
items.description: Two mercenaries ride a wave of pitch-black camaraderie as they travel through the desert night to carry out a kidnapping in Iraq. As the raid progresses, their world turns in on itself as past misdeeds resurface and threaten to tear them apart.

items.title: The Princess and the Pirate
items.description: A cowardly actor and a runaway princess are voyaging on a ship that is captured by a notorious pirate who recently buried his treasure on a secretly mapped island.

items.title: The Kid from Brooklyn
items.description: After a timid milkman knocks unconscious a boxing champion who was accosting his sister, he decides to take up boxing himself in order to impress a beautiful nightclub singer.

items.title: The Booksellers
items.description: A behind-the-scenes look at the New York rare book world.

items.title: Incitement
items.description: Details the year leading to the assassination of Israel's Prime Minister, Yitzhak Rabin (1922-1995), from the point of view of the assassin.

items.title: Gordon Lightfoot
items.description: The iconic Canadian musician, Gordon Lightfoot, reflects on his life and career.

items.title: Cold Skin
items.description: A young man arrives at a remote island to take a post of weather observer only to find himself defending the watchtower from deadly creatures which live in the island shores.

items.title: The Green Standard
items.description: In late 2016, state lawmakers formally petitioned the DEA to loosen federal restrictions on cannabis for medical use. Without deliberating, the DEA rejected the petition, maintaining a decades-old prohibition alongside heroin and PCP.

items.title: Tennessee Whiskey: The Dean Dillon Story
items.description: Dean Dillon wrote over 30 #1 hit songs for the biggest artists in country music over the past four decades, yet most have never heard his name.

items.title: Samsara
items.description: Prepare yourself for an unparalleled sensory experience. SAMSARA reunites director Ron Fricke and producer Mark Magidson, whose award-winning films BARAKA and CHRONOS were acclaimed for their combining visual and musical artistry.

items.title: Actors of Sound
items.description: From footsteps to bone cracks, Foley artists bring films to life with their imaginative sound effects, but as digital technology goes full speed ahead in 21st-century moviemaking, can Hollywood’s low tech Foley artist survive in this high tech age?

items.title: Lost Solace
items.description: Lost Solace is the story of psychopath Spence Cutler’s encounter with a new drug that causes Spence's brain to begin experiencing emotions, empathy, and guilt. As his brain rapidly changes, he is unable to continue the life he once had.

items.title: Truck Turner
items.description: Isaac Hayes is a bounty hunter who is after a strong-armed pimp who has skipped bail. In the hunt, the pimp is killed but his girlfriend takes a contract out on Hayes.

items.title: The World Of Henry Orient
items.description: Peter Sellers stars as a hilariously seedy concert pianist who is nearly driven mad after he becomes the obsession of two crush-crazed schoolgirls in this poignant, funny look at innocence lost. Angela Lansbury and Paula Prentiss also star.

items.title: The Private Life Of Sherlock Holmes
items.description: When a beautiful woman claims that her husband has disappeared, the investigation takes Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson to Scotland, where they uncover a plot involving a clandestine society, Her Majesty's Secret Service... and the Loch Ness Monster!

items.title: The Bank Shot
items.description: Fresh from his recent jailbreak, criminal mastermind George C. Scott is already plotting his next bank heist. This time he's thinking big...he's not just taking the loot, he's stealing the whole bank in a film brimming with imaginative silliness.

items.title: The Taking of Pelham One Two Three (1974)
items.description: A gang hijacks a subway train and threaten to kill the hostages one by one until their demands are met. Forced to stall, transit chief Lt. Garber (Walter Matthau) must outmaneuver one of the craftiest and cruelest screen villains (Robert Shaw) ever.

items.title: Frank Capra's Pocketful Of Miracles
items.description: Impish, gin-swilling New York City peddler "Apple Annie" (Bette Davis) has a problem: her daughter (Ann-Margret) has never seen her and believes Annie is society matron. Newly engaged, her daughter is coming to visit with a society fiancé in tow.

items.title: Muscle Beach Party
items.description: Frankie Avalon and Annette Funicello and the gang are back together in the 2nd of American International's Beach Party films and this time the beach is overrun by muscle men and their obnoxious trainer.

items.title: It! The Terror From Beyond Space
items.description: The survivor of a space expedition claims his crew was killed by an alien creature. The rescue captain dismisses the explanation only to find that a creature has stowed away on the spacecraft and begins to hunt the human hosts.

items.title: Frankie and Johnny
items.description: Join Elvis Presley and Donna Douglas for a riverboat ride of rollicking musical entertainment in this charming and sassy comic hit about a gambler and his lady love.

items.title: Cooley High
items.description: Set in 1964 Chicago, "Cooley High" is a slice-of-life tale of two high school students--best friends--coping with the challenges of everyday life and growing up in the shadows of the housing projects. Glynn Turman and Laurence-Hilton Jacobs star.

items.title: Thomas and the Magic Railroad
items.description: Thomas the Tank Engine's feature film debut follows Thomas and Mr. Conductor (Alec Baldwin) as they cross between the real world and the fictional Island of Sodor, in an attempt to recover lost gold dust.

items.title: The Abandoned
items.description: In this epic true story, a seasoned captain and three men set sail from New Zealand to Tonga in an outrigger sailboat. When a massive wave tosses their boat upside down, the men must rally together to survive in a sea full of terror.

items.title: Beyond Hoarding
items.description: Beyond Hoarding takes a fresh look at hoarding through the courageous and tragic experiences of people afflicted with this compulsion. Mental health experts shed light on this psychiatric disorder, which is treatable, and provide hope.

items.title: Bit x Bit: In Bitcoin We Trust
items.description: Futurists enlightening the minds of the many for the acceptance of a digital value exchange system focused on prosperity and transforming our world.

items.title: Mosul
items.description: An Iraqi journalist joins an army of uneasy allies and unforgettable characters in the epic battle to liberate the city of Mosul from the Islamic State.

items.title: The City that Sold America
items.description: An entertaining and informative look at how Chicago’s creative community pioneered modern advertising, forever influencing consumer behavior and culture in America.

items.title: Saving Jaws
items.description: Biologist OCEAN RAMSEY (“Shark Whisper\") credits her connection with sharks to years of research, but others feel it’s something more. Join Ocean and a team of biologists as they travel the globe trying to halt their looming extinction.

items.title: 14 Cameras
items.description: An unassuming family with two daughters rents a summer home, having no idea their obsessive landlord, Gerald, is broadcasting their lives online. A follower on the dark web wants to buy one of the girls and Gerald will protect what's his.

items.title: 2036 Origin Unknown
items.description: After a deadly crash, Mission Controller Mackenzie Wilson (Katee Sackhoff) assists an artificial intelligence system, A.R.T.I., to uncover a mysterious object under the surface of Mars that could change the future of our planet as we know it.

items.title: 350 Days
items.description: “350 Days” peels back the curtain on the severe toll pro wrestlers endured on the road 350 days a year, a toll on their bodies, families, and psyches.

items.title: 44 Pages
items.description: A portrait of Highlights magazine following the creation of the cultural phenomenon’s 70th anniversary issue.

items.title: 4th Man Out
items.description: Adam, a small-town mechanic, decides it’s time to tell his friends and family he’s gay. Will his straight-as-an-arrow best bros have his back? A lighthearted and unexpectedly subversive comedy about coming out of the blue-collar closet.

items.title: 7 Guardians of the Tomb
items.description: 7 Guardians of the Tomb follows a team of scientists in search of a colleague that disappeared in an ancient cave. To save him, the group must battle a swarm of deadly man-eating spiders and discover the elixir - before it’s too late.

items.title: A Conspiracy to Rule: The Illuminati
items.description: Investigate how the Global Elite strives to form a One World Government, pulling the strings of deception through manipulation of the media that control our thoughts and actions.

items.title: A Faster Horse
items.description: A FASTER HORSE explores the drama, passion and challenges behind the creation of the new Ford Mustang, while chronicling the powerful history that turned a car into a cultural icon.

items.title: A Good American
items.description: The story of a terrorist monitoring system that was discontinued just weeks before 9\11. Featuring a former NSA analyst who was a leading expert on metadata responsible for the world's most sophisticated globall monitoring effort.

items.title: Abducted in Plain Sight
items.description: A true-crime documentary that tells the twisting, turning story of the Broberg's, a naïve, church-going, Idaho family that falls under the spell of a sociopathic neighbor who will stop at nothing to be with their 12-year-old daughter.

items.title: Acrocats!
items.description: Self-taught animal trainer, Samantha Martin, quits her day job and follows her dream of creating the world's first traveling cat circus, The Amazing Acrocats.

items.title: American Circumcision
items.description: American Circumcision is the award-winning definitive documentary about the modern circumcision debate.

items.title: Ancient Aliens and the New World Order
items.description: Jim Marrs, author of the best-selling book \"Our Occulted History: Do the Global Elite Conceal Ancient Aliens?\" takes you into this secret world and exposes the truth about Ancient Aliens and their connection to modern rulers.

items.title: Austin Found
items.description: A former beauty queen who is fed up with her mundane lifestyle hatches a scheme to make her family instant celebrities by having her ex-boyfriend kidnap her 11-year-old daughter for a month. What could go wrong?

items.title: Back in Time
items.description: Back in Time is a look at the impact the Back to the Future movies have had on our culture. From Spielberg to Zemeckis, Lloyd and Fox, paired with amazing trilogy fans, Back in Time features interviews and footage that must be seen.

items.title: Barbecue
items.description: Barbecue is about more than grilling a piece of meat. It’s a ritual performed religiously across the world. It's a path to salvation. It’s the pride of nations. And the stories told around the fires become a way to bring the world together.

items.title: Bayou Caviar
items.description: Oscar® winner Cuba Gooding Jr.’s directorial debut is a thrilling story of sex, murder and revenge set in Louisiana. Also starring Oscar® winner Richard Dreyfuss, Famke Janssen (X-Men: Days of Future Past) and Katharine McPhee (Scorpion).

items.title: Beers of Joy
items.description: Beers of Joy is a fascinating, entertaining, and savory journey into our world’s favorite magical elixir. Feast upon stunning visuals from across the globe as four people immerse themselves in their passion for beer.

items.title: Birthright: A War Story
items.description: BIRTHRIGHT: A WAR STORY is a feature length documentary that examines how women are being jailed, physically violated and even put at risk of dying as a radical movement tightens its grip across America.

items.title: Blue Gold
items.description: BLUE GOLD: American Jeans is a tour de force around the world with jeans hunter Eric Schrader. From fashion and rock’n roll, to the loss of American manufacturing, Blue Gold explores how we are all connected in a globalized world.

items.title: Blurred Lines: Inside the Art World
items.description: BLURRED LINES: INSIDE THE ART WORLD exposes the provocative contemporary art world, a glamorous and cutthroat game of genius versus commerce.

items.title: Bodyguards: Secret Lives from the Watchtower
items.description: Bodyguards & Protection Agents are the individuals on the front lines for the rich, famous, and powerful. These individuals deal with violence, stalkers, isolation, and potential loss of life every single day.

items.title: Bogalusa Charm
items.description: Through the lens of an anachronistic charm school that has existed for almost three decades in rural Louisiana, we explore a town confronted with contemporary issues of class and race.

items.title: Born Strong (fka Gods or Men)
items.description: The four strongest men on the planet compete for the crown. We meet each 400-pound giant in his home country, then on to The Arnold (Schwarzenegger) Strongman Classic. Starring Eddie Hall, Hafthor Bjornsson, Brian Shaw and Zydrunas Savickas

items.title: Brave New Jersey
items.description: A small town on the night of Orson Welles’s legendary 1938 \"War of the Worlds\" radio hoax is fooled into believing aliens are invading America. As they face what they think is their last night alive, hilarious & life-changing events unfold.

items.title: California Typewriter
items.description: Cultural historians, collectors, and various celebrity obsessives, including Tom Hanks and John Mayer, launch us into the bittersweet moment when a beloved-but-dying technology, the typewriter, faces extinction.

items.title: Catwalk: Tales from the Cat Show Circuit
items.description: Catwalk: Tales From the Cat Show Circuit follows a competitive season in the lives of two top cat fanciers, Shirley and Kim, and their prize-winning felines: Oh La La, the regal Red Persian, and Bobby, the rambunctious white Turkish Angora.

items.title: Chippendales: Off the Cuff
items.description: Chippendales Off The Cuff is a look behind the curtain of the Infamous Chippendales dancers. The film director and dancer John Bernard Richardson simply describes his experience as \"Visceral.\"

items.title: Climate Warriors
items.description: CLIMATE WARRIORS presents people who show resistance against the devastating effects of climate change. They show that we need a fast transition in order to save the environment and keep the human rights in balance in favor of peace.

items.title: Hanna Ranch
items.description: Cattleman Kirk Hanna struggled to protect a once prominent way of life in Colorado. Born into ranch life, Hanna became a leader in the environmental ranching movement, setting out to protect encroachment of development and misuse.

items.title: Kim Swims
items.description: The inspiring story of an accomplished open water swimmer’s attempt to become the first woman to swim 30 miles through a stretch of cold, rough and shark-inhabited waters near the San Francisco coast.

items.title: Latex 2
items.description: Latex: Fetish or Fashion rocked and shocked the world exposing an underground fetish community that relishes in this rubberized fabric that so many people love to touch. In Latex 2, delve even deeper into the erotic world of Latex.

items.title: Light in the Water
items.description: In 1982 soon after the first Gay Games, West Hollywood Aquatics registered as the first openly gay masters swim team in the world. This athletic powerhouse fought injustice in the world of competitive sports, and ultimately became a family.

items.title: Magicians: Life in the Impossible
items.description: MAGICIANS follows the trials and triumphs of four professional magicians, both on and off stage, as they pursue the mysterious art of making magic.

items.title: Making the Grade
items.description: A feel good documentary about piano lessons from beginners to accomplished pianists.

items.title: Middle Men
items.description: Chronicles Jack Harris, one of the pioneers of internet commerce, as he wrestles with his morals, and struggles not to drown in a sea of con men, mobsters, drug addicts, and porn stars.

items.title: Nore Davis: You Guys are dope
items.description: Comedian Nore Davis brings down the house in his fresh new stand-up special, as he shares his take on social media dependence, being in love, and the hard truths of protesting, all with some a little help from his New York comedy crew.

items.title: Nothing is Truer Than Truth
items.description: Nothing Is Truer than Truth introduces Edward de Vere, A-list party boy on the continental circuit, who travels to Venice in 1575 and becomes Shakespeare. The film argues that the author’s bisexuality is the reason for the pseudonym.

items.title: Parrot Heads
items.description: An in-depth look at the world of "Parrot Heads", the loyal fan base of Jimmy Buffett.

items.title: Perfect Bid: The Contestant Who Knew Too Much
items.description: Perfect Bid: The Contestant Who Knew Too Much is the thrilling, award-winning documentary from CJ Wallis about a math genius from Texas named Ted Slauson who spent the majority of his life memorizing the prize amounts on The Price Is Right. The film explo

items.title: Real Fake
items.description: An investigative documentary about Elmyr de Hory, one of history’s most notorious art forgers who is alleged to have painted thousands of fakes but never convicted. The film re-opens the criminal case, examining his art, life and crimes.

items.title: Score: A Film Music Documentary
items.description: Featuring cinema’s most celebrated names in film music, SCORE: A FILM MUSIC DOCUMENTARY offers a candid look into how composers developed, and continue to develop, some of the most iconic scores in history.

items.title: Social Animals
items.description: A daredevil photographer, an aspiring swimsuit model, and a midwest girl next door are all looking for the same things from their Instagram account–a little love, acceptance and of course fame. And they’ll do just about anything to get it. With an observa

items.title: Standing Up
items.description: Three unlikely aspiring stand-up comedians – an ultra-Orthodox Jew, a couchsurfing custodian, and a personal injury lawyer – risk everything to find their voices on the cutthroat New York comedy scene.

items.title: Fittest in Dubai

items.title: Immortality or Bust
items.description: Immortality or Bust explores Transhumanism through the 2016 presidential campaign of Zoltan Istvan. Transhumanism is a philosophical movement embracing science and technology to radically expand our capabilities as human beings.

items.title: It Started As A Joke
items.description: IT STARTED AS A JOKE is a feature documentary that chronicles the decade-long run of the Eugene Mirman Comedy Festival, and reminds us of the healing properties of comedy - even in the most challenging of life's circumstances.

items.title: Making Waves
items.description: Making Waves: The Art of Cinematic Sound reveals the hidden power of sound in cinema, capturing its history, impact, and creativity featuring directors including Lucas, Spielberg, Streisand, Lynch, Redford, Google, and their sound artists.

items.title: Prey

items.title: Ski Bum: The Warren Miller Story

items.title: Skin Deep: The Battle Over Morgellons

items.title: Streetlight Harmonies

items.title: The Last Stop

items.title: TRACK - Search for Australia's Bigfoot

items.title: Daffodils

items.title: Juice: How Electricity Explains The World

items.title: Kangaroo: A Love-Hate Story

items.title: Pigeon Kings

items.title: The Trouble With Wolves

items.title: The Family Fang

items.title: MST3K: Gamera Vs. Guiron

items.title: A Very Brady Christmas
items.description: The entire Brady family manages to overcome personal obstacles to spend a happy holiday together.

items.title: We Three Kings
items.description: The Fay children can’t wait for their Uncle Henry to arrive for Christmas. With the help of Uncle Henry’s new song, "We Three Kings", the children learn truths about Jesus and the gifts that were given to Him.

items.title: Take Two

items.title: 12 PUPS OF CHRISTMAS
items.description: A woman tasked with finding homes for 12 abandoned puppies before Christmas finds love with her co-worker just in time for the holidays.

items.title: A CHRISTMAS SWITCH
items.description: Two women magically switch bodies during the holidays and teach each other valuable lessons about family, love, and Christmas cheer.

items.title: HOW SARAH GOT HER WINGS
items.description: In order to gain access into Heaven, Sarah is sent back down to earth as an \"angel in training\" with 12 days to help a soul in need.

items.title: Merry Kissmas
items.description: An impromptu kiss with Dustin, leaves Kayla to ponder who her true love may be: relationship gun-shy Dustin or her long-term boyfriend, Carlton, who treats her like an assistant.

items.title: Waiting
items.description: Ryan Reynolds, Anna Ferris, y Justin Long son unos jóvenes que trabajan de meseros mientras buscan el significado de la vida, el amor, y la amistad, en esta jocosa comedia.

items.title: Home for Christmas
items.description: An old thief befriends a young child.

items.description: When Martian children become obsessed with Santa Claus, the Martian elders decide to visit our planet and bring Santa back to Mars. It's not an easy task - first they must sort through an array of shopping mall Santas!

items.description: When a girl is given a horse that has been deemed useless, she finds purpose in a world that’s lost its shine. With a renewed hope in life since losing her mom, she clings to the one thing she still has: barrel racing.

items.description: Christmas time at the home of George and Denise but all is not well. Solutions come to the fore on a Silent Night, when everyone is reminded of The Gift of Christmas.

items.description: While Joseph Goebbels infamously declared Berlin "free of Jews" in 1943, 1,700 managed to survive in the Nazi capital through the end of WWII. The Invisibles traces the stories of four young people who learned to hide in plain sight.

items.title: Boiler Maker

items.description: It was one of the greatest mysteries in modern science: a series of brief but extremely bright flashes of ultra-high energy light coming from somewhere out in space. What can we learn from the violent birth of a black hole?

items.title: Birth of Planet Earth
items.description: This eye-opening 4K documentary tracks the perilous path our planet took in its early years through advanced, data-driven, cinema-quality CGI. It asks: How did Earth become a living planet?

items.title: Earth in 1000 Years
items.description: There are signs that Earth's great stores of ice on Greenland and Antarctica are starting to melt in the wake of rising sea temperatures. Scientists are looking back at past geological ages to understand the influence of ocean currents and other factors.

items.title: Mars Calling
items.description: Some believe Mars is the next home for Humanity. But the real “red planet” is a trickster; strikingly beautiful, yet sweetly sinister. Even as a growing armada of instruments arrive, this small cold world conceals its secrets.

items.title: When Will Time End?

items.title: Tsunami: Facing the Global Threat
items.description: One of the deadliest natural phenomena on the planet, tsunamis are so sudden and powerful that they can wipe out a coastline in minutes. What can we do to get ready? How can we protect ourselves against this global threat?

items.title: The Real Joan of Arc
items.description: Joan of Arc is considered a heroine of France for her role during the Lancastrian phase of the Hundred Years' War, and was canonized as a Roman Catholic saint. Her true story is so extraordinary that it has become a mystery of the ages.

items.title: The Incredible Journey of Apollo 12
items.description: It's the ultimate buddy movie. Pete Conrad and Alan Bean were the second pair of Apollo astronauts to land on the moon. They combined precision with a sense of humor. But it was the rocks they picked up that would define the mission's legacy.

items.title: The Chair
items.description: In 100 years, the electric chair has killed more than 4,000 prisoners, more than any other means of execution in America. It has become the symbol of America's death penalty. This is the story of the very first electric chair killing.

items.title: Malaria: The Serial Killer
items.description: Even in this age of modern medicine, malaria kills twice as many people as AIDS. Despite this vast death count, progress in the fight against this disease is marked with relative indifference. Why is this?

items.title: The Paperboy

items.title: Leaves of Grass

items.title: In Hell (Broadcast Edit)

items.title: Elephant White

items.title: Night Fishing
items.description: A haunting ghost story from the director of Oldboy. A man gets tangled in his fishing line and an eerie mystery when he catches more than he bargained for.

items.title: Nature Calls
items.description: Determined to honor his father's scouting legacy and mount one last comeback for his dwindling troop, an Assistant Scoutmaster convinces a group of kids to secretly ditch a slumber party in favor of a weekend scout trip.

items.title: The Bad News Bears (1976)
items.description: A major surprise as one of 1976's top-grossing films. THE BAD NEWS BEARS is a movie about children that is refreshing, utterly believable, and quite cleverly funny.

items.title: Hitler's Favourite Royal
items.description: Prince Charles Edward was Queen Victoria's youngest grandchild. Transformed overnight from a British Prince to a German Duke, his life was altered in ways he could never have imagined.

items.title: Imperium - Vespasian: The Path to Power
items.description: Vespasian, one of the Roman Empire’s finest emperors remains largely unknown. Yet his reign in 1st century AD transitioned a weakening Empire into a period of stability and growth.

items.title: Traci Townsend
items.description: A beautiful and successful journalist, interviews her three previous boyfriends, to find out why they never proposed. Each distinctly different interview, comically teaches Traci more about herself than she would care to know.

items.title: Back Roads
items.description: In 1993, Harley's dad is shot dead and his mom goes to prison. He has to earn money and look after his 3 kid sisters. No college. Over 2 years, family secrets are slowly revealed. Will a good therapist be enough?

items.title: Karma Calling
items.description: Call centers, Hindu hip-hop, and busybody aunties are toppings for this extra large slice of the immigrant story. The moral: Don't hang up on that call center operator. Karma is calling.
