items.title: Ultra Fight Orb
items.description: Ghost Sorcerer Reibatos, a new enemy that rises to fight Ultraman Zero and Ultraman Orb, uses the vengeful spirits of deceased monsters for his own use.

items.title: The Howling: New Moon Rising
items.description: A number of brutal, werewolf-like slayings begin occurring in a small California town after the arrival of an unfamiliar motorcyclist.

items.title: Stronger Than Blood
items.description: Tommy and Sule are like brothers. They dream of opening an auto body shop together but Tommy gets caught up in a botched drug deal and is sent to a juvenile prison. After being released, he promised himself that he wouldn't touch anything illegal anymore.

items.title: My Name Is Myeisha
items.description: A hip-hop musical fantasia, My Name Is Myeisha chronicles the life of a young black woman in California's Inland Empire. My Name Is Myeisha is a profoundly moving story of self-discovery and the moments that make us who we are.

items.title: MacShayne: Winner Takes All
items.description: MacShayne is back, now he is the head of security at the hotel where he stayed in the previous movie. First he has to take care of the grandson of the hotel's CEO, who is a kleptomaniac.

items.title: MacShayne: Final Roll Of The Dice
items.description: MacShayne is back, now he is the head of security at the hotel where he stayed in the previous movie. First he has to take care of the grandson of the hotel's CEO, who is a kleptomaniac.

items.title: Jester Till
items.description: Jester Till is on his way to the city to visit his grandfather, the slightly absent-minded wizard Marcus. The old man brews up a magical happiness potion he feels the townsfolk need.

items.title: Ben
items.description: Ben the rat returns to lead a violent rodent army in this 1972 horror sequel to "Willard."

items.title: William Shatner's Gonzo Ballet
items.description: On a cold night in Milwaukee high art meets pop culture as award winning choreographer Margo Sappington premieres her latest ballet, "Common People", set to the music of William Shatner and Ben Folds from their album, Has Been.

items.title: Get A Life!
items.description: Directed by William Shatner, based on his hugely popular book, in which he examines the cultural phenomena of Star Trek, its fan-following and his own role within it.

items.title: Get Big
items.description: "Get Big" follows the misadventures of two friends, Alec and Nate, as they reconnect to attend a high school classmate's wedding.

items.title: Cut: Exposing FGM Worldwide
items.description: Part adventure travelogue, part athropological study, and certainly an explosive human rights exposé, Cut investigates the secret practice of female genital mutilation (FGM) globally.

items.title: Elian
items.description: ELIÁN is the remarkable story about Elián González, a five-year-old Cuban boy plucked from the Florida coast in 1999, and how the fight over his future sparked a flashpoint for simmering US and Cuban tensions.

items.title: Embrace
items.description: EMBRACE follows Taryn’s crusade as she explores the global issue of body loathing, inspiring us to change the way we feel about ourselves and think about our bodies.

items.title: Fallen
items.description: A Police Officer is killed in the line of duty every 53 hours in the United States. Giving these heroes a voice, FALLEN tells their stories through the eyes of the partners, families, and communities they left behind.

items.title: General Magic
items.description: From the first smartphones to social media, eBay to emojis, the ideas that dominate our lives were born at a 1989 tech startup you’ve never heard of. ‘General Magic’ is a tale of how a great vision and an epic failure changed the world.

items.title: Getting Over
items.description: A man discovers a box of interviews with his father, a heroin addict who died of AIDS in 1997. What he finds will uncover generations of family secrets, forcing him to redefine his own past, doubt his present, and question his future.

items.title: Ghost and Demon Children of the Damned
items.description: Ghosts and demons send chills up your spine, but there is something extra disturbing when they are Children! Meet Children of the Damned who can be found shrieking in tunnels, moving objects, animating dolls, haunting the living and looking for revenge.

items.title: The Sensitives
items.description: What if pesticides, perfumes, and even cell phones made you sick? For many suffering from environmental illnesses, modern life has become toxic. The Sensitives captures the upheaval and hope of families seized by a mysterious illness.

items.title: The Bill Murray Stories: Life Lessons Learned from a Mythical Man
items.description: Following one man's journey to find meaning in Bill Murray's many unexpected adventures with people. Whether it be singing karaoke with strangers or crashing a kickball game, Bill Murray shows us what living in the moment is all about.

items.title: Father's Kingdom
items.description: Father's Kingdom is the untold story of a remarkable American civil rights pioneer, Father Divine, who at one time had over a million followers worldwide but whose story is little known because he claimed that he was God incarnate.

items.title: Kon Tiki
items.description: This is the classic Academy-Award winning documentary film of an astonishing adventure, a journey spanning 4,300 nautical miles across the Pacific Ocean by raft.

items.title: Arangol
items.description: La vida de un héroe anónimo que se convierte en el Cid Campeador del fútbol en un país que juega béisbol.

items.title: La batalla de Los Ángeles
items.description: En febrero de 1942, las fuerzas estadounidenses atacaron un objeto volador no identificado sobre Los Ángeles. Ahora, casi 70 años después, los invasores extraterrestres han regresado.

items.title: Pandemia lupina
items.description: Un joven fotógrafo de vida silvestre aterriza en el aeropuerto JFK infectado con una enfermedad extraña. En línea en la aduana, de repente se convierte en un hombre lobo. Todos a los que muerde que no mueren, "se vuelven" también.

items.title: A Christmas Snow
items.description: For the past 30 years, Kathleen (Catherine Mary Stewart) has carried around the haunting memory of her father abandoning her and her mother on Christmas Eve. She has to choose between letting go and grabbing hold of a life-changing forgiveness.

items.title: Wild Horses
items.description: An over-the-hill rodeo champion gets fired from his assembly line job in Texas. He and a buddy then decide to head to Wyoming to get a job herding mustangs.

items.title: 5 Weddings
items.description: A journalist writing a story on Punjabi weddings falls in love with her liaison officer who is trying to keep her story censored amidst a colorful mosaic of transgender dancers and cultural clashes.

items.title: A Doggone Christmas
items.description: A dog with telepathic abilities escapes a government lockdown and runs straight into the loving arms of two young brothers. But the Washington brass won’t give up their secret weapon that easily.

items.title: America's Sweethearts: The Queens of Nashville
items.description: Chronicles the incredible careers of five country music superstars from their unassuming beginnings to the world's largest stages, with special antidotes from the artists themselves, friends, family and their influence on other artists.

items.title: Great Barrier Reef
items.description: Explore the paradise in Australia that is home to a large diversity of species including turtles, colorful fish and coral reefs. Accompany underwater cinematographers on their journey through this miracle of nature.

items.title: Love's Kitchen
items.description: After a poor review from a critic, a talented chef turns a country pub into a gourmet eatery. His dessert catches the eye of Kate, and they soon discover that the recipe for true happiness is a pinch of teamwork and a whole lot of love.

items.title: The 12 Dogs of Christmas
items.description: A widowed father sends his daughter to stay with her aunt in a town that has outlawed dogs. When she decides to keep a stray puppy, she is inspired to help the dogs and charm the mayor with the most memorable Christmas pageant ever.

items.title: The Standoff
items.description: When eight alpha teens vie to win a car there's only one rule--keep a hand on the automobile until you're the last one standing. They will go to any length to win, and with a new car at stake, noone is backing down—even for romance!

items.title: Ultimate Justice
items.description: When the daughter of their commander is kidnapped, a team of elite soldiers are called back into action. The mission to track down the daughter causes the team to sacrifice their lives to uncover the truth, save her and deliver justice.

items.title: Evolution
items.description: Embark on a journey through the depths of the ocean, the beautiful savannah and the majestic forest to discover amazing creatures and the characteristics they have developed to evolve and adapt to their environment.

items.title: Worth
items.description: After losing his wife in a drunk driving accident, the husband begins attending an AA meeting that happens to be run by his wife’s reformed killer. Can this man repent before he commits the ultimate sin and gets his revenge?

items.title: All Roads Lead Home
items.description: When Belle, struggling with the loss of her mom, is sent to live with her grandfather, she soon becomes the savior of all living things! An old race horse and Atticus the dog change Belle’s life, and in turn the life of those who love her.

items.title: Anything Is Possible
items.description: Piano prodigy Nathan runs away after he discovers that his mother is reported MIA and his dad isn't his biological father. He becomes the star attraction at a benefit concert, reconnects with his dad and realizes that anything is possible.

items.title: Closer To God: Jessica's Journey
items.description: A young girl dying of cancer struggles with her family to find meaning in their lives and turn to God for healing.

items.title: Vegas Baby
items.description: From executive producer Morgan Spurlock, this documentary chronicles the lives of Americans who turn to in vitro fertilization contests as their only hope of starting a family.

items.title: Silicon Cowboys
items.description: Three friends dream up the Compaq portable computer at a Texas diner in 1981, and soon find themselves battling mighty IBM for PC supremacy. Their improbable journey altered the future of computing and shaped the world we now know.

items.title: Man with a Gun
items.description: In this thrilling crime drama, Michael Madsen plays an assassin who is hired to kill the woman he loves. Co-starring Jennifer Tilly and Gary Busey.

items.title: Crossed the Line
items.description: A young woman refuses to bow down to the local criminal kingpin who wants to take control of her late mother's flower shop in order to run drugs. However, when he crosses the line, she and her siblings seek revenge.

items.title: Chaos On The Bridge
items.description: Acting legend William Shatner takes viewers inside the creation of Star Trek: The Next Generation, the bold attempt in 1986 to recreate the success of the original television series, in which Shatner played Captain James T. Kirk.

items.title: The Captains
items.description: The original Captain Kirk, William Shatner, travels around the globe to interview the elite group of actors (Patrick Stewart, Chris Pine, Scott Bakula, Avery Brooks and more) who have portrayed the role of Enterprise Captain.

items.title: Human Rights Concerts: A Conspiracy of Hope, Part 1
items.description: On January 21, 1989, on the evening following the presidential inauguration, some of the biggest names in classic rhythm and blues performed at the Washington Convention Center at the Presidential Inaugural Concert.

items.title: Human Rights Concerts: A Conspiracy of Hope, Part 2
items.description: On January 21, 1989, on the evening following the presidential inauguration, some the biggest names in classic rhythm and blues performed at the Washington Convention Center at the Presidential Inaugural Concert.

items.title: Zombie Hunter
items.description: The world is turned into a wasteland full of zombies, and one man hunts down flesh eaters with his car and guns. He meets a group of survivors and helps them survive, putting his skills to the test.

items.title: White Haired Witch
items.description: Leaders frame Jade Raksha, a powerful sorceress, for a murder to turn the peasants against her. Zhou Yihang, the leader of the Wudang clan, is sent to investigate the crime, and ends up falling for the mysterious woman.

items.title: Vengeance of an Assassin
items.description: An assassin escapes a battle and hides out in his childhood home. As he recovers, he realizes he has to fight faster and harder to survive.

items.title: These Final Hours
items.description: A self-obsessed young man makes his way to the party-to-end-all-parties on the last day on Earth, but ends up saving the life of a little girl searching for her father. Their relationship ultimately leads him on the path to redemption.

items.title: The Truth About Emanuel
items.description: A troubled girl (Emanuel) becomes preoccupied with her mysterious new neighbor (Linda), who bears a striking resemblance to her dead mother. In offering to baby-sit Linda's newborn, Emanuel unwittingly enters a fragile, fictional world.

items.title: The Timber
items.description: In the wild west, two brothers embark on a journey to collect a bounty in a desperate attempt to save their home: but what they find along the way is more than they bargained for.

items.title: The Suspect
items.description: Betrayed and on the run, a North Korean agent tries to uncover the volatile secrets hidden inside the eyeglasses of a dead man.

items.title: The Road Within
items.description: A man with Tourette's syndrome brings his OCD roommate and an anorexic woman along on a road trip to bring his late mother's ashes to the ocean.

items.title: The Pirates
items.description: A band of pirates and a group of bandits fight to catch a grey whale that has swallowed a royal stamp.

items.title: The Man From Nowhere
items.description: A quiet pawnshop keeper with a violent past takes on a drug-and-organ trafficking ring in hope of saving the child who is his only friend.

items.title: The Lookalike
items.description: Two crooks, looking out for a drug lord's love interest, scramble to find a look-alike after she dies unexpectedly.

items.title: The Assassin
items.description: During the ninth century, a general's young daughter is kidnapped and trained to become an exceptional assassin. When she doesn't execute a mission, she is ordered to kill her betrothed, forcing her to choose between love, family and the assassins.

items.title: The Adventurers
items.description: An infamous and charismatic thief joins forces with two other criminals to pull off the heist of a lifetime. They must take their game to the next level when a legendary French detective begins to pursue them across Europe.

items.title: Tai Chi Zero
items.description: A gifted martial artist protects his adopted village from a villain who wants to build a railroad through the centre of the community.

items.title: Sword of Vengeance
items.description: Vengeance is the driving force behind a shadow walker's return to Norman conquered Saxon lands after the Battle of Hastings and the brutal repression of its people by a cruel lord.

items.title: Swelter
items.description: Ten years after their casino heist, four escaped convicts trace their former partner to a desert town, where he is now a lawman with no memory of his criminal past.

items.title: Supremacy
items.description: A just paroled white neo-nazi and his ruthless girlfriend kill a cop and take an African-American family hostage.

items.title: Special ID
items.description: An undercover cop (Donnie Yen) infiltrates one of China's most ruthless crime syndicates. He must risk everything to protect his family and his life after the boss (Collin Chou) vows to find and kill every traitor in his organization.

items.title: Saving Mr. Wu
items.description: Mr. Wu, a Hong Kong movie star, is kidnapped by four unpredictable criminals disguised as police officers. Will he get rescued?

items.title: Monkey King 2
items.description: The Monkey King must protect a traveling monk from White Bone Spirit, a demon who seeks immortality.

items.title: Memories of the Sword
items.description: While in medieval Korea, a young girl sets out to revenge the betrayal and the death of her mother. But therefore she must face one of the most powerful men and warriors of the Goryo Dynasty.

items.title: Kung Fu Yoga
items.description: Using his vast knowledge of history and kung fu, Jack leads his team on a race around the world to beat the mercenaries to the treasure and save an ancient culture.

items.title: Interview with a Hitman
items.description: An elite hit man tries to erase his past, and he is shocked to learn that someone has messed up his future.

items.title: I'll Follow You Down
items.description: After a scientist disappears during a business trip, his son (Haley Joel Osment) and wife (Gillian Anderson) struggle to cope, then they make a bizarre discovery years later that may bring him home.

items.description: A taut, solidly constructed action thriller with uncommon intelligence, Drug War delivers exhilarating set pieces without skimping on sophisticated filmmaking.

items.title: Dead Snow: Red vs Dead
items.description: Dead Snow 2: Red vs. Dead expands the original's canvas without sacrificing any of its bloody fun, adding up to a sequel that fans of the first are bound to enjoy.

items.title: Commitment
items.description: The son of a North Korean spy decides to follow in his father's footsteps to protect his little sister.

items.title: Better Watch Out
items.description: On a quiet suburban street, a babysitter must defend a twelve-year-old boy from intruders, only to discover it's far from a normal home invasion.

items.description: A guy decides to sell weed after losing his job, but things soon go out of hand as demand of business and paranoia starts taking over.

items.title: Badges of Fury
items.description: In just 3 days, three cases of Smiling Murder shock Hong Kong. The young detective Wang Bu'er and his buddy Huang Feihong embark on an investigation full of excitement and unexpected events.

items.title: A Single Shot
items.description: The tragic death of a beautiful young girl starts a tense and atmospheric game of cat and mouse between hunter John Moon and the hardened backwater criminals out for his blood.

items.title: A Company Man
items.description: When a change of heart moves a well-trained hitman to tender his resignation to his employers, no good comes of it for anyone.

items.title: The Hydra
items.description: “The Hydra” is about the rise of ecstasy and other synthetic drugs in Europe after the collapse of the Soviet Union in the early 1990s. The film tells the extraordinary covert operation to bring down the drug cartels.

items.title: Wonder Dogs
items.description: When the universe's highest-flying dogs warp into outer space, Skyfetcher and Spaceslobber get a call from canine headquarters! It seems an unknown force is attacking unsuspecting planets, and it's up to them to root out the source of the trouble!

items.title: Shadows of Sofia
items.description: Filmmaker Kevin Booth travels to Bulgaria where a clandestine meeting with an Oligarchs' notorious banker reveals all, transforming the story into a political adventure- an entire country controlled by a shadowy mafia boss linked to the KGB

items.title: Burying Yasmeen
items.description: After his recently deceased ex-wife comes to him in a dream promising eternal unity, Jason embarks on a desert odyssey to return the wedding ring to her cold dead finger before she's buried forever.

items.title: Indistinguishable From Magic
items.description: Aliens are real and the greatest conspiracy ever is the cover-up to this shocking truth. Nick Pope, who ran the UFO program at the UK Ministry of Defense now reveals how the world will change forever the day the Aliens arrive.

items.title: The Last Merchants of Venice
items.description: This is the fascinating story of Venice from the late 19th century, to the rise of Mussolini, through the saga of one of its richest families: the Stucky family.

items.title: Ninja: Shadow Of A Tear
items.description: Ninjutsu master Casey is back and out for revenge when his pregnant wife is murdered.

items.title: Entertainment
items.description: An aging comedian tours the California desert. Fueled by the promise of a lucrative Hollywood engagement and the possibility of rekindling a relationship with his daughter, he trudges through a series of increasingly surreal and volatile encounters.

items.title: Jay Sebring....Cutting To The Truth
items.description: Follows the life of artist, designer, and entrepreneur Jay Sebring, who was murdered alongside Sharon Tate by followers of Charles Manson.

items.title: Princess Emmy
items.description: Princess Emmy is a young girl with a secret gift – she is the only one in the Kingdom of Kandis who can speak to horses.

items.title: Lazy Susan
items.description: Susan (Hayes) has always been the self-centered oddball in her family who lazily skated through life with their begrudging support until one day she wakes up to realize she's middle-aged with no job, no relationship, and an increasingly estranged family.

items.title: Kate & Leopold
items.description: When a rip in time brings together a charming 19th-century bachelor and a thoroughly 21st-century woman, the potential for an old-fashioned modern romance ignites!

items.title: Flash Point
items.description: The creators of Kill Zone take action to the next level with a breakthrough combination of hard-hitting mixed martial arts battles and nail-biting tension.

items.title: Kid Cannabis
items.description: A high-school dropout and his 27-year-old friend smuggle marijuana across the Canadian border to make money.

items.title: Not Suitable for Children
items.description: A womanizer learns he has one month before he becomes sterile, so he tries to impregnate a woman before it's too late.

items.title: Little Big Soldier
items.description: An old soldier captures a young general after a battle in China and takes him on a long journey to collect a reward.

items.title: Kung Fu Killer (2014)
items.description: Released from prison, a kung-fu expert (Donnie Yen) tries to help the police find a vicious serial killer (Wang Baoqiang) who targets martial-arts masters.

items.title: Down a Dark Hall
items.description: Based on Lois Duncan's young adult thriller, story follows Kit Gordy, a new student at Blackwood Boarding School, who must unlock the mysteries of the school's tragic past.

items.title: The Glass Castle
items.description: Based on the worldwide best-selling memoir starring Academy Award® winner Brie Larson and Academy Award® nominees Woody Harrelson and Naomi Watts, THE GLASS CASTLE chronicles the adventures of an eccentric, resilient, tight-knit family.

items.title: The Three Musketeers (2011)
items.description: A gifted ensemble cast sparks this bold retelling of Alexander Dumas’ classic tale of friendship and heroism. With Christoph Waltz as wily Cardinal Richelieu.

items.title: 12 Days of Christmas
items.description: Two childhood friends spend their college winter break navigating reunions, romances, and even an unplanned pregnancy.

items.title: I Met a Girl
items.description: An aspiring musician embarks on an epic, cross-country journey to find the woman of his dreams… who may be all in his head.

items.title: The Argument
items.description: When a couple has an argument at a party, and neither will admit to being wrong, they decide to recreate the evening again and again in order to determine who was right. But this leads to even more confusion, and soon everyone is arguing.

items.title: The Mole Agent
items.description: When a family grows concerned for their mother’s well-being in a retirement home, private investigator Romulo hires 83-year-old Sergio to become a new resident and a mole inside the home.

items.title: Miracle in the Desert: The Rise and Fall of the Salton Sea
items.description: The Salton Sea is an unfolding environmental disaster of extraordinary magnitude that threatens the health of millions of Californians.

items.title: One Hour Outcall
items.description: One Hour Outcall is a sexy drama unraveling the complex relationship between an escort and her client who meet every Thursday night. Their interludes force the man to confront his relationship with his family and his own demons.

items.title: Humboldt: The New Season
items.description: A look at how families, survivors and a community are pulling together to heal after the devastating bus crash.

items.title: Machine
items.description: A hard-hitting and eye-opening documentary about artificial intelligence, the most radical new technology of our time.

items.title: Krow's Transformation
items.description: Follows Krow as he begins transitioning from female to male, putting his modelling career on hold.

items.title: Literary Ink: A Wizard's Journey
items.description: Literary Ink follows four tattoo artists at the first ever wizard themed tattoo convention in the world.

items.title: Clueless
items.description: A US West Coast teen lifestyle parody centered around Cher, a popular high school girl who spends her days playing match-maker, helping her friends with fashion choices, and looking for a boyfriend.

items.title: A River Between Us
items.description: A River Between Us tells the story of the oldest and most bitterly disputed water war in the West and chronicles efforts to achieve the largest restoration project in American history.

items.title: An Act of Love
items.description: In 2013 Rev. Frank Schaefer was put on trial in the United Methodist Church for officiating his son's same-sex wedding. The film explores the family’s struggle and the movement for LGBTQ equality in the nation’s 2nd largest protestant denomination

items.title: A Brony Tale
items.description: A film about men... who like "My Little Pony."

items.title: DTF
items.description: A filmmaker follows his friend and widowed pilot across the world, to find love on Tinder. The quest spins to an expose of depraved behaviour.

items.title: Girl Most Likely
items.description: Kristen Wiig stars in this sweet and funny movie about a failed playwright who is forced to move home with her eccentric mother (Annette Bening).

items.title: Game of Death
items.description: Billy Lo, a champion fighter and movie star, fakes his death to escape and then expose the crime syndicate that wants to control him.

items.title: Strictly Ballroom
items.description: A championship ballroom dancer finds inspiration within, and decides he'll stop at nothing to win, even if it means rewriting the rules. A worldwide feel-good hit, with an incredible soundtrack, from director Baz Luhrmann (MOULIN ROUGE!).

items.title: The Great Raid
items.description: As World War II rages, the elite 6th Ranger Battalion is given a mission of heroic proportions: push 30 miles behind enemy lines and liberate over 500 American prisoners of war.

items.title: Venus
items.description: Life for a pair of veteran actors gets turned upside down after they meet a brash teenager.

items.title: The Forger
items.description: A teenager wanders into Carmel, California, where he is soon introduced to the art-forgery community.

items.title: Peter Pan
items.description: Mary Martin takes on the role of Peter Pan, the boy who refuses to grow up, in this made-for-TV family special. Together with sidekick Tinker Bell, Peter Pan visits the bedroom of Wendy, Michael, and John Darling.

items.title: A Christmas Without Snow
items.description: A recently divorced woman (Michael Learned of The Waltons) joins a church choir in time to learn Handel's Messiah for the holidays. The music is daunting, and the choir director is a taskmaster, but the experience helps her cope with her failed marriage .

items.title: Scary Movie 2
items.description: Four teens are tricked by their professor into visiting a haunted house for a school project.

items.title: Scary Movie
items.description: The spoof that started it all. Scream with the Wayans brothers, Carmen Electra, Shannon Elizabeth, and Anna Faris as they bumble and shriek their way to horror-movie hilarity in Scary Movie.

items.title: The Gambler Returns Part 2
items.description: The Gambler Brady Hawkes is back and he's about to lose his primary means of livelihood, when a law banning gambling is about to be passed.

items.title: The Gambler Returns Part 1
items.description: The Gambler Brady Hawkes is back and he's about to lose his primary means of livelihood, when a law banning gambling is about to be passed.

items.title: Pete's Meteor
items.description: Pete is a streetwise ex-junkie running from the mob. After his two best friends die, he feels obligated to help raise their three kids who now live with their grandmother.

items.title: A Fantastic Fear Of Everything
items.description: A crime novelist whose research on Victorian serial killers has turned him into a paranoid wreck must confront his worst fears when a film executive takes a sudden interest in his movie script.

items.title: Serving Sara
items.description: Joe Tyler is a process server who will do anything to deliver legal documents to victims. But nothing in Joe's bag of tricks prepares him for Sara, the stunning, soon-to-be ex-wife of a playboy cattle baron named Gordon Moore.

items.title: El ataque del tiburón de dos cabezas
items.description: Los sobrevivientes escapan a un atolón desierto después de que su barco del programa Semester at Sea sea hundido por un tiburón mutante de dos cabezas. Pero cuando el atolón comienza a inundarse, nadie está a salvo de las dobles fauces del monstruo.

items.title: Cocaine Cowboys 2
items.description: The sequel follows cocaine dealer Charles Crosby beginning in 1991 on the inner-city streets of Oakland, California. The story of Griselda Blanco is presented in greater depth.

items.title: Food as Medicine
items.description: From personal healing, inspiration grew to create a positive film about people addressing disease with food.

items.title: Her Composition
items.description: A talented, artistically stuck composition student starts seeing escort clients after failing to secure her scholarship. Struck with unexpected sounds during her sexual encounters, she turns them into music and the clients into her muse.

items.title: Induced Effect
items.description: Two blue collar workers form an unlikely partnership of selling illegal prescription pills to make ends meet while trying to avoid disastrous mishaps.

items.title: Ladies On Laughter
items.description: A documentary about six women of color trying to make it as stand up comedians in North Carolina. The documentary exposes some of the discrimination women of color face from event promoters, male comedians and society.

items.title: I Want to Believe
items.description: A thrilling study of the UFO phenomenon and the people who dedicate their lives to it.

items.title: 7 Hills
items.description: Unlocked Films' presents 7Hills, a feature length documentary showcasing refugee kids who frequent the 7 Hills skate park in Amman, Jordan.

items.title: An Eye for an Eye
items.description: In the aftermath of 9/11 Mark Stroman went on a shooting spree to kill people he thought looked arab. He was put on death row but in a twist of fate his only surviving victim became his biggest advocate. A true story of hate, revenge, and redemption.

items.title: Motown Mafia
items.description: Eddie 'The Fat Man' Jackson and Courtney 'The Field Marshal' Brown were labeled 'Kingpins' in an era where their names reigned supreme in Detroit.

items.title: Origin Story
items.description: When Kulap Vilaysack was 14, she took her father's side in an argument and her mother replied, 'Why are you defending him? He's not your real dad.' Twenty years later, she's finally ready to explore what that means.

items.title: Ruminations
items.description: A documentary profile on Rumi Missabu, the iconoclast cofounder of San Francisco's infamous Cockettes.

items.title: Sincerely, Brenda
items.description: After a sudden tragedy, a recovering alcoholic, attempts to reconcile with his two estranged sons over a weekend, but the encounter reveals skeletons from the family's past that he must accept, or risk losing his sons forever.

items.title: Stop at Nothing
items.description: An intimate but explosive portrait of the man behind the greatest fraud in sporting history. Lance Armstrong enriched himself by cheating his fans, his sport, and the truth.

items.title: Surprise Me!
items.description: What if pain was merely a set up for the ultimate surprise party? Genie Burns, owner of Surprise Enterprise, masterminds off the wall surprise parties in nobody would-suspect-it locations.

items.title: Switch
items.description: Tasha (Crystal Hilliard) wants her husband James (Ken Thompson) to make love to her like when they first met. James needs her to understand it takes a lot to run a successful business and he hasn't had the energy to make love lately.

items.title: Take Me Out
items.description: Take Me Out is a dramatic, feature film with baseball at its center, about an upper class, black suburban, Chicago family. It will explore marriage, infidelity, education, and teenager relationships.

items.title: M.O.M. Mothers of Monsters
items.description: A distraught mother suspects her teenage son is a psychopath who may shoot up his high school, but when he outsmarts the system, she is forced to take matters into her own hands.

items.title: Wamplers Ascent
items.description: Stephen J Wampler scales "El Capitan" in Yosemite National Park. Stephen has a severe form of Cerebral Palsy and overcomes diversity and physical challenges by doing 20,000 pull ups over 6 days to summit El Capitan.

items.title: Underneath the Same Moon
items.description: A happily married man loses his memory in a car accident. He awakens from a coma losing the last 5 years of his memory. He wakes with the last memory of being about to propose to his Ex. Will his heart remember what his mind forget.

items.title: Art Paul of Playboy Man Behind the Bunny
items.description: A feature-length documentary film on the life and impact of Art Paul, the founding art director of Playboy magazine, creator of the iconic bunny logo and prolific artist,who blurred the lines between commercial and fine art.

items.title: A Deeper Shade of Blue
items.description: This is not a surf movie, it is a film about surfing's deepest roots: in the subconscious; in ancient lore; in the craft of surfboard building; in man's perpetual quest for a joyful relationship with the natural world.

items.title: Please Come With Me
items.description: In this exploration of love, commitment, and trust, a long-time couple is forced to navigate the delicate waters of their relationship and the life-changing events they experience over the course of a year.

items.title: Boogaloo Shrimp
items.description: The life story of Michael Chambers aka "Boogaloo Shrimp: the dancer, actor, singer, comedian and master of waving, ticking, backsliding and liquid animation dance during the 1980's breakdancing phenomenon.

items.title: Marsha Hunt's Sweet Adversity
items.description: In 1935, 17-year-old aspiring actress Marsha Hunt was discovered in Hollywood. She signed with Paramount Pictures and went on to a flourishing career at MGM.

items.title: Fat Fiction
items.description: Fat Fiction reveals how the United States government relied on questionable evidence to support one of the most damaging public health recommendations in the history of our country: the “low fat diet.”

items.title: Making Apes: The Artists Who Changed Film
items.description: Making Apes tells the emotional and thrilling story of how 50 years ago, a group of ambitious make-up artists led by John Chambers and Tom Burman ushered in a new era of cinema with their groundbreaking work on Planet of the Apes.

items.title: Lobster War: The Fight Over The World's Richest Fishing Grounds
items.description: Lobster War is an award-winning film about a climate-fueled conflict between the US and Canada over waters both countries have claimed since the end of the Revolutionary War.

items.title: Addiction Incorporated
items.description: A drug researcher hired by a tobacco company unexpectedly discovers the ingredients of addiction and fuels a national campaign to have it regulated.

items.title: Adjust Your Color: The Life of Petey Greene
items.description: Actor Don Cheadle narrates this insightful documentary that explores the life and times of Petey Greene, the bombastic radio DJ-activist who rose to national prominence in the 1960s.

items.title: Bridegroom
items.description: Shane Bitney Crone's plans to marry Tom Bridegroom in California after the same-sex marriage law is passed takes a tragic turn when his partner of six years accidentally dies and Tom's family refuses Shane from attending the funeral.

items.title: Cyber-Seniors
items.description: A humorous and heartwarming documentary feature, CYBER-SENIORS chronicles the extraordinary journey of a group of senior citizens as they discover the world of the Internet through the guidance of teenage mentors.

items.title: Eyes of the Mothman
items.description: A feature length documentary of the real story behind the legend of The Mothman.

items.title: How to Beat a Bully
items.description: This is a family comedy with an anti-bullying theme. When a new kid named Cory moves to town, he's picked on by the school bullies.

items.title: This Is Happening
items.description: An estranged brother and sister are forced on the road when the grandmother they've been sent to place into a home flees to Seattle. Little does grandma know that she's hauling her granddaughter's secret marijuana buy in the trunk of her car.

items.title: Joyland
items.description: Pooda Johnson is celebrating his last weekend on house arrest with a kickback (party) that could jeopardize the very freedom he's celebrating.

items.title: Sunshine Day
items.description: A once happy wife and mother of eight world is turned upside down when her husband begins displaying signs of mental illness.

items.title: Love is Not Enough
items.description: The love and lives of recent college graduates and the pitfalls they must overcome dating and in corporate America.

items.title: Don't Let the Night End
items.description: After an injury upends her ambitious career as a dancer, Mia escapes her life in Tel Aviv for a temporary stay in Brooklyn.

items.title: Every 40 Years
items.description: An exploration of Gunhill Road's return to music 40 years after breaking into the Billboard Top 40 charts in 1973. Every 40 Years is about second chances and the power of chasing your dream down one more time.

items.title: Confused By Love
items.description: A non-social author and his wife, invites his successful best friend & former ex-girlfriend to stay with them to save their home from foreclosure.

items.title: Convict
items.description: War vet Ray is sent o prison for manslaughter and has to navigate his way around a new kind of war. The only way to get back to his girl is to get down in the gutter and fight dirty.

items.title: Elephants
items.description: A true indie film through and through, Elephants takes an authentic look at a modern relationship in a "slice of life" style.

items.title: Christopher Titus: Amerigeddon
items.description: Stand-up comic Christopher Titus takes the stage for his eighth stand up comedy special with one goal in mind, uniting America.

items.title: Cherry
items.description: An Ivy League freshman gets an unexpected education when he falls for an older woman and her 14 year-old daughter develops a crush on him.

items.title: Broken Ceiling
items.description: When Angela Walker is passed over for yet another promotion, she decides she's going to have to break through the invisible corporate barriers once and for all.

items.title: Before the Dawn
items.description: A young high school teacher moves to a new town for a fresh start and falls for a troubled student.

items.title: Scream
items.description: After a series of mysterious deaths, an offbeat group of scary movie fans becomes the target of a masked killer in this smash-hit thriller from legendary director Wes Craven (A NIGHTMARE ON ELM STREET) that breathed new life into the horror genre.

items.title: Scream 2
items.description: While away at college, Sidney Prescott thought she'd finally put the terror behind her...until a copycat killer begins acting out a real-life sequel in which no one is safe or beyond suspicion.

items.title: Scream 3
items.description: The first film set the rules. In the sequel, the stakes got higher. In the third installment of the hit franchise SCREAM, all bets are off. It's an insidious game of horror movie mayhem with surprising twists and turns.

items.title: Find Me
items.description: An emotionally wounded accountant decides to break away from routine and find his missing friend, who has left clues for him of her whereabouts throughout National Parks across the West.

items.title: Madman
items.description: Around a crackling campfire, T.P, one of the head counselors at a camp, sings the spooky, "Song Of The Fifth Wind", to the campers and counselors: Betsy, Ellie, Dave, Stacy, Bill, and Max, the older camp director.

items.title: Killing Jimmy Hoffa
items.description: Jimmy Hoffa was one of America's most powerful men. He fought the Kennedy's, made deals with the Mafia, and controlled 2 million union members. Then he disappeared.

items.title: American Dope White Powder Black Power
items.description: Slavery had been over 100 years before large amounts of capital flowed into Black America for the first time- and it came from illegal drugs.

items.title: Idaho The Movie
items.description: Idaho, the Movie is a one-hour television documentary featuring the well known and the hidden treasures of Idaho. An elemental theme carries viewers on a tour of the state's mountains, rivers, deserts, landscapes, lakes and more.

items.title: Chasing After You
items.description: Chasing After You takes a twist on modern romance, after a young male pursues a single mother with no interest in a relationship; other than her one with God.

items.title: Standing Ovation
items.description: About a group of friends competing in a national tween music video contest. Enter a world of hilarious adventures, original songs and never before seen dance routines. You will be left believing in the power of childhood dreams.

items.title: The Aristocrats
items.description: One hundred superstar comedians tell the same very, VERY dirty, filthy joke--one shared privately by comics since Vaudeville.

items.title: The Adventures of SharkBoy and Lavagirl
items.description: From Robert Rodriguez, the director of the SPY KIDS franchise comes another superhero adventure for the entire family. This is the extraordinary tale of a girl with the force of a volcano who teams up with a boy raised by Great White sharks.

items.title: Adventureland
items.description: From the director of SUPERBAD comes a coming-of-age comedy of big dreams, hysterical consequences, and young love, set in a run-down amusement park.

items.title: Bridget Jones's Baby
items.description: Bridget Jones is back, this time unexpectedly pregnant and unsure of the baby's father. Patrick Dempsey joins Oscar® winners Renée Zellweger and Colin Firth in this next chapter of Bridget's hysterically unpredictable life.

items.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 2: Texas Blood Money
items.description: When a gang of bank robbers makes a run for the border, they wander into the wrong bar and mess with the wrong vampires. It's kill-or-be-killed in the ultimate battle to stop these evil creatures and save their own lives!

items.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
items.description: In this thrilling cult classic, two dangerous outlaw brothers head out on a wild crime spree. After kidnapping a father and his two kids, the bad guys head to a seedy Mexican bar for safety, but come face to face with blood-sucking vampires.

items.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 3: Hangman's Daughter
items.description: Set in Mexico in the early 1900s, this prequel to the From Dusk Till Dawn series finds outlaw Johnny Madrid on the run from the hangman, with the hangman's daughter Esmeralda by his side. Together they are faced with the fight of their lives.

items.title: I Remember You
items.description: I REMEMBER YOU tells the story of a chance accident that leads to an unexpected romance, which echoes across time.

items.title: 12 Wishes of Christmas
items.description: A woman must set things right when a mysterious lady named Noel grants her 12 wishes and they magically come true for Christmas.

items.title: Christmas Matchmakers
items.description: Two hard-working executive assistants arrange for their bosses to fall in love during the holidays.

items.title: Christmas Town
items.description: A cynical workaholic gets suspicious of her banker father's sudden departure from his career and city life to move to a small town with unusually strong ties to Christmas.

items.title: A Christmas Princess
items.description: A prince from Europe comes to New York for a royal holiday dinner and falls in love with the chef that is planning the event.

items.title: Wilder
items.description: Detective Wilder (Pam Grier) and her partner Harland Lee (Romano Orzari) are tough cops. When they're assigned a strangulation case, their main suspect is Dr. Sam Charney (Rutger Hauer), the victim's former lover.

items.title: Witchtrap
items.description: A team of parapsychologists are hired to exorcise the evil spirit of a witch who is haunting an inn.

items.title: Split Second
items.description: In a futuristic London where rising sea levels have placed large areas of the city underwater, a burned-out cop is assigned to investigate a series of bizarre murders that point to a non-human killer.

items.title: Showdown
items.description: An ex-policeman/school janitor (Billy Blanks) shows a new student (Kenn Scott) how to defend himself from a martial-arts bully.

items.title: Sabotage
items.description: When a bodyguard fails to protect his client, he discovers ties between the assassins and a failed mission that ended a Navy career years earlier. With the help of an FBI agent, he will try to bring the killers to justice and clear his name.

items.title: Red Velvet
items.description: A man and a young woman have a chance encounter at a laundry mat which leads to a story about a birthday party where everyone has been killed by a madman in a white jumpsuit.

items.title: Only Thrill, The
items.description: A small-town store owner (Sam Shepard) with a comatose wife shares a long-term relationship with his seamstress (Diane Keaton).

items.title: Nico, the Unicorn
items.description: A 12-year-old disabled boy, whose father recently passed away, has his life changed when the pony he rescues gives birth to a unicorn. Can he save the unicorn from the people who want to exploit it?

items.title: Nemesis 3:  Prey Harder
items.description: The struggle continues between Cyborg and mankind with Alex and her superhuman DNA as the hope for humanity.

items.title: Nemesis 2:  Nebula
items.description: It has been 73 years since Alex failed and the humans lost the Cyborg Wars. When the Cyborgs learn that a young girl containing the DNA that could end their reign has been sent into the past, they dispatch the bounty hunter Nebula to kill her.

items.title: Nemesis
items.description: The year is 2027 and troubled cyborg cop Alex is ordered to apprehend his former partner Jared, accused of smuggling data to information terrorists plotting to kill government officials.

items.title: The List
items.description: High-class call girl Gabrielle (Madchen Amick) stages her own arrest in a scheme to blackmail her well-known clients. When the list is entered as evidence in court, the judge (Ryan O'Neal), faces a dilemma on whether or not to make the list public.

items.title: Lionheart
items.description: Jean-Claude Van Damme is Lyon Gaultier, a deserter in the French Foreign Legion who travels to the USA and enters the gory world of bare-knuckled street fighting in order to make money to save his brother's life and family.

items.title: Jack Frost
items.description: When his prison transport collides with a truck full of "genetic material," condemned serial killer Jack Frost (Scott MacDonald) is inexplicably transformed into a terrifying, murderous snowman.

items.title: In The Dark
items.description: After an accident, a woman hires a caretaker to help her adjust to life as a blind woman. Before long, she is embroiled in a fight for her life. Will she learn to protect herself using her only remaining senses in time to save her life?

items.title: In Sight
items.description: Kaitlyn, an ER nurse who is tending to a young stabbing victim, is accidentally electrocuted by the defibrillator that is used in an effort to save the woman’s life. Almost immediately Kaitlyn starts to experience the victim’s memories.

items.title: Falcon Rising
items.description: John "Falcon" Chapman (Michael Jai White) is an ex-marine driven by guilt and on the edge. He travels to Brazil to hunt down his sister's attackers and discovers an underground world of drugs, prostitution, and corruption ruled by the Japanese mafia.

items.title: Double Dragon
items.description: Evil meets its match in this daring martial arts adventure about two teen brothers out to stop an obsessed tycoon from finding both halves of a mystical talisman.

items.title: Digging to China
items.description: Kevin Bacon stars in this touching comedic look at the friendship between an adolescent girl and a mentally retarded young man.

items.title: Crazy Six
items.description: In a crumbling Europe, powerful mafia families have emerged from the anarchy to vie for control of the lucrative arms trade.

items.title: Cause of Death
items.description: DA Taylor Lewis (Patrick Bergin) finds himself falling for his chief suspect (Joan Severance) during a high profile murder investigation.

items.title: Boogie Boy
items.description: A man who has just been released from prison vows to start a new life but agrees to help a former cellmate and his motley gang take down one last score.

items.title: Bloodfight (aka Final Fight)
items.description: Years after retiring from the world of free fighting martial arts, a man returns to the ring of fighting after his best student is killed in the tournament.

items.title: Black Eagle
items.description: When one of the US Air Force’s most modern tactical aircraft crashes in the sea near Malta, the CIA dispatches their best agent to salvage the plane's advanced weapons system before it falls into enemy hands.

items.title: The Apocalypse
items.description: A Salvage pilot and a bartender go up against a crazed computer programmer who has armed a spaceship with nuclear weapons and plans to crash it into the earth.

items.title: All Tied Up
items.description: Ladies' man Brian has found true love with Linda, but before popping the big question, he can't resist one last fling. When Linda finds out, she and her roommate formulate a plan for revenge.

items.title: Alan Rudolph's Ray Meets Helen
items.description: In bizarre, unrelated turns of events, Ray and Helen each happen upon large sums of money which give them the chance to re-invent themselves.

items.title: Sorted
items.description: After the mysterious drowning death of his brother, Carl Dawson (Matthew Rhys) heads to London to investigate. Teaming up with his brothers beautiful girlfriend (Sienna Guillory), Carl delves into the heart of Londons wild, drug-crazed club scene.

items.title: Afterglow
items.description: Producer Robert Altman and director Alan Rudolph team up for this stylish dramedy about couples on the verge of complete fallout.

items.title: The Neon Bible
items.description: While on a train, a teenage boy thinks about his life and the flamboyant aunt whose friendship acted as an emotional shield from his troubled family. This film evokes the haunting quality of memory while creating a heartfelt portrait of a boy's life.

items.title: Napoleon Life of an Outlaw
items.description: Mutah Beale, better known as Napoleon of Tupac Shakur's infamous rap group "The Outlawz" goes through an emotional roller coaster since birth.

items.title: Texas Rangers
items.description: After the Civil War, Texas is at the mercy of murderous bandits. A group of unlikely heroes emerges to battle these renegade outlaws. Out-manned, they summon the courage to protect the innocent and put the wrong things right in their beloved homeland.

items.title: Undisputed
items.description: When the world's heavyweight champion is sent to prison, everything points to an inevitable showdown with the penitentiary's undefeated champ. But to make sure the meeting will happen, a former mob boss must call in favors from the outside world.

items.title: Yul Brynner: The Man Who Was King
items.description: There is only one Yul Brynner. No other actor had his looks, his range of talents, his energy, and his capacity to draw others into the spell of his charm.

items.title: William Holden: The Golden Boy
items.description: It was said of him that in more than seventy films, he never once gave a bad performance.

items.title: Walter Mathau: Diamond in the Rough
items.description: Walter Matthau was barely three when his father deserted the family. Poverty and New York street smarts produced a self-deprecating humor that never left.

items.title: Ultimate Roblox Tower Battle
items.description: Tiny Turtle and Bruno the Bear play Ultimate Tower Battle in Roblox.

items.title: The Worlds of Harry Connick Jr.
items.description: Narrated by Harry himself in a candid look at his own life and career, the program features interviews with jazz greats Branford and Wynton Marsalis and their father, Ellis Marsalis.

items.title: The Story of Lassie
items.description: For 50 years, she has represented all that is good about the enduring bonds between human beings and their dogs. She first leaped to stardom in the 1943 MGM film, Lassie Come Home.

items.title: Steve McQueen: Man on the Edge
items.description: Abandoned by his father, he was a reform school kid with nothing going for him and a giant chip on his shoulder. He joined the Marines, but never stayed far from trouble.

items.title: Deceitful Passions
items.description: Married but single, Vito quickly learns that love, lust and passion doesn't always mix.

items.title: Loving The Bad Man
items.description: When a young Christian girl has a baby boy from a rapist, she sets out to try and give her child a chance at a somewhat normal family by forgiving and visiting the man in prison.

items.title: A Holiday Boyfriend
items.description: Katie gets dumped right before Christmas and gets on a dating app to never spend Christmas alone!

items.title: A Kiss On Candy Cane Lane
items.description: Jennifer Monroe, a romance novelist returns home for the holiday reconnecting with her family and her childhood sweetheart.

items.title: Broken Memories
items.description: “Broken Memories” is a romantic drama that depicts the often-untold story of a family caregiver tending to an elderly parent.

items.title: One Small Hitch
items.description: On a flight home to Chicago for a family wedding, childhood friends Josh and Molly agree to fake an engagement for Josh's dying father. Things get crazy when their two boisterous families collide and cause them to start planning a phony wedding.

items.title: Metamorphosis
items.description: While exploring the wilds of the Carpathian Mountains, three young carefree Americans pick up an attractive stranger, Elizabeth, who will take them on the journey of their lives.

items.title: New Blood
items.description: Prodigal son Danny White makes a grand entrance back into his father Alan and sister Emma's lives when he returns after seven years, bleeding from a gunshot wound. The reunion is given urgency by the revelation that Emma is also in mortal danger.

items.title: Goosed
items.description: After a woman is informed by a psychic that the man of her dreams is a doctor named Steve, the woman desperately begins the search for the right "Steve".

items.title: Bullfighter
items.description: Olivier Martinez plays Jack, a rebel on the run with his pregnant girlfriend, Mary (Michelle Forbes) -- who may, against all odds, be carrying a baby with Messianic powers.

items.title: Bullet Boy
items.description: "Bullet Boy" is a gripping and authentic drama that takes an unflinching look at two troubled, street-smart boys who deal with the harsh realities of modern life in the inner city.

items.title: Resurrection of Jake The Snake
items.description: A fallen professional wrestling superstar battles his past demons in a struggle to reclaim his life and the family that has given up on him.

items.title: Where's Poppa?
items.description: Gordon finally meets the perfect girl, but his batty, eccentric mother is intent on ruining his chances. George Segal and Ruth Gordon shine in Carl Reiner's outrageous black comedy that stomps gleefully on the idea of devotion to Mom above all.

items.title: Valley Girl
items.description: When Valley Girl Julie (Deborah Foreman) dumps her preppy boyfriend, she unexpectedly finds love with rocker Randy (Nicolas Cage)...much to the dismay of her valley girlfriends who find Julie's punk hunk to be "grody to the max!" Fer Shure.

items.title: The Misfits
items.description: In their final screen performances, Clark Gable and Marilyn Monroe are at their luminous best as an aging cowboy and a disillusioned divorcee, each trying to adapt to new ways of life in John Huston's piercing classic. Montgomery Clift also stars.

items.title: Stay Hungry
items.description: Jeff Bridges and Sally Field star in this quirky, sensitive drama about a wealthy Southern bachelor who learns that money and charm have their limitations. Arnold Schwarzenegger also appears.

items.title: Rolling Thunder
items.description: William Devane and Tommy Lee Jones star as two former P.O.W.s out for revenge in this neo-noir action-thriller that Quentin Tarantino cites as one of his favorite films. Written by genre masters Paul Schrader and Heywood Gould. John Flynn directs.

items.title: 11 Grados de Culpa
items.description: 11 ex-compañeros de colegio disfrutan de una opulenta celebración y son sorprendidos por la inesperada visita de Mónica. Ella es asesinada en los jardines de la casa, lo que genera una investigación sobre su muerte.

items.title: The Human Torpedoes Of WWII
items.description: See the history of the mysterious 'Human Torpedoes' of WWII - and how they originated and developed upon the standard torpedo in top secret.

items.title: RiffTrax: Replica
items.description: RiffTrax, the guys who make movies funny, bring their comedic riffing treatment to another slice of cheese from Director James Nguyen (Birdemic)! Helping bring Replica to light may be either the greatest or worst thing we've ever done for the world.

items.title: Finding Yingying
items.description: After a young Chinese student goes missing on a university campus, her family travels to the U.S. for the first time. While unraveling the mystery of her disappearance, they discover how much her life has touched others.

items.title: Enter The Fire
items.description: On the run from the mob, Jake Bolt visits his estranged foster brother. As the mafia closes in, the two brothers must band together to fend off the mafia - while trying not to kill each other in the process.

items.title: Harriet And Herbert's Day At The Beach
items.description: Two hermit crabs, Harriet and Herbert, find friendship during their adventurous sunny day at the beach.

items.title: Nuyorican Básquet
items.description: The dramatic story of Puerto Rico's 1979 National Basketball Team, whose players were mainly born or raised in New York.

items.title: Look Away
items.description: Maria, an alienated high-school student, has her life turned upside down when she switches places with her sinister mirror image.

items.title: Children of 9/11
items.description: Ten years after September 11th2001, Children Of 9/11 gives a voice, for the first time, to the young people directly affected by that fateful day.

items.title: Blackmail
items.description: A struggling actor and taxi driver finds himself in possession of an incriminating DVD that a dirty cop wants to use to blackmail a politician.

items.title: Wolf
items.description: A family is shaken to the core when they discover that their son has been molested. As they struggle to deal with the betrayal, their son heads towards a total mental collapse because of his love for his abuser.

items.title: Nineteen Summers
items.description: Born in the generational Los Angeles street culture a 19-year-old father seeks a better life in the midst of a turf war.

items.title: Silverrain
items.description: Ajoa, a street girl (Kayayo's as they are called in Ghana, are street girls who live and work primarily in the market areas of Ghana), meets Bruce, the rich heir of the Timothy fortunes.

items.title: He Was A Quiet Man 2020
items.description: An office worker inadvertently becomes a hero after he saves a woman's life.

items.title: Netflix vs. The World
items.description: Two decades before there was a streaming war, a tiny, broke Silicon Valley company that rented DVDs by mail laid the foundation for a revolution in how the world watches entertainment today.

items.title: The Secrets Of Jonathan Sperry
items.description: In 1970, twelve-year-old Dustin befriends a wise old man after mowing his lawn. Senior citizen Jonathan Sperry, a devout Christian, starts mentoring Dustin and his two best friends.

items.title: Children Of Beqaa
items.description: Since March 15, 2011, millions of Syrian refugees have been living in limbo with no country, nearly no rights, little education and not enough food. Children of Beqaa gives a voice to those refugees who just want their stories to be heard.

items.title: District C-11
items.description: In the year 2019, where the world is under martial law, two rookie cops are tasked to patrol District C-11 where death is just a bullet away.

items.title: Healing Scars
items.description: UK cage fighter and mixed martial artist Rob 'C4' Sinclair, battles to overcome a career-threatening injury in order to fulfill his dream of fighting in the USA.

items.title: In Search Of Francis Of Assisi
items.description: This inspiring biographical chronicle portrays the remarkable life, struggles, achievements and legacy of Saint Francis of Assisi, who revolutionized Catholicism in the 13th century.

items.title: Racing Through The Forest
items.description: Legendary racers share first-hand accounts of the 1950-56 Pebble Beach Road Race, taking us back to where sports car road racing began.

items.title: The Remarkable Life of John Weld
items.description: John Weld started as an extra in Hollywood during the 1920s silent era. Paid per foot jumped, John climbed the ladder to reach new heights, becoming a respected stuntman.

items.title: Beast From Haunted Cave -Schlock Classic
