items.description: Autry is the sheriff of a small western town and sings about Eleanor, who is a singer from a Chicago nightclub.

items.title: Nevada City
items.description: The conflict between a railroader and a stageline owner is being aggravated by bad guys who are sabotaging both sides. Roy and Gabby mediate the conflict and expose the bad guys.

items.title: Night Time in Nevada
items.description: The bad guy steals a gold mine from his partner and then murders him. Next, he turns to rustling cattle. Songs include the title song, "Sweet Laredo Lou," and "Big Rock Candy Mountain."

items.title: The Ranger and the Lady
items.description: While Sam Houston is trying to get Texas into the Union, his aide is trying to impose a self-serving tax on the use of the Santa Fe Trail. The lady owner of a wagon train is using the trail, and a Texas Ranger comes to her assistance.

items.title: Oh, Susannah!
items.description: A fugitive assumes the identity of Gene Autry and he kills a man. Autry is jailed and breaks out with the help of his friends. They are determined to clear his name.

items.title: Rough Riders' Round-Up
items.description: Roy, Rusty and Tommy join the border patrol. One of them gets killed and the other two cross the border hunting the killer, where they find a gold smuggling racket.

items.title: Rootin' Tootin' Rhythm
items.description: Gene and Frog get into trouble when they impersonate two dead cattle rustlers.

items.title: Roll on Texas Moon
items.description: The age-old battle between the cattlemen and the sheepmen in the West both having a different idea of the development of the West. Then an attempted murder occurs and Roy investigates.

items.title: Riders of the Whistling Pines
items.description: Lumber men are cutting restricted timber. Since Gene is hired to deal with a moth infestation that threatens the trees, they accuse him of poisoning cattle to get him out of the way.

items.title: The Mystery of the Hooded Horseman
items.description: Tex is up against a group of hooded outlaws. When he shoots one; he uses the hood to infiltrate the gang.

items.title: The Lawless Frontier
items.description: The sheriff is in pursuit of a ruthless killer who killed his parents. When he catches him, he escapes, but the sheriff stays on his trail.

items.title: San Fernando Valley
items.description: A ranch owner fires his ranch hands and brings in women to replace them. The owner's daughter wants the male hands back and comes up with a plan to do it. They will rustle the horses and bring the men in to get their old jobs back.

items.title: Round Up Time in Texas
items.description: Gene's brother finds diamonds in South Africa and when they get there they find he has gone missing. They go into the jungle, but Gene soon becomes a prisoner too.

items.title: Idaho
items.description: A deputy sets out to prove that a respected judge, who had once been a criminal, is being framed for crimes committed by a crooked saloon owner.

items.title: The Man from Utah
items.description: When rodeo riders are being picked off one by one by a venomous snakebite it is up to John Weston to figure out who is killing the riders for prize money. Weston (John Wayne) enters a rodeo to find it's rigged by some outlaws.

items.title: The Kansan
items.description: A man injured while trying to stop a bank raid wakes in his hospital bed to find he has been elected to public office.

items.title: The Gay Ranchero
items.description: After a cargo of gold is hijacked from a stagecoach, Sheriff Roy Rogers captures two of the thieves, Slim and Roberts, and escorts them toward nearby Manzanita Springs.

items.title: The Carson City Kid
items.description: Roy Rogers as the Carson City kid seeks to avenge the killing of his brother. He searches everywhere for him and wrongfully earns the reputation of thief.

items.title: The Border Legion
items.description: A doctor, who heads west after fleeing authorities in New York, finds himself helping some friends who are in trouble after a gang, known as the Border Legion, has captured them.

items.title: Man from Music Mountain
items.description: Singing cowboy Gene Autry and his sidekick Smiley Burnette star in this feature pitting cattle ranchers and real estate speculators. When it appears that there's gold on a ranch; a group of suspicious men begins selling claims in the local community.

items.title: Man from Cheyenne
items.description: Roy is a government man sent to solve a novel crime problem - a woman flirts with unsuspecting ranchers in order to get information from them which she passes on to her cattle-rustling gang.

items.title: Mad Dog Morgan
items.description: The true story of Irish outlaw Daniel Morgan; who is wanted; dead or alive; in Australia during the 1850s.

items.title: Jesse James at Bay
items.description: Roy plays Jesse James as the Robin Hood of the west who helps settlers fight a greedy railroad magnate.

items.title: It Can Be Done Amigo
items.description: A drifter promises an old man that he will help a boy get his rightful inheritance which is some land and a house.

items.title: In Old Caliente
items.description: A family is accused of robbery as they try to make a new life in the west. Roy Rogers makes sure justice is done. Lots of music in this film -- a vehicle for the singing of Roy Rogers.

items.title: Hit the Saddle
items.description: Unable to legally capture and sell a herd of protected wild horses, corrupt rancher Rance Macgowan uses his trained killer horse, Volcano, to substitute for the real leader of the herd and cause havoc and death among the ranches.

items.title: Heldorado
items.description: Roy Rogers goes to Las Vegas for the annual Heldorado Frontier Days Festival. There, he meets heiress Carol Randall, the Queen of the Heldorado. He learns that there are counterfeit thousand-dollar bills being passed over the gambling tables.

items.title: Heart of the Golden West
items.description: When the crooked truckers responsible for moving the local cattle herds decide to jack up their rates, Roy Rogers and his posse convince a wary riverboat operator to save the ranchers by running a water route up to Cherokee City.

items.title: Hands Across the Border
items.description: Horse breeders Adams and Brock are vying for the Army contract. When Adams is killed trying to ride his horse Trigger; Roy saves the horse from being shot. He trains him and then plans to ride him in the race to win the contract.

items.title: Frontier Horizon
items.description: "The Three Mesquiteers" help a group of settlers whose land is threatened by barrens who are trying to run the citizens off of their land to profiteer.

items.title: China 9, Liberty 37
items.description: A condemned man, Clayton, is released on the condition that he kills a rancher for the railway company. He can't do it, but when the man's wife believes she has killed him, she runs away with Clayton. The husband, not dead, follows them.

items.title: Branded a Coward
items.description: As a young boy, Johnny Hume (Johnny Mack Brown) witnesses the slaughter of his family by an outlaw gang led by The Cat. Pledging to avenge their murders, the townspeople of Lawless invite him to be their marshal.

items.title: Bells of Rosarita
items.description: Dale Evans inherits a circus, but her dead father's partner (Grant Withers) is trying to take it away from her. Roy and Bob Nolan are filming a movie on location at the circus.

items.title: Apache Rose
items.description: Roy is an oil prospector. His efforts to get drilling rights on an old Spanish land grant are countered by gamblers from an off-shore gambling boat determined to control the land (and oil) themselves.

items.title: American Empire
items.description: Two Civil War heroes decide to build a cattle empire.

items.title: Pride & Groom
items.description: Celebrating one year of marriage equality in New York, this docu-style special follows an engaged Upstate couple on their journey to wedded bliss.

items.title: The Amazing Truth About Queen Raquela
items.description: Raquela, a Filipino transsexual prostitute, dreams of moving to Paris and escaping her lifestyle. To make her wishes come true, she starts working in Internet porn where she quickly becomes a star.

items.title: Here Together
items.description: Where did you meet the love of your life? At the supermarket? On a hiking trail? Here Together gathers gay couples to tell the stories of meeting and falling in love.

items.title: Here Comedy Presents Kate Clinton
items.description: No topic is too taboo to conquer in this stand-up performance from comedienne Kate Clinton, offering her riotous take on feminism, lesbianism, and life.

items.title: Heart of Broadway
items.description: Heart of Broadway goes inside Broadway Cares/Equity Fights AIDS for an in-depth look at the organization and its key players. Since 1988, they have raised more than $195 million for essential services for people with AIDS and other critical illnesses.

items.title: Eleven Minutes
items.description: The feature documentary "Eleven Minutes" chronicles "Project Runway" winner Jay McCarroll's year-long journey preparing his first independent runway show in NYC.

items.title: A Year of Pride with Taylor Barrett
items.description: Actress, filmmaker, and comedian Taylor Barrett takes a look back at a monumental year of LGBT pride. Join Taylor as she conducts interviews and provides insight into the passing of Marriage Equality, LGBT acceptance, and what's next on the agenda.

items.title: The Days of Jesse James
items.description: After a bank robbery, Jesse James is accused, but it seems it was done by another gang; maybe by the bank owner himself.

items.title: The Big Show
items.description: A cowboy disappears and Gene Autry, who is his double, impersonates him. He sings and herds cattle on his famous horse Champion, but the hoax is becoming problematic with blackmail and consequences.

items.title: Gunman from Bodie
items.description: The Rough Riders are back in town! In this gritty Western favorite, which begins with a suspenseful opening sequence, the three Rough Riders are special agents assigned to look into a series of rustlings near the small town of Larabie.

items.title: Frontier Pony Express
items.description: In the midst of the Civil War, Pony Express rider Roy must round up a pack of outlaws, as Yankee and Rebel forces contend for the allegiance of California.

items.title: Far Frontier
items.description: Roy battles crooks at the US & Mexican border.

items.title: Dirty Outlaws
items.description: The film tells the story of an outlaw who masquerades as a blind man's son in order to trick the old man out of a cache of gold located in a vacated town.

items.title: Death Rides a Horse
items.description: A young boy is a witness the murder of his family. Fifteen years later he sets of to find the four killers. Along the way he befriends another cowboy out for the same revenge.

items.title: Cowboy and the Senorita
items.description: A worthless gold mine might in fact have hidden gold deposits. Leave it to Roy to find out the truth!

items.title: Colorado Sundown
items.description: Disbanded Texas Rangers are gathered together to help the U.S. Cavalry put an end to marauding outlaws.

items.title: Buckskin Frontier
items.description: Railroad troubleshooter Stephen Bent is assigned to supervise the building of 120 miles of track through the treacherous Santa Fe cutoff. He is opposed in this mission by a land baron.

items.title: Bells of San Angelo
items.description: A silver mine with a secret entrance along the Mexican border is the setting for this typical Roy Rogers western with music.

items.title: Night of the Living Dead (1968)
items.description: A ragtag group of Pennsylvanians barricade themselves in an old farmhouse to remain safe from a bloodthirsty, flesh-eating breed of monsters who are ravaging the East Coast of the United States.

items.title: Ultraman X The Movie
items.description: When reality TV host Carlos Kurozaki breaks into a mysterious underground pyramid for a television event, he removes a special gem... and unwittingly releases a diabolical monster called Zaigorg!

items.title: Call for Dreams
items.description: In a rain-drenched Tokyo, from a high rise apartment, Eko complicates her life by publishing a 'Call For Dreams' ad in the newspaper.

items.title: Sin Reaper
items.description: Young Samantha Walker's decision to face her unknown past becomes a fight for life and death.

items.title: The Haunting of Sorority Row
items.description: Sam, a bright-eyed college freshman is thrilled at the prospect of pledging at the most prestigious sorority on campus. Her enthusiasm turns to dread when she begins to sense something sinister about the sorority house and sisters.

items.title: Boys of Bonneville
items.description: This film celebrates the vision, stamina and prowess of heroic endurance land speed racer Ab Jenkins, and his legendary race cars.

items.title: Operation Condor
items.description: Jackie Chan ignites the big screen as the world's greatest secret agent, code name Condor. Sent to track down stolen Nazi gold, he is pursued by a ruthless band of treasure-hunting terrorists on a globe-spanning quest to reach the bounty first!

items.title: Southside with You
items.description: From executive producer John Legend comes the touching love story inspired by the romantic first date between President Barack Obama and the First Lady.

items.title: The Aviator
items.description: The early years of larger-than-life American figure Howard Hughes are captured by legendary director Martin Scorsese in this acclaimed Oscar-winning biopic starring Leonardo DiCaprio and Cate Blanchett.

items.title: Fresh
items.description: Disenchanted by the harsh realities of life in the city, a smart, streetwise kid named Fresh strives to create a better future for himself and his family. He defies the odds by staying one move ahead of the criminals in a dangerous game of survival.

items.title: A Bridge Too Far
items.description: With an all-star cast that includes Sean Connery, Anthony Hopkins, Laurence Olivier, Gene Hackman and Robert Redford, this epic WW II drama recreates Operation Market Garden, an ambitious plan to hasten the end of WW II that ended in disaster.

items.title: The Killer Elite
items.description: James Caan and Robert Duvall star in Sam Peckinpah's tense, action-packed thriller that explores savagery and betrayal in the murky world of killers-for-hire.

items.title: Stargate: Continuum
items.description: In this adrenaline-driven, action adventure, members of SG-1 find themselves returning to a world where their history has been dramatically altered and the Stargate program never existed! Richard Dean Anderson, Beau Bridges and Michael Shanks star.

items.title: The Alamo
items.description: John Wayne produces, directs and stars in this retelling of the Alamo, a battle in which 185 men joined together against an army of 7,000. Filmed entirely in Texas, "The Alamo" is a visually stunning and historically accurate celebration of courage.

items.title: Comes a Horseman
items.description: Set in the American West of the 1940s, a pair of little-guy ranchers join forces against the depredations of a ruthless land baron determined to expand his empire at whatever cost. Starring Jane Fonda, James Caan, and Jason Robards.

items.title: The Night Of The Hunter
items.description: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

items.title: The Train
items.description: Screen greats Burt Lancaster, Paul Scofield and Jeanne Moreau star in this suspense-laden tale of justice and retribution as a French Resistance fighter (Lancaster) attempts to stop a Nazi commander from looting the art treasures of Paris.

items.title: Paths Of Glory
items.description: This powerful, fact-based absurdity-of-war film stars Kirk Douglas as a commanding officer who defends three scapegoats on trial for a failed offensive that occurred within the French Army in 1916.

items.title: Birdman of Alcatraz
items.description: Burt Lancaster stars in the true story of killer Robert Stroud, who spent 43 years in solitary confinement at Alcatraz, and who educated himself, becoming a world renowned authority on birds. Thelma Ritter, Telly Savalas and Karl Malden co-star.

items.title: The Love Witch
items.description: A modern-day witch uses spells and magic to get men to fall in love with her, in a tribute to 1960s Technicolor thrillers.

items.title: Wild Combination: A Portrait of Arthur Russell
items.description: Director Matt Wolf's critically acclaimed documentary examines the life and work of Arthur Russell, an influential singer, songwriter, cello player and disco auteur who died tragically in 1992.

items.title: Who Took The Bomp? Le Tigre On Tour
items.description: WHO TOOK THE BOMP? LE TIGRE ON TOUR follows iconic feminist band Le Tigre on their 2005 international tour. Le Tigre confronts sexism and homophobia in the music industry while tearing up the stage.

items.title: Welcome to Pine Hill
items.description: Shanon, a reformed drug dealer, is now an insurance claims adjuster. In the days following a grim medical diagnosis he sets out to make peace with those around him and in turn find his own peace beyond the cacophony of New York City.

items.title: These Birds Walk
items.description: In this beautifully filmed, inspirational documentary, a high-spirited runaway boy in Pakistan tries to find his way back home from the orphanage in which he lives, aided by a sympathetic ambulance driver who was once a street kid himself.

items.title: The Kill Team
items.description: This provocative, bold, and deeply moving documentary profiles Adam Winfield, a soldier-turned-whistleblower who returns from the battlefield to expose shocking war crimes that the U.S. Army will do anything to cover up.

items.title: Soul of a Banquet
items.description: In this mouth-watering documentary, director Wayne Wang (The Joy Luck Club) profiles Cecilia Chiang, the matriarch of modern Chinese cooking, as she relates her fascinating history and cooks up a sumptuous, once-in-a-lifetime banquet.

items.title: Scott Walker: 30th Century Man
items.description: SCOTT WALKER: 30 CENTURY MAN is a rare glimpse into the creative world of the most enigmatic figure in rock history, tracing the undeniable impact he has had on popular music through casual interviews with some of his biggest, highest profile fans.

items.title: Rebirth
items.description: REBIRTH follows the ten-year transformation of five people whose lives were forever altered on September 11, 2001. Time-lapse photography simultaneously tracks the evolution of the space where the Twin Towers once stood.

items.title: Pulp: A Film About Life, Death and Supermarkets
items.description: Legendary Britpop band PULP return to Sheffield for their final performance in a rock doc like no other. Dynamic concert footage and hilarious interviews paint a portrait of a band and city that's funny, moving, and life-affirming.

items.title: Night School
items.description: Indianapolis has one of the lowest high school graduation rates in the country. Victims of circumstance and a broken system, Greg, Melissa, and Shynika are optimistic that they don’t need to be on the wrong side of statistics.

items.title: John McEnroe: In the Realm of Perfection
items.description: Though John McEnroe was the No. 1 tennis player of his day, he never won the French Open. Director Julien Faraut uses the toughest of those losses -- to Ivan Lendl in 1984 -- to anchor this cinematic study of McEnroe's wily game and notorious anger.

items.title: Hello I Must Be Going
items.description: An affair with a 19-year old actor (GIRLS' Christopher Abbott) helps reinvigorate life for thirty-something Amy after she moves home to her parents’ house following her divorce, in this humorous take on modern relationships.

items.title: Coherence
items.description: In this mind-bending sci-fi thriller, 8 friends at a dinner party start experiencing strange and mysterious events on the night a comet is passing close to Earth. Soon it becomes clear that nothing and no one are what they appear.

items.title: Wasteland
items.description: Harvey Miller, a young Englishman recently released from prison, reunites with his three best friends to rob and enact revenge on a local drug kingpin - all while trying to win back his ex-girlfriend.

items.title: The Messenger
items.description: An injured soldier is paired with a by-the-book captain to notify families of their loss -- a job that bonds them as they debate differing views on serving America. At odds at first;the two find common ground while facing life's variety of battles.

items.title: The Fits
items.description: While training at the gym 11-year-old tomboy Toni becomes entranced with a dance troupe. As she struggles to fit in she finds herself caught up in danger as the group begins to suffer from fainting spells and other violent seizures.

items.title: Searching for Ingmar Bergman
items.description: To mark the centennial of legendary director Ingmar Bergman's birth, noted German filmmaker Margarethe von Trotta revisits the settings, scenes, people and themes key to the auteur's creative cinematic legacy.

items.title: 28 Hotel Rooms
items.description: A passionate and lurid affair threatens the day-to-day lives of an author (Chris Messina) and an accountant (Marin Ireland) after a one-night stand becomes much more.

items.title: Wendy and Lucy
items.description: Wendy is driving to Alaska, in hopes of lucrative work and the start of a new life with her dog, Lucy. When her car breaks down, the thin fabric of her financial situation comes apart, and she confronts a series of increasingly dire economic decisions.

items.title: We Need to Talk About Kevin
items.description: In this Golden Globe nominated psychological thriller, Oscar winner Tilda Swinton plays the mother (Eva) of the evil Kevin (Ezra Miller). Eva contends with her clueless husband (John C. Reilly) and her son's malevolent ways.

items.title: The Road Movie
items.description: A mosaic of asphalt adventures, landscape photography, and some of the craziest stuff you’ve ever seen, this is a stunning compilation of video footage shot exclusively via the deluge of dashboard cameras that populate Russian roads.

items.title: Teenage
items.description: With narration by actors Jena Malone, Ben Whishaw, Julia Hummer and Jessie Usher, filmmaker Matt Wolf explores the origins of the modern-day "teenager" -- a demographic that didn't even exist until the mid-20th century.

items.title: Rare Exports: A Christmas Tale
items.description: In this darkly comic gem, it's Christmas Eve in northern Finland, and an archeological dig has just unearthed Santa Claus. But this Santa isn't one you want coming to town.

items.title: Meek's Cutoff
items.description: Settlers traveling through the Oregon desert in 1845 find themselves stranded in harsh conditions.

items.title: It's a Disaster
items.description: Four feuding couples meet for Sunday brunch only to discover they are stuck in a house together as the world is about to end.

items.title: Girl Asleep
items.description: Greta’s bubble of loserdom is burst when her parents throw her a 15th birthday party & invite the whole school! Suddenly, she’s flung far from her comfort zone into a weird, distant, parallel place - but only there can she find herself.

items.title: Dark Days
items.description: An exploration of the surprisingly domestic subterranean world of a homeless community living in a train tunnel beneath NYC. Through stories heartbreaking and hilarious they reveal their reasons for taking refuge and their struggle to survive underground.

items.title: Contemporary Color
items.description: In the summer of 2015, legendary musician David Byrne staged an event at Brooklyn's Barclays Center to celebrate the creativity of color guard: synchronized dance routines involving flags, rifles, and sabers, colloquially known as “the sport of the arts.”

items.title: Brimstone & Glory
items.description: The National Pyrotechnic Festival in Tultepec, Mexico is documented in this spectacular look at explosive celebrations, unrestrained delight and real peril.

items.title: Bellflower
items.description: While Woodrow and Aiden prepare for the global apocalypse by crafting homemade flamethrowers and fire breathing Mad Max-inspired muscle cars, Woodrow falls hard in love with a femme fatale who's potentially more dangerous than any end of days.

items.title: Art and Craft
items.description: A funny, fascinating, too-good-to-be-true documentary about Mark Landis, one of the world’s most prolific art forgers, who for over 30 years has duped museums across the country--until one determined registrar sets out to stop him.

items.title: Always Shine
items.description: Best friends Anna & Beth take a weekend trip to Big Sur, hopeful to re-establish a bond broken by years of competition & jealousy. Tensions mount, leading to an unexpected yet inevitable confrontation, changing both of their lives forever.

items.title: A Film Unfinished
items.description: This potent documentary uses a long-lost film reel to illustrate how the Nazis controlled images of Jewish life during World War II. Though the Nazis made a propaganda movie of contented Jews in the Warsaw ghetto, the missing spool exposes the truth.

items.title: 12 O'Clock Boys
items.description: In the most thrilling trip into Baltimore since The Wire, we follow Pug, a precocious kid who will stop at nothing to join the 12 O’Clock Boys– a notorious dirt bike pack who perform death-defying stunts while evading the police.

items.title: Your Mother Wears Combat Boots
items.description: When her son quits college to become an Army Ranger, the only way his mom can stop him is to enlist herself. They strike a deal: if she completes basic training, he'll return to college.

items.title: Boggy Creek II: And the Legend Continues
items.description: Dr. Brant Lockhart gets a call from the sheriff reporting a Bigfoot-like creature in a secluded town in Southwest Arkansas. Lockart brings along three students from the university to help investigate.

items.title: On the Streets of L.A.
items.description: An estranged father and son are paroled from the same maximum-security prison with one unusual condition, they must become roommates.

items.title: Keeping It In The Royal Family
items.description: With the births of Prince George and Princess Charlotte heralding a new generation, this program uncovers the past of the British Royal Family through stunning dramatic reenactments.

items.title: Don Verdean
items.description: A comedy of Biblical proportions from the creators of NAPOLEON DYNAMITE. A self-proclaimed Biblical archaeologist fuels a comic conspiracy when he tries to cover up his failure.

items.title: Fly Me to the Moon
items.description: Three adventurous houseflies stow away on the Apollo 11 moon flight and are secret contributors to the mission's success. Animated fun voiced by Christopher Lloyd, Kelly Ripa, and more.

items.title: Joe (2013)
items.description: Academy Award® winner Nicolas Cage gives an intensely powerful performance as Joe, a hard-living ex-con who must face ruin or redemption when he meets a homeless boy in need of help.

items.title: Little Italy
items.description: The director of How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days and Miss Congeniality cooks up a sizzling comedy about two lifelong pals whose romance is threatened by their families' rival pizzerias.

items.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
items.description: After a car crash, a woman wakes up in a survivalist's bunker. He claims to have saved her from an apocalyptic attack, but, growing suspicious of his motives, she'll have to escape to discover the truth.

items.title: Almost Famous
items.description: A high-school boy is given the chance to write a story for Rolling Stone Magazine about an up-and-coming rock band as he accompanies it on their concert tour.

items.title: Barefoot In The Park
items.description: Robert Redford is Mister Straight. Jane Fonda is his new wife. As the ecstasy of the honeymoon gives way to the reality of setting up housekeeping in a five-flight walk-up, the harmony of marriage turns to comical discord.

items.title: Same Kind Of Different As Me
items.description: From The NY Times bestseller comes an inspirational true story about two men from drastically different backgrounds, who develop a surprising bond that will lead them on the most remarkable journey of their lives and forge an everlasting friendship.

items.title: We Were Soldiers
items.description: In 1965, America is at war with North Vietnam, and Lt. Col. Hal Moore prepares his troops for one of the most violent battles in U.S. History: “The Valley of Death.”

items.title: The Beautician and The Beast
items.description: A New York cosmetologist mistakenly thought to be a science teacher is offered a job to teach the children of an Eastern European dictator.

items.title: Almost Home
items.description: A group of homeless teenagers in Los Angeles struggle to find themselves.

items.title: Dennis & Lois
items.description: DENNIS AND LOIS is a documentary about two quirky New York City characters who came together over their fervent fan-hood of fringe bands in the 70s

items.title: Live The Stream: The Story of Joe Humphr
items.description: Live The Stream is the inspiring life story of legendary Joe Humphreys: a famous fly fisherman, teacher, and conservationist from Pennsylvania who will catch your heart in this powerful tale of tenacity, life and love.

items.title: We Stand Corrected: Dannemora
items.description: We Stand Corrected: Dannemora examines the causes and effects of the 2015 escape from Clinton Correctional Facility in New York. Told from those on the inside, it's an alternate narrative to that which was told by the media.

items.title: Aliens In LA
items.description: Los Angeles has had the most Alien and U.F.O. sightings in the entire world since the 1950's. This unique documentary takes an unparalleled look at several of those encounters over the years with shocking, previously unseen eyewitness interviews, evidence

items.title: Blowing Up Right Now
items.description: A millennial couple in a long-term relationship break up amid a nuclear missile crisis in LA.

items.title: Blush
items.description: The sexual, psychological and moral unraveling of an obsessive-compulsive, suburban mom. Starring Wendi McLendon-Covey, Christine Woods, Max Burkholder and Steve Little.

items.title: The House in Between
items.description: A beautiful documentary telling the real story of a homeowner, and the team looking for answers that will move Alice back into her house. This documentary shows a detailed look at what could be the most haunted house in America.

items.title: Public Enemy Number One
items.description: Public Enemy Number One sheds light on the politics behind the war on drugs from Nixon to today, with first of its kind insight from U.S. Drug Czars, and the founders of the “Just Say No” movement.

items.title: RiffTrax: Arachnia
items.description: RiffTrax, the guys who make movies funny, bring their comedic riffing treatment to this cheesy 2000 era horror classic where survivors of a plane crash battle it out Starship Troopers style against a giant bug attack!

items.title: ABCs of Death 2
items.description: ABCs OF DEATH 2 features segments directed by over two dozen of the world's leading talents in contemporary genre film.

items.title: Peter and the Farm
items.description: Peter Dunning has spent 37 years working on a 187-acre farm. His charismatic exterior has been peeled back after 38 harvests, the departure of three wives and four children, revealing a man in the throes of a personal crisis.

items.title: Howl (2010)
items.description: James Franco delivers a career-defining performance as poet Allen Ginsberg. Through his search for personal and creative expression, Ginsberg writes HOWL, and must contend with attorney Jake Ehrlich (Jon Hamm) during HOWL’S bizarre obscenity trial.

items.title: Wuthering Heights (2011)
items.description: The greatest love story ever told, Wuthering Heights is an excitingly fresh and distinct take on the classic novel by Emily Brontë.

items.title: Yours, Mine and Ours
items.description: When widowed nurse Helen North (Lucille Ball) meets widower Frank Beardsley (Henry Fonda), a population explosion takes place as her eight kids blend (or don't) with his ten in this chaotic, classic comedy! Van Johnson and Tom Bosley co-star.

items.title: A Fistful Of Dynamite
items.description: The results are explosive when an Irish terrorist (James Coburn) with a dynamite obsession teams up with a Mexican peasant-turned- revolutionary (Rod Steiger) in this action-packed tale of power and politics. Directed by the legendary Sergio Leone.

items.title: Juliet, Naked
items.description: Annie develops an unlikely transatlantic romance with the once admired, now washed up, singer-songwriter, Tucker Crowe, who also happens to be the subject of Duncan’s musical obsession.

items.title: American Pastoral
items.description: Ewan McGregor, Jennifer Connelly, and Dakota Fanning star in this acclaimed film about a father coping with his fugitive daughter and his perfect life suddenly unraveling.

items.title: The Matrix Reloaded
items.description: In the second chapter of the Matrix trilogy, Zion falls under siege by the Machine Army. Neo and Trinity choose to return to the Matrix with Morpheus. Now, Neo must follow the path he has chosen if he is to save humanity.

items.title: The Matrix Revolutions
items.description: In this final chapter of the Matrix trilogy, Neo, Morpheus, and Trinity battle to defend Zion against the machines' onslaught that has enslaved the human race. And Neo faces the consequences of the choice made in The Matrix Reloaded.

items.title: Undertaking Betty
items.description: A woman, whose husband is cheating on her, and an undertaker, who has been in love with her since their childhood, decide to fake her death so they can be together.

items.title: Operation Condor II: The Armour Of The Gods
items.description: Jackie Chan is a fortune hunter whose ex-girlfriend is kidnapped by an evil cult! Things kick into high gear when her fiancée, an old friend of Jackie’s, asks him for help in securing the kidnappers’ lone demand: the priceless Armor of The Gods!

items.title: George Carlin Personal Favorites
items.description: This HBO special presentation highlights the best of his live performances in Los Angeles, New Jersey, Phoenix, and New York from 1977 to 1998.

items.title: The Matrix
items.description: When a beautiful stranger leads computer hacker Neo to a forbidding underworld, he discovers the life he knows is the elaborate deception of an evil cyber-intelligence. Every second becomes a fight to stay alive - to escape The Matrix.

items.title: Citizen Ruth
items.description: In this outrageous satire, Laura Dern is Ruth Stoops, an irresponsible, care-free drug addict pregnant for the fifth time, horrifying everyone around her. Soon, Ruth's at the forefront of a national debate, when all she wants to do is party.

items.title: Paid in Full
items.description: A young man from Harlem, forced to cope with the 1980s drug scene, builds an illegal empire, only to have a crisis of conscience. Featuring the hit soundtrack with songs by Eric B. & Rakim, Boogie Down Productions, Guy, and Jay-Z.

items.title: Lord Lucan: My Husband, The Truth
items.description: The 40-year mystery uncovered by his wife. This is the story of Lord Lucan, playboy, aristocrat, gambler, and murderer.

items.title: Monte Cassino: The Soldiers' Story
items.description: In March 1944, the Allies were enmeshed in one of the most bloody, dramatic battles of the war - brutal days of fighting for the key obstacle on the allied route to Rome. This is the story of the men who captured the mountain top.

items.title: Operation Valkyrie: The Plot to Assassinate Hitler
items.description: On July 20th, 1944 a group of German conspirators lead by Claus von Stauffenberg attempted to assassinate Adolf Hitler himself. The plan was to remove the Nazi Party from power. However, the plot failed and lead to nearly 5,000 executions.

items.title: Sal
items.description: Director James Franco chronicles the final hours in the life of actor Sal Mineo, one-time teen heartthrob, gay icon, and the Academy Award-nominated star of REBEL WITHOUT A CAUSE and EXODUS.

items.title: The Armstrong 100 Ton Gun
items.description: The Armstrong 100 Ton Gun was first created in the late 1870s and was easily the largest weapon of the time. Weighing in at 103,888 kg, the 100 Ton Gun had a length of 9.953 meters and took a crew of 35 men to operate.

items.title: The Big Ask
items.description: Three couples head to the desert to help their friend heal after the death of his mother - but are not prepared for the outrageous request he makes.

items.title: The Man Who Cracked the Nazi Code
items.description: 6 June 1944. D-Day. The biggest land and sea operation in history. The D-Day landings were only possible thanks to a socially-awkward, antimilitarist mathematician named Alan Turing and his field was the most fundamental branch of mathematics: logic.

items.title: The Last Rites of Joe May
items.description: Joe May is an aging hustler clinging to the belief that he's one scam away from his big score. With his health failing and resources dwindling, Joe is presented with one last shot at redemption.

items.title: The High Cost of Living
items.description: Zach Braff and Isabelle Blais star in this thought-provoking drama about two lives that randomly collide with tragic consequences forcing them to confront loss; love and life and decide if the high cost of living is worth the price.

items.title: The Man on the Train
items.description: When a career criminal planning to knock off a bank crosses paths with a professor, they form an unlikely partnership, allowing each man to live vicariously through the other as they hatch their plans for the heist.

items.title: The Riot Act
items.description: A mysterious actress witnesses a murder at an esteemed opera house. As the town's dark past begins to reveal itself, she exacts an elaborate plot of revenge that revolves around the origins of a real-life ghost story.

items.title: Secrets of the Dead Sea Scrolls
items.description: Unfolding like a real-life mystery, intriguing in its theories, fascinating in its truths, and providing new ways of looking at Judaism and early Christianity, this compelling program reveals the amazing secrets behind the 2000-year-old Dead Sea Scrolls.

items.title: 7 Signs to Christ's Return
items.description: Biblical prophecy can provide fascinating insights into the future. Scriptures foretell seven momentous world events that will herald the second coming of Jesus Christ.

items.title: Clancy
items.description: A runaway changes the life of a bad-tempered, homeless war vet, who must now shelter her from the machinations of a corrupt mayor.

items.title: Nikki & The Perfect Stranger
items.description: Now in her 40s and having given up her career as a high-powered attorney, Nikki becomes disenchanted with her spiritual life until, for the second time, she has a chance encounter with Jesus. From that point, everything changed.

items.title: Princess Cut
items.description: After her boyfriend messes things up, Grace tries to understand what it means to truly love another person.

items.title: Bringing Up Bobby
items.description: Challenged by his older brother, a teenager (Alex Hinsky) examines his life and faith.

items.title: Between The Walls
items.description: A man uncovers a family secret when he learns about the repossession of his childhood home.

items.title: Another Perfect Stranger
items.description: A teenager bonds with an unlikely friend who shares her disdain for religion.

items.title: Redemption Of The Heart
items.description: Alex, a broken man, starts swindling churches to live the good life. When he meets Elaine, a member of a church he is trying to bilk out of money, they fall in love.

items.title: Jackson's Run
items.description: Having rejected his faith, a troubled teen with a life-threatening disease struggles to overcome his fear of death as he searches for a purpose.

items.title: Jimmy
items.description: A mentally impaired youth who interacts with beings he calls "watchers" is asked to testify as a defense witness at a criminal trial.

items.title: Love Covers All
items.description: On the eve of his wife's due date, Michael has to leave on a business trip 400 miles away. When he gets stranded in the middle of nowhere and she goes into labour, he seeks help from a gas station owner who questions his faith.

items.title: The Perfect Gift
items.description: A spoiled schoolgirl, her overworked executive mother and a disillusioned young minister each receives an uplifting message about friendship, commitment, and the truest meaning of Christmas from a friendly but mysterious drifter named Jess.

items.title: The Lost Medallion
items.description: Daniel tells foster kids a story about Billy and Allie -- two friends who uncover a long-lost medallion then accidentally wish themselves back in time.

items.title: The Perfect Stranger
items.description: An attorney receives a dinner invitation from a man who claims he is Jesus.

items.title: Time Changer
items.description: A professor travels more than 100 years into the future to witness the effects of his manuscript on the Bible.

items.title: Unidentified
items.description: Two reporters travel to a small town in Texas to investigate a series of UFO sightings. Their search leads them to a supernatural connection that could be linked to the end of the world.

items.title: Touched By Grace
items.description: Skylar wages a campaign to elect Grace, a classmate with Down syndrome, as homecoming queen as a prank, and blames Cara for the humiliating outcome.

items.title: Courageous Love
items.description: Alex Shelby encounters romance and intrigue as he tries to save the family business that he recently inherited. Corruption in a new building project threatens to shut down the company.

items.title: Badge Of Faith
items.description: Paralyzed on duty, a police officer uses his faith as a source of strength during recovery.

items.title: Amazing Love: The Story Of Hosea
items.description: After a confrontation in a youth group, Stuart shares the story of Old Testament prophet Hosea.

items.title: A Matter Of Faith
items.description: After she is taught the theory of evolution in her biology class at university, a young Christian woman begins to drift away from her faith.

items.title: Spy Kids 4: All the Time in the World
items.description: The action packed franchise is back…with the next generation of Spy Kids!

items.title: El Boxeo
items.description: EL BOXEO tells the timely story of the emergence & dominance of Latinos in what was once considered the traditional all-white sport of boxing. EL BOXEO is as much a film about Latinos in boxing as it is about the immigrant stories that reshaped the sport.

items.title: Kickboxer 4: The Aggressor
items.description: David Sloan is on a mission to free his wife who has been enslaved by an evil world champion, Tong Po. He attempts to gain entry into Po’s savage kingdom by fighting in the tournament of champions where the winner takes all.

items.title: Tokyo!
items.description: Three short films set in Tokyo chronicle the metamorphosis of a woman, the trial of a man who emerges from a manhole, and a reclusive man's first experience with human contact during an earthquake.

items.title: Unlikely Angel
items.description: A country music singer meets an untimely demise and learns she can't enter heaven until she performs a good deed Earth. She must find a mother for a widowed father and his two children.

items.title: The Wonderland [Dubbed]
items.description: A girl without self-confidence meets a mysterious alchemist Hippocrates and his student Pipo who are on a mission to save the world. Together, they laid the groundwork for "Wonderland" and Akane is labeled as Wonderland's savior.

items.title: Beauty And The Beast
items.description: A struggling merchant stumbles upon the magical domain of the fearsome Beast, who sentences him to death for stealing a rose. As Belle valiantly attempts to release the Beast from his curse, the two discover that an unlikely bond blooms… true love.

items.title: Wild Honey
items.description: Wild Honey is a romantic comedy about a lonely phone sex operator in Chicago who falls for one of her callers, and flies out to LA to find him.

items.title: Perdido en la fama
items.description: Un rockero semi retirado y caprichoso (Antonio Banderas) debe espabilarse para rescatar a su esposa, quien ha sido secuestrada mientras se encontraba de vacaciones en Chile.

items.title: The Bachelors
items.description: A mourning father moves across the country with his teenage son for a private school teaching job, after the early death of his wife. Their lives begin to transform due to two unique women, who help them embrace life and love again.

items.title: Breaking & Exiting
items.description: Breaking & Exiting is a romantic comedy about how certain decisions can impact one's life. It tells the story of Harry, a career criminal with a knack for robbing houses and paying his rent with the used TVs and jewelry that he sells.

items.title: Beyond the Brink
items.description: Witness firsthand how California's evolving water crisis is a growing threat to our National Securityin its capacity ofprovidinghealthy food to our Nation and world.

items.title: Bernard and Huey
items.description: BERNARD AND HUEY is a particularly timely story of two men behaving badly, and the strong women who rein them in.

items.title: Discreet
items.description: Monique, a high class escort has always given her clients exactly what they wanted, while Thomas, has always been exactly what everyone has expected.

items.title: Kickboxer 2: The Road Back
items.description: In this rousing sequel to Kickboxer, Tong Po broods about his defeat at the hands of Kurt Sloan. Po and his managers resort to drastic measures to goad Kurt into the ring for a rematch.

items.title: Red Dust
items.description: Police officer Dirk Hendricks (Bartlett) files an amnesty application for Alex Mpondo (Ejiofor), a member of the South African Parliament who can't remember the torture he once endured as a captive political activist.

items.title: The Marvelous History of the US Dollar
items.description: The Marvelous History of the US Dollar examines the 'greenback's' history, allure, and unique role as a catalyst for globalization, and how the American buck became so almighty that "$" is the most powerful symbol on earth.

items.title: Iris
items.description: From legendary late 88-year-old documentarian Albert Maysles (GREY GARDENS, GIMME SHELTER), comes IRIS. Iris Apfel, is the 93-year-old style maven who has had an outsized presence on the New York fashion scene for decades.

items.title: Battle of Demons
items.description: In a town of demons, evil forces kidnap young women to be their eternal brides. Can one young student defeat the sinister spirits?

items.title: El hombre de negro 2
items.description: Evaristo Juárez es un poderoso hacendado que mantiene en terror al pueblo de Palo Alto. Sus hombres amenazan y matan a todas las personas que se opongan a entregarle sus tierras. Juan Pablo se da cuenta de las injusticias que comete su padre.

items.title: Creepy
items.description: A year after a botched hostage negotiation with a serial killer turned deadly, ex-detective Koichi and his wife move into a new house with a deeply strange new neighbor. His old cop colleagues come calling for his help on a mysterious case, which may be

items.title: La suburban dorada
items.description: Un policía judicial es acusado de estar relacionado con el narcotráfico sólo por ayudar a su primo. Las circunstancias lo convierten en un fugitivo de la ley y por recuperar a su hijo tiene que involucrase con el narco.

items.title: Beside Still Waters
items.description: When old friends reunite for one last weekend at a family lake house, dancing and drinking games lead to rekindled romances.

items.title: Grave Encounters
items.description: A reality TV show crew film inside an abandoned mental hospital, where unexplained phenomena was reported. They quickly realize that the building is not only haunted, but it has no intention of ever letting them leave.

items.title: Grave Encounters 2
items.description: Tortured by the ghosts of the demonized insane asylum that killed the crew of GRAVE ENCOUNTERS, film students fight to escape death as their own paranormal investigation goes terribly wrong in this horrifying sequel.

items.title: Hansel & Gretel Get Baked
items.description: Stoner siblings Hansel and Gretel battle an evil witch (Lara Flynn Boyle) who uses a magical blend of marijuana to lure in teenage bait. Will this be the last high of their lives?

items.title: W.
items.description: Controversial filmmaker Oliver Stone takes on the life and presidency of George W. Bush, capturing the alleged notorious moments in his life.

items.title: A Soldier's Story
items.description: A fine drama set during World War II, in which a black military attorney investigates the death of a black sergeant. The lawyer eventually discovers that the sergeant was both ashamed of his own culture and virulently hated by his men.

items.title: La Hummer asesina
items.description: Todas las noches Gonzalo y un grupo de amigos, todos ellos pertenecientes a poderosas familias, recorren las calles a bordo de una Hummer para asesinar a todos los indigentes que se encuentran a su paso por un supuesto mandato divino.

items.title: Juice
items.description: Q. Raheem. Bishop. Steel. They're four Harlem friends who spend their days hanging out and looking for a way to get the power and respect they call Juice. Q hopes to earn respect by becoming a scratch 'n' mix DJ.

items.title: Flight
items.description: Airline pilot Whip Whitaker miraculously lands his plane after a midair catastrophe, but questions arise about who or what was really at fault.

items.title: No Rest For The Wicked
items.description: While attempting to cover his tracks from a violent shooting, a crooked cop uncovers a deadly plot that he is uniquely qualified to prevent in this taut, award-winning thriller.

items.title: Open Grave
items.description: A man wakes up in a pit of dead bodies with no memory of who he is or how he got there. Now he must determine if the killer is among the strangers who rescued him -- or if he could be the killer himself.

items.title: Palo Alto
items.description: An unflinching portrait of adolescent lust, boredom, and self-destruction that centers around a shy young girl (Emma Roberts) on the cusp of an illicit relationship with her soccer coach (James Franco). From director Gia Coppola.

items.title: Pressing On: The Letterpress Film
items.description: How has letterpress printing survived in a digital age? Young printers blend wood, metal and type as they strive to save a process in danger of being lost forever.

items.title: Sleepless Night
items.description: A cop races through a packed nightclub, dodging drug dealers and his own corrupt colleagues, in a mad chase to rescue his son from the crime kingpin he is in debt to.

items.title: Somebody Up There Likes Me
items.description: Nick Offerman (Parks and Recreation) stumbles through life with his best friend and the woman they both adore (Jess Weixler) in this smart, subversive comedy about watching your life fly by.

items.title: Sparrows Dance
items.description: A tender, comical love story between a woman (Marin Ireland, "Homeland") who refuses to leave her apartment and the man (Paul Sparks, "House of Cards") she finally lets in.

items.title: A Valentine's Date
items.description: Starring Elisa Donovan, Brad Rowe and Tom Skerritt. A working mother is forced to return to a life she left behind in Texas when her daughter's father files for joint custody.

items.title: Hitler's Last Secrets: Private Hitler's War
items.description: Why, at the height of the battle for France in 1940, was Hitler driven to step aside from the battle to visit the graves of his fallen comrades and lead the General Staff on a tour of his old trenches from the Great War?

items.title: Starred Up
items.description: Condemned to an adult prison, an explosively violent young man is forced to fight for survival as criminal forces attempt to control him for their own good. Help comes from the unlikeliest source, his estranged father also serving time.

items.title: Road To Gymkhana Grid
items.description: Road to Gymkhana Grid is a feature documentary following eight world-class drivers' journey to South Africa to compete in the world drifting championship event.

items.title: Secrets Of Dark Fest
items.description: Ten of the World's best mountain bike riders gather to compete against one another in South Africa for Dark Fest, a unique and ambitious free riders event.

items.title: Drag Kids
items.description: Four preteen drag queens come together for the biggest performance of their young lives. As they prepare for the big show, they struggle to claim a place of their own on the fringes of a fringe culture.

items.title: 16 Photographs at Ohrdruf
items.description: With only a small stack of his grandfather's photos for guidance, filmmaker Matthew Nash tries to understand a family secret that began on April 4, 1945.

items.title: Autonomy
items.description: Malcolm Gladwell leads a documentary about self-driving vehicles, asking us: what is control and who do we become as we relinquish it to machines?

items.title: Saving Atlantis
items.description: Saving Atlantis focuses on the loss of coral reef ecosystems around the world, and the impact of that decline on the communities that depend on them, on a global journey that celebrates the majesty and mystery of coral habitats

items.title: The Food Cure
items.description: Six advanced cancer patients make an unusual choice. They decide to face the disease with their forks. The patients embark on an arduous 7-year journey as they attempt to eat and juice their way back to health...with surprising results.

items.title: The Truth About Marriage
items.description: Filmmaker Roger Nygard (Trekkies, The Nature of Existence) tracks down the experts and discovers surprising scientific facts behind what makes happy relationships work, and what we can do to increase our chances of finding a soulmate.

items.title: Challenging Churchill
items.description: Churchill, a name typically associated with braveness and altruism. Recently found evidence from Soviet and British sources however brings up questions about Churchill's doings in the conferences of Tehran, Yalta and Potsdam.

items.title: Coco Chanel & Arletty
items.description: This documentary tells us about two beautiful stories, two beautiful women, two routes of life that marked each in their own way the memories of the French. They both have an atypical path whose paths intersect several times.

items.title: Dunkirk: The Real Story
items.description: At just before 7 PM on May 26, 1940, Prime Minister Winston Churchill authorized ‘Operation Dynamo' to commence. With rare historical archival footage from both the German and British sides, this is the real story.

items.title: Exploring Hitler's Mountain
items.description: Adolf Hitler spent over 1,000 days on the Obersalzberg, his mountain holiday refuge near Berchtesgaden. It was there he made his decisions about war and destruction.

items.title: Fatal Liaison
items.description: The protracted romance between Adolf Hitler and Eva Braun began in 1929 and ended in 1945 in the bunker under the ruins of the Chancellery. Eva was Hitler’s bride for less than 40 hours before she committed suicide.

items.title: Fearless Fighters
items.description: High flying action, outrageous stunts and stupendous, flying appendages are just a few of the sights in store as mighty warriors face off in a battle that can only leave one side standing.

items.title: Fortress
items.description: When the commander of the crew of a B-17 Flying Fortress bomber is killed in action in a raid over Sicily in 1943, his replacement, a young, naive pilot, struggles to be accepted by the plane's already tight-knit Irish American crew.

items.title: From George VI to Kate
items.description: See the exciting history of the Royal Family starting from George VI and going up to William's marriage with Kate.

items.title: George III: The Genius of the Mad King
items.description: After 200 years under lock and key, all the personal papers of one of our most important monarchs are seeing the light of day for the first time.

items.title: Hitler's Last Secrets: Hitler and Wagner
items.description: From the moment in 1906 when he heard the first note of Lohengrin at Linz opera house until his death in the burning ruins of Berlin in 1945, Hitler was obsessed with the music and mythology of Richard Wagner.

items.title: Hitler's Last Secrets: Hitler and the Beer Hall Putsch
items.description: One of the great ironies of history that Hitler’s first assignment after the Great War was to help the Bavarian army to identify extremist political parties, then to infiltrate and report back.

items.title: Hitler's Last Secrets: Hitler, Himler, and the Occult
items.description: The link between Hitler, the esoteric mystical movement of the nineteenth century, and the Aryan mythology of the Waffen SS is finally established.

items.title: Hitler's Last Secrets: Hitler the Drifter
items.description: Drawing upon the often overlooked memoirs of his erstwhile friend Reinhardt Hanisch and revisiting the key sites on his journey, this powerful film traces Hitler’s wilderness years in Vienna and Munich.

items.title: The Story Of: The Kinks
items.description: Discover the inside story of the most influential English rock band of the 60’s. Inspired by a mix of genres including rhythm and blues, folk and country, their music created a British Invasion around the world! Their third single "You Really Got Me" b...

items.title: The Phantom Of The Opera (1925)
items.description: A mad, disfigured composer seeks love with a lovely young opera singer.

items.title: The Hunchback Of Notre Dame
items.description: In 15th-century Paris, the brother of the archdeacon plots with the gypsy king to foment a peasant revolt. Meanwhile, a freakish hunchback falls in love with the gypsy queen.

items.title: The Brother From Another Planet
items.description: A mute alien with the appearance of a black human is chased by outer-space bounty hunters through the streets of Harlem.

items.title: Guide to Shark & Big Game Fishing
items.description: Big Game fishing is the most exhilarating and dramatic form of angling available to the modern day fisherman. It is to fishing what the Grand Prix Circuit is to Motor Racing and this guide covers the many skills needed to take on the major fish species...

items.title: Takedowns & Falls
items.description: Takedowns and Falls tells the story of a group of Pennsylvania teens and their relationships within a high school wrestling team, on a journey to win a state championship. It chronicles a season of the Central Dauphin Rams in Harrisburg, PA and highli...

items.title: Charade
items.description: Romance and suspense ensue in Paris as a woman is pursued by several men who want a fortune her murdered husband had stolen. Whom can she trust?

items.title: Ghost in the Shell (2017)
items.description: Major (Scarlett Johansson) is the first of her kind, a human mind inside an artificial body. Discovering her creators lied about her past life to control her, Major will stop at nothing to unravel the mystery of her true identity and exact revenge.

items.title: A New Leaf
items.description: Henry Graham, a confirmed bachelor with a zest for luxuries, receives the shocking news that he is now broke. Henry’s spirits are low as he returns to his town-house to discuss the situation with his butler, Harold who suggests marriage as a way out.
