items.description: Generation Zapped is a thought provoking documentary about the potential health dangers associated to overexposure to wireless technologies.

items.title: Climate of Change
items.description: From the producers of "Food Inc," Award winning actress Tilda Swinton narrates this inspiring documentary of a world of everyday people taking action to save our environment.

items.title: Nas: Time is Illmatic
items.description: The story behind Nas's groundbreaking debut album 'Illmatic,' and the early life of one of the most talented rappers of all time. Featuring Pharrell Williams, Alicia Keys, Q-Tip, and Busta Rhymes.

items.title: Avenida Cloverfield 10
items.description: Después de un accidente de autos, una mujer despierta en el búnker de un supervivencialista. Él afirma haberla salvado de un ataque apocalíptico, pero al sospechar de sus intenciones, ella deberá escapar para descubrir la verdad.

items.title: 13 horas: los soldados secretos de Bengasi
items.description: Del director Michael Bay, 13 horas es la historia de un grupo élite de seis exmilitares asignados para proteger a la CIA, que lucharon cuando los terroristas atacaron un complejo diplomático estadounidense el 11 de septiembre de 2012.

items.title: Casi famosos
items.description: Un chico de secundaria tiene la oportunidad de escribir una historia para la revista Rolling Stone sobre una banda emergente mientras los acompaña en su gira.

items.title: Beowulf, la leyenda
items.description: En la era de los héroes llega el más grande guerrero, Beowulf. Tras destruir al poderoso demonio Grendel, se desata la interminable ira de su Madre, una bestia despiadada y seductora que hará todo para asegurar su venganza

items.title: Harlem Nights (ESP)
items.description: Sugar Ray es el propietario de una casa de juego en Harlem. Con la ayuda de su hijo Quick, tratará de evitar que el gángster Bugsy Callhoune, que cuenta con la colaboración de un policía corrupto, se entrometa en sus negocios.

items.title: I.Q: fórmula para amar
items.description: Todo el mundo sabe que Einstein es un genio científico. Pero ¿qué hay de Einstein el casamentero? I.Q. pone esta noción a prueba y logra resultados ganadores en esta "divertida y cálida comedia romántica" que aplauden críticos y público.

items.title: Aventura en Alaska
items.description: Tras graduarse de la Universidad Emory en 1992, el estudiante estrella y atleta Christopher McCandless abandonó sus posesiones, entregó sus ahorros de $24.000 a la caridad y se fue a dedo hasta Alaska a vivir en la naturaleza.

items.title: Bolo
items.description: Bolo Yeung stars and directs this brilliant kung fu comedy. Two convicts get freed from prison and become lawmen in a corrupt village. The scene is set for revenge, and justice finds strange allies.

items.title: Against the Tide
items.description: This documentary examines the conflict that erupted in the American Jewish community over the best means to rescue the European Jews who were trying to escape the Holocaust.

items.title: 2017 the Memorial Tournament
items.description: Jason Dufner wins the 2017 Memorial Tournament presented by Nationwide.

items.title: 2017 RBC Canadian Open
items.description: Jhonattan Vegas wins the 2017 RBC Canadian Open.

items.title: 2017 Quicken Loans National
items.description: Kyle Stanley wins the 2017 Quicken Loans National.

items.title: 2017 DEAN & DELUCA Invitational
items.description: Kevin Kisner wins the 2017 DEAN & DELUCA Invitational.

items.title: 2016 Wyndham Championship
items.description: Si Woo Kim wins the 2016 Wyndham Championship.

items.title: 2016 Travelers Championship
items.description: Russell Knox wins the 2016 Travelers Championship.

items.title: 2016 The Honda Classic
items.description: Adam Scott wins the 2016 Honda Classic.

items.title: 2016 TOUR Championship
items.description: Rory McIlroy wins the 2016 TOUR Championship.

items.title: 2016 RBC Canadian Open
items.description: Jhonattan Vegas wins the 2016 RBC Canadian Open.

items.title: Cotton Club Encore
items.description: Francis Ford Coppola's lavish, 1930s-era epic comes to a vivid new life in this newly remastered and restored version featuring never-before-seen scenes and musical sequences.

items.title: McLintock!
items.description: The cattle rancher McLintock (John Wayne) puts his brand on the territory and every woman in it! Louise Warren plays a widow who moves with her two children onto McLintock’s ranch to serve as cook, while Maureen O’Hara plays the estranged wife.

items.title: Christmas Cupid's Arrow
items.description: Holly, a single college professor, signs up for an online dating service, but begins to grow suspicious when the guy's beautifully-written texts don't match his actions.

items.title: Conversations with Other Women
items.description: When a man and woman flirt with each other at a wedding reception, the sexual tension seems spontaneous. As they break from the party to a hotel room, the flirtation turns into a night filled with passion and remorse.

items.title: Dead Don't Die in Dallas
items.description: A miracle pill intended to save the world causes unforeseen side-effects forcing the surviving gays and bible thumpers in a small Texas town to join forces or fall prey to the flesh craving mutants.

items.title: Dirty Lies
items.description: An under-appreciated intern entrusted with a million dollar necklace races to find out which of his money hungry room-mates betrayed him as he battles a desperate criminal duo bent on stealing.

items.title: Love By Design
items.description: After designer Danielle loses her boyfriend and her job in New York, a trip to her native Romania may help her find herself again.

items.title: Moontrap Target Earth
items.description: A long forgotten ancient spacecraft discovered on Earth. Investigations carried out by Scout transport her to the moon where upon she meets the impressive machines preserving the wisdom of that long lost civilization.

items.title: No Surrender
items.description: An Egyptian police officer named General Yousef al-Masri lives in Karamouz neighborhood in Alexandria. The film dates back to the reign of King Farouk before the 1952 revolution in the English occupation of Egypt.

items.title: Runaway Christmas Bride
items.description: A runaway bride makes herself scarce at a winter resort, where she meets a charming ski patrol rescuer. Just when she begins to believe in love again, her jilted fiance arrives at the resort.

items.title: Street
items.description: Remo Street thinks his dream of becoming a professional fighter will never come true until destiny takes him in a new direction. A Russian gangster meets him on the street and takes him into the world of bare-knuckle boxing.

items.title: The Griddle House
items.description: The story follows teenager Jack Benson. Jack is on the hunt for his birth mother he finds she has been a regular all along at the nearby Griddle House.

items.title: The Town that Came A-Courtin'
items.description: While visiting a Mississippi town for a book tour, a successful author finds romance with the widowed mayor.

items.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
items.description: Sex. Money. Power. Drugs. Brace yourself for a true story from legendary filmmaker Martin Scorsese. Leonardo DiCaprio stars as a young stockbroker hungry for a life of non-stop thrills, where corruption was king and more was never enough.

items.title: The Truman Show
items.description: Truman doesn’t realize that his quaint hometown is a giant studio set run by a visionary producer/director/creator (Ed Harris), that folks living and working there are Hollywood actors, and that even his incessantly bubbly wife is a contract player.

items.title: It's a Mad, Mad, Mad, Mad World
items.description: Spencer Tracy leads a hilariously zany cast of Hollywood's greatest comedians (including Milton Berle, Sid Caesar, Ethel Merman and Mickey Rooney) as eight vacation-bound motorists set off on a mad-cap, side-splitting race to find a stolen fortune!

items.title: Convoy
items.description: Feuding with Sheriff Lyle Wallace (Ernest Borgnine), Martin Penwald (Kris Kristofferson) unites scores of his fellow-drivers via Citizen Band radio into a mile-long convoy which, powered by pent-up resentments, rolls along the Arizona highways.

items.title: The Deadly Companions
items.description: The feature film debut of legendary director Sam Peckinpah finds ex-Union Army sergeant Yellowleg (Brain Keith) in the days following the Civil War on a manhunt for a Rebel army deserter who once tried to have his scalp as he lay dying on the battlefield.

items.title: The Dawn Rider
items.description: When John finds out his father's killer is the brother of his betrothed, complicated decisions arise.

items.title: Sagebrush Trail
items.description: Wrongly put into jail, John Brant escapes, goes West, and joins a gang of outlaws. Ironically, one of the gang members is responsible for the murder Brant was jailed for.

items.title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
items.description: It took some time after the Civil War for the South to recover. Towns imposed martial law to maintain order and the "good guys" banded together against the criminals.

items.title: Riders of Destiny
items.description: The water rights are controlled by Kincade and he charges outrageous rates. An agent for the government wants to make water more accessible and he makes a plan with the ranchers to make it happen.

items.title: Lawless Range
items.description: The Duke wants to win the Cheyenne Rodeo but his father asks him to help an old friend in trouble. So he rides into the valley, finds a beautiful girl to rescue

items.title: My Pal Trigger
items.description: The story of Roy Roger's horse Trigger and the relationship between the cowboy and the horse.

items.title: Azul como el cielo
items.description: Un adolescente con una novia embarazada y sus hermanos se embarcan en un inesperado viaje por carretera con su padre separado que se convierte en la manera perfecta de curar su problemática relación y comprender lo que realmente significa ser padre.

items.title: Pretty In Pink
items.description: She’s a high school girl from the wrong side of town. He’s the wealthy heartthrob who asks her to the prom. But as fast as their romance builds, it’s threatened by the painful reality of peer pressure.

items.title: Let There Be Light
items.description: A group of scientists are approaching the final steps of a machine decades in the making: an artificial star that could provide millions of years of clean energy. Are scientists about to crack nuclear fusion, or chasing a delusion?

items.title: Strad Style
items.description: A rural Ohio hillbilly with an obsession for 'Stradivari', through the magic of social-media, convinces a famous European concert violinist that he can make a copy of one of the most famous and valuable violins in the world.

items.title: UFO Chronicles: Alien Detectives
items.description: Explore the ramifications of the alien presence on planet Earth.

items.title: Public Figure
items.description: A documentary that investigates the psychological effects of everyday social media use while exploring how our influencers deal with the fame, money, hate, and obsession that comes with it.

items.title: Poisoning Paradise
items.description: Produced by Pierce Brosnan and his wife Keely Brosnan. Discover what’s at stake for Hawaii from local activists, scientific experts, and healthcare professionals.

items.title: Call Us Ishmael
items.description: Filmmaker David Shaerf takes us on a journey into the world of Moby-Dick. On the way, he meets artists, musicians, and fans who introduce him to the Great American Novel.

items.title: Caught in a Landslide
items.description: Jay's resident ghost appears nightly, conjuring up visions of a lost summer romance; taunting him with the opportunity to speak words previously unspoken that slowly begin to heal his broken heart and release him from darkness.

items.title: Confessions of a Gay Poet
items.description: Explore a life's journey of love and loss, triumph and tragedy with LGBT rising star Wade Radford (Twink, 1 Last Chance at Paradise). Deeply personal, inspiring and moving, enjoy this candid, poetic exposé into a complex soul.

items.title: Inside the Edge: A Professional Blackjack Adventure
items.description: The documentary film, \"Inside The Edge\" is an unprecedented glimpse into the world of elite blackjack players as they take on casinos for millions.

items.title: Father's Day
items.description: Father's Day is approaching, and sea creatures everywhere are competing for the top prize in the annual Deep Sea Burp Contest. Navigating their way through an awesome ocean adventure, they discover that love is the best prize of all!

items.title: The United States of Detroit
items.description: “The United States of Detroit”, a stylish and moving documentary about the resilience and spirit of Detroit’s neighborhoods, recounting the story of the city’s past, its present resurgence and future potential.

items.title: 3 Bears' Christmas
items.description: After a rigorous journey through the Forest, Baby Bear and Benny realize that the perfect gift simply comes from the heart.

items.title: La vigilante del futuro
items.description: Major (Scarlett Johansson) es la primera de su clase: Una mente humana dentro de un cuerpo artificial. Al descubrir que sus creadores mintieron sobre su pasado para controlarla, no se detendrá hasta revelar su verdadera identidad y vengarse.

items.title: John Grisham's: el poder de la justicia
items.description: Matt Damon es Rudy Baylor, un abogado novato superado por un caso de alto perfil. En su contra, un ejército de tiburones de la ley. De su lado, Deck Shifflet, un batallador "para-abogado" que nunca consiguió obtener su título.

items.title: La máquina del tiempo
items.description: Con la esperanza de alterar los acontecimientos del pasado, un inventor del siglo XIX viaja 800 000 años hacia el futuro, donde encuentra a la humanidad dividida en dos razas beligerantes.

items.title: What Haunts Us
items.description: Haunted by the suicides of her schoolmates in the aftermath of revelations of sexual abuse by a faculty member, one woman revisits her past to uncover the truth of the ghosts that remain in her hometown to this day.

items.title: Abe
items.description: Twelve-year-old Abe has a complicated family: part Israeli, part Palestinian, and constantly fighting. But when he meets chef Chico and his fusion cuisine, Abe wonders if he can craft the perfect meal to bring them all together.

items.title: The Snowman Trek
items.description: A team of marathon runners journey to Bhutan to set a speed record on the world's hardest trek. They confront the harsh conditions of the Himalayas and the skeptical local culture as their adventure verges on the edge of total failure.

items.title: Church & State
items.description: A federal court ruling in 2013 legalized gay marriage for Utah, triggering a fierce battle in a state where Mormon church values control the Legislature and public life. It’s the story of a case that shook a state and changed the nation.

items.title: A Tuba To Cuba
items.description: A TUBA TO CUBA follows New Orleans' famed Preservation Hall Jazz Band as they retrace their musical roots from the storied city of jazz to the shores of Cuba and in turn discover a connection that runs much deeper than could have been imagined.

items.title: Eyes of the Dead
items.description: After a plague of zombies invades a family’s once-peaceful hometown, the havoc they wreak is deadly. Taking place in real time, it’s a zombie thriller that immerses the audience in a pulse-pounding, innovative survival experience.

items.title: A Wizard's Tale
items.description: A reluctant hero flies high above the clouds to a magical kingdom where he must find the crystal key in order to lift a spell… will he be able to ward off the mean-spirited wizard, The Grump, and find the happiness he’s searching for?

items.title: Ice Dragon: Legend of the Blue Daisies
items.description: Melody, a gifted young dreamer, and her feisty friend Leif must set aside their differences and use the power of magic and song to save their world from an evil Ice Dragon in this inspiring animated adventure for the whole family.

items.title: The Phantom of the Opera
items.description: A mad, disfigured composer seeks love with a lovely young opera singer.

items.title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
items.description: In 15th-century Paris, a deformed bell-ringer falls for the kind-hearted Esmeralda, in this 1923 version starting Lon Cheney

items.title: 15 Minutes of War
items.description: French & English w/English Subtitles. Based on the 1976 true story of the Somalian rebel hijacking of a school bus. French captain André Gerval and his team of elite snipers carry out an attack to get them and their teacher out safely.

items.title: The Bouncer
items.description: English & French w/English Subtitles. After an altercation leaves a bodyguard in jail, he must infiltrate a dangerous gang to secure his freedom and the custody of his daughter.

items.title: Big Bear
items.description: After his fiancée runs off with another guy, Joe’s friends throw him a bachelor party anyway with a big surprise tied up in the basement.

items.title: The Night Eats The World
items.description: Sam wakes one morning to find himself living in a nightmare: an army of zombies have invaded the streets of Paris and he the lone survivor. While contemplating his bleak future and how to survive, he learns he may not be alone after all.

items.title: Cartoon Christmas Classics
items.description: Two fun filled hours of rarely seen and highly cherished broadcast television specials and a vintage assortment of theatrical movie studio cartoons.

items.title: Alien Contamination
items.description: One of Gina’s first, a mystery thriller where she takes her husband’s place in a smuggling ring, only to have his partner fall in love with her.

items.title: A Quiet Place to Kill
items.description: In the 1943 invasion of Italy, one American platoon lands, digs in, then makes its way inland to blow up a bridge next to a fortified farmhouse, as tension and casualties mount.

items.title: Metropolis
items.description: In a futuristic city sharply divided between the working class and the city planners, the son of the city's mastermind falls in love with a working class prophet who predicts the coming of a savior to mediate their differences.

items.title: Purple Death From Outer Space
items.description: Flash Gordon, Dale Arden and Rd. Zarkov must go to the planet Mongo and fight the evil emperor Ming when a deadly “Purple Death” plague breaks out on Earth. Tracking the source, our group of adventurers flies to it in Dr. Zarkov’s rocket.

items.title: United
items.description: United is based on the true story of Manchester United's legendary Busby Babes, the youngest side ever to win the Football League, and the 1958 Munich Air Crash that claimed eight of their number.

items.title: Time Warp Vol. 3 - Comedy & Camp
items.description: The final volume of Time Warp digs deep into what makes us laugh over and over again as we reveal the greatest cult comedies and campy classics of all time.

items.title: Time Warp Vol 2 - Horror & Sci-Fi
items.description: The greatest cult horror and science fiction films of all-time are studied in vivid detail in the second volume of Time Warp.

items.title: Time Warp Vol 1: Midnight Madness
items.description: From The Rocky Horror Picture Show to The Big Lebowski and everything in between, this fascinating deep-dive documentary begins its celebration of the greatest cult movies of all-time discussing the birth of the midnight movie

items.title: Ice Girls
items.description: A 15-year-old figure skating champion leaves the sport after her mother loses her job and the family moves to a small town. She struggles to fit in until the owner of a local skating arena helps her fulfill her true potential.

items.title: Gloves Off
items.description: Following his boxing trainer’s sudden death during his championship fight, Doug has inherited a crumbling debt-ridden gym, packed full of a mixed bag of crazy would-be pugilists.

items.title: Android Uprising
items.description: After a devastating battle against an army of drones leaves Sergeant Barbara Slade paralyzed, her only chance for survival is to be placed inside an artificial, android body.

items.title: Death of a Superhero
items.description: Andy Serkis (THE HOBBIT, RISE OF THE PLANET OF THE APES) and Thomas Brodie-Sangster (LOVE ACTUALLY, NOWHERE BOY) star in this exceptional drama about life, death, and first love as a teenage boy faces his own mortality.

items.title: Detachment
items.description: Adrien Brody (in his most acclaimed performance since THE PIANIST), Marcia Gay Harden & Christina Hendricks star in this award-winning drama about teachers and students in a troubled high school. From the director of AMERICAN HISTORY X.

items.title: Essential Killing
items.description: Captured by the US military in Afghanistan, Mohammed (Vincent Gallo) is transported to a secret detention centre somewhere in Europe. When an accident allows him to escape, Mohammed must confront the necessity to kill in order to survive.

items.title: Expecting
items.description: When Andie (Michelle Monaghan, SOURCE CODE) gets pregnant after a one night stand, she offers to give the baby to her best friend (Radha Mitchell, RED WIDOW), who has been unable to conceive. But can their friendship survive the pregnancy?

items.title: For Ellen
items.description: A powerful performance from Paul Dano (LITTLE MISS SUNSHINE, THERE WILL BE BLOOD) as a burgeoning rock star wrestling with the prospect of losing custody of his young daughter. With Jon Heder (NAPOLEON DYNAMITE).

items.title: Hollow
items.description: Terrorized by a legendary dark spirit that drives couples to suicide from the hollow of an ancient tree, four vacationing friends struggle for survival amongst the ruins of a centuries-old monastery.

items.title: How to Make Money Selling Drugs
items.description: Want to make millions in a $400 billion global industry? Find out why no one is winning the war on drugs in this provocative investigation, featuring Russell Simmons, Susan Sarandon, David Simon (creator of "The Wire"), and 50 Cent.

items.title: I Am Big Bird: The Caroll Spinney Story
items.description: An affectionate portrait of Caroll Spinney, the beloved puppeteer responsible for creating worldwide icons out of Sesame Street's Big Bird and Oscar the Grouch for the last 45 years.

items.title: Janie Jones
items.description: Ethan, a musician content with his rock-n-roll lifestyle, has his life turned upside down with the arrival of a 13 year-old daughter he never knew he had. Left to raise Janie Jones, Ethan and Janie embark on a road trip of music and bonding.

items.title: Listen Up Philip
items.description: When a self-obsessed novelist (Jason Schwartzman) has problems with his novel and his girlfriend (Elisabeth Moss), he seeks refuge in his mentor's cottage where the peace and quiet allow him to focus on his favorite subject - himself.

items.title: A Long Way From Home
items.description: The struggles and triumphs of the African-American and Latino players who followed Jackie Robinson into white professional baseball.

items.title: Maladies
items.description: A former soap star (James Franco) appears to have a narrator stuck in his head. As he moves in with his best friend (Catherine Keener) and works to restart his creative career, he tries to figure out who is really calling the shots.

items.title: Carne de neón
items.description: Lleno de humor salvaje, este thriller criminal de alta energía se centra en Ricky, que quiere honrar a su madre prostituta abriendo un burdel, pero no se da cuenta de que invade los dominios del despiadado matón El Chino.

items.title: Stephen King's A Good Marriage
items.description: With a serial killer on the loose and a stranger stalking her family, a dedicated wife unveils a sinister secret about her husband that threatens their marriage, and their lives.

items.title: Still Life
items.description: A government worker charged with finding the family members of those who have died alone is assigned to his final case - and finds himself on a liberating journey that allows him to finally start living his own life to the fullest.

items.title: Struck by Lightning
items.description: Chris Colfer (GLEE) and Rebel Wilson (PITCH PERFECT) star in this hilarious comedy about surviving high school when your classmates don't get you, your parents are crazy, and all you have are your dreams.

items.title: Summer in February
items.description: Dan Stevens (Downton Abbey) and Dominic Cooper (Mamma Mia) star as friends and rivals caught up in a tumultuous love triangle in this sweeping period romance, played out against the timeless beauty of the English coast.

items.title: The Giant Mechanical Man
items.description: This charming romantic comedy proves that it only takes one person to make you feel important. Starring Jenna Fischer (The Office), Chris Messina (Vicky Christina Barcelona) and Topher Grace (That 70's Show).

items.title: The Man Who Unlocked the Universe
items.description: Ruler. Warrior. Astronomer. Ulugh Beg was one of the world's greatest astronomical minds. Blast off on a stunning, cinematic journey from his birth as a prince through right up to his untimely death…foretold in the stars.

items.title: From Prada to Nada
items.description: Nora and Mary are spoiled sisters living the good life in Beverly Hills until their loving father unexpectedly dies.

items.title: Asesino perfecto
items.description: Jean-Claude Van Damme se enfrenta a su oponente más letal hasta el momento, él mismo, cuando interpreta tanto a un atroz asesino en serie como al clon replicado que los científicos han construido para matarlo.

items.title: ¿A quién ama Gilbert Grape?
items.description: Ocuparse de Arnie es una tarea que puede ser bastante demandante para Gilbert, al menos mientras trabaja en la tienda local.

items.title: Cartagena
items.description: Muriel is beautiful, free-spirited and bed-ridden since a horrific accident. Leo is a drunk middle-aged ex-boxer. Desperate for work and unqualified, he interviews Muriel, who hires him to cook and care for her against her better judgment.

items.title: The Punk Rock Movie
items.description: Documentary on the London punk-rock scene, circa '78.

items.title: The Kid
items.description: The Tramp cares for an abandoned child, but events put that relationship in jeopardy.

items.title: Last Holiday
items.description: Upon learning of a terminal illness, a shy woman (Queen Latifah) decides to sell off all her possessions and live it up at a posh European hotel.

items.title: Stake Land
items.description: When an epidemic of vampirism strikes and his family is slaughtered, Martin is taken under the wing of a grizzled, wayward hunter whose new prey are the undead. Mister takes Martin on a journey through the locked-down towns of America’s heartland.

items.title: Master of Dark Shadows
items.description: MASTER OF DARK SHADOWS reveals the fascinating impact of the ground-breaking Gothic drama Dark Shadows with a compelling blend of rare footage and behind-the-scenes stories exploring the diverse talents of filmmaker Dan Curtis.

items.title: Saving Private Ryan
items.description: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

items.title: Looking for Lenny
items.description: Lenny Bruce was one of the key anti-Establishment figures of 1960s America, who constantly pushed the boundaries with his numerous brushes with the law and his convictions for obscenity in 1964. Now is the time to find the man behind the myth.

items.title: The Krays: The Myth Behind the Legend
items.description: Ronnie and Reggie Kray remain two of the most infamous criminals in British history. Legends to many, their fame was built on a fearsome reputation and almost mythical celebrity-like status, but who were the real Kray twins?

items.title: RiffTrax: The Journey: Absolution
items.description: Mario Lopez takes his dimples to space military school in The Journey: Absolution! A movie that contains no journey and even less absolution. But it does contain dialogue like this, an actual conversation in the film.

items.title: Back to the Sea
items.description: When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.

items.title: Ozzy
items.description: Lovable Ozzy’s pampered life is thrown into turmoil after his family drops him at Blue Creek before their vacation. Ozzy quickly learns that Blue Creek is a dog prison, and he’ll need to rely on some new friends to help him break out and get back home.

items.title: Rabbit School
items.description: Max is a rabbit with big dreams, but when he gets lost in a strange land where rabbits are trained to bring children eggs for Easter, he’ll need to learn the secrets of Easter magic to save the Rabbit School from being taken over by a gang of evil foxes.

items.title: Two Tails
items.description: After becoming best friends, a beaver and a cat embark on a dangerous mission to rescue their friends from outer space.

items.title: The Lookout
items.description: Chris "Slapshot" Pratt, whose once-bright future has been dimmed by a severe head injury, is a night janitor at a bank. Lonely and frustrated, he falls prey to a con man and agrees to help rob the bank where he works.

items.title: RiffTrax: Uninvited
items.description: Uninvited is a horror movie written and directed by Star Games and Final Justice mastermind Greydon Clark, so it's not surprising that Greydon Clark put himself in the movie. What is surprising? Pretty much everything else.

items.title: RiffTrax: The Little Unicorn
items.description: The Little Unicorn is a tale of whimsy, fantasy, and extremely generous definitions of the word “little.” Turns out making CGI little unicorns is way more difficult.

items.title: RiffTrax: Grizzly
items.description: Some movies are labors of love, the product of a singular vision and a lifetime of hard work. And sometimes, a guy just says “Make Jaws, but with a bear.”

items.title: RiffTrax: Invasion of the Animal People
items.description: What do a furry monster terrorizing Lapland, a wrecked spaceship, John Carradine, and a beautiful skiing star have in common? Very little, as it turns out! Nonetheless, you'll find them all in Invasion of the Animal People!

items.title: RiffTrax: Jack Frost
items.description: Okay, now that we've got that out of the way, grab your stovepipe hat and favorite murder implement for Jack Frost!

items.title: RiffTrax: Merlin The Return
items.description: Merlin, the legendary wizard is stuck inside a terrible nether dimension. Meanwhile, the former stars of Wayne's World, Highlander, and The Young Ones are stuck in a terrible movie about Merlin, the legendary wizard.

items.title: RiffTrax: Miami Connection
items.description: If you put everything about the 80s in a blender, then somehow ran the resulting smoothie through a translator that only speaks languages from another dimension.

items.title: RiffTrax: Missile X
items.description: A nuclear missile has been stolen! The fate of the planet hangs in the balance! There's only one thing to do: send an aging Peter Graves to Iran and imply that beautiful women half his age are somehow attracted to his lumbering!

items.title: RiffTrax: Oblivion
items.description: It's Cowboys & Aliens in the Wild Wild West! How could a sci-fi western about either of those things possibly be bad?

items.title: RiffTrax: Oblivion 2: Backlash
items.description: Oblivion 2: Backlash! No, it's not just a compilation of all the backlash the first Oblivion received, it's the title of a direct-to-video sequel to Oblivion. What did we do to deserve this? No, seriously, what did we do to deserve this.

items.title: RiffTrax: Omega Cop
items.description: The surest way to tell you're in for a really crappy movie, (other than “Written and directed by James Nguyen”) is the word Cop appearing in the movie title.

items.title: RiffTrax: Pressure Point
items.description: When an assassination attempt fails in a part of Chile that looks suspiciously like Vermont, Sebastian is thrown under the bus by his government.

items.title: RiffTrax: Psychotronic Man
items.description: A surreal journey into the trippy world of, uh, being a barber, it's Psychotronic Man!What does “psychotronic” mean, exactly?

items.title: RiffTrax: Star Games
items.description: Star Games! If you've ever asked what it would be like if Greydon Clark, the infamous director of Final Justice and Angels' Revenge, tried his hand at a science fiction movie.

items.title: RiffTrax: Starship Invasions
items.description: Do you ever stop to wonder what it would be like if Canadian Ed Wood directed Star Wars with a bunch of pages from The Happening randomly inserted into the screenplay? You do??? Please seek help immediately!

items.title: RiffTrax: The Dark
items.description: Are you afraid of The Dark? You should be. Not because it's scary, it most certainly isn't, but because it will rattle your brains if you try too hard to understand what it's about.

items.title: RiffTrax Short: Carnivorous Plants
items.description: Carnivorous Plants! Like Wii Boxing, they're one of those things that instantly becomes 1000X less cool the moment you bring it home and try it out. Rather than quickly earning their keep and chomping down on your neighbors annoying labradoodle.

items.title: RiffTrax Short: Christmas Toyshop
items.description: Can't anyone tell me what Christmas is all about!? an exasperated Charlie Brown once asked. Well, pace Linus van Pelt, the true meaning of Christmas—according to Christmas Toyshop—is a criminally incompetent fathe.

items.title: RiffTrax Short: Why Doesn't Cathy
items.description: At long last, the question of the ages is met head on. No facet of the issue is left unexplored. The philosophical, eschatological, teleological, epistemological, and cosmological aspects are all given a thorough exegetical going over.

items.title: RiffTrax Presents: She
items.description: SHE: it's not just a singular nominative pronoun - it's the latest RiffTrax from Bridget and Mary Jo!

items.title: RiffTrax Presents: Deadly Instincts
items.description: Take off your bra, perm your hair, and shine your love! Bridget and Mary Jo take you back in time to riff the 1979 classic Angels' Revenge.

items.title: RiffTrax Presents: Junior Prom

items.description: Justice & Laurie, friends since childhood, discover their true feelings for one another, as Laurie gets set to marry Quinton, Justice's best friend.

items.title: A Christmas Star
items.description: Born under the Christmas Star, Noelle believes she has the gift to perform miracles, so when conniving developer McKerrod threatens her peaceful life she and her friends determine to use this gift to thwart his plans and save their village.

items.title: Across the Line
items.description: The story centers on Charlie, a Los Angeles billionaire financial whiz who goes into self-imposed exile in Tijuana after his empire is revealed to have been a Ponzi scheme.

items.title: The Christmas Switch
items.description: Through Eddie's wit and guile, he gives Sam that last night and finally finds the real meaning of Christmas the gambler's way.

items.title: Beverly Hills Christmas
items.description: A spoiled, rich, young teenage girl is about to find that true value is not found in price tags and 'things' but by the kind acts of helping others with the helping hand of a guardian angel.

items.title: Killer Island
items.description: While on a dream vacation with her husband, a woman becomes a target after she starts to suspect one of the island's locals may have committed multiple murders.

items.title: Patient Killer
items.description: In an effort to uncover the truth behind her patient's nightmare's, a psychiatrist suggests hypnosis without realizing the deadly consequences.

items.title: Art of the Prank
items.description: Joey Skaggs, Godfather of the media hoax, famed for such media fictions as Celebrity Sperm Bank, Cathouse for Dogs, Fat Squad, and Portofess, decides to pull off the most demanding hoax of his career.

items.title: Topkapi
items.description: Peter Ustinov won an Oscar for Best Supporting Actor in this lighthearted thriller about five thieves (including Melina Mercouri, Maximilian Schell and Robert Morley) who undertake an absolutely impossible grand theft in Istanbul.

items.title: Merry Ex-Mas
items.description: During a blizzard at christmas, a man becomes snowbound with ex-wife, her wealthy suitor, his former mother in law, and his daughter.

items.title: Don't Get Caught
items.description: While on a road trip, two friends rob a marijuana farm, and end up with a $100,000 bounty on their heads.

items.title: Iron Monkey
items.description: Presented by Quentin Tarantino, Iron Monkey is the spirited tale of a mysterious and mythical Chinese legend in this exhilarating non-stop martial arts excitement.

items.title: The King (2018)
items.description: Driving a Rolls-Royce once owned by Elvis Presley - with a revolving crew of musicians in the backseat - director Eugene Jarecki embarks on a cross-country road trip to explore how Elvis lost his authenticity as America lost its soul.

items.title: Animals
items.description: Jude and Bobbie are conning their way through life to feed their endless addiction. When confronted with the reality of their situation, the young lovers must decide if true love can prevail in the face of all else.

items.title: Hijos De La Sal
items.description: En las salinas desiertas de Las Cumaraguas, la vida es tan dura como los minerales que extraen del agua. Cuando Evaristo muere, sus hijos se enfrentan a sus propios demonios, deseos y tradiciones de su ciudad, en busca de un camino vigorizante.

items.title: A Girl Like Her
items.description: Everybody’s dream girl. One girl’s nightmare. Based on a million true stories, A Girl like Her follows 16-year-old Jessica and her hidden camera that documents the merciless bullying handed down by Avery, the most popular girl in school.

items.title: 30 Days of Night: Dark Days
items.description: Almost a year has passed since vampires decimated Barrow, Alaska’s population. Stella, mourning her husband’s murder, has been traveling the world trying to convince others that vampires exist.

items.title: 30 Days of Night
items.description: Josh Hartnett (The Black Dahlia, Pearl Harbor) crosses over to the dark side in this bone-chilling adaptation of the cult-hit graphic novel, brought to the screen in all its demonic glory.

items.title: 50 Glorious Years: The Remarkable Marriage of the Queen and Prince Philip
items.description: Celebrating the Golden Wedding Anniversary of the Queen and Prince Philip, this programme is a sympathetic look at not only their lives together, but also an insight into Britain and the changes it has gone through in 50 Glorious Years.

items.title: A Date With Miss Fortune
items.description: When a struggling writer meets a superstitious Portuguese beauty, he has the idea that his life and luck are both about to change. A romantic comedy about cross-cultural relationships, ala 'Meet the Parents' and 'My Big Fat Greek Wedding'.

items.title: Astronaut: The Last Push
items.description: When disaster strikes the dangerous mission to explore life on Jupiter's moon, Europa - stranded and alone, astronaut Michael Forrest must fight to maintain his sanity as he holds his tiny spacecraft together for the trip home.

items.title: Battle Of Dunkirk
items.description: Relive the bravery of the Dunkirk veterans in defenseless boats crossing the English Channel to rescue the stranded soldiers through their uplifting stories of heroism in a battle that changed the course of WWII.

items.title: Beauty and the Breast
items.description: A compelling insight into the reality of breast cancer, as seen through the eyes of nine female patients. Their individual stories demystify the deadly disease while painting intimate, often humorous portraits of struggle and survival.

items.title: Beyond Boundaries
items.description: Hollywood media mogul Harvey Weinstein becomes a catalyst for the #MeToo Movement. Contains testimonials from those who knew him well such as Hillary Clinton, Emma Thompson, Heather Kerr, Ashley Judd, Rose McGowan, Uma Thurman, and more!

items.title: Breaking Legs
items.description: A high school freshman moves to a town where there's no place to dance except the school dance team. But when the boyfriend of the team's lead girl falls for her, she'll have to fight to win her place among the popular but venomous girls.

items.title: Breath of Life
items.description: Explore the wisdom of the people who sustainably live off the land, as this poignant documentary goes on a global journey to get insightful commentaries from the world’s greatest scientists. Ponder what we can do to preserve our planet.

items.title: Check Point
items.description: When a sleeper cell terrorist plot is discovered in a small town, a team of unlikely heroes must rise up to fight the enemy and protect their country.

items.title: Cheeseheads: The Documentary
items.description: What does it mean to be a Cheesehead? Most people think cheese, beer, and football. But when a devoted Cheesehead returns to Wisconsin to explore the deeper meaning, he discovers a state of beauty, tradition, and hometown pride.

items.title: Comedy Warriors
items.description: Take 4 top comedians (The Coaches: Zach Galifianakis, Bob Saget, B.J. Novak, Lewis Black), and 5 wounded veterans (Stephen Rice, Darisse Smith, Rob Jones, Bobby Henline, Joe Kashw) and the result… laughter and the healing power of humor.

items.title: Crazy
items.description: Inspired by the life of Hank Garland, CRAZY is the story of a legendary guitar player who emerged from Nashville in the 1950s.

items.title: Egypt
items.description: Discover the secrets of Egypt! Take a look at the pyramids, pharaohs, mummification, the Sphinx, hieroglyphs, and gods like never before in this stereoscopic journey.

items.title: Elle: A Modern Cinderella Tale
items.description: Elle dreamed of becoming a singer. She is now in L.A. interning at a record label and meets her Pop Prince Charming. But the divas at the label will do anything to keep her from success. Elle proves happily ever after is just a song away.

items.title: Fart: A Documentary
items.description: Why is farting so funny? Dive into the history of passing gas, with notable appearances from celebrities such as Mr. Methane (aka “World’s Only Performing Flatulist”).

items.title: Fifty Shades Uncovered
items.description: As the 50 Shades craze continues to smash sales records, this documentary provides an intimate look into why the books have become such a success. Featuring exclusive interviews with an archive from the twilight zone of submissive romance.

items.title: Fight Like a Girl
items.description: Follow Jill Morley as she delves inside the world of female boxers to meet the women who are passionate about fighting hard. Real emotional histories and traumas bubble up, fleshing out a compelling story about women overcoming adversity.

items.title: For The Love of George
items.description: A jilted wife leaves her husband and jets off to Los Angeles in search of the man of her dreams: George Clooney – and will stop at nothing to meet him!

items.title: From War To Wisdom
items.description: Veterans from the most decorated Battalion in Marine Corps history, Fox 2/5, discuss the psychological injuries of war—and the unexpected trauma of returning to civilian life after the accolades of their successful battles have ended.

items.title: A Frosty Affair
items.description: In this romantic comedy, a small-town teacher is on her way to the city for her wedding when a blizzard strikes, and she is snowed in. An unlikely adventure with a lumberjack leaves her questioning her future wedding plans.

items.title: As Dreamers Do
items.description: Behind every great mouse there is a man…Follow Walt Disney through his early life, as his ever-growing imagination and eternal optimism lead to the birth of a legend.

items.title: A Gift Horse
items.description: Torn apart by the loss of her mother, young Amanda spends time at a ranch owned by a business tycoon. When his spoiled daughter rejects their new horse, Amanda proves that Misty is a true champion and restores her happiness in the process.

items.title: Tyler Perry's Madea's Family Reunion
items.description: A pistol-packing grandma tries to hold a family reunion, a funeral, and a wedding all in the same weekend.

items.title: Lise Meitner
items.description: This is the story of a woman who deserves to be placed on a par with Einstein, Heisenberg and Otto Hahn. The talented physicist, Lise Meitner is a historical figure that was ahead of her time; both as a scientist and a feminist.

items.title: Nadia Comăneci
items.description: The Montreal Olympic Games, 18th July 1976: an angel-faced young gymnast storms onto the international sports scene, quickly becoming a legend. Behind the scenes, she was forced to maintain a relationship with a strange dictator.

items.title: ¿Y dónde está el policia? 33 1/3: el insulto final
items.description: La noche de los Óscar(r). ¿Puede alguien echar ese zoquete? ¡Esperen! No es un zoquete cualquiera, es el Tte. Frank Drebin. ¡Y se coló para detener un atentado terrorista!

items.title: Un despertar glorioso
items.description: Un presentador de la vieja escuela renuncia a su programa de noticias de mucho tiempo debido a las costumbres nuevas. Es reclutado por un productor estrella que quiere revivir un programa matutino endeble.

items.title: Noé
items.description: Russell Crowe interpreta a Noé, en la historia llena de valor, sacrificio y esperanza. Esta impactante aventura de acción es aclamada como "una de las más inolvidables historias bíblicas llevadas a la pantalla". (Richard Roeper, Chicago-Sun-Times).

items.title: Silencio
items.description: Silencio de Martin Scorsese cuenta la historia de dos misioneros que viajan a Japón en búsqueda de su mentor desaparecido en un momento en que el cristianismo estaba prohibido. Cuando son capturados, ambos hombres se sumergen en una peligrosa odisea.

items.title: Capitán Sky y el mundo del mañana
items.description: Cuando misteriosos robots gigantes comienzan a atacar las calles de la ciudad de Nueva York, la intrépida reportera Polly Perkins cubre la historia y solicita la ayuda del aviador y su amor del pasado Joseph "Sky Captain" Sullivan.

items.title: Vampire Skeletons
items.description: A new archaeological find reveals a disturbing truth behind the legend of the vampire. Were mutilated bodies in an ancient Irish grave associated with political terrorism or a ritual killing performed by a vampire?

items.title: Space Smash
items.description: Just like the movie “Gravity”, fragments of missiles and satellites in space have become a nightmare for astronauts. In 2009, two satellites collided, sending tons of space trash into orbit at an incredible speed, creating a vicious circle of space waste.

items.title: Scarlet Woman
items.description: Mary Magdalene is one of the Bible's most enduring enigmas. She's described as a Jewish woman who traveled with Jesus and witnessed both the Crucifixion and Resurrection. For millennia, artists have been telling the tale of her relationship with Jesus.

items.title: Poker Brain
items.description: In poker, it is often impossible to decipher another players’ emotions or intentions. This film takes viewers into the minds of the world’s best players using state-of-the-art computer analysis, theories of human expression, and expert commentary.

items.title: One Way Astronaut
items.description: The Mars One initiative plans to take four astronauts on a mission to Mars within 10 years. The astronauts leave, knowing they’ll never see everyone they love again.

items.title: Manet and the Birth of Impressionism
items.description: Manet is often cited as the father of Impressionism, and yet he refused to show with them and was careful to maintain an aesthetic distance from Monet, Renoir and others. He looked down on them, preferring his own departure from the traditional art forms.

items.title: Earth's Survival
items.description: Made in consultation with world leading climate scientists and organizations, this groundbreaking documentary explains how we may be in the middle of the most crucial moment of Earth’s history.

items.title: Chicken Planet
items.description: The love story between chickens and men has lasted for over 5000 years. How has this humble forest animal managed to conquer all continents, all territories and become the most abundant and diversified feathered species on our planet?

items.title: Calamity Jane: Legend of the West
items.description: From the Great Plains of the American West to the Rocky Mountains, from Apache Reservations to the suburbs of Deadwood, she could be seen bringing up the rear in convoys of pioneers or riding with desperados. Meet Martha Canary, alias Calamity Jane.

items.title: Becoming Cary Grant
items.description: Cary Grant is one of the most enduring icons of Hollywood's golden era. Film historian and biographer David Thomson describes him as the greatest screen actor of all time. Now, for the first time, one of Hollywood’s greatest stars tells his own story.

items.title: Chonda Pierce: Girl Talk
items.description: As the undisputed highest-selling female comedian of all time, this preacher's daughter is here to share some of her funniest stories with you and your whole family.

items.title: La Treintena
items.description: Cuatro amigos están a punto de entrar en la treintena en medio de la cuarentena por coronavirus.

items.title: A Christmas Snow
items.description: Kathleen Mitchell (Catherine Mary Stewart), has carried around the unwanted memory of her father abandoning her and her mother almost 30 years ago on Christmas Eve.

items.title: Biblical Mysteries: Sodom & Gomorrah
items.description: This compelling, NBC primetime special featuring scholar Mike Sanders leads us on an unprecedented exploration to the depths of the salty Dead Sea.

items.title: Sheeba
items.description: When Clay has to move away from his friends and the bright lights of New York City, he's far from happy. He soon finds comfort and friendship with his new dog, Sheeba.

items.title: The Apocalypse
items.description: From the Emmy Award-winning Bible Collection comes a production starring Richard Harris as the Apostle John.

items.title: The Lady Vanishes
items.description: While traveling in continental Europe, a rich young playgirl realizes that an elderly lady seems to have disappeared from the train.

items.title: Kiss Me, Stupid
items.description: In this comic gem from the legendary Billy Wilder and his long-time writing partner I.A.L. Diamond, Dean Martin is a famous singer targeted by two would-be songwriters who encourage a waitress (Kim Novak) to coerce Dino into a song-buying mood.

items.title: Bonhoeffer Agent of Grace
items.description: The story of Dietrich Bonhoeffer, a German clergyman of great distinction, who actively opposed Hitler and the Nazis. His convictions cost him his life.

items.title: Some Girls
items.description: An American college student (Patrick Dempsey) spends Christmas with his girlfriend's (Jennifer Connelly) outlandishly odd family in Quebec City in this farcically unpredictable comedy.

items.title: Clancy Once Again
items.description: Exploring the lives of Nick, Avery, Walter, Chief Payne, Kelly Smith, and more after a decade.

items.title: RiffTrax Short: Primary Safety
items.description: The follow-up to the smash hit "Primary Safety: In the Three Mile Island Cooling Tower", Primary Safety: In The School Building starts with a catchy name and builds from there.

items.title: Paradise Canyon
items.description: The King of the Cowboys In A Whizz-Bang Western! John Wayne stars as an undercover man trying to catch up with some counterfeiters.

items.title: Loco Love
items.description: After losing his restaurant to his ex-wife, Donald's gardener wins the lottery & offers him a new restaurant if he agrees to marry his beautiful, but crazy sister so she can get a green card.

items.title: Black Beauty
items.description: A father allows his daughter to spend the summer with her grandfather rehabilitating an injured horse, and they learn that love and trust can heal anything.

items.title: Trapped
items.description: Lloyd Bridges and Barbara Payton star in this suspenseful drama from director Richard Fleischer (The Boston Strangler, Soylent Green).

items.title: Tulsa
items.description: Susan Hayward stars in this dramatic tale of the Oklahoma oil boom. She plays Cherokee Lansing, a determined young woman out to protect her father's honor after he's killed by men from a competing oil company.

items.title: Hatfields and McCoys: Bad Blood
items.description: Starring Jeff Fahey, Perry King and Christian Slater. When a Union soldier on his way home crosses paths with a family of Confederate supporters, a bloody feud erupts between neighboring families.

items.title: Aliados
items.description: Cuando el agente de inteligencia Max Vatan (Brad Pitt) descubre que su esposa (Marion Cotillard, ganadora del Oscar) puede conspirar con el enemigo, solo tiene 72 horas para demostrar su inocencia y salvar a su familia antes de hacer lo impensable.

items.title: Hotel para perros
items.description: Un adolescente huérfano que aloja en secreto a perros perdidos en un hotel abandonado. Basado en la novela de Lois Duncan.

items.title: Locos por el juego
items.description: Un jugador de bolos estrella, con una carrera "cortada" prematuramente, quiere llevar a un nuevo prodigio al éxito.

items.title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: la cuna de la vida
items.description: Lara Croft inicia una búsqueda para evitar que la caja de Pandora caiga en las manos equivocadas.

items.title: Minority Report: sentencia previa
items.description: Minority Report es sobre un policía del futuro que trabaja en una división del departamento de policía arrestando asesinos antes de que cometan crímenes, gracias a una avanzada tecnología de premoniciones.

items.title: The Vicious Kind
items.description: A man warns his brother about his new girlfriend, only to be drawn to her himself in this dark comedy.

items.title: Wild Bill Hickok: Swift Justice
items.description: Wild Bill Hickok has faced many challenges on his quest to redeem himself from a colorful past as an outlaw and gunslinger.

items.title: Get the Gringo
items.description: A career criminal nabbed by Mexican authorities is placed in a tough prison, where he learns to survive with the help of a young boy.

items.title: La Sra. Dalloway
items.description: En 1923 en Londres, la fiesta delicadamene planificada de la socialité Clarissa Dalloway se ve ensombrecida por el regreso de un antiguo pretendiente que había conocido 33 años antes.

items.title: Momentos que cambiaron la historia: Desechando el transbordador
items.description: El transbordador espacial fue la obra maestra de la aeronáutica de su tiempo, pero los altos costos de producción.

items.title: La profecía
items.description: El ángel Gabriel viene a la Tierra para recoger un alma que pondrá fin a la guerra estancada en el Cielo. Protagonizada por los nominados al Óscar Christopher Walken y Viggo Mortensen.

items.title: Sueños violentos
items.description: Una adolescente descarriada (Drew Barrymore) asesina a su padrastro abusador; luego ayuda a su amigo por correspondencia, que está en prisión, a salir libre por buen comportamiento y se da a la fuga.

items.title: Un plan infalible
items.description: Un ingenioso trío de ladrones disfrazados debe luchar por sus vidas y el botín cuando un verdadero criminal maestro los chantajea para que planifiquen y ejecuten un atraco de $20 millones. Protagonizada por Ryan Reynolds.

items.title: Sweet Talker
items.description: A sweet-talking con man starts to turn his life around when he falls in love with this family-oriented comedy.

items.title: Party Monster
items.description: The life of a prominent party organizer spirals out of control when he brags about killing his drug dealer.

items.title: Life in the Doghouse
items.description: This film tells the inspiring stories of Danny Robertshaw and Ron Danta and the remarkable work they do at Danny & Ron’s Rescue. Ten years and 10,000 dogs later, their unique approach to life and dog rescue will capture hearts and inspire millions.

items.title: Defenseless
items.description: In this crime drama, a lawyer is hired to defend an old college friend accused of murdering her husband.

items.title: Decoys
items.description: In this chilling sci-fi horror, a college student begins to believe that the girls on campus are behind a string of bizarre murders.

items.title: Dayveon
items.description: In the wake of his older brother’s death, 13-year-old Dayveon spends the sweltering summer days roaming his rural Arkansas town.

items.title: Chicago: The Terry Kath Experience
items.description: A journey into the mind of one of the most underrated guitarists in rock history. Follow Terry Kath's daughter as she discovers the truth around the life and death of a father she never knew.

items.title: Diary of the Dead
items.description: While on location filming a horror movie, a group of college students finds themselves overrun by zombies, and ultimately end up capturing the epidemic on film.

items.title: Don't Give Up The Ship
items.description: New bridegroom called to D.C. to explain what happened to a navy destroyer escort gone since WWII.

items.title: Earth Girls Are Easy
items.description: Three aliens (Jim Carrey, Damon Wayans, and Jeff Goldblum) crash-land in Los Angeles' San Fernando Valley. A manicurist (Geena Davis) and her boss (the wacky Julie Brown) befriend the threesome, give them makeovers and show them the town.

items.title: Jack Ryan: Shadow Recruit
items.description: Jack Ryan must quickly evolve from soldier to analyst to full-fledged operative to stop a devastating terrorist plot against the United States.

items.title: Eden Lake
items.description: A young couple travels to a remote lake quarry in England, only to fend off a group of teenage hoods.

items.title: The Grandmaster
items.description: From director Wong Kar Wai and starring Tony Leung and Ziyi Yang, THE GRANDMASTER is an epic action film inspired by the life of Ip Man, the legendary kung fu master who trained Bruce Lee.

items.title: The Matador
items.description: A globetrotting hitman and a salesman form an unlikely relationship after meeting at a hotel bar in Mexico City.

items.title: The Road
items.description: In the years following a world-shattering apocalyptic event, a father and son travel on foot through the charred remains of North America, struggling to survive on a quest to reach the ocean.

items.title: My Friend Irma
items.description: A slapsticky saga related by a comparatively bright brunette dishing the dirt about her dumb blonde roommate. Dean Martin and Jerry Lewis's movie debut.

items.title: My Friend Irma Goes West
items.description: Singer Steve, friend Seymour and fiance Jane, along with her dizzy blonde room mate Irma, have a series of misadventures on a California-bound train and end up involved with a gang of murderous gangsters in Las Vegas.

items.title: Super 8
items.description: In the summer of 1979, a group of friends in a small Ohio town witness a catastrophic train crash while making a Super 8 movie and soon suspect that it was not an accident.

items.title: Black Mama, White Mama
items.description: A prostitute (Pam Grier) and a revolutionary (Margaret Markov) escape from a Philippine woman's prison. Disguised as nuns and chained together, they head into jungle, pursued by local police and a small-time kingpin enlisted to bring them back.

items.title: 200 Motels
items.description: The great Frank Zappa's outrageous psychedelic precursor to today's music videos features The Mothers of Invention wreaking havoc in a typical American town. Ringo Starr narrates.

items.title: The Hospital
items.description: George C. Scott stars as the Head of Medicine at a hospital where, over one night, everything falls apart.

items.title: Stephen King's Sometimes They Come Back
items.description: A high school teacher (Tim Matheson) faces the demon ghosts of a gang of former students. Brooke Adams, Robert Hy Gorman, Robert Rusler, Nicholas Sadler and William Sanderson also star. Based on a short story by Stephen King.

items.title: Pork Chop Hill
items.description: Gregory Peck heads an all-star cast in this true re-enactment of the terrifying Korean War that brilliantly pulls the viewer inextricably into the crossfire that surrounds American foot soldiers.

items.title: Crisscross
items.description: Goldie Hawn delivers a moving portrayal as a poor, single mother, abandoned by her husband (Keith Carradine), and left to raise her young son (David Arnott) in a seedy Key West neighborhood.

items.title: Black Caesar
items.description: The brutal assault at the hands of a racist cop will inform the life of Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson, Hammer), who will grow up to become the reigning head of Harlem’s black mafia in Black Caesar.

items.title: The Magnificent Seven Ride!
items.description: When his wife is killed, Marshal Chris Adams (Lee Van Cleef) discovers that a ruthless horde of marauders have killed all the men -- and will come back for the women -- in a nearby border town...unless The Magnificent Seven can stop them!

items.title: Support Your Local Sheriff!
items.description: James Garner stars in this rollicking western spoof that has him taking on the job of a frontier town sheriff who must fend off villains (led by Walter Brennen) from every direction...all without breaking a sweat or dirtying his shiny black boots!

items.title: Support Your Local Gunfighter
items.description: James Garner is back in the saddle again as hustler Latigo Smith whose latest con is passing off cowhand Jug (Jack Elam) as the dreaded gunman Swifty Morgan. But when the real Swifty shows up, the Wild West is going to get a whole lot wackier!

items.title: Return Of The Seven
items.description: Starring Yul Brynner and a stellar supporting cast that includes Robert Fuller, Warren Oates and Claude Akins, this classic western adventure follows the legendary Magnificent Seven as they thunder through Mexico to face the shootout of their lives!

items.title: American Ninja 3: Blood Hunt
items.description: Martial artist David Bradley takes the reins as Sean Davidson in this third installment of the wildly popular American Ninja franchise, teaming up with Steve James to battle a maniacal terrorist in yet another explosive action-packed adventure!

items.title: Wheel Of Time
items.description: Wheel of Time is Werner Herzog's photographed look at the largest Buddhist ritual in Bodh Gaya, India.

items.title: The Dark Glow Of The Mountains
items.description: Werner Herzog follows mountaineers Hans Kammerlander and Reinhold Messner during their expedition into climbing the Gasherbrum mountains, which has some of the most difficult peaks to be conquered, and they'll do it without the use of oxygen tanks.

items.title: Sebastian Maniscalco: Aren't You Embarrassed?
items.description: Sebastian Maniscalco returns home to Chicago to perform in front of a live sold-out audience in this all-new comedy event. With his inimitable delivery, he burns modern-day society through the lens of his old-world Italian-American upbringing.

items.title: La Soufrière
items.description: Herzog takes a film crew to the island of Guadeloupe when he hears that the volcano on the island is going to erupt. Everyone has left, except for one old man who refuses to leave. Herzog catches the eeriness of an abandoned city.

items.title: How Much Wood Would A Woodchuck Chuck?
items.description: Herzog examines the world championships for cattle auctioneers, his fascination with a language created by an economic system, and compares it to the lifestyle of the Amish, who live nearby.

items.title: Herdsman Of The Sun
items.description: Herzog's documentary of the Wodaabe people of the Sahara/Sahel region. Particular attention is given to the tribe's spectacular courtship rituals and 'beauty pageants', where eligible young men strive to outshine each other and attract mates.

items.title: The Medusa Touch
items.description: Psychological thriller about a novelist, a telekinetic, who causes disasters simply by thinking about them.

items.title: Space Truckers
items.description: A space trucker and his cute fiancee are on their way from a space station to Earth with an unknown cargo. When space pirates hijack them, 5000 disintegrator robots are found in the cargo.

items.title: Scanners II: The New Order
items.description: A breed of humans with dangerously powerful telepathic abilities The Scanners are being recruited by a corrupt police commander, John Forrester, in his crusade to take over the city.

items.title: Guardians [Dubbed]
items.description: DEFENDERS OF THE WORLD, UNITE! During the Cold War, the secret organization Patriot created an elite squad of superheroes to defend the Soviet Union from threats far beyond the capabilities of mortal men.

items.title: Galaxy Of Terror
items.description: Neurotic astronauts (Edward Albert, Erin Moran, Ray Walston) face a giant worm and other monsters on a distant planet.

items.title: Forbidden World
items.description: Part Alien. Part Human. All Nightmare! In the distant future, a federation marshal arrives at a research lab on a remote planet where a monstrous genetic experiment is loose and feeding on the scientists who created it.

items.title: Escape To Athena
items.description: A World War II adventure, involving a group of Allied POWs, Nazis, black market priceless art treasures, Greek resistance, a Greek monastery, and a secret German rocket base.

items.title: A Thousand Kisses Deep
items.description: An unsettling drama that cinematically captures and recreates the psycho-analytic experience.

items.title: The Legend Of Longwood
items.description: Mickey Miller is a thoroughly modern 12-year-old New Yorker who has little enthusiasm for her mother's plan to take her and her little brother to start a new life Longwood, a windswept town in Ireland.

items.title: Jeffrey
items.description: This romantic comedy centers on the chaotic love life of Jeffrey, a gay man who swears off sex only to fall in love with his ideal man.

items.title: Cinderella And The Secret Prince
items.description: With the help of good fairy Crystal, Cinderella and her three mouse friends are able to escape the attic they live in and make it to the Royal Ball at the palace but they soon discover a terrible secret.

items.title: Sound! Euphonium: The Movie – Our Promise: A Brand New Day [Subtitled]
items.description: Kumiko is now in her second year at Kitauji High School, and with a new year comes new problems. As if making it to Nationals wasn't hard enough, Kumiko is tasked with mentoring the concert band's troublesome first years. [Subtitled]

items.title: Dark Star
items.description: In the far reaches of space, a small crew, 20 years into their solitary mission, find things beginning to go hilariously wrong.

items.title: Jóvenes locales
items.description: Dos hermanos y sus compañeros de surf se enfrentan a nuevos desafíos y aventuras en el transcurso de un verano memorable. Protagonizada por los íconos de la televisión Eric Christian Olsen.

items.title: Fórmula 51
items.description: Un químico maestro estadounidense planea obtener un gran puntaje en un negocio de drogas único en la vida. No todo va según lo planeado y pronto se enreda en una red de engaños.

items.title: Dahmer (ESP)
items.description: Jeffrey Dahmer (Jeremy Renner, Zona de miedo) fue vilipendiado cuando las autoridades descubrieron que había asesinado, desmembrado e incluso tratado de consumir los cuerpos de 15 jóvenes en Milwaukee.

items.title: The Vikings
items.description: Legends Kirk Douglas, Tony Curtis, Ernest Borgnine and Janet Leigh dazzle in this epic chronicle of brutal rivalry and bloodthirsty ambition as two brothers are locked in a battle that will decide their fate...and that of a beautiful princess.

items.title: Control
items.description: Wanting to emulate his musical heroes, Ian Curtis joins a band, Joy Division. The singer's professional, personal, and romantic troubles slowly begin to eat away at him; leading him to commit suicide at the age of 23.

items.title: The Cooler
items.description: Bernie Lootz (William H. Macy), is the unluckiest man in Vegas. His bad luck is so contagious that Shelly Kaplow (Alec Baldwin), the last of the old-time mobsters, uses Bernie to kill the high rollers' action at his casino.

items.title: Dedication
items.description: A lonely and eccentric children's book writer is assigned to work with an attractive female illustrator after his partner and sole friend dies. All the while, the illustrator's ex-boyfriend is attempting to win her over.

items.title: Nowhere Boy
items.description: A biopic of the early years of John Lennon.

items.title: Vicky Cristina Barcelona
items.description: Two girlfriends on a summer holiday in Spain became enamored with the same painter, fully unaware that his ex-wife, with whom he still has a tempestuous relationship, is about to re-enter the picture.

items.title: Snowpiercer
items.description: After a failed global-warming experiment, a post-apocalyptic Ice Age has killed off nearly all life on the planet.

items.title: Cubo cero
items.description: Un grupo de participantes forzados se mueven frenéticamente a través de una construcción ominosa de habitaciones en forma de cubo.

items.title: The List
items.description: A lawyer inherits an interest in a mysterious secret society following his father's death. He is then courted by members of the shady organisation and uncovers the sinister secrets and deceit that exists at the heart of the organisation.

items.title: The War Within
items.description: A battle rages for the being of Michael, a successful cartoonist, whose faith is tested when six aspects of his soul, Mind, Memory, Emotion, Will, Conscience, and Heart, vie for control, eventually impacting his marriage.

items.title: Mr. and Mrs. Andelman
items.description: Love and ambition, treason and secrets blend together as we follow the odyssey of this extraordinary couple Sarah and Victor, within the greater story of the past century.

items.title: Seven Swords: Bone of the Godmaker (2019)
items.description: In this action fantasy saga, a group of four swordsmen team up to battle a powerful demonic force.

items.title: Namiya: Adventure Into the Past
items.description: In this fantasy adventure starring Jackie Chan, three drifters go on a time-traveling journey to the past. When a group of runaway teens come across a long-deserted general store, they discover a hidden magic in its walls - one that lets them travel to th

items.title: Seven Swords: Eye of Shura (2019)
items.description: In this fantasy saga, a man battles against an ages-old evil demon that has long haunted his family.

items.title: Through the Shadow
items.description: Evil spirits haunt a farm in this supernatural tale. When Laura is hired to tutor two children on a rural site, she begins to suspect the kids are possessed by a sinister force.

items.title: Veronica
items.description: After his parents are murdered by a drug cartel, young Leandro goes on the run of his life. Powerful traffickers are out to kill Leandro. His teacher, Veronica, puts her life on the line to protect him from evil.

items.title: Detective K: Secret of Virtuous Widow
items.description: Detective genius Detective K is enlisted by the king to investigate a string of murders that may be linked to a government conspiracy. But when K becomes a suspect himself, he'll have to catch the killers to prove his own innocence.

items.title: El sustituto (1996)
items.description: Un exmarine se hace pasar por maestro sustituto en una preparatoria para identificar a la pandilla que está sembrando el terror. Cuando la situación se hace más peligrosa, entra en acción para limpiar la escuela de crimen.

items.title: I'm Not There
items.description: The life of Bob Dylan is examined through multiple variations of his own personality and career, as played by a series of different actors.

items.title: Four Brothers
items.description: After their adoptive mother is murdered during a grocery store hold-up, the Mercer bros reunite to take the matter into their own hands. As they track down the killer, they quickly realize that their old ways of doing business have new consequences.

items.title: The Rachel Papers
items.description: This charming, witty teen comedy follows a young genius (Dexter Fletcher) as he allows his raging hormones, high intellect -- and desktop computer -- to ensnare him in the most unsolvable of all equations: love! Ione Skye and James Spader also star.

items.title: Scream, Blacula, Scream!
items.description: Brought back to the world of the living by a voodoo ceremony Blacula (William Marshall) is loosed with insatiable bloodlust upon the population of a small community in the Louisiana back country. Pam Grier also stars in this scintillating sequel

items.title: Joe (1970)
items.description: Anti-hippie Joe (Peter Boyle) finds a kindred spirit in Bill Compton (Dennis Patrick) who boasts that he killed a drug-dealing hippie (Patrick McDermott). When a news report confirms the incident, vigilante justice is set in motion.

items.title: Hammer
items.description: Fred Williamson stars a boxer on-the-rise who is asked to throw a fight by the local mob that has figured prominently in his success. His moral dilemma hits close to home when the life of his girlfriend (Vonetta McGee) is put in jeopardy.

items.title: Black Sabbath
items.description: The anthology, Black Sabbath tells three short tales of horror. A woman haunted by menacing phone calls from a former lover, a vampire hunter whose family is stalked by the spirit of an ghoul, and a nurse who steals a ring from a cursed corpse.

items.title: Rocky Marciano
items.description: The life of boxer Rocky Marciano, the only undefeated heavyweight champion.

items.title: Carrie (2002)
items.description: Angela Bettis stars in this adaptation of Stephen King's classic tale of horror. Carrie White has been cursed with the power of telekinesis and when her tormenters commit an act of unforgivable humiliation, they'll soon learn a deadly lesson.

items.title: A Dead Calling
items.description: When a supernatural force causes Elizabeth, a young story editor for the local paper, to investigate an old house, she finds herself to be the only hope for a family of long dead ghosts yearning to tell the story of their massacre.

items.title: Deadly Sanctuary
items.description: A reporter, is drawn into an evil web of conspiracy working for a newspaper in an isolated small town, where she strives to uncover the horrifying secret of a vanished reporter, two dead teenage girls and an attractive cowboy.

items.title: House of Secrets
items.description: After Julie Manning and her husband divorce, she decides to move into the house he was building for them. Soon she realizes someone is breaking into the house and spying on her.

items.title: Kidnapped: The Hannah Anderson Story
items.description: True story that follows the abduction of a 16 year old cheerleader in California in 2013 and the shocking conclusion that made national news.

items.title: Renegade
items.description: Mattie, a young lady living in a mine camp of the Southwest, unwittingly marries a claim jumper despite the fact she is in love with a gold miner. Soon, the Old West brings her death, confusion and the hard reality of her claim jumping husband.

items.title: Ann Rule's Too Late to Say Goodbye
items.description: Starring Rob Lowe and Lauren Holly. After discovering her husband's affair, Jenn forges an online connection with a charming mystery man. Which man is more likely to be involved in her sudden death? Based on the best-selling crime novel.

items.title: Behind the Mask (1999)
items.description: Starring Donald Sutherland and Matthew Fox. When an overworked doctor has a heart attack his life is saved by one of his autistic patients. The two men forge a friendship and help each other rekindle what is missing from both their lives.

items.title: Colorz of Rage
items.description: When an interracial couple move to New York City from the suburbs of Boston, they are hit with a hard-core reality that they are totally unprepared for.

items.title: Confessions of a Sociopathic Social Climber
items.description: Bold, sexy, and deliciously wicked, Jennifer Love Hewitt plays a fashion-obsessed social climber willing to do whatever it takes to crash the most important party of the year and win over the man of her dreams.

items.title: Fighting the Odds: The Marilyn Gambrell Story
items.description: Starring Jami Gertz and Ernie Hudson. Faced with teens struggling to process the incarceration of a parent, parole officer Marilyn Gambrell institutes a groundbreaking high school program to help them adapt.

items.title: Outlaw Justice
items.description: Starring Kris Kristofferson and Willie Nelson. Two aging gunfighters re-form their old gang to avenge the murder of one of the former members.

items.title: Too Close to Home
items.description: Starring Judith Light and Rick Schroder. A woman obsessed with her adult son, angered by the idea of him leaving her and his marriage to a beautiful nurse, does everything in her power to prevent his independence.

items.title: Broken Promise
items.description: Starring Ashley Scott and Louis Mandylor. Twenty years after their teenage rebellion left a man dead, Mina lives a perfect suburban life. But Reese is finally up for parole - and ready to make up for lost time.

items.title: Hacker
items.description: Starring Haylie Duff. A young computer hacker and her father find themselves targeted by a powerful enemy when they uncover an assassination plot.

items.title: Another Pair of Aces
items.description: Starring Willie Nelson and Kris Kristofferson. A gambler, a Texas Ranger and an FBI agent investigate a series of vigilante murders.

items.title: Falling for You
items.description: Starring Jennie Garth. A serial killer attacks a commercial artist which leaves her with amnesia before moving into the apartment next door.

items.title: The Capture of the Green River Killer
items.description: Starring Tom Cavanagh, James Russo, and Amy Davidson. Fate, bad luck, and bad choices propel a young runaway into the path of a notorious serial killer. Based on a true story.

items.title: The Legend of Butch and Sundance
items.description: The legend of Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid comes to life in this blazing action-adventure that follows the early adventures of two of the most famous outlaws in the history of the American West.

items.title: Murder at My Door
