items.description: Starring Judith Light and Johnny Galecki. In a quiet neighbourhood, a suburban family is shocked when their son is the prime suspect in the brutal murder of a neighbour's daughter.

items.title: Without Consent
items.description: A troubled and rebellious teen crashes her car whilst drunk. In desperation, her parents refer her to a mental institution that is notorious for mistreating its patients. Starring Jennie Garth and Johnny Galecki.

items.title: A Mother's Nightmare
items.description: A recently divorced woman is thrilled when her teenage son is smitten with the new girl in school. Her happiness is short-lived when she discovers her son's new love interest has left a string of dead boyfriends in her wake.

items.title: A Wife's Nightmare
items.description: When a teenage girl shows up on their doorstep claiming to be her husband's daughter, Liz Michaels welcomes her into their home – but when Liz starts to feel pushed out of her own family, she begins to question the girl's true motives.

items.title: A Working Mom's Nightmare
items.description: Kathy struggles with returning to work as a new mother. She starts to suspect her husband of having an affair, while her mysterious new coworker Hannah seems to be trying to not only edge her out of a job but also take over her life.

items.title: Enemy Within
items.description: A prison bus crashes in a severe snowstorm, releasing five dangerous convicts. In a remote cabin a few miles away, Amy Oliver, a young woman grappling with her recent blindness, slowly begins to realize that she is not alone.

items.title: Recon
items.description: At the close of WWII, four American soldiers are sent on a reconnaissance mission led by an Italian man with indeterminate loyalties. Hunted by a mysterious sniper, they must fight to make it out alive.

items.title: Down in the Delta
items.description: In Maya Angelou's directorial debut, a troubled single mother spends the summer at her family's ancestral home in rural Mississippi and learns to reverse the downward slide of her life in this uplifting story of family, community and friendship.

items.title: Pulp Fiction
items.description: Writer-director Quentin Tarantino delivers an iconic cast of characters in PULP FICTION, a wildly entertaining tale of violence and redemption. John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson, Uma Thurman, and Bruce Willis star in this pop culture phenomenon.

items.title: Reggaeton The Movie
items.description: Estamos a finales de los 90 y dos peluqueros y aspirantes a cantantes, un estudiante de baile y un productor musical suenan con tener una carrera musical exitosa. Pero otro productor, cuyo proyecto paralelo es un prospero negocio de las drogas.

items.title: Er Relajo Der Loro
items.description: 50 años de historia venezolana vistos a través de los ojos de un loro. Su vida quedó marcada cuando se vendió a los traficantes de animales cuando era solo una paloma.

items.title: Un Amor De Película
items.description: Bernardo es un productor de cine al borde de la bancarrota que decide convencer erróneamente a un director de cine famoso para que haga una mala película para poder ganar mucho dinero. Laura, su novia y agente, se convierte en su musa y confiada.

items.title: Scotland, PA
items.description: A modernized retelling of MacBeth set in 1970s suburban Pennsylvania. Joe McBeth, an unambitious hamburger stand employee, is driven to success by his scheming wife.

items.title: Mountain
items.description: An experience about the highest peaks around the world.

items.title: Desert One
items.description: Using new archival sources and unprecedented access, documentarian Barbara Kopple reveals the story behind one of the most daring rescues in modern US history: a secret mission to free hostages of the 1979 Iranian revolution.

items.title: 10 Items or Less
items.description: An actor prepping for an upcoming role meets a quirky grocery clerk, and the pair hit the road to show one another their respective worlds.

items.title: Summer Night
items.description: A coming-of-age story about the complexities of young romantic relationships.

items.title: Blue Ruin
items.description: BLUE RUIN is a classic American revenge story, following a mysterious outsider whose quiet life is turned upside down when he returns to his childhood home, determined to carry out an act of vengeance.

items.title: Candyman: Day of the Dead
items.description: The living descendant of Candyman tries to put an end to the vengeful spirit's murderous legacy in this latest installment of the hit horror series.

items.title: DOA: Dead or Alive
items.description: The world's best fighters are invited to DOA, a martial-arts tournament. Four female rival fighters, an aristocratic warrior, a wrestling superstar, an athlete with a tragic past, and an assassin-for-hire, work together to uncover a secret.

items.title: Miss Potter
items.description: Biography of children's author Beatrix Potter, including how she overcame a domineering mother, and the chauvinism of Victorian England, to become a best-selling author.

items.title: My Week With Marilyn
items.description: An assistant on the set of THE PRINCE AND THE SHOWGIRL documents the week he spent befriending Marilyn Monroe (Michelle Williams) and helping her escape the pressures of fame and Hollywood.

items.title: Black Christmas (2006)
items.description: An escaped maniac returns to his childhood home on Christmas Eve, which is now a sorority house, and begins to murder the sorority sisters one by one. A remake of the 1974 film by Bob Clark.

items.title: Hannibal Rising
items.description: Young Hannibal moves in with his aunt and begins plotting revenge after his baby sister is killed during World War II. Based on Thomas Harris' novel.

items.title: Zulu (2013)
items.description: Based on the novel by Caryl Férey. Set against the backdrop of post-apartheid South Africa, two South African police officers on opposing sides of the apartheid divide work together to fight crime.

items.title: Three Night Stand
items.description: A married couple's romantic weekend is turned upside down when the husband's ex-girlfriend, a woman he's secretly obsessed with, is running the ski lodge where they're staying.

items.title: After the Ball
items.description: After a young fashion designer runs afoul of her corrupt stepmother and stepsisters, she dons a disguise to help save the family business for her father.

items.title: The Cutting Edge: Chasing The Dream
items.description: When his partner is injured, driven - and sometimes reckless - skater Zach Conroy has to find another partner… fast. In glides Alejandra, a tough-talking hockey player, and soon enough, the sparks begin to fly both on and off the ice.

items.title: Guns Of The Magnificent Seven
items.description: In this thrilling follow-up to one of the greatest Western sagas in film history, notorious desperado Chris Adams (George Kennedy) is offered a huge reward to free a young Mexican revolutionary from prison…in the midst of the Mexican Revolution.

items.title: Brannigan
items.description: John Wayne stars as Chicago Police Lieutenant Jim Brannigan and Richard Attenborough co-stars as British policeman Cmdr. Swann in this action-comedy. Brannigan teams up in the U.K. with Cmdr Swann to escort a crime boss back to the U.S.

items.title: God Mars
items.description: In this anime spinoff of the sci-fi television series, Takeru has been sent from a distant planet to destroy the earth. However, as he learns of the beauty of the earth and its inhabitants, he begins to question his mission.

items.title: The Terminal
items.description: After arriving at New York's JFK airport, Viktor Navorski gets unwittingly caught in bureaucratic glitches that make it impossible for him to return to his home country or enter the U.S.

items.title: Whitewash
items.description: Thomas Haden Church (SIDEWAYS, SPIDER-MAN 3) stars in this darkly comic thriller about a snowplow driver who, after accidentally killing a man, attempts to escape the cops by fleeing into the harsh Canadian wilderness.

items.title: The Unloved
items.description: THE UNLOVED, a powerful and personal look at the strength and resilience of youth through the eyes of Lucy, a ward of the state seeking refuge from her abusive father.

items.title: Sollers Point
items.description: Keith - a 24-four-year-old drug dealer newly released from prison and living with his father under house arrest in Baltimore - struggles to reestablish himself in a community scarred by unemployment, neglect, and segregation.

items.title: Mother of George
items.description: In this dazzlingly beautiful romantic drama, a Nigerian woman living in Brooklyn must make a choice that could have dire consequences when she has failed to conceive a child a year after her glorious wedding.

items.title: Ma Ma
items.description: Oscar-winner Penelope Cruz delivers the performance of her career as Magda, a woman who is determined to live life to the fullest in the face of her recent breast cancer diagnosis.

items.title: Four Lovers
items.description: In this sexy, French romance, two couples explore the boundaries of their relationships by swapping partners. What starts as a fun, free-spirited experimentation soon turns into a hotbed of desire, anger, and confusion.

items.title: Lost in Paris
items.description: Filmed in Dominique Abel and Fiona Gordon’s signature whimsical style, LOST IN PARIS stars the filmmakers as a small-town Canadian librarian and a strangely seductive, oddly egotistical vagabond.

items.title: Dear Zachary: A Letter to a Son About his Father
items.description: Filmmaker Kurt Kuenne's poignant tribute to his murdered childhood friend, Andrew Bagby, tells the story of a child custody battle between Bagby's grieving parents and Shirley Turner, Bagby's pregnant ex-girlfriend and suspected killer.

items.title: The Black Dragon's Revenge
items.description: Martial arts legend Ron van Clief stars as an investigator trying to solve the mystery of Bruce Lee's death. Rival gangs get in his way, but he's ready for any kind of bone-breaking mayhem. From the heyday of 1970s Blaxploitation and kung fu flicks, this

items.title: Derailed
items.description: When two married business executives having an affair are blackmailed by a violent criminal, the two must turn the tables on him to save their families.

items.title: Hellraiser: Revelations
items.description: A pair of buddies on a mission to get laid over spring break unwitting release the demon Pinhead who creates havoc. This is the ninth film in the horror franchise.

items.title: Shut Up & Sing
items.description: A documentary of the Dixie Chicks including covering the anti-George Bush comment singer Natalie Maines made during a concert in 2003.

items.title: The Artist
items.description: Hollywood 1927. George Valentin is a very successful silent movie star, but the arrival of talking pictures could mark the end of his career.

items.title: Savage Dog
items.description: A story set in Indochina in 1959, a land beyond rule and a time without mercy, and the birth of a legend.

items.title: Un invierno en la playa
items.description: Un escritor aclamado, su exesposa y sus hijos adolescentes aceptan las complejidades del amor en el transcurso de un año. Protagonizada por Jennifer Connelly, Kristen Bell, Greg Kinnear.

items.title: Súper 8
items.description: En el verano de 1979, un grupo de amigos de un pueblo pequeño de Ohio son testigo de un accidente de trenes catastrófico, mientras tanto filman una película en super 8. Pronto sospechan que no fue un accidente.

items.title: Sicko
items.description: Documentary from Michael Moore exploring the profit-based healthcare system in the US, and how it fares against its counterparts in Canada, the UK, and France where medical care is free.

items.title: The Delta Force
items.description: Political extremists have taken innocent people hostage, and only super-soldiers Chuck Norris, Lee Marvin, and The Delta Force can rescue them in this explosive adventure filled with wall-to-wall action! Martin Balsam and Shelley Winters also star.

items.title: Delta Force 2: The Colombian Connection
items.description: Chuck Norris is in peak form in this explosive action/adventure that brings back one of his most unforgettable characters, Delta Force Colonel Scott McCoy, for a daring mission to destroy a deadly drug cartel led by the ruthless Billy Drago!

items.title: Just Write
items.description: A tour-bus driver (Jeremy Piven) meets his favorite actress (Sherilyn Fenn), who mistakes him for a famous scriptwriter and arranges to meet again.

items.title: Vanilla Sky (ESP)
items.description: Joven y próspero, David puede tener todo lo que desee su corazón. Pero su vida parece estar incompleta. Una noche, David conoce a la mujer de sus sueños y cree que puede haber encontrado la pieza que le faltaba.

items.title: Tortugas Ninja 2: fuera de las sombras
items.description: Las tortugas vuelven para pelear contra más villanos junto a su nuevo aliado Casey Jones. Cuando escapa el supervillano Shredder con su plan de conquistar al mundo, los hermanos se preparan para vencerlo.

items.title: Camino a la perdición
items.description: Lazos de lealtad son puestos a prubea cuando el hijo de un sicario descubre cómo se gana la vida su padre.

items.title: Malaventura
items.description: En camino a una fiesta escolar, un grupo de amigos juegan una broma pesada que sale mal y terminan en la cárcel. Sin embargo, eso no es lo peor, es solo el inicio de su odisea.

items.title: Casese Quien Pueda
items.description: The best-laid love plans go hilariously awry in this romantic-comedy hit about two sisters (Martha and Miriam Higareda) who find themselves in uncharted romantic territory.

items.title: Magic
items.description: Anthony Hopkins and Ann-Margret star in this thriller about a ventriloquist whose dummy seems to have a mind of its own.

items.title: The Smell of Success
items.description: A comedy about manure salesmen in 1960s heartland America.

items.title: Stay Cool
items.description: An author who returns to his hometown to deliver a commencement address to a class of graduating high school students has to deal with his feelings for an old flame as well as the advances of a student who has the hots for him.

items.title: Red Headed Stranger
items.description: Revisionist western about fallen preacher Shay, who guns down his wife Raysha for running off with another man. Wandering, he meets single mom Laurie. However, helpless sheriff Scoby wants Shay to help him fight the villainous Clavers.

items.title: Bright Young Things
items.description: An adaptation of Evelyn Waugh's novel, Vile Bodies, is a look into the lives of a young novelist, his would-be lover, and a host of young people who beautified London in the 1930s.

items.title: Bloodlines
items.description: In the sticks of Kentucky, a demented family of inbreds begins the process of cleaning up their bloodline. Their twisted family is led by Billy Bob Hackford, who in his madness abducts unsuspecting young women.

items.title: Bride and Prejudice
items.description: Based on Jane Austen's classic novel Pride And Prejudice, with a musical twist, sparks fly, and cultures clash between a small-town beauty and a wealthy American. An acclaimed treat from director Gurinder Chadha.

items.title: Flirting with Disaster
items.description: From the director of AMERICAN HUSTLE and SILVER LININGS PLAYBOOK comes this clever comedy with an all-star cast that examines dysfunctions of modern family life.

items.title: Kinky Boots
items.description: To save his family's shoe business from imminent bankruptcy, young Charlie Price turns to an unlikely new creative consultant: a fabulous drag queen whose creative style and wild designs are a breath of fresh air in the stuffy old factory.

items.title: Spy Kids 2: The Island of Lost Dreams
items.description: In the sequel, the OSS now has a full child-spy section and our hero siblings Carmen and Juni Cortez have become agents. On a mission to recover a dangerous device that threatens the entire world, they enlist the skills of their family.

items.title: Spy Kids 3: Game Over
items.description: Antonio Banderas, Carla Gugino, Alexa Vega, and Daryl Sabara return in this third installment of the popular SPY KIDS trilogy that finds Carmen kidnapped by an evil Toymaker (Sylvester Stallone) and imprisoned inside a virtual reality game.

items.title: The Yards
items.description: After being released from prison, Leo Handler (Mark Wahlberg) takes a job with his powerfully influential Uncle Frank (James Caan). Leo soon finds himself unwittingly drawn into a world of sabotage, high-stakes payoffs and even murder.

items.title: Shaolin Soccer
items.description: In this hysterical, eye-popping comedy, a team of misfits take their best shot at winning a championship by mixing martial arts with soccer. Using unorthodox game play, they face the dreaded Team Evil in the ultimate battle for the title.

items.title: RiffTrax: Godmonster of Indian Flats
items.description: At its heart, this is really a movie about the importance of branding. The Mutated Sheep Embryo That Kind of Lurches Around Draggling a Vestigial Leg and Screeching of Indian Flats? Not interested! But the Godmonster of Indian Flats? Now you're talking!

items.title: El arrepentimiento
items.description: Un policía temerario está determinado a llevar ante la justicia a un contrabandista de oro, incluso si tiene que viajar por el mundo para encontrarlo.

items.title: Once Upon a Time in Shanghai
items.description: Ma dreams of making a life in Shanghai without using his fist. But when he befriends the Boss of a rival gang, he must fight for honor or lose everything.

items.title: Ip Man (ESP)
items.description: Ip Man es una adaptación galardonada basada en la vida de Ip Man (Donnie Yen), el gran maestro del arte marcial Wing Chun y tutor del legendario Bruce Lee.

items.title: Wolf Warrior 2
items.description: China's deadliest special forces operative settles into a quiet life on the sea, but when sadistic mercenaries begin targeting nearby civilians, he must leave his newfound peace behind and return to his duties as a soldier and protector.

items.title: Wolf Warrior
items.description: A expert marksman in the Chinese special forces is pursued by deadly foreign mercenaries hired by a vicious drug lord to assassinate him.

items.title: The Villainess
items.description: Bloody revenge is at the heart of this stylish action-thriller that doses the classic femme fatale story with a shot of adrenaline as it follows a former assassin who will stop at nothing to cut ties to her past.

items.title: The Great Battle
items.description: With epic scale and breathtaking action, THE GREAT BATTLE tells the story of the Siege of Ansi, where Goguryeo forces held their fortress against 500,000 invading Tang soldiers in a battle that raged for eighty-eight days.

items.title: The Gangster, The Cop, The Devil
items.description: After barely surviving a violent attack by an elusive serial killer, crime boss Jang Dong-su finds himself forming an unlikely partnership with local detective Jung Tae-seok to catch the sadistic killer known as K.

items.title: The Battle of Jangsari
items.description: Based on the true story of forgotten heroes of the Korean War, a small, inexperienced battalion of student soldiers are tasked with liberating the strategic location of Incheon.

items.title: T-34
items.description: During WW2, a soldier assembles a courageous group of POWs to plan a daring escape from captivity. With the power of a half-destroyed T-34 tank, the brave men challenge an enemy battalion, ready to battle until the end.

items.title: Rise of the Legend
items.description: A martial artist with extraordinary power (Eddie Peng) returns to the town where his father was murdered to face off against a ruthless crime boss (Sammo Hung) and bring justice back to the people.

items.title: My Way
items.description: In World War II-era Korea, rival runners, one Korean (Jang Dong-gun) and one Japanese (Joe Odagiri), go to war together against the Soviets.

items.title: Legend of the Fist: The Return of Chen Zhen
items.description: Incredible martial arts sequences mark this thriller about a legendary fighter who takes on ruthless outside oppressors in World War II-era Shanghai.

items.title: Kung Fu League
items.description: Desperate to get the girl of his dreams, Fei Ying magically summons the help from Kung Fu legends Master Ip, Master Wong, Master Huo and Chen Zhen in order to learn martial arts, defeat his enemy, and win over the girl.

items.title: Kill Zone 2
items.description: When his cover gets blown, a Hong Kong cop (Wu Jing) lands in a Thai prison where the warden works with a criminal mastermind (Louis Koo) to harvest organs.

items.title: Jonathan
items.description: In this sci-fi-tinged thriller, Ansel Elgort plays two brothers living very separate lives – inside the same body. Previously content to live life in shifts, their delicate balance is ruined when they fall for the same woman (Suki Waterhouse).

items.title: Ip Man 3
items.description: In this explosive third installment of the blockbuster martial arts series, when a band of brutal gangsters led by crooked property developer (Mike Tyson) make a play to take over the city, Master Ip is forced to take a stand.

items.title: Ip Man 2
items.description: Newly arrived in Hong Kong, martial arts instructor Ip Man encounters stiff opposition when he begins teaching the Wing Chun fighting style. But instead of bowing to his rivals' demands, he perseveres and retaliates with amazing speed and power.

items.title: Iceman: The Time Traveler
items.description: In the action-packed second chapter of the Iceman saga, Ying's heroic fight to rewrite history and reclaim his honor continues but those he trusts most may be leading into a deadly trap.

items.title: Iceman
items.description: Four hundred years after being frozen in time, a Ming Dynasty palace guard and his three associates are thawed and left to adjust to the modern-day.

items.title: Chasing the Dragon
items.description: Donnie Yen stars as infamous real-life drug kingpin Crippled Ho, who ruthlessly carved out his empire in 1960's Hong Kong.

items.title: Burning
items.description: Hailed by critics as one of the best films of the year, BURNING is a searing romantic thriller about a young man whose suspicions spin out of control when the free-spirited woman he loves disappears.

items.title: Ip Man 3 (ESP)
items.description: Donnie Yen regresa a la exitosa serie de artes marciales de Ip Man. Cuando un desarrollador de bienes raíces corrupto (Mike Tyson) y su pandilla brutal intentan tomar control de la ciudad, Master Ip decide luchar contra ellos.

items.title: Ip Man 2 (ESP)
items.description: ternacional Donnie Yen repite su papel icónico como el gran maestro de kung fu, Ip Man.

items.title: In Too Deep
items.description: Officer Cole is assigned to infiltrate the syndicate of God, a deadly crime lord. But as Cole sinks deeper into God's crew, he begins to get in over his head, until the line that separates his true identity from his street persona begins to disappear.

items.title: Zombeavers
items.description: They're ferocious, they're furry, they're ZOMBEAVERS, the stars of this 2015 horror-comedy, directed by Jordan Rubin. When a trio of sexy college girls (Cortney Palm, Rachel Melvin, Lexi Atkins) arrive at a remote cabin for a weekend getaway.

items.title: Calling All Earthlings
items.description: Guided by aliens, a man builds a desert time machine. Can the Integratron work? Will he finish it before the government finishes him?

items.title: Twogether
items.description: All that John and Allison wanted was to lose themselves in a weekend of wild, passionate, unbridled, kinky sex… They got a lot more!

items.title: You & Me
items.description: A funny and moving love story about a deaf woman who meets a recently blinded man.

items.title: American Veteran
items.description: Sgt. Nick Mendes is the most upbeat quadriplegic soldier you'll ever meet. AMERICAN VETERAN follows Nick as he studies for his real estate license, casts a fishing reel with his mouth, and falls in love with a nurse he meets in the VA hospital.

items.title: RiffTrax: Sisters Of Death
items.description: Join Mike, Kevin, and Bill as they pledge Delta Gamma and get initiated into the Sisters of Death! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from RiffTrax (formerly of MST3K).

items.title: RiffTrax: Beast Of The Yellow Night
items.description: RiffTrax, the guys who make movies funny, bring their comedic riffing treatment to this cheesy horror classic! Go mad trying to figure out what is happening in Beast of the Yellow Night!

items.title: RiffTrax: Swamp Of The Ravens
items.description: The stars of Mystery Science Theater 3000 bring their comedic riffing treatment to this utterly baffling horror classic about a mad doctor who believes death is simply an evolution and that every woman wants to sleep with him.

items.title: RiffTrax: The Dark Power
items.description: RiffTrax bring their comedic riffing treatment to this "so bad it's still bad" movie where ancient indian gods come back from the dead to torment pretty co-eds and get whipped by Lash LaRue! Commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill (former stars of MST3K.)

items.title: RiffTrax: City Of The Dead
items.description: Join the former stars of MST3K on their visit to scenic City of the Dead!. Comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from RiffTrax (former stars of Mystery Science Theater 3000 aka MST3K).

items.title: El juego del duende
items.description: Después de que un grupo de ladrones es enviado a cazar leyendas urbanas, roban el oro de un duende, solo para descubrir que hay que pagar un alto precio.

items.title: La cazadora: runa de los muertos
items.description: Una joven encuentra a un hombre sangrando y comienza a darse cuenta de que ha sido enviado para protegerla de un mal que se acerca.

items.title: La resurrección de la momia
items.description: Un grupo de estudiantes de arqueología despierta una momia antigua. Después de quedar atrapados en un bucle de tiempo, la única forma en que pueden escapar es derrotar a la momia.

items.title: Habitación Ouija
items.description: Una mujer agorafóbica comienza a convocar espíritus para que sean sus amigos mientras su hermano / cuidador no está durante el día, pero cuanto más tiempo pasa con los espíritus, más claro se vuelve que no son tan amigables después de todo.

items.title: Mata a la caballería
items.description: En una misión para eliminar al general Joseph Wheeler de C.S., Kilpatrick diseña un plan para apoderarse de la pequeña ciudad de Barnwell.

items.title: Muñeca de payaso
items.description: Después de comprar una muñeca, la vida de Lane empeora cuando los amigos cercanos y la familia comienzan a desaparecer.

items.title: 90 pies de casa
items.description: Un exjugador de Grandes Ligas con problemas regresa a casa para enfrentarse a su padrastro abusivo.

items.title: Hada de dientes
items.description: Los adultos de una pequeña comunidad agrícola se reúnen, comienzan a darse cuenta de que el hada de los dientes maldita, que los traumatizó en su juventud, está suelta de nuevo. ¡Esta vez, viniendo tras sus hijos!

items.title: Desde las profundidades
items.description: Después de sobrevivir al ataque de un tiburón, una joven sufre pesadillas de ser acechada en el mar oscuro por un depredador voraz, y alucinaciones de las visitas de su hermana y su novio, ambos muertos en el ataque.

items.title: Team America: World Police
items.description: Team America, an international police force dedicated to maintaining global stability learns that a power hungry dictator is brokering weapons of mass destruction to terrorists.

items.title: Selma
items.description: From the Oscar-winning producers of 12 Years a Slave comes a powerful true story starring David Oyelewo and Oprah Winfrey. Facing violent opposition, Martin Luther King, Jr., led a historic march from Selma to Montgomery, changing the world forever.

items.title: Bang The Drum Slowly
items.description: The story of the friendship between a star pitcher, wise to the world, and a half-wit catcher, as they cope with the catcher's terminal illness through a baseball season.

items.title: The Miseducation of Cameron Post
items.description: Based on the celebrated novel by Emily M. Danforth, this film follows the titular character (Chloë Grace Moretz) as she is sent to a gay conversion therapy center after getting caught with another girl in the back seat of a car on prom night.

items.title: City Hunter: .357 Magnum
items.description: A beautiful pianist comes to Tokyo for a charity concert, and City Hunter is there. But music isn't his forte; he wants lessons in the language of love. Desperation becomes the word of the day as the bodies start dropping.

items.title: City Hunter: Million Dollar Conspiracy
items.description: A new island resort has been built in Tokyo bay, and it is run by one of the world's most powerful supercomputers. The City Hunter gang has been invited to the grand opening party, but only Miki & Kaori have gotten there.

items.title: City Hunter: Bay City Wars
items.description: Beautiful American Emily O'Hara offers the City Hunter (Ryo Saeba & Kaori Makimura) one million dollars to protect her from a man named Douglas. Ryo & Kaori take the job, but things are not quite what they seem. The real target just might be Ryo.

items.title: #Captured
items.description: A group of privileged high school kids runs an illicit chat room where they Livestream their drug-fueled sex parties to paying viewers on the internet. Little do they know there's a murderous zealot on a mission to rid the internet of sin.

items.title: 20 Weeks
items.description: A romantic drama about a couple who finds out that their baby may have a serious health issue at their 20-week scan. As they're faced with tough decisions about their pregnancy, they recount their relationship and love for one another.

items.title: Alien vs. Zombies
items.description: Joe Alien fulfills a dream of coming to Earth to find that it's overrun by zombies. Finding an ally in young Parker, he attempts to save the world!

items.title: All Girls Weekend
items.description: High school friends reunite after many years to spend a weekend in the mountains, but when everything goes wrong, there is no time for girl bonding.

items.title: Tierra de policias
items.description: El director de Ford vs. Ferrari junta a un elenco de estrellas que incluye a Robert De Niro, Sylvester Stallone, Ray Liotta y Harvey Keitel en este tenso thriller lleno de acción y crimen.

items.title: Del crepúsculo al amanecer 3: la hija del verdugo
items.description: Esta precuela de la serie de, From Dusk Till Dawn, muestra al bandido, Johnny Madrid, quien escapa de su verdugo, junto a la hija sensual del verdugo, Esmeralda. Juntos enfrentarán la pelea de sus vidas.

items.title: Del crepúsculo al amanecer 2: Texas sangriento
items.description: Cuando una pandilla de ladrones de bancos escapa hacia la frontera, terminan en el bar equivocado y se meten con los vampiros equivocados.

items.title: El elefante desaparecido
items.description: Edo sigue obsesionado en saber lo que le pasó a su novia, Celia, después de su desaparición durante un terremoto.

items.title: Sprinter
items.description: A Jamaican teen who is burdened by family troubles hopes his meteoric rise in track and field can reunite him with his mother in the US. Executive produced by Will and Jada Pinkett Smith.

items.title: Southwest of Salem: The Story of the San Antonio Four
items.description: Emmy nominee Southwest of Salem examines the persecutions of four Latina lesbians wrongfully convicted of gang-raping two young girls.

items.title: Change in the Air
items.description: After a mysterious young woman moves to a small town, a peaceful community is brought face to face with its own secrets and identity. Starring Rachel Brosnahan (The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel).

items.title: Los paranoicos
items.description: Luciano Gauna, un guionista fracasado en Buenos Aires, se le tira el mundo patas arriba cuando su exitoso amigo productor de televisión regresa de Madrid con una deslumbrante novia.

items.title: La nana
items.description: Raquel, una mujer agria y introvertida, lucha a capa y espada por mantener su puesto de 23 años como nana de la familia Valdez.

items.title: Garden of Stars
items.description: An enchanted cemetery in Berlin. Next to the Grimm Brothers' grave, stillborn babies and gay people rest in peace. This is the Garden of Stars.

items.title: John Apple Jack
items.description: When playboy John (Chris McNally) discovers his sister's fiancé is childhood crush Jack (Kent S. Leung), passions ignite and his life spirals out of control. Losing his job, reputation and underwear, John ventures to find a better recipe for life.

items.title: Solo química (Just a Little Chemistry)
items.description: Una fan se encuentra dividida entre la atracción por su ídolo del cine y su mejor amigo.

items.title: Made in Japan
items.description: The remarkable story of Tomi Fujiyama, the world's ﬁrst Japanese female country music star. Tomi's career culminates in a 1964 performance at The Grand Ole. Forty years later she sets out on a journey to perform at The Grand Ole Opry one more time.

items.title: Primary
items.description: Primary is an arthouse-thriller that tracks an Insurance Executive, simultaneously in the present and in the future, as he seeks revenge after a betrayal and the moral choices he makes along the way.

items.title: Stronger Than Bullets
items.description: Defiant Libyan musicians rise up against the tyrant Moammar Gaddafi...and strike a chord for freedom.

items.title: The Wasting
items.description: A teenager braves love and sexual awakening, and fights her controlling parents by refusing to eat...until a nightmare ghost appears that may be real, or may be a deadly creation of her starving body.

items.title: Tough Guy: The Bob Probert Story
items.description: Archival footage and personal testimonials present an intimate portrait of the life and career of legendary NHL tough guy Bob Probert.

items.title: Almost Amazing
items.description: When not believing in love is a job, what happens when you find something, amazing?

items.title: America Has Fallen
items.description: Former Marine, Ryan Taylor's life is thrown into chaos when he's implicated in a terrorist bombing. With federal agents and a terrorist cell on him, Ryan needs to use every skill he's learned to prevent an even bigger terrorist attack from happening.

items.title: American Rodeo: A Cowboy Christmas
items.description: The two weeks before the Fourth of July are unofficially called "Cowboy Christmas", as there are 65 rodeos across 25 states and that many chances for the cowboys to win money. This is their story.

items.title: American Terror
items.description: A group of friends hatch a plan for revenge, when they discover an underground torture chamber filled with unspeakable horrors. Their only hope for survival is to fight back and find a way to escape the killer's bloody grip.

items.title: Amityville Exorcism
items.description: A family awakens the vengeful spirit of a killer, who now possesses their daughter. A priest must try to save the family and exorcize the demon that threatens to destroy them all.

items.title: Apocalypse Road
items.description: Apocalypse Road follows the journey of two sisters while separated during a post apocalyptic depression.

items.title: Avenged
items.description: The spirit of an Apache warrior takes possession of a young woman's body, murdered by a gang of rednecks. Now among the living she seeks revenge, as the clock ticks away on her decomposing body.

items.title: Beacon Point
items.description: A group of hikers lost on the Appalachian Trail stumble across an ancient secret that threatens their survival.

items.title: Bornless Ones
items.description: With the help of her friends, Emily moves to a remote home to take better care of her brother, Zack who is diagnosed with cerebral palsy. But what they don't know is that the house kept a terrifying secret that will haunt them one by one.

items.title: Blood Moon
items.description: A stagecoach of travelers, a gunslinger and two outlaws arrive in a deserted mining town lit by the glow of a reddish full moon. As their worlds collide, they are hunted by a beast that only appears on the night of a blood moon.

items.title: Clawed
items.description: A geology field trip into the remote Bear Claw wilderness area turns into a nightmare for a group of college students as they find themselves prey to a viscous man-beast the locals call The Shadow of Death.

items.title: Closer to God
items.description: A genetic scientist successfully clones the first human being, a baby girl named Elizabeth, but his work is soon threatened by a dark secret, a secret that threatens to destroy everything and everyone precious to him.

items.title: Deep Dark
items.description: Hermann, a failed sculptor is about to kill himself when he finds a strange, talking hole in the wall. The creature in the hole can fulfill his every wish, but when the killing starts, it becomes his worst nightmare.

items.title: Seat 25
items.description: When a disillusioned young woman secretly enters the Seat 25 competition she never expects to win. But when the dangerous one-way trip to Mars becomes a reality, her life on Earth is turned upside down.

items.title: Demon Tongue
items.description: Four paranormal research students are sent to an abandon complex to conduct an investigation into strange occurrences that the locals feel are the results of demonic possessions.

items.title: Do You Dream in Color
items.description: Do You Dream in Color? is the coming-of-age story of four courageous blind high school students as they strive to prove that their disability will not hold them back from achieving their dreams.

items.title: Don't Be Bad
items.description: Vittorio and Cesare live a life of mobster excess. When Cesare begins to spiral out of control, Vittorio gets out. But their bond is too strong to separate.

items.title: Empathy Inc
items.description: An investor in a VR startup discovers that the reality the company provides isn't virtual.

items.title: Entanglement (2017)
items.description: While recovering from a suicide attempt, Ben Layton accidentally falls in love with a girl who was very nearly, almost his sister - and then things start to get weird.

items.title: Ghosts of Darkness
items.description: Two paranormal investigators are thrown together to solve a 100-year old mystery. Locked for three nights in a house with an unsettling past, they discover the myths are nothing compared to what actually resides within the walls of Richmond Manor.

items.title: Jamie Kennedy: Unwashed
items.description: Jamie Kennedy performs his first stand-up concert special, filmed before a sold-out audience at the San Jose Theater. Raunchier, edgier and more unpredictable than you've ever seen him.

items.title: Kickin' It Old Skool
items.description: A young breakdancer hits his head during a talent show and slips into a coma for twenty years. Waking up in 2006, he looks to revive his and his team's career with the help of his girlfriend and his parents.

items.title: Peelers
items.description: A small town strip club owner must defend her bar, her strippers and her life when violent infected patrons show up on the final closing night and all hell breaks loose.

items.title: The Dawnseeker
items.description: It's the year 2248 and to save the Earth's sun, five mercenaries must survive the onslaught of an alien species and collect a rare mineral before their home planet goes dark forever.

items.title: The Elf
items.description: After inheriting an old toy shop, Nick discovers a cursed elf doll sealed inside an ancient chest with a naughty list of his family's names written on it. The elf was an evil conduit meant to unleash a supernatural killing spree by whomever set it free.

items.title: The Hollow
items.description: When a U.S. congressman's daughter is murdered in a small Mississippi town, a team of F.B.I. agents come to investigate. They quickly discover how deep the corruption runs in this small town…

items.title: The Lighthouse
items.description: Two men are trapped in an isolated lighthouse, cut off from the outside world. As a freak storm rages for months and getting help seems impossible, a terrible tragedy hits, leaving them fighting to stay sane in a nightmarish situation.

items.title: The Lullaby
items.description: Chloe is overwhelmed by the birth of her first child. She begins hearing voices, the humming of a childhood lullaby and sees flashes of a strange entity around her son. Convinced the entity is real, she will do anything in her power to protect him.

items.title: The Queen of Hollywood Blvd
items.description: On her 60th birthday, the proud owner of a Los Angeles strip club, finds herself in hot water over a twenty-five year old debt to the mob, leading her on a downward spiral of violence and revenge through the underbelly of Los Angeles.

items.title: Viking Siege
items.description: Vengeful warriors plot a massacre, but are stopped when a horde of Vikings arrive with an army of evil demons chasing them.

items.title: Let's Scare Jessica To Death
items.description: A recently institutionalized woman has bizarre experiences after moving into a supposedly haunted country farmhouse and fears she may be losing her sanity once again.

items.title: Abbey Grace
items.description: When her mom dies, Stacey puts her life and career on hold and returns to her childhood home to take care of her agorophobic brother Ben who hasn't been out of the house for 23 years only to find out the house they grew up in harbors a disturbing secret.

items.title: American Exorcism
items.description: Damon Richter thought he left the world of possessions, exorcisms, and evil behind until an old friend arrives with frightening information about his estranged daughter knowing that only his otherworldly skills can save her.

items.title: American Killing
items.description: A writers retreat takes a very dark turn when its obsessive showrunner manipulates his team into playing along in his distrubed, hidden-camera "masterpiece."

items.title: Amityville Terror
items.description: When a new family moves to an old house in Amityville, they are tormented and tortured by an evil spirit living in the home while trapped by the malicious townspeople who want to keep them there.

items.title: Anti Matter
items.description: Ana, an Oxford PhD student finds herself unable to build new memories following an experiment to generate and travel through a wormhole. She must fight to understand what happened, and to find out who - or what - is behind the rising horror in her life

items.title: Beaster Day
items.description: A giant bloodthirsty Easter bunny starts viciously killing the local townsfolk. When the Mayor refuses to act and the attacks grow more gruesome, the town finds its very survival in the hands of a wannabe actress and a crazy dog-catcher.

items.title: The Answer
items.description: After being attacked, an introverted young man must follow clues left by his dead parents in order to figure out who is after him - and who he really is.

items.title: The Gatehouse
items.description: 10-Year-Old Eternity lives in a gatehouse at the edge of a forest and likes to dig for buried treasure. One day she digs up something she shouldn't, and the forest wants it back. What follows is a battle with an ancient force from a forgotten world.

items.title: The Grand Son
items.description: High in the Hollywood Hills Tod lives a charmed life, but when senses his decadent lifestyle is in jeopardy, things take a dark turn as he hatches a diabolical plan to save it and ensure the money keeps coming in.

items.title: The Nursery
items.description: When Ranae agrees to babysit for a family with a tragic past, a run-of-the-mill Saturday night quickly turns into a confrontation with unspeakable horror.

items.title: They Call Me Jeeg
items.description: Enzo, a lonely and misanthropic small time crook, uses the superpowers gained after falling in the Tiber river to chase down a crazy gangster called "The gypsy".

items.title: Thirst
items.description: Stranded in the desert, a group of campers are hunted and attacked by a chameleon-like alien that feeds on the fluid of it victims, leaving behind a dehydrated, dusty corpse. They must find a way to destroy the creature or suffer a horrible death.

items.title: Face/Off
items.description: As a result of a new medical technique, an agent is able to surgically take on the identical appearance of a criminal in order to take down his terrorist organization.

items.title: Ghost
items.description: Patrick Swayze plays a ghost who teams with a psychic (Whoopi Goldberg) to uncover the truth behind his murder — and to rescue his sweetheart (Demi Moore) from a similar fate.

items.title: The Disaster Diaries 2017
items.description: The year 2017 was marked by several major Atlantic hurricanes (including Harvey, Irma, and Maria), flooding in Sri Lanka, two serious earthquakes in Mexico, and deadly forest fires in California and Portugal.

items.title: Venice: The Technological Challenge Through The Ages
items.description: The sea level in Venice has increased drastically in the last century or so, threatening the very existence of the city.

items.title: The Disaster Diaries 2015
items.description: While we can't look into the future and foresee what may hit us next, we do know that each year brings its share of natural disasters that we often try, in vain, to anticipate, understand, and predict.

items.title: The Disaster Diaries 2016
items.description: Is 2016 the tipping point towards climate and geological chaos? In the footsteps of the successful 2015, The Disaster Diaries, the 2016 edition is a new kind of natural disaster program.

items.title: Strange Creatures
items.description: Hidden in the magical underwater world of one of the most biodiverse marine areas on the planet exists a community of spectacular animals more peculiar than we can imagine.

items.title: Scream. Grita antes de morir
items.description: Luego de una serie de muertes misteriosas, un grupo de fanáticos de películas de terror se vuelven el blanco de un asesino enmascarado en este thriller exitoso del director Wes Craven, que reinventó el género del terror.

items.title: Scream 2
items.description: En la universidad, Sidney Prescott creyó que al fin había dejado atrás el terror... hasta que un asesino imitador empieza a interpretar una secuela real donde nadie está a salvo ni libre de sospecha.

items.title: Scream 3
items.description: La primera película estableció las reglas. En la secuela, la apuesta es mayor. En la tercera entrega de la exitosa franquicia "Scream", todo es posible. Es un juego insidioso de caos de película de terror con sorprendentes giros y vueltas.

items.title: G.I. Joe: Retaliation
items.description: The greatest American Heroes are back, and they've been set up to take the fall for a heinous crime they didn't commit. Roadblock (Dwayne Johnson) leads a new team (including Channing Tatum and Bruce Willis) on this high-octane adventure.

items.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
items.description: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

items.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
items.description: The battle for Earth continues when college-bound Sam Witwicky learns the truth about the ancient origins of the Transformers and must join in their continued battle against the Decepticons.

items.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
items.description: The non-human machine ruling elite of the nuclear war-torn future has dispatched a cyborg assassin into the past to kill a young boy because he soon will be the resistance leader against the machines.

items.title: Acts of Vengeance
items.description: A fast-talking lawyer (Antonio Banderas) transforms his body and takes a vow of silence, not to be broken until he finds out who killed his wife and daughter and has his revenge.

items.title: Grizzly Man
items.description: Werner Herzog (Cave of Forgotten Dreams) crafts a compelling documentary look at wildlife preservationist Timothy Treadwell, who lived unarmed among grizzly bears in Alaska.

items.title: Seal Team Six: The Raid on Osama Bin Laden
items.description: When the rumored whereabouts of Osama bin Laden are revealed, the CIA readies a team of seasoned US Navy SEALs for the mission of a lifetime.

items.title: Alex Rider: Operation Stormbreaker
items.description: After his uncle dies, a young boy learns of his relative's true occupation as an undercover spy and is later recruited to be undercover himself. Based on the novel by Anthony Horowitz.

items.title: Powder Blue
items.description: A top-notch cast fuels this powerful thriller that links the destinies of four people desperate for connection and redemption on the gritty streets of LA.

items.title: Kill Switch
items.description: A pilot battles to save his family and the planet after an experiment for unlimited energy goes wrong.

items.title: En lo más profundo
items.description: El oficial, Cole, tiene la misión de infiltrarse en el sindicato de Dios, un brutal jefe criminal. Pero a medida que Cole se involucra en el grupo de Dios, la línea que separa su verdadera identidad de su personalidad callejera comienza a desaparecer.

items.title: Del crepúsculo al amanecer
items.description: En este clásico de Tarantino, los bandidos hermanos Gecko cometen una ola de crímenes. Secuestran a un padre y sus dos hijos, y se esconden en un bar mexicano. Pero se enfrentarán a los clientes del bar y se unirán a sus rehenes para sobrevivir.

items.title: Applesauce
items.description: After he confesses the worst thing he’s ever done, Ron Welz’s past starts catching up to him and someone starts sending him body parts. Who is tormenting him? There are eight million people in New York, and everyone's a suspect.

items.title: Becket
items.description: One of the greatest historical dramas in motion picture history, Becket is the moving, passionate, and ultimately tragic story of King Henry II (Peter O’Toole) and his friend and confidant, Thomas Becket (Richard Burton).

items.title: Citizen Koch
items.description: A searing exposé on the state of American democracy and the fracturing of the Republican Party, CITIZEN KOCH investigates the money behind the Tea Party and traces the impact of unlimited election spending by corporations and billionaires.

items.title: Dan Curtis' Dracula
items.description: Jack Palance stars as Count Dracula in this newly-restored and terrifying adaptation of Bram Stoker’s classic vampire legend written by sci-fi/horror master Richard Matheson and produced by the legendary Dan Curtis (Dark Shadows).

items.title: Deathgasm
items.description: Two high school metalheads play a forbidden piece of music that unlocks the gates of hell. Now the two headbangers and a metal maiden must join forces to save their town from a demonic onslaught.

items.title: GIRLTRASH: All Night Long
items.description: In this musical comedy, Daisy tries to get over her ex-girlfriend, while Colby falls in love with Misty - the only problem - Misty's got a mad crush on the wild and seductive Tyler. In one epic night, the girls find sex, drugs, and rock'n'roll.

items.title: I Am Thor
items.description: Jon Mikl Thor was a bodybuilding rock star in the '70s & '80s whose theatrical band, THOR, never quite made it big. Ten years into retirement, Thor attempts a comeback of his band – a comeback that nearly kills him.

items.title: LFO
items.description: In this darkly comic sci-fi thriller, an amateur scientist hypnotizes his neighbors with sound frequencies and subjects them to increasingly outlandish scenarios in order to fuel his megalomania.

items.title: One Eyed Girl
items.description: In this critically acclaimed thriller, a young psychiatrist follows an alluring woman to a secretive religious sect where he's forced to confront his deepest beliefs by the group's charismatic leader.

items.title: Starry Eyes
items.description: In the city of dreams, a desperate actress will do whatever it takes for the role of a lifetime…no matter what the cost.

items.title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
items.description: Based on Oscar Wilde’s compelling supernatural fable of morality vs. mortality, The Picture of Dorian Gray stars Shane Briant as Dorian Gray.

items.title: Therese
items.description: Audrey Tautou stars as a provincial housewife in 1920s France, whose marriage to a landowner inspires her to make a fatal bid for freedom, in Claude Miller's adaptation of a François Mauriac novel.

items.title: George Carlin: On Location at USC
items.description: George Carlin’s March 5, 1977 standup concert at the University of Southern California showcases his unique role as America’s first counter-culture comedian.

items.title: An Inspector Calls
items.description: Emotionally powerful and still sharply relevant, An Inspector Calls is a mysterious detective thriller set in 1912 and written by English dramatist JB Priestley.

items.title: George Carlin: At Carnegie
items.description: Taped before a sold-out house at New York City´s Carnegie Hall, the performance represents a creative resurgence for Carlin, following a heart attack earlier that year.

items.title: George Carlin: On Campus
items.description: In his New York City grammar school, George Carlin was known as a “disruptive influence in the classroom.” With this concert, the ultimate class clown is back at school at UCLA, making another generation of students roar with laughter.

items.title: George Carlin: Playin' With Your Head
items.description: George Carlin presents one of his most hysterical stand-up comedy performances in this one-man show recorded at the Beverly Theater in Los Angeles.

items.title: George Carlin: What Am I Doing in New Jersey?
items.description: George Carlin's sixth HBO stand-up concert special, "What Am I Doin' in New Jersey," aired as a live broadcast from the Park Theater in Union City, New Jersey.

items.title: George Carlin: Back in Town
items.description: George is back with his ninth HBO stand-up performance, taped live at the Beacon Theater in New York City. "Back in Town" features Carlin’s trademark acerbic observations.

items.title: George Carlin: George's Best Stuff
items.description: George’s Best Stuff is a compilation of some of Carlin’s legendary routines, including “A Place For My Stuff,” “Dogs and Cats,” “Baseball and Football" and others.

items.title: George Carlin: You Are All Diseased
items.description: Growing up in New York City, George Carlin was always the class clown. He went on to become one of the great comedians of our time, with an appeal that has spanned generations.

items.title: George Carlin: Complaints & Grievances
items.description: In Complaints & Grievances, George Carlin’s 12th HBO comedy special, taped at the Beacon Theater in New York on November 17, 2001 (ten weeks after 9/11), Carlin casts his usual jaundiced eye on America and its inhabitants.

items.title: George Carlin: Doin' It Again
items.description: In Doin’ It Again, the minutiae of everyday life is up for Carlin’s hilarious interpretation as he takes on the best of the worst in all of us.

items.title: George Carlin: Life Is Worth Losing
items.description: George Carlin returns to the stage in Life is Worth Losing, his 13th live comedy stand-up special, performed at the Beacon Theatre in New York City for HBO.

items.title: George Carlin: Jammin' in New York
items.description: When George Carlin was asked which HBO concert was his favorite, his answer was always, “Jammin’ In New York.”

items.title: George Carlin: It's Bad for Ya
items.description: It’s Bad For Ya, Carlin's Emmy-nominated 14th and final HBO special from March of 2008 features Carlin's irreverent and unapologetic observations.

items.title: El frío de la noche
items.description: Scott es un fotógrafo de moda preocupado por la aparición repentina de pesadillas en sus sueños nocturnos. En estos, parece estar involucrado en el asesinato de una hermosa joven. Cuando conoce a esta mujer de los sueños en realidad, comienza a sospechar

items.title: Perdita Durango
items.description: A psychotic couple’s crime spree grows shockingly violent as they kidnap and rape a random teenage couple and then prepare them for human sacrifice.

items.title: The First Boys of Spring
items.description: The story of baseball’s spring training traditions in Hot Springs, Arkansas beginning in 1886. Many of the best who ever played the game came to Hot Springs, including Negro League teams, to prepare for long seasons ahead. Narrated by Billy Bob Thornton.

items.title: Out of Place
items.description: Out Of Place is an inspiring film that explores the underground surfing community of Cleveland, Ohio dating back to the early 1960s.

items.title: The Pursuit
items.description: The Pursuit reflects the lives of motivated, up-and-coming, young surfers from around the globe.

items.title: The Hunter's Prayer
items.description: An assassin (Sam Worthington) helps a young woman avenge the death of her family.

items.title: Luxor
items.description: When British aid worker Hana returns to the ancient city of Luxor, she comes across Sultan, an archeologist and former lover. Haunted by the familiar place, she struggles to reconcile the choices of the past with the uncertainty of the present.

items.title: Happy Hell Night
items.description: A fraternity-hazing prank goes terribly wrong and a psychotic killer is set loose. Now a relentless evil has been unleashed, and the coeds of Winfield College will face the bloody horror of Happy Hell Night.

items.title: Rock and Roll Revue
items.description: Rhythm-Packed and Star-Studded! Compiled for theatrical release from made-for-television short films, this curiosity from the early days of rock 'n' roll features more jazz than you might expect, but it's still an exciting time capsule of sound! Duke Elli

items.title: Jivin' In Be-Bop
items.description: Featuring treasured musical and dance numbers from some of the greatest minds of the music industry, this documentary-style musical is sure to get viewers moving.

items.title: Killer Diller
items.description: An all-Black comedy and dance revue with stars of stage and screen.

items.title: Lady Cocoa
items.description: Lady Cocoa has a mobster boyfriend, and she’s going to bring him down! With a cast that includes Lola Falana and NFL star “Mean” Joe Greene, director Matt Cimber (The Black 6; Butterfly) creates a stirring piece of street action for lovers of the Blaxplo

items.title: The Blood of Jesus
items.description: In this tale, also released under the title The Glory Road, Martha (Cathryn Caviness), a young religious woman, finds herself at the Crossroads between Heaven and Hell. At these pivotal crossroads, Martha finds herself tempted by Judas (Frank H. McClennan

items.title: Wishmaster: el genio del mal
items.description: Cuando un apreciador de joyas recibe una gema antigua, sin saberlo, desata un espíritu inmortal que concede deseos a los humanos a cambio de sus almas.

items.title: Sworn to Justice
items.description: After attackers kill her sister and nephew, a female psychologist becomes a defense witness by day and avenger by night.

items.title: Hotel Artemis
items.description: In 2028, Los Angeles is in the midst of the most violent riot in its history. Four bank robbers botch a heist and head to the Hotel Artemis, a penthouse and an ER that exclusively serves criminals – all of whom now set their sights on the robbers.

items.title: Red Sun Rising
items.description: Thomas Hoshino is a tough Japanese detective, who lost his partner by a deadly Yakuza killer Jaho. He tracks down the killer and master to LA, where he teams up with Det. Karen Ryder to find a way to defeat the killer who posses mystical ninja powers.

items.title: Ultimate Fight
items.description: A martial arts champion saves the life of a street fighter and must fight for him in the ultimate fight to the death.

items.title: H is for Happiness
items.description: Based on the award-winning book My Life as an Alphabet by Barry Jonsberg, it is the genuinely heart-warming and unflinchingly honest story of one twelve-year-old’s determination to unite her family and spark happiness in their lives.

items.title: Eight Million Ways to Die
items.description: Crime drama based on the novel by Lawrence Block. An ex-Sheriff embarks on an unrelenting mission to avenge the death of a young prostitute at the hands of a ruthless pimp. How far will he go to see justice served?

items.title: MST3K: Manos: The Hands of Fate
items.description: A hapless family on a car trip in rural Texas takes refuge at a lodge that is secretly the home of a deadly cult.

items.title: For Now
items.description: Still grieving the death of their parents while trying to build a future for themselves, two siblings take a road trip up the California coast for a ballet audition.

items.title: MST3K: Robot Monster
items.description: The guys watch a post-apocalyptic film about aliens and robots, riff on two more installments of "Radar Men from the Moon", and try to understand surrealism.

items.title: MST3K: Operation Kid Brother (Operation Double 007)
items.description: A plastic surgeon (played by Neil Connery, brother of Sean), the brother of a secret agent, combats villain Thair Beta.

items.title: MST3K: Tormented
items.description: A betrothed jazz pianist believes he's escaped his troublesome mistress when he fails to save her from a fall. But then he's visited by her ghost and a blackmailer.

items.title: MST3K: Racket Girls
items.description: A gym owner gets into trouble, becoming the target of the mob and the law. The 1950 short presents a high school couple rushing into marriage, and the marriage counselor who talks them out of it.

items.title: Hell Up In Harlem
items.description: Sequel to Black Ceasa with Fred Williamson starring again as the underworld king of Harlem, the leader of a black syndicate who works his rackets like Robin Hood, doing continuous battle with dishonest politicians, corrupt police, and even his sidekick.

items.title: The Fortune Cookie
items.description: In their very first screen pairing, Walter Matthau (who would win a Best Supporting Actor Oscar for his performance) and Jack Lemmon portray a crooked lawyer and his TV cameraman brother-in-law in this madcap tale of greed and recouping lost love.

items.title: The Ice King
items.description: John Curry transformed ice skating from a dated sport into a new artistic medium. Coming out on the night of his Olympic win in 1976, he became the first openly gay Olympian in a time when homosexuality was not even fully legal.

items.title: The Reflecting Skin
items.description: Available for the first time in HD in North America, THE REFLECTING SKIN is a cult classic set in the heartlands of America and stars 3 times Oscar-nominee Viggo Mortenson (GREEN BOOK), in this haunting web of misguided fantasies.

items.title: The Odds
items.description: A young woman enlists in an underground game of pain endurance in the hope of winning the million-dollar prize. She soon learns the real opponent is the man who's running the game, as he employs horrific methods to manipulate and defeat her.

items.title: What Makes a Woman
items.description: The film follows Munroe as she undergoes dramatic facial feminization surgery as part of tackling her gender dysphoria, a hugely personal moment that kick starts an exploration of the central question – "What Makes a Woman?"

items.title: MST3K: The Painted Hills
items.description: A Lassie movie, set in 1870s California amongst rival gold miners. The 1950s-era short teaches college students how to improve their hygiene.

items.title: MST3K: Blood Waters of Dr. Z
items.description: Seeking revenge against those responsible for stripping him of his tenure and the denial of human research subjects, Dr. Z mutates himself into a hideous — and murderous — half-human-half-fish-like creature!

items.title: The Crawling Eye
items.description: Things start to look eerily familiar to scientists Crevett and Brooks when mountain climbers begin losing their heads in the Trollenberg Mountains.

items.title: The Corpse Vanishes
items.description: In the theater, Joel and the Bots get the third installment of "Radar Men from the Moon" before the Bela Lugosi film "The Corpse Vanishes".

items.title: Dinero fácil
items.description: Monty Capuletti (Rodney Dangerfield) bebe, fuma, juega, y come demasiado. Pero cuando su suegra le deja una herencia considerable, solo hay un inconveniente: según el testamento, él debe convertir sus vicios en virtudes antes de poder cobrar.

items.title: Ring of Terror
items.description: A medical student (played by George B. Mather) is tormented by a frat-house hazing after being asked to remove a ring from the finger of a corpse.

items.title: Pasión por el triunfo
items.description: Doug es un jugador de hockey sobre hielo, pero sus sueños se truncan por un accidente que da fin a su carrera. Kate es una patinadora artística, quien elitista la fuerza a patinar sola. Juntos, el improbable dúo va por el oro olímpico.

items.title: Pequeñas grandes amigas
items.description: Molly es una princesa fiestera, con dinero que acaba de agotarse. Ray es una niña quisquillosa, quien acaba de sacar la niñera huyendo. Cuando Molly es contratada para cuidar de Ray, las chicas deben de cambiar sus vidas.

items.title: Corazón indomable
items.description: Una camarera apenas nota a un tímido ayudante de camarero quien la ama en secreto; hasta que una noche la atacan y él viene a rescatarla. A partir de ahí, su relación se convierte en una de las historias de amor más inolvidables del cine.

items.title: La familia Perez
items.description: En el 1980, un dueño de una hacienda cubana es finalmente liberado tras pasar 20 años en la cárcel. Anhelando con ver a su esposa y hija, le permiten entrar al barco migratorio que va para Florida.

items.title: Una disparatada bruja en la universidad
items.description: Una semana antes de cumplir dieciséis años, una niña se da cuenta de que es descendiente de una de las brujas de Salem y que tiene poderes.

items.title: Rescate al alba
items.description: Durante la guerra de Vietnam, el piloto americano, Dieter Dengler (Christian Bale) es derribado y tomado prisionero por el Vietcong. Durante su cautiverio, le tocó vivir una de las experiencias más notables y horrorosas de toda la guerra.

items.title: Raging Bull
items.description: Robert De Niro gana el Oscar como Mejor Actor caracterizando el papel de Jake La Motta, un boxeador cuyas complejidades psicológicas y sexuales estallan en violencia tanto dentro como fuera del ring.

items.title: Venganza diabólica
items.description: Un hombre conjura a un demonio aterrador llamado Pumpkinhead para llevar a cabo su venganza en contra de los adolescentes, quienes sin querer, mataron a su hijo.

items.title: Sin salida
items.description: Un encubrimiento y una caza de brujas ocurren después de que un político mata accidentalmente a su amante. Kevin Costner y Gene Hackman protagonizan esta tensa historia de suspenso político.

items.title: Comando especial
items.description: Charlie Sheen, Michael Biehn, y Bill Paxton son tres de los mejores comandos del Navy de Estados Unidos. Ellos son enviados para rescatar una tripulación de un avión estadounidense que tiene misiles.

items.title: Mystic Pizza
items.description: En esta tierna historia de anhelos de juventud, Julia Roberts, Annabeth Gish, y Lili Taylor, son tres chicas trabajando en una pizzería y soñando con un futuro brillante fuera de su pueblecito Mystic, Connecticut.

items.title: Larger Than Life
items.description: Bill Murray y Janeane Garafalo protagonizan está loca comedia sobre un hombre al que la vida le cambia para siempre cuando hereda un elefante de circo.

items.title: Las estafadoras
items.description: Una mujer y su hija son estafadoras profesionales que utilizan sus armas de seducción para engañar a millonarios, hasta que la joven hija se enamora poniendo en apuros el último golpe: un excéntrico magnate del tabaco.

items.title: Hart's War
items.description: Bruce Willis interpreta a un oficial encarcelado que se niega a abandonar su lucha contra los nazis. ¡Con la ayuda de un joven teniente, arriesga todo para liberar a sus hombres y cambiar el resultado de la guerra!

items.title: Fama
items.description: Se pondrán a prueba las pasiones y los corazones se romperán. Fama es la inspiradora historia de un grupo de bailarines, cantantes, músicos y actores de la Escuela Secundaria de Artes Escénicas de la Ciudad de Nueva York.

items.title: Bull Durham (ESP)
items.description: La temporada de béisbol tiene un comienzo difícil cuando el nuevo receptor de Bull Durham (Kevin Costner) y el joven y arrogante lanzador (Tim Robbins) compiten para conquistar a la sexy Susan Sarandon.

items.title: Lluvia de fuego
items.description: When an explosion jolts Boston, bomb squad expert Jimmy Dove (Jeff Bridges) is thrust into the most harrowing work of his career. And when evidence points to his former mentor (Tommy Lee Jones), Dove must face a bitter enemy and a haunting past.

items.title: Otoño en Nueva York
items.description: El exitoso playboy Will (Richard Gere) nunca ha pensado seriamente en el compromiso hasta que conoce a Charlotte (Winona Ryder). A medida que su relación se convierte en algo maravilloso, ambos se dan cuenta de que este amor podría durar toda la vida...

items.title: The Barefoot Contessa
items.description: A waning director revives his career after discovering a beautiful Spanish dancer and makes her into a Hollywood star. Ava Gardner, Humphrey Bogart and Edmond O’Brien star in this bitter tale of stardom won and wasted from Joseph L. Mankiewicz.

items.title: The Way West
items.description: Icons Kirk Douglas, Robert Mitchum and Richard Widmark star in this sumptuous, epic tale of the brave men and women in the U.S. who left the comfort and safety of life in the East for the promise of free land a better life in the untamed West.

items.title: The Octagon
items.description: Chuck Norris is back in this action-packed martial arts showcase co-starring the legendary Lee Van Cleef. Norris takes on his adoptive brother and a training camp where terrorists are being taught the secret killing techniques of the ninja!

items.title: The Defiant Ones
items.description: In Stanley Kramer's cinema classic, screen legends Sidney Poitier and Tony Curtis star as two convicts on the run from a Southern work gang who are bound together by an unbreakable iron chain and separated by an unbridled hatred for each other.

items.title: Shout At The Devil
items.description: In this epic tale of adventure and revenge, Lee Marvin and Roger Moore are recruited by the WW I allied forces to take on a German battleship! An exciting mix of humor, action and the unique chemistry shared between two of Hollywood's finest stars.

items.title: Run Silent, Run Deep
items.description: The legendary Clark Gable and Burt Lancaster star in this gripping, classic military drama as a submarine commander (Gable) drives his men and his 1st officer (Lancaster) to the brink of mutiny in his quest to sink an enemy sub. Robert Wise directs.

items.title: Red River (1948)
items.description: John Wayne, Montgomery Clift and Walter Brennan give stellar performances in Howard Hawks' epic masterpiece as a self-made cattle baron (Wayne) and his adopted son (Clift) risk everything to drive their herd across the treacherous Chisholm Trail.

items.title: Lilies Of The Field
items.description: Nominated for 5 Academy Awards® including Best Picture and winner of the Best Actor Oscar® for Sidney Poitier for his role as an itinerant handyman who stops to help five impoverished nuns and the small Arizona desert town in which they reside.

items.title: Kinjite: Forbidden Subjects
items.description: International superstar Charles Bronson is a vice squad veteran forced to battle his own racial prejudices when he's assigned to track down a young Japanese girl enslaved by a vicious child prostitution ring.

items.title: Duel at Diablo
items.description: Frontier scout Jess Remsberg leads a wagon train through hostile territory to Fort Conchos. But underneath his valor, he has an ulterior motive: to settle a score with the man he believes killed his wife. James Garner and Sidney Poitier star.

items.title: Cyborg
items.description: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this adrenaline-charged sci-fi thriller as Gibson Rickenbacker, the future's most fearsome warrior. In the wake of a plague, Rickenbacker must rescue the only person who can develop a vaccine and save civilization.

items.title: Breakheart Pass
items.description: As a train races through the Rocky Mountains, the passengers are being murdered! The only hope is John Deakin (Charles Bronson) who uncovers a secret that explodes in a torrent of shocking revelations, explosive brawls, and blazing gun battles.

items.title: Billy Two Hats
items.description: Archie (Gregory Peck) and his partner, Billy (Desi Arnaz, Jr.) are bandits by trade, staging daring robberies throughout the American frontier. But when their latest heist takes a deadly turn, they are pursued by a ruthless marshal (Jack Warden).

items.title: Anna And The Apocalypse
items.description: In this gleeful mashup, Anna and her friends must fight – and sing – their way through a zombie invasion to reach the supposed safety of their school, not knowing if their parents and friends will still be alive when they get there.

items.title: La maldición de la ouija
items.description: Una niña lleva a sus amigos a una casa con un pasado oscuro para un proyecto de investigación. Inconscientemente convocan a una entidad malvada con planes propios que hace la casa parte de su juego siniestro.

items.title: MST3K: Cave Dwellers
items.description: Wise ruler Akronas (aka “The Great One”) is the keeper of an incredibly powerful but potentially deadly device.

items.title: MST3K: Star Force: Fugitive Alien II
items.description: Ken and the crew of the Bacchus 3 return in Star Force: Fugitive Alien II (1987) while Joel and the Bots make a Captain Joe action figure and stage a "name that puppet" quiz show.

items.title: The Unearthly
items.description: A mad scientist creates havoc when an experiment to stop the aging process goes awry.

items.title: The Castle of Fu-Manchu
items.description: The Castle of Fu-Manchu tries to conquer the world by turning all water into ice.

items.title: MST3K: Attack of the Giant Leeches
items.description: Hillbillies, holo-clowns, and a giant leech named Patches abound when Joel and the Bots take on this bloodsucking tale from acclaimed producer/director Roger Corman.

items.title: The Killer Shrews
items.description: An experiment on a remote island goes awfully awry when Professor Marlowe Cragis and his research team accidentally create giant, venomous shrews.

items.title: MST3K: Hercules Unchained
items.description: While trying to resolve a quarrel between warring brothers Eteocles and Polynices, Hercules is taken captive by Queen Omphale of Lydia.

items.title: Always
items.description: A parking lot attendant with a violent past finds hope in the love of the blind girl that walks into his booth one day.

items.title: 200 Pounds Beauty
items.description: After a drastic "head-to-toe" plastic surgery, Han-na, an overweight back-up singer, goes from shy duckling to full-on pop diva in this acclaimed Korean comedy. When Han-na finally gets the spotlight she always wanted, she realizes that fame wasn't what s

items.title: A Special Lady
items.description: This action saga tells the story of Na, a woman who rises to the top of an underworld crime ring, that becomes a powerful business. When Na faces threats to her power, she's forced to go on the run and protect her beloved son from ruthless rivals - by any

items.title: No Mercy
items.description: In this vengeance-fueled thriller, a martial arts champion will stop at nothing to find her missing younger sister --hunting down the predators that kidnapped and assaulted her one by one.

items.title: Untold Scandal
items.description: Untold Scandal

items.title: MST3K: Indestructible Man
items.description: In Indestructible Man, a violent criminal named Butcher Benson is executed and becomes indestructible when he’s brought back to life.

items.title: MST3K: Hercules Against the Moon Men
items.description: A race of evil Moon aliens lands in ancient Greece, wreaking havoc for years on the city of Samar. It’s up to the mighty Hercules to end the chaos.

items.title: MST3K: The Rebel Set
items.description: Three coffee shop customers help an owner rob an armored car.

items.title: MST3K: Monster A-Go-Go
items.description: The search for an astronaut on an alien planet.

items.title: The End of Violence
items.description: A haunting meditation on the causes and effects, the uses and abuses of violence in life and art.

items.title: After The Fox
items.description: Pretending to be a movie director, an Italian crook known as The Fox (Peter Sellers) cons local villagers and the police into smuggling into Rome the loot from a $3 million Cairo bullion robbery...as part of the film script!

items.title: Frogs
items.description: A revenge-of-nature-type film in which thousands of swamp critters attack a wheelchair-bound, Deep South plantation owner and his family on his birthday...the 4th of July...probably because he's been destroying the bayou wildlife.

items.title: Man With The Gun
items.description: Robert Mitchum portrays an Exterminator--in the American West. He will, for a price, eliminate any outlaws annoying the peace of any Western town. When his wife, in disgust, leaves him, he pursues her, only to encounter his greatest gunfighting challenge.

items.title: Betrayed
items.description: Debra Winger and Tom Berenger star in this tense, provocative tale of betrayal about an FBI agent who falls for a murder suspect with a shocking secret. John Heard, John Mahoney, Richard Libertini, Betsy Blair and Ted Levine co-star.

items.title: Inherit The Wind
items.description: Spencer Tracy and Fredric March go toe-to-toe in this powerful recreation of a titanic courtroom battle in which an attorney faces off against a fundamentalist in a Tennessee town where a teacher has been brought to trial for teaching Darwinism.

items.title: Busting
items.description: Elliott Gould and Robert Blake star in this comedy/drama about vice officers, assigned to the mean streets of L.A., who wage a war against crooked cops on the force.

items.title: Patty Hearst
items.description: Patty Hearst's own story of her kidnapping.

items.title: The Knack...And How To Get It
