items.description: Sophisticated Tolen has a monopoly on womanizing while the awkward Colin desperately wants a piece of it. When Colin falls for an innocent girl, it's not long before Tolen moves in for the kill. Can Colin get The Knack and beat Tolen at his own game?

items.title: Felix All Around the World: An Animated Classic
items.description: After being separated from his friend Sophie, Felix embarks on a journey filled with mystical creatures in this high quality animated feature for your kids and family.

items.title: Lucky U Ranch
items.description: In 1953, 11-year-old Junior McCaully is bullied and stuck at an Arizona trailer court with his hardworking mom. All seems lost until the arrival of Melissa, an energetic free-spirit, who teaches him baseball, self-confidence and changes everything.

items.title: Felix and the Time Machine: An Animated Classic
items.description: On a visit to a museum, Felix discovers a virtual time machine. Surprisingly, the futuristic capsule turns out to have the power to carry him to the past. With the company of baby mammoth Woolly and turtle Gertrude, they set out to return from the past...

items.title: Ip Man
items.description: Ip Man is the award-winning film adaptation about the life story of Ip Man, the grandmaster of the Wing Chun style of kung fu and sifu of legendary martial arts superstar, Bruce Lee.

items.title: Paradox
items.description: When his daughter goes missing, a police negotiator (Louis Koo) teams with local police (Tony Jaa) to find her, but instead finds himself embroiled in a web of corruption and violence in this explosive thriller from director Wilson Yip.

items.title: The Courier
items.description: A specialist carrier is hired to deliver a mysterious case to the underworld's most dangerous hitman.

items.title: The Last Tycoon
items.description: Action superstar Chow Yun-Fat portrays real-life gangster Chen Daqi as he rises to the upper echelons of power, finding himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

items.title: Swamp Diamonds
items.description: An undercover policewoman infiltrates a group of hardened female criminals who plan to break out of prison and retrieve diamonds from a swamp.

items.title: Secret Agent Super Dragon
items.description: A secret agent tries to stop a drug lord from taking over the world with hallucinogenic chewing gum.

items.title: MST3K: Eegah
items.description: Driving home one night through the Southern California desert, teenager Roxy Miller encounters Eegah – a 7-foot giant! As Eegah’s fondness for her grows, Can Dr. Miller and Roxy’s boyfriend Tom save her from the clutches of the prehistoric caveman?

items.title: The Wild Wild World of Batwoman
items.description: In this lower-than-low budget film, Batwoman enlists her band of go-go dancing Batgirls to protect the Atomic Hearing Aid from the rotten Rat Fink.

items.title: MST3K: Beginning of the End
items.description: A swarm of giant grasshoppers, inadvertently created by a radioactive experiment, heads for Chicago.

items.title: MST3K: Outlaw (Of Gor)
items.description: A hero and loser friend are transplanted to the planet of Gor by mysterious forces and are soon caught up in an evil sorcerer's plot of dastardly evil.

items.title: MST3K: Code Name: Diamond Head
items.description: Counterintelligence takes on new meaning in this barely coherent tale of Hawaiian espionage that takes place on movie sets meant to look like Hawaii.

items.title: MST3K: Last of the Wild Horses
items.description: A cowboy winds up in the middle of a turf war between a rancher and his neighbors in Last of the Wild Horses.

items.title: MST3K: The Starfighters
items.description: An Air Force pilot attempts to gain the respect of his father.

items.title: MST3K: Red Zone Cuba
items.description: An escaped convict and his two pals take part in the Bay of Pigs invasion, then return home with a plan to get rich.

items.title: MST3K: The Brute Man
items.description: Rondo Hatton plays a disfigured man, a/k/a “The Creeper,” who hunts down and kills the people responsible for his deformity.

items.title: MST3K: The Phantom Planet
items.description: When US astronaut Captain Frank Chapman’s military spaceship is damaged by asteroids, he lands safely on the giant asteroid Rheton.

items.title: The Touch of Satan
items.description: An aimless young man encounters a rural family that seems to have some secrets.

items.title: Overdrawn At The Memory Bank
items.description: A weather tech's mind gets trapped in a computer and Pearl establishes her own public television pledge program.

items.title: MST3K: Girl in Gold Boots
items.description: A girl from rural California goes to Los Angeles to work as a go-go dancer, but soon gets involved with drug dealers.

items.title: MST3K: Future War
items.description: Future War was the most recent film ridiculed by the Satellite of Love crew, proving once and for all that movies aren’t always turned bad by age.

items.title: MST3K: Final Justice
items.description: When tough-as-nails Texas Deputy Sheriff Thomas Jefferson Geronimo captures a member of the Italian mob, only he can successfully get his prisoner back to Italy to stand trial.

items.title: MST3K: Hamlet
items.description: A dour production of Shakespeare’s play produced for German TV. A prince returns home for his father’s funeral and doesn’t like what he finds.

items.title: Horrors of Spider Island
items.description: A group of showgirls washes up on a deserted island after their plane crashes. Soon they discover the island is home to a large, radioactive spider.

items.title: MST3K: Boggy Creek II: And the Legend Continues
items.description: A professor and his students camp out in the rural Arkansas swamp, in hopes of finding a Bigfoot-like creature.

items.title: "Cocodrilo" Dundee II
items.description: Justo cuando el australiano excéntrico comienza a acostumbrarse a la vida en la ciudad de Nueva York, Dundee y su hermosa novia (Linda Kozlowski) son blanco de muerte de una pandilla de feroces traficantes de drogas.

items.title: Tan distinto como yo
items.description: Del éxito de ventas del NY Times llega una historia inspiradora y verdadera sobre dos hombres de orígenes radicalmente opuestos, que desarrollan un sorprendente vínculo que los llevará al viaje más notable de sus vidas y forjará una amistad eterna.

items.title: Seabiscuit, más allá de la leyenda
items.description: Una auténtica historia del mundo de las carreras en el momento de la depresión, cuyas victorias animaron no solo a los espíritus del equipo que los apoyaba, sino también a toda una nación.

items.title: Petróleo sangriento
items.description: Una epopeya en expansión sobre la familia, la fe, el poder y el petróleo. La historia narra la vida de Daniel Plainview, quien se transforma a sí mismo de un minero de la plata en un magnate petrolero hecho por cuenta propia.

items.title: Las torres gemelas
items.description: Nicolas Cage y Michael Peña protagonizan a dos policías de la Autoridad Portuaria de Nueva York que quedaron atrapados entre los escombros el 11 de septiembre de 2001.

items.title: Deathcember
items.description: A collection of 24 films that take a look at the dark side of the festive season. 24 international directors with the most diverse ideas and styles; linked by short animated segments that deal with the Advent calendar itself.

items.title: Indian Head Massage: A Day at the Spa Collection
items.description: When it comes to relaxation people are becoming more and more imaginative as the stresses and strains of 21st Century life take their toll. There are many complimentary and alternative therapies to choose from, grounded in the traditions of the ancient...

items.title: Reflexology: A Day at the Spa Collection
items.description: With modern-day life getting ever more stressful, therapeutic treatments that promote health and well-being are becoming increasingly accepted as a valuable part of 21st Century living. One of the most popular therapies offered is Reflexology and alth...

items.title: Rugrats la película: aventuras en pañales
items.description: Con el nacimiento de su nuevo hermano Dylan, Tommy Pickles sabía que las cosas iban a cambiar, pero nunca esperó que ser un hermano pudiera ser tal aventura.

items.title: Beyond Weight Loss
items.description: Beyond Weight Loss is a film that takes a hard look into the world of sustainable weight loss by exposing the fraud and deceit of the diet industry and our government. Find out the truth behind fad diets, food labels, and permanent fat loss.

items.title: Believe (2016)
items.description: A small-town business owner struggles between his desire for financial success and the responsibility of funding the annual Christmas pageant.

items.title: The Pistol Shrimps
items.description: Featuring Aubrey Plaza, this funny documentary follows a ragtag group of actresses, musicians, writers, comedians and moms who come together to form a recreational basketball team, revealing that women can be ballers in sports - and comedy.

items.title: Miracle on Highway 34
items.description: A diverse set of characters find themselves together in an old diner in a small town on Christmas Eve during a snowstorm. While a young expecting couple tries to make it home on a night that's anything but silent.

items.title: Resolution Song
items.description: A young man's family torn apart by tragedy reaches out to begin rebuilding trust and seek healing through the only thing that speaks through pain; the healing power of music.

items.title: River Runs Red
items.description: Judge Charles Coleman trusts the legal system he swore to uphold. But when two white cops gun down his only son in cold blood, the system fails. Grieving and in despair, Judge Coleman switches his gavel for a gun, dishing out revenge, not justice.

items.title: Neil Simon's The Odd Couple II
items.description: The times may have changed, but thankfully not the traits that make ex-roomies Felix Ungar (Lemmon) and Oscar Madison (Matthau) the all-time perfect mismatch.

items.title: The Delicate Delinquent
items.description: Lewis plays Sidney Pythias, a bumbling janitor caught up in the middle of a gang rumble. Mistaken for a member of the switchblade set, Sidney is encouraged to undergo a 180-degree transformation - from street hoodlum to full-fledged policeman!

items.title: Billy Graham: An Extraordinary Journey
items.description: Billy Graham—An Extraordinary Journey takes a deep and personal look at the historical Billy Graham – the man, the mission and the message.

items.title: A Tale of Two Thieves
items.description: An exclusive inside take on the biggest heist in British history - The Great Train Robbery. This film reveals the inside man for the first time.

items.title: Brave Girls
items.description: Brave Girls neatly captures the challenge of 3 young Indian women breaking with cultural tradition in a conservative, Muslim town in Gujarat, India. They are forced to choose between their evolving dreams and their obligations to their community.

items.title: Celluloid Bloodbath: More Prevues from Hell
items.description: "Celluloid Bloodbath: More Prevues from Hell" is the long-awaited sequel to 1987's horror cult classic, "Mad Ron's Prevues from Hell."

items.title: Curse of the Man Who Sees UFOs
items.description: Christo Roppolo claims to have been filming and communicating with UFOs for several years. Filmmaker Justin Gaar follows his journey and finds that sometimes aliens from space can tell us more about our own humanity on Earth.

items.title: Glen Campbell: I'll Be Me
items.description: This film documents Glen's amazing "Goodbye Tour" as he and his family attempt to navigate the wildly unpredictable nature of his progressing Alzheimer's disease using love, laughter and music as their medicine of choice.

items.title: Scalia: Portrait of a Man and Jurist
items.description: 'Scalia: Portrait of a Man & Jurist' is a feature documentary examining the judicial life, influence and legacy of the controversial and influential Supreme Court Justice Antonin Scalia.

items.title: John Paul II in Ireland: A Plea for Peace
items.description: In 1979 John Paul II was one year into his papacy. Northern Ireland was a decade into a bloody conflict that shrouded all of Ireland in gloom. This is the dramatic encounter between the charismatic Polish Pope and the "land of Saints and Scholars."

items.title: Love Between the Covers
items.description: Romance fiction is the behemoth of the publishing industry; it outsells mystery, sci-fi, and fantasy combined. Yet no filmmaker has ever taken an honest look at the global community romance writers and readers have built - until now. This funny and ins...

items.title: Django Unchained
items.description: Winner of 2 Academy Awards, including Best Original Screenplay. With the help of his mentor, a slave-turned-bounty hunter sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal plantation owner.

items.title: Maynard
items.description: The Obama before Obama, in 1973 at 35 years old, Maynard Holbrook Jackson Jr. became the first black Mayor of Atlanta, Georgia (home of the Confederate south) and the most significant black political leader since reconstruction.

items.title: Alexander the Great: Footsteps in the Sand
items.description: Visionary warrior, ambitious youth, angry son, ruthless conqueror - such words have been used to describe Alexander the Great. But who exactly was this proclaimed man? When he set out to conquer the world way back in the 4th Century BC, not even the er...

items.title: Beware of Christians
items.description: Beware of Christians chronicles the wild ride of four college guys traveling through Europe and asking themselves what it really looks like to follow Jesus.

items.title: C.S. Lewis and The Chronicles of Narnia
items.description: When C.S. Lewis, a mild-mannered Professor at Oxford University in the heart of England, sat down to write a story for children, not even his closest friend thought it would be a success. The fact that C.S. Lewis was a confirmed bachelor and the friend...

items.title: Dos vidas contigo
items.description: ¿Quién sabía que cuando pidiera el especial, recibiría el plato de su vida? David Duchovny y Minnie Driver encienden chispas en esta historia afectuosa sobre un viudo y una camarera que parecían estar destinados a conocerse y enamorarse.

items.title: Along Came Jones
items.description: Gary Cooper gives a marvelous, tongue-in-cheek performance as a fumble-fingered cowpoke who is mistaken for a notorious bandit and almost gets killed by both sides of the law...all while managing to capture the attention of Loretta Young.

items.title: Pasión por el triunfo 2: medalla olímpica
items.description: Dos patinadores de hielo (Christy Carlson Romano, Ross Thomas) entablan una relación de amor y odio mientras sueñan con alcanzar la gloria.

items.title: A primera vista
items.description: La historia, basada en la vida real, transcurre en Nueva York y comienza cuando una arquitecta se enamora de un carismático masajista ciego.

items.title: ¿Qué más podría pasar?
items.description: Un millonario y despiadado hombre de negocios le roba a un ladrón profesional un apreciado anillo de la suerte. El ladrón hará todo lo posible por recuperarlo y el millonario por evitarlo.

items.title: Ronin (ESP)
items.description: Un equipo de agentes especiales internacionales debe llevar a cabo una misión misteriosa: robar un maletín fuertemente custodiado buscado tanto por el IRA como por la mafia rusa.

items.title: Sirenas
items.description: Una joven se ve atrapada en una guerra emocional, al lidiar con su primer amor y una madre poco convencional.

items.title: Texas: masacre en cadena 2
items.description: La familia de psicópatas asesinos más peligrosa vuelve a la carga. Después de secuestrar a la DJ Vantia Block, deben enfrentarse a un policía texano que los persigue.

items.title: Un mujeriego en apuros
items.description: Un vendedor de autos muy mujeriego se encuentra en apuros cuando enfrenta al esposo de una de sus amantes, enterado de lo que ocurre entre ambos.

items.title: The Death of Dick Long
items.description: In small-town Alabama, Zeke & Earl scramble to cover up the unlikely (and, in most states, highly illegal) events that led to their friend's death, as they try to dodge their families, the cops, and one horrified medical examiner.

items.title: Care to Laugh
items.description: When his mother is diagnosed with a brain tumor, Jesus Trejo, a rising star in comedy, becomes his parents’ sole caregiver. Transforming adversity into comedy, he uses his life experience as material for his routine.

items.title: La entidad
items.description: Estudiantes deciden investigar una serie de videos extraños que se originan en los rincones más oscuros de Internet. Cuando descubren una antigua maldición, sin saberlo, desatan una aterradora fuerza demoníaca.

items.title: Pasión por el triunfo 3: persiguiendo un sueño
items.description: Un patinador de hielo y su nueva pareja se sienten atraídos mutuamente mientras entrenan para competir en París.

items.title: En el tiempo de las mariposas
items.description: En el tiempo de las mariposas es una novela de la escritora dominicana Julia Álvarez, publicada en 1994, sobre la historia de las hermanas Mirabal.

items.title: Fuerza Delta
items.description: Un comando de élite debe recatar a un grupo de personas en un avión secuestrado en Beirut. Los terroristas llevan a los rehenes a escondites dentro de la ciudad, lo que hace de la misión una carrera contra el tiempo.

items.title: Clambake
items.description: The king of rock 'n' roll, Elvis Presley, is as a lonely million-heir who gives up his fortune and trades identities with a water ski instructor to learn about life from the bottom up in this musical romp! Bill Bixby and Shelley Fabares also star.

items.title: Redención
items.description: Una estudiante de una escuela bautista es repudiada y considerada demoníaca tras quedar embarazada.

items.title: Halloween With The New Addams Family
items.description: America's first family of ghastly giddiness reunites for a Halloween celebration that will raise the…dead! John Astin, Carolyn Jones, Ted Cassidy, Jackie Coogan, Lisa Loring and Ken Weatherwax all reprise their roles from the hit original series!

items.title: Ann Rule's Everything She Ever Wanted
items.description: Starring Gina Gershon, Rachel Blanchard, and Ryan McPartlin. A sensual, self-assured Southern belle uses her easily influenced young husband - and any other means necessary - to ascend the ranks of Atlanta's elite.

items.title: Homeward
items.description: A boastful elf and his prank-happy orc brother must learn to work together to stop a fiendish orc gang from retrieving a magical stone that will give them the power to take over the world.

items.title: Dangerous Intentions
items.description: Beth Williamson must battle disbelieving parents and an unsympathetic legal system in order to protect herself and her daughter from an abusive husband.

items.title: Naked Boys Singing!
items.description: Naked Boys Singing! sings the praises of male nudity and the cast includes a multi-talented, racially diverse selection of singers, dancers and actors who bare it all on the BIG screen.

items.title: The Belko Experiment
items.description: Bienvenido a Belko Industries, un tranquilo lugar de trabajo que está a punto de convertirse en un sangriento campo de batalla, cuando 80 empleados son encerrados en su edificio de oficinas y obligados a jugar un juego despiadado de matar o morir.

items.title: Códigos de guerra
items.description: John Woo dirige este épico drama de acción sobre un soldado de la Segunda Guerra Mundial (Nicolas Cage) asignado para proteger a un soldado navajo (Adam Beach) ... y el código secreto que conoce.

items.title: Al Madrigal: Shrimpin' Ain't Easy
items.description: Former 'Daily Show with Jon Stewart' correspondent Al Madrigal applies his comedic insight to relatable topics like cilantro politics, anger management, family, fatherhood, and an unbelievable tale of seafood revenge in this stand-up comedy special.

items.title: Hara-Kiri: Death of a Samurai
items.description: Revenge, honor and disgrace collide when a samurai's request to commit ritual suicide leads to a tense showdown with his feudal lord. From cult auteur Takashi Miike (13 ASSASSINS). In Japanese w/ English subtitles.

items.title: Ultrasuede
items.description: A portrait of the rise and fall of America's first celebrity designer--Halston. Interviews with Liza Minnelli, Diane Von Furstenberg, Billy Joel & others round out the story of a man who defined beauty & fashion in the 70's.

items.title: Mark Ellis: Dog Stepfather
items.description: Comedian Mark Ellis hits up Chicago, IL to film his full-length comedy special, Dog Stepfather. In his very first standup special, Mark covers a lot of pressing topics..

items.title: Love, Antosha
items.description: A portrait of late actor Anton Yelchin, 'Love, Antosha' explores his successes and struggles through his journals, photography, original music, and interviews with his colleagues, including Chris Pine, Kristen Stewart, and Jennifer Lawrence.

items.title: Detective Story
items.description: Kirk Douglas stars as the rigid detective whose personal code has become twisted from dealing with too many criminals. Eleanor Parker is his wife, tormented by a guilty secret.

items.title: Luz
items.description: Simón is a physicist who measures the length of Karma in space-time. This opens a new perception of reality where everything will collapse. Justice, truth and knowledge are metaphical representations of reality.

items.title: Trust Machine
items.description: Award-winning filmmaker Alex Winter's new documentary reveals that proponents of Blockchain are already using the technology to change the world; fighting income inequality, the refugee crisis and world hunger. Narrated by Rosario Dawson.

items.title: Wild Style
items.description: Universally hailed as the first hip-hop movie, WILD STYLE captures New York's 1981 hip-hop culture and several prominent figures including Busy Bee Starski, Fab Five Freddy, The Cold Crush Brothers, and one of the godfathers of hip-hop, Grandmaster Flash.

items.title: Kalifornia
items.description: Una pareja decide ir a conocer los lugares donde se cometieron los crímenes de un libro de asesinos en serie, pero ni se imaginan que no tienen que ir muy lejos para conocer a unos brutales criminales.

items.title: You Laugh But It's True
items.description: In the world of stand-up comedy in South Africa, Trevor Noah uses his experiences during Apartheid to prepare for the biggest show of his life.

items.title: Happy Happy Joy Joy - The Ren & Stimpy Story
items.description: Happy Happy Joy Joy chronicles the rise and fall of one of the most influential animated series. It's the story of a group of talented artists whose incredible work created two of the most beloved characters of all time - Ren and Stimpy

items.title: CBD Nation
items.description: CBD Nation examines the highest levels of research and evidence behind the safest known, therapeutically active medicine humanity has: cannabis

items.title: Mean Girls
items.description: Cady thinks she understands "survival of the fittest." However, the law of the wild takes on a whole new meaning when the homeschooled 15-year-old enters public high school for the first time.

items.title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
items.description: High school senior Ferris Bueller decides to skip school and is determined to experience a day of pure freedom with his girlfriend and best friend in downtown Chicago before graduating.

items.title: The Instrumental Chemist
items.description: The Instrumental Chemist features the remarkable life of chemist, inventor, entrepreneur, and philanthropist Arnold O. Beckman. His brilliantly designed instruments enabled scientists to answer old questions faster and more accurately.

items.title: I Used to Go Here
items.description: Following the launch of her new novel, writer Kate Conklin is asked to speak at her alma mater by her old professor. Soon Kate finds herself deeply enmeshed in the lives of a group of college students. Starring Gillian Jacobs, Jemaine Clement

items.title: The Gumby Movie
items.description: This masterpiece was written and directed by Gumby Creator Art Clokey, and showcases Gumby, Pokey, Prickle, Goo, the Blockheads and Professor Kapp. The Gumby Movie takes viewers in and out of books, to Toyland, Camelot, outer space and beyond!

items.title: Little Wolf's Book Of Badness
items.description: Little Wolf is sent away by his parents because he has not been behaving badly enough. In hilarious letters home, Little Wolf chronicles his journey to Uncle Bigbad's Cunning College For Brute Beasts and his efforts to learn the Nine Rules of Badness.

items.title: Encounter
items.description: A group of friends uncover an otherworldly object in a rural field, which they soon discover holds greater secrets than they could imagine.

items.title: Transpecos  (ESP)
items.description: Para tres agentes de la Guardia Fronteriza de los EE. UU., el contenido de un auto revela un oscuro secreto en el interior de su unidad que podría costarle toda su vida.

items.title: The War and Peace of Tim O'Brien
items.description: Award-winning author Tim O'Brien is embarking on a new mission – to finish one last book. But his return to writing reawakens past struggles -- PTSD, a volatile father, and the ghosts of combat.

items.title: Elyse
items.description: Memory and hallucination intertwine to expose a history of trauma, revealing Elyse is Catatonic and institutionalized in a State Hospital.

items.title: Chuck Leavell: The Tree Man
items.description: Chuck Leavell is the greatest piano and keyboardist over the last 40 years. Follow him as he divides his talent between music, forests and family.

items.title: Suffer For Good
items.description: 30 years removed from his Olympic dreams, a boxing coach and diplomatic refugee from Ethiopia rediscovers his desire to fight in Los Angeles.

items.title: Sidemen: Long Road to Glory
items.description: Sidemen is an intimate look at the lives and legacies of three legendary Muddy Waters and Howlin' Wolf musicians.

items.title: Dave Not Coming Back
items.description: Two divers break a world record for depth in a 283-meter cave. Before surfacing up, they find a body. They decide to come back and retrieve it.

items.title: The Runaways
items.description: After the death of their father, three runaway children and their two donkeys embark on a journey across the English North York Moors, in a search for their estranged mother. An atmospheric, emotional celebration of childhood and family.

items.title: Assholes: A Theory
items.description: Ever get the impression that assholes are taking over? Assholes: A Theory, a timely new doc from John Walker, investigates the breeding grounds of contemporary asshole culture and searches for signs of civility in a rude-'n-nasty universe.

items.title: Wolfman's Got Nards
items.description: WOLFMAN'S GOT NARDS explores the relationship a dedicated audience has with The Monster Squad. This doc takes an in-depth look at an audience of self-proclaimed misfits who have kept The Monster Squad alive for more than 30 years.

items.title: Pretty Little Stalker
items.description: Self-help writer Lorna (Nicki Whelan) must protect her teenage son (Parker Mack) from a disturbed girl (Ashley Rickards) with whom she shares a horrible past and has become obsessed with destroying everything Lorna loves.

items.title: Tread
items.description: TREAD looks back at the 2004 incident where a Colorado man destroyed a small town with a fortified bulldozer.

items.title: Horn From The Heart: The Paul Butterfield Story
items.description: Paul Butterfield learned the blues from the Chicago masters and is considered to be the greatest blues harmonica player of all time. His interracial blues band, with its rock edge, struck a chord with rock audiences of the 60s and beyond.

items.title: Chop Chop
items.description: An innocent night between a loving young couple takes a strange turn when a psychotic serial killer shows up at their door. The couple's fight for survival ultimately leads them into a night of shocking, bizarre and violent encounters.

items.title: Assimilate
items.description: Best friends Zach (Joel Courtney, THE KISSING BOOTH) and Randy (Calum Worthy) discover that people are being killed and replaced by duplicates. Their only chance to survive is to record the takeover in a desperate attempt to warn the world.

items.title: Changeland
items.description: Directed by and starring Seth Green, the film follows two estranged best friends on a life-changing adventure in Thailand.

items.title: Big Top Evil
items.description: Five disparate youths lost on a road trip to the location of the infamous 'mangrove slasher' end up being pursued by a cadre of cannibal clowns.

items.title: Santa Fake
items.description: Santa Fake is a musical comedy filled with Christmas spirit and holiday hijinks as an orphan gets a job as a shopping mall Santa Claus to hide from a gang of hooligans, only to find out his role as Santa is more than just a disguise.

items.title: Hoops Africa: Ubuntu Matters
items.description: From the first-ever game held in Africa to the streets of Zimbabwe, this film explores the dreams of young players and a nonprofit that uses basketball as a force of good. Witness the power of Ubuntu and how it can change the world.

items.title: Manson
items.description: Featuring the first ever in-depth interview with Linda Kasabian, high end drama and rare archive, Manson chronicles the final days in 1969 leading up to America's notorious Tate/La Bianca murders.

items.title: Manson's Missing Victims
items.description: Featuring interviews with former family members, detectives, and prosecutors, as well as rare archive and forensics, we follow Paul and Buster in their search for hidden graves and buried secrets.

items.title: Perro salvaje
items.description: Una historia desarrollada en Indochina en 1959. Una tierra más allá de las reglas, una época despiadada y el nacimiento de una legenda.

items.title: La piel fría
items.description: Un joven llega a una isla remota para ocupar un puesto de observador meteorológico y luego se encuentra defendiendo la torre de vigilancia, contra las criaturas mortales que viven en la costa de la isla.

items.title: Fuerzas de la naturaleza
items.description: Ben está intentando llegar a Savannah para su boda. Una gaviota vuela hacia el motor de su avión cuando está despegando. Todos los vuelos más tarde se cancelan por un huracán, entonces hace dedo y lo lleva una atractiva mujer llamada Sara.

items.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman
items.description: A mother falls for a younger man while her daughter falls in love for the first time. Mother Nature messes with their fates.

items.title: Beyond The Lights
items.description: The pressures of fame have superstar singer Noni on the edge until she meets Kaz, a young cop who works to help her find the courage to develop her own voice and break free to become the artist she was meant to be.

items.title: Lovesick
items.description: The comic tale of Charlie Darby, who has everything going for him except every time he falls for a girl, he goes clinically insane. When he meets Molly Kingston, he must find a way to overcome his psychosis to claim his chance at true love.

items.title: Hoop Soldiers
items.description: While investigating her brother's death, a lawyer uncovers an illegal basketball league where the games are often fatal.

items.title: American Animals
items.description: The unbelievable but true story of four young men who brazenly attempt to execute one of the most audacious art heists in U.S. history.

items.title: Double Eagle Ranch
items.description: A couple's failing relationship implodes when their mountain cabin accidentally gets double booked.

items.title: Neruda
items.description: At the start of the Cold War, subversive Chilean senator and poet Pablo Neruda is pursued by police prefect Oscar Peluchonneau. Unable to flee the country, Neruda goes into hiding and becomes a symbol of liberty at home and in Europe.

items.title: Christmas Together
items.description: A woman leaves New York for LA after a break-up and falls in love while renting the guest house of a young father.

items.title: A Royal Christmas Engagement
items.description: While disguised as a commoner, a Prince falls in love with an advertising executive during the Christmas season.

items.title: All I Want for Christmas (2013)
items.description: A young woman unexpectedly meets Santa's helper, St. Nick, who grants her an extraordinary Christmas wish.

items.title: A Christmas Wedding Date
items.description: After being fired, Rebecca heads back to her old home town to attend her friends wedding on Christmas Eve and visit her mother. But when she tries to return home, she finds she must relive Christmas Eve over and over until she gets it right.

items.title: Unfinished Plan: The Path of Alain Johannes
items.description: Musician Alain Johannes travels to Chile to take refuge from pain after his partner Natasha dies. Influential rockers tell this story of love and musical inspiration.

items.title: FAT: A Documentary
items.description: Health expert Vinnie Tortorich exposes the history behind myths and lies regarding healthy eating, fat, and weight loss.

items.title: Alien Armageddon
items.description: Hidden from humanity for millennia, an Alien race has been secretly controlling not only mankind's progression but the Earth's as well. Within 200 years, humans will be forced to relocate and live a nightmare of slavery under their rule.

items.title: In Search of Greatness
items.description: Through the eyes of the greatest athletes of all time, IN SEARCH OF GREATNESS is a cinematic journey into the secrets of genius.

items.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
items.description: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

items.title: His Secret Past
items.description: A popular crime novelist begins to suspect that her daughter's new boyfriend has a hidden agenda.

items.title: The Godfather
items.description: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America, along with the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

items.title: The Godfather Part II
items.description: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and New York during the 1910s, then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

items.title: The People I've Slept With
items.description: Angela Yang is a young woman who enjoys sex and has had a number of partners. As mementos, she photographs her lovers and gives each of them a nickname. When she finds out she's pregnant, she decides to keep the baby.

items.title: Obscene Beauty
items.description: Diving into the NYC Neo-Burlesque scene, this documentary explores the culture's sexuality, comedy, and art, and examines how performers use their three minutes on stage as a platform for socio-political commentary.

items.title: Burn the Ships
items.description: Women's pro softball has spent decades fighting for survival. The world's best players must choose between their livelihood and their dreams. Burn the Ships is the story of one woman and her team who refuse to let those dreams slip away.

items.title: Bible Bees
items.description: Follow the adventures of two young bees, Sunny and Petal, as they forage the countryside for pollen, while interacting with various colorful friends, like Grunt the Elk and Carlotta the Cow!

items.title: Death in Small Doses
items.description: When Nancy Lyon unexpectedly dies from arsenic poisoning, her family sets their sights on her husband Richard, who briefly left her last year after she engaged in an affair.

items.title: Getting Gotti
items.description: Diane Giacalone, a new Assistant DA, is determined to prosecute John Gotti, her former childhood neighbor. She fights against uncooperative FBI agents and bureaucrats in her pursuit of justice.

items.title: 2nd Date Sex
items.description: In hopes of a better relationship this time around, Laura and Ryan are trying to navigate their dating lives. How bad can a second date get? Laura and Ryan are about to find out.

items.title: Castle in the Ground
items.description: After the death of his mother (Neve Campbell), Henry (Alex Wolff), a rudderless teenager, befriends his charismatic but troubled next-door neighbor (Imogen Poots), becoming embroiled in a world of opioid addiction and violence.

items.title: Nostradamus: Future Tense
items.description: From the death of Kings to JFK to Hitler and WWII, his predictions cannot be explained with rationality. Nostradamus, the great mystic, seer, and prophet may have also predicted the end of civilization as we know it.

items.title: 1990 Bronx Warriors
items.description: The year was 1990. Milli Vanilli began their unstoppable march up the pop charts and evidently The Bronx was a wasteland overrun by gangs with really lame themes. Join Mike, Kevin, and Bill for the most 90s-est movie since Cool as Ice!

items.title: Attack Of The Supermonsters
items.description: When stop-motion dinosaurs meet anime superheroes, only one thing is certain: things are about to get dumb as hell! Join Mike, Kevin, and Bill for one of the most unique movies we've ever done, Attack of the Super Monsters!

items.title: Feeders
items.description: When a poorly rendered UFO lands on Earth, the aliens immediately seek out our best and brightest. The aliens proceed to feed on them by waggling around in short bursts so as not to reveal the hand of the Polonia brother currently shaking the puppet.

items.title: Giant From The Unknown
items.description: A sleepy mountain town called Pine Ridge has a big problem: someone's been mutilating their cows. Ah, it must be the giant from the title of the movie, you're probably thinking. Spoiler alert: nope! Join Mike, Kevin and Bill to find out!

items.title: Kill Or Be Killed
items.description: Kill or Be Killed is a cornucopia of wonders, specifically South African martial arts wonders. It's got a long-haired karate hero and a whacked-out plot. Join Mike, Kevin & Bill as they riff or be killed!

items.title: Marvin's Room
items.description: With an all-star cast including Leonardo DiCaprio, Meryl Streep, Diane Keaton, and Robert DeNiro, Marvin's Room tells the funny and stirring tale of one family's journey to reconnect.

items.title: Wes Craven Presents: Dracula 2000
items.description: Master of horror Wes Craven presents a sexy, modern-day adaptation of the classic Gothic thriller. After Dracula is awakened from his 100-year slumber, he makes America his first destination, specifically the exotic city of New Orleans.

items.title: Spy Kids
items.description: Super-spies Gregorio (Antonio Banderas) and Ingrid (Carla Gugino) give up their lives of intrigue to raise their children. After a sinister super-villain kidnaps the parents, it's up to the kids to come to the rescue.

items.title: An Unfinished Life
items.description: Einar Gilkyson (Robert Redford) lives on a Wyoming ranch with his only friend, Mitch (Morgan Freeman). Then, suddenly, the woman he blames for his son's death arrives at his door broke, desperate, and with a granddaughter he's never known.

items.title: No Country for Old Men
items.description: Winners of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which the irresistible stolen loot from a crime scene sets off an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.

items.title: Frank Miller's Sin City
items.description: In these intertwined tales, a universe of unlikely and reluctant heroes try to do the right thing in a city that refuses to care.

items.title: Get Over It
items.description: When a popular high school basketball star gets dumped by his girlfriend, he desperately does anything to get her back. With the help of his best friend's sister, he joins the same school musical as his ex... resulting in an inevitable love triangle.

items.title: Chicago
items.description: Winner of 6 Academy Awards, including Best Picture, and based on the hit Broadway musical, Chicago is a dazzling spectacle cheered by audiences and critics alike, where crimes of passion make way for legends to those seeking the spotlight.

items.title: Robo Vampire
items.description: What it lacks in tradition it more than makes up for in utterly incoherent madness. There's not even a Robo Vampire and that's like the thirtieth most crazy thing in the movie Robo Vampire.

items.title: The Last Man On Earth
items.description: Ah, The Last Man on Earth. Of all the adaptations of Richard Matheson's novel, I Am Legend, there's no denying that this was the earliest. And the Vincent Price-iest!

items.title: Yor, Hunter From The Future
items.description: With an over-the-top theme song, cheesy creature effects, and a ridiculous final act that will truly surprise anybody who didn't finish reading the title, this flick is truly an 80s cheese connoisseur's delight.

items.title: Terror al anochecer
items.description: En 1946, el pueblo de Texarkana sufrió una serie de experiencias traumáticas que todavía recuerda hoy, treinta años más tarde, entre marzo y mayo, cinco personas fueron asesinadas a manos de un loco enmascarado.

items.title: El bosque maldito
items.description: En una noche, el hijo de Sarah desaparece dentro del bosque detrás de su casa de campo. Cuando regresa, se ve igual, pero su comportamiento se convierte cada vez más inquietante.

items.title: Los telelocos
items.description: Después de perder otro trabajo, George (Weird Al Yankovic) se pregunta si hay alguna carrera que pueda manejar su escandalosa personalidad.

items.title: Perturbados
items.description: Gavin Strick (Nick Stahl) le advierte al recién llegado Steve (James Marsden) sobre el Blue Ribbons, un club de estudiantes robóticos y perfectos que dominan la escuela. Cuando Gavin se vuelve perfecto, Steve y Rachel Wagner (Katie Holmes) investigan.

items.title: Cazador de cocodrilos
items.description: Para salvar a un cocodrilo de un ranchero cuyo ganado estaba siendo depredado, Steve Irwin y su esposa Terri se dispusieron a atraparlo y reubicarlo. ¡Pero el cocodrilo se tragó un faro satelital y los transformó en objetivos de la CIA! ¡Cielos!

items.title: Un perro de otro mundo
items.description: Owen, de 12 años, tiene un nuevo perro, Hubble, que además de sentarse y quedarse quieto, habla, ¡literalmente! Resulta que Hubble es un agente interplanetario, ¡y Owen descubre que Hubble y todos sus amigos caninos tienen la misión de dominar el mundo!

items.title: Leviatán, terror en la profundidad
items.description: En esta película de ciencia ficción, un equipo de exploración de aguas profundas descubre un barco de carga con un secreto mortal.

items.title: Fair Game
items.description: A riveting thriller inspired by the experiences of real-life CIA officer Valerie Plame, whose identity was revealed after her husband questioned the U.S. involvement in Iraq.

items.title: Gimme Shelter
items.description: A pregnant, homeless teen flees her abusive mother and seeks out her estranged biological father.

items.title: The Ex
items.description: After getting fired, a man winds up working for his wife's father while she takes care of the baby.

items.title: Horns
items.description: A man wakes up after the death of his girlfriend to find he has grown horns.

items.title: Piranha 3DD
items.description: After their spring break extravaganza at Lake Victoria, the swarm heads upstream where they look to make a meal out of patrons at a local water park.

items.title: The Pretender
items.description: A man obsessed with \\"Rocky\\" begins to question where the film ends and real life begins.

items.title: Caught Up
items.description: After being released from prison a man finds himself caught up in a love triangle.

items.title: 3rd Reich Hitler's UFOs
items.description: Hitler's UFOs are the story of the Nazis and the Aliens from outer space.

items.title: BBC Television Shakespeare: Hamlet Prince Of Denmark
items.description: Derek Jacobi stars as the most complex of all Shakespeare's characters in Rodney Bennett's adaptation of Hamlet.

items.title: Ping Pong Summer
items.description: In the summer of 1985, an awkward 13-year-old white kid obsessed with hip hop and ping pong takes a family vacation that will show the entire boardwalk of Ocean City, Maryland that he's as funky fresh as it gets.

items.title: Queens & Cowboys
items.description: Chronicles a complete season of the International Gay Rodeo Association (IGRA). Roping and riding across North America, the IGRA's courageous cowboys and cowgirls brave challenges in and out of the arena on their quest to the World Finals.

items.title: The Last Days of Patton
items.description: This film depicts the aging General's autumn years as a controversial ex-Nazi defender and desk-bound World War II historian. Following the close of World War II, General George S. Patton is seriously injured in a car accident and not expected to survive.

items.title: Dying of the Light
items.description: Nicolas Cage ignites a powder keg of action as a veteran CIA agent who goes rogue to hunt down his nemesis, a deadly terrorist.

items.title: Killshot
items.description: An experienced hitman and his unhinged young partner target a blue-collar couple who have entered Witness Protection after witnessing an extortion scam gone wrong. Based on the novel by Elmore Leonard.

items.title: Secrets of the Mona Lisa
items.description: The Mona Lisa is the world's most famous painting. But what secrets lie underneath the canvas? This extraordinary film unveils a mystery and astonishing revelations.

items.title: Things To Do In Denver When You're Dead
items.description: An ex-gangster (Andy Garcia) reassembles his old gang for one last job. When things go awry and someone gets killed, Jimmy and his partners are marked for death, leaving Jimmy 48 hours to make things right for his buddies and the woman of his dreams.

items.title: A Month By The Lake
items.description: An attractive older guest at the Lake Como Resort has her eye on a handsome, well-to-do bachelor, and will go to outrageous lengths to reel in her wealthy catch.

items.title: Justin Bieber: Rise of a Superstar
items.description: Justin Bieber- a young musician with the world at his feet. Incredibly he is one of the biggest hitters in social networking. This exclusive documentary explores Justin Bieber's meteoric rise to being the iconic pop star he is today.

items.title: Love Kills: The Story of Sid and The Pistols
items.description: The Sex Pistols, bringing the revolution of punk music to Britain. One of the most influential bands of the era. We hear from members of the band about their unique story and get to know of the key pioneers of UK punk; Sid Vicious. Described as an arch...

items.title: The Flock
items.description: A hyper-vigilant employee of the department of public safety tracks down a missing girl who he is convinced is connected to a paroled sex offender.

items.title: The Groomsmen
items.description: A groom and his four attendants wrestle with issues related to friendship and maturity a week before the big day.

items.title: Horsehead
items.description: A shocking horror fantasy about a young woman haunted by fevered nightmares involving a horse-man.

items.title: Give Me Shelter
items.description: A documentary uncovering the most prevalent issues in the animal world through the eyes of individuals dedicating their lives to them daily.

items.title: The Coolest Guy Movie Ever
items.description: THE COOLEST GUY MOVIE EVER is the definitive look at the making of the 1963 classic, "The Great Escape."

items.title: The Girls in The Band
items.description: THE GIRLS IN THE BAND tells the poignant, untold stories of female jazz and big band instrumentalists and their fascinating, groundbreaking journeys from the late '30s to the present day.

items.title: Don't Think I've Forgotten: Cambodia's Lost Rock and Roll
items.description: Track the twists and turns of Cambodian music as it morphs into rock and roll, blossoms, and is nearly destroyed along with the rest of the country. This documentary provides a new perspective on a country usually associated with only war and genocide.

items.title: Irish Jam
items.description: Upon discovering that their town is up for sale, crafty Irish villagers scheme to raise the money to prevent the buy-out.

items.title: The Oyster Farmers
items.description: Oysters were once a staple for people in the northeast USA, until over-harvesting and disease decimated the oysters. Today, a new hope arises in the Barnegat Bay through the work of a solitary few: The Oyster Farmers.

items.title: The Uncondemned
items.description: THE UNCONDEMNED tells the riveting story of an underdog group of young lawyers and activists who defied the odds to do what had never been done: prosecute rape as an international war crime. The case changed the course of international judicial history.

items.title: One Nation Under God
items.description: Four college students journey around the United States to ask people about their personal spiritual beliefs.

items.title: Fist of the Red Dragon
items.description: Young Beggar Su is addicted to opium and manipulated by a scheming imperial prince to fight against WFH and assassinate a righteous general.

items.title: The Defender
items.description: Lance and his team are bodyguards for NSA's head sent by the president to a secret meeting outside Bucharest which is attacked. But Why?

items.title: Highland Park
items.description: When the teachers and faculty of a public school in a Detroit suburb think they've won the lottery, their lives and the town are changed forever. Starring Billy Burke (Twilight), Parker Posey, Danny Glover.

items.title: The True Don Quixote
items.description: Tim Blake Nelson is a man who's safe and comfortable and bored to death with his life. In his state of despair, he looks to classic stories for inspiration. Awakened by the tales of yore, he anoints himself as Don Quixote to find adventure and glory.

items.title: Born to Raise Hell
items.description: A US drug cop in Bucharest is up against a Russian gun and drug trafficker employing and Gypsy gang leader who attacks the young and rich.

items.title: Sin lugar para los débiles
items.description: Los cineastas Joel y Ethan Coen (FARGO), ganadores de cuatro premios de la Academia, incluyendo mejor película, regresan con un éxito apasionante en el que el irresistible botín robado de la escena del crimen desata una violencia imparable.

items.title: Buffalo Boys
items.description: Two brothers named Jamar and Suwo came back to the land of Java to avenge their father, who was a Sultan, after years of exile in America.

items.title: Lone Wolf
items.description: Students use a computer to track the werewolf preying on their high school.

items.title: Molly
items.description: A girl living alone in a post-apocalyptic wasteland finds herself hunted down by marauders who want her to fight in their fighting pit for their entertainment.

items.title: Making Mr. Right
items.description: A public relations woman (Ann Magnuson) is hired by a high-tech conglomerate to humanize an android (John Malkovich) designed for deep space travel and to make him accessible to the public… leading to love of a rather non-binary type.

items.title: Invitation to a Gunfighter
items.description: Screen legend Yul Brynner turns in a magnificent performance as a gunfighter who must do battle with his most formidable adversary - his own conscience - in this gripping, double-barreled western full of surprise twists and colorful villainy.

items.title: In the Time of the Butterflies
items.description: Salma Hayek gives a powerful, passionate performance as an idealistic young woman who wages a daring struggle for freedom against a murderous dictator (Edward James Olmos) in this moving thriller that tells of the personal toll of political tyranny.

items.title: Holiday Heart
items.description: Holiday, a female impersonator, bonds with a child and her drug-addicted mother and helps them off the street. But when the mom hooks up with a drug dealer, it forces Holiday to confront his own prejudices if it means saving the two people he loves.

items.title: Punk: Loud and Live in London
items.description: Punk: Loud and Live in London brings the opposition of contemporary and commercial music to light. Showcasing an era of Music which shook the world, with it’s raw sound rooted in politics and musical revolution. With live London performances from Punk ...

items.title: Hendrix (2000)
items.description: On stage, Jimi Hendrix (Wood Harris) electrified audiences with his powerful guitar playing and mesmerizing performances. But behind the scenes -- fueled by a dark haze of drugs and alcohol -- this rising star was on a crash course with destiny.

items.title: The Double O' Kid
items.description: Lance, a teenager, dreams of being a Secret Agent, when he is suddenly in the middle of a hacker’s plot. Lance gets in possession of a computer access card, one of which the hackers are in urgent need for their operation.

items.title: Chiller
items.description: Technical difficulty brings a man (Michael Beck) back to life and the family business after 10 years in a frozen state.

items.title: A Million to Juan
items.description: A romantic comedy about an honest Mexican immigrant struggling without a green card by selling oranges on a street corner. One day a limousine pulls up and he is handed a check for $1,000,000.

items.title: Shock
items.description: A woman (Daria Nicolodi) returns to her former home with a new spouse (John Steiner) and a son (David Colin Jr.) possessed by the ghost of his father.

items.title: Punk: Rocking Live in London
items.description: Rocking Live in London brings you a diverse selection of live punk performances from home grown punk bands of the era. Showcasing some of the pioneers of what was a brand new musical age. With performances from Bad Manners, Ken Dodd’s Dad's Dog’s Dead...

items.title: All-American Murder
items.description: An antisocial college student gets transferred to a new college, where he meets the popular girl in school. When she's suddenly killed, he becomes the prime suspect. While he tries to clear his name, more victims fall to the brutal killer.

items.title: Bible Quiz
items.description: Bible Quiz follows seventeen-year-old Mikayla Irle as she memorizes thousands of Bible verses in her quest to win the National Bible Quiz Championship and the heart of JP, her quiz team captain.

items.title: Blood on the Mountain
items.description: Blood on the Mountain is a searing investigation into the economic and environmental injustices that have resulted from coal company control in West Virginia.

items.title: Clarence Clemons: Who Do I Think I Am?
items.description: This film highlights Clarence Clemon's life as a musician and member of the E Street band while also presenting another side of him; it's an intimate portrait of a man who searched for enlightenment and meaning at the unknowingly final years of his life.

items.title: Matt Shepard Is A Friend of Mine
items.description: Matt Shepard is a Friend of Mine is a powerful feature documentary about Matthew Shepard, the gay young man who was tortured and murdered in one of the most notorious hate crimes in U.S. history.

items.title: Meet the Hitlers
items.description: Meet the Hitlers' is a feature documentary that examines the relationship between names and identity, by exploring the lives of people who are linked by the name "Hitler."

items.title: Misdirection: The Real Magic
items.description: Misdirection follows two inner-city kids from Queens, New York who struggle to get off the streets and onto the stage by becoming famous magicians.

items.title: We Are Columbine
items.description: On April 20, 1999, Columbine High School in Littleton, Colorado experienced one of the most deadly school shootings in United States history. The incident shocked a country that could scarcely imagine the epidemic of teen violence it foreshadowed.

items.title: A Classy Broad: Marcia's Adventures in Hollywood
items.description: \"I didn't need to watch Mad Men - I lived it.\" Legendary studio executive and producer Marcia Nasatir shattered Hollywood's glass ceiling in 1974 when she became the first female vice-president at a major film studio, United Artists.

items.title: Thank You, Friends: Big Star's Third Live... and More
items.description: A celebration of the musical legacy of Memphis' best-known secret - Big Star - performed by a collective featuring members of Big Star, the dB's, Let's Active, the Posies, R.E.M., Semisonic, Wilco and Yo La Tengo with Kronos Quartet and more.

items.title: Two Trains Runnin'
items.description: Two Trains Runnin' is about the search for two forgotten blues singers, set in Mississippi during the height of the civil rights movement. Directed by Sam Pollard, narrated by Common, and featuring the music of Gary Clark Jr.

items.title: Unforgotten: A Hero's Story of War
items.description: Filmmaker Darrin Dick goes on a discovery to uncover the story of his Korean War veteran grandfather, Harold Bauer. A story of bravery, loss, and faith amidst the extremities of war.

items.title: Anchors Up
items.description: After receiving an emergency call from Big Harbor during a fierce storm, a young rescue boat named Elias pulls off a daring rescue mission and is hailed a hero. He is thrilled when the harbor recruits him as its new lead rescue boat and sets out to st...

items.title: Faith. Hope. Love.
items.description: A request from an Oscar-winning author brings six strangers together for an unexpected weekend of personal revelations about friendship, faith, and love.

items.title: Groove Squad
items.description: Three hip cheerleaders and the team mascot are accidentally turned into superheroes by a deranged genius. They must defeat the power-hungry mad scientist and his evil cheerleader daughter while struggling to win the annual cheerleading competition.

items.title: The Archies in JugMan
items.description: When a new geothermal heating system is installed under Riverdale High, Jughead's hairy Neanderthal ancestor thaws out instantly out-Jugheading Jughead, becoming the toast of Riverdale.

items.title: Femme
items.description: A celebration of women around the world actively transforming and healing our global society. Sharon Stone and leading experts in religion, science, history, politics and entertainment, discuss solutions to inspire new hope for the future.

items.title: 90 Feet From Home
items.description: A former, troubled major league baseball player comes home to rural Texas to confront his abusive step-father.

items.title: Storm Riders
items.description: A young woman and her 5-year-old brother find themselves on their way to the virgin goldfields with their father to start a new life.

items.title: Baristas
items.description: What does it take to make the perfect cup of coffee? Four passionate National Barista Champions from the United States (Kyle Ramage), Ireland (Niall Wynn), Germany (Chloe J. Nattrass) and Japan (Miki Suzuki) represent their countries and their craft in...

items.title: Captain Morten and the Spider Queen
items.description: Ten-year-old Morten spends his days building a toy ship and trying to avoid the ire of his reluctant guardian – a mean ex-ballerina named Anna – while his father is at sea. Morten hopes to one day be a Captain just like him. After a chance meeting wi...

items.title: The Station Agent
items.description: A loner with a passion for trains inherits an empty train station in the middle of nowhere. He encounters unexpected neighbors and with absolutely nothing in common, they form a friendship none of them could foresee.

items.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
items.description: Single girl Bridget Jones decides to turn over a new page in her life, channeling her thoughts, opinions, and insecurities into a diary. It's instead a hilarious chronicle of her adventures in this modern-romance classic based on the bestseller.

items.title: Next Stop Wonderland
items.description: A young nurse is forced back into the dating scene by her mother after a bad break up.

items.title: Happy, Texas
items.description: Two escaped convicts are mistaken as consultants to a local beauty pageant in the town of Happy, Texas, and masquerade as the couple orchestrating the pageant. The two quickly meet with outrageously unpredictable consequences!

items.title: Cinema Paradiso
items.description: In this celebrated Oscar winner for Best Foreign Language Film, a famous Italian filmmaker, haunted by the memories of his first love, returns to his hometown after an absence of 30 years.

items.title: My Left Foot
items.description: Winner of two Academy Awards, including Best Actor Daniel Day-Lewis and Best Actress Brenda Fricker, this is the inspiring true story of a man who defied the odds to become a well-known author, artist, and activist.

items.title: Clerks
items.description: The legendary indie film that launched the career of Kevin Smith and won over audiences with its raw energy, outrageous comedy, and a hip soundtrack. CLERKS features razor-sharp wit and the debut of pop-culture icons Jay and Silent Bob.

items.title: Up and Away
items.description: Hodja lives in a small desert village with his parents and faithful goat Raya but spends his days dreaming about the big, adventurous world beyond the mountains on the horizon. Hodja´s father is not supportive of his son’s dreams and insists he stay pu...

items.title: Z For Zachariah
items.description: Chris Pine, Margot Robbie and Chiwetel Ejiofor are the last three people on earth, struggling to survive, secrets, suspicions and threats in this intense thriller based on the award winning book.

items.title: Grandma's House
items.description: A teenager and her step-brothers are forced to move in with Grandma. They learn the true meaning of love, faith, and family through the strict rules she imposes and devotion she displays as the extended family has its ups and downs.

items.title: Out of the Darkness
items.description: After returning from war, a young man finds himself alienated from his family and disconnected from the faith he once knew. He must decide between following his destiny to be a leader of men, or turn his back on his faith forever.

items.title: The True Adventures of Wolfboy
items.description: A coming of age journey about a boy with an illness that causes hair growth over the entirety of his face and body. After a disastrous carnival experience, he goes in search of his mother who abandoned him at birth.

items.title: Jellyfish
items.description: A young carer discovers an unlikely talent for stand-up comedy.

items.title: The Last Whistle
items.description: When the all-star player of the local high school football team collapses during practice, all eyes turn to the storied head coach. Instead of mollifying the situation, the coach tries to maintain the team's winning streak.

items.title: Deep Murder
items.description: This raunchy horror comedy delves deep into the story of a deranged killer as he slashes his way across a soft core porno. Who will last the longest as the stiffs pile up and the killer plows through his victims?

items.title: Southern Comfort
items.description: A washed-up actor, determined to get back into the show business ventures to charming Franklin, South Carolina for a new role and finds Summer love.

items.title: The Mighty Macs
items.description: In the 1970s, Cathy Rush becomes the head basketball coach at a tiny, all-girls Catholic college. Her team has no gym and no uniforms, steers her girls to their first national championship.

items.title: Love Again
items.description: A distant father (Kevin Sorbo) and losing his girlfriend to his best friend (Ben Davies) leads Nathan (Jason Burkey) on a journey of rediscovery.

items.title: The Devil Inside
items.description: In 1989 Maria Rossi was diagnosed insane after brutally murdering three people. Twenty years later, her daughter Isabella searches for answers that lead to an exorcism of her mother.

items.title: Armstrong
items.description: Dramatic, moving and insightful, ARMSTRONG tells the definitive life story of Neil Armstrong: From his childhood in rural Ohio, through aerial combat in Korea, to his first steps on the Moon, and unwanted celebrity status that ensued.

items.title: Rescuing Rex
items.description: Rescuing Rex follows the remarkable journey of the world's stray dogs and the animal lovers coming to their rescue.

items.title: Kings of Beer
items.description: Kings of Beer is a documentary about a diverse group of elite Brewmasters from around the globe who compete in the world's most intense brewing competition.

items.title: UFO Chronicles: The Smoking Gun
items.description: UFO investigators reveal new evidence of the Alien crash at Roswell. From reconstructing the memo held by General Ramey to the actual sequence of events, hear shocking new insights into the greatest cover-up of all time.

items.title: UFO Chronicles: The Lost Knowledge
items.description: The Ancient Alien theory expanded as Dolores Cannon explains the Alien creator's intention when creating the Earth and the first humans. The man who discovered the first UFO crash in 1947 is remembered by his son, Jesse Marcel Jr.

items.title: The Four Feathers (1978)
items.description: The Four Feathers

items.title: 1,000 Times Goodnight
items.description: On assignment, while photographing a suicide bomber in Kabul, Rebecca (Juliet Binoche), a top war photojournalist gets badly hurt. Back home, another bomb drops as her husband and daughters give her an ultimatum: her work or her family.

items.title: Cassandro, the Exotico!
items.description: After 26 years of spinning dives and flying uppercuts in the ring, Cassandro, the star of the gender-bending cross-dressing Mexican wrestlers known as the Exoticos, is far from retiring.

items.title: I Am Not A Witch
items.description: When 9-year old orphan Shula is accused of witchcraft, she is exiled to a witch camp.

items.title: Never Ever
items.description: Benoît Jacquot's adaptation of Don DeLillo’s “The Body Artist” is a dreamlike romance with supernatural overtone, starring Palme d'Or nominee Mathieu Amalric as a famed director who falls prey to the allure of the beautiful performance artist, Laura.

items.title: El mundo según Wayne
items.description: Cuando un importante ejecutivo de televisión les ofrece a los locos y poco convencionales Wayne y Garth un jugoso contrato para que en su estación realicen su peculiar programa nocturno, ambos no pueden creer la suerte que tuvieron.

items.title: The Terror Within
items.description: When a chemical warfare leaves the world barren and filled with mutated monsters, a band of survivors in a underground complex battles one of the creatures who was able to break in.

items.title: Control
items.description: P. Raheem. Bishop. Steel. Son cuatro amigos de Harlem que pasan sus días pasando el rato y buscando una forma de obtener el poder y el respeto que llaman Juice. Q espera ser respetado al convertirse en un DJ scratch ‘n’ mix.

items.title: Mugshots: Robert Durst - Mogul in Murder Mystery
items.description: Robert Durst was the scion of a multi-millionaire real estate family, but was always a bit of an eccentric. He is suspected of killing three people.

items.title: Five Last Days
items.description: After being arrested for possession of anti-Nazi propaganda, young Sophie Scholl is thrown in jail. Her cellmate, Else Gebel, is incarcerated on similar charges. Else is quite a bit older than Sophie, but they grow close in the five days they are together

items.title: Truth is the Only Client: The Official Investigation of the Murder of John F. Kennedy
items.description: Interviews with Warren Commission staff and people personally involved tell the story of the investigation into JFK's murder. Conspiracy theories are debunked. Oswald's actions, Jack Ruby's role, and revelations since the 70s are explored.

items.title: The Last Man On Earth
items.description: The survivor (Vincent Price) of a global epidemic battles a race of zombie vampires in an adaptation of Richard Matheson's \\"I Am Legend.\\"

items.title: Mr. Jealousy
items.description: After his first date at age 15 ended with the girl making out with another man at a party, aspiring writer Lester Grimm has treated all his girlfriends with jealousy and suspicion. While dating Ramona Ray, paranoia gets the best of him.

items.title: Mansfield Park

items.description: This film is about the agonizing spiritual crisis of C. S. Lewis when his wife died from cancer.

items.title: The Diary Of Jack The Ripper
items.description: Step by painstaking step, the diary is analyzed, verified, and questioned; experts pit their knowledge against the information in the diary.

items.title: Elvis Presley: From The Beginning To The End
items.description: A warm, moving and sensitive tribute and a comprehensive and detailed biography of Elvis' life.

items.title: Calm Before
items.description: A Husband and Wife on the brink of divorce are trapped at a Lake House on their anniversary and are forced to confront their demons, both real and imaginary.

items.title: Christmas Cupid's Arrow
items.description: Holly, a single college professor, signs up for an online dating service, but begins to grow suspicious when the guy's beautifully-written texts don't match his actions.

items.title: Un regalo inesperado
items.description: Una comedia de Navidad sobre una joven novelista que se convirtió en ama de casa. Cuando su imprudente cuñada se muda con ella, las dos mujeres liman sus asperezas escribiendo juntas una novela erótica.

items.title: Best of the Big Easy
items.description: Get to know New Orleans the way the locals know it. Feel the rhythms of the street and experience the city's contagious culture and energy.

items.title: Wonders of Americas National Parks
items.description: Travel to lands where monumental forces prevail. Where panoramas of the greatest natural wonders on the planet exist. Products of fire and ice, wind, water, and time, together we will explore the extraordinary wonders of America's National Parks.

items.title: Sólo un sueño
items.description: Esta historia fascinante y conmovedora muestra la vida de una pareja joven que vive en las afueras de Connecticut y que decide arriesgarlo todo para seguir sus sueños.

items.title: Sahara
items.description: Dos aventureros ávidos de emociones se cruzan con una hermosa doctora y van en busca del mayor tesoro, que se cobra las vidas de todos los que lo buscan.

items.title: Un pueblo navideño
items.description: Para salvar su reputación, Piper Jensen, un genio de las relaciones públicas y dueña de su propia agencia, acepta trabajar para el dueño de un pueblo de Santa en dificultades; ahí descubrirá el amor y lo mágica que es la Navidad.

items.title: Dos bodas en Navidad
items.description: Una novia fugitiva hace una búsqueda espiritual cuando es atrapada por la nieve dentro de una cabaña con su abuela y un viejo romance en Navidad.

items.title: My Baby Is Missing
items.description: When career-driven Jenna delivers a stillborn baby girl, the police suspect foul play. With the help of the baby's estranged father, Jenna sets out to uncover what really happened to her baby.

items.title: House Under Siege
items.description: When one of three thieves is hurt during a jewelry heist, the trio seeks the help of a local doctor. But when the diamonds go missing, the thieves take the doctor and his family hostage.

items.title: Love Thy Neighbor
items.description: Plagued by flashbacks of a home invasion and looking for a fresh start, Laura and her husband relocate. Their new community seems idyllic, until a series of strange and terrifying events unfold.

items.title: Sins Of The Preacher
items.description: Inspired by true events, this story follows a mother's quest for justice when she realizes her daughter's \\"suicide\\" may have actually been murder at the hands of her minister husband.

items.title: Un novio para Navidad
items.description: Cuando el plan de Ashley de reconectar con un exnovio en Navidad fracasa, ella y su mejor amigo Liam deciden fingir un romance. Mientras sus sentimientos comienzan a hacerse realidad, Ashley tendrá que decidir qué quiere en verdad su corazón.

items.title: Una boda complicada
items.description: Meg y Tyler nunca se llevaron bien entre sí, pero pronto tendrán que trabajar juntos para salvar el casamiento de sus mejores amigos. Ellos se darán cuenta de que hacen un buen equipo y que quizá hay lugar en este casamiento para un poco de romance.

items.title: Mind Killer
items.description: A lonely library clerk stumbles across a manuscript that he uses to develop psychic powers, which make him irresistible to women. Soon, his powers get out of control, just as they start showing up in his friends.

items.title: De chef a princesa en Navidad
items.description: Un príncipe de Europa llega a Nueva York y se enamora del chef que está planeando su evento anual de Navidad.

items.title: Una Navidad real
items.description: Un ejecutivo de publicidad trabajador se enamora de un consultor que es un príncipe disfrazado.

items.title: Cupido navideño
items.description: Dos asistentes ejecutivos que trabajan duro hacen arreglos para que sus jefes se enamoren durante las vacaciones.

items.title: Juntos en Navidad
items.description: Una mujer se enamora mientras alquila la casa de huéspedes de un joven padre en Navidad.

items.title: Made In China
items.description: While working for a shady real-estate company in Shanghai, Bryan Zellerman is framed by his corrupt employers. Faced with a choice between escape or finding out the truth behind his betrayal, his path veers terribly out of control.

items.title: Goodbye Honey
items.description: In an isolated rest stop, an exhausted truck driver hides a young woman who allegedly escaped from the trunk of a manís car.

items.title: Served Like A Girl
items.description: Director Lysa Heslov's documentary, "Served Like a Girl, provides a candid look at several American women as they transition from active duty to civilian life after serving tours of duty in Iraq and Afghanistan.

items.title: Porndemic
items.description: 'Porndemic' takes us behind the scenes of the 1998 HIV outbreak that tore through the Hollywood adult film industry, threatening its very existence, and told by the people who experienced it.

items.title: Age of Summer
items.description: A determined teenage boy struggles to find acceptance within the Jr. Lifeguards while juggling relationships and challenges in the summer of 1983.

items.title: The Life, Blood and Rhythm of Randy
items.description: From Mariachi to Ozzy, from Native roots to Mötley Crüe, Randy Castillo became the greatest drummer in rock. His personal story was even more magical. Home videos trace his musical evolution, from childhood to surreal stagecraft.

items.title: County Fair, Texas
items.description: County Fair, Texas is a portrait of a year in the lives of four, small-town kids as they raise and care for farm animals to show in competition at a local county fair. Presented from the perspective of the kids themselves.

items.title: 100 Blocks
items.description: In a city where dreams become nightmares, Jaleel finally has enough cash saved up to leave Oakland, California and avoid the violent fate of his father, along with so many of his peers.

items.title: American Jedi
items.description: AMERICAN JEDI is a documentary film about three Star Wars fans who become candidates for knighthood and must confront the darkest issues from their past in order to be accepted into a real-life Jedi community.

items.title: Faith Filled Christmas
items.description: Three generations of the Fairway family ensure the Christmas season has the opportunity to be about Christ through their involvement in foster care, adoption, retirement community, and homeless ministry.

items.title: Human Affairs
items.description: A compassionate drama about a young, successful theatre couple in New York City who meet their surrogate mother for the first time and embark on a startling and intimate weekend of surprises and emotional revelations.

items.title: Old Man Football
items.description: Old Man Football is a feature documentary presenting multiple stories of personal redemption for a group of grown men and women who return to Corpus Christi (Texas) Carroll High School.

items.title: American Futbol
items.description: En route to the World Cup in Brazil, 4 filmmakers search for the soul of fútbol in Latin America, as they travel over 7,000 miles across 8 countries.

items.title: Dawn Rider
items.description: After his father is killed, John Mason is willing to turn the world inside out to find the man responsible. What he doesn't know is the killer might be in his own house.

items.title: A Very Corgi Christmas
items.description: Laura, a single mom meets a fellow single dad Ben, who enlists her help in taking care of a cute corgi puppy he plans to give to his daughter at Christmas. Through all the chaos, Lauren gets the chance to finally experience the holiday spirit.

items.title: Shoelaces For Christmas
items.description: When Jennifer’s father forces her to volunteer at the shelter to teach her compassion and responsibility, she creates an unlikely bond with the staff and a special young guest which makes her realize the true meaning of Christmas.

items.title: Christmas Wedding Runaway
items.description: A runaway bride does some soul-searching when she’s trapped in a snowed-in cabin with her grandmother and an old flame at Christmas.

items.title: A Christmas Village
items.description: To save her reputation, Piper Jensen, a public relations genius and owner of her own PR company, agrees to work for the owner of a failing Santa’s Village and discovers love and how magical Christmas is after all.

items.title: My Best Friend's Christmas
items.description: When Ashley’s plans to reconnect with her high school sweetheart over Christmas fails, she and her best friend Liam decide to fake their own romance. But as her feelings start to turn real, Ashley will have to decide what her heart really wants.

items.title: Save The Wedding
items.description: Meg and Tyler have never gotten along with each other but when they work together to save the best friends' wedding, they discover they actually make a good team and begin a little romance of their own.

items.title: New Year's Kiss
items.description: After suffering a devastating break-up the same night as Kelly Hartwick, a rock-star creative director receives an advertising award. She swears off dating in order to focus on a major Christmas ad campaign.

items.title: Christmas Crash
