items.description: A couple on the brink of divorce crash their private plane into the woods and are presumed dead. With the help of their children they are rescued and discover that the crash was not an accident.

items.title: Wild National Parks
items.description: From grizzly bears of Katmai National Park in Alaska to rattlesnakes of Montezuma's Castle in Arizona, answer the call of America's wildest national parks.

items.title: Yellowstone Americas First National Park
items.description: Vast, beautiful and untamed, Yellowstone's rugged wilderness ignites the imagination like no other national park. Llama trekking, wolf-watching, and geyser gazing are just a few of the out-of-the-ordinary activities that await you.

items.title: Yosemite: America's Treasure
items.description: Experience Yosemite's incredible wonders with breathtaking cinematography, including such icons as the granite monoliths El Capitan and Half Dome, and the spectacular Bridal Veil and Yosemite Falls.

items.title: Heathers
items.description: Winona Ryder, Christian Slater, and Shannen Doherty star in this cruelly hilarious dark comedy, which became one of the biggest cult classics of the `80s.

items.title: Defending Santa
items.description: A small-town sheriff finds a man asleep in the woods who claims to be Santa Claus.

items.title: His Deadly Affair
items.description: Violinist Danielle's dream boyfriend, James the Conductor of the Orchestra, has a dangerous and obsessive wife, who is waiting to extract her vengeance on Danielle.

items.title: Deadly Honeymoon
items.description: Lindsey and Trevor are expecting a fairytale honeymoon cruise, but when Trevor goes missing and Lindsay loses her memory, a vacationing FBI agent must launch an investigation.

items.title: Cries in the Dark
items.description: Detective Carrie Macklin's sister is missing after a run-in with a sex offender, days before she is due to give birth. When her body is found - without the baby - Carrie races to find the baby alive!

items.title: A Mother's Revenge
items.description: After accidentally taking a madman's suitcase at baggage claim, Jennifer must go through a series of elaborate checkpoints to rescue her kidnapped daughter from him.

items.title: Running Away
items.description: Sisters Maggie and Lizzie move in with mom Peg's new husband. Secrets and lies start immediately. Maggie cannot handle what follows and recruits a friend to help her plan to get out of town with her stepfather's secrets.

items.title: Double Tap
items.description: A mysterious killer named Cypher has evaded capture for years. When an FBI agent seeks him out, their shared skill as professional killers draws them together as they evade a ruthless Mafia hitman.

items.title: Stolen Daughter
items.description: A female police detective returns to work after suffering PTSD from a previous case, only to have her teenage daughter kidnapped by an emotionally disturbed parolee.

items.title: In The Electric Mist
items.description: While on an investigation into a series of grisly murders, veteran detective Dave Robicheaux navigates his way through the Louisiana bayou and the dark, sultry world of New Orleans mobster.

items.title: Coffee Shop
items.description: Donovan Turner is a smart, independent woman in her late twenties operating a hip café in a small town. She’s also looking for Mr. Right. However, when her café faces foreclosure, Donavan’s business and love life are turned upside down.

items.title: The Christmas Wife
items.description: Jason Robards portrays John Tanner, a recent widower who doesn't know what to do with the changes imposed upon his life.

items.title: The Hippopotamus
items.description: Based on the Best-Selling Comedy Novel by Stephen Fry.

items.title: The Pass
items.description: Jason and Ade are nineteen. They’ve been in the academy of a famous London soccer club since they were eight, and now it’s the night before their first-ever game as professionals. They should be sleeping, but they’re over-excited.

items.title: Phoenix
items.description: Inspired by Michelangelo Antonioni's 1961 classic L'Avventura, Michael Akers' "PHOENIX" is infused with symbolism and a sexy spark.

items.title: Voices of the Battle of Britain
items.description: As Winston Churchill said, 'Never was so much owed by so many to so few.' The RAF Veterans of the Battle of Britain tell their harrowing and incredible stories as they fought for the very existence of England

items.title: The Real Joan of Arc
items.description: The myth of Joan of Arc has fascinated people the world over. In the collective memory, she is the young shepherd girl who died at the stake having saved France.

items.title: The Bouquet
items.description: Two estranged sisters torn apart by their differences suddenly find themselves working together towards a common goal in this heartwarming drama.

items.title: A Student's Obsession
items.description: Stephanie's family is distant and her high school students are disengaged, leading her to lower her guard and allowing a new, charismatic student kiss her. Explaining it was a mistake, her student disagrees and develops a deadly obsession.

items.title: The Suspect
items.description: Beth is wrongly accused of murdering her husband. With the help of an insurance investigator and her stepdaughter together they find the real killer.

items.title: The Virginian
items.description: A gritty and riveting re-imagining of the classic Western saga. Raised by powerful cattle baron Judge Henry (Perlman), South, aka “The Virginian” (Adkins), lives his life as a ranch enforcer with bravery and steely determination.

items.title: CC & Company
items.description: Motorcycle mechanic C.C. Ryder joins "The Heads," an outlaw biker gang. Fellow gang members menace fashion journalist Ann when her limo breaks down in the desert, but C.C. comes to her rescue. He then must race to free her after she's kidnaped.

items.title: Black Brigade
items.description: During WWII, a bigoted Army captain is assigned to an all-black company, & is then forced to share his command with a Black Lieutenant. Racial tensions erupt within the group, but they eventually pull together in order to destroy an important Nazi bridge.

items.title: Joshua
items.description: A black soldier returns from fighting in the Civil War only to find out that his mother, maid to a frontier family has been murdered by a gang of bandits. He becomes a bounty hunter, determined to track down and kill the men who killed his mother.

items.title: The Wedding Chapel
items.description: Uninspired and newly single painter Sarah is down on her luck and wants nothing more than to get away from her problems. When she decides to take a trip to visit her mom, she becomes involved in the efforts to save a local church.

items.title: 16 and Missing
items.description: A former FBI agent frantically searches for her 16-year-old daughter after discovering that she left in the middle of the night to meet her online boyfriend—a predator with a secret agenda.

items.title: 911 Nightmare
items.description: Officer Chris McCullers isn't happy working on 911-dispatch. Chris dismisses a call from a scared kid as a prank, but when it results in a murder, she becomes obsessed. Seeking redemption and justice, Chris takes matters into her own hands.

items.title: Don't Wake Mommy
items.description: Molly is struggling with being a new mom, but after meeting Beth on a support website for new moms, things seem to improve-until Beth's dark intentions are brought to light.

items.title: Hidden Truth
items.description: Jaime investigates the murders of her niece, Zoe, and her niece's mother. With Jaime's brother, being the prime suspect, Jaime investigates to find justice. Will Jaime be able to connect the dots and bring the true murderer to justice?

items.title: A Mother’s Escape
items.description: Murel is determined to protect her son from her second husband Tommy. When she discovers that Tommy has reported Kipp's disappearance as an abduction, Murel must take matters into her own hands to end Tommy's abuse once and for all.

items.title: The Truth About Christmas
items.description: After she tells a Christmas lie, a woman is cursed to only tell the truth when she spends the holidays with her boyfriend's family.

items.title: D-Day
items.description: When an elite group of American soldiers are ordered to take out a series of German machine gun nests, they find themselves blindly venturing into hostile territory.

items.title: Joseph & Mary
items.description: JOSEPH AND MARY is a story of inspiration and hope, of mercy versus revenge, in the years before Jesus became the Man that ultimately changed the course of humanity forever.

items.title: Triple Dog
items.description: On the night of a sleepover, a group of teenage girls venture out in a competitive game of challenging dares. As the antics escalate, and the dares become more extreme, the girls unravel the truth behind a former student's rumored suicide.

items.title: Get Out Alive
items.description: When an estranged couple are invited on a couple's retreat, they are pursued by dangerous criminals. They must overcome their marital problems to get out alive.

items.title: Tormenta de meteoritos
items.description: Para la astrónoma Michelle Young, un suceso celestial único en la vida se convierte en una pesadilla cuando miles de meteoritos estallan en la superficie de la atmósfera y bombardean la ciudad de San Francisco.

items.title: Stagecoach: The Texas Jack Story
items.description: A former stagecoach robber is hunted by a vengeful US Marshal.

items.title: Haunters: The Art Of The Scare
items.description: A mind-blowing documentary about how haunted houses for Halloween have spawned a controversial subculture of full-contact terror simulations. Go inside the most notorious extreme haunt in the world and ask yourself - how far is too far?

items.title: Madness in the Method
items.description: Legendary stoner actor Jason Mewes is tired of Hollywood's perception of him. Upon advice from best friend Kevin Smith, Mewes tracks down a secret method acting book to reinvent himself as a serious actor - with disastrous consequences!

items.title: Chonda Pierce Presents: Stand Up for Families - Family Is Forever and Ever, Amen
items.description: Join Christian comedian Chonda Pierce, the "Queen of Clean", as she hosts Part 2 of her hilarious stand up comedy special aimed at families; featuring some of her favorite comedians joining her onstage!

items.title: My Daddy Is In Heaven
items.description: Becca Adam's has an ideal, young family. With all their lives ahead of them, Becca's husband dies in a tragic accident. Now Becca must reconcile why bad things happen to good people and find the strength to resist her demons & rediscover her faith.

items.title: Sister Helen
items.description: Sister Helen opens a private home for recovering addicts and alcoholics in the South Bronx after the death of her husband and two sons.

items.title: Stay Human
items.description: Award winning musician Michael Franti takes us on a personal journey where he meets extraordinary humans who inspire him to overcome cynicism with optimism in today's challenging times and STAY HUMAN. Featuring new music from Franti's tenth studio album.

items.title: The Hooping Life
items.description: Hula-hooping's back. The Hooping Life's about the rise of a hot new trend: sultry dance, cool culture, slammin' clothes, outer struggle and inner peace. Featuring Shaq O'Neal, The String Cheese Incident, The Scissor Sisters, and a score by Basement Jaxx.

items.title: Firehouse Christmas
items.description: Firefighter Jenny has fallen in love with Tom. However his ex-wife Mary (a bestselling author) demands a reconciliation if he wants to see his daughter at Christmas.

items.title: We Have Always Lived in the Castle
items.description: Two sisters live in isolation with their deranged uncle following the deaths of the rest of their family. When a cousin comes to visit, family secrets and scandals unravel. Based on the beloved Shirley Jackson novel.

items.title: Christmas Miracle
items.description: Due to a road closure, eight strangers must take refuge in an abandoned church during a storm. They learn how to manage through various dilemmas by working together.

items.title: The Wolf Hour
items.description: Set in the Bronx during the Summer of Sam, June (Naomi Watts) becomes unraveled when an unseen tormentor begins harassing her in this taut Hitchcockian Thriller.

items.title: Coming Home for Christmas
items.description: After their parents separate, two estranged sisters who haven't been on speaking terms reunite in hopes that having a family Christmas all together for the first time in years will bring their Mom and Dad close again.

items.title: Christmas Lodge
items.description: During a weekend trip to the mountains, Mary finds herself at the now run-down lodge where she spent the holidays with her family growing up. She becomes determined to restore the building to its former glory.

items.title: Swimming For Gold
items.description: A former US women's swim team star suffers an injury that forces her to reevaluate her dreams while coaching the Australian men's swim team.

items.title: Danny Says
items.description: DANNY SAYS follows Danny Fields from Harvard Law dropout, to Andy Warhol's Silver Factory, to Director of Publicity at Elektra Records, to \\"punk pioneer\\". Danny's taste and opinion, once deemed defiant, has turned out to have been prescient.

items.title: The Gospel According to André
items.description: This intimate portrait for André Leon Tally, a fixture in the world of fashion, takes viewers on a journey from André's roots growing up to becoming one of the most influential tastemakers and fashion curators of our times.

items.title: Love & Basketball
items.description: Quincy and Monica fall in love as teens and share an all-consuming interest in basketball. Still, they struggle to keep their relationship alive while pursuing success as professional athletes.

items.title: Confessions of an Alien Abductee
items.description: Follow the work of one of Britain's most unusual phone-based services, the Anomalous Mind Management Abductee/Contactee Helpline, set up for people who claim to have had close encounters with extraterrestrials.

items.title: Set It Off
items.description: Jada Pinkett, Queen Latifah, Vivica A. Fox and Kimberly Elise star as four African American women living in a Los Angeles housing project who--pushed to the edge--resort to violence to escape poverty.

items.title: Socios enamorados
items.description: David Grodin y Maxine Smith se divorciaron y tienen un pequeño negocio juntos, de trajes de baño. Todo va genial hasta que descubren que su divorcio nunca llegó a concretarse, por lo que David intentará volver a encender su matrimonio.

items.title: Soulfish 2: Fish Mode
items.description: Soulfish 2 is an epic global fly-fishing adventure. Fish Mode is a state of being experienced by the anglers who lived this adventure. It’s a trance like state in which the angler becomes completely fixated on the pursuit of the fish and in that moment...

items.title: Blade of the Immortal
items.description: Manji, a highly skilled samurai, becomes cursed with immortality after a legendary battle. Haunted by the brutal murder of his sister, Manji knows that only fighting evil will regain his soul. The 100th film by master director TAKASHI MIIKE.

items.title: The Gangster
items.description: A newly released prisoner desires to live straight, but - knowing nothing else but the life of a gangster - returns to his old gang.

items.title: Weirdsville
items.description: A pair of slackers get in way over their heads when they try to dump the body of a dead girlfriend in the basement of a drive-in movie theater where a satanic cult performs ritual sacrifices.

items.title: School Life
items.description: This documentary follows a year in the lives of two inspirational teachers at the only primary-age boarding school in Ireland. For nearly half a century they have shaped thousands of minds, but the unthinkable looms: what would retirement mean?

items.title: El levantamiento del gueto de Varsovia
items.description: El 19 de abril de 1943, los jóvenes del gueto de Varsovia llevaron a cabo una rebelión armada contra las fuerzas de liquidación nazis.

items.title: Voyage to Amasia
items.description: "Voyage to Amasia" documents composer Eric Hachikian’s return to his ancestral home - Amasia, Turkey - nearly 100 years after Ottoman soldiers deported his grandmother Helen and her family during the Armenian Genocide. Eric first learned about Amasia f...

items.title: Marineros
items.description: Con la ayuda de un grupo de soldados rusos, un coronel de la marina debe capturar a un terroritsa ruso.

items.title: How We Got Gay
items.description: HOW WE GOT GAY tells the incredible story of how gay men and women went from being the ultimate outsiders to occupying the halls of power, with a profound influence on our cultural, political and social lives.

items.title: Solo una vez
items.description: Cuando la prometida de un bombero accede a regañadientes a participar en un trío con otra mujer, lo hace con la condición de que él le corresponda el favor con otro hombre.

items.title: Ted Bundy (en español)
items.description: Este impactante documental dramático explora la vida de Ted Bundy, el infame y carismático asesino en serie que asesinó al menos a 19 mujeres en la década de 1970.

items.title: Esther And The King
items.description: When a modern-day girl faces a big challenge in her life, her mother teaches her about the power of fasting by sharing the story of a heroine from the Bible.

items.title: After the Reality
items.description: Scottie Olson (Matthew Morrison) is once again trying to find purpose in his life, this time by vying for a woman's heart on "Young Bucks", a hit reality TV dating show. But after the sudden death of his father, Scottie is forced to quit the series.

items.title: Astraea
items.description: When disease nearly wipes out the human race, a telepathic teenage girl named Astraea believes her visions confirm that survivors are living in Northern Canada. She leads her doubting brother on a five thousand mile journey, through a silent America.

items.title: Beginner's Guide to Sex
items.description: The students of Peabody High have fallen prey to a series of sex-related mishaps, forcing the principal to establish mandatory sexual education classes. Laci Cox is the new sex-ed teacher, but there's one problem… Laci is a virgin.

items.title: The Scrooge Mystery
items.description: An exploration of the life and work of Don Rosa, his favorite character, Scrooge McDuck, and how they've both become global inspirations.

items.title: Queen: Mercury Rising
items.description: Freddie Mercury, Brian May, Roger Taylor, and John Deacon, four names synonymous with one of the world's all-time greatest rock bands, Queen.

items.title: Kittie: Origins/Evolutions
items.description: Thrust into heavy metal stardom as teenagers with their debut release, the all-female Kittie has thrashed the heavy metal world for more than twenty years.

items.title: Aria
items.description: 10 of the world's greatest directors were commissioned to create short pieces based on the world's greatest opera music. Erotic, demented, funny, poignant, extravagant, and outrageous, the result is breathtaking and totally unique.

items.title: Hip Hop Don't Stop
items.description: This film gives us the definitive chronicle of hip-hop from its beginnings. See the evolution of music with vintage footage, live performances, and exclusive interviews with hip hop legends

items.title: Metallica: Masters of Metal
items.description: They are one of the most influential heavy metal bands of all time. Alongside Slayer, Anthrax, and Megadeth, the Masters of Metal are an important part of the "big four".

items.title: North Korea vs. USA: A Nuclear Chicken Game
items.description: In North Korea, the Kims’ communist dynasty has tried to become a nuclear power since the Cold War. This is the riveting account of a 60-year deception that reached its climax with Donald Trump's historical acknowledgment of the North Korean regime.

items.title: Man Who Defied Beijing
items.description: Human rights hero and the 2010 Nobel Peace Prize winner, Liu Xiaobo, was a key figure of the Tiananmen Square protest. He spent 9 long years in jail and was released in 2017 on medical parole, only to die a few weeks later.

items.title: Quest for the Lost Pharaoh
items.description: Unraveling the tale of a priest and his family by following the clues left to us by the ancients, Vassil Dobrev will attempt to reconstruct the past in his quest for the lost pharaoh. State of the art CGI brings the ancient necropolis to life.

items.title: Airline Disaster: Crash of the Century
items.description: March 27, 1977. A thick fog rolled into the usually quiet Los Rodeos Airport in Tenerife. An explosion at a nearby airport had redirected air traffic to the undermanned airfield. This film reconstructs the moments leading up to the tragedy.

items.title: Bodysnatchers of New York
items.description: The world of tissue collection may seem questionable but is entirely legal. However, when a group of men start paying off funeral homes and fail to get consent to rummage through bodies, it becomes clear their questionable morals are lawbreaking.

items.title: The Khufu Pyramid Revealed
items.description: The Great Pyramids are the only wonders of the ancient world that still stand today, the greatest of which is the pyramid of Khufu. Many theories have been offered to explain its construction, but none as convincing or unique as this one.

items.title: Electric Kingdom
items.description: Electric Kingdom is a behind-the-scenes documentary following the first Formula E electric car race in the Middle East.

items.title: Blink of an Eye
items.description: Based on the NY Times bestselling book and directed by Paul Taublieb, Blink of an Eye, is a feature documentary about Michael Waltrip, his journey to a complex victory, and his star-crossed friendship with the iconic driver, Dale Earnhardt.

items.title: The Lost Boys
items.description: A single mother and her two sons discover much more than they anticipated in this visually stunning blend of hip humor, horror, and rock 'n' roll about the most compelling group of contemporary vampires ever to put fang to vein.

items.title: Third Eye Spies
items.description: For more than 20 years the CIA studied psychic abilities for use in their top-secret spy program. With previously classified details about ESP now finally coming to light, there can be no more secrets.

items.title: The Cosmic Secret
items.description: For time immemorial we have looked to the Stars for answers to unlock our past. We have interpreted prophecy with the hope of predetermining our future and yet the questions remain: Who are we? Why are we here and what is our destiny?

items.title: Lights in the Sky
items.description: Hundreds of people reported strange lights in the sky. The US government can’t figure it out. What are the lights in the sky? This film shows never-before-seen footage with scientific explanations, from the quantum to the biological.

items.title: Andy Parkin: A Life in Adaptation
items.description: A multi award winning documentary about the extraordinary life of Andy Parkin, an artist and one of the world's leading solo climbers. Andy is regarded as one of the world's finest alpine climbers.

items.title: Jackie
items.description: Twin sisters (Carice Van Houten and real-life sister Jelka) embark on a life-changing search for their long-lost mother (Holly Hunter).

items.title: The War Of The Gargantuas
items.description: An experimental lab animal called a Gargantua escapes from his captors and is suspected to be the creature that is killing people all over the countryside.

items.title: Invasion Of Astro-Monster
items.description: Aliens from Planet X request the use of Godzilla and Rodan to fight off King Ghidorah but have a better use for the three monsters.

items.title: Ebirah, Horror Of The Deep
items.description: A teen searching for his brother stows away on a criminal's boat that shipwrecks on Letchi island, where terrorists have enslaved the Infant Island natives.

items.title: All Monsters Attack
items.description: A bullied schoolboy dreams of traveling to Monster Island, where he befriends Godzilla's son, who is also having bully troubles.

items.title: Deep Blue Sea
items.description: One of nature's most perfect killing machines has been re-engineered as something smarter, faster, and deadlier. When things go wrong, the aquatic killing machines begin hunting their creators, who are alone and adrift on the Deep Blue Sea.

items.title: The Black Cat
items.description: When the townspeople of a small village begin to die in a series of horrible accidents, an inspector arrives to investigate. But when suspicion falls on a local medium who records conversations with the dead, the grisly deaths take on a sinister twist.

items.title: Mirage Men
items.description: MIRAGE MEN takes you on a journey through the badlands and backwaters of America. Mark Pilkington and John Lundberg, based on their best-selling book, uncover a 60 year-old story stranger than any conspiracy thriller. For over sixty years, teams withi...

items.title: Mayan Renaissance
items.description: Mayan Renaissance is a feature length film which documents the glory of the ancient Maya civilization, the Spanish conquest in 1519, 500 years of oppression, and the courageous fight of the Maya to reclaim their voice and determine their own future, in...

items.title: Jane Austen Country: The Life & Times of Jane Austen
items.description: When Jane Austen, the daughter of a country clergyman, was born in the picturesque village of Steventon in Hampshire in December 1775, few people could have guessed the impact she would have on the world of literature. With just six completed novels, “...

items.title: Immortal
items.description: A chilling anthology film told in four chapters; Immortal revolves around stories of characters who discover that they are immune to death.

items.title: Chronicle of a Serial Killer
items.description: This thriller takes us on a journey into the twisted mind of serial killer Henry Brolin.

items.title: Get Christie Love!
items.description: Teresa Graves stars as a sassy sexy undercover. Going deep undercover as she tries to bring down the big-time drug ring. With her street smarts and sexy kung fu, she turns the tables!

items.title: Savage!
items.description: A young black man becomes the legendary leader of a rebel army, as the daring ambush on the beach takes place the leader of the rebel army is captured.

items.title: Good Guy From Harlem
items.description: In Miami, a private detective is hired to protect the wife of the head of state in town for diplomatic business and recover the daughter of the leader of a criminal organization kidnapped by a rival gang.

items.title: The Black Connection
items.description: In Las Vegas, these drug dealers are in deep with the Italian mob over large amounts of cocaine. He must get one step ahead of the mob before they take the ultimate action on him.

items.title: The Black Godfather
items.description: There's a new godfather in town as tension rises between two rivals. The explosive confrontation as a man climbs his way to the top of an urban drug-selling mob.

items.title: The Black Gestapo
items.description: The permission is granted to start a protection squad to stand up to the Mafia. After driving out the mob, they take up the same lucrative crime activities they once fought against.

items.title: Albino
items.description: In Rhodesia, a colonial police officer hunts down the albino terrorist who murdered his fiancee.

items.title: Black Cobra
items.description: Struggling to protect a female photographer from a gang of psychopathic bikers, a lone cop does everything possible.

items.title: Asylum: Twisted Horror and Fantasy Tales
items.description: Brandon prepares to give his last stand-up comedy show. But during the show he will realize that these stories have a strong relationship with his past. More than he imagines.

items.title: Summer '03
items.description: On her deathbed, Jamie’s grandmother leaves her with two pieces of information, one religious, the other more... personal. Jamie must navigate her own love life and maintain her closest friendships in the midst of this family crisis.

items.title: She Is The Ocean
items.description: A woman is like the ocean: a force of nature with depths unknown. SHE IS THE OCEAN follows nine extraordinary women - women who live in all corners of the globe, but are united by their love and devotion to the same sea.

items.title: Sometimes Always Never
items.description: After his son Michael left over a game of Scrabble, Alan and his family barely speak to each other. But when a mysterious online player emerges who might be their prodigal son, Alan must find the right words before he loses everything.

items.title: Al Murray Live - The Only Way is Epic
items.description: Broken Britain may be staring into the bottom of an empty pint glass, but don't lose hope Al Murray The Pub Landlord is back to fill it up again, with a brand new stand-up show of epic proportions.

items.title: Al Murray Live - One Man One Guvnor
items.description: The Pub Landlord is back to save the nation, in this, his latest stand-up extravaganza, because he knows what the country really needs right now is some bloke waving a pint around offering common-sense solutions.

items.title: Al Murray Live - Barrel of Fun
items.description: The Guv tackles all the current topics; from global warming and a PC-world gone mad, to debt and the financial crisis - whilst dispensing his knowledge on the ultimate fail-safe chat-up lines and, ahem,... erectile dysfunction.

items.title: Al Murray Live - And a Glass of Wine for the Lady
items.description: Comedian Al Murray is back with a second installment of the 'Pub Landlord' live show, in which outrageous barroom banter and pub philosophy are the order of the day.

items.title: Al Murray Live - Giving it Both Barrels
items.description: One of the most popular live stand-up comedians of recent years, Al Murray has starred in his own major TV series and his Pub Landlord show consistently packs out major west end venues. Guaranteed laughs, but definitely not for the faint-hearted.

items.title: Al Murray Live - Live at the Palladium
items.description: In this show, Britain's favourite Pub Landlord holds court with his distinctive common sense, reasoning on subjects such as "The War on Terror", "Hell", "Life Itself", and his personal crusade to "Bring Back Shame"

items.title: Al Murray Live - My Gaff My Rules
items.description: Recorded live in London's Playhouse Theatre, My Gaff, My Rules sees Al Murray's Perrier Award-winning comic creation in the top, boisterous ale-swilling form.

items.title: Al Murray Live - Beautiful British Tour Live At the O2
items.description: Recorded at The Guv's biggest lock-in to date at London’s O2 Arena, Al Murray will once again raise a glass at home with you whilst he muses over topics including: the global financial crisis, London 2012, and his crusade to fix Broken Britain.

items.title: Frank Skinner - Live at The Apollo
items.description: Frank Skinner performs previously unrecorded, uncensored, stand-up comedy material that could never be shown on TV. This performance was filmed at London's Apollo Theatre on September 4th, 1994.

items.title: Frank Skinner - Live at The Birmingham Hippodrome
items.description: Featuring all the original and exclusive material and was filmed at the Birmingham Hippodrome during a 100-date tour which earned an entry into the Guinness Book of Records

items.title: Frank Skinner - Live at The Bloomsbury
items.description: Frank Skinner made his television debut in 1988. After five minutes of stand-up, the station received 131 calls from outraged viewers. Here he is, live and uncensored, performing the act that won him the 1991 Perrier Award for Comedy.

items.title: Frank Skinner - Live at The London Palladium
items.description: The Perrier award-winning star of BBC Two's "Fantasy Football League" and BBC One's "The Frank Skinner Show" performs live and uncensored stand-up comedy to a sell-out audience at the London Palladium.

items.title: Frank Skinner - Live From Birmingham's National Indoor Arena
items.description: Frank Skinner returned to live stand-up in 2007 with his fifth sell-out tour of the UK, a decade since he played his last major live gig.

items.title: Frank Skinner - Man In A Suit
items.description: Recorded during his 40-night sell-out run at the Leicester Square Theatre and part of his highly anticipated 2014 tour, Frank delivers this critically acclaimed and hilarious show in his usual witty and hugely entertaining style.

items.title: Greg Davies - Back Of My Mum's Head
items.description: Stung by his mother's suggestion that he is 'not normal' Greg puts everyone under the microscope in a petty quest to discover if anyone actually is. To be clear, as an educational tool this show is worthless. It is funny though.

items.title: Greg Davies - Firing Cheeseballs at a Dog
items.description: Greg Davies' hotly anticipated debut stand-up show was a critically lauded sell-out smash hit at the 2010 Edinburgh festival, picking up a prestigious nomination for the Fosters Comedy Award.

items.title: Lee Mack - Going Out
items.description: Lee Mack, star of BBC comedy shows 'Not Going Out' and 'Would I Lie To You?', delivers his high-energy banter and sharp one-liners to venues across the country on his 'Going Out Live' tour.

items.title: Lee Mack - Hit the Road Mack
items.description: Lee Mack, star of BBC comedy shows 'Not Going Out' and 'Would I Lie To You?', delivers his high-energy banter and sharp one-liners to the audience of the London Hammersmith Apollo, filmed over seven nights of shows.

items.title: Lee Mack - Live at the Bloomsbury
items.description: Recorded live at the Bloomsbury Theatre, Lee's relentless determination to have fun is marvelously infectious and leaves his audience exhausted by laughter.

items.title: Russell Howard - Dingledodies
items.description: Recorded at Brighton Dome as part of his twice extended sell-out Dingledodies tour (which played to over 125,000 people), the show sees the star of Mock the Week (BBC Two) and Russell Howard's Good News (BBC Three) share his observations on life

items.title: Russell Howard - Live at the Bloomsbury
items.description: Russell Howard recorded live at The Bloomsbury Theatre, London, performing his stand-up show "Adventures".

items.title: Russell Howard - Right Here Right Now
items.description: Russell Howard is back in 2011 with his third sell-out tour Right Here, Right Now. The star of Russell Howard's Good News and Mock The Week never fails to entertain with his trademark mix of eloquent gags and deft storytelling.

items.title: Russell Howard - Wonderbox
items.description: The popular 'Mock the Week' panelist performs live in front of his home crowd in Bristol as part of his 2014 sell-out 'Wonderbox' tour. Russell performs his juvenile brand of social commentary and discusses the joy to be found in everyday experiences.

items.title: Jim Allison: Breakthrough
items.description: The astounding true story of one warm-hearted, stubborn man's visionary quest to find a cure for cancer.

items.title: Minecraft: The Story of Minecraft
items.description: Since its development in 2009, Minecraft has taken the digital world by storm. It’s now played by millions of people on a global scale. Its impact on the gaming community is unrivalled, so much so that Microsoft purchased Minecraft for an eye watering ...

items.title: Minecraft: Through the Nether Portal
items.description: Minecraft: Through the Nether Portal takes you on a journey through the ever-evolving, epic game of Minecraft. Its popularity is opening up a whole new world for this generation, with millions of new players signing up each week. With exclusive intervi...

items.title: Seabiscuit: America's Legendary Racehorse
items.description: Heroes come in all shapes and sizes. The heroes of this true story entered the stage as minor players and left as champions…real life American legends. In 1936, an unlikely cast of characters came together: SEABISCUIT: a burned-out, knobby-kneed raceho...

items.title: The Sheik
items.description: THE SHEIK is the amazingly entertaining story of the man that lived the American Dream by assuming the persona of the supreme villain. Filmed extensively between 2006 until 2013. This is a touching story about the unlikely revival of a former wrestling...

items.title: Murders of Hollywood
items.description: Sensational and shocking stories from Hollywood are not always fiction. Beyond anything a screenwriter could imagine, and with cast of famous stars and celebrities, this documentary goes behind the scenes to explore the real-life stories of murders in ...

items.title: Cheap Thrills
items.description: A couple engages two friends in a series of dares in exchange for money, with each challenge upping the ante in both reward and boundaries.

items.title: Manufacturing Stoke
items.description: No other sport is so intrinsically linked to nature. Some call it a spiritual experience, most call it indescribable. And yet, in becoming the multi-billion dollar industry it is today, a great paradox has risen. Surfers are indeed directly connected t...

items.title: 10 Brothers of Shaolin
items.description: The martial-arts action film 10 Brothers of Shaolin tells the tale of ten specially trained fighters, five monks, five laymen, who have been taught their skills in order to protect Master Chu, who needs all the help he can.

items.title: Pinned
items.description: Lakewood, Ohio has two high schools with very different wrestling teams. The public school, Lakewood High, dominated during World War II but hasn’t had a state champion since 1959. This may change with senior Matt Curley. Matt, who is naturally strong...

items.title: 29 Palms
items.description: This is the story of a bag of money and the people who come into contact with it.

items.title: Black Cobra II
items.description: A Chicago cop finds himself in the Philippines learning the techniques of Interpol. After leaving the airport, his wallet is stolen by being pickpocketed. Evidence surrounding the stolen wallet pulls him deeper into a web of intrigue.

items.title: Black Cobra III
items.description: After a shipment of American weapons was stolen in the Philippines, Hawkins an American tries to find the weapons. These criminals always seem to know where Duncan and Malone will be, which leads them to suspect a traitor in their midst.

items.title: The Tattoo Connection
items.description: After a diamond was stolen by a local criminal organization, an American investigator goes to Hong Kong to retrieve it.

items.title: A Taxi Driver
items.description: In this powerful true story set in 1980, a down-on-his-luck taxi driver from Seoul is hired by a foreign journalist who wants to go to the town of Gwangju for the day.

items.title: Beyond Redemption
items.description: Master stuntman Brian Ho (X-MEN: DAYS OF FUTURE PAST) stars in this action-packed thriller as undercover cop Billy Tong, who infiltrates the inner circle of a powerful gang in order to prove his loyalty to its leader

items.title: Brotherhood of Blades 2
items.description: An imperial guard searches for the truth behind a conspiracy that framed him and his partners. The proof of his innocence lies with a wanted woman named Bei Zhai... but will she reveal what she knows? In this intense prequel to BROTHERHOOD OF BLADES.

items.title: Call of Heroes
items.description: Louis Koo stars as Cao Shaolun, the spoiled son of a powerful general who has grown into a vicious and depraved warlord.

items.title: Chasing the Dragon 2
items.description: Based on real-life crimes that terrorized Hong Kong in the 1990s, Logan (Tony Leung Ka Fai) is the head of leading a notorious human trafficking gang, abducting the children of Hong Kong's elite.

items.title: Cold War 2
items.description: A suspected criminal mastermind escapes from police custody, throwing the city into turmoil. With the police department now divided, rival police chiefs are forced to take their fight to the streets of Hong Kong—with deadly consequences.

items.title: Confession of Murder
items.description: When the statute of limitations expires on a series of high-profile murders, a handsome and mysterious young man emerges with a tell-all book, taking credit for the crimes.

items.title: The Broken Circle Breakdown
items.description: A tattoo artist and a musician fall in love at first sight in this intensely romantic portrait, set to an electrifying bluegrass score.

items.title: First Love
items.description: The film is the prolific auteur, Takashi Miike, at his most fun and anarchic, a noir-tinged yakuza film blending genres in the story of a young boxer and a call girl, who fall passionately in love.

items.title: Far From Men
items.description: Viggo Mortensen stars as a reclusive teacher who must help a wanted man escape into the mountains during the Algerian War.

items.title: God of War
items.description: This action-packed historical epic stars martial arts legend Sammo Hung as maverick leader Commander Yu, who led a small army against hordes of invading pirates on the China coastline during the 16th century. Mandarin w/ English subtitles.

items.title: Stanley and the Dinosaurs
items.description: Stanley is no ordinary caveman. He paints, grows a garden and is polite to others including dinosaurs. He leaves his dark, damp cave and builds the world's first house, serenaded in four-part harmony by his dinosaur friends. From a book by Syd Hoff.

items.title: House of Hummingbird
items.description: Eun-hee is a curious 14-year-old growing up in a country on the brink of enormous change. Ignored and rejected by her family, Eun-hee finds her escape roaming her neighborhood with her best friend, experiencing all that life has to offer.

items.title: I am not Madame Bovary
items.description: Li Xuelian (Fan Bing Bing) and her husband stage a fake divorce to secure a second apartment in the city reserved by the government for single people.

items.title: Kickboxer: Retaliation
items.description: When MMA fighter Kurt Sloane is forced into an underground death match with a 400lb drug-enhanced killer, he seeks help from the legendary Master Durand (Jean-Claude Van Damme) and prison fighter Briggs (Mike Tyson) to survive the fight.

items.title: Kill Your Friends
items.description: A coldblooded British talent scout (Nicolas Hoult) hunts for the last Megahit of London's Britpop music scene. Fueled by drugs, alcohol, and greed, he plans to eliminate the competition by any merciless (and murderous) means necessary.

items.title: Three
items.description: Three desparate souls—a doctor who must redeem her reputation, a policeman who will go to any length to seek justice, and a suspected criminal with a gunshot wound to the head—cross paths in the hustle and bustle of an emergency room.

items.title: Punching Henry
items.description: A journeyman comedian is lured to LA by a TV producer who wants to make him a reality star. As reality sets in, he must decide whether his legacy will be to tell jokes for a living or become the butt of them.

items.title: The Final Master
items.description: A Wing Chun master has to defeat 8 martial arts schools to open his own school, yet he has become a chess piece to the local power dynamics.

items.title: Assassination
items.description: Snipers. Marksmen. Hired Guns. Double Agents. A group of exiled rebels are planning a hit on an Army Commander in Japanese-occupied Korea, but the only killer for the job is in prison.

items.title: Big Brother
items.description: A former soldier is recruited for his toughest mission yet – teaching a class of teen delinquents. As he kicks his way into their school and home lives, it becomes clear that his unconventional teaching style might be just what they need.

items.title: Merci Bocuse
items.description: A young and ambitious team of chefs face the life-changing challenges of competing in the world's most prestigious culinary competition.

items.title: Meeting Michael
items.description: When Adam Kontras got a press pass to a Bulls game on November 9th 1995, he bought his first video camera that morning and captured everything.

items.title: Gozo
items.description: After a couple moves to the Island of Gozo, their relationship starts to crumble after the past begins to haunt them.

items.title: Companeros
items.description: When a Swedish arms dealer and Mexican bandit team up to kidnap a professor who holds the key to a fortune in gold, they find themselves hunted by the American army, stalked by a crazed sadist and trapped in the middle of a revolution about to explode.

items.title: Keoma
items.description: Franco Nero is Keoma, a half-breed gunfighter weary of killing as a way of life. But when he returns to his troubled childhood home, Keoma is caught in a savage battle between innocent settlers, sadistic bandits and his vengeful half-brothers.

items.title: The Toolbox Murders
items.description: In a quiet apartment complex in Los Angeles, a deranged handyman goes on a killing spree, savagely murdering immoral women with the tools of his trade - claw hammers, power drills and even a deadly nail gun!

items.title: Se7en
items.description: Gluttony, greed, sloth, envy, wrath, pride, lust—everyone has a sin. Detectives William Somerset and David Mills live among these sins every day. But nothing can prepare them for the killings they're about to experience.

items.title: The Legend of Swee' Pea
items.description: The Legend of Swee’ Pea follows the twists and turns of fortune in the life of a basketball prodigy: his dramatic downfall, miraculous comeback, and, finally, the bittersweet confrontation with a life imperfectly lived.

items.title: The Doonies
items.description: Dirt bikes, off-road trucks, and more thrash through the dunes in this high-flying film featuring premier moto athletes.

items.title: Why We Fight
items.description: What drives someone to fight for a living? This compelling documentary follows three fighters in different disciplines including Muay Thai, MMA and Boxing, to answer the question, Why Do We Fight?

items.title: Stagefright
items.description: While a group of young actors rehearse a new musical about a mass murderer, a notorious psychopath escapes from a nearby insane asylum and is accidentally locked inside the theater with the unsuspecting cast.

items.title: Behind the Story: We Are Skateboarders
items.description: Behind every picture is a thousand words, and behind every film there is a filmmaker who usually has to bleed unbridled passion to get the film from point A to point B.

items.title: Best of Monster Skate
items.description: Best of Monster Skate features some of the biggest names in the international world of skateboarding as they draw creative lines in the countless bowls, parks, and streets that the world has to offer.

items.title: Contamination
items.description: A deserted ship arrives in New York City carrying its slaughtered crew and a horrific cargo: Mutant green eggs the size of footballs that pulsate with life until they spray hideous chest-bursting death.

items.title: Django (1965)
items.description: Franco Nero stars as the lone stranger who roams the West dragging a coffin filled with chaos towards a destiny ruled by vengeance. This is the one and only DJANGO!

items.title: Superhuman: The Invisible Made Visible
items.description: Award-winning documentary that provides tangible evidence for the power of the human mind over matter. Through a series of experiments and jaw-dropping demonstrations, viewers will uncover the true nature of mind and physical reality.

items.title: The Life Of Jesus
items.description: The story of Jesus' life as told by the apostle John, narrated by Christopher Plummer.

items.title: Mountain Top
items.description: A lawyer-turned-preacher living in a small Appalachian town is pursued by an eccentric man to represent him in court. Now involved in a case that ties into his own small-town life, the former attorney agrees to help a man.

items.title: Straight Up: Kentucky Bourbon
items.description: Kentucky's rise to undisputed Bourbon Capital of the world is a rich, detailed, and innovative story that displays how the state has continued to raise the level of whiskey making to unprecedented heights.

items.title: Bastards y Diablos
items.description: Two estranged brothers adventure together through Colombia to fulfill their dead father's will and connect with their family, their father's homeland, and ultimately each other.

items.title: 2015 The Greenbrier Classic
items.description: Danny Lee wins the 2015 Greenbrier Classic

items.title: 2015 AT&T Byron Nelson
items.description: Steven Bowditch wins the 2015 AT&T Byron Nelson

items.title: A Christmas Tail
items.description: Maggie y Jack,dos personas solteras,tratan de regalar un perro a sus hijos de Navidad. Su lucha por la custodia de un mismo animal,les lleva a hacer algo que nunca hubieran esperado: enamorarse.

items.title: Cupido no funciona
items.description: Holly, profesora universitaria, se inscribe en un servicio de citas románticas en línea, pero sospecha que algo anda mal cuando ve que las acciones del chico no coinciden con sus bonitos mensajes.

items.title: Hyena
items.description: When a ruthless undercover cop is exposed for making deals with London's most violent drug traffickers, he's forced to rapidly shift his loyalties and sell out his allies in order to stay alive.

items.title: Shut Up Little Man!: An Audio Misadventure
items.description: When two friends tape-recorded the fights of their violently noisy neighbors, they accidentally created one of the world's first "viral" pop-culture sensations.

items.title: Bright Days Ahead
items.description: In this sophisticated and sexy tale, a married woman in her 60s (French icon Fanny Ardant) tumbles into an affair with a much younger man. In French with English subtitles.

items.title: The Bachelor Weekend
items.description: A bachelor party weekend in the great outdoors takes some wild detours in this hilarious and heartfelt comedy. Official Selection, 2014 Tribeca Film Festival.

items.title: Some Velvet Morning
items.description: Stanley Tucci stars as a man who surprises his former mistress (Alice Eve), claiming to have left his wife. Before too long, a dark history between the two has come into focus. From Neil LaBute.

items.title: The Comedy
items.description: Tim Heidecker stars as an aging hipster testing the limits of acceptable behavior with his like-minded friends in this provocative character study.

items.title: Accidente en Navidad
items.description: Una pareja que está a punto de divorciarse, se estrella en su avioneta en el bosque. Sus hijos los rescatan y descubren que no fue un accidente. Estar cerca a la muerte les recuerda que todavía se aman.

items.title: Navidad en cuatro patas
items.description: Maggie y Jack, dos personas solteras, tratan de regalar un perro a sus hijos de Navidad. Su lucha por la custodia de un mismo animal, les lleva a hacer algo que nunca hubieran esperado: enamorarse.

items.title: La cabaña de Navidad
items.description: María viaja de vacaciones a las montañas con su novio. En el camino, se encuentran con una niña que se había torcido el tobillo, y que casualmente es la hija de un antiguo amigo de la niñez.

items.title: Beso de Año Nuevo
items.description: La protagonista principal Kelly Hartwick se enfoca en una campana nueva para Navidad, mientras que un hombre de la calle la convence de tratar de buscar el amor de su vida en línea.

items.title: Regresando a casa en Navidad
items.description: Kate tiene la gran idea de reunir para Navidad a su familia separada y volver as antigua casa. El problema es que alguien vive allí y no es muy amable.

items.title: Buckjumping
items.description: Buckjumping takes the pulse of present day New Orleans by turning to its dancers, the men and women who embody the rhythm of the city and prove it on the streets every chance they get.

items.title: Inferno
items.description: A young woman stumbles upon a mysterious diary that reveals the secrets of \\"The Three Mothers\\" and unleashes a nightmare world of demonic evil.

items.title: Maniac
items.description: Frank Zito is a deeply disturbed man, haunted by the traumas of unspeakable childhood abuse. And when these horrific memories begin to scream inside his mind, Frank prowls the seedy streets of New York City to stalk and slaughter innocent young women.

items.title: Vigilante
items.description: New York City factory worker Eddie Marino is a solid citizen and regular guy, until the day a sadistic street gang brutally assaults his wife and murders his child. But when a corrupt judge sets the thugs free, Eddie goes berserk and vows revenge.

items.title: The Bigfoot Alien Connection Revealed
items.description: We are not alone in the universe. Alien life is here right now, contacting us in the form of Bigfoot, U.F.O.s, orbs, & other inter-dimensional paranormal phenomena. These experiences are changing human nature as we’ve known it.

items.title: We Could be King
items.description: The true story of two rival high school football teams forced to merge into one and their struggle to become champions against all odds. An unflinching snapshot of the power of sports to bring young people, neighborhoods, and a city together.

items.title: Christmas in New York
items.description: A young boy named Ari decides to leave the jungle with his animal friends in order to experience Christmas in New York City. Ari also hopes to finally reunite with his parents in time for the season.

items.title: Amityville: Dollhouse
items.description: A children's dollhouse, which is a miniature of the infamous haunted Long Island house, is given to a young girl where the demonic evil soon comes out to cause more terror.

items.title: Cagney & Lacey: The View Through the Glass Ceiling
items.description: Cagney & Lacey are back to investigate the murder of a man whose evidence points to him being killed by a cop. Lacey feels uneasy about investigating their own when the evidence is circumstantial.

items.title: Cagney & Lacey: Together Again
items.description: Cagney & Lacey must balance their personal demons with the needs of their latest case: the murder of a homeless man who kept harassing the residents of an upscale apartment building.

items.title: Fire and Ice: The Rocket Richard Riot
items.description: Maurice Richard, star player for the Montreal Canadiens, was suspended by the president of the league towards the end of the 1955 season, setting off a historical riot in the streets of Montreal.

items.title: Cries Unheard: The Donna Yaklich Story
items.description: Hooked on steroids and unable to control his bursts of sudden rage, a police officer keeps his wife under his thumb and routinely abuses her behind the closed doors of their house.

items.title: Cagney & Lacey: The Return
items.description: Cagney, now a Lieutenant, re-teams with Lacey, who has retired from the force, to find a cache of firearms. Trouble arises when Marcus becomes a suspect & Mansfield has returned to torment the duo!

items.title: Cagney & Lacey: True Convictions
items.description: Cagney & Lacey are back & working on two cases! The first is a murder trial, in which Lacey has doubts about the suspect's guilt. Meanwhile, Cagney becomes involved with the father of her late neighbor.

items.title: Secuestro: Vuelo 285
items.description: Un asesino convicto es escoltado por alguaciles en un vuelo, pero poco después de despegar, dos de sus ayudantes se disfrazan de pasajeros, toman el control del vuelo y lo liberan.

items.title: El caldero de los pecados
items.description: En un pequeño pedazo de desierto llamado Sin’s Kitchen, tres cuentos oscuros y complejos exploran las profundidades ocultas del alma del hombre.

items.title: Eco
items.description: Un gemelo idéntico asume la identidad, el trabajo y la esposa de su hermano en un plan para vengarse de la familia que lo abandonó.

items.title: Destrozador de mentes
items.description: Un experimento de alto secreto que intentó crear un superhumano ha salido mal. Ahora los creadores, atrapados en un puesto avanzado remoto del desierto, están siendo cazados por su creación.

items.title: Cazador de recompensas
items.description: Cuando un asesor fiscal escapa de un ataque a toda su oficina, debe esconderse de los asesinos profesionales que quieren matarlo.

items.title: Niños de la noche
items.description: Una apartada colonia de niños vampiros es atacada por vengativos aldeanos en esta divertida y oscura historia de terror del cineasta argentino Iván Noel. Un periodista visita un orfanato apartado donde los niños padecen una enfermedad cutánea desconocida.

items.title: Obediencia perfecta
items.description: Los escándalos sexuales pedófilos de la Iglesia Católica reciben una mirada explosiva, con este drama ambientado en la década de 1960 basado en una historia real sobre el fundador y abusador de niños de Legion of Christ, Marcial Marcial.

items.title: City Of The Living Dead
items.description: The Seven Gates Of Hell have been torn open, and in three days the dead shall rise and walk the earth. As a reporter and a psychic race to close the portals of the damned, they encounter a seething nightmare of unspeakable evil.

items.title: Deep Red (Uncensored)
items.description: An English jazz pianist living in Rome witnesses the brutal hatchet murder of a renowned psychic and, with the help of a tenacious female reporter, is quickly drawn into the savage crime.

items.title: Fire And Ice
items.description: Experience a world unlike any ever seen, where savage warriors, horrific monsters and luscious maidens battle for the soul of a civilization in a time of good and evil, pleasure and pain, and FIRE AND ICE.

items.title: Manhattan Baby
items.description: A young girl on vacation in Egypt is given a mysterious charm, causing her archaeologist father to be struck blind inside an unexplored pyramid tomb. But when the family returns home to Manhattan, a plague of supernatural evil and sudden violence follows.

items.title: Shock Waves
items.description: During World War II, the Nazi High Command ordered its scientists to create a top secret race of indestructible zombie storm troopers. No member of this horrific SS unit was ever captured and, somewhere off the coast of Florida, they have survived...

items.title: Street Law
items.description: The legendary Franco Nero stars as Carlo Antonelli, an average citizen until the day he is brutally beaten during a violent robbery. But when the police drop the case and the suspects remain free, Carlo is pushed beyond his breaking point.

items.title: Zombie
items.description: Tisa Farrow, Ian McCulloch, Al Cliver, and Richard Johnson star in this worldwide splatter sensation directed by Lucio Fulci that remains one of the most eye-skewering, skin-ripping, gore-gushingly graphic horror hits of all time!

items.title: I Am Shakespeare (The Henry Green Story)
items.description: Stephen Dest's documentary I Am Shakespeare: The Henry Green Story chronicles the true life story of 19 year old, Henry Green, living a dual life as a brilliant young actor and inner-city gang member, who was brutally shot and left for dead .

items.title: Los miércoles no existen
items.description: En el Madrid actual y a lo largo de cuatro años, las decisiones de seis personas, van a influir directamente sobre todos ellos. Diez momentos de sus vidas que marcarán el final de una etapa y el comienzo de otra.

items.title: Emerson Heights
items.description: When Los Angeles actor Cody McClain falls for New Yorker Briley Williams, they attempt to beat the odds of long-distance love. But, when he books the lead role in a blockbuster film, the distance may not be their biggest hurdle.

items.title: Tormentas de polvo
items.description: Analizamos la cada vez más presente amenaza de las tormentas de polvo, y la posibilidad de mejorar las vidas de aquellos afectados por estas brutales nubes. Gracias a nuevas tecnologías y el esfuerzo del sector científico.

items.title: Nosotros fuimos a la misión Apolo
items.description: El Programa Apolo revolucionó a la humanidad en los sesenta y vuelve a emocionarnos ahora. Recordamos el trabajo y sacrificio de los hombres y mujeres de esta carrera espacial y descubrimos su verdadero día a día.

items.title: Un valor atípico
items.description: Desde prodigio matemático a computadora en la NASA, seguimos la inspiradora vida de Katherine Johnson. Después de 33 años en la NASA y una medalla presidencial, nos paramos a escuchar como esta persona extraordinaria contribuyó tanto a la humanidad.

items.title: Hijos de Tesla
items.description: Seguimos el vivo legado de Nikola Tesla mediante las admirables historias de cinco inventores y sus descubrimientos. Invenciones que consiguen casi eclipsar las del gran mentor; presentamos a los hijos de Tesla.

items.title: 25th Anniversary Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame Concerts
items.description: On three evenings in October of 2009, rock 'n' roll royalty held court at Madison Square Garden for what have been called “the best concerts ever." Featuring musical greats in combinations that will most likely never be witnessed again.

items.title: Mujeres piloto en la Segunda Guerra Mundial
items.description: Casi 80 años después de su desaparición, celebramos las conmovedoras vidas de las mujeres del W.A.S.P, aviadoras que después de la guerra fueron dejadas en el olvido.

items.title: Vida Electrónica
items.description: Desafortunadamente no hay un contenedor amarillo o verde para nuestros móviles viejos o portátiles obsoletos, sino uno marcado ‘fuera de occidente’. Caminamos por vertederos llenos de humos tóxicos que amenazan la salud.

items.title: La historia de Saturno V
items.description: El Saturno V permitió al hombre embarcar en la mayor aventura de exploración de su historia, mandar al hombre a la luna. Desde su diseño a su último lanzamiento en 1973, seguimos la historia del cohete más impresionante que ha creado el ser humano.

items.title: Vida Tras Las Estrellas
items.description: Un viaje personal para descubrir uno de los fenómenos más impresionantes y menos conocidos de la naturaleza: los rayos cósmicos. Una lluvia oculta de partículas súper energéticas que une nuestras vidas con fenómenos espectaculares.

items.title: Fanarquía
items.description: En un mundo donde el ser fan ya no significa tan sólo el ir al cine a ver una película, el fogoso mundo de los fandoms nos muestra sus obstáculos. Un talento que se ve forzado a esconderse a nivel mundial a costa de los gigantes de Hollywood.

items.title: An Irish Story: This is My Home
items.description: Pursuing the American Dream in an RV, rambunctious guitar-slinging, pint-drinking Irish immigrant band The Black Donnellys connect with fans through music on a whirlwind road trip to play in all 50 states breaking the Guinness World Record.

items.title: Christmas On Chestnut Street
items.description: A store decides to start a contest to sell off 60,000 Xmas lights, ordered by accident. The competition soon causes unrest among the locals, but the Store's owner, Diane, wants to keep what has become a very profitable competition going, at all costs

items.title: A Miracle On Christmas Lake
items.description: A teen boy struggles with hockey and friends, after he loses his best friend and Dad around Christmas. When an ice rink magically appears on the frozen lake near his home, he reminisces the good times.

items.title: All Between Us
items.description: An engaged couple gathers family and friends together. This celebration turns into disaster as secrets surface. One night, one mistake, one dinner unravels the lives of four people forever.

items.title: Eat Local
items.description: With their glory days long gone and facing difficult times, the eight undisputed British vampire overlords gather for their semi-centennial meeting. When vampire killers close in, chaos ensues.

items.title: Cassidy Red
items.description: A woman returns to her hometown when her lover is killed by her scornful ex-fiancé, seeking bloodthirsty retribution. Torn between love, hate, loyalty, and vengeance, her path to seek satisfaction widens out of her control.

items.title: Beatles: How The Beatles Changed The World
items.description: A fascinating story of the cultural, social, spiritual and musical revolution that was ignited by The Beatles, with revealing interviews and rarely-seen archival footage of the band.

items.title: Finding Happiness
items.description: While visiting a spiritual community in northern California an investigative journalist with a fair amount of skepticism and a dash of curiosity discovers that the key to finding happiness comes from within and when you change, everything changes.

items.title: My First Miracle
items.description: In this heartwarming inspirational film, a teenage girl battling cancer hopes to find her first true love. Destiny brings her together with a runaway. Together they witness a miracle and a love deeper than she could have ever expected.

items.title: Manson: Music From An Unsound Mind
items.description: The untold story of Charles Manson’s obsession to become a rock star, his rise in the LA music scene, the celebrities who championed his music and his descent into violence once his dreams fell apart.

items.title: Walt Before Mickey
items.description: The true story of a boy whose dreams built a kingdom. The legendary Walt Disney had a tumultuous childhood, yet he was determined to over come obstacles in his path, before the creation of his first iconic character: Mickey Mouse.

items.title: Hunt for Truth
items.description: Everything that power attorney Kerry Evans knows about her past is irreversibly changed when she uncovers the sordid history of her boss and his involvement in the disappearance of a mysterious woman.

items.title: Pure Country 2: The Gift
items.description: Three angels bestow the gift of song to a young girl, who must follow a series of rules in order hold on to it during her rise to fame and fortune.

items.title: Tuscaloosa
items.description: Alabama, 1972. While Billy falls for a patient at his father's mental asylum, his best friend becomes involved in a radical civil rights movement against Tuscaloosa's power elite.

items.title: Trash Dance
items.description: Sometimes inspiration is found in unexpected places. Choreographer Allison Orr finds beauty and grace in garbage trucks—and in the men and women who pick up our trash. At first they are reluctant; "This lady’s crazy!" Orr persists, riding out with ske...

items.title: Demon City Shinjuku
items.description: A young warrior battles against a city overtaken by demons, one devil at a time. To save Tokyo from evil, he must defeat a sinister psychic from the underworld.

items.title: A Wind Named Amnesia
items.description: In this anime classic, a powerful wind has left all memories erased. Two years later, a young man travels on a journey to find the truth about the apocalyptic wind.

items.title: Deep in the Valley
items.description: A mysterious video booth transports two friends to an alternate reality straight out of a pornographic film.

items.title: Harriet Tubman: They Called Her Moses
items.description: This compelling documentary narrated by Alfrelynn Roberts features expert interviews with leading scholars.

items.title: Battle Of The Atlantic: Greyhound vs Wolfpack
items.description: Western Approaches is a vast area of ocean control covering thousands of square miles of the Atlantic. In these waters is set this single incident in the fiercest and longest sea battle in history.

items.title: Gutterbug
items.description: A crust punk named Bug grapples with the realities of homelessness, mental health, drug use and toxic friendships. On his 21st birthday he resolves to find his way home, a decision that leads him and his misfit crew down a dangerous path.

items.title: The Midnight Man
items.description: An assassin with a genetic disorder that renders him unable to feel pain is attacked, and his world is turned upside-down when he awakens to discover that he can feel pain for the first time in his life.

items.title: Arthur Newman
items.description: A story of a man who fakes his own death and assumes a new identity in order to escape his life, who then moves in with a woman who is also trying to leave her past behind.

items.title: American Violence
items.description: Fascinated by the causes of violence, Dr. Amanda Tyler, interviews and analyzes death row inmate Jack Shea. As the interview begins, and Jack's fate hangs in the balance, Amanda must decide if a stay of execution should be granted.

items.title: 3 Bellezas
items.description: Perla es madre de tres hijos: Carolina, Stefania y Salvador. Está obsesionada con convertir a una de sus hijas en reina de belleza y cumplir su propio sueño de infancia. Pero su deseo y obsesión fomentan la competencia entre sus hijas desde pequeña.

items.title: The Real Merlin
items.description: His name conjures up images of a golden age of magic, mystery, and chivalry. Of Camelot and the search for the Holy Grail, King Arthur and his Knights of the Round Table. But is there any truth behind the myth of Merlin, a man beyond the legend?

items.title: The Mystery Of Masonic Music
items.description: This film attempts to get to the bottom of the secretive world of the freemasons through their famous composer members such as Haydn, Mozart, Lortzing and Liszt, Duke Ellington and Irving Berlin, and succeeds in uncovering some surprising insights.

items.title: Boys of Summer
items.description: Curacao has sent their little league team to the World Series for seven consecutive years. While these children carry a nation's pride, they're also athletes competing at the highest level and having a great time.

items.title: The True Story of John Dillinger
items.description: Michael Mann directed his latest movie Public Enemies, with Johnny Depp as the famous gangster John Dillinger.

items.title: Wrestling with Life
items.description: After losing his twin brother to cancer, Dave Nowick is left to fulfill his brother's parting wish, "Take care of our wrestling club.

items.title: Sasquatch Gang
items.description: When fantasy/sci-fi aficionado Gavin (Jeremy Sumpter) ventures into the woods, he stumbles onto some mammoth footprints and a large turd. Could this be the infamous Sasquatch or just another one of Zerk's (Justin Long) ludicrous pranks?

items.title: Yowamushi Pedal Re:RIDE
items.description: Experience the first season of Yowamushi Pedal in Re:RIDE, a compilation movie to get you pumped for Yowamushi Pedal Grande Road.

items.title: Yowamushi Pedal Re:ROAD
items.description: Re:ROAD highlights the best of Yowamushi Pedal Grande Road in this non-stop compilation movie.

items.title: Katrina Cop in the Superdome
items.description: Local black celebrities, New Orleans Police and other residents discuss the things they experienced at the Louisiana Superdome during and after Hurricane Katrina.

items.title: Warning Shot
items.description: A single mother and her young daughter struggle to make ends meet until they inherit their family's farmhouse. When a business rival covets their water rights, the situation spirals out of control.

items.title: Arctic Apocalypse
items.description: A massive influx of glacial melting triggers a new ice age in the Northern Hemisphere, forcing a family to make their away the across ice-covered landscape before they are frozen out for good.

items.title: Clown (The Asylum)
items.description: A group of teens fights for their lives as they find themselves trapped in a funhouse, stalked by a killer clown who won't rest until every last one of them is dead.

items.title: The Final Level: Escaping Rancala
items.description: When an arcade manager realizes her brother has been transported into a dangerous video game, she and her two best friends follow him into the virtual world.

items.title: 40 Kids by 20 Women
items.description: What’s it like to have fathered more than 40 children? How do you provide for them, what kind of legacy will you leave?

items.title: Drama Drama
items.description: The most unlikely pairing of teen-age girls end up bonding to form the pop group Drama Drama, and make a stand against bullying in their high school.

items.title: Murder Rap: Inside The Biggie and Tupac Murders
items.description: The inside story behind the Biggie and Tupac murder investigations is laid bare using police case files, taped confessions never before shown on film.

items.title: Pity of War, The: Poets at the Front
items.description: The lives and works of Siegfried Sassoon and Wilfred Owen, renowned poets who both fought on the front lines during WWI.

items.title: The Accountant of Auschwitz
items.description: Seventy years after WWII, Oskar Gröning, one of the last surviving members of the SS, goes on trial as an accessory to the murder of 300,000 people at the Auschwitz concentration camp.

items.title: I Am the Blues
items.description: I AM THE BLUES takes you on a journey through the swamps of the Louisiana and the juke joints of the Mississippi Delta. The film visits blues musicians rooted in the genre's heyday still living in the deep south and touring the Chitlin' Circuit.

items.title: Hands of God
items.description: Executive produced by Academy Award winner Alfonso Cuarón, HANDS OF GOD is a stirring portrait of resilience in the face of crisis, as it follows the Iraqi National Boxing Team's historic attempt to qualify for the 2016 Summer Olympics.

items.title: Apocalypse of Ice
items.description: Already in the throes of a viral pandemic, a massive polar vortex threatens to cover nearly all of Earth in ice.

items.title: Elf Quest
items.description: A boastful elf and his prank-happy orc brother must learn to work together to stop a fiendish orc gang from retrieving a magical stone that will give them the power to take over the world.

items.title: Nature's Grave
items.description: In an effort to revive their stale marriage, Peter (Jim Caviezel) and Marcia (Claudia Karvan) go camping on a remote Australian beach.

items.title: Monster Hunters
items.description: When an alien prison ship crash lands and unleashes creature after creature in the California desert, they make quick work of the army that tries to stop them.

items.title: Monster Island
items.description: As the world tries to stop a giant Kaiju bent on destruction more and more monsters appear - each one more terrible than the last - leaving mankind defenseless until our heroes reach out to a specialist versed in monster lore.

items.title: Dinosaur Island
items.description: Four teens cast in a plot for a 'Survivor' type TV series end up on a hidden island-like mesa, deep in the jungle, on which dinosaurs and cavemen still live. They must grow up fast and learn to trust one another if they are to make it out alive.

items.title: Collision Earth
items.description: A giant asteroid threatens to destroy Earth after military protocols designed to stop the impact fail.

items.title: Arranged
items.description: Rochel is an Orthodox Jew and Nasira a Muslim. Both are going through the process of arranged marriages. With family pressure on the one hand and the outside world’s rejection of traditional values on the other, they rely their friendship to pull through.

items.title: Miss Conception
items.description: A 33-year-old woman realizes that her partner doesn't want children, but is still determined to reproduce.

items.title: Treasure Island
items.description: Robert Louis Stevenson's high-seas adventure tale of an orphaned boy, a mysterious map, a devilish island, buried treasure, and the peg-legged, parrot-toting, cut-throat of a pirate who befriends him, Long John Silver.

items.title: Respeto (2017)
items.description: Hendrix (Abra), an aspiring young rapper from the slums strikes an unlikely friendship with Doc (Dido de La Paz), a poet who has long abandoned his art. They turn to each other trying not to be swallowed by their circumstances.

items.title: Paul Rodriguez: Just for the Record
items.description: Paul Rodriguez gives a recap of his story in jokes.

items.title: The Ramen Girl
items.description: An American adrift and abandoned by her boyfriend in Tokyo finds her calling in an unlikely place: a local ramen house run by a tyrannical chef who doesn't speak of a word of English.

items.title: Courage
items.description: An adventure story about an aspiring author and his family, who crash their boat during a storm, becoming stranded on a small rocky island in the middle of a treacherous river.

items.title: Damage
items.description: Recently released from prison, John Brickner (Austin) is ready to leave violence behind him. But when he learns that the young daughter of the man he killed can't afford the heart transplant she needs to save her life, he knows he must fight again.

items.title: Desperate Hours
items.description: Police Chief Martha Geiger is determined to find Larsan, the man responsible for the kidnapping of two teenage girls, Katie and Debra. The girls are able to outsmart their kidnapper and stay alive.

items.title: Hunt To Kill (Apple Tree)
items.description: U.S. Border patrol agent Jim Rhodes is a tough divorce mourning the loss of his murdered partner while struggling to raise his rebellious daughter in the mountains of Montana.

items.title: A Father's Choice
items.description: An unforgettable story about the promise and the power of family. Following the death of their mother, 13-year old Kelly and her 10-year-old sister Chris must leave the city to live with their estranged father Charlie Mac McClain.

items.title: A Mother's Sacrifice
items.description: A mother fears that her daughter has been abducted when a phone call is interrupted by something suspicious.

items.title: Midnight Stallion
items.description: Fifteen-year-old Megan Shephard and her parents will do anything to save their struggling farm. When they discover a wild stallion in a nearby forest they begin to wonder if this could be the answer to their prayers…a heartwarming and inspiring tale.

items.title: Recoil
items.description: The age-old battle of good versus evil plays out in the town of Hope, Washington when mysterious stranger Ryan Varrett (Steve Austin) blows in with nothing on his mind but vengeance.

items.title: Tactical Force
items.description: During a training exercise in a remote airplane hangar, Captain Tate (Steve Austin) and his team stumble upon a covert meeting between two rival gangs hunting a rare and valuable item. Both fiendish gangs will kill anyone who gets in their way.

items.title: Contraband
items.description: Luca Di Angelo is an idealistic family man and cigarette smuggler in the treacherous Naples underworld. But when a rival gang massacres his brother and abducts his wife, Luca triggers a psychotic mob war that goes far beyond mere revenge.

items.title: Soundtrek Everest
