items.description: After two years of planning, months of training, and a 12 day hike to 18,000 feet, Paul Oakenfold and his team threw the highest party on earth for 300 locals and visitors, traveling from Kathmandu, Nepal to Base Camp at Mount Everest in April of 2017.

items.title: Crazy Legs Conti: Zen And The Art Of Competitive Eating
items.description: Crazy Legs Conti dedicates himself to fulfilling his lifelong dream of becoming a professional competitive eater. Does he have the eating prowess to earn a spot at the Super Bowl of Competitive Eating - Nathan's Coney Island Hot Dog Eating Contest?

items.title: A Blade in the Dark
items.description: Bruno is hired to compose the music for a new horror movie and rents an isolated villa to concentrate on his work. But when several beautiful young women are brutally murdered within the house, Bruno becomes obsessed with solving the savage crimes.

items.title: Four Of The Apocalypse
items.description: Having survived a vigilante slaughter, four hard-luck strangers escape into the lawless frontier. But when they meet a sadistic bandit named Chaco, the four are plunged into a nightmare of torture, brutality and beyond.

items.title: Macabre
items.description: In this horrific tale, a New Orleans wife and mother carries on a torrid affair behind her family's back. But when a violent accident leaves her lover dead, the woman returns from a mental institution determined to pursue her forbidden desires.

items.title: How To Kill A Judge
items.description: Franco Nero stars as Giacomo Solaris, a director whose latest film depicts a prominent Sicilian judge as being on the Mafia's payroll. But when the actual judge is found murdered, Solaris begins his own investigation.

items.title: Venom
items.description: A sexy maid, a psychotic chauffeur and an international terrorist kidnap a wealthy ten-year old boy from his London townhouse. But they didn't count on one very unexpected houseguest: a furious Black Mamba, the most lethal and aggressive snake known.

items.title: The Blood Spattered Bride
items.description: A young bride marries into a family with a dark secret and quickly becomes haunted by dreams of a mysterious woman. When her visions become flesh, the newlywed finds herself drawn into a nightmare of unholy communion, violent murder and forbidden desires.

items.title: The Big Racket
items.description: Inspector Nico Palmieri is a tough police detective tearing apart Rome to bust a ruthless protection racket. But when these violent thugs expand their empire into drugs, rape and murder, Nico throws away the rulebook to unleash his own brand of justice.

items.title: Mountain Of The Cannibal God
items.description: When her anthropologist husband disappears in New Guinea, Susan Stevenson convinces her colleague Dr. Edward Foster to lead her into the dark heart of the deadly jungle where the expedition is attacked and captured by a tribe of primitive natives.

items.title: Remember The Goal
items.description: A new female coach fresh out of college takes over the cross country program at an all girls Christian school and attempts to lead them to their first ever state title.

items.title: Me & You, Us, Forever
items.description: A 47 year old Christian man, on the other side of an unwanted divorce, thinks back and reminisces about his old high school girlfriend and first love of 30 years ago.

items.title: Cruel and Unusual
items.description: Cruel and Unusual' is the story of three men who have spent longer in solitary confinement than any other prisoners in the US because of the murder of a prison guard in 1972 at Angola.

items.title: Boxing: In and Out of the Ring
items.description: An investigative documentary that takes viewers inside the high-stakes business of boxing. It is an unprecedented look at the inner workings of the fight game from both sides of the ropes.

items.title: Roads
items.description: Two lost teenage boys, from Congo and Britain, meet in Morocco and take a road trip in a stolen RV to France, encountering poverty and refugees on the way.

items.title: Say My Name
items.description: When a one-night stand gets interrupted by a robbery, two complete strangers must help each other navigate the seedy underbelly of a Welsh island to recover their stolen property.

items.title: Heavy
items.description: Drug-dealer Sev and his equally broken girlfriend Maddie accept a risky deal from an old childhood friend, setting off an irreversible chain of events.

items.title: When Saturday Comes
items.description: Jimmy Muir is a hard-drinking brewery worker in the city of Sheffield, with an arrogant lack of respect for authority. Jimmy then has to consider his future and his choices and if he has the self discipline to succeed!

items.title: Before You Go
items.description: The imperfect lives of three sisters are revealed at their unloved mother's funeral.

items.title: Online Abduction
items.description: When Isabel's little brother is kidnapped while on her watch, she uses geotagged pictures to gather facts to help bring him home.

items.title: The Building
items.description: A woman discovers that one of her neighbors might be a murderer. The police are non-responsive and even her best friend Lily is skeptical. There is a killer in the building,but it's not who anyone expected.

items.title: Canal Street
items.description: After Kholi Styles becomes a suspect in the mysterious death of a classmate, it's up to his father to defend his son and battle an outraged public.

items.title: Ditto (2000)
items.description: In this classic romance with a time travel twist, two students at the same high school, 20 years apart, are somehow able to communicate through their ham radio sets.

items.title: Circus Of Fear
items.description: What begins as a daring daylight armored car heist on London's Tower Bridge leads to a sinister circus where a disfigured lion tamer is one of several suspects in a three-ring nightmare of red herrings, grisly 'accidents' and cold-blooded murder.

items.title: The Crazies
items.description: Its code name is Trixie, an experimental government germ weapon that leaves its victims either dead or irreversibly insane. And when the virus is accidentally unleashed in Evans City, PA, the small community becomes a war zone.

items.title: Dead & Buried
items.description: Something very strange is happening in the quiet coastal village of Potters Bluff, where tourists and transients are warmly welcomed... then brutally murdered. But even more shocking is when these slain strangers reappear as normal citizens around town.

items.title: Machine Gun McCain
items.description: After serving 12 years behind bars for armed robbery, tough guy Hank McCain finds himself the pawn of a ruthless mob runt's rebellion against a high level don. Not blood, nor lust, nor wedding vows can come between McCain and his money...or his machine gu

items.title: Mary Higgins Clark: A Crime of Passion
items.description: Freddie has everything -- a gorgeous new husband and half ownership of a winery. But when her business partner's wife is murdered, Freddi suspects her partner's new love. While searching for the truth, her new husband becomes a suspect.

items.title: Mary Higgins Clark: All Around Town
items.description: An innocent girl is kidnapped and held hostage for two years causing her to develop multiple personalities and making her the number one suspect when her English professor is brutally murdered.

items.title: Mary Higgins Clark: Before I Say Goodbye
items.description: Nell MacDermott loses her husband in a fiery boating accident and visits a psychic to connect with him again. But when she's informed that he was murdered, Nell is compelled to find the killer searching for an elusive witness.

items.title: Mary Higgins Clark: Haven't We Met Before
items.description: After attempting to murder a woman he's convinced tried to kill him in a past life, a man is committed to a hospital for the criminally insane, but a suspicious District Attorney is convinced that the man has killed before.

items.title: Mary Higgins Clark: He Sees You When You're Sleeping
items.description: Sterling Brooks, a self-absorbed stockbroker, is killed in a freak golfing accident. In order to secure a heavenly future, Sterling is given the opportunity to help a needy young girl reunite with her family in time for Christmas.

items.title: Mary Higgins Clark: Loves Music, Loves to Dance
items.description: New York's trendy magazines are a source of peril when a killer enacts a bizarre dance of death, using the personal ads to lure his victims.

items.title: Mary Higgins Clark: Pretend You Don't See Her
items.description: As she lay dying, a woman gives the only witness to her murder her daughter's journal, implying that her attacker may also be responsible for her child's death.

items.title: Brawl Busters
items.description: The cruel Tien Hu, with his many powerful alliances, oppresses an entire Chinese province, killing many of the hard-working citizens.

items.title: Mutant War
items.description: The sequel to Battle for the Lost Planet finds our hero Harry Trent wandering Earth's post-apocalyptic landscape full of mutants, monsters, and fragmented human tribes.

items.title: Slaughterhouse
items.description: A late-80s video store staple, Rick Roessler's SLAUGHTERHOUSE is a gleefully bloody San Diego slasher featuring atmospheric and noirish cinematography along with a generous helping of creative kills.

items.title: Space Babes from Outer Space
items.description: Three space babes land on Earth in search of sexual energy to fuel their interstellar spaceship and get back home. They befriend a lonely but handsome farmboy who helps them on their plight by getting them jobs as dancers at the local strip club.

items.title: Mary Higgins Clark: Lucky Day
items.description: Having the winning lottery jackpot ticket is the best thing that could have happened to delivery man Bill Regan - until he turns up dead with his wallet emptied.

items.title: A Dangerous Man
items.description: After years in special ops and wrongful imprisonment, a witness to the murder of a Chinese cop agrees to retrieve a kidnapped girl and a bag of money.

items.title: Beyond Dream's Door
items.description: Ben's nightmares come back to haunt him and his friends in this psychological/supernatural horror film.

items.title: Canadian Strain
items.description: When cannabis becomes legal in Canada, boutique weed dealer Anne Banting is swiftly run out of business by the biggest gangsters in town - the government.

items.title: Christmas Thieves
items.description: After a robbery goes wrong, Frank and Vince break into a home to avoid the cops. Liam and Olivia think that it’s their babysitters. Frank begins to read them stories from a magic book taking them to the enchanted world of 'Arctic Friends'.

items.title: Rainman Twins
items.description: This is the untold story of the only identical twin autistic savant sisters known to exist. Over a span of 50 years, Flo and Kay have memorized the world around them. You’ll never forget them…and they’ll never forget you.

items.title: Jupiter Enigma
items.description: What can the giant planet Jupiter tell us about the birth of our solar system five billion years ago? Drawing on new findings from NASA’s Juno mission, scientists are peering into Jupiter’s stormy heart to reveal the very origins of our solar system.

items.title: How China Got Rich
items.description: Over the last 40 years, China has been transformed out of all recognition. How did an impoverished and backward communist country become an engine of global capitalism? What lies ahead for this economic behemoth?

items.title: Mooz-lum
items.description: Amid a strict Muslim rearing and a social life he's never had, Tariq enters college confused. New peers, family and mentors help him find his place, but the 9-11 attacks force him to face his past and make the biggest decisions of his life.

items.title: Chicago at the Crossroad
items.description: Where did Chicago go wrong? Chicago at the Crossroad tells the story of a city caught in the aftermath of a policy of mass displacement shaded by a long history of segregation.

items.title: Jennifer Aniston: More than Friends
items.description: There are multiple levels to global superstar actress Jennifer Aniston. Yet the road to success did not come without its challenges. Aniston radiates a vulnerable warmth both on and off-screen that keeps her audience loyal.

items.title: Will Smith: The Prince of Hollywood
items.description: Fans forever love Will Smith, who are reassured they will always be entertained. Follow the journey of this fascinating actor, producer, husband, father, who has the WILL to win.

items.title: Basil
items.description: Un joven aristócrata solitario en la Inglaterra de principios de siglo lucha por encontrar la aprobación de su padre autoritario y consciente de la clase, mientras trata de complacer a la mujer egoísta que ama.

items.title: Mi último suicidio
items.description: El poeta beat Neal Cassady es arrastrado entre dos mujeres: María, una adolescente tentadora, y Juana, su primer amor verdadero. Basado en la carta de Casady a Jack Kerouac.

items.title: Hiroshima: Out Of The Ashes
items.description: El 6 de agosto de 1945, la primera bomba atómica explotó sobre Hiroshima. Esta es la historia real de unos pocos estadounidenses, europeos y japoneses que lucharon por sobrevivir al ataque más devastador de la historia.

items.title: Preparatoria U.S.A.
items.description: Mayor J.J. Manners navega por las camarillas y rivalidades que conlleva la escuela secundaria, todo mientras persigue a Beth Franklin, quien resulta ser la novia del mariscal de campo y presidenta de la clase.

items.title: Freeway (ESP)
items.description: Intentando huir de su vida, la delincuente juvenil adolescente Vanessa Lutz se va a vivir con su abuela. En su camino, conoce a Bob Wolverton, un asesino en serie encantador pero sádico.

items.title: Sueños mortales
items.description: Una mujer tiene visiones sobre una serie de asesinatos, apuntando hacia un asesino en serie que ahora la ha puesto en la mira. Debe trabajar con la policía para resolver el rompecabezas antes de ser la próxima víctima.

items.title: Más allá de la máscara
items.description: Un mercenario de la Compañía Británica de las Indias Orientales ha llegado a las colonias americanas. Trabajando para redimir su nombre, William ahora se esconde detrás de una máscara con la esperanza de frustrar a su antiguo empleador.

items.title: Christmas in Carolina
items.description: Elle, a career-driven investment banker, has given up on love until she meets Wesley who invites Elle to his hometown in South Carolina. There she falls in love and finds the spirit of Christmas again.

items.title: The Man Who Skied Down Everest
items.description: This Oscar-winning film features adventurer, poet, and world champion skier Yuichiro Miura in his attempt to ski down Mount Everest from its summit.

items.title: Tregua de Navidad
items.description: Un soldado americano y una Belga se enamoran durante un festivo de tregua, en medio de una de las batallas de la 2da Guerra Mundial. Cuando vuelven al campo de guerra, prometen reunirse en Navidad.

items.title: The World Without You
items.description: A family is brought together for the one-year anniversary of the death of their son Leo, a journalist killed while on assignment in Iraq. Dark secrets emerge, threatening to tear the fragile threads that are holding the family together.

items.title: Alicia a través del espejo
items.description: In this classic tale, Alice falls through a mirror and arrives in a wonderful place called Chessland. Along the way, Alice meets friends like Tweedledee, and foes like Jabberwock and Bandersnatch.

items.title: El hechizo de un hada
items.description: Before bedtime, a writer reads his fantastical fairytales to his daughter. When an actual fairy flies to the windowsill one night to listen, an unfortunate development leaves her grown to human size.

items.title: Los papeles póstumos del Club Pickwick
items.description: Samuel Pickwick desea respuestas. Viaja a la parte oscura de la sociedad inglesa para descubrir por qué la gente es como es. A lo largo del camino, se encuentra con personajes coloridos, mujeres hermosas y peligros.

items.title: Sherlock Holmes y la maldición de Baskerville
items.description: El Dr. Mortimer no está satisfecho con el veredicto del forense, según el cual la muerte de Sir Charles Baskerville en los páramos fue causada por un ataque cardíaco. Por eso, contrata a Sherlock Holmes para que lo investigue.

items.title: Sherlock Holmes: Estudio en escarlata
items.description: Con solo un anillo de bodas y la palabra 'Rache' grabada en la escena del crimen como pistas para la investigación, Sherlock Holmes lidera la búsqueda de un asesino que está empeñado en vengarse.

items.title: Historia de dos ciudades
items.description: The most telling tale of the selfless Englishman who generously gave his life for one courageous French nobleman during the turbulent days of the French Revolution.

items.title: Regreso a la isla del tesoro
items.description: Después de que la posada "Benbow" es asediada por bucaneros liderados por Blind Pew, el joven Jim Hawkins descubre el mapa del tesoro del capitán Billy Bones. Jim se embarca en "La Hispaniola" para descubrir el tesoro.

items.title: El reino escondido
items.description: Cuando un niño curioso descubre accidentalmente una magnífica ciudad en miniatura situada detrás del fregadero de la cocina, él y su hermano adolescente y hermana son transportados a una tierra extraña.

items.title: David Copperfield
items.description: From the pages of Dickens's book to this charming animated retelling, David Copperfield remains a timeless classic about a gentle orphan who discovers life and love in an indifferent adult world.

items.title: Llamada para un asesinato
items.description: Una mujer descubre que uno de sus vecinos podría ser un asesino. Sin embargo, la policía no le presta atención y su mejor amiga no le cree. Pero hay un asesino en el edificio, y no es el que todos imaginan.

items.title: Recoil (ESP)
items.description: Despues del asesinato de su familia John Varrett, policia, va en busca de los criminales y ejerce la justicia a esos criminales.

items.title: Pure Country 2: The Gift (LAS)
items.description: Tres ángeles le dan el don del canto a una niña y una serie de reglas a seguir para su fama y fortuna.

items.title: Final Girl (ESP)
items.description: Veronica está entrenando para ser una asesina y un grupo de chicos que la llevan al bosque con intenciones de asesinarla a ella, se encuentran con esta sorpresa. Serán ellos su presa.

items.title: Anna Nicole (LAS)
items.description: Anna Nicole Smith pasó de ser una madre soltera a los 17 años, a convertirse en un símbolo sexual. Se casa con un billonario de 63 años, lucha por su herencia y sufre la muerte de su hijo de 39 años.

items.title: Una milla en sus pies
items.description: Murph es un entrenador de béisbol y está en busca de nuevo talento para su liga de menores. Descubre a Mickey quien sufre del Síndrome de Asperger y quien es un lanzador increíble.

items.title: ¿Qué haría Jesús? 2: El tallador de madera
items.description: Matthew es un chico rebelde que destruye la iglesia que su padre está renovando como carpintero. Trabajando se dan cuenta que todo es posible con fe, familia y amistad.

items.title: A Chorus Line
items.description: After narrowing down hundreds of Broadway hopefuls, choreographer Zach (Michael Douglas) leads a select group of dancers on an audition that could change their lives forever in this stunning adaptation of the hit Broadway musical.

items.title: Alias Jesse James
items.description: In this hilarious western spoof, insurance broker Milford Farnsworth (Bob Hope) unwittingly sells a life insurance policy worth $100,000 to the infamous Jesse James. Now, he has to figure out how to keep the deadliest outlaw in history alive!

items.title: Clara's Ghost
items.description: Aging comedian Chris Elliott and his wife (Paula Niedert Elliott) invite their daughters (Bridey Elliott, Abby Elliott) home to celebrate a birthday. While Ted and the girls rehash old wounds, Clara begins to see a spirit that no one else does.

items.title: Electra Glide In Blue
items.description: In this visually stunning cult classic, when good-hearted motorcycle cop John Wintergreen (Robert Blake) is promoted to detective, he heads out on his bike, the Electra Glide, and makes a discovery that could cost him his life!

items.title: Good Guys Wear Black
items.description: Action superstar Chuck Norris stars as John T. Booker, the former leader of an elite commando unit who must uncover the reason why his former squad members are being systematically murdered one by one. Anne Archer and James Franciscus co-star.

items.title: Species: The Awakening
items.description: When Miranda Hollander suffers a strange blackout, she learns her true origin as a human-alien hybrid and becomes locked in battle with other hybrids. But time is running out…will she surrender to her own killer instincts in the search for a mate?

items.title: The Dunwich Horror
items.description: When a beautiful student named Nancy Wagner (Sandra Dee) catches the eye of the weird Wilbur Whateley (Dean Stockwell), her professor uncovers a buried secret – and a plot intended to call forth an evil beyond imagination. Daniel Haller directs.

items.title: West Side Story
items.description: Winner of ten Academy Awards including Best Picture, this electrifying musical sets the ageless tragedy of 'Romeo and Juliet' in the slums of 1950s New York and stars Natalie Wood, Richard Beymer, Russ Tamblyn, Rita Moreno, and George Chakiris.

items.title: Cazador de demonios
items.description: A cursed gunman (Wesley Snipes) whose victims come back from the dead recruits a young warrior to help in the fight against a gang of zombies.

items.title: The Santa Trap
items.description: Santa Claus winds up in jail after a 7-year-old sets a trap in order to prove his existence to her family.

items.title: Doc
items.description: Stacy Keach, Haris Yulin, and Faye Dunaway give riveting performances in this controversial and myth-shattering reexamination of the darker side of gunslinger Doc Holliday and the actions that led to the infamous showdown in Tombstone, Arizona.

items.title: Burnt Offerings
items.description: Karen Black, Oliver Reed, and Bette Davis star in this riveting haunted-house chiller that delivers hidden terrors as a family finds itself surrounded by an evil, hypnotic living presence that feeds on torture, fear and murder. Dan Curtis directs.

items.title: Hour Of The Gun
items.description: Director John Sturges presents a reworking of the Wyatt Earp/Doc Holliday legend and the struggle for political control of Tombstone, with a marvelous trio of antagonists: James Garner as Earp, Jason Robards as Holliday, and Robert Ryan as Clanton.

items.title: Man of the West
items.description: Screen legend Gary Cooper demonstrates why he will always be remembered as one of the most authentic stars of the screen. Capable yet vulnerable, Cooper's portrayal of a former outlaw whose past returns to haunt him ranks among his very best.

items.title: Shake Hands With The Devil
items.description: James Cagney stars in this action-packed tale of the struggle between the Irish Republican Army and the British Black and Tans, as an Irish-American medical student (Don Murray) takes up arms with the rebellion after losing his best friend!

items.title: The Manchurian Candidate
items.description: Frank Sinatra, Laurence Harvey, Janet Leigh, and Angela Lansbury headline an all-star cast in this daring thriller rife with political intrigue, mental manipulation, and a diabolical plot that may lead to the highest levels of the government.

items.title: My Zoe
items.description: Isabelle is a geneticist recovering from a broken marriage and raising her only daughter, Zoe, with her toxic ex-husband. When an unexpected tragedy strikes, Isabelle takes the girl’s fate into her own hands.

items.title: Wheely
items.description: In an imaginary world where vehicles are the citizens, one underdog cabbie attempts to become king of the road in his hometown, Gasket City. He soon discovers that staying true to oneself is a greater pursuit than personal glory.

items.title: Becks
items.description: After a crushing breakup with her girlfriend, a Brooklyn musician moves back in with her Midwestern mother. As she navigates her hometown, playing for tip money in an old friend's bar, an unexpected relationship begins to take shape.

items.title: Sugar Daddy
items.description: When a struggling musician can’t afford her rent, she signs up for a mysterious website where rich older men pay to date younger women. But her dreams become a nightmare when she is forced down a dark rabbit hole of sex and oppression.

items.title: Kill Zone
items.description: An inspector and his unit are after a crime boss and are willing to capture him at all costs. The crime boss enlists his top henchmen to end their dirty schemes.

items.title: Atardecer
items.description: En esta comedia hilarante y llena de acción, los mejores amigos Logan y Blake viajan a la destinación exótica de Puerto Vallarta para las vacaciones de primavera. Allí van a encontrar un paraíso de tequila con grandes problemas.

items.title: Terminator Genisys
items.description: When John Connor sends Kyle Reese back to 1984 to protect a young Sarah Connor, unexpected events alter the past and threaten the future of all mankind. Charged with a new mission, Reese must join forces with Sarah and her "Guardian" to save the world.

items.title: Haikara-San: Here Comes Miss Modern: Part 2 [Japanese-Language Version]
items.description: After marrying the head of the military, Benio hears her husband died in Siberia during a war. However after finding out he's alive and fighting against his home land, Benio starts looking for her first love.

items.title: Haikara-San: Here Comes Miss Modern: Part 1 [Japanese-Language Version]
items.description: Adapted from Waki Yamato's popular manga, Haikara-San is a heartfelt, and sometimes comical, tale of love surviving through the perils of war and separation.

items.title: Millennium Actress [Japanese-Language Version]
items.description: When the legendary Ginei Studios shuts down, filmmaker Genya Tachibana and his assistant are tasked with interviewing its reclusive star, Chiyoko Fujiwara, who had retired from the spotlight 30 years prior.

items.title: Liza In New Orleans
items.description: Liza Minnelli in concert at the New Orleans Theatre of the Performing Arts.

items.title: Liza With A "Z"
items.description: Liza Minnelli stars in a television concert directed and choreographed by Bob Fosse. She performs such songs as the title number, Liza with a Z and Son of a Preacher Man

items.title: Liza In London
items.description: Liza Minnelli in concert at the London Palladium.

items.title: Lucky Stiff
items.description: Based on the hit Off-Broadway musical. A young, down-and-out British shoe salesman (Dominic Marsh) learns that he’s inherited $6 million from an American uncle.

items.title: Iggy Azalea: Shock Value
items.description: One of the most unlikely crossover success stories, Blonde Australian Beauty Iggy Azalea transferred from a high-profile modeling career to become a Hip Hop superstar. Influenced in her childhood by Missy Elliot, TLC, and Tupac Shakur, she moved to the...

items.title: Bang Bang Baby
items.description: A small-town teenager in the 1960s believes her dreams of becoming a famous singer will come true when her rock star idol gets stranded in town. A leak in a nearby chemical plant that is believed to be causing mass mutations threatens to turn her dream...

items.title: Died Young, Stayed Pretty
items.description: Died Young, Stayed Pretty is a candid look at the underground poster culture in North America. This unique documentary examines the creative spirit that drives these indie graphic artists.

items.title: Sam Whiskey
items.description: Welcome to America's Wild - and very wacky - West! Burt Reynolds, Clint Walker, Ossie Davis and Angie Dickinson star in this tongue-in-cheek tale of love, lust and larceny as an amiable con-artist is hire by a sexy widow to break into the U.S. Mint.

items.title: Penguin Highway [Japanese-Language Version]
items.description: A fourth-grader, Aoyama-kun, investigates the mysterious reason behind the sudden appearance of penguins in his village, which is somehow related to a power from a young woman working at a dental clinic.

items.title: Sound! Euphonium: The Movie May The Melody Reach You! [Japanese-Language Version]
items.description: A recap movie of the second season of Sound! Euphonium (2015).

items.title: Sound! Euphonium: The Movie Welcome To The Kitauji High School Concert Band [Japanese-Language Version]
items.description: A recap movie of the first season of Sound! Euphonium (2015).

items.title: Drawing the Line - A Portrait of Keith Haring
items.description: The one and only portrait of Keith Haring. One of the most famous pop-artist of the 20th Century who died from AIDS at the age of 31 at the peak of his glory.

items.title: The Offence
items.description: Sean Connery delivers a devastatingly desperate performance as Detective-Sergeant Johnson, whose 20 years of handling murder, rape, and other violent cases culminate in a deadly loss of control during a routine interrogation. Ian Bannen co-stars.

items.title: The Healing Power of Psychedelics
items.description: For many years psychedelic drugs were banned, but now doctors are finding new uses for hallucinogens.

items.title: Chanel No 5
items.description: The revolutionary fragrance Channel N°5 is a true and unique symbol of elegance around the world. Go behind the scenes into the creation of this iconic scent.

items.title: 39 escalones
items.description: Un hombre en Londres intenta ayudar a un agente de contraespionaje.

items.title: Noche De Los Muertos Vivientes
items.description: Un grupo de jóvenes es perseguido por zombis carnívoros.

items.title: La Bestia
items.description: Nuevos amigos forman un equipo para luchar contra una bruja maligna.

items.title: A Christmas Without Snow
items.description: Sentimental holiday tale of a divorcee from San Francisco who moves to a small Nebraska town to start a new life. She joins the church choir that is under the strict leadership of a perfectionist director. Issues of age, racism, single parenthood arise.

items.title: La mansion de los horrores
items.description: Cinco personas aceptan ser encerradas durante la noche en una espeluznante mansión.

items.title: La casa roja
items.description: Un anciano y su hermana ocultan un terrible secreto.

items.title: Pequeña Tienda De Los Horrores
items.description: Un joven torpe nutre una planta para luego descubrir que es carnívora.

items.title: Black Hawk Down: The Untold Story
items.description: In October 1993, two U.S. Black Hawk helicopters were shot down in Mogadishu, Somalia. This is the true story of the 14th Infantry Regiment of the 10th Mountain Division that engaged in a ferocious fight to reach the soldiers and bring them home.

items.title: Forgotten Heroes: The Robert Hartsock Story
items.description: In Vietnam, over 10,000 American lives were saved by the actions of over 4,000 military working dogs and their handlers. This is the story of US Army SSgt Robert Hartsock, the only handler to have ever received the Medal of Honor.

items.title: Gone In 60 Seconds
items.description: Buckle-up as Eleanor, the fast and furious Ford Fastback Mustang, takes you on a full-throttle ride you'll never forget. The Assignment: To steal 48 muscle and exotic cars! The Challenge: Avoid getting caught!

items.title: Kid West
items.description: Harper is a precious 12-year-old, armed with a slingshot and her wits. She's on a mission to protect a mystical treasure from falling into the hands of a gang of bullies.

items.title: Legend Of The American Sniper
items.description: One who sacrifices for the greater good of his comrades, and the greater good of his country, is the American sniper. The sniper is the man of myth and legend. Few can measure up to what it takes to become a sniper.

items.title: Never Surrender: The Ed Ramsey Story
items.description: A story of heroism, and reconciliation. Lt. Edwin P. Ramsey made history as the last mounted horse cavalry charge in U.S. military history. Refusing to surrender, he joined the Filipino resistance and commanded 40,000 guerilla warriors.

items.title: Picasso Trigger
items.description: When agent Picasso Trigger is killed by arch-criminal Miguel Ortiz, the Agency decides to send a trio of female agents out with the task of bringing Ortiz down. Our agents must use all of their skills in order to track down Trigger's killer.

items.title: Return To Tarawa: The Leon Cooper Story
items.description: Depicting a WWII veteran, Leon Cooper, as he returns to the Tarawa battle site after learning that many of his countrymen, who died in the battle, still lie where they fell sixty-six years later. Narrated by Ed Harris

items.title: All American High Revisited
items.description: We spend a year with the Class of '84 - an era of neon fashion, punk posing and Princess Di hairdos. Flash forward three decades to those same students reflecting back at their teen selves with fond, bittersweet memories.

items.title: La Última Vez Que VI París
items.description: Un periodista estadounidense regresa a París, una ciudad que le dio verdadero amor y profundo dolor.

items.title: Mesa de mujeres perdidas
items.description: Un científico loco está creando arañas y gnomos gigantes en su laboratorio.

items.title: Mesías Del Mal
items.description: Una joven busca a su padre artista desaparecido.

items.title: Un cubo de sangre
items.description: Un estúpido impostor pretende ser artista.

items.title: Vestida Para Matar
items.description: Sherlock Holmes persigue a un trío de villanos asesinos.

items.title: El pequeño Tate
items.description: Jodie Foster makes her directorial debut and stars, along with Dianne Wiest, in this life-affirming drama about a single mother and her son, a child prodigy who feels isolated, lost and lonely…until Dede realizes what Fred’s needed all along.

items.title: Adiós Las Vegas
items.description: Nicolas Cage garnered a Best Actor Academy Award® for his hauntingly disturbing portrayal of a suicidal alcoholic who falls for a compassionate Las Vegas prostitute (Elisabeth Shue) in one of 1995's most critically acclaimed films.

items.title: Los enredos de Wanda
items.description: Four conniving jewel thieves...three Yorkshire terriers...two heaving bosoms...one proper British barrister and a fortune in jewels all add up to an outrageously funny farce starring John Cleese, Michael Palin, Kevin Kline and Jamie Lee Curtis.

items.title: Dance Flick
items.description: Street dancer Thomas Uncles is from the wrong side of the tracks, but his bond with the beautiful Megan White might help the duo realize their dreams as they enter into the mother of all dance battles.

items.title: Hardball
items.description: An aimless young man who is scalping tickets, gambling and drinking, agrees to coach a Little League team from the Cabrini Green housing project in Chicago as a condition of getting a loan from a friend.

items.title: 12 Angry Men
items.description: Eleven jurors are convinced that the defendant is guilty of murder. The twelfth has no doubt of his innocence. How can this one man steer the others toward the same conclusion? Henry Fonda and Lee J. Cobb lead the all-star cast in this classic!

items.title: American Heist
items.description: James (Hayden Christensen) and his older brother Frankie (Adrien Brody) turn to underworld connections in hopes that one last heist will be the answer to change both of their lives.

items.title: Between Worlds
items.description: Nicolas Cage delivers a dynamic performance as a struggling truck driver whose life spirals out of control after the spirit of his deceased wife comes to life in another's body.

items.title: Hot Tub Time Machine
items.description: Four buddies share a wild night of drinking in a ski resort hot tub and wake up with hangovers in 1986! Now, they’ll need the help of a one-armed bellhop and a hot tub repairman to survive the crazy 80’s, but it may change their future forever!

items.title: Falling for Christmas
items.description: When champion figure skater Claire becomes injured she is sent to a rehabilitation center in the snowy mountains where she meets and falls for a local ice fisherman who shows her there is more to life than competition.

items.title: Christopher Plummer: A Man For All Stages
items.description: Christopher Plummer has played a thousand parts - from Shakespeare to Broadway, from radio to television to Hollywood.But beneath that elegant stage presence lies the restless heart of a risk-taker.

items.title: Finding Atlantis
items.description: Atlantis. The name echoes through the ages like a magic spell. Did it really exist? Where is it? Are there any remaining artifacts that can tell us what it was really like? Who were the Atlanteans? Is it all myth, or is it historical fact?

items.title: Isonzo: The War In The Mountains
items.description: The river Soca region in Slovenia is scarred with traces of the first world war. This documentary explores how events over 100 years ago shape the region today.

items.title: Street Fighter II: The Animated Movie
items.description: Based on the legendary video game series. This anime classic follows Ryu, a talented fighter who may be the greatest in all of the world, and Bison, the evil mastermind searching for Ryu's talents.

items.title: Missing in Action
items.description: American servicemen are still being held captive in Vietnam – and it's up to one man to bring them home in this blistering, fast-paced action/adventure starring martial arts superstar Chuck Norris.

items.title: Missing in Action 2: The Beginning
items.description: Chuck Norris returns as James Braddock in this action-packed prequel to the original hit film. As war rages in Vietnam, Braddock and his men are captured and imprisoned. With fists and sheer courage, he must become an army of one to save his men.

items.title: Desaparecido en combate
items.description: Militares estadounidenses siguen cautivos en Vietnam, y depende de un solo hombre llevarlos a casa en esta trepidante aventura de acción protagonizada por la superestrella de las artes marciales Chuck Norris.

items.title: Inside the War on ISIS
items.description: Filmmakers embedded with Iraqi forces document The Battle Of Mosul, the deadliest battle since WWII.

items.title: I Am Dragon
items.description: In the midst of the wedding princess, Miroslava is kidnapped by a dragon and carried away into his castle on the remote island.

items.title: Queen Of Spades
items.description: A tenor in an opera is given the chance of a lifetime when a famous opera diva joins his troupe.

items.title: Sleeping Dogs Lie
items.description: A recently engaged woman's life is thrown into turmoil after confessing to her fiancé that she once experimented with bestiality.

items.title: Tiempo de morir
items.description: Christian Bale, Freddy Rodriguez and Eva Longoria star in this gritty look at friendship, loyalty and ambition set on the rough streets of South-Central Los Angeles as an ex-Army Ranger (Bale) attempts to come to terms with life after the military.

items.title: Richard the Lionheart - The Trapped King
items.description: The story of King Richard, passionate, violent king who wielded Excalibur.

items.title: Faith, Life & Death: Thirty Years of War Part 1
items.description: Examines how the 30 Year War began and ravaged Europe, and how this war is affecting us today.

items.title: Fifty Shades Of Rosé
items.description: From the south of France to Napa Valley, California; from Cape Town, South Africa to Shanghai, on China's central coast, Rosé has earned its place at the pinnacle of the world of wine. What secret recipe lies behind these pink bottles' success?

items.title: Greencard Warriors
items.description: The tragic struggle of an undocumented Latino family in Los Angeles after they have sent their eldest son to war.

items.title: Brexitannia
items.description: A sociological portrait of the United Kingdom after the historic Brexit vote of 2016. A funny, sometimes terrifying and non-judgemental look at the new populist politics sweeping western democracies.

items.title: My Awkward Sexual Adventure
items.description: Desperate for sex tips after his girlfriend dumps him, an uptight accountant meets a beautiful stripper who expands his horizons, complete with trips to massage parlors, S&M toys and cross-dressing in this sweet yet raunchy comedy.

items.title: Ely Kahn - New York City's Mastermind
items.description: His is not a name many people know, but his buildings in Manhattan are legendary: Ely Jacques Kahn. Designing over 60 skyscrapers, he is responsible for the iconic Manhattan skyline.

items.title: The Age Of Anxiety
items.description: Anxiety. It’s being called the disease of the 21st century. The Age of Anxiety examines what anxiety is, and how and why it is being re-defined by medical and pharmaceutical industries.

items.title: The Fall of the Habsburgs
items.description: The Habsburg Dynasty had ruled large parts of Europe and the world for 650 years. During World War I, however, the mighty Austro-Hungarian Empire sowed the seeds of its own demise, and quickly crumbled.

items.title: Zero Charisma
items.description: In this darkly comedic ode to nerds from every realm, a passionate Game Master of a fantasy role-playing game becomes unhinged when a charismatic hipster joins his group, disrupting the balance of power with an unexpected coup.

items.title: El tercer deseo
items.description: Eugenio despierta de una borrachera y descubre cerca una tetera de metal. Cuando la toca, se le aparece el espectro de un duende que le ofrece tres deseos. Eugenio comprobará que los deseos le han sido concedidos pero de forma equivocada.

items.title: Toque de queda
items.description: La violencia se ha convertido en un virus. Las personas se esconden y se protegen, pero la seguridad es cada vez más frágil y todos parecen estar infectados. El barrio decide armarse y defenderse.

items.title: Super Furball
items.description: A young girl's ordinary life is turned upside down when she acquires a secret superpower from her pet guinea pig.

items.title: Windstorm 3

items.description: Buckle-up and blast-off with your favorite space heroes, as the mischievous Fuzzlumps Fritz and Blitz — along with many colorful friends and foes alike — fight to save the galaxy from the dreaded Balderdash Bug virus! But, can they do it?

items.title: Fish School: Adventures with Jellyfish
items.description: Fish School is in session! Professor Shark has a new lesson for the little ones: they are going to learn all about glowing, gooey, graceful and giant... jellyfish! It’s Fish School: Adventures With Jellyfish!

items.title: Gadget Heads: Learn About Robots
items.description: Join mega smart space cadets Scrap and Hub of the robotic fleet Gadget Heads for a journey of learning and discovery like never before! This time around, the duo embarks on a mighty adventure to meet and learn about amazing robots!

items.title: Game On: The History Of Basketball
items.description: Sportscasters Bill 'Foul Play' O’Connel, and his feisty giraffe co-anchor Tony 'Leftfield' Stromboli are putting their game faces on for an in depth look into one of America’s favorite sports, Basketball!

items.title: Halloween Dance
items.description: It’s Halloween and besties BeezBee the bee, Peanut the giraffe and Brooklyn the lion already picked out their Halloween costumes! Now it’s just about discovering where the best Trick Or Treat yummies are to be found!

items.title: Hodge And The Lost Easter Egg
items.description: Meet Hodge, the Easter Bunny’s younger brother! Hodge is well-meaning but trouble seems to find him no matter where he hides! When Hodge accidentally loses the Magic Easter egg, he decides to dive headlong into an adventure!

items.title: Holly Hippo's Book Club For Kids: Sleeping Beauty
items.description: Few fairy tales have captured the imagination quite like the Brothers Grimm's Sleeping Beauty. Join us as we uncover the myths and truths behind one of the most popular fictitious character ever written about!

items.title: Hopz And The Easter Mystery
items.description: Easter is just around the corner, and Hops the Easter Bunny is on a mission to solve the greatest Easter mystery ever: what came first, the chicken or the egg?

items.title: Horseplay: The History Of Horse Riding
items.description: Join Scout the horse as he hops on his trusty plane Axel, and sets off on an incredible learning journey about the amazing history of horse riding!! Grab your saddle and join them for Horseplay: The History Of Horse Riding!

items.title: Hua Mulan
items.description: Over the years, the name Hua Mulan has become synonymous with the Walt Disney animated film Mulan and more recently with the 2020 American action drama film by the same name. But Mulan’s roots go a lot deeper than that.

items.title: Jurassic Planet
items.description: Meet Oki, a baby human separated from his parents when a Tyrannosaurus Rex attacks his village. When Oki befriends a baby triceratops named Kona is friendship at first sight!

items.title: It's Christmas Sing-Along 2
items.description: Let the Christmas spirit whisk you away on an incredible sing and dance-along journey you won’t soon forget, It's Christmas Sing-Along 2!

items.title: Lil Santa's Book Club: The New Year’s Bargain
items.description: Celebrate the Christmas holiday with Lil’ Santa and all the adorable members of his favorite book-club as they gather around the fire to tell the beloved classic holiday story.

items.title: Lil' Monsters 2
items.description: It’s Halloween in the spooktacular town of Monsterland! Little mummy Rags and his pal Tickles the dragon are looking for Halloween legendary monster Little Frankenstein!

items.title: Kid Brainiac: Lovin' Lizards
items.description: When young genius Felix Brainiac teams up with his time-traveling dinosaur pal Big T, the duo sets out on an amazing adventure, going where no kid and dino have gone before!

items.title: Lil' Yogis: International Yoga Day
items.description: Welcome to Lil’ Yogis, a fun and enlightening new animated series where spiritual learning is made fun and simple for all ages! Get ready to dive into an eye-opening and exciting new adventure in spirituality with Lil’ Yogis: International Yoga Day!

items.title: Little Alice's Storytime: Alice's Adventures In Wonderland
items.description: Gather around. Little Alice and her best pals, the weird and wacky Hatter, the adorable Dormouse and the mischievous Cheshire Cat, are ready to narrate a magical storybook rendition of Lewis Carroll’s timeless classic.

items.title: Christine
items.description: CHRISTINE is the story of an aspiring newswoman caught in the midst of a personal and professional life crisis. Between unrequited love, frustration at work, a tumultuous home, and self-doubt; she begins to spiral down a dark path.

items.title: Django (2018)
items.description: The story of Django Reinhardt, famous guitarist and composer, and his flight from German-occupied Paris in 1943.

items.title: The Dinner
items.description: Two estranged brothers and their wives meet at a restaurant to discuss a grotesque crime committed by their sons. With their involvement still a secret, they must decide how far they’ll go to protect the ones they love.

items.title: All About Nina
items.description: Just as Nina Geld’s (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) brilliant stand-up kicks her career into high gear, her romantic life gets complicated, forcing her to reckon with what it means to be creative, authentic, and a woman in today’s society.

items.title: Happily Ever After
items.description: A young documentary filmmaker (Janet Montgomery) turns her camera on her former best friend (Sara Paxton), a seemingly carefree bride-to-be, in this delightful dramedy about family and secrets - and best friends forever.

items.title: BPM (Beats Per Minute)
items.description: In the early 1990s, Act Up-Paris activists advocate for those stricken with HIV/AIDS with a literal life-or-death urgency. Amid rallies, fierce debates and ecstatic dance parties, newcomer Nathan falls in love with Act Ups radical leader.

items.title: Me, My Dog, And I
items.description: Me, My Dog, and I explores the magical bond between people and dogs. A documentary intended to help you choose the right dog became one of the most heart-warming feel-good stories. Join us for the adventure.

items.title: Little Historians A Very American Christmas
items.description: Join the Little Historians! Jump into the time machine and gear up for a new adventure in our fascinating past with Little Historians: A Very American Christmas!

items.title: Little Historians: Our Founding Fathers
items.description: Join the Little Historians, it’s time for another adventure in our fascinating past to learn all about the history of the Founding Fathers of the United States of America. Let the adventure begin with Little Historians Our Founding Fathers!

items.title: Monster Class: Bigfoot vs the Giant Squid
items.description: Join Monster Class teacher extraordinaire Count Dracula as he unveils two of the most amazing monster legend to ever haunt our nightmares! It's Monster Class Bigfoot Vs The Giant Squid!

items.title: Monster Class: Krampus and Other Christmas Monsters
items.description: Join Monster Class teacher Count Dracula as he goes batty for cryptozoology, the study of monsters! In the world of cryptids — that's a fancy word for monsters — there is a group of monsters that haunt our favorite holiday, Christmas!

items.title: Murder Hornets Vs Killer Bees
items.description: Killer Bees. Murder Hornets. Their name alone is enough to trigger fear in people the world over. Is their terrifying name deserved? And which of the two is the deadliest?

items.title: New Years Dance
items.description: It’s New Year's Eve and all the inhabitants of Sunnyville are celebrating! But there's a problem! Nobody can find the fireworks for this year's display.

items.title: Otis and Lewis Go Treasure Hunting
items.description: Monkey explorers Otis and Lewis are back and ready to solve another one of history's greatest mysteries! This time around, Otis and Lewis go hunting for lost treasures. Will these adventurous monkeys get to the bottom of the mystery and find the loot?

items.title: Pets 2
items.description: Best buddies, Bella the laid-back cat, Bagel the goofy dog, and Alvin the opinionated parrot are hanging out on their cherished couch watching the best show on TV, Pets!

items.title: Pets: Christmas Furballs
items.description: Everyone’s favorite couch potato pets, Bella the cat, Bagel the dog, and Alvin the mouthy parrot break it down yet again from the comfort of their own cushions, with holiday-themed pets, pets, and more pets in Christmas Furballs!

items.title: Pets: Top 10 Pets
items.description: Woof! Everyone’s favorite couch potato pets, Bella the cat, Bagel the pooch, and Alvin the mouthy parrot break it down yet again from the comfort of their couch with an all out winged, clawed, feathered and furred favorite pet-themed extravaganza.

items.title: Pup School: Arctic Adventure
items.description: Pup School is back in session and cuddly pups Moxie and Bo are ready to learn from their super smart teacher, Professor Twiggles. This time, the pups get bundled up and head to the Arctic.

items.title: Pup School: Cuddly Easter Animals
items.description: Pup School is back in session and delightful pups Moxie and Bo are ready to learn from their super smart teacher, Professor Twiggles. This time, the pups get ready to dive into the most egg-cellent adventure, discovering adorable Easter creatures!

items.title: Pup Tales Miss Muffet's Christmas Party
items.description: Cuddle up alongside fluffy fur-ball Zoey the Maltese puppy as her big sister Dixie narrates Samuel McChord Crothers’ classic fairy tale, Miss Muffet's Christmas Party.

items.title: Just A Gigolo
items.description: After World War I, a war hero returns to Berlin to find that there's no place for him--he has no skills other than what he learned in the army, and can only find menial, low-paying jobs. He decides to become a gigolo to lonely rich women.

items.title: Pup Tales: The Golden Key
items.description: Cuddle up alongside fluffy fur-ball Zoey the Maltese puppy as her big sister Dixie narrates some of the most amazing book-based fairytales of all time! Sit, stay, and listen in, Pup Tales: The Golden Key is about to begin!

items.title: Puppy Playground: A Puppy Christmas
items.description: It's Christmas time with puppies! Meet a gang of cuddly snow-white pups as they celebrate the holidays in style by decorating the Christmas tree, wearing adorable Santa hats and letting you know all about their incredible Christmas puppy adventures.

items.title: Quick Wisdom With Bliss: Kundalini Yoga In 30 Minutes
items.description: Join Bliss for a new adventure exploring Kundalini, a form of divine energy also known as Shakti in Hinduism. Through love, joy and wisdom we can learn anything! Let's get ready to make our spirit soar with Quick Wisdom With Bliss: Kundalini Yoga!

items.title: Quick Wisdom With Bliss: Meditation In 30 Minutes
items.description: Join Bliss for a fun-filled adventure exploring the health and spiritual benefits of meditation, a long practiced science in which its practitioners use a variety of techniques, such as mindfulness.

items.title: Quick Wisdom With Bliss: Unconditional Love
items.description: Join Bliss for a feel-good adventure exploring the joys of unconditional love. That’s Quick Wisdom With Bliss: Unconditional Love!

items.title: Quick Wisdom With Bliss: The History Of Yoga
items.description: Join Bliss for a mind-expanding adventure exploring the ancient history of yoga, a group of physical, mental, and spiritual practices which originated in ancient India. Through love, joy and wisdom we can learn anything!

items.title: Saint Patrick's Big Dance
items.description: It’s St. Patrick’s Day and all the inhabitants of Sunnyville are celebrating! Besties Beezbee the bee, Peanut the giraffe and Brooklyn the lion are looking for the best St. Patrick’s Day party in town!

items.title: Shark School: Whale World
items.description: Swim with Milo and Bella to Shark School and learn all about the wonderful world of whales!

items.title: St Paddy
items.description: Meet Patrick, the cutest leprechaun you’ll ever know on a mission to bring good luck and grant wishes to the whole world! But Goldie the Golden Goos teaches the little leprechaun that for every wish granted, there is a consequence.

items.title: Superfan Dogs: Comic Book Legends
items.description: Faster than a speeding bullet! More powerful than a locomotive! Able to leap tall buildings in a single bound! Your favorite comic book superheroes can do all that and lots more!

items.title: Tech Talk Time: Augmented Reality In 30 Minutes
items.description: Welcome to Tech Talk Time! I’m Tim and I’m here to make technology simple and understandable for everyone! In this episode we will be examining the incredible world of augmented reality. Let's take a look at this exciting new technology.

items.title: Tech Talk Time: Tik Tok In 30 Minutes
items.description: Welcome to Tech Talk Time! I’m Tim and I’m here to make technology simple and understandable for everyone! In this episode we will be examining a craze that has taken the world by storm, TikTok.

items.title: The Golden Goose
items.description: Meet Goldie the golden goose, the Easter Bunny’s favorite helper! Find out the true meaning of Easter and meet the most colorful characters in the world in this holiday adventure for kids of all ages!

items.title: The Thanksgiving Movie
items.description: Join Butterball the turkey and Missy the Dodo as they come to the rescue of Thanksgiving and embark on an unforgettable, clock-racing countdown to a holiday dinner! It’s a Thanksgiving Movie for the ages!

items.title: The Halloween Dragon
items.description: While exploring their new kingdom, an adventurous Wee Dragon named Boil and his buddy Scazzle discover a way to enter the Upside Down Wee World, an alternate dimension that closely mirrors their own!

items.title: Three Little Pigs Storytime
items.description: Oink, oink, Once upon a time there were three little pigs traveling the whole wide world in their hot air balloon looking high and low for the best fairytale of them all! It's Three Little Pigs Storytime!

items.title: Train School
items.description: Toot-toot! Hop on board the smartest locomotive in the world, Toot Skoot and join his exciting Train School where kids learn fascinating facts about their all-time favorite subjects! It’s toot-toot... Train School!

items.title: Nasty Baby
items.description: An award-winning favorite that centers on a Brooklyn artist who, with his boyfriend and their best friend, try to have a baby. Their bliss is clouded by a series of confrontations with an annoying neighbor who just might be a madman.

items.title: The Party's Just Beginning
items.description: A surreal coming of age story told from the perspective of a young Scottish woman (Karen Gillan) trying to cope with the suicide of her best friend and struggling to confront what's truly haunting her.

items.title: Train School: Learning For Tots
items.description: Toot-toot! Hop on board the smartest locomotive in the world, Toot Skoot and join his exciting Train School where tots learn and play with a variety of subjects including shapes, colors, number and much more! It's Train School: Learning of Tots!

items.title: Turkey Day
items.description: When the devious Count Dracula uses his powers to hypnotize Turk the Thanksgiving turkey to officially cancel his big day, Turk does as commanded and announces the end of the world’s tastiest holiday!

items.title: Valentine's Day Dance
items.description: It’s Valentine’s Day and all the inhabitants of Sunnyville are celebrating! Besties Beezbee the bee, Peanut the giraffe and Brooklyn the lion are trying to figure out what Valentine’s Day is all about!

items.title: Under The Sea 2
items.description: The holidays are just around the corner and the friendly inhabitants of Bubbletown are on a mission to have the grandest time under the sea! Dive in with the Bubbletown crew in Under The Sea 2!

items.title: Welcome To The Day Of The Dead
items.description: Despite the town's ban on comedy, Diego dreams of becoming an accomplished comedian/ But grumpy Queen Of The Dead Erasma Bones simply hates it when the dead laugh! Desperate to prove his talent, Diego embarks on an extraordinary journey.

items.title: Witchmas
items.description: When Selma the Wicked Witch enlists an arrogant little elf named Grumper and his pet dragon Grus to transform Christmas into a whole new holiday known the world over as Witchmas, it sparks mayhem on the eve of the big day!

items.title: State Like Sleep
items.description: One year after her husband's (Michiel Huisman) untimely death, a young widow (Katherine Waterston) receives an unsettling phone call that forces her to revisit the past.

items.title: School for Scoundrels (2006)
items.description: A young guy short on luck enrolls in a class to build confidence to help win over the girl of his dreams, which becomes complicated when his teacher has the same agenda.

items.title: The Unlikely Good Samaritan
items.description: A modern retelling of the Good Samaritan parable.

items.title: Destination Point
items.description: Destination Point' is packed with high voltage surfing from the West Coast plus many, many insane spots from around the globe. Featured surfers include Bobby Martinez, Tom Curren, Kelly Slater, Andy Irons and more.

items.title: Kobe Bryant: A Tribute
items.description: Kobe’s dedication to his career, his family and his charity work led to him being adored the world over. But on Sunday January 26th 2020 his life would come to a sudden and tragic end.

items.title: Lebron James: King of the Court
items.description: After impressing scouts with his skills in high school, LeBron James skipped college to join the NBA’s Cleveland Cavaliers and would later go on to play for the Miami Heat and the legendary Los Angeles Lakers.

items.title: Manchester United: For the Glory
items.description: Winners of 20 Premiere League Titles, 3 UEFA Champions Leagues and 12 FA cups, Manchester United are one of the most award winning Football Teams in the sport.

items.title: Return to Mount Kennedy
items.description: A wild band manager, a candidate for governor, and a young mountaineer embark on an expedition to a remote peak that connects them all. With original music by Eddie Vedder, the film sits at the junction of environmentalism, and adventure.

items.title: The 2020 BFG Mint 400 Limited Race
items.description: Each year, the best UTV and vintage off-road racers in the world compete at the Great American Off-Road Race! Some race all four hundred grueling miles of hellish Las Vegas desert. Others brave a single, 100 mile lap. It's the Mint 400!

items.title: The 2020 BFG Mint 400 Moto Race
items.description: The best desert motorcycle racers in the world battle shoulder to shoulder at the world famous Mint 400 for cash and prizes!

items.title: The 2020 BFG Mint 400 Unlimited Race
items.description: Over 500 of the best desert off-road racers in the world gather in the harsh and unforgiving desert outside Las Vegas, and battle door to door for fame, fortune and a shot at making history! The Mint 400 is four hundred miles of hell!

items.title: The Fight of a Lifetime: McGregor vs Mayweather
items.description: Two of the biggest combat sports stars in the world. UFC Star, Conor McGregor. Undefeated Boxer, Floyd Mayweather. A once in a lifetime fight.

items.title: The Dick Van Dyke Show Remembered
items.description: A special tribute to the iconic sitcom starring the legendary Dick Van Dyke and Emmy Award winner Mary Tyler Moore.

items.title: The Late Bloomer
items.description: The story of an adult male who, after the successful removal of a benign tumor, experiences all the changes and effects of puberty over a three-week period. Starring Johnny Simmons and Brittany Snow.

items.title: Gladiator
items.description: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back and gain the freedom of his people in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

items.title: Building a Decade: Minecraft
items.description: For more than 10 years, there has been one game that has taken the world by storm. Minecraft.

items.title: Dior and I
items.description: Dior and I brings the viewer inside the storied world of the Christian Dior fashion house with a privileged, behind-the-scenes look at the creation of Raf Simons’ first haute couture collection as its new artistic director.

items.title: Shaolin Soccer (en español)
items.description: En esta risueña y llamativa comedia, un equipo de inadaptados se esfuerza por ganar un campeonato mezclando artes marciales con fútbol. Utilizando un juego poco ortodoxo, se enfrentan al temido equipo malo en la batalla final por el título.

items.title: The Island
items.description: A man goes on the run after discovering he is actually a "harvested being" and is being kept, along with others, in a utopian facility.

items.title: Mission: Impossible III
items.description: Ethan Hunt hurdles into spectacular new adventures from Rome to Shanghai as he races to rescue a captured agent and stop Davian from eliminating his next target, Ethan’s wife.

items.title: Drácula 2000
items.description: El maestro del terror Wes Craven presenta una adaptación moderna y sexi del clásico thriller gótico. Luego de que Drácula despierta de su sueño de 100 años, su primer destino es Estados Unidos y la exótica ciudad de Nueva Orleans.

items.title: Three Came Home
items.description: During World War II, American author Agnes Newton Keith is imprisoned by the Japanese

items.title: The 39 Steps
items.description: A London tourist gets entangled in espionage in this Hitchcock Classic

items.title: Little Men
items.description: When two homeless boys from Boston find themselves at Plumfield, a rural boarding school, the boys learn both academic and life lessons they won't ever forget.

items.title: Degree of Guilt
items.description: Two attorneys defend a young woman accused of murdering a famous writer. During the high-profile trial, attorneys Chris and Terri start falling for each other, but Terri's estranged husband turns up dead and Chris is wrongly accused.

items.title: Lethal Lolita
items.description: Told from her viewpoint, this is Amy Fisher's sensational version of her real-life account of her affair with Joey Buttafuoco and her conviction for aggravated assault for shooting Buttafuoco's wife.

items.title: Snowbound
items.description: Based on a true story and starring Neil Patrick Harris and Kelli Williams, Jim and Jennifer Stolpa (with baby Clayton) lose their way and are stranded in an endless wilderness of deep snow, battling for survival against the elements.

items.title: The Terror Inside
items.description: A woman who is racked by multiple personalities confronts a horrifying past of dark secrets buried a long time ago. When her father dies, she descends into a bizarre emotional world where she lashes out at her husband and two young daughters.

items.title: Undue Influence
items.description: A defense attorney promises his dying wife that he will help her sister win a custody battle against her ex-husband. But when a murder takes place, and he tries to investigate, he finds himself caught in a complex web of infidelities and homicide.

items.title: Carolina
items.description: Julia Stiles and Oscar winner Shirley MacLaine headline this charming romantic comedy in which a young woman tries to escape the eccentric ways of her wacky Southern family and meet the man of her dreams.

items.title: La ratoncita valiente
items.description: En esta aventura animada, una ratoncita de carácter tranquilo necesita un milagro de ingeniería, valor y el Secreto de NIMH para salvar su hogar del arado de un granjero. Con las voces de Dom DeLuise, John Carradine y Peter Strauss.

items.title: Georgia Rule
items.description: A troubled young woman is sent to live with her grandmother for the summer, while hiding a secret that could potentially tear her family apart.

items.title: Dominion: Prequel To The Exorcist
items.description: Years before Father Lankester Merrin helped save Regan MacNeil's soul, he first encounters the demon Pazuzu in East Africa. Merrin's initial battle with Pazuzu leads to the rediscovery of his faith.

items.title: Man of the Year
items.description: A comedian who hosts a news satire program decides to run for president, and a computerized voting machine malfunction gets him elected.

items.title: Pacific Heights
items.description: A couple work hard to renovate their dream house and become landlords to pay for it. Unfortunately, one of their tenants has plans of his own.

items.title: Two for the Money
items.description: After suffering a career-ending knee injury, a former college football star aligns himself with one of the most renowned touts in the sports-gambling business.

items.title: Liz: The Elizabeth Taylor Story
items.description: The story of Elizabeth Taylor's rise to stardom, beginning in Los Angeles 1942. Growing up, Elizabeth has several love-affairs - and several divorces, since her husbands can't accept being married to a Hollywood icon.

items.title: Financing Terror
items.description: After 9/11, an unprecedented weapon was used to “starve terrorism”: financial warfare. At first, it seemed effective, but there were setbacks with the insurrection in Iraq and the fiasco of the Syrian war.

items.title: FRESH (ESP)
items.description: Desencantado con la dura realidad de la vida en la ciudad, un chico listo llamado Fresh intenta crear un mejor futuro para él y su familia. Fresh desafía las probabilidades adelantándose a los criminales en un peligroso juego de supervivencia.

items.title: A Woman Named Jackie
items.description: This starts when Jackie Kennedy was working after college; and spans her life through the Presidency of John F. Kennedy and her marriage to Aristotle Onassis after the assassination of President Kennedy.

items.title: Confessions Of An Alien Abductee
items.description: This film focuses on one of Britain's most unusual phone-based services. The 'Anomalous Mind Management Abductee/Contactee Helpline' was set up for people who claim to have had close encounters with extraterrestrials.

items.title: California Republic
items.description: Nowhere else in the world does the natural environment create such an endless feeling of freedom while stoking the fires of progressive evolution.Follow the breath taking beauty of surfing in California Republic.

items.title: Lucky Number Slevin
items.description: A case of mistaken identity lands Slevin into the middle of a war being plotted by two of the city's most rival crime bosses: The Rabbi and The Boss.

items.title: Zack and Miri Make a Porno
items.description: In order to resolve their financial woes, lifelong platonic friends Zack and Miri decide to produce a porno film.

items.title: Hollywood Or Bust
items.description: A movie-mad nitwit driving across the country to his mecca, Hollywood, is joined by a gambler who wants to break into singing when they pick up a pretty girl en route. Once in Hollywood the nitwit meets his dream goddess.

items.title: The Keep
items.description: WWII German soldiers try to defend a Rumanian mountain pass by establishing headquarters in an ancient fortress - despite warnings about a strange presence inside.

items.title: Inside Llewyn Davis
items.description: Inside Llewyn Davis follows a young folk singer as he navigates the Greenwich Village folk scene of 1961. Llewyn Davis (Oscar Isaac) is struggling to make it as a musician against seemling insurmountable obstacles - some of them of his own making.

items.title: The to Do List
items.description: Valedictorian, Brandy wants to get "educated" before college, so she assembles a list of all the sexual activities she missed out on. Quickly realizing that she's way out of her league, Brandy solicits her sister and burn-out boss for their help.

items.title: Overdosed
items.description: In a rural drug-ravaged West Virginian town, a doctor goes to jail, the pharmacy gets slapped with a fine and drug distributor McKesson corporation goes to trial. At the nexus of this American tragedy OVERDOSED asks: Who are the true drug dealers?

items.title: The Guest (LAS)
items.description: The expected return of the son for his father funeral shakes up a traditional and secretive familiar environment where women are supposed to count on men to survive as he shows himself turned into a female.

items.title: Howard Zinn : A People's History of the United States
items.description: With the tremendous success of his book, A People's History of the United States, Howard Zinn radically changed the way Americans see themselves.

items.title: Wrath of Silence
items.description: A young boy tends sheep on a hillside in Northern China goes missing. His mute father looks for him with a special way of solving problems: Fisticuffs.

items.title: Ghosthunter
items.description: A 40-year old security guard and part-time ghost hunter cannot remember his childhood and has spent two decades searching for his absent father.

items.title: Tomorrow
items.description: The world's climate is changing. Instead of showing the worst that can happen, this documentary focuses on the people suggesting solutions and their actions.

items.title: LOL - Laughing Out Loud
items.description: When Lola's boyfriend is unfaithful to her on his summer holiday, she dumps him and flirts with his best friend as punishment. But as their class prepares to leave on an excursion to London, the relationship heats up.

items.title: Geek and You Shall Find
items.description: While attending a local comic book convention, three filmmakers are so moved by the stories shared with them by attendees that they decide to travel across the country to better understand what makes fans so passionate about superheroes.

items.title: The Crest
items.description: Two cousins meet for the first time in Ireland to explore their shared heritage and surf the waters of their ancestors. Their's is a story of family, immigration and the value of tradition and culture.

items.title: Hidden Away
items.description: Learning that his wife and daughter faked their deaths, a man hatches a plot for revenge.

items.title: The Lookout
items.description: Chris "Slapshot" Pratt (Joseph Gordon-Levitt), cuyo brillante futuro fue cortado por un accidente, es un conserje nocturno en un banco. Solitario y frustrado, Chris cae en las garras de un estafador y lo ayuda a robar el banco donde trabaja.

items.title: Chocolate
items.description: Johnny Depp y Juliette Binoche protagonizan esta comedia romántica dulce y sexi que enamoró al público y obtuvo cinco nominaciones al Óscar, incluida la de Mejor Película, y que se centra en una chocolatería de un pequeño pueblo francés.

items.title: Cheri
items.description: A famed courtesan to the rich and famous in pre-World War I Paris is asked to teach a spoiled 19-year-old boy about women. It's an adventure that becomes a heated and passionate affair that results in power struggles -- and unexpectedly, love itself.

items.title: Redemption Way
items.description: Jenny Paine is a hospice nurse who feels it is her mission to safely deliver souls into the next life. However, when her childhood friend Autumn is put on hospice, Jenny's attempts at sharing her Christian faith are angrily rejected.

items.title: Mayweather v Mosley (2010)
items.description: In a fight of contrasting styles, Floyd Mayweather Jr. and 'Sugar' Shane Mosley clashed in an all-American bout at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas. Mayweather promised to produce a masterclass, while Mosley vowed to deliver a punishing KO.

items.title: Sarafina!
items.description: A story of the courage and spirit of the children of South Africa's townships in their resistance to apartheid.

items.title: Woman
items.description: WOMAN is a worldwide project giving voice to 2000 women in 50 different countries.

items.title: El Lamento de la Serpiente Negra
items.description: En este relato sobre el amor, el candidato para el Premio Óscar(r) Samuel L. Jackson y Christina Ricci buscan la redención en el sur profundo a través del poder del blues y la transcendencia de una extraña amistad.

items.title: Golpe mortal
items.description: Un exconvicto lucha por su vida en la jaula para ganar dinero y pagar la cirugía de la hija de una de sus últimas víctimas, encontrando amor paternal y nuevas amistades en los lugares más inverosímiles.

items.title: Cazar para matar
items.description: Jim Rhodes, agente divorciado, está pasando por momentos difíciles: intenta educar solo a su hija rebelde. Cuando unos fugitivos secuestran a Rhodes y a su hija, el objetivo es cazarlos para matarlos.

items.title: Karen
items.description: An entitled, racist, Caucasian woman pulls out all the stops to rid her precious neighborhood of the peaceful African American couple who just moved in next door.

items.title: Muerte en Buenos Aires
items.description: Muerte en Buenos Aires, el mayor éxito del año en su Argentina natal, es un apasionante thriller policial sobre la corrupción, la paranoia y la vida gay secreta de la élite adinerada de Buenos Aires durante los políticamente tumultuosos años ochenta.

items.title: En las Afueras de la Ciudad
items.description: Una de las películas de terror más controvertidas que jamás haya surgido en América Latina, es el cine de terror del siglo XXI en su forma más impactante. En lo profundo del campo chileno, Ana y Anny viven con su hermano deforme y están sujetas.

items.title: Luciferina
items.description: El argentino Gonzalo Calzada dirige una película visualmente explosiva donde la religión, la inocencia, la sexualidad reprimida y la maldad chocan espectacularmente.

items.title: A Memoria del Muerto
items.description: Una sorpresa sobrenatural con estilo que ha sido un éxito en festivales de cine de todo el mundo.

items.title: Terror 5
items.description: Mientras que la mayoría de los residentes de un pequeño pueblo argentino asiste a una procesión fúnebre tras el trágico derrumbe de un edificio, los pocos que no lo hagan se enfrentarán a sus propios terrors.

items.title: Perfidia
items.description: Una pieza de humor inquietante, críptica y etérea que mantiene hábilmente un aura de temor y tensión en todo momento.

items.title: Toro Loco: Sangriento
items.description: A Fistful of Dollars se encuentra con Death Wish a través de Blazing Saddles en esta salvaje comedia de acción.

items.title: Trauma
items.description: Una historia impactante y brutal que mezcla la oscura historia del pasado reciente de Chile (la violenta y represiva dictadura militar de Pinochet) con el Chile aparentemente moderno y progresista de hoy.

items.title: Cinderella and the Prince Charles
items.description: Unhappy about all of the royal pressures placed on him, young Prince Charles swaps places with his stableboy and ventures into town alone. There, he meets a young servant girl named Cinderella.

items.title: Cinderella at the Emerald Castle
items.description: The Duke plans to seize power of the Kingdom so that he can eventually take over. When things go awry, Charles seeks Cinderella's aid in thwarting his evil plans before it's too late!

items.title: Pocahontas I
items.description: When white colonists arrive by ship on Chesapeake lands, Native American princess Pocahontas must teach them to live in peace with her people and respect the environment around them.

items.title: The Prince of Dinosaurs
items.description: Prince Rakhal stumbles upon an ancient parchment full of incomprehensible hieroglyphs and summons the help of his five little dinosaur friends to help decipher it.

items.title: The Jungle Book: Search for the Lost Treasure
items.description: While searching for treasure, a diamond thief captures a research team. The team's children must escape into the jungle to rescue their fathers and beat the thief. Luckily, they have Mowgli's help.

items.title: Fungus the Bogeyman
items.description: Fungus is a working-class bogeyman who comes to the surface to scare humans. However, Fungus soon begins to question his purpose in life when his son Mould rebels against the rules of Bogeys.

items.title: Robin Hood: The First Outlaw Hero
items.description: The preeminent documentary about the world's most famous outlaw. Using forensic evidence, this popular film discovers the true story of Robin Hood and his time.

items.title: Robin Hood III: Enemies Forever
items.description: Baron Alwyn, with a powerful war machine at his disposal, plans an attack on Sherwood Forest—hoping to run the band of outlaws out of their sanctuary in order to obtain a rumored hidden treasure.

items.title: Ramses of Egypt
