items.description: A young archer leads the Egyptian army to victory against the Hittites. Egypt will be saved, but its ongoing deceit does not sit well with a villainous priest who intends to ascend the throne.

items.title: Robin Hood IV: King's Return
items.description: A mysterious man saves Robin and the outlaws from a poison gas attack on Sherwood Forest. When the gang invites him back to camp, they learn that the nomad suffers from extreme memory loss.

items.title: The Thief of Baghdad
items.description: When King Achmed, undercover as a villager, is arrested for treason, a young pickpocket finagles his own arrest in order to rescue the betrayed monarch from execution.

items.title: Sherlock Bones: Undercover Dog
items.description: Ten-year-old Billy's plans to spend the summer with his father go awry when Sherlock, a talking police dog, demands his help to rescue his police detective handler who was kidnapped by smugglers.

items.title: Felix and the Time Machine
items.description: While visiting a history museum, Felix and his new friends are accidentally set back in time by a scientist. Each jump they make in time, they get closer to home—but will they be able to make it?

items.title: Robin Hood II: The Invincible Knight
items.description: Baron Alwyn forces Gilbert to kidnap Marian in order to obtain her gold crucifix, said to hold an invaluable secret. However, Little John has given the crucifix to his new love, Winifred.

items.title: Backfield In Motion
items.description: Nancy Seavers and her teenage son Tim have moved to a small town where football reigns supreme. When Tim joins the junior-varsity team, Nancy organizes a mothers vs. sons football game.

items.title: Cinderella
items.description: Cinderella's life worsens when her stepmother moves her daughters into Cinderella's room and puts her to harsh menial labor. Luckily, her fairy godmother has plans to get her a happily ever after!

items.title: Robin Hood
items.description: The boy hero Robin Hood and his merry band of outlaws fight back against the injustices and suffering of the people at the hands of the evil Baron Alwyn and the greedy Bishop of Herfort.

items.title: How To Grow A Band
items.description: Following a divorce and the break up of his platinum-selling band, virtuoso Chris Thile decides to start over. Filmmaker Mark Meatto shadows the enigmatic 26 year-old musician as he leads his new group, Punch Brothers, down an uncertain path.

items.title: Kung Fu Traveler
items.description: Aliens have invaded and overtaken the Earth. Trying to escape defeat, a Chinese General is accidentally sent back in time while trying to devise a way to defeat the alien invaders.

items.title: Kung Fu Traveler 2
items.description: Southern Style Kung Fu was unsuccessful in defeating the invading enemy aliens. General Chen (Tiger Chen) has no choice but to be go back in time again to the late Qing Dynasty to find the master of Northern Style Kung Fu.

items.title: 24 Hours to Live
items.description: Ethan Hawke gives an explosive performance as a former special-ops marine turned mercenary who's given one last shot at redemption in this nonstop action-thriller from the producers of JOHN WICK.

items.title: Final Score
items.description: After deadly terrorists abduct his niece at a soccer match, an ex-soldier with lethal fighting skills (Dave Bautista) wages a one-man war to save her and prevent mass destruction.

items.title: The Words
items.description: A writer at the peak of his literary success discovers the price he must pay for stealing another man's work.

items.title: What If
items.description: Wallace, who is burned out from a string of failed relationships, forms an instant bond with Chantry, who lives with her longtime boyfriend. Together, they puzzle out what it means if your best friend is also the love of your life.

items.title: El mal hijo
items.description: Un asesino de mujeres inocentes anda suelto por las calles de Seattle. La policía y el FBI lo están rastreando, pero nunca estuvieron preparados para enfrentar algo así.

items.title: Memoria perdida
items.description: Lauren pierde la memoria después de un accidente; poco a poco va recordando lo que pasó hasta darse cuenta de que su hija está desaparecida. Ahora debe ayudar a la policía a encontrarla.

items.title: The Opposite Sex
items.description: The Opposite Sex tells the story of Vince, New England's most successful divorce attorney. To Vince, life is one big competition, and losing is unacceptable. This also applies to his dating life, with his love 'em and leave 'em approach.

items.title: Island In The Sky
items.description: Set after World War II, John Wayne plays Dooley, a former army pilot flying transport missions, who is forced to crash-land his fuel-starved plane on a frozen lake after it strays from its course.

items.title: Who's Minding The Store?
items.description: An incompetent young man is given a job in a department store by his girlfriend's mother, who hopes to put an end to their romance.

items.title: Hell Is For Heroes
items.description: It's 1944, and Nazi forces along the Siegfried Line have the numbers, the fortifications and the firepower to break through. GIs have little more than a dogged determination and the ingenuity to fool the Germans into thinking they are allies.

items.title: Pardners
items.description: A rich momma's boy returns west with the son of his murdered father's partner to foil a gang trying to gain control of his family ranch. They accidentally clean up the town.

items.title: Elvira's Haunted Hills
items.description: Spooky high jinks abound when Elvira finds herself spending the night in a mysterious castle en route to 1851 Paris.

items.title: Unraveling Athena: The Champions Of Women's Tennis
items.description: Unraveling Athena is a feature documentary that chronicles the journey that Women Tennis Champions pass through - from small child with a large racket, to ranked player, and ultimately to WTA number one in the world

items.title: El gringo
items.description: El Hombre cruza a México con $2,000,000 y un plan para vivir sus días en la playa, pero se queda atrapado esperando en "El Fronteras". Bajo ataque de policías corruptos, mafiosos y forajidos, debe salvar "El Fronteras" a través de espectaculares tiroteos.

items.title: Water Get No Enemy
items.description: Professional surfers Damien Castera and Arthur Bourbon flew to Liberia, one of the poorest countries in the world. For their film "Water Get No Ennemy", they met the first generation of surfers in the country.

items.title: Alien Contact: NASA Exposed 2
items.description: The recent discovery of 1300 exoplanets that could sustain life has rocked the scientific world. Now everyone from world leaders to former astronauts are testifying that UFOs not only exist, but that Aliens are here and have been monitoting the human race

items.title: The Lover
items.description: In 1929 French Indochina, a French teenage girl embarks on a reckless and forbidden romance with a wealthy, older Chinese man, each knowing that knowledge of their affair will bring drastic consequences to each other.

items.title: I Am Santa Claus
items.description: A year in the lives of five men who portray Santa Claus.

items.title: I Know a Woman Like That
items.description: I KNOW A WOMAN LIKE THAT brings to its audience interviews with 17 exceptional and vigorous women who share an extraordinary attitude about how to live the upper decades of one's life.

items.title: Supercop
items.description: Jackie Chan, Michelle Yeoh y Maggie Cheung protagonizan un clásico repleto de acción, con impactantes escenas de riesgo, desde saltar de un edificio de diez pisos a un helicóptero en el aire hasta caer sobre un tren en marcha.

items.title: Insatiable: The Homaro Cantu Story
items.description: Chef and inventor Homaro Cantu helped put Chicago on the culinary map and wanted to change the world. INSATIABLE takes you on a dizzying and thrilling ride with Cantu, in a story that moves from redemption and inspiration to tragedy and back again.

items.title: Returning Citizens
items.description: \\"Returning Citizens\\" focuses on a passionate, close-knit community of formerly incarcerated individuals who are looking for a second chance – or perhaps a chance they never had to begin with.

items.title: Ring of Faith
items.description: Featuring interviews with professional boxers, religious leaders, and influencers in sports, this is an in depth look at the impact boxing has made on communities and how faith and religion have played immense roles in the sport and lives of the boxers.

items.title: Stealing Charlie Chaplin
items.description: Shortly after Charlie Chaplin's death, his body disappeared from its grave. After being left initially with no clues - only outrageous rumors - the robbers finally made contact with the family and started a tense, but often comedic game of cat and mouse.

items.title: The Weight of Honor
items.description: Filmed over five years, THE WEIGHT OF HONOR follows caregivers of veterans who have been catastrophically wounded in America's longest war. The film reveals family dynamics, hardships, and now, the uncertainties that lie ahead.

items.title: Troll Inc.
items.description: Prosecuted as a whistle-blower by the Federal Government, Troll Inc. follows the world's most famous, Andrew Auernheimer, and his legion of cultural saboteurs as they attempt to overthrow civilization, one meme at a time.

items.title: Patterns of Evidence: The Exodus
items.description: Is It fact or fiction? What does the hard evidence have to say about the foundational story of the old testament: The Exodus Out of Egypt? Investigative filmmaker Timothy Mahoney journeyed to Egypt, Israel and throughout the world in search of the answer.

items.title: 1917 - The Real Story
items.description: A factual, deep-dive exploration of the historic events that inspired 1917, the celebrated WWI film nominatedfor 9 Oscar awards.

items.title: Otherlife
items.description: Two inventors make a virtual reality drug with ground-breaking potential, but when this powerful narcotic lands in the wrong hands, the true dangers emerge.

items.title: Love To Kill
items.description: Nick,a happily married man,learns that his wife Francis murdered her previous husbands. She stalked,she married and then she killed. Francis Sweet a 29 year old gorgeous woman who uses her beauty and charm to lure wealthy men.

items.title: Bad Kids Go To Hell
items.description: On a stormy Saturday afternoon, six students from Crestview Academy begin to meet horrible fates as they serve out their detentions.

items.title: Scary Movie 3
items.description: David Zucker (AIRPLANE!) directs SCARY MOVIE 3, which piles on hysterical yet gratuitous cameos from thrillers, blockbusters, and pop culture in general, getting its best goosing yet.

items.title: Dear Frankie
items.description: A loving mom (Emily Mortimer) hides her young son from the truth about his father by hiring a handsome stranger (Gerard Butler) to pose as the boy's dad.

items.title: Jackie Chan's Project A
items.description: Dragon Ma a lieutenant in the 19th-century Hong Kong marines battles Pirates that have been terrorizing local waters in this must-see adrenaline-pumping adventure delivers all the intense thrills and witty fun that Jackie Chan fans demand!

items.title: Jackie Chan's Project A2 (A Gai Waak Juk Jaap)
items.description: Dragon Mao is assigned to lead the local police force but soon discovers that police corruption is running wild right under his nose. When he's framed for a jewelry robbery, Dragon Mao must fight to clear his name.

items.title: Life Is Beautiful (La Vita E Bella)
items.description: In this movie masterpiece, a charming but bumbling waiter wins the heart of the woman he loves, and creates a beautiful life for his young family, only to be challenged by the horrors of World War II.

items.title: Nightwatch
items.description: A cash-strapped law student is making easy money as night watchman at the city morgue. But his peaceful graveyard shift becomes a time of terror when a serial killer begins wreaking havoc and leaving behind clues pointing to Martin's guilt!

items.title: La Duquesa
items.description: Crónica de la vida en el siglo XVIII de la aristócrata Georgiana, Duquesa de Devonshire, antepasado de la Princesa Diana.

items.title: A.C.O.R.N.S: Operation Crackdown
items.description: Frankie the squirrel finds out acorns are being stolen by the evil A.C.O.R.N.S. Corporation. Now he must assemble a rag-tag team of forest animals with only three days to pull off their biggest heist.

items.title: ¿Y dónde está el policía? 2 1/2
items.description: Frank Drebin (Leslie Nielsen) adora el misterio. ¿Por qué estamos aquí? ¿Hay vida después del sexo? Sí, aborda los grandes temas, y el más grande es detener a Quentin Hapsburg (Robert Goulet) en su plan para destruir el medio ambiente.

items.title: Case 347
items.description: CASE 347 follows psychologist and UFO skeptic, Dr. Mia Jansen (Maya Stojan), and a team of documentary filmmakers who believe that alien abduction claims are forms of "mass hysteria". This is their footage:

items.title: Battle of Britain - Empty Skies
items.description: Explore the WWII air battles fought in the Summer of 1940, in this moving recounting of actual events, told by the veterans who were there.

items.title: We Still Steal the Old Way
items.description: The Archer Gang are back and doing a daring heist in London. Remanded in prison, they will try to break out their old friend Briggs.

items.title: Who Is Arthur Chu?
items.description: The award winning documentary Who Is Arthur Chu? follows the controversial 11-time Jeopardy! champion turned internet iconoclast, Arthur Chu, as he struggles to reform society and himself in a seminal year.

items.title: It All Begins With A Song: The Story Of A Nashville Songwriter
items.description: Visit the world of Nashville songwriters, whose melodies and lyrics reach millions of fans. With over 50 masters: Garth Brooks, Brad Paisley, Luke Bryan, Rodney Crowell, Kacey Musgraves, John Hiatt, Keb Mo, Liz Rose, Claude Kelly and more!

items.title: The More You Ignore me
items.description: Set to the songs of the Smiths, The More You Ignore Me is a darkly funny coming-of-age story of dysfunctional family life in the 1980's.

items.title: Iron Monkey
items.description: Presentado por Quentin Tarantino, Iron Monkey es el brioso relato de una misteriosa y mítica leyenda china de artes marciales excitantes e incesantes.

items.title: In Old California-Colorized
items.description: The Duke plays a young, ambitious pharmacist who moves into a brawling frontier town but locks horns with a local crime lord, bent on keeping the town for himself.

items.title: Above & Beyond
items.description: When a cop is accidentally shot by his partner, leaving him paralyzed, he tries to come to terms with his anger and heal his relationship with his wife and his partner.

items.title: Blind Obsession
items.description: When a police officer is blinded in a gunfight, he finds his life is invaded by an obsessive therapist and her deranged sister. The unexpected becomes the norm in this taut thriller.

items.title: Dangerous Attraction
items.description: When a woman dates two very different men, she finds herself torn between a responsible co-worker and a dangerous yet stimulating ruffian. Before long, she finds out the two men have more in common than she thinks in this taut sexual thriller.

items.title: El día de la bestia
items.description: When a rogue priest discovers the exact date The Antichrist will be born, he'll enlist a Death Metal record store clerk and a cheesy TV psychic to prevent the Apocalypse by summoning Satan himself. Now restored in 4k from the original negative.

items.title: Dark Desire
items.description: A young man desperate to be connected to the people close to him resorts to devious measures to achieve that desire.

items.title: Daydream Believers: The Monkees Story
items.description: The true story of four hopeful young singers who are brought together by NBC as a singing group, a group manufactured to be the American alternative to the Beatles.

items.title: Determination of Death
items.description: A woman gets dragged into a life insurance scam by her abusive husband and nefarious sister, only to find that her own life may now be in danger – a twist at every turn in this gripping whodunit.

items.title: Dying On The Edge
items.description: Based on a true story, the owners of a Hollywood sound studio try to capitalize on the music business and get in over their heads with moneylenders.

items.title: Face Value
items.description: When Tim, a wealthy young entrepreneur, invites his old college friend Barry to LA, Barry is swept up into Tim's glamorous and fast-paced life. When Tim disappears, Barry assumes his identity and ends up being pursued by a gang of murderous drug dealers.

items.title: Modigliani
items.description: The story of Amedeo Modigliani's bitter rivalry with Pablo Picasso, and his tragic romance with Jeanne Hebuterne.

items.title: Accident Man
items.description: Mike is a tough hitman, who makes his hits look like accidents or suicide. He's in a gang of hitmen, each with his own style. When his loved ex is killed, Mike looks for those responsible.

items.title: Take Me to the River (2015)
items.description: California teen Ryder plans to come out to his extended family at their Nebraska reunion, but instead finds himself the target of suspicion when a strange encounter with his younger cousin Molly places him at the center of a long buried family secret.

items.title: Farewell My Love
items.description: A young girl who witnessed her family being killed by a Russian crime family, vows revenge years later. A rival gang, concerned that more killings will start a crime war, tries to thwart her until they can find out what's behind her intentions.

items.title: The Girl Next Door
items.description: When passion and desperation cause a woman to abandon her values, her police officer boyfriend seduces her into a nefarious crime. A psychologist figures out what has happened and tries to extricate her and bring the cop to justice.

items.title: Living in Fear
items.description: A newly married bride travels to her husband's hometown for the reading of his father's will. When she discovers that the townspeople suspect her husband of a murder committed twenty years ago, she has her doubts about the man she's committed her life to.

items.title: Malpractice
items.description: An attorney investigates a malpractice case against her physician husband and discovers that he had an affair with his nurse, and that the patient's death may have been a murder planned and executed by the two of them.

items.title: Las 7 aventuras de Simbad
items.description: Simbad, el Príncipe de Persia original, debe completar siete tareas para salvar al mundo de una catástrofe.

items.title: Perilous
items.description: A business man on a trip to Russia is mistaken for a jewel thief and thrust into a world of gangsters. The only way out appears to be with a Russian woman who knows how to navigate the Russian underground, and knows more than she is letting on.

items.title: Point Last Seen
items.description: A park ranger searches the desert for a mother's lost child, while praying and hoping for the safe return of her own children, who were abducted by her abusive ex-husband. Based upon the book by Hannah Nyala.

items.title: Rites of Passage
items.description: A father and his two sons reunite at the family's vacation cabin in the hope of reconciling their past differences. When this is interrupted by two escaped convicts who descend onto the cabin, the father must negotiate for the lives of his family.

items.title: Seduced By A Thief
items.description: When a security guard is blamed for the theft of a necklace, he tracks down the beautiful thief, only to be seduced into a world of diamond smuggling and double-cross.

items.title: Latter Days
items.description: An LA party boy falls in love with a hunky, repressed Mormon missionary in this gay romantic comedy from C. Jay Cox, writer of the Hollywood hit 'Sweet Home Alabama'.

items.title: Snowbound
items.description: Two women, lifelong friends, retreat to a mountain cabin only to become snowbound in a winter storm. Their friendship is put to the test as they face one's violent ex-husband who is after two million dollars in stolen money.

items.title: Spirit
items.description: When a woman's mother is killed in a car accident, she is riddled with guilt for having caused the accident. She and her father move to an old house in New Orleans that is haunted by her mother's ghost in this gripping tale of discovery and compassion.

items.title: Striking Poses
items.description: When a young woman who works as a paparazzo is stalked and then swindled by a group of people she trusted, she tries to fight back in a violent world of cons and double-cross.

items.title: The Good Mother
items.description: Teen Jillian is arrested. Melanie, her best friend, family takes her in. When Melanie dies after a long illness, Jillian discovers that Melanie's mom might not be who we think she is. Jillian must fight to find out the truth.

items.title: Tick Tock
items.description: The young wife of a rich businessman finds herself being blackmailed by her lover after a one-night stand, but who is blackmailing who, and will anyone live to tell about it? Twists and turns abound in this sexy psychological thriller.

items.title: The Perfect Wife
items.description: A twisted woman wants revenge against the unwitting man she blames for killing her brother. She seduces him, marries him and proceeds to make his life hell while plotting his ultimate demise.

items.title: Touched By A Killer
items.description: A lonely woman falls for an inmate on death row. Believing him to be innocent, she lies to get him acquitted, then fears she's made a deadly mistake. Expect the unexpected in this thriller based on Richard Vetere's play "Rage of the Blue Moon."

items.title: Million Dollar Hotel
items.description: Tragi-comic, romantic whodunnit set in a run down hotel which plays host to mentally ill people too poor to afford medical insurance.

items.title: A Boy. A Girl. A Dream
items.description: On the night of the 2016 Presidential election, Cass, an LA club promoter, takes a thrilling and emotional journey with Frida, a Midwestern visitor. She challenges him to revisit his broken dreams, while he pushes her to discover hers.

items.title: ¿Sólo amigos?
items.description: Harto de malas relaciones, Wallace (Daniel Radcliffe), que abandonó su carrera de medicina, decide poner su vida amorosa en pausa. Tras enamorarse de Chantry (Zoe Kazan), una animadora que vive con su novio Ben (Rafe Spall), el "amor" se complica.

items.title: Madeline: Lost in Paris
items.description: When a long-lost uncle form Vienna pays a surprise visit, Madeline’s dreams of family life seem wonderfully fulfilled – until she finds herself in the middle of an unscrupulous scheme.

items.title: Here Come the Littles
items.description: When Henry Bigg's parents are lost in Africa, the boy must go live with his mean Uncle Augustus.

items.title: Run For Cover
items.description: Ex-criminal in the old days of the West teaches a woman the ways of love and a boy the art of courage.

items.title: No hay más remedio
items.description: Roberto, Fonso and Ángel are three old men full of regrets and unfulfilled dreams. They decide to rob a drug store as an easy way to reach those unsatisfied needs before it's to late.

items.title: Café los Maestros (LAS)
items.description: Interviews with the musicians and singers from Argentina's golden days of Tango.

items.title: Veganism: Cooking for Tomorrow
items.description: Enrich your palette with some of the tastiest vegan dishes coming out of London with The Feel Good Cafe owner Idan Naor, social media superstar Clare Every (The Little London Vegan), and award-winning vegan chef Brett Cobley.

items.title: Come Back, Little Sheba
items.description: Based on William Inge's classic play, Come Back, Little Sheba is the stirring tale of a life-weary couple who rescue hope from the ruins of the past.

items.title: Jessica Watkins: SPECIALish
items.description: A struggling standup comedian decides to jump start her career by walking across the United States. Never having hiked before, and not a comedy club in sight, getting laughs won't be the only hard part.

items.title: Little Big Man
items.description: From director Arthur Penn (BONNIE AND CLYDE), Dustin Hoffman, Chief Dan George, Faye Dunaway, Martin Balsam, Jeff Corey and Richard Mulligan star in a genre-defying tale of an alleged 121-year-old white survivor of Custer's Last Stand.

items.title: Heaven (2002)
items.description: A woman takes the law into her own hands after police ignore her pleas to arrest the man responsible for her husband's death, and finds herself not only under arrest for murder but falling in love with an officer.

items.title: I Love You, I Love You Not
items.description: Daisy feels like a complete outsider at her stuffy New York prep school. So when she catches the eye of the coolest guy in the school, she is totally psyched...but afraid that opening up too much might blow it for her.

items.title: Dracula: The True Story of Vampires
items.description: How did the myth of the vampire come to be? Explore the birth of vampire in this documentary. From small Transylvanian villages, to Ireland's fields, this journey takes one into the heart of Count Dracula, and beyond.

items.title: El Coco
items.description: Piroberta llega a vivir a una casa que heredó su tía, pero en esa casa vive un espíritu maligno, y junto a sus amigas, y la hechicera Dioselina, tendrán que salir de allí con vida.

items.title: El Coco 2
items.description: En una prisión colombiana se están produciendo extraños efectos paranormales. Esto se ve agravado por la llegada de un extraño nuevo recluso. El director de la prisión decide acudir a Piroberta, Micolta, Don Jediondo, Carroloco y El Mono Sánchez para acab

items.title: KUSAMA - INFINITY
items.description: Artist Yayoi Kusama battles sexism and racism while rising to fame in America during the 1960s, from a conservative upbringing in Japan to her eventual placement in a Tokyo mental institution.

items.title: Buena Vista Social Club: Adios
items.description: Revisit with the remaining original members of the Buena Vista Social Club and explore their contribution to the unknown history of Cuba.

items.title: Rio Lobo
items.description: This fifth and final collaboration between John Wayne and director Howard Hawks is an action-filled Western set after the Civil War, in which a group of men seek out Union traitors responsible for a string of train robbers.

items.title: Samba
items.description: Senegalese Samba has worked 10 years in France. He's arrested and befriends the woman helping him with legal matters as volunteer after a burnout at work. He's released after being told to leave France. Chemistry?

items.title: Eden (2014)
items.description: Paul, a teenager in the underground scene of early-nineties Paris, forms a DJ collective with his friends

items.title: Overdrive
items.description: Scott Eastwood stars in this action-adventure from the writers of 2 Fast 2 Furious and the director of Taken. When two legendary car thieves are caught stealing from a mafia boss, they are given a week to nab a vintage Ferrari, or risk losing everything.

items.title: Mike Wallace is Here
items.description: A look at the career of '60 Minutes' newsman, Mike Wallace.

items.title: Love, Gilda
items.description: In her own words, comedienne Gilda Radner looks back and reflects on her life and career.

items.title: Support the Girls
items.description: Regina Hall (Girls Trip) stars as the manager of a "sports bar with curves." She runs the joint like a family, but over the course of one challenging day her incurable optimism is tested by sketchy employees, bad customers and an even worse boss.

The mastermind behind New York's hottest club plucks a young man from those clamoring to get inside and hires him as a barback. With an all-star cast and a hit dance soundtrack, it's about to become the most legendary party on the planet.

items.title: Braven
items.description: Jason Momoa stars in this intense action-thriller about a logger fighting for survival against drug traffickers who have stashed heroin in his hunting cabin.

items.title: Killing Them Softly
items.description: During the economic turmoil of 2008, Jackie Cogan (Brad Pitt), an enforcer, is hired to restore order after three idiots rob a mob-protected poker game.

items.title: Pulse
items.description: When their computer hacker friend accidentally channels a mysterious wireless signal, a group of co-eds rally to stop a terrifying evil from taking over the world.

items.title: The Con Is On
items.description: This stylish, star-studded caper comedy stars Uma Thurman and Tim Roth as a con-artist couple cooking up a jewel-theft scam in LA to pay off a sexy, deadly British gangster.

items.title: The Iron Lady
items.description: OSCAR-winning Meryl Streep is Margaret Thatcher in this insightful and intimate portrait of the first and only female Prime Minister of the United Kingdom.

items.title: The Promotion
items.description: Two assistant managers of a corporate grocery store contend for a coveted promotion.

items.title: LOVE'S LABOUR'S LOST
items.description: The King of Navarre and his best friends have sworn off love in the pursuit of intellectual enlightenment. But when the Princess of France and her beautiful attendants arrive for a diplomatic visit, their high-minded plans turn completely upside down

items.title: Muriel's Wedding
items.description: In this perfect marriage of feel-good comedy and heartfelt drama, a shy daydreamer finds the courage to leave on a tropical vacation, where she meets a wacky new friend, changes her name, and turns her world upside down, all to an ABBA soundtrack.

items.title: Secret World of Lego
items.description: In The Secret World of LEGO, we follow Justin, a young design student, as he travels to LEGO headquarters in Denmark in pursuit of one of the most hotly contested jobs in the world, a LEGO set designer.

items.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! The Movie
items.description: Heroic Yugi squares off against archrival Kaiba in an adventure even more dangerous when the imaginary monsters in their playing cards become ferociously real…and when an old evil enters the fray.

items.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Bonds Beyond Time
items.description: It's a whole new deal! For the first time, Yugi, Jaden & Yusei are together in an all-new adventure!

items.title: El chico del tiempo
items.description: Cuando el hijo adolescente del inventor de la Máquina del tiempo se da cuenta que su padre está perdido en el tiempo, él se embarca en una aventura espectacular.

items.title: El increíble Zorro
items.description: La emocionante historia de Don Diego Vega, un joven aristócrata perezoso de la vieja California, viviendo una vida secreta como el Zorro, el misterioso vengador enmascarado y defensor de los oprimidos

items.title: Collision
items.description: A deadly accident in the Sahara leaves newlyweds facing a dangerous journey to safety...and the lies and betrayals that got them there.

items.title: Remember Me
items.description: Two people scarred by grief find happiness in each other. Robert Pattinson (the TWILIGHT films) and Emilie de Ravin star in this deeply romantic story with a stunning ending.

items.title: The Lost Bladesman
items.description: Set in 198 A.D., when the Eastern Han Dynasty has collapsed into civil war, and the young Emperor is a puppet of prime minster and generalissimo Cao Cao (Jiang), the film singles out two famous chapters from Guan’s (Yen) many heroic adventures.

items.title: The Miracle Season
items.description: In the inspiring true-life drama THE MIRACLE SEASON, one girl’s story leads her team and town to victory.

items.title: In Secret
items.description: A sexually-repressed young woman (Elizabeth Olsen) embarks on an illicit affair with her husband's alluring friend in this smoldering & seductive thriller set in 1860's Paris.

items.title: Steppin
items.description: College students prepare to enter a step-dance competition that features a big money prize. Sororities and fraternities battle to recruit the best talent to help them win.

items.title: Busco novio para mi mujer
items.description: Paco, harto de las quejas y reproches de su esposa, idea un ingenioso plan para acabar con su infeliz matrimonio: conseguirle un novio contratando a un seductor profesional apodado “El Taiger” para que la conquiste y la saque del matrimonio.

items.title: As It Happened: Tarawa
items.description: Tarawa was the most strongly defended island in the Pacific which the Japanese boasted that a million Americans couldn’t take the island in one hundred years. On Tarawa the Marines faced their sternest test yet.

items.title: A Frozen New Year's
items.description: Cozy-up tight, it's New Years Eve! The world-renowned Santa, along with his trusty deer, Lear, fly high and listen to holiday songs that fills them with cheer! Ride along, kids with our holiday heroes as they have a fantastic time on the most fun of night

items.title: As It Happened: Saipan
items.description: June 15th 1944, just nine days after D-Day in Normandy, on the far side of the world another invasion fleet was about to land its troops. The battle for the Island of Saipan would be savage, its capture to three, long, gruesome weeks.

items.title: As It Happened: Pearl Harbour
items.description: Take a look into the events that unfolded in Pearl Harbour, in 1941. Aerial reconnaissance photographs have been used to reconstruct Pearl Harbour to create an unprecedented vantage point on the most infamous attack of World War II.

items.title: As It Happened: Iwo Jima
items.description: In the final year of World War 2, one of the most dramatic battles took place on the volcanic island of Iwo Jima, Japan. This dramatic documentary features the stories of the brave heroes who were on the ground that day fighting for our freedom.

items.title: Aliens And Atlantis
items.description: Aliens and Atlantis uses new research and insight to expose Atlantis as the pivotal part of our ancient beginnings.

items.title: As It Happened: Guadalcanal
items.description: US Marines strike back on their first attack of the Pacific War. In horrific conditions US Marines fight a six month campaign of attrition against the seemingly invisible Japanese.

items.title: Dark Secrets Of The Nazis
items.description: Are there secret organizations that have manipulated society and even brought about war? Explore the influence of organizations cloaked in mystery, which hold power over world events.

items.title: Wee Dragons
items.description: The peaceful Kingdom of the Wee Dragons is plunged into turmoil, when villainous Blister teams with fearsome dragon Durwyn, to overthrow King Bedwyr and force his daughter, Princess Cai, to marry the evil goblin, King Foul.

items.title: Sir Noface
items.description: Award-Winning Documentarian Chad Calek's Sir Noface documentary chronicles the only paranormal investigation in history to be officially sanctioned by the Australian Government.

items.title: G.I. Joe: The Rise of Cobra
items.description: They are G.I. Joe, a top-secret elite strike force featuring the best operatives from around the globe. After the evil Cobra steals a secret weapon, the G.I. Joes must stop Cobra from plunging the world into chaos.

items.title: Zoolander
items.description: Three-time male model of the year, Derek Zoolander, is devastated when he loses the title to newbie Hansel. After the news, Mugatu's fashion empire brainwashes Derek into being an assassin.

items.title: Two Face: The Gray
items.description: The sequel to Chad Calek's Sir Noface documentary, Two Face: The Grey is the continuation of the investigation into the most compelling paranormal case in history, which reveals extraterrestrial implications on a global scale.

items.title: UFO Chronicles: Alien Technology
items.description: Experts reveal shocking accounts of UFO encounters on Earth and the effect Alien tech has had on our planet.

items.title: The Impossible
items.description: Nominated for an Academy Award® (Best Actress, Naomi Watts), this gripping drama tells the incredible true story of one family’s survival in the face of impossible odds.

items.title: For Pete's Sake
items.description: Have you ever wanted to do something you knew wasn't right, but still wonder what if? Like opening a bag of peanuts to see who might be allergic. In For Pete's Sake, Pete Correale explores topics that everyone may secretly be thinking.

items.title: Wrestled Away
items.description: Kemp's life starts in racial turmoil until he finds wrestling in 9th grade. He goes nearly undefeated in High School and moves on to Wisconsin. At 18, Kemp defeats Dan Gable, a legend in american wrestling. Kemp goes on to take 3 NCAA Championships and 10

items.title: Alone Across The Arctic
items.description: Acclaimed explorer Adam Shoalts brings a canoe, his full repertoire of wilderness survival skills on an extraordinary trek across approximately 4,000 kilometres of the remote North. The intrepid Shoalts aims to cross the breadth of the northernmost wilds

items.title: Functional Fitness
items.description: This documentary takes a raw and introspective look into the world of Functional Fitness, illustrating what this growing trend is all about. An inspiring film that explores how this fitness phenomenon has enhanced the lives of so many people.

items.title: Flin Flon: A Hockey Town
items.description: The mining town of Flin Flon is similar to most other small towns with one major exception – the community is lovingly obsessed with their junior hockey team, which over the decades has spawned several National Hockey League legends. Flin Flon, named for

items.title: Life Without Basketball
items.description: Life Without Basketball takes us inside the world of Bilqis Abdul-Qaadir. As a record-breaking high school star and college athlete, her life as a basketball player had structure and a clear forward path. Bilqis was raised to follow the Quran and has been

items.title: Nazis on Trial: Nuremberg in Colour
items.description: After almost six years of the Second World War, Germany had surrendered unconditionally on May 8, 1945. Now Nuremberg, where the Nazi Party once celebrated arrogant rallies, was to become the scene of the party's reckoning before the law.

items.title: Field of Operations: D-Day
items.description: The Normandy landings were the landing operations and associated airborne operations on Tuesday, 6 June 1944 of the Allied invasion of Normandy in Operation Overlord during World War II. Codenamed Operation Neptune and referred to as D-Day.

items.title: The Sword And The Sorcerer
items.description: A mercenary with a three-bladed sword rediscovers his royal heritage's dangerous future when he is recruited to help a princess foil the designs of a brutal tyrant and a powerful sorcerer in conquering a land.

items.title: The Hoax
items.description: The intriguing and comedic account of the unbelievably true story of the scam that shook the literary community about a man who sold a fraudulent biography of Howard Hughes to publishing giant McGraw Hill.

items.title: The Human Stain
items.description: Coleman Silk (Hopkins) has a secret. A terrible fifty-year-old secret that the esteemed college professor has kept hidden from everyone including his wife, his children and his down-and-out young lover (Kidman)and it's about to ruin his entire life.

items.title: A Walk In The Woods
items.description: After spending two decades in England, Bill Bryson (Robert Redford) returns to the U.S., where he decides the best way to connect with his homeland is to hike the Appalachian Trail with one of his oldest friends, Stephen Katz (Nick Nolte).

items.title: Sketch Artist II: Hands That See
items.description: In this electrifying thriller, sketch artist Jack Whitfield (Jeff Fahey) is drawn into the strangest -- and deadliest -- case of his career when the only witness to a brutal crime spree is a beautiful -- and blind -- young woman (Courtney Cox).

items.title: The Dirty Dozen: The Fatal Mission
items.description: Major Wright is threatened with court-martial unless he accepts an assignment to rescue six scientists coerced into developing a nerve gas so lethal that it could change the course of the war.

items.title: The Dirty Dozen: The Deadly Mission
items.description: The Dirty Dozen are back! Telly Savalas and Ernest Borgnine lead a motley crew of twelve renegade soldiers as they attempt to thwart a Nazi scheme of establishing a Fourth Reich in this thrilling -- and explosive -- World War II action-adventure!

items.title: Cold Turkey
items.description: Dick Van Dyke stars as Clayton Brooks, minister in a small Iowa town, who takes up the challenge presented by an ad exec (Bob Newhart) for a tobacco company: any city or town in America that can give up smoking for 30 days gets $25 million dollars.

items.title: The Night They Raided Minsky's
items.description: Britt Ekland, Elliott Gould and Jason Robards lead a stellar cast -- including Bert Lahr in his final performance -- in this utterly charming comedy about a young Amish girl who accidentally creates the striptease during the golden age of burlesque!

items.title: Sketch Artist
items.description: In this intense psychological thriller, police composite artist Jack Whitfield (Jeff Fahey) must discover the truth when a witness (Drew Barrymore) in a murder investigation describes the prime suspect...his own wife, Rayanne (Sean Young)!

items.title: The Blood On Satan's Claw
items.description: Horror, suspense, and the occult mix to make this a hair-raising experience even for veteran horror fans.

items.title: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure
items.description: Our non-heinous heroes Bill (Alex Winter) and Ted (Keanu Reeves) are in danger of flunking history! But when the righteous Rufus (George Carlin) arrives in a time-travelling phone booth, the dense dudes discover their destiny!

items.title: A Force of One
items.description: In this thrill-a-minute film, action superstar Chuck Norris stars as a martial arts champion enlisted to help track down a serial killer...and the man responsible for the murder of his adoptive son. Jennifer O'Neill and Clu Gulager also star.

items.title: Caníbal
items.description: Un sastre meticuloso con un secreto macabro se enamora de una mujer rumana fascinante a pesar de temer que llegue a un final espantoso.

items.title: The Woman In White
items.description: Based upon Wilkie Collins' Victorian mystery, the gothic tale tells of a pair of half sisters whose lives end up caught in a grand conspiracy revolving around a mentally ill woman dressed in white

items.title: El curioso caso de Benjamin Button
items.description: Brad Pitt y Cate Blanchett protagonizan esta adaptación de la historia de F. Scott Fitzgerald acerca de un anciano que va rejuveneciendo y los problemas que surgen cuando se enamora de una mujer.

items.title: Marilyn, Misunderstood
items.description: A glimpse into other sides of Marilyn; Marilyn never stopped fighting to be taken seriously.

items.title: Victory at Last: WWII Is Over
items.description: Upon the defeat of Germany, celebrations erupted throughout the western world, especially in the UK and North America. More than one million people celebrated in the streets throughout the UK to mark the end of the European part of the war.

items.title: Saddle Club: Friends Forever
items.description: The arrival of beautiful, mysterious French Junior Champion DorothŽe Doutey, causes rumors and sparks to fly in this chapter of the classic series.

items.title: Saddle Club: Horse Crazy
items.description: Between school, riding, boys, and typical adolescent drama, the girls of the Pine Hollows ranch are never bored. They're in for even more excitement, however, when Skye Ransom, a young teenage heartthrob, comes to the farm to shoot a film.

items.title: Saddle Club: Horse of a Different Color
items.description: A valuable show horse transported from France arrives at Pine Hollow, with the horse's mysterious owner to arrive later. When the champion event horse (Hugo) escapes, Carol, Stevie, and Lisa take it upon themselves to help find him.

items.title: Saddle Club: Saving Pine Hollow
items.description: When financial issues at Pine Hollow have the Saddle Club scrambling to make money to help out, Veronica's father decides to help out by investing in the stables.

items.title: Saddle Club: Storm At Pine Hollow
items.description: Lisa takes a beautiful but violent foster horse named Storm to be rehabilitated at Pine Hollow.

items.title: Saddle Club: The Mane Event
items.description: In this chapter of the classic series, Carole, Stevie, and Lisa get involved in everything from a burning barn to an unexpected proposal.

items.title: British Jets: Empire of the Sky
items.description: From the Tornado to the GR4 to the Eurofighter Typhoon. Britain’s international domination of the sky, its magnificent aerospace engineering have been the savior of many escalating conflicts globally. The pinnacle of military accomplishment.

items.title: Vietnam War: Tales from Nam
items.description: From 1955 to 1975 the war in Vietnam was unprecedented and relentless. It was like no war ever fought before. This was a new kind of warfare and for once the US was out of its depth. In this documentary, we take an intimate look at Nam.

items.title: 1933: The Fall of the Weimar Republic
items.description: The Weimar Republic came to bear for many the humiliation of World War I and the blame for all its accompanying hardships. Adolf Hitler converted democracy into a dictatorship, causing the fall of the Weimar Republic.

items.title: WWII Aircraft: Designed for Victory
items.description: Watch as we follow the ingenuity and genius of designers from both side of the Atlantic as they manufacture planes such as the Vought XF5U and the Chance Vought flying Pancake throughout the Second World War.

items.title: Hitler's Defeat: Victory Against All Odds
items.description: This is the journey of British people’s courage, resourcefulness and ‘Keep Calm and Carry On’ attitude led to victory in the fight against Hitler.

items.title: Elite Formations: The Story of the Red Arrows
items.description: Explore the beginnings of powered flight and the exponential development during the 20th century of precision engineering, lighting speed and human ingenuity.

items.title: The Battle Above: True Stories from WWII Pilots
items.description: Join us as we hear the incredible real accounts from military officers on both sides of the war as they recount harrowing true stories from their time in aerial combat.

items.title: London Under Nazi Siege: WWII Britain
items.description: At the height of the second world war the Nazis knew that the British were their fiercest enemy. They had tried to capture Britain by land and sea but decided that it was by sky that they would make send their evil message.

items.title: Battle of Britain
items.description: A stellar cast, including Michael Caine, Laurence Olivier and Christopher Plummer highlights this epic telling of the greatest air battle in history, when the outnumbered Royal Air Force defeated the German Luftwaffe, saving England from invasion.

items.title: Journey to the West 2
items.description: Based on the beloved classic 16th century Chinese novels, Journey to the West tells the story of Monkey, a most unlikely hero on a most extraordinary journey… where adventure lurks beyond every turn.

items.title: My Uncle the Alien
items.description: While at a visit to a Los Angeles youth shelter, the President’s wife and daughter learn the shelter is to be shut down due to budget difficulties.

items.title: Nadie es perfecto
items.description: Walter Koontz quien una vez fue héroe de la policía, hoy es guardia de seguridad en una cocina. Una fatídica noche, después de escuchar los gritos de un vecino, su intento de ayudar se convierte en una pesadilla tras sufrir un ataque cerebrovascular.

items.title: Hitler's Best Kept Secret: The Eva Braun Tapes
items.description: Eva Braun. Hitler’s mistress and eventual wife. A woman with a passion for photography and film, documenting the daily goings-on among Hitler’s inner circle. Now, a haunting look behind closed doors, uncovering the Eva Braun tapes.

items.title: War at Sea: Naval Aviation
items.description: The idea of uniting the aircraft and the ship is a simple one but this simple idea has been the subject of great technical innovation, has led to decisive military success, and has found itself the focus of increasing controversy.

items.title: Death from Above: Air Combat Vietnam War
items.description: Decades after it ended the Vietnam War might seem like a remote affair. In fact it was an enormous conflict, the longest war in American history and the only one from which the USA did not emerge victorious.

items.title: Führerbunker: Adolf Hitler's Final Days
items.description: Adolf Hitler is in hiding. The man that fuelled this chaos, leaving the country to crumble. These are Adolf Hitler’s final days. Inside the Fuhrerbunker.

items.title: The Pacific War: Okinawa & Guadalcanal
items.description: Take a look at two of the most hard hitting battles of the second world war in the pacific.Hear from some of the veterans that served their country and the horror stories they lived through during the battles in Okinawa and Guadalcanal.

items.title: Churchill: The Road to Victory
items.description: Politician, officer and leader - Winston Churchill served as the Prime Minister of Great Britain in arguably some of the most trying times of modern history.

items.title: D-Day: The Day That Won the War
items.description: D-Day… It was all or nothing and one of the biggest strategic gambles ever to be undertaken but it was a gamble that paid off and became the most decisive victory for the allied forces.

items.title: Navajo Joe
items.description: Burt Reynolds, Aldo Sambrell and Fernando Rey star in this lusty, gutsy action western about a fearless Indian with a relentless vendetta against the band of outlaws that killed his people. Directed by Spaghetti Western legend Sergio Corbucci.

items.title: Semi-Tough
items.description: Barbara Jane (Jill Clayburgh), Billy Clyde (Burt Reynolds) and Shake (Kris Kristofferson) have been best friends for years. But when Barbara Jane's new interest in Shake turns into love, Billy Clyde realizes she's the woman he’s wanted all along!

items.title: Un funeral de muerte
items.description: Esta estrafalaria comedia británica nos muestra con un humor negro azabache la miríada de escandalosas calamidades que asuelan a un excéntrico clan inglés, que guarda unos cuantos muertos en el armario, cuando el patriarca muere inesperadamente.

items.title: The Masque of the Red Death (1964)
items.description: When the sadistic prince (Vincent Price) finds that the Red Death has arrived in the village he rules, he forsakes his people and hides in his castle with his fellow aristocrats…until a mysterious stranger turns his haven into a danse macabre!

items.title: Yo, el halcón
items.description: Un título de campeón, un gran premio en metálico y el amor de su hijo: el premio más grande de todos, corren peligro cuando Hawk se enfrenta a su mayor enemigo por todo lo que siempre ha querido.

items.title: Flying Fortress: History of the B-17 Bomber
items.description: The Boeing B-17 stood as a powerful symbol of the United States’ unsurmountable air power. Dubbed the flying fortress it conquered the skies and is most closely associated with the air war over Europe.

items.title: A Price Above Rubies
items.description: Renée Zellweger portrays a Brooklyn Hasidic woman struggling for fulfillment while hemmed in by tradition and an arranged marriage. Boaz Yakin (Remember the Titans) directs.

items.title: Extraordinary Measures
items.description: Determination pushes an idealistic father into joining forces with a reclusive medical researcher to find a cure before it's too late. Harrison Ford and Brendan Fraser star in this true story of the power of love and faith against impossible odds.

items.title: Hitler's Fatal Mistake: The Fall of the Third Reich
items.description: With the declaration of war on September 3rd, the fight would be long and bitter, and Hitler’s decision to destroy his non aggression pact with Stalin was a fatal mistake that would cost him dearly.

items.title: Best In Class: The Making Of A Concours D'elegance
items.description: Best In Class: The Making Of A Concours D'elegance

items.title: Funny Cow
items.description: Funny Cow

items.title: Cásate conmigo
items.description: Después de perder a la mujer de sus sueños, Anderson (Biggs) es empujado por su mejor amigo para conocer a una completa extraña. Justo cuando pensaba que su vida había terminado, se da cuenta de que es sólo el comienzo.

items.title: Field of Operations: The U-Boats
items.description: While war was raging on land a whole new breed of war was being waged in the oceans of the world. The German submarine U-Boat threat was a dangerous game of sink or swim against British and American forces.

items.title: Becoming Jane
items.description: Anne Hathaway gives a radiant performance as a young, lovestruck Jane Austen in this witty and engaging comedy, exploring the untold romance that inspired the novels of one of the worlds most celebrated authors.

items.title: Cosmic Conspiracy
items.description: There is a conspiracy to rule the world, but the truth is far stranger than fiction. Reality isn't what it seems. With UFO sightings and Alien Abductions on the rise, now is the time to awaken, and realize the biggest conspiracy of them all.

items.title: Blindness
items.description: Led by an all-star cast including Mark Ruffalo and Julianne Moore, victims of a mysterious epidemic of blindness sweeping through a city soon face an even greater affliction: the chaotic breakdown of social order.

items.title: Birthday Girl
items.description: A lonely bank employee, John Buckingham (Ben Chaplin), meets Nadia (Nicole Kidman) through a Russian mail-order bride service. Soon, the sudden arrival of Nadia's gregarious cousins makes John realize that he's in over his head.

items.title: Wings Of The Dove
items.description: When a beautiful young society woman must choose between a life of privilege and poverty, she befriends an heiress whose own tragic secret offers an irresistible, but dangerous, solution to her dilemma in this intriguing story of forbidden love.

items.title: Tommy Boy
items.description: Tommy's earned his diploma and a job at Callahan Auto Parts. However, the family business starts to tank, and now Tommy hits the road with his dad's right-hand man, a smug numbers cruncher.

items.title: All-American Girl: The Mary Kay Letourneau Story
items.description: This provocative film recounts the true facts behind the notorious case of forbidden love between a thirteen-year-old boy and his thirty-four-year-old teacher.

items.title: Abduction
items.description: Quinn, a member of a SWAT unit, steps out of a park fountain in an Asian city with no recollection of who he is or where he came from. As he pieces together clues from his past, he vaguely recalls his young daughter, who has been kidnapped.

items.title: Country Crush
items.description: Nancy Taylor is an aspiring singer struggling to launch her country music career and navigate a relationship with an opportunistic music producer.

items.title: Piranha (1978)
items.description: When flesh-eating piranhas are accidentally released into a summer resort's rivers, the guests become their next meal.

items.title: The Company Of Wolves
items.description: A teenage girl in a country manor falls asleep while reading a magazine, and has a disturbing dream involving wolves prowling the woods below her bedroom window.

items.title: Trial By Jury (1994)
items.description: Valerie is a juror in the trial of a mob boss. When her young son's life is threatened, she has no option other than to see that justice isn't done.

items.title: Wild Gibraltar
items.description: Wild Gibraltar is a wildlife feast featuring the varied and colourful animals which inhabit the border between Africa and Europe.

items.title: Island of the Penguins
items.description: In the middle of the Antarctic Ocean, an entire mountain range arises from the water: South Georgia, the nursery of the Antarctic. Hundreds of thousands of penguins, elephant seals, fur seals, and their young overcrowd the beaches.

items.title: The Incredible Five - A Cheetah's Tale
items.description: Cheetahs are the high-speed hunters of the Savannah. Few attempt to take on larger prey than gazelles or smallish antelopes. But on occasion, the predatory cats reveal their surprisingly different side.

items.title: New Life: Born to Hunt
items.description: Baby animals beguile with their innocent charm. But while some remain harmless, others have a deep-rooted instinct. It may take weeks or months of training to hone their skills, but in every corner of the globe predators emerge.

items.title: New Life: Born to Run
items.description: In a land of dangers, plant-eating animals are always at risk, and never more so than at the time of their birth; out on the open they are vulnerable and there are few places to hide. But luckily some are born to run...

items.title: New Life: Born to Swim
items.description: It's a water world and life couldn't survive without it. And thanks to it, a mind blowing diversity of creatures thrive beneath the surface.

items.title: Tierra de vampiros II
items.description: Tras el asesinato de su familia, Martin se adentra en las tierras baldías de Estados Unidos en busca de Mister con la esperanza de volver a asociarse con él para combatir una nueva amenaza de vampiros.

items.title: Presencias del más allá
items.description: Tras más de cien años en actividad, la posada Yankee Pedlar Inn está por cerrar sus puertas. Los empleados que quedan están decididos a demostrar que se trata de uno de los hoteles más embrujados de Nueva Inglaterra.

items.title: Down in the Delta
items.description: En el debut como directora de Maya Angelou, una afligida madre soltera pasa un verano en la casa familiar de campo en Misisipi, y aprende a revertir el rumbo de su vida en una historia inspiradora sobre la familia, la comunidad y la amistad.

items.title: The Year of Spectacular Men
items.description: Izzy has a bad case of pre-real-world millennial-itis. She falls in and out of some not so romantic romances, and figures out that when it totally feels like the end of your story, it's often just the beginning.

items.title: Here After
items.description: A struggling actor dies right after a bad breakup and finds himself in an afterlife where he's told that he must find true love in order for his soul to move on to the other side.

items.title: Quanta
items.description: A physicist's life-long work is realized when he is reluctantly partnered with a gifted young assistant, but ego divides them when they receive an unknown signal from space.

items.title: Inside
items.description: A woman in her third trimester of pregnancy is stalked by a stranger who is obsessed with her unborn child.

items.title: Passion and Power - Queen Victoria's Secrets
items.description: The secret life of Queen Victoria, the bloodthirsty domineering queen of the English Empire.

items.title: Brand Irish
items.description: The film takes a look at some of the elements that have contributed to the brand: the effect of mass emigration, the contribution to global culture, sport and business, the role of the Irish language, and the drive for political leadership.

items.title: Miracle Weddings
items.description: Miracle Weddings features couples whose love has been tested to the limits because of seemingly insurmountable odds ranging from medical emergencies to natural disasters to the ravages of war.

items.title: Strange Pregnancies
items.description: From the inspiring to the downright shocking, Strange Pregnancies introduces the parents, the babies, and the doctors involved with some of the most unusual pregnancies ever documented.

items.title: Footloose
items.description: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and, therefore, all youthful joy have been banned.

items.title: Mission: Impossible II
items.description: The world's greatest spy, Ethan Hunt, returns and partners up with the beautiful Nyah Hall to stop renegade agent Sean Ambrose from releasing a new kind of terror on an unsuspecting world.

items.title: Mission: Impossible - Ghost Protocol
items.description: Agent Ethan Hunt and his elite team go underground after a bombing implicates them as terrorists. While trying to clear their name, the team uncovers a plot to start a nuclear war.

items.title: Mission: Impossible
items.description: Ethan Hunt, a secret agent, is framed for the deaths of his espionage team and attempts to flee from government assassins after him. He races against the clock to discover the truth.

items.title: Deathstalker II
items.description: Hero Deathstalker (John Terlesky) helps Princess Evie (Monique Gabrielle) reclaim her throne from a sorcerer (John La Zar) and his Princess Evie clone.

items.title: Borderline (1980)
items.description: On the U.S.-Mexican border, border cop Jeb Maynard is hunting for a human smuggler responsible for Jeb's partner's murder.

items.title: Deathstalker
items.description: A medieval muscleman sword-fights a sun lover on his way to free a princess from a wizard's castle.

items.title: Love And Bullets
items.description: The FBI sends a loner (Charles Bronson) to kidnap a mobster's mistress in Switzerland.

items.title: Man Up
items.description: Martin, a 19-year-old post high school bum, is on a year-long extended summer vacation when his world gets flipped after he learns that his Mormon girlfriend is pregnant

items.title: Season of the Witch
items.description: A 14th-century Crusader returns to a homeland devastated by the Black Plague. A beleaguered church commands the knight to transport an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will perform a ritual in hopes of ending the pestilence.

items.title: The Count of Monte Cristo
items.description: A young man, falsely imprisoned by his jealous 'friend', escapes and uses a hidden treasure to exact his revenge.

items.title: One Message
items.description: One Message

items.title: The Harder They Come
items.description: Reggae legend Jimmy Cliff stars as Ivan Martin, an aspiring singer hoping to make a name for himself. Robbed of his money and possessions, he finds work with a self-righteous preacher

items.title: The Last Seduction
items.description: A devious sexpot steals her husband's drug money and hides out in a small town where she meets the perfect dupe for her next scheme.

items.title: Defining Moments
items.description: Defining Moments

items.title: The Real Blonde
items.description: Joe and Mary have been living together in Manhattan for six years. Joe is an actor, who has no agent and no thesping credits, but whose ambitions are very high.

items.title: The Rebound
items.description: Sandy, upon discovering her husband's infidelity while watching her son's birthday video, leaves the suburbs and moves into the city.

items.title: Welcome Home, Roxy Carmichael
items.description: A small town prepares for the homecoming of superstar Roxy Carmichael, as does a young outsider, who believes Roxy is her mother.

items.title: Detective Dee: The Four Heavenly Kings
items.description: Accused of wrongdoing by Empress Wu, Detective Dee must defend himself against this formidable foe, all while investigating a crime wave that has engulfed the city, marked by strange and seemingly supernatural occurrences.

items.title: The Tiger
items.description: An ex-sharpshooter for the Kingdom of Korea is hunting the country's last tiger. But Japanese forces and vicious local poachers also seek 'The Four-Legged Mountain Lord,' and will stop at nothing to claim their prey.

items.title: Unstoppable
items.description: In this hard-hitting action-thriller, Ma Dong‑Seok stars as a legendary gangster enjoying a quiet retirement. But when his wife is kidnapped, he must once again become the brutal criminal he left behind in order to get her back.

items.title: The Mayor
items.description: For the first time in Korean history, the mayor of Seoul attempts a third term in office.

items.title: The Prison
items.description: A troubled ex-cop imprisoned for a hit-and-run accident discovers that the entire penitentiary is controlled by an inmate who has been running a crime syndicate with the help of the warden and guards which provides them 100% alibi.

items.title: Shadow
items.description: To finally achieve victory over a rival kingdom, a brilliant general devises an intricate plan involving his wife, a look-alike, and two kings.

items.title: Rampant
items.description: Returning from imprisonment abroad, a prince and his fellow countrymen band together to battle bloodthirsty demons in ancient Korea.

items.title: Broken Sword Hero
items.description: From the disparity as a young runaway to the toughest warrior among his people, a legendary fighter with unparalleled skills in Muay Thai and swordplay, fights for the freedom of his people.

items.title: Samurai Marathon
items.description: A young ninja goes undercover in the court of an ageing Lord to win a race to prevent a shogunate from wrecking an alliance.

items.title: The Swindlers
items.description: Unlikely allies from different sides of the law must work together to achieve a common goal -- trapping the world's most legendary con man.

items.title: Bitcoin Heist
items.description: To catch the world's most wanted thief, an Interpol agent assembles a team of elite hackers to plan the ultimate crypto-currency heist.

items.title: The Swordsman
items.description: After being blinded in a coup against the king, Joseon’s greatest swordsman goes into hiding, far removed from his city’s anguish. But when traffickers kidnap his daughter, he has no choice but to unsheathe his sword once more.

items.title: Master Z: Ip Man Legacy
items.description: Legendary action director Yuen Woo Ping draws on a stellar cast (Michelle Yeoh, Dave Bautista, Tony Jaa, and Max Zhang) to create a hard-hitting martial arts blast worthy of its place in the celebrated IP MAN universe.

items.title: The Bodyguard
items.description: A retired bodyguard suffering from dementia finds a new friend in a young girl. When her life is threatened by her father's connection with crime, he must call upon his abandoned skills to save her.

items.title: Deliver Us From Evil (2020)
items.description: After the shocking kidnapping of a little girl in Thailand, a mercenary with a murky past as a government black ops agent (Hwang) is forced to re-emerge from the shadows when he learns the incident is closely connected to him.

items.title: Heaven
items.description: Two inspiring real-life stories are intertwined with never-before seen footage of Billy Graham talking about heaven, filmed at his North Carolina mountain home.

items.title: Bayou Maharajah
items.description: BAYOU MAHARAJAH explores the life, times and music of piano legend James Booker, who Dr. John described as "the best black, gay, one-eyed junkie piano genius New Orleans has ever produced."

items.title: Flying Blind
items.description: As four confessing Christians deal with the consequences of their sin, God offers a way of restoration.

items.title: Come The Morning
items.description: In search of her estranged husband, a mother brings her 3 children to Los Angeles in the hope of finding him. With no prospects they wander the streets; becoming beggars before long.

items.title: Christmas Ranch
items.description: A rebellious girl is sent to stay on her grandmother's horse ranch for Christmas. She falls into friendship with her grandmother's pony and becomes determined to help save the ranch from foreclosure.

items.title: Return To The Holy Land
items.description: Journey with Franklin Graham and his family, to the land of the Bible. Many passages from God's Word come alive in this devotional series, filmed on location in the Holy Land.

items.title: 7 Days In The Holy Land
items.description: See God's Word come alive in this special devotional series, filmed on location in the Holy Land.

items.title: Footprints Of A Pilgrim
items.description: The life story of evangelist Billy Graham's wife, Ruth Bell Graham, told through her own prose and poetry as well as stories from family and friends. Her commitment to God's Will led her on a lifelong journey few could imagine.

items.title: Billy Graham: A Life Remembered
items.description: Beginning with a simple expression of faith at age fifteen - and speaking around the world with clarity and conviction, Billy Graham's ministry has delivered the message of hope in Jesus Christ throughout the world for over 80 years.

items.title: Decisions
items.description: A skeptic, a struggling teen, and a woman hiding from her past reach a moment of truth. Watch their stories, interwoven with a powerful message from Franklin Graham on life's most important decision.

items.title: Adolescence of Utena
items.description: Utena Tenjou, a mysterious transfer student, gets drawn into duels at the Ohtori Academy to win the hand of the Rose Bride and the power to bring on a revolution in this retelling of the surrealist shoujo classic.

items.title: Lose To Gain
items.description: Lose to Gain introduces professional skate boarder Brian Sumner, Comedian Michael Jr. and young professional Shannon Culpepper. Each wanted something different- success, laughs, and love.

items.title: The Forbidden Book
items.description: The history of the English Bible.

items.title: Mysteries Of The Dead Sea Scrolls
items.description: This documentary takes you a fascinating journey and give you a firm grasp of God's sovereign hand behind the preservation of the Bible and the unfolding of history.

items.title: Polycarp
items.description: A young slave girl, Anna, is rescued and adopted by Christians in 2nd Century Smyrna and befriended by their aged bishop, Polycarp. As Anna is taught by Polycarp and her new family, she struggles to reconcile her beliefs with those of the Christians.

items.title: Joni
items.description: Based on Joni Eareckson's autobiography. She becomes paralyzed after breaking her neck in a swimming accident at age 17. Trying to cope with her new life, she learns to paint using her mouth and finds strength in her new Christian faith.

items.title: Reading Kate
items.description: A down-on-his-luck academic is called to the side of his ex-wife, who may or may not be suffering from a debilitating disease.

items.title: War of the Worlds
items.description: A contemporary retelling of H.G.Wells' classic, the sci-fi thriller reveals the extraordinary battle for the future of humankind through the eyes of one American family.

items.title: Punisher: War Zone
items.description: Continuing his crusade to punish violent criminals in America, former FBI agent Frank Castle arrives in New York to take on a scarred villain who plots to take control of the underworld.

items.title: A Match Made at Christmas
items.description: Romantic, small-town girl Holly, and realist, career-driven, Chris aren't a likely pair, but when 'matched' together by Holly's all-knowing great-aunt, they don't seem to have much of a choice.

items.title: A Fall City Christmas
items.description: With nowhere to go, a recently paroled thief, Jon Price, is forced to return to his small hometown right before Christmas. Unexpectedly, he meets a struggling, single mother who lives her life with hope and shows him kindness through gentle compassion.

items.title: El paciente inglés
items.description: Poderosa e inolvidable, la ganadora de 9 premios Óscar, incluso Mejor Película, Mejor Director (Anthony Minghella) y Mejor Actriz de Reparto (Juliette Binoche), desarrolla una increíble historia de pasión, intriga y aventura.

items.title: Knowing
items.description: A professor (Nicolas Cage) deciphers a mysterious code foretelling future calamities. Can he somehow avert them?

items.title: Knights Templar: Rise and Fall
items.description: Eons ago, an enigmatic group of warrior monks made history together. The Knights Templar has been linked to the Holy Grail, the Ark of the Covenant, keeping mankind's greatest secret for centuries, and even the bloodline of Jesus Christ.

items.title: Alien from Area 51: The Alien Autopsy Footage Revealed
items.description: The Alien Autopsy Footage, launched on T.V. in London in August 1995 by Ray Santilli, is by far the most controversial evidence ever submitted to U.F.O. researchers. What you will see will test your beliefs and rattle you to the core.

items.title: Frank and Jesse
items.description: After the defeat of the South in the Civil War and the murder of their younger brother, Frank and Jesse James seek their own brand of justice. As outlaws, they gain fame for their daring hold-ups of banks, trains, and stagecoaches.

items.title: Call Me Lucky
items.description: Barry Crimmins was a volatile but brilliant comic who became an honored peace activist and influential political satirist. Famous comedians and others build a picture of a man who underwent an incredible transformation.

items.title: Phyllis Diller: Not Just Another Pretty Face
items.description: Phyllis Diller's brand of comedy is as timeless today as it was in the 1960s when she became a regular on popular variety and talk shows. Phyllis Diller was a pioneer among female comediennes highlights some of her best routines.

items.title: The House of the Devil
items.description: Desperate for quick cash, college sophomore Samantha Hughes takes a babysitting job in the isolated mansion of the creepy Ulman family. Samantha has no idea that a nightmare of unspeakable fear and torment awaits her within these walls.

items.title: The Innkeepers
items.description: After over one hundred years of service, The Yankee Pedlar Inn is shutting its doors for good. The last remaining employees - Claire and Luke - are determined to uncover proof of what many believe to be one of New England's most haunted hotels.

items.title: Greater
items.description: A true story of Arkansas Razorbacks walk-on offensive lineman Brandon Burlsworth. Devoutly Christian and ridiculed for his portly appearance, he defies the odds to make the Razorbacks' squad in 1994, and develops into an All-American and top NFL prospect.

items.title: Bible Conspiracies 2
items.description: Divine messages are hidden within the passages of the Holy Bible that we are only now beginning to decipher. Explore the truth about Jesus and Mary and the shocking origins of humanity using new insights into the Bibles' secret codes.

items.title: Abducted by Aliens: U.F.O. Encounters of the 4th Kind
items.description: Are we being taken by alien beings from outer space, or from another dimension? Countless individuals clearly recall being abducted against their will. The question is, how deep does this conspiracy go, and what does the government know?

items.title: Flying Objects: A State Secret
items.description: In less than 100 years, mankind has experienced a wide range of U.F.O./U.A.P. phenomena, and fascinating data has been gathered by key geopolitical countries, leading them to believe that a unified human effort should study extraterrestrial phenomena.

items.title: Top Ten Enigmas of the Ancient World
items.description: From supposed stargates to powerful deities, and from fantastic giants to steampunk style science fiction, this is not an alien planet or a fantasyland. This is Planet Earth but of the past. Yet, it was a world of wonder and achievement.

items.title: Top Ten Secrets of the Ancient World
items.description: From the mysterious origins of civilization to startling revelations about the pyramids, discover how the ruling elite have hidden ancient knowledge from the masses for millennia. We are just now beginning to rediscover our true history.

items.title: A Picture Perfect Wedding
items.description: Wedding photographer Lindsey gets a big opportunity when a New York mogul’s son, Josh, asks her to shoot his sister’s wedding. Sparks fly between Lindsey and Josh, but what will their hearts decide?

items.title: Calling For Love
items.description: Podcast host Samantha has an aversion to romance but is assigned to host a show that reunites lost loves. Samantha falls for charming Jake, who calls in with a problem she is determined to solve.

items.title: Driveways
items.description: A lonesome boy accompanies his mother on a trip to clean out his late aunt's house, where he ends up forming an unexpected friendship with the retiree who lives next door.

items.title: Tromeo and Juliet
items.description: Tromeo, a filmmaker, falls in love with Juliet, the daughter of a former partner who tried to steal his business from him.

items.title: Graduation Day
items.description: A masked killer begins murdering students on the school track team after a track runner dies upon completion of a 30 second 200-meter race.

items.title: Enchufe sin visa
items.description: Una divertida comedia en la que seis latinos viajan a EE.UU y pronto se ver?°n inmersos en las situaciones m?°s rid??culas y vergonzosas. Desde un estudiante de intercambio a una ingenua actriz, cada uno vivir?° peripecias inesperadas.

items.title: Def By Temptation
items.description: An evil succubus is preying on libidinous black men in New York City, and all that stands in her way is a minister-in-training, an aspiring actor, and a cop who specializes in cases involving the supernatural.

items.title: Frankenhooker
items.description: A medical student sets out to recreate his decapitated fiancée by building her a new body made of Manhattan street prostitutes.

items.title: Class Of Nuke 'Em High
items.description: The pupils at a high school next to a nuclear power plant start acting and looking strange after buying contaminated drugs from a plant worker.

items.title: The Toxic Avenger
items.description: Tromaville has a monstrous new hero. The Toxic Avenger is born when meek mop boy Melvin falls into a vat of toxic waste. Now evildoers will have a lot to lose.

items.title: Para Elisa
items.description: Tras responder a un anuncio para un trabajo de niñera, Ana descubre que la persona a su cargo, Elisa, es una joven violentamente trastornada de su misma edad. Ana, atrapada en la casa como el nuevo juguete de Elisa, debe luchar para sobrevivir.

items.title: Cyrano de Bergerac
items.description: A poet and sword fighter helps another man woo the woman he loves with words of love and devotion.

items.title: The Front Page
items.description: Hildy Johnson's current employer is full of reporters who invent stories as much as write about them. The paper's current story focuses on the hanging of Earl Williams. When Williams escapes from jail, Hildy seizes upon the opportunity for a unique scoop.

items.title: My Favorite Brunette
