items.description: Ronnie Jackson is a photographer who fantasizes about being a private detective. When a lovely baroness mistakes Ronnie for being a real detective, she requests he attempt to find her missing husband, Baron Montay, an invitation Ronnie finds irresistible.

items.title: Redentor
items.description: Marko Zaror interpreta a un ex asesino a sueldo que les da a los rufianes la oportunidad de pedir perdón por sus crímenes o pagar el precio máximo.

items.title: Scherzo Diabolico
items.description: Cuando le niegan un ascenso muy merecido, el apacible Aram enloquece. Su plan radical de secuestrar a una colegiala y llevarla a un depósito abandonado pronto se convertirá en su peor pesadilla.

items.title: A Mother's Testimony
items.description: When a woman's son is released from prison she welcomes him into her family's home, finally a chance to have a normal life but has her doubts when he becomes the suspect in a brutal murder.

items.title: The Man In The Iron Mask
items.description: Despotic King Louis XIV discovers he has a twin brother who has grown up under the tutelage of his foster father, the patriotic musketeer D'Artagnan.

items.title: The Flesh Eaters
items.description: A group of young adults trapped on a desert island finds the water inhabited by a violent form of flesh-eating organisms.

items.title: A Mother's Rage
items.description: While on a trip to drop off her daughter at college, Rebecca Mayer's protective mother instincts kick in when they are terrorized on the highway. She will keep her daughter safe - at any cost.

items.title: The Art of Murder
items.description: A beautiful young artist commits adultery with her husband's young business partner and finds herself embroiled in pornography, blackmail and murder.

items.title: La casa del fin de los tiempos
items.description: Una madre condenada a 30 años de prisión por el asesinato de su esposo regresa a su hogar. Pero los sucesos sobrenaturales responsables de su crimen vuelven para atormentarla y revelan un secreto siniestro sobre la casa.

items.title: Infección
items.description: Un padre emprende un viaje para rescatar a su hijo durante un brote epidémico por una nueva cepa de la rabia en Venezuela.

items.title: Luz: The Flower of Evil
items.description: El líder de un culto aislado pierde la credibilidad de sus fieles, incluidas sus tres hijas, luego de llevar a un falso mesías a la comunidad.

items.title: Mientras Duermes
items.description: Un portero trastornado que tiene la manía de atormentar a sus residentes decide intimidar a la vecina más alegre y arruinarle la vida a toda costa.

items.title: México Barbaro
items.description: Un grupo de directores mexicanos se unen para traernos los relatos más brutalmente aterradores de la leyenda y el folklore mexicano.

items.title: Saddle Club: The First Adventure
items.description: Pine Hollow's new arrival, Lisa Atwood, gets a frosty reception from equestrians Stevie Lake and Carole Hanson after Lisa's mother nearly runs them down in this fun adventure based on the popular series of books by Bonnie Bryant.

items.title: Metroland
items.description: After ten years absence Toni, Chris's best friend, suddenly reappears in London to bring chaos and doubt into Chris's calm, tranquil, slightly boring, predictable life.
A story of how obsession, addiction and abuse cause a young woman to execute an elaborate plan of revenge.

items.title: Bedrooms And Hallways
items.description: Keith runs a male bonding group, which was meant to be macho fun, but acts as therapist as dreaded-unmanly emotional and even relational problems prove unavoidable

items.title: Blue Collar Comedy Tour: The Movie
items.description: The comedic stylings of four sort-of famous funnymen are brought to the big screen courtesy of this 2002 documentary.

items.title: KAT & THE BAND
items.description: Seventeen year old, music obsessed school girl Kat Malone tricks her way into managing struggling band Dollar Days, pretending to be a band manager in her twenties.

items.title: Lemony Snicket: Una serie de eventos desafortunados
items.description: Una emocionante desventura con tres ingeniosos huérfanos y un villano actor llamado Conde Olaf (Jim Carrey) quien busca quitarles su enorme fortuna.

items.title: Across the Rails
items.description: In the early 70's Chris, Liam, & Manny decide to open a bar without any previous ability or concept of what it takes.

items.title: Me, Myself, and Di
items.description: When Bridget Jones-type Janet wins the trip of a lifetime, she's convinced by her best friend to pretend to be the opposite of who she actually is, in the hope of finding love.

items.title: Dark Shadows and Beyond: The Jonathan Frid Story
items.description: The fascinating life of the Shakespearean actor who became a classic TV icon as vampire Barnabas Collins.

items.title: Birdemic: Shock and Terror
items.description: This 2010 midnight movie sensation is part tender love story, part graphic horror shocker, and an urgent ecological warning. When a quaint California town is attacked by millions of homicidal birds, the picturesque paradise becomes a winged hell on earth.

items.title: My Heart Can't Beat Unless You Tell It To
items.description: Dwight and his sister Jessie reach a crossroads over what to do about their younger brother Thomas, a sickly child with a mysterious affliction.

items.title: Lost Soul: The Doomed Journey of Richard Stanley's Island of Dr. Moreau
items.description: The filming of the ill-fated 1996 THE ISLAND OF DR. MOREAU is a sensational story of what could have been a science fiction masterpiece but which became a huge creative and financial disaster; the story of the outsider artist versus Hollywood machine.

items.title: The Man Standing Next: The Assassination of a President
items.description: The untold story of the Korean Central Intelligence Agency's political scheming in the 1970s is brought to vivid life in this powerfully acted drama.

items.title: Ashfall
items.description: In the face of a disaster that will engulf both North and South Korea, a mission is put into action to stop a super volcanic eruption.

items.title: The Angel's Secret
items.description: Many know its name; few have seen it. Once present throughout Europe, the angel shark is now critically endangered and finds itself struggling off the coast of the Canary Islands. As unique as it is extraordinary, this species is full of secrets...

items.title: The Auctioneers: Profiting From The Holocaust
items.description: Historical data journalism brings to light the true story of Kristallnacht and thereafter.

items.title: Adam & Steve
items.description: Years after a horribly embarrassing one night stand, two men fail to recognize each other and fall in love. The question is: can they make it work?

items.title: Learning To Drive
items.description: As her marriage dissolves, a Manhattan writer takes driving lessons from a Sikh instructor with marriage troubles of his own.

items.title: Break Point
items.description: Two estranged brothers reunite to make an improbable run at a grand slam tennis tournament.

items.title: American Mustang
items.description: A young girl discovers that America's wild horses are in danger of being wiped off the land they've called home for thousands of years, as American Mustang the Movie unveils the compelling story of the wild mustang.

items.title: I Smile Back
items.description: Addicted to drugs and alcohol, a housewife's self-destructive behavior starts to take its toll on her husband and two young children.

items.title: Wish Upon
items.description: A teenage girl discovers a box that carries magic powers and a deadly price for using them.

items.title: My Prison Yard (LAS)
items.description: In Madrid, a petty thief who cannot adjust to life outside of jail puts together a theater troupe her friends -- a prostitute, a gypsy, and a Colombian immigrant -- in an attempt to make a go at a relatively straight life.

items.title: Atlantic
items.description: Documentary about the two big resources in the North Atlantic, fish and oil, and the impact of their exploitation on the environment in various countries on both sides of the Atlantic.

items.title: Night Drive
items.description: A ride share driver's life is turned upside down after an unexpected series of misfortunes.

items.title: Body of Lies
items.description: Leonardo Di Caprio and Academy Award winner Russell Crowe star in director Ridley Scott's adaptation of the best-selling post-9/11 espionage thriller.

items.title: Jack y Jill
items.description: Un recuento de terror de la canción infantil Jack y Jill. Un grupo de amigos que están de duelo por una pérdida reciente se encuentran solo para descubrir que Jack y Jill los están persiguiendo.

items.title: Masacre Del Conejito De Pascua
items.description: Un grupo de amigos que ocultan un secreto mortal son perseguidos uno por uno por un asesino enmascarado de conejito.

items.title: Hada de los dientes: La última extracción
items.description: Corey y su hija, Sally, decidieron irse de vacaciones de verano con sus amigos, Diane, Christy, Toby y Benny. Poco saben, el pasado de Corey lo alcanzará.

items.title: La maldición de Humpty Dumpty
items.description: Una mujer mayor con demencia se reencuentra con una muñeca de su pasado. Al poco tiempo, comienza a recordar que esta muñeca tiene un pasado oscuro.

items.title: Espantapájaros de Amityville
items.description: Después de que su madre fallece, dos hermanas se encuentran como dueñas de un campamento de verano cerrado. Pronto, las hermanas aprenderán la leyenda de.. El Espantapájaros.

items.title: Culto de Amityville
items.description: Después de heredar inesperada y misteriosamente la mansión de su abuela, Stanley DeFeo se encuentra en la pequeña ciudad de Amityville, rodeado de secretos familiares enterrados y un complot siniestro en su contra.

items.title: Pueblo del Vampiro
items.description: Rebecca busca a su hermana, una joven periodista que desapareció mientras investigaba una serie de hechos desafortunados.

items.title: Anular
items.description: Ria es un humanoide, programado para ser un ama de casa obediente, reviviendo el mismo día una y otra vez para una audiencia de televisión. Cuando Ria es hackeada, toma como rehén al hijo del Vicepresidente, amenazando con matarlo.

items.title: Mi Cumpleaños Sangriento
items.description: Los amigos de Emma organizan una fiesta sorpresa de cumpleaños, sin darse cuenta de los horrores que han despertado.

items.title: A Bennett Song Holiday
items.description: Mrs. Song is expecting a baby to add to their diverse roster of 14 adopted children and the family will team up to stop a developer who wants to close down the community center. Love, teamwork, and holiday magic are sure to save the day!

items.title: Banksy and the Rise of Outlaw Art
items.description: Banksy, his illegal anti-establishment art and daring invasions, the multi-million dollar empire that he built, and the movement he inspired.

items.title: Bennett's Song
items.description: When two very unique and diverse families with 7 kids each collide, they find laughs, music, love, and a few answers about what it means to be a t-so-rmal American family in the 21st century.

items.title: Cecil
items.description: Cecil Stevens' name reveals his lisp so he changes it to "Michael Jordan." His whole school learns a lesson about acceptance after he and his friends start a business with the corrupt principal that sells celebrity names to kids.

items.title: Christmas Coupon
items.description: An ice-skating champion begins teaching a skating class, but when her former high school sweetheart (and now famous hockey player) brings his niece for lessons, the holidays are filled with a second chance for love.

items.title: Christmas Cupcakes
items.description: When their family bakery may have to close its doors right before Christmas, rival sisters Kim and Gina must team up to win a national baking competition, save the family business, and perhaps even discover a bigger prize than they hoped.

items.title: Hada de dientes 2: La raíz del mal
items.description: 20 años después de ser aterrorizada por el Hada de los Dientes, Corey comienza a sospechar que ha regresado para terminar el trabajo.

items.title: Brujas De Amityville
items.description: Las Belle Witches tienen que volver a utilizar sus talentos mágicos para disuadir al malvado Dominique Marcom de intentar traer al demonio Botis al mundo.

items.title: Elf-Man
items.description: When Santa leaves an Elf behind on Christmas Eve, the Harper kids find out his true identity as the super-hero "ELF-MAN". Together they must save their Dad's new invention from a bumbling gang of thieves, and enjoy the best Christmas, ever.

items.title: Santuario: población uno
items.description: Un joven idealista, Ethan, se queda buscando a su familia mientras lucha contra los infectados, la milicia Med-Ex y los merodeadores sedientos de sangre, así como contra los fantasmas de su pasado.

items.title: Profecías rojas
items.description: La vida de un reportero en Rusia se pone en peligro mientras escribe historias políticas basadas en información proporcionada por una fuente misteriosa llamada 'El Oráculo'.

items.title: Asteroide
items.description: Un hombre de familia desconectado se muda con su esposa y su hija de la gran ciudad a la casa de sus sueños en las afueras de un pequeño pueblo justo a tiempo para el apocalipsis.

items.title: Ella Bella Bingo
items.description: Ella Bella and Henry are best friends, but she becomes jealous when Henry wants to play with the cool new kid. When Henry runs away, Ella Bella and a new kid go on a bicycle adventure to find Henry and learn the magic of friendship.

items.title: Sky Dog
items.description: After a high school senior working on his pilot's license rescues a dog named Oreo, he finds out his mom is a CIA agent who's been captured. He teams up with Oreo and a new friend to find his mother and uncover double agents inside the CIA.

items.title: Farmer and the Belle: Saving Santaland
items.description: Sparks fly between a famous model and a farmer with a young daughter, when she visits her childhood home. The town is in danger of losing their beloved Santaland festival, but miracles can happen with a little love, family, and faith.

items.title: Gadgetgang In Outerspace
items.description: A group of kids help five quirky little aliens who crashed into Earth, fix their spaceship, and together they save the universe from danger.

items.title: More Beautiful for Having Been Broken
items.description: A broken FBI agent struggling with the loss of her mother travels to a small mountain town where she is befriended by a special needs boy who possesses the extraordinary gift of healing others through his unique outlook and unbroken spirit.

items.title: To the Beat! Back 2 School
items.description: Sisterhood is tested, rivalries heat up and new bonds are formed when students go back to their performing arts school to compete for an all-expense paid summer scholarship program to a prestigious Conservatory of Fine Arts.

items.title: One More Orbit
items.description: A daring team of astronauts and aviators fly a high-speed Gulfstream jet around the earth faster than anyone ever has to set the pole-to-pole circumnavigation record, breaking the boundaries of what was previously thought possible.

items.title: Toys & Pets
items.description: A little toy with a wish and a robot from the future team up to find a fabled mystic and rescue their friend from the evil rat Flash. On this magical animated journey, they discover that teamwork and friendship will help them save the day.

items.title: To The Beat!
items.description: While twins Mia and Mackie form separate tap and jazz dance teams to compete against each other in a contest, their neighbor and nemesis, Avery, uses her charm and resources to get the upper hand in the competition.

items.title: The Key to Christmas
items.description: When a disgruntled elf takes over the North Pole, she turns time backwards and Santa Claus begins getting younger-- fast! It's up to a loyal elf, a little girl with a magic key, and the now-teenage Santa to save the future of Christmas.

items.title: Bliss
items.description: A brilliant painter turns to anything she can to complete her masterpiece, spiraling into a hallucinatory hellscape of drugs, sex, and murder.

items.title: The Concubine
items.description: A love triangle between a royal concubine, her commoner-lover, and a prince ignites a series of political, passionate and life-threatening upheavals.

items.title: Await Further Instructions
items.description: After a mysterious phenomenon traps them inside their house, a series of increasingly disturbing instructions on TV lead the Milgram family into a cycle of paranoia and violence.

items.title: Doomed!
items.description: Doomed: The Untold Story of Roger Corman's The Fantastic Four explores through extensive interviews with the cast and crew, the circumstances surrounding the legendary cult classic and lost Roger Corman film, The Fantastic Four.

items.title: Tierra De Alfareros
items.description: Un ex merodeador confederado intenta hacer un comienzo limpio en una granja de tierra de Texas con su esposa y su hija pequeña. Rápidamente aprende que a veces el pasado simplemente no permanecerá enterrado.

items.title: 7 Dollars on the Red
items.description: A ruthless gang kidnaps a young boy after murdering his family

items.title: A Man Called Blade
items.description: A bounty hunter is hired to find the mayor's daughter

items.title: Any Gun Can Play
items.description: A would-be bounty hunter is on the tail of a stolen shipment of gold

items.title: Jesse and Lester
items.description: Brothers inherit a plot of land and must work together

items.title: Powder Keg
items.description: Two adventurers are hired to bring back a hijacked train

items.title: The Grand Duel
items.description: A former sherrif helps a man who has been famed for murder

items.title: The Price of Power
items.description: Former union soldiers try to expose a conspiracy to kill President James A Garfield

items.title: Hidden (LAS)
items.description: Tres atletas, tres elementos, tres amigos. Todos creyentes a sus propias trayectorias y riesgos de vida. Cruzando el mismo camino lleno de dudas, esfuerzos y pasion por un deporte, por un trabajo, un fuego que en este momento deja de ser oculto.

items.title: Tío Nino
items.description: Una familia distante y un poco disfuncional restablecen sus lazos de unidad cuando el desaparecido Tío Nino llega de Italia en una visita sorpresa.

items.title: Froning: The Fittest Man in History
items.description: Rich Froning Jr. is a legend in CrossFit and the Sport of Fitness. In this biopic, take a look at his childhood, follow his quest for a fourth CrossFit Games title, and see him as a son, a husband and a new father.

items.title: Drugs as a Weapon Against Us
items.description: Evidence supports that the CIA manipulated musicians and activists to promote drugs for social control, particularly targeting those involved in the Civil Rights and anti-war movements. Resistance was often met with deadly targeting.

items.title: Encierro
items.description: El Festival de San Fermín en Pamplona, España es una celebración de ocho días arraigada en eventos tradicionales. Este documental incluye imagenes de su evento más famoso “El encierro” donde miles de personas corren perseguidos por seis toros al ataque.

items.title: Survivor's Guide to Prison
items.description: You're more likely to go to prison in the USA than any other country in the world, so should it happen to you, this is the SURVIVORS GUIDE TO PRISON with gripping commentary from inmates, officials, attorneys, celebrity activists and more.

items.title: Chasing Bonnie & Clyde
items.description: Don't build prisons, they cost too much!' In this era of Great Recession, the conservative and tough-on-crime State of Texas takes an unprecedented path by becoming a social justice leader with programs that rehabilitate offenders.

items.title: Freejack
items.description: Bounty hunters from the future transport a doomed race car driver to New York City in 2009, where his mind will be replaced with that of a dead billionaire.

items.title: Before The Devil Knows You're Dead
items.description: Andy, an overextended payroll executive, lures his younger brother, Hank, into a larcenous scheme: the pair will rob a suburban mom-and-pop jewelry store that appears to be the quintessential easy target.

items.title: Castle Falls
items.description: Castle Heights Hospital, a symbol of the city's segregated past, is ready to be demolished. No one knows that a gang leader, now in prison, hid the 3 million dollars in cash he stole from his rivals inside the abandoned building.

items.title: Sliding Doors
items.description: The split-second moments that can take a life down one path instead of another form the tantalizing 'what if?' in this delightful romantic comedy starring Gwyneth Paltrow.

items.title: RiffTrax: Trucker's Woman
items.description: If the old dusty carousel of audio cassettes at a truck stop could be distilled into a movie, this would be that movie. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

items.description: The new sherrif of Tombstone voes to clean up the town

items.description: Howard Hughes found time between cataloging his urine jar collection to produce a film about the Son of Sinbad! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

items.description: The kids in this sleepy town are concerned their ice cream man might be a murderer who puts human parts in his ice cream. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

items.title: RiffTrax Live: Space Mutiny
items.description: Space Mutiny! The very title conjures up many memories: tiny cars, writhing spandex witches, deadly railings. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin, and Bill from MST3K.

items.title: Queerama
items.description: Compilation of archive footage from 1919 to the present, from both documentary and fictional sources, set to music, illustrating the huge changes in LGBTQ life in Britain (mainly England) over the 20th century.

items.title: RiffTrax: Silent Rage
items.description: You'll laugh, you'll cry, and you probably won't be so silent about the great deal of rage you'll feel. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin, and Bill from MST3K.

items.description: A female teenage skateboarder befriends an all-girl skateboarding crew called Skate Kitchen. This film captures the experience of women in male-dominated spaces and tells a story of a girl who learns the importance of camaraderie and self-discovery.

items.title: Rifftrax: Night Of The Shorts: SF Sketchfest 2016
items.description: Mike, Kevin, and Bill from RiffTrax were joined onstage at Sketchfest Live 2016 by very special guest riffers Bridget Nelson, Mary Jo Pehl, Cole Stratton, Janet Varney, Adam Savage, Paul F. Tompkins, and John Hodgman!

items.title: Tom Petty: Won't Back Down
items.description: Tom Petty is recognized as one of rock's greatest singer-songwriters.

items.description: Una madre soltera acepta hacerse pasar temporalmente como la esposa de su jefe, el cual necesita una esposa para impresionar a un industrialista amante de las tradiciones.

items.title: Olympia
items.description: Olympia is an aspiring artist struggling to develop a business and keep her home. At age 30, her life crumbles apart. Her mother is hospitalized, and both her boyfriend and dearest friend announce they are relocating. In the balance hang Olympia's dreams.

items.title: Rifftrax Live: Reefer Madness
items.description: Mike, Kevin, and Bill deliver their trademark comedy in front of a live audience in a feature about reefer! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

items.description: All about a mysterious dancing granddaughter of a sorceress cave granny who lives in the wilderness, it's Yambaó! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

items.title: RiffTrax: Terror In The Wax Museum
items.description: Mike, Kevin, and Bill all hope to one day be enshrined in Madame Tussauds. Until then, they'll be settling for this riff. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

items.description: Deadly Prey is the kind of budget badassery you've come to expect from the guy who donned a mesh belly shirt in Future Zone. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

items.description: Olivia and Brian are shocked to find themselves as the maid of honor and best man at the same wedding. But they now have to put their contentious feelings aside to save it.
