items.title: RiffTrax: The Amazing Mr. X
items.description: Ravens, crystal balls, cocktails and MURDER! Run to your computer screen and prepare yourself for The Amazing Mr. X. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

items.title: Middleton Christmas
items.description: In a small town, high-school dean Alana and her vivacious teenage daughter Samantha plan a holiday concert to save the school with the help of the new maintenance man, Army veteran Johnny, and his quiet son Max.

items.title: Planet Raptor
items.description: The year 2066. U.S.S. Santee receives an S.O.S. from planet AC9. As the rescue team, led by captain Mace Carter, is beamed to the surface a giant, prehistoric raptor attacks the team and one soldier gets dragged away.

items.title: Incredible Story of the Giant Pear
items.description: Life in Solby is nice and peaceful until one day Mitcho and Sebastian find a message in a bottle by the harbor. The bottle is from the missing mayor of Solby with a message that he is on a mysterious island and has made a great discovery.

items.title: RiffTrax: The Phantom Creeps
items.description: Bela Lugosi! An ugly robot! The power of invisibility! All of these and more are contained within The Phantom Creeps! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

items.title: RiffTrax: The Devil's Hand
items.description: The Devil's Hand is a cheesy 60's horror classic about a satanic cult in a mysterious doll shop. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

items.title: The Dark Divide
items.description: Based on the story of renowned butterfly expert Robert Pyle (David Cross) who embarked on a life-changing trek through one of America's most important unprotected wildlands in the summer of 1995.

items.title: RiffTrax: I Believe In Santa Claus
items.description: In this cheesy Christmas classic, Santa Claus goes on a covert mission to rescue hostages with the aid of a fairy princess. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

items.title: RiffTrax: Cyber Tracker
items.description: Cyber tracker is a Terminator knock-off starring Don "the Dragon" Wilson! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

items.title: Reefer Madness
items.description: This freaky musical is a parody of an actual, dead serious anti-marihuana propaganda film from 1936, trying to convince the American public that just one drag of pot forever and irrevocably turns average high school kids into hopeless drug addicts.

items.title: RiffTrax: Breaker Breaker
items.description: Breaker Breaker is a Chuck Norris filled tale of moonshine, hillbillies, and sweet airbrushed eagles on the side of vans! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

items.title: RiffTrax: Devil Girl From Mars
items.description: Pour a glass of scotch and join Bridget and Mary Jo as they riff this Sci Fi classic! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Bridget and Mary Jo from RiffTrax.

items.title: RiffTrax: Honor And Glory
items.description: Martial arts sisters team up to fight corruption! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

items.title: RiffTrax: Hawk The Slayer
items.description: If you took a D&D adventure written by an 8th grader and turned it into a movie, you'd wind up with Hawk the Slayer. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

items.title: The White Buffalo
items.description: Charles Bronson and Will Sampson star as Wild Bill Hickok and Chief Crazy Horse in this one-of-a-kind western that finds both western legends braving the snowy wilderness in search of the demon that haunts them both, the fabled White Buffalo!

items.title: Midnight Cowboy
items.description: This Academy Award-winning Best Picture stars Dustin Hoffman and Jon Voight in standout, Oscar-nominated performances as a con man and a Texas hustler trying to survive on the tough streets of New York. The legendary John Schlesinger directs.

items.title: June Again
items.description: A twist of fate gives June a reprieve from a debilitating illness. She sets about to put her family and business back on track. When it goes awry, she sets out on a journey and discovers she needs help from the people she was trying to help.

items.title: ECCO
items.description: A former assassin living a new life in the shadows with his family emerges from hiding to discover the origin of his lethal beginnings.

items.title: The Last Bus
items.description: Pensioner Tom travels the length of the UK by bus, retracing the journey he made with his late wife years before, so that he can visit his hometown and his memories one last time.

items.title: Top End Wedding
items.description: Engaged and in love, Lauren and Ned have just ten days to find Lauren's mother who has gone AWOL somewhere in the Northern Territory, reunite her parents and pull off their dream Top End Wedding.

items.title: People and Bats
items.description: Bats are under the spotlight after being pointed to be the cause of the Covid19 crisis. This new documentary approaches the impact of this often viewed as dangerous animals by many people.

items.title: The Boys of Abu Ghraib
items.description: An American soldier deployed at Abu Ghraib finds himself behind the walls of the infamous Hard Site, where he develops a secret friendship with an Iraqi detainee.

items.title: Elvis: Part One
items.description: A chronicle of the life of Elvis Presley, from his humble beginnings to his rise to international stardom.

items.title: Elvis: Part Two
items.description: A chronicle of the life of Elvis Presley, from his humble beginnings to his rise to international stardom.

items.title: Emily & the Magical Journey
items.description: Emily and her mother live alone after losing her father. She wants to help her mother find happiness and to learn about the father she never knew. When Emily finds a mysterious chest that transports her to a magical world, she meets fantastic creatures.

items.title: George and the Dragon
items.description: After the first crusade to free the Holy Land, the English knight George decides to settle down. Back in England he meets the kindly king Edgaar, whose beautiful daughter Lunna has disappeared. He agrees to search for the princess.

items.title: Goalie
items.description: Biopic of the life of legendary NHL goaltender Terry Sawchuk.

items.title: Flower
items.description: A rebellious, quick-witted teenage girl (Zoey Deutch) living with her single mom (Kathryn Hahn) conspires with her troubled stepbrother to expose a high school teacher's (Adam Scott) dark secret.

items.title: Digging for Fire
items.description: The discovery of a bone and a rusty old gun send a husband and wife on separate adventures over the course of a weekend.

items.title: Billy the Kid
items.description: When a bounty hunter kills a member of an outlaw gang, all Hell breaks loose in this shoot-‘em-up tale of gun smoke and justice in the Old West.

items.title: A Family Lost
items.description: Valérie & her diabetic daughter Claire survive a plane crash in the remote Alaskan wilderness during the heart of winter. Along with Marcus, the only other survivor, they desperately try to find their way back to civilization for food, water and insulin.

items.title: Crossing Over
items.description: This ensemble piece focuses on immigrants of different nationalities trying to achieve legal status in Los Angeles.

items.title: Lay the Favorite
items.description: Beth Raymer (Rebecca Hall) leaves her dancing job at a Florida strip club to become a Las Vegas cocktail waitress.

items.title: South of Heaven, West of Hell
items.description: A small-town marshal, tormented by the puzzling conditions that surround him, is forced to confront his demons at an unexpected and untraditional 'family reunion'.

items.title: The Last Legion
items.description: As the Roman empire collapses, young Romulus Augustus must leave the city and set out for a dangerous journey to Britain to locate his last legion of supporters.

items.title: Zoe Gone
items.description: Sixteen-year-old Jennifer life changes when she gives birth to baby Zoe. Her boyfriend Randy refuses to help and her mother Alicia is not interested in raising another child. But when Zoe is kidnapped, Jennifer will stop at nothing to find her baby.

items.title: Fear Dot Com
items.description: Detective Mike Reilly and Department of Health researcher Terry Huston try to uncover the truth behind a series of murders in which the victims have just one thing in common: all were logged into the website fear.com 48 hours before their death.

items.title: Welcome to Happiness
items.description: There's a magical door in Woody's closet that allows those who go through it to erase mistakes from their past. When he finds out where it goes, his life will be changed forever.

items.title: The Italian Job (2003)
items.description: The plan was flawless. The execution was perfect. Charlie Croker pulled off the crime of a lifetime. The one thing that he didn't plan on was being double-crossed.

items.title: Save The Last Dance
items.description: Sara is a small-town girl who dreams to become a world-class ballerina. But when her mother suddenly dies, she must abandon her plans and join her estranged father on Chicago's South Side.

items.title: Forrest Gump
items.description: Tom Hanks gives an astonishing performance as Forrest, an everyman whose simple innocence comes to embody a generation.

items.title: Dark Places
items.description: A woman who survived the brutal killing of her family as a child is forced to confront the events of that day with the help of a secret society obsessed with solving notorious crimes.

items.title: The End of the Tour
items.description: A funny and touching exploration of fame, success, and friendship as we follow journalist David Lipsky (Jesse Eisenberg) during five days he spent on the road interviewing renowned and reclusive novelist David Foster Wallace (Jason Segel).

items.title: Ginger & Rosa
items.description: In 1962 London, the lifelong friendship between two teenagers (Elle Fanning, Alice Englert) dissolves after one seduces the other's father.

items.title: Vikes
items.description: High school kid, Thorvald, influenced by a girl he likes, Ida, campaigns to change his school's mascot, the Viking, to something less offensive to the Scandinavian community. It's a love story.

items.title: The Unicorn
items.description: An engaged couple, Caleb (Nick Rutherford) and Malory (Lauren Lapkus), set out on a wild night after discovering the secret to a happy marriage, but this experience inadvertently tests their relationship in ways they never imagined.

items.title: American Violet
items.description: Falsely accused of distributing narcotics in a school zone, Dee Roberts (Beharie) is offered a deal she can't refuse: plead guilty and accept a 10-year suspended sentence. The alternative: risk serving 16-to-25 in jail.

items.title: The Invitation
items.description: In this taut psychological thriller by Karyn Kusama (Girlfight, Jennifer's Body), the tension is palpable when Will shows up to his ex-wife Eden and new husband David's dinner party.

items.title: God's Fool
items.description: A new story about an old saint: St. Francis of Assisi - the first Ragamuffin. This is the third and final movie in "The Ragamuffin Trilogy."

items.title: The Oh in Ohio
items.description: Frustration leads an unsatisfied married woman on a quest for her first 'O' in this sexy comedy.

items.title: The Panama Papers
items.description: An explosive, global story, with immediate and ongoing consequences that strikes at the heart of the biggest themes of our times; income inequality, whistleblowers, and corrupt power-brokers manipulating world governments and big business.

items.title: The Healing Garden
items.description: A military chaplain and a young girl from a broken home join forces to plant a miracle garden touched by God.

items.title: Remember
items.description: Everything is not what it seems in this riveting revenge thriller, where a relentless man will stop at nothing to find and kill the Nazi officer who murdered his family 70 years earlier in WWII.

items.title: Ex Machina
items.description: A young programmer (Domhnall Gleeson) at an internet company is chosen by a reclusive CEO (Oscar Isaac) to evaluate the capabilities and consciousness of a beautiful and sophisticated robot (Alicia Vikander).

items.title: Lean on Pete
items.description: When 15-year-old Charley rescues an aging racehorse, Lean on Pete, from imminent slaughter, the two embark on a treacherous odyssey across the new American frontier in search of a new home.

items.title: Mississippi Grind
items.description: Down-on-his-luck gambler Gerry (Ben Mendelsohn) and his hot-streak buddy Curtis (Ryan Reynolds) hit the road for New Orleans hunting a big payday. On riverboats and racetracks they chase women and thrills—before risking it all in the wager of their lives.

items.title: Laggies
items.description: A woman (Keira Knightley) stuck in permanent adolescence lies to her fiancé about going on a retreat and spends the time hanging out with teenagers (Chloe Grace Moretz) instead. A comedy about acting your age and other adult decisions.

items.title: Locke
items.description: A man's (Tom Hardy) life unravels after he leaves a construction site at a critical time and drives to London to be present for the birth of a child conceived during a one-night stand.

items.title: Division 19
items.description: 2039: Anonymity/living off the grid is a crime. Punishment is "disappearance". Following the lives of convicts becomes entertainment on TV. A group of young men called Division 19 works against the system.

items.title: Rising Free
items.description: In late nineteenth-century America, Rising Free portrays the story of a young woman living in the aftermath of racial prejudice.

items.title: Spirit of Love: The Mike Glenn Story
items.description: NBA player Mike "Stinger" Glenn plays himself in this wonderful film inspired by his real-life basketball camps for the deaf and hard of hearing.

items.title: Ben and Charlie
items.description: A newly released prisoner must decide which path to take in the free world

items.title: Filmage: The Story of Descendents/All
items.description: Long before punk rock inflicted its puncture wound on the map of mainstream music, the Descendents were in a van brewing a potent mix of pop, angst, love and coffee and influencing a generation to come.

items.title: Mobile Homes
items.description: A young mother drifts from one motel to the next with her intoxicated boyfriend and her 8-year-old son. The makeshift family scrapes by, living one hustle at a time, until the discovery of a mobile home community offers an alternative life.

items.title: One of Her Own
items.description: Toni Stroud, a trainee police officer, is raped by a colleague. When she goes to her superiors about it, they retaliate by firing her instead of taking action against him.

items.title: The Marriage Fool
items.description: Recently widowed after 41 years of marriage, Frank Walsh meets the outgoing Florence, sparking joy back into his life again. However, there is clear disapproval of her from his grown children.

items.title: Race Against Time: The Search for Sarah
items.description: With no help from the police, Sarah Porter's parents are forced to act on their own to find her. When the crucial clue is discovered, Sarah's father confronts her kidnapper at gunpoint.

items.title: Intimate Affairs
items.description: Edgar is an artist living in Paris during the 1920s who believes that sex is a subject of vital importance, but almost no one discusses it with the gravity it deserves. With this in mind, Edgar gathers together a panel of fellow creative types.

items.title: In a Relationship
items.description: A funny chronicle of a summer in the lives of two couples.

items.title: The White Orchid
items.description: A shy investigator assumes the identity of a small-town murder victim in order to solve her gruesome death.

items.title: Amy
items.description: AMY tells the incredible story of six-time Grammy-winner Amy Winehouse—in her own words. Featuring extensive unseen archive footage and previously unheard tracks, this strikingly modern and moving film shines a light on the world we live in.

items.title: Stars Fell On Alabama
items.description: Bryce Dixon is returning to Alabama for the first time in 15 years for his high school reunion. When he learns he's the only one of his friends who isn't married with children, he gets his client, starlet Madison Belle, to pretend to be his girlfriend.

items.title: Bad Reputation
items.description: The life and career of rock 'n' roll icon Joan Jett from her years with The Runaways to Joan Jett & The Blackhearts. With her inimitable singles \\"I Love Rock N' Roll,\\" and \\"Bad Reputation\\" Joan Jett inspired a generation of young women to rock.

items.title: Inventors Under The Swastika
items.description: This film explores the inventions and inventors who created ground-breaking yet terrifying inventions under the Nazi regime.

items.title: A Father's Fight
items.description: Hitting rock bottom, an aging boxer's rivalry within himself restores his vitality with hopes of retraining to fight for what matters most.

items.title: Blanco
items.description: Based on true events, a young Latin man's faith is tested when he chooses to live life in the fast lane and crashes head-on with its consequences.

items.title: Broken Armor
items.description: Diverging from his faith to borrow money for his daughter's surgery, Tristian's lender orders him to rob a church to test his loyalty.

items.title: Fearless Faith
items.description: Officer Shep (Ben Davies) sets out on a courageous mission to lay his life down and save his partner when Colton (Jason Burkey) a respected sheriff's deputy begins to question his faith.

items.title: Miracle on Christmas
items.description: During the Christmas holiday, Mary (Erin Bethea) experiences emotional trials that cause her to question her faith until a visitor (Brett Varvel) arrives and her husband (Jason Burkey) receives an unexpected miracle.

items.title: Muñecas Bebe
items.description: Cuatro estudiantes de intercambio se refugian en una vieja casa abandonada cuando comienzan a escuchar susurros y a ver cosas espeluznantes. Uno por uno, comienzan a descubrir la aterradora verdad de la casa.

items.title: Slow West
items.description: A bounty hunter (Michael Fassbender) keeps his true motive a secret from the naïve Scottish teenager (Kodi Smit-McPhee) he's offered to serve as bodyguard and guide while the youth searches for his beloved in 1800s Colorado.

items.title: Revenge of the Green Dragons
items.description: A Chinese emigrant (Justin Chon) and his best friend (Kevin Wu) rise through the ranks of one of New York's most-powerful street gangs.

items.title: Woman Walks Ahead
items.description: Based on a true story, this riveting western follows a headstrong New York widow (Jessica Chastain) as she journeys west to meet Sioux chief Sitting Bull, facing off with an army officer (Sam Rockwell) intent on war with Native Americans.

items.title: Surf Nazis Must Die!
items.description: When the son of a gun-wielding woman is murdered by neo-Nazi surf punks in the post-apocalyptic future, his Mama hunts them down for some bloodthirsty revenge.

items.title: I Know Where Lizzie Is
items.description: When 15-year-old Lizzie is kidnapped, Judith and Martin are devastated. The police can't find the girl but Tracy Spencer comes forward claiming she's a psychic and knows where Lizzie is. It soon becomes clear that Tracy has an agenda of her own.

items.title: The Miseducation of Bindu
items.description: When a bullied teenage girl forges her mother's signature to test out of high school, hijinks ensue as she struggles to pay the test fee before the end of the day.

items.title: El sospechoso
items.description: Un robo a un banco toma un giro mortal y no planificado.

items.title: An American Affair
items.description: A corrupt DA becomes sexually involved with two beautiful women who happen to be best friends. When one gets pregnant he finds himself in a deadly game of double-cross. Twists and turns abound in this sexy political thriller.

items.title: #SquadGoals
items.description: High school reporter Samantha Hodges investigates a series of possible murders that her school is trying to hide when, one-by-one, finalists for the World Patron's Scholarship are ending up dead. Too bad she and her closest friends are next on the list.

items.title: Secrets in the Water
items.description: When Mia's body washes ashore, her mother, Laura, enlists the help of Mia's best friend to figure out who killed her daughter. Together, they narrow down the suspects. But further investigation uncovers a new piece of evidence that changes everything.

items.title: Seleccion Natural
items.description: Como el chico nuevo, un tímido estudiante de último año de secundaria se ve atormentado por todos sus compañeros excepto uno, pero su nuevo amigo tiene una perspectiva oscura y contagiosa.

items.title: El agujero negro
items.description: Un thriller de ciencia ficción centrado en un violinista de secundaria que es testigo del colapso del espacio y el tiempo.

items.title: Dios no hace las leyes
items.description: La pequeña ciudad de Rockwell está misteriosamente congelada en el tiempo después de un accidente de autobús, es decir, hasta que un niño con un pasado sórdido llega a la ciudad y luego las manecillas del tiempo avanzan.

items.title: Verano Rojo
items.description: Cuatro jóvenes llegan a Mallorca para disfrutar de unas idílicas vacaciones de verano, pero acaban en el lugar más inhóspito de la isla, y emprenden un viaje al infierno.

items.title: Cazadores de Brujas Americanos
items.description: Dos investigadores intentan detener un aquelarre de brujas que se han apoderado de un pequeño pueblo de Nueva Inglaterra.

items.title: Abigail inquietante
items.description: Después de escapar de las garras de una relación abusiva, Katie es obligada a regresar al hogar de acogida en el que creció. Poco sabe ella, su madre adoptiva Marge alberga un siniestro secreto que data de hace una década.

items.title: Life After Prison
items.description: A story of six men after being released from prison follow their journey as they try to get their lives back, hoping to change their future by mending their past.

items.title: Backs Against The Wall: The Howard Thurman Story
items.description: Backs Against the Wall: The Howard Thurman Story explores the extraordinary life and legacy of one of the most important religious figures of the 20th century.

items.title: Duplex
items.description: Young and vibrant New Yorkers Alex and Nancy have just found the perfect place to settle down and share a bright future: the bottom half of a beautiful old duplex. But their new home comes with a permanent fixture they didn't expect.

items.title: The Grifters
items.description: The acclaimed hit thriller that asks "who's conning who," with its irresistibly entertaining tale of a small-time "grifter" caught in a web of passion and mistrust.

items.title: Ghost Stories 1: Walking With The Dead
items.description: Walking with the Dead examines some of the most haunted places in the state of Indiana. See evidence of unexplainable paranormal events like visits from turn-of-the-century celebrities at Tuckaway House and appearances of Lady Rivoli at the Rivoli Theater

items.title: Ghost Stories 2: Conversations With The Dead
items.description: Conversations with the Dead marks the return of more paranormal activity and even more haunted places. Witness first-hand the supernatural presence felt at these locations through clear sound clips and captivating images.

items.title: Ghost Stories 3: Following The Dead
items.description: Following the Dead spotlights the life of legendary serial killer, H.H. Holmes by tracing his footsteps and his eerie past. As Dan T. Hall and his crew continue to communicate with the other side, view their actual footage from Hell's Gate.

items.title: Ghost Stories 4: Unmasking The Dead
items.description: Unmasking the Dead features Michael Jones, purported to have been the inspiration of The Sixth Sense, who shares his insight on experiencing the paranormal.

items.title: The Lost Tomb of Jesus
items.description: In 1980, a bulldozer accidentally uncovered a first-century tomb in Jerusalem. Of the ten ossuaries (stone coffins) found inside, six bore inscriptions: Jesus son of Joseph, Maria, Mariamene (the name by which Mary Magdalene was known), Joseph, Matthew, a

items.title: Beasts Clawing at Straws
items.description: A bag stuffed full of cash sends a group of hard-luck lowlifes on a desperate chase.

items.title: Critters
items.description: This film captures the bizarre, undersea life of Indonesia's Lembeh strait, host to the best muck diving on the planet.

items.title: The Night Before Christmas
items.description: A kind-hearted, young orphan boy and his loyal cat discover the true spirit of Christmas in this delightfully animated Yuletide tale of musical, magical holiday cheer! Produced by Golden Films. Directed by Diane Eskenazi.

items.title: Women Space Pioneers
items.description: On June 18th, 1983 Dr. Sally Ride became the first American woman to fly in space. Her accomplishments came to symbolize women's achievements in an all male-dominated fields and overnight she became one of the most famous women in American History. The fi

items.title: Lethal Eviction
items.description: A first-time landlord purchases a run-down, rent-controlled apartment building in hopes of making a solid investment. Everything seems to be going smoothly until, one by one, the tenants begin to meet strange, untimely gruesome deaths.

items.title: Michelle Obama: Life After the White House
items.description: Former First Lady Michelle Obama's story has just begun. Get lost in the incredible journey of this modern-day First Lady's story in the making...

items.title: Surviving Sandy Hook
items.description: Three families talk about their experiences after the Sandy Hook tragedy.

items.title: Benji The Dove
items.description: A tale of four boys who are rapidly coming to terms with bullies, friendship, and loyalty. The Order of the Red Dragon, a brotherhood of knights, is created to fight injustice with justice.

items.title: Diamond in the Rough
items.description: A faith-based film about a family that struggles with the issues of homelessness, PTSD, and substance abuse and how they overcome it together.

items.title: Discarded Things
items.description: When the life of Grace Wyatt, an esteemed music professor, is disrupted by the tragic loss of her husband Eric, Grace retreats to substance abuse as a way to cope with her grief. Finally at rock-bottom, Grace seeks help from a Christian recovery center.

items.title: Long Live Rock…Celebrate The Chaos
items.description: A deep dive into the hard rock music culture where members of Metallica, GnR, Slipknot, Ice-T, MGK, Rob Zombie, Five Finger Death Punch, Halestorm and more disccuss the maligned genre & the symbiotic relationship they have with their fans.

items.title: Herb Alpert Is…
items.description: Herb Alpert, musician, artist and legend, has sold more than 72 million albums and co-founded A&M Records, the most successful independent record company in history. Herb Alpert Is... looks at his life with rare footage and interviews.

items.title: Mary 4 Mayor
items.description: Running for mayor against her incumbent mayor father, an eighteen-year-old young woman learns valuable life lessons that not only are the building blocks to saving her family, but also the town she lives in.

items.title: I Spit On Your Grave
items.description: An aspiring writer (Camille Keaton - What Have You Done to Solange?, Tragic Ceremony) is attacked and left for dead by four men whom she systematically hunts down to seek revenge.

items.title: Parkland Rising
items.description: Parkland Rising documents the 2018 teen-led gun reform movement which followed the mass shooting at a Florida high school. With exclusive access, the film shows how ordinary citizens rose up and inspired millions to fight for change.

items.title: Found
items.description: A deputy sheriff sets out to rescue an orphaned boy raised up in the mountains away from the modern world and ends up trying to save him from a greedy oil company and a dangerous past.

items.title: The Master (2012)
items.description: Haunted by his past, WW-II veteran and drifter Freddie Quell (Joaquin Phoenix) crosses paths with a mysterious movement led by The Master (Phillip Seymour Hoffman) and his wife (Amy Adams).

items.title: Source Code
items.description: Jake Gyllenhaal stars in this action thriller about a man who awakens in another man’s body to discover only he has the ability to stop a terrorist attack on a commuter train.

items.title: Deadly Paradise
items.description: When she inherits a fortune, Tamara takes a Hawaiian vacation to celebrate and finds herself swept up in a whirlwind romance with Dario. But when her friend is attacked and her money is stolen, she sets her sights on Dario as the culprit.

items.title: Money for Nothing: The History of the Music Video
items.description: A history of the music video from the Beatles and Michael Jackson to Bruce Springsteen and Lady Gaga and everyone in between.

items.title: Barquero
items.description: When a small town on the Paria River is decimated by a group of vile outlaws, the bandits get more than they bargained for after the local bargeman turns the tables on the vicious gang! Lee van Cleef and Warren Oates star in this rousing western.

items.title: Vera Cruz
items.description: In this epic Western, two shady mercenaries (Gary Cooper, Burt Lancaster) in Mexico during the 1866 revolution are hired to escort a Countess and her gold to the Mexican army in Vera Cruz and find themselves at odds with the army…and each other!

items.title: Odds Against Tomorrow
items.description: When bigoted ex-con Earl Slater agrees to carry out a heist with a disgraced former cop and his cohorts – one of whom is Black – tensions mount as the job comes together, until Earl’s seething hatred erupts, risking the heist...and their lives!

items.title: Beach Party
items.description: It's the film that launched a genre and an iconic screen pairing as Frankie Avalon and Annette Funicello team for the first time for sand, surf and fun as an anthropologist (Robert Cummings) studies the wild dating habits of Malibu teenagers!

items.title: Gunslinger
items.description: When the town marshal is gunned down, his wife Rose (Beverly Garland) dons his badge. But now an evil dancehall diva (Allison Hayes) wants her dead and hires a gunslinger (John Ireland), who agrees to kill Rose...until he falls in love with her!

items.title: Another Man, Another Chance
items.description: Set in the late-1800s American West, a widowed frontier veterinarian and widow fall in love after losing their spouses.

items.title: Todo Incluido
items.description: Una familia de vacaciones se ve obligada a esconderse en su habitación de hotel cuando un huracán arrasa el centro turístico, donde pronto empiezan a revelarse verdades que han permanecido ocultas durante mucho tiempo.

items.title: Camino a Marte
items.description: Fue amor a primera vista entre José y Abril, pero un accidente causa la muerte de José. En el cielo lo tiene todo, excepto a Abril. José convence a su ángel de la guardia de dejarlo volver a Tierra.

items.title: Adios, Sabata
items.description: Under the brutal rule of garrison leader Col. Skimmel, a group of Mexican revolutionaries hire gunslinger Sabata (Yul Brynner) to rob a transport of gold in order to buy weapons. But the Colonel has other plans...taking the gold for himself.

items.title: Bobbie Jo And The Outlaw
items.description: A stunning carhop who wants to be a country singer and her sweetheart who dreams he's Billy the Kid become involved in robbery and murder.

items.title: Billion Dollar Brain
items.description: A billionaire, intent on destroying Communism by starting a world war, is close to achieving his goal with the help of the world's largest, and most powerful, computer. Secret Agent Harry Palmer (Michael Caine) is the only man who can stop him!

items.title: Cattle Annie And Little Britches
items.description: Two young aspiring outlaws (Amanda Plummer and Diane Lane) manage to join what’s left of the Doolin-Dalton gang, led by the aging Bill Doolin (Burt Lancaster). The gang’s heyday may be far behind them, but there’s still plenty of adventure left!

items.title: Hanoi Hilton
items.description: A group of POW'S, captives inside Hanoi's Hoa prison during the Vietnam War, endure some brutal lessons in the art of survival and find dignity in the bargain. A top-notch drama with a superb cast.

items.title: Snowmance
items.description: Mary's favorite Christmas tradition is building a \"Snow Beau\" with her best friend Nick. After a breakup, Mary wonders if she'll ever find true love. When her Snow Beau comes to life, Mary has a choice between dream romance and reality.

items.title: 10 Year Reunion
items.description: At their 10-year high school reunion, Carly Newman and her old clique discover that their friend Abby's death right before graduation may not have been an accident after all.

items.title: How to Stuff a Wild Bikini
items.description: While stationed in Tahiti, Frankie (Frankie Avalon) learns he’s in danger of losing Dee Dee (Annette Funicello) to another guy! That is, until a wacky witch doctor (Buster Keaton) conjures up a gorgeous bikini-clad vixen...whom no man can resist!

items.title: Ned Kelly
items.description: Mick Jagger makes his dynamic screen debut in this explosive tale based on the true-life story of the 19th-century Australian 'Armored Bandit,' who would become a mythic sagebrush hero even as the law closes in and prepares for an all-out war.

items.title: Judgment At Nuremberg
items.description: Judge Daniel Haywood (Spencer Tracy) presides over the trial of four German jurists accused of 'legalizing' Nazi atrocities. But mounting political pressure for leniency forces Haywood into making the most difficult decision of his career.

items.title: The Broken Star
items.description: A marshal murders a rancher for gold, but is foiled by his assistant.

items.title: Sunday, Bloody Sunday
items.description: In this groundbreaking and provocative drama, Glenda Jackson and Peter Finch portray two Londoners coping with the noncommittal affections of the free-spirited lover (Murray Head) they have in common. John Schlesinger directs.

items.title: The Heavenly Kid
items.description: Thou Shalt Be Cool with this totally awesome 80s classic when a helpless nerd (Jason Gedrick) gets divine intervention from a hip guardian angel (Lewis Smith) straight from the 1960s! Jane Kaczmarek, Nancy Valen and Richard Mulligan also star.

items.title: The Halliday Brand
items.description: A western about a young man's (Joseph Cotten) disillusionment with his father (Ward Bond), a corrupt sheriff. When his dad turns away from the lynching of his sister's lover, the boy rebels and his father declares him an 'outlaw.'

items.title: The Hunting Party (1971)
items.description: To cattle baron Brandt Ruger (Gene Hackman), his stunning wife (Candice Bergen) is just one of his possessions. So when a notorious bandit kidnaps her, an enraged Ruger organizes a posse to recover his property dead or alive in the searing western!

items.title: The Town That Dreaded Sundown (1977)
items.description: After a series of brutal murders on Texas country roads, police are on the hunt for 'the Phantom Killer.' Based on one of America's most baffling murder cases, this horrifying suspense thriller is a shocking experience you'll never forget.

items.title: Death On The Nile
items.description: As Hercule Poirot enjoys a luxurious cruise down the Nile, a newlywed heiress is found murdered on board. Can Poirot identify the killer before the ship reaches the end of its journey?

items.title: The Howling III: The Marsupials
items.description: A female werewolf runs away from her family and falls in love with a man who works in the movie business, while a sociologist who studies these creatures is looking for proof of their existence.

items.title: Rabid
items.description: Surgery leaves a Montreal motorcyclist (Marilyn Chambers) with a bloodsucking appendage in her armpit.

items.title: Road Games
items.description: A laid-back American truck driver in South Australia starts to suspect a man driving a green van of killing young women along his route, and proceeds to play a cat-and-mouse game in order to catch him red-handed.

items.title: RiffTrax Live: Santa And Ice Cream Bunny
items.description: One of the strangest, most baffling Christmas movies ever made, this movie defies logic, reason, and the laws of physics. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

items.title: Losin' It
items.description: Set in 1965, four rowdy teenage guys travel to Tijuana, Mexico, for a night of partying when they are joined by a heartbroken housewife who is in town seeking a quick divorce.

items.title: The House Of Tomorrow
items.description: Sebastian is a sixteen-year-old who has spent most of his life with his Nana in their geodesic dome home, a tourist attraction where she raises him on the futurist teachings of her former mentor Buckminster Fuller

items.title: RiffTrax: Viva Knievel!
items.description: Grab your baseball bat and join Mike, Kevin, and Bill as they spectacularly jump Snake River Canyon and see Viva Knievel! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

items.title: The Tiger Hunter
items.description: The Tiger Hunter is the story of Sami Malik, a young Indian man who travels to 1970s America to become an engineer in order to impress his childhood crush and live up to the legacy of his father.

items.title: Electric Dreams
items.description: An artificially intelligent PC and his human owner find themselves in a romantic rivalry over a woman.

items.title: Then Came You
items.description: Then Came You tells the story of Skye, a spunky teenager with a terminal illness who befriends Calvin, a 19-year-old hypochondriac who is afraid of his own shadow.

items.title: Bloodsucking Bastards
items.description: A loser and his slacker best friend who work at a soulless telemarketing company discover their new boss is a vampire who is turning their coworkers into fellow bloodsuckers.

items.title: Where We're From: Rise Of L.A. Underground Hip Hop
items.description: WHERE WE'RE FROM captures the rise of underground Hip Hop in Los Angeles during the 90s and 2000s.

items.title: Izzy Gets The Fuck Across Town
items.description: Broke, struggling musician Izzy finds herself at rock bottom when she learns that her ex and her former best friend have just gotten engaged.

items.title: Bite
items.description: While on her bachelorette party getaway, Casey, the bride-to-be, gets a seemingly harmless bite from an unknown insect.

items.title: ABBA: Super Troupe
items.description: Few bands have been able to dominate the industry in the same way as ABBA. Follow their journey to celebrity stardom, through archival interviews and performances from ABBA, with added inside knowledge from leading industry professionals.

items.title: Bee Gees: Everlasting Words
items.description: These three brothers rose to the top of their profession. Writing all of their own hits, the harmonious family act became one of the world's best-selling artists of all time, selling over more than 220 million records worldwide.

items.title: Blake Shelton: Oklahoma Star
items.description: Blake Shelton is one of the biggest country stars the world has ever seen. With a career that keeps reaching new heights, over 90 awards and countless number one hits, Blake Shelton is bound to leave a lasting legacy on country music forever.

items.title: Brad Pitt: Breaking Hollywood
items.description: "He may be one of the sexiest Hollywood actors, but his career and personal goals offer much more than his looks. Brad Pitt, one of the leading names in all of Hollywood. The well-known story of an unknown talent who transformed into a superstar."

items.title: Bob Dylan: Busy Being Born
items.description: Few musicians have made an impact throughout the decades as seismic as Bob Dylan. Retrace his journey, from humble folk beginnings in Hibbing, to the bustling electric Greenwich Village.

items.title: Brangelina: The Inside Story
items.description: From an on-set encounter, a fictional romance turned into a real life romance for two of the most famous actors of the Hollywood scene. After a decade of hysteria, the world grieved the loss of one of the world's most influential and talented duos.

items.title: Cher: In Her Own Words
items.description: Cher, the star who refused to be boxed in, stood up to conformity, and championed female independence. Proving the doubters wrong with every change of direction. Her influence on women in the industry, and direction of modern music is incalculable.

items.title: Cher: Life in the Spotlight
items.description: A legendary musician, a timeless icon, Cher has secured her legacy amongst the stars. Starting out as a young girl with crippling stage fright, evolving into one of the most recognised figures in Hollywood.

items.title: David Bowie: Out of This World
items.description: Few artists marked the 20th century like David Bowie did. He was an astonishing and eclectic performer. He was a true artist in every sense of the word. Infinitely changeable and unpredictable, he remains immortal in the people's heart.

items.title: Harry & Meghan: The Next Step
items.description: On January 8th 2020 The Duke and Duchess of Sussex made a shocking announcement that sent ripples around the world... they were leaving the Royal Family.

items.title: Harry & Meghan: The Price of Freedom
items.description: Harry and Meghan's decision to leave royal life behind was far and away from the stiff upper lip announcements of the past. Now for the first time we're taking a look behind the headlines at a version few of us got the chance to hear.

items.title: Harry & Meghan: The Revelations
items.description: Ever since the former Duke and Duchess of Sussex left royal life for Los Angeles tension has been mounting between the two households. Too many questions remained unanswered as the newly independent couple built their new life together.

items.title: JLO: From the Block
items.description: Jennifer Lopez is one of Hollywood's leading ladies. Throughout her illustrious career, she has starred in major blockbusters, released multi platinum albums and raised thousands for charities.

items.title: Kim Kardashian West: Hollywood Royalty
items.description: Whether it's rumours of plastic surgery or complimenting her figure in a body hugging outfit, Kim will always be the superstar at the top of celebrity news, with her famous family not far behind.

items.title: Led Zeppelin: Whole Lotta Rock
items.description: Led Zeppelin, One of the most iconic rock bands of all time, and key pioneers of heavy metal. Follow the band through their journey, from formation in 1968, their exciting climb to being one of the most influential bands in history.

items.title: Meghan Markle: Changing Traditions
items.description: She's here, she's royal and she's shaking things up. Meghan Markle has now become very much part of the most famous family in the world, but this strong and powerful woman is not stopping there.

items.title: Mick & Keith
items.description: Mick Jagger and Keith Richards often considered as pioneers of rock music genre. Without their unique contribution to music, the contemporary landscape would be very different and it is this originality which has set them apart.

items.title: Ozzy Osbourne: Throne of Darkness
items.description: The Prince of Darkness. Ozzy Osbourne. He is the physical embodiment of Rock and Roll.

items.title: Mick Jagger: A Knight to Remember
items.description: There has never been a rock and roll star quite like Mick Jagger. He is the voice of a generation. He is a successful musician, artist, actor, movie producer and business man. Relive the life and career of the face of the Rolling Stones.

items.title: My Father and the Man in Black
items.description: The inside story of 'bad boy' Johnny Cash, his talented but troubled manager, Saul Holiff, and a son searching for his father in the shadow of a legend.

items.title: Lucha Mexico
items.description: In Mexico, the war between good and evil has been waged each week with the spectacle of Lucha Libre.

items.title: Paul McCartney: Wings of a Beatle
items.description: From the small clubs of Liverpool to the world stage, Sir Paul McCartney has dedicated his life to the music industry. Experience the story behind one of the music industries most treasure musical icons. This is Sir Paul McCartney.

items.title: Queen Elizabeth & Prince Philip: Love, Marriage & Country
items.description: Queen Elizabeth The Second has been the reigning monarch of the United Kingdom and the Commonwealth since 1952. Through it all she has had the love and support of Prince Philip. Together they have captained the most famous family in the world.

items.title: Prince Harry: A New Kind of Royal
items.description: Prince Harry's passion for change has often brought him to heads with those determined to maintain the status quo. Recently, his longing for privacy has lead to his choice to leave royal life behind and pursue an independent future for his family.

items.title: Rod Stewart: The Signature Voice
items.description: His unique voice, presence on stage and dynamic fashion sense has turned Rod into a superstar. Some guys have all the luck, but Rod has persisted, through ups and downs, to remain one of Britain's most notable performers.

items.title: Queen Elizabeth II: The Unlikely Queen
items.description: Queen Elizabeth The Second. The cornerstone of modern British history. Reigning monarch for over six decades. Her inscrutable commitment to duty has defined her lifetime of service to the throne. But Elizabeth was never meant to be Queen.

items.title: Stevie Nicks: Wild at Heart
items.description: Through her drive and passion for creating art, the Bohemian Rock Queen found an avenue to overcome her obstacles, going on to become the only woman inducted into the rock and roll hall of fame, twice.

items.title: Selena Gomez: Devotion
items.description: After returning from her 5 year break from music, Selena Gomez has blown the world away with her 3rd studio album Rare. She has transformed over the years, from Disney pop star to award winning film and tv producer.

items.title: Taylor Swift: Dare to Dream
items.description: The incredible journey of Taylor Swift all began with a girl, a guitar and a dream. She in the only artist in History to have an album hit the 1 million first week sales figure three times.

items.title: The Dolly Parton Story: From Rags to Rhinestones
items.description: From the bright lights of recording contracts in Nashville to topping the music charts, to acting in movies to global appearances in sold-out arena tours, Dolly has certainly come a long way and it hasn't always been an easy ride.

items.title: The Beatles: In the Life
items.description: Shooting onto the scene in the early 60's, The Beatles took the world by storm. Their fame was new, massive and continues to this day. They are still the best-selling band of all time 183 million sales world wide.

items.title: The Kardashians: Reality Royalty
items.description: With millions of selfies between them and a wide variety of product endorsements, the Kardashian's are winning awards and breaking the internet. They are the royal family of reality tv.

items.title: The Life and Death of Tupac Shakur
items.description: Tupac endures as one of hip-hop's most iconic figures and its most potent enigma - he elevated rap, changing it from a passing trend to a complex art form. His poetic tales of urban alienation captivated young people of all races and backgrounds

items.title: The Last Days of Princess Diana
items.description: From a fairytale princess to a powerful independent mother. Now free from the shackles of a royal marriage, Diana was just about to conquer the world again and this time on her own terms, but everything was about to come to a screeching halt.

items.title: The Story of Jay-Z
items.description: Jay-Z is one of the most talented, successful and acclaimed musicians of all time. He changed the game and without him, music - and more specifically hip hop - would not be in the medium it is today.

items.title: The Story of James Brown
items.description: James Brown is one of the founders of funk music and is a major figure of 20th century music and dance. This program features interviews with the man himself, live performances, interviews with band members Bobby Byrd and Maceo Parker Jr.

items.title: A Wall in Jerusalem
items.description: A brilliant documentary about the growth of Israel into the Jewish homeland.

items.title: Deadtime Stories
items.description: A babysitting uncle tells his charges three horror stories--about a killer witch, Little Red Riding Hood and a werewolf, and a story about 'Goldi Lox' and the three bears.

items.title: Dudes
items.description: Two punks from the big city, traveling across the country in a Volkswagen bug, embrace the western ethos

items.title: Small Soldiers
items.description: Cuando la tecnología de misiles se usa para reforzar muñecos de acción, los juguetes toman muy en serio su programación de pelea.

items.title: Look to the Sky
items.description: These are the inspiring true stories of young people who have demonstrated the spirit of Superman. This film explores the power of hope and the importance of positive ideals while encouraging viewers to find the superhero within themselves.

items.title: A Most Violent Year
items.description: In 1981 NYC, an immigrant (Oscar Isaac) and his family try to expand their business as rampant violence and corruption drag them in and threaten to destroy all they have built.

items.title: Chinese Connection 2
items.description: A martial artist (Lieh Lo) seeks vengeance against the fighters who killed his mother.

items.title: Lila & Eve
items.description: Lila, a grief-stricken mother reeling from her son's murder, attends a support group where she meets Eve, who urges her to take matters into her own hands to track down her son's killers. They soon embark on a journey of revenge and recovery.

items.title: A Volcano Odyssey
items.description: Follow the story of 65 millions years of evolution around a volcanic hotspot in the Indian Ocean.

items.title: A Frozen Christmas Dance: Christmas Miracle
items.description: It’s Christmas and all of Sunnyville is preparing for a wonderful holiday and non-stop dance party! What miracle will Santa perform this year? Find out in the most exciting Holiday dance party around, A Frozen Christmas Dance: Christmas Miracle!

items.title: A Frozen Christmas Dance: Party Like A Reindeer
items.description: It’s Christmas and Sunnyville's little baby animals are in for the time of their life! Dance along as the party hops on, it's A Frozen Christmas Dance: Party like A Reindeer!

items.title: A Frozen Christmas Dance: Party Like A Turkey
items.description: It’s Christmas and Sunnyville's little baby animals are in for the time of their life! Dance along as the party hops on, it's A Frozen Christmas Dance: Party like A Turkey!

items.title: A Frozen Christmas Dance: Thank You Santa
items.description: It’s Christmas and Sunnyville's little baby animals are in for the time of their life! Dance along as the party hops on, it's A Frozen Christmas Dance: Thank You Santa!

items.title: A Frozen Christmas Time 3
items.description: It's Christmas time and Santa must solve the greatest mystery of all! What to bring all his friends for the holidays? Never fear! Santa and his bestie Mittens the reindeer have plenty of friends in Sunnyville ready to come to the rescue.

items.title: A Frozen New Years 2
items.description: It’s New Year’s Eve and all of Sunnyville is preparing to ring in the New Year! Santa is also getting ready for his well-deserved holiday! But where will he go? Find out with A Frozen New Years 2!

items.title: 4th of July Dance 2
items.description: It’s the 4th Of July and all the inhabitants of Sunnyville are celebrating with the greatest 4th Of July party anybody has ever seen! On this festive day Besties Beezbee the bee, Peanut the giraffe and Brooklyn they lion are on a new adventure!

items.title: Be My Valentine
items.description: Get in the Valentine’s Day spirit with Lovey and Dovey, two holiday hearts excited to spread joy and celebrate their favorite day with dancing and singing! It’s a Valentine’s Day party for the whole family! Join the fun in Be My Valentine.

items.title: Elf Day
items.description: Another holiday season is over, and joy still blankets the land - that is, until Santaʼs beloved Christmas tree goes missing! Enter Bingle, Jingle, Tingle, Dorabelle, and Cheer - the E.L.F. Detective Agency!

items.title: Little Historians: The Constitution
items.description: Join the Little Historians, it’s time for another adventure in our fascinating past! Let’s get ready for a new journey to learn all about the history of the Constitution of the United States of America with Little Historians: The Constitution!

items.title: A Frozen Christmas
items.description: A Frozen Christmas is the perfect way to get the family in the Holiday spirit with the most beloved animated Christmas characters, including Santa Claus, the Snowman, Elves, Santa’s Reindeer, and more!

items.title: Killer Asteroid
items.description: When natural disasters threaten, we turn to science and technology to warn us to seek shelter or get out of the way. But can they face down the ultimate threat: speeding projectiles from the depths of space?

items.title: Cosas que diría con solo mirarla
items.description: Una historia compuesta de cinco tramas entrelazadas que se centran en un grupo de mujeres cuyas vidas, en el transcurso de unos pocos días, se enredan, se erosionan, se enriquecen y, finalmente, terminan por cambiar para siempre.

items.title: Asesinato al ritmo del tango
items.description: En este thriller evocador, un sicario experto (Robert Duvall) va a Buenos Aires para abatir a un general corrupto. Tras un repentino retraso de la operación, una sensual bailarina de tango le ha seducido y una conspiración mortal le ha traicionado.

items.title: Foragidos y ángeles
items.description: Cuando una banda de forajidos invade la casa de una familia inocente para esconderse durante la noche, se crea un juego inesperado del gato y el ratón, que conduce a la seducción, el cambio de roles y, en última instancia, a la sangrienta venganza.

items.title: Salvador
items.description: Es 1980. Los jóvenes, las mujeres y los niños están siendo brutalmente asesinados en una sangrienta guerra civil en El Salvador. Es un escenario horrible, pero perfecto para Richard Boyle, reportero gráfico de guerra cuya carrera necesita un impulso.

items.title: El perdón
items.description: En 1849, Daniel Dillon, su esposa Elena y su hija Hope se dirigen a California para buscar oro. Topan con una cabaña en la que un letrero reza: 'Venga a nosotros tu reino'. Dillon vende a su esposa y a su hija al buscador de oro a cambio de una concesión.

items.title: Nothing But the Truth
items.description: A polygraph examiner has an affair with a murder suspect after her tests clears him, but new evidence then suggests he might be guilty after all.

items.title: Led Zeppelin IV
items.description: Hailed as one of the greatest albums in rock history, Led Zeppelin IV became a peak moment for an iconic band. This documentary explores the story of the album's making, and its enduring legacy.

items.title: Navidad Beverly Hills
items.description: Con solo dos días antes de Navidad, Angelina se embarca en una misión casi imposible para tratar de salvar a su malcriada hija de 14 años, de ir por el camino equivocado. ¿Podrá Angelina sacar a su hija de la lista de los traviesos?

items.title: Un chico. Una chica. Un sueño
items.description: Cass, un promotor de discotecas en LA, tiene una experiencia emocionante e inolvidable con Frida, una turista del Medio Oeste de Estados Unidos. Ella lo impulsa a retomar sus sueños olvidados y el, a su vez, la empuja a descubrir los suyos.

items.title: Resistencia
items.description: James es un agente británico. Danny, una científica, trabaja en un proyecto bajo el mar profundo. A pesar de sus trabajos y misiones individuales peligrosas, que parecen destinadas a separarlos, surge un amor apasionado entre ellos.

items.title: El túnel
items.description: Un camión cisterna choca dentro de un túnel en Noruega, dejando atrapada a la gente dentro del mismo. Se desata una fuerte tormenta de nieve, impidiendo que el principal equipo de rescate llegue a lugar.

items.title: The Spruces & The Pines
items.description: Rival Christmas tree farms, run by the Spruce and the Pine families, have always competed. When Julie Pine and Rick Spruce fall in love, they must conceal their romance or risk condemnation from their families.

items.title: Getting Grace
items.description: Grace, a teenage girl dying of cancer, crashes a funeral home to find out what will happen to her after she dies, but ends up teaching awkward funeral director Bill how to celebrate life.

items.title: Hunting Bin Laden
items.description: September 11th, 2001. Four terrorist attacks on the United States of America claim over 2,900 lives, and leave more than 25,000 injured.

items.title: La mujer de negro 2 : El ángel de la muerte
items.description: 40 años después del primer embrujo en la Casa Eel Marsh, llega un grupo de niños evacuados desde Londres en medio de la Segunda Guerra Mundial, despertando al habitante más tenebroso de la casa.

items.title: Best Bug Buddies
items.description: Join the Best Bug Buddies for a bug-tastic adventure. Get a bug's-eye view of the habits and habitats of actual insects. Learn incredible facts from some amazing creatures that will facinate and inspire. Jump into the lake with the Best Bug Buddies!

items.title: A Frozen Christmas Carol
items.description: Hop on Santa's sleigh for a ride of a lifetime! This holiday season, Santa and his trusty sidekick, Lear the reindeer, tell the magical classic tale of A Christmas Carol.

items.title: Buzzed
items.description: Dive into the pond for a whole new adventure! All your favorite pond critters are back and this time they're dealing with a robotic toad that threatens to upstage Joe.

items.title: The Student
items.description: When handsome Law Student Vance & volatile Law Professor Abigail Hardacre's battle of Ethics transcends debate, Abigail's life spins so far out of control it seems destined for a tragic ending....unless she can outwit her star pupil.

items.title: 9/11: Minute by Minute
items.description: The four coordinated attacks, driven by religious extremism, claimed the lives of thousands. The chaos in the skies sent radio communications into meltdown. Follow the key aspects of the nation's response as the deadly disaster unfolds.

items.title: Finders Keepers
items.description: Amputee John Wood finds himself in a stranger-than-fiction battle to reclaim his mummified leg from Southern entrepreneur Shannon Whisnant, who found it in a grill he bought at an auction. A true-life tragicomedy about fame, addiction, and family.

items.title: Into the Cosmos: The Space Race, Mars and Beyond
items.description: Detailed accounts of previous missions for the exploration of Mars, including the landing of the rovers on the planets surface.

items.title: Around the World in 80 Anthems
items.description: Narrated by Daymond John, this film follows Guinness World Record-setting 11 year old Capri Everitt and her family through 80 countries as she sings the national anthem in each country’s national language to raise money for orphaned kids.

items.title: Yamasong: March of the Hollows
items.description: An automaton girl and a tortoise warrior embark on an incredible journey to defeat a sinister mechanized army. Their only hope is to team up with a band of outlaws to find a legendary relic and save the creatures of their world.

items.title: Wolfy
items.description: Wolfy is a wolf. Tom is a rabbit. Wolfy thought he was an orphan until a gypsy told him his mother is alive. The two friends set out to find Wolfy's mom in the principality of Wolfenberg. What incredible secret lies behind Wolfy's birth?

items.title: Hitler: Empire of Evil
items.description: How the rise of a man who dreamt of becoming an artist became the worlds most feared dictator. Nazi Germany was one of the most brutal eras in History, leaving a lasting affect on the country forever.

items.title: Life, Animated

items.title: 9/11: Stories from the City
items.description: Where were you the day the world changed? When everyone stopped and nothing would ever be the same again. 20 years on, listen to some of the incredible first hand stories in this emotional reflection of one of the darkest days in American history.

items.title: 19 Years in Vietnam: Unaccompanied, Unarmed and Unafraid

items.description: Detective Mike Logan takes on a special undercover assignment as a nanny when a quiet, upscale neighborhood is turned upside down by a string of robberies. When the mystery begins to unravel, new relationships are threatened.

items.title: Recipe for Love
items.description: A culinary-school hopeful gets assigned to ghostwrite a cookbook for a popular celebrity chef, but the two of them clash over contradictory cooking styles. However, their shared love of cooking sparks a connection.

items.title: Redwood Curtain
items.description: A story of an Amer-Asian girl, with the reluctant approval of her adoptive parents, seeks her natural father in the redwood forests of Northern California. From the Hallmark Hall of Fame.

items.description: A down-on-her-luck waitress meets jewelry store clerk, Gus, but complications ensue because of his memory problems. A brain aneurysm three years earlier gives Gus a blank slate the second his alarm wakes him each day.

items.description: He was an extraordinary leader, with vision and ambition. He would fight tirelessly until his last days against injustice. By fighting for his dreams and against injustice, he powerfully impacted generations and he changed the world.

items.description: The accident at Chernobyl released at least 100 times more radiation than the atomic bombs dropped on Hiroshima and Nagasaki. An incalculable number of Europeans still hold the scars from what happened that disastrous night in Chernobyl.

items.description: Una familia se prepara para celebrar el fin de año en una aislada casa en medio del bosque.

items.title: Rommel: The Soldier, The Son, and Hitler
items.description: Never a member of the Nazi party, Rommel detested blending politics and war. He would quickly discover that both were always in play under Hitler.

items.description: A circulation-hungry newspaper brings a terminally ill Vermont woman to New York as a publicity stunt.

items.title: UFO Chronicles: Masters Of Deception
items.description: Experts reveal insights into the UFO enigma and the Alien Presence on Earth exploring the role of global corporations/one world government in a wide cover-up.

items.title: 3: JFK Homicide
