items.description: Escaping war, a young girl finds a lone surviving infant and decides to raise him as her son.

items.title: Little John
items.description: An estranged father's failing health forces a reunion between a judge and the child she gave up for adoption. Stars Ving Rhames, Gloria Reuben, Patty Duke, and Robert Bailey, Jr. From the Hallmark Hall of Fame Collection.

items.title: Kiss at Pine Lake
items.description: Luke Garvey buys his uncle's Camp Pine Lake only to find himself the owner of a sinking business. Zoe McConnell, Luke's girlfriend from years ago, wants him to sell until an old flame is rekindled.

items.title: Lead with Your Heart
items.description: When their parents contemplate splitting up, two teens hatch a scheme to make them realize how much they need each other. Stars Billy Baldwin and Kari Matchett.

items.title: The Locket
items.description: After his mother dies, a college dropout befriends a patient at a health-care center who gives him support and guidance. Stars Vanessa Redgrave. From the Hallmark Hall of Fame.

items.title: William Faulkner's Old Man
items.description: Set in the 1920s, a prison inmate is tempted by the opportunity to escape during a Mississippi flood. Stars Jeanne Tripplehorn and Arliss Howard. From the Hallmark Hall of Fame Collection.

items.title: When Sparks Fly
items.description: Fireworks go off when Amy Peterson comes home to help save her family's annual 4th of July celebration and discovers she loves the man she left behind years ago to pursue her dreams of becoming a journalist. Stars Meghan Markle.

items.title: The Echo of Thunder
items.description: A young girl goes to live with her father and stepmother in the Australian outback after her mother's death. Stars Judy Davis and Jamey Sheridan. From the Hallmark Hall of Fame Collection.

items.title: Living on Soul
items.description: Filmed during their three-night, sold-out residency at the historic Apollo Theater, this hybrid docu-concert film features the late great Sharon Jones, Charles Bradley and the rest of the Grammy-nominated Daptone Records family.

items.title: Swan Lake
items.description: In master storyteller Graeme Murphy's hands, the world's favourite ballet becomes a witty, dramatic and ultimately devastating story of love and betrayal - a love triangle between a princess, her prince, and a woman with a prior claim on his heart.

items.title: The Legendary Barry White
items.description: Recorded live in Belgium, Barry White was a regular in the Top Twenty in the 1970s with hit after hit featuring lush strings over his amazing bass voice.

items.title: The Music of Duke Ellington and Lionel Hampton
items.description: This program features rare footage of the two jazz greats that captures not only the glory of their music, but also the enthusiasm and charisma that have made these two musicians into legends.

items.title: The Legendary Bobby Darin
items.description: Although he first came to prominence as a rock-and-roll star, U.S. entertainer Bobby Darin proved to be a versatile performer who made a name for himself in a variety of musical genres as well as in film.

items.title: The Osmond Brothers: American Trilogy
items.description: The Osmond Brothers, American Trilogy live in concert.

items.title: Johnny Mathis: In Concert
items.description: Johnny Mathis is one of a handful of artists who truly deserves a legendary status. Since his impact on scene in the 1950s, Johnny has maintained a high levels of performance, both on recordings and on stage.

items.title: Tyler Perry's Madea Goes to Jail
items.description: At long last, Madea returns to the big screen! This time, America's favorite irreverent, pistol-packin' grandmomma is raising hell behind bars and lobbying for her freedom.

items.title: Christmas with Felicity
items.description: A struggling young baker in no mood for the holidays returns to her small hometown, where her festive family and a handsome farmer try to get her back in the Christmas spirit.

items.title: The Killer Nun
items.description: Legendary Swedish sex bomb Anita Ekberg stars as Sister Gertrude, a cruel nun who discovers depraved pleasure in a frenzy of drug addiction, sexual degradation and sadistic murder.

items.title: Cape Cod Christmas
items.description: When a children's author hosts one last Christmas dinner with her disagreeable siblings before they sell the family house, she reunites with her childhood sweetheart who helps her find a way to keep the home she loves so dearly.

items.title: Labou
items.description: Tres niños se pierden en los pantanos de Luisiana al ir en busca de un pirata fantasma y su tesoro perdido, pero lo que descubren es la verdadera amistad y la aventura de sus vidas.

items.title: 48 Christmas Wishes
items.description: After losing an entire town's letters to Santa, two junior Elves leave the North Pole and attempt to blend into small town life as they set out to retrieve every missing wish before Santa's sleigh departs on Christmas Eve.

items.title: Happy, Texas
items.description: Dos convictos fugitivos son confundidos con dos asesores de un concurso de belleza local en la ciudad de Happy, Texas y se hacen pasar por la pareja que organiza el concurso. ¡Los dos se enfrentan rápidamente a consecuencias impredecibles!

items.title: La duda
items.description: Este cautivador drama lleno de suspenso elevado por las actuaciones de los nominados al Óscar Meryl Streep, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Amy Adams y Viola Davis, Doubt, te mantendrá en vilo.

items.title: Duplex
items.description: Los jóvenes y vibrantes neoyorquinos Alex y Nancy encontraron un lugar perfecto para establecerse y compartir un futuro brillante: la planta baja de un hermoso y viejo dúplex. Pero su nuevo hogar viene con un accesorio permanente que no esperaban.

items.title: Sounder
items.description: The oldest son of a loving and strong family of black sharecroppers comes of age in the Depression-era South after his father is imprisoned for stealing food.

items.title: Chance in the World, A
items.description: Based on the award-winning book, A Chance in the World is the inspirational true story of a gifted boy who must escape his abusive foster parents to fulfill his incredible destiny.

items.title: Hero Ain't Nothing but a Sandwich, A
items.description: A troubled boy becomes addicted to heroin, and his mother and foster father help him fight it.

items.title: Peter Rabbit
items.description: Based on the beloved classic book by Beatrix Potter, this new educational video follows the history of the mischievous and disobedient young Peter Rabbit as he gets into, and is chased about, the garden of Mr. McGregor.

items.title: Hobson's Choice
items.description: Widower Henry Hobson is a successful bootmaker and a tyrannical father of three daughters who all want to leave him by getting married, but he refuses because marriage traditions require him to pay out settlements.

items.title: Open Marriage
items.description: To rekindle their passion, a married couple agrees to experiment with an open relationship. All goes to plan until a stranger creates a dangerous path to betrayal, heartbreak and bloodshed.

items.title: Cloudy Times
items.description: El tiempo nublado is a supremely personal film about a universal issue, we all have to face: What are we going to do with our parents, once they are old and ill?

items.title: Louder Than Bombs
items.description: LOUDER THAN BOMBS explores the death of a famous photographer (Isabelle Huppert), and how her husband (Gabriel Byrne) and sons, (Jesse Eisenberg and Devin Druid) cope while unraveling the truth behind the mysterious accident that claimed her life.

items.title: Operator
items.description: An anxious programmer enlists the help of his empathetic wife when given the task to create the perfect call center program. However, their relationship spirals out of control when he begins replacing her with an ideal computerized replica.

items.title: La Sombra De La Noche
items.description: Un estudiante de derecho intenta ganar dinero como vigilante nocturno en la morgue de la ciudad. Pero pronto el turno nocturno es de terror cuando un asesino serial siembra el caos y deja pistas que señalan a Martin como sospechoso.

items.title: El heredero del crimen
items.description: Dragon Mao debe liderar la policía local, pero pronto descubre toda la corrupción policial que pasa bajo sus narices. Cuando se lo acusa del robo en una joyería, Dragon Mao debe luchar para limpiar su nombre.

items.title: Destierros
items.description: Border mechanisms that act on migrants are multiple. From shelter to shelter, boarding on trains, migrants aim up north across Mexico to reach the United States and Canada.

items.title: Cows Wearing Glasses
items.description: When a solitary, eccentric artist and professor learns he's going blind, he must come to terms with this terrifying fact and sort things out with his daughter, who became estranged from him years ago.

items.title: A Holiday Romance
items.description: A superintendent must fire the town's favorite music teacher to meet budget cuts. But a romance grows between them, and through the power of music, he discovers how instrumental a single individual can become in our lives.

items.title: I'll Be Home For Christmas
items.description: A mayor of a small town is desperate to find a doctor to keep open the town's clinic. When a surgeon visits for the Christmas holiday, their history as high school sweethearts and challenges in his big city hospital position causes complications.

items.title: Judgment Day: The Ellie Nesler Story
items.description: Based on a true story. A woman is put on trial for murder after she shoots the man who sexually molested her son at summer camp.

items.title: Possessing Piper Rose
items.description: Adopting a little girl triggers a series of unfathomable events in the lives of a desperate couple whose dreams of parenthood turn into a nightmare.

items.title: Seeds of Deception
items.description: Based on a true story of a renowned doctor who used his own sperm to impregnate patients, without informing them.

items.title: The Stalking of Laurie Show
items.description: Laurie falls for Butch, a popular boy at her new school. When Michelle, Butch's girlfriend, walks in on him raping Laurie at a party, she accuses Laurie of being the seducer. Michelle tries to ruin her, until events explode on a dark night.

items.title: The Chateau Meroux
items.description: A woman inherits a struggling Napa Valley Winery and must compete against a ruthless neighbor to keep her business from failing. When she begins having feelings for a local winemaker, she is forced to realize that all is fair in love and wine.

items.title: Break Every Chain
items.description: A police officer's battle with alcoholism, depression, and devastating loss; and the true story of how God changed his life forever.

items.title: Turbulence
items.description: An FBI Agent's family is kidnapped while she is on a flight and a mysterious stranger seated beside her forces her to make a decision to save their lives.

items.title: Past Shadows
items.description: An ancient Middle Eastern relic, with the ability to see into the past, gets unearthed, crossing paths with a University professor and his students, changing their lives forever.

items.title: Where The Land Meets The Sky
items.description: A family film about the journey of life and the beauty of second chances.

items.title: Lake Los Angeles (LAS)
items.description: A middle-aged Cuban man and a ten-year-old Mexican girl bond over being away from home in the hopeless back-drop that is Lake Los Angeles.

items.title: Mike Tyson: Fists of Iron
items.description: The baddest man on the planet. The multiple-time heavyweight boxing champion of the world. 'Iron' Mike Tyson. Growing up, he struggled immensely. Inside the ring, he steamrolled an entire division of elite athletes.

items.title: Floyd "Money" Mayweather
items.description: Whether it's taking on one of the best boxers in the world, Manny Pacquiao, or fighting the king of the Octagon, Conor McGregor, Floyd 'Money' Mayweather puts on a show no matter the opponent.

items.title: Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson: No Pain No Gain
items.description: The People's Champion, The Rock. An Icon in both professional wrestling and Hollywood. From humble beginnings to one of the highest-grossing actors today, he remains grounded, charismatic and enjoyable to watch in any form of media.

items.title: Travis Pastrana's Baja Diaries
items.description: From the inception of the team to the purchase and construction of the motorcycle and super-fast pro, Baja Diaries covers the difficulties and expenses that face any team attempting to mount a charge in the Mexican Desert.

items.title: Breaking Ice
items.description: In 1986, a group of elite rowers traded their boats for bobsleighs in a bid to become Ireland's first-ever Winter Olympians.

items.title: Hurley
items.description: In the 1970's, Hurley Haywood was the dominant force in motor racing, but his personal life remained a mystery. Hurley chronicles a remarkable life, revealing a greater insight into the tightrope walk between career and personal life.

items.title: Life Cycles
items.description: Life Cycles is a true adventure film. Over 5 years in the making, and using the bicycle as the vehicle, Life Cycles takes you on a journey through nature's most beautiful, dramatic, and sometimes unforgiving landscapes.

items.title: THE WATCHER
items.description: Unaware of its terrible history, a young couple purchases their dream home. It soon becomes clear that they may not be alone in the house and that someone, or something, is determined to drive them out.

items.title: A CHRISTMAS LOVE
items.description: A couple struggling to make ends meet are given a new chance by the arrival of a mysterious letter that grants them one special wish during the holiday season.

items.title: BLUE DREAM
items.description: His industry dying and the newspaper where he works purchased by a ruthless media mogul, Robert drinks, does drugs and has sex as he takes full advantage of the final days of his of print journalism career.

items.title: SAMURAI COP
items.description: A bitter samurai cop and his sidekick intend to get their revenge and bravely try to go after the Yakuza.

items.title: Bloodknot
items.description: A family, shattered by the death of a son, is wickedly manipulated by the mysterious young woman who turns up, claiming to be the son's girlfriend, in this suspenseful psychological puzzle that probes the dark secrets of the heart.

items.title: The Bear
items.description: The Bear follows the story of a young cub and an adult grizzly as they join forces to survive the perils inherent in their mountain habitat.

items.title: The Night They Saved Christmas
items.description: A mother and her three children find themselves on a wondrous journey to the North Pole, where they alone can save Santa Claus and his massive toy factory from destruction.

items.title: Hats Off To Christmas!
items.description: For ten years, Mia has been a loyal and hard-working small-town Christmas hat shop manager. But this holiday season, her boss has gifted her a disappointing revelation.

items.title: I Do (But I Don't)
items.description: Wedding planner Lauren Crandell’s job is to work miracles on other people’s weddings. Unfortunately, when troubleshooting her own life, she’s hit a few snags.

items.title: A Christmas Carol: The Musical
items.description: The miserly and bad-tempered Ebenezer Scrooge encounters three spirits on Christmas Eve, each of which shows him the reasons, reality and future of his crabbed existence.

items.title: Mrs. Santa Claus
items.description: A musical adventure in which Mrs. Claus leaves the North Pole and finds herself in 1890s New York. She explores this new world by getting a job in a sweat shop and befriending a young suffragette, only to become empowered by urban life.

items.title: Mr. St. Nick
items.description: Take one Santa who’s losing his powers, a Santa-to-be who is addicted to Miami nightlife, and a scheme to bring a totally unexpected new demographic to Christmas, and you have a wildly funny holiday romp from Sonar Entertainment.

items.title: The Saddle Club: Adventure At Pine Hollow
items.description: Join Stevie, Carole and Lisa on their adventures at Pine Hollow Stabels as they juggle their time between riding, school, and boys in this chapter.

items.title: Christmas Trade
items.description: Just days before Christmas, an LA real-estate lawyer and his eleven-year-old son magically swap bodies. As they walk in each other's shoes, the father and son rediscover what it means to be family.

items.title: Marcus
items.description: Patrick Savey plunges us into Marcus's world, capturing the New York roots of the legendary bass player, following his path like the pebbles of Tom Thumb, as he meets masters of Jazz like Jaco Pastorius, Herbie Hancock, Al Jarreau and Miles Davis.

items.title: Made in France
items.description: After the horrible terrorist attacks that rocked Paris, this daring investigation thriller plunges you inside the extremist muslim groups that grow inside western countries and can strike at any moment.

items.title: The Greasy Hands Preachers
items.description: This film explores the revival of manual work through the passion of motorcycle enthusiasts who have found their way to a happy life

items.title: Red Stone
items.description: A dangerous hitman (McDonough) is tasked with hunting down a teenager who witnessed the murder of his older brother at the hands of a ruthless Southern crime lord (Cudlitz).

items.title: Lost at Christmas
items.description: In this feel-good festive romance, two strangers come together to try and get home for Christmas.

items.title: Black Coffee
items.description: After Robert is fired from his own father's company, he feels like his luck has run out - until Morgan enters into his life.

items.title: Falling In Love Again
items.description: A recently divorced couple navigating the challenges of co-parenting their young son while moving on to new partners. They soon find the grass isn't quite greener. Will they take a second shot at love?

items.title: Our Dream Christmas
items.description: A family visits relatives in Los Angeles on Christmas Eve to spend one last holiday together. Hidden secrets are uncovered, old relationships are tested, and they must figure out a way forward.

items.title: Like Water For Chocolate
items.description: After the man she admires marries her sister, a young Mexican woman throws her passion into cooking, discovering she can transfer her emotions through the food she prepares.

items.title: The Wishing Tree
items.description: A young professor supervises several "orphan" students who have nowhere to go for the holidays. He brings them together through The Wishing Tree--a Christmas tree decorated with handwritten wishes. Stars Jason Gedrick.

items.title: To Dance with the White Dog
items.description: An unusual love story in which a strange white dog appears and helps Sam Peek, a Georgia tree farmer, cope with the loss of his wife, Cora. Stars Hume Cronyn and Jessica Tandy. From the Hallmark Hall of Fame Collection.

items.title: What The Deaf Man Heard
items.description: After 20 years of pretending not to be able to hear or speak, a man breaks his silence to get revenge on the man who made his life miserable. Stars Matthew Modine, James Earl Jones, Bernadette Peters, and Frankie Muniz.

items.title: The Memory Book
items.description: At a flea market, Chloe discovers a book of photos showcasing the romance of a young couple from the early seventies. She sets out on a literal and emotional journey to find the happy couple she knows only through photos.

items.title: The Mystery Cruise
items.description: Alvirah, Regan, and their husbands join a murder mystery cruise. But, when Alvirah sees a real murder attempt, she and Regan must find a way to keep the intended victim safe while trying to find proof to expose the murderer.

items.title: Missing Pieces
items.description: A Colorado rancher uncovers a bed of lies and unanswered questions as he investigates his son's apparent suicide. Stars James Coburn. From the Hallmark Hall of Fame Collection.

items.title: The Piano Lesson
items.description: A family is torn by the choice of keeping a valuable family heirloom piano or selling it to improve their lives. Stars Charles S. Dutton, Alfre Woodard, and Courtney B. Vance. From the Hallmark Hall of Fame Collection.

items.title: Enormous: The Gorge Story
items.description: The Gorge has brought fans to a patch of rural Washington farmland.

items.title: Man In The Field
items.description: Profiles pioneering artist and chef Jim Denevan, founder of Outstanding in the Field.

items.title: Keyboard Fantasies
items.description: Beverly Glenn-Copeland becomes a cult icon.

items.title: Trouble Is My Business
items.description: Detective Roland Drake falls for two sisters from the Montemar family. One woman is dead and the other wants to kill him. Passion, murder, and betrayal. Just another day at the office.

items.title: Bonobos: Back to the Wild
items.description: The plight of the endangered BONOBOS of Africa – mankind’s closest genetic relative – are presented in this critically praised, epic nature documentary.

items.title: Paper Year
items.description: Franny (Eve Hewson) and Dan (Avan Jogia) are fresh-faced, 22-year old newlyweds playing house and juggling new jobs in Los Angeles. When Franny falls for a coworker, they face the challenges of growing up together.

items.title: Long Nights Short Mornings
items.description: An examination of the romantic life of a young man in New York City and his sometimes fleeting, sometimes profound experiences with the women he encounters.

items.title: Pink Wall
items.description: A modern romance, following the six-year relationship of Jenna (Tatiana Maslany) and Leon (Jay Duplass), intimately told through their journey, exploring how friendship and resentment grow when confronted with the pressures of adult life.

items.title: Ghost Team (Unrated)
items.description: Determined to catch some ghosts on film, a paranormal-obsessed man mounts his own investigation into the beyond with his depressed best friend, misfit nephew, a cable access medium and an overeager security guard by his side.

items.title: To Dream
items.description: Two self-destructive teens won’t let anything come between their friendship, but when dysfunctional family life becomes intolerable, loyalty leads one to make a choice that will change their lives forever.

items.title: Rosy
items.description: A socially awkward young man (Nat Wolff) kidnaps an aspiring actress (Stacy Martin) so she can get to know him, but he gets much more than he bargained for with Rosy.

items.title: Lazarus
items.description: A man is killed, but his death is a brief affair.

items.title: The World Before Your Feet
items.description: Matt Green has been walking every block of every street in New York City.

items.title: Sacred Blood
items.description: Infected by a vampire, a young circus performer flees her native country for San Francisco. There she finds others of her ilk but rejects affiliation with them and takes up instead with an infatuated young artist.

items.title: The Last Supper
items.description: The story of two warring generals (Liu Bang and Xiang Yu) fighting for control of China at the end of the Qin Dynasty.

items.title: The Lost Child
items.description: A story about Rebecca, a woman who goes in search of her natural parents and in the process finds her long lost family and her rich cultural heritage. Stars Mercedes Ruehl and Jamey Sheridan. From the Hallmark Hall of Fame.

items.title: The House Sitter
items.description: A family still reeling after the accidental death of one of their daughters, returns home after an aborted month long getaway to Rebecca, a seemingly pleasant house sitter. Since they returned early, Rebecca has nowhere to go, so the family invite her to

items.title: Before You Say I Do
items.description: When it comes to love, George is about to realize it's all about timing. His girlfriend Jane is reluctant to get married again after Doug, her first husband, broke her heart. George has to rework some history to make sure Jane ends up with him.

items.title: Journey
items.description: A grandfather struggles to get through to his grandson after the boy's mother abandons him and his sister. Stars Jason Robards and Meg Tilly. From the Hallmark Hall of Fame Collection.

items.title: The Beatles in America
items.description: The Beatles, the world's most iconic rock and roll band, changed pop culture forever when they traveled to America. Explore the legacy of Paul, John, George and Ringo in this documentary.

items.title: Blind Date
items.description: Jon Ratcliff (Joseph Bottoms), is blinded in an accident, but given modified sight when an \"optical\" computer chip implanted in his brain allows him to see images in bold outlines. That's when he witnesses a murder by the serial killer.

items.title: Space Adventure Cobra
items.description: Cobra, a famous space pirate with a psycho-gun hidden in his left arm, supposed dead for two years, is back in action. He falls for bounty huntress Jane Flower, whom crime lord Necron wants dead, and tries to help her save her world.

items.title: Invincible Armour
items.description: John Liu and Hwang Jang Lee star together in this awesome kung fu film. The storyline involves a man who is framed for murder and must fight to clear his name while authorities pursue him. Great fighting styles and high kick action!

items.title: Deadly Silver Spear
items.description: A Wang Yu as Silver Spear meets the Flying Guillotine. He is hired by a noblewoman to do away with three top-class Kung Fu masters, but news reaches the ears of the white haired man, who deploys his own killers to deal with \\"Silver Spear\\".

items.title: Duel of the 7 Tigers
items.description: Defeated in a match at Shaolin, Wu Kung wanders China till he finds his own temple and style of fighting: Tang Sao Do Karate. Years later, student and ninth successor, Hsi Man Kwong challenges and crumbles all the Chinese kung fu schools in the area.

items.title: Albert: Up, Up And Away!
items.description: Albert is a smart and cheeky boy, but his taste for mischievous pranks make him a menace in his small hometown. When he accidentally destroys the statue of a local hero and famous hot-air balloon captain, Albert is determined to make up for his mistake.

items.title: Kikoriki: Legend Of The Golden Dragon
items.description: The residents of peaceful Kikoriki Island are thrown kicking and screaming into big adventure when their resident scientist invents a helmet called 'the Improverizor' which take personality traits from one person and swaps them with someone else's!

items.title: Maya The Bee Movie
items.description: Freshly hatched bee, Maya can't help but make friends with all kinds of other bugs, including a young hornet named Sting. When the Royal Jelly is stolen, the hornets are the prime suspects and Maya is thought to be their accomplice.

items.title: Maya The Bee 2: The Honey Games
items.description: After a slow harvest season, the survival of the hive is threatened. Maya and Willy go to Buzztropolis, where the Empress invites them to participate in the Honey Games. But if they lose, the hive will have to give the Empress all of their summer honey!

items.title: One Special Night
items.description: Two strangers who take refuge in a small cabin during a stormy winter night and, despite their differences, or perhaps because of them, they are undeniably drawn to one another in this holiday classic.

items.title: Never Goin' Back
items.description: Angela and Jessie are best friends intent on taking a wild beach trip, but when their roommate loses all of their money in a drug scam, the girls -- blissfully stoned -- go to increasingly daring and absurd lengths to get it back.

items.title: A Deadly Game
items.description: When Dawn and Kayla reunite for a mother-daughter weekend at a popular spa resort, they find themselves fighting for their lives as they discover the visiting guru has turned the resort into a cult nightmare.

items.title: Riding the Bus With My Sister
items.description: A photographer and her developmentally challenged sister begin living together when their father dies. Stars Andie MacDowell and Rosie O'Donnell. From the Hallmark Hall of Fame Collection.

items.title: Chariots Of The Gods: 50th Anniversary
items.description: Based on Erich von Daniken's international best seller. Did travelers from outer space visit Earth in our ancient past?

items.title: A Prayer Before Dawn
items.description: The amazing true story of Billy Moore, an English boxer incarcerated in Thailand's most notorious prison. Thrown into a world of drugs and violence, he finds his best chance to escape is to fight his way out in Muay Thai tournaments.

items.title: Cruel Jaws
items.description: In 1995, legendary director Bruno Mattei, here as 'William Snyder', stunned the civilized world with this ultimate sharksploitation saga.

items.title: Dave Hill: Pride Of Cleveland
items.description: Comedian/musician performs live at Union Hall in Brooklyn, NY.

items.title: Kikoriki: Team Invincible
items.description: The lives of the Kikoriki are suddenly turned upside-down when they stumble on a strange device they had only heard about - a TV.

items.title: Postman Pat: The Movie
items.description: A veteran postman finds his beliefs challenged after he enters a TV talent show competition.

items.title: Z Channel: A Magnificent Obsession
items.description: Xan Cassavetes' film explores the euphoric rise and tragic descent of Z Channel, Los Angeles’ first pay cable service and its virtuosic film programmer Jerry Harvey.

items.title: Hot Summer Nights
items.description: An awkward teenager gets in over his head dealing drugs while falling for his business partner's enigmatic sister during one scorching summer in Cape Cod, Massachusetts.

items.title: A Tiny Ripple of Hope
items.description: Charismatic activist Jahmal Cole works tirelessly to build a better Chicago for the teens in his neglected community, even if it comes at the cost of his home, his family, and his safety.

items.title: Gas Warfare of World War I
items.description: A look back at the terrifying use of Gas as a deadly weapon in WWI.

items.title: Battle of the Bulge
items.description: In June 1944, after the enormous success of the D-Day landings, an end to World War II and Nazi tyranny seemed imminent.

items.title: German Armour: The Panzer III
items.description: It was Heinz Guderian who in 1934, gave specifications for 2 frontline tanks to be manufactured.

items.title: El páramo
items.description: Un equipo de soldados llega al pie de una base de montaña y descubre que algo siniestro acecha en la niebla y las sombras.

items.title: Made Of Stone
items.description: A revealing journey through the life of one of the most revered and influential bands in British music history.

items.title: Mausoleum
items.description: A maxed-out mix of 80s supernatural horror and slasher excess, MAUSOLEUM is a stylish, sleazy, and outrageously gory production, featuring a series of imaginative death scenes orchestrated by effects wizard John Carl Buechler (RE-ANIMATOR, GHOULIES)

items.title: Day Of The Dead
items.description: A small group of scientists and soldiers have taken refuge in an underground missile silo where they struggle to control the flesh-eating horror that walks the earth above.

items.title: Yes Virginia, There Is A Santa Claus
items.description: Inspired by the famous 1897 editorial that has become a holiday staple, Young Virginia O'Hanlan who, at the urging of her father, writes a letter to New York newspaper The Sun asking for the truth about the existence of Santa Claus.

items.title: Sophie's Choice
items.description: Adapted from William Styron's best-selling novel, this passionate tale of a writer's love for a holocaust survivor is an exhilarating and compelling revelation.

items.title: Dos vidas en un instante
items.description: Esas decisiones fugaces que pueden llevar una vida por un camino en lugar de otro dan forma al tentador “¿y si yo hubiera?” Gwyneth Paltrow protagoniza esta encantadora comedia romántica llena de esas encrucijadas.

items.title: Griff el Invisible
items.description: Ryan Kwanten, la estrella de True Blood, interpreta a un tímido oficinista cuya heroica identidad secreta se ve amenazada por una joven peculiar.

items.title: My Punch-Drunk Boxer
items.description: Years after the scandal that ruined his career, a disgraced boxer dreams of bringing his unique 'Pansori' fighting style back into the ring. With the help of one of his plucky young students, he might just succeed-though not in the way he expected.

items.title: Iron Monkey (1977)
items.description: Iron Monkey is the nickname of a young man who becomes the sole survivor of a Manchurian massacre. After burying his family, a fate-filled road leads Iron Monkey to the Shaolin Temple, where he masters with agility the fearsome Monkey Fist method.

items.title: Jesus' Female Disciples: The New Evidence
items.description: The traditional story of the birth of Christianity is dominated by men, but were female disciples crucial to Jesus' mission? And why has the role those women played disappeared from history?

items.title: Halo: The Fall Of Reach
items.description: Animated series adapted from the original book, Halo: The Fall of Reach. It's an explanation and backstory of the shaping and creation of Spartan 117, The Master Chief.

items.title: Halo Legends
items.description: The universe of the Halo video game series is expanded in seven short animated films from Japan's greatest anime directors and studios.

items.title: Stranger With My Face
items.description: A teenage girl is contacted by her long-lost identical twin, only to discover that the dead ringer has plans to steal her identity in unimaginable ways.

items.title: SHOPLIFTERS
items.description: A family of small-time crooks take in a child they find on the street.

items.title: Episode 1
items.description: 'Horror Film Director Found Slain, Buried Under Floor,' screamed the 1995 headlines read around the world. But the truth behind the wild life of Al Adamson and his grisly death reveals perhaps the most bizarre career in Hollywood history.

items.title: Halo 4: Forward Unto Dawn
items.description: UNSC Cadet Thomas Lasky must conquer his inner fears and join forces with super-soldier John-117 to take down a massive faction of the Covenant.

items.title: Thanksgiving With The Carters: 2nd Helping
items.description: The Carter family is back together again for the Thanksgiving holiday, and this time they are celebrating at a cabin deep in the woods. When chaos ensues and dinner is ruined, the family must work together to save the holiday tradition.

items.title: Thanksgiving With The Carters
items.description: A family tries to find common ground with its newest members, as they honor their tradition of Thanksgiving surprise, where each person attempts to surprise the family with something unique and positive.

items.title: Dying In Vein: The Opiate Generation
items.description: A deeply personal exploration of opiate and heroin addiction that drops you directly into the lives of someone in recovery, a couple trying to get clean, a family grieving the loss of their son, and an ER Physician trying to save one patient at time.

items.title: Monsieur Le President
items.description: Volunteering in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake, Victoria Campbell meets Gaston, a charming voodoo priest and local hero in the relief efforts. He becomes a close friend, until an unexpected turn causes her to re-examine her entire experience in Haiti.

items.title: Father Joseph
items.description: Almost all of Father Joseph's 25 years of work in Haiti was destroyed by the 2010 earthquake, but he is rebuilding with an inspiring humor and determination.

items.title: El monje
items.description: Chow Yun Fat y Seann William Scott protagonizan esta gran aventura, en la que un misterioso monje tibetano, quien ha protejido un pergamino por 60 años; cree que ha encontrado a su sucesor: un joven callejero.

items.title: Exploited
items.description: When a college freshman becomes obsessed with a missing webcam model, he and his friends are terrorized by a voyeuristic hacker.

items.title: Conversion
items.description: A psychologist practicing conversion therapy has a chance encounter with a young gay activist, resulting in his own epiphany concerning the very practice he was conducting.

items.title: Castro's Spies
items.description: The thrilling story of an elite group of Cuban spies sent undercover to the US in the 1990s. From their recruitment, training and eventual capture on US soil; this film peers into a secret world of false identities, love affairs and betrayal.

items.title: In A New York Minute
items.description: In A New York Minute follows three strangers as they accidentally discover the solution to their problems lies in a single pregnancy test.

items.title: Ride Till I Die
items.description: Ricky Ringer enjoyed a stellar bull riding career, but he could never win a championship. 25 years later, with his son, Lil' Ricky, and fellow rider Ernie Courson by his side, Ricky is determined to chase that elusive title or die trying.

items.title: Barely Legal
items.description: A plant, a medicine, a drug? Illegal for decades for many confusing reasons, the most glaring being systematic racism, with cannabis, we are undoubtedly still stuck in a rut today in most of the United States.

items.title: De Palma
items.description: Filmmaker Brian De Palma discusses his body of work, including "Sisters," "Obsession," "Carrie," "Dressed to Kill," "Blow Out," "Scarface," "The Untouchables," "Carlito's Way" and "Mission: Impossible."

items.title: Hermosas chicas

items.title: Como agua para chocolate
items.description: Después de que el hombre que ella admira se case con su hermana, una joven mexicana le dedica su pasión a la cocina, descubriendo que puede transmitir sus emociones a través de las comidas que prepara.

items.title: Asuntos pendientes antes de morir
items.description: Un exgánster (Andy Garcia) reúne a su banda para un trabajo. Cuando las cosas salen mal y alguien resulta asesinado, Jimmy y sus compañeros parecen los culpables, dejando a Jimmy 48 horas para aclarar todo para sus amigos y la mujer de sus sueños.

items.title: Gang In Blue
items.description: A group of white police officers allow their racist feelings to turn murderous.

items.title: Killer Instinct: From The Files Of Agent Candice DeLong
items.description: The extraordinary true story of Candice DeLong, the FBI’s first female profiler who rose above the bureau’s sexism to take on the most terrifying and personal case of her career.

items.title: Krisha
items.description: Tensions rise at a Thanksgiving gathering when Krisha shows up at her sister's Texas home and reunites with the extended family that she abandoned years earlier in an emotionally charged familial reckoning.

items.title: The Extinction of Fireflies
items.description: 'The Extinction of Fireflies' is a contemporary comedy loosely based on the epic romance of Roman Emperor Hadrian and his teenage lover Antinous.

items.title: Willie Nelson: Highs and Lows
items.description: An emerging counter-culture connects with Willie's unorthodox ways; the Outlaw Movement.

items.title: The Nightmare
items.description: Five percent of the world's population have had the experience of awaking paralyzed while a supernatural entity climbs onto their chest suffocating them, inducing a level of fear that is beyond imagination.

items.description: Cass, a high-powered attorney and single mother of two, is on the hunt for a new nanny after her precocious kids ran off the last one. Stars Nicollette Sheridan, Dan Payne and Jayne Eastwood.

items.title: The Blackwater Lightship
items.description: Based on the novel by Colm Toibin, The Blackwater Lightship tells the compelling story of reconciliation between three generations of women that has been marked by decades of misunderstandings.

items.title: Wild Prairie Rose
items.description: In 1952 Rose Miller returns to her rural hometown of Beresford, South Dakota to care for her ailing mother. Once there, she falls in love with a deaf man and must decide if she has the courage to follow her heart.

items.title: Crash and Burn (2016)

items.description: Years ago, winter came and left. Survivors have tried to build a new society underground, but they soon learn the real danger is not from the ice and cold, but from their fellow survivors.

items.title: A Christmas Eve Miracle
items.description: After wondering what her life would be without children, a mother is granted her Christmas wish!

items.title: Cover Me
items.description: A woman receives a rare chance to reset her future after a strange encounter with a mysterious man.

items.description: Jack takes his family on Christmas vacation to an old favorite cabin for some tech-free festive fun.

items.description: A young Viking fights a lone battle to become a warrior Viking and fulfill his family legacy.

items.title: In the Heat of the Night (1967)

items.title: The Little Girl Who Lives Down The Lane
items.description: Jodie Foster and Martin Sheen star in this haunting story of a thirteen-year-old girl who lives in an old house with her reclusive father...all alone. Or does she? It seems she is hiding a dark secret, one she is determined to preserve. At any cost!

items.title: Sabata
items.description: Get ready for fast-paced, explosive action as Lee Van Cleef stars as Sabata, the mysterious, steely-eyed gunslinger who, after he discovers the masterminds behind an elaborate bank heist, imposes his bullet-laced brand of justice on a guilty town.

items.title: The Mean Season
items.description: A newspaper reporter (Kurt Russell) becomes the unwitting ally of a vicious serial killer (Richard Jordan) who contacts the reporter and appoints him his spokesman. As the killer's calls and clues increase, the reporter is lured into a deadly trap.

items.title: Christmas Carol: The Movie

items.description: In this action-packed pulp thriller starring Michael C. Hall, Sam Shepard and Don Johnson, a violent break-in triggers a journey deep into the bloody heart of Texas.

items.description: Brooke Shields & Ed Westwick star in this enchanting comedy about a pretty girl (Felicity Jones) who discovers love and snowboarding at an exclusive winter resort.

items.title: Exploradores
items.description: En su laboratorio improvisado, tres niños hacen uso de su ingenio y un descubrimiento sorprendente para construir una nave espacial y emprender un increíble viaje interplanetario.

items.title: The Babadook
items.description: In this terrifying thriller, a mother must protect her son from an evil, supernatural entity that has escaped the pages of a children's book and is lurking in their home.

items.description: Two women take their carnal desires to the extreme in this kinky, deliciously twisted tale of sex and butterflies.

items.description: Kham, a young fighter must go to Australia to retrieve his stolen elephant. He must take on a gang led by two deadly bodyguards and an evil woman.

items.description: Dos francotiradores, uno ruso y uno alemán, juegan al gato y el ratón durante la Batalla de Stalingrado.

items.description: From legendary filmmaker Werner Herzog comes a riveting exploration of a horrible crime that probes the human psyche and explores why people kill.

items.title: La telaraña de Charlotte

items.title: Superagente Cody Banks
items.description: Frankie Muniz encarna a un agente juvenil de la CIA en esta mezcla de comedia y acción. Cody Banks es elegido para impedir el complot de un villano que busca apoderarse del mundo. ¡Pero primero, él debe superar su timidez hacia las chicas!

items.title: Cody Banks: destino Londres
items.description: En Inglaterra, Cody Banks se hace pasar por un prodigio de la música para frustrar los planes de un agente malvado que quiere dominar el mundo con un dispositivo controlador de mentes.

items.title: I'm the Best Iberian Red Deer
items.description: Every autumn, the Iberian red deer starts his season by emitting a disturbing sound that slips through the whole forest.

items.title: Aventuras en juguetilandia
items.description: Juguetilandia está en peligro por el malvado Barnaby (Richard Mulligan) y solo puede salvarla Lisa (Drew Barrymore), una niña que no cree en los juguetes. También protagonizada por Eileen Brennan, Keanu Reeves y Pat Morita.

items.title: Kraftwerk and The Electronic Revolution
items.description: Night Flight Presents: As innovative as they are influential, Kraftwerk's contribution to the development of electronic music since their formation in 1970 remains unsurpassed.

items.title: Life On The V: The Story Of V66
items.description: Night Flight Presents: In 1985; during the height of the music video craze; a free music video UHF-TV channel appeared in the Boston market; only to disappear from the airwaves after 18 months.

items.title: Looking For Johnny: The Legend Of Johnny Thunders
items.description: Night Flight Presents: Looking For Johnny, a 90-minute film that documents Thunders' career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991.

items.title: Masters del universo
items.description: El malvado Skeletor (Frank Langella) quiere conquistar el universo. ¡Pero no teman! He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) le ha declarado la guerra, y la batalla entre el bien y el mal ha llegado a la Tierra. Courteney Cox coprotagoniza esta épica aventura.

items.title: Stigmata
items.description: Una joven manifiesta estigmas como los que Jesucristo sufrió en su cricifixión. Ni médicos ni psiquiatras pueden darle ninguna explicación, sólo un sacerdote enviado por el Vaticano la ayudará, aunque tenga que ir en contra de algunas de sus creencias.

items.title: A Night With Lou Reed
items.description: Night Flight Presents: A Lou Reed concert at the Bottom Line in New York City; 1983.

items.title: American Hardcore: The History of Punk Rock 1980-1986
items.description: Night Flight Presents: Fueled by a ferocious soundtrack; director Paul Rachman's American Hardcore gives fans an all-access pass to the rise and fall of the U.S. punk scene.

items.title: Anti-Nowhere League - We Are The League
items.description: Night Flight Presents: The full uncensored story of how a biker; a skinhead; a grammar school boy and a Persian exile came together; with no musical talent or ambitions to burst into the UK charts with their debut single.

items.title: Bad Brains - Live at CBGB 1982
items.description: Night Flight Presents: This breathtaking performance displays why Bad Brains became one of the most important bands in the history of American Hardcore.

items.title: Betty Davis - They Say I'm Different
items.description: Night Flight Presents: Creatively blending documentary and animation; this movie traces the path of Betty's life; how she grew from humble upbringings to become a fully self-realized black female pioneer the world failed to understand or appreciate.

items.title: Bowie; Iggy & Lou; The Sacred Triangle: 1971- 1973
items.description: Night Flight Presents: The Sacred Triangle. By 1971, Bowie was branded a one-hit-wonder; Reed was considered washed up and Iggy Pop was seen as a drug crazed ex-Stooge. But a meeting of minds was the catalyst for a turnaround for these three geniuses.

items.title: Brainiac: Transmissions After Zero
items.description: Night Flight Presents: An exploration of the seminal 90's rock band Brainiac; its creative force Tim Taylor and the tragedy they overcame.

items.title: Brian Eno 1971-1977: The Man Who Fell To Earth
items.description: Night Flight Presents: The first ever film about one of the most influential characters in the history of modern music. Brian to his friends; Eno to the rest of us - defies categorisation. Musician; composer; record producer; music theorist.

items.title: Captain Beefheart - Under Review

items.title: Devo - The Men Who Make The Music

items.title: High Lonesome - The Story Of Bluegrass Music

items.title: Devo — The Complete Truth About De-evolution
items.description: Night Flight Presents: Devo; the seminal concept band; made a career out of setting to music video their dada-gone-camp theory of De-Evolution and its rebuke of corporate culture.

items.title: Pele: Birth of a Legend
items.description: Discover the story of the greatest sports hero ever-how a kid from the slums of Brazil named Péle transformed soccer into the world's biggest sport. With Vincent D'Onofrio.

items.title: Passing Strange
items.description: Director Spike Lee's passionate adaptation of the thrilling Broadway musical about a young bohemian who experiences sex, drugs, and rock and roll on his journey to selfhood.

items.title: Love, Bubbles and Crystal Cove
items.description: When Skye's childhood sweetheart arrives to help her improve her bath and body business, sparks begin to fly.

items.title: A Romance Wedding
items.description: Zoe is a successful wedding planner in the city. When her father asks her for help at the family café, she returns home. Little does she know her mom has already hired Will, an aspiring chef.

items.title: Loves Sweet Recipie
items.description: Courtney is a chef who runs her family's restaurant. Armed with a family heirloom her father left behind called the 'Rule Book of Love' to guide the way.

items.title: The Man Who Knew Infinity
items.description: Based on a true story, Jeremy Irons and Dev Patel star in this inspirational film about an obscure Indian mathematician whose groundbreaking theories changed mathematics forever.

items.title: Band Aid
items.description: In a last-ditch effort to save their marriage, a couple turns all their fights into songs and starts a band with their neighbor.

items.title: Brawl in Cell Block 99
items.description: When Bradley (Vince Vaughn) is sent to prison, he is forced to commit acts of violence that turn the place into a savage battleground.

items.title: Sleeping Beauty
items.description: A haunting portrait of a shy co-ed who allows a coin toss to spark her first impromptu sexual encounter and immerse her in a darkly sexual new world.

items.title: Wolves (2016)
items.description: On-court action accompanies strong performances in this story of a promising high school basketball prospect and his troubled relationship with his father.

items.title: Boogie Woogie
items.description: Heather Graham and Gillian Anderson star in this sexy comedy about the lying, cheating, and backstabbing behind the glamorous facade of the art world.

items.title: Byzantium
items.description: An insatiable thirst for blood thrusts a beautiful young woman into an exhilarating and deadly new world of dark mysticism and hauntingly intoxicating vampire legends.

items.title: Ghost Stories
items.description: A man looking to debunk a series of paranormal events falls into a world of terror. Martin Freeman stars in a tale that will haunt your dreams.

items.title: Stanford Prison Experiment, The
items.description: Based on the infamous true story, 24 students role-play as prisoners & guards in an experiment that shocked the world. This chilling thriller stars Ezra Miller & Billy Crudup.

items.title: Bushwick
items.description: Stupe and Lucy must navigate through a hail of gunfire and lethal explosions in their Brooklyn neighborhood as Texas attempts to secede from the US in a new civil war.

items.title: I Kill Giants
items.description: A woman stands between giants and destruction of her town.

items.title: Kickboxer: Vengeance
items.description: A man seeks revenge against a brutal martial-arts fighter.

items.title: Power of the Air
items.description: An African Missionary shares with a Christian man in the United States how he feels the church in America is in great danger. The Christian is very convicted by what he hears and then sets forth a plan to reach his city with the gospel.

items.title: The Perfect Race
items.description: A female athlete at a small Christian college works hard to overcome long odds in trying to win a national title in the 800 meter run. "The Perfect Race" is a follow up movie to "Remember The Goal".

items.title: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre
items.description: Five youths on a weekend getaway fall prey to a depraved family of cannibals in Tobe Hooper's masterpiece of subversive horror, now featuring a 4k digital transfer and all-new surround sound mix supervised by the director.

items.title: Benedict Arnold: Hero Betrayed
items.description: His name is synonymous with treason but this cinematic documentary shows that Benedict Arnold's heroic contributions to American Independence far outweigh his later change of allegiance.

items.title: Beyonce & Jay-Z: Power Love
items.description: A merger of megastar music. Discover the story of multi-genre performer and fashion promoter, Beyonce Knowles sand the world's first hip hop billionaire, Jay-Z.

items.title: Blake & Gwen: Now & Then
items.description: Follow the offstage, unlikely romance of the king of country, Blake Shelton, and pop princess, Gwen Stefani. Both stars braved their share of challenges on the way to writing their own love song.

items.title: Britney Spears: Breaking Free
items.description: Almost four decades as the Princess of Pop, superstar Britney Spears, continues to be in the public eye on the brink of winning a legal battle with her father that would end a conservatorship and at long last give her control of her life.

items.title: DJ Khaled: Another Win
items.description: DJ Khaled may have started by spinning records in his New Orleans garage, but today is one of the recognized social media moguls and record producers. With 12 albums, a hit Miami restaurant, and one Grammy to his credit, his story is in the making.

items.title: Dua Lipa: Elevating
items.description: One of the most recognizable voices in all of modern day music, Dua Lipa quickly rose to fame. Her catchy tunes and sultry vocals make her music appeal to a global audience.

items.title: Camila Cabello: Just Jump
items.description: A Cinderella story with Latin roots. Camila Cabello personifies the American Dream come true. Havana, Mexico, meet Miami. A loser then winner on the X Factor. Fifth Harmony pop to superstar. Save herself. Save the world.

items.title: Lady Gaga: Glory
items.description: While an outrageous fashion sense, elaborate videos, and spectacular stage sets are her norm, it's the music of 'Monster Mother' Lady Gaga that has led to her explosive career full of fame and accolades.

items.title: The Real Taylor Swift: Wild Dreams
items.description: The amazingly talented Taylor Swift is more than her catchy pop, country, and rock songs. A life story filled with love and loss, all Taylor-made. Music was her mission fulfilling her wildest dreams.

items.title: Tina Turner: Simply the Best
items.description: The odds were against her. Learn how singer Tina Turner reached super-stardom with her high energy and gravelly voice and prevailed as the "Queen of Rock 'n' Roll". Learn how Tina prevailed then reached solo superstardom with songs like "Private Dancer".

items.title: U2: Rockumentary
items.description: A cliche start: 4 teenage boys form a rock band in the drummer's kitchen. 45 years, 14 albums, 24 concert tours, 22 Grammies. U2 raises millions to fight hunger, disease and poverty. Music transcends melody. It means mission.

items.title: Tyler Perry: Man of Many Faces (Legacy Distribution)
items.description: Despite humble beginnings, Tyler Perry established a successful career as a writer, director, and producer for stage, television and film. Perry's acclaimed work has lead to international stardom making him Hollywood's highest paid man.

items.title: When the Bands Stopped Playing
items.description: When The Bands Stopped Playing is a time capsule, giving viewers a glimpse into a shattered industry when the Covid-19 pandemic hit, as seen through the eyes of its hardest workers.

items.title: Una Propuesta Navideña
items.description: Una abogada se enfrenta a su antiguo novio para defender su pequeña ciudad de la demolición.

items.title: Una Niñera Para Navidad
items.description: Una mujer de carrera cuida a los hijos de un ejecutivo de publicidad de Beverly Hills durante las vacaciones navideñas.

items.title: La Lista Perfecta Para Navidad
items.description: Una mujer inventa un plan para reparar la relación entre su hija y su nieta justo para navidad.

items.title: Todo Gira Alrededor de la Navidad
items.description: Una mujer debe elegir entre un trabajo de Nochebuena o unas vacaciones con su novio.

items.title: Pueblo Navideño
items.description: Una adicta al trabajo sospecha de la partida repentina de su padre para mudarse a un pequeño pueblo en Navidad.

items.title: Loco Love
items.description: Un hombre que pierde su riqueza acepta casarse con la hermana de un jardinero, quien acaba de ganar la lotería.

items.title: El perro que salvó la navidad de vacaciones
items.description: Un astuto can y un caniche francés deben salvar su hogar de unos tontos ladrones que atacan durante las vacaciones de Navidad.

items.title: El perro que salvó las Navidades
items.description: Un perro valiente y su todavía cachorra hermana trabajan juntos para evitar que dos ladrones entren en una casa.

items.title: 13 Slays Till X-mas
items.description: On December 24th, five seemingly random men are invited to a dive bar by a mysterious e-mail. They decide to pass the time by resurrecting the old tradition of telling scary stories on Christmas Eve.

items.title: Love at the Christmas Contest
items.description: A young woman enters a Christmas tree decorating contest to honor the memory of her mother, only to discover that the competition includes her recently widowed high school sweetheart and his adorable 10-year-old daughter.

items.title: A Christmas Karen
items.description: Karen is an entitled middle-aged woman whose demanding nature has alienated her loved ones. After a series of instances displaying her privilege, Karen receives an intervention from some unconventional spirits.

items.title: Murderous Minds - H.H. Holmes
items.description: Herman Webster Mudgett, better known as Dr. Henry Howard Holmes or H. H. Holmes, was an American serial killer. While he confessed to 27 murders, he was convicted and sentenced to death for only one murder.

items.title: Hitler's Secret Science
items.description: In the crucible of World War II, Germany's most brilliant scientists raced to create an arsenal of terrifying new weapons of mass destruction, even an atomic bomb.

items.title: Burying the Ex
items.description: Max's controlling girlfriend Evelyn dies in a freak accident. Just when Max thinks it's time to move on, Evelyn returns from the dead, determined to get her boyfriend back.

items.title: Revenge of the Pink Panther
items.description: Peter Sellers’ comedic genius shines when the hapless Inspector Clouseau is presumed to be dead. However, the very much alive Inspector travels to Hong Kong to investigate a dangerous drug lord (Robert Webber). Dyan Cannon and Herbert Lom also star.

items.title: A Christmas Proposal (2021)
items.description: When work moves Jason across the world, the only way he can bring his love Carla, is if they are married.

items.title: Man in Red Bandana
items.description: This feature-length documentary film tells the inspirational story of a 9/11 American hero - Welles Remy Crowther. The young man worked on the 104th floor of the South Tower.

items.title: A Very Merry New Year
items.description: Secrets and old ties are exposed when Mary gathers her high school friends together to celebrate the New Year.

items.title: Murderous Minds - Bonnie and Clyde
items.description: Due to their glamorization in fiction, people are often unaware of the dark reality of Bonnie and Clyde. Far from being a loved-up couple, they were in fact cold-blooded murderers who stopped at nothing.

items.title: Murderous Minds - The Iceman
items.description: With almost 200 admitted murders, Richard Kuklinski, The Iceman, was a mafia hitman for hire and worked with all the New York and New Jersey crime families.

items.title: Murderous Minds - Jim Jones
items.description: Jim Jones was an American cult leader, preacher, and self-professed faith healer. He launched the Peoples Temple in Indiana during the 1950s.

items.title: Ghosts in Ghost Towns: Haunting the Wild West
items.description: Across America's Old West, there are deteriorating ghost towns filled with reports of the paranormal, spirits of the dead that still roam the empty streets leftover from a time of lawlessness and violence.

items.title: Isla Dinosaurio
items.description: Un niño y una niña se encuentran atrapados en una tierra misteriosa. Juntos, se embarcan en el mágico viaje de regreso a casa y se encuentran con nativos tribales, feroces dinosaurios y una tierra olvidada desde hace mucho tiempo.

items.title: Tenías que ser tú
items.description: Dos desconocidos se conocen y surge la chispa durante el fin de semana en que están planeando sus respectivas bodas.

items.title: Nancy (LAS)
items.description: Nancy becomes increasingly convinced she was kidnapped as a child. When she meets a couple whose daughter went missing thirty years ago, reasonable doubts give way to willful belief.

items.title: Pet (LAS)
items.description: A man bumps into an old crush and holds her captive underneath the animal shelter where he works.

items.title: Accidentally In Love
items.description: Edie finds true love in London just days before she is to return to the US. They are separated, but as fate would have it, they reunite 6 years later in the US.

items.title: Los elegidos
items.description: En este clásico de culto de Troy Duffy, dos hermanos irlandeses católicos se convierten en vigilantes y eliminan el inframundo criminal de Boston en nombre de Dios.

items.title: Love In Bloom
items.description: When her soon-to-be-married little sister and fiancé become marooned at a mountain retreat days before their wedding, Amelia and the best man, Grayson Tanner, are tasked with stepping in to save the wedding.

items.title: Resaca mortal
items.description: Después de celebrar la boda de Doug en un hotel en Laughlin, Nevada, los chicos con resaca Bradley, Ed y Zach se despiertan en una distopía futurista, al haber perdido a su amigo, Doug.

items.title: Khumba
items.description: Rechazado por su rebaño supersticioso, una cebra a media raya se embarca en una atrevida búsqueda para ganarse sus rayas, pero encuentra el valor y la aceptación para salvar a todos los animales del gran Karoo.

items.title: Scream, Queen! My Nightmare on Elm Street
items.description: Actor Mark Patton shares his story of being a closeted gay man while starring in "A Nightmare on Elm Street 2: Freddy's Revenge."

items.title: The Jackie Stiles Story
items.description: The Jackie Stiles Story is an inspirational film about a 5'8" girl from a small Kansas town who became a basketball legend in the Midwest. Against all odds, Jackie became the all-time leading scorer in NCAA history and the WNBA Rookie-of-the-Year.

items.title: 5 Submarines Against the Nazis
items.description: On 18 June 1940, Charles de Gaulle's appeal was heard as far as the depths of the oceans. It is here that one of the War's most important resistance movements came into being: The Maquisards de la Mer.

items.title: Death in the Bunker: The True Story of Hitler's Downfall
items.description: Death In The Bunker: The True Story of Hitler's Downfall examines the final 10 days in the Berlin Führerbunker deep below the Chancellery of the Reich.

items.title: Martin Luther: A Return to Grace
items.description: The great drama of Martin Luther's life comes alive in this vivid portrayal of the penniless monk's quest for truth—a quest that would re-shape the church, and the world.

items.title: The Reckoning
items.description: Stories from Holland of survival and courage during the Nazi tyranny of World War II.

items.title: To The Ends of the Earth
items.description: Follow Paul's remarkable visit to the city of Philippi as he connects with people from all walks of life.

items.title: Beyond White Space
items.description: The USS Essex is traveling in the furthest reaches of the known Universe when it encounters a gigantic creature. After being pirates steal their cargo and most of their supplies the crew decide to capture the creature.

items.title: Bit
items.description: Laurel moves to LA and falls in with a gang of vampires. Not knowing if they want to kill her, befriend her or turn her, she learns to understand the love and dangers of her new and first group of friends.

items.title: Born to Play
items.description: Spend a season with the Boston Renegades, a women’s semi-professional tackle football team on a path for redemption after losing the national championship the previous year.

items.title: Hollow in the Land
items.description: A woman with a troubled past sets out to find her missing brother.

items.title: The Strange Ones
items.description: Mysterious events surround two travelers, presumably brothers, as they make their way across a remote American landscape. On the surface all seems normal, but what appears to be a simple vacation soon gives way to a dark and complex web of secrets.

items.title: Fire Mountain: The Eruption and Rebirth of Mount St. Helens
items.description: Two hundred and thirty square miles leveled in moments.

items.title: Great Battles of WWII: Midway, Kursk, and Crete
items.description: Using authentic color and black & white footage captured from the battles this program explains the events, circumstances, and results of three of the most important battles of WWII -- the battles of Midway, Kursk, and Crete.

items.title: Azure Dust: Inside Chernobyl's Exclusion Zone
items.description: The Exclusion Zone - a 1,000 square mile area around the site of the Ukraine 1986 nuclear power plant meltdown. Take a tour of the radiation zone and meet people who live and work in the shadow of the worst man-made environmental disaster in history.

items.title: Cyborgs: Human Machines
items.description: Technology has improved our lives in so many ways. Trans-humanists are fusing their bodies with digital implants to increase their abilities and expand their senses. How is life going to change for us all if some people have supernatural powers?

items.title: Gettysburg: The Final Measure of Devotion
items.description: The Battle of Gettysburg is considered a major turning point in the Civil War. This film explores Abraham Lincoln's role as commander in chief and Lee's invasion of the North. Battle sequences are from The 150th Gettysburg Anniversary Reenactment.

items.title: Hitler's Eastern Headquarters: The Wolf's Lair
items.description: Nazi delusions preserved in concrete ‚Äì a place shrouded in mystery and still a symbol of the horror of the Nazi regime. This documentary tells the story of clandestine construction of the Wolf's Lair.

items.title: Ingrediente: A Restaurant Uprooted
items.description: This documentary follows chef Drew Deckman who was forced to shutter his restaurant operations due to the pandemic. It's a hero’s story as he cooked everyday feeding his staff, 200 local fishermen, and their families every week.

items.title: Loreto: The Mystery of The Holy House
items.description: A documentary investigation into one of the most fascinating mysteries of Christianity. How was the Holy House of the Virgin Mary transported from its original location in Nazareth, Palestine, to the town of Loreto on Italy's Adriatic coast?

items.title: Song of Rapa Nui
items.description: Song of Rapa Nui' tells the story of Mahani Teave, who left Rapa Nui to pursue her dream of becoming a classical pianist. At age 30, on the brink of international success, Teave gives up her career to found a free music school for the island’s children.

items.title: Silent Wings - The American Glider Pilots of WWII
items.description: Silent Wings - The American Glider Pilots of WWII reveals the critical role gliders played in World War II offensives. Thousands of lives were saved and battles won because of their efforts. This film features gliders from both sides of the battle.

items.title: The Mystery of the Disappearing Bees
items.description: The future of our food resources depends on the western honey bee. One third of our food supply depends directly on pollination from bees. This is the story of a worldwide ecological disaster that has been waiting to happen for several generations.

items.title: Ukraine: Path to Freedom
items.description: Documentary about the events on the Maidan during the Revolution of dignity and subsequent events in Ukraine. The main character - an American history teacher from Cleveland who arrived in Ukraine to observe how modern history is created.

items.title: Urartu: The Forgotten Kingdom
items.description: Urartu is one of the most mysterious states in the history of the ancient world. This documentary will help us recollect its history and to get acquainted with its unique background and developed culture, economy, astronomy and religious life.

items.title: 2nd Chance For Christmas
items.description: A modern-day adaptation of Charles Dickens' classic "A Christmas Carol" about a Rock/Pop celebrity, Chance Love, who has grown spoiled, selfish and heartless with her newfound fame and fortune.

items.title: Awaydays
items.description: Set in 1979 Liverpool, this film -- based on the cult novel of the same name by Kevin Sampson -- captures the energy of the post-punk era as it follows 19-year-old Carty in his quest to become part of the Pack, a gang of violent football hooligans.

items.title: Heavenly Sword
items.description: A power-hungry ruler known as King Bohan seeks to obtain the long-protected Heavenly Sword in order to use its devastating power for evil. Why doesn't anyone ever use immensely powerful swords for good anymore?

items.title: Merry Single Christmas
items.description: Morgan escapes to a single's retreat to rekindle her Christmas spirit, but things get complicated when her Ex, Liam, shows up.

items.title: A True Christmas
items.description: Reminded of her past, Jessica can't stand Christmas, but this holiday season has several surprises in store.

items.title: Boxed In
items.description: Ria is an up and coming female boxer whose one and only focus is to be the best boxer alive.

items.title: Coming Home For Christmas
items.description: Coming from mixed backgrounds, the Higher-Mills family try to reunite their changing family for Christmas.

items.title: For The Love Of Christmas
items.description: Faith must choose between taking over her father's church or handing it over to a new minister by Christmas.

items.title: Single Bells
items.description: When the Bell sisters lose their family restaurant, they hatch a plan to save it and find love at Christmas.

items.title: The Christmas Spirit
items.description: Faith must choose between taking over her father's church or handing it over to a new minister by Christmas.

items.title: Christmas With The Carters
items.description: When their holiday gift budget is stolen, the Carters must band together to save Christmas.

items.title: Una Estrella Navideña
items.description: Una joven que cree que puede hacer milagros pone en marcha un plan para salvar a su pueblo de un desarrollador.

items.title: Gettysburg and Stories of Valor - The Civil War
items.description: This documentary features some of the most riveting Civil War stories, including moments such as the brutality at the Dead Line in Andersonville Prison, Pickett's Charge at Gettysburg, the loss of Brigadier General Alexander Hays, and more.

items.title: Haunted Places
items.description: Haunted Places explores some of the most remarkable haunted places in America. This companion piece to Hauntings Across America investigates some of the most baffling cases of ghostly activity.

items.title: Jingle Hell
items.description: A witty comedy about the Fitzgeralds, a large Irish Catholic clan from New York, whose grown children and spouses and grandchildren have gathered for a holiday that turns out to be a far cry from the Currier & Ives Christmas anyone had in mind.

items.title: Proudly We Served: The Men of the USS Mason
items.description: This is the thrilling true story of the USS Mason and its crew, the only African-American sailors to take a U.S. Navy warship into battle during World War II. They challenged the segregation of the U.S. Military, fought the Nazi U-boats, and won.

items.title: Heavy Metal: The Evolution of the Naval Warship
items.description: This film covers the evolution of the design and armament of ocean-going warships. The ships filmed include the Golden Hinde, the Amsterdam, H.M.S. Victory, H.M.C.S Sackville the last corvette, and more.

items.title: Schemers
items.description: His football career over, Davie starts promoting gigs in Dundee with two friends, leading to a hugely ambitious Iron Maiden show. Out of his depth and in debt with gangster Fergie, Davie needs to pull off the biggest scheme of his life.

items.title: Johnstown Flood
items.description: Here is the story of the tragic 1889 disaster which claimed more than 2,200 lives. Pennsylvania's South Fork Dam exploded and unleashed a 40-foot wall of water. The flood devastated the valley below under the force of a 20-million-ton tidal wave.

items.title: Gettysburg and Stories of Valor - The Battle of Gettysburg
items.description: This documentary looks at America's Civil War and its most important battle. Here are artifacts and stories, including Colonel Strong Vincent's defense of Little Round Top, Gettysburg National Cemetery's hallowed ground, and more.

items.title: A Christmas Proposal (2008)
items.description: Two lawyers dueling over a proposal to turn a quaint town into a ski resort soon discover they are former childhood sweethearts. When the big-city attorney is forced to stick around, his former beloved and small-town charm work their magic on him.

items.title: A Nanny for Christmas
items.description: The lives of a smart young career woman, a Beverly Hills advertising executive mom, and a tough-guy company owner intertwine for a Christmas that could change everyone's lives forever.

items.title: A Christmas Reunion
items.description: Amy gets a Christmas surprise when she inherits her aunt's bakery, half of which was left to her old boyfriend, forcing them to reunite.

items.title: A Perfect Christmas List
items.description: When Evie tasks her family with a list of festive accomplishments to do together before Christmas, hoping it will repair their relationship, her granddaughter discovers an adventure of her own.

items.title: All About Christmas Eve
items.description: Party planner Evelyn must choose between taking a Christmas Eve gig or a vacation with her boyfriend, unaware that her whole future depends on this choice.

items.title: Her Sister's Keeper
items.description: Kate's life is turned upside down when her younger sister, Melissa, disappears. When Kate investigates, she discovers that a large amount of drug money vanished with her sister.

items.title: The Dog Who Saved Christmas Vacation
items.description: The Bannister family - including former K-9 police hero Zeus (voiced by Mario Lopez) - is back, and this time they're spending their holidays at a beautiful Rocky Mountain resort.

items.title: The Dog Who Saved the Holidays
items.description: The Bannisters are back with a new family addition - a mischievous pup named Eve. Watch as everyone's favorite dog, Zeus, learns to love his new sister and take down some bumbling thieves.

items.title: The Sons of Mistletoe
items.description: A wealthy benefactor of a boy's orphanage dies suddenly and leaves the estate to his heiress daughter. When she returns home for the holidays with no interest in funding the orphanage, the owner and residents must convince her to change her mind.

items.title: Like a Boss
items.description: Best friends, Mia and Mel (Tiffany Haddish & Rose Byrne), are running their own cosmetics company when a villainous beauty mogul (Salma Hayek) conspires to steal it. Mia and Mel must stick together and fight to reclaim their company.

items.title: Skyline
items.description: Jarrod and Elaine travel to Los Angeles to meet his friend Terry and wife Candice. Terry gives a party in his apartment for Jarrod. The next morning, the group is awakened by beams of light. The group of friends tries to escape from the alien invaders.

items.title: The Lawnmower Man (Director's Cut)
items.description: Dr. Lawrence Angelo (Pierce Brosnan) is a brilliant scientist obsessed with perfecting virtual reality software. When his experiments on animals fail, he finds the ideal substitute – Jobe Smith (Jeff Fahey), a slow-witted gardener.

items.title: 8th Round Pick
items.description: Arriving home from the NFL draft, Austin Aimes is a broken man returning to a broken town. As a top-rated college quarterback, it seemed Austin had a lock on the life he always wanted to live, but now a destroyed knee seems to be his only guarantee.

items.title: The Murder of Nicole Brown Simpson
items.description: Inspired by true events, follows OJ Simpson's ex-wife Nicole Brown Simpson in the last days leading up to her tragic death on June 12 1994, as seen from her point of view.

items.title: Into The Cold: A Journey of the Soul
items.description: Two men embark on a dramatic expedition to the North Pole and journey 400 plus miles on foot facing harsh temperatures to below 50 degrees F. Into the Cold is a bone-chilling story of true bravery, incredible courage and unrelenting determination.

items.title: Rambling Rose
items.description: A confused and over-sexed young woman is taken in by a respectable Southern family. She is warmly received but trouble begins when she cannot control her sexual desires.

items.title: That's My Boy
items.description: An athletic father tries to press his hypochondriac teenage son to follow in his footsteps.

items.title: Bowie: The Man Who Changed The World
items.description: An inside look at David Bowie, one of the most creative and influential rock artists of all time. Featuring exclusive contributions from those who worked with David Bowie and archive interviews with the man himself.

items.title: When Worlds Collide
items.description: An impending collision with a runaway star signals the destruction of Earth. As doomsday approaches, people race against time and the panic of those who will be left behind.

items.title: A Snow White Christmas
items.description: With the help of seven quirky friends, Blanca Snow must use the power of true love to overcome her evil stepmother from ruining Christmas.

items.title: Country Christmas Album
items.description: When country singer star Tess Stapleton is forced to record a Christmas Album with fallen star/bad boy bander Derek Copeland, sparks fly and love blooms just in time for Christmas.

items.title: An En Vogue Christmas
