items.description: When her late father and uncle Marty's club, The Opera House, is about to be foreclosed, Kendall must convince her old friends, Terry, Cindy and Rhona of the R&B powerhouse En Vogue, to put on a Christmas concert to keep the beloved club in business.

items.title: Holiday Heist
items.description: A man released from prison is torn between a life of crime and a fresh start with a woman he meets while scoping out a potential heist.

items.title: A Furry Little Christmas
items.description: A big-city veterinarian falls for a small-town doctor when he sets out to recreate a New York City Christmas in her Vermont hometown.

items.title: Love On The Rise
items.description: A baker mistakes a wealthy bachelor for a waiter, and the two quickly fall in love, not realizing his company is trying to evict her bakery.

items.title: The Office Mix-Up
items.description: A woman stumbles into a dream job and finds love with a co-worker but is afraid she will lose everything if her real identity is revealed.

items.title: Ilusiones S.A.
items.description: Para hacer feliz a su mujer, un hombre contrata a una empresa que crea fantasías para fingir que su nieto, quien los dejó hace años, es un hombre de bien. Pero el verdadero nieto, quien es en realidad un delincuente, se aparece exigiendo dinero.

items.title: The Honeymooners Specials: A Christmas Carol
items.description: The Honeymooners return for their final series of long-lost specials – in color!

items.title: Becoming the G.O.A.T.: The Tom Brady Story
items.description: Tom Brady's stats surpass even Manning, Montana, and Marino. With seven Super Bowl rings and a legendary rocket arm, he is the GOAT. Learn the backstory of how this champion rose to the top from his friends, coaches, and teammates.

items.title: The Savior
items.description: The story of the Man, His times, and His message. Taken directly from the Gospel of Luke and filmed in Israel and Palestine.

items.title: Accidental Climber
items.description: Summiting Mount Everest is a grueling and dangerous endeavor, known to torture the mind, body, and soul of those who even dare. When a 68-year-old great grandfather attempts this feat, what ensued was the worst disaster in mountaineering history.

items.title: Days of Rage: The Rolling Stones' Road to Altamont
items.description: As the dream of peace and love was shattered in the late 1960s amidst riots, assassinations and war, The Rolling Stones became a defiant voice in this turbulent era, which came to a shocking end at the Altamont festival.

items.title: Tear The Roof Off: The Untold Story Of Parliament Funkadelic
items.description: Uncover the secrets of Hall of Fame band Parliament Funkadelic. Members Perpetuity up about money, exploits, and the creativity behind a unique genre of music. This is untold story of the rise and fall of the greatest funk band ever.

items.title: Underground, Inc
items.description: Alternative music's revolution, its meteoric rise to mainstream dominance in the wake of Nirvana, and the raw talent that made it big. Plus, discover some of the greatest music that was lost in an era where art and the business collided.

items.title: Life on the Line
items.description: In this tense thriller starring John Travolta and Kate Bosworth, a team of Texas linemen races to install miles of cable before a deadly lightning storm destroys the power grid.

items.title: Mara
items.description: A criminal psychologist (Olga Kurylenko) investigating a murder is plunged into a terrifying mystery involving an ancient demon who kills her victims as they sleep.

items.title: Spinning Man
items.description: When a female college student goes missing, a popular professor is the prime suspect. Suddenly, the questions he faces aren’t merely academic – they’re a matter of life and death.

items.title: The Whole Truth
items.description: Keanu Reeves is a defense attorney trying to clear a teen in the brutal stabbing of his father. As more evidence comes to light, the whole truth seems darker than ever.

items.title: Trading Paint
items.description: A down-and-out stock car racing legend (John Travolta) is drawn back to the dirt track when his son (Toby Sebastian), an aspiring driver, joins a rival racing team, which sparks an intense and dangerous competition between father and son.

items.title: Waiting...
items.description: Ryan Reynolds, Anna Ferris, and Justin Long serve up the laughs as young waiters and waitresses searching for the meaning of life, love, and friendship in this outrageous comedy.

items.title: Where'd You Go Bernadette?
items.description: Cate Blanchett stars as Bernadette, a loving mother and wife who embarks on journey to rediscover herself.

items.title: JT: Reflections
items.description: Singer, Songwriter, Producer, Actor, Businessman, Philanthropist and w with his third album released there's denying the powerhouse Justin has become. Follow his journey from child star to A-list status as one of the biggest stars on the planet.

items.title: Tupac Shakur: Before I Wake
items.description: A look back on Tupac's final years through the eyes of Rap legends "Eazy-E", Russell Simmons and Tupac's personal bodyguard, Frank Alexander. Featuring never-before-seen footage.

items.title: Tupac Vs.
items.description: Tupac Shakur remains a controversial and misunderstood figure long after the shooting that ended his life. Featuring an in-depth, never before seen 1995 interview, rare footage and stills, interviews from manager Leila Steinberg and more.

items.title: Hired Gun: Out Of The Shadows, Into The Spotlight
items.description: "First Call, A-List" musicians share their incredible stories of touring, the dedication required to play next to the world's most iconic musicians, and the origin of rock's most celebrated songs.

items.title: 27: Gone Too Soon
items.description: The 27 Club is a cultural phemen horing popular Rock and Roll musicians who died at age 27. Follow the rise of talented musicians and their destructive lifestyles, including an often abusive relationship with alcohol and/or drugs.

items.title: The Ninth Gate (LAS)
items.description: Roman Polanski dirige y Johnny Depp protagoniza este thriller sobrenatural sobre un vendedor de libros raros que descubre un manuscrito demoníaco.

items.title: A Job to Kill For
items.description: The new head of a huge advertising company becomes fearful for her job and life itself when an overly ambitious new girl who will stop at nothing to make the company her own playground joins the firm.

items.title: Past Tense
items.description: A widowed mother struggles to accept her daughter's claims about a past life involving the murrder investigation her late husband worked on.

items.title: Murder on Spec
items.description: Shortly after her rich husband is found dead, leaving Kate as the primary suspect, an unknown man who claims he killed her unloving husband 'for her' demands 10% of his vast inheritance.

items.title: Ride to Freedom: The Rosa Parks Story
items.description: Rosa Parks recalls events leading to her act of peaceful defiance against racial bus segregation and inspiring the 1955 Montgomery Bus Boycott.

items.title: Deadly Season: The Secret of Hidden Lake
items.description: When the authorities consider her father's death a hunting accident, the young woman returns to her small-town home to investigate, and discovers some eery occurrences.

items.title: Love On Trend
items.description: When Allie left her small town to move to San Francisco to pursue her dream of becoming a fashion designer, little did she imagine that the city had big plans for her...and for her heart.

items.title: Birth of Speed
items.description: Two mature and experienced Cheetahs are both raising cubs. The only difference is their age. ‘The Birth of Speed’ follows them on their challenge of raising cubs in this unexpected landscape.

items.title: Bounce (2016)
items.description: BOUNCE is a feature documentary that takes us to the far reaches of the globe and the deep recesses of our ancient past to answer the question: Why do we play ball?

items.title: Desert Kings
items.description: In ‘Desert Kings’ we follow the story of sub-adult Kalahari lions. This is a story of fighting for survival, death and hope. Who will survive the next two summers?

items.title: Love, Game, Match
items.description: When the new economics teacher Liz team up with tennis coach Ted to organize the school carnival, sparks fly.

items.title: The Nature of Romance
items.description: A busy travel writer goes glamping at a state park with her best friend and finds herself falling in love with one of the park rangers.

items.title: Going All The Way
items.description: After returning home from the Korean War, two young men search for love and fulfillment in middle America.

items.title: Love Songs
items.description: Three separate but interconnected dramas set in the same predominantly black neighborhood of North Philadelphia.

items.title: Picking Up and Dropping Off
items.description: Two lonely New Yorkers struggle to come to terms with the reality of being a single parent while longing for companionship and love.

items.title: Timepiece
items.description: A couple struggle with the tragic death of their only child during the 1940s. From the Richard Paul Evans prequel to 'The Christmas Box.'

items.title: Most Dangerous Game
items.description: A father and son are shipwrecked on a remote island where they are caught up in a trophy hunt held by its mysterious owner, a merciless man who uses the land as an elite hunting preserve for stalking the most dangerous game of all: human.

items.title: Dark Crimes
items.description: From the producer of The Revenant and Black Mass, Officer Tadek (Jim Carrey) chases a murderer whose killings eerily resemble those found in a novel.

items.title: Dog Days
items.description: Dog Days is a hilarious and heartwarming ensemble comedy with an eclectic cast of characters both human and canine.

items.title: Fierce People
items.description: A massage therapist trying to overcome her addictions and reconnect with her son moves in with a wealthy client in New Jersey, and realizes too late how dangerous people of privilege can be.

items.title: Killers Anonymous
items.description: Tensions mount at Killers Anonymous, a support group for killers, as the members of the group try to unravel a mystery: Which one of them is responsible for the assassination attempt on a U.S. senator that has the police in the city on high alert?

items.title: Kristy
items.description: A young female college student finds herself trapped on her deserted campus as she is stalked by a group of deadly intruders.

items.title: Lawless
items.description: Shia LaBeouf, Tom Hardy, and Jessica Chastain star in this adaptation of 'The Wettest County in the World.' A bootlegging gang make a run for the American Dream during Prohibition.

items.title: Ghoulies (ESP)
items.description: Cuando un universitario hereda una vieja mansión, descubre que también ha heredado a sus residentes: un puñado de criaturas viscosas y peludas que harán cualquier cosa por él… incluso matar.

items.title: The Details
items.description: After 10 years of marriage, Jeff and Nealy Lang (Tobey Maguire and Elizabeth Banks) have an idyllic suburban home and a relationship on the skids.

items.title: Wyatt Earp's Revenge
items.description: Approached by a journalist, Wyatt Earp recounts his time before he became a lawman, hunting down the ruthless Kenedy brothers to avenge his love, Dora Hand.

items.title: The Eleventh Victim
items.description: A District Attorney tirelessly pursues the conviction of a serial killer. When her clients start to turn up dead with the same M.O. as the serial killer she put behind bars, she is forced back into the dark world before she becomes the next target.

items.title: Hard Time
items.description: A cop does time for a crime he did not commit and then comes out of prison to track down the person who set him up.

items.title: Hard Time: The Premonition
items.description: A serial bomber terrorizes a city, leaving no clues in his terrifying wake and a veteran police officer investigates the cops only witness: a notorious convicted murderer.

items.title: Hard Time: Hostage Hotel
items.description: When a congressman's daughter is taken hostage in a deserted hotel, a disgraced ex-cop and his drunken ex-partner may be the only ones who came save her.

items.title: The Ranger, The Cook And A Hole In The Sky
items.description: In 1919, a cocky sophomore in the forest service has to learn life the hard way.

items.title: State Of Grace
items.description: In this neo-noir crime film, an undercover cop (Sean Penn) comes back to his old neighborhood in New York City's Hell's Kitchen to bring down the Irish Mafia, which is now led by two of his childhood friends (Gary Oldman and Ed Harris).

items.title: Pulse
items.description: Cuando su amigo hacker accidentalmente canaliza una misteriosa señal inalámbrica, un grupo de estudiantes se reúnen para detener a un terrible mal que se apodera del mundo.

items.title: Tira a mamá del tren
items.description: Un ex-marido amargado, un niño de mamá. Ambos la quieren muerta, pero ¿quién se encargará de hacerlo?.

items.title: Inmersión letal
items.description: Paul Walker y Jessica Alba esperan pasar unos momentos inolvidables buceando, pero se meten en un lío con un traficante cuando encuentran la carga ilícita de un avión hundido en este thriller submarino lleno de acción y sorpresas.

items.title: Pecado original
items.description: Una mujer, junto con su amante, planea engañar a un hombre rico casándose con él, ganándose su confianza y luego huyendo con todo su dinero. Todo sale según lo previsto hasta que ella se enamora de él.

items.title: Love Locks
items.description: A woman returns to Paris after 20 years and begins a journey of romance and rediscovery when she reconnects with her college boyfriend and first love. Stars Rebecca Romijn and Jerry O'Connell.

items.title: The Beach House
items.description: When Cara finds her life spinning out of control, she returns to the scenic Lowcountry to visit her mother. Before long, the rhythms of the island open her heart in wonderful ways as she repairs the family beach house.

items.title: Truly, Madly, Sweetly
items.description: When Natalie and Eric each inherit a share of an old bakery, this unlikely pair must decide what's in store for this historic landmark. When both of their careers come to a screeching halt, an opportunity presents itself.

items.title: NIMH: El ratoncito valiente
items.description: Cuando Timmy llega a Thorn Valley, es tratado trata como a un esclavo. Después de encontrar a una pequeña ratoncita, cuyos padres han sido raptados, ambos se ponen en marcha para encontrar al gran búho.

items.title: Braddock: desaparecido en combate 3
items.description: Cuando el coronel James Braddock (Chuck Norris, ‘Desaparecido en combate’) descubre que su mujer y su hijo de 12 años siguen vivos en el Vietnam comunista, prepara un ataque solitario para liberarlos… armado con un arsenal de última tecnología.

items.title: Cyborg
items.description: En una tierra azotada por la peste del siglo 21, un hermoso cyborg mitad humano contiene la información que puede salvar a la civilización. ¡Pero sólo la fuerza y la astucia de un guerrero solitario podrá salvar esos datos tan importantes!

items.title: Desaparecido en combate 2: el comienzo
items.description: Precuela de Missing in Action ambientada a inicios de los 80: muestra la captura del coronel Braddock en la guerra de Vietnam, su cautiverio en un brutal campo junto a otros prisioneros estadounidenses y sus planes para escapar.

items.title: Mapplethorpe
items.description: A chronicle of the career of photographer Robert Mapplethorpe, from his rise to fame in the 1970s to his death in 1989 at the age of 42.

items.title: Karen Kingsbury's A Time to Dance
items.description: John and Abby were once the perfect couple. Now, after 21 years, they are about to lose it all. But when their daughter announces her engagement, they secretly agree to put their divorce plans on hold.

items.title: Jane Eyre
items.description: A young governess falls in love with her aloof employer. Franco Zeffirelli (Romeo and Juliet) guides Charlotte Gainsbourg and William Hurt in the beloved Charlotte Brontë classic.

items.title: Whitney
items.description: An intimate, unflinching portrait of Whitney Houston and her family that probes beyond familiar tabloid headlines and sheds new light on the spellbinding trajectory of Houston's life.

items.title: Mr. & Mrs. Bridge (Miramax)
items.description: Centered around a clean-cut Kansas City couple who find their traditional roles challenged by a changing world, this emotional tale paints a portrait of a mariage as it rides the tumultous changes of 1930s and 40s America.

items.title: Cry, The Beloved Country
items.description: In a land torn by hatred and injustice, two men (James Earl Jones and Richard Harris) with opposing cultures form an unlikely union, and together they find the kind of understanding that could heal a nation.

items.title: Holy Smoke
items.description: PJ Waters is a cult deprogrammer who meets his match when he is hired to "cure" the beautiful, intelligent, and iron-willed Ruth. It's no holds barred in this darkly hilarious electric battle of the sexes!

items.title: The Next Three Days
items.description: John Brennan (Crowe) will stop at nothing to protect his family, but he’s never had to put his life and others’ on the line. When his wife is convicted of murder, and all appeals efforts are exhausted, the only hope he sees is breaking her out.

items.title: Invasion Of The Body Snatchers
items.description: Extraterrestres con forma de plantas han invadido la Tierra, tomando posesión del alma de la gente mientras duermen. La gente acusa a sus seres queridos de ser impostores sin emoción. Al principio creen que están equivocados, pero no lo están.

items.title: Christmas at the Holly Hotel
items.description: A young woman living a picture-perfect city life is asked by her parents, owners of Michigan's historic Holly Hotel, to come home for Christmas. Once there, she realizes she might be wrong about what a picture-perfect life truly looks like.

items.title: Nobody's Fool (1995)
items.description: Paul Newman protagoniza a Donald Sullivan, un trabajador carismático que pasó su vida entera tomando malas decisiones. Esta interpretación le dio a Paul Newman varias nominaciones, premios y honores en su carrera artística.

items.title: Plan B
items.description: Jennifer López interpreta a una soltera que se enamora del hombre perfecto justo cuando decide ser madre en esta comedia romántica de éxito sobre el noviazgo, el amor, el matrimonio y la paternidad, pero no necesariamente en ese orden.

items.title: La Princesa Que Quería Vivir
items.description: Roman Holiday fue nominada por diez premios de la Academia, y Audrey Hepburn obtuvo un Óscar por su interpretación de una princesa de los tiempos modernos rebelándose contra sus obligaciones reales, que explora Roma por las suyas.

items.title: Sabrina
items.description: Bogie y Holden Larrabee son los hermanos megáricos de Long Island. Bogie trabaja y Holden es un casanova. Pero cuando Sabrina (Hepburn), la hija del chofer de la familia, regresa de París, se monta el escenario para las explosiones familiares.

items.title: The Toxic Avenger Part 2
items.description: The Toxic Avenger is tricked into traveling to Tokyo to search for his estranged father, leaving Tromaville open to complete domination by an evil corporation.

items.title: Maniac Cop
items.description: A killer dressed in a police uniform begins murdering innocent people on the streets of New York City.

items.title: Mother's Day (1980)
items.description: Two brothers kidnap and brutalize three women for the pleasure of their demented mother.

items.title: Red Scorpion
items.description: A Spetsnaz commando is sent on a covert mission by his Soviet superiors to infiltrate a rebel army and assassinate its leader.

items.title: McBain
items.description: A former Vietnam War lieutenant reforms his old team in order to help a revolutionary's sister overthrow a ruthless dictator.

items.title: The Toxic Avenger Part 3
items.description: Toxie finds he has nothing to do as a superhero, as he has ridden his city of evil. He decides to go to work for a major corporation, which he discovers may be the evilest of all his adversaries.

items.title: Return of the Wolves
items.description: This documentary reveals the dramtic effect of the reintroduction of wolves and the ecological balance of the oldest and most famous National Park oif the United States

items.title: Supercar Blondie: viviendo el sueño
items.description: "Supercar Blondie: viviendo el sueño" registra el viaje de Alex Hirschi. Ella comenzó su propio vlog dando opinión sobre algunos de los súper-autos más exclusivos y costosos del mundo.

items.title: Jndia: The Fast Life
items.description: Conozcan a Jndia Erbacher. Solo una muchacha normal a la que le gusta salir de fiesta irse de vacaciones y conducir autos en picadas a 550 kilómetros por hora.

items.title: Spontaneous
items.description: Get ready for the most outrageous coming-of-age love story about growing up...and blowing up! When students in their school begin exploding (literally...), seniors Mara and Dylan struggle to survive in a world where each moment may be their last.

items.title: Star Trek Into Darkness
items.description: When a ruthless mastermind, Khan (Benedict Cumberbatch), declares a one-man war on the Federation, Captain Kirk (Chris Pine), Spock (Zachary Quinto), and the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise set out on their most explosive manhunt of all time.

items.title: Alien Contact Outer Space
items.description: Many people think of Space as a quiet and desolate vacuum of emptiness, but new evidence reveals that space is rife with activity beyond our comprehension.

items.title: See You Next Christmas
items.description: When chronically single Natalie and Logan continue to run into each other at the same holiday party year after year, they begin to wonder if maybe they're meant to be together.

items.title: Moonlight
items.description: A look at three defining chapters in the life of Chiron, a young Black man growing up in Miami. His epic journey to manhood is guided by the kindness, support, and love of the community that helps raise him.

items.title: American Honey
items.description: An adolescent girl from a troubled home runs away with a traveling sales crew who drive across the American Midwest selling subscriptions door to door.

items.title: Music Of The Heart
items.description: Nominated for two Academy Awards, Angela Bassett, Meryl Streep, Cloris Leachman and Gloria Estefan headline this heartwarming, acclaimed true story of how one woman's musical gift affected those who least expected it.

items.title: Good Will Hunting
items.description: The hit Oscar-winning drama, which launched the careers of Matt Damon and Ben Affleck, tells the tale of a headstrong, working-class genius who's failing the lessons of life until he meets a relatable psychology professor (Robin Williams).

items.title: The Mighty
items.description: In this uplifting buddy comedy-drama, based on the popular young adult novel FREAK THE MIGHTY, a pair of teenagers' courageous adventures and forming friendship adds up to exceptional entertainment.

items.title: Swingers
items.description: In this laugh-out-loud indie comedy classic that launched the careers of its outstanding cast, two friends set out to rewrite modern dating from Los Angeles to Las Vegas.

items.title: Vice President Kamala Harris: Chase the Dream
items.description: Follow the journey of Kamala Harris, the first black woman and South Asian American to serve as the Vice President of the United States as she Chased the Dream from classroom to courtroom, and now to the White House.

items.title: Eurotrip
items.description: Europe will never be the same again after Scotty Thomas and his buddies take off for the express to excess! They're hooking up with hot strangers and jamming all the extreme insanity they can into the wildest trip of their lives!

items.title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber Of Fleet Street
items.description: Depp interpreta el personaje que da nombre a la película, un hombre enviado injustamente a prisión que jura venganza, no solo por su castigo, sino también por las devastadoras consecuencias para su esposa e hija.

items.title: MST3K: The Batwoman
items.description: Emily's crew watch a scantily-clad Mexican superhero take on a mad scientist and his aquatic super-soldiers in THE BATWOMAN (1968).

items.title: MST3K: Santo In The Treasure Of Dracula
items.description: Jonah's crew watch SANTO IN THE TREASURE OF DRACULA (1969). The Mads introduce the Gizmoplex.

items.title: MST3K: The Bubble
items.description: Joel's crew watch as a married couple find themselves trapped in a mysterious town in THE BUBBLE (1966). The test subjects hatch a plan to escape.

items.title: MST3K: The Christmas Dragon
items.description: All three hosts watch a group of precocious orphans attempt save a dying Father Christmas in THE CHRISTMAS DRAGON (2014).

items.title: MST3K: The Mask
items.description: For MST3K's first-ever Halloween episode, Jonah's crew watch THE MASK (1961) in 3D! Jonah teaches the bots about Halloween.

items.title: MST3K: The Million Eyes Of Sumuru
items.description: Jonah's crew watch an evil woman bent on world domination in THE MILLION EYES OF SUMURU (1967). The bots realize Jonah is tall.

items.title: MST3K: The Shape Of Things To Come
items.description: Emily's crew watch three humans and their robot friend defend the moon colonies in H.G. Well's THE SHAPE OF THINGS TO COME (1979).

items.title: Everybody Loves Chris Rock
items.description: Comedian, actor, and producer Chris Rock boasts critical acclaim and global stardom. We take an intimate look into the life of one of the world's greatest entertainers as fans agree Everyone Loves Chris Rock.

items.title: Dr. Dre: Beat by Beat
items.description: Renowned for being one of the founding fathers of gangsta rap, Dr. Dre has been revered for bringing innovation and slick technique to the world of hip-hop leaves fans thirsting for more.

items.title: Rocky IV
items.description: East meets West when Rocky (Sylvester Stallone) takes on a vicious Soviet fighter (Dolph Lundgren) with a deadly punch in a match that means not only defending himself, but also defending the honor of his country and the memory of an old friend.

items.title: Rocky II
items.description: Sylvester Stallone, Carl Weathers, and Burgess Meredith return for the rematch of the century as Rocky takes on Apollo Creed, even though his doctors advise against it, in this blockbuster sequel that brought audiences to their feet!

items.title: Rocky III
items.description: Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) battles his most powerful adversary yet, Clubber Lang (Mr. T), in this hard-hitting actioner that comes out swinging as Rocky strives to regain the 'eye of the tiger' after a humiliating defeat in the ring.

items.title: Morgan Freeman: Breaking Barriers
items.description: Perhaps it is his distinctive velvet-smooth voice and calming demeanor that made Morgan Freeman a household name. World-renowned actor, Freeman has starred in over 100 movies in just three decades and continues to break barriers.

items.title: Snoop Dogg: Uncaged
items.description: From Crime to Primetime. For over five decades rapper, songwriter, and media personality Calvin Cordozar Broadus Jr. aka 'Snoop Dogg' would go onto global fame, with tens of millions of record sales and a career in movies and television.

items.title: Rocky V
items.description: Broke and injured after his bout with Russian powerhouse Ivan Drago, Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) must rediscover his roots in this thrill-packed drama that reunites Stallone with John G. Avildsen, the Oscar®-winning director of 'Rocky.'

items.title: Rocky Balboa
items.description: Sylvester Stallone is back in this action-packed sequel, and this time he's up against an opponent (Antonio Tarver) who's faster, stronger, and 30 years his junior! Milo Ventimiglia and Burt Young are ringside for the hard-hitting battle of the ages!

items.title: Rocky
items.description: As the boxer 'everyman' Rocky Balboa, Sylvester Stallone comes out swinging with heart, humor, and unforgettable power as he 'goes the distance' against World Heavyweight Champion Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers) in this unforgettable, Oscar®- winning film!

items.title: MST3K: Beyond Atlantis
items.description: A new test subject arrives on the Simulator of Love, and her crew watches BEYOND ATLANTIS (1973).

items.title: MST3K: Demon Squad
items.description: Joel's crew watch as a paranormal investigator tries to save the world in DEMON SQUAD (2019), and the original test subject returns.

items.title: MST3K: Doctor Mordrid
items.description: Emily's crew watch as the magical DOCTOR MORDRID (1992) defends Earth from the forces of evil, and Dr. Kabahl schemes to increase viewership.

items.title: MST3K: Gamera vs. Jiger
items.description: Jonah's crew watch Gamera save the day at Osaka's Expo '70, in GAMERA VS JIGER (1970). Pearl tries to convince Kinga to take a break.

items.title: MST3K: Munchie
items.description: Jonah's crew watch as a child befriends MUNCHIE (1992). Jonah refuses to go back into the theater and suffers the consequences.

items.title: MST3K: Robot Wars
items.description: Jonah's crew watch ROBOT WARS (1993). A new SOL is introduced and a new Gizmonic tech arrives.

items.title: To Be First: The Quest For Yangmolong
items.description: Follow a climbing expedition as they make three attempts to summit one of the last unclimbed peaks on earth.

items.title: Gangs Of New York
items.description: Martin Scorsese's epic film set in mid-19th century Lower Manhattan tells the story of a young Irish immigrant (Leonardo DiCaprio) seeking revenge against the rival gang leader who killed his father.

items.title: Nuestra Señora de Guadalupe
items.description: Cuando se le pide a un joven periodista que escriba un artículo sobre Juan Diego, él lucha por encontrar significado e inspiración.

items.title: Proscrito
items.description: Un comando de los Royal Marines descubre evidencia que podría derribar a un funcionario corrupto y ponerlo tras las rejas de por vida.

items.title: Música Del Corazón
items.description: Nominada para dos premios Óscar, Angela Bassett, Meryl Streep, Cloris Leachman y Gloria Estefan protagonizan esta alentadora historia verdadera de cómo el talento musical de una mujer afecta a las personas más inesperadas.

items.title: Lo que de verdad importa
items.description: Un joven descubre que posee el don de la curación. Una adolescente con cáncer terminal le explica cómo ayudar a los demás y creer en sí mismo.

items.title: Mary White
items.description: A touching drama based on the real-life relationship between author William White and his daughter Mary, who died at 16 in a horseback accident.

items.title: How to Catch a Serial Killer
items.description: Sir Trevor McDonald presents this documentary which explores the extraordinary pursuit of serial killer Christopher Halliwell by detective Steve Fulcher.

items.title: The Glass Window
items.description: An inspirational story for today... Climbing the corporate ladder and living the fast life, a successful business professional is forced to confront his real purpose in The Glass Window.

items.title: I Am Toxic (LAS)
items.description: Una historia de terror futurista llena de sangre, polvo y acero.

items.title: A Doggone Hollywood (LAS)
items.description: Murphy ("Just Jesse the Jack") es una estrella de televisión canina mega famosa que está harta de que los ejecutivos de Hollywood la traten como una "máquina de dinero".

items.title: Un milagro en el lago de Navidad
items.description: Campo de sueños para una nueva generación con un toque navideño. Al lidiar con la tragedia, un adolescente pierde su espíritu alegre. Su viaje se transforma justo a tiempo.

items.title: Mr. Blue Sky
items.description: A coming-of-age romance that explores an unconventional love triangle among childhood friends who all struggle with they are and how society perceives them.

items.title: Miles Between Us
items.description: In this story of healing and redemption, an estranged father and daughter find themselves on a trip across the country that becomes harder than they imagined.

items.title: For The Love Of Jessee
items.description: Doctor Luke Matthew's world comes crashing down when he loses the love of his life and becomes a father in the same night.

items.title: Amo la cocina
items.description: Después de una mala crítica de un crítico y una charla del chef Gordon Ramsay, un talentoso pero afligido chef londinense convierte un pub rural en un restaurante gourmet.

items.title: Outcasts (LAS)
items.description: Dos mejores amigas y geeks de clase mundial superan una broma humillante de las chicas "cool".

items.title: Una Navidad de perros
items.description: Un perro con habilidades telepáticas escapa de un bloqueo gubernamental y corre directamente hacia los brazos amorosos de dos hermanos jóvenes.

items.title: Inspirational Sounds: Unity Concert
items.description: It's the Inspirational Sounds Unity Concert featuring the world's biggest stars in Gospel Music! Kierra Sheard-Kelly, Fred Hammond and more!

items.title: Above Suspicion
items.description: After a woman learns that her husband was once accused of his fiancée's murder, she discovers that his sordid past doesn't end there.

items.title: Top Gear: The Worst Car in the History of the World: Special
items.description: Jeremy Clarkson and James May, the Motormouth and Captain Slow, put their petrol-heads together on a journey to identify, name and shame the world's worst car ever.

items.title: Top Gear: Special: The Perfect Road Trip II (Movie)
items.description: In 2013 they embarked on what they hoped would be the perfect road trip. It started well and ended, badly. Unbowed, the Top Gear pair are back for another crack and this time they're hoping to avoid inconveniences like apprehension by the French police.

items.title: Murder Upstairs, A (aka Secrets of My Stepdaughter)
items.description: A mother protects her stepdaughter after the teenager witnesses the murder of her best friend, but is soon forced to come to grips with the terrifying possibility that her stepdaughter may be the real killer.

items.title: Sappy Holiday
items.description: A sous chef begins doubting her future with her boyfriend after a handsome maple farmer comes to her rescue.

items.title: Furie
items.description: When a little girl is kidnapped by a trafficking ring, they soon find they messed with the wrong child. Her mother, a notorious former gang leader, is close on their trail and will go to any lengths to bring her daughter home.

items.title: Extraordinary Measures (Cbs Films)
items.description: La determinación empuja a un padre idealista a unir fuerzas con un investigador médico solitario para encontrar una cura antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

items.title: La llegada
items.description: Cuando las naves espaciales aterrizan en todo el mundo, la traductora Louise Banks es enviada para descifrar su intención. A medida que aumentan las tensiones, Banks aprende la verdad y debe tomar una oportunidad que podría amenazar a la humanidad.

items.title: Cosa de hombres
items.description: Jason Lee interpreta a un ejecutivo en la ciudad de Seattle que se va a casar con la hija de su jefe (Selma Blair). Su vida se convierte en una pesadilla cuando no se acuerda si la engañó durante su despedida de soltero.

items.title: El apartamento
items.description: ¿Y si la mujer que amabas desapareciera sin decir una sola palabra? ¿Hasta qué punto llegarías para volver a encontrarla? Josh Hartnett, Diane Kruger, Rose Byrne y Matthew Lillard protagonizan este intenso neonoir donde el amor se convierte en obsesión.

items.title: Fled: Corre por tu vida
items.description: Una divertida e ingeniosa aventura de acción. Fled sigue el rastro de dos prisioneros fugitivos en su carrera por encontrar un alijo oculto y un disco incriminatorio, que podría terminar con la mafia cubana o matarlos.

items.title: Home of the Brave
items.description: Cuando período de servicio en Irak llega a su fin, cuatro soldados estadounidenses se enteran de que están programados pare emprender una misión final. Una misión profética que cambiará eternamente el concepto que tenían hasta ahora de guerra.

items.title: Hotel Rwanda
items.description: Cuando Paul Rusesabagina (Cheadle) ve que el mundo no va a intervenir en la masacre de la minoría tutsi, encuentra el coraje para abrir las puertas de su hotel a más de 1.200 refugiados.

items.title: Negocio De Sangre
items.description: Después de realizar un recorrido de rutina, Brandon King (Phillipe) enfrenta un cambio inesperado que lo coloca en una situación incomóda ante los viejos soldados y pone a prueba los vínculos con sus viejos amigos.

items.title: West Side Story (ESP)
items.description: Diez premios “Oscar”, incluyendo Mejor Película, fueron otorgados a esta versión del éxito de Broadway en los conflictos entre pandillas de Manhattan y dos amantes de diversos orígenes étnicos.

items.title: Renegados
items.description: En la Cuba de 1898, cinco Buffalo Soldiers encuentran un alijo de oro, desertan y regresan a Estados Unidos, donde ayudan a defender un pueblo afroamericano del KKK, mientras intentan evitar ser capturados por las autoridades civiles y militares.

items.title: Los Hermanos Grimm
items.description: En esta película visionaria, Will y Jake Grimm sorprenden a los pueblos con sus folclores creativos e ilusiones elaboradas, pero descubren que los personajes fantásticos y las situaciones emocionantes en sus amadas historias son reales.

items.title: Snowball Effect
items.description: Rival meteorologists Tara and Sam find themselves stuck in a village that Christmas forgot.

items.title: Better Days
items.description: In this dramatic thriller, Nian is faced by relentless bullying from her peers as she prepares for her entrance exam. Fate brings her together with Bei, and then both are dragged into the middle of a murder investigation.

items.title: Los 12 perros de Navidad
items.description: Un padre viudo y desempleado envía a regañadientes a su hija a permanecer con su tía en una ciudad que ha prohibido los perros. En el camino a la escuela un día encuentra un perrito y decide quedárselo.

items.title: Sharks, Scavengers of the Seas
items.description: Before being an earthly paradise with enchanting colours, the lagoon of New Caledonia is above all a paradise for sharks. But not just any sharks: they are used to being considered as fearsome predators, they are essentially opportunistic scavengers.

items.title: Operation Condor
items.description: Jackie Chan enciende la gran pantalla como el mejor agente secreto del mundo, Cóndor. En su misión de rastrear el oro nazi robado, es perseguido por una banda despiadada de terroristas en una búsqueda global para alcanzar la recompensa primero!

items.title: Crawl
items.description: As a hurricane tears through Florida, Haley rushes to find her father, who is injured and trapped in the crawl space of their home. With the storm intensifying and water levels rising, the pair faces an even greater threat lurking beneath the surface.

items.title: Top Gun
items.description: Tom Cruise is superb as Maverick Mitchell, a young flyer who's out to become the best. And Kelly McGillis plays the instructor who teaches Maverick a few things you can't learn in a classroom.

items.title: The Ambulance
items.description: When the girl of his dreams vanishes after a mysterious ambulance whisks her away, a young comic book artist (Eric Roberts) frantically searches for her...and finds unimaginable horror! James Earl Jones, Janine Turner and Red Buttons also star.

items.title: Romeo is Bleeding
items.description: In the faded past of his youth, patrolling was an important job but now Sgt. Jack Grimaldi sees that life on the other side of the binoculars has a little something extra—extra sex, extra money, extra excitement. Gary Oldman stars in this neo-noir.

items.title: Rappin'
items.description: Fresh out of jail, John 'Rappin' Hood returns to his community to find it terrorized by a greedy developer and a vicious gang leader. Now Hood and his fast-talking friends must rally to fight back, but not with their fists...with their powerful rap!

items.title: Todos los perros van al cielo
items.description: Ambientada en 1939 en Nueva Orleans, esta colorida historia tiene muchas canciones. Se enfoca en la vida de Charles B. Barkin, un pastor alemán rebelde que posee el encanto de un estafador y el corazón de un malvavisco.

items.title: About Alex
items.description: Crushes and rivalries are rekindled when college friends reunite for a lake house weekend. With Aubrey Plaza.

items.title: Black Fox: Good Men and Bad
items.description: The western saga continues as Alan's family is caught in the deadly crossfire of a revenge plot against Britt. After Alan's wife is slain, he and Britt hunt the bigot responsible for her death.

items.title: Raging Fire
items.description: Shan (Donnie Yen) is a hardline cop with a long history of success, but his past comes back to haunt him when a sting is attacked by a group led by his former protégé (Nicholas Tse), a man set on destroying everyone who ever wronged him.

items.title: Max Cloud
items.description: When teen gamer Sarah opens a portal into her favorite side-scroller, she becomes trapped in an intergalactic prison, home to the galaxy’s most dangerous villains.

items.title: Triple Threat
items.description: This breakneck thriller teams over half a dozen of the world’s biggest action stars for the martial arts event film of the year. When a hit is taken out on a billionaire’s daughter, it’s mercenaries versus assassins in an all-out war.

items.title: Fist of Fury
items.description: Bruce Lee stars as Chen Zhen, a martial arts protégé who returns to his former school in Shanghai when he learns that his beloved instructor has been murdered. To avenge his master's death, Chen must fight the greatest assassins from a rival school.

items.title: A Christmas Hero
items.description: Firefighter Jenny has fallen in love with Tom, but his ex-wife demands a reconciliation.

items.title: From Paris With Love
items.description: A low-ranking intelligence operative working with the U.S. Ambassador in France takes on more than he bargained for when he partners with a wisecracking, fast-shooting, high-ranking U.S. agent who’s been sent to Paris to stop a terrorist attack

items.title: Rounders
items.description: Oscar-winner Matt Damon and Edward Norton star in ROUNDERS. An ex-gambling addict (Damon) is drawn back to the tables in a do-or-die bid to rescue his friend.

items.title: FernGully: The Last Rainforest
items.description: The magical inhabitants of a rainforest fight to save their home, which is threatened by logging and a polluting force of destruction called Hexxus.

items.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
items.description: After six perfect weeks with boyfriend Mark Darcy, the mischievous Daniel Cleaver returns, claiming to be a reformed man. Can Bridget find a way to make true love last forever? A comedy that proves there's nothing like love to send you over the edge.

items.title: The Big Boss
items.description: Bruce Lee faces an underground criminal element after members of his family begin disappearing. Now he must break his vow of non-violence to take on the terrifying "Big Boss."

items.title: Drone
items.description: Ideologies collide when a military drone contractor (Sean Bean) meets an enigmatic Pakistani businessman.

items.title: The Crossing Guard
items.description: For six agonizing years, Freddy Gale has waited for John Booth, the man jailed for a crime that destroyed Freddy's life. Now, Booth is out of prison and Freddy's giving him just three days to live, before he returns to even the score.

items.title: HoneyBee
items.description: A teenage girl is pulled into a battle against an archaic evil when a mysterious woman comes to a small town.

items.title: Todos los perros van al cielo 2
items.description: Todos los perros van al cielo, pero unos cuantos con suerte vuelven a la Tierra. Cuando los perros callejeros animados Charlie Barkin, Itchy y Sasha recuperan el cuerno de Gabriel, que había sido robada del cielo.

items.title: The Vanished
items.description: A family vacation takes a terrifying turn when a couple's young daughter disappears without a trace. As the list of suspects grows, the search for the truth leads to a shocking revelation.

items.title: The Night Clerk
items.description: While on duty, a young, socially challenged hotel clerk (Tye Sheridan) witnesses a murder in one of the rooms but his suspicious actions land him as the lead detective's (John Leguizamo) number one suspect.

items.title: Las momias de Guanajuato
items.description: Las momias de Guanajuato se han levantado y Leo San Juan, Don Andrés, Teodora y el Alebrije deben detenerlos, todo mientras rescatan a su amiga Xóchil y descubren el misterio.

items.title: Asesino a Sueldo
items.description: Slevin (Josh Hartnett) se marcha de Los Ángeles, por un error de identidad cae en medio de una guerra entre los dos jefes criminales más temidos de la ciudad: El rabino (Ben Kingsley) y el jefe (Morgan Freeman).

items.title: Cómo cortar a tu patán
items.description: Amanda, una terapeuta especializada en ayudar a las mujeres a terminar las relaciones destructivas, vive lejos de los hombres y del compromiso. Dedicada al trabajo y la protección de su hermana Natalia.

items.title: The Fugitive
items.description: Harrison Ford stars as the wrongly convicted Dr. Richard Kimble, and Tommy Lee Jones is U.S. Marshal Sam Gerard, his relentless pursuer, in this intense thriller based on the hit television series of the 1960s.

items.title: El que busca encuentra (LAS)
items.description: Esperanza y Marcos son dos personas que creen en el destino y en el amor verdadero.

items.title: Ladrones
items.description: Fernando Colunga y Eduardo Yáñez lideran las risas como los Robin Hoods modernos en esta tremendamente entretenida secuela del gran éxito "Ladrón que roba a ladrón".

items.title: Behind The Sun
items.description: Siga esta historia aclamada por la crítica sobre el amor, la lealtad y la elección que un hijo debe hacer entre honrar a su familia y seguir su corazón.

items.title: Dirty Pretty Things
items.description: Audrey Tautou (AMELIE) and Chiwetel Ejiofor (12 YEARS A SLAVE) star in a gritty urban thriller in which two immigrants learn that everything is for sale in London's secret underworld.

items.title: Norman
items.description: A time travelling scientist is trapped in the past with only his A.I. companion.

items.title: Robot World
items.description: A pilot lands on an alien planet and soon discovers the planet is inhabited by predatory machines.

items.title: Space Force: Battlefront
items.description: The first deep space mission becomes stranded in the future, but it turns out they're not alone…

items.title: Hannibal Rising (LAS)
items.description: El joven Hannibal comienza a planear venganza después de la muerte de su hermana menor durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial. Basada en la novela del escritor Thomas Harris.

items.title: A Mother's Crime
items.description: Encouraged by her lover, Danielle kills her husband and goes on the lam with her infant daughter Cali. But the cops catch her and, en route to prison, she agrees to give custody of Cali to her arch rival, her sister Nikki.

items.title: Dognapped
items.description: Eight kids develop their natural talents to superhero levels to confront a comic-book-inspired villain kidnapping neighborhood dogs to pull off the crime of the century.

items.title: Sailor Moon R: The Movie
items.description: Sailor Moon and the Sailor Guardians unite to save Earth from an alien force!

items.title: Sailor Moon S: The Movie
items.description: Princess Snow Kaguya has a chilling plan to freeze Earth. Sailor Moon and her team are now the only hope!

items.title: Sailor Moon Super S: The Movie
items.description: The evil Queen plots to trap Earth in a energy field, powered by the dreams of children. Sailor Moon and the Sailor Guardians must now save the world!

items.title: Come to Daddy
items.description: Elijah Wood is a man in his thirties who receives an invitation to a remote cabin for a visit with his father after a lifetime of estrangement. What he gets is much more than he ever expected!

items.title: Instructions Not Included
items.description: Valentin (Eugenio Derbez) is Acapulco’s resident playboy until his life gets turned upside down when a former fling leaves a baby girl on his doorstep.

items.title: Grand Isle
items.description: A father is charged with murder and must prove his innocence by recalling dark events. With Nicolas Cage.

items.title: Semper Fi
items.description: When his reckless younger brother is given an unfair prison sentence, a Marine Corps reservist is torn between his by-the-book code and loyalty to family.

items.title: Sex Drive
items.description: When an online hottie offers to help him become a man, Ian embarks on a wild road trip to a sure thing.

items.title: The Stoned Age
items.description: Joe and Hubbs are a pair of rockers who are on a quest for 'chicks'. This is the tale of their adventures over one night.

items.title: Vamps
items.description: Two socialite vampires in New York City (Krysten Ritter of TV’s DON’T TRUST THE B*** and Alicia Silverstone of CLUELESS) fall in love while being pursued by vampire hunters.

items.title: Poltergeist
items.description: At first, the spirits that invade the Freelings' home seem like playful children. But then they turn angry. And when 10-year-old Carol Anne is pulled from this world into another, Steve and Diane Freeling turn to an exorcist.

items.title: Intensive Care
items.description: Three criminals try to rob a dying woman's home, but her live-in nurse is more than they bargained for.

items.title: La Soga
items.description: Based on true events in the Dominican Republic, 'La Soga' tells the personal struggle of Luisito, a brave cop, who revolts against his country's immoral government.

items.title: Blue Iguana
items.description: Two low-level crooks get an offer they can't refuse to steal a rare jewel. With Sam Rockwell.

items.title: Jumbo
items.description: Jumbo the elephant trains overtime for the annual spelling bee - until resident bad guy Mr. Hollis curses Jumbo and causes him to lose his memory completely! Now, Jumbo and his friends must find a cure before time runs out!

items.title: What's Cooking
items.description: A funny, mouth-watering and deeply moving vision of 21st century diversity and the future of the American family.

items.title: Escuela de la vida
items.description: Un nuevo maestro se enfrenta a su malhumorado competidor por el premio al maestro del año.

items.title: The Way We Weren't
items.description: When Charlotte and Brandon meet, they rush into marriage after failing in previous relationships. Then they discover each other's true selves.

items.title: Acquainted
items.description: When two old acquaintances meet for the first time in years, there is an instant attraction though they're both in committed relationships.

items.title: Alterscape
items.description: A grieving man submits himself to a series of scientific trials designed to fine-tune human emotions

items.title: Dead Heading
items.description: A flight attendant races to piece the puzzle together after she is framed for a murder.

items.title: Destination Marfa
items.description: A road trip becomes a nightmare when four lifelong friends take a shortcut through Marfa, TX

items.title: I Walk Alone
items.description: After taking the rap for his partner, a mobster is released from prison to find his former partner entranched in a swank night club with no intention of sharing the riches.

items.title: Elfette Saves Christmas
items.description: When Santa Claus is kidnapped by the New York mafia, Elfette, a special not-so-ordinary elf, must stop the bad guys, find Santa, and save Christmas.

items.title: Bad Samaritan
items.description: BAD SAMARITAN is a terrifying cautionary tale of two thieves uncovering more than what they bargained for when breaking into a house they thought would be an easy score.

items.title: The Pawn
items.description: After a New York cop is corrupted, he returns to his hometown and has time to reflect on who he really is and who he wants to become.

items.title: Unchained
items.description: Carol Buckley and her team campaign for better treatment of captive elephants in Nepal.

items.title: The Girl Who Believes In Miracles
items.description: When young Sara hears a preacher say faith can move mountains, she starts praying. Suddenly, people in her town are mysteriously healed - but fame soon takes its toll.

items.title: School of Life
items.description: Ryan Reynolds lights up the screen as the charismatic and hip Mr. D, a teacher whose lessons extend far beyond the classroom. Featuring David Paymer ('State and Main').

items.title: Forever Mine
items.description: An affair between a cabana boy (Joseph Fiennes) and the young wife (Gretchen Mol) of a sinister politician (Ray Liotta) triggers a 16-year vendetta between the two men.

items.title: Judy & Punch
items.description: Seaside (nowhere near the sea), puppeteers Judy and Punch are trying to resurrect their marionette show in an an anarchic town on the brink of mob rule.

items.title: The Skull
items.description: The skull of the Marquis de Sade has been taken from its grave, bringing terror to those who own it. Demonologist Christopher Maitland is eager to add the piece to his occult collection.

items.title: We Summon the Darkness
items.description: A post-concert party at a remote country mansion turns into a grisly satanic slaughter scene in this dark-humored horror-thriller starring Alexandra Daddario and Johnny Knoxville.

items.title: The Bells Of St Mary's
items.description: At a big city Catholic school, Father O'Malley and Sister Benedict indulge in friendly rivalry, and succeed in extending the school through the gift of a building.

items.title: Better Off Dead
items.description: In this essential 80s classic, Lane (John Cusack, HIGH FIDELITY) decides that suicide is the answer after his girlfriend ditches him for a boorish ski jock. However, his increasingly inept attempts bring him only more agony, not to mention embarrassment.

items.title: Collateral
items.description: Vincent is a cool, calculating contract killer at the top of his game. Max is a cabbie with big dreams and no results. On this fateful night, Max has to transport Vincent on his next job - one night, five stops, five hits and a getaway.

items.title: Eddie Murphy: Laugh 'Til it Hurts
items.description: Almost six decades later Eddie Murphy remains loved by fans for his infectious smile and goofy laugh. Learn about many challenges Eddie is faced with along his way to stardom as Eddie continues to make his fans Laugh 'Til it Hurts.

items.title: My Secret Billionaire
items.description: A handsome billionaire disguised as a regular guy falls in love with a regular gal and finds that true love is something money can't buy.

items.title: Toy Train Christmas Memories
items.description: All aboard for a joyous Christmas ride to a land filled with toy trains, tiny lights, wrapped presents, and the wonder of Christmas. We feature three dazzling Christmas layouts with Lionel, MTH, and G gauge trains dashing about Dept. 56 Villages.

items.title: Christmas Train Spectacular
items.description: Five amazing Christmas train displays, all with sparkling lights, glistening snow, trains zipping around Christmas villages - and marvelous stories that will tug at your heart, train buff or not.

items.title: Felicia's Journey
items.description: A young woman leaves Ireland to find her boyfriend in England, and while there is helped by a man hiding unsettling secrets.

items.title: Dirt Music
items.description: Western Australia is the backdrop for an impassioned tale of love and grief in Gregor Jordan's adaptation of the acclaimed novel by Tim Winton.

items.title: Zatiochi: Darkness is His Ally
items.description: This thrilling martial arts epic finds nomadic hero Zatôichi in the middle of a bloody turf war between two rival clans. It is a blood-stained epic that shows the facilities of a man at odds with the Bushido Code.

items.title: Dog Soldiers
items.description: A routine military exercise turns into a nightmare in the Scotland wilderness.

items.title: Blind Dating
items.description: A blind young man (Pine) thinks he finds love with an Indian woman (Jay), though their relationship is fraught with cultural differences.

items.title: Rogue Warfare
items.description: Stephen Lang (Avatar) stars in the action-packed Rogue Warfare. An international team of highly trained special ops soldiers is assembled for a covert mission in Afghanistan.

items.title: Rogue Warfare: Death of a Nation
items.description: Stephen Lang returns for the final chapter in the action-packed trilogy. When an elite team of soldiers uncover plans for a deadly bomb set to detonate in 36 hours, they must race against time to find it and defeat their enemy once and for all.

items.title: Rogue Warfare: The Hunt
items.description: The second installment of the action-packed Rogue Warfare trilogy returns with its most daring mission yet. When the leader of an elite team of soldiers is captured by terrorists, it is up to the team to find and rescue him before it's too late.

items.title: Sin City: A Dame To Kill For
items.description: Some of Sin City's most hard-boiled citizens cross paths with a few of its more reviled inhabitants.

items.title: Misty
items.description: The film version of the classic novel about siblings in Virginia whose plan to catch a beautiful mare changes after she soon gives birth to a colt.

items.title: Christmas at Maxwell's
items.description: With a successful career, two adoring children and having married his high school sweetheart - Andrew Austin had everything. But a cancer diagnosis and past secrets quickly turn their lives upside down.

items.title: Big Fan
items.description: A hard-core New York Giants fan struggles to deal with the consequences when he is beaten up by his favorite player.

items.title: Apollo 18
items.description: Decades-old found footage from NASA's abandoned Apollo 18 mission, where three American astronauts were sent on a secret expedition, reveals the reason the U.S. has never returned to the moon.

items.title: Sugar Mountain
items.description: Two brothers, down on their luck, fake a disappearance in the Alaskan wilderness so they'll have a great survival story to sell, but the hoax turns out to be more real than they planned. Featuring Jason Momoa and Cary Elwes.

items.title: The Way of the Dragon
items.description: Legendary Bruce Lee's only complete directorial film is packed with action and epic fight scenes. Lee visits his relatives at their restaurant in Italy and has to help them defend against brutal gangsters harassing them.

items.title: Lymelife
items.description: In this coming-of-age story, 15-year-old Scott is caught up in his first love while watching the relationship of his parents slowly crumble as they try to keep up with the changing 1970s. Featuring a star-studded cast including Emma Roberts.

items.title: Swinging with the Finkels
items.description: This funny, sexy comedy stars Martin Freeman ('Sherlock') and Mandy Moore ('Entourage') as a suburban couple who decides to shake up their marriage by 'swinging' with another couple.

items.title: Terrifier 2
items.description: After being resurrected by a sinister entity, Art the Clown returns to Miles County where he begins to target a teenage girl and her younger brother on Halloween.

items.title: My Name Is Lopez
items.description: Born in Dallas of undocumented Mexican immigrants, Trinidad Trini Lopez III fought his way out of the ghetto with a guitar to become a true American rock and roll legend, one of the first Latino rock stars.

items.title: Aerial Assault Vietnam
items.description: Decades after it ended, the Vietnam War might seem like a distant memory. In fact, it was an enormous conflict, the longest war in American history and the only one from which the USA did not emerge victorious.

items.title: Adult Beginners
items.description: A young, hipster entrepreneur (Nick Kroll) crashes and burns on the eve of his company’s big launch.

items.title: The Lady In Red
items.description: A farm girl (Pamela Sue Martin) turns to guns, sin and bathtub gin with gangster John Dillinger (Robert Conrad).

items.title: The Shooting
items.description: A mysterious woman persuades two cowboys to help her in a revenge scheme.

items.title: The Red Carpet With Carol Burnett And Friends
items.description: Tune in to the celebration as Shout! Factory and the Carol Burnett Show Channel hits the red carpet, with host Maude Garett and some incredible guest stars.

items.title: Celebrating Carol Burnett: The Gift Of Laughter
items.description: Join Carol Burnett as she shares her favorite moments of her storied career and incredible life - spanning 90 years of love and laughter.

items.title: Overlord
items.description: Nothing can prepare you for the mind-blowing mayhem that is Overlord. Mega producer J.J. Abrams creates an insanely twisted thrill ride about a team of American troops who come face-to-face with Nazi super-soldiers unlike anything the world has ever seen.

items.title: C'mon C'mon
items.description: Johnny and his young nephew forge a tenuous but transformational relationship when they are unexpectedly thrown together in this delicate and deeply moving story about the connections between adults and children, the past and the future.

items.title: The Humans
items.description: Based on the Tony Award-winning play, a family gathers for Thanksgiving in their daughter's apartment. Amidst the warmth and humor of the holiday, the tight-knit family tries to hold together in the face of an anxious and uncertain future.

items.title: The Last Black Man in San Francisco
items.description: Jimmie & his best friend Mont try to reclaim the home built by Jimmie's grandfather, launching them on a poignant odyssey that connects them to their past, even as it tests their friendship & sense of belonging in the place they call home.

items.title: Sidekicks (ESP)
items.description: El adolescente Barry Gabrewski es un soñador. Para escapar de sus problemas de la vida real, Barry se imagina a sí mismo como el compañero de su héroe de acción, Chuck Norris, en una serie de aventuras de alto octanaje sacadas de sus películas.

items.title: A Lionel Christmas
items.description: Heartwarming stories from Lionel collectors and layout builders from all over the country remembering the golden age of toy trains, and the holiday excitement of watching Lionel trains puffing smoke and gliding around ovals of three-rail track.

items.title: A Lionel Christmas 2
items.description: See a behind-the-scenes look at Lionel on the NBC Today Show, the magnificent Christmas tree at Rockefeller Center, and the Lionel retail store that was across from Radio City Music Hall. Visit the spectacular displays at the Gaylord Hotel in Dallas.

items.title: Hoop Dreams
items.description: Dos niños comunes y corrientes del centro de la ciudad se atreven a soñar con la gloria imposible y profesional del baloncesto en esta crónica épica de esperanza y fe.

items.title: LBJ
items.description: In the immediate aftermath of the Kennedy assassination, Lyndon Johnson faces off against enemies from within his own party and his own White House as he frantically struggles to secure the legitimacy of his presidency.

items.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
items.description: Get ready for thrills in Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion Ravenwood dodge booby-traps, fight Nazis, and stare down snakes in their incredible worldwide quest for the mystical Ark of the Covenant.

items.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
items.description: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom brings you thrills and excitement. Indy, his sidekick Short Round, and nightclub singer Willie Scott go from high-flying action above the Himalayas to a spine-tingling escape from a fortress-like mine in India.

items.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
items.description: There's nothing more exciting than trying to keep up with the Joneses in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. Indy's Nazi enemies are back and have kidnapped his father in their effort to locate the sacred Holy Grail.

items.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
items.description: STEVEN SPIELBERG and GEORGE LUCAS present Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull. Join Indy as he races against a brilliant and beautiful agent for the mystical, all-powerful crystal skull of Akator in this thrilling adventure!

items.title: Gloria Bell
items.description: Gloria (Julianne Moore) spends her nights joyfully letting loose at clubs around Los Angeles and finds herself thrust into an unexpected and complicated new romance.

items.title: Minari
items.description: A tender and sweeping story about what roots us, Minari follows a Korean-American family that moves to an Arkansas farm in search of their own American Dream.

items.title: Ya veremos
items.description: Los padres de Santi están divorciados, y él está acostumbrado a vivir con ellos pero por separado. Tras una urgente cirugía para salvar su vista, Santi decide hacer una lista de deseos por cumplir pero con sus padres unidos.

items.title: Incontrol
items.description: A group of students discovers a machine that projects consciousness into the minds of others.

items.title: About Hope
items.description: After finally meeting "Mrs. Right," a man tempted by wealth and fame learns that it's not only true love that makes us whole.

items.title: Chasing Ghosts
items.description: Lucas Simons, an 11-year-old filmmaker, is obsessed with death after the loss of his brother. When Lucas accidentally captures a mysterious presence in one of his films, he becomes a YouTube phenomenon and must learn to live life in the spotlight.

items.title: Wish Man
items.description: Based on the true story of Frank Shankwitz, founder of the Make-A-Wish Foundation. A motorcycle cop makes a dying boy's last wish come true.

items.title: Love Blossoms
items.description: Hallmark Original Movie. Perfumer Violet hires a botanist with an uncanny ability to identify scents.

items.title: Daniel and the Lions
items.description: When his parents go on a trip, 6-year-old Devin is too sad to say his prayers. To help him understand the importance of praying, Devin's grandpa enlightens him with the story of Daniel and the Lions.

items.title: A-X-L
items.description: A.X.L. is a top-secret, robotic dog created by the military to help protect tomorrow's soldiers. Code named by the scientists who created him, A.X.L. stands for Attack, Exploration, Logistics, and embodies next-generation artificial intelligence.

items.title: Brotherhood of the Wolf
items.description: In 18th-century France, the Chevalier de Fronsac and his Native American friend Mani are sent to the Gevaudan province at the king's behest to investigate the killings of hundreds by a mysterious beast.

items.title: Dragon Fist
items.description: Tong Huo-wan (Jackie Chan) seeks redress from the man responsible for his master's death, but becomes entangled in a feud between a local clan and gangsters.

items.title: Saint Jack
items.description: Jack Flowers, an American hustler in early 1970s Singapore, dreams of building a fortune by running a brothel and returning to the States to lead a life of luxury.

items.title: Shaolin Wooden Men
items.description: After witnessing the murder of his father, Little Mute trains in Shaolin Temple for revenge and is taught by various teachers, one of which is clandestine.

items.title: Snake & Crane Arts Of Shaolin
items.description: A martial arts book, which Hsu Yin-Fung (Jackie Chan) carries, is being highly sought by various clans and gangs, but he is in pursuit of someone himself.

items.title: To Kill With Intrigue
items.description: After the execution of his family by a gang, Lei Shao-feng is spared by its afflicting leader who stands in the way of him becoming reunited with his love, as does a traitorous friend, who takes advantage of their predicament.

items.title: Silver City
items.description: The discovery of a corpse threatens to unravel a bumbling local politician's campaign for governor of Colorado.

items.title: The Killer Meteors
items.description: Mei Xing He is a local hero, as known as 'Killer Meteors', his secret weapon makes him invincible. However, when Hua Wu Bin, another powerful local character seeks his assistance, Mei Xing He will face the deadliest challenge of his life.

items.title: The UnMiracle
items.description: Inspired by true events, this tale of how a small town reacts to the accidental drug overdose of a popular high school girl is told through 7 interweaving storylines.

items.title: Peter - The Redemption
items.description: Tormented by his denial of Christ. Peter spent his life attempting to atone for his failures. Now as he faces certain death at the hand of Nero, will he falter again, his weakness betray him or will he rise up triumphant in his final moment?

items.title: David And Goliath
items.description: Your whole family will enjoy the live-action musical David and Goliath, starring recording artist and former professional basketball star Thurl Bailey as Goliath and introducing Spencer Forsey as David.

items.title: La leyenda del Charro Negro
items.description: Leo debe obtener la ayuda de sus amigos después de ser engañado por el Charro Negro, lo que provoca que una chica sea arrojada al inframundo.

items.title: Tropic Thunder
items.description: Ben Stiller, Jack Black and Robert Downey Jr. lead an ensemble cast in 'Tropic Thunder,' an action comedy about a group of self-absorbed actors who set out to make the most expensive war film.

items.title: Complices (LAS)
items.description: Un seductor experto lleva a su sobrino en un viaje a la playa en busca de mujeres calientes. Pero la única mujer capaz de causarle problemas, aparece allí.

items.title: Pena de muerte
items.description: Ganadora del Oscar, Susan Sarandon interpreta a la hermana Helen Prejean. Una mujer espiritual quien se embarca en la peligrosa misión de salvar a un joven condenado a la pena de muerte.

items.title: Frankie y Johnny
items.description: Pfeiffer interpreta a Frankie, una camarera en una cafetería de Nueva York. Después de una serie de relaciones desafortunadas, lo último que Frankie busca es un hombre nuevo... hasta que él viene a buscarla.

items.title: Lluvia Negra
items.description: El ganador del Oscar(r) Michael Douglas y Andy García interpretan a dos policías de Nueva York, cuya misión de escoltar a un asesino de regreso a su Japón natal los lleva a los bajos mundos de Osaka y directamente al centro de una batalla violenta.

items.title: Un Ratoncito Duro De Cazar
items.description: Los dos hermanos sin suerte Lars y Ernie Smuntz no aprecian la vieja mansión en ruinas que heredaron, hasta que descubren que la propiedad vale millones.

Halfway through a 10 year mission in deep space, a group of astronauts awaken to find Earth has suffered a catastrophic event. The already unstable crew desperately races to repair their deteriorating space station and fight off unforeseen threats.

items.title: Gueros
items.description: Sombra y Santos han estado en el limbo mientras su universidad está en huelga, pero su rutina se ve interrumpida por la llegada del hermano menor de Sobra, quien los convence de localizar a su ídolo de la infancia.

items.title: La fortaleza
items.description: Tras el colapso económico de Venezuela, el alcohólico en recuperación Roque, trata de cambiar su vida reconstruyendo un hotel abandonado en la selva amazónica; pero el encanto de la minería ilegal de oro amenaza con hacer fracasar sus sueños.

items.title: Post Mortem (LAS)
items.description: Una mordaz comedia negra del director Pablo Larrain (Jackie).

items.title: We Are Stronger
items.description: We Are Stronger is a faith-based movie exploring a veteran's battle with PTSD.

items.title: Emma
items.description: Emma is a mischievous beauty who sets up her single friends, making a hilariously tangled mess of their lives until she herself falls in love. Gwyneth Paltrow stars in this beloved adaptation of Jane Austen's novel.

items.title: Crime Story [English Subtitled]
items.description: A Special Agent is assigned to protect a wealthy business magnate. However, when the businessman is kidnapped in a daring ambush, he teams up with a seasoned detective to crack the case. But soon he discovers the case isn't that simple.

items.title: Bordertown
items.description: Jennifer Lopez portrays a tenacious American reporter investigating the murders of young women working in a Mexican bordertown.

items.title: I Never Promised You A Rose Garden
items.description: A disturbed, institutionalized 16-year-old girl struggles between fantasy and reality.

items.title: Waru
items.description: Following the death of a child, eight Māori women are confronted by guilt, pride and defeat but will ultimately risk everything for the greater good of their community.

items.title: Clint Eastwood: Hollywood Outlaw
items.description: Clint Eastwood has a career spanning over six decades and is one of the most successful actors ever.

items.title: Bill Engvall: Just Sell Him For Parts
items.description: Original standup comedy special featuring the original material of Bill Engvall.

items.title: Blue Collar Comedy Tour Rides Again
items.description: Bill Engvall, Ron 'Tater Salad' White, Jeff Foxworthy, and Larry the Cable Guy return on-stage to give some funny redneck laughs and humorous spins on everyday affairs.

items.title: Blue Collar Comedy Tour: One For The Road
items.description: Bill Engvall, Ron 'Tater Salad' White, Jeff Foxworthy, and Larry the Cable Guy return on-stage to give some funny redneck laughs and humorous spins on everyday affairs.

items.title: Kakurenbo
items.description: Hikora enters the ruins of a forbidden city with a group of other children to play a game of hide-and-seek where the players are said to be kidnapped by ghosts and demons.

items.title: Citizen Toxie: The Toxic Avenger Part 4
items.description: The Toxic Avenger must defend his friends from his own evil alternate universe doppelgänger, The Noxious Offender.

items.title: Checkered Ninja
items.description: A possessed Ninja doll teams up with a shy teenager to avenge the murder of a poor child factory worker. Alex learns courage enough to vanquish the school bully and score points with his school crush.

items.title: Cannibal! The Musical
items.description: The sole survivor of an ill-fated mining expedition tells how his taste for gold was replaced by that of human flesh.

items.title: The Girl on the Train
items.description: A documentary filmmaker boards a train at Grand Central Terminal, heading to upstate New York to interview the subjects of his latest project. A chance encounter with a mysterious young woman leads him on a journey of a very different sort.

items.title: A Beautiful Now
items.description: A group of five friends reunite for one night to save the woman, Romy, at the center of their former circle. As the night progresses, they struggle with their past relationships and finally the truths are revealed.

items.title: Half of a Yellow Sun
items.description: Sisters Olanna and Kainene return home to 1960s Nigeria, where they soon diverge on different paths. As civil war breaks out, political events loom larger than their differences as they join the fight to establish an independent republic.

items.title: 3 Nights in the Desert
items.description: What could have been? What might have been? Reunions can be exciting, frustrating, exhilarating, nostalgic, a life given over to practicality while another chases lost dreams. Set against the majestic landscape of the desert, three estranged friends.

items.title: The Beyond
items.description: A young woman inherits an old hotel in Louisiana where, following a series of supernatural "accidents", she learns that the building was built over one of the entrances to Hell.

items.title: Tammy and the T Rex
items.description: A teen (Denise Richards) learns that a scientist implanted her dead boyfriend's brain (Paul Walker) into an animatronic dinosaur.

items.title: Inspector Mom
items.description: When Tara's soccer coach is brutally murdered, it's up to newswoman turned soccer mom Maddie Monroe to solve the murder and prove her husband's innocence.

items.title: Inspector Mom: Kidnapped in 10 Easy Steps
items.description: Set against the backdrop of the latest craze - ballroom dancing - Maddie Monroe must discover the identity of dangerous kidnappers and bring them to justice before her best friend becomes their next victim.

items.title: Pussy Riot: The Movement
items.description: The true-life odyssey of the punk girls that rocked a country and fight for human rights around the world. Follow Pussy Riot through their harsh two year sentences for playing music to the stunning upwards trajectory of a youth movement.

items.title: Christmas In The Smokies
items.description: A family spends a fateful Christmas season fighting the odds to save their historic berry farm in the heart of the Smoky Mountains.

items.title: Dark Encounter
items.description: A family grieving the loss of an 8-year-old child encounters an eerie, unsettling phenomenon that seems bent on terrorizing them—but these otherworldly beings may also hold the key to the truth behind the girl's tragic disappearance.

items.title: Christmas On The Coast
items.description: Hard-hearted New York novelist Dru Cassadine, known for her holiday romance stories, is desperate to get her mojo back after a string of flops, decides that a change of scenery might get her creative juices flowing, and heads south for the winter.

items.title: The Real Top Guns
items.description: Meet the Real Top Guns that the blockbuster movie was based on. See behind the scenes of their intense training, with incredible never before seen footage of flight and combat training in some of the fastest fighter jets on the planet.

items.title: The Roundup
items.description: Two South Korean detectives are sent to Vietnam to extradite a suspect, where they uncover a series of connected murders and crimes against tourists.

items.title: Darlin'
items.description: A feral teenager is indoctrinated into strict religious care, unleashing the mother of all hell from the wild woman who raised her.

items.title: Girl on the Third Floor
items.description: Don Koch (Phil "CM Punk" Brooks) tries to renovate a rundown house with a sordid history for his growing family, only to learn that the house has other plans.

items.title: Henry: Portrait of a Serial Killer: 30th Anniversary Edition
