items.description: A seemingly mild-mannered drifter introduces an ex-con and his innocent sister into his world of cold-blooded killing in this shocking and thought-provoking plunge into the mind of a murderer.

items.title: Heart Of The Country
items.description: With her husband jailed for Wall Street fraud, Faith leaves her life of luxury behind to return to rural North Carolina and the father and sister she'd left behind.

items.title: Be The Light
items.description: A down & out girl trying to make amends with her dying father raises money to save him by entering a music competition.

items.title: God & Salsa
items.description: A grief-stricken therapist is determined to help a suicidal teen but to help him, she must face her own pain and let go of her guilt. With help from God, a pastor and a dance instructor, the two realize they just might have a second chance.

items.title: New Hope
items.description: This inspiring drama reminds us that life's troubles may test our faith, but God is watching out for us every step of the way.

items.title: Healer, The
items.description: A young man discovers he has the family gift of healing. A teenage girl with terminal cancer shows him how to help others and believe in himself.

items.title: Jeremy Clarkson: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
items.description: In an attempt to find the ultimate American car, US models are pitched against their European counterparts. The trademarks of opinions galore and dry humour are as evident in The Good, The Bad, The Ugly as in any other Clarkson spectacle.

items.title: Equilibrium
items.description: In the future, mankind has outlawed the things that trigger emotion-literature, music, and art. To uphold the law, a special breed of police is assigned to eliminate all transgressors. Christian Bale stars in this awesome high-tech action thriller.

items.title: La familia Monster
items.description: Después de que Emma Wishbone lleva a su familia a una fiesta de disfraces en la noche de Halloween, todos están malditos por una bruja y se convierten en monstruos.

items.title: Monster Family
items.description: After Emma Wishbone drags her family to a costume party on Halloween night, they are all cursed by an evil witch and transformed into monsters. Now Emma must fight to keep her Monster Family together and uncover the secret of their curse…

items.title: Pixi Saves Christmas
items.description: Since the beginning, the Christmas Genies of the world have brought magic and happiness to all. When a former Genie steals Christmas for himself, it's up to Pixi Post – a lowly elf – to use all of her wits and skills.

items.title: Ploey
items.description: Separated from his family, Ploey, a young flightless plover chick, must embark on a perilous journey to a legendary valley to save his family and friends from falling prey to the evil hawk.

items.title: The Wacky Hen
items.description: A misfit hen who can't lay eggs discovers she can talk, sing, and dance! Her talents take her on the road as a world-famous circus act.

items.title: Hidden Turkey
items.description: Hosted by CBS News Travel Editor Peter Greenberg, Hidden Turkey allows the audience to immerse themselves in Turkey's evolving story and enduring culture. Among the locations visited: Istanbul, Cappadocia, Antakya, Antalya and Laodicea.

items.title: Hidden Canary Islands
items.description: Hidden Canary Islands is a one-hour television special hosted by CBS News Travel Editor Peter Greenberg, exploring all eight Spanish islands: El Hierro, Fuerteventura, Gran Canaria, La Gomera, La Graciosa, Lanzarote, La Palma, and Tenerife.

items.title: Hidden Poland
items.description: This one-hour special hosted by CBS News Travel Editor Peter Greenberg gives viewers a look at Poland's enduring culture. Watch Peter take a hot air balloon ride over the 13th century Czocha Castle and glide across the Tatra Mountains.

items.title: JL Family Ranch: The Wedding Gift
items.description: Hallmark Original Movie. After Rebecca's engagement, a visitor from her past comes to the ranch.

items.title: A Royal In Paradise
items.description: A pop fiction writer takes a post-breakup vacation with her best friend, where she runs into one of her fans and starts to fall for him — only to find out that he's actually a Prince.

items.title: Saving Christmas Spirit
items.description: An archaeology professor travels to Scotland in search of an ancient shrine, but finds more than she bargained for when a handsome Whiskey brewer offers to be her tour guide.

items.title: Summer in the City
items.description: Hallmark Original Movie. A midwestern girl tries to adopt a big city personality with disastrous results.

items.title: City Slickers
items.description: Billy Crystal and Jack Palance ride the range as a middle-aged urban SUV jockey and a hardened and weathered cowpoke in this Western tale of a cattle drive that becomes a journey of self-discovery for a band of City Slickers.

items.title: Godsend
items.description: When their eight-year-old son dies, a grieving couple turns to a geneticist who successfully clones their child—with terrifying results—in this pulse-pounding suspense thriller.

items.title: Hellboy
items.description: After years of hiding from a society that shuns him, Hellboy and his team attempt to stop the resurrection of an ancient witch who once spread an unstoppable plague before she was locked away by the legendary King Arthur.

items.title: Bad Santa 2
items.description: Fueled by cheap whiskey, greed and hatred, Willie Stoke (Billy Bob Thornton) returns as "Santa," this time in an effort to knock off a Chicago charity on Christmas Eve. It's a hysterical sequel just outrageous enough to outdo the original.

items.title: Miracle on Christmas
items.description: Durante las vacaciones de Navidad, María experimenta pruebas emocionales que le hacen cuestionar su fe hasta que llega un visitante y su marido recibe un milagro inesperado.

items.title: The Poison Rose
items.description: This star-studded detective noir features John Travolta as a troubled private eye whose latest case forces him to confront dangerous men (among them, Morgan Freeman), desirable women — and his own dark past.

items.title: The Winning Season
items.description: A misfit guy (Sam Rockwell) is brought on to coach the local girls' high school basketball team, but he never imagined how this experience would alter his life and theirs.

items.title: Defendiendo a Ben
items.description: El abogado, Benjamin Stills, está a punto de ser sentenciado a prisión y encuentra fe en Dios después de que una adolescente pierde su vida en un accidente automovilístico por enviar mensajes de texto mientras conducía.

items.title: Legionnaire
items.description: Alain is a boxer in 1925 Marseille, France. When he doesn't take the dive paid to take by a mob boss, he has to split. He joins the Foreign Legion and is sent to Morocco. He makes 3 friends and they watch each other's backs.

items.title: Point Break
items.description: An F.B.I. Agent goes undercover to catch a gang of surfers who may be bank robbers.

items.title: Timecop
items.description: Max Walker, an officer for a security agency that regulates time travel, must fend for his life against a shady politician who's intent on changing the past to control the future.

items.title: Bloodshot
items.description: A gripping thriller with a grisly edge, starring East London legend Danny Dyer. A torrid night of passion and terror awaits Phillip after a chance meeting with a beautiful stranger, whose shocking secret past threatens to destroy them.

items.title: Solstice
items.description: While on vacation, a young woman believes that her twin sister who recently committed suicide is trying to contact her.

items.title: LOL
items.description: Anne (Demi Moore) deals with life as a working mother and raising her teen, Lola, (Miley Cyrus) who seems to be growing up faster than expected.

items.title: Hunter Killer
items.description: When an American submarine captain discovers a secret Russian coup is in the offing, he must assemble an elite group of Navy Seals.

items.title: Jack Reacher
items.description: Investigator Jack Reacher leaps off the pages of Lee Child's novel and onto the big screen in this thriller. When a horrible crime is committed, all evidence points to the suspect in custody, who offers up a single note in defense: "Get Jack Reacher!"

items.title: El tren del infierno
items.description: Mientras un tren atraviesa las Montañas Rocosas, los pasajeros están siendo asesinados. La única esperanza es John Deakin, el cual descubre un secreto que explota en un torrente de revelaciones impactantes, peleas y tiroteos explosivos.

items.title: Buscando a Susan desesperadamente
items.description: La fascinación de una aburrida ama de casa de las afueras de Nueva Jersey por una estrafalaria mujer sobre la que ha leído en varias revistas, le lleva a ser confundida con dicha mujer.

items.title: Revenge
items.description: Jimmy, Ronnie, Jack and Chris execute a daring soccer stadium robbery but the volatile dynamic soon turns sour when the leader of the group begins to self-destruct. After a stint in prison, leader Ronnie is unrelenting in his path to retribution.

items.title: Masters of Love
items.description: A group of friends are at different stages in their relationships: Emmy and Samantha are getting married, Josh and Jenifer are breaking up and Niall is sleeping around; but can any of them hold down a relationship?

items.title: Most Beautiful Island
items.description: A psychological thriller that follows a day in the life of a young immigrant struggling to survive in Manhattan. Desperate for money, she suddenly finds herself playing a cruel and twisted game for the perverse entertainment of a privileged few.

items.title: Un par de seductores
items.description: Dos estafadores rivales hacen una apuesta: ganará el primero que estafe cincuenta mil dólares a la próxima mujer que conozca, y el otro se irá de la ciudad. Hay mucho en juego en esta comedia divertida, ingeniosa, sucia y podrida.

items.title: House of the Long Shadows
items.description: The Four Kings of Horror -- Vincent Price, Christopher Lee, Peter Cushing and John Carradine -- star with Desi Arnaz, Jr. in this delightfully ghoulish comedy about a novelist, an eccentric family and a dinner party where murder is on the menu!

items.title: Last Embrace
items.description: After the death of his wife, Harry Hannan (Roy Scheider) hires a private investigator to help him find the identity of the stalker who is sending death threats, but it only leads to more questions as the killer gets closer and closer.

items.title: Duelo en Diablo
items.description: El explorador Jess Remsberg dirige una caravana a través de territorio hostil hasta Fort Conchos, pero en su valor se oculta un motivo: saldar cuentas con el hombre que cree que mató a su esposa. Protagonizada por James Garner y Sidney Poitier.

items.title: Burn!
items.description: In this riveting and powerful study of colonialism, a British man is sent to an 1800s Caribbean Island for a devious three-part mission: trick the slaves into revolt, grab the sugar trade for England…and then return the slaves to their servitude.

items.title: The End
items.description: When Sonny (Burt Reynolds) is diagnosed with a fatal disease, he swallows a bottle of pills to end it all! Instead, he ends up in a loony bin beside the demented Marlon (Dom DeLuise) who is eager to help Sonny succeed...one madcap attempt at a time!

items.title: Murders in the Rue Morgue
items.description: In early 20th-century Paris, a theatrical company undertakes their most gruesome production yet. But when a madman with an axe to grind arrives on the scene, the stage is set for real mayhem and murder most foul. Jason Robards and Herbert Lom star.

items.title: Audrey Rose
items.description: Suppose a stranger told you that your daughter was actually his daughter in another life. Suppose it was really true! Anthony Hopkins stars with Marsha Mason and John Beck in this hair-raising occult thriller that will make your blood run cold!

items.title: New Year's Evil
items.description: This New Year's, you're invited to a killer party...While the host of a punk-rock TV show is broadcasting live, she begins receiving calls on-air from a psychopath who’s planning to kill a 'naughty girl' as midnight strikes in each U.S. time zone!

items.title: Shark Divers Part 1
items.description: Shark divers study, photograph and interact with some of the most terrifying creatures on earth. This group of skilled professionals routinely work with sharks out in the wild and in aquariums.

items.title: Shark Divers Part 2
items.description: Shark divers study, photograph and interact with some of the most terrifying creatures on earth. This group of skilled professionals routinely work with sharks out in the wild and in aquariums.

items.title: Go Tell the Spartans
items.description: A savvy U.S. major (Burt Lancaster) reluctantly obeys an ill-advised order to send out a unit of South Vietnamese troops and American advisors to a peaceful, former French outpost. He fears it will draw the Viet Cong into the area – and he’s right!

items.title: Capturen a Quigley
items.description: El francotirador Matthew Quigley (Tom Selleck) cree que ha sido contratado para matar perros salvajes en Australia, pero un rico ganadero (Alan Rickman) tiene otros planes para el francotirador. Laura San Giacomo coprotagoniza este elegante western.

items.title: Showgirls: lo prohibido
items.description: Conflictos de seducción, pasión y poder se revelan cuando los creadores de 'Instinto Básico' destapan el aparentemente glamoroso mundo del espectáculo en Las Vegas con esta controvertida película protagonizada por Elizabeth Berkley.

items.title: Mucho ruido y pocas nueces
items.description: Una guerra acaba de terminar, pero continúa una guerra feliz entre Beatrice (Emma Thompson) y Benedick (Kenneth Branagh). ¿Podrán sus amigos atraerlos para que hagan el amor de modo que el curso del amor verdadero pueda seguir fluyendo?

items.title: Invasión USA
items.description: Un ejército terrorista encabezado por el agente soviético Rostov (Richard Lynch) sorprende en EE. UU. y lo sumerge en una guerra. Solo un hombre puede poner fin a la violencia: el agente retirado de las artes marciales Matt Hunter (Chuck Norris).

items.title: Live in Peru
items.description: El percusionista Tony Succar actúa en vivo en Perú con una banda de 40 músicos y una formación llena de estrellas.

items.title: I Still See You
items.description: Several after years after a cataclysmic event, Ronnie's suburban world has mostly returned to normal, except that the world is shared with ghosts, and one of them appears to be trying to kill her.

items.title: The Courier
items.description: In this intense action-thriller starring Academy Award® winner Gary Oldman and Olga Kurylenko, a female motorcycle courier must fight off a sadistic crime boss's henchmen in order to protect the one witness that can bring him down.

items.title: Love, Weddings & Other Disasters
items.description: Diane Keaton, Jeremy Irons, and Maggie Grace lead this warmhearted romantic comedy that follows a colorful cast of characters searching for love against the backdrop of a wedding.

items.title: The Angel Levine
items.description: A sentimental tale of an elderly Jewish tailor (Zero Mostel) who has lost his faith in God and himself. Enter a Jewish angel (Harry Belafonte), on probation, who must earn his wings by convincing the tailor that life does have meaning.

items.title: Chaos
items.description: Dos policías, un novato (Phillippe) y un veterano de cabellos grises (Statham), persiguen a un hábil ladrón de bancos (Snipes).

items.title: Whale Sharks…Gentle Giants
items.description: Whale Sharks, gentle giants of the sea, are nearly 50 feet in length and weigh over 30 tons! With recent technology, researchers can identify, catalogue and track individual sharks. Whale shark tourism has proven to be both a blessing and a curse.

items.title: Certain Prey
items.description: Minneapolis Deputy Police Chief, Lucas Davenport, has to face off against a duo unlike any he's ever encountered - a lethal hit woman and a ferociously cunning killer determined to hunt him down.

items.title: A Holiday to Remember
items.description: Carolyn leaves the big city with her daughter Jordi for her childhood village. She meets her former fiance and finds a lost boy who she wants to adopt, but Jordi is not too keen on the idea.

items.title: Maximum Overdrive
items.description: After a mysterious comet turns every machine on Earth into a homicidal rampage device, the survivors at the Dixie Boy Truck Stop are making a stand, and human vengeance goes into overdrive.

items.title: Tender Mercies
items.description: Winner of two Academy Awards®, TENDER MERCIES is a compassionate love story tracing the relationship between a burnt-out country western star and the young widow he meets in a small Texas motel.

items.title: El cuerpo del delito
items.description: Tras una noche de pasión desenfrenada, Rebecca Carlson (Madonna) será juzgada por asesinato. Ahora está en manos de su abogado (Willem Dafoe) demostrar su inocencia, aunque el camino hacia la verdad tiene tantas curvas como su seductora cliente.

items.title: Equilibrium (ESP)
items.description: En el futuro, la humanidad ha prohibido cosas que producen emociones como la literatura, la música y el arte, para mantenerlo, un grupo especial de policías eliminará a los transgresores. Christian Bale protagoniza esta increíble película de acción.

items.title: A Toda Madre
items.description: Barbra Streisand y Seth Rogen son el dúo cómico perfecto al embarcarse en un gran viaje. Cuando Andy invita a su madre a un viaje de 8 días y 4800 kilómetros por el país, cuanto más lejos viajan, más cercanos se vuelven.

items.title: Mátame suavemente
items.description: Al rojo vivo, Heather Graham (Boogie Nights) y Joseph Fiennes (Shakespeare in Love) como nunca antes, en esta odisea sexual acerca de los poderes adictivos y mortales de la pasión ilícita. Algo muy bueno puede resultar mortal.

items.title: Tranquil Fireplace (Signature)
items.description: Settle down with a book and hot drink and enjoy this beautifully authentic crackling fireplace. Joined by a resting boxer dog relaxing on a fluffy rug, this scene creates a perfectly tranquil and warm atmosphere in your home.

items.title: California Dreaming (ESP)
items.description: Una familia de Omaha decide tomar las vacaciones de sus sueños en una casa móvil rumbo a California, sin imaginarse que sus peores pesadillas están a punto de comenzar.

items.title: Escobar: Paradise Lost
items.description: A young surfer, Nick, falls madly in love with a beautiful girl. It all seems perfect until he meets her uncle, the famous drug kingpin Pablo Escobar.

items.title: 16-Love
items.description: Ally “Smash” Mash, de 16 años, vive entre las líneas blancas cuidadosamente pintadas del tenis juvenil.

items.title: Tesoro escondido del Mississippi
items.description: Dos niños son testigos de un asesinato pero deciden no contárselo a nadie por miedo.

items.title: A Killer Within
items.description: Addison Terrill (Howell), a Dallas attorney, comes home one night to find his wife brutally murdered with the words "we're even now" scrawled across the bedroom wall.

items.title: Rare Beasts
items.description: Mandy (Billie Piper) is a nihilistic young writer and mother who, while navigating her dysfunctional family and misogynistic workplace, falls for Pete (Leo Bill), a traditionalist searching for 'restored' male identity.

items.title: Guilty
items.description: Caught in a web of deceit, Traci is thrown into dager after she lies for a friend about an innocent teacher who commits suicide.

items.title: Fatal Lessons: The Good Teacher
items.description: A woman finds her life unraveling after she makes friends with her daughter's teacher.

items.title: Plan A
items.description: The true story of a group of Jewish vigilantes who survive the holocaust and vow to avenge their people - "an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth."

items.title: GoodFellas
items.description: Director Martin Scorsese exposes the fascinating, mysterious, and violent underworld of New York's Mafia families through the life of insider Henry Hill.

items.description: A slice of life film about a kid who must decide between choosing the future his father wants, or following his dream of becoming a pro skater.

items.title: Envy
items.description: A man becomes increasingly jealous of his friend's newfound success.

items.title: A Father's Nightmare
items.description: Reeling from the recent death of his wife, Matt sends his daughter Lisa off to college, where she is manipulated by her older roommate Vanessa, and grows apart from Matt. Will Matt figure out what's really going on before it's too late?

items.title: The Ward
items.description: An institutionalized young woman becomes terrorized by a ghost.

items.title: Things Behind The Sun
items.description: A young music journalist's dark memories are awakened when he goes to interview a female rock singer, and both are forced to confront troubling secrets from their pasts.

items.title: Fanboys
items.description: A group of Star Wars fans travel to Skywalker Ranch to steal a copy of 'The Phantom Menace,' so that their terminally ill friend can see it before its release in theaters several months down the line.

items.title: Operation Condor II: The Armour of the God
items.description: ! Jackie Chan es una cazafortunas, cuya exnovia es secuestrada por un culto malvado! Luego, la situación se acelera cuando su prometido, un viejo amigo de Jackie, recurre a él en busca de ayuda.

items.title: El último paseo triunfal
items.description: Un chico, su nueva amiga, su abuela y su viejo vecino que solía trabajar de chófer para un mafioso, buscan el tesoro supuestamente oculto hace mucho tiempo por el delincuente, para ayudar al vecino a conservar su casa.

items.title: Los recién llegados
items.description: Un niño de 12 años y su familia comienzan su vida en una nueva ciudad.

items.title: El club de los espíritus traviesos
items.description: Un grupo de niños descubren un fantasma amigo llamado Carolyn, que acecha en un bosque cercano, e intentan idear un plan para capturarla.

items.title: Twin Betrayal
items.description: A struggling single mother, in the midst of a fierce custody battle, is framed for the murder of her wealthy father by her ambitious identical twin.

items.title: The Perfect Student
items.description: Nicole Johnson is a well-respected criminology professor. When one of her students is accused of the brutal slaying of her roommate, Nicole is the only person who believes she is innocent and begins to investigate the murder.

items.title: Deadly Delusion
items.description: Hoping for a fresh start, Julia moves to Los Angeles with her boyfriend. After settling into a fancy new home, it seems her demons have come back to haunt her when mysterious things begin to happen.

items.title: Revenge
items.description: A woman hires a man to remodel her home and quickly starts to grow suspicious of his intentions.

items.title: A Royal Christmas on Ice
items.description: Looking to escape his Royal life, a dashing prince comes to the United States to start a business in a small town in upstate New York and winds up falling for a former Olympic ice skater.

items.title: Christmas in Palm Springs
items.description: Two kids scheme to get their parents back together again. Soon, the father realizes he is still in love and will do anything to charm himself back into her life.

items.title: Banksy Most Wanted
items.description: An in depth look into one of the art world's biggest unanswered mysteries -- who is Banksy?

items.title: Florida Keys Protecting Paradise
items.description: The story of conservation and sustainability in the Florida Keys for the past 100 years.

items.title: Florida Keys Real Blue Chill

items.description: After their high school graduation, Peter realizes he is in love with his neighbor and childhood friend, Erica.

items.title: A Star Is Born
items.description: Man meets a shy, young country girl (Janet Gaynor), falls in love, marries her and then helps her to become a big star.

items.title: 17th Airborne: The Bulge To The Rhine
items.description: 5 vets of the 681st Glider Field Artillery Battalion tell their Band of Brothers tale from the Bulge to the Rhine.

items.title: Perfume de violetas (LAS)
items.description: Dos adolescentes entablan una profunda amistad hasta que una de ellas es violada. La indiferencia y el egoísmo de los adultos rompen el fraterno vínculo y las orillan a la tragedia.

items.title: World War Z
items.description: World War Z is the fast-paced, pulse-pounding epic of the potential last days of the human race. Former United Nations employee Gerry Lane (Brad Pitt) is called in to help stop the pandemic from spreading worldwide.

items.title: Avión de combate
items.description: La historia de cinco pilotos que se entrenan para convertirse en "los mejores pilotos" y los obstáculos que deben superar para alcanzar su objetivo.

items.description: When Hurricane Katrina hits, a young father (PAUL WALKER) must take extreme measures to protect his newborn baby in their evacuated and darkened hospital.

items.title: No Escape
items.description: A soldier convicted of murdering his commanding officer is dumped on a prison island and left to fend for himself.

items.title: Meteorito: primer impacto

items.title: Rise of the Great White Shark
items.description: The Great White Shark has been here for millions of years. How did it come to be one of the world's most ingenious predators? Rise of the Great White Shark takes an in depth look into the events and adaptations that helped sharks dominate the sea.

items.description: Things seem bleak for fisherman Zosimo and his family until the world's biggest fish, the whale shark, comes along and changes everything.

items.title: Sharks: The Big Five

items.title: Rescate el día de la Tierra

items.title: Zig Zag
items.description: An autistic 15-year-old boy steals money from his boss to provide rent for his abusive father, who uses the money to repay a loan shark.

items.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
items.description: When Russia's first nuclear submarine malfunctions on its maiden voyage, the crew must race to save the ship and prevent a nuclear disaster.

items.title: The Crow: Salvation

items.title: Wuthering Heights (1970)
items.description: A passionate adaptation of Emily Brontë’s superbly strange and hauntingly enduring classic novel, starring Timothy Dalton and Anna Calder-Marshall as the doomed and deathless lovers, Heathcliff and Cathy. Directed by Robert Fuest.

items.title: Fitzwilly
items.description: It’s handmaiden-to-footservant combat when secretary Barbara Feldon attempts to scuttle butler Dick Van Dyke right out of the heist business in this spirited comedy that also stars John McGiver, Norman Fell, Sam Waterston and Edith Evans.

items.title: A Chance Encounter
items.description: In a Sicilian town an aspiring poet in search of inspiration meets a folk singer.

items.title: Alice Upside Down
items.description: An 11-year-old girl moves to a suburb of Washington, D.C. with her father Ben and her 17-year-old brother Lester.

items.title: Bandslam
items.description: Music-obsessed misfits (Aly Michalka, Vanessa Hudgens, Gaelan Connell) cope with high school life by forming a band for the big Bandslam competition.

items.title: Lady Gaga - Lady Gaga: Unauthorized Biography
items.description: Known for her image reinventions and musical versatility, Lady Gaga is an American singer, songwriter, and actress. Lady Gaga began performing as a teenager, singing at open mic nights and acting in school plays.

items.title: AKA Tommy Chong

items.title: Chuck Berry - The Original King Of Rock 'n' Roll

items.description: Tragedy strikes as two ruthless brothers kidnap a bride during her wedding. Hurt and angry, H.H. Hart (Tony Anthony) begins his quest to find the love he lost, and take vengeance upon the wicked. Presented in 2D.

items.title: Atomic: History Of The A-bomb
items.description: Documenting the discovery that changed everything.

items.title: Ben Gurion, Epilogue
items.description: A revealing portrait of David Ben-Gurion, founder of Israel and one of modern history's political giants based on never-seen archival material.

items.title: Bush - Live In Tampa

items.title: Edith Wharton: The Sense Of Harmony

items.title: I Danced For The Angel Of Death: The Dr. Edith Eva Eger Story
items.description: The Dr. Edith Eva Eger Story

items.description: Every time the Blood Theatre opened for business, someone died. But this time, the theater has a good feeling about its chances! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by RiffTrax.

items.title: RiffTrax: Bounty Tracker

items.title: RiffTrax: Contamination
items.description: Delivered straight from Mars to a mysterious abandoned boat to the sewers of New York City to your very own home! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary from RiffTrax (formerly of MST3K).

items.title: RiffTrax: Feeders 2 Slay Bells
items.description: If you ever wanted to see the Feeders take on Santa Claus and his reindeer you'll be very happy! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from RiffTrax (formerly of MST3K).

items.title: RiffTrax: Hijacked Flight 285
items.description: Here's the good news: Hijacked: Flight 285 will still make sense even if you haven't seen any of the previous 284 movies in the Hijacked: Flight series. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic from RiffTrax.

items.title: RiffTrax: Day of the Shorts SF Sketchfest 2019
items.description: Live from SF Sketchfest, it's Day of the Shorts: Sketchfest 2019! This feature is a parody and contains the original shorts combined with a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from RiffTrax (formerly of MST3K) and other comedy guests.

items.title: Guy Martin: D-Day Landing
items.description: To mark the 75th anniversary of D-Day, Guy Martin restores a Dakota plane and parachutes into the Normandy countryside where the operation occurred.

items.title: Hitler: A Strategy of Failure
items.description: Adolf Hitler, considered himself to be the world's greatest military strategist - superior even to Napoleon Bonaparte - and early Blitzkrieg successes could be said to easily confirm this assertion.

items.title: RiffTrax: The Most Dangerous Game
items.description: The Most Dangerous Game encounters problems right out of the gate when it turns out to NOT be about playing Twister nude with an angry badger. This feature contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary from RiffTrax (formerly of MST3K).

items.title: RiffTrax: The Power
items.description: Join Mike, Kevin, Bill, and a harmless little tiki idol that Kevin brought back from Hawaii for The Power! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by RiffTrax (formerly of MST3K).

items.title: RiffTrax: The Shape of Things to Come
items.description: Choose your jumpsuit wisely and get on board with Mike, Kevin, and Bill for a geometrical taste of The Shape of Things to Come! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary from RiffTrax.

items.title: RiffTrax: The Million Eyes of Sumuru
items.description: Bring a straw so you can drink up The Blood of Fu Manchu! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

items.title: RiffTrax: Sunset Strip
items.description: The protagonist rides around the Sunset Strip on a motorcycle, and he's trying to help a friend keep his sleazy nightclub open. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary from RiffTrax.

items.title: RiffTrax: The Girl From Rio
items.description: The Girl From Rio is about the island nation of Femina, which is inhabited by superwomen. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary from RiffTrax (formerly of MST3K).

items.title: RiffTrax: The Visitor
items.description: A baffling mess, as incoherent as it is unintentionally funny. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from RiffTrax (formerly of Mystery Science Theater 3000).

items.title: RiffTrax: The Sorcerers Apprentice
items.description: No, it's not the terrible Sorcerer's Apprentice movie with Nicolas Cage, come on, we wouldn't do that to you.

items.title: RiffTrax: Velvet Smooth
items.description: Is Velvet Smooth, a 1970s blaxploitation heroine, or a new yogurt brand full of decadent flavors? It's the former, so put down your spoons and get groovy! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic from RiffTrax.

items.title: RiffTrax: Yesterday's Target
items.description: Way back in 1996, the stars aligned and gave us Yesterday's Target, a TV movie starring LeVar Burton, Malcolm McDowell, and a Baldwin brother! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by RiffTrax.

items.title: RiffTrax: Zombie I Eat Your Skin
items.description: A more accurate title would have been I Occasionally Chop Off Heads With a Machete Because I'm The Voodoo Kind Of Zombie, Not The BRAAAAINS Kind. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary from RiffTrax.

items.title: Heartthrob
items.description: Henry is overjoyed to fall into an unexpected romance with popular Samantha the summer after high school graduation. When Henry spirals into twisted obsession, Samantha pulls back. Now he will never let her go, and things get dangerous.

items.title: Deviant Love
items.description: A woman is charmed by a handsome man with a dark family secret who will do anything, including murder, to keep her forbidden love.

items.title: Love On Repeat
items.description: A woman repeats the same day over and over as she tries to get back together with her boyfriend but finds love in unexpected places.

items.title: Jason Fox: Return To Afghanistan
items.description: Former elite Special Forces soldier Jason Fox embarks on a highly personal journey back to Afghanistan, nearly a decade after he last set foot in the country where he endured harrowing combat experiences during multiple tours of duty.

items.title: Kindred Spirits
items.description: A woman will stop at nothing to remove everyone from her beloved big sister's life so she can finally have her sister all to herself.

items.title: Love At Sky Gardens
items.description: A barista and event planner team up to plan a rooftop garden wedding and find love in the process.

items.title: Special Forces: Beijing Special Combat Brigade
items.description: This is a heart-stopping journey into Asia’s elite Special Forces, from brutal training to cutting-edge combat capabilities: experience the endurance.

items.title: Jupiter 2032
items.description: In a near future run by one world government and mass propaganda, children suddenly acquire the ability to connect to the planet Jupiter. While they learn how to master higher human potential, the planet Earth 'shifts' into a new awakening.

items.title: Betrayed: Surviving an American Concentration Camp
items.description: During WWII, Japanese-American citizens were unconstitutionally incarcerated in mass by the U.S. government, purely on the basis of race.

items.title: Cradles for Cash
items.description: When Kelly's newborn baby is stolen from the hospital where she works, she teams up with Gloria, also a victim of baby abduction, to get her child back from a black market adoption ring.

items.title: Hitler: A Journey Through His World Then And Now
items.description: Historian Bob Carruthers directs this documentary looking into the world of Adolf Hitler.

items.title: Fukushima: Robots in Hell
items.description: On the 11th of March 20t11, an earthquake and a tsunami led to to the most serious nuclear accident of the century. On the heels of explosions, radioactivity levels reached record highs.

items.title: La isla mínima
items.description: Se producen una serie de crímenes brutales contra chicas adolescentes en un paraje remoto del sur de España. Dos detectives, con personalidades contrapuestas, son designados para investigar.

items.title: Darryl Jones: In The Blood
items.description: Follows the evolution of Jones, who grew up on the South Side of Chicago.

items.title: Waiting For The Barbarians
items.description: At an isolated frontier outpost, a colonial magistrate of an unnamed empire suffers a crisis of conscience.

items.title: El Cuerpo
items.description: Un detective busca el cuerpo de una mujer fatal después de que desaparece de la morgue.

items.title: The Youth Governor
items.description: The Youth Governor is the story of the candidacy, campaign, and election of the 72nd California Youth Governor.

items.title: Dinner Rush
items.description: It's just another evening at the huge Italian restaurant of proprietor and bookmaker Louis Cropa in New York.

items.title: Vivir es fácil con los ojos cerrados
items.description: El año 1966, en España, un profesor de inglés es acompañado por dos mochileros en su misión de conocer a John Lennon.

items.title: Stay Prayed Up
items.description: A spirited celebration of 83-year-old Lena Mae Perry and her legendary North Carolina gospel group The Branchettes.

items.title: Ben is Back
items.description: 19 year-old Ben Burns unexpectedly returns home to his family's suburban home. His mother, Holly, is relieved but wary of her son staying clean. Over a turbulent day, truths are revealed, and her love for her son is tested as she tries to keep him safe.

items.title: It's A Boy Girl Thing
items.description: The next door neighbors Nell Bedworth and Woody Deane have opposite behaviors and hate each other.

items.title: Between Friends
items.description: A reunion of five university friends, seven years later, seems like a great idea. But old friends know all your secrets, and some of them won't shut up.

items.title: WWI's First Frontline Cameraman
items.description: Geoffrey Herbert Malins is history's first war ‘kinematographer.’ The documentary he shot during WWI's Battle of the Somme drew 20 million viewers.

items.title: After Darkness
items.description: Natalia Dyer ('Stranger Things') and Kyra Sedgwick ('The Closer') highlight this apocalyptic sci-fi thriller about a family’s fight to survive a solar disaster.

items.title: Queenpins
items.description: A housewife from the suburbs and her closest companion transform a pastime into an elaborate operation involving counterfeit coupons, resulting in millions of dollars.

items.title: Wicker Man (1973)
items.description: When a young girl mysteriously disappears, police sergeant Howie travels to a remote Scottish island to investigate. But this pastoral community, led by the strange Lord Summerisle, is not at all what it seems.

items.title: The Journeyman
items.description: Orphaned since he and his brother were boys, a man tries to find and redeem the other who is now an outlaw in the Wild West.

items.title: The Sanctity Of Space
items.description: Climbers/filmmakers Renan Ozturk and Freddie Wilkinson retrace the steps of pioneering mountaineer and aerial photographer Bradford Washburn.

items.title: We Are As Gods
items.description: A compelling deep dive into the many sides of Stewart Brand - creator of The Whole Earth Catalog.

items.title: Above Suspicion
items.description: Emilia Clarke ('Game of Thrones') stars in this riveting crime-thriller based on the true story of an FBI agent and an informant on a collision course with deadly consequences.

items.title: MST3K: The Giant Spider Invasion
items.description: Mike and the 'bots suffer through The Giant Spider Invasion (1975).

items.title: Next of Kin
items.description: When the mob murders policeman Truman Gates' younger brother, Gates is torn between his desire to uphold the law and his lust for revenge. But Gates' older brother will not be satisfied until every member of the Chicago mob is dead.

items.title: The Wolf of Snow Hollow
items.description: A small-town sheriff and his lackluster team of officers must solve a series of brutal murders that are occurring on the full moon. As he's consumed by the hunt for the killer, he struggles to remind himself that there's no such thing as werewolves…

items.title: MST3K: The Atomic Brain
items.description: A rich, elderly woman wants her doctor to transplant her brain into the body of one of her young captives.

items.title: Memento
items.description: A man with short-term memory loss attempts to track down his wife's murderer.

items.title: Three Amigos!
items.description: Steve Martin, Chevy Chase and Martin Short are three wild and crazy caballeros in this comedy adventure that’s a fiesta of fun. Co-starring Phil Hartman and Jon Lovitz, the '¡Three Amigos!' blaze a side-splitting trail across the comedy frontier!

items.title: MST3K: Bride Of The Monster
items.description: Horror cinema icons Bela Lugosi and Tor Johnson star in this Ed Wood classic as the crazed Dr. Vornoff and his beastly assistant Lobo, who conduct heinous experiments on human victims in an effort to create a race of atomic super-beings.

items.title: Propaganda Swing - Dr. Goebbels' Jazz Orchestra
items.description: In the twisted annals of the Third Reich, few stories are so improbable as that of "Charlie and his Orchestra." Even as Nazis campaigned against "degenerate" jazz music, persecuting musicians and throwing "swing kids" into concentration camps.

items.title: Sight: The Story Of Vision
items.description: An in depth look at the science, medicine, and technology of vision and individuals who are battling blindness. Narrated by Elton John.

items.title: Pistol Packin' Mama: The Missions Of A B-17
items.description: 5 crew members of Betty Boop/Pistol Packin' Mama relate what it was like in the grim early days of daylight bombing. Members of the 390th Bomb Group, they led their squadron and sometimes the entire 8th Air Force into action.

items.title: Muhammad Ali & Bert Sugar - Sweet Ali With Bert Sugar
items.description: The Story of Muhammad Ali, told by Bert Sugar, from his beginning as Cassius Clay to his passing as the immortal legend.

items.title: Margaret Fuller: Transatlantic Revolutionary
items.description: Biography of a leading female 19th century intellect, cohort of Thoreau and Emerson, embeds in Italian Revolution.

items.title: Operation Paperclip: The Secret Recruitment
items.description: NASA's shocking connection to Nazi Germany

items.title: Pershing's Paths Of Glory
items.description: Honor - Acceptance - Integrity

items.title: Atlas of a Changing Earth
items.description: This award-winning MagellanTV original explores alarming changes to Earth's features and climate and reveals a vision of slowing environmental change.

items.title: MST3K: The Beast Of Yucca Flats
items.description: After a devastating atomic test, Joseph Javorsky, a defecting Russian scientist, is transformed into a murderous radioactive beast. Can desert patrolmen Jim Archer and Joe Dobson stop the creature before it kills again?

items.title: Jingle Bells
items.description: A merry elf reveals how a loving farm family learns that the very best holiday gifts come from the heart. Voices of this animated tale include Jason Alexander and Don Knotts.

items.title: The Bear Who Slept Through Christmas
items.description: While the rest of the world is getting ready for Christmas, all the bears in Bearbank are getting ready to sleep… except for Ted E. Bear. Ted gets curious about Christmas, so he learns the meaning from Santa Claus himself.

items.title: Tower of London
items.description: Vincent Price shines as Richard of Gloucester, the ambitious brother to a dying king. When he is overlooked to take the throne, he goes on a murderous rampage...only for the ghosts of those he has slain to return from the grave and haunt him!

items.title: Allied
items.description: When Intelligence Officer Max Vatan (Brad Pitt) learns his wife (Academy Award winner Marion Cotillard) may be conspiring with the enemy, he has only 72 hours to prove her innocence and save his family before he must do the unthinkable.

items.title: Eagle Eye
items.description: Shia LaBeouf and Michelle Monaghan star as two strangers trying to escape danger when they are ripped from their ordinary lives and 'activated' as part of a hightech assassination plot.

items.title: Selena
items.description: Young. Beautiful. Enormously gifted. At 23, Selena shone as a fresh star in a vibrantly new musical field. But just as she was poised to be the next pop-music sensation, her life was tragically cut short.

items.title: Alias María
items.description: A través de los ojos de María, una niña guerrillera de 13 años de edad, veremos el desolador panorama del conflicto armado en Colombia: una guerra peleada por niños.

items.title: La virgen de agosto (LAS)
items.description: Eva decide quedarse durante agosto en Madrid, todo un acto de fe, para poder ver y sentir las cosas de otra manera y encontrar nuevas oportunidades.

items.title: Rockula
items.description: Ralph is a vampire with music in his veins – and a curse on his head. Every 22 years, he is doomed to lose his soulmate, Mona, at the hands of a crazy pirate. But now, with his new band Rockula, Ralph is going to crush the curse once and for all!

items.title: MST3K: The Robot vs. The Aztec Mummy
items.description: Scientists search for the ancient breastplate of a mummy, culminating in a mad scientist's attempt to fight the creature through the construction of a robot.

items.title: MST3K: I Accuse My Parents
items.description: A young man gets mixed up with a crime syndicate and blames his inattentive parents. The 1940s-era documentary short explains the then-new techniques that enabled farmers to rush produce to market.

items.title: MST3K: Fugitive Alien
items.description: Movie constructed from two episodes of a Japanese television show. An alien marauder becomes a fugitive from his planet Valnar's Star, then joins the Earth spaceship Bacchus 3 to fight against his former masters.

items.title: Sayonara
items.description: Marlon Brando stars as an Air Force Major who faces prejudice when he falls in love with a Japanese actress while stationed in Japan. Winner of 4 Academy Awards® including Best Supporting Actor and Actress nods to Red Buttons and Miyoshi Umeki .

items.title: MST3K: Catalina Caper
items.description: Two college boys enjoy Catalina Island sunshine, scuba diving, and beach 'bunnies', while another boy's con-artist parents scheme to sell a stolen scroll.

items.title: Acantilado
items.description: Un hombre viaja desde Londres hasta las Islas Canarias en busca de su hermana menor, quien desapareció después de un suicidio en masa de un culto del que formaba parte.

items.title: MST3K: Santa Claus Conquers The Martians
items.description: Martians abduct Santa Claus and two human children in hopes of bringing Christmas to their planet.

items.title: MST3K: First Spaceship On Venus
items.description: A multinational team of astronauts heads to Venus, but finds a world destroyed by nuclear war.

items.title: Rush Hour

items.title: Rush Hour 3

items.title: The Pelican Brief

items.title: A Time to Kill
items.description: Old ways die hard. It's the lesson learned by Carl Lee Hailey, a Mississippi factory worker, when two racist thugs brutally assault his ten-year-old daughter on a drunken spree.

items.title: The Client
items.description: The Mafia wants to keep 11-year-old Mark Sway quiet, and a federal prosecutor wants to learn exactly what he knows. So Mark finds a lawyer who's smart and tough, and she wants to help him. If he can only trust her…

items.title: Free Fire
items.description: When a black market arms deal goes outrageously wrong, Justine (Brie Larson) finds herself caught in the crossfire, forced to navigate a warehouse full of trigger-happy madmen all hanging on for dear life in this hilarious action-comedy.

items.title: Last Vegas
items.description: Four lifelong best friends head to Las Vegas with a plan to stop acting their age and relive their glory days. Upon arriving, they quickly realize that the decades have transformed Sin City and tested their friendship in ways they never imagined.

items.title: Echo Boomers
items.description: Michael Shannon stars in this gripping crime-thriller. When Lance Zutterland leaves school in mounting debt, he is pulled into a criminal operation made up of rebellious college graduates who steal from the rich and give back to themselves.

items.title: MST3K: Zombie Nightmare
items.description: A hit-and-run victim is brought back from the dead by a voodoo doctor, and then seeks revenge.

items.title: Música en espera
items.description: Un compositor y una mujer embarazada se ayudan el uno al otro para solucionar sus problemas.

items.title: MST3K: Mad Monster
items.description: Things get hairy on the Satellite of Love thanks to the lupine antics of The Mad Monster (1942) and the second chapter of Radar Men from the Moon (1952).

items.description: Mike and the bots learn the art of safe driving and why you should pay attention at railroad crossings in the 1959 short, Last Clear Chance. Later, they watch government agents use radar technology to catch criminals in Radar Secret Service.

items.title: Gustavo Cisneros: Sin Descanso

items.title: Más negro que la noche
items.description: Cuando Greta hereda la vieja mansión de su excéntrica tía, el único requisito es cuidar del adorado gato de su tía, pero cuando fracasa estrepitosamente en su misión, despierta a los demonios de la casa.

items.title: Jimmy Neutrón: El niño genio
items.description: Durante la noche, los extraterrestres llegan a la tierra en sus naves espaciales y secuestran a todos los padres del pueblo de Jimmy, Retroville. Jimmy debe rescatar a los padres secuestrados.

items.title: The Promotion (LAS)
items.description: Dos asistentes del gerente principal de una corporación de supermercados, compiten entre sí para ganarse un ascenso en la compañía.

items.title: Lynyrd Skynyrd - Gone With The Wind
items.description: This film revisits the story of Lynyrd Skynyrd in a manner previously unattempted. Using a mixture of new and archive interviews, contributions from band members and those closest to the group.

items.title: Lynyrd Skynyrd - I'll Never Forget You: The Last 72 Hours Of Lynyrd Skynyrd
items.description: I'll Never Forget You: The Last 72 Hours of Lynyrd Skynyrd chronicles the story of three survivors: security guard Gene Odom, lead backup singer Leslie Hawkins and guitar tech Craig Reed.

items.title: Donnie Darko (Theatrical Cut)
items.description: After narrowly escaping a bizarre accident, a troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a man in a large rabbit suit who manipulates him to commit a series of crimes.

items.title: Perdita Durango
items.description: Rosie Perez and Academy Award winner Javier Bardem star in this “amoral love story” (DVD Talk) filled with human sacrifices, kidnapping, murder, fetus trafficking and the dogged DEA agent (James Gandolfini) on the trail of it all.

items.title: El último traje
items.description: Abraham, un sastre judío de 88 años, emprende un largo viaje en busca del hombre que lo salvó de una muerte segura durante el Holocausto, en los últimos alientos del nazismo.

items.title: El Alien y yo
items.description: Una banda de punk contrata a Pepe, un tecladista con síndrome de Down, pero es tan talentoso que termina por opacarlos en el escenario.

items.title: Bala mordida
items.description: Mauro Hernández es un joven policía que bajo las órdenes de su comandante se ve involucrado en un intercambio de droga.

items.title: Public Enemy - Welcome To The Terrordome
items.description: Public Enemy's 20 year career has had a monumental impact on the music world. This film chronicles their legacy and history, while revealing what icons of the music world say about their influence.

items.title: Sheryl Crow - Live At The Capitol Theater
items.description: On November 10, 2017, at the historic Capitol Theatre in Port Chester New York, Sheryl Crow played the final night of her Be Myself tour.

items.title: Alone (2020)
items.description: During a global pandemic, a man must battle swarming hordes of the undead to rescue a female neighbor. This zombie horror tale stars Tyler Posey, Summer Spiro, and Donald Sutherland.

items.title: Old Friends: A Dogumentary
items.description: The paw-inspiring tale of the Old Friends Senior Dog Sanctuary, a place where love never grows old.

items.description: Three lighthouse keepers on a remote Scottish isle discover a chest full of gold — and are ensnared in a web of greed, paranoia, and murder. Starring Gerard Butler.

items.title: Murder In The Front Row: The San Francisco Bay Area Thrash Metal Story
items.description: In the early 1980's, a small group of dedicated Bay Area headbangers shunned the hard rock of MTV and Hollywood hairspray bands in favor of a more dangerous brand of metal that became known as thrash! Director Adam Dubin captures the rocking early days.

items.title: The Bug: Life And Times Of The People's Car
items.description: This film explores the history of the Volkswagen Beetle and the intense emotional connection it has with its owners past and present.

items.title: They Survived Together
items.description: A 2022 EMMY WINNER. The true story of the Neiger family's miraculous escape from certain death by the Nazis during World War II.

items.title: Seniors: A Dogumentary
items.description: An old dog can teach you new tricks!

items.title: The Holstein Dilemma
items.description: What the heck is a heritage breed, anyway, and why should we all care?

items.title: Secrets & Mysteries Of Christopher Columbus
items.description: Christopher Columbus Might Not Be Who You Think He Was.

items.title: The Changeling
items.description: A Manhattan composer moves to a secluded Victorian mansion when he is consumed by grief after his wife and daughter are killed in a shocking accident.

items.title: Pistoleros - Pistoleros: Death, Drugs And Rock N'roll
items.description: Inspiring story of brothers Mark and Lawrence Zubia who grew up in a Mexican-American family in Arizona. Playing as young kids in their father's Mariachi band, they formed several leading bands of the 90's Tempe music scene made famous by Billboard.

items.title: Phenomena
items.description: The young Jennifer Corvino (played by Oscar-winning actress Jennifer Connelly) is sent to a private Swiss academy for girls where a killer is on the loose, brutally murdering students. Jennifer is a "gifted" girl with a strange ability...

items.title: Michael Jackson: Unauthorized Biography
items.description: Michael Jackson was an American singer, songwriter, and dancer. Dubbed the "King of Pop", he is regarded as one of the most significant cultural figures of the 20th century. Presented by Wiki.Film.

items.title: Primal (2019)
items.description: A hunter (Nicolas Cage) must fight for his life on a ship when his deadly animals — including a rare white jaguar — are set loose by a dangerous criminal out to kill everyone on board.

items.title: Take Me Home Tonight

items.title: War on Everyone

items.title: When Liberty Burns

items.title: Miley Cyrus: Unauthorized Biography
items.description: Miley Cyrus is an American singer, songwriter, and actress. Noted for her distinctive raspy voice, her music incorporates elements of varied styles and genres, including pop, country pop, hip hop, experimental, and rock. Presented by Wiki.Film.

items.title: Stevie Ray Vaughan - 1984-1989: Lonestar
items.description: The Full, Previously Un-Told Story Of Stevie Ray Vaughan's Glory Years

items.title: Pizza, A Love Story

items.title: Nobody Famous
items.description: Set against the backdrop of the socially and politically volatile 1960s, Nobody Famous traces the quick rise and steady fall of the 60s folk/pop trio, The Pozo Seco Singers.

items.title: Adventures of a Mathematician
items.description: Polish immigrant and talented mathematician, Stan Ulam, moves to the US in the 1930s. When he loses his fellowship at Harvard, an intriguing job offer takes him and his wife to New Mexico where Stan begins top secret work on developing the nuclear bomb.

items.title: Transmutators
items.description: A rebel group of survivors must embrace mega fighting machines to take on intergalactic invaders threatening humanity.

items.title: The Ten Commandments
items.description: In this animated adaptation of the Bible, Moses hears the voice of God from a burning bush, which inspires him to confront Egypt's pharaoh and demand freedom for the Israelite slaves.

items.title: Sin ley
items.description: Shia LaBeouf, Tom Hardy y Jessica Chastain protagonizan esta adaptación de la novela basada en hechos reales “El condado más húmedo del mundo”. Una banda de contrabandistas que huyen hacia el sueño norteamericano durante la “Ley Seca”.

items.title: El rostro oscuro de la ley
items.description: “Del autor de Training Day”, llega este excelente drama sobre policías corruptos, ambientado en los días previos a los disturbios en la ciudad de Los Ángeles.

items.title: Guerrero americano
items.description: Michael Dudikoff es Joe Armstrong, una máquina de pelear que sirve en el Ejército para evitar cumplir condena. Él sera obligado a enfrentarse con la mortífera Orden de la Estrella Negra y con los líderes militares para acabar con la venta ilegal de armas.

items.title: Asesinos del más allá
items.description: Un profesor de secundaria (Tim Matheson) se enfrenta a los fantasmas demoníacos de una pandilla de exalumnos. Con actuaciones de Brooke Adams, Robert Hy Gorman, Robert Rusler, Nicholas Sadler y William Sanderson. Basada en un relato de Stephen King.

items.title: El Guerrero Americano 4: La Aniquilación
items.description: El guerrero americano regresa a la pantalla en esta cuarta entrega repleta de acción y de artes marciales.

items.title: Especies: el despertar
items.description: Helena Mattsson y Ben Cross protagonizan esta aterradora continuación acerca de una sobrina y su tío que destapan la verdad de sus raíces alienígenas como consecuencia de una oleada de masacres. Dirigida por Nick Lyon.

items.title: Luna de porcelana
items.description: Un apasionado thriller de suspenso sobre un detective veterano en una pequeña ciudad de Florida, cuyo romance clandestino con una viuda joven y rica teje una telaraña de engaño, traición y asesinato.

items.title: La  mitad siniestra
items.description: Thad Beaumont (Timothy Hutton) espera distanciarse de las novelas de terror que escribió bajo el pseudónimo de George Stark. Pero cuando urde el plan para asesinar a Stark, descubre que su alter ego ha iniciado una espeluznante búsqueda de venganza.

items.title: Blood and Chocolate
items.description: Adaptación del relato de la autora Annette Curtis Klause acerca de una joven loba adolescente, que debe elegir entre su amor por un joven humano muy lindo y honrar la lealtad de la manada.

items.title: Mordiscos peligrosos
items.description: Una vampiresa de siglos de edad llega a L.A. para acosar a hombres vírgenes: necesita su sangre para conservar su juventud y su belleza. Sus objetivos se quedan con un gran apetito por hamburguesas crudas y una tendencia a dormir durante el día.

items.title: Abuso de poder
items.description: Cuatro policías agresivos y deshonestos investigan el asesinato de una joven. Cuando descubren que estaba vinculada emocionalmente con su jefe, un destacado general del ejército estadounidense, intentan encubrir el asesinato.

items.title: El guerrero americano II
items.description: En una remota isla caribeña, el soldado Joe Armstrong rescata a un viejo amigo de las garras de 'El León', un malvado criminal que ha secuestrado a un científico para producir en masa un ejército de guerreros ninjas mutantes.

items.title: Wu-Tang Clan - Wu-Tang Saga
items.description: The influential hip-hop group Wu-Tang Clan is the subject of this music-filled documentary that follows the group members, including Method Man, RZA and Ghostface Killah, over a two-year period, with highlights from their "8 Diagrams" tour of 2007.

items.title: Peter, Paul And Mary - Peter, Paul And Mommy Too
items.description: Peter, Paul and Mary continue their folk music magic for children and their families

items.title: The Decemberists - A Practical Handbook
items.description: Live recording of the band in concert in Portland, Oregon in 2005.

items.title: The Little Hours
items.description: In the Middle Ages, a young servant fleeing from his master takes refuge at a convent full of emotionally unstable nuns. Introduced as a deaf mute man, he must fight to hold his cover as the nuns try to resist temptation.

items.title: The Lovers
items.description: A husband and wife, each embroiled in a secret, extramarital affair, are sent reeling when they suddenly fall for the least likely person imaginable—one another—in this scalpel-sharp, deliciously grown-up comedy.

items.title: The Souvenir
items.description: In this exquisite story of first love, a woman falls into an intense, emotionally fraught relationship with a charismatic but untrustworthy older man. Enigmatic and enrapturing, The Souvenir is a lush, dreamlike portrait of young adulthood.

items.title: The Evening Star
items.description: After the death of her daughter, Aurora struggled to keep her family together, but has one grandson in jail, a rebellious granddaughter, and another grandson living just above the poverty line.

items.title: Robocop (2014)
items.description: In 2028 Detroit, when Alex Murphy (Joel Kinnaman) -- a loving husband, father and good cop -- is critically injured in the line of duty, the multinational conglomerate OmniCorp sees their chance for a part-man, part-robot police officer.

items.title: Romeo and Juliet (2013)
items.description: Adapted by Julian Fellowes (Downtown Abbey) from the play by William Shakespeare.

items.title: The Reading
items.description: After a deadly home invasion, Emma (Mo'Nique Hicks) copes by writing a book, but when a young psychic and her team perform a reading in her home, a new terror is unleashed.

items.title: Game Changers
items.description: As Jeopardy marks its 50th anniversary, including 30 years with Alex Trebek, take a look at the phenomenon of game shows, the iconic hosts and personalities, the contestants and the triumphs and controversies.

items.title: MST3K: Gunslinger
items.description: The widow of a murdered sheriff attempts to clean up the crime in her small town with help from the man hired to kill her.

items.title: MST3K: The Day The Earth Froze
items.description: Joel and the Bots learn the ins and outs of the circus in the short Here Comes the Circus (1946) and then try to make sense of the Nordic fairy tale film The Day the Earth Froze (1959).

items.title: Hearts Beat Loud
items.description: A father and daughter form an unlikely songwriting duo in the summer before she leaves for college.

items.title: Funny Thing About Love
items.description: Samantha Banks is a successful business with a handsome fiancee. But over one crazy Thanksgiving Holiday with her scheming family, her whole world is thrown into a tailspin when they invite her ex-boyfriend, "the one that got away".

items.title: Christmas Collision
items.description: Theodora, a time-consumed professional crosses paths with Charlie, a writer, when she travels to his hometown for business just before Christmas. Both are taken by surprise when unexpected circumstances present themselves.

items.title: My Dad's Christmas Date
items.description: A 16-year-old tries to play matchmaker for her widowed father during Christmastime.

items.title: La vela de Navidad
items.description: En Gladsbury, hay una leyenda que dice que cada 25 años un ángel los visita para tocar una vela en la víspera de la Navidad y conceder un milagro a quien la prenda. Pero esto podría cambiar tras la llegada de un joven sacerdote.

items.title: Cupid's Christmas
items.description: As Santa Claus searches for his lost Reindeer (Cupid) in the small town of Holly; the love story of Katie Valentine and Army veteran/firefighter Luke Murphy is re-ignited.

items.title: Soul Santa
items.description: When an unlucky businessman gambles away the mob's money, he's forced to go on the run and hide out as a shopping mall Santa Claus.

items.title: 1618 (ESP)
items.description: The Inquisition continues the persecution of Portuguese Jews.

items.title: The Sound of Christmas
items.description: BET+ ORIGINAL. In this Christmas musical, songbird Montana helps to enlighten others about loss and love when she accepts a job as a nanny to a grieving billionaire two kids.

items.title: A Christmas Vintage
items.description: Samantha will need a Christmas miracle to help her sister, Emily, who cannot be with the one she loves unless Sam tames the shrewd owner of a competing winery.

items.title: A Perfect Christmas Pairing
items.description: While hiding out at her family's winery B&B following a bad review, top chef Grace collides with a worldly travel writer who helps her appreciate her family's Christmas traditions and rediscover her roots.

items.title: The Christmas Clapback
items.description: BET+ ORIGINAL. Three sisters honor their late mother's memory with their annual Christmas cook-off, but a bubbly influencer and a handsome businessman add unexpected spice to the tradition.

items.title: Dear Secret Santa
items.description: Mourning the loss of a friend, a woman receives a surprising Christmas card from a secret admirer.

items.title: A Prince and Pauper Christmas
items.description: A confidential informant goes missing and a young agent hires a look-a-like to play his role.

items.title: A Holiday Heist
items.description: Over Christmas break, a group of college students apprehend a heist by three bumbling thugs.

items.title: Dognapped: Hound for the Holidays
items.description: An assistant of an influencer and a charming vet bond to find a missy puppy before Christmas.

items.title: The Christmas Intern
items.description: A retired mother becomes an intern at her daughter's online gift-giving business and learns the importance of family during the most wonderful time of the year.

items.title: Something's Brewing
items.description: After losing her job and boyfriend on the same day, Jane Peterson vows to leave the city for good. Before she can, a handsome and charming barista helps her rediscover the city.

items.title: The Christmas Gift
items.description: A journalist decides to write a holiday piece about her search for a `Secret Santa' from her childhood whose anonymous gift made a huge impact on her life.

items.title: The Case of the Christmas Diamond
items.description: A woman is accused of stealing a gem and seeks to find the culprit amid a litany of wealthy guests.

items.title: The Flight Before Christmas
items.description: Two strangers who both happen to be in marketing, share a room at a bed-and-breakfast when a snowstorm strands their flight in Montana on Christmas Eve.

items.title: The Search for Secret Santa
items.description: A reporter tries to uncover and bring closure to a long-lost, undelivered gift before Christmas.

items.title: Salto de fé
items.description: Steve Martin interpreta al reverendo Jonas Nightengale, un hombre tramposo que viaja de ciudad en ciudad convenciendo a personas descarriadas y viviendo de sus donativos.

items.title: La Novia
items.description: Desde pequeños, Leonardo, el novio, y la novia han formado un triángulo inseparable. Sin embargo, las cosas se complican cuando el novio y la novia deciden casarse.

items.title: Besos de Azúcar
items.description: Nacho es un niño que intenta sobrevivir los primeros años de su adolescencia como refugiado bailando en una máquina. Su vida cambia drásticamente cuando conoce a Mayra.

items.title: Thanksgiving Roast 2
items.description: Plans go off the rails when Mya reluctantly visits her crazy family with a hired "boyfriend" for Thanksgiving.

items.title: A Christmas Family Secret
items.description: Joan sacrifices family for success. When she surprises her father on Christmas, the real surprise is on her.

items.title: A Thanksgiving Christmas
items.description: "One-Time" begs his sister-in-law to host Christmas for him and his extended family on Thanksgiving day.

items.title: A Christmas Miracle
items.description: When an accident forces her to confront her past, Miracle must face the music, and count her blessings.

items.title: A Coldhearted Christmas
items.description: Family secrets unravel over Thanksgiving. Now Christmas, picking up the pieces is not as simple as they think.

items.title: The Kill Team
items.description: When a young US soldier in Afghanistan witnesses other recruits killing civilians under the direction of a sadistic sergeant, he begins to fear that the men he's serving with might be the ones to kill him.

items.title: Just In Time for the Holidays
items.description: Widowed father, Allen, struggles with grief and parenting, but receives help just in time for the holidays.

items.title: Un asesino anda suelto
items.description: Un asesino en serie está suelto y ha secuestrado al hijo de un agente del FBI que lo persigue. Pero, ¿quién es el asesino? Una historia llena de emociones y sorpresas.

items.title: The Christmas Pledge
items.description: June and Declan, once at odds, are forced to work together at a local TV station to keep June out from under her father's thumb. When their Christmas concert idea fails to save the station, they must look to the heart of the matter.

items.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
items.description: John Rambo is sent on an assignment back to Southeast Asia to uncover evidence of still missing POWs, and ends up with his hands full when he comes up against Vietnamese soldiers still guarding the camps.

items.title: First Blood
items.description: A soft-spoken Vietnam vet drifts into a small town looking for no trouble, but finds it in the form of a psychotic local sheriff who finds pleasure in hating him for no reason.

items.title: Happily
items.description: A happily married couple (Joel McHale and Kerry Bishé) discover their friends are resentful of their lustful relationship. When a visit from a mysterious stranger leads to a dead body, they begin to question the loyalty of their so-called friends.

items.title: A Prince and Pauper Christmas
items.description: Un informante secreto desaparece y un joven agente contrata a un doble para interpretar su papel.

items.title: A Royal Christmas on Ice
items.description: Un príncipe llega al norte del estado de Nueva York para establecer una empresa y se enamora de una ex patinadora olímpica.

items.title: Dognapped: Hound for the Holidays
items.description: Un asistente de influencers y un encantador veterinario forman un equipo para encontrar un cachorro antes de Navidad.

items.title: The Search for Secret Santa
items.description: Un reportero intentará sacar a la luz y resolver sobre un regalo perdido desde hace mucho tiempo que nunca se entregó en Navidad.

items.title: Christmas Time
items.description: A physics teacher who detests Christmas is forced to go with his family to a Christmas-themed resort where an enchanted meeting with Santa helps him overcome his trauma and embrace the Christmas-Time spirit.

items.title: The Case of the Christmas Diamond
items.description: Acusan a una mujer de robar una gema, pero ella buscará al culpable en medio de una letanía de huéspedes ricos.

items.title: La conquista del honor
items.description: Del director ganador del premio de la Academia Clint Eastwood y del ganador del premio de la Academia Steven Spielberg, llega la historia de los seis hombres que izaron la bandera en la Batalla de Iwo Jima, un punto de inflexión en la Segunda Guerra.

items.title: More than Friends
items.description: When Angela, a heterosexual, learns her friend, Tennille, loves her, she is surprised to find that she may feel the same.

items.title: Rambo III
items.description: Rambo refuses to join his friend and former mentor, Colonel Trautman, on a mission to Afghanistan. The mission fails, and Russian troops capture Trautman. Now Rambo must infiltrate the Russian fortress to save his only friend.

items.title: Daddy's Home
items.description: Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father, Dusty (Wahlberg), shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.

items.title: Anchorman 2: The Legend Continues
items.description: The wait is over, America -- Ron Burgundy is back! After losing his job, Ron reassembles the news team and squares off against a new rival in the comedy that critics are calling one of the funniest movies of the year!

items.title: New Year New Us
items.description: Bakari, a record executive on the rise, is laser focused on his career while his wife Imani, a clothing designer who gave up her business for Bakari, is ressuring him to start a family.

items.title: Ping!
items.description: Ping is a chihuahua rescued from the pound by nearsighted Ethel, who thinks he's a cat. When a pair of bumbling thieves try to break into Ethel's house to steal the money they think she has stashed away, only Ping can foil their plans.

items.title: The Magic Pudding
items.description: An old man, a young anthropomorphic koala, a South Pole penguin and Albert, a magic sentient walking and talking bowl of pudding with an attitude are searching for koala's missing parents. However, sinister forces want the pudding.

items.title: Curves Under the Mistletoe
items.description: Faced with trials and tribulations, curvaceous Delight finds love as she makes her way in the world.

items.title: Everybody Hates Christmas
items.description: A family that has lost faith in Christmas, is reminded that the spirit of the holiday is more than just gifts.

items.title: Sleigh Queen
items.description: Sole's Christmas wish is to level up as a stylist, but between work and home, it's hard for a queen to slay.

items.title: For the Love of Christmas 2: A Heart for the Holidays
items.description: Christmas turns out to be more than what Rashad and Annie had in mind when they spend the holiday with family.

items.title: Christmas at the Chateau
items.description: How will 3 sisters save the Shakespeare Chateau, historic mansion and beloved family home, from a corrupt bank that threatens to foreclose on Christmas Day? Especially when one of them falls in love with one of the bankers.

items.title: Flags of Our Fathers
items.description: From Academy Award-winning director Clint Eastwood and Academy Award-winner Steven Spielberg comes the life stories of the six men who raised the flag at The Battle of Iwo Jima, a turning point in WWII.

items.title: Giving Thanks
items.description: When a mother brings her divided family together for Thanksgiving, sparks fly and true thanks is learned. For the Love of Christmas 2

items.title: Norbit
items.description: Murphy stars as mild-mannered Norbit, who gets a second chance at love with his childhood sweetheart, Kate. However, obstacles may make this romance slightly more difficult than expected.

items.title: A Christmas Venue
items.description: Losing faith in Christmas after a rough break-up, Cait heads home where she meets Drew, a handsome handyman, and is thrust into a plan to persuade a wealthy couple to let her host their wedding in order to save her family's bed and breakfast.

items.title: Cazadora
items.description: En un futuro distópico, una madre y su hijo adolescente van de caza a las montañas. El encuentro con un extraño pondrá en juego los roles entre los tres.

items.title: En busca del amor
items.description: Cuando el canal de televisión anuncia que su programa de terapia se está convirtiendo en una fiesta sensacionalista, una psicóloga cariñosa y sincera decide regresar a su ciudad natal y se reúne con su novio de la escuela secundaria.

items.title: Un romance escurridizo
items.description: Una estrella de reality shows deja Hollywood y se encuentra en una comunidad Amish, donde debe decidir entre permanecer en su nueva realidad o regresar a la anterior.

items.title: El sabor del amor
items.description: Alice, una joven y talentosa sous chef del mejor restaurante de Nueva York, recibe una invitación para ser jueza de un concurso de comida para una prestigiosa recaudación de fondos anual.

items.title: Encontrando el amor en Big Sky
items.description: A Paisely le niegan la financiación para renovar el rancho de su abuelo. Sin embargo, le vuelven a presentar a su exnovio, quien ahora es un importante ejecutivo de marketing, y le dará ideas para reunir fondos.

items.title: A Vineyard Christmas
items.description: Heather Marques, host of Tannin TV's popular show: Read Between the Vines, is determined to create the perfect Christmas episode by featuring a unique winery from her hometown in Vermont the specialists in Ice Wine.

items.title: Christmas in Scotland
items.description: On vacation in Scotland, an installation designer finds herself helping a small, rural community create a festive light display, despite the interventions of a wealthy, influential heir who sees Christmas as an inconvenience.

items.title: El encuentro
items.description: Un grupo de amigos encuentran un ovni estrellado con solo un extraterrestre y descubren que el ser tiene grandes secretos de lo que pueden entender.

items.title: Christmas By Candlelight
items.description: Juliet pitches Christmas memory candles to her boss in hopes of earning a promotion and enlists the help of boutique candle store owner, Tom. He refuses at first but agrees when he realizes the money will help make his daughter's Christmas wish come true.

items.title: Christmas Casanova
items.description: Elise is a podcaster in need of catchy Christmas content. Elise agrees to be Daniyal's wing woman and guide. As the two scramble to build the best Christmas ever, it becomes clear that Daniyal might be trying to win over the wrong woman.

items.title: 12 Dares of Christmas
items.description: High school teacher Elara's quiet holiday season gets a jolt of spice when she accepts a 12 Dares of Christmas challenge from her sister while scrambling to ready her town for a Christmas exchange program with suave, opinionated French teacher Gabriel.

items.title: Waking Up to Christmas
items.description: On the verge of a massive deadline, a cynical workaholic is zapped by faulty Christmas lights while stranded in a small Colorado town and finds herself cast as the lead in an over-the-top Hallmark-style holiday movie.

items.title: Hope Street Holiday
items.description: Galia, an Afro Latina attorney, returns home to rediscover her self-worth, the true meaning of family and finds true love.

items.title: Las sanadoras
