items.description: Mujeres corren el riesgo de ir a la cárcel por fabricar cannabis medicinal para sus niños. No pararán de luchar hasta que se legalice el cannabis y se cultive en paz.

items.title: Encontrando el amor en San Antonio
items.description: Adela Romero, una exitosa chef televisiva que vive en Los Ángeles, acaba de terminar la nueva temporada de su programa.

items.title: Encontrando el amor en la montaña
items.description: Después de enterarse de que le han confiado el cuidado de los hijos de su prima fallecida, una arquitecta se debate entre centrarse en su carrera y honrar el deseo de su prima.

items.title: The Christmas Checklist
items.description: A grieving daughter discovers a red envelope from her mom that contains a final request: for her to complete a Christmas Checklist of twelve activities before Christmas, the last one being “Find Love”.

items.title: Por un puñado de besos
items.description: Una chica, un chico en una historia de amor, pero también sobre los sueños, los miedos, la vida, el amor verdadero, la amistad, la forma en que lo afrontamos y un secreto entre los dos…

items.title: A Very English Christmas
items.description: Christmas in the English countryside wasn't on Kate's meticulously planned festive calendar until her half-sister Harriet, who was brought up in England, announces her plan to get married on Christmas Eve.

items.title: El medallón perdido: las aventuras de Billy Stone
items.description: El arqueólogo Dr. Michael Stone buscó el medallón perdido toda su vida y ahora su hijo Billy ha retomado la búsqueda.

items.title: Prim: El Asesinato de la Calle del Turco
items.description: Biopic histórico sobre el complot para asesinar al general Prim. La acción se sitúa tras el fin de la revolución Gloriosa en 1868 y finaliza con la proclamación del rey Amadeo I de Saboya.

items.title: The Fabric of Christmas
items.description: Liam, a fireman, and Amy, a quilting teacher, team up to make a Christmas quilt for Liam's sister's wedding, but their burgeoning romance is threatened by Liam's intention to travel to South America after the wedding.

items.title: Coupled Up For Christmas
items.description: Tiffany hatches a plan with a recently heartbroken Peter, to win back the affection of their respective soulmates by pretending to be a couple in love, but soon realise that they have more in common than they ever realised…

items.title: Food Club
items.description: Follows three longtime girlfriends from elementary school who are coming into their prime and finding a new lease on life after participating in a cooking course in Italy.

items.title: Food And Romance
items.description: A sudden change forces Karin to re-evaluate her life. With the help of friends, food and passion she refuses to accept that life has an expiration date and takes the second chance she is given.

items.title: Kenny Scharf: When Worlds Collide
items.description: Documentary on the life of renowned street artist Kenny Scharf

items.title: Mister Mayfair: A Song To Kill For
items.description: Max Mayfair, flourishing in London with his girlfriend Ava, a crime family, and a stolen diamond, faces peril as the NYC mafia's henchmen pursue his allies. Allying with Marseille Mafia's Paul, Max schemes to draw the NYC mob to Mayfair, risking it all.

items.title: Renovación del corazón
items.description: Cuando los Dover se encuentran en peligro financiero, sólo tienen una solución; vender la casa que le dejaron los padres de Anne. Pero cuando nadie quiere comprarla, deciden que la única forma de deshacerse de la casa es arreglarla.

items.title: Garry Winogrand: All Things Are Photographable
items.description: A documentary about an important American still photographer who captured New York City in the 1960s (his work there is said to have influenced the TV show Mad Men) and later the West in Texas and Los Angeles.

items.title: Into The Darkness
items.description: Denmark, April 9th, 1940. Danish industrialist (portrayed by Jesper Christensen of James Bond fame) , cooperates and profits from the German occupation of Denmark. While his family finds themselves on opposite sides of the conflict.

items.title: Pie Grande
items.description: Después de chocar su bicicleta en el bosque, Percy Caldwell se encuentra con un nuevo amigo, Bigfoot, una criatura de dos metros y medio de altura, que ha sido desplazada por un reciente incendio forestal.
The Inquisition continues the persecution of Portuguese Jews.

items.title: Delicious
items.description: France, 1789, just before the Revolution. With the help of a surprising talented young woman, a chef who has been sacked by his noble master finds the strength to free himself from his position as a servant and opens the first ever restaurant.

items.title: Nacido para correr: velocidad máxima
items.description: Cuando dos corredores rivales de un pequeño pueblo se ven obligados a trabajar juntos para derrotar a un campeón reinante, la supervivencia del más rápido se convierte en una carrera definitiva hasta la línea de meta. Protagonizada por Brett Davern.

items.title: False Freedom
items.description: Post-WWII, a German doctor from Hitler's regime evades justice. He meets a war-torn Polish-German-Jewish woman and they embark on a journey. Can a past killer find redemption? Is their bond love or solace? Can love rise from ruin? Are we ever truly free?

items.title: Last Film Show
items.description: Samay fights heaven and earth to find light. He wants to catch, control, cut and project that light to tell stories. Now to pursue that dream he must leave everything he loves and take a flight to find the light.

items.title: Mister Mayfair
items.description: Max Mayfair, ex-NYC gangster, now runs London's swankiest club, trading guns for glam. Life's smooth until his unknown granddaughter, Barbara, appears. With girlfriend Ava and his crime crew, Max discovers London's as perilous as NYC—with more at stake.

items.title: Mister Mayfair: Shooting Paul
items.description: Seeking a fresh start, Max opens a club in Portugal. Yet, violence ensues as London gangsters and Italian Mafia clash. Old flame Serena threatens his bond with Ava. As his world unravels, crime boss Tommy blackmails Max to target his ally, Paul.

items.title: Mister Mayfair: Serena'S Game
items.description: Defying Tommy, Max and Paul plot his downfall and Serena's arrest. Success is short-lived as MI6 coerces Max into aiding Serena against the Russian mob. Torn between crime with Serena or a life with Ava, Max Mayfair's journey remains complex.

items.title: Mister Mayfair: The Spyce Of Life
items.description: Post trip with girlfriend Ava, Max returns to his London club only to be blackmailed by MI6 to spy on suspected terrorists, Aziz and Omar, frequent guests at his club. Suspected of plotting a cyber attack, Max plans to trap them using MI6's truth serum.

items.title: Kitchen Brigade
items.description: Cathy is a sous-chef wanting to open a restaurant. With financial difficulties, Cathy accepts a job at a shelter for young migrants. At first she hates the job then her passion for cuisine starts to change children's lives.

items.title: New Best Friend
items.description: A North Carolina sheriff investigates the near-fatal drug overdose of an underachieving college girl, and uncovers many sordid details of her life before and during her descent into drugs and debauchery.

items.title: Kid Millions
items.description: A musical comedy about a Brooklyn boy (Eddie Cantor) who inherits a fortune from his archaeologist father, but must go to Egypt to claim it.

items.title: Knuckledust
items.description: A former marine is trapped in an elite underground fight club. When cops swoop in they discover only one man left alive, him. But all is not as it seems. Is he the sole survivor or a mass murderer?

items.title: Last Exit To Brooklyn
items.description: Set in Brooklyn during the 1950s against a backdrop of union corruption and violence. A prostitute falls in love with one of her customers. Also a disturbed man discovers that he is homosexual.

items.title: Prince Valiant
items.description: In Arthurian Camelot, squire Valiant secretly escorts Princess Ilene, masquerading as a knight. As Arthur's enemies plot to steal Excalibur, Valiant faces kidnappings and duels, ultimately discovering he's Thule's heir and must reclaim his kingdom.

items.title: Renegade
items.description: Marshal Mike Blueberry, battles to unite the natives who raised him. He tries to maintain the balance between two civilizations. But when a destructive killer comes to town, ancient legend and the strongest cowboys take back what's theirs.

items.title: Once Upon A Time In Ukraine
items.description: What if Taras Shevchenko put down his pen and took a samurai sword into his hands?

items.title: Once I Was Engaged
items.description: When Bree Carrington gets engaged while at BYU Hawaii, her loving, over-the-top mom goes all out to create the wedding of the century. But both mother and daughter must overcome perfection when this happily ever after story doesn't go quite as expected.

items.title: Baader Meinhof Komplex
items.description: A look at Germany's terrorist group, The Red Army Faction (RAF), which organized bombings, robberies, kidnappings, and assassinations in the late 1960s and '70s.

items.title: Fatal Attraction
items.description: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

items.title: Powder Keg
items.description: Film about the events surrounding the terrorist attacks in Copenhagen on February 14th and 15th 2015.

items.title: Preparations To Be Together For An Unknown Period Of Time
items.description: Márta, a forty-year-old neurosurgeon, falls in love. She leaves her shining American career behind and returns to Budapest to start a new life with the man. But the love of her life claims they have never met before.

items.title: Assassin'S Bullet
items.description: A woman is killing off int'l bad guys (and witnesses). An ex FBI new man at the American Embassy in Sofia, Bulgaria, is put in charge of investigating the vigilante's actions there.

items.title: Hello, Bookstore
items.description: In the shadow of the pandemic, a small town rallies to protect a beloved local bookstore.

items.title: Dave Stevens: Drawn To Perfection
items.description: Dave Stevens made The Rocketeer and reintroduced the world to 50's pin-up model Bettie Page. While creating his unique corner of importance in comic book and illustration art, he showed the world what it's like to pursue the life of a creative individual.

items.title: In a World
items.description: Carol (Lake Bell) is an underachieving voice coach who finds herself competing in the movie trailer voice-over profession against her arrogant father and his protégé.

items.title: Imperium
items.description: Inspired by real events. To stop domestic terrorists from building a dirty bomb, an FBI agent (Daniel Radcliffe) poses as an extremist, infiltrating a dissident group to find its dangerous leaders.

items.title: Lady Macbeth (2016)
items.description: Lust, power and murder collide in this critically-acclaimed thriller about the awakening of a young woman’s desire.

items.title: The Spirit
items.description: In the vein of BATMAN BEGINS and SIN CITY, THE SPIRIT takes us on a sinister, gut-wrenching ride with a hero who is born, murdered and born again.

items.title: Hell Fest
items.description: A serial killer in costume at a Halloween theme park kills off visitors, unbeknownst to bystanders who think it's part of the fun.

items.title: The Turkey Bowl
items.description: A former high school quarterback is lured back to his small hometown to finish a legendary snowed-out football game in this riotous comedy.

items.title: Most Wonderful Time
items.description: Before her mother sells their family home after the holidays, 30-something struggling author Bria reunites with her three best friends to reminisce and re-create the glory days of their high school years.

items.title: Guns Akimbo
items.description: A guy relies on his newly acquired gladiator skills to save his ex-girlfriend from kidnappers.

items.title: How To Be A Latin Lover
items.description: Eugenio Derbez (INSTRUCTIONS NOT INCLUDED) and Salma Hayek head an all-star cast in this hilarious comedy about an aging ladies’ man who learns that love and trust must be earned.

items.title: Professor Marston And The Wonder Women
items.description: A superhero origin tale unlike any other, PROFESSOR MARSTON & THE WONDER WOMEN is the incredible true story of what inspired Harvard psychologist and inventor Dr. William Moulton Marston to create the iconic feminist superhero Wonder Woman.

items.title: Blue Steel (1990)
items.description: This thriller stars Jamie Lee Curtis as a suspended NYPD officer stalked by an obsessed commodities trader, who threatens everything she holds dear.

items.title: School Dance
items.description: High school freshman Jason has found his dream girl, but there's just one problem: she doesn't know he exists.

items.title: Line Of Duty
items.description: A disgraced cop (Aaron Eckhart) finds himself in a race against time to find a kidnap victim whose abductor he accidentally killed.

items.title: Missing Link
items.description: Mr. Link recruits explorer Sir Lionel Frost to help find his long-lost relatives in the fabled valley of Shangri-La. Along with adventurer Adelina Fortnight, this trio of explorers travel the world to help their new friend.

items.title: The One I Love
items.description: On the brink of separation, Ethan (Mark Duplass) and Sophie (Elisabeth Moss) escape to a beautiful vacation house for a weekend getaway in an attempt to save their marriage.

items.title: The Golden Cane Warrior
items.description: Story of two student fighters who, after their master is killed, set out to find the Golden Cane relic before it falls into the wrong hands.

items.title: Warriors of the Nation
items.description: After the Sino-Japanese War, the Japanese army tries to once again gain control in China by hiring a secret organization to kidnap the military minister Zhang Zhidong. Wong Fei-Hung and his disciples try once again to prevent another war from starting.

items.title: Unbending Mr. Fang
items.description: After learning martial arts, Fong Sai-yuk comes back to Zhaoqing and immediately gets involved in a corruption case.

items.title: Lovely And Amazing
items.description: Self-esteem and insecurity are at the heart of this comedy about the relationship between a mother and her three confused daughters.

items.title: De mente y música
items.description: Una historia sobre una bella músico callejera que sufre pérdida de memoria y un neurocientífico descorazonado que intenta ayudarla, uniendo la ciudad de Nueva Orleans y el jazz que la hizo famosa.

items.title: Atrapados: enterrados vivos
items.description: Protagonizada por Jack Wagner, Gabrielle Carteris y Mark Lindsay Chapman. Michael Cooper (Wagner) emprende una arriesgada misión de rescate para salvar a su mujer, a su hija y a los demás ocupantes de un albergue de ski que han sido atrapados.

items.title: She's Funny That Way
items.description: A married Broadway director falls for a call-girl-turned-actress and works to help her advance her career, but things get a little more complicated than they bargained for.

items.title: A Ghost Story
items.description: After being separated by loss, a young couple discovers an eternal connection and a love that is infinite.

items.title: Menashe
items.description: In a notoriously secretive community, a loving father fights against tradition in order to keep custody of his only son after his wife passes away.

items.title: Un extraño en la boda de mi hermano
items.description: April trabaja en un prestigioso hospital de Nueva York y recientemente conoció a un apuesto veterinario llamado Jesse. Cuando todo parece ir perfecto entre ellos, April se entera que Jesse viene de una familia Amish, y las cosas toman un nuevo rumbo.

items.title: God of War II
items.description: Lü Bu, general to warlord Dong Zhuo, has blazed a trail of victories on the battlefield. But when a beautiful apprentice arrives claiming to be his long-lost love, he soon realizes that his closest allies may yet be his most dangerous foes.

items.title: Cómo entrenar a tu esposo
items.description: Una terapeuta matrimonial intenta arreglar su propio matrimonio centrándose en cómo cambiar a su marido.

items.title: Maika: The Girl From Another Galaxy
items.description: After a meteor falls to earth, 8-year-old Hung meets an alien girl from the planet Maika, searching for her lost friend. The alien helps Hung make new friends and heal a broken heart. But danger lurks everywhere.

items.title: Dark Circles
items.description: From the go-to name in Horror and the creators of America’s #1 Horror Festival comes the terrifying story of a family that’s been pushed beyond their limits.

items.title: Buster's Mal Heart
items.description: In this bold thriller spiked with dark humor, Rami Malek (Mr. Robot) is a family man whose chance encounter with a conspiracy-obsessed drifter leaves him on the run from the police and an impending event known as The Inversion.

items.title: Spiritwalker
items.description: A man with amnesia suddenly begins regaining consciousness in a new body every 12 hours. But with no memory—and no allies—his time is running out.

items.title: Warriors of the Rainbow: Seediq Bale
items.description: Between 1895 and 1945, a Japanese colony inhabited Taiwan and subdued the aboriginal tribes who first settled the land. Seediq leader Mouna forged a coalition with other tribal leaders and plotted a rebellion against their Japanese colonial masters.

items.title: If I Can't Have You
items.description: An attractive radio host is targeted by an unknown stalker who launches a campaign of terror and intrigue against the host and her meddling friends.

items.title: Sword of Destiny
items.description: Twenty years after the murder of his father, Meng Yang attempts to avenge him using the sacred Chengying Sword.

items.title: Young Detective Dee
items.description: In Dee Renjie's beginnings in the Imperial police force. His very first case, investigating reports of a sea monster terrorizing the town, reveals a sinister conspiracy of treachery and betrayal, leading to the highest reaches of the Imperial family.

items.title: The Conspirator
items.description: From director Robert Redford comes the riveting true story behind the assassination trial of Abraham Lincoln – including the lone woman who was accused of plotting his murder.

items.title: The Dragon Tamer
items.description: The desert youngster, Guo Jing, follows his masters, The Six Freaks of Jiangnan, to train and retrieve the Nine Yin Scriptures.

items.title: Miss You Already
items.description: Drew Barrymore and Toni Collette star as lifelong besties who laugh and cry through love and loss.

items.title: Girl In Progress
items.description: As single mom Grace juggles work, bills, and her affair with a married doctor, her daughter, Ansiedad, plots a shortcut to adulthood after finding inspiration in the coming-of-age stories she's reading for school.

items.title: Shadow Master
items.description: After being slain by a group of criminals, a man is reborn with animal-like superpowers and makes it his mission to right the wrongs of his city.

items.title: Ip Man: Awakening
items.description: While visiting Hong Kong, a young Master Ip intervenes in a kidnapping attempt, unintentionally igniting a turf war with a ruthless human trafficking ring.

items.title: Baby Assassins
items.description: Chisato and Mahilo are two high school girls who are about to graduate. They also happen to both be highly skilled assassins. When the organization they work for orders them to share a room, the relationship between them turns sour.

items.title: The Grandmaster of Kung Fu
items.description: Near the end of the Qing Dynasty, a renowned Chinese martial artist engages in a life-or-death battle with a feared Japanese military commander in order to prevent Japan's ultimate goal of seizing martial arts stronghold Tianjin.

items.title: Erased
items.description: Ex-CIA operative Ben Logan (Aaron Eckhart) has been long estranged from his young daughter (Liana Liberato).

items.title: Escape From Mogadishu
items.description: Based on a true story: as civil war rages in Mogadishu, rival North and South Korean diplomats are left trapped. With no aid from either government, their only shot at survival may require uniting with bitter adversaries to escape.

items.title: The Fatal Raid
items.description: Two elite police teams undertake a secret operation tracking a dangerous gang across the border into Macau, ending in a deadly firefight. Twenty years later, an escort mission brings the survivors back to the scene—and an unwelcome reunion.

items.title: Crooked
items.description: Two police detectives must protect a beautiful call girl from mob hitmen and a crooked cop.

items.title: Young IP Man
items.description: In 1917 young Ip Man first came to Hong Kong to study, but his peaceful campus life was unexpectedly broken. A shocking hostage situation occurred on the day when the school held an English speech contest.

items.title: A Janitor
items.description: Fukami, a janitor at high school whose true identity is a professional assassin raised by Majima who killed his father, fights 9 assassins to save Majima's daughter.

items.title: Silat Warriors: Deed of Death
items.description: When a young gambler runs afoul of the gang rigging a local betting ring, his luck soon runs out. When they show up to collect, he faces dire consequences, and his siblings must fight for their land and their lives—before time runs out.

items.title: Can You Fix A Brain Like Mine ?
items.description: An in-depth look at the moral and ethical implications in the field of neuroscience.

items.title: Corazón verdadero
items.description: Con ayuda de un miembro de las Naciones indígenas originarias y un oso legendario, dos adolescentes sobreviven a la naturaleza y a los cazadores, en esta aventura que ganó el “Premio a la Excelencia” del Film Advisory Board.

items.title: Sentencia de muerte
items.description: La superestrella de acción Jean-Claude van Damme (Contacto sangriento, Cyborg) es un veterano agente secreto que se hace pasar por un recluso en una peligrosa prisión estatal.

items.title: El templo del oro
items.description: Dos mercenarios con mala suerte (Chuck Norris y Louis Gossett Jr.) conocen a una hermosa chica (Melody Anderson) con un mapa de una mina de oro perdida y deciden intentar hacerse ricos. ¡Pero el camino hacia el tesoro no es cosa fácil!

items.title: Cielo azul
items.description: Jessica Lange hace una interpretación ganadora de un premio "Óscar" como la atractiva e inestable mujer de un científico nuclear (Tommy Lee Jones) que se enfrenta a difíciles decisiones morales a raíz de las pruebas atmosféricas que debe llevar a cabo.

items.title: The Real Doctor Zhivago
items.description: Stephen Smith traces the beginnings of the novel 'The Real Doctor Zhivago' to its role as a pawn of the CIA, at the height of the Cold War.

items.title: El beso del vampiro
items.description: Después de una noche de sexo apasionado donde le muerden en el cuello a un editor literario un poco desquiciado, se convence de que él es un vampiro y comienza a representar el papel.

items.title: Roman Scandals
items.description: A kind-hearted young man is thrown out of his corrupt home town of West Rome, Oklahoma. He falls asleep and dreams that he is back in the days of olden Rome, where he gets mixed up with court intrigue and a murder plot against the Emperor.

items.title: Ronnie'S
items.description: A chronicle of the life of saxophonist Ronnie Scott and his world famous London jazz club.

items.title: Tell It Like A Woman
items.description: Stories of women, both in front of and behind the camera.

items.title: Spoor
items.description: Janina Duszejko, an elderly woman, lives alone in the Klodzko Valley where a series of mysterious crimes are committed. Duszejko is convinced that she knows who or what is the murderer, but nobody believes her.

items.title: A Better Way To Die
items.description: Set along the highways of the U.S. heartland, an ex-cop who is inadvertently thrust into a fierce struggle between the FBI and the Chicago underworld, both of which are searching for a missing federal agent who holds the key to the syndicate's demise.

items.title: Westwood: Punk, Icon, Activist
items.description: The first film to encompass the remarkable story of one of the true icons of our time, Vivienne Westwood, as she fights to maintain her brand's integrity, her principles - and her legacy.

items.title: The Name of the Rose
items.description: In 1327, an enlightened friar and his young apprentice investigate a series of mysterious deaths at an abbey, risking the wrath of a powerful Inquisitor. Television adaptation of Umberto Eco's novel 'The Name of the Rose'.

items.title: They Got Me Covered
items.description: Fired by his editor for incompetence, idiotic reporter Robert Kittredge sees a chance at redeeming himself when he accidentally uncovers a network of Nazi spies in Washington, D.C.

items.title: Wild Target
items.description: A hitman tries to retire, but a beautiful thief may change his plans.

items.title: Black Ops
items.description: Follows the story of Dom and Kay, who join the Met Police in the hope of cleaning up their community but are unwittingly thrust into the murky world of deep cover infiltration as they become part of a powerful criminal enterprise.

items.title: Cairo Conspiracy
items.description: Adam, the son of a fisherman, is offered the privilege to study at the Al-Azhar University in Cairo, the center of power of Sunni Islam. Adam becomes a pawn in the conflict between Egypt's religious and political elites.

items.title: How It Ends
items.description: In this feel-good apocalyptic comedy, Liza (Zoe Lister-Jones) embarks on a hilarious journey through LA in hopes of making it to her last party before it all ends, running into an eclectic cast of characters along the way.

items.title: Deadline
items.description: A screenwriter travels to an abandoned house to finish a script on time, but a series of strange events lead her to a psychological breakdown.

items.title: Crossover
items.description: The lives of a gifted athlete and his best friend change when they take a fateful trip to Los Angeles. The young hopefuls must use every skill at their command to topple the reigning street ball champions from their thrones.

items.title: Dinner At Freds
items.description: An orderly and average man finds himself entrenched in the odd lives in a strange town. Attempts to depart lead him to discover the best parts of himself have found a home and a belonging he could never have dreamed of

items.title: 10 Reasons Why Men Cheat
items.description: In the wake of a wedding catastrophe, three couples discover the meaning of commitment while discussing what women want to know when it comes to men and relationships.

items.title: Do's and Don'ts of Dating
items.description: Ladies' man Scott Hall thinks he has the dating game figured out. He has dating rules that he follows until he meets his match. Will she throw him off his game?

items.title: Finding Boaz
items.description: Church administrator, Torrey, attempts to put the pieces of her life together after a failed engagement.

items.title: Her Little Secret
items.description: When Lerrez finally manages to turn her life around, her dark past finds its way back in. How far will she go to keep HER LITTLE SECRET?

items.title: Christmas At Cattle Hill
items.description: Klara the Calf is excited to spend her first Christmas on Cattle Hill with her Father, but when they arrive at the farm, Klara is disappointed to see he has not attempted to decorate for the holidays.

items.title: Deadly Exchange
items.description: Samantha and her daughter invite Chloe, a foreign exchange student, into their home. But Chloe's twisted past follows her abroad and down a path of manipulation, fraud and murder.

items.title: Blood and Money
items.description: Four cousins from a tight-knit family are thrust into a world of chaos when the youngest of them is suspected of stealing money from one of Memphis' most dangerous drug dealers.

items.title: Menno's Mind
items.description: Menno (Bill Campbell, 'The Rocketeer') is a computer programmer at The Resort, an enormous funhouse where people can live out their fantasies in virtual reality. When terrorists threaten a presidential election, he must help save the day.

items.title: How to Get Away with Cheating
items.description: Although Professor Alex P. Keating and his wife Olivia's marriage has hit a bit of a dry spell, his professional life could not be better.

items.title: Monogamish
items.description: Successful realtor Zane is living the American dream: a perfect NFL Husband, a nice house and a growing business; until the day her husband presents her with a request.

items.title: The Wrong Nanny
items.description: Stella Armstrong hires Blake, a seemingly perfect nanny, to help with her twin baby boys. She soon discovers that the young nanny is the daughter she gave up for adoption years ago.

items.title: Time Capsule
items.description: In the near future, a politician fresh off an electoral loss escapes to his family's summer lake house. His vacation is disrupted by the appearance of his first love, who has just returned from a 20-year space voyage and hasn't aged a day.

items.title: Romeo and Isabella
items.description: Trans woman, Isabella, has struggled to find the right man. When she goes back home, old friends and skeletons come back to find her.

items.title: Class Dismissed
items.description: When an unemployed actress finds herself broke and sleeping on her best friend's couch, she is forced to get a job as a substitute teacher working with one student.

items.title: A Christmoose Story
items.description: When his father cannot make it home Max is convinced that Christmas will be extremely boring this year. But then Mr Moose crashes through his roof and he is not so sure anymore. This is a giant talking Moose with a warm heart and a tendency for drama.

items.title: Surviving the Storm
items.description: A twenty-eight year old single mother hears the unsettling news of stage three breast cancer; causing two estranged sisters to confront family secrets and stop the silence.

items.title: The Calling
items.description: Tamar has been called to become a minister, and for most, this would be an honorable moment, but for Tamar, it is the worst thing that could happen.

items.title: The Exit Row
items.description: Sasha Dade is dedicated to her demanding, yet comfortable life as a wife, mother and advertising executive near the nation's capital.

items.title: La Cucaracha
items.description: A desperate writer fights for survival when the Mexican mob involves him in murder.

items.title: Blind Ambition
items.description: Four Zimbabwean men form their country's first Wine Tasting Olympics team.

items.title: Encuentro siniestro
items.description: Una familia que sufre la pérdida de una niña pequeña, enfrenta un fenómeno que puede ser la clave para la verdad, después de su trágica desaparición.

items.title: The Love App
items.description: Rachel is a promising young woman getting over a recent breakup while her friend signs her up for a dating app unbeknownst to her.

items.title: Held for Ransom
items.description: Young Danish photographer Daniel Rye is captured by ISIS in 2013.

items.title: The Morning After
items.description: After Michael & Tiffany end their five-year relationship, they awaken to find they've switched bodies.

items.title: Ultimatums
items.description: Roman visits recently engaged Luke and his sexually frustrated fiancé Mya.

items.title: Python 2
items.description: A man, his business partner, and his wife are enlisted to transport an unknown object from a Russian military base, only to discover that the object is a giant, genetically-altered python.

items.title: You Look Familiar: Vernee Watson
items.description: Actress Vernee Watson has broken ground and paved the way for black actresses on television today: with a career spanning over 4 decades, 3 Emmy awards, and costars such as Will Smith and Denzel Washington.

items.title: Leones por corderos
items.description: La película explica tres historias interrelacionadas. Un profesor intenta inspirar a uno de sus alumnos. Dos de sus antiguos alumnos se encuentran atrapados en Afganistán y un senador en Washington tiene una nueva estrategia de guerra.

items.title: Colores de guerra
items.description: Un policía experimentado y su compañero novato patrullan las calles del este de Los Ángeles mientras tratan de mantener bajo control las bandas de violencia callejera.

items.title: No sin mi hija
items.description: Sally Field ofrece una interpretación electrizante en esta convincente historia real de Betty Mahmoody, una mujer estadounidense que, junto con su hija, queda atrapada en Irán, engañada por su marido al visitar su país natal.

items.title: Motín a bordo
items.description: Un viaje idílico a Tahití enfrentará a la tripulación y su capitán, cuando tras encontrar un paraíso tropical y sexo ilimitado, el capitán decide zarpar y adentrar a su tripulación en un peligroso viaje alrededor del Cabo de Hornos.

items.title: Princess of the Row
items.description: The inspiring tale of a runaway foster child who will stop at nothing to live with the only family she knows: her homeless, mentally-ill veteran father who lives on the streets of LA's skid row.

items.title: Restraining Order
items.description: A happy couple on the verge of marriage have their plans derailed when David comes across the love that got away from his past.

items.title: EscapeCation
items.description: When an unemployed actress finds herself broke and sleeping on her best friend's couch, she is forced to get a job as a substitute teacher working with one student.

items.title: 10,000 Saints
items.description: In this ensemble drama, teen Jude (Asa Butterfield) moves from 1980s Vermont to NYC to live with his father (Ethan Hawke) in the East Village. Caught in the chaos of city life, Jude tries to hide a secret in a neighborhood on the verge of riots.

items.title: Good
items.description: Payton becomes the caretaker of Gregory Devereaux, a wealthy man facing his final months. As they become close, Gregory's past sins force Payton to decide between his dreams and a pregnancy that could squander them all.

items.title: Soul Assassin
items.description: When Kevin Burke's girlfriend Rosalind is murdered, he discovers her secret espionage life. Amidst treachery, Kevin becomes a target, questioning trust in allies. He seeks her true killer in a web of deception. Who's the true foe?

items.title: The 4th Quarter: Legacy
items.description: In the wake of a wedding catastrophe, three couples discover the meaning of commitment, while discussing what women want to know most of all when it comes to men and relationships.

items.title: Till Death Do Us
items.description: Ladies' man Scott Hall thinks he has the dating game figured out. He has dating rules that he follows until he meets his match. Will she throw him off his game?

items.title: When it Rains
items.description: Church administrator, Torrey, attempts to put the pieces of her life together after a failed engagement.

items.title: The Shrink Is In
items.description: A young woman impersonates a shrink to win over her Prince Charming.

items.title: A Match for the Prince
items.description: A medieval history specialist is hired to be a matchmaker for a real-life prince before his royal wedding date. But will they end up falling for each other instead?

items.title: Full Body Massage
items.description: A successful but world-weary art dealer finds out that her usual masseur has sent a substitute for her regular weekly massage at her home. They find that they are both mutually attracted, and annoy one another a great deal.

items.title: Ruby's Bucket of Blood
items.description: Passions run ripe as the sweltering bayou when a club owner must juggle an unfaithful husband and her attraction to a white singer in 1960s Louisiana. Starring Angela Bassett ('Black Panther').

items.title: A Royal Makeover
items.description: When Ramone discovers he is the heir to Kingdom of San Pablo, he is daunted by the prospect of becoming king. To prepare him for his royal duties, King Felipe hires royal expert Angelica to help.

items.title: The Dark
items.description: In mourning over the tragic drowning of their daughter Sarah, James and Adèle are visited by Ebrill, a young girl who claims she died 60 years ago - and bears a startling resemblance to Sarah.

items.title: Run for the Dream
items.description: American track star Gail Devers captured the world's heart when she won the gold medal in the 100-meter sprint at the 1992 Barcelona Olympics after overcoming a debilitating illness that threatened to end her career.

items.title: A Slice of Romance
items.description: When unlucky in love PR Executive Mikayla meets coffee shop owner and aspiring pastry chef Austin, the pair strike a deal: she'll taste his desserts if he gives her dating advice. Little did they know sparks would fly between them.

items.title: A Royal Recipe for Love
items.description: When Emma is hired to bake for the King and Queen of Sanovia's anniversary party, she finds herself at odds with the unpredictable Prince Oliver who is determined to challenge her.

items.title: Dark Cloud
items.description: In the aftermath of a horrific accident, Chloe wants to get her old life back. She volunteers to try a new rehabilitation process using artificial intelligence. The Al, known as AIDA, will do anything to keep Chloe safe despite the consequences.

items.title: Mr. Pawsitively Perfect
items.description: An aspiring marketing designer's favourite foster dog is adopted by a famous but down on his luck furniture designer, whom she fears only wants the dog for his new image.

items.title: Fisherman's Friends: One And All
items.description: Following the success of their first album, the Fisherman's Friends struggle to adjust to their new-found fame and work towards a second album.

items.title: Dirty Games
items.description: Contestants in a reality TV gameshow compete against each other to win big cash prizes. What begins as flirty fun soon turns sinister as the online viewers send in challenges for them that become increasingly perverse and dangerous.

items.title: The Comeback
items.description: Jeff and Tisa Murray have decided to move their family back to their hometown of Atlanta when Tisa is offered her dream job. The dream becomes a hilarious reality when family issues, Mom's new boyfriend, and ex-lovers are waiting on them.

items.title: Queen Victoria: Secrets of a Queen
items.description: Queen Victoria ruled the United Kingdom for 63 years, an era in which the sun never set on the British Empire. More than 100 years later, new research reveals little known secrets about a Queen who became the symbol of the Victorian Era.

items.title: Real Soul: A Gospel Music Story
items.description: The roots of gospel music extend back to a time when to have a voice meant having a freedom no one could silence. As the river of gospel music flourished, its' influence fed many musical tributaries whose resonance rings true to this day.

items.title: The West: Hidden History
items.description: An emotional and historical journey through the American West on the tracks of the pre-1848 border, to meet families that lived there since long before the US takeover.

items.title: The True Story of King Tut's Treasure
items.description: What exactly happened to all the objects found by Howard Carter after he finished exploring Tutankhamun's tomb in 1930, after they has been lying there for the past 3200 years.

items.title: Dirty Kung Fu
items.description: Jet, a young soldier at the end of the second World War must overcome some abusive Americans who are bullying him as well as the Chinese people.

items.title: Nazi Death Marches
items.description: Through exclusive film archives and written journals, we will reveal a lesser known chapter of the end of the Third Reich, a story of brutality and murder.

items.title: 444 Days – The Iran Hostage Crisis
items.description: It was a 444 days ordeal for the American diplomats taken hostage in Tehran. 444 days of humiliation for the most powerful nation in the world, the United States.

items.title: Fists and Guts
items.description: Gordon Liu stars in this Kung Fu comedy as an undercover Shaolin Monk. While searching for a fugitive who has wronged the order, the Master (Liu) uncovers a scheme to steal the priceless Jade Buddha.

items.title: Lightning: Bolts of Destruction
items.description: A meteorologist (Joanna Pacula) and her family work feverishly to find a way to extinguish a storm that threatens to destroy mankind.

items.title: Underdogs
items.description: Set in rural Ohio, the birthplace of football, a small-town high school football team rises to play their cross-town rival, a perennial powerhouse, while standing up for an entire community.

items.title: Elon Musk: The Real Life Iron Man
items.description: Discover the meteoric rise of Elon Musk, the man who is transforming the way we think about travel techlogy through electric cars, the Hyperloop, and revolutionary ideas on how we live through artificial intelligence and colonizing Mars.

items.title: Lightning: Fire from the Sky
items.description: Overwhelmed by a disastrous lightning storm that his son predicted, a man must learn to trust his son in order to save his family and the whole community.

items.title: Any Gun Can Play
items.description: A gang robs a gold shipment from a train. A so called bounty hunter is sent to track down the robbers and decides to let them lead him to the gold.

items.title: Long Gone Wild
items.description: The killer whale is once again under siege, hunted for sale into the exploding marine theme park industry. An in-depth look at the case against captivity, the Whale Sanctuary Project, and covert missions in search of orcas held captive.

items.title: All Natural
items.description: A man with bad luck in relationships finally meets Mrs. Right, but she makes a hair-raising decision that challenges him to love her through the thick and thin.

items.title: Happy as a Cat
items.description: The famous writer Bernard Werber narrates this fantastic journey into the feline world. After being obsessed with ants, cats have become his new passion.

items.title: Dilemma
items.description: A happy couple on the verge of marriage has their plans derailed when David comes across the love that got away from his past.

items.title: Wu Tang Clan Da Mystery Of Kung Fu
items.description: Lyrical assassins, the Wu Tang clan present this action packed documentary. Method Man, O.D.B. , The Gza and the rest of the Wu-Tang posse give you an insight into their world discussing the kung fu films films that shaped their way of life.

items.title: Tom Cruise: The Last Movie Star
items.description: Tom Cruise - actor, producer, daredevil. Forty years into his career, he is king of the box office once again, risking life and limb to entertain audiences worldwide. A totally unique figure in popular culture…the last movie star.

items.title: Space: Into the Great Beyond
items.description: We are on the edge of a new era as the vastness of space has become humanity's new hope. With robots now walking the surface of Mars, mankind will not only journey to other planets within our lifetime, we will also inhabit them.

items.title: Origins of the Universe: The Great Debate
items.description: The world has many complex systems that work perfectly together. We always questioned, "was the earth created, or did it come into existence on its own?" Meet seven experts who have devoted their lives to the study of this question.

items.title: Código 46
items.description: En un futuro cercano, un investigador de seguros que debe desmantelar una red de falsificación de pasaportes se enamora de la cabecilla, algo problemático tras revelarse un secreto que corresponde a una infracción del Código 46.

items.title: It's Quieter in the Twilight
items.description: Fighting outdated technology and time, Voyager's flight-team pursues humankind's greatest exploration.

items.title: End Game: Technology
items.description: The technology we rely on could one day be used against us as artificial intelligence, facial recognition, drone surveillance, and human chipping bring science-fiction to life. Could humanity face extinction at the hands of robot armies?

items.title: Dachau Liberation
items.description: The horrific nature of Hitler and the Nazi's plan for world domination was clearly defined by the concentration camps they conceived, erected, and operated until Germany was liberated by Allied forces. Dachau was the first death camp built by the Nazis.

items.title: Tom Cruise: An Eternal Youth
items.description: After 40 years, Tom Cruise's exuberance for creating films remains buoyant. A dedicated actor of immeasurable talent, Cruise has overcome overwhelming odds and personal conflict to continue to push the envelope in filmmaking.

items.title: Living in the Future's Past
items.description: Jeff Bridges shares the screen with scientists and profound thinkers going beyond politics and borders to look under the hood of humanity, revealing eye-opening concepts about ourselves and our past, providing the keys to a better future.

items.title: Sharks: Monster of the Media
items.description: Dive into the world of sharks. Coined as monsters by the media, experience these behemoth majestic creatures in their natural habitat and learn about the threat of extinction to nearly one in four shark species and why they need our help.

items.title: Solar System: The Secrets of the Universe
items.description: Join our host on the International Space Station of the year 2050. Marvel at the three-dimensional sights and learn many things about the astral bodies that surround us.

items.title: Volando Alto
items.description: Gwyneth Paltrow protagoniza en esta comedia hilarante sobre una chica de pueblo con grandes planes. Cuando se propone ser azafata internacional de primera clase, Donna se arriesga y sale a perseguir su sueño.

items.title: Why on Earth
items.description: Rarely before seen footage of deforestation and the illegal trade of endangered species exposes the vital connection between humans, animals, and our planet. By caring about our natural world, we begin a healing process that helps us all.

items.title: Disturbia
items.description: Living under three months' house arrest, Kale Brecht (Shia LaBeouf, Transformers) passes his days spying on the neighbors. It's all fun and games until things take a horrifying turn for the worse.

items.title: Alien Conspiracies: The Hidden Truth
items.description: From the ancient pyramids to online conspiracies, are extraterrestrials guiding mankind's past, present and future?

items.title: Fearless Master aka Fearless Hyena 3
items.description: A young kung fu fantatic learns the Mngoose style from a drunken master in order for him to send a bunch of mericelss fighters running form the town.

items.title: Borderline (2023)
items.description: Mads, a successful marketing executive, has a chance encounter with Joan. He returns to his life back home, but for Joan, it doesn't end there.

items.title: Volition
items.description: In this time-bending sci-fi thriller, a man afflicted with clairvoyance tries to change his fate when a series of events leads to a vision of his own imminent murder. Best Feature at the Philip K. Dick Film Festival.

items.title: Millennium Bugs
items.description: Set in the days leading up to the year 2000, Kelly and Miguel find themselves facing mounting pressures and the harsh realities of their futures.

items.title: Diana at Sixty
items.description: A new insight into Princess Diana, with interviews from those who knew her best, looking at her life, loves, and where she might be today.

items.title: Drive All Night
items.description: Drive All Night follows Dave, a reclusive swing-shift taxi driver, whose night takes an unexpected turn after he picks up a mysterious passenger, Cara, a young woman hiding a dark secret.

items.title: Final Summer
items.description: In the aftermath of a tragedy at a summer camp, a group of camp counselors find themselves fighting for their lives against a masked killer.

items.title: Princes of the Palace
items.description: Follow the lives of the Royal British Princes, with insightful interviews from Royal biographers. Get an inside view of how each generation of princes are groomed for duty in our everchanging world.

items.title: Rescued
items.description: Inspired by true life events, RESCUED carefully meshes the lives of two brothers, where questions of inner struggle and faith are depicted.

items.title: Kathie Lee Gifford Presents: The Way
items.description: Bible stories brought to life as never seen before written by four-time Emmy award-winning TV personality, actress, and best-selling author Kathie Lee Gifford.

items.title: Once Upon a Time in Mongolia
items.description: Mya tries to find her long-lost father in the exotic deserts of Mongolia. Her journey includes horse racing, archery and wrestling contests, debates about God, dead-end leads and ultimately falling in love.

items.title: Summer of 8
items.description: Eight close friends soak up their last day of summer together on the beach before parting ways for college.

items.title: The Trial
items.description: After the death of his wife and two sons, suicide seems to be the only escape for a small town attorney, until he's assigned a capital punishment case that begins to transform his life.

items.title: Blank
items.description: After checking in for an A.I.-operated writer's retreat, Claire finds herself trapped in her unit with a malfunctioning android. As her captor becomes increasingly unstable she has to outsmart the technology in order to make it out alive.

items.title: Elizabeth Windsor
items.description: A woman caught between ruling a nation, duty, and family, and how she has led a monarchy through some of the greatest changes in modern history. A woman who never chose her life, but who has become the world's longest-ever serving Queen.

items.title: Prince Phillip: The Man Behind the Throne
items.description: The incredible story of Prince Philip's journey from refugee to consort of Queen Elizabeth II. A descendant of kings, queens, and czars, he shaped and modernized the British monarchy, preserving it for future generations.

items.title: Sunset Strip
items.description: Home to the biggest sounds, iconic images, and cultural movements experience the Strip from its origins in the 1920s with Prohibition through the Mafia Wars, Teen Riots, Punk, Hair Bands, Heavy Metal, Hip Hop, and Grunge to today's resurgence.

items.title: My Darling Vivian
items.description: The story of Vivian Liberto, Johnny Cash's first wife and the mother of his four daughters. Features never-before-seen footage and photographs.

items.title: A Greater Yes:  The Amy Newhouse Story
items.description: A sixteen-year-old girl's faith in God proves stronger than the cancer killing her.

items.title: Bridget Jones: Al borde de la razón
items.description: Después de seis semanas perfectas con su novio Mark Darcy, el pícaro Daniel Cleaver vuelve, afirmando ser un hombre reformado. ¿Encontrará Bridget una forma de hacer que el amor perdure para siempre?

items.title: Turn It Around: The Story Of East Bay Punk
items.description: TURN IT AROUND: THE STORY OF EAST BAY PUNK spans over 30 years of the California Bay Area's punk music history with a central focus on the emergence of Berkeley's inspiring 924 Gilman music collective.

items.title: Being BeBe: The BeBe Zahara Benet Documentary
items.description: Being BeBe intimately charts 15 years for drag performer BeBe Zahara Benet, an immigrant from homophobic Cameroon, the first champion on the iconic LGBTQ+ reality show RuPaul's Drag Race & a leading artist celebrating Queer Black Excellence today.

items.title: Forget Me Not
items.description: Will, a man struggling with a tragedy in his life, spends 24 hours with the beautiful Eve after a chance meeting, but can he reveal his secret to her?

items.title: Maserati: 100 Years Against All Odds
items.description: From a small Italian garage into the world-famous icon and luxurious automobile we know today, the evolution of the Maserati business, brand, and cars over 100 years, as told by the Maserati family, world-famous racers, collectors, and more.

items.title: Girl Gone Bad
items.description: A teenage girl has the house to herself with a romantic evening planned. However, an intruder makes it a night that will change her life.

items.title: Good Dick
items.description: A modern fairy tale about a troubled, reclusive young woman and the persistent video clerk who draws her out of her claustrophobic world by starting up a unique courtship with her.

items.title: Britain's Royals: The House of Windsor
items.description: The Royals have held us spellbound for centuries. Their every action is monitored and reported to the masses. But it wasn't always this way. The evolution of the family is an amazing story with more intrigue and drama than any Hollywood blockbuster.

items.title: Infinitum: Subject Unknown
items.description: Jane wakes up in a strange, empty world. Unbeknownst to her, she is part of a mysterious experiment. With few clues and little help, she must discover a way out in order to avoid repeating the same day over and over again, Ad Infinitum.

items.title: Graphic Desires
items.description: When reclusive Franklin cheats on his partner with a mysterious girl he meets on a dating app, it becomes the start of a deadly obsession.

items.title: King George VI: The Man Behind the King's Speech
items.description: When his brother abdicates the throne, successor George "Bertie" VI is plagued with shyness and a speech impediment in this true story of an introverted humble man who became an inspiration for the British nation during WWII.

items.title: Gatsby in Connecticut: The Untold Story
items.description: The summer Scott and Zelda Fitzgerald met a mystery millionaire who threw extravagant parties inspired one of the world's most beloved novels: The Great Gatsby. Discover the untold story of the real-life Jay Gatsby himself.

items.title: Oppenheimer: The Real Story
items.description: The documentary covers Oppenheimer's contribution to nuclear physics as a professor and leader of the Los Alamos Laboratory.

items.title: Alien Origin
items.description: Recently discovered footage from a lost military expedition exposes a horrifying truth about the genesis of life on earth.

items.title: War of the Worlds (The Asylum)
items.description: Modern retelling of H.G. Wells' classic: Earth invaded by aliens with colossal walkers, cities crumble, and one man seeks a game-changing weapon.

items.title: The Wrong Friend
items.description: The moment Riley meets Chris, she thinks he is handsome, charming and affectionate. He seems perfect, but after a party at his house, Riley sees that Chris has a darker side.

items.title: Color of Medicine, The: The Story of Homer G. Phillips Hospital
items.description: Homer G. Phillips Hospital provided state-of-the-art medical training to African-American physicians and nurses during the most turbulent of segregated times paving way for people of color to achieve greatness for the benefit of humankind.

items.title: Interface
items.description: Shortly after returning home from college, Claire lost her father in a hit & run car accident which deteriorated her estranged mother's health and sent her into a coma.

items.title: Harry & Meghan: A Modern Royal Romance
items.description: Meet the newest royal couple Prince Harry and Meghan Markle as we follow the story from the beginning of their unconventional romance to engagement and discover how an American actress will become a member of the British Royal family.

items.title: Ana
items.description: Rafa, discovers nine-year-old Ana sleeping in the back of one of his car. In an attempt to both locate Ana's father and somehow settle Rafa's increasingly pressing debts, Rafa and Ana embark on an dangerous expedition together.

items.title: Sweet on You
items.description: Small-town pie shop owner Kate encounters city boy Drew, who has arrived to build tract homes that would run straight through her business. Until Drew soon finds his heart trapped between his family's wishes and a chance at love.

items.title: Harry & Meghan: A Modern Royal Wedding
items.description: Follow the royal couple's journey from the engagement to their epic wedding with actual footage, the cake and flowers to the location - Windsor Castle - with commentary from close friends, correspondents and stylists.

items.title: The Gospel According to Matthew
items.description: In Israel/Palestine/Jordan, then known as Judea (Roman province) of the Roman Empire, Jesus Christ of Nazareth travels around the country with his disciples preaching to the people about God and salvation of their souls.

items.title: Acts of the Apostles
items.description: Luke tells the story here. Jesus ascends to heaven after 40 days, and Judas is replaced by Matthias.

items.title: Sweetness in the Belly
items.description: An orphan in Ethiopia escapes as a refugee to England, whereupon growing up, she works to aid fellow immigrants and refugees in reuniting with their families.

items.title: Ghosts and the Afterlife: A Scientific Investigation
items.description: 12 years of scientific research and expert investigations prove that ghosts are real and our souls are consciousness with or without the physical body. Doctors discuss what happens upon death and how different religions perceive it.

items.title: Hallucinations
items.description: Aliens descend in crystal spaceships to make contact with people through guitar amp distortion and glowing animal skulls.

items.title: Outpost
items.description: A woman seeks recovery from a violent assault as a fire lookout, but is overwhelmed by her isolation and tragic past.

items.title: Lazarus (ESP)
items.description: Un hombre es víctima de un asesinato. Al recobrar la conciencia, descubre que le han sido otorgados poderes sobrenaturales, los cuales le permiten luchar heroicamente contra la organización responsable de hundir a su ciudad en la oscuridad.

items.title: The Sad Sack
items.description: A bumbling hero with a photographic memory winds up in Morocco as a private in the French Foreign Legion. He still hasn't adjusted after 18 months. Among other things, he's lost a tank.

items.title: Killerman
items.description: LIAM HEMSWORTH stars in this gritty action thriller. After a car crash leaves money launderer Moe Diamond with no memory, millions in cash, and dirty cops hunting him down, he must race to survive in New York City's criminal underworld.

items.title: Fly Like A Girl
items.description: Follows women who dared to aim higher from Lego-loving young girls who include female pilots in her toy airplanes, to a courageous woman who helped lead shuttle missions to space.

items.title: Hearts and Bones
items.description: Daniel is preparing an exhibition of his work from the world's war zones. When Sebastian learns that this exhibition may display photographs of a massacre in his village, he finds Daniel and appeals to him to exclude those photographs.

items.title: Stacked
items.description: Twenty-three years after a fly ball determined the outcome of one of the greatest high school baseball games ever played, for the first time ever players from both teams sit down to recant that game, that play, and the effect it's made on their lives.

items.title: Ella espera un bebé
items.description: Jake y Kristi eran dos jóvenes solteros locos y enamorados. Pero un año después, se convirtieron en dos adultos locos y casados atravesando una fase de transición.

items.title: Sergio Mendes In the Key of Joy
items.description: A joyful cinematic celebration of this singular musical artist who remains as vital and relevant today as when he exploded on the scene with his group, Brasil '66.

items.title: Running the Bases
items.description: When a small-town baseball coach gets an offer to coach at a large school, he uproots his family and leaves the only home he's ever known. But as a man of faith, he soon faces opposition to his coaching style from the bitter superintendent.

items.title: Body Cam
items.description: A police officer (Mary J. Blige) investigating a fellow officer's murder discovers an evil spirit targeting the cops in her unit, uncovering a sinister secret surrounding the shooting and cover-up of an unarmed youth in this intense action thriller.

items.title: Contra las cuerdas
items.description: Contra las cuerdas presenta a Meg Ryan como Kallen. Una osada y estridente entrenadora de boxeo decidida a cambiar Luther Shaw “Lethal” (Omar Epps) de ser un hombre punk de la calle a convertirse en el ganador mundial del boxeo.

items.title: The Ring Two
items.description: When evidence at a local crime scene reveals a mysterious unmarked videotape, Rachel realizes that Samara is back and more determined than ever to continue her relentless cycle of terror.

items.title: Una extraña pareja, otra vez
items.description: Oscar Madison y Félix Ungar son invitados a la boda de sus hijos, Brucey y Hannah respectivamente. Por lo que deciden viajar juntos a Los Angeles para llegar a la boda de sus hijos. Pero a pesar del tiempo siguen siendo una extraña pareja.

items.title: Wonder Park
items.description: Buckle up for a fun-tastic family adventure where anything is possible! Future inventor June discovers her dream amusement park is real. But when trouble hits, she takes her misfit team of animal friends on an unforgettable journey to save the park.

items.title: Sometime Other Than Now
items.description: Seeking redemption, a middle-aged man drives cross the country, in search of the daughter he abandoned as a child.

items.title: Sound of Violence
items.description: Alexis recovered her hearing during the brutal murder of her family when she was ten. The visceral experience awakened synesthetic abilities in her and started her on an orphaned path of self-discovery through the healing music of brutal violence.

items.title: All We Had
items.description: The unstable life & relationship of a mother & daughter seems to be looking up with the opportunity of a fresh start, until the dark side of the American dream leads them to face the prospect of homelessness & tests their bond to the core.

items.title: The Breach
items.description: Chief of Police John Hawkins must investigate a final case involving a mutilated body with strange wounds found on the banks of a river.

items.title: The Hammer
items.description: When a prison boxer turns down freedom for fighting in the 1984 Olympics, to protect those he loves, he forces his best friend to learn the true meaning of loyalty.

items.title: Stand By Me: Ben E. King Legacy Live
items.description: The legendary composer of "Stand By Me," Ben E. King's last live performance in Tokyo, Japan. Previously unreleased songs are included.

items.title: Paranoia
items.description: Kale Brecht (Shia LaBeouf) pasa los días espiando a los vecinos, mientras cumple un arresto domiciliario de tres meses. Todo es juegos y diversión hasta que las cosas dan un horroroso giro hacia lo peor.

items.title: Coda (2019)
items.description: A famous pianist suddenly afflicted with a severe case of stage fright is brought to confront old wounds with the help of a free-spirited music critic with an uncommon take on life.

items.title: Baby Done
items.description: Wannabe-adventurer Zoe freaks out when she falls pregnant to her long-term boyfriend Tim. As Tim embraces the prospect of fatherhood, Zoe attempts to rush through her dreams.

items.title: Sydney. Juego, prostitución y muerte
items.description: John, lleva una vida sin recursos en Reno. Un día, un misterioso hombre llamado Sydney, se compadece de él y le ofrece la oportunidad de ganar dinero en los casinos, abriéndole la puerta a un universo peligroso, plagado de criminales y estafadores.

items.title: Encubrimiento
items.description: Una policía investiga el asesinato de un compañero y se enfrenta a un espíritu maligno que acosas a los policías de su unidad. Pronto descubre el siniestro secreto sobre el encubrimiento de un tiroteo en contra de un joven desarmado.

items.title: Corporate Animals
items.description: Lucy (Demi Moore), an egotistical CEO, takes her staff on a corporate team-building caving weekend. When disaster strikes, this mismatched and disgruntled group must pull together in order to survive.

items.title: Candid About Love
items.description: Gallery assistant Laura is finally promised a spot in a newcomer's photography showcase - but only if she can get a reclusive artist, Shane, to premiere his newest photographs at the gallery.

items.title: Food for the Heart
items.description: Chef Lia's efforts to expand her meal delivery service is stunted by her juggling it all alone. With help from her neighbor Eli she finds that business, like romance, can thrive with effort and trust.

items.title: Love at First Like
items.description: A journalist who is out of her depth in the social media world is partnered with the leading dating advice influencer on a profile. Can they move past their clashes and open up their hearts?

items.title: Hot Pursuit
items.description: What would you do to share a sun-splashed week in the Caribbean with someone special? Battle a pirate?...A hurricane?...A hijacking goon squad? Prep-schooler Dan Bartlett does all that and more when he takes off in Hot Pursuit of his girlfriend.

items.title: Love's Playlist
items.description: Streaming music exec Amanda is partnered with arrogant brand rep Sam on an important launch party, discovering that he is the same person she has been flirting with in an online chatroom.

items.title: Love on the Reef
items.description: A smart and serious marine biologist and a fun-loving and laissez-faire dive instructor must team up to save their beloved reef from being destroyed before it's too late.

items.title: The PA and the Manhattan Prince
items.description: Loyal, quick-thinking Lucy is a Personal Assistant to the stars. But when Prince Rupert arrives in New York for a masked ball, Lucy finds herself falling in love with her new employer.

items.title: A Very British Christmas
items.description: When a US opera singer is stranded in Yorkshire, the only place to stay is a B&B in an enchanting village, run by handsome widower Andrew.

items.title: Popeye (ESP)
items.description: El legendario y querido marinero de los siete mares, armado con un yunque, cobra vida mágicamente en este encantador musical, protagonizado por Robin Williams como Popeye.

items.title: Family of Us: A PBS American Portrait Story
items.description: Whether we came together through blood or through love, by genetics or by choice, we recognize the value of our families. Family of Us: A PBS American Portrait Story paints a picture of today's American family and the ways it defines us.

items.title: Acechada
items.description: Una mujer policía recibe un caso en el que descubre que todos los asesinados son antiguos novios.

items.title: Resucitados
items.description: Un grupo de investigadores médicos descubren una manera de revivir a los pacientes muertos.

items.title: Le Mans
items.description: Steve McQueen is an American endurance driver racing the 24 HOURS OF LE MANS in this fast and furious original movie. Filmed on location throughout the Le Mans circuit, with jaw dropping car crash stunts and heart-pounding action.

items.title: Dreamland
items.description: Discovering a fugitive bank robber (Margot Robbie) is hiding in his small town, a young man is torn between claiming the bounty on her head and his growing attraction to the seductive criminal, in this epic love story set during the Great Depression.

items.title: Generation 9/11
items.description: Generation 9/11 marks the 20th anniversary of the attacks by telling the stories of 7 young people whose fathers were killed that day. Their experiences echo those of an entire generation, whose lives so far have been bracketed by crisis.

items.title: Journey of the Bonesetter's Daughter
items.description: Follow the creation of the San Francisco Opera's production of Amy Tan's bestselling book. This cross-cultural tour de force brings together artists from China and the U.S., and tells a story about the bond between mothers and daughters.

items.title: Christmas At The Holly Day Inn
items.description: Emma visits her father's country inn over Christmas. When she finds out he is under pressure to sell, she sets out to save the inn.

items.title: Suffocated: Room to Breathe
items.description: To pass a college course, Elaine, comes on to her female professor, and is met with unexpected consequences.

items.title: The Elephant King
items.description: The clumsy and timid elephant becomes king by facing his fears.

items.title: When I Walk
items.description: The film follows Jason DaSilva during the seven years following his diagnosis of primary progressive multiple sclerosis.

items.title: Favorite Son
items.description: When David returns to his childhood hometown, he is still haunted by old secrets. David is the last one the town elders want near the young, troubled Ross, but David might be the only one who can save Ross from an evil that's been haunting the town.

items.title: Pacto de amor
items.description: El Rey de Navarra y sus mejores amigos renuncian al amor, para dedicarse a la iluminación intelectual; pero con la visita de la Princesa de Francia y sus hermosas asistentes, sus juramentos tambalean.

items.title: A Wiseguy Christmas
items.description: Former New York mob boss Tony Pantera has just been relocated to Los Angeles in the witness protection program. Not a fan of Christmas, Tony must rediscover the true meaning of Christmas, while trying to stay alive.

items.title: A Taste Of Whale
items.description: It is the 'Grind' season again - Faroe Islanders' ritual slaughter of pilot whales. Two proud whalers are on one side, two young and passionate Sea Shepherd activists on the other. A Taste of Whale invites you to see what meat-eating is truly about.

items.title: Chaplin
items.description: Chaplin es un encantador retrato a gran escala de la vida y época del vagabundo. Su infancia marcada por la pobreza en Inglaterra cobra vida, junto con su amistades, sus esposas y romances escandalosos, y la implacable persecución de J. Edgar Hoover.

items.title: La isla
items.description: Un hombre huye tras descubrir que en realidad es un “ser clonado”, y permanece junto a otros en un lugar único.

items.title: Mission to the Moon
items.description: Louis sets off on a race to the moon alongside a brilliant inventor and a nervous hedgehog. Together, they must complete a daring mission that is out of this world.

items.title: King Kong (1976)
items.description: Una expedición americana va en búsqueda de un yacimiento petrolífero, y descubre una isla en la que habita King Kong, un gorila gigante, al que capturan y llevan de vuelta a Nueva York.

items.title: Georgetown
items.description: Christoph Waltz, Vanessa Redgrave, and Annette Bening star in the thrilling true story of a smooth-talking social climber scaling the ranks in D.C., who comes under investigation when his wealthy, well-connected older wife turns up dead in their home.

items.title: Here And Now
items.description: Vivienne (Sarah Jessica Parker), is an established singer with a successful career. On the eve of a major performance, Vivienne receives some life-altering news causing her to reevaluate her priorities.

items.title: Kings of Mulberry Street
items.description: An epic tale of two 9-year-old misfits who must overcome their differences and defeat the bullying local crime lord who's threatening their families.

items.title: Baby Cages: Denazification Of Hitler Youth
items.description: In a final insane attempt to turn the tide of the war, Hitler recruited from the Hitler Youth, enlisting children as young as 12 years old.

items.title: Alaskan Nets
items.description: Metlakatla is Alaska's last Native Indian reserve. For hundreds of years, two distinct traditions have defined their community, fishing and basketball.

items.title: After Everything
items.description: A young couple's relationship develops quickly when one of them is diagnosed with a life-changing illness.

items.title: Woodshock
items.description: A haunted young woman spirals into confusion and chaos after she falls under the spell of a potent reality-altering drug.

items.title: In Bloom
items.description: Embark on a captivating journey through 5 compelling short films that delve into the complexities of gender issues following characters on the brink of a life defining moment, whether a first or a last, by choice or circumstance.

items.title: Always At The Carlyle
items.description: Always At The Carlyle brings to life the untold stories of the legendary hotel from its own employees and top guests, George Clooney, Jeff Goldblum, Wes Anderson, Jon Hamm & more.

items.title: El informante
items.description: Moe Diamond, blanqueador de capitales, sufre un accidente automovilístico que lo deja sin memoria, con millones en efectivo, y un grupo de policías corruptos persiguiéndole. Liam Hemsworth protagoniza este oscuro thriller de acción.

items.title: Showdown at the Grand
items.description: A proud movie theater owner must defend his family business against corporate developers, alongside a legendary action star, as art imitates life in a showdown for the ages.

items.title: 15 Things You Didn't Know About Bigfoot
items.description: A clickbait journalist is sent to the Appalachian foothills to cover a Bigfoot convention, where he discovers there's more to this assignment than meets the eye.

items.title: All Nighter
items.description: A workaholic father who attempts to visit his daughter during a layover in LA, only to discover that she's disappeared, is forced to team up with her awkward ex-boyfriend to find her over the course of one transformative night.

items.title: My Giraffe
items.description: A young boy hatches a mischievious plan to bring his pet giraffe to school.

items.title: 100% Coco
items.description: A quirky 13-year-old girl dreams of becoming a style icon and anonymously starts her own fashion vlog called the Style Tiger. As the vlog becomes a big hit, Coco gets the chance to chase her dreams in Paris.

items.title: Bel Canto
items.description: A world-renowned opera singer (Julianne Moore) becomes trapped in a hostage situation when she's invited to perform for a wealthy industrialist (Ken Watanabe) in South America.

items.title: Benjamin the Elephant
items.description: Benjamin the Elephant and his best friend Otto set off on a wild adventure to save the zoo.

items.title: Hope Lost
items.description: A young girl meets a producer who wants to cast her in a show in Italy. But when she arrives, she is sold into prostitution and then bought by a sadist who makes snuff movies.

items.title: Battle for Afghanistan
items.description: 1988-1989. The end of the Soviet-Afghan war. The USSR begins its withdrawal from Afghanistan. Soviet General Vasiliev's son - a pilot named Alexander gets kidnapped by the mujahideen after his airplane crashes.

items.title: A Gentleman's Game
items.description: A drama revolving around characters whose lives are transformed one summer at an exclusive East Coast country club.

items.title: El mafioso, el policía y el diablo
items.description: Tras apenas sobrevivir al violento ataque de un escurridizo asesino en serie, el jefe criminal Jang Dong-Su se encuentra formando una extraña asociación con el detective local Jung Tae-Seok, para atrapar al sádico asesino sencillamente conocido como “K”.

items.title: El caballero de las sombras
items.description: Pu Songling, un legendario cazador de demonios, debe investigar las misteriosas desapariciones de niñas en un pequeño pueblo. Cuando descubre las fuerzas del mal, trata de salvar a la humanidad en esta fantástica comedia de artes marciales y acción.

items.title: El hombre sin pasado
items.description: Un tranquilo cuidador en una casa de empeño, con un pasado violento, se enfrenta a una red de tráfico de drogas y órganos con la esperanza de salvar a una niña que es su única amiga.

items.title: Estación zombi
items.description: Una desgarradora película de terror y suspenso zombi, que sigue a un grupo de pasajeros aterrorizados que se abren camino a través de un brote viral en todo el país.

items.title: Imparable
items.description: El señor Dong Chul y la señora Ji Soo son una pareja felizmente casada. Un día, Dong Chul regresa a casa, la encuentra desordenada y con su esposa desaparecida.

items.title: The President's Man: A Line In The Sand
items.description: A counterterrorism specialist is assigned by the President to track down a terrorist who is suspected of planning to set off a nuclear device in the U.S.

items.title: Coffee Wars
items.description: Vegan barista takes on the world at the World Barista Championship.

items.title: Away From Here
items.description: After serving time for an affair with his mentor's teen daughter, a former youth minister returns home to find that he can't leave the past behind.

items.title: Doom Runners
items.description: In a post-apocalyptic world, a group of children move from one uncertain world to another, seeking sanctuary. With Tim Curry.

items.title: American Sausage Standoff
items.description: Two hopeless dreamers join forces in a quest to erect the ultimate German sausage restaurant, much to the irritation of the residents of the small-town of Gutterbee, who want to keep their town wholly American.

items.title: Logan's War: Bound By Honor
items.description: An Army Ranger infiltrates a mob family by posing as a hit man. In conjunction with his uncle, they are plotting revenge against the killers who murdered his entire family when he was young.

items.title: Simulacros de liberación
items.description: Después de soportar una crisis económica de diez años, los peligros del cambio climático y la inestabilidad del gobierno, los puertorriqueños organizaron centros comunitarios, marcando su camino hacia la liberación.

items.title: Ti@s
items.description: Inspirado por la discriminación que sufre su tío Ramón debido a su condición sexual, John Petrizzelli utiliza la pantalla para narrar la anécdota.

items.title: Plantados
items.description: Cuando Ramón descubre a Mauricio, uno de los guías carcelarios más crueles que recuerda cuando fue encarcelado en Cuba y ahora vive en Florida, empieza a recordar algunos casos traumáticos vividos con su torturador.

items.title: All Styles
