items.description: Brandon, a college freshman, tries to focus on his studies but keeps coming to the same conclusion: dance is his passion. He assembles a ragtag crew to face off against his former crew and must prove that they have what it takes to make it as dancers.

items.title: The President's Man
items.description: A U.S. president's highly classified secret agent must find a fearless replacement to take over his extremely dangerous military missions.

items.title: La leyenda de los puños de fuego
items.description: Con Japón dividido en dos por el conflicto internacional, es un caldo de cultivo de espías, mafiosos, militares, todos tratando de obtener el control del país, con poca consideración por lo que ocurre a sus ciudadanos.

items.title: Dope Boy Magic
items.description: Stacy is a freshman at a Historic Black College & University. She Meets and falls in love with a Grad Student named Benjamin.

items.title: Shaolin
items.description: En una joven República de China, Hou Jie nos muestra piedad con sus enemigos que buscan refugio con los monjes Shaolin. Hou Jie paga un precio terrible por sus acciones y se ve obligado a buscar refugio en el monasterio de Shaolin.

items.title: Max Cloud (ESP)
items.description: Cuando la pequeña Sarah abre un portal a su juego favorito de desplazamiento lateral, queda atrapada en una prisión intergaláctica, hogar de los villanos más peligrosos de la galaxia.

items.title: Acción policial
items.description: La leyenda de las artes marciales Jackie Chan presenta la quinta entrega de la franquicia “Acción policial”, incluyendo a Tian Jing (SPECIAL ID) y Rongguang Yu (THE KARATE KID) en una historia de vínculos familiares, traiciones y venganza.

items.title: American Badger
items.description: A seemingly cold-blooded hitman is assigned to befriend a call girl, but all hell breaks loose when he is ordered to kill her.

items.title: Ashgrove
items.description: Dr. Jennifer Ashgrove - one of the world's top scientists - is battling to find a cure to a crisis that affects the world's water supply.

items.title: Spiritwalker (ESP)
items.description: Un hombre con amnesia de repente comienza a recuperar la conciencia en un nuevo cuerpo cada 12 horas. Pero sin memoria, y sin aliados, su tiempo se está acabando.

items.title: Sombras
items.description: En Pei, un reino gobernado por un rey joven y impredecible, el comandante militar se enfrenta a peligros tanto dentro como fuera del palacio. Pero tiene un arma secreta; una 'sombra', un parecido, que puede engañar a los enemigos de Pei y al Rey.

items.title: American Folk
items.description: When their plane from Los Angeles to New York is grounded on the morning of September 11, 2001, strangers Elliott (Joe Purdy) and Joni (Amber Rubarth) are unexpectedly thrust together amidst the chaos of that historic day.

items.title: Alive
items.description: Two injured strangers awaken in an abandoned hospital with no recollection of who they are or how they got there.

items.title: Murder Masters of Kung Fu
items.description: Passing through town, a martial arts master attempts to seduce a young woman then kills her outraged father. The daughter subsequently slips incognito into the enemy camp on a mission of revenge.

items.title: Margrete: Queen of the North (Eng dub)
items.description: 1402. Queen Margrete is ruling Sweden, Norway, and Denmark through her adopted son, Erik. But a conspiracy is in the making and Margrete finds herself in an impossible dilemma that could shatter her life's work: the Kalmar Union.

items.title: Wildlife Of The West
items.description: Experience the wonder of more than 2 dozen of the West's most intriguing animals. Wildlife of the West takes you stream-side and mountain-side, to dizzying heights and stunning habitats. Written and narrated by Emmy Award winner, Tim Woodward.

items.title: Beating Super Bugs
items.description: BEATING SUPERBUGS: CAN WE WIN?, a feature-length documentary, presents an accessible, in-depth, true-to-fact message with a touch of mystery and suspense throughout: CAN we beat superbugs?

items.title: Being The Change
items.description: Complementing the book Being the Change, this feature documentary film delves into the life of Caltech / Jet Propulsion Laboratory atmospheric scientist Peter Kalmus, showing how a change in life philosophy and mind frame enabled Kalmus.

items.title: The Hunter Legacy
items.description: Grandchildren of big game hunters travel through Kenya to see how to save endangered species.

items.title: Back To Berlin
items.description: Back to Berlin is the first biker flick-meets-holocaust feature documentary. Eleven motor bikers have a mission to take the Maccabiah torch from Israel to the site of the infamous 1936 Berlin Olympics, for the first Jewish Olympic Games on German soil.

items.title: The Boneyard (1991)
items.description: Children turned into zombies wreak havoc in a coroner's building with just a burned-out psychic, an experienced cop and two coroners to stop the madness.

items.title: Nazi Hunters
items.description: Shortly after the end of the World War II: In 1945 and 1946, the men of the British 'War Crimes Investigation Unit' drove through northern Germany on the hunt for Nazi criminals. One of them is Captain Anton Walter Freud, the grandson of Sigmund Freud.

items.title: The Rise and Fall of the American Mafia in Las Vegas
items.description: The Rise and Fall of the American Mafia in Las Vegas is a 90-minute documentary film by Mark W. Curran. It tells the story of how the mob came to control Las Vegas through corruption, greed, and murder.

items.title: Mata Hari The Naked Spy
items.description: A 100 years ago, Mata Hari faced the firing squad as a convicted German spy. Was she a dangerous spy, whose boldness and sexuality threatened the establishment, or a victim entangled in a climate of blame and desperation as WWI dragged on?

items.title: Las horas contigo
items.description: Eva debe aprender a lidiar con un embarazo no deseado frente a la muerte inminente de su amada abuela y arreglar su relación con su madre separada.

items.title: Creation
items.description: Torn between faith and science, and suffering hallucinations, English naturalist Charles Darwin struggles to complete 'On the Origin of Species' and maintain his relationship with his wife.

items.title: The Last Rite
items.description: A medical student suffering from sleep paralysis finds herself plagued by a demonic entity, after moving in with her boyfriend.

items.title: Running Against the Wind
items.description: In Ethiopia, two men are running to achieve their dreams.

items.title: Besos que matan
items.description: Ocho mujeres secuestradas, todas hermosas, todas talentosas, todas en peligro de perder su vida cruelmente, si el detective Alex Cross y la testigo clave Kate McTiernan no logran localizar al escurridizo “coleccionista” que se hace llamar Casanova.

items.title: Hansel y Gretel: Cazadores de brujas
items.description: Prepárate para una versión retorcida del cuento clásico. Convertidos en profesionales, Hansel y Gretel se enfrentan al trauma de su cautiverio infantil, asesinando brujas a sueldo.

items.title: Descubriendo el país de nunca jamás
items.description: Fantasía y realidad confluyen en este éxito memorable que explora los orígenes de una de las fábulas más maravillosas de todos los tiempos: Peter Pan. Nominada a siete Premios Óscar, incluida la mejor película.

items.title: Chameleon Street
items.description: William Douglas Street is bored with his life. Working for his father is getting to him, his wife wants more money, and he's had enough. His solution is to re-invent himself. He becomes a chameleon, taking on whatever role suits the situation.

items.title: Brian Wilson: Long Promised Road
items.description: Join The Beach Boys' Brian Wilson on an intimate journey through his legendary career as he reminisces with 'Rolling Stone' editor and friend Jason Fine. Featuring interviews with Elton John, Bruce Springsteen, Nick Jonas, Linda Perry and more.

items.title: Black Water: Abyss
items.description: Deep in the forests of Australia, five friends are exploring a remote cave system when a tropical storm hits. As rising flood waters trap them deep below the surface, something even deadlier emerges from the darkness: killer crocodiles.

items.title: El puño del cóndor
items.description: Un grupo de luchadores de artes marciales de todo el mundo está buscando un libro que contenga los antiguos secretos de cómo superar los límites del cuerpo humano.

items.title: Nemesis
items.description: An underworld kingpin's past catches up with him when he returns to London, igniting an explosive chain of events which ends in revenge and murder.

items.title: Perdidos en Nueva York
items.description: La pasión del matrimonio entre Henry y Nancy Clark desapareció hace mucho tiempo. Pero ahora su hijo menor ha abandonado el nido y los Clarks tienen la oportunidad de trasladarse a Nueva York.

items.title: Jugadores
items.description: Los ganadores del Óscar, Matt Damon y Edward Norton, protagonizan Rounders. Un exadicto a las apuestas regresa a las mesas en una apuesta de vida o muerte para rescatar a su amigo.

items.title: Tierra de sueños
items.description: Un joven se encuentra en un dilema, cuando descubre a una ladrona de bancos escondiéndose en su pequeña aldea; entre reclamar la recompensa por su cabeza y su creciente atracción por la seductora delincuente.

items.title: Storm Lake
items.description: Pulitzer prize-winning journalist Art Cullen and his family fight to unite and inform their rural Iowan farming community through their biweekly newspaper, The Storm Lake Times—come hell or pandemic.

items.title: The Feud
items.description: Discover the real story behind the most famous family conflict in U.S. history - the battle between the Hatfields and McCoys. More than a tale of two warring families, the film goes beyond the myth to show the forces that ignited the feud.

items.title: The Jewish Journey: America
items.description: The Jewish Journey: America explores what it meant to be part of a tight-knit Jewish community and make the heartbreaking choice to leave family behind, whether for economic opportunity or to escape persecution.

items.title: Through the Night
items.description: Through the Night is a verité documentary that explores the personal cost of our modern economy through the stories of two working mothers and a childcare provider - whose lives intersect at a 24-hour daycare center.

items.title: The Orphan Trains
items.description: They relied on the kindness of strangers. The stories of some of the 150,000 poor children who from 1854 to 1929 were sent away from the cities on trains, by children's charities, to begin new lives with foster families far away.

items.title: The Windermere Children
items.description: Written by Simon Block, this powerful and uplifting drama is based on an extraordinary, untold true story of hope in the aftermath of the Holocaust.

items.title: Up Heartbreak Hill
items.description: Chronicling the lives of three Native American teenagers in Navajo, New Mexico, this is a moving look at a new generation of Americans struggling with what it means to be Native American in the contemporary world.

items.title: Underground Railroad: The William Still Story
items.description: William Still was one of the most important, yet largely unheralded heroes of the Underground Railroad. Still was determined to get as many runaways as he could to "Freedom's Land," smuggling them across the US border to Canada.

items.title: La fuerza de la verdad
items.description: Henry es un abogado exitoso que necesita ganar a toda costa, incluso si debe sacrificar a su familia. Pero un disparo detiene el veloz ascenso de Henry, dejándolo incapacitado y sin recuerdos de su vida anterior.

items.title: Stella - A History of War
items.description: Stella Andrássy fled the Red Army invasion of Hungary in 1945. Born in Sweden, she married into one of Hungary's most influential families. Her world torn apart from the war, she wrote a book about her experiences.

items.title: Scenes from the Glittering World
items.description: Three Indigenous students experience the highs and lows of adolescence while attending one of the most remote high schools in the United States. They navigate teenage life in the Navajo Nation while grappling with their uncertain futures.

items.title: Payback
items.description: After a successful heist, Porter is left for dead. Once he recovers, he seeks vengeance and wants his share of the money.

items.title: Hex
items.description: Following a mysterious disappearance on a jump, a group of skydivers experience paranormal occurrences that leave them fighting for their lives.

items.title: American Cousins
items.description: Two American mafiosi, Gino and Settimo, take refuge in the Glasgow cafe owned by their Scottish/Italian cousin. But cousin Roberto isn't the tough guy they'd expected.

items.title: Real Men
items.description: A secret agent finds himself on the riskiest – and craziest – mission of his career. But when he’s forced to take on a mild-mannered insurance agent as his partner, his already peculiar mission suddenly turns extra dangerous...and extraterrestrial!

items.title: Rage of Honor
items.description: When his partner is killed during a drug bust, a federal agent throws away his badge and the rule book with it. Arming himself with an array of deadly weaponry including nunchucks and ninja stars, he sets out to settle the score with the bad guys.

items.title: The Amish: Shunned
items.description: What is it like to be cut off from your faith and your family? Follow seven people who have chosen to leave their closed and tightly-knit Amish communities for the outside world, knowing they can never return.

items.title: The Musicians' Green Book: An Enduring Legacy
items.description: Celebrate African American Jazz, R&B and Soul. Explore the Green Book, a guide to destinations where Black entertainers were safe during segregation. Experience classic songs, performances, interviews and stories from the era's musicians.

items.title: Golden Gate
items.description: Matt Dillon and Joan Chen heat up the screen in this stylish and compelling tale of mystery, intrigue and revenge as a brash F.B.I. Agent falls for the daughter of a man he wrongfully imprisoned during the height of McCarthy-era hysteria.

items.title: Puños de furia
items.description: Bruce Lee interpreta a Chen Zhen, un artista de artes marciales que regresa a su antigua escuela en Shanghái cuando se entera de la muerte de su amado instructor.

items.title: Señales de humo
items.description: Esta película, favorita de la crítica y el público, sigue a dos amigos muy diferentes en un viaje que nunca esperaban hacer. Combinando humor y emociones, explora la aventura de la amistad y el descubrimiento de nuevos mundos.

items.title: El último maestro del aire
items.description: Aire, agua, tierra, fuego. Se enfrentan cuatro naciones atadas por el destino cuando el fuego inicia la guerra contra los demás. Atrapado entre la guerra, un Avatar descubre que es capaz de manipular los cuatro elementos.

items.title: The Shadow of Violence
items.description: An ex-boxer turned enforcer has his loyalties tested when his ruthless employers order him to kill for the first time.

items.title: Wordplay
items.description: Filmmaker Patrick Creadon pays tribute to crossword puzzles with this in-depth look at The New York Times' long-time crossword puzzle editor Will Shortz and his loyal fan base.

items.title: Prey (2007)
items.description: While on holiday, an Amerian family are trapped by hungry lions in South Africa.

items.title: Death of Me
items.description: An island vacation turns deadly when a couple is snared in a web of mystery, black magic, and murder.

items.title: Mundo cool
items.description: Cuando Jack Deebs estaba tras las rejas, pudo salirse con la suya creando Cool World, una serie de cómics acerca de la sexy Holli Would. De todos modos, cuando Holli toma forma humana en Las Vegas, la carne resulta ser más débil que la tinta.

items.title: Cumbres Borrascosas
items.description: La intemporal historia de amor y pasión de Emily Bronte se hace realidad en esta emotiva versión cinematográfica que protagonizan Juliette Binoche y Ralph Fiennes.

items.title: Querido Dios
items.description: Greg Kinnear protagoniza en este espíritu-levantador sobre un estafador que va de nada bueno al hacer el bien.

items.title: Jay and Silent Bob Reboot
items.description: Jay and Silent Bob return to Hollywood to stop a reboot of the BLUNTMAN AND CHRONIC movie from getting made.

items.title: The Girl with All the Gifts
items.description: Six-time Academy Award® nominee Glenn Close stars in a post-apocalyptic story about a devastating disease that eradicates free will and turns its victims into flesh-eating 'hungries.'

items.title: Operación Overlord
items.description: Nada puede prepararte para el caos alucinante de Operación Overlord. El mega productor J.J. Abrams crea un emocionante viaje retorcido sobre un equipo de tropas estadounidenses que se encuentran cara a cara con los súper soldados nazis nunca vistos.

items.title: Sobreviviendo
items.description: Son cinco años después y Tony Manero sigue ardiendo. Ahora se pavonea hacia un desafío aún mayor, hacerlo como un bailarín en el escenario de Broadway.

items.title: Tragedy Girls
items.description: A twist on the slasher genre, following two death-obsessed teenage girls who use their online show about real-life tragedies to send their small mid-western town into a frenzy, and cement their legacy as modern horror legends.

items.title: Villains
items.description: After a pair of amateur criminals break into a suburban home, they stumble upon a dark secret that two sadistic homeowners will do anything to keep from getting out.

items.title: Fachon Models
items.description: Ulises es un actor fracasado que trabaja en avisos comerciales. Después de reunirse con Carolina, su novia de la escuela primaria, encuentra la motivación para obtener mejores conciertos y ponerse en forma.

items.title: Treintona, soltera y fantástica
items.description: Una mujer en sus treinta y tantos años se descubre a sí misma a través de la vida, el amor y el corazón roto.

items.title: Kung Fu Yoga
items.description: Un profesor de arqueología conocido mundialmente y su equipo deben localizar y salvar un antiguo tesoro perdido antes, que un equipo de mercenarios lo destruyan para siempre.

items.title: Death Rides A Horse
items.description: Lee Van Cleef and John Phillip Law star in this bona fide Spaghetti Western classic as, fifteen years after bandits massacred his family, a young man seeking revenge forms an unlikely alliance with the outlaw who was framed for the murders.

items.title: Jack Goes Boating
items.description: Jake Vig is a con man with a gift for duplicity and a natural charm. Now he’s cooked up the con of a lifetime, all part of a plan to even the score for the murder of a buddy, pay back those he owes and get the hell out of the business.

items.title: Elvis And Annabelle
items.description: Anabelle is a small town beauty on the road to being crowned the Miss Texas Rose title, when she tragically dies and on stage due to an eating disorder.

items.title: Valley Girl (2020)
items.description: In this musical adaptation of the hit 1983 film that changed American teenage life forever, Julie (Jessica Rothe) is the ultimate ‘80s Valley Girl, whose world is rocked when she falls hard for Randy (Josh Whitehouse), a punk rocker from Hollywood!

items.title: Hurricane Streets
items.description: One troubled teen trapped by the city and planning for the day that he can make a new life with his uncle in New Mexico. Just when he is on the verge of realizing his dream, a stunning turn of events creates a dark vortex that threatens to pull him down.

items.title: God's Creatures
items.description: A mother tells a lie for her beloved son that rips apart their family and close-knit Irish town— ultimately testing her own sense of right and wrong in this tense, atmospheric thriller.

items.title: Amistad
items.description: “Amistad” es la historia de un motín en 1839 a bordo de un barco de esclavos que viaja a la costa noroeste de Estados Unidos. Gran parte de la historia tiene que ver con un drama judicial sobre el esclavo que lideró la rebelión.

items.title: Actos de violencia
items.description: Cuando su prometida es secuestrada por traficantes de personas, Roman y sus hermanos ex-militares se proponen localizarla y salvarla antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

items.title: Asesino Kung Fu
items.description: Donnie Yen es un asesino y experto en kung fu, reclutado por la policía para rastrear a un asesino a cambio de recuperar su libertad.

items.title: The Slammin' Salmon
items.description: The Broken Lizard gang is back with a rowdy comedy involving a Miami restaurant owner who is indebted to the mob and institutes a contest to see what waiter can earn the most money in one night.

items.title: Lured
items.description: British police are after a serial killer who lures his female victims through newspaper personal ads and sends cryptic poem clues to the cops.

items.title: Elliot: The Littlest Reindeer
items.description: Elliot, a small but determined horse, travels to the North Pole to compete for a spot alongside the famous reindeer that pull Santa's sleigh. Against all odds, Elliot and his friend Hazel the goat set out to prove that no dream is too big.

items.title: Canadian Pacific
items.description: A surveyor for the Canadian Pacific Railroad must fight fur trappers who oppose the building of the railroad by stirring up Indian rebellion.

items.title: Cariboo Trail
items.description: Montanans Jim Redfern and Mike Evans head into Canada's British Columbia via the Cariboo Trail intent to raise cattle and dig for gold but find trouble instead.

items.title: Liga de Kung Fu
items.description: Cuando el jefe de Fei Ying Xiong le impide conseguir la chica de sus sueños, este pide ayuda a cuatro legendarios maestros de Kung Fu para aprender el máximo nivel de artes marciales y derrotar a sus enemigos.

items.title: La leyenda del gato demoniaco
items.description: Un poeta y un monje investigan a un gato demoniaco que ha poseído a la esposa de un general de la corte imperial. La investigación los conducirá al misterio que se esconde tras la muerte de una legendaria y bella cortesana.

items.title: Kickboxer: Contrataque
items.description: Cuando el luchador de MMA Kurt Sloane se ve obligado a participar en un combate a muerte con un asesino de 400 libras, busca la ayuda del legendario Maestro Durand (Jean-Claude Van Damme) y del luchador de prisión Briggs (Mike Tyson) para sobrevivir

items.title: Gundala
items.description: Basada en el exitoso cómic clásico Gundala. Cuando la avaricia y la violencia alcanzan un punto álgido, Sancaka, un huérfano convertido en malote, se convierte en la única esperanza de paz del pueblo.

items.title: Insignias de furia
items.description: Jet Li y Zhang Wen son un par de policías desparejados asignados a Los asesinatos de la sonrisa, que persiguen a un asesino en serie que tiene como objetivo a los ex novios de una famosa estrella.

items.title: Master Z: el legado de Ip Man
items.description: Tras su derrota ante el maestro Ip, Cheung Tin Chi, hace su vida con su hijo pequeño en Hong Kong, sirviendo mesas en un bar que atiende a expatriados. La mezcla de extranjeros, dinero y líderes de tríadas no tarda en atraerle de nuevo a la lucha.

items.title: Labyrinth
items.description: Sixteen-year-old Sarah must solve a labyrinth to rescue her baby brother when he is taken by the Goblin King.

items.title: The Dark Crystal
items.description: On another planet in the distant past, a Gelfling embarks on a quest to find the missing shard of a magical crystal, and to restore order to his world.

items.title: A Scandal in Paris
items.description: Born in a French prison in 1775, François Eugène Vidocq becomes a professional thief and is later appointed chief of Parisian police.

items.title: Carnegie Hall
items.description: A mother wants her son to grow up to be a pianist and to play at Carnegie Hall.

items.title: Story of G.I. Joe
items.description: At the close of WWII, Pulitzer Prize-winning war correspondent Ernie Pyle travels with the U.S. Army's Company C Division during their liberation of Italy.

items.title: Las Aparicio: la película
items.description: La exitosa serie “Las Aparicio” se traduce al cine y narra la historia de una familia de mujeres, pero; víctimas de una maldición, son viudas y no pueden concebir niños varones, por lo que deben unirse para resolver el secreto detrás de su viejo hogar.

items.title: Road to the Lemon Grove
items.description: A deceased Sicilian father has one last outrageous mission in store for his son - spread his ashes in the lemon groves of Sicily, reunite two feuding families, and discover the heart and soul of who he really is.

items.title: Night Skies
items.description: March 13, 1997. Five friends bound for Las Vegas accidentally hit a stalled truck belonging to an ex-soldier. Stranded together on an isolated country road, they are about to witness one of the largest UFO sightings in history.

items.title: Oklahoma!
items.description: In Oklahoma, several farmers, cowboys and a traveling salesman compete for the romantic favors of various local ladies.

items.title: Andrea Bocelli: A Bocelli Family Christmas
items.description: A Bocelli Family Christmas captures the wonder and music of the holidays with a mix of classic carols and original songs from the Bocelli family's brand new multi-generational album. It's a magical Christmas special for the whole family.

items.title: Hangmen Also Die
items.description: After the German administrator of Czechoslovakia is shot, his assassin tries to elude the Gestapo and struggles with his impulse to give himself up as hostages are executed.

items.title: Lazer Team
items.description: Four losers are thrust into the position of saving the world when they stumble upon a UFO crash site and become genetically equipped to the battle suit on board.

items.title: Hollywood Barn Dance
items.description: Charming variety collection of music is hosted by Cottonseed Clark.

items.title: Lazer Team 2
items.description: After one of their own is lost in another dimension, the Lazer Team groups together once again to fight against a new threat.

items.title: Visitantes
items.description: Espíritus malignos atormentan a una exitosa doctora (Kate del Castillo) y a su familia, haciendo que enloquezcan y desconfíen el uno del otro.

items.title: Bitch Slap
items.description: Three bad girls travel to a remote desert hideaway to steal $200 million in diamonds from a ruthless underworld kingpin.

items.title: Oklahoma! (1999)
items.description: Cowboy Curly McClain tries to win the heart of a girl in a singing and dancing extravaganza.

items.title: Los tres amigos
items.description: Las locuras de tres actores hollywoodenses (Steve Martin, Chevy Chase y Martin Short) que enfrentan a un grupo de bandidos mexicanos. ¿Qué podría salir mal?

items.title: The Infiltrator
items.description: A U.S. Customs official uncovers a money laundering scheme involving Colombian drug lord Pablo Escobar.

items.title: Wayne's World
items.description: When a sleazy TV exec offers Wayne and Garth a contract to tape their late-night cable-access show at his network, they discover the road to the big time is full of gnarly twists and turns.

items.title: Rob Roy: la pasión de un rebelde
items.description: En la Escocia de 1713, Rob Roy MacGregor es agraviado por un noble y su sobrino, se convierte en un proscrito en busca de venganza mientras huye de los casacas rojas y se enfrenta a la acusación de ser jacobita.

items.title: Evelyn (ESP)
items.description: Son tiempos difíciles en Dublín, Irlanda. Pero nadie lo tiene más difícil que Desmond Doyle cuando su esposa se marcha y el gobierno decide mandar a su amada hija Evelyn y sus otros dos hijos jóvenes a un orfanato.

items.title: Rojo
items.description: Un misterioso hombre llega a una ciudad y sin motivo aparente agrede a Claudio, un exitoso abogado. Tras un intento fallido, los ataques continúan, lo que despierta la ira de la esposa de Claudio.

items.title: Especies
items.description: Un experimento genético genera a una hermosa mujer mutante que amenaza a la raza humana.

items.title: Novio por una noche
items.description: Un dentista guapo pero un poco egocéntrico (Dane Cook) descubre que es un amuleto andante de la buena suerte, ya que las mujeres inevitablemente encuentran su alma gemela justo después de salir con él.

items.title: Jacuzzi al pasado
items.description: ¡Prepárese a olvidar el pasado con la versión inapropiada más salvaje del jacuzzi al pasado! Las risas comienzan cuando cuatro amigos comparten una noche en un jacuzzi en un resort de esquí, y se despiertan con una fuerte resaca en 1986.

items.title: Stargate: El Continuo
items.description: Después de que dos miembros del equipo SG-1 desaparecen, el resto del equipo élite militar vuelve a la Tierra y descubre que su propia historia ha sido borrada.

items.title: Lars y una chica de verdad
items.description: Lars (Ryan Gosling), un chico dulce y ermitaño, se pierde en un cómico triángulo amoroso al encontrar a la chica de sus sueños en una muñeca llamada Bianca, a la vez que comienza a sentirse atraído por su compañera de trabajo, Margo.

items.title: Capote
items.description: Philip Seymour Hoffman nos ofrece una actuación ganadora del Oscar® (2006, Mejor Actor) como Truman Capote, el cual se embarca en un viaje para investigar el asesinato de la familia Clutter en Kansas, lo que se convertirá en su libro más reconocido.

items.title: New Orleans
items.description: Gambling hall owner relocates from New Orleans to Chicago and entertains his patrons with hot jazz by Louis Armstrong, Billie Holiday, Woody Herman, and others.

items.title: After Midnight
items.description: Ten years into his small-town, storybook romance with Abby, Hank suddenly wakes up to an empty home. With nothing but a cryptic note to explain why she left, Hank's charmed life begins to fall apart.

items.title: The King of Thieves
items.description: Based on infamous true events, KING OF THIEVES follows famous thief Brian Reader (Sir Michael Caine) as he pulls together a band of misfit criminals to plot the biggest bank heist in British history.

items.title: Disparé a mis padres
items.description: Nathon Brooks, de 14 años, entró en la habitación de sus padres y les disparó en la cabeza mientras dormían, sorprendentemente, sus padres sobrevivieron. Este documental narra cómo los Brooks lidian con esto y tratan de entender por qué lo hizo.

items.title: Drugstore Cowboy
items.description: Matt Dillon and his not-so-merry band of junkies rob pharmacies and cheat death.

items.title: South Pacific
items.description: On a South Pacific island during World War II, love blooms between a young nurse and a secretive Frenchman who's being courted for a dangerous military mission.

items.title: Confidence
items.description: Jake Vig is a con man with a gift for duplicity and a natural charm. Now he’s cooked up the con of a lifetime, all part of a plan to even the score for the murder of a buddy, pay back those he owes and get the hell out of the business.

items.title: Transformers
items.description: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.

items.title: Contacto sangriento
items.description: El maestro de Ninjutsu Frank Dux viaja a Hong Kong para participar en el Kumite, las olimpiadas de artes marciales, y conoce a una hermosa periodista estadounidense. Al poco tiempo deberá enfrentarse a Chong-Li, un despiadado maestro coreano de taekwondo.

items.title: My Days of Mercy
items.description: After a female activist protesting the death penalty befriends a woman with opposing views, they begin a passionate relationship that tests their beliefs and their values.

items.title: Hurlyburly
items.description: Hollywood movers and shakers dissect their own personal lives when everything seems to clash together

items.title: Let Us In
items.description: Emily and her best friend Christopher start investigating the sudden disappearances of several missing teens in their small town. Realizing there might be something deeper happening, the duo come up against forces they can't even imagine.

items.title: Del amor y otros demonios
items.description: Una mordida de perro cambia la vida de Sierva y es abandonada hasta que conoce a un cura.

items.title: Madre planta
items.description: Un colectivo de madres lucha por la legalización del aceite de cannabis. Un camino de resistencia, en busca de la creación y reglamentación de una ley que abogue por el derecho a la salud.

items.title: The Love Advisor
items.description: When an assistant who has secretly been writing the love advice for her boss's podcast finds out her favourite journalist is a fan, she'll have to decide if love is worth risking her career for.

items.title: Eat, Love, London
items.description: When everything Stella thought was certain falls apart, she ends up working for a chef in a new London restaurant who just might help things fall back into place.

items.title: Been There All Along
items.description: After her public breakup, Charley, the founder of a dating app is near bankruptcy and must team up with Liam, a self-assured and innovative marketing expert, to save her company.

items.title: The Love Gala
items.description: When Kate is given the job of planning her mom's Garden Gala, she must compromise with the head of the Botanical Garden. Can she juggle this combative relationship and please her mom?

items.title: Encubrimientos y conspiraciones: el globo espía chino
items.description: Objetos derribados en el espacio aéreo de Estados Unidos y Canadá. El Pentágono finge ignorancia. ¿Participación alienígena?

items.title: Ingenieros extraterrestres
items.description: Nuestra evolución puede estar influenciada por nuestros antepasados y sus dioses. No estamos solos en el universo.

items.title: Extraterrestres en la URSS
items.description: Misterios alienígenas sin resolver de la Unión Soviética: incidente del Paso Dyatlov, milagro de Petrozavodsk, caso Voronezh. Asombro y miedo, pero duda de la participación alienígena.

items.title: Love and the Radio Star
items.description: Savannah, a single parent and consultant, is hired to rebrand a New York radio show. When she accidentally ends up on the air with the host, she discovers that love might have the last word after all.

items.title: Cazadores de ovnis II: cuentos del universo
items.description: Los ufólogos italianos exploran la evidencia alienígena en la historia y el folclore. ¿Hemos sido observados desde la antigüedad?

items.title: Los testigos: encuentros con antiguos alienígenas
items.description: El contactado, el vidente y el abducido comparten experiencias similares y diferentes con seres de otras dimensiones, dejando una marca duradera de su presencia.

items.title: The Love Hunt
items.description: A real estate executive must find a hidden treasure In order to inherit her late father's estate. When teaming with a farmer who owns the land where X marks the spot, will she find love as well?

items.title: From Italy with Amore
items.description: When Ariel sees her dream man, she will stop at nothing to get to know him better. In her quest to see him again, she meets restaurateur Daniel, who shows her that food is the way to her heart.

items.title: The Love Issue
items.description: A beauty editor persuades an up-and-coming photographer to pretend to be her boyfriend when her ex (who is also her boss) gets engaged. Is developing real feelings for each other against the rules?

items.title: Heart of the Manor
items.description: Before her sister's wedding, real estate agent Lisa is in competition with handsome developer Matthew who wants to buy her family's historic estate. But could he hold the key to Liz's heart?

items.title: Falling for the Competition
items.description: Molly runs the local mom's group and this year they're entering the prestigious Modern Parenting Group of the Year Contest. When a new-to-town dad, Ashley, sets up a rival dad's group, their competitive rivalry sparks town-wide competition.

items.title: Falling for the Manny
items.description: Businesswoman Alice is up for partner at her firm and hires her sister's manny, Jacob, to help look after her 9-year-old daughter. Can Alice become a partner and land her dream man at the same time?

items.title: The Happiness Playbook
items.description: Journalist Amy goes undercover at a happiness retreat run by the handsome Paul, but soon learns he is the son of a wealthy investor forcing her to choose between her career and love.

items.title: For the Love of Lily
items.description: A career-minded city girl must build a rooftop garden with an old-school country boy to appease her boss's new passion for 'green' living and secure her promotion. But love may be in bloom.

items.title: The Single's Guidebook
items.description: A content creator is tasked with making an online series about singlehood in order to get a big new job, but gets more than she bargained for when she's paired with her polar-opposite, Jackson.

items.title: The Perfect Man(icure)
items.description: Katya partners with consultant Ryan to sell her manicure device at the upcoming Beauty Expo. But Katya's meddling-but-loving mom, Mila, just might sabotage this opportunity and the budding romance.

items.title: The Soulmate Search
items.description: When PR executive Mikayla meets cafe owner and aspiring pastry chef Austin, the pair strike a deal: she'll taste his creations and rebrand his café in exchange for dating advice.

items.title: Eating Our Way to Extinction
items.description: Narrated by Kate Winslet, this surprising documentary will challenge the way you look at the food industry with shocking undercover footage and poignant first-hand accounts. What is the true cost of food? Who pays the price?

items.title: The Wedding in the Hamptons
items.description: An aspiring fashion designer gets her chance to debut at a lavish Hamptons wedding where she is mistaken for a socialite and falls for a groomsman. But can she keep up the charade?

items.title: Running With Speed
items.description: Over the past three decades, speedrunners have been collaboratively digging for secrets, working to uncover mind-blowing shortcuts and glitches which are used to streamline their runs.

items.title: The White Maasai Warrior
items.description: The Massai, one of the last great warrior tribes in the world, live free from civilization until one courageous outsider, the first white man ever, had the opportunity to live with them and learn their traditions and way of life.

items.title: The Proposal Spot
items.description: The owner of a romantic cafe risks losing everything when a celeb gets dumped. So the owner vows to get him and his would-be fiance back together, only to wind up falling in love with him herself!

items.title: Big In Japan
items.description: With adulthood calling and a lack of success pulling them down, Seattle indie rock band Tennis Pro decide to put it all on the line and take a crack at making it big in Japan before calling it quits for good.

items.title: World's Most Dangerous Paper Route
items.description: Witness the story of the unsung heroes who write and photograph for the Stars and Stripes military newspaper as well as those who deliver the newspaper to soldiers in Afghanistan along the world's most dangerous paper route.

items.title: Formentera Lady
items.description: Samuel is an old hippie musician who settled in Formentera in the 1970s, when British rock bands frequented the island. His daughter Anna, who has had to accept a job in France, is forced to leave her little son on the island with grandfather Samuel.

items.title: The Wedding Rule
items.description: Gemma and Max, former childhood friends are bequeathed a beloved restaurant on one condition: they must be married to claim the inheritance. The race is on to find the "one", will they succeed?

items.title: Stockholm
items.description: It starts with a guy trying to get a girl he met at a party to like him. She refuses but he doesn't give up and the story continues in a long and interesting conversation between them during which he manages to gain her attention.

items.title: Murder on the Cape
items.description: Based on the true story of New York fashion writer Christa Worthington who has an affair with a man during a winter in Cape Cod. She returns two years later with his child. When she is murdered, a mystery unfolds within the community.

items.title: Three Dates to Forever
items.description: Maddie and John are opposites, she's a hard-working radio host and he is a carefree tech entrepreneur. When John's new dating app pairs them together live on Maddie's show, sparks start to fly.

items.title: Vote One for Love
items.description: When Candace is sent home to small town to help win a mayoral race, she is shocked to discover her high school rival is the candidate in question.... and possibly the one who can win her heart!

items.title: From Poor to CEO
items.description: This is the true story of Herman Cain. A man who comes from a poor and under-educated family and reaches the highest levels of corporate, social and political America.

items.title: Hidden Nature in Guinea Bissau
items.description: The archipelago of the Bissagos Islands is a dream destination. A labyrinth of 88 islands have been recognized as a Biosphere Reserve by UNESCO.

items.title: Island of the Hippos
items.description: Explores the life within this hippo colony, where dominating males are strongly gregarious and attack any intruder who might enter their territory.

items.title: Flying Rainbow
items.description: The Oriental Dwarf Kingfisher is one of the world's most enigmatic and rarely filmed birds. This fascinating documentary spends a year with them as they survive monsoons, droughts, and predators to raise their brood for the next season.

items.title: Wildlife Rebirth in the Old Mine
items.description: La Jayona is an iron mine abandoned 100 years ago. A gigantic 80-hectare gorge, up to a hundred meters deep, condemned to be a barren desert of rock and rubble.

items.title: Rivers of Croatia
items.description: Pristine waters and rocky beaches with ancient towns made of stone. The sea however is only one of Croatias jewels.

items.title: Hearts Under the Olive Tree
items.description: When a world-renowned author can't find inspiration for her next fantasy book, her over-bearing mother takes her to a farmland retreat to get her creative juices flowing.

items.title: China: Frame by Frame
items.description: When Emmy Award winning American filmmaker Bill Einreinhofer stepped off the plane in Beijing more than 30 years ago, he had no idea it was the first of dozens of visits to China.

items.title: Meet You in Scotland
items.description: An aspiring writer sent to Scotland to collect an award for her boss and is mistaken for someone else by a Scottish poet. She'll need to decide if telling the truth is worth losing the dreamy poet.

items.title: RiffTrax Presents: Whatever Happened to Baby Jane
items.description: Bridget and Mary Jo bring you up to speed with the 1991 redux of the classic - this time with real live sisters: the Redgraves Lynn and Vanessa! This feature is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by Mary Jo and Bridget from RiffTrax.

items.title: RiffTrax Shorts: Charlie's Christmas Secret
items.description: What is fifth-grader Charlie hiding from his family, his classmates, the customers on his newspaper route? This short is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by RiffTrax.

items.title: RiffTrax: Aladdin
items.description: Long before there was a terrible Disney live-action version of Aladdin, there was a terrible Disney live-action version of Aladdin! This feature is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by RiffTrax.

items.title: Meet Me In New York
items.description: Events planner Kelly has a reputation as one of the best in New York. But stubborn website editor Joe hires her to organize his niece's 10th birthday party, she quickly sees she has met her match.

items.title: Inspiring Love
items.description: Isla is shocked when her painting is accidentally sold to charismatic salesman, Mark. Tasked with creating a new sculpture, Mark helps her through the process, falling in love at the same time.

items.title: RiffTrax: Beaks!
items.description: Throw on some goggles and join Mike! Kevin! and Bill! for Beaks! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from RiffTrax (formerly of MST3K).

items.title: Our Take on Love
items.description: Designer Isabella and filmmaker Blake find themselves planning a huge celebration in a mansion home to a famous romance. When paired together they bond, unexpectedly finding a love of their own.

items.title: Planning for Joy
items.description: Hazel launches a subscription box to encourage joy in organization. Trivia host Theo helps her after a disastrous promotion show and sparks soon fly as they clash over his unconventional methods.

items.title: Loving Vincent: The Impossible Dream
items.description: Loving Vincent: The Impossible Dream recalls a 10 year journey that brought the world's first fully painted feature film to the cinema screen.

items.title: RiffTrax: Charade
items.description: What's this, Mike and Bridget riffing what is generally considered a good movie?! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mike and Bridget from RiffTrax (formerly of MST3K).

items.title: RiffTrax: Jack-O
items.description: What was your favorite Halloween tradition? The candy? Or visiting a middle-aged guy's Haunted Garage? Jack-O strongly posits that the last one was a part of many childhoods. This is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by the guys from RiffTrax.

items.title: Just for Showmance
items.description: When Tara's presenting career stalls, her PR team puts her on a TV show to marry Joe, a stranger. Tara tells Joe the marriage is just for show, but she soon starts to feel something for him after all.

items.title: Rocketman
items.description: This one-of-a-kind musical biopic embarks on the spectacular journey of Elton John in his rise to fame. With incredible performances of Elton's most beloved songs, discover how a small-town boy became one of the most iconic figures in rock & roll.

items.title: How To Rob
items.description: Sean Price and Jimmy Winters are a two man stickup crew, robbing criminals from Boston to Cape Cod. Sean wants out of the game but it's not so simple when a couple of killers are hunting them for retribution over a past robbery.

items.title: RiffTrax: Light Blast
items.description: Starring Erik Estrada and directed by the guy who gave us Warriors of the Wasteland, Light Blast is an 80s fever dream of explosions, car chases, and of course, Light Blasting. This feature is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by RiffTrax.

items.title: Linda Napolitano: la abducción alienígena del siglo
items.description: La abducción alienígena de Linda Napolitano en 1989 es el caso de abducción del siglo.

items.title: A Perfect Vintage
items.description: Some of the world's finest winemakers share a backstage pass to Napa Valley, winemakers, vintners, and sommeliers who share their passions and techniques in bringing that perfect bottle of wine from the vine to your table.

items.title: Love Marks the Spot
items.description: Ghostwriter Becca goes to Barbados with action star, Lee, to secure movie rights to a popular novel series. Their trip becomes an adventure when they find themselves on the trail of the last novel.

items.title: Roswell: la verdad no revelada
items.description: El comandante Jesse Marcel investiga extraños escombros encontrados en 1947, a pesar de que le dijeron que era un globo meteorológico.

items.title: What We Do For Love
items.description: Sophie secures a job at the famous wellness firm, Floating Lotus, but soon finds herself at loggerheads with the chief Life Coach, Jason, who is the son of the firm's President.

items.title: RiffTrax: Martial Law 2 Under Cover
items.description: When Detective Sean Thompson's ex-partner winds up dead, all eyes are on the main suspect: the town's evil karate billionaire. This feature is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from RiffTrax (formerly of MST3K)

items.title: Dude Bro Party Massacre 3
items.description: A satricial twist on the gory and sexually charged 1980's slasher genre! In the wake of back to back mass murders on Chico's Frat Row, loner Brent Chirino must infiltrate the ranks of a popular fraternity to investigate his twin brother's murder.

items.title: With Love, Your Sweetly Salted
items.description: Anonymous critic Alison goes viral for trashing a restaurant. Her editor insists she goes undercover as a prep cook for the chef she maligned, but as they bond she risks her identity being revealed.

items.title: Write Place, Write Time
items.description: When Paige's mother wants to sell her publishing firm, she decides to write under a pseudonym, so no one - not even Daniel - will know that it's her family who poses the threat in the first place.

items.title: Breaking Habits
items.description: Cheated by her stealing, polygamist husband of 17 years, once high-flying corporate exec Christine Meeusen fled penniless with her three young children as her American dream began to unravel.

items.title: RiffTrax: Stitches
items.description: Satan walks among us and he's a… sassy grandma?? All this takes place in the late 90s, or perhaps the Revolutionary War. We've seen it a dozen times and we're still unclear. This feature is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by RiffTrax.

items.title: Extraterrestres entre nosotros: la teoría de Michael Wolf
items.description: Michael K. Wolf comparte 30 años de ideas sobre ovnis, extraterrestres, proyectos gubernamentales y círculos de las cosechas.

items.title: Líbranos del mal
items.description: Tras un secuestro, un agente secreto convertido en mercenario reaparece cuando descubre que el crimen golpea cerca de su casa. Sin embargo, cuando un mafioso infame se entera de que ha entrado en el país, se enfurece al frustrar la misión de rescate.

items.title: Cosmic Dawn
items.description: After witnessing the abduction of her mother as a child, Aurora, now a young woman, joins the UFO cult The Cosmic Dawn after discovering a book written by the group's leader Elyse.

items.title: RiffTrax: Vengeance of the Dead
items.description: Vengeance of the Dead is the bone-chilling tale of a young man visiting his grandpa, and several other grandpas! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by RiffTrax.

items.title: Iceman: El viajero del tiempo
items.description: Un guardia imperial y sus tres traidores amigos de la infancia, a quienes se les ordenó cazarlo, sufren un accidente y quedan congelados. Al derretirse, luego de 400 años de haber estado atrapados en el hielo, continuaran una batalla que dejaron atrás.

items.title: Don't Leave Home
items.description: Artist Melanie Thomas is contacted by Father, a reclusive Irish priest who once painted the portrait of a young girl who later disappeared on the very day her image disappeared from the painting.

items.title: El hombre de hielo
items.description: Donnie Yen es un guardián del palacio de la dinastía Ming, acusado erróneamente de homicidio y perseguido por tres hermanos vengativos. Los cuatro están sepultados accidentalmente, congelados en medio de la batalla.

items.title: Enemy Lines
items.description: November 1943. A British commando squad is teamed with an American officer on a covert mission into Poland, deep behind enemy lines.

items.title: Cazadores de ovnis: los ufólogos Italianos
items.description: Investigadores italianos exploran avistamientos masivos de ovnis, clipeología y testimonios reales, profundizando en la historia y los métodos de investigación de la ufología.

items.title: You, Me and that Mountain Retreat
items.description: Rebecca is put to the test during a mountain retreat to see if she's a good fit for a new company's outdoorsy culture. The only problem is she's partnered with salesman Nathan, who hates nature.

items.title: Firecrackers
items.description: Two best friends' plan to escape their destitute town becomes derailed when the consequences of a night of debauchery begins to dismantle their friendship and threatens their chance at freedom.

items.title: Love on Retreat
items.description: Jenny takes beauty brand, Bloom, in a new eco-friendly direction at the corporate retreat. Sparks fly when Jenny clashes with the activities of director, Nate, who turns out to be the brother of her boss.

items.title: RiffTrax Presents: Amanda and the Alien
items.description: Amanda's whole world is turned upside down when she meets a hot alien and helps hide him from ruthless government agents that are trying to track him down. This feature is a parody and a comedic commentary by Mary Jo and Bridget from RiffTrax

items.title: Love on Your Doorstep
items.description: A talented TV host show profiles a local florist with a groundbreaking same-day-delivery florist service and a long-running flower competition for a chance to land her show.

items.title: Badass Beauty Queen
items.description: The story behind Miss World Canada Anastasia Lin who uses her beauty to stand up to an oppressive regime. Follow her as she brings attention to China's human rights atrocities, putting everything on line to stay true to her conscience.

items.title: Journey's End
items.description: With a German offensive imminently approaching, the company anxiously awaits their unknown fate. Based on the Tony award winning play.

items.title: Let Love Grow
items.description: Landscape architect, Evie, meets her match with new client, stubborn archaeologist, Ryan. Can Ryan's daughters convince her to pick Ryan over her ex-boyfriend Mark?

items.title: Bob Fosse: It's Showtime!
items.description: The life of award-winning legendary director, choreographer, and cinematographer Bob Fosse, from his self-destructive side, to his ability to adapt for each new decade from stage to screen, filling the space with creative artistic genius.

items.title: Method of Murder
items.description: Guns, lions, illusions, and shallow graves all presented by British author Jacky Rom who jets off to LA and Las Vegas to investigate murder weapons, deception, and body disposal methods, to help inspire her latest crime vel.

items.title: Loving Every Minute
items.description: Stephanie inherits a watch that allows her to travel back in time five minutes. But as she uses it more and more, her romance with her coworker, Hunter, doesn't shake out the way she hoped.

items.title: Growing Up Smith
items.description: In 1979 an Indian family moves to America with hopes of living the American Dream. While their 10-year-old boy Smith falls head over heels for the girl next door, his desire to become a "good old boy" propels him further away from his family's ideals.

items.title: Love Served Here
items.description: Passed over for promotion, a chef, she bets her boss that she can turn around the worst restaurant in the city. But when she starts to fall for the owner, she'll realize the key ingredient is love.

items.title: May the Best Wedding Win

items.description: This is one of those vintage educational shorts that breaks down the complex details of something most people never encounter in their lives: water. What is it? Where does it come from? This short is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by RiffTrax

items.title: RiffTrax Shorts: People Soup
items.description: Seemingly shot without a script or purpose, People Soup gives hope to the maker of every pointless educational short that your efforts will one day be rewarded with critical acclaim. This short is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by RiffTrax.

items.title: RiffTrax Shorts: How to be a Friend
items.description: This DIY video shows you how to build your very own friendship, step-by-step! Start with courtesy, kindness, and honesty, then add buddies Bridget and Mary Jo to laugh along with! This short is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by RiffTrax.

items.title: RiffTrax Shorts: Six Murderous Beliefs
items.description: These beliefs are bad, and not just “the Tim Burton Planet of the Apes is the best version” bad. They're seriously bad. This short is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by RiffTrax.

items.title: RiffTrax Shorts: A Christmas Fantasy
items.description: Enjoy A Christmas Fantasy, even if you were one of those weirdos whose Santa didn't wear an awful, awful mask. This short is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by RiffTrax.

items.title: RiffTrax Shorts: Building an Outline
items.description: You think you know how to outline a high school essay. You'd probably even be arrogant enough to say that once in your life you've built an outline. Well, Coronet is here to let you know you're wrong. This short contains a comedic by RiffTrax.

items.title: RiffTrax Shorts: Glasses for Susan
items.description: Susan needs glasses. Not like, “Oh, it's hard for her to read a small font.” No, Susan appears to be legally blind. Somehow she has made it to eight without wandering in front of a truck. This short is a parody and contains a comedic commentary.

items.title: RiffTrax Shorts: A Song for Santa
items.description: Because apparently “Jingle Bells, Batman Smells” wasn't enough for him, here's A Song For Santa! This short is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by RiffTrax.

items.title: RiffTrax Shorts: Harry the Dirty Dog
items.description: Harry The Dirty Dog is the saga of a beautiful but conflicted border collie who runs away from the only life he's ever known when it's bathtime. He finds his way back home filthier than ever. This short contains a comedic commentary by RiffTrax.

items.title: RiffTrax Shorts: Farm Family in Spring
items.description: There's cows, corn, trips to town, 4-H clubs, a birthday party and most importantly incriminating evidence about Grandpa! This short is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by RiffTrax.

items.title: RiffTrax Shorts: What Mary Jo Wanted
items.description: Mary Jo's family can't sleep because her puppy cries all night. Everyone is pretty fed up with Mary Jo. Mary Jo comes up with a plan so “Out There” that it just might work! This short is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by RiffTrax.

items.title: A Canterbury Tale
items.description: Set amid the tumult of the Second World War, the film follows three modern-day incarnations of Chaucer’s pilgrims, who are forced to solve a bizarre village crime in the English countryside en route to the mythical town of Canterbury.

items.title: Bear Essentials
items.description: We follow three young bears of different species – polar bears, brown bears and sloth bears (like Baloo, the Jungle Book Bear) – that inhabit dramatically varied landscapes as they find their way in the world.

items.title: The Monster Project
items.description: A horror film crew interview three people claiming to be "real life" monsters - a skinwalker, a vampire, and a demon. When the night turns deadly, the crew must fight evil, inside and out.

items.title: Rollerball (ESP)
items.description: Chris Klein, LL Cool J y Rebecca Romijn-Stamos forman parte del mejor equipo del brutal deporte del Rollerball. Cuando descubren que el propietario de la liga (Jean Reno) hará lo que sea por la audiencia, se prepararán para acabar con el deporte.

items.title: It Happened Tomorrow
items.description: A young turn-of-the-century newspaper man finds he can get hold of the next day's paper. This brings more problems than fortune, especially as his new girlfriend is part of a phony clairvoyant act.

items.title: I Know Where I'm Going!
items.description: A young Englishwoman goes to the Hebrides to marry her older, wealthier fiancé. When the weather keeps them separated on different islands, she begins to have second thoughts.

items.title: Henry V
items.description: In the midst of the Hundred Years' War, the young King Henry V of England embarks on the conquest of France in 1415.

items.title: The Wave
items.description: When Frank goes out on the town to celebrate a promotion, he is dosed with a hallucinogen that changes his life forever.

items.title: The Winter Lake
items.description: When Holly's dark secret is uncovered by her new neighbor, they are pulled into a violent battle with her father.

items.title: To Hell & Back: The Kane Hodder Story
items.description: The story of stuntman Kane Hodder who survived a near-death burn accident to eventually become FRIDAY THE 13th's Jason!

items.title: Trafficked
items.description: Inspired by real characters, three girls from America, Nigeria, and India are trafficked through an elaborate network and enslaved in a Texas brothel.

items.title: Turbo Kid
items.description: Set in the Wasteland of a post apocalyptic parallel future of 1997, an orphaned teenager named The Kid is scavenging for relics when he befriends a mysterious girl.

items.title: Bigfoot's Reflection
items.description: A modern psychological and ecological exploration of the giant ape-man legend of North America from the perspective of those who choose to study it and guard its wild habitat.

items.title: Vikingdom
items.description: Based on Viking mythology, Eirick battles from hell and beyond to retrieve the mystical artifact, Odin's Horn, before Thor and his army can unleash its powers to conquer the world.

items.title: Torn: Dark Bullets
items.description: A raw and unapologetic look into a police shooting, racism, and the connections they share. Without stating that we know the answers, but not being afraid to ask the direct questions.

items.title: Anna and the Dead
items.description: When her parents decide to separate, sixteen year old Anna Brooks, a narcoleptic, is sent to spend the summer in a small coastal town with her aunt and uncle.

items.title: Circus of the Dead
items.description: A sadistic group of clowns kidnap an unsuspecting man, forcing him to play a deadly game in order to save his family.

items.title: The Original Fight Club
items.description: There are many reasons for animals to fight and each have their own weapons and rules of combat.

items.title: RiffTrax Shorts: Drawing for Beginners: The Triangle
items.description: Pull up an oddly motionless, disembodied hand and lower your expectations and intelligence level, because it's time to draw some damn triangles baby!!! This short is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by RiffTrax.

items.title: RiffTrax Shorts: Drawing for Beginners: The Square
items.description: With Drawing for Beginners: The Square, you get exactly what's advertised - real-time, excruciating instructions on how to draw a square. With a pen. On paper. So BUCKLE UP, BEGINNERS! This short is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by RiffTrax

items.title: RiffTrax Shorts: The Shoemaker and the Elves
items.description: The elderly shoemaker and his wife are puppets in a little puppet village, where everything looks like it was made of damp papier-mâché that was already used for something else. This short is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by RiffTrax.

items.title: RiffTrax Shorts: Beginning Responsibility: Learning to Follow Instructions
items.description: David has trouble following instructions. Namely, “For the love of god, do not appear in a Coronet educational short.” Fortunately, some animated creatures are here to help him learn. This short is a parody and contains a commentary by RiffTrax.

items.title: RiffTrax Shorts: Ladybug, Ladybug, Winter is Coming
items.description: The bug who happens to be a lady crawls around asking everyone she sees why it is so cold. She is told repeatedly it's because WINTER IS COMING and yet she persists in her willful ignorance. This short is a parody and contains a comedic commentary.

items.title: The Real Angry Birds
items.description: Angry birds are very popular - especially in the minds of game playing kids - but are there real angry birds out there?

items.title: Wild Alpine Rivers
items.description: What would happen to the mountains without water?

items.title: Wild Sharks
items.description: With the aid of modern technology, reveal the unknown behaviour of some unusual species of shark: lemon sharks and their white-tip reef counterparts.

items.title: Wild Skagerrak
items.description: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents.

items.title: Butt Boy
items.description: A newly sober detective must prove his AA sponsor has a power to make people disappear using his butt.

items.title: Winter Wonderland
items.description: When Jack Frost blankets the landscape there is magic in the air.

items.title: Badsville
items.description: A gang is torn when their leader promises his dying mother to leave Badsville, a town where no one makes it out alive.

items.description: When a man desperate to start a new life throws away his childhood plush, Benny, it's a move that can only end in death.

items.title: Candy Corn

items.title: New Year New Us 2: #LoveGoals
items.description: A couple work to maintain their marriage in a city full of temptation, only for secrets and lies to threaten their security.

items.title: Big Ass Spider!
items.description: A giant alien spider escapes from a military lab and rampage the city of Los Angeles.

items.title: No Conscience
items.description: After years of being taken advantage of by men, Yanni flees to Atlanta to seek refuge with her best friend and her ex-con boyfriend.

items.title: Slightly New
items.description: Two friends inherit a failing car dealership, and work to make it a success.

items.title: Catherine Celebrates Christmas 2020

items.title: Catherine Celebrates Christmas 2021
items.description: Catherine Fulvio, shows us how to make a selection of delicious, seasonal treats in this episode celebrating the culinary traditions of Christmas.

items.title: The 39 Steps (1935)
items.description: A man in London tries to help a counter-espionage Agent. But when the Agent is killed, and the man stands accused, he must go on the run to save himself and stop a spy ring which is trying to steal top secret information.

items.description: Sophie finds her life in danger when her estranged aunt re-appears and must uncover the truth about her mysterious past before it's too late.

items.title: Shockwaves
items.description: An earthquake has hit the city and a family must seek refuge before its too late.

items.title: Reflections
items.description: As Brooke and her girlfriends reflect about love, money and self-image, an arranged situation reveals true intentions, secrets and lies. Will one's decision be worth the sacrifice to help someone else, selfish reasons, or is it truly all for love.

items.title: Black Narcissus
items.description: A group of nuns struggle to establish a convent in the Himalayas, while isolation, extreme weather, altitude, and culture clashes all conspire to drive the well-intentioned missionaries mad.

items.title: The Red Shoes
items.description: A young ballet dancer is torn between the man she loves and her pursuit to become a prima ballerina.

items.title: Odd Man Out

items.title: Fertile Floods - Croatia's Wetlands of the Save
items.description: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade.

items.description: From exile to hero to rejected by his own country post-civil war, Ashur Shamis finds his dream of Libya now distorted. Ashur’s son uncovers a dangerous past and questions the choices his father made to inherit the mess Gadaffi left.

items.description: Explore the mysteries of the deep sea: underwater anomalies, alien abductions, UFOs, and unexplained cases that defy our understanding.

items.title: The Blessing
items.description: The Blessing follows Lawrence, a Navajo coal miner raising his secretive daughter as a single father, as he contends with his role in the disturbing destruction of their sacred mountain at the hands of America’s largest coal producer.

items.description: An uncomfortable conversation between the African immigrant community and the Black American community.

items.description: A Scotland Yard undercover detective is on the trail of a saboteur who is part of a plot to set off a bomb in London. But when the detective's cover is blown, the plot begins to unravel.

items.title: Masai Mara: The Big Hunt
items.description: The Mara River, nature's best laid trap for migratory animals, is the stage for a grandiose spectacle.

items.title: Little Killers
items.description: The world is full of predators, but not all are big and showy. Lurking in the shadows, the little killers can be just as effective.

items.title: In the Realm of the Giants - Mysterious Cephalopods
items.description: Octopuses and squids are anything but cuddly pets. They have neither legs nor fins.

items.title: Last Paradises, Symphony of Life - Underwater World of Australia
items.description: Australia stands for tourism icons like the Ayers Rock, the Pinnacles and the Kakadu National Park.

items.title: King of the Seas, Sea Eagle
items.description: The different habitats of the species in Europe.

items.title: King of the Mountains, Golden Eagle
items.description: When the golden eagle watches for prey while gliding over its hunting ground, groundhogs, hares and other animals had better watch out.

items.title: Home of the Seals: On Brittanny's Wild Coast
items.description: Some have called the coast of Brittany the Riviera of the North.

items.title: Forests of our Earth
items.description: A forest is like an organism, ancient and full of complex mechanics at work.

items.title: Eagles - Kings of the Skies
items.description: Whether in Alaska or in the Dolomites, eagles are generally seen as Kings of the skies.

items.title: Worst To First: The True Story Of Z100 New York
items.description: WORST TO FIRST is a feature-length documentary that portrays the against-all-odds inspirational story of the launch of the iconic and most successful radio station in history, New York City's Z100.

items.description: Willem Dafoe made his unforgettable movie debut as the leader of a 50s biker gang lost in a world of black leather, bad girls and sudden violence in the independent hit that marked the emergence of one of modern cinema's most important woman directors.

items.description: Herbert Blount is a crowdfunder that takes things too far when he kidnaps actress Missi Pyle for his own feature film!

items.title: Dulce Base: The New Illuminati

items.title: Roswell: The Untold Truth
items.description: Major Jesse Marcel investigates strange debris found in 1947, despite being told it's a weather balloon.

items.title: The Lady Vanishes (1938)
items.description: While travelling in continental Europe, a rich young playgirl realizes that an elderly lady seems to have disappeared from the train.

items.title: Half Nelson
items.description: A powerful, award-winning film about an inner-city junior high school teacher with a drug habit who forms an unlikely friendship with one of his students after she discovers his secret.

items.title: A River Below
items.description: Deep in the Amazon, the near-mythical pink river dolphin is being hunted to extinction. This surprising roller-coaster of a doc digs into the complexities of the modern media and the moral dangers of using the ends to justify the means.

items.description: Deitrick Haddon, a soul torn between family duty and gospel stardom, navigates a symphony of challenges. Witness the clash of desires, the relentless pursuit of passion, and a soulful journey that echoes with sacrifice and triumph.

items.title: The Witnesses: Ancient Alien Encounters
items.description: Contactees, sighters, and abductees share similar and different experiences with beings from other dimensions, leaving a lasting mark of their presence.

items.title: Underground Aliens: Baba Vanga and Quantum Biology

items.title: MST3K: Stranded In Space
