items.description: A girl finds herself in a deadly game of cat and mouse after her police officer boyfriend becomes a dangerous stalker.

items.title: When Christmas Was Young (LHP)
items.description: A music manager in desperate need of a hit song reaches back to his high school girlfriend for the Christmas song she wrote years ago. From writer Robert Tate Miller (Hope at Christmas), with the title song by nine-time Grammy winner Sheryl Crow.

items.title: Day of the Dead: Celebration of Life
items.description: Each year, the spirits of the dead visit the living in this fascinating look into this famous Mexican tradition.

items.title: The Game of Their Lives
items.description: The U.S. soccer team (Gerard Butler, Wes Bentley, Jay Rodan) are heavy underdogs as they prepare to play the British squad in a 1950 World Cup preliminary game.

items.title: A Christmas Arrangement
items.description: A flower shop owner enters the local Holiday Floral Show in an effort to win a cash prize to help keep her struggling business afloat, but she starts to fall for one of her direct competitors.

items.title: Shattered Memories
items.description: With no memory of events, a woman wakes up next to the dead body of her ex-lover and must find the killer to exonerate herself.

items.title: La abducción de las colinas: el incidente Zeta Reticuli
items.description: Se explora el secuestro de Barney y Betty Hill, y el incidente de Zeta reticuli.

items.title: Dirty Thirty
items.description: After celebrating her 30th birthday, a woman is found dead and her husband is the prime suspect.

items.title: Extraterrestres de las profundidades
items.description: Explora los misterios de las profundidades marinas: anomalías submarinas, abducciones alienígenas, USOs y casos inexplicables que desafían nuestra comprensión.

items.title: El incidente del Lago Falcón
items.description: Los extraterrestres visitan la Tierra a menudo; destaca el incidente OVNI de 1967 en el lago Falcón de Canadá. Los frecuentes avistamientos en Canadá lo hacen enigmático.

items.title: Unwritten Obsession
items.description: A struggling author sees a potential solution to her problems when a talented and mysterious stranger shows up.

items.title: Astaroth
items.description: Shrouded by the mists of time, the demon Astaroth has been forgotten. But there is always someone there to remember…

items.title: Fotografías auténticas de un extraterrestre: el caso Caponi
items.description: La historia de Caponi es uno de los testimonios más famosos de encuentros cercanos del tercer tipo con extraterrestres en todo el mundo. En estos, Caponi tomo cinco fotos que han sido confirmadas como reales.

items.title: Hopkinsville: Los duendes extraterrestres
items.description: Una familia lucha contra alienígenas goblins durante una noche. Una lucha que terminó siendo para detener una invasión alienígena. Sin embargo, no olvidemos que el miedo es lo que mueve las acciones del hombre.

items.title: Fit For Christmas
items.description: A holiday romance between a fitness instructor and a mysterious businessman. Sparks fly, and love changes everything, especially during the holidays.

items.title: Break In
items.description: A woman, recently separated from her wealthy husband, is terrorized during one harrowing night when a masked intruder breaks into her home. Is it a random home invasion or is there something more malicious and personal going on?

items.title: Country Romance
items.description: When Sarah Kress learns her family's vineyard is up for sale, she visits her hometown to help with the sale and have her last harvest. With the help of a handsome neighbor, the task becomes fun and they soon fall in love.

items.title: Crash Dive
items.description: An atomic submarine on patrol is assaulted by terrorists, and there's $1 billion in gold and the nation's capital at stake. Action superstar Michael Dudikoff is the only one who can stop nuclear disaster.

items.title: Crown Vic
items.description: This story follows one memorable night in the life of LAPD officer Ray Mandel (Thomas Jane) as he hunts two cop killers on the loose. Co-starring Bridget Moynahan and David Krumholtz.

items.title: The Wrong Teacher
items.description: A teacher's affair with a younger man turns out to be a new student with dangerous consequences.

items.title: Curvature
items.description: An intriguing sci-fi drama about an engineer (Lyndsy Fonseca, 'Kick-Ass') who risks everything to go back in time to stop herself from committing a murder she now regrets.

items.title: Mama Jones
items.description: A matriarch becomes territorial when her son and his girlfriend come home with a surprise.

items.title: Extraterrestres ancestrales: el origen de la Humanidad
items.description: La creciente evidencia y los avistamientos de ovnis sugieren contacto con seres extraterrestres que pueden haber influido en los orígenes de la vida humana.

items.title: Extraterrestres contra la guerra nuclear: Edgar Mitchell
items.description: 12 caminantes lunares afirman que los extraterrestres visitaron la Tierra, el gobierno lo encubrió. Los extraterrestres detuvieron la guerra nuclear. ¿Una locura o vale la pena escuchar más?

items.title: Navidad en buena forma
items.description: Un romance navideño entre una profesora de gimnasia y un hombre de negocios. Las chispas vuelan, y el amor cambia todo, en especial en las fiestas. Amanda Kloots, coconductora de The Talk, formará parte del festival de cine de Sundance de este año.

items.title: Sacrifice
items.description: While visiting a remote Norwegian Island, a couple are drawn into a sinister cult that worships a sea-dwelling deity.

items.title: Guilty Until Proven Innocent
items.description: Martin Sheen and Brendan Fraser star in this true story chronicling a doubting father's realization of his wrongly convicted son's innocence and the six-year struggle to win his release.

items.title: Navidad epoca para amar
items.description: Una escritora de romances, famosa por sus obras ambientadas en navidad, queda varada por la nieve en Cranberry Falls, donde queda involucrada en un triángulo amoroso entre un amor de su niñez y el periodista que busca entrevistarla.

items.title: Colateral: Lugar y tiempo equivocado
items.description: Vincent es un asesino a sueldo tranquilo y calculador que está en su mejor momento. Max es un taxista con grandes sueños y sin resultados. Esta noche, Max llevará a Vincent a su próximo trabajo. Una noche, cinco paradas, cinco asesinatos y un escape.

items.title: Cuando la navidad era joven
items.description: Un representante que necesita una canción exitosa llama a su novia de la escuela y le pide la canción de Navidad que ella escribió. Del autor Robert Tate Miller (Hope at Christmas), con la canción de la nueve veces ganadora del Grammy Sheryl Crow.

items.title: The Curse of Audrey Earnshaw
items.description: A devout community suffering from a plague is torn apart by the forces of witchcraft, black magic, and possession.

items.title: Brothers of War
items.description: With the world on the brink of WWII, a violent rivalry over the same woman tears two brothers apart.

items.title: Expired
items.description: A turbulent and intriguing love story between two parking officers in the city of Los Angeles.

items.title: Imitation Girl
items.description: When an alien takes the form of an adult film star, both must learn how to cope with the complexities of being human.

items.title: Last Rampage
items.description: Based on a horrific true story, the film follows the infamous prison break of the savage Gary Tison and Randy Greenawalt.

items.title: Red Letter Day
items.description: A recently divorced mother and her two teens receive mysterious red letters instructing them each to kill or be killed.

items.title: Annie Hall
items.description: Woody Allen is in prime form in this celebrated comedy and 1977 Best Picture Oscar®-winner in which he portrays a highly neurotic comedy writer who falls head-over-heels in love with a naive small-town girl (Diane Keaton) who aspires to be a singer.

items.title: Barbershop: The Next Cut
items.description: It's been more than 10 years since our last appointment at Calvin's Barbershop. Ice Cube, Cedric the Entertainer and the whole crew are back together for a quick trim, some good conversation, a little gossip...and to save their neighborhood!

items.title: Candyman: Farewell To The Flesh
items.description: His myth has endured for generations. His legacy is eternal rage. And now he's back! 'Candyman: Farewell to the Flesh' continues the tale of the phantom-like figure who wreaks a terrible fate upon those who chant his name five times.

items.title: Cast A Long Shadow
items.description: Audie Murphy plays Matt, a troubled saddle tramp with a penchant for drinking. When he inherits a massive ranch, it leads him back into the arms of an old flame (Terry Moore), as well as into the fists some old rivals who would rather see him dead.

items.title: Frank Capra's A Hole In The Head
items.description: Frank Capra catches lightning in bottle again when he teams with Frank Sinatra and Eleanor Parker in this heartwarming comedy about the problems of a footloose widower, his 12-year-old son, a bongo-playing showgirl and a matchmaking sister-in-law.

items.title: Hercules (2014)
items.description: The most towering myth of all time meets up with the mission of a real man in this action-adventure thriller that reveals the famed symbol of courage as he’s never been seen before: finding the hero’s heart that beats beneath his colossal image.

items.title: Terrifier
items.description: Art The Clown sets his sights on three young women, along with anyone else that gets in his way.

items.title: The Dark Tapes
items.description: A horrifying and twisted journey into the world of the paranormal, demonic, and supernatural.

items.title: 400 Days
items.description: Four astronauts are sent on a simulated mission to a distant planet to test the psychological effects of deep space travel. Locked away for 400 days, the crew's mental state begins to deteriorate when they lose all communication with the outside world.

items.title: Broadcast Signal Intrusion
items.description: In the late 90s, a video archivist unearths a series of sinister pirate broadcasts and becomes obsessed with uncovering the dark conspiracy behind them.

items.title: Sideline Confessions
items.description: Marketing guru Candy Boudreaux launches her boldest campaign—capturing the heart of football sensation Eric Whitaker. In a high-stakes game of love, ambition meets desire, where victory has never been more intoxicating.

items.title: She Is Love
items.description: A divorced couple unexpectedly cross paths at a country inn. What starts as an awkward encounter leads them to revisit a love long lost.

items.title: Vengeance: Rise of the Footsoldier
items.description: TATE goes on a rampage to avenge his loyal and trusted foot soldier's violent death. Set to execute his revenge, TATE will stop at nothing even as the world around him starts to explode.

items.title: The Lodgers
items.description: A gothic supernatural thriller about an orphan twin who fights to free herself from a horrid, long-held family curse.

items.title: American Mary
items.description: The allure of easy money sends Mary Mason, a medical student, into the world of underground surgeries which ends up leaving more marks on her than her so called "freakish" clients.

items.title: Y todos arderán
items.description: Un pueblo español se verá sumido en el caos cuando la aparición de una extraña niña con poderes oscuros amenaza con cumplir una profecía que provocaría el fin del mundo.

items.title: Los parecidos
items.description: En la lluviosa noche del 2 de octubre de 1968, ocho personajes que esperan en una remota estación un autobús con destino a Ciudad de México comienzan a experimentar un extraño fenómeno...

items.title: The Swerve
items.description: The dark secrets of Holly's seemingly perfect life are exposed, when an intruder spins her life out of control.

items.title: Housebound
items.description: A young woman is forced to return to her childhood home after being placed under house arrest, where she suspects that something evil may be lurking.

items.title: Una navidad para recordar
items.description: Sebastián, quien odia la Navidad y enfrenta su primer año sin sus hijos después de un divorcio, decide pasar la temporada con su madre Ángela, quien padece de Alzheimer.

items.title: Allegiance
items.description: Lieutenant Danny Sefton becomes embroiled in a last minute AWOL attempt by one of his soldiers -- forcing him to choose between his loyalties to the fleeing soldier, his unit and his fiancé.

items.title: Deliciosa Navidad
items.description: Máximo, chef de cocina molecular, hereda un restaurante dirigido por Luciana, experta en cocina típica. Durante la Navidad, ambos se enfrentan por sus diferentes visiones de la vida, la cocina y el amor, creando una combinación explosiva y deliciosa.

items.title: Deadly Vows
items.description: Tom Weston is dating a woman half his age and plans on marrying her. The problem is, he's already married. To keep the life he has always wanted, Tom is driven to kill. Based on a true story.

items.title: La mejor Navidad
items.description: Gloria, enfocada en su trabajo en Miami después de su divorcio, envía a sus hijos a pasar la Navidad con su exmarido en Jalisco. Lo que no imaginan es que esta decisión les va a cambiar la vida.

items.title: Novios por navidad
items.description: La organizadora de eventos Valeria, traicionada por su amiga Tere que le robó a su prometido, finge un romance con Camilo para vengarse, lo que desemboca en una inesperada historia de amor navideña.

items.title: Mi amor en navidad
items.description: Lucas, un famoso cantante cuyo mayor éxito ha sido "Mi Amor en Navidad", decide tomarse un descanso, volviendo a su pueblo natal para pasar las fiestas. Allí se reencuentra con Elisa, su primer amor y la inspiración de su éxito navideño.

items.title: On The Count Of Three
items.description: From Annapurna Pictures and Orion Pictures, Jerrod Carmichael makes his directorial debut and stars in a darkly comic feature about two best friends, Val (Carmichael) and Kevin (Christopher Abbott), on the last day of their lives.

items.title: A Wandering Path: The Story of Gilead Media
items.description: Adam Bartlett operates a renowned label specializing in black metal, doom and noise rock releases. Through live performances and behind-the-scenes hangouts, we meet the artists behind the music and how they used music to struggle through adversity.

items.title: Craig Ferguson: Just Being Honest
items.description: Recently nominated for a Grammy, 'JUST BEING HONEST' covers 'the deeply meaningless to the profoundly meaningful'-the pros and cons of catch phrases, shoes that look like feet, and the Scottish version of hacky sack.

items.title: Intercambio navideño
items.description: Las gemelas Maya y Ana, separadas al nacer y con vidas totalmente distintas, se descubren e intercambian vidas por una noche, alterando sus destinos para siempre.

items.title: Un Papá para Navidad
items.description: Rebeca, una estrella de las redes sociales enfocada en la fama, recibe una sorpresa cuando un desconocido, que dice ser su padre, aparece en Navidad.

items.title: Base de dulce: Los nuevos Illuminati
items.description: Dulce, Nuevo México, es un punto de acceso para fenómenos misteriosos y una supuesta colaboración militar secreta entre humanos y extraterrestres.

items.title: Avistamientos masivos de extraterrestres: La verdad innegable
items.description: El documental analiza los avistamientos masivos de extraterrestres, cuestiona la fiabilidad de las explicaciones oficiales e identifica patrones comunes para una mayor investigación.

items.title: Operation: endgame
items.description: Two rival teams of assassins. One killer day at the office. An all-star cast including Rob Corddry, Ellen Barkin, Zach Galifianakis, Ving Rhames, and Jeffrey Tambor fight to the death to be the last man standing in this hilarious action comedy!

items.title: Juntos esta Navidad
items.description: Luego de una ruptura amorosa, Isabel y el viudo Juan Andrés con su hija comparten, accidentalmente, una cabaña navideña. Circunstancias inusuales y la magia de las fiestas resultarán en una unión muy especial.

items.title: The Force Beyond
items.description: Join us on this unique and captivating documentary concerning the most unusual phenomena on our strange planet. These science fiction-like spectacles appear almost too good to be true, but are they?

items.title: JCVD
items.description: Jean-Claude Van Damme gets involved in a bank robbery with hostages situation and reflects about his life during it.

items.title: Una última y nos vamos
items.description: Un grupo de mariachis salen de casa por primera vez para competir en un certamen nacional en la ciudad de México. Los 8 hombres tienen que soportar muchos desafíos, lo que parece ser una oportunidad de su vida, pronto podría conducir al final del grupo.

items.title: A Christmas Gift
items.description: BET+ ORIGINAL. An expectant couple -- who are giving their relationship a second chance after being divorced -- host their family for Christmas despite a rapidly approaching due date.

items.title: Qué pena tu vida
items.description: Un hombre inseguro y con el corazón roto, trata de recuperar a su último amor con la ayuda de su amigo fiel, tomando un camino de malas decisiones que lo llevan a comprenderse a sí mismo y a los demás.

items.title: Blood on Her Hands
items.description: Isabelle Collins seduces her lover Richard Davis into killing her husband. Richard is promptly arrested for the murder, and Isabelle conspires with his lawyer to frame Richard for the murder.

items.title: Deadly Entanglement
items.description: The ex-wife won't let her husband go, first she tries seduction, then deceit, finally, if she can't have him, no one will.

items.title: Un gallo con muchos huevos
items.description: Cuando su hogar se ve amenazado por un malvado granjero, un pequeño gallo viene al rescate. En esta excelente película animada de larga duración, la cual garantiza hacer reír a toda la familia.

items.title: El punto sobre la i
items.description: El cineasta Matthew Parkhill añade un giro tras otro, formando una sorprendente película de suspenso romántico. Gael García Bernal interpreta al forastero, Natalia Verbeke es Carmen y James D’Arcy retrata a su prometido.

items.title: Un crucero de locura
items.description: Un joven comediante en apuros toma un trabajo simple en un crucero, donde espera tener su gran oportunidad para triunfar en el mundo de la comedia en cruceros.

items.title: Todos queremos a alguien
items.description: Karla Souza interpreta a una joven doctora soltera en Los Ángeles quien está dividida entre dos amantes y dos posibles amores, en esta divertida comedia romántica bilingüe.

items.title: Un padre no tan padre
items.description: La nueva era choca con la vieja en esta hilarante y cálida comedia familiar sobre un anciano gruñón de 85 años que se muda con su hijo y sus excéntricos compañeros de casa.

items.title: A Holiday Chance
items.description: The family of the founder of a multi-million-dollar film company experiences some tragic events during the holidays and two sisters must set aside a life-long rivalry and come together to turn the company around and keep the family intact.

items.title: Jane Got a Gun
items.description: A woman asks her ex-lover for help to save her outlaw husband from a gang out to kill him.

items.title: The Machine
items.description: In efforts to construct perfect android killing machines in a war against China, UK scientists exceed their goal and create a sentient robot.

items.title: Una mujer sin filtro
items.description: Paz, una amable mujer, permitió que todos alrededor de ella la trataran como si no fuera nada, manteniendo el silencio para no herir ningún sentimiento. Hasta que un día, un fenómeno fuerza su cabeza a expresar lo que siente.

items.title: Departing Seniors
items.description: After being bullied, high school senior Javier develops psychic abilities which he must use to stop a mysterious killer targeting his classmates.

items.title: Doors
items.description: When numerous mysterious alien "doors" appear around the globe, humanity must come together to understand their purpose.

items.title: Holiday For Hire
items.description: Katie hires Josh to pretend to be her boyfriend “Dean” who breaks up with her right before they were going to her home for the holidays. As Katie spends more time with Josh, she realizes that their relationship might have something real.

items.title: Dry Blood
items.description: A recluse drug addict is terrorized by ghosts, a sheriff & his hallucinations while trying to uncover a murder mystery.

items.title: KillHer
items.description: Four friends decide to spend their pre-bachelorette party camping in the woods, but the trip turns out to be a little more grisly than expected.

items.title: Double Blind
items.description: After an experimental drug trial goes awry, the test subjects must fight off sleep, and each other, to stay alive.

items.title: Infinity Chamber
items.description: A man trapped in an automated prison must outsmart a computer in order to escape.

items.title: The Diabolical
items.description: A single mother, and her children, are awoken nightly by an intense presence. She asks her scientist boyfriend to destroy the violent spirit, that paranormal experts are too frightened to take on.

items.title: Lost Angel
items.description: Lisa's quest for the truth about her sister's death leads her to uncover shady criminal activity that puts her own life in danger. Her only ally, a mysterious man called Rich, is hiding a dark secret of his own.

items.title: 1278 - The Battle For Europe
items.description: A detailed analysis of the greatest calvary battle that ever took place on the continent of Europe, and decided it's fate for centuries.

items.title: Don Peyote
items.description: DON PEYOTE tells the story Warren Allman, an unemployed stoner who finally finds a purpose in life after an unpleasant encounter with a homeless man preaching the end is near.

items.title: Feel Rich: Health Is the New Wealth
items.description: Narrated by Quincy Jones III, this film features interviews with iconic artists, producers, urban farmers and meditators who have made dramatic changes in their lives by opening themselves up to new ideas about what it means to be rich.

items.title: She Makes Comics
items.description: This documentary is about the women and their important role in the comic book industry. It includes numerous interviews with icons like Kelly Sue DeConnick, Karen Berger and Jenette Kahn.

items.title: Merry Ex-Mas
items.description: While stranded at a random hotel bar during a snowstorm, two unwitting ex-high school sweethearts discover their first love memories may be more than that after revisiting their past and present lives.

items.title: Time Lapse
items.description: Three friends discover a mysterious machine that takes pictures twenty-four hours into the future, and conspire to use it for personal gain, until disturbing and dangerous images begin to develop.

items.title: Dirty Work
items.description: Arabella lands a dream job as personal assistant to a rich novelist. Eager to please, she soon falls under the spell of her adventurous new boss, and is lured into a dangerous world of risky liaisons, secret pleasures and very dark desires.

items.title: We Kill For Love
items.description: We Kill for Love goes in search of the forgotten world of the direct-to-video erotic thriller, a genre that once dominated late night TV and video stores and revealing the heart and soul of a forgotten and often maligned film movement.

items.title: Newness
items.description: Two young Los Angelenos navigating a social media-driven hookup culture begin a relationship that pushes both emotional and physical boundaries. From director Drake Doremus (Like Crazy, Equals).

items.title: Jimi: All Is By My Side
items.description: A drama based on Jimi Hendrix's life as he left New York City for London, where his career took off.

items.title: A Patch of Fog
items.description: A security guard catches a famous writer/television host shoplifting and blackmails him into becoming friends.

items.title: Among the Living
items.description: In the aftermath of a deadly outbreak, a brother and sister fight to survive against a vicious landscape.

items.title: The Bodyguard
items.description: Karate master and anti-drug vigilante Kiba returns to his home in Japan, where he aims to wipe out the nation's drug industry.

items.title: The Flying Scotsman
items.description: Based on the true story of world champion cyclist Graeme Obree. Despite his modest beginnings and a lifelong battle with bipolar disorder, this tenacious and resourceful competitor pedaled his way into sports history on a handmade scrap metal bike.

items.title: Salt and Fire
items.description: A scientist blames the head of a large company for an ecological disaster in South America. But when a volcano begins to show signs of erupting, they must unite to avoid a disaster.

items.title: She Came Back
items.description: On the way to her father's wedding, Charlie is involved in a life-threatening car accident. During a brief moment of death, she reunites with her deceased mother, Claire. Charlie survives, but Claire's spirit is determined to keep her.

items.title: Saturday Morning Massacre
items.description: A dark and bloody parody about a Scooby-Doo-like team of paranormal investigators and their devoted dog. With the crew nearing bankruptcy, they're hired to get to the bottom of a series of spooky events at the remote Kyser mansion.

items.title: Perfectos desconocidos
items.description: Cuando un grupo de mejores amigos se reúne durante un eclipse lunar para compartir una cena íntima en la elegante casa de Eva y Antonio, sospechan que se trata de otra noche cualquiera hasta que la anfitriona les propone un juego.

items.title: I Am ZoZo
items.description: I Am ZoZo is a psychological thriller about five young people who play with a Ouija board on Halloween and attract the attention of a malevolent demon. The film is based on real experiences with an ancient and malevolent spirit called ZoZo.

items.title: After Louie
items.description: After Louie follows Sam (Tony Award® winner Alan Cumming), an artist and activist from ACT UP who lived through the early years of HIV/AIDS — a man scarred and still struggling with survivor's guilt. Cemented into an oppressive past.

items.title: Instant Karma
items.description: A young man hits rock bottom as a ride share driver when his car breaks down, his life changes when he magically gets new things every day in his car. If he can only figure out what's causing it.

items.title: Incoming
items.description: The International Space Station is now a prison - the ultimate black site. But when the imprisoned terrorists take over the Station and turn it into a missile aimed at Moscow, only a shuttle pilot and a rookie doctor can stop them.

items.title: Before I Change My Mind
items.description: 1987: While the other students wonder if new kid Robin is a boy or a girl, Robin sides with the school bully to fit in.

items.title: Howling Village
items.description: A psychologist visits an infamous haunted location known as 'Howling Village' to learn about her family's dark history.

items.title: I Will Follow you into the Dark
items.description: After the deaths of both her parents, a young woman retreats within herself, only to be drawn out of her depression by an unexpected romance with a man named Adam.

items.title: Prototype
items.description: Androids are created in the near future, to carry out home help tasks. The creator's family tests out the first models, but when a malfunction occurs, their lives are at risk as the super-human androids make a sinister plot to take control.

items.title: Desde el Hombre Polilla hasta los Reptilianos: Una guía de especies alienígenas
items.description: Testigos de todo el mundo han tenido encuentros cercanos con razas extraterrestres, dando forma a nuestra imaginación y convirtiéndose en fenómenos culturales.

items.title: Cíclope extraterrestre: El extraordinario caso de la Sagrada Familia
items.description: En 1963 en Brasil, tres niños son testigos de un OVNI en su patio trasero. Un cíclope alienígena desciende y el Sr. Alberto investiga el fenómeno.

items.title: Murder in New Hampshire: The Pamela Smart Story
items.description: Pamela Smart is dissatisfied with her loveless marriage and job as a schoolteacher. She applies for a job at a local TV station, but when her dreams are dashed, she seduces one of her students.

items.title: Catfight
items.description: Sandra Oh and Anne Heche star as two women from opposite walks of life whose violent fight at a party sets off an epic feud that lasts a lifetime.

items.title: Islander
items.description: En 1877, la isla Robinson Crusoe fue adquirida por Alfred von Rodt, un aristócrata suizo optimista y explorador. La película "Islander" explora la vida contemporánea de los habitantes, ajenos a nacionalidades, en la isla.

items.title: Swearing Allegiance
items.description: Two high school sweethearts enter separate military academies, placing their relationship in jeopardy when one is unfaithful. An ultimatum offered to the cheating party results in a murderous pact.

items.title: Target for Rage
items.description: While students at a local high school prepare for the annual prom and graduation, a tense game of wits develops when Jason Copeland, a former student, plans to inflict revenge upon the school.

items.title: Deep Web
items.description: Deep Web gives the inside story of one of the most important and riveting digital crime sagas of the century -- the arrest of Ross William Ulbricht, the convicted 30-year-old entrepreneur accused to be 'Dread Pirate Roberts.'

items.title: Betrayal of Trust
items.description: Judith Light stars as a woman fighting to have her highly esteemed psychiatrist convicted of rape after she realizes he has been assaulting her during drug-induced treatment sessions for the past 18 years.

items.title: Stepping into Love
items.description: When her art museum faces money problems, a conventional curator works with an avant garde artist to develop an unconventional exhibit. Can they find a way to work together and find love?

items.title: Unlikely Heroes
items.description: For most, the idea of Jewish resistance during the Holocaust is limited to the Warsaw Ghetto uprising. Unlikely Heroes chronicles untold stories of resistance and heroics throughout the Holocaust.

items.title: Mohawk
items.description: During the War of 1812, a young Mohawk warrior brutally turns the tables on her bloodthirsty American pursuers after they murder her kinsman and partner.

items.title: Blueberry
items.description: In 1870, after a brutal run-in with an outlaw in a brothel, Mike Blueberry becomes marshal in Arizona

items.title: One Eight Seven
items.description: When a student writes the police code for homicide, 187, inside a textbook owned by teacher Trevor Garfield, he feels threatened.

items.title: Lethal Legacy
items.description: BET+ ORIGINAL. After the death of her wealthy uncle, a digital artist inherits his estate and control of his company, but her success is overshadowed by a former business partner.

items.title: Bono: Waiting on a Saviour
items.description: Alongside his bandmates, Bono's rise from a small-town Irish kid to selling out stadiums worldwide leaves no doubt that he has solidified a legacy before he's even retired from the music industry.

items.title: Bruce Willis: All American Hero
items.description: With over a hundred films to his credit and many successful ones to boot, Bruce Willis is certainly an actor who has amassed a widespread fan following throughout his career.

items.title: Killed Walking Home
items.description: Every three days, a woman is killed in the UK. Although there is a lead that breaks open the case leaves an everlasting scar on the families.

items.title: Killer Doctor: The Harold Shipman Case
items.description: Known as 'doctor death', Shipman was a general practitioner operating in Hyde, greater Manchester. From police negligence, to manipulation, Shipman was able to murder over 200 victims, hiding under a soft, caring demeanor.

items.title: Murderous Minds: Rose West
items.description: A look into the psychology of one of Britains most notorious serial killers, Rose West.

items.title: Cold Betrayal
items.description: A woman flees to her estranged criminal father after she steals drugs from the mob. But when she uncovers his deadly secret, her father becomes a far greater danger to her.

items.title: Eva Braun: In Love With Adolf Hitler
items.description: It was a strange affair, full of love, lust and despair... That of Adolf Hitler and Eva Braun, his mistress from 1932 to their double suicide in Hitler's Berlin bunker, that fateful day in April 1945.

items.title: How to Find Forever
items.description: Marley is brilliant at organizing other people's engagements. When designing her most important proposal yet, will the man who could jeopardize it all be her very own prince charming?

items.title: Murderous Minds: Dennis Nilsen
items.description: Dennis Nilsen was a Scottish serial killer and necrophile who murdered at least twelve young men and boys between 1978 and 1983 in London. We delve into the psychology of Dennis to try and understand what turned him so cruel.

items.title: Memories of a Nazi Camp
items.description: The Natzweiler-Struthof camp has been erased from historical memory and yet… with one of the highest death rate, this Nazi camp saw the worst exactions and scientific experiences of the history.

items.title: Remembering Tony Bennett
items.description: The legendary New York jazz singer. On July 21st 2023 Tony Bennett passed away at the incredible age of 96.

items.title: Embodied
items.description: Through the eyes of a drag queen, a scuba diver, a midwife, a mermaid, and a CEO, embodied is an intimate exploration of an uncomfortable truth: our opportunities and relationships are informed by our body size.

items.title: Something You Said Last Night
items.description: After being fired from her job, Ren joins her family on vacation. The realities of being a stunted millennial and a trans woman coalesce as Ren struggles to balance yearning for independence with the comfort of being taken care of.

items.title: Snakehead
items.description: A Chinese immigrant get caught up in an international crime ring of human smuggling while attempting to make a better life for her family.

items.title: The Madeleine McCann Case
items.description: It is every parents worst nightmare. Their daughter, only three years of age, taken from her bed.

items.title: The UFO Crash at Roswell
items.description: Cover-ups and conspiracies… what really happened that night in Roswell, 1947.

items.title: UFO Paranormal Overlords
items.description: Since ancient times, we have encountered what we now call "Aliens" in many forms that have more than influenced our history, they may have created it.

items.title: Lavender
items.description: After losing her memory a woman begins to see unexplained things after her psychiatrist suggests she visit her childhood home

items.title: UFO Government Files Declassified
items.description: The mystery of UFO's or unidentified flying objects has intrigued and confused the public for decades. This documentary explores declassified government files that can finally point to the existence of UFOs.

items.title: Lunana: A Yak in the Classroom
items.description: A young teacher in modern Bhutan, Ugyen, shirks his duties while planning to go to Australia to become a singer

items.title: THE LOST UFO TAPES: Taken By Aliens
items.description: Author of the Paramount picture "Fire in the sky" gives us a unique insight into the Walton Story. Travis Walton relates in his own words the best documented account of alien - abduction yet recorded.

items.title: The Mule
items.description: After a trip to Thailand, a first-time drug mule finds himself in police custody, with his stomach crammed with narcotics. Now, he has to endure seven sphincter-clenching days to convince them of his innocence. Will nature take its course?

items.description: When Kyle Matthews, an elite Sniper from the World Defense Force, is trapped in enemy territory - his skills are put to the test as he attempts to survive against a whole armada of Cerulean soldiers, Hell bent on wiping all humans from existence.

items.description: Chaos reigns on the wide open plains as a host of stars, including Burt Lancaster and Lee Remick, have their eyes set on a shipment of whiskey and let loose in this wild comedy that spoofs nearly every convention of movie westerns.

items.title: House of Lust
items.description: 27-year-old Emma becomes a prostitute at a high-end brothel in order to research her next novel. But was it really for research or all for pleasure?

items.title: Infidelity
items.description: BET+ ORIGINAL. After the loss of their unborn child, a couple struggles to keep their relationship intact -- but when secrets are revealed, they realize more than their marriage is at stake.

items.title: Highway Hitcher
items.description: A businessman with a compulsive gambling problem which has led to his wife leaving him, travels to Reno, Nevada for some gambling therapy which takes a turn when he picks up a psychotic serial killer posing as a hitchhiker.

items.title: THE LOST UFO TAPES: Aliens and The Scalpel
items.description: Discover the truth about Alien Implants. Dr. Leir has acted as Chief of Podiatry in many Southern California Hospitals.

items.title: The Good Traitor
items.description: April 9, 1940: Denmark is invaded by Nazi Germany with demands for immediate and unconditional surrender

items.title: Con Queens
items.description: Betrayed by her closest friend, a woman seeks to break out of jail to get back control of her life.

items.title: Good Deed Gone Bad
items.description: A tech savvy man finds a lost cellphone. He attempts to return it to it's owner but at a cost.

items.title: Blossom
items.description: BET+ ORIGINAL. While battling depression, Clarisse volunteers at a women's shelter and befriends a domestic abuse survivor, only to discover there's more to the young woman than she alludes.

items.title: Call Her King
items.description: BET+ ORIGINAL. After sentencing a notorious gangster to death, Judge Jaeda King must rely on her wits, strength and skill when her courtroom is taken over by force by the prisoner's brother.

items.description: After a series of setbacks, high-achieving lawyer Reina must learn how to handle her mental health before her emotional outbursts destroy her career and her relationships.

items.title: Game of Deceit
items.description: When her police officer husband starts abusing her, Maya realizes she must gather ironclad evidence to take him down.

items.title: Christmas Party Crashers
items.description: Two corporate holiday party crashers find themselves in over their heads when they're invited into an influential family's home to plan their Christmas Eve bash.

items.title: Rolling into Christmas
items.description: A globe-trotting influencer returns home for Christmas and reconnects with her childhood sweetheart as they team up to save their beloved roller rink from foreclosure.

items.title: Bokeh
items.description: On a romantic getaway to Iceland, a young American couple wakes up one morning to discover every person on Earth has disappeared.

items.title: Damsel
items.description: A businessman travels West to join his fiancée in the mountains.

items.title: Holiday Hideaway
items.description: BET+ ORIGINAL. After a disastrous Thanksgiving dinner, a holiday-obsessed travel writer decides to take an assignment that will keep her away from her family and boyfriend during Christmas.

items.description: Davis takes his audience through a therapeutic rollercoaster of subjects ranging from the hood to Hollywood; as well as hood-rats to Heaven. From relationships gone bad; to rappers gone rogue; nothing is too taboo; and no one is safe from DeRay.

items.title: Hamlet
items.description: Hamlet, Prince of Denmark, finds out that his uncle Claudies killed his father to obtain the throne, and plans revenge

items.title: Foreign Land
items.description: As Israeli society slips into extremism, an Arab actor and a Jewish journalist search for a place, where they can belong.

items.title: Rescue Me: International
items.description: In this moving and informative documentary, the Rescue Me team goes to the United Kingdom to exam a local home-grown cat rescue and a larger national organization.

items.title: Artik
items.description: A comic book obsessed serial killer teaches his son how to get away with a series of brutal murders.

items.title: Alien Insurrection
items.description: Revelations of the E.T. presence on Earth has prompted theologians to prepare mankind for the inevitable, a take over of all of humanity by extraterrestrials.

items.title: Aliens at Loch Ness
items.description: From Spectres and Ghosts, to the legend of Occultist Aleister Crowley, Loch Ness is a world of wonder with highly Paranormal encounters from Nessie to UFOs.

items.description: When Monica Martel discovers that her body double is having a torrid affair with her leading man, she vows bitter revenge that climaxes in a brutal murder.

items.title: Richard Pryor: Live & Smokin'
items.description: Richard Pryor live comedy performance at the Improvisation in New York City.

items.title: The Missing
items.description: BET+ ORIGINAL. A year after Raina flees her abusive husband while pregnant, her baby daughter disappears and she must take matters into her own hands.

items.title: Gary Owen: True Story
items.description: Gary Owen, who’s starred alongside Kevin Hart in Ride Along and the Think Like a Man series, proves why he’s one of today’s top comic talents in this hysterical performance.

items.description: Tough LA cop John Sato is fired from his elite SWAT team after the accidental death of a fellow officer. When he turns to a life of crime to support both himself and his young son, the choices he makes may lead to deadly consequences.

items.description: A thief is betrayed after a well done job in Detroit. Returning to Chicago, he decides on revenge.

items.title: Condorito: la película
items.description: ¡La más amada tira cómica cobra vida en una hilarante aventura de otro planeta para toda la familia!

items.description: Valentina tiene la vida perfecta en Estados Unidos. Su universo tiembla cuando su novio Jason le propone matrimonio y debe enfrentar a su familia, “los perfectos Tate”, con la suya, “los Hidalgo”, la dinastía política más caótica de la historia de México.

items.title: Leave of Absence
items.description: Sam has been happily married for years, but things suddenly change when the free-spirited Nell breezes into his life. They embark on an affair until Nell is diagnosed with terminal cancer.

items.title: Survival on the Mountain

items.title: La Navidad en pleno vuelo

items.description: Opposite worlds collide when seductive exotic dancer, Isis Shaw, falls in love with up-and-coming politician, Osiris Hughes. But their new love is threatened to be ripped apart when a band of criminals from Isis' past make Osiris its newest target.

items.title: Las aventuras de Buckaroo Banzai

items.title: Mundo futuro
items.description: Un parque de atracciones del futuro satisface las fantasías de cualquier adulto. Unos androides muy realistas complacen todo tipo de caprichos. Divertido, ¿verdad? No tanto, como descubren un reportero y su secretaria durante una fiesta para la prensa…

items.title: Especie mortal II
items.description: Un extraterrestre en forma de parásito se incuba en el cuerpo de un astronauta. Justin Lazard, Natasha Henstridge, Marg Helgenberger, Michael Madsen, Mykelti Williamson. Director: Peter Medak.

items.title: Danger Zone
items.description: American mining engineer gets involved in civil war and international conspiracy in an African country.

items.title: The christmas toy
items.description: Rugby the tiger, who was young Jamie's favorite christmas toy last year, thinks he should go under the tree again this year.

items.title: Sirona
items.description: A young woman with supernatural gifts escapes captivity, only to be hunted down by a group of mercenaries whose lives she will change forever.

items.title: Boomtown

items.title: Love & Murder: ATL Playboy Part 1

items.title: Love & Murder: ATL Playboy Part 2

items.title: Vanished: Left Behind

items.description: When a young coffee shop owner is threatened with repossession she must take a chance with life and love as she fights to save her business.

items.title: Medal of Honor

items.title: Psychopaths: Killing Spree Couples

items.title: Todo sucede en Elizabethtown

items.title: Young Ones

items.title: Music

items.title: Cruise

items.title: ¿Qué le dijiste a Dios?

items.title: Good Kids
items.description: Four high school students look to redefine themselves after graduation.

items.title: Liam Gallagher: As It Was
items.description: This documentary follows British singer Liam Gallagher as he attempts to make a solo comeback.

items.title: The Hunt For Dark Matter
items.description: The search for the substance that physicists and astronomers believe holds the universe together.

items.title: Cocodrilo Dundee en Los Ángeles

items.title: Veneno

items.title: Vichy and The Nazis: A Deal With The Devil

items.title: WWII: Capitulation

items.title: Grease

items.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture - The Director's Edition
items.description: The U.S.S. Enterprise proudly soars again in this new, beautifully restored Director's Edition of the original Star Trek movie classic. This edition features enhanced visual effects and a new sound mix, supervised by legendary director Robert Wise.

items.title: The Body vs. Coronavirus

items.title: Return To The Moon
items.description: Examining how renewed excitement about returning to the moon could lead to a colony.

items.title: The Apollo Moon Landings

items.title: The Angel Of Pennsylvania Avenue

items.title: The Mercy

items.title: Serenity

items.title: Adeline
