items.title: The Getaway
items.description: An ex-con and his devoted wife must flee from danger when a heist doesn't go as planned.

items.title: Twelve Trees of Christmas
items.description: A big-city publicist relocates to a small town to replace its beloved Christmas ornaments. She forms unexpected bonds, learns the true spirit of Christmas, and finds love. By decorating twelve trees, she restores hope and discovers the magic of tradition.

items.title: Sospechoso cero
items.description: Un agente del FBI que investiga la muerte de un asesino serial sigue la pista de un justiciero que dedica su vida a perseguir asesinos seriales.

items.title: Paranormal World: Aliens, UFOs, Cryptids and Ghostly Encounters
items.description: Bizarre encounters with Bigfoot, Dogmen, El Chupacabras, Lake Monsters, Thunderbirds, Aliens and UFOs may very well be connected to our paranormal planet.

items.title: Shipwreck Robberies
items.description: In what is being called 'The world's biggest grave robbery', over 40 shipwrecks serving as mass graves for thousands of World War II soldiers have been illegally plundered by salvage crews.

items.title: Book of Ruth: Journey of Faith
items.description: This movie is an adaptation of “The Book of Ruth” from the Bible. Powerful themes of tolerance and acceptance gained through love and understanding shine in this production.

items.title: The Death Train
items.description: this film revisits the first massive crime of WWII killing 13,000 people in the city of Lasi, Romania that lays out the early stages of the Shoah.

items.title: Living With Lions
items.description: It's the dry season near the Serengeti, and hungry lions threaten the livelihood of cattle-herders.

items.title: What is Reality? with David Eagleman
items.description: David Eagleman reveals how the human brain pieces together reality.

items.title: Apostle Peter and the Last Supper
items.description: Three days before his execution, the elderly Apostle Peter tells his jailer about his time with Jesus.

items.title: Street Scene
items.description: Twenty-four hours elapse on the stoop of a Hell's Kitchen tenement as a microcosm of the American melting pot interconnects during a summer heatwave.

items.title: The Book of Esther
items.description: Jewish girl Esther (Jen Lilley) is chosen as the new queen consort to King Xerxes of Persia. Will she be able to stop the evil Lord Haman’s plot to exterminate the Jews?

items.title: The Book of Daniel
items.description: Daniel is forced to serve the most powerful king in the world, King Nebuchadnezzar. Daniel proves himself a trusted advisor, until he is forced to choose between serving the king and honoring his creator.

items.title: My First Love
items.description: A widow (Beatrice Arthur) gets in touch with her former high school sweetheart: a divorced doctor (Richard Kiley) who now has a young girlfriend (Joan Van Ark).

items.title: Ethiopiques
items.description: The story of forgotten Ethiopian musicians who became an considerable inspiration for free jazz and pop music nowadays.

items.title: Sometimes Lucky Is More Important Than Smart: Conversations with Mace Neufeld
items.description: From his day’s in live TV to the big screen, Neufeld’s films include The Omen, No Way Out, The Hunt for Red October and The Equalizer.

items.title: Love & Dance
items.description: When Chen decides to enroll in dance lessons, he upsets his Israeli father but pleases his Russian mother. Amid mounting tensions at home, Chen finds joy in his lessons and in the true source of his interest in the sport: his crush and classmate, Natalie.

items.title: Operation March On Rome
items.description: The story of two marchers take us back to the heart of the rising of Mussolini to power.

items.title: The Long Night
items.description: Police surround the apartment of apparent murderer Joe Adams, who refuses to surrender although escape appears impossible. During the siege, Joe reflects on the circumstances that led him to this situation.

items.title: Deadly Dancer
items.description: A police detective investigating a string of murdered strippers at a Los Angeles night club must race against the clock to clear his name when he's wrongfully accused of being the killer.

items.title: The Complete Taylor Swift Story
items.description: Swift is regarded as a trailblazer of the twenty-first century for her diverse musical ability and business acumen, all of which have served as an inspiration to musicians, entrepreneurs, and businessmen all over the world.

items.title: A Race of Giants
items.description: In America alone there have been over 1,500 newspaper accounts, including 3,781 skeletons of a race of blond-haired giants discovered and exhumed. Where did the evidence go?

items.title: Charming the Hearts of Men
items.description: In the early 60s, a sophisticated woman returns to her southern home town and finds her options are limited. With the help of a Congressional ally, she inspires historic legislation which allows opportunities never before afforded to women.

items.title: A Friend's Obsession
items.description: When Megan moves to a new city to move on from a tragic death, she is followed by an old colleague who wants to be more than friends— by any means necessary.

items.title: Twenty Pearls: The Story of Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority Inc.
items.description: The documentary tells a powerful story of sisterhood. In 1908, nine Black women enrolled at Howard University made one decision that would change the course of history. These college students created Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority, Incorporated.

items.title: Hidden in Plain Sight
items.description: Anna must face her past and abusive ex-boyfriend that she's been running away from to protect herself and her son.

items.title: Fatal Crossing
items.description: High-flying tech entrepreneur Carson wakes up in a bloody car with no memory of what happened the night before. His world in chaos, things only get worse when he falls for June.

items.title: Beyond the Trek
items.description: A deep-space mining vessel has been adrift for two years, and it's suspected that the crew brutally killed each other. A rescue team will soon discover the truth. Starring Sunny Mabrey ('Hillbilly Elegy').

items.title: Killing Season
items.description: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ('Raging Bull') and Oscar nominee John Travolta ('Pulp Fiction') star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

items.title: Do Not Reply
items.description: Chelsea, a teenager, is abducted through a social media app by Brad and is held captive with other girls who are to become victims in his virtual reality filmed murders.

items.title: Stephen King: A Necessary Evil
items.description: Featuring rarely-seen interviews, this doc explores the long and successful career of the King of Horror, who has captivated readers for decades.

items.title: Cutting Class
items.description: Troubled Brian Woods, back from a mental institution and dealing with his father's death, competes for Paula's love against rebel Dwight. As students vanish, suspicion falls on Brian, but the threat lurks elsewhere.

items.title: An Affair To Die For
items.description: When a woman and her boyfriend’s infidelity is discovered, they are forced to play the twisted game of their captor to save their family members from being murdered.

items.title: Endless
items.description: When madly in love high school graduates Riley and Chris are separated by a tragic car accident, Riley blames herself for her boyfriend's death while Chris is stranded in limbo. Miraculously, the two find a way to connect.

items.title: Erin's Guide to Kissing Girls
items.description: Middle school nerds Erin and Liz find their friendship tested when Liz is accepted into a private school and Erin falls for the popular new girl.

items.title: Mothers and Daughters
items.description: Photographer Rigby Gray (Selma Blair) captures uplifting stories of motherhood, inspiring a decision even she wouldn't expect. With an all-star cast including Susan Sarandon, Sharon Stone, Courtney Cox and more.

items.title: For the Love of Spock
items.description: For The Love of Spock celebrates the life and career of Star Trek's Mr. Spock and the actor who played him, Leonard Nimoy, in a never-before-seen way: through the eyes of his son and director Adam Nimoy.

items.title: Home
items.description: An ex felon returns home from prison and must confront the demons of his past.

items.title: Jurassic Punk
items.description: Spaz' Williams is considered a pioneer in computer animation. This intimate account examines his life story surrounding the historical moment when digital dinosaurs walked onto the silver screen.

items.title: Sam & Mattie Make a Zombie Film
items.description: Sam and Mattie, two badass best friends with Down syndrome, rally the entire town of Providence RI to help them storyboard, script, produce, cast, and star in their own dream movie: 'Spring Break Zombie Massacre.'

items.title: Alone
items.description: A grief-stricken widow is kidnapped by a man, escapes into the wilderness and is pursued by her captor.

items.title: 85: The Greatest Team in Football History
items.description: Filmmaker Scott Prestin examines the 1985 Chicago Bears and their road to the Super Bowl. Includes interviews with former players Mike Singletary and Jim McMahon, former coach Mike Ditka, President Barack Obama and actor Bill Murray.

items.title: The Mental State
items.description: In the heart of rural Kentucky, a high school senior and his family struggle to cope with the true identity and intentions of a dangerous town shooter.

items.title: Til Death Do Us Part
items.description: Michael and Madison Roland had planned to spend the rest of their lives together, until one day Michael's controlling ways turned their perfect marriage.

items.title: Seaside
items.description: Daphne runs away to the Oregon Coast with her boyfriend, Roger when he inherits his family beach house. When they run into Roger's old fling, Susanna, Daphne realizes that she will have to fight for her relationship and maybe even her life.
Returning from deployment in Afghanistan, a U.S. Marine (Victor Almanzar) must face the consequences of a violent past he hoped he had left behind with the help of fellow vet (John Leguizamo).

items.title: After the Murder of Albert Lima
items.description: Frustrated with the legal system, Paul Lima hires two bounty hunters to track down his father's killer in Honduras.

items.title: Serena Williams: The Power and The Glory
items.description: Serena Williams – champion, inspiration, icon. A once-in-a-generation talent, The Power and The Glory traces Serena's remarkable journey, from a Compton prodigy to the greatest female tennis player of all time.

items.title: Dark Angel: The Ascent
items.description: A young demoness yearns to visit the world of man. She ascends from Hell and finds herself on the streets disguised as a human. Her mission now: to punish the evil on Earth.

items.title: Doctor Mordrid
items.description: Doctor Mordrid has been guarding the gates to the 4th dimension for over a century and his eternal foe Kabal has crossed over to Earth, ready to carry out his threat to destroy humankind.

items.title: Dollman
items.description: Brick Bardo from outer space is forced to land on Earth, where he's a doll-sized creature. Brick is besieged by kids, gang members and more as he tries to get off the planet alive.

items.title: Family Squares
items.description: The Worths are a family portrait of dysfunction. When Grandma Mabel dies suddenly, they must set aside their differences and come together. Featuring an ensemble cast including Henry Winkler, Judy Greer, Billy Magnussen, Ann Dowd and more.

items.title: Girl
items.description: A young woman (Bella Thorne) heads back to her hometown intent on exacting revenge on her abusive father — only to discover someone beat her to it. She soon finds herself prey to a sinister sheriff (Mickey Rourke) and his wicked brother.

items.title: Catching Air
items.description: Competitive air guitar, often mocked, is showcased in the documentary "Catching Air." It follows diverse participants who channel creativity through air guitar, aiming to inspire hidden talents and defy stereotypes.

items.title: Miracle Fishing: Kidnapped Abroad
items.description: The story of a father's kidnapping as told through the 1994 video diaries of his son, the film's Director Miles Hargrove.

items.title: Hope Gap
items.description: A couple's visit with their son takes a dramatic turn when the father tells him he plans on leaving his mother. Starring Annette Bening ('American Beauty') and Bill Nighy ('Love Actually').

items.title: Hollywood Bulldogs: The Rise and Falls of the Great British Stuntman
items.description: This doc tells the rough-and-tumble story of the small community of British stunt performers who went on to dominate Hollywood in the 70s and 80s. Narrated by Ray Winstone.

items.title: Marcus
items.description: Marcus has a checkered past and an unstable present. Unexpected news brings a new opportunity. But Marcus will have to face the consequences of his past and overcome the greatest obstacle: Himself.

items.title: THE LOST UFO TAPES: Abducted by Aliens
items.description: Peter's first conscious UFO abduction experience was in 1988, and he still has a mark on his head where a needle was inserted by Alien beings and a scoop mark on his right leg where a sample was taken.

items.title: Streets
items.description: Meek Mill meets Nicole Gordon who pursues an education in classical music, in the midst of Meek gets tangled up in murder of a local boxer, Micheal Butler younger brother Tariq. This sparks a heated war between Meek Mill and Micheal.

items.title: Passionate Revenge
items.description: In this thrilling drama about secrets and lies, a man cheats on his wife during a work trip. Upon returning home, he is shocked to discover the woman from his affair is his baby's new nanny.

items.title: Robert the Bruce
items.description: King Robert the Bruce is injured and on the run from the English army. On the brink of defeat, a widow and her family nurse him back to health and join The Bruce as he sets out to claim the long-awaited freedom of Scotland.

items.title: Meridian
items.description: After Catherine (Sherilyn Fenn, 'Twin Peaks') inherits a castle in Italy, she gets caught in a love triangle with a man and a wolf-like being. With the help of her nanny, she learns of a family curse.

items.title: One Four Three
items.description: A woman diagnosed with amnesia struggles to remember her attacker, her lover, and herself.

items.title: The Layover
items.description: Two friends on a road trip compete for the affections of a handsome man when their flight is redirected due to a hurricane.

items.title: The Girl In The Book
items.description: Set in the world of New York publishing, a young book editor is forced to confront a troubling chapter from her past when a bestselling author re-enters her life.

items.title: Stonehearst Asylum
items.description: An Oxford grad (Jim Sturgess, 'Across the Universe') accepts a job at a mental asylum and soon discovers that its 'revolutionary' new treatments are inhumane and horrific. Also starring Kate Beckinsale, Ben Kingsley, and Brendan Gleeson.

items.title: Puppet Master: The Legacy
items.description: As a young boy, Eric was saved from Hitler's SS by toymaker Andre Toulon. Fascinated by Toulon's seemingly supernatural abilities, Eric spends his entire life attempting to unlock the secret.

items.title: Puppetmaster 2
items.description: The killer puppets return and hunt paranormal researchers in an attempt to collect brain fluid for their master, Andre Toulon.

items.title: Puppet Master 4
items.description: Decapitron is the new head-swapping leader of Toulon's puppets. Each of Decapitron's heads will be put to its ultimate test when Blade and the gang go toe to toe with their most sinister enemy yet.

items.title: Puppet Master 5
items.description: In the darkened Bodega Bay Inn, the greedy Dr. Jennings has come to pilfer Blade, Six Shooter, Jester, Pinhead, Torch, Tunneler and Decapitron to discover the source of their animation.

items.title: Karen y los fantasmas de navidad
items.description: Karen es una mujer de mediana edad que, debido a su actitud exigente y arrogante, ha alienado a sus amigos y familia. Un día, Karen recibe una visita por parte de unos espíritus no convencionales.

items.title: Moon Crash
items.description: When a drilling accident causes a giant piece of the Moon to crack off and hurtle towards Earth, the surviving space mining team and the head of the aerospace firm responsible must figure out how to destroy the meteoroid before it wipes out the planet.

items.title: The Iron Sheik - The Maim Event
items.description: The story of one hot night in Alabama as an Independent Pro Wrestling Show rolls into town with its cast of high flying characters in faded tights.

items.title: Quantum Apocalypse
items.description: A rogue space anomaly is discovered approaching Earth and it is up to the world's top scientists to stop it from destroying the planet.

items.title: Sanctified
items.description: A thrilling Western set in 1890 North Dakota, 'Sanctified' is the tale of an outlaw rescued from death by a nun traveling the Badlands. A deep friendship develops as she nurses the man back to health in exchange for his guidance at a local church.

items.title: Skyfire
items.description: Chaos erupts when the once-dormant volcano at the world's only volcano theme park and resort rumbles: everyone must evacuate before it's too late.

items.title: Amanece en Calcuta
items.description: Ofrece los testimonios entrelazados de seis personas que hoy siguen arriesgando sus vidas en los lugares más remotos del planeta para dar a conocer a Cristo y hacerlo amar, según la espiritualidad de la Madre Teresa.

items.title: Diamantes negros
items.description: Amadou y Moussa son descubiertos en Malí por un ojeador de fútbol, separados de sus familias para convertirse en estrellas del balompié. Emprenden un viaje que les mostrará el mundo de sombras que se esconde tras el deporte rey.

items.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! The Dark Side of Dimensions
items.description: The stakes have never been higher, the rivalries never as fierce, the risks never so great. One wrong move - one card short - and it's game over for good.

items.title: Un amable fantasma
items.description: La historia, basada en el cuento de Hans Christian Andersen El polvorín. Voita adquiere un polvorín de oro con el que puede conjurar al fantasma y pedirle que cumpla tres deseos.

items.title: La cueva encantada
items.description: La película cuenta una historia sobre la esperanza, pero también sobre la codicia humana. Un emocionante cuento de hadas lleno de suspenso, arrastra al espectador a las profundidades de una misteriosa cueva hasta que no quiere salir a la superficie.

items.title: Cemetery Man
items.description: When a cemetery watchman tasked with dispatching the recently deceased falls in love with a widow, will his lust for life eclipse his bond with death?

items.title: Una estrella en Navidad
items.description: Incluso las estrellas se enfrentan a los mismos problemas que los humanos. Un día, la celosa Próxima derriba a la estrella lucero del cielo y ésta aterriza en un pueblo. Lucero sólo tiene unos días para volver al cielo, de lo contrario se extinguirá.

items.title: Poor White Trash
items.description: A white-trash family must resort to crime to send their teenage son to college.

items.title: THE LOST UFO TAPES: Ancient Alien Archeology
items.description: Explore how the Sumerian culture suddenly sprang seemingly from nowhere in Mesopotamia.

items.title: El campeón
items.description: Christian es un futbolista talentoso, imprevisible y rebelde. Tras su última "metedura de pata", el presidente de su equipo decide asignarle un tutor personal que le ayude a controlar su temperamento.

items.title: THE LOST UFO TAPES: The Crop Circles
items.description: Freddy Silva is one of the world's leading experts on UFO's, crop circles and sacred sites, and a highly regarded researcher into the interaction between temples and consciousness.

items.title: Amor letra por letra
items.description: Recién despedida, Hanna deposita por accidente su último cheque en la cuenta de banco de Edgar, un aspirante a escritor. Hanna se dispone a encontrar a Edgar, quien ya comenzó a gastar el dinero.

items.title: Song For Hope: The Ryan Anthony Story
items.description: When Ryan is diagnosed with a rare terminal cancer with months to live, him and his wife Niki started the charity "Cancer Blows" raising vital funds for cancer research by organizing music concert tours with some of the world's greatest musicians.

items.title: The Laureate
items.description: Set in the mid-1920s, celebrated poet and writer Robert Graves returns from war traumatised and creatively struggling. It takes young poet Laura Riding to re-ignite Robert's passion, and with the blessing of his wife his muse becomes his lover.

items.title: Los campeones
items.description: Cinco historias reales de victorias de atletas rusos. Todas las victorias son historias humanas, donde el amor, la traición, la amistad, el respeto, el trabajo y la fe se entrelazan en una sola. Historias sobre creer en uno mismo, creer en la victoria.

items.title: Edhel
items.description: Edhel tiene una malformación en las orejas que parecen las de un elfo. Afronta su malestar evitando relacionarse con la gente. El encuentro con un extraño conserje de la escuela convence a la niña de pertenecer a la noble línea de los Elfos.

items.title: Lucy And Desi: Before The Laughter
items.description: This made for TV movie tells the story of Lucille Ball and Desi Arnaz. It begins in the 1930's when they met as actors under contract at RKO and ends with their divorce in 1960.

items.title: 13 Tracks to Frighten Agatha Black
items.description: After a tragic event, a sheltered young woman seeks the comfort of some long-forgotten scary story records from her youth. Eerily, they begin to reveal occult truths and hint at a violent, inescapable fate, bringing her to the threshold of terror.

items.title: Shelter
items.description: A homeless Nigerian immigrant (Anthony Mackie) and a junkie (Jennifer Connelly) band together for survival on the streets of New York.

items.title: Shadow Dancer
items.description: The relationship between April and Nick, two exotic dancers, begins to unravel when Nick falls for one of his clients. His unrequited love soon turns into a deadly obsession.

items.title: Trancers
items.description: A gruff bounty hunter travels back in time to 1980s Los Angeles to stop a twisted criminal who can transform people into zombie-like creatures.

items.title: The St. Tammany Miracle
items.description: Despite very little funding, an all-girls Episcopalian high school basketball team fights to make a name for themselves through the help of their new female coach.

items.title: A Marriage of Convenience
items.description: A successful businesswoman gives up her career to raise her late sister's son. Eight years later, the boy's father—who was unaware of his son's existence—arrives and the two begin to fall in love.

items.title: Cone Of Silence
items.description: In a rare villainous role, Peter Cushing stars as an arrogant pilot who attempts to undermine the investigation into the cause of an airline disaster.

items.title: Coverup, The
items.description: The story centers on around the mysterious death of repeat drunk driving offender Thacker and the discovery of his body in an alley behind the Marshalltown, Iowa, police department after his latest DUI arrest.

items.title: Puppet Master 3: Toulon's Revenge
items.description: A puppeteer's ability to bring inanimate objects to life attracts the attention of the Nazis during World War II. Little do they know, he is using the puppets to kill the Nazis who have wronged him.

items.title: We the Party
items.description: In Los Angeles, five high-school friends deal with romance, money, prom, college, sex, bullies, Facebook, fitting in, standing out, and finding themselves.

items.title: Christmas Manger
items.description: An elderly man grapples with his wife's death until his young daughter and his estranged foster child re-enter his life, giving him a new purpose.

items.title: Ghost of Goodnight Lane
items.description: When the staff inside a renovated film studio finds a co-worker dead one morning, the pieces of a 40-year puzzle add up to an angry ghost who has let the last person step inside her house. Will they get out alive?

items.title: Finding Normal
items.description: The only thing standing between Dr. Lisa Leland (Candace Cameron Bure) and her dream wedding in the Hamptons is a 2600-mile drive from Los Angeles to Long Island.

items.title: An Unlikely Angel
items.description: Janie is an in-control businesswoman falling apart of the thought of becoming a mom. Will a chance meeting with an angel be an answer to prayer?

items.title: Creep Van
items.description: A 20-something slacker gets caught up in a deadly game of cat and mouse after answering a 'For Sale' sign placed on a dilapitated van.

items.title: Orbita Prima
items.description: Durante la evacuación de La Tierra, Manuel pierde a su hermano y queda a la deriva. Ahora, debe salvar al planeta para poder volver a verlo.

items.title: 96 Minutes
items.description: Four kids. One night. One shocking act that forever entwines their disparate lives. Not all of them are innocent, not all of them survive. 96 Minutes can change everything.

items.title: GLOW: The Story of the Gorgeous Ladies of Wrestling
items.description: This heartfelt documentary chronicles the rise and fall of the first-ever all-female pro-wrestling show through the stories of those who lived it.

items.title: The Courtyard
items.description: Architect Jonathan (Andrew McCarthy) moves to Los Angeles and meets the beautiful, free-spirited Lauren (Mädchen Amick). When there's a murder in the building, everyone at the Shangri-La courtyard apartments is a suspect.

items.title: Lady Of The Manor
items.description: The ghost of a Southern belle tries to teach a slacker to be a lady in this hilarious buddy comedy starring Melanie Lynskey, Judy Greer, Justin Long, and Ryan Phillippe.

items.title: The Big Bang (2010)
items.description: A detective (Antonio Banderas) is asked to find a boxer’s missing girlfriend and a stash of diamonds, but what starts as a missing person’s case could soon mean the end of the world.

items.title: Follow Your Cat
items.description: Do you know your cat? When not purring on the living room sofa, do you know to where your pet roams?

items.title: Huachicolero
items.description: Un enamoramiento inocente lleva a Lalo, de 14 años de edad, a descender al mundo criminal de la extracción ilegal de gasolina. Lo que comienza como un atajo hacia el último smartphone se convierte, rápidamente, en una pelea mortal por su vida.

items.title: Elvis Presley: The Last 24 Hours
items.description: The last 24 hours in the life of Elvis are counted down.

items.title: 10 Steps To Love
items.description: Sophie Michaels has used a 10 step plan to succeed, until she decides to try this strategy to find love. Fate will step in to teach her that the heart doesn't need a list.(….teach her that you can't always choose who you're going to love).

items.title: Spirited Killer
items.description: The maniac is the Spirited Killer, a forest dweller who kills anyone stepping into his jungle. Leading the pack to help stop this madman is Tony Jaa (Ong Bak), making his film debut!

items.title: My Boss' Wedding
items.description: Nicole, a workaholic executive assistant, is given the unexpected task of planning her boss' wedding. All would be manageable except for the groom's free-spirited nephew Michael distracting Nicole's workflow.

items.title: Wedding Cake Dreams
items.description: A woman who put a piece of wedding cake under her pillow as a girl hoping to dream of her future husband, goes home to her sister's wedding and learns that the best man is the “man of her dreams.”

items.title: Rescue Me: A Home 4 Spot
items.description: Explore the highs, lows and daily realities of running an urban animal rescue. This is the story of Diana England, a retired nail-stylist, who started her own dog rescue in Las Vegas, a "Home 4 Spot".

items.title: La habitación
items.description: Ocho historias que ocurren en la misma habitación en diferentes períodos de la historia mexicana.

items.title: José
items.description: La vida de un joven de 19 años en la ciudad de Guatemala es rutinaria y sin eventualidades, hasta que encuentra pasión, dolor y autorreflexión a través de una relación con un migrante caribeño.

items.title: Dark Night Of The Scarecrow
items.description: When young Marylee Williams (Tonya Crowe) is found viciously mauled, all hell breaks loose in her small rural town. A gang of bigots pursue a suspect: her mentally challenged friend Bubba Ritter (Larry Drake).

items.title: The Witness
items.description: The name Kitty Genovese became synonymous with urban apathy after The New York Times printed an article stating that she was stabbed to death during an attack that lasted more than half an hour — while 38 witnesses did nothing.

items.title: La tierra y la sombra
items.description: Alfonso es un viejo campesino que retorna después de 17 años al hogar que abandonó debido a que su único hijo padece de una grave enfermedad. Al llegar a la región descubre que todo lo que alguna vez conoció ya no existe.

items.title: Fire In The Sky
items.description: In 1975, logger Travis Walton (D.B. Sweeney) and his co-workers discovered a hovering UFO. Walton's pals fled, but Walton was not so fortunate. Whisked aboard the strange craft, he was subjected to a painful, unearthly medical study.

items.title: A to Zeppelin: The Led Zeppelin Story
items.description: A gripping program that reveals the colorful and controversial history of rock's heaviest band, featuring interviews with members of the Yardbirds, Bad Company, The Ramones, and Foreigner.

items.title: Gangster
items.description: The true-life story of Paul Ferris.

items.title: Four Fast Guns
items.description: He was faster than any man alive - but how he had to face his most dangerous enemy - the woman he loved!

items.title: Goldie
items.description: Goldie, a spirited teenager in a family shelter, fights the system to keep her sisters together as she pursues her dreams of being a dancer. A story about displaced youth, ambition, and maintaining your spirit in the face of any obstacle.

items.title: Shadowman
items.description: In the 1980s, Richard Hambleton was the Shadowman, a specter in the night who painted hundreds of startling silhouettes on the walls of lower Manhattan and, along with Keith Haring and Jean-Michel Basquiat, sparked the street art movement.

items.title: Hard Copy
items.description: A rookie reporter gets drawn into a shady, sexy club scene as she writes about it.

items.title: The Howling V: The Rebirth
items.description: In this fifth installment of 'The Howling' films, a group of people is stranded in an ancient Hungarian castle with a werewolf.

items.title: In The Soup
items.description: When filmmaker Adolpho puts out an ad to sell his script, Joe, a semi-connected wiseguy and habitual criminal, agrees to help make the picture.

items.title: Sacrifice
items.description: A tough undercover detective delves into the dangerous underworld of human trafficking to save a young girl. His mission becomes personal, pushing him to the edge of morality in a gripping race against time.

items.title: Charms for the Easy Life
items.description: The story of three women who live in a North Carolina town and defy the traditional roles set for them by society. Starring Gina Rowlands, Mimi Rogers and Susan May Pratt.

items.title: Flutter
items.description: Chancer John lives for playing the odds - and he's always willing to take a calculated risk. But when he meets the mysterious and beautiful female bookie Stan, he discovers there's much more to gambling than just greyhounds and horses.

items.title: Actos de venganza
items.description: Un abogado de hablar rápido (Antonio Banderas) transforma su cuerpo y toma un voto de silencio, que no se romperá hasta que descubra quién mató a su esposa e hija y tenga su venganza.

items.title: Bank Robber
items.description: After robbing a bank, Billy hides out from the police in a seedy hotel where he is forced to bribe various tenants for their silence. Soon the tenants begin to up the price for their trouble.

items.title: Bent: Plan de venganza
items.description: En este mordaz thriller policíaco, un policía desacreditado que busca al asesino de su compañero descubre accidentalmente una conspiración gubernamental vinculada al asesinato de una mujer con un coche bomba.

items.title: Illicit
items.description: A couple finds out that starting an extramarital affair is a lot easier than ending the one they're in when they're both seduced into outside situations.

items.title: Battle Warrior
items.description: International martial arts superstar Tony Jaa makes his return as The Battle Warrior!

items.title: Shanghai Affairs
items.description: A Shanghai doctor named Tangsan, is trying to help the town's poor people. Meanwhile, he has the murderous Axe Gang to deal with as well as his feelings for the gang leader's sister.

items.title: Invaders From Mars
items.description: In the early 1950s, Cold War tensions and the burgeoning space race created a heady mix of paranoia and unbridled creativity as filmmakers speculated as to the marvels - and horrors - that lay beyond the stars.

items.title: Cannibal Women in the Avocado Jungle of Death
items.description: Bill Maher stars as a chauvinistic tour guide who takes an angry feminist anthropologist on a journey through the hostile jungles of Bakersfield in search of the seductive and deadly Piranha Women.

items.title: Squeal
items.description: Lost in a remote part of Eastern Europe, Sam is a foreigner searching for his biological father when a minor road accident leads to a chance meeting with a pig farmer's daughter, who captures him, making him a slave on the farm.

items.title: New Big Boss (Legend of the Wolf)
items.description: A young man learns through a series of flashbacks about the earlydays of the legendary Wolf, how he lost his memory and knew only to return to a small village and reunite with his long-lost love.

items.title: Waiting for Anya
items.description: From the author of War Horse, a shepherd-boy risks everything to help smuggle Jewish children into Spain from German-occupied France.

items.title: The Pumpkin Man
items.description: Cromwell is a town whose history is intertwined with that of a local legend; The Pumpkin Man. As the mystery unfolds, the residents must confront their own fears and unravel the truth to put an end to the Pumpkin Man's reign of terror.

items.title: Liberation
items.description: A retrospective of the Allied campaign to liberate Europe during WWII, and Hitler's genocidal war against the Jews. With film footage, music, and radio broadcasts collected from around the world.

items.title: Where Cars Don't Dare
items.description: Where Cars Don't Dare follows AdMo Tours on a remarkable journey through the Mojave Desert by dirt bike. We have our courage tested against sand dunes, dry lake beds, salt basins, snow, and mountains - all without ever touching asphalt.

items.title: Cómo no casarse con una princesa
items.description: Tras el nacimiento del príncipe, tres Parcas predicen una profecía. Un cuento de hadas sobre viajes en el tiempo, cambiar el curso del destino y descubrir que una profecía puede ser la mayor de las bendiciones.

items.title: The Trials Of Cate McCall
items.description: In order to be reinstated to the bar and recover custody of her daughter, a hotshot lawyer, now in recovery and on probation, must take on the appeal of a woman wrongfully convicted of murder.

items.title: Shotgun
items.description: The west ablaze with the Technicolor legend of the Shotgun Avenger! There was always open season on women like Abby!

items.title: The Intruder
items.description: After a whirlwind romance and rushed marriage, Catherine (Charlotte Gainsbourg, 'I'm Not There') moves into her husband's apartment. As strange things begin to happen, she finds herself questioning her own sanity. With Nastassja Kinski & John Hannah.

items.title: Blood Tea and Red String
items.description: A stop-motion animated fairy tale for adults about the struggle between the aristocrats (the White Mice) and the commoners (the Rustic Creatures Who Dwell Under The Oak), fighting for the doll of their heart's desire.

items.title: Blue: The American Dream
items.description: "Blue" Meekins, a boxer struggling to escape the mean streets of Harlem, is roped into robbing a drug dealer by a friend, only to find out the victims were an innocent family. Consumed by guilt, Blue commits himself to seeking redemption in the ring.

items.title: Mi gran boda gay italiana
items.description: Antonio ha encontrado por fin al amor de su vida, Paolo, con quien vive felizmente en Berlín. Aunque todavía no están seguros de la reacción de sus familias, deciden casarse en Italia, en el pequeño pueblo donde viven los padres de Antonio.

items.title: Asterix and the Mansion of the Gods
items.description: When Julius Caesar plans to build an opulent mansion right next to their village, aiming to tempt the locals away from their traditional ways, it’s up to Asterix and Obelix to outwit the Romans.

items.title: Cats
items.description: Blanket is an indoor cat who is too afraid to leave his apartment. But when his adventurous son, Cape, sets out to find a legendary cat paradise, Blanket must overcome his own fears and embark on the wildest ride of his life.

items.title: Father's Day
items.description: A murderer, a priest, and a delinquent try to bring down a father-killing madman.

items.title: A Birders Guide To Everything
items.description: David (Kodi Smit-McPhee), a fifteen-year-old birding enthusiast, thinks that he's made the discovery of a lifetime. On the eve of his father's remarriage, he escapes on an epic road trip with his best friends to make their place in birding history.

items.title: The Boogeyman (2005)
items.description: A young man tries to deal with the childhood terror that has affected his life.

items.title: The Amaranth
items.description: Lily and Richard move to a luxurious and cult-like community, where Lily becomes unsettled by the transformation she observes in her older husband.

items.title: B'Twixt Now And Sunrise - Authentic Cut
items.description: Experience the Authentic Cut of a haunting murder-mystery written, directed, and produced by Francis Ford Coppola, starring Val Kilmer, Bruce Dern, and Elle Fanning.

items.title: Bloodsucking Freaks
items.description: Sardu and his assistants present a show involving the torture and mutilation of young women.

items.title: How the Gringo Stole Christmas
items.description: A Mexican father’s Christmas celebration goes from merry to messy when his daughter shows up with her new boyfriend — an uninvited gringo — in this hilarious holiday comedy.

items.title: Red State
items.description: The abduction of three teenaged boys leads to a guns-blazing standoff between a military task force and a band of fanatical fundamentalists.

items.title: No Man's Land
items.description: While on a long journey through a remote region of Texas in 1866, Rusty wakes up to find that his family has vanished. As he frantically searches for them, his only hope in finding them is a beautiful but desperate indigenous woman.

items.title: I'm With Me
items.description: Days before Valentine's day and their wedding, Cindy Hunter, editor-in-chief of a tabloid and Damon Tuckland, a successful therapist, encounter a strange plant that magically puts Cindy's mind in Damon's body and vice-versa.

items.title: The Pardon
items.description: Based on a true story, this film recounts how a grisly murder leads to a series of sensational trials in which Toni Jo Henry pleads her innocence.

items.title: P2
items.description: Una mujer que es la última en salir de su oficina en la víspera de Navidad debe confiar en su ingenio para sobrevivir cuando está atrapada en un estacionamiento con un guardia de seguridad demente.

items.title: Open 24 Hours
items.description: A young woman, newly-released from a mental hospital, where she landed for setting her brutal boyfriend on fire, takes a job at an all-night gas station. The isolation triggers her paranoia and hallucinations, with devastatingly gory results.

items.title: Christmas with the Prince
items.description: A turn of events finds a fashion designer spending her Christmas with a prince.

items.title: Valley Of Love
items.description: Kathleen thinks she has it all until her grandmother dies and leaves her a house and farm in the country. Kathleen discovers a whole new world as she meets Oliver, a handsome local doctor.

items.title: My Freaky Family
items.description: Betty Flood dreams of learning her unusual family's magical secret, but when an evil wizard threatens her family, she must leave on a quest to discover the powers she already has.

items.title: Rally Road Racers
items.description: A rookie race car driver gets the opportunity of a lifetime to compete against the reigning rally car champion.

items.title: Stardog and Turbocat
items.description: When genius cat, Felix, and loyal canine, Buddy, set out to find Buddy's lost owner, they discover not only the power of friendship but their inner superpowers along the way.

items.title: Amityville II: The Possession
items.description: An Italian-American family move into a house built on an ancient Indian burial ground. The oldest son is possessed by an evil spirit, and is forced to murder his family. The family's priest feels responsible, and tries to save the possessed boy's soul.

items.title: Winnie-the-Pooh: Blood and Honey
items.description: Winnie-The-Pooh: Blood and Honey follows Pooh and Piglet as they go on a rampage after Christopher Robin abandons them.

items.title: La fiesta silenciosa
items.description: Laura y su novio viajan a un rancho para celebrar su boda. Laura decide salir a caminar sola y a partir de ahí todo se convierte en una pesadilla.

items.title: Kalanag - Hitler's Magician
items.description: Helmut Schreiber alias Kalanag is one of the most controversial entertainers - a man with a white waistcoat and a dark past.

items.title: Killer Kitty
items.description: Cats are both beloved pets and wild predators. This film explores why some endangered species need protection from the cuddly creatures.

items.title: New York Ninja
items.description: Originally shot in 1984 and not finished until 2021, New York Ninja is about a sound technician for a news station (John Liu) who becomes a vigilante ninja in New York City after his pregnant wife is murdered.

items.title: Gaudi Afternoon
items.description: Alone in a foreign city, Cassandra must solve a family's darkest, deepest secrets before she can confront her own past.

items.title: Home for the Holidays
items.description: After losing her job, making out with her soon-to-be ex-boss, and finding out that her daughter plans to spend Thanksgiving with her boyfriend, Claudia Larson has to face spending the holiday with her family.

items.title: Insectos
items.description: Un veterano de guerra paranoico y desquiciado que ve insectos por todas partes se refugia con una mujer solitaria en una espeluznante habitación de un motel de Oklahoma.

items.title: Hazlo como hombre
items.description: Mauricio Ochmann y Aislinn Derbez protagonizan esta divertidísima comedia sobre un hombre cuyo mundo se pone patas arriba cuando su mejor amigo - y futuro cuñado - le anuncia que es gay.

items.title: Scrooge (1970)
items.description: The spirit of Christmas becomes a musical celebration of life in this rousing Oscar-nominated adaptation of Charles Dickens' A Christmas Carol.

items.title: The Curse of Humpty Dumpty
items.description: The classic English nursery rhyme gets a horror movie adaptation in The Curse of Humpty Dumpty. Based on a famous legend, an old doll seemingly returns to life to wreak havoc.

items.title: Indivisible
items.description: Upon returning from serving in the U.S. Army, Chaplain Darren Turner faces a crisis that shatters his family and faith in God but through the help of his fellow soldiers, he returns to his faith and family.

items.title: Heaven Sent
items.description: Elise, a grandmother hurt by her past, and Patrick, a widowed pastor, have closed the door on love. But with faith and a little help from technology, will their live-streamed romance find a way?

items.title: Sospecha Mortal
items.description: Richard Gere es Peck, y Andy Garcia es Raymond Avila, un investigador decidido a llevar a Peck a la justicia en este thriller policial emocionante.

items.title: La profecía
items.description: Robert Foxworth y Talia Shire son un doctor y su esposa que viajan a Maine para investigar el impacto de la industria maderera en el medio ambiente. Investigar una serie de eventos misteriosos: fenómenos de la naturaleza y muertes humanas extrañas.

items.title: Angels Sing
items.description: A father must overcome his past to find the Christmas joy he lost years ago.

items.title: The Believers
items.description: Widowed police psychologist Cal Jamison (Martin Sheen) is forced to deal with a series of ritualistic child murders perpetrated by a rogue cult. As the cult's connections to corporate oligarchs emerge, Cal and his family are put at terrible risk.

items.title: The Hills Run Red
items.description: A man recently released from a five-year prison sentence seeks vengeance against the former friend who has violated his trust and sought his death. Starring Thomas Hunter, Henry Silva, and Dan Duryea.

items.title: Black Mamba
items.description: When Kyiera Stone is killed by corrupt cops, angels reincarnate her as an assassin charged with destroying those who killed her and her friends.

items.title: Max
items.description: Lauren Graham, Thomas Haden Church and Josh Wiggins star in 'Max,' a family film about a wayward teen who finds comfort and friendship with the military dog of his older brother, a U.S. Marine who was killed on the Afghanistan frontlines.

items.title: We'll Never Have Paris
items.description: Simon Helberg, Melanie Lynskey and Zachary Quinto star in this hysterical tale, a clumsy and at once human account of screwing up on a transcontinental level in a noble effort to win back 'the one.' And it's based on a true story…unfortunately.

items.title: Renegades
items.description: When a retired Green Beret soldier is murdered by an international drug gang in London, four of his veteran SAS comrades set out to avenge him, dispensing their own brand of justice on the streets of London.

items.title: Flag Day
items.description: Sean Penn directs and stars along side his daughter Dylan Penn in this intimate family portrait of a young woman who struggles to reconcile her memories of her loving father with the fact that he was the most notorious counterfeiter in U.S. history.

items.title: God's Own Country
items.description: Johnny Saxby works long hours on his family’s farm in the north of England. And when a handsome Romanian migrant worker arrives to take work on the family farm, Johnny suddenly finds himself having to deal with emotions he has never felt before.

items.title: Jinn
items.description: Summer is a 17-year-old carefree black girl whose world is turned upside down when her mother, Jade, abruptly converts to Islam. Jade becomes a different person, prompting Summer to reevaluate her identity.

items.title: Breaking News In Yuba County
items.description: In this dark comedy, Sue Buttons, an under-appreciated suburban wife, gains fame after her husband mysteriously disappears, but she quickly finds herself in over her head, dodging cops, criminals and local reporters all aiming to uncover the truth.

items.title: Alien Hunter
items.description: In this sci-fi thriller, extraterrestrial and cryptology expert Julien Rome (Emmy winner James Spader) is brought in to investigate a mysterious alien object in Antarctica.

items.title: Wiggly, Wiggly Christmas
items.description: Merry Christmas to one and all! "Wiggly Wiggly Christmas" is sure to get everyone in the festive spirit with songs and carols that will have the whole family singing, dancing and laughing.

items.title: Belly of the Beast
items.description: In this action-packed flick, a former CIA agent (Steven Seagal) goes to Thailand to rescue his daughter from the clutches of an Islamic terrorist group.

items.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
items.description: Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) is a young FBI agent who is given a difficult assignment: spy on his mother (Meg Ryan) and her boyfriend (Antonio Banderas) who is suspected of leading a gang of art thieves.

items.title: Prozac Nation
items.description: A talented young writer struggles with self-destructive behavior and paralyzing depression during her first year at Harvard. Featuring an all-star cast including Christina Ricci, Anne Heche and Michelle Williams.

items.title: The Order
items.description: Martial arts icon Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as a playboy criminal thrust into a dangerous world of ancient evil when he must investigate the disappearance of his archaeologist father. With Oscar winner Charlton Heston and Sofia Milos.

items.title: Burn Country
items.description: An Afghan journalist (Dominic Rains) finds himself in a small town in Northern California working as a crime reporter. And when his friend (James Franco) goes missing, he is drawn deep into the community's dark peculiarities. Melissa Leo co-stars.

items.title: Night Owls
items.description: Workaholic Kevin goes home with the beautiful trainwreck Madeline for a drunken one night stand, but he's horrified to discover she's actually his boss' ex-mistress. After she takes a bottle of sleeping pills, Kevin is forced to keep her awake all night.

items.title: Hundreds of Beavers
items.description: A drunken applejack salesman must go from zero to hero and become North America's greatest fur trapper by defeating Hundreds of Beavers.

items.title: Child's Play (2019)
items.description: In this shocking re-imagining of the horror classic, single mother Karen (Aubrey Plaza) buys her son Andy (Gabriel Bateman) a seemingly innocent, AI-enhanced Buddi doll, unaware of its more sinister nature…and its true name…Chucky!

items.title: Mente indomable
items.description: El exitoso drama ganador del Óscar, que lanzó las carreras de Matt Damon y Ben Affleck, cuenta la historia de un genio de clase obrera obstinado a quien no le va bien en la vida, hasta que conoce a un profesor de psicología cercano (Robin Williams).

items.title: Bad Reputation
items.description: A high school girl wrongly branded as the school slut embraces her 'bad reputation' and takes revenge on the kids who have made her life a living hell.

items.title: Puppetmaster
items.description: Psychics find themselves plotted against by a former colleague who committed suicide after discovering animated, murderous puppets.

items.title: Emma
items.description: In Andrew Davies' dramatized version of the classic Jane Austen novel, a rich and beautiful girl is happy to play matchmaker but fails to notice that her own heart has been captured. Starring Kate Beckinsale, Bernard Hepton and Mark Strong.

items.title: Going Clear: Scientology and the Prison of Belief
items.description: Nominated for seven Emmys, this acclaimed documentary examines the controversial Church of Scientology and how the church attracts and holds on to its followers.

items.title: Growing the Big One
items.description: Emma returns to her small home town when her grandfather dies and a string of debt is uncovered. She enters a pumpkin growing competition to help pay them back — and loves it. But can the charms of the country compete with her successful city life?

items.title: Mozart and the Whale
items.description: Starring Josh Hartnett and Radha Mitchell, this heartwarming romantic drama is inspired by the true story of two people with Asperger's syndrome, whose emotional dysfunctions threaten to sabotage their budding romance.

items.title: Fast Color
items.description: Hunted by mysterious forces and a local sheriff, a young woman with supernatural abilities flees back to her family—and unearths the depths of the power within her.

items.title: Messiah Of Evil
items.description: A woman arrives in a seaside town after receiving unsettling letters from her father, only to discover it's under the influence of a strange cult.

items.title: Shaky Shivers
items.description: From Director Sung Kang (star of Fast X). Bitten by a mysterious creature, Lucy believes she'll become a werewolf. With her best friend by her side, they face a throat-slashing creature in this campy adventure filled with magic and mayhem.

items.title: Flesh And Bone
items.description: A figure from the past awakens a memory as deep and dark as a grave: a family history written in cold blood.

items.title: Persiguiendo un sueño: basada en una historia real
items.description: Ben cree que un caballo de carreras herido merece otra oportunidad. Él y su hija adoptan al caballo y lo salvan. La llegada de la yegua a la granja de Crane será la oportunidad perfecta para que ambos, padre e hija, se acerquen y fortalezcan su vínculo.

items.title: Mcquade, el lobo solitario
items.description: Un inconformista guarda forestal de Texas (Chuck Norris) deja las armas por las artes marciales cuando se enfrenta al líder de un grupo de traficantes de armas.

items.title: Theory of Obscurity
items.description: The story of the iconic renegade cult music and art collective known as The Residents who have achieved levels of fame most groups can only dream of, yet no one knows who they are.

items.title: Stripped: Los Angeles
items.description: Enter with a full-access pass into the lives of five women whose raw ambitions drive them through struggles and taboo to female empowerment.

items.title: The Gate (1987)
items.description: The removal of an old tree in Glen's backyard reveals a large and mysterious hole which leads to The Gate – an underground chamber of terrifying demonic evil.

items.title: Fort Yuma
items.description: When a revered Apache chief is brutally murdered en route to Fort Yuma to negotiate a peace treaty, all-out war erupts in this rousing -- and surprisingly touching -- western starring Peter Graves and directed by the legendary Lesley Selander.

items.title: Hot Tub Time Machine 2
items.description: Rob Corddry, Craig Robinson, and Clark Duke return for more side-splitting adventures in time! When Lou (Corddry) finds himself in trouble, the boys fire up the hot tub time machine and head back to the past…but end up in the future…with Adam's son!

items.title: Spellbinder
items.description: When a scream pierces the night across a deserted L.A. street, a young attorney rushes to the aid of a beautiful, mysterious woman. At first, she appears to be a dream come true. But a bloodthirsty cult lurks in the shadows...waiting to reclaim her!

items.title: Children Of The Corn: Genesis
items.description: An update of the horror classic that follows a couple who take a cross-country road trip to work out their marital issues and end up falling victim to a cult of killer children in an abandoned Nebraska town.

items.title: Creature From The Haunted Sea (1961)
items.description: A crook kills off members of his crew and blames their deaths on a legendary sea creature. But what happens when the sea creature is actually real?

items.title: Sophie Jones
items.description: The raw, emotional coming-of-age story of Sophie, a teen pushing the boundaries of her newfound sexual awakening as she copes with the recent loss of her mother.

items.title: Poser
items.description: Local indie music podcaster Lennon Gates finds herself spiraling down a path of dark obsession when she befriends the striking performer Bobbi Kitten who coaxes her to find her voice. Lennon does..and creates an identity not wholly her own.

items.title: North V South
items.description: After decades of peace, the truce has been broken.

items.title: Lucille Ball: We Love Lucy
items.description: The trail-blazing life of Lucille Ball.

items.title: Better Start Running
items.description: In BETTER START RUNNING, an unexpected series of events turns everyday store clerk Harley [Alex Sharp] into a wanted man and even more unexpectedly, he finds himself on the run with the girl of his dreams (Analeigh Tipton).

items.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
items.description: From director Michael Bay comes the best 'Transformers' ever! With humanity facing extinction from a terrifying new threat, it's up to the Autobots to save Earth. They'll need new allies, including inventor Cade (Mark Wahlberg) and the Dinobots!

items.title: Todos los perros van al cielo: Un cuento de navidad
items.description: Tres perros defenderán con uñas y dientes las Navidades, en un esfuerzo por salvarlas de un espíritu malvado (Carface) que quiere utilizar perros de todo el mundo para arruinar la Navidad.

items.title: God & Country
items.description: Looks at the implications of Christian Nationalism and how it distorts not only the constitutional republic, but Christianity itself.

items.title: Madeline's Madeline
items.description: While her mom sees Madeline as a fragile, emotional teen, the director of her theater workshop sees her as a raw talent with a troubled history that can be exploited for her art. Before long, Madeline's loyalties are torn between mother and mentor.

items.title: Break The Stage
items.description: A troubled and self-centered teen must earn the respect of her step team before she can lead them to the National Championship.

items.title: Bon Jovi: No End in Sight
items.description: Since the dawn of hair mousse, the New Jersey-based band formed over 40 years ago and quickly took the world by storm. With more than 100 million records sold worldwide, Bon Jovi continues to rock on.

items.title: Papi (LAS)
items.description: Docufilm pena de muerte: Los escalofriantes asesinatos en los 80 en Chile, revelando una evolución psicopática en medio de la agitación política.

items.title: 10 Songs For Charity
items.description: Beaten and hardened by life in a Nigerian ghetto, Charity leaves for Europe to work as a prostitute, in pursuit of her dream of becoming rich.

items.title: Bethany Hamilton: Unstoppable
items.description: Bethany Hamilton's "Unstoppable", the continuing story from shark attack survivor to fearless athlete, mother and UNSTOPPABLE force, a story of relentless strength and beauty.

items.title: American Ultra
items.description: Jesse Eisenberg and Kristen Stewart star in this explosive action-adventure about a small-town slacker who discovers he’s a sleeper agent targeted by CIA operatives.

items.title: Rememory
items.description: When an inventor turns up dead, a mysterious man (Peter Dinklage) steals his latest invention: a device able to extract, record and play a person’s memories.

items.title: Shattered Glass
items.description: Hayden Christensen stars in this critically acclaimed true story of a disgraced journalist, directed and co-written by Billy Ray, Oscar®-nominated writer of CAPTAIN PHILLIPS.

items.title: Doc Holliday
items.description: Doc Holliday runs a small dental practice in rural Georgia when he is visited by Wyatt Earp and offered a chance to become a United States Deputy. All Doc has to do is capture the Bridle Brothers – two of most notorious outlaws the West has ever seen.

items.title: Cheyenne
items.description: After shooting her cheating husband and taking off with his money, the sexy and feisty Cheyenne is on the run from the law.

items.title: Knight Club
items.description: A wannabe actor becomes a bouncer and is seduced by the fast-paced world of Los Angeles nightlife.

items.title: Washington's Armor
items.description: Follow the trajectory of George Washington as a boy and a young man as he develops his relationships and ideals.

items.title: A Band To Honor
items.description: This is the story of Navy Band Unit 22, the ship band for the USS Arizona. The band trained together, practiced together, performed together, lived together, and, on December 7, 1941, died together!

items.title: Chick Fight
items.description: When Anna Wyncomb is introduced to an underground, all-female fight club in order to turn the mess of her life around, she discovers she is much more personally connected to the history of the club than she could ever imagine.

items.title: Shadow Dance
items.description: A battered veteran and an assertive stripper share a lap dance that send both their lives down a dark unexpected path while finding light.

items.title: Ride In The Whirlwind
items.description: Two out of three cowboys (Cameron Mitchell, Jack Nicholson) run for their lives after meeting up with outlaws and a lynch-law posse.

items.title: Open Water 3: Cage Dive
items.description: When three friends from California hit the rugged Australian coast, a rogue wave destroys their boat, leaving them afloat and defenseless in shark-infested waters.

items.title: Dos meseros majaderos
items.description: Capulina busca la ayuda de Viruta para trabajar en un centro nocturno donde él trabaja. Una peligrosa confusión hará que se vean envueltos en una investigación policíaca y en la mira de un peligroso asesino.

items.title: ClownTown
items.description: A group of friends get stranded in a seemingly deserted small town and find themselves stalked by a violent gang of psychopaths dressed as clowns.

items.title: El médico módico
items.description: El mecánico de las ambulancias de un hospital habla de su oficio en términos médicos. En el hospital atiende a un delincuente pero éste sale huyendo provocando confusión y un relajo en todo el hospital.

items.title: Capulina chisme caliente
items.description: El empleado de la compañía telefónica Capulina escucha conversaciones por los aparatos que repara y cuenta chismes de todo el vecindario, pero cuanto dice siempre es útil para las víctimas del cotilleo.

items.title: Capulina corazón de león
items.description: Capulina accidentalmente adopta un león de una tienda de mascotas, pensando que es un gato. Las cosas se complican cuando, encima de todo, lo toman por asaltante.

items.title: Macabra, la mano del diablo
items.description: Un arqueólogo mexicano desentierra una urna en la cual encuentra una mano humana que posee extraños poderes.

items.title: County Line
items.description: When his brother in blue is gunned down, a former sheriff finds himself caught in a deadly criminal network as he investigates the murder.

items.title: Huelepega
items.description: Oliver huye de los malos tratos de su familia y se refugia en las violentas calles de Caracas, donde sobrevive en un entorno de corrupción, delincuencia y hambre inhalando pegamento para evadirse, como otros niños en su misma situación.

items.title: Jóvenes y bellas
items.description: Un grupo de padres decide mandar a sus hijas a un campamento para alejarlas de la música rock, pero ahí ocurre lo que todo progenitor teme: sus pequeñas encuentran novio.

items.title: La maldición de la llorona
items.description: Una joven hereda una mansión, solo para descubrir que está hechizada por brujas y espíritus malignos.

items.title: La marquesa del barrio
items.description: Una cantante alcohólica no es sincera con su hija sobre su situación económica y puede ser descubierta con la llegada de su hija de Argentina.

items.title: Rebelde sin casa
