items.description: A classic Korean ghost story gets a horrifying new spin in THE MIMIC, as the mother of a missing child takes in a lost girl she finds in the woods and soon begins to wonder if she is even human.

items.title: Crazy Fist
items.description: After an opponent dies mid-match, a prominent MMA champion swore never to fight again and retired to run his family’s company. But when his best friend dies under suspicious circumstances, he has no choice but to step back in the ring.

items.title: Gangster No. 1 - The Freddie Foreman Story
items.description: Freddie Foreman reveals the audacious details of the heists, double crossings, shootouts, murders and betrayals he was involved in and ultimately, what has made him 'Gangster No. 1'.

items.title: Kate: The Making of a Modern Queen
items.description: A profile of the Duchess of Cambridge, exploring her transformation from a seemingly ordinary young woman to a future monarch and what this means for the royal family.

items.title: The Unity Of Heroes
items.description: Wong Fei Hung battles foreign and domestic enemies to stop the distribution of a dangerous narcotic, risking all to save lives.

items.title: King Charles and Queen Camilla: Into the Unknown
items.description: The past, present and future of a royal romance which has survived against all odds. But what will that future bring for King, ‘Queen’ and country?

items.title: Jobs
items.description: College drop-out Steve Jobs teams with childhood friend Steve ìWozî Wozniak to assemble the first Apple Computer in his parentsí garage. Driven by a relentless pursuit of excellence, Jobs transforms the world of computing at the cost of his personal life.

items.title: Two Lovers and a Bear
items.description: A couple in the Arctic, joined by a mystical bear, navigate love amidst past haunts. Their journey through beautiful, harsh landscapes tests their bond, confronting demons in a tale of survival and connection.

items.title: Christmas on the Range
items.description: All Kendall Riley wants for the holidays is to save her family's ranch, but her longtime rival, small-town Scrooge Brick McCree, has other plans in mind.

items.title: Little Boy
items.description: A child tries his best to bring his father home from war.

items.title: Wiggle Bay
items.description: Join The Wiggles and friends at Wiggle Bay for a magical picnic by the sea. Can they solve the mystery and return the golden key to its rightful owner? Prepare for fun, singing, dancing and learning at Wiggle Bay!

items.title: Gintama
items.description: Set in the Edo shogunate where power of samurai is on decline as the aliens from outer space have invaded the country and outlawed their swords, it portrays the life of a handyman Gintoki Sakata, whom still carries the heart of a samurai.

items.title: A Date By Christmas Eve
items.description: After her brilliant idea for a new dating app is stolen by a workplace rival, Chelsea's fortunes take a turn for the better following a Christmas wish upon a shooting star.

items.title: Sadness of Sex
items.description: Comprised of 15 vignettes, this film is about love and the phases of courtship that lead to break-up.

items.title: Silent Hill: Revelation
items.description: Heather Mason and her father have always tried to stay one step ahead of the malevolent forces intent on their destruction. But on the eve of her 18th birthday, a dangerous revelation leads her deeper into a demonic world.

items.title: The Endless
items.description: Acclaimed filmmakers Moorhead and Benson return with this mind-bending thriller that follows two brothers who receive a cryptic video message inspiring them to revisit the UFO death cult they escaped a decade earlier.

items.title: Christmas Time Capsule
items.description: When Tiffany's best friend, James, arrives at her house looking for the heirloom engagement ring he left in her care, she quickly realizes that he wants to use it to propose to another woman.

items.title: Alien Agenda: Into the Future
items.description: The abundant evidence suggests UFOs exist and have been encountered for decades and that the earth is being visited by extraterrestrial entities. The question is what do they want? Why come to earth? Do they have an agenda? The answers might shock you.

items.title: The Deliverance of Amy Stronghold
items.description: Amy Stronghold, a tough and resourceful woman hardened by years on the streets as a hustler, faces a life-altering challenge: reunite with her estranged daughter, Kia. The catch? Amy must clean up her act, get a job, and embrace a suburban life.

items.title: Preman: Silent Fury
items.description: After his son witnesses a brutal murder by a notorious crime boss, a deaf Indonesian gangster is thrust into the fight of his life when he takes on his dangerous former allies—including a sociopathic assassin—in order to protect his child.

items.title: En otro lugar
items.description: Pedro y Luis encuentran el amor en el norte de España después de una serie de aventuras inesperadas.

items.title: Lejos de casa
items.description: Un grupo de niños, niñas y adolescentes, procedentes de México y Latinoamérica, espera en albergues de Tijuana una resolución a su solicitud de asilo para ingresar a Estados Unidos.

items.title: When Harry Met Sally
items.description: As Harry Burns and Sally Albright build their lives and careers in Manhattan, their paths continue to cross, and their friendship continues to grow … until they confront the decision whether to let their friendship develop into romance.

items.title: Founders Day
items.description: A small town is ripped apart by a series of gruesome killings in the week leading up to a heated mayoral election.

items.title: Chocolate Covered Christmas
items.description: Successful marketing executive Sadie is the daughter of the owners of a traditional chocolate store in small town America. She decides to spend Christmas back at her home town and discovers that her parents are planning to sell the store.

items.title: A Christmas Wish In Hudson
items.description: When a software developer travels to a small town in Washington to meet a widowed firefighter she saw compete on a cooking show, his daughter believes she's the answer to her Christmas wish—for her dad to find someone to love.

items.title: Christmas All Over Again (LAS)
items.description: Un niño travieso y obsesionado con el botín debe superar el Scrooge que lleva dentro o quedarse atrapado en un ciclo en el que cada día es una Navidad sin regalos.

items.title: Eat, Drink and Be Married
items.description: Three days out from their wedding day, Jess and Max are ready to cancel. Max's brother Charlie enlists the help from wedding planner Billie to save the wedding. In the process, he starts to fall for her.

items.title: Christmas in the Pines
items.description: As Ariel, an up-and-coming magazine writer, and Mark, a successful architect, battle over ownership of an idyllic Christmas cottage, they soon discover that their cozy holiday getaway may not be the only thing they love.

items.title: Christmas in Wolf Creek
items.description: When the reindeer and star of the holiday play goes missing, new couple Sam and Austin set out to save Christmas- and their relationship.

items.title: Christmas in the Wilds
items.description: Jessica, Buck, and the Thompson family from Romance in the Wilds return in an exciting holiday sequel. Buck and Jessica's merry little Christmas together takes a dangerous turn when their journey through the wild turns into a battle for survival.

items.title: Christmas in the Rockies
items.description: After her father is involved in a logging accident, Katie puts her dream job on hold and enters a lumberjack competition to save her family's business.

items.title: Mean Girls 2
items.description: The Plastics are back in the follow-up to the smash-hit Mean Girls... and now the clique is more fashionable, funny and ferocious than ever!

items.title: Abominable Christmas
items.description: Two Abominable Snowkids find themselves in a sleepy Colorado mountain town after being chased out of their hideaway by a scientist determined to capture them.

items.title: The Fluffy Movie
items.description: Stand-up comedian Gabriel Iglesias offers hilarious observations and impressions in this concert film featuring never-before-seen footage from his Unity Through Laughter tour. Directed by Manny Rodriguez.

items.title: Too Late
items.description: A lonely assistant finally finds love and must escape her monster of a boss before she and her new love become his next meal.

items.title: Christmas Lover's Anonymous
items.description: A best-selling author hides her love for Christmas after an ugly breakup, but could find love again when she discovers a website for people who are crazy about Christmas: "Christmas Lovers Anonymous."

items.title: Miles
items.description: Miles Walton (Tim Boardman), age 17, is biding his time until he can go away to college in Chicago and study filmmaking. His father passes away unexpectedly, revealing a secret affair with a local girl, which gutted their family savings.

items.title: The House Of The Lost On The Cape [English-Language Version]
items.description: A strange old woman allows a teenage runaway and a young orphan to stay in an abandoned house overlooking the sea. However, when a menacing entity threatens their new home, they must band together and face their fears to save it.

items.title: Polar Rescue
items.description: After a young boy gets lost during a bitter snowstorm, his frantic parents (Donnie Yen, Cecilia Han) seek help from the local police, who are soon faced with a desperate race against the clock as hours tick by with no sign of the child.

items.title: The Knight Of Shadows
items.description: Legendary demon hunter Pu Songling (Jackie Chan) investigates the kidnapping of young girls by evil forces, embarking on a perilous journey to save humanity in this action-packed martial arts comedy.

items.title: Champion
items.description: A former arm-wrestling champion raised in the US returns to South Korea for a tournament that could return him to glory, but finds his life complicated by the appearance of the biological family he never knew.

items.title: I Get Knocked Down
items.description: Part music documentary, part unflinching character study, part a punk version of 'A Christmas Carol' - I Get Knocked Down is the funny, surreal, and deeply human untold story of Chumbawamba and its ex-front man Dunstan Bruce.

items.title: Monster Island
items.description: As the world tries to stop a giant Kaiju bent on destruction more and more monsters appear - each one more terrible than the last - leaving mankind defenseless until our heroes reach out to a specialist versed in monster lore.

items.title: Triassic Hunt
items.description: When two dinosaurs break out of a lab and attack an industrial park, a ragtag group of mercenaries is called in to contain the creatures before they decimate the park and escape into the world.

items.title: One-Percent Warrior
items.description: After his devastatingly fast, samurai-style combat approach sets filmmakers against him, a legendary action star (Tak Sakaguchi) films his own movie—on turf claimed by feuding yakuza gangs, including Japan’s deadliest martial arts assassin.

items.title: Crazy Samurai: 400 vs 1
items.description: When a samurai arrives to duel the disgraced Yoshioka, he walks into an ambush. In the world’s first 77-minute, one-take samurai action film, he fights for his life against 400 warriors, earning a place in history as CRAZY SAMURAI MUSASHI.

items.title: The Divine Fury
items.description: Yong-hu, a champion fighter, seeks help from a priest when mysterious wounds appear on his palms, thrusting him into a battle against evil forces

items.title: Planet Dune
items.description: A mission to rescue a marooned base on a desert planet turns deadly when the crew finds themselves hunted and attacked by the planet’s apex predators: giant sandworms.

items.title: Elephants: Changing Lives
items.description: Few animals have more complex societies and interactions than elephants.

items.title: A Christmas Carol (1984)
items.description: Ebenezer Scrooge, a bitter and lonely old man, learns to open his heart to the spirit of Christmas.

items.title: The New Abolitionists
items.description: Filmmaker Christina Zorich follows abolitionists in Southeast Asia committed to rescuing and rehabilitating those trapped in human sex trafficking and their efforts towards prevention and the prosecution of offenders.

items.title: Dirty South House Arrest
items.description: Drake is sentenced to house arrest, after committing a crime. His bad judgment places the family home in jeopardy and so he decides to raise the money by throwing a house party that will change him and this neighborhood forever.

items.title: Elsewhere
items.description: After being evicted from his beloved home, a man sets a desperate plan in motion to get it back, with very unlikely and life-changing results.

items.title: Cornerstore
items.description: CornerStore chronicles one hot summer day at a convenience store in Detroit. The store is operated by Earl Jenkins, father of Gerard and Gail. Gerard's dream is to attend culinary school in New York to become a chef.

items.title: The Mojo Manifesto: The Life And Times Of Mojo Nixon
items.description: On a bicycle trip across the country, a young Neill Kirby McMillan Jr. experiences The Mojo Revelation and becomes Mojo Nixon. After teaming up with the enigmatic Skid Roper, he unexpectedly finds mainstream success during the Golden Age of MTV.

items.title: Gunfight at Dry River
items.description: In the Old West, a family of renegades controls the only water source in a Mexican border town ravaged by severe drought. However, when a stranger arrives to reclaim his father's land, a violent confrontation changes all of their lives forever.

items.title: Mrs. Doubtfire
items.description: An eccentric dad dresses as a British nanny to care for his kids at their mother's home.

items.title: Chaos
items.description: Two cops, a rookie and a grizzled vet, pursue an accomplished bank robber.

items.title: Heart Of A Champion
items.description: Charlie, a fourteen-year-old girl, from a divorced home, has a dream of raising a horse and competing in a riding competition.

items.title: Knuckleball
items.description: After his Grandfather unexpectedly dies in the night, 12 year old Henry finds himself cut off and alone on an isolated farm.

items.title: Max Steel
items.description: Teenager Max McGrath is adjusting to a new school when his body starts to generate strange energy flare-ups that he can't control.

items.title: Willy's Wonderland
items.description: A drifter (Nicolas Cage) is tricked into a janitorial job at a condemned amusement park and the mundane tasks suddenly become an all-out fight for survival against demonic animatronics.

items.title: Trust
items.description: A teenage girl is targeted by an online sexual predator. This dark thriller from 'Friends' star David Schwimmer features Clive Owen, Catherine Keener, Jason Clarke and Viola Davis.

items.title: Brothers In Blues
items.description: Dripping with rock history and untold stories from the people who were in the room when it happened, BROTHERS IN BLUES is an intimate look into the tragedies and glories of Jimmie and Stevie Ray Vaughan and their enduring rock and roll legacies.

items.title: Signed, Sealed, Delivered: From Paris With Love
items.description: Hallmark Original Movie. The POstables explore the mystery of true love as they deliver divorce papers.

items.title: American Yakuza
items.description: Viggo Mortensen ('Green Book') stars as an undercover FBI agent who has risen through the ranks of the Yakuza and now finds himself caught in a war between the Yakuza, the mob and the FBI.

items.title: Creating Christmas
items.description: Harper, an aspiring illustrator, eager for her big break, is to collaborate with a demanding children's book author. When he insists on her working through Christmas week in a small town in Colorado, she must help break him out of his writer's block.

items.title: Dead of Night: A Darkness at Blaisedon
items.description: Legendary producer-director Dan Curtis presents a thrilling trilogy of spell-binding stories with mystery-horror writer Richard Matheson.

items.title: Bad Connection
items.description: When a young, penniless waitress buys a cheap stolen cell phone online, she has no idea that the original owner is a killer that will stop at nothing to track down the videos of his previous killings.

items.title: Dobermann
items.description: The Dobermann is the slickest gangster in town and the leader of the gang of the same name. They have more bank robberies to their name than they can count. But his adversary, corrupt and ruthless cop Christini, is hell bent to capture him.

items.title: My Friend Tommy
items.description: Tommy is a sheltered, real-life 40 year old virgin who embarks on a life-changing quest across the country to discover the adulthood he's missed out on with his friends. As he's pushed far out of his comfort zone to grow up, past traumas arise.

items.title: Return of the Beverly Hillbillies
items.description: Jed Clampett has left Beverly Hills to return to country life while Elly May works at a zoo and Jethro produces films in Hollywood. Jane Hathaway and her government boss attempt to solve the nation's energy crisis with their help.

items.title: The Last Kumite
items.description: A karate champion is forced to fight in an illegal and deadly fighting competition in order to save his kidnapped daughter.

items.title: Paradox Effect
items.description: A single mother is kidnapped by a corrupt cop, and together the two must work together to save her daughter's life.

items.title: Splice Here: A Projected Odyssey
items.description: FILM IS DEAD! The mantra that accompanied the dawn of the digital projection age. But was it really true? Now ten years on from that momentous transition, journey to find out what has really happened to film.

items.title: The Mouse Trap
items.description: It's Alex's 21st Birthday, but she's stuck at the amusement arcade on a late shift so her friends decide to surprise her, but a masked killer dressed as a mouse decides to play a game of his own with them which she must survive.

items.title: Tomorrow Before After
items.description: In a post-apocalyptic world, a lone woman searches for survivors while coping with an unborn child growing inside her.

items.title: Concussed: The American Dream
items.description: As NFL players deteriorate, a grim truth emerges: head trauma's toll. Through the stories of Tyler Sash and Brett Favre, football's hidden dangers are exposed, shedding light on a long-covered correlation between head trauma and the sport.

items.title: Comeback Kids: A Middle School Basketball Story
items.description: The heartwarming journey of the Thomas G. Pullen middle school basketball team's pursuit of championship gold.

items.title: Exit The Dragon, Enter The Tiger
items.description: A student of Bruce Lee travels to Hong Kong to search for answers.

items.title: Enter The Panther
items.description: A young kung fu master seeks vengeance upon the villains.

items.title: Colegas
items.description: Cuando José deja embarazada a Rosario, la hermana de su mejor amigo Antonio, los tres deben buscar una solución para evitar la furia de sus padres.

items.title: La belleza de la vida
items.description: Una joven con sueños de convertirse en autora de libros para niños forma una inesperada amistad con un malhumorado y adinerado viudo. Juntos, descubrirán que la vida tiene mucho más que ofrecer cuando se abren al otro.

items.title: Two Chefs and a Wedding Cake
items.description: When a food critic at the top of her game comes face to face with a chef renowned for refusing food critics to his restaurant at her sister's wedding, they must find a way to overcome their differences before the big day.

items.title: Ivy & Mistletoe
items.description: A young woman is determined to get home for Christmas, but gets stranded in a small town during a snow storm. Little does she know that she is exactly where she is supposed to be.

items.title: Magic in Mount Holly
items.description: A new gallery owner discovers that she can paint the future using a paintbrush left by Santa. As she discovers the true magic within herself, she also learns to love and be more confident.

items.title: In This Together: A PBS American Portrait Story
items.description: Through personal stories, photographs and videos, people across America share their firsthand stories of how the global coronavirus pandemic has affected their lives, our nation, and how it has brought us all together.

items.title: Encuentra el amor en Charm, Ohio
items.description: Una joven Amish, que no está satisfecha con su camino en casa, visita a una prima durante el verano. Durante el verano, se expone a otro mundo, encuentra amistades y mucho más. Pronto deberá elegir y aceptar la vida que quiere.

items.title: Elimination Game
items.description: A disgraced Navy SEAL is forced into a deadly televised game of survival. Hunted in a dystopian future, he must outwit his pursuers in a brutal race for freedom, seeking redemption and revenge in a world where justice is a game.

items.title: The Derby Stallion
items.description: An alcoholic former horse-trainer perceives in a fifteen-year-old boy a unique gift of horsemanship.

items.title: Shaolin Deadly Hands
items.description: The girlfriend of a con-man and Wing Chun fighter is being held in a brothel.

items.title: Showdown At The Equator
items.description: An undercover detective uses a restaurant to infiltrate the gang and arrest its members.

items.title: Fling
items.description: An attractive young couple's open relationship is stretched to the breaking point when each partner finds themselves falling in love with other people.

items.title: Return Of The Tiger
items.description: Shrewd'n'suave Chang Wong and his female partner devise an elaborate plan to take out a heroin drug ring.

In the pre-Spanish era Philippines, a young beautiful native princess falls in love with a handsome Spanish soldier. Against all odds and pulled apart by their loyalties to their own people, they fight for their clandestine romance.

items.title: Savage State
items.description: When the American Civil War breaks out, a family of french settlers must abandon their Missouri home.

items.title: Divorce Bait
items.description: A suburban housewife posts a fake message on social media that she is getting a divorce.

items.title: The Bravest One
items.description: The drunken master takes on some new disciples from a kung fu school.

items.title: Free Samples
items.description: Stanford Law dropout Jillian wakes up with a hangover and is pressured by her friend to take a shift at an ice-cream truck in LA, giving out free samples. People drop by.

items.title: Royally Yours, This Christmas
items.description: Single mother and hotel housekeeper NEVE never meant to deceive JAMES when he mistakes her for a wealthy hotel guest. As the couple get to know each other on a tour of the city, a jealous lady uncovers Neve's true identity, she stands to lose everything.

items.title: Game Of Killers
items.description: Two top killers team up to take on the darker forces in the martial world.

items.title: The Heiress of Christmas
items.description: Loryn, heiress to a famous department store Hamptons, is put to the test by her Grandmother. Things do not run smoothly as she navigates her way through the pit falls of working at the store during its busiest time of the year – Christmas!

items.title: Damn Yankees
items.description: A frustrated fan of the hopeless Washington Senators makes a pact with the Devil to help the baseball team win the pennant. Gwen Verdon is a total delight as Lola, the temptress used by the devil (Ray Walston) to lure Joe Hardy (Tab Hunter).

items.title: Peace, War and 9/11
items.description: In a wide-ranging interview filmed six months before his passing, eminent scholar and lifelong peace activist Graeme MacQueen shares his final words on 9/11 and the 2001 anthrax attacks.

items.title: Falling
items.description: Elderly farmer Willis stays with gay son John in LA, where his mental decline and caustic humor reignite past wounds and mistrust in their clashing worlds.

items.title: Merry Good Enough
items.description: Meet the Raulie family: two divorced parents, three adult children, one missing mother and a partridge and a pear tree.

items.title: The Wrong Boy Next Door
items.description: After troubled teen Katie is sentenced to house arrest, she falls for her handsome new neighbor John. Katie soon becomes convinced there's more to John than meets the eye.

items.title: The Seven Year Itch
items.description: With his family away for their annual summer holiday, New Yorker Richard Sherman (Tom Ewell) decides he has the opportunity to live a bachelor's life. The beautiful but ditzy blonde (Marilyn Monroe) from the apartment above him catches his eye.

items.title: Coming Home in the Dark
items.description: A teacher is forced to confront a secret from his past when a pair of ruthless drifters take his family on a nightmare road-trip.

items.title: A Bestselling Kind of Love
items.description: Nora's first novel shoots to the top of the bestsellers list but is terrified of speaking in front of crowds to promote her book, so her literary agent hires Daniel, a public speaking coach, to help Nora overcome her fears, which is easier said than done.

items.title: Lemonade Stand Romance
items.description: When a girl's lemonade stand gets shut down over an outdated bylaw, Trish, a PR rep, is tasked to return to her hometown to fight the ban. The girl's father is none other than George, the high school sweetheart she left behind.

items.title: A Match in Manhattan
items.description: When Celeste loses her job as a teacher, her boss puts her forward for an au pair job with a NY Property Tycoon. As she struggles with the children, can Celeste win over Richard and his children so she can keep her job, or maybe love has other plans...

items.title: Coasts: Rolling With The Waves
items.description: Surf zones where ocean waves meet coastal habitats are food-rich waters.

items.title: Crocodile Kingdom
items.description: Today's 25 species are a testament to the crocodile's intelligence and adaptability.

items.title: The Crooked Man
items.description: Olivia returns home after six years, and a string of unusual deaths leads her to believe that she's being haunted by a mysterious force from her childhood.

items.title: A Priceless Love
items.description: After realizing one of the items in her store is actually an antique teapot worth $80K, Rose finds herself in the sights of Joe, an antique broker. He's determined to buy the teapot from Rose, but she refuses to sell until she can find the original owner.

items.title: A Slice of Chicago Romance
items.description: Romanos & Juliatos, two pizza places, have competed for business for years. When both restaurants hand over the reins to the next generation, a pizza chain moves into town, they struggle to continue the rivalry after they begin to fall for one another.

items.title: A Snapshot of Forever
items.description: After leaving her big city life behind, wedding photographer Jessie Brookes is happier than ever. When famous actor Nate Brown shows up on her parent's vineyard for his sister's wedding, she quickly realizes that there is more to him than meets the eye.

items.title: Cold Blood (2019)
items.description: Retired hitman Henry, secluded in a forest, remains one of the world's most dangerous and wanted killers. Meanwhile, a girl becomes severely injured in a fall nearby and must be taken to a hospital, risking Henry's cover.

items.title: Moon Garden
items.description: A little girl in a coma is thrust into a surreal industrial dreamworld. Haunted by a spectre that feeds off her tears, she must follow her mother’s voice to find her way back to consciousness.

items.title: Piaffe
items.description: Introverted and unqualified, Eva is unexpectedly tasked with foleying the sound for a commercial featuring a horse. As she slowly acclimates to the new job, her obsession with creating the perfect equine sounds grows into something more tangible.

items.title: Team Bride
items.description: Hannah runs a side business making bespoke wedding dresses when she's not busy with her day job at a bridal salon. Her operation is soon threatened, however, when Will, heir to the bridal empire, comes in looking to revamp the brand.

items.title: Against the Grain
items.description: An inner-city kid goes to college, hoping to become a neurosurgeon one day.

items.title: Bucket List Africa
items.description: Africa, from mountains to marshland, deserts to coastlines, and grasslands to jungles.

items.title: Ligeia
items.description: A respected academic falls under the spell of a sexy siren who needs his soul for her own survival.

items.title: Strife Of Mastery
items.description: Brothers skilled in the martial arts set out to trap their uncle.

items.title: Bucket List Australia
items.description: Exploring Australia's widely varied landscapes and weird and wonderful wildlife.

items.title: Writing Kung Fu
items.description: A wimpy schoolteacher must learn kung-fu to defend his village against a wandering Vietnamese killer.

items.title: Bucket List Europe
items.description: Europe has a staggering diversity of natural wilderness teeming with wildlife.

items.title: Bucket List South America
items.description: South America is home to record-breaking mountain ranges and massive rainforests.

items.title: Cheetah: Beating the Odds
items.description: A cheetah raises her young family on the vast Serengeti.

items.title: Christmas Eve
items.description: Six different groups of New Yorkers get trapped inside elevators overnight on Christmas Eve. Over the course of this long night, it becomes clear that the lives of these seeming strangers are intertwined in meaningful and magical ways.

items.title: Street Gang: How We Got to Sesame Street
items.description: Take a stroll down Sesame Street and witness the birth of the most impactful children's series in TV history. From the iconic furry characters to the songs you know by heart, learn how a gang of visionary creators changed our world.

items.title: Finding Love in Saint Lucia
items.description: INSPIRED BY TRUE EVENTS - An Ornithologist and a Journalist partner up to save an endangered bird species in the jungle of Santa Lucia. They immediately fall in love with the nature, and in the process, they'll also fall in love with each other.

items.title: Love at the Bootcamp
items.description: When a scattered marketing exec is tasked with helping an unpopular small-town bootcamp turn its image around, she finds that the strict, regimented ways of its owner might just be the perfect 'fit' for love.

items.title: Owls: Masters of the Night
items.description: Owls have moved into environments from tundra to rain forest and will hunt almost anything.

items.title: Bruce's Fists Of Vengeance
items.description: Jack flies into Manila from Hong Kong and brings along a book of secrets.

items.title: Succubus
items.description: A new father struggling with fatigue, emotional insecurities, and a failing marriage joins a dating app, only to swipe right on what may be an inhuman presence.

items.title: Little Bi Peep
items.description: When directionless Emma falls for transgender IT technician Mason, her usual barricade made out of lies might jeopardize the true love that she has been looking for.

items.title: Submerged (2005)
items.description: The world's best mercenary (Steven Seagal, 'Exit Wounds') is freed from prison...with a catch. He must use his lethal weapons and fighting skills to stop terrorists who have taken over a nuclear sub.

items.title: Me and Mr. Christmas
items.description: Zoe persuades bookstore owner Sam to join the Mr. Christmas pageant to promote her new PR business. As Sam competes in festive challenges, their growing connection raises the question: is it just business, or is he Zoe’s Mr. Christmas?

items.title: Meet Me at The Christmas Train Parade
items.description: Charlotte and her son Benny work to revive the Christmas train parade with help from his teacher. But as sparks fly, she uncovers his secrets tied to the parade's past.

items.title: The Wedding Contest
items.description: When a wealthy couple can't decide on a wedding theme, they hire two wedding planners, TAYLOR and BEN, to compete for the job. As they compete for the gig and playfully sabotage each other's efforts but are growing closer together than they realise.

items.title: High Life: Forest Canopy
items.description: The trees' canopy holds its biggest animal diversity.

items.title: Gorillas: Rumble In The Jungle
items.description: Gorillas live in complex social groups predominantly led by a dominant male 'silverback.'

items.title: Meet The Marsupials
items.description: Australia and their animal representative, the marsupial.

items.title: Penguin Party
items.description: Few animals are more loved than penguins waddling on ice like clumsy people.

items.title: Polar Bears
items.description: Following the lives of polar bears -- top predators able to withstand a harsh environment.

items.title: Rainforest Home
items.description: Rainforests, the richest habitats on earth, teem with millions of dramatic plants and animals.

items.title: Sloth Bears: Birth Of A Prince
items.description: The sloth bear remains largely unknown and rarely seen.

items.title: Terrifier (ESP)
items.description: Art el payaso regresa y pone su mirada en tres mujeres jóvenes, junto con cualquiera que se meta en su camino.

items.title: Icy Coast
items.description: Cold coasts are challenging landscapes, but they can reveal surprising riches for wildlife too.

items.title: Jaguar: King Of The Jungle
items.description: The jaguar is the third largest of the big cats and pound for pound the most powerful.

items.title: Lions: Africa's Super Power
items.description: The most social of all cats, lions form prides that are unlike any other animals.

items.title: Magical Fjords
items.description: Fjords' majestic and dramatic landscapes are just the tip of the iceberg.

items.title: Manatees On The Move
items.description: Once thought to be mermaids, the blubber butts are actually gentle giants.

items.title: Marine Mammals Born to Swim
items.description: Marine mammals are among the most loved creatures on the planet, much of their lives remain a mystery, adding to their mystique and appeal.

items.title: Bad City
items.description: In poverty-stricken Kaiko City, a corrupt mayoral candidate eliminates rival mafias, prompting a released ex-cop to lead a treacherous battle for justice with a special task force in the gritty underworld.

items.title: Fondo de fideicomiso
items.description: Reese Donahue lleva una vida aparentemente ideal, con un futuro brillante por delante. Pero cuando descubre la verdad, que su madre le dejó suficiente dinero para que ella eligiera su propio camino, se enfrenta a un dilema.

items.title: The Enchanted Forest
items.description: There are few places more magical than a forest where enchantment can be found at every turn.

items.title: The Gunfighter
items.description: A retired gunslinger is forced to strap on his six-shooters once again by the vengeful brothers of a man he killed in self-defense.

items.title: The World From Above
items.description: Looking down on the world from above, one might see the incredible diversity of landscapes.

items.title: Warlock
items.description: An ex-outlaw (Richard Widmark) divides and challenges a quick-draw lawman (Henry Fonda) and his sidekick (Anthony Quinn).

items.title: Wolves: Power Of The Pack
items.description: From the tundra to the great plains, the kingdom of the wolf extends across the northern hemisphere.

items.title: Wonderful Wetlands
items.description: Water provides a haven; it can be a nursery, a migration stop, a larder and a home.

items.title: One Tough Cop
items.description: A sordid tale of police corruption involving real-life New York City detective Bo Dietl, a maverick who — on top of his daily battles with street thugs — must fight crooked cops within his unit.

items.title: A Missed Connection
items.description: After finding a spark with a woman on a train platform, a photographer posts a missed connection in the newspaper, but never hears from her – then, 5 years later, they're seated next to each other on a plane heading to the same wedding – hers.

items.title: How to Win a Prince
items.description: A perennially single dating coach attempts to seduce a prince as she helps him navigate the cut-throat NYC dating scene, but starts to fall for his right hand man in the process. Will she win the prince, or find love in an unexpected place instead?

items.title: The Royal Bake Off
items.description: Rival bakers Allie and Marilyn compete to impress a prince seeking a royal baker. As sparks fly between Allie and the prince, Marilyn schemes to ensure Allie doesn’t win the gig—or his heart.

items.title: Generation Nation: A PBS American Portrait Story
items.description: Explore how people in different age groups see themselves and their place in America. Through self-shot video, they share common experiences that bind age groups together and generational differences that put them at odds with one another.

items.title: Let's Eat!
items.description: It's time for a musical feast with The Wiggles, so let's eat! Join a number of special guests for tasty tunes about food and hygiene, from 'Let's Cook' to 'Wonderful Wags'!

items.title: The Professional Golgo 13
items.description: After killing the son of a powerful oil tycoon, an infamous hit-man is targeted by American governmental forces and superhuman assassins.

items.title: A Town Called Love
items.description: Emma needs to prove herself to her boss Jenna. But when she butts heads with the mayor's son on a mission to scout out a town called Love, she decides to impersonate Jenna to teach him a lesson.

items.title: Surge
items.description: In this tense thriller, an airport security worker (Golden Globe winner Ben Whishaw) trapped in a soulless life unleashes his darker side on a crime spree through London, ultimately experiencing what it feels like to be truly alive.

items.title: Sweeney Todd
items.description: A dark tale of love, obsession and murder set in 1765 London. Based on the classic penny dreadful.

items.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks Christmas
items.description: A traditional Christmas feast Tom Kerridge style means Turkey, but this is Turkey with a twist. A seasonal spiced orange cake with plum sauce, Christmas pudding ice cream, and festive mulled cider accompany this memorable holiday meal.

items.title: Speed of Thought
items.description: Scopers. They know everything. But the truth.

items.title: The Confession
items.description: All her life, Katie Lapp (Katie LeClerc) has known no other world than that of the Amish family who raised her. But upon discovering that she was actually adopted from out of the

items.title: The Proposal
items.description: An undercover cop needed a wife for the night for an assignment into the underground. Between the deception and the danger, they let the job get personal. When your life is on the line, never turn your back, never show your fear, and never fall in love.

items.title: Wedding Bell Blues
items.description: Three women are apartment mates: one is about to be married, another discovers she is pregnant by her longtime boyfriend, and the third has an endless queue of men in and out of her bedroom. Sudden jiltings lead them to Vegas.

items.title: Who Loves the Sun
items.description: A troubled young man's sudden return after a mysterious five-year disappearance reunites him with his wife and his best friend.

items.title: For the Love of Chocolate
items.description: Aria's plans are rattled when she loses her partner shortly before the Masters of Chocolate Festival. However, Rhett steps in just in time to help Aria find the winning ingredient.

items.title: Love Afloat
items.description: When Lorelei inherits a sailboat from a distant relative, she hires Rob to help clean, fix and sail it from its present location at a Caribbean island to Miami. The two have a definite culture clash as romantic sparks fly.

items.title: Love Amongst the Stars
items.description: Heidi, an astronomy professor, sees a rare planetary alignment as her chance to secure an observatory. But August, a bold archaeologist, could either advance her research or ruin it—and possibly her heart.

items.title: Love at the Ranch
items.description: Reporter Allison heads to Clybourne Ranch to profile her favorite author, Annabelle Lee. While uncovering Annabelle’s story, she bonds with charming rancher Hank and his Grandma Stella. Sparks fly, and unexpected surprises await around every corner.

items.title: Love for Starters
items.description: To save her father's lake-front restaurant, a talented interior designer must partner with the celebrity chef her father hired without her knowledge to revamp the place before time runs out.

items.title: Love in Full Swing
items.description: Aspiring romance columnist Becks helps her best friend Casey find his first love but discovers deeper feelings along the way. Torn between helping him or risking their friendship, Becks must decide if she’s ready to open her heart to true love.

items.title: Love Map
items.description: A journalist on the verge of launching a dating app is tasked with writing a map of the most romantic places in Florida. The only problem is that she has to team up with a tour guide whose tastes are diametrically opposed to hers.

items.title: The Wedding Arrangement
items.description: When Violet needs help preparing flower arrangements for a high-profile wedding, she calls upon Jack, a photographer who has taken over responsibility for his grandfather's flower shed.

items.title: Monkey Mayhem
items.description: Covering monkeys, from Japanese snow monkeys to African baboons.

items.title: Mountain Lion: The Ghost Cat
items.description: The ghost cat is one of the most elusive animals roaming the wilderness.

items.title: Nature’s Weirdest
items.description: How do you decide nature's weirdest animal? Is it the sloth, that hangs upside down?

items.title: Discretion Assured
items.description: Successful businessman Trevor McCabe finds himself in a romantic quandary with three women, leading to his involvement in embezzlement and murder.

items.title: Kill Me Later
items.description: A suicidal loan officer is about to jump off the bank roof after seeing her lover/boss's pregnant wife, when a bank robber grabs her as hostage. She helps him escape.

items.title: Deadly Past
items.description: A bartender in freedom is reconciled with his ex-petite friend before discovering what is part of his criminal project.

items.title: My Gay Life
items.description: Filmed over 7 years, we follow Billy as he deals with how his homosexuality is accepted through childhood.

items.title: Niko 2: Little Brother, Big Trouble
items.description: Set right before the holidays, Niko comes home one day to an unexpected little brother, who annoys him in every way. But when his new brother is goes missing, Niko must find a way to save him and accept every part of his family.

items.title: The Wrong House
items.description: A personal trainer begins a campaign of harassment against a couple and their young daughter after the family moves into the house that she wanted.

items.title: Witness Protection
items.description: A single mother and her daughter find themselves in even greater danger when they enter the Witness Protection Program to hide from a serial killer.

items.title: Looks and Smiles
items.description: Mick and Alan have just left school and are full of dreams, but against the background of Thatcher's Britain the two soon wake up to reality. Directed by Ken Loach ('I, Daniel Blake'), this film won the Young Cinema Award at the Cannes Film Festival.

items.title: The Rhythm Section
items.description: Blake Lively and Jude Law star in this action-packed thriller from the producers of James Bond. After finding out her family's death was not an accident, Stephanie (Lively) transforms from victim to assassin, seeking revenge on those responsible.

items.title: Pipe Dream
items.description: A plumber (Martin Donovan) pretends to be a filmmaker and holds fake auditions in order to meet women.

items.title: True Colors
items.description: While Tim dreamed of working in the Justice Department, Peter aspired to be a high-powered political player — at any cost.

items.title: Alone up There
items.description: A firsthand journey to understand the most unforgiving art form

items.title: Silent House
items.description: When Sarah finds herself sealed inside her family's secluded lake house with no contact to the outside world, panic soon turns to terror as events become increasingly ominous.

items.title: Foul Play
items.description: Beware of the Dwarf, whispers the hitchhiker to the beautiful librarian as he dies through a screening of This Gun Is Mine. Suddenly, Hawn is propelled into a world of wild chases and deadly encounters with an assortment of weird characters.

items.title: Oxygen
items.description: Two guys kidnap a rich man's wife and bury her in a box with 24 hours of oxygen. Tough NYPD Detective Maddy and others get the case. Will they reach it in time?

items.title: Saturday Night at the Baths
items.description: A pianist at a legendary gay bathhouse struggles with his own homophobia while developing feelings for a man.

items.title: Lipstick (ITV)
items.description: The last thing 27-year-old college graduate Geralyn (Sarah Chalke, 'Scrubs') expects from her busy, promising life is a breast cancer diagnosis. Based on the memoir by Lifetime executive Geralyn Lucas.

items.title: The Gunman
items.description: Eight years after a successful assassination, a former mercenary finds himself the target of hit squads hired to ensure his silence.

items.title: The Accused (1988)
items.description: Jodie Foster gives an Oscar-winning performance as the hard, independent Sarah Tobias, who is assaulted in the back of a neighborhood bar. But that is only the beginning of her ordeal.

items.title: Coup de Chance
items.description: Coup de Chance is about the important role chance and luck play in our lives.

items.title: Life is Not a Fairytale
items.description: An incredible voice and an 'American Idol' audition helped single mother Fantasia Barrino rise above a history of poverty, sexual abuse and illiteracy to achieve national prominence.

items.title: The Last Kiss
items.description: The Last Kiss is a contemporary comedy-drama about life, love, infidelity, forgiveness, marriage, friendship and coming to grips with turning 30.

items.title: Al calor de la noche
items.description: Un policía afroamericano tiene que investigar el caso de un asesinato por motivos raciales en una hostil ciudad sureña.

items.title: Entrega mortal
items.description: Un sargento del ejército tiene la misión de llevar a un prisionero desde Berlín a Washington. Cuando este último escapa, el sargento se ve envuelto en medio de una conspiración para deshacerse de él.

items.title: Los amigos de Peter
items.description: Kenneth Branagh, Emma Thompson, Hugh Laurie, Imelda Staunton y Stephen Fry encabezan esta comedia conmovedora sobre un grupo de amigos de la universidad que se reúnen después de diez años en una gran mansión inglesa para celebrar el Año Nuevo

items.title: Seis grados de separación
items.description: Haciéndose pasar por el hijo de un famoso actor, un joven desconocido (Will Smith) entra hábilmente en el mundo elitista de los marchantes de arte (Stockard Channing, Donald Sutherland) y pone en marcha algo que cambiará sus vidas para siempre.

items.title: Mark of Zorro
items.description: A young Spanish aristocrat must masquerade as a fop in order to maintain his secret identity of Zorro as he restores justice to early California.

items.title: Supernova: el fin del universo
items.description: En los confines del espacio, la tripulación de una nave desvelará un secreto antes de que una supernova haga estallar la galaxia. James Spader, Angela Bassett, Peter Facinelli y Robert Forster protagonizan este thriller de ciencia ficción.

items.title: Madison
items.description: Miss Madison, un destartalado hidroplano, ha sido inscrito en la carrera del campeonato de la Copa de Oro. Jim McCormick, un hombre local que ha sacrificado el futuro de su familia para participar en la carrera, es escogido como su piloto.

items.title: ¡Agáchate, maldito!
items.description: Un desenlace explosivo aguarda a un terrorista irlandés (James Coburn) obsesionado con la dinamita, quien se alía con un campesino mexicano convertido en revolucionario (Rod Steiger) en este trepidante relato de poder y política.

items.title: Mississippi en llamas
items.description: Dos agentes del FBI de aspecto muy diferente llegan a Mississippi para investigar la desaparición de algunos defensores de los derechos civiles.

items.title: La luz incidente
items.description: Una mujer joven que tiene problemas al criar a sus hijas gemelas después de que su marido y su hermano mueren, acepta el cortejo de un pretendiente encantador pero misterioso, mayor que ella.

items.title: What Men Want
items.description: A successful sports agent (Taraji P. Henson) mysteriously gains the ability to hear men's thoughts. With this newfound power, she looks to outsmart her colleagues but the lengths she goes to put her relationships to the test in this hilarious comedy!

items.title: The Wipers Times
items.description: It’s 1916 and Captain Fred Roberts, a diamond prospector-turned-soldier, leads a small detachment of British soldiers through the ruins of Ypres, whereupon he and his men make an amazing discovery in a bombed-out building - an abandoned printing press.

items.title: Detention
items.description: A soldier-turned-teacher (action legend Dolph Lundgren) defends his school against violent gunmen who plan to use the building in a drug-smuggling operation.

items.title: Invitation to Hell (1984)
items.description: Horror master Wes Craven directs this story about a family that moves to a suburban town only to be coerced into joining a suspicious club.

items.title: Hot Pursuit (2015)
items.description: In this riotous spin on the mismatched buddy movie, an uptight and by-the-book cop (Reese Witherspoon) tries to protect the gregarious widow (Sofía Vergara) of a drug boss as they race through Texas pursued by crooked cops and murderous gunmen!

items.title: The Gunfight at Dodge City
items.description: Seeking a fresh start, Bat Masterson (Joel McCrea) rolls into Dodge City with a chip on his shoulder and a gun on his hip. But soon, his mysterious past will catch up with him when an old friend calls in a favor...one that might cost him his life!

items.title: Bill & Ted Face the Music
items.description: Yet to fulfill their rock and roll destiny, the stakes are higher than ever for the now middle-aged Bill and Ted who set out on a new adventure when a visitor from the future warns them that only their song can save life as we know it.

items.title: Lago Ness
items.description: Al Dr. Dempsey, un investigador científico desacreditado, hostigado y con problemas económicos, lo despachan rumbo al lago Ness para que refute la existencia de Nessie. Aunque fracasa en su cometido, el encuentra algo más improbable durante su aventura.

items.title: House of Gucci
items.description: Inspired by the true story of the family behind the Italian fashion empire. When Patrizia Reggiani marries into the Gucci family, her unbridled ambition begins to unravel the family legacy and triggers a spiral of betrayal, decadence, and murder.

items.title: Moby Dick
items.description: Esta adaptación del clásico de Melville es insuperable en cuanto a entretenimiento, imaginación y aventura. Consumido por la rabia, el capitán Ahab (Gregory Peck) tiene un propósito en la vida: vengarse de la gran ballena blanca que lo desfiguró.

items.title: Licorice Pizza
items.description: Licorice Pizza' is the story of Alana Kane and Gary Valentine growing up, running around and falling in love in the San Fernando Valley, 1973. Written and Directed by Paul Thomas Anderson, the film tracks the treacherous navigation of first love.

items.title: The Kentuckian
items.description: Eli Wakefield (Burt Lancaster) and his son are Kentucky adventurers longing for life on the Texas frontier. They learn, however, that their greatest challenge lies not in the uncharted wilderness, but in the people they meet along the way.

items.title: The Odyssey
items.description: Highly influential and a fearlessly ambitious pioneer, innovator, filmmaker, researcher and conservationist, Jacques-Yves Cousteau's aquatic adventure covers roughly thirty years of an inarguably rich in achievements life.
While on a routine patrol, an aging cop, his partner and their ride-along, get caught in a standoff with a band of former mercenaries robbing a bank.

items.title: All Roads Lead To Rome
items.description: Maggie, a single mother from New York City, embarks on a journey to a Tuscan village in an effort to reconnect with her rebellious teenage daughter, Summer.

items.title: Another Happy Day
items.description: A family weekend is fraught with emotional landmines for mercurial and sensitive Lynn as she arrives at her parents’ Annapolis estate for the marriage of her estranged eldest son Dylan, accompanied by her three younger children.

items.title: Pastor Shepherd
items.description: The tale of a down on his luck freeze-dried pet salesman and his journey to become the first ever cyber-evangelist.

items.title: Bang Bang Club
items.description: The Bang Bang Club was the name given to four young photographers whose work captured the final bloody days of white rule in South Africa.

items.title: Brimstone
items.description: A triumphant thriller set in the menacing inferno of the old American West, Brimstone tells the story of Liz, a genuine survivor who is hunted by a vengeful Preacher for a crime she didn’t commit.

items.title: Looking Glass
items.description: A couple buy a desert motel where they find out that strange, mysterious events occur.

items.title: I Think We're Alone Now
items.description: The carefully crafted paradise of the last man on Earth is threatened by the arrival of a mysterious interloper.

items.title: Forsaken (2014)
items.description: In 1872, an embittered gunslinger named John Henry Clayton attempts to make amends with his estranged father, Reverend Samuel Clayton, while their community is besieged by ruthless land-grabbers.

items.title: The Virtuoso
items.description: Danger, lies, and murder ensue for a professional assassin on a job in a remote town in this noir thriller starring Anson Mount, Abbie Cornish, and Oscar® winner Anthony Hopkins.

items.title: Two Night Stand
items.description: A snowstorm forces two people who made an online connection to unwillingly extend their one-night stand.

items.title: Half Magic
items.description: Three women use their newly formed sisterhood to fight against sexism, bad relationships and low self-esteem. Through embracing their wild adventures, they learn the secret to ultimate fulfillment.

items.title: The Death And Life Of John F. Donovan
items.description: A decade after the death of an American TV star, a young actor reminisces the written correspondence he once shared with the former, as well as the impact those letters had on both their lives.

items.title: You're Not You
items.description: A drama centered on a classical pianist who has been diagnosed with ALS and the brash college student who becomes her caregiver.

items.title: The Professor
items.description: After he learns he has six months to live, a college lecturer (Johnny Depp) turns rebellious party animal and wages a hilarious crusade against authority in this dark comedy.

items.title: No Way Back (1995)
items.description: A rogue FBI agent (Oscar winner Russell Crowe) recruits a yakuza boss and a ditzy flight attendant (Helen Slater) in his determined efforts to free his kidnapped son from the clutches of a revenge-crazed mobster.

items.title: Secrets in the Walls
items.description: When newly divorced Rachel jumps at the opportunity to buy an idyllic home in the suburbs, she has no idea that she and her teenage daughters will be entering into a terrifying nightmare.

items.title: Free LSD
items.description: Elderly sex shop owner, Keith, falls for a younger customer, but struggles with performance. Seeking help from a strange doctor, he discovers an experimental drug leading to renewed vitality and a journey into a parallel universe .

items.title: Single Black Female
items.description: Rose is a young college freshman who meets her roommate Max for the first time. The two develop an intense bond, and Max is willing to prove her loyalty to Rose, even if it means someone will have to die if they get in the way.

items.title: Who's Watching Us
items.description: When Ruth is hired to babysit for the Harris family, her and the kids find out that someone else is watching them closely. Ruth and Jasmine have to fight to protect themselves and her little brother, Micah.

items.title: Search & Destroy
items.description: In this satire, a desperate man tries to reinvent himself as a B movie producer only to find himself in even deeper trouble. Starring Griffin Dunne, Dennis Hopper, Christopher Walken, Illeana Douglas, John Turturro, Ethan Hawke and Rosanna Arquette.

items.title: The Cutter
items.description: A determined detective (Chuck Norris) sets out to rescue an aged diamond cutter from the hands of a murderous thief in this action-packed thriller.

items.title: After Blue (Dirty Paradise)
items.description: On a dangerous planet inhabited by women, a teenage girl and her mother must go after a notorious killer.

items.title: Cas & Dylan
items.description: When the self-proclaimed loner and terminally ill Dr. Cas Pepper reluctantly agrees to give aspiring writer and social misfit, Dylan Morgan, a ride home, the last thing he expects is that they will end up on a cross country journey together.

items.title: The Wrong Child
items.description: A wealthy woman who's married to a successful architect welcomes her husband's alleged son into the family after he appears on their doorstep, but she soon discovers the mysterious teen is a dangerous sociopath with a grudge.

items.title: Tadpole
items.description: Oscar Grubman is no ordinary 15-year-old. He's suave, smart, cultured and has one thing on his mind: older women! But when a sexy 40-something friend of the family takes Oscar up on his infatuation, he suddenly finds himself in way over his head!

items.title: The Boy In The Striped Pajamas
items.description: A forbidden friendship forms between Bruno, the son of a Nazi commandant, and Schmuel, a Jewish boy held captive in a concentration camp. Though separated physically by a barbed wire fence, their lives become inescapably intertwined.

items.title: Of Love And Shadows
items.description: During Pinochet's dictatorial reign of Chile, a journalist who's unphased by the political turmoil around her changes her views when she falls in love with a photographer who opens her eyes and heart to the atrocities committed by the state.

items.title: We Are What We Are (2013)
items.description: The Parkers, a seemingly wholesome family, keep to themselves, and for good reason. Local authorities begin to uncover clues that bring them to the secret that they have held for so many years.

items.title: The New Statesman: Who Shot Alan B'Stard
items.description: Following an attempt on his life, B'Stard (Rik Mayall) returns and helps reinstate capital punishment. Tables turn, however, when he is pinned for a murder he didn't commit.

items.title: Finding Love in San Antonio
items.description: ADELA ROMERO, a successful TV chef living in Los Angeles has just wrapped the newest season of her show. She gets an offer to work on a new network series that will send her traveling to Europe, but she is worried about moving her daughter, Fabiola.

items.title: I'm Coming Out
items.description: In a UK first, teenagers Ross and Owen film themselves coming out to their parents.

items.title: Lost in Florence
items.description: A heart-broken ex-college football star gets deeply involved with a dangerous Florentine sport and an alluring local woman.

items.title: The Class
items.description: Six high school students are forced to show up on a Saturday to retake an exam in this modern re-imagining of The Breakfast Club.

items.title: Some Like It Rare
items.description: When a struggling butcher accidentally kills a vegan activist vandalizing his store, he uses his skills to dispose of the body... to the delight of his clueless customers.

items.title: The Kill Room
items.description: A hitman, his boss, an art dealer and a money-laundering scheme that accidentally turns the assassin into an overnight avant-garde sensation, one that forces her to play the art world against the underworld.

items.title: Get Away If You Can
items.description: A married couple sailing the open ocean hit a breaking point when they come across a dangerous deserted island where they are forced to make drastic decisions to survive.

items.title: El señor de la guerra
items.description: Nicolas Cage, ganador de un Oscar®, protagoniza esta historia tensa y llena de acción sobre un famoso traficante de armas que vendió armas a dictadores y consiguió eludir la ley durante casi veinte años.

items.title: The Reality of Love
items.description: The manager of sinking idol Ryan Banks attempts to revive his career by making him the star of a reality show where contestants get the chance to be his bride. Starring Jason Priestley ('Beverly Hills, 90210') and Bradley Cooper (A Star Is Born).

items.title: In the Line of Duty: A Cop for the Kiling
items.description: A look at the dangerous and bizarre life of an undercover cop who lives on the edge and the strife and heartbreak that comes with the job.

items.title: In the Line of Duty: Ambush in Waco
items.description: Religious fanatics are barricaded in a building, and surrounded by police. But they're not going to surrender, they prefer to die.

items.title: Alchemy
items.description: A battle between a computer program and a flesh-and-blood man for the ultimate reward: the love of a woman.

items.title: In the Line of Duty: Blaze of Glory
items.description: Former marine and cop Jeff Erickson starts a new life after meeting his dream girl, Jill, running a bookshop, until they decide to become the modern Bonnie and Clyde.

items.title: In the Line of Duty: Hunt for Justice
items.description: When a state trooper is gunned down on a New Jersey highway, his friend and colleague sets out to track down the killers.

items.title: In the Line of Duty: Manhunt in the Dakotas
items.description: Gordon Kahl is man who feels that the U.S. government doesn't care about the American farmer, so he retaliates by not paying taxes.

items.title: Bandidos
items.description: ¡Prepárate para una comedia de acción de lo más divertida con Bruce Willis, Billy Bob Thornton y Cate Blanchett! Joe (Willis) y Terry (Thornton), dos convictos, arman un plan para robar un banco… hasta que se topan con una ama de casa bastante excéntrica.

items.title: Marshall
items.description: About a young Thurgood Marshall, the first African-American Supreme Court Justice, as he battles through one of his career-defining cases.

items.title: Shootfighter II
items.description: Seeking vengeance for his son's death, a police chief recruits the world's finest fighters to smash an illegal combat ring in the Miami underworld.

items.title: In the Line of Duty: Smoke Jumpers
items.description: An elite group of firefighters jumps from helicopters to extinguish fires. One firefighter must choose between his love for his family and his addiction to life-risking danger. Inspired by a true story.

items.title: Streets of Blood
items.description: While investigating the 'accidental' death of his partner, a New Orleans police officer plunges into the city's criminal underworld. Starring Val Kilmer and 50 Cent.

items.title: In the Line of Duty: Siege at Marion
items.description: F.B.I. agent Bob Bryant is charged with an operation to arrest Adam Swapp and his brother Jonathan, suspects in the bombing of a Mormon Center in Utah.

items.title: In the Line of Duty: Street War
items.description: A cop's partner is killed, now he wants revenge.

items.title: In the Line of Duty: The Price of Vengeance
items.description: A detective is assassinated by a black gang. Now his friend is trying to find the killer.

items.title: Maleika
items.description: Maleika, a cheetah mother and her six cubs, share their lives with director Matto Barfuss.

items.title: Chernobyl Disaster
items.description: The Chernobyl disaster was a nuclear accident that occurred on Saturday 26 April 1986, at the Number 4 reactor in the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant. This documentary examines the history and damage of the Chernobyl Disaster.

items.title: Creed
items.description: Adonis Johnson (Michael B Jordan) never knew his father, heavyweight champion Apollo Creed, who died before he was born. But, with boxing in his blood, he heads to Philadelphia to convince the retired Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) to train him.

items.title: Survivor (2015)
items.description: A Foreign Service Officer in London tries to prevent a terrorist attack set to hit New York City but is forced to go on the run when she is framed for crimes she did not commit. Starring Milla Jovovich and Pierce Brosnan.

items.title: Mom And Dad

items.description: Armin van Buuren's closing show of his Intenz World tour.

items.title: Bruce Springsteen: Live
items.description: A critical analysis of the music of Bruce Springsteen.

items.title: Atomic Rooster: Ultimate
items.description: An in-depth review of the music of Atomic Rooster.

items.title: Amsterdam Music Fest
items.description: Experience AMF as it hosts a festival of world-class artists and the best party culture you’ll ever experience.

items.title: Afrojack & Friends
items.description: A recap of a very special night in Ahoy Rotterdam in celebration of Afrojack's 10 years of music.

items.title: Creeping Death
items.description: After a prank goes terribly wrong, Tim and his friends are hunted down by the Aos Si - a Celtic entity that walks the Earth on Halloween. They have until midnight to make things right… or die trying.

items.title: Aerosmith: In Performance
items.description: Featuring extensive archive interviews, classic live footage this unique in-depth review of the band and its music provides a fascinating insight into what it took to make Aerosmith into rock legends.

items.title: Hannibal Hopkins & Sir Anthony
items.description: This captivating documentary tells the lesser-known story of a well-known actor: two-time Academy Award winner Anthony Hopkins, whose career has spanned more than 60 years and 300 movies.

items.title: Twist, locura de juventud
items.description: Judy va a bailar con su tía Rita al lugar de moda, Enrique's, que pertenece al cantante y estudiante universitario Enrique. Al llegar la Liga de la Salud Espiritual, todos huyen del lugar.

items.title: Aerosmith: Live on Air
items.description: Aerosmith live on stage with all their hits.

items.title: Aerosmith: Masterpieces
items.description: An in-depth review of the music of this great American band.

items.title: The Adventures of Maid Marian
items.description: After three years of hiding in a remote priory, news reaches Marian that King Richard the Lionheart is dead. Her lover Robin Hood is returning from the wars. Leaving her sanctuary she hurries to meet him but they discover all is not as it seems.

items.title: Timecrafters: The Treasure of Pirate's Cove
items.description: While searching for lost treasure, time traveling pirates end up in the modern day and do battle with unlikely foes: a group of kids with the latest in techy gadgetry.

items.title: Useless Humans
items.description: A thirtieth birthday and the survival of mankind are left hanging in the balance after a mysterious creature crashes a party, forcing four childhood friends to save the night.

items.title: The Samuel Project
items.description: Eli, an outcast teen, connects with his isolated grandfather Samuel for the first time, and uncovers his surprising past, when he makes his grandpa the subject of an animated art project for school.

items.title: The Wrong Woman
items.description: Ellen Plainview, a sweet, caring, working wife and mother, learns that she is under arrest for attempted murder.

items.title: Undercover Grandpa
items.description: When the girl he likes goes missing, Jake enlists the help of his Grandpa, as well as Grandpa's former special ops buddies.

items.title: Who Made the Potatoe Salad?
items.description: Amidst a lively family gathering, Aunt Mabel's coveted potato salad goes missing. A comical investigation unfolds, revealing eccentric relatives and their quirky attempts at replicating the prized recipe.

items.title: Wish You Were Here
items.description: In a staid English seaside town after the Second World War, young Lynda grows up with her widowed father and younger sister. She eventually becomes pregnant by an acquaintance of her father.

items.title: A Merry Royal Christmas
items.description: A high-powered wedding planner is pulled in at the last minute to plan a royal wedding set for Christmas Day. She meets a handsome and alluring stranger, who she is shocked to later discover is the prince whose wedding she is planning.

items.title: Asesinato en el  Expreso de Oriente
items.description: El famoso detective Hércules Poirot está en el expreso de oriente, pero el tren queda atrapado en la nieve. Cuando se descubre que uno de los pasajeros ha sido asesinado, Poirot comienza a investigar inmediatamente.

items.title: Mid-Century
items.description: Academy Award Nominee Bruce Dern and Stephen Lang star in this horror tale about a couple renting a vacation home who meet the spirits of the architect and his two wives—plus their deranged, living son.

items.title: Snowy with a Chance of Christmas
items.description: A weatherwoman is tasked with saving her local TV station. But when she partners with a toy drive run by a single father who only cares to give back and not give in to the holiday spirit, she finds her heart is something she can't predict.

items.title: Vanquish
items.description: When her daughter is kidnapped, a former drug courier is forced by an ex-cop to take out a series of gangsters. This stylish action-thriller stars Morgan Freeman and Ruby Rose.

items.title: Zeros And Ones
items.description: Ethan Hawke and Abel Ferrara join forces for this gritty, tense political thriller set in one deadly night in Rome as a soldier (Hawke) races to stop an imminent terrorist bombing.

items.title: A Sprinkle of Christmas
items.description: Libby, a baker, has opened up her business just in time for the Christmas season. She finds herself in a heated online feud with Peter after he gives the bakery a scathing review.

items.title: Walking With Herb
items.description: A former amateur golfer embarks on a spiritual journey along with God's personal messenger Herb to face his fears, have confidence in his abilities, and commit to God before he can succeed.

items.title: God's Not Dead: A Light in Darkness
items.description: Now the late 2010s, an aging Reverend Dave faces cultural and social backlash, including having his church burned down during a protest, and he is antagonized by atheists, leftists, liberal college students, the school board, and rioters.

items.title: Perdiendo a mi hijo
items.description: "Jessica Lange interpreta a una madre adoptiva que da a un niño abandonado una nueva oportunidad en la vida. Halle Berry es la madre biológica que limpia su vida y se dispone a reclamar al niño."

items.title: All About the Money
items.description: Two down on their luck buddies are convinced by a third to take a vacation to Colombia. Only after landing in the third world country do they realize that they are there to attempt to capture the United States most wanted criminal.

items.title: Aurora: A Love Story
items.description: Kenny and Giselle are set to marry on a beach in Puerto Rico. When Giselle disappears on the day of the ceremony it sets off a crazy chain of events unearthing secrets, lies and betrayal that threatens to destroy the fairytale love story.

items.title: The Reason
items.description: The film, based on the William Sirls book, follows a small-town pastor, his wife and their sick child as a mysterious man is sent to give them hope.

items.title: God's Not Dead: We The People
items.description: Reverend Dave defending himself and a group of Christian homeschooling families after the inspection by the local government official.

items.title: Samson
items.description: Out of the pages of ancient scripture arises the first superhero saga - that of a child born with supernatural strength in 1200 BC who, as an adult, leads his oppressed tribe against the mighty empire of his day.

items.title: Love Gets a Room
items.description: In 1942 Nazi-occupied Poland, a Jewish actress faces heartrending choice: love or flee ghetto? Real-time narrative akin to "Buried," the film depicts romance and survival amid dire circumstances.

items.title: The Commitments
items.description: Jimmy Rabbitte, an unemployed Dublin boy, decides to put together a soul band made up entirely of the Irish working class.

items.title: I'm Not Ashamed
items.description: On April 20th, 1999 at Columbine High School, America changed. Two teenage boys entered the school with guns and homemade bombs with a plan to kill hundreds of their classmates. I'm not ashamed is Rachel's story in her own words.

items.title: A Single Man
items.description: A day in the life of a college professor; recently widowed after a sixteen-year marriage.

items.title: Beast (2018)
items.description: A troubled woman living in an isolated community finds herself pulled between the control of her oppressive family and the allure of a secretive outsider suspected of a series of brutal murders.

items.title: Cassandra's Dream
items.description: Two financially strapped brothers must face the moral dilemma of being paid to eliminate a family business acquaintance at the behest of their rich uncle.

items.title: The Wrong Mommy
items.description: After receiving a promotion at work, a young woman hires a personal assistant who seems perfect, but the assistant has an ulterior motive for taking the job.

items.title: Desert Fiends
items.description: Six friends on their way to a concert break down in the middle of nowhere and encounter a deranged family that lives in the desert killing anyone they come across.

items.title: Margot en la boda
items.description: En vísperas de la boda de su distanciada hermana Paulin con Malcolm, un músico desempleado, artista y depresivo, en la casa de playa familiar, Margot aparece para reavivar el vínculo con su hermana y ofrecer su propio tipo de "apoyo".

items.title: Hauntology
items.description: An older sister takes her runaway sibling on a road trip, to share the most chilling tales surrounding their hometown.

items.title: From Embers
items.description: Lily navigates a new life with her son Kevin after her husband's death. She meets Marty, an alcoholic neighbor devoted to his beloved daughter Chloe. Together, they uncover disturbing truths about Ron's death, leading to a confrontation.

items.title: Little Brother
items.description: Two brothers on a road trip across the American West must learn to transcend their differences, confront their shared family trauma, and find solace in what matters most to them--each other.

items.title: Infierno en la tormenta
items.description: Cuando un huracán arrasa en Florida, Haley sale al rescate de su padre atrapado en el sótano de su casa.

items.title: Sueños de un asesino
items.description: La vida pacífica de la familia de Claire Cooper (Annette Bening) sufre un cambio terrorífico cuando un asesino serial (Robert Downey Jr.) invade su pueblo de Nueva Inglaterra... y acosa sus sueños con pistas de sus próximos movimientos mortales.

items.title: Malas noticias para los osos
items.description: Uno de los éxitos más asombrosos del año 1976, La pandilla de pícaros, es una película en la que el entrenador de una liga menor de béisbol (Walter Matthau) intenta convertir a su equipo de niños inadaptados en campeones.

items.title: Hasta que llegó su hora
items.description: La historia épica de un misterioso desconocido con una armónica que se une a un conocido forajido para proteger a una hermosa viuda de un asesino despiadado que trabaja para el ferrocarril.

items.title: Dead Man Walking
items.description: Inspired by the true story of a nun's relationship with a condemned man, this provocative examination of crime, punishment and redemption earned Susan Sarandon the 1995 Oscar for Best Actress and Sean Penn an Oscar nomination for Best Actor.

items.title: Best Laid Plans
items.description: David Blair stages this powerful British drama, which is loosely inspired by John Steinbeck's novel Of Mice and Men.

items.title: Death Wish V: The Face Of Death
items.description: Former vigilante Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) has moved back to New York and is leading a quiet life. But when his beautiful fiancée (Lesley-Anne Down) is killed, once again upholding the law becomes his way of life...and this time it's for good!

items.title: Puedes contar conmigo
items.description: Sammy y Terry tienen un vínculo inquebrantable desde que quedaron huérfanos años atrás. Después de llevar una vida despreocupada, el caprichoso hermano vuelve a la vida de Sammy y su hijo Rudy.

items.title: El color de la venganza
items.description: Mientras que Tim soñaba con trabajar en el Departamento de Justicia, Peter aspiraba a ser un político poderoso... a cualquier precio.

items.title: Love the Beast
items.description: Eric Bana casts himself in his perfect role: exploring the meaning of a 25-year-long relationship with his first car, The Beast.

items.title: Fighting With My Family
items.description: Former wrestler Ricky and his wife Julia make a living performing with their children Saraya and Zak. When brother and sister get the chance to audition for WWE, they learn that becoming a WWE Superstar demands more than they ever imagined possible.

items.title: El vengador anónimo
items.description: En esta explosiva historia de venganza y violencia urbana, un liberal humanitario cambia de opinión después de que su esposa y su hija sufren el violento ataque de una banda de mafiosos en su departamento.

items.title: Cinema Paradiso
items.description: En esta célebre película ganadora del Óscar a Mejor Película Extranjera, un famoso cineasta italiano, atormentado por los recuerdos de su primer amor, regresa a su pueblo natal después de 30 años de ausencia.

items.title: Que linda adivina
