items.description: Cuando el carnicero Leo regresa de un viaje de pesca, no puede esperar para mostrar su "presa": su bella esposa, una clarividente llamada Marina. Pronto se entera de una psíquica que transforma a los curtidos habitantes de la ciudad en niños enamorados.

items.title: Five Guns To Tombstone
items.description: A reformed outlaw is living a clean life until his no-good brother who just escaped from prison ropes him into pulling a robbery. Now Billy has his own plan...to prevent it. And all he needs is his six shooters and a little luck.

items.title: The Hound Of The Baskervilles (1959)
items.description: A hellish hound feeds upon the flesh of the heirs of Baskerville Hall. But before this beast can sink its teeth into the newest lord, it must pit its vicious fangs against the searing intellect of Sherlock Holmes (Peter Cushing) and Dr. Watson.

items.title: Memorial Day
items.description: Matt Walker is an attorney and a Vietnam veteran. He attends a reunion with three of his war buddies, but soon after, one of the men kills himself and leaves a note asking Matt to contact his estranged son in Texas.

items.title: Viernes 13 parte VI: Jason vive
items.description: De niño, Tommy Jarvis hizo algo que muchos murieron intentando hacer: mató a Jason Vorhees, el asesino que aterrorizó a Crystal Lake. Ahora, años después, Tommy está atormentado por el temor de que Jason siga vivo.

items.title: Her Smell
items.description: A self-destructive punk rocker struggles with sobriety while trying to recapture the creative inspiration that led her band to success.

items.title: Wreckers
items.description: David and Dawn move back to his childhood village to start a family but a surprise visit from Nick, David's brother ignites sibling rivalry and exposes the lies embedded in the couple's relationship.

items.title: The Man Who Sold His Skin
items.description: A man gets his back tattooed for his Visa and to get the girl.

items.title: Red Riding 1974
items.description: Rookie journalist Eddie Dunford is determined to find the truth in an increasingly complex maze of lies and deceit surrounding the police investigation into a series of child abductions.

items.title: Red Riding 1980
items.description: The Home Office bring in senior Manchester detective Peter Hunter to conduct a secret review of the Ripper investigation to date.

items.title: Red Riding 1983
items.description: When another child goes missing, washed-up solicitor John Piggott unwittingly provides a catalyst for Detective Chief Superintendent Maurice Jobson to start to right some wrongs.

items.title: Sleepaway Camp
items.description: After a terrible boating accident killed her family, shy Angela Baker is sent to Camp Arawak. Shortly after her arrival a series of bizarre and violent "accidents" begin to claim the lives of various campers.

items.title: The Beastmaster
items.description: A sword-and-sorcery fantasy about a young man's search for revenge. Armed with supernatural powers, the handsome hero and his animal allies wage war against marauding forces.

items.title: The Couch Trip
items.description: When asylum inmate John Burns (Dan Ackroyd) intercepts a call and impersonates his doctor, he agrees to be the host of a radio advice show and is soon spreading his offbeat psychobabble to ultra-trendy Angelenos in this outrageous comedy!

items.title: Temple de acero
items.description: Una obstinada joven (Kim Darby) contrata al cascarrabias Rooster para buscar al hombre que asesinó a su padre y huyó con los ahorros familiares.

items.title: To Live And Die In L.A.
items.description: Federal agent Richard Chance has a score to settle, and he's through playing by the rules. He vows to take down a murderous counterfeiter by any means necessary. But as the stakes grow higher, will Chance's obsession ultimately destroy him?

items.title: Bleach: Fade to Black
items.description: Ichigo must fight a lonely battle to save Rukia before the two are forced to part ways forever!

items.title: Trapeze
items.description: Aerialist Burt Lancaster--who retired after suffering an injury--agrees to train aspiring trapeze artist Tony Curtis. But when both men fall in love with the beautiful and ambitious Gina Lollobrigida, the triangle threaten the dreams of them all.

items.title: Bleach: Memories of Nobody
items.description: Ichigo and his fellow Soul Reapers must save two worlds from annihilation.

items.title: Bleach: The DiamondDust Rebellion
items.description: After the treasured Ouin is stolen, Toshiro Hitsugaya disappears and becomes suspected of treason.

items.title: Trouble With Sex
items.description: After an emotional break-up, Michelle stumbles across bar tender, Conor. This is the tale of a blossoming relationship, and how sex can lead to feelings…

items.title: Un disparo en la sombra
items.description: Al torpe inspector Clouseau (Peter Sellers) se le asigna un importante caso, pero se enamora de la principal sospechosa (Elke Sommer), aumentan los cadáveres y Clouseau debe darse prisa por encontrar al verdadero culpable o su carrera acabará.

items.title: Catherine Cookson's The Fifteen Streets
items.description: In this romantic drama starring Sean Bean, Owen Teale and Clare Holman, a rugged laborer and the daughter of a wealthy shipbuilder struggle to find love across class divides in northern England at the turn of the 20th century.

items.title: Dusk for a Hitman
items.description: A hitman faces a hard order: eliminate his family for the mob boss. Detectives offer him a way out by making him their informant, a dangerous act between loyalty and survival.

items.title: El vengador anónimo 2
items.description: Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) no es una víctima: su arma es la venganza. Después de empezar una nueva vida en Los Ángeles, agreden sexualmente y matan a su hija. No descansará hasta encontrar a los agresores... y enterrarlos a todos.

items.title: Cold Pursuit
items.description: Liam Neeson returns to form in a new darkly comedic thrill ride. (ABC-TV)

items.title: El sol tambíen es una estrella
items.description: Sumergirse en este romance épico sobre dos adolescentes que se conocen y se enamoran en un día fatídico en medio del fervor de la ciudad de Nueva York.

items.title: A Song for Christmas
items.description: Two single parents discover the possibility of love for Christmas but learn soon after that their daughters are embroiled in a nasty rivalry at school.

items.title: Cracker: Lucky White Ghost
items.description: In this explosive two-hour special, Fitz (Robbie Coltrane) is asked by local police to help investigate the murder of a Chinese businessman while in Hong Kong on a lecture tour.

items.title: Justicia roja
items.description: Un estadounidense (Richard Gere) está en China por un viaje de negocios. Le acusan de un brutal asesinato y se encuentra a merced de un sistema judicial extranjero que no entiende. ¿Encontrará al verdadero asesino antes de que sea demasiado tarde?

items.title: F/X: Efectos mortales
items.description: Rollie Tyler, un técnico de efectos especiales, acepta 30.000 dólares del Programa de Protección de Testigos para escenificar el falso asesinato de un miembro de la mafia que está dispuesto a dar nombres.

items.title: Pánico en la calle 110
items.description: Cuando los gánsteres de Harlem se meten con la mafia, las balas comienzan a volar, los policías comienzan a morir y, una improbable pareja de los mejores policías de Nueva York, deben trabajar juntos para llevar justicia a las calles.

items.title: City Island
items.description: Meet the Rizzos, a fuedel family in the throws of battle as their bizarre and layered lies unravel. A star-studded cast including Andy Garcia, Julianna Margulies, Alan Arkin, and Emily Mortimer create a perfect storm of deception.

items.title: The Doorman (2020)
items.description: A former Marine turned doorman (Ruby Rose, JOHN WICK: CHAPTER 2) must call upon all her lethal fighting skills to protect her sister’s family and stop a group of vicious art thieves at a New York City high-rise.

items.title: High School
items.description: When the principal (Michael Chiklis) institutes a mandatory drug test the day after he gets high for the first time, the soon-to-be class valedictorian devises a plan to get the whole school stoned.

items.title: El lobo de snow hollow
items.description: El sheriff de un pueblo pequeño y su apático equipo de oficiales deben resolver una serie de asesinatos que ocurren en la luna llena. Mientras es consumido por la búsqueda del asesino, lucha por recordarse a sí mismo que los hombres lobo no existen...

items.title: Undertow, un legado de violencia
items.description: Ambientada en una zona sureña por la que no pasa el tiempo, Undertow es un thriller sobre dos hermanos que se escapan de casa con un secreto tras la muerte de su padre (Dermot Mulroney) y la llegada de su codicioso y atormentado tío (Josh Lucas).

items.title: El caso de Thomas Crown
items.description: Steve McQueen interpreta a un sofisticado, pero aburrido magnate, que lleva a cabo un espectacular atraco a un banco y Faye Dunaway es la elegante investigadora de seguros que lo atrapa del corazón.

items.title: Resultado final
items.description: Después de que terroristas mortales secuestran a su sobrina en un partido de fútbol, un ex soldado con habilidades de combate letales (Dave Bautista) libra una guerra de un solo hombre para salvarla y evitar la destrucción masiva.

items.title: The Tournament
items.description: A 24 hour kill or die tournament is held in an English town. The winner will claim a $10,000,000 cash prize.

items.title: The Silencing
items.description: A reformed hunter (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) and a sheriff (Annabelle Wallis) are caught in a deadly game of cat and mouse when they set out to track a killer who may have kidnapped the hunter’s daughter five years ago.

items.title: Solo Dios perdona
items.description: Only God Forgives reúne la visión del célebre director Nicolas Winding Refn (DRIVE) con Ryan Gosling en un thriller de suspenso ambientado en los sórdidos bajos fondos de Bangkok.

items.title: Destrucción
items.description: Una detective de policía reconecta con gente relacionada con una misión encubierta de hace años para encontrar paz.

items.title: Silent Grace
items.description: Based on true events, this is the story of a young girl who is caught joyriding and ends up sharing a prison cell with a political prisoner: a high ranking IRA woman.

items.title: Goon: The Last Of The Enforcers
items.description: Billy Shiner Simpson is a man who has spent much of his life making a living by skirting the law, but he thinks he may finally have a legitimate path to the big time managing his son Eddie, an up-and-coming boxer nicknamed Golden Boy.

items.title: Jungle (2017)
items.description: A group of friends trek into the Amazon jungle with a guide who has a mysterious past. Their journey quickly turns into a terrifying ordeal as the deadliest threats of the wilderness lead to an all-out fight for survival.

items.title: Popcorn
items.description: Too insecure to approach the girl of his dreams, Danny takes a job at the local multiplex where she works.

items.title: Stylebender
items.description: An intimate exploration of a bullied outsider's battle to the top of the UFC, revealing Israel Adesanya's brutal, beautiful struggle to become the global phenomenon known as 'The Last Stylebender.'

items.title: Deathwatch
items.description: In the middle of World War I, nine British soldiers caught behind enemy lines seek refuge in a complex network of German trenches. What they soon discover is that they aren't alone - and it isn't a German soldier that's hunting them down.

items.title: My Old Friend: Paul McCartney & Carl Perkins
items.description: Paul McCartney was trying to cope with John Lennon’s recent death the only way he knew how: by making another album.

items.title: Widow on the Hill
items.description: When a wealthy man shockingly dies, his daughter grows suspicious of his young, sexy wife. Emmy winner James Brolin and Natasha Henstridge star in this thrilling murder mystery.

items.title: La leyenda del Chupacabras
items.description: Siguiendo la tradición aterradora y divertida de SCOOBY DOO y GOOSEBUMPS, llega esta aventura animada sobre un niño heroico y algunos amigos mágicos que descubren el misterio de un monstruo legendario.

items.title: Clean
items.description: A fly-on-the-wall insight into the world of trauma cleaning through the journey of charming transgender business owner Sandra Pankhurst and the lives of a motley crew of workers at Frankston's Specialised Trauma Cleaning Services (STC).

items.title: A Question of Faith
items.description: When tragedy strikes three families, their destiny forces them on a converging path to discover God's love, grace, and mercy as the challenges of their fate could also resurrect their beliefs.

items.title: God's Not Dead
items.description: A Christian college student's faith and reputation is challenged by his atheist philosophy professor who is insistent that God is dead.

items.title: Sounds of The Streets
items.description: Fentanyl is claiming lives at an alarming rate. Trevor and Richard, the city's top detectives, are determined to track down the distributor.

items.title: La Trampa
items.description: El ganador del Oscar, Adrien Brody, Antonio Banderas y John Malkovich protagonizan esta atrapante y explosiva historia policial sobre tres criminales atrapados en un depósito tras un asalto.

items.title: La hora de tu muerte
items.description: Las superestrellas de la WWE Dolph Ziggler y Kane protagonizan esta emocionante película de suspenso y acción sobre un policía que compite contra el tiempo para detener a un terrorista loco y salvar a un niño.

items.title: El abogado del mal
items.description: Jamie Foxx presenta la inspiradora historia real del director de una banda de música de instituto que transformó a su variopinta banda de jazz en un legendario grupo de funk que arrasó en todo el país.

items.title: Jessabelle
items.description: Una chica se enfrenta cara a cara con un espíritu que, después de mucho tiempo de tormento, ha estado buscando su regreso.

items.title: Queens of Pain
items.description: Three women — Suzy Hotrod, Evilicious, and Captain Smack Sparrow — struggle to balance life in New York City with the dedication needed to maintain their spots on the world's best roller derby team.

items.title: End Game
items.description: A secret service agent (Cuba Gooding Jr.) and a news reporter (Angie Harmon) investigate the conspiracy behind the assassination of the president of the United States.

items.title: Rage
items.description: After a violent home invasion leaves him in a coma and his wife deeply traumatized, a mild-mannered husband awakens to find out that one of the attackers is still on the loose.

items.title: When We Speak
items.description: British intelligence employee Katharine Gun, Oxfam aid worker Helen Evans and Hollywood actress Rose McGowen open the lid on what happens to women when speaking out against wrongdoing in When We Speak.

items.title: Do You Believe?
items.description: Do You Believe? Follows the deeply personal journey of a handful of characters in interweaving stories of love and forgiveness, heartbreak and healing, and the gift of new life.

items.title: God's Not Dead 2
items.description: A high school teacher faces an epic court case with the help of a sympathetic and charismatic defense lawyer that could cost her the career she had always dreamed of - and expel God from the classroom once and for all.

items.title: Woodlawn
items.description: In 1973, a spiritual awakening captured the heart of nearly every player of the Woodlawn High School football team.

items.title: Manhattan en la oscuridad
items.description: Cuando una viuda seductora le pide a un periodista que resuelva la misteriosa muerte de su marido, la investigación lo sumerge en un peligroso mundo de adulterio, chantaje y asesinato.

items.title: Blaze
items.description: Struggling to make sense of what she saw, Blaze unleashes the wrath of her imaginary dragon.

items.title: Free Angela and All Political Prisoners
items.description: The dramatic true story of college professor Angela Davis and how her social activism implicated her in a botched kidnapping attempt, landing her on the FBI’s Ten Most Wanted list.

items.title: The Accursed
items.description: Decades after a betrayal leads to a curse being placed on a family bloodline, a wedding reunites the estranged clan. When a dark force starts to pick them off one by one, the matriarch must protect the family.

items.title: Chitty Chitty Bang Bang
items.description: Dick Van Dyke interpreta a un excéntrico inventor que crea un extraordinario coche que conduce por tierra, mar y aire, y que le lleva con sus hijos y su novia (Sally Ann Howes) a un mundo mágico de aventuras sin fin. ¡Un clásico para la familia!

items.title: Between Me and My Mind
items.description: Driven by a constant need to create, Phish frontman Trey Anastasio takes on new projects, including some of his most personal music to date as well as Phish's ambitious New Year's Eve show at Madison Square Garden.

items.title: The Swearing Jar
items.description: Equal parts humor and heartbreak, two love stories exploring the challenges of marriage, parenting, loss, and moving on.

items.title: Where Are You
items.description: A grieving photographer searches for his missing girlfriend through the eyes of his subconscious.

items.title: One of These Days
items.description: In a small southern US town, the annual 'Hands On' endurance contest offers the chance of a lifetime to win a brand new pickup truck. Each contestant has their own reasons for entering, but the true cost of the competition is higher than it appears.

items.title: Our Friend
items.description: After receiving life-altering news, a couple finds unexpected support from their best friend, who puts his own life on hold and moves into their family home, bringing an impact much greater and more profound than anyone could have imagined.

items.title: I'll Find You
items.description: When two young lovers, ROBERT, a tenor and RACHEL, a violin virtuoso get torn apart by the outbreak of WWII, Robert vows to find Rachel, no matter what.

items.title: Vivarium
items.description: A couple’s search for a dream home plunges them into a terrifying nightmare after they are trapped in a mysterious, labyrinth-like neighborhood of identical houses.

items.title: All Gone Wrong
items.description: After his rookie partner is killed in a drug bust gone wrong, a veteran agent embarks on an unauthorized investigation, revealing a vast narcotics network just under the surface of a rural town.

items.title: Mouse of Horrors
items.description: In a quiet seaside town, a sinister doctor creates a monstrous creature causing terror among the locals.

items.title: Bloody Hell
items.description: A man with a mysterious past flees the country to escape his own personal hell... only to arrive somewhere much, much, much worse. In an effort to survive this new horror, he turns to his personified Conscience.

items.title: Limbo
items.description: Jaded detective, Travis Hurley (Simon Baker), investigates a 20-year old outback cold case murder.

items.title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead (2024)
items.description: Tanya finds her summer plans canceled when her mom jets off for a last-minute retreat, and the elderly babysitter who arrives at her door unexpectedly passes away.

items.title: Something Like a Business
items.description: An aspiring pimp struggles to make a mint after inheriting his late uncles escort service and discovering that competition on the streets is fierce.

items.title: Stock Option
items.description: When a homeless ex-stock broker rescues a famous model from a robbery attempt, she takes him home as an act of gratitude.

items.title: Tijuana Jackson: Purpose Over Prison
items.description: An ex-convict on parole is set on becoming a world-renowned motivational speaker.

items.title: It's So Easy and Other Lies
items.description: The life story of Guns N' Roses bass player, Duff McKagan. How he struggled with alcohol and drug addiction, and overcame it. Talks about the real challenges in everyday life, his childhood, and how the band made it big.

items.title: Krispr
items.description: A family's holiday turns deadly when a genetically enhanced clone exposes their darkest secrets'and seeks revenge.

items.title: Sex-Positive
items.description: Virginia tumbles into a wild and thrilling new world of sexual liberation when she moves in with a group of polyamorous party animals, including the charming but commitment-phobic Jake.

items.title: Nación Prozac
items.description: Una joven y talentosa escritora lucha contra el comportamiento autodestructivo y la depresión paralizante durante su primer año en Harvard. Con un elenco de estrellas que incluye a Christina Ricci, Anne Heche y Michelle Williams.

items.title: Purasangre
items.description: Purasangre narra la historia de cómo un equipo de cinco profesionales se ve obligado a robar un famoso hipódromo y casino.

items.title: Marijuana Minutes
items.description: Amy is a slacker who just wants to hang out and get high. But one day her laid-back lifestyle is thrown for a loop -- a time loop, that is. She's given a vape pen that does more than get her high: It can reverse time!

items.title: Piglet
items.description: On Kate's 21st birthday camping trip, her friends encounter Piglet, a monstrous human-pig hybrid beast. They uncover Piglet's origins, and Kate must confront her past to survive the relentless killer.

items.title: What Remains
items.description: A small town pastor reckons with an act of forgiveness while sheriff investigates a murder that may be related.

items.title: Private Peaceful
items.description: Set in WW1, two brothers fall for the same girl while contending with the pressures of their feudal family life, the war, and the price of courage and cowardice.

items.title: Employee of the Month
items.description: Fired from his job and dumped by his fiancee, banker David Walsh turns to his best friend, an inept con artist, for support. Soon, heartbreak becomes the least of David's worries. Starring Matt Dillon, Steve Zahn and Christina Applegate.

items.title: The Manson Brothers Midnight Zombie Massacre
items.description: After being relegated, the two fighting brothers signed up for a new game. But they didn't know that they need to stay in an arena to fight zombies.

items.title: Shadow Fighter
items.description: Reggie, an inner-city teen struggling with the murder of his brother and the drug dealers who pulled the trigger, forms an unexpected bond with a homeless ex-boxer, 'Lightning' Rhodes.

items.title: Hope Lives
items.description: An inspiring drama that shows the triumphs and pains of a group of high school students who are victims of bullying, and how one man can make a difference.

items.title: Steve Jobs: The Man In The Machine
items.description: Academy Award-winning director Alex Gibney pulls no punches in his portrait of Apple founder Steve Jobs and his legacy. This probing look at the life and aftermath of this iconoclast explores what accounted for the grief of so many when he died.

items.title: Marionette
items.description: A grieving psychiatrist moves to Scotland for a fresh start but discovers her young patient's eerie drawings predict real disasters. As secrets unravel, she must uncover the truth before tragedy strikes again.

items.title: Kinda Married Like
items.description: Makayla and Devon appear to have the perfect life, until they encounter the notorious 7-Year Itch. As Makayla devises and begins a plan to explore new horizons, Devon reluctantly agrees -- only for it all to go haywire!

items.title: Reboot Camp
items.description: Seymour and Danny team up to document how easy it is to start a fake self-help group and con people. But the Reboot Camp takes on a life of its own and grows into a full-blown cult.

items.title: Mass Hysteria
items.description: When a tourist dies on Halloween Night in Salem, the crowd seeks juastice by mounting a modern day witch hunt. Our wrongly accused heroes, a troupe of Witch Trial reenactors, flee as another tourist dies, then another... making it clear this is much more

items.title: Motherly
items.description: When a vengeful couple invades her home, a single mother is forced to do whatever it takes to defend her daughter.

items.title: Paper Spiders
items.description: A high school senior's life turns upside down as her mother's paranoid delusions spiral out of control. A bittersweet story about coming of age in the shadow of mental illness.

items.title: Voyeur
items.description: In her first term at an Ivy League drama school, sweet and na've freshman, Ella, finds herself in a battle with a popular upperclassman, Maxine, to win a starring role.

items.title: Some Nudity Required
items.description: An aspiring actress dreams of stardom, but flounders between her integrity and getting nude in movies. As she attempts to navigate this, she is hilariously misguided by two friends who are always willing to get naked!

items.title: Three Day Millionaire
items.description: A rollicking black comedy straight from the rain-soaked British fish docks of Grimsby, which follows a thrill-seeking young fisherman and his pals looking to party hard for three days straight before all goes wrong.

items.title: The Wiggles - Top of the Tots
items.description: It's a Wiggly countdown to fun! In "Top of The Tots," The Wiggles have invited all of their friends to help them sing about being a conductor, a doctor, a dentist, a baker and a pilot!

items.title: Obstacle Corpse
items.description: Obstacle Corpse is the tale of lovably cranky teen Sunny and her quest to prove her mettle to her dad (and, ultimately, herself) in an obstacle course race that goes totally f*cking insane. Like, The Warriors meets Saw.

items.title: Tumbledown
items.description: When a music scholar (Jason Sudeikis) and the protective widow (Rebecca Hall) of an acclaimed singer collaborate on a book, their stormy partnership blossoms into an unexpected connection.

items.title: The Dare
items.description: Four sinners are forced together to relive a childhood prank that has resulted in them fighting for their lives at the hand of a masked psychopath.

items.title: Two Heads Creek
items.description: A timid butcher and his drama-queen twin sister adventure to Australia in search of their birth mother. But the seemingly tolerant folk of their hometown are hiding a dark, meaty secret.

items.title: The O'Briens
items.description: Two years after the death of his wife, a father summons home his children, causing all to fear the worst, but he is not the only one with a secret...

items.title: Unfinished
items.description: A year after her dad's death, Zora Matthews moves into his house to complete his unfinished novel and try to stop the grisly nightmares that have been plaguing her.

items.title: Baking Up Love
items.description: Morton Pumpkin Co.'s CEO marks the town's 200th anniversary with a bake-off. The favorite to win, the town sweetheart, faces a challenge when her niece stays over, making victory seem elusive.

items.title: Cats of Malta
items.description: Experience the colorful cats of Malta as you journey through cat colonies, meeting locals and artists who embrace and look after the huge population of stray cats in this Mediterranean Island.

items.title: Juan pistolas
items.description: La última película de Javier Solís. Juan Pistolas ofrece su vida y dinero para comprar armas y ayudar a la Revolución.

items.title: La isla de los dinosaurios
items.description: En el intento por demostrar que la Atlántida aún existe, un profesor y sus alumnos se aventuran en un viaje que los llevará a un lugar detenido en el tiempo.

items.title: Zombies
items.description: In this fantastical horror film, a widow (Lori Heuring) and her two daughters (Scout Taylor-Compton, Chloë Grace Moretz) inherit a remote house where zombie children roam the woods.

items.title: Buff In Vietnam
items.description: A bomber built to obliterate Moscow is sent to destroy Viet Cong sanctuaries. With the B-52, the U.S. hopes to win in Southeast Asia with superior firepower.

items.title: Camino de Guanajuato (LAS)
items.description: En el concurso radiofónico 'Amor en la Onda', dos jóvenes amigos comparten sus sentimientos por una chica, lo que desencadena una complicada red de emociones y relaciones personales que pondrán a prueba su amistad y amor.

items.title: Nico
items.description: A veteran detective risks his life and career to investigate the brutal murder of a teenage boy from his past. The investigation leads the detective down a winding path of twists and turns, only for him to discover a disturbing truth.

items.title: Lady Jane
items.description: Based on the true story of the girl who found herself Queen of England for nine days at age 16, Lady Jane is a historical romance at its bittersweet best.

items.title: Bleach: Hellverse
items.description: Ichigo must travel into the depths of Hell to save his younger sister Yuzu.

items.title: Cherry
items.description: When 25 years-old rollerskater Cherry (Alex Trewhitt) discovers that she is ten weeks pregnant, she embarks on a journey across Los Angeles to make a decision she never imagined she would have to.

items.title: Arrivederci, Baby!
items.description: A con man who marries and murders rich women meets a con lady with similar intentions.

items.title: The Devil's Left Hand
items.description: During a Séance at a housewarming party, a Demonic entity comes through the Medium, wreaking havoc and terrifying the partygoers. The Demon then begins stalking and killing them, one by one.

items.title: Stockholm
items.description: Una noche, un chico y una chica se encuentran y acaban acostándose juntos, pero a la mañana siguiente ninguno de ellos encuentra a su lado a la persona que creían conocer.

items.title: La mansión de las 7 momias
items.description: Después de la muerte de su padre, Sofía hereda parte de su fortuna. Sin embargo, el oro tiene una antigua maldición que cae sobre quien lo posea. Unas momias se disponen al acecho de Sofía.

items.title: Gringa
items.description: An outcast teen and a disgraced, alcoholic soccer star get a last chance to form a family when she unexpectedly reunites with him in Mexico.

items.title: Death Of The Luftwaffe
items.description: The Luftwaffe held more sway with Hitler than the Army or the Navy, yet it failed him. What caused one of the most powerful air forces in the world to come crashing down?

items.title: Return Of The Superfortress
items.description: When the B29 is set to retire after WWII, a novel plastic coating cocoons the superforts in retirement. But the fast-approaching Korean War pulls them back into action.

items.title: Cmdr. J. R. "Hotdog" Brown on the Air War in Vietnam
items.description: Navy fighter pilot 'Hot Dog' Brown discusses his training and combat missions over Vietnam.

items.title: Lt. Gen. Spence Armstrong On The Air War In Vietnam
items.description: In Vietnam, Lieutenant General Spence Armstrong pilots and leads F105's into battle as a flight commander during Operation Rolling Thunder.

items.title: Rocketmen
items.description: After WWI, restrictions placed on Germany leave the Nazis few options for military technical innovation, but they discover a loophole: the liquid-powered rocket.

items.title: Dr. Sanator: Legacy
items.description: In WWII, when the U.S. Air Force's Thunderbolt strikes down close to 4,000 enemy aircraft, the aircraft's manufacturer and chief engineer become leaders in the field.

items.title: Rainbow 5
items.description: While Britain stands alone, the U.S. government secretly prepares to battle Nazi Germany.

items.title: Die For The Emperor
items.description: During World War II, as the U.S. Navy presses westward across the Pacific, the Japanese military must resort to desperate tactics, such as the lethal Kamikaze.

items.title: Skycarriers
items.description: Since fighter planes lack enough fuel to trek deep into enemy territory, engineers found ways for fighters to bring along their supplies.

items.title: Runway Of Thunder: The Story Of Project Zelmal
items.description: In the Cold War's battle of technology, both sides work to solve complex problems. Can they master zero-length launches-and landings-to erase the need for long runways?

items.title: Race For The Superfortress
items.description: To bring the fight into the heart of Japan, the U.S. needs an aircraft with enormous range and firepower. What do engineers face while building the B-29 Superfortress?

items.title: Engines of Change
items.description: With Germany's FW 190 terrorizing the skies of Europe, Britain and America merge the P-51 Mustang and the super Merlin engine to create the ultimate fighting machine.

items.title: Hitler's Spacemen
items.description: While Hitler funds space projects for his war effort, rather than science, German space pioneer Eugen Sanger is a true believer in advancing science and space flight.

items.title: Mighty Mouse
items.description: When the Soviets clone the B-29, America worries about a nuclear strike. The U.S. turns to an equally deadly weapon: a folding fin rocket nicknamed 'Mighty Mouse.'

items.title: Bad Bunny: Global Takeover
items.description: Not many music artists can claim to be a famous pop star, professional wrestler, and activist - meet the 'King of Latin Trap,' Bad Bunny. Bad Bunny is known for bringing reggaeton music onto the global stage.

items.title: Who Killed The Neanderthal?
items.description: A team travels the world in an attempt to discover why Neanderthals vanished.

items.title: Crónica de un Cobarde
items.description: Juan, casado con María y dueño del rancho La Troja, es asaltado y rescatado por Tomás. Al regresar, descubre que su padre ha sido asesinado por un forastero. Decidido a vengarlo, sigue la pista dejada: una espuela que pertenece a Tomás.

items.title: Fear Blood & Gold
items.description: In 1846, with a $500 reward for his kill or capture for six murders, Oscar Malle escapes from the custody of a Nevada sheriff and heads west into California in search of gold with his slave, Sancho Panza.

items.title: Inmaculada
items.description: Una mujer cuya hija está a punto de lanzar su vida por el bien de un canalla. La mujer toma a su hija a un lado y le ruega que no cometa ese desastroso error. Para reforzar su argumento, nos cuenta su propia desgracia.

items.title: La Escondida (LAS)
items.description: A comienzos del siglo XX, surge una dramática historia que cuenta el amor entre una bella mujer llamada Gabriela y un hombre revolucionario. Lucharán por su amor en un escenario de violentas y apasionantes batallas.

items.title: Reba McEntire: Country Gold
items.description: It all began way back when with a sibling trio in the back seat of her family car. Almost 7 decades later, Reba McEntire, has sold 75 million records and 25 #1 hits on the Hot Country Songs Chart. All that practice has clearly paid off.

items.title: Hasta el viento tiene miedo
items.description: Tras un frustrado intento de suicidio, Claudia es internada en un singular centro de apoyo para adolescentes con problemas emocionales, regido por la inflexible psiquiatra Bernarda Alquicira.

items.title: Black Bear
items.description: A director works on her latest screenplay at a cabin in the woods, where she witnesses (and accelerates) the deterioration of a marriage.

items.title: La agonía de ser madre
items.description: Gravemente enferma, una mujer pide a Dios que le dé vida para solucionar todos los problemas que provocó el alcoholismo de su esposo y sacar a su familia adelante.

items.title: Merry Christmas, Baby
items.description: Marci throws herself into preparing for Christmas and building her new event-planning business.

items.title: Pride & Prejudice: Atlanta
items.description: All five of Reverend Bennet's daughters are still single. When the very eligible Will Darcy arrives in town, Mrs. Bennet sets her sights on the handsome bachelor for daughter Lizzie.

items.title: Saving Westbrook High
items.description: Westbrook High is closing. Can parents, teachers, and students set aside their differences to save the school?

items.title: My Dad's a Soccer Mom
items.description: Cut from his NFL football team, a man starts bonding with his young daughter and encourages her to play soccer.

items.title: My Other Mother
items.description: When gruff and independent Candy meets her angry and stubborn birth mother, can the two open their hearts to each other?

items.title: Dicen que soy Comunista
items.description: Benito es un viudo que trabaja en una humilde imprenta para mantener a su hijo. Cuando un dirigente comunista acude a su negocio y le propone unirse al partido, Benito se verá envuelto en alocados enredos.

items.title: Donde nacen los Pobres
items.description: Jesús y Blanca provienen de mundos opuestos: Jesús, un hombre humilde que ha trabajado duro para sobrevivir, y Blanca, una mujer rica a la que la desgracia la ha llevado a un lugar de vulnerabilidad, sus vidas se cruzan en un amor inesperado.

items.title: El triunfo de los campeones justicieros
items.description: Mano Negra envía un grupo de enanos a un laboratorio del gobierno para secuestrar al profesor Arego y obtener cierta fórmula, la cual descubren está dividida entre sus cuatro hijas. Una historia llena de mucha acción.

items.title: Degrassi High: School's Out
items.description: Pool parties, cottage trips, part-time jobs and making-out bring summer temperatures to a boiling point. The gang that has grown up together may not survive the summer as friends.

items.title: Carne de presidio
items.description: Pedro es declarado culpable de asesinato tras matar accidentalmente al esposo de una amiga. Mientras su familia enfrenta tiempos difíciles, él cometerá un grave error al confiar su libertad en la persona equivocada.

items.title: Love Me or Leave Me
items.description: LOVE ME OR LEAVE ME combines hilarious comedy, true-to-life drama and rousing song that underscore the play's themes of responsibility and forgiveness.

items.title: Lord All Men Can't Be Dogs
items.description: LORD, ALL MEN CAN'T BE DOGS is a riveting story of the lives of two people, Lisa and Tim Johnson, whose struggles are closely tied with the four spirits that reside in their home.

items.title: Sugar Mommas
items.description: Sisters Sheila and Lynn have little in common except their love for sweets. In need of a change, they partner with their close friend Tommi to open a bakery.

items.title: Love the One You're With
items.description: The Wright sisters have made a solemn pact never to let a man stop them from achieving their dreams, but that's easier said than done!

items.title: Marry Us For Christmas
items.description: In the sequel to the popular UP Original Movie "Marry Me For Christmas", it's a year after Marci and Blair declared their love for each other and decided to tie the knot.

items.title: Love Will Keep Us Together
items.description: It'll be a slippery slope until their big day Best friends since childhood, Tao (Reagan Gomez-Preston) and Bren (Cynthia McWilliams) are preparing to live out their dreams of an extravagant double wedding in Hawaii.

items.title: Marry Me for Christmas
items.description: To appease her family during the holidays, a single woman pretends to be engaged to her employee.

items.title: If You Really Love Me
items.description: Three sisters rely on the strength of their faith, love and family to get them through life's challenges.

items.title: White Girl
items.description: A college girl falls hard for a guy she's just met. After a night of partying goes wrong, she goes to wild extremes to get him back.

items.title: Bruised 2
items.description: After rebuilding her life and building her success, a woman must escape a stalker bent on revenge.

items.title: Forgot About Us
items.description: Married owners of a successful magazine split but agree to date others. Chaos follows as they seek love and happiness in this romantic comedy!

items.title: Dolly Parton: Big Hair, Bigger Heart
items.description: No royal beginnings for this Queen of Country Music. Known for her larger-than-life positive attitude parading big hair and bold make-up, Dolly Parton would carved out her own identity as a singer, movie actress, and entrepreneur.

items.title: Friends Like Sisters
items.description: Two women's lifelong friendship -- akin to that of sisters -- goes bad when events and betrayals impact their bond of trust. Can faith mend it?

items.title: Area Bombing
items.description: The story of the unprecedented Allied bombing campaign during WWII. At first, they target enemy manufacturers; next, the civilian populations.

items.title: Carmen and Magic
items.description: Two friends plan to disrupt their father's relationship with the school principal.

items.title: Quiet as Kept
items.description: Jay and his business partners work to exist in the dangerous drug underworld cleanly after he is unlawfully detained.

items.title: Boruto: Naruto the Movie
items.description: Sasuke appears before Naruto to warn him of impending danger. An inconceivable foe lies in wait as Sasuke, the Five Kage and Boruto, charge into another dimension!

items.title: 1 Million Followers
items.description: When Karissa, an Idaho farmgirl, is flown to a luxurious mansion in Thailand to join a host of social media influencers, she soon discovers the dark world of fame.

items.title: My Louisiana Sky
items.description: Juliette Lewis (Cape Fear) and Michael Cera (Juno) feature in this adaptation of Kimberly Willis Holt's emotional story about a twelve-year-old girl re-evaluating her relationship with her mentally disabled parents.

items.title: Road to Ninja : Naruto the Movie
items.description: Naruto and his friends succeed in driving away the infamous Akatsuki, who have mysteriously returned from the dead, but afterwards, a strange masked figure appears before him!

items.title: The Wrong Tutor
items.description: When star high school athlete Eric needs help with his school work, a woman named Emily convinces Eric's mother that she is the perfect tutor for her son, but she has other reasons that stem beyond helping him with his homework.

items.title: The Hole
items.description: A pair of brothers stumble upon a mysterious hole in their basement that leads to the darkest corridors of their fears and nightmares.

items.title: The Holiday List
items.description: A woman makes a deceptive, well-intentioned plan to bring her dysfunctional family together for Christmas.

items.title: Naruto Shippuden: The Movie
items.description: A long time ago, a powerful spirit drove the world to the brink of destruction. Naruto's latest mission is to protect Shion, a priestess from the Land of Ogres, whom the spirit is after.

items.title: The Last: Naruto the Movie
items.description: The moon approaches dangerously close! Naruto, Sakura, Shikamaru, Sai and Hinata, sets out to investigate and comes upon a certain plan and its unbelievable mastermind lying in wait.

items.title: The King Tide
items.description: After the mayor of an island village discovers a child with mysterious powers, the once peaceful community dissolves into war, over the belief that the child is the next savior.

items.title: The Monster Beneath Us
items.description: When her estranged husband suddenly dies, Grace and their son Charlie are forced to move to his country estate. As the boy spends more and more time in the basement, Grace’s concern begins to turn to fear...

items.title: Naruto Shippuden the Movie: Blood Prison
items.description: Naruto's battle to reclaim his honor begins! Naruto is convicted of a serious crime he didn't commit and is sent to the inescapable prison, Hozuki Castle.

items.title: Naruto Shippuden the Movie: Bonds
items.description: Mysterious flying ninja have launched a sudden attack against the Leaf. To save their village, Naruto and his friends set out to stop this new threat.

items.title: Naruto Shippuden the Movie: The Lost Tower
items.description: The Rogue Ninja Mukade is about to be caught by Naruto, when he summons the power of an ancient underground channel of chakra. Naruto gets caught up in the chakra and is sent back in time.

items.title: Naruto Shippuden the Movie: Will of Fire
items.description: Four Kekkei Genkai shinobi who have been guarding the Cloud, Stone, Mist and Sand disappear without a trace. At the same time, Naruto discovers that Kakashi has left the village.

items.title: The Neighbor
items.description: A middle-aged man in a stagnant marriage finds his life upended when an attractive young woman and her seemingly abusive husband move in next door.

items.title: Hashtag Blessed
items.description: It's Christmastime and Jessi is all but excited. She finds herself with comparisonitis in the world of social media. Will she continue down her dark path of negativity and struggle, or will the magic of Christmas shine?

items.title: Adam
items.description: A hard-working salesman thinks he has the perfect life, until he becomes quadriplegic after a tragic accident. With the help of a mouthy Russian nurse, he learns that life isn't over…life has just begun.

items.title: Welcome Home
items.description: A couple spend a weekend at a vacation rental home in the Italian countryside in an attempt to repair their relationship, but soon become victims of the homeowner's sinister plans.

items.title: What Lies Below
items.description: Liberty, a socially awkward 16-year-old, returns from two months at camp to a blindsided introduction of her Mother’s fiancée, John Smith, whose charm, intelligence, and beauty paint the picture of a man too perfect to be human.

items.title: Bullets of Justice
items.description: In the post-apocalyptic aftermath of World War 3, an army of half-human half-pig super-soldiers takes over the world. It is up to a group of human rebels to destroy them and liberate humankind.

items.title: Agatha Christie's Ordeal By Innocence
items.description: Back from a long trip, Dr. Calgary seeks to return an item left in his car by a young hitchhiker – Jack Argyle. Except Jack was executed for a murder, committed while in the doctor’s car. Calgary can clear Jack’s name. So...why is no one interested?

items.title: Come Early Morning
items.description: A thirty-something southern woman searches for love, despite the burdens she carries with her.

items.title: Crime Spree
items.description: A French gang of thieves flies over to Chicago for a one time job. However, things seem to get out of hand soon.

items.title: Navidad salvaje
items.description: Quizás no haya ningún animal más vinculado a la Navidad que los renos.

items.title: Gotti
items.description: John Travolta stars as the legendary mobster, John Gotti, head of the largest and most powerful crime organization in North America, the Gambino Family. His flamboyant style, charm and ruthless persona made him the most famous mobster of the 20th Century.

items.title: Who Invited Charlie
items.description: A troubled family’s bubble is popped when a cocktail-swilling, pot-smoking ‘Charlie’ from their past shows up unannounced, crashing their stay in the Hamptons.

items.title: Home Education
items.description: When her father, an obscure cult-follower, dies, a home-schooled teenager is convinced by her mother that he will be resurrected if they want him back strongly enough

items.title: Horrible Histories: The Movie - Rotten Romans
items.description: Atti, a quick-witted Roman teenager, manages to upset Emperor Nero with one of his schemes. For punishment, Atti is sent to work in a cold and wet Britain where he meets the Celts.

items.title: Wild Indian
items.description: Two men learn to confront a traumatic secret they share involving the savage murder of a schoolmate.

items.title: Yes, God, Yes
items.description: A Catholic teenager in the early 2000s discovers her sexuality and struggles to suppress her new urges in the face of eternal damnation.

items.title: Los chimpancés del Congo rescatados, con Jane Goodall: El especial
items.description: La Dra. Jane Goodall crea un santuario, se reúne con el chimpancé Gregoire, la madre sustituta, La Vielle, y el huérfano Motambo.

items.title: El jefe de Sinaloa
items.description: Joaquín Archivaldo Guzmán Loera, El Chapo, un capo del narcotráfico famoso por utilizar maniobras inteligentes para evadir la captura.

items.title: Aliens Abducted My Parents
items.description: High school journalist Itsy befriends her space-obsessed neighbor Calvin. After he convinces her that his parents were abducted by aliens, they concoct a plan to get them back.

items.title: The Cameraman (silent with New Score)
items.description: Hopelessly in love with a woman working at MGM Studios, a clumsy man attempts to become a motion-picture cameraman to be close to the object of his desire.

items.title: Thunder Alley
items.description: A group of friends start a rock band, but as they start their rise in the music world, they get mixed up with drugs.

items.title: The Wrong Housesitter
items.description: Successful editor Deb sends Dan on an out-of-town assignment just as he moves into his dream house. When he meets Kristin, his problem is solved because she seems like the perfect house sitter. But his problems are just starting.

items.title: Ticket Out
items.description: "Ticket Out" is set in the world of the controversial underground railways that aid women and children escaping from abusive and sometimes murderous spouses.

items.title: Los lunes a las 9
items.description: Basado en el exitoso programa que cambió la historia de la televisión puertorriqueña "No te duermas", por el estilo ingenioso, controvertible, espontaneidad e indiscutible talento de su anfitrión Tony Sánchez, El Gángster.

items.title: Hunter x Hunter: Phantom Rouge
items.description: Someone has stolen Kurapika's eyes! Gon and Killua investigate, but the Phantom Troupe is back!

items.title: Lorelei
items.description: Wayland is released from prison after 15 years. He reunites with Dolores, his high school girlfriend, who is now a single mother of three. What follows is a lyrical take on love, regret, and second chances.

items.title: Match Me If You Can
items.description: When a computer nerd is rejected by an online dating service and dubbed unmatchable, she goes viral by declaring war on the dating service.

items.title: Mini's First Time
items.description: A rebellious girl hooks up with an escort agency, where her stepfather is a client.

items.title: Slingshot
items.description: Taylor and Ashley has found the perfect way to earn money. They seduce rich suburban women and rob them. This all goes well until Taylor falls in love with one of their victims.

items.title: Sweetwater
items.description: In the late 1800s, a fanatical religious leader, a renegade Sheriff, and a former prostitute collide in a blood triangle on the rugged plains of the New Mexico Territory.

items.title: La vida de los Reyes
items.description: La vida y la carrera del dúo cómico dominicano Raymond Pozo y Miguel Céspedes.

items.title: La última gira
items.description: El legendario cantante Daniel Santos prepara su biografía con Secre, un joven periodista. El recuerdo de glorias pasadas hace que Daniel se embarque en una aventura más: una gira de países de Sur América.

items.title: Mi suegra y yo
items.description: Historia que relata las dificultades por las que pasa una pareja recién casada cuando acepta la visita temporal de la suegra, quien tiene un carácter intenso y fuera de control, lo que pondrá en riesgo la unión matrimonial.

items.title: My Father's Killer
items.description: As graduation nears, twins Tracy and Tim plan to escape their controlling parents, Frederick and Wendy. But when Frederick dies mysteriously and Wendy is arrested, Tracy risks everything to uncover the real killer.

items.title: 10 Rules for Sleeping Around
items.description: A screwball sex comedy following two couples and their 10 rules to a happy, healthy, open relationship.

items.title: 35 and Ticking
items.description: Four friends (Nicole Ari Parker, Tamala Jones, Kevin Hart, Keith Robinson) struggle to figure out where their lives are heading as they approach their mid-thirties.

items.title: A Baby for Christmas
items.description: It's Christmas with the Chandlers, but no one seems to have the Christmas spirit. That is, until a group of kids at an orphanage helps the family realize that there's more to Christmas than wrapping gifts and baking cookies.

items.title: Chandler Christmas Getaway
items.description: The Chandlers pack up and head to a cabin for maximum holiday fun. With old feuds, new feuds, and a heap of holiday stress, the Chandler family must pull together to make this the best Christmas ever.

items.title: Daddy's Home
items.description: With a young daughter, two baby mamas, and his own mama breathing down his neck, Ronald "R.C." Carr (Travis Winfrey) has got more ladies in his life than he can handle!

items.title: Everyday But Christmas
items.description: A Christmas-hating author is taken by fate on a ride outside of his comfort zone and back to a place where he will face his fears, find his fate, and ultimately discover the true meaning of Christmas.

items.title: The House on the Hill
items.description: After years in a mental hospital, Megan goes home to visit her brother. But once she arrives, her brother has vanished, and no one in town remembers him ever existing. Is Megan losing her mind, or is something more diabolical at work?

items.title: How to Snatch a Bachelor
items.description: Two sisters decide to kidnap a reality star bachelor for their New Year's resolution, but they don't account for the FBI being hot on their trails.

items.title: Hunter x Hunter: The Last Mission
items.description: The Battle Olympia begins! Gon and team attend, but The Shadow puts a deadly end to the festivities!

items.title: La Mujer del Puerto
items.description: Rosario, una joven mujer, se ve abandonada después de la muerte de su padre y un engaño amoroso, y se convierte en una prostituta enigmática en Veracruz, allí busca a su hermano perdido y una noche con el marino Alberto revela un trágico destino.

items.title: La Vida No Vale Nada
items.description: Con una perspectiva un poco fatalista sobre la naturaleza humana y la búsqueda de la felicidad a través del amor, Pablo experimenta de manera cínica algunas relaciones sin éxito.

items.title: La Virgen de Guadalupe
items.description: En 1531, las tropas españolas atacan a los indígenas y Temoch, un joven líder azteca, trata de detener la masacre. Mientras, la Virgen María se le aparece al indígena Juan Diego para que transmita su mensaje que unión y paz.

items.title: The Wrong Student
items.description: Amber tries out for the soccer team and becomes acquainted with student Maddie Sawyer, who is also on the team. When Amber's aunt Kelly and coach Dominic fall in love, he gains the unwanted attention of unstable Maddie.

items.title: Drones
items.description: A man discovers a universal threat to his life, job and the planet.

items.title: Marcelino
items.description: Marcelino es un niño abandonado criado en un monasterio. El niño tiene un amigo a quien le comparte todos los días pan y vino, un día, un grupo de soldados atacan por sorpresa al campamento, e intentan llevarse a Marcelino.

items.title: Dear Santa
items.description: A greedy, workaholic father with little time for his family discovers the meaning of Christmas when he is whisked off to the North Pole by an enterprising elf named Lillith.

items.title: Antisocial
items.description: Five university friends gather at a house party to ring in the New Year. Unbeknownst to them, an epidemic has erupted outside, causing outbreaks around the world.

items.title: Antisocial 2
items.description: Years after having her newborn child stolen from her, Sam searches a world infested with infected users from the Social Redroom website.

items.title: Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation
items.description: Ethan and team take on their most impossible mission yet, eradicating the Syndicate - an International rogue organization as highly skilled as they are, committed to destroying the IMF.

items.title: Diana Krall: Live in Rio
items.description: In this stunning concert filmed in Rio de Janeiro, the home of bossa nova, Diana Krall delivers a superb set of standards in true bossa nova style which clearly bear her unique stamp.

items.title: Diana Krall: Live in Paris
items.description: Recorded live at the Paris Olympia to a sold-out audience, the captivating voice of Diana Krall delivers a sensual collection of romantic ballads and bossa novas.

items.title: Redemption
items.description: A grieving young man falls into the wrong crowd after the death of his mother.

items.title: Devilman
items.description: Akira and Ryo are high school students who must fight demonic hordes terrorizing earth. When Akira becomes possessed, he becomes Devilman, a demon who retains his humanity and fights for earth’s survival.

items.title: The Dempsey Sisters
items.description: The Dempsey Sisters is a movie about the power of believing in a dream, the force of a family bond, and being willing to give up a sure thing for the one thing that makes life worth living overall.

items.title: The Ideal Husband
items.description: A couple is joyously expecting their first child, but a secret from the husband's past threatens to destroy their happiness.

items.title: The Last Stand
items.description: The Last Stand, a drama that chronicles the life of four very different people attempting success as performers in Los Angeles until life becomes too much to handle.

items.title: The Love Letter
items.description: Established entertainment columnist Parker (Keshia Knight Pulliam) begins to re-evaluate her platonic feelings towards her sports-fanatic best friend Aaron (Romeo Miller) in this charming rom-com about balancing friendship and love.

items.title: The Love You Save
items.description: Alexis is a successful single mother who has it all - except happiness. When a down and out stranger enters her family's world, a secret is revealed that will change all of their lives.

items.title: What Would You Do for Love
items.description: Reggie Brooks is a fitness trainer whose good looks have always overshadowed the fact that he lives paycheck to paycheck. After being notified that he has come into a large sum of money, Reggie decides to keep his new multi-millionaire status a secret.

items.title: Leones: los superhéroes africanos
items.description: Las interminables llanuras del este de África son el paraíso para los leones. Los leones son los felinos más sociables y forman manadas distintas a las de otros animales.

items.title: Conociendo a los Marsupiales
items.description: Los marsupiales son extrañas criaturas que llevan a sus crías en su marsupio. Saltan, trepan y vuelan, son animales fascinantes.

items.title: Viviendo con Leones
items.description: Cuando los leones hambrientos amenazan el sustento de un pastor de ganado, se enfrentan a una terrible decisión de vida o muerte.

items.title: Conociendo a las Suricatas
items.description: En el desierto Namíb, las suricatas confían en su grupo para sobrevivir. Una joven hembra es forzada a marcharse tras un brutal ataque.

items.title: Monos caóticos
items.description: Los monos son una de las especies evolutivas más exitosas del planeta, desde los monos de nieve japoneses, hasta los babuinos africanos.

items.title: The Rat Race
items.description: A saxophonist (Tony Curtis) tries to share an apartment platonically with a dancer (Debbie Reynolds) in New York.

items.title: Post Malone: On His Terms
items.description: For reasons unknown Post Malone changed his last name to his first name, then chose his surname from a rap generator. See how he went on to sell 80 million records and win 10 Billboard Music Awards.

items.title: No Longer Human
items.description: True story of a shocking life one of the most well-known Japanese writer.

items.title: Sons of Summer
items.description: Four surfers plan a tribute trip to a beach town for one of their dads who was murdered decades earlier. After a drug deal gone wrong a psychotic killer is after them.

items.title: Merry Birthday, Happy Christmas
items.description: Reunited just before Christmas, Sarah and Kevin will discover if their lifelong friendship withstands the test of true love.

items.title: The Call
items.description: From the creator of Final Destination, Lin Shaye and Tobin Bell star in this terrifying tale of death from the fall of 1987. After a tragic accident, a group of small town friends must survive the night in the home of a sinister couple.

items.title: O Holy Knight!
items.description: After saving Santa from being mugged, a loveable, peace-seeking store clerk is hurtled back in time where he is expected to compete in a medieval gladiatorial event known as the 'Christmas Game of Champions.'

items.title: #AMFAD: All My Friends Are Dead
items.description: A group of college friends rent an Airbnb for the biggest music festival of the year. But their weekend of partying quickly takes a turn, as the group is murdered one by one, in correspondence with the seven deadly sins.

items.title: Miami Connection
items.description: Directed by black belt philosopher/inspirational speaker Grandmaster Y.K. Kim, the film tells the story of fearless synth rock band Dragon Sound as they embark on a roundhouse wave of crime-crushing justice in the streets of Orlando.

items.title: American Meltdown
items.description: A young woman, jobless and struggling, befriends a pickpocket who persuades her that survival in America means turning to petty crime.

items.title: President in Waiting
items.description: Through exclusive interviews with our nation's former leaders, discover how the Vice Presidency went from being a ceremonial office to one of the most powerful positions in politics.

items.title: Dr. Jekyll & Mr. Hyde
items.description: Dr. Henry Jekyll experiments with scientific means of revealing the hidden, dark side of man and releases a murderer from within himself. John Barrymore stars in this silent horror classic featuring a brand-new score by Michael Richard Plowman.

items.title: Through Sickness and Hell
items.description: When a police officer is trapped in a toxic marriage, he must find the strength to break free from his abusive wife.

items.title: Ringo of Nebraska
items.description: A drifter helps a ranch couple fend off the approaches of a ruthless landowner.

items.title: For Love or Money? A Poker Documentary
items.description: An inside look as two professional poker players, Chris Leong and Stanley Lee, attempt to win poker's most coveted prize… a World Series of Poker bracelet.

items.title: A Deadly Lullaby
items.description: After losing her child, Olivia (Katie Leclerc, "Switched at Birth") meets a woman and her daughter, and admiration turns into obsession.

items.title: The Jesus Rolls
items.description: In this spin-off of The Big Lebowski directed by and starring John Turturro, bowler Jesus Quintana pairs up with fellow misfits Petey and Marie after his release from prison for a freewheeling joyride of petty crime and romance.

items.title: Raising Wolves
items.description: A young fearless group of friends called the wolf pack Jodey, JD, Relly and Craig have been hustling on the streets since they were 13. Their successful run of hustling, making money and alluding police catch the envy eyes of the streets.

items.title: Average Joe
items.description: When his display of faith turned the ire of a nation against him, a soldier turned high school coach battles in the courts to restore his station and the religious freedoms of all.

items.title: Janet Jackson: In Control
items.description: She may have been the youngest of 10 of the Jackson children, but that did not stop Janet Jackson from embracing her own identity. Her unquestioned talent has built an empire of success as Ms. Janet remains In Control.

items.title: Christmas in the Friendly Skies
items.description: Two strangers find unexpected holiday romance during a turbulent flight, bonding amidst the chaos of festive air travel.

items.title: Bobby
items.description: The story of the assassination of U.S. Senator Robert F. Kennedy, and twenty-two people in the Ambassador Hotel, whose lives were never the same.

items.title: Pajama Party
items.description: When a Martian scout named Go-Go is sent to explore Earth for a possible conquest, he lands in the middle of a wild, teenage pajama party, giving Mars second thoughts about invasion...and turning the party into an out-of-this-world cosmic shindig!

items.title: What Lurks Beneath
items.description: The USS Titan crew faces World War 3 as a mysterious naked stowaway in a torpedo tube reveals a danger beyond Russia.

items.title: Last Known Location
items.description: Three women from different walks of life are mysteriously taken. Detectives struggle to find a connection, as the women seemingly vanished into thin air. Over time, the women form an unlikely bond that becomes the key to their survival.

items.title: The Sand
items.description: After an all-night graduation beach party, a group of hung-over twenty-somethings awake to a beating sun, and a seemingly carnivorous beach that devours anything with a heartbeat that touches the sand.

items.title: Monolith
items.description: While trying to salvage her career, a disgraced journalist begins investigating a strange conspiracy theory. But as the trail leads uncomfortably close to home, she is left to grapple with the lies at the heart of her own story.

items.title: Run With The Hunted
items.description: Oscar, a young boy, commits a crime and is forced to run away, leaving behind his best friend, Loux. 15 years later, he has forgotten his past and become the leader of a band of lost children. Loux takes it upon herself to find the boy who saved her life.

items.title: Land of Dreams
items.description: In small-town America, Simin, an Iranian immigrant, works for the United States Census Bureau which has gone beyond data collection and now explores the dreams of citizens for unknown intentions.

items.title: Love Bomb
items.description: A mysterious dating app designed for one night stands brings three strangers together with deadly consequences.

items.title: Small Town Santa
items.description: On Christmas Eve, the sheriff arrests a jolly old fellow with a little white beard. While behind bars, the old man brings kindness and wisdom to the town. By the end of the evening, even the sheriff believes he might be the real Saint Nick.

items.title: Liza, Liza Skies Are Grey (Director's Cut)
items.description: Starring 2025 Best Actress Academy Award winner Mikey Madison in her first feature, after deciding to be each other's "first," a couple navigating their youth in the summer of 66' takes a motorcycle road trip up the California coast.

items.title: Quackser Fortune Has a Cousin in the Bronx
items.description: A comedy of the human spirit about a highly independent young Irishman who triumphs over conformity.

items.title: Poupelle Of Chimney Town
items.description: What is the secret of the town covered in smoke, where everyone has forgotten to look up? This is the story of a young boy and a man made of garbage who look for "stars".

items.title: Nine Nights
items.description: When an accident kills her twin brother, a teenager refuses to believe he's dead. As the 'Nine Night' (a Caribbean mourning ritual) begins, her descent into paranoia unleashes long-buried secrets, which threaten to destroy her family.

items.title: Carnival Lady (1933)
items.description: When his bank fails, a young man not only loses all his money- his fiancée deserts him too. Depressed, he joins a circus.

items.title: Convict's Code (1939)
items.description: Dave Tyler (Robert Kent) is being released from prison after serving three years for a crime he claims he didn't commit.

items.title: Kentucky Rifle (1955)
items.description: A man brings a wagonload of Kentucky rifles through Indian Territory. Unfortunately, the Indians realize what he has and offer the travelers an ultimatum: the rifles or their lives!

items.title: The Comet Bomber
items.description: The jet age has arrived, and the Soviet Union works to produce an atomic weapon. With the mounting nuclear threat, Britain looks to build its own nuclear bomber fleet.

items.title: The Atomic Dilemma
items.description: This is the story of America's decision to drop the atomic bomb on Japan during WWII. What factors lead to using such a devastating weapon to end the war in the Pacific?

items.title: Tiburón de montaña
items.description: Un grupo de cazadores enviados a las montañas en una misión, descubren la verdad mortal que los está esperando.

items.title: The Base 2: Guilty as Charged
items.description: The Pentagon sends its top soldier to uncover the mystery behind the disappearance of two dozen soldiers.

items.title: Policía implacable
items.description: Un policía se pone en pie de guerra para localizar a los traficantes de personas que secuestraron a su hijo.

items.title: Cocodrilo jurásico
items.description: Nava, un brillante estudiante de botánica, busca el origen de una planta llamada “Chalawan”, y para ello, organiza un equipo de amigos para viajar por la selva. Allí, se encuentran con un enorme cocodrilo devorador de hombres.

items.title: Behind You
items.description: Two young sisters find that all the mirrors in her house are covered or hidden. When one of the sisters happens upon a mirror in the basement, she unknowingly releases a malicious demon that had haunted her mother and aunt years ago.

items.title: Color of Fear
items.description: In Italy, a woman fears her sister may have been kidnapped. Inspector Enzo Avolfi fears it’s worse. They team up to rescue her from a sadistic killer known only as Yellow.

items.title: Tiburón toro 2
items.description: El ex guardabosques Spencer Timmes es llamado de nuevo a la acción con la esperanza de encontrar a un trío de niños desaparecidos que han desaparecido y se teme que hayan sido devorados por el ahora infame Tiburón Estrella Solitaria.

items.title: Siempre victorioso
items.description: Un hombre busca venganza después de regresar a su pueblo, solo para encontrar a sus amigos y a su padre asesinados por un brutal general.

items.title: Knuckleball!
items.description: A documentary that showcases baseball's most unpredictable pitch. Follow MLB's Tim Wakefield and R.A. Dickey through a dramatic MLB season. Featuring Phil Niekro, Charlie Hough, and Jim Bouton.

items.title: The Mattachine Family
items.description: When their foster son is reunited with his mom, Thomas and Oscar diverge as they grapple with life after fatherhood. As Oscar's career takes off, Thomas embarks on a personal journey to find the meaning of family.

items.title: Estampillas de droga
items.description: La película cuenta la historia de un valiente e inteligente oficial de policía, Wu Xian Jun, que se gana la confianza de un narcotraficante, Hua Ge, con su comportamiento tranquilo y decidido.

items.title: And Mrs.
items.description: When a bride-to-be’s fiancé suddenly dies, she vows to marry him anyways. To do so she must overcome the court of public opinion, the court of law, and her loved ones' objections.

items.title: ¿Alguien ha visto a Lupita?
items.description: Lupita se ve obligada a separarse de su familia pues quieren internarla en un hospital. Comienza así un viaje, en el cual ella nos llevará a descubrir un mundo que, al parecer, está mucho más loco que ella.

items.title: Rustlers' Rhapsody
items.description: The Wild West goes wacko when the Greatest Fast-Drawin', Silver-Spurred, Geetar Playin', Singing Cowboy movie matinee idol Rex O'Herlihan hits the saddle in Rustlers' Rhapsody, a cockeyed, affectionate send-up of the '40s B-movie Western.

items.title: A Fireman For Christmas
items.description: In small town Michigan, city girl Dani plans her best friend's wedding at the Holly Hotel but clashes with the best man, a charming fireman. Through the sparks, romance blooms, but when his ex returns, will it ruin Dani's perfect Christmas?

items.title: Christmas At Xander Point
items.description: A week before Christmas, plans to tear down the old iconic lighthouse at Xander Point are announced, sparking debate. When the mayor's son goes missing, the town's hopes rest on a Christmas miracle to save him and the lighthouse.

items.title: 10,000 km
items.description: Alex moves to Los Angeles for a new job, Sergi stays in Barcelona. They love each other, but maintaining a relationship through technology proves challenging.

items.title: Ava
items.description: Ava (Jessica Chastain) is a deadly assassin for a black ops organization. When a job goes dangerously wrong she is forced to fight for her own survival.

items.title: By the People: The Election of Barack Obama
items.description: An all-access pass to the historic Obama campaign during its two-year odyssey to the White House from 2006-2008, chronicling the daily ups and downs of the campaign trail as experienced by Obama, his family, campaign stuff and volunteers.

items.title: 90 Minutos
items.description: El fútbol une estas cuatro historias: un inmigrante que debe luchar por su vida; un barra brava con un dilema; un camarógrafo de un canal de noticias ; y una leyenda del equipo nacional hondureño de la década de los 80.

items.title: Pee-wee's Playhouse Christmas Special
items.description: Pee-Wee Herman throws a Christmas party at his playhouse with his friends and some celebrity guests.

items.title: Awoken
items.description: A medical student attempts to cure her brother from a terminal sleep illness, but a more sinister reason for his condition is revealed.

items.title: Psychomania
items.description: In this '70s cult classic and "grooviest zombie biker movie of all" (Cinesploitation), a motorcycle gang's occult pact grants them eternal life.

items.title: American Woman
items.description: A woman raises her young grandson after her daughter goes missing.

items.title: Reuniting the Rubins
items.description: Lenny Rubins, (Timothy Spall - The King's Speech) an up-tight lawyer, has to put his dream retirement on hold when his ailing mother (Honor Blackman - Goldfinger) emotionally blackmails him into reuniting his estranged children for a Jewish holiday.

items.title: TC 2000
items.description: Somewhere in an apocalyptic future, where the rich live underground and the poor are left to fend for themselves on the surface by forming gangs, corrupt members of an underground security force plot to destroy the surface.

items.title: Ten Little Indians
items.description: Ten people are invited to a hotel in the Iranian desert, only to find that an unseen person is killing them one by one. Could one of them be the killer?

items.title: The Exterminator
items.description: A man's best friend is killed on the streets of New York City. The man (Robert Ginty) then transforms into a violent killer, turning New York City into a great war zone, and Christopher George is the only one to stop him.

items.title: The Founders
items.description: The Founders is a story about thirteen female golfers from across the country who chose to go pro in 1950, thus creating the LPGA.

items.title: The Legend Of Hei
items.description: In bustling human world, various of goblins live peacefully with mankind. Luo Xiao-Hei, the cat demon, begins his journey of wandering because his forest home is destroyed.

items.title: The Low Life
items.description: John came to Hollywood to get that one big break in life. Years have passed since and all he has to show for are a menial job, unpaid bills and airhead friends and he's getting sick of it all. Is there a way out of this downward spiral?

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Attack Of The Giant Leeches
items.description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark.

items.title: Ethan Frome
items.description: A faithful adaptation of the classic Edith Wharton tale of blazing passion and forbidden desire. Ethan Frome is a man torn between his joyless marriage to one woman and his lustful desire for another.

items.title: Código de honor
items.description: Cuando su familia es asesinada, un agente de Operaciones Especiales se convierte en justiciero. ¿Podrá su antiguo protegido, ahora agente del FBI, detenerlo antes de que la mafia y la policía lo alcancen?

items.title: Día de la madre
items.description: Rebecca DeMornay brinda una interpretación aterradora en este baño de sangre brutal. Cuando sus hijos entran a una casa y toman como rehenes a los dueños; ella les enseña cómo es la verdadera tortura. Coprotagonizada por Shawn Ashmore.

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Beast From Haunted Cave
items.description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark.

items.title: Peligro en tu mirada
items.description: Una fotógrafa es obligada por un mafioso a espiar a un candidato político. Ella, al ser testigo de un asesinato que implica al amante del candidato, debe decidir qué hacer con la verdad.

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Scared To Death
items.description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira prepares for her annual Halloween party by kidnapping Martha Stewart and holding her captive in a wooden crate.

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Teenagers From Outer Space
items.description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira gets in touch with her inner child while hosting "Teenagers from Outer Space."

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Brain That Wouldn't Die
items.description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira prepares to compete on a game show while hosting "The Brain That Wouldn't Die."

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Devil's Wedding Night
items.description: A quest for the mythical Ring of Vermougglian leads the Schiller brothers to Transylvania and Castle Dracula, where they find more than they bargained for in the castle's current resident and her undead servant.

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Doomsday Machine
items.description: When a Chinese plot to destroy the Earth is uncovered, the U.S. teams up with the Soviet Union to replace members of its all-male crew with women. Now, it's up to the crew of Project Astra to keep the human race alive and thriving.

items.title: A Man and a Woman
items.description: Sang-min is in Finland to send her autistic son to a special camp. Feeling alienated, she meets Ki-hong, an architect with family issues. Their children attend the same camp, leading them to a short trip where they connect.

items.title: Detective K: Secret of the Lost Island
items.description: In 1795, counterfeit silver threatens the economy. Detective Kim Min and his sidekick Seokpil go undercover in a village. A woman named Dahae asks for help finding her missing sister, but she vanishes too. Kim Min uncovers a link to the fake silver.
