items.title: Like a French Film
items.description: A retired mother calls her four daughters to announce something unexpected. Despite their differences, they come together.

items.title: Lost in the Moonlight
items.description: Hyunjuli travels to the moonlight world and meets Mr. Squirrel and warrior Won. She must save the moonlit palace and return home.

items.title: My Mother, the Mermaid
items.description: Na-young meets her 20-year-old mother, Yeon-soon, in the past. She witnesses her parents' young love while searching for her missing father.

items.title: My Ordinary Love Story
items.description: Eun-jin, dumped by her boyfriend, gets drunk and shares a taxi with geeky Hyeon-seok. They start dating, but Eun-jin suspects Hyeon-seok after finding a message from another woman. Investigating him, she uncovers a dark secret.

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Manster
items.description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries to figure out a way to avoid being deported.

items.title: Secret Reunion
items.description: Ex-spy Han-kyu partners with Ji-won, a North Korean spy, to capture him for a bounty.

items.title: She's on Duty
items.description: Jea-in, a tough cop with a wild past, goes undercover as a high schooler to catch a gangster. While tracking his daughter, she falls for the charming student No-young—and starts forgetting her mission.

items.title: The Face Reader
items.description: Face reader Nae-kyung teams up with geisha Yeon-hong and gets pulled into a murder case. Recognized by King Moonjong, he's tasked with spotting traitors. After the king's death, he risks everything to protect the young heir.

items.title: Sorority House Massacre
items.description: College student Beth and her sorority sisters are stalked by an escaped psychopathic killer who shares a strange telepathic link with her.

items.title: Timeline
items.description: Based on the Michael Crichton novel. TIMELINE tells the story of a professor who inadvertently catapults himself back to 14th-century France, in the middle of the 100 Years War.

items.title: Strangers With Candy
items.description: A prequel to the critically-acclaimed series featuring Jerri Blank, a 46-year-old ex-junkie ex-con who returns to high school in a bid to restart her life.

items.title: Hitman [English-Language Version]
items.description: Two hitmen, one a novice and the other a veteran with poor luck, band together to find the "King of Killers" for whom there is a large reward.

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Giant Gila Monster
items.description: Elvira pet-sits six animals while hosting "The Giant Gila Monster," but complications quickly arise when the pets begin feasting upon each other.

items.title: The Company
items.description: A young ballet dancer is poised to become the principal performer in a group of ballet dancers.

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Killer Shrews
items.description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark.

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Terror
items.description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira mocks Roger Corman classic "The Terror" until she falls asleep.

items.title: The Hottest State
items.description: A young actor from Texas tries to make it in New York while struggling in his relationship with a beautiful singer/songwriter.

items.title: Whale Rider
items.description: A contemporary story of love, rejection and triumph as a young Maori girl fights to fulfill a destiny her grandfather refuses to recognize.

items.title: Dick Tracy Vs. Cueball
items.description: A braided cord is his only clue as Tracy (Conway) searches desperately for a gang of jewel thieves.

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Manos: The Hands Of Fate
items.description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries to elevate the material by hosting Manos as if it were an episode of Masterpiece Theater.

items.title: Oscuro veneno
items.description: Helena se embarca en una nueva misión como la seductora agente de una fuerza policial secreta en México. Helena deberá infiltrarse en el círculo de un reconocido científico, sospechoso de estar confeccionando un virus letal.

items.title: Super familia
items.description: Después de ganar la custodia de sus hijos a sus ex-suegros, Juan Antonio intenta conciliar la educación de sus hijos con un nuevo matrimonio y un embarazo que, sin duda, pondrá a la familia entera de cabeza.

items.title: Por amor al money
items.description: Dos días antes de su boda, Santiago, un encantador gerente de hotel, es cautivado por Dolores. Cuando es descubierto siendo infiel, la boda se cancela y Santiago pierde todo al ser acusado de traficar con drogas.

items.title: Triunfo en Canadá
items.description: Para ganar popularidad, el presidente de EE.UU. orquesta una nueva Guerra Fría... ¡con Canadá! Pero cuando un sheriff y su alguacil lideran su propia invasión descabellada, ¡se convierte en un divertidísimo incidente internacional!

items.title: Arthur & Merlin
items.description: A young Celtic warrior and a hermit wizard must unite to defeat an evil druid.

items.title: Dos Pasiones aka Cadetes de la Naval
items.description: Los mejores amigos de Cristobal y Ricardo son compañeros infantes de marina que aprenden el significado del honor, el deber y, sobre todo, la amistad en este mundo agitación drama de la Guerra Mundial.

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Satanic Rites Of Dracula
items.description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira decides that the film she's hosting is so boring that she catches up on her reading and various personal chores.

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Werewolf Of Washington (1981)
items.description: While on assignment in Hungary, a young reporter (Quantum Leap's Dean Stockwell) is attacked by a mysterious animal.

items.title: In Her Name
items.description: A dramedy about estranged sisters forced to confront reality amidst the absurdity of the Los Angeles art world while dealing with their egomaniacal, formerly-important-artist father's descent.

items.title: Dos pesos dejada
items.description: Fermín, un taxista vividor, se enamora de la hija de una comerciante adinerada, pero sus intenciones de conquistarla pronto se vuelven obsesivas y pierden el rumbo, llevándolo a consecuencias inminentes y peligrosas.

items.title: Arañas en las Alturas
items.description: Un grupo de pasajeros encuentra su vuelo infestado de mortales arañas mutantes.

items.title: Abismo estelar
items.description: Una nave espacial que viaja a través de Stargates queda atrapada en el Abismo de las Estrellas. Con solo 4 de los 15 pasajeros capaces de usar cápsulas de hibernación, uno de ellos libera un monstruo alienígena para aumentar sus probabilidades.

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Maneater Of Hydra
items.description: While vacationing in the Mediterranean, a group of tourists pay to spend a weekend exploring a lush island occupied by the botanist Baron von Weser and his bloodthirsty, carnivorous plants.

items.title: Duelo de pistoleros
items.description: El duelo por ser el mejor en la comarca, duelo por ser quien mande en ese sitio pero sobre todo duelo por tan lindas mujeres.

items.title: Lluvia solar
items.description: Trevor y su colega científico Nick descubren que el sol ha sido empujado hacia la Tierra, causando todo tipo de desastres relacionados con el fuego a medida que el planeta comienza a calentarse rápidamente.

items.title: El aduanal
items.description: La hija del jefe de la aduana está obligada a casarse con el hijo de un traficante de drogas, luego de que este la viola. El ex novio de la muchacha, un policía de aduanas, está tras la pista de este infame. Se desata una cacería sin tregua.

items.title: El bruto
items.description: El dueño de un edificio planea desalojar a sus inquilinos para venderlo. Ante la resistencia de los afectados, y con la ayuda de su amante, contrata a un matón para que se encargue de los desalojos de manera violenta.

items.title: Body Brokers
items.description: This is the true and untold story of multi-billion-dollar drug and alcohol treatment frauds, where former drug addicts and dealers become millionaires overnight as body brokers.

items.title: Archive
items.description: 2049. A roboticist has been working on a true, human equivalent android and each prototype is an increasingly advanced version of his deceased wife.

items.title: El capitán Mantarraya
items.description: El capitán Mantarraya, aventurero y charlatán, se deleita contando sus memorias a un público de inocentes niños. Esta vez compartirá la historia de una mujer que lo contrató para ir a la Isla Maldita.

items.title: El comandante Furia
items.description: En San Isidro, Demetrio planea robar a Pancho el dinero para una escuela, usando a Rutilo y sus secuaces para asaltarlo y matarlo en el camino a Tepetlapa, evento presenciado por los hermanos Mendoza.

items.title: El corazón y la espada
items.description: En Granada, la obsesión por el dinero hace que una mujer invierta su tiempo, sus ahorros y sus energías en encontrar a un misterioso alquimista que ha descubierto la fórmula para obtener oro en cualquier lugar y de forma rápida.

items.title: The Card Player
items.description: A Rome policewoman teams up with a British Interpol agent to find a crafty serial killer who plays a taunting game of cat-and-mouse with the police by abducting and killing young women and showing it over an Internet webcam.

items.title: Tornado Texano
items.description: Un hombre comienza a tener visiones de un tornado destructivo después de la muerte de su hijo.

items.title: Sleepless
items.description: A retired police detective and a young amateur sleuth team up to find a serial killer who's resumed a killing spree in Turin, Italy after a 17-year period.

items.title: Raise Hell: The Life And Times Of Molly Ivins
items.description: RAISE HELL: THE LIFE & TIMES OF MOLLY IVINS tells the story of media firebrand Molly Ivins, six feet of Texas trouble who took on the Good Old Boy corruption wherever she found it.

items.title: Stendhal Syndrome
items.description: A young policewoman slowly goes insane while tracking down an elusive serial rapist/killer through Italy, when she herself becomes a victim of the brutal man's obsession.

items.title: Breakfast Of Champions
items.description: A rich car dealer is losing his mind. His son lives in the bomb shelter. His suicidal wife has an affair with his transvestite sales manager.

items.title: The Adventures of the Wilderness Family
items.description: Based on a true story, the Robinson family decide to leave city life behind for one of clean living in the wilderness for the sake of their daughter's health. There they learn the value of family as they become closer to nature.

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Monstroid
items.description: When a small Colombian village is viciously attacked by a creature from a nearby lake, a corrupt chemical company sends a specialist (Jim Mitchum) to destroy the beast and cover up their involvement with its creation. Inspired by a true story!

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Night Of The Living Dead
items.description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira decides to clean out her basement, relaunch "Movie Macabre," and host "Night of the Living Dead."

items.title: La colina del francotirador
items.description: Un francotirador altamente hábil arriesga su vida para proteger la vida de sus compañeros soldados.

items.title: Una osa llamada Winnie
items.description: La extraordinaria historia real del oso negro que se convertiría en la inspiración para las historias de A.A. Milne, y el hombre heroico que le salvó la vida.

items.title: Nosferatu The Vampyre [German-Language Version]
items.description: Count Dracula moves from Transylvania to Wismar, spreading the Black Plague across the land. Only a woman pure of heart can bring an end to his reign of horror.

items.title: El beso de un hermano
items.description: Los hermanos Lex y Mick crecen en Harlem tomando caminos opuestos tras un trágico evento que lleva a Lex al reformatorio. Con su sueño destruido de una carrera pro en baloncesto, Lex gira hacia el crimen. Con Rosie Perez, Marisa Tomei y John Leguizamo.

items.title: Un héroe para navidad
items.description: La bombera Jenny se ha enamorado de Tom. Sin embargo, su ex esposa Mary, autora de bestsellers, exige una reconciliación si quiere ver a su hija en Navidad.

items.title: What We Started
items.description: An exploration of electronic dance music's past, present, and future through the eyes of superstar DJs, including Carl Cox and Martin Garrix. What We Started is the definitive film of the electronic dance music genre.

items.title: Pretérito perfecto americano
items.description: El psiquiatra de criminales, Jake Nyman, está de vacaciones de sus responsabilidades en un viaje de carretera experimental durante el cual cada decisión se hará lanzando una moneda.

items.title: El yakuza americano
items.description: Viggo Mortensen (Green Book) interpreta a un agente del FBI encubierto que ha ascendido en las filas de la Yakuza y ahora se ve atrapado en una guerra entre la Yakuza, la mafia y el FBI.

items.title: The Legend [English Subtitled]
items.description: This Hong Kong martial-arts extravaganza tells of evil emperors and true love. The secret Red Lotus Flower Society is committed to the overthrow of the evil Manchu Emperor and his minions.

items.title: The Legend 2 [English Subtitled]
items.description: The Cantonese hero Fong Sai Yuk becomes involved in the secret brotherhood "The Red Flower", who are trying to overthrow the Manchurian emperor and re-establishing the Ming dynasty.

items.title: Espalda con espalda
items.description: Después de que un ex-policía (Michael Rooker, Guardians of the Galaxy) se ve atrapado en una batalla entre mafiosos japoneses y pandilleros locales, descubre que fue incriminado por un policía corrupto.

items.title: Animal
items.description: En este cautivador drama criminal, un famoso gánster debe reconciliar su pasado para dejar un futuro a su hijo con mente criminal. Con ganador del Globo de Oro Ving Rhames, el nominado al Oscar Terrence Howard y la superestrella del fútbol Jim Brown.

items.title: Prácticamente muerto
items.description: Cuando un fotoperiodista es secuestrado y torturado por tres asaltantes que buscan venganza por el asesinato de su líder de culto extremista, el enfrentamiento resultante revela rápidamente que pueden estar equivocados.

items.title: Sugar Colt
items.description: To avenge a friend and to fulfill his last wish, Tom has to find out what happened to an army corps that has mysteriously disappeared. He therefore puts on the disguise of a doctor and starts investigating in a somewhat uncomfortable town.

items.title: Bloodfist VI: Ground Zero
items.description: A kickboxer (Don "The Dragon" Wilson) must prevent the launch of a nuclear missile by terrorists targeting New York.

items.title: Bloodfist VII: Manhunt
items.description: Jim Trudell is a man pursued. Branded a cop-killer, he must fight simply to stay alive, and to clear his name - with the very police who framed him.

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Hercules And The Captive Women
items.description: Elvira's stuck hosting this Greek tragedy about Hercules and his voyage to Atlantis to rescue his son and battle an army of identical men and a strange up-right dragon.

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: I Eat Your Skin
items.description: While hosting "I Eat Your Skin," Elvira complains that there's no actual flesh eating in the film, so she invents the I Eat Your Skin Diet and hawks Zombatrim pills.

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Lady Frankenstein
items.description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. The son Elvira never knew she had abruptly appears and tries to take over her show.

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Legacy Of Blood
items.description: When their father dies, three greedy sisters and their husbands reunite to hear the reading of the will. His fortune is theirs, assuming, of course, they're able to survive a full week at the family mansion.

items.title: Gravy
items.description: On Halloween night, three misfits dress up in costumes and force the employees of a Mexican cantina to engage in depraved gluttony.

items.title: Cover-Up
items.description: A tough ex-U.S. Marine journalist battles against time to save the lives of thousands of innocent people after uncovering a complex terrorist plot.

items.title: Bloodfist VIII: Hard Way Out
items.description: Kickboxing champion Jake Raye thought his fighting days were over, until a call from an old friend draws him to the Far East and into the hands of a madman.

items.title: Funny About Love
items.description: NYC cartoonist Duffy meets the bad cappuccino maker, chef Meg, and falls in love. She moves in with him, marries him - but they have problems having a baby.

items.title: An Eye For An Eye (1966)
items.description: A former bounty hunter teams up with a younger one, to track down and kill the wanted gang leader who murdered his wife and little boy.

items.title: Animal Factory
items.description: A young man goes to prison and a tough, older convict takes him under his wing as a mentor.

items.title: Absolute Denial
items.description: Follows a genius programmer who sacrifices everything in his personal and professional life to build a supercomputer of unprecedented power.

items.title: Grind
items.description: While the rest of his high school graduating class is heading to the same old grind of college, skateboarder Eric Rivers and his best friends, Dustin and misfit slacker Matt have one last summer roadtrip together to follow their dreams.

items.title: Hard Country
items.description: A factory worker (Jan-Michael Vincent) with no ambition loves a woman (Kim Basinger) who wants to pursue a life outside of Texas.

items.title: Hercules vs. The Hydra
items.description: Hercules must save his true love from an evil queen.

items.title: 10 Tokyo Warriors: The Final Battle
items.description: Long ago, the land was in a state of chaos as the feudal lords waged territorial wars. In the midst of the bloodshed, a ferocious warrior, known as the Demon King, appeared and conquered all. It is now 400 years later.

items.title: The Great Texas Dynamite Chase
items.description: Explosive drama and action when two sexy girls go on a bank robbing binge.

items.title: Attack Of The Crab Monsters
items.description: Scientists become trapped on a shrinking island with intelligent, murderous giant crabs.

items.title: Soviet Sleep Experiment
items.description: In the late 1940s, Russian researchers keep four test patients awake for thirty days using an experimental gas-based stimulant. What starts as a purely scientific study, quickly spirals out of control.

items.title: Most Wanted
items.description: Ex heroin junkie, Daniel Léger, gets involved in a drug deal with the wrong people for the wrong reasons.

items.title: Affliction
items.description: A deeply troubled small-town cop investigates a suspicious hunting death while other events jeopardize his sanity.

items.title: El caballo prieto afamado
items.description: Un melodrama ambientado en una zona rural que nos muestra a través de su más afamado y de majestuosa belleza equina, todas las aventuras en el marco de música, jinetes y carreras.

items.title: Compromising Positions
items.description: An ex-newspaper woman who is now a suburban housewife can't resist getting involved in an investigation of the murder of a philandering dentist who had been having affairs with several of her neighbors.

items.title: Accident Man: Hitman's Holiday
items.description: A hit man must beat the top assassins in the world.

items.title: When Taekwondo Strikes [English-Language Version]
items.description: During the Japanese occupation of Korea in the 1930's, the leader of a small resistance movement attempts to get information to sympathizers in China.

items.title: The Skyhawk [English-Language Version]
items.description: In Bangkok, Kwangtung boxer Wong Fei-hung, The Skyhawk, rescues Hsiao Shih-tzu, a young man who fights off five thugs only to be wounded himself.

items.title: Death And The Maiden
items.description: A political activist is convinced that her guest is a man who once tortured her for the government.

items.title: Last Days In The Desert
items.description: An imagined chapter from Jesus' forty days of fasting and praying in the desert. On his way out of the wilderness, Jesus struggles with the Devil over the fate of a family in crisis.

items.title: Kids In The Hall: Brain Candy
items.description: A pharmaceutical scientist creates a pill that makes people remember their happiest memory, and although it's successful, it has unfortunate side effects.

items.title: Brewster's Millions
items.description: In order to inherit $7,000,000, an ex-soldier must spend $1,000,000 in two months' time.

items.title: Joe Strummer: The Future Is Unwritten
items.description: As the front man of the Clash from 1977, Joe Strummer changed people's lives forever. Four years after his death, his influence reaches out around the world, more strongly now than ever before.

items.title: Besos Prohibidos
items.description: Daniel le propone matrimonio a Teresa, una hermosa cantante y madre de una niña. Pero ella no es viuda, como él cree: su esposo cumple una condena de 30 años en prisión. Ahora, Teresa deberá decidir su futuro.

items.title: Canción del alma
items.description: María fue una gran estrella del canto que perdió todo su dinero entre su exmarido y en pagar la matrícula de la escuela de su hija. ¿Comprenderá alguna vez la hija el sacrificio de su madre?

items.title: Capitan de rurales
items.description: El joven capitán de un grupo conocido como los rurales es perseguido por el gobierno mexicano por defender los derechos de los campesinos de las injusticias, pero en esta odisea contará con el apoyo del pueblo.

items.title: Cien muchachas
items.description: Manuel, el dueño de una fábrica de trajes de baño, decide retirarse y quiere dejar a cargo de su compañía a uno de los dos grupos de empleados que se enfrentan entre sí en una hilarante competencia.

items.title: Adventures in Game Chasing
items.description: Billy and Jay, friends since kids and now beaten down with life, go on an adventure to track down Billy's original NES gaming system given by Billy's now departed Grandfather in the 80's, in order to play it one more time.

items.title: Perú: Sacrificios en el reino de Chimor
items.description: Un descubrimiento de cientos de niños sacrificados en Perú descubre los secretos de una de las civilizaciones más poderosas y misteriosas.

items.title: Club de señoritas
items.description: Una verdadera guerra de competencia televisiva se desencadena entre el Club de Señoritas y el Club del Cha Cha Cha, enfrentando a hombres y mujeres en una batalla por el control del hogar.

items.title: 3 hombres en mi vida
items.description: Carmen es una hermosa mujer que vive junto a su esposo Leonardo, un hombre desempleado y alcohólico. Tras un accidente, Carmen conoce a Fernando, un chofer, y al Dr. Carlos Junco, quienes intentarán conquistar su amor.

items.title: A los cuatro vientos
items.description: Una joven de origen humilde conoce a un empresario que impulsa su carrera como cantante, despertando los celos e inseguridades de su novio. Esto desencadena conflictos mientras ella lucha por equilibrar su nueva vida y su relación.

items.title: Karate Killer
items.description: Kiba is back again, but this time he has fallen from grace and sent to prison for all the violent acts he has committed. Once he's out, he begins working as a bodyguard in a club that is crawling with gangsters.

items.title: That's The Way Of The World
items.description: Record-industry mobsters make an executive (Harvey Keitel) push a boring family trio instead of Earth, Wind & Fire.

items.title: Blackout (1978)
items.description: Thriller about four sadistic criminals who, after escaping during a transfer, take over a posh Manhattan apartment complex and start looting and terrorizing its occupants during New York City's famous 1977 blackout.

items.title: The Editor
items.description: A film editor gets embroiled in a string of murders.

items.title: The Evil
items.description: A psychologist and his wife turn a house of the devil into a drug-rehabilitation center.

items.title: The Last Of The Mohicans
items.description: As Alice and Cora Munro attempt to find their father they are set upon by French soldiers and their cohorts, Huron tribesmen. Fighting to rescue the women are Chingachgook the last of the Mohican tribe, and the frontiersman known as Hawkeye.

items.title: Phantom of the Opera
items.description: Gory remake of the Gaston Leroux classic story, only this time, the phantom is not disfigured, but a man who was raised by rats deep under the Paris Opera House.

items.title: Homicidio en la pasarela
items.description: El mariscal de los EE.UU. Jack Devlin intenta proteger a una joven de los gángsters. Desafortunadamente, la capacidad de Devlin para hacer su trabajo está restringida después de que una explosión lo cegó temporalmente.

items.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
items.description: In the lawless West, The Cowboys a notorious brotherhood of killers and thieves reigned over the land with brutal fists and fast guns. Fate had finally caught up with them - and now the merciless gang has but a single surviving member.

items.title: Blue tiger: furia en la piel
items.description: Una mujer (Virginia Madsen, Duna) dedica su vida a buscar venganza después de que su hijo muere en el fuego cruzado de un ataque de la Yakuza japonesa.

items.title: La juventud se impone
items.description: Enrique y César son dos amigos estudiantes que sus momentos libres lo dedican a cantar en un café. Con el tiempo llegará la fama y con ésta, la rivalidad. ¿Sobrevivirá la amistad?

items.title: La ley de las pistolas
items.description: El Gavilán es un justiciero que roba a los ricos para ayudar a los pobres de la región. Sin embargo en otra ranchería, una banda a nombre del Gavilán, está haciendo lo mismo pero su metodología es aterradora.

items.title: La marca de Satanás
items.description: Un brutal asesinato conmociona a los habitantes de un pequeño pueblo rural; pero las cosas apenas comienzan cuando varias fuerzas malignas comienzan a plagar la ciudad.

items.title: John Lennon: Plastic Ono Band (Classic Album)
items.description: This documentary dives deep into the making of John Lennon's first post-Beatles solo album, Plastic Ono Band, a fierce and emotional album showcasing some of his most personal songs. Featuring exclusive interviews with Yoko Ono and Ringo Starr.

items.title: Dr. Giggles
items.description: A madman who believes he's a doctor comes to the town where his crazy father was killed, and soon begins murdering people and becoming infatuated with a teenage girl who has a heart condition.

items.title: Conduct Unbecoming
items.description: At a British Regimental party in Colonial India, the widow of Captain Scarlett is assaulted in the garden, and she accuses one of the newly arrived junior Lieutenants of the crime.

items.title: Slaughter In San Francisco [English-Language Version]
items.description: A Chinese-American cop, skilled in martial arts, battles the most powerful criminal gang in San Francisco that is responsible for the death of his partner.

items.title: City Of Industry
items.description: A retired thief swears revenge on the lunatic who murdered his brother and partner, while going on the run with the loot they stole.

items.title: House On Haunted Hill
items.description: A millionaire offers $10,000 to five people who agree to be locked in a large, spooky, rented house overnight with him and his wife.

items.title: La máscara de hierro
items.description: Dos hermanas, una de ellas prisionera en la casa de piedra bajo el yugo inclemente del Vampiro, quien la ha condenado a vivir con una máscara de hierro. La otra hermana hará todo lo posible por rescartarla antes de que sea tarde.

items.title: La mujer murcielago
items.description: La mujer murciélago se enfrenta a un científico loco que quiere crear una nueva raza de luchadores subacuáticos.

items.title: Martín Santos, el llanero
items.description: Martín es un domador de caballos que encuentra petróleo en su propiedad. Blanca es una rica tirana que se casa con Martín para salvar a sus padres de la ruina financiera que los amenaza, pero ella está enamorada de otro.

items.title: La trampa mortal
items.description: Melquíades, un astuto ranchero, se apodera ilegalmente de la hacienda vecina mediante su habilidad para jugar al póquer, lo que conduce a un ciclo de venganza cuando el hijo del dueño regresa años después para buscar justicia.

items.title: Trouble In Mind
items.description: In the fictional Rain City, ex-cop Hawk has just been released from prison after serving hard time. Meanwhile, a young down-on-his-luck father, Coop, and his radiant wife, Georgia, head toward the city with their new baby in search of a new life.

items.title: Mis abuelitas...no más!
items.description: Roque y Remigo son dos personas diferentes, pero uno de ellos usurpa la vida del otro. Ahora está en medio de compromisos, amores y la fortuna oculta de las abuelas Casilda y Paz.

items.title: La venganza de La Sombra
items.description: El hermano del enmascarado La Sombra es asesinado por un grupo de asaltantes, y ahora junto al Zorro Escarlata a jurado tomar venganza.

items.title: México de noche
items.description: Julio, ignorando el tratado de paz de su padre con su enemigo, el gánster Arturo, empieza a operar en su territorio, sin imaginar las fatales consecuencias de sus provocadores actos.

items.title: La Venus de fuego
items.description: Un joven se enamora perdidamente de una mujer a la que llaman La Venus de Fuego y por ella se ve envuelto en un crimen. Lo acusan de asesinato y se ve obligado a huir a un lugar bien alejado.

items.title: Titanic Town
items.description: Set in Belfast, Northern Ireland in 1972, the politically naïve Bernie McPhelimy is trying to bring up a normal family in less than normal surroundings. Her best friend is accidentally shot and killed by the I.R.A.

items.title: Las Señoritas Vivanco
items.description: Dos hermanas solteronas creen que cometer un robo deja de ser considerado como pecado luego de ir a la confesión.

items.title: TNT Jackson
items.description: A young karate expert searches for her brother's killer in Hong Kong.

items.title: Donnie Darko (Director's Cut)
items.description: After narrowly escaping a bizarre accident, a troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a man in a large rabbit suit who manipulates him to commit a series of crimes.

items.title: Nobleza ranchera
items.description: Don Fernando regresa de la capital con sus dos hijas. Pronto se desatará una tragedia en su propio rancho, cuando ellas se disputen el amor de Luis.

items.title: Language Lessons
items.description: A Spanish teacher and her student develop an unexpected friendship.

items.title: La visita que no tocó el timbre
items.description: En la víspera de Año Nuevo, dos hermanos descubren un bebé abandonado en la puerta de su casa. Después de muchas tribulaciones, deciden adoptarlo, pero pronto recibirán una noticia inesperada.

items.title: La zandunga
items.description: En un pequeño pueblo en el Istmo de Tehuantepec, Oaxaca, la joven Lupe se enamora del marino Juancho, pero su ausencia le hace aceptar un compromiso con otro muchacho, desatando una serie de eventos que afectan la comunidad.

items.title: Judgment Night
items.description: Four young friends, while taking a shortcut en route to a local boxing match, witness a brutal murder which leaves them running for their lives.

items.title: Ladronzuela
items.description: Una ladrona huerfana vive en la calle con tres niños que cantan en los camiones y termina en la cárcel por defenderlos.

items.title: Homegrown
items.description: Life is good for Jack, Carter and Harlan, three inept ne'r-do-wells who help run master dope-grower Malcoms flourishing marijuana plantation. But then Malcom is killed by an assailant the naive trio decide to take over the business themselves.

items.title: Las recién casadas
items.description: Una historia que envuelve drama y comedia sobre aquellas pruebas a las que se ven enfrentados dos parejas de recién casados. Secretos revelados y ánimos que se caldean.

items.title: A Hitman in London
items.description: After his last assignment ended with the death of an innocent woman, a hitman's new job in London is compromised when he is overcome with guilt and ends up helping a desperate woman who is caught up in a human trafficking operation.

items.title: Lady Frankenstein
items.description: When Dr. Frankenstein is killed by a monster he created, his daughter and his lab assistant Marshall continue his experiments.

items.title: Day Of The Dead 2: Contagium
items.description: In 1968, in the Ravenside Military Hospital in a military facility in Pennsylvania, the army loses control of an experiment of a lethal bacteriologic weapon that changes the DNA and transforms human beings into zombies.

items.title: Slithis
items.description: Leaked radiation mutates something from the sea into a walking man-eating monster.

items.title: Shaolin Wooden Men [English Subtitled]
items.description: After witnessing the murder of his father, Little Mute trains in Shaolin Temple for revenge and is taught by various teachers, one of which is clandestine.

items.title: A Tale Of Two Cities
items.description: An ex-aristocrat from France and an alcoholic English lawyer find themselves crossing paths and in love with the same woman during the French Revolution.

items.title: Papá en onda
items.description: Ricardo es un hombre de negocios cuyos tres hijos adolescentes viven con su esposa. Esta comedia se centra en las dinámicas familiares entre Ricardo y sus hijos, así como su relación con su amigo Julio, un soltero que viva la vida al máximo.

items.title: Por querer a una mujer
items.description: Un asesino elimina a uno de los hombres que disputan un duelo por el amor de una mujer.

items.title: El mundo loco de los jovenes
items.description: Un muchacho decide irse de su casa y se enfrenta a su padre cuando éste se opone a su amor por la música. Una encantadora historia comienza a tejerse cuando conoce a su profesora de canto.

items.title: El proceso de las señoritas Vivanco
items.description: Teresita insiste en acompañar a Hortensia en la cárcel. Ella se las ingeniará para que la metan presa. El director del penal pone a las Vivanco al abrigo de las burlas de las demás presas y de la dureza de los carceleros.

items.title: El esqueleto de la señora Morales
items.description: Pablo es un taxidermista aburrido de su discapacitada esposa Gloria, quien se niega a darle el divorcio. Aparentemente Gloria se va por un tiempo donde su familia. Pronto saldrá a flote el siniestro secreto de Pablo.

items.title: El revólver sangriento
items.description: Cuando uno nace con el alma de un pistolero, todo lo que uno piensa es matar. Su fiel compañero para esto es un Revolver, pero este es el caso de un REVOLVER SANGRIENTO que no tiene miedo, incluso mientras realiza sus deseos más mortales.

items.title: Lío de faldas
items.description: Cuatro mujeres jóvenes en busca de su independencia, alquilan una casa juntas. Pronto se verán enfrentadas a diversas dificultades que les impide pagar el alquiler, ¿ qué se ingeniarán?

items.title: El sol sale para todos
items.description: Un novillero sufre un accidente durante una tarde de corrida en una plaza pueblerina, siendo testigo su ex amante, quien recuerda su historia al tiempo que reflexiona sobre la naturaleza mortal de su oficio.

items.title: Locos por la televisión
items.description: Los propietarios de clubes nocturnos intentan juntar suficiente dinero para patrocinar un programa de variedades en la televisión para publicitar a sus artistas y su lugar.

items.title: MDMA
items.description: Step into the drug-fueled 1980s in this harrowing and powerful drama based on the true-life experiences of writer/director Angie Wang.

items.title: Ella y yo
items.description: Una joven rica escapa a la ciudad pero se enfrenta a algunos problemas durante su viaje. Ella termina tomando un autobús y conoce a un mujeriego que intenta seducirla.

items.title: Munchies
items.description: An archaeologist finds a strange creature in Peru and takes it home. He dubs the creature a `Munchie', but is unprepared for the ensuing chaos when the beast starts to mutate.

items.title: Saturday The 14th
items.description: A family moves into a house inhabited by scary creatures and a number of close calls ensue.

items.title: Song To Song
items.description: Two intersecting love triangles. Obsession and betrayal set against the music scene in Austin, Texas.

items.title: The Ballad Of Gregorio Cortez
items.description: After he is accused of murdering a lawman in 1901 Texas, a Mexican-American farmer flees and manages to elude a large posse for two weeks before he is finally captured.

items.title: The Big Sleep
items.description: A grizzled American private detective in England investigates a complicated case of blackmail turned murder involving a rich but honest elderly general, his two loose socialite daughters, a pornographer and a gangster.

items.title: The Chosen (1978)
items.description: Robert is in charge of constructing a nuclear power plant in the Middle East. Will it be instrumental in prophecies of Antichrist's apocalypse?

items.title: Esos de Penjamo
items.description: Un ranchero se casa con su prima para que sus herederos puedan quedarse con sus propiedades cuando muera. Al no poder quedar en embarazo, su ambiciosa cuñada toma provecho de la situación.

items.title: Ferias de México
items.description: Tiburón de cartas itinerante con una hija preadolescente adopta a un niño huérfano; los niños crecen y se enamoran. Una vez que deciden casarse, surgen complicaciones.

items.title: Los chiflados del  rock and roll
items.description: Tres bohemios deciden conquistar un aldeano rico con el fin de adquirir los fondos necesarios para salvar su negocio.

items.title: Hay ángeles con espuelas
items.description: Esteban, quien se creía muerto, planea visitar a su familia . Tan pronto como los pobladores reciben la noticia, todos los hombres esconden a sus esposas e hijas, porque Esteban tiene fama de apuesto mujeriego.

items.title: Bystanders
items.description: Abby and her friends attend a frat party, but it turns into a nightmare when they are drugged and hunted for sport. As Abby escapes, a mysterious couple arrives and they're ready to turn the tables on the predators.

items.title: Poker de reinas
items.description: Una comedia musical sobre un grupo de guapas mujeres que deciden entrar en el mundo del espectáculo. Ellas hacen un pacto en el que prometen no involucrarse con hombres. Pero el amor las alcanza y las cosas se complican.

items.title: La fuerza del deseo
items.description: Una joven está en la miseria, y al tener un hijo enfermo del corazón, trata de pedir ayuda a un pintor que fue su amante.

items.title: A Chinese Odyssey: Part 1 - Pandora's Box
items.description: A Monkey King is reincarnated in the inhuman form of Joker, a highwayman oblivious to his original identity and the fact that 500 years earlier, he and his master, the Longevity Monk, were punished and forced to remain human.

items.title: Last Night at Terrace Lanes
items.description: When a bloodthirsty cult invades a bowling alley on its final night of operation, a high schooler on a date from hell, must join forces with her survivalist dad to fend off the crazed murderers.

items.title: Todas mias
items.description: A pesar de estar comprometido con su millonaria novia, Lucas sigue con sus aventuras amorosas y es sorprendido por ella besándose con otra mujer. La condición para perdonarlo es que tome terapia en una cabaña aislado.

items.title: La horripilante bestia humana
items.description: Un médico intenta salvar la vida de su hijo mediante una complicada operación de trasplante de corazón, siendo el donante involuntario un gorila. Eventualmente, el joven se convierte en una violenta bestia híbrida.

items.title: Poker de ases
items.description: Doña Chonita es muy estricta con sus cuatro hijos, Luis, Antonio, David y Pichi, así como con su esposo mujeriego, Lencho. David se enamora de Felisa, una mujer de clase alta, a pesar de que ella está comprometida con Eduardo.

items.title: Pervertida
items.description: Una joven provinciana termina cayendo en las garras de la perdición y la prostitución en Ciudad de México.

items.title: Las mujeres panteras
items.description: Las mujeres pantera son adoradoras de Satanas y en su honor realizan rituales y sacrificios. Las luchadoras les harán frente arriba y abajo del ring.

items.title: Peligros de juventud
items.description: Un grupo de estudiantes enfrenta un enredo amoroso. Uno de ellos, un joven limpiabotas, está perdidamente enamorado de una chica, pero ella ama a otro, quien, a su vez, está interesado en alguien más.

items.title: Por ellas, aunque mal paguen
items.description: Un aristócrata arruinado casa a su hija con un rico ranchero para no caer en la pobreza, sin saber que este es más astuto que ellos y los pone a trabajar duro en el campo.

items.title: Misión cumplida
items.description: Un agente honesto del Ministerio Público tiene una hija estudiando para ser abogada y un hijo que va a la cárcel por ser imprudente.

items.title: Los de abajo
items.description: Liderados por el capitán Anastasio Montañez, el recién formado ejército de campesinos cansados de las injusticias de los federales, toman como código de honor saquear las casas para repartir las riquezas.

items.title: The Base
items.description: An Army intelligence officer (Mark Dacascos) goes undercover to disband an illegal drug ring near the Mexican border.

items.title: La ausente
items.description: Un hombre sufre la pérdida de su esposa, quien ha fallecido en un accidente automovilístico. Existen pruebas que lo llevan a pensar que detrás de todo se esconde un plan criminal.

items.title: March Or Die
items.description: During the 1920s, French Foreign Legion Major William Foster's unit is protecting an archaeological dig, but the discovery of an Arab sacred burial site prompts the angry Arab tribes to attack Foster's small garrison.

items.title: Stripped To Kill
items.description: A female detective gets her cuffs out and goes undercover (and underdressed) at a strip club to snatch the killer of local strippers.

items.title: La joven mancornadora
items.description: Lola se disfraza de hombre para matar a los hermanos Salazar, pero al ver que no es tan sencillo, se convierte en su caporal y trata de enamorarlos para vengarse de ellos.

items.title: Mujeres de teatro
items.description: En la pista de baile de un club nocturno se escucha un disparo: un agente de artistas ha sido asesinado. Ahora, la policía investiga quién pudo cometer el crimen y cuáles fueron sus motivos. Las únicas sospechosas son las trabajadoras del local.

items.title: Café con sabor a mi tierra
items.description: Historia de una familia productora de café, que ve amenazada su cosecha por una terrible plaga y los bajos precios. La muerte del padre los pondrá a prueba y los medirá para ver si una familia unida.

items.title: Rigged: The Voter Suppression Playbook
items.description: America's democracy is threatened. Narrated by Jeffrey Wright, Rigged tells the story of how the principle of "one person, one vote" is being compromised, and how American citizens are fighting back.

items.title: Los hermanos del hierro
items.description: Reynaldo y Martín Del Hierro son testigos del asesinato de su padre por parte de Pascual Velazco. Mientras crecen, son envenenados por el deseo de venganza de su madre, pero una vez que lo consiguen cambiará sus vidas para siempre.

items.title: Mujeres sacrificadas
items.description: Graciela Montero, una inocente estudiante de ballet clásico, descubre que su madre trabaja como cabaretera, una noticia que le cambia la vida para siempre.

items.title: Los pistoleros
items.description: Los hermanos Jiménez y sus aliados lideran operación contra banda de delincuentes que aterroriza la región. Enfrentamientos comienzan a arrojar los primeros saldos mortales, intensificando la lucha por restablecer la paz y el orden en la comunidad.

items.title: Un macho de mujer
items.description: Ramón, después de trabajar, no tiene reparos en irse de parranda, provocando el hartazgo de su esposa. Un día un personaje enigmático le regala un amuleto que ocasiona un hechizo intercambiando los roles familiares de ambos.

items.title: Hell House LLC.
items.description: Five years after an unexplained malfunction causes the death of 15 tour-goers and staff on the opening night of a Halloween haunted house tour, a documentary crew travels back to the scene of the tragedy to find out what really happened.

items.title: Préstame tu cuerpo
items.description: Leonor es una estrella de baile quien muere en un accidente en altamar. Al no poder evitar su muerte, su ángel de la guarda deberá conseguirle un cuerpo donde reencarnar.

items.title: Hopscotch
items.description: A disgruntled CIA agent quits after office politics confine him to a desk job. He heads to Europe, where he links up with a former lover. All goes smoothly until the CIA agent writes a tell-all autobiography.

items.title: Knight Of Cups
items.description: A writer indulging in all that Los Angeles and Las Vegas have to offer, undertakes a search for love and self via a series of adventures with six different women.

items.title: The Bodyguard from Beijing [English Subtitled]
items.description: A corrupt businessman commits a murder and the only witness is the girlfriend of another businessman with close connections to the Chinese government.

items.title: Una fiesta inolvidable
items.description: Unos jóvenes deciden hacer una fiesta en la casa donde años atrás sucedió el suicidio de una mujer. En la misma fiesta, la hija de aquella mujer, inicia un plan de venganza contra los hombres que provocaron el suicido.

items.title: Plots with a View
items.description: A woman, whose husband is cheating on her, and an undertaker, who has been in love with her since their childhood, decide to fake her death so they can be together.

items.title: The Way Out
items.description: Pizza guy Alex, aspiring singer with a troubled past, inherits home after father's death. Against advice, he houses manipulative roommate Shane, a fighter who leads Alex down a perilous path risking sobriety and lives.

items.title: Pueblito
items.description: Una maestra persuade a un ingeniero para construir una escuela en su pueblo, pero enfrentan la corrupción del alcalde, quien, a pesar de que el ingeniero salva a su hijo, se opone; los habitantes deciden seguir adelante con su plan de construcción.

items.title: Three Businessmen
items.description: Two art dealers become involved in discussion and argument as they search the world for a mutually acceptable restaurant.

items.title: Un niñero para Navidad
items.description: Celeste puede haber encontrado el niñero perfecto para su sobrina y el amor navideño perfecto para ella misma.

items.title: Yakuza Wolf 2
items.description: Attacking Asao Uchida's lonely, clifftop mansion in no-holds barred massacre.

items.title: Puerto de tentación
items.description: Una cabaretera ayuda a un hombre herido y ambos se enamoran, sin imaginar que juntos enfrentarían la tragedia.

items.title: Reportaje
items.description: Absurdas y extravagantes aventuras resultan, cuando un hombre ofrece una gran recompensa a la periodista que sea capaz de encontrar la mejor noticia a vísperas de la celebración de Año Nuevo.

items.title: Revolver en guardia
items.description: Es la historia de un ranchero que, en su lecho de muerte, le confiesa a su hijo la existencia de otro hijo. Ahora, depende de ellos decidir si se quieren en sus vidas.

items.title: Rondalla
items.description: Una mujer violada (Alicia Neira) se dispone a rehacer su vida con otro hombre (Luis Aguilar), pero el bandido que la poseyó (Enrique Zambrano) se lo obstaculiza. Solamente queda la venganza, el dolor, y el amor eterno en una pelicula llena de accion.

items.title: Yakuza Wolf
items.description: The son of a murder crime boss exacts his revenge by pitting two rival clans against each other.

items.title: Dylan Dog: Dead of Night
items.description: The adventures of supernatural private investigator, Dylan Dog, who seeks out the monsters of the Louisiana bayou in his signature red shirt, black jacket, and blue jeans.

items.title: Warlords Of The 21st Century
items.description: A biker running on chicken-made methane fights an outlaw whose battle-truck guzzles fuel.

items.title: Acá las tortas (Los hijos de los ricos)
items.description: Don Chente y Dolores son un matrimonio que dirige una modesta pero exitosa tortería. Cuando sus hijos regresan tras terminar sus estudios en el extranjero, deberán lidiar con sus refinados gustos y constantes solicitudes económicas.

items.title: Snowbound for Christmas
items.description: When a snowstorm traps a new marketing exec and her boss at a resort, they realize there may be more to their relationship than business.

items.title: Alazán y enamorado
items.description: Un ranchero con temple debe lidiar con que su caballo se ha enamorado de Lady Godiva, la yegua de su vecina, una mujer fuerte y decidida. Mientras buscan una solución para el romance de sus caballos, entre ellos también surgirá el amor.

items.title: Aventura en Río
items.description: Alicia sufre amnesia en las calles de Río de Janeiro. Mientras tanto, su esposo, un respetable médico mexicano, la cree muerta. Ella se relaciona con un gánster y acaba trabajando en un cabaré. Pronto, la verdad comenzará a revelarse.

items.title: No Maps For These Territories
items.description: Follows author and cyberpunk pioneer William Gibson, on a digital North American road trip.

items.title: The Battery
items.description: The personalities of two former baseball players clash as they traverse the rural back roads of a post-plague New England teeming with the undead.

items.title: Las canciones unidas
items.description: Los delegados a una conferencia internacional deberán decidir sobre un 'Canto Unido', capturando las tradiciones y características culturas de los países participantes. Un muestra de arte sin precedentes!

items.title: La Cabeza De Pancho Villa (LAS)
items.description: En sus últimos resoplos de vida, un hombre entrega una caja a sus amigos, pidiéndoles protegerla con su propia vida. Un grupo de forajidos anda tras la caja, lo que desatará una pugna sanguinaria.

items.title: La rebelión de los colgados
items.description: Un grupo de trabajadores rebeldes del campamento maderero de la selva mexicana se insurrecciona ante condiciones inhumanas de trabajo. Luchan por justicia y mejores condiciones, desafiando la opresión en búsqueda de dignidad y derechos laborales.

items.title: Las puertas del presidio
items.description: Martín quiere renunciar a su trabajo y comenzar su propia empresa después de casarse con María Elena. En un ataque de ira, el jefe de Martín roba su dinero y asegura que él mismo lo ha robado. Martín es arrestado y encarcelado.

items.title: Los resbalosos
items.description: En en pueblo ranchero llamado Rio Mojado, llegan dos vaqueros para apostar, robar y enamorar a las mujeres de la localidad.

items.title: A la orilla de un palmar
items.description: La Fierecilla Domada de Shakespeare es la base argumental de esta película. La acción y los personajes se transladan a un pequeño pueblo rural de la costa mexicana y la acción se adereza con números musicales basados en el folklore local.

items.title: La momia Azteca
items.description: En la antigua Mesoamérica, Popoca es maldecido a la inmortalidad para proteger la pirámide donde Xóchitl está enterrada. En el presente, el Dr. Almada descubre que su novia es la reencarnación de Xóchitl.

items.title: Avalanche
items.description: The vacationers at a winter wonderland struggle to survive after an avalanche of snow crashes into their ski resort. Their holiday then turns into a game of survival.

items.title: Blood Ties
items.description: An armed hate group hunts a clan of Los Angeles vampires (Patrick Bauchau, Harley Venton, Jason London) who prefer to be called Carpathians.

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Eegah
items.description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira celebrates the achievements of "Eegah" (or lack thereof) by honoring the film at the Elvie Awards.

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Gamera, Super Monster
items.description: With the intention of conquering Earth, the evil alien Zanon unleashes the biggest threat Gamera's ever faced! Tasked with defeating each of his former adversaries again, Gamera and the Spacewomen are the world's only hope against total enslavement.

items.title: Silent Night, Deadly Night (Unrated Cut)
items.description: Little Billy witness his parents getting killed by Santa after being warned by his senile grandpa that Santa punishes those who are naughty. Now Billy is 18, and out of the orphanage, and he has just become Santa, himself.

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Don't Look In The Basement
items.description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. While hosting "Don't Look in the Basement," Elvira hears radio reports of a deranged killer on the loose in her neighborhood.

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Frankenstein's Castle Of Freaks
items.description: The count (Rossano Brazzi) recruits a dwarf (Michael Dunn) and others to help him put a brain in the body of a brute.

items.title: In Sickness and in Health
items.description: A soon-to-be-married couple facing a potentially life-altering dilemma.

items.title: From This Day Forward
items.description: "From This Day Forward" is a story of trust and expectations. As a married couple deals with baggage from the past, a newly-engaged couple deals with what the future might hold.

items.title: Comeback Dad
items.description: A man tries to reconnect with his estranged daughter.

items.title: Dirty Love
items.description: Klutzy, but beautiful Rebecca catches her boyfriend cheating, she dives into dating guided by friends & a psychics vision. Every guy is a disaster, except for her shy, sweet friend John. But will she realize love has been right in front of her all along?

items.title: A Modern Affair
items.description: When Grace, a high-powered executive, tracks down and falls for her anonymous sperm donor (Stanley Tucci), she's left with a choice: keep the baby's parentage a secret or reveal the truth, even if it means ruining a budding romance?

items.title: Una golfa
items.description: Diana es echada del cabaré donde trabaja. Luis, un músico, la aloja en su casa sin imaginar las consecuencias de su decisión.

items.title: Swap
items.description: A young couple is lured into the clutches of a bloodthirsty 500-year-old vampire; the exotic stranger tries to persuade them to swap partners and join his kind.

items.title: Rosauro Castro
items.description: García Mata, funcionario del gobierno, viaja a un pequeño pueblo mexicano para investigar el asesinato de Cardozo, candidato a la alcaldía y enemigo del "Cacique" Rosauro Castro, quien gobierna con mano de hierro.

items.title: Hollywood Boulevard
items.description: A Midwestern ingenue (Candice Rialson) moves to Hollywood and rivals a B-movie queen (Mary Woronov) in low-budget quickies.

items.title: Queen of Hearts
items.description: Fed up with unfaithful and abusive men, a woman begins targeting them for death. A female cop chasing the killer falls prey to an abusive man herself'

items.title: Terremoto en Guatemala
items.description: Tras el devastador terremoto de 1976 en Guatemala (7.6 Richter), se destaca la historia de amor y sacrificio de una pareja recién casada, víctimas del desastre. Un relato conmovedor sobre la fuerza del compromiso en medio de la tragedia.

items.title: Santo contra los jinetes del terror
items.description: Después de que un grupo de leprosos violentos se escapan de un sanatorio, robando varias granjas, los residentes de la ciudad exigen al sheriff que tome acción. Mientras tanto, un criminal local, une fuerzas con los leprosos a cometer aún más robos.

items.title: Santo en el museo de cera
items.description: El enmascarado de plata debe investigar extraños secuestros cometidos por el Dr. Karol, quien utiliza a sus víctimas para crear un ejército de muñecos de cera.

items.title: Santo en la venganza de la momia
items.description: Santo se une a una expedición en busca de las ruinas indígenas Opalche. En el viaje lo acompaña unos exploradores. Pronto se encuentran la tumba momificada de Nonoc. Al entrar en la tumba, serán maldecidos por los espíritus que habitan en ella.

items.title: Santo y Blue Demon contra Dr. Frankenstein
items.description: Santo y Blue Demon se unen con unos detectives para detener al nieto del Dr. Frankenstein, quien fragua un diabólico y macabro plan.

items.title: 9 Dead
items.description: I have brought the nine of you here for a reason. Your survival depends on you figuring out what that reason is. I will return every ten minutes and kill one of you until you figure out why I have brought you here, or until you are all dead.

items.title: You Picked the Wrong One
items.description: A woman is kidnapped and manipulates and outsmarts the kidnappers to gain her freedom.

items.title: A Royal Surprise
items.description: When Riley's boyfriend, Mandla, invites her to South Africa to meet his family, she is shocked to discover that he is a prince. The news puts Riley's trust in Mandla in jeopardy, and he must do what he can to win her love back.

items.title: All Hallows Eve Trickster
items.description: Lost on Halloween, a traveler discovers an eerie gas station and family of degenerate, devilish creatures.

items.title: Al caer la tarde
items.description: Un hombre de origen humilde enriquecido a traves del trabajo duro, corteja a la hija de un terrateniente arruinado. Él le propone casamiento y así recuperar su posición económica y social, pero ella lo rechaza.

items.title: Bad Twin
items.description: THE BAD TWIN: Jen Burgess is estranged from her sinister sister Cassie, but when Cassie reappears and attacks Jen she is sent into psychiatric treatment while her disturbed twin daughters (15) are sent to live with Jen.

items.title: Kit Carson
items.description: Indian fighter, trapper, and frontier scout Kit Carson leads a wagon train of settlers from Fort Bridger, along the Oregon Trail through Shoshone territory, to California, which plans to secede from Mexico.

items.title: Asesinatos accidentales: unas vacaciones para morir
items.description: Mike Fallon está de regreso y debe vencer a los mejores asesinos del mundo, para proteger al hijo de un jefe de la mafia, salvar la vida de su único amigo y reavivar su relación con su figura paterna.

items.title: Fire on the Hill: The Cowboys of South Central LA
items.description: A critically-acclaimed documentary about three Black cowboys living in Compton and South LA who find purpose, hope, and freedom through the cowboy lifestyle.

items.title: Stolen Seas
items.description: A chilling exploration of the Somali pirate phenomenon which will force you to rethink everything you thought you knew about pirates.

items.title: Unlawful Entry
items.description: A burglar holds a knife to Karen's throat while her husband does nothing. The couple ends up befriending the cop that comes. The friendship ends when the cop beats up the culprit. Karen isn't ready to end it. Things get ugly with the cop.

items.title: In the Company of Kings
items.description: 8 former boxing World Champs come together to talk about race, struggle, victory, defeat & picking yourself up off the canvas.

items.title: All Over the Guy
items.description: While the flame of Jackie and Brett's attraction intensifies, Eli and Tom, the unlikely pair they attempt to bring together, appear destined to spiral out of love rather than make any sort of progress toward becoming a genuine couple.

items.title: The Call of the Wild
items.description: 1898, Alaska: John Thornton and his partner, Pete, make deliveries to mining outposts using a sled-dog team led by Buck, a prized sled dog that is targeted by crooked prospectors. Over time, Buck is increasingly drawn to life in the wild.

items.title: 2B Honest
items.description: Murder, love, insurance policies. On the run from the law, Kato Roberts stumbles into a secret community that throws him into a world of chaos.

items.title: Fuga de Alcatraz
items.description: Alcatraz es la prisión más segura de su tiempo. Se cree que nadie puede escapar de ella, hasta que tres osados hombres hacen un intento posiblemente exitoso de escapar de una de las prisiones más infames del mundo.

items.title: Susana
items.description: Susana escapa de un reformatorio y llega a la hacienda de Guadalupe. Repuesta de sus heridas, la paz de esta familia se verá amenazada. Sus coqueteos y falsa inocencia encenderán la pasión de los varones de la hacienda.

items.title: Revelaciones
items.description: La esposa de un investigador universitario cree que su casa en el lago de Vermont está embrujada por un fantasma, o que está perdiendo la cabeza.

items.title: The Cold Father
items.description: A 55-year-old man desperate for truth uses a lie-detection machine to interrogate all the suspects involve in the daughter's disappearance, all while battling his inner demons and uncovering hidden secrets.

items.title: La novia de un soldado
items.description: Este conmovedor drama, narra la trágica historia real de Barry Winchell, un soldado del ejército de EE. UU. que fue asesinado por un compañero soldado por su relación con una corista transgénero.

items.title: Eternally Yours
items.description: Anita Halstead, swept off her feet by magician Arturo, finds the results less than magical.

items.title: Firepower
items.description: A merc is hired by the FBI to track down a powerful recluse criminal. A woman is also trying to track him down for her own personal vendetta.

items.title: The Cry Baby Killer
items.description: A teenage boy panics and takes hostages when he thinks he's committed murder. Jack Nicholson's film debut as the juvenile delinquent.

items.title: The Crystal Ball
items.description: Toni Gerard lands in New York with 38 cents to her name and is befriended by fortune-teller Madame Zenobia and a neighboring shooting gallery owner. Toni is smitten with Brad, a lawyer/suitor to Jo, one of Zenobia's "clients."

items.title: The Romantic Englishwoman
items.description: A marriage crisis between a writer and his wife leads her to flee to Germany and eventually return with another man, through whom the writer is going to overcome his writer's block.

items.title: Tomorrow
items.description: A lonely farmer takes in a pregnant woman and looks after her. After she gives birth, tragedy strikes.

items.title: Used People
items.description: At her husband's funeral, Pearl (Shirley MacLaine), Jewish mother of two divorced and antagonistic daughters, meets an old Italian friend (Marcello Mastroianni) of her husband, whose advice years previously had stopped the husband leaving home.

items.title: Winter Kills
items.description: The younger brother of an assassinated US President is led down a rabbit hole of conspiracies and dead ends after learning of a man claiming to be the real shooter.

items.title: King Kong Lives
items.description: Kong falls from the twin towers and he appears to be alive. However, his heart is failing, so it's replaced with an artificial one. All is well until he senses that there's a female Kong somewhere out there and escapes wreaking havoc.

items.title: Naked Weapon
items.description: 40 13 y.o. girls are kidnapped and the next 6 years forcefully trained to be sexy assassins. The survivors go on to be top int'l assassins known as China dolls. A CIA agent's on track of them.

items.title: Baby
items.description: A tragic tale of an Asian youth's gang life in South East Los Angeles, set during the mid 80's to the early 90s.

items.title: Black Conflux
items.description: The seemingly separate lives of an anxious, disillusioned teen girl and a troubled, alienated man converge fatefully in this haunting exploration of womanhood, isolation, and toxic masculinity, set in 1980s Newfoundland.

items.title: DARKSTAR: Riffed by The Mads of Mystery Science Theater 3000
items.description: The captain of a derelict spaceship awakens after 300 years in suspended animation with no memory of his identity or his mission. He must find clues and solve mysteries to recover his past and save his ship.

items.title: Rose Gold
items.description: Fighting to keep her family together, Trina (Crystal The Doll) is introduced to the underground world of drug trafficking. She enlists her two dancer friends to become transporters for the suave T Fame.

items.title: Gigoló americano
items.description: Un acompañante masculino de Los Ángeles, que atiende principalmente a una clientela mayor, está acusado de un asesinato que no cometió.

items.title: Gigi X MJ
items.description: This film explores LGBTQIA+ culture through the lens of the Millennial generation.

items.title: House of Pride 2021
items.description: Shea Diamond, Laganja Estranja, Sam Tsui and House of Balmain shine in the new show Revry Presents House of Pride Brought to You By McDonald's and hosted by Manila Luzon, Ryan Mitchell and Shar Jossell.

items.title: Loss Prevention
items.description: A bar owner and his daughter get caught up in a cat-and-mouse game of corporate espionage.

items.title: Outrave!
items.description: OUTRAVE focuses on the queer pioneers and shining stars of Toronto's vibrant rave scene.

items.title: Desde las gradas: Pelé
items.description: Pelé un ídolo completo, como ser humano y atleta excepcional. Más allá de sus logros en los campos de juegos, ha tocado y tocará millones de corazones a través de un legado que permanecerá por siempre.

items.title: Tintanson Cruzoe
items.description: Tin-Tán Cruz, un taxista acusado de robarle dinero a los turistas, se escapa a una isla donde los hombres son prisioneros del dios Mio Mao y las mujeres son gobernadas por el malvado rey, Soleto.

items.title: Steam! The Musical
items.description: A musical thriller about the conductor of a tourist steam train who deserts his boyfriend for a wild night with a real life outlaw.

items.title: Amor a ritmo de go go
items.description: Dos muchachos llegan a la gran ciudad con la intención de conquistarla. En una discoteca Go-Go conocen a Lupe y ahí comienza la acción y la clásica música de Rock & Roll.

items.title: Home Of The Seals: On Brittany's Wild Coast
items.description: Some have called the coast of Brittany the Riviera of the North. The many coves with white sandy beaches appear to be idyllic, but the Atlantic here in the northwest of France is rarely calm.

items.title: Last Devils
items.description: Tasmanian Devils are the world's largest carnivorous marsupials and they are only found in Tasmania.

items.title: Las acacias
items.description: Rubén es un experimentado camionero a punto de comenzar un viaje por una nueva ruta: la relación con una hija.

items.title: Gafas amarillas
items.description: Luego de una separación, Julia se muda a un frío departamento donde enfrenta los conflictos cotidianos de la soledad. Julia encuentra un nuevo comienzo cuando tiene una aventura con Darío, un atractivo mesero con ínfulas de poeta.

items.title: Hermosa juventud
items.description: Natalia y Carlos, son dos jóvenes enamorados de 20 años, que luchan por sobrevivir en la España actual. Para ganar algo de dinero deciden rodar una película porno amateur. El nacimiento de su hija, Julia, será el principal motor de sus cambios.

items.title: Lobsters - Knights Of The Deep
items.description: The knights of the deep are on the move; almost no part of their bodies is without armor. Like medieval warriors, these fighters are well armed – not with sword and shield, but with scissors and forceps.

items.title: Magic Lakes
items.description: At 117 square kilometres, the Müritz is the largest lake on German territory, but it's far from the only one in the north east of the country. Even the Mecklenburg Lake District, between Waren and Feldberg, contains around 2000 lakes alone.

items.title: Mantises - Masters Of Deception
items.description: They are killers. They kill with unbelievable precision. They fight Kung Fu style and are seen in Japan as a symbol of vigilance - the mantises.

items.title: Nyiragongo, Journeys To The Center Of The Earth
items.description: In the east of the Democratic Republic of Congo, on the border with Rwanda, in the heart of the Nyiragongo volcano, the largest lava lake on the planet is boiling.

items.title: Santo y Mantequilla Nápoles en la venganza de La Llorona
items.description: Santo, un luchador y héroe, ayuda a un profesor y su hermosa sobrina a encontrar la pista de un tesoro que se utilizará para una noble causa.

items.title: A Chinese Odyssey: Part 2 - Cinderella
items.description: The convoluted continuation of the adventures of the time-traveling, now-human Monkey King, who attempts to fulfill his divine destiny.

items.title: The Grove
items.description: The Grove, about one church, in a small Appalachian town, that dared to believe, that love is love.

items.title: Wild Medicine - Animals' Superpowers
items.description: Animals are true superheroes. They have superpowers that we humans can only dream of. Some grow back their limbs after they have lost them. Others let huge bones grow on their heads at a rapid speed.

items.title: Wild Sardinia
items.description: Sardinia has always been the epitome of pure wilderness, an emerald of volcanic origin in the Mediterranean. 1900 metres of coastline and an infinite maze of offshore islands.

items.title: Wild Skagerrak
items.description: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region.

items.title: Spark!
items.description: In this original musical comedy, a bisexual twenty-something guy who's addicted to dating apps enlists his roommate—who's secretly in love with him—to swipe for him.

items.title: Proud In A Pandemic
items.description: An unflinching & inspiring feature documentary that examines the experiences of 22 Los Angeles community members & leaders through this historic time and the lessons learned from their forebears of the HIV/AIDS pandemic & COVID – 19.

items.title: House of Pride 2022
items.description: Pride has never been this fun with the 2nd annual “House of Pride”– only on Revry!

items.title: I'll Be Right There
items.description: Life's complicated for Wanda (Edie Falco). Between a pregnant daughter, a wayward son, an absent ex-husband, and a hypochondriac mother, she must figure out how to keep her family together while finding her own love and happiness.

items.title: Justicia verdadera: justicia letal
items.description: El equipo de Kane (Steven Seagal) se enfrenta a un grupo neonazi llamado “New Hope” mientras intentan influir en el voto del público en las elecciones municipales.

items.title: Justicia verdadera: Hermandad
items.description: Seattle se ve atrapada en el fuego cruzado de una guerra de bandas entre la mafia japonesa, la Yakuza, y la peligrosa banda mexicana MS-13.

items.description: Elijah Kane y su duro equipo siguen la pista de un meticuloso asesino que practica la «Magia Negra» en el submundo de los clubes de striptease de vagabundos.

items.description: Una ama de casa suburbana felizmente casada publica un mensaje falso en las redes sociales diciendo que se está divorciando, solo para ver cuál de sus amigas intentará robarle el marido.

items.description: Two classic RiffTrax shorts, Boy of India Rama and His Elephant & The Creeps Machine. This video is a parody that combines the original movie with comical commentary from Mike, Kevin, and Bill of RiffTrax.

items.description: Una científica necesita la sangre de Santo para preparar el suero de la eterna juventud. Ella contará con la ayuda de un viejo monstruo para su malévolo propósito.

items.title: Vampiros de coyoacan
items.description: Los protagonistas descubren que sus oponentes han muerto de una manera horrible. La persona responsable es Baron Von Bradock, de Transylvania, quien tiene un ejército de vampiros en su castillo. Los luchadores se unen para matar a Baron Von Bradcock.

items.title: Sex And Zen
items.description: A man marries a beautiful wife, but decides to go out and experience as many sexual conquests as possible, with unusual and often hilarious results. Meanwhile, his wife is forced to enter a brothel and work as a prostitute.

items.title: Financing Terror: The Real Cost of Oil
items.description: Financial warfare has been used to starve terrorism post-9/11. Amid successes, there were setbacks in Iraq and Syria stymied by foreign policy errors.

items.title: Follow Your Nose: The Amazing Science of Smell
items.description: How do we perceive smells? What messages do they contain? How do they alter and influence our brain and behavior? Scientists have surprising answers.

items.title: Hunan: The Other World of Avatar
items.description: China's Zhangjiajie National Park attracted James Cameron, who came seeking inspiration for his film Avatar.

items.title: In the Mind of Plants
items.description: Can plants sense touch, feel pain, dream, and even remember? Some scientists are convinced plants have surpassed animals on their evolutionary paths.

items.title: Kalahari: The Flooded Desert

items.title: Eagles: Kings Of The Skies
items.description: Whether in Alaska or in the Dolomites, eagles are generally seen as Kings of the skies. This film devotes itself on the one hand to the bald eagle, the heraldic bird of the United States and on the other, the Golden Eagle, Europe's largest predatory bird.

items.title: La guerra de Logan: destino y honor
items.description: Un ranger del ejército se infiltra en una familia mafiosa haciéndose pasar por sicario. Junto a su tío, planea vengarse de los asesinos que acabaron con toda su familia cuando era joven.

items.title: Tom Petty: Somewhere You Feel Free

items.title: Los inquilinos

items.title: Somos calentura

items.title: The Adventures of America's Horses

items.title: Plague Town

items.description: Un acercamiento íntimo a las Patronas, un grupo de mujeres mexicanas que desde 1995 prepara comida diariamente y la lanza a los inmigrantes que viajan sobre el tren de carga al que llaman "la Bestia", que viaja rumbo a Estados Unidos.

items.title: Zona mortal (LAS)
items.description: Después de un accidente vehicular, un hombre se despierta amnésico. Mientras busca por ayuda, solo encuentra cadáveres. Luego descubrirá la horrible verdad, cualquier ser viviente que esté a 50 pies de radio de él morirá instantáneamente.

items.title: Navidad en las altas cumbres
items.description: Un gerente de ventas de Nueva York viaja a las remotas Tierras Altas Escocesas en Navidad para adquirir un perfume de edición limitada de un conde que se prepara para su bola anual, pero inesperadamente encuentra amor en su lugar.

items.title: Rifftrax Shorts: Let's Pretend: Magic Sneakers
items.description: Two classic RiffTrax shorts, “Reading from Now On” and “Beginning Responsibility, Broken Bookshop.” This feature is a parody, combining the original movie with comedic commentary from Mike, Kevin, and Bill at RiffTrax.

items.title: RiffTrax Shorts: Setting Up a Room
items.description: Setting Up a Room is a 27-minute parody about two women setting up a kindergarten classroom. It contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin, and Bill from RiffTrax (formerly of MST3K).

items.title: A Better Life
items.description: Demián Bichir earned a 2011 Best Actor Oscar® nomination for his memorable portrayal of an undocumented L.A. gardener struggling to keep his son out of gangs.

items.title: Juego final
items.description: Un agente del servicio secreto (Cuba Gooding Jr.) y una reportera (Angie Harmon) investigan la conspiración detrás del asesinato del presidente de los Estados Unidos.

items.title: El hombre del presidente 2: misión especial
items.description: Un especialista en contraterrorismo es asignado por el Presidente para rastrear a un terrorista que se sospecha que planea detonar un dispositivo nuclear en los EE. UU.

items.title: Acción directa
items.description: Frank Gannon, un policía veterano, es perseguido por sus compañeros policías al descubrir que traicionó a la hermandad y expuso ante los agentes federales su corrupción a gran escala.

items.title: Máxima venganza
items.description: En la línea de TRAINING DAY, STREET KINGS y AMERICAN GANGSTER, Curtis 50 CENT Jackson, Val Kilmer y Vinnie Jones protagonizan una nueva película de acción llena de venganza entre policías buenos y malos.

items.title: Elefante blanco
items.description: Un asesino es contratado por un hombre de negocios para vengar el asesinato de su hija por parte de traficantes de esclavos blancos en Tailandia.

items.title: Cuando los hijos pecan
items.description: Una mujer con un pasado sospechoso quiere rehacer su vida casándose con un hombre honesto, pero los secretos que guarda amenazan con salir a la luz.

items.title: Stand-In
items.description: A New York bank plans to sell a Hollywood studio at a big loss. But the head accountant is suspicious and goes to investigate. He finds chicanery, romance, and help to save the studio.

items.title: Highlander: The Source
items.description: The world is falling into chaos and Duncan MacLeod, the Highlander, roams a crumbling city and remembers happier times before the love of his life left.

items.title: Ditched
items.description: Desperate to escape an overturned ambulance, a group of paramedics are trapped with violent prisoners. The group quickly discover that they are the victims of an ambush with the perpetrators hunting them down one by one.

items.title: Man-Thing
items.description: A young detective sent to a rural town to investigate a series of gruesome killings soon learns that its dark past may be to blame.

items.title: Drive Back
items.description: A couple returning from their engagement party must escape a sinister and seemingly endless road.

items.title: Hatchet III
