items.description: In this action packed slasher, murderous Victor Crowley takes on an entire police department, paramedic team, and heavily armed S.W.A.T. unit, forcing Marybeth and the troops into an epic showdown.

items.title: Level 16
items.description: Level 16 is a dystopian thriller about a group of teen girls who are trapped in a mysterious and cruel boarding school that hides a dark secret.

items.title: Stake Land II
items.description: After his family is murdered, Martin ventures into the American badlands in search of Mister, hoping to reteam with him against a new Vamp threat.

items.title: The Tiger Rising
items.description: In this heartwarming adaptation of the New York Times best-selling book, 10-year-old Rob Horton (Christian Convery) discovers a caged tiger in the woods and his imagination runs wild.

items.title: Return Of The Living Dead III
items.description: A young man uses a secret government chemical and program to reanimate his dead girlfriend, and helps her as she consumes the only thing that will nourish her—human brains.

items.title: Return Of The Living Dead: Rave To The Grave
items.description: A college student creates a drug called Z and sells it on campus, inadvertently resurrecting the living dead, who wreak havoc at a Halloween rave.

items.title: Después de la tormenta
items.description: Rosa y su marido, Melchor, trabajan como encargados del faro en la Isla de Lobos. Cuando Melchor sale a navegar junto a su gemelo durante una tormenta, solo un hermano regresa, afirmando que es Rafael.

items.title: Hitler y yo: reflexiones sobre el mal
items.description: Un documental emocionante que explora las preguntas que surgieron en la realización de la miniserie: "Hitler: el reinado del mal"

items.title: De cocula es el Mariachi
items.description: El cantante Roberto viaja con su exnovia a Estados Unidos, donde luego se entera de que ella se ha casado con Jimmy, el empresario de la industria musical. Los celos de Jimmy lo llevarán a arruinar la carrera de Roberto.

items.title: Siempre tuya
items.description: Ramón y Soledad, campesinos zacatecanos, emigran a la Ciudad de México en busca de una vida mejor. Pronto, Ramón triunfa como cantante, mientras Soledad sufre al ver cómo la fama lo transforma.

items.title: La conspiración del diablo
items.description: Un culto satánico roba la Sábana Santa de Turín para fines malvados.

items.title: Rifftrax Shorts: David and Hazel: A Story in Communication
items.description: Let Mike, Kevin, and Bill invite David and Hazel into your home. This feature parodies the original movie by combining it with comedic commentary from Mike, Kevin, and Bill of RiffTrax (formerly of MST3K).

items.title: Baby Assassins 2
items.description: After the agency suspends its top assassins, aspiring hitmen decide to eliminate them—leading to a lightning-fast showdown between trained killers.

items.title: Maniac Cop III: Código de silencio
items.description: El policía zombi, el oficial Matt Cordell (Robert Z'Dar, Tango & Cash), en su tercera vuelta desde más allá de la tumba, busca una novia: alguien amable, tierna y no muerta.

items.title: Cuarenta noches
items.description: "Cuarenta noches" es una historia profunda sobre una de las figuras más conocidas, cuestionadas y misteriosas de la historia de la humanidad.

items.title: College
items.description: To reconcile with his girlfriend, a bookish college student tries to become an athlete.

items.title: Sombra verde
items.description: Con el propósito de utilizar raíces de barbasco en la producción de cortisona, una empresa farmacéutica envía a un científico a investigar las posibilidades de explotación en Veracruz.

items.title: The Colony (2021)
items.description: A female astronaut shipwrecked on a long-decimated Earth must decide the fate of the wasteland’s remaining populace in this sci-fi thriller set in the not-so distant future.

items.title: Tigre
items.description: Después de que su madre lo abandonara de niño por un amante, buscó consuelo en un tigre bebé. Pero cuando se convierta en una bestia salvaje, tendrán que hacer lo que sea necesario para sobrevivir.

items.title: Sor alegría
items.description: Una mujer que vive una vida de fiesta descubre la miseria que existe en las zonas pobres de la ciudad y decide hacerse monja.

items.title: The Bay
items.description: From Oscar®-winning Director Barry Levinson and the producers of Paranormal Activity and Insidious comes a terrifying story of a town hit by a parasitic outbreak.

items.title: New Normal
items.description: In 2024 Seoul, dining alone becomes a sinister ritual for six strangers, plunging them into a world where loneliness breeds unimaginable horror.

items.title: City Cops
items.description: Martial arts adventure about a tough FBI cop (Cynthia Rothrock) high-kicking her way to the final showdown with a Chinese Mafia boss.

items.title: Ransomed
items.description: A young diplomat is assigned the task of carrying the ransom money to rescue an abducted diplomat in Lebanon, and a local taxi driver accidently gets involved in the mission.

items.title: Bart Got a Room
items.description: While Danny's father and mother independently search for love, Danny is on his own desperate quest to find a prom date.

items.title: Infalible
items.description: Un ingenioso trío de ladrones disfrazados debe luchar por sus vidas y el botín cuando un verdadero criminal maestro los chantajea para que planifiquen y ejecuten un atraco de $20 millones. Protagonizada por Ryan Reynolds.

items.title: Viento negro
items.description: Un hombre recientemente separado de su esposa está a cargo de establecer una nueva vida a través del desierto en condiciones difíciles. Las cosas se complican aún más cuando su hijo 'protegido' llega con ganas de conectarse

items.title: Steamboat Bill, Jr.
items.description: The effete son of a cantankerous riverboat captain comes to join his father's crew.

items.title: Y mañana serán mujeres
items.description: Una estudiante de posgrado acepta un trabajo de verano como ama de casa, acompañante de un grupo de chicas adolescentes que están de vacaciones en una villa de campo.

items.title: Amorcito Corazón
items.description: Rosita, una dama de ciudad, finge un embarazo para complacer a su esposo y calmar sus celos antes de que él se marche al campo. Todo se complica cuando regresa y ella debe presentarle a su “primogénito”.

items.title: Guerra de pasiones
items.description: En este drama de la Segunda Guerra Mundial, un soldado británico (Gabriel Byrne, Los sospechosos de siempre) se enamora de una mujer francesa que es buscada por la resistencia por crímenes contra su país.

items.title: Horny Teenagers Must Die!
items.description: A group of high school graduates travel to a cabin in the woods to celebrate and party, only to be picked off one by one by a demented psychopath who kills with farm tools and sex toys.

items.title: F/X 2: Ilusiones mortales
items.description: El técnico de efectos especiales Rollie Tyler se vuelve a meter en problemas cuando acepta ayudar a un policía a atrapar a un asesino en serie. Con la ayuda de un policía retirado y su propia magia cinematográfica, Tyler derrota a los malos.

items.title: Robot Jox
items.description: En esta emocionante aventura de ciencia ficción no hará falta soñar con batallas de robots, ya que las disputas del mundo se resuelven con grandes robots de combate. Pero se masca la traición y la tragedia cuando un piloto tiene ansias de venganza.

items.title: Midnight Return: The Story of Billy Hayes and Turkey
items.description: An exploration of the true story behind the iconic blockbuster 'Midnight Express' and the political power of cinema. Billy Hayes returns to Turkey to face a nation still haunted by the film and his own demons.

items.title: Juego de ladrones
items.description: Un ladrón veterano (Morgan Freeman) contrata a uno más joven (Antonio Banderas) para ayudarle a hacer un último trabajo para saldar una deuda con la mafia rusa.

items.title: El dedo
items.description: Después de años de dictadura, una aldea remota se convierte formalmente en una ciudad con el nacimiento de su habitante número 501, creando una apertura para el cargo de Mayer.

items.title: Pushout: The Criminalization of Black Girls in Schools
items.description: This documentary confronting the criminalization and miseducation of African American girls that has led to their alarming high school dropout rate and increase into the juvenile justice system.

items.title: La heredera
items.description: El amor prohibido entre una hermosa huérfana y un soltero de clase alta despierta envidias y engaños entre la familia que la adoptó cuando era niña, en este drama de época del director Bobby Roth.

items.title: Best seller: palabras que matan
items.description: Joseph Wambaugh, un policía viudo que escribe novelas policiacas de gran éxito, recibe la visita de un antiguo asesino a sueldo que quiere que escriba la historia de su vida.

items.title: Los últimos días de Franky, La Mosca
items.description: El afable y mezquino pandillero Frankie La Mosca tiene la oportunidad de cumplir su sueño de vengarse de su jefe después de pasar una noche con una actriz porno de buena naturaleza.

items.title: Operation Foxley - Mission: Liquidate Hitler
items.description: Operation Foxley was a secret British mission to assassinate Hitler during his morning walk. This film, based on declassified documents, reveals the plan, its details, and why it ultimately failed.

items.title: Chilly Scenes Of Winter
items.description: Charles (John Heard) loves Laura (Mary Beth Hurt). And Laura loves Charles. But when she changes her mind and returns to her husband, Charles decides to win her back, aided – and occasionally hindered – by his mixed bag of quirky friends and family.

items.title: Carbon Copy
items.description: Walter Whitney (George Segal) is a straight-laced and successful executive whose world is turned upside-down when he discovers the seventeen-year-old son he never knew he had: Roger (Denzel Washington, in his feature film debut).

items.title: The Burning
items.description: Gather around the campfire....to die! After a cruel joke severely disfigures him, camp caretaker Cropsy is back -- with hedge clippers in hand -- seeking revenge on those who scarred him! Can the campers save themselves before he kills them all?

items.title: The Aviator
items.description: In this high-flying action-adventure, when their plane crashes in rugged mountain terrain, an aviator (Christopher Reeve) and the rebellious passenger (Rosanna Arquette) who drives him crazy have only one source of hope for survival: each other.

items.title: The Beast With A Million Eyes
items.description: An unspeakable horror! Extraterrestrial terror is on the hunt for human flesh in this horrifying tale of invasion! This is a 1950s creature-feature with some serious sociological bite! Paul Birch, Lorna Thayer, and Richard Sargent star!

items.title: Initial D
items.description: After winning his first competition, Takumi focuses his attention on drift racing, a sport he has unknowingly perfected while delivering tofu in his father's Toyota AE86.

items.title: Curry And Pepper
items.description: Two best friends and cop partners become the subject of a beautiful news reporter's documentary. The two soon find themselves competing for screen time as well as the love of the reporter while after a murderous arms dealer.

items.title: Hopeless
items.description: A teenager wants to escape his hometown where violence is very common. Desperate for money, he joins a gang to help his family. His new life begins to fall more and more into dangerous circumstances as he fights to survive.

items.title: Breakup Season
items.description: A young man brings his girlfriend to his rural Oregon hometown for Christmas and to meet his family, only for things to go terribly wrong upon arrival. Comedy, drama, and serious heartbreak ensue.

items.title: Tormentero
items.description: El cuento mágico de Romero, ahora un pescador jubilado, que hace años descubrió un campo petrolero en su pueblo que causó que sus amigos y vecinos perdieran su forma de vida y lo rechazaran.

items.title: Fall Is A Good Time To Die
items.description: A young ranch hand hunts justice for his sister through the vast landscape of South Dakota. As he wrestles with what he is about to do, Cody crosses paths with a local county sheriff coming to terms with what she has already done.

items.title: Sugarcane
items.description: When Phoebe goes missing, Mari takes it upon herself to find her. With an old friend's help, they uncover a sinister website linked to the kidnapping, forcing Mari to confront her past to save Phoebe before time runs out.

items.title: Return Engagement
items.description: A well-known gangster is released from prison, and decides to look for his daughter with the help of a troubled young woman.
There's a scare for everyone in this anthology of horror written and directed by some of indie horror's best and brightest!

items.title: 10/31 Part 2
items.description: A follow up to the wildly popular horror anthology, 10/31 Part 2 summons up 5 more blood soaked tales of terror and macabre.

items.title: Christmas 4 Sale
items.description: Real Estate Mogul, Terri McKenzie finds herself with a case of mistaken identity when Billionaire George Camden needs help with his divorce proceedings. When she falls in too deep, can the truth save her company and her heart?

items.title: Everything That Glitters
items.description: Victoria Robinson seems to have the perfect life. But her unfaithful husband and a sexy younger man with dark motives will lead her into a dangerous game of cat and mouse, where she'll discover that the perfect life comes with a high cost.

items.title: La chica del tanque
items.description: En este divertidísimo thriller futurista, un megavillano (Malcolm McDowell) controla el suministro de agua mundial, y depende de Tank Girl (Lori Petty) y sus escandalosos acompañantes acabar con este avaricioso reinado

items.title: My Online Valentine
items.description: A woman finds romance through an online dating site, but her ex-boyfriend has plans to win her back.

items.title: When the Mist Clears
items.description: A young woman reconnected with her estranged father while vacationing in remote Italian country estate.

items.title: The Little Mermaid
items.description: Beauty is both deceiving and dangerous in this dark twist on Hans Christian Andersen's classic tale, as an underwater discovery draws an innocent man into a mermaid's evil world.

items.title: Mi amigo Dahmer
items.description: Esta es una historia real de Jeffrey Dahmer en la escuela secundaria antes de convertirse en un infame asesino en serie.

items.title: El camino del oeste
items.description: Kirk Douglas, Robert Mitchum y Richard Widmark protagonizan esta suntuosa historia de los hombres y mujeres que dejaron la comodidad y seguridad de sus vidas por la promesa de una tierra libre y una vida mejor en el indómito Oeste.

items.title: Apocalypto (ESP)
items.description: Cuando el reino maya está al borde del colapso, un joven se embarca en un peligroso viaje hacia un mundo dominado por el miedo y la opresión.

items.title: En el infierno
items.description: Dentro de la prisión más corrupta de Europa del este, el alcaide pone a los prisioneros unos contra otros en peleas hasta la muerte.

items.title: Asesinos en serie
items.description: Un condecorado detective de homicidios, viaja a través del depravado inframundo de Memphis para enfrentarse a un perverso asesino serial en este thriller de acción.

items.title: Mercenario por justicia
items.description: En este thriller criminal, el mercenario John Seeger (Steven Seagal) intenta infiltrarse en la prisión más impenetrable de Europa del Este para liberar al hijo de un notorio narcotraficante.

items.title: Sueño en otro idioma
items.description: En este drama mexicano ganador de premios, una lengua indígena peligra porque sus dos últimos hablantes no se hablan desde hace más de 50 años. Martín, un lingüista joven, intentará reconciliar a los viejos amigos. Subtitulada.

items.title: Secreto entre mujeres
items.description: Arturo Varela (Víctor Junco) ya había hecho mucho daño y era tiempo que alguien le hiciera pagar por él. La pregunta era, ¿quién?

items.title: Una canción para navidad
items.description: Dos padres solteros tropiezan con la posibilidad de amor en Navidad, sólo para descubrir que sus hijas están envueltas en una desagradable rivalidad en la escuela.

items.title: Santos y Blue Demon vs. Drácula y el hombre lobo
items.description: Después de ser derrotado por el mago Cristaldi, Drácula regresa para vengarse. Con la ayuda del hombre lobo y sus seguidores, la victoria es aplastante.

items.title: Una niñera engañosa
items.description: Susan debe recordar la muerte de su esposo para rescatar a su hija luego de su desaparición.

items.title: La hija equivocada
items.description: Kate se reconecta con la niña a que renunció en adopción, pero pregunta si esta es realmente su hija.

items.title: El esposo incorrecto
items.description: Melanie nota que su marido está actuando diferente cuando se revela que en realidad es su gemelo idéntico.

items.title: Madre sustituta
items.description: El sueño de Kaylene finalmente se hizo realidad: gemelos de un procedimiento in vitro. Pero cuando necesita atención domiciliaria, la enfermera no es otra que la propia donante de óvulos que ha venido a reclamar a sus bebés.

items.title: La paciente incorrecta
items.description: La Dra. Katie Jones se enreda en la red de un narcisista cuyo camino hacia la perfección amenaza todo.

items.title: When You Finish Saving the World
items.description: Evelyn (Julianne Moore) tries to parent an unassuming teenager at her shelter while her oblivious son Ziggy (Finn Wolfhard) fumbles through his pursuit of a brilliant young woman at school.

items.title: Aballay, el hombre sin miedo
items.description: Un joven busca venganza contra la banda de forajidos que asesinó a su padre diez años antes.

items.title: The Black Candle
items.description: A documentary about the struggle and triumph of African-American family, community, and culture, using Kwanzaa as a vehicle to celebrate the African-American experience.

items.title: Sonny
items.description: An honorably discharged soldier returns home to New Orleans, hoping to break away from his upbringing as a trained prostitute, but his brothel-madam mother has other expectations.

items.title: Agente revelación
items.description: Un agente militar obtiene poderes sobrenaturales tras un misterioso contacto alienígena. Ahora, debe luchar contra una invasión que amenaza con destruir a la humanidad.

items.title: Infidelidad
items.description: Cuando se descubre la infidelidad de una mujer y su novio, se ven obligados a participar en el retorcido juego de su captor para salvar a los miembros de su familia de ser asesinados.

items.title: Mi ángel
items.description: Una esposa amorosa y su esposo se mudan a una cabaña remota para sanar tras la devastadora pérdida de sus gemelos nacidos muertos. Pronto, ella percibe una presencia maligna y es llevada al límite cuando oscuros secretos comienzan a revelarse.

items.title: Pelea de chicas
items.description: Cuando Anna Wyncomb conoce un club de lucha clandestino exclusivamente femenino para cambiar el caos de su vida, descubre que está mucho más conectada personalmente con la historia del club de lo que jamás podría imaginar.

items.title: Witless Protection
items.description: When a small-town sheriff (Larry the Cable Guy) witnesses what he believes to be an attempted kidnapping, his effort to save the beautiful damsel in distress sets him down a wild path of comic mishap.

items.title: MVP: Most Valuable Primate
items.description: Jack, a chimpanzee who recently escaped from an experimental lab, finds his way onto the ice at a junior hockey practice.

items.title: Pup Star
items.description: Welcome to a world where dogs can not only talk -- they can SING!

items.title: Pup Star: Better 2Gether
items.description: In Pup Star: Better 2gether, Tiny, the Yorkie winner of a canine competition, faces a rival's trick and swaps lives with street pup Scrappy. Their journey through iconic cities teaches them about family, being true to oneself and who the real Pup Star is!

items.title: Pup Star: World Tour
items.description: Pup Star is back, and bigger than ever as the hit singing pup competition goes global!

items.title: Puppy Star Christmas
items.description: The Pup Star family just got bigger! the new pups: Cindy, Rosie, Charlie, and Brody will have to learn the true meaning of Christmas. Pup Star’s mean team, scheme to ruin Christmas, the pups end up in the North Pole to save Santa and the holiday spirit.

items.title: Steel Dawn
items.description: A nomad warrior must help save a beautiful woman and her young son from a band of henchmen stalking them through the desert after a nuclear war.

items.title: Russell Madness
items.description: For Russell, a lovable terrier, family means everything and he'll do anything to find one to call his own – even get in the wrestling ring and take on the reigning champion!

items.title: La niñera equivocada
items.description: Una niñera contratada para cuidar a gemelos recién nacidos resulta ser la hija de su madre, abandonada al nacer. En busca de venganza, la niñera planea arruinar la vida de su recién descubierta madre.

items.title: MVP II: Most Vertical Primate
items.description: After being booted from his hockey team, Jack hits the road and meets Ben, a skateboarder with big dreams. Turns out Jack also has some impressive skater skills and the two set out on an hilarious cross-country skate tour!

items.title: Snake & Crane Arts of Shaolin [English Subtitled]
items.description: A martial arts book, which Hsu Yin-Fung (Jackie Chan) carries, is being highly sought by various clans and gangs, but he is in pursuit of someone himself.

items.title: The Amsterdam Kill
items.description: Ex-DEA agent Quinlan enters a labyrinth of deception and death as he tries to destroy a powerful Amsterdam-based drug cartel named 'Juliana'.

items.title: Without Evidence
items.description: The story revolves around a possible conspiracy behind the real life murder of the Oregon's Head of Corrections Michael Francke.

items.title: Mad Dog - From Chaos to Comeback
items.description: In 2013, UFC fighter Reza 'Mad Dog' Madadi was arrested for involvement in a smash-and-grab coup. He was sentenced to prison which led to him losing everything. 'MAD DOG' tells the story about his fascinating way back.

items.title: La venganza de Cenicienta
items.description: En este oscuro giro al clásico cuento, Cenicienta busca venganza contra quienes la maltrataron, convirtiéndose en una heroína feroz que enfrenta su destino con valentía.

items.title: Dawg
items.description: To inherit a million dollars, an egotistical man must find the women he's betrayed and convince them to forgive him.

items.title: Adam the First
items.description: Adam sets out on a cross country adventure to track down a series of men who could be his estranged father, each one with a different life that could become his own.

items.title: The Man In The Iron Mask (1977)
items.description: D'Artagnan and his fellow Musketeers plot to replace the ineffectual Louis XIV of France with his secretly imprisoned twin brother Philippe who is the firstborn and rightful king.

items.title: Crisis (ESP)
items.description: El descubrimiento revolucionario de un profesor, una misión encubierta de la DEA contra un cartel y una madre en busca de justicia se entrelazan en un mundo de corrupción, avaricia y dilemas morales dentro de la industria farmacéutica.

items.title: Ex psicópata
items.description: Una relación tóxica toma un giro aterrador cuando la ex de un hombre reaparece con intenciones siniestras.

items.title: La hija del lobo
items.description: Una veterana militar debe rastrear a la banda que secuestró a su hijo en el desierto helado, solo para descubrir un secreto mortal y enfrentarse a un líder despiadado que pondrá a prueba hasta dónde llegará una madre para proteger a su hijo.

items.title: Get the Girl
items.description: A retired hitman and his trainee get pulled into trouble when he decides to save a sex trafficking victim he finds unconscious on his property.

items.title: Un amor muy conveniente
items.description: Una joven artista desafía las expectativas de su familia al fingir un compromiso con un carismático desconocido.

items.title: Orgullo sobre hielo
items.description: Una joven campeona de patinaje deja el deporte tras una mudanza familiar. Con ayuda del dueño de una pista de hielo, descubre su verdadero potencial.

items.title: La acusación de Rachel
items.description: Inspirado en una historia real. Una madre protege a su hijastra después de que la adolescente presencie el asesinato de su mejor amiga, pero pronto se ve obligada a enfrentarse a la aterradora posibilidad de que su hijastra sea la verdadera asesina.

items.title: It's So Easy and Other Lies
items.description: The life story of Guns N' Roses bass player, Duff McKagan. How he struggled with alcohol and drug addiction, and overcame it. Talks about the real challenges in everyday life, his childhood, and how the band made it big.

items.title: This Sporting Life
items.description: Despite success on the field, a rising rugby star senses the emerging emptiness of his life as his inner angst begins to materialize through aggression and brutality, so he attempts to woo his landlady in hopes of finding reason to live.

items.title: Rally Caps
items.description: Stars Judd Hirsch, Amy Smart, and Carson Minniear. An injury derails a young baseball player's dream of becoming a pitcher. At a sleepaway camp, he befriends a deaf catcher who helps him conquer his fear of returning to the mound.

items.title: Perro Genial
items.description: Una familia debe mudarse a un apartamento en la ciudad de Nueva York que tenga una política estricta de no mascotas.

items.title: Naturaleza desatada: terremoto
items.description: La familia de un ingeniero está en el camino directo del peligro después de que un temblor masivo dañe gravemente una planta nuclear rusa.

items.title: Los ministros
items.description: Un detective de Nueva York investiga una serie de asesinatos ligados a un oscuro culto religioso, mientras desentraña secretos que podrían destruirlo todo.

items.title: Contrarreloj
items.description: Un ex ladrón busca desesperadamente a su hija que ha sido secuestrada y encerrada en el maletero de un taxi. Protagonizada por Nicolas Cage y Malin Akerman.

items.title: Los Wánabis
items.description: Tres amigos, en busca de un mayor estatus social, arriesgan sus vidas y las de sus familias al aceptar una misteriosa propuesta de negocio que promete convertirlos en millonarios de la noche a la mañana.

items.title: Survivor (2015)
items.description: Incriminada por crímenes que no cometió, una diplomática (Milla Jovovich, El quinto elemento) trata de impedir un ataque terrorista en Nueva York. Con Pierce Brosnan y Dylan McDermott.

items.title: The Last Deal
items.description: When marijuana becomes legal in California, Vince, an unlicensed dispensary owner and Cannabis dealer is forced to make one final score before getting squeezed out of the business.

items.title: V13
items.description: Vienna, 1913: Two unlikely friends—privileged Hugo seeking insight through Freud's psychoanalysis and struggling Adolf finds purpose in nationalism. Their diverging paths show how casual bonds collide with history's most devastating turns.

items.title: Leprechaun: The Beginning
items.description: A family discovers a treasure box of gold in their late father's house.

items.title: Erzulie
items.description: Four friends reunite at the riverside Pont Laveau in South Louisiana, to relax and reconnect. One of the friends, Wendy, convinces the others to join her in summoning the legendary water goddess, Erzulie, to ask for her blessings and protection.

items.title: The Other Me
items.description: An architect is diagnosed with a rare eye disease, entering him into a surreal reality in which he sees people's true motives. As the visions become intolerable, he falls for a mysterious woman and confronts the truth about his own identity.

items.title: El rey del fin del mundo
items.description: Las aventuras de Sir James Brooke, que desafió al Imperio Británico para gobernar el reino en la jungla de Borneo en 1840, embarcándose en una cruzada para acabar con la piratería y la esclavitud durante el resto de su vida.

items.title: Fanático
items.description: La obsesión de un hombre con su actor favorito se convierte en locura al no poder conocerlo, borrando la línea entre admiración y delirio en este inquietante retrato de la fama y la obsesión.

items.title: El abuelo espía
items.description: Cuando la chica que le gusta desaparece, Jake recurre a su abuelo y a los antiguos compañeros de operaciones especiales de su abuelo para que lo ayuden.

items.title: Mouseboat Massacre
items.description: The story follows a young woman battling a drug addiction who suddenly begins to see a mutated mouse-human hybrid who infests her life.

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Werewolf Of Washington (2010)
items.description: Elvira decides to throw her "ring into the hat" and campaign for office. To improve election odds, she masquerades as Sarah Palin and accepts a phone call from the dreaded Breather.

items.title: The Million Pound Note
items.description: As part of a bet, two aristocrats offer a penniless American a loan, without telling him that the amount is 1,000,000 in the form of a single banknote.

items.title: Venciendo el mal
items.description: En esta película llena de acción, un exagente de la CIA (Steven Seagal) viaja a Tailandia para rescatar a su hija de las garras de un grupo terrorista islámico.

items.title: The Man With The Golden Arm
items.description: A strung-out junkie deals with a demoralizing drug addiction while his crippled wife and card sharks pull him down.

items.title: Por siempre fuerte
items.description: Un jugador de rugby es enviado a un centro de detención juvenil. Allí juega para el equipo de rugby Highland y finalmente se enfrenta a su padre en el Campeonato Nacional.

items.title: Tormenta terrestre
items.description: Un asteroide galpea el lado oscura de la luna, desencadenando cambios climáticos en la tierra.

items.title: Forget Me Not
items.description: Sandy should be enjoying the time of her life, but when her friends start disappearing, she discovers they have awakened the vengeful spirit of a girl they wronged long ago. Now Sandy must unlock a dark secret from her past before its too late.

items.title: Silk Road (2021)
items.description: Ross launches the website Silk Road, an anonymous drug market, catching the focus of DEA agent Rick. As their private lives erode, they are trapped in a game of cat-and-mouse.

items.title: 92 In The Shade
items.description: A young drifter returns to his home in Key West, Florida and attempts to open a fishing charter business, provoking a dangerous feud with a rival fishing sea captain.

items.title: The Super (2018)
items.description: When tenants of a NY apartment begin disappearing, former cop turned building superintendent suspects a sadistic murderer is roaming the eerie corridors.

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: They Came From Beyond Space
items.description: After a team of scientists are dispatched to investigate the remnants of a meteor shower, they return controlled by a mysterious alien force. Meanwhile, nearby town residents are infected with the deadly "Crimson Plague."

items.title: Un gallo en corral ajeno
items.description: Laura es una escultora exigente y aristócrata que, en vista de la poca suerte que ha tenido con sus pretendientes, prefiere poder esculpir a un hombre a su gusto, sin importar su clase social.

items.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Tormented
items.description: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira becomes paralyzed by a spider bite and is forced to watch "Tormented."

items.title: The Monster Club
items.description: A writer of horror stories is invited to a "monster club" by a mysterious old gentleman. There, three gruesome stories are told to him, between each story some musicians play their songs.

items.title: The Boy Downstairs (ESP)
items.description: Una joven mujer es forzada a reflexionar sobre su primera relación cuando se muda por accidente al edificio de su novio.

items.title: Cambiapieles
items.description: Un niño de 12 años y su madre se convierten en el objetivo de dos manadas de hombres lobo en guerra, cada una con intenciones y motivos diferentes.

items.title: Burlesque: Heart of the Glitter Tribe
items.description: A feature documentary about the passion and personalities at the heart of today's new wave of burlesque.

items.title: La niña que se escapó
items.description: Una mujer que se escapó de un asesino en serie cuando era niña debe enfrentar su pasado cuando él reaparece veinte años después, y esta vez, viene por ella.

items.title: La agencia de la humanidad
items.description: Un thriller distópico ambientado en el año 2030 que ve al mundo en un estado permanente de recesión económica y enfrenta serios problemas ambientales como resultado del calentamiento global.

items.title: The Super
items.description: Karma comes into play when a wealthy wisecracking landlord is ordered by a court to live in the filthy building that he runs.

items.title: Pandilla de Rosas
items.description: En este western lleno de acción, la exlíder de la disuelta pandilla femenina Rose Gang reúne a sus compañeras una vez más para buscar un tesoro escondido y vengar la muerte de su hermana.

items.title: Dos amantes y un oso
items.description: Una pareja en el Ártico, acompañada por un oso místico, navega paisajes duros y bellos mientras enfrentan su pasado y ponen a prueba su amor.

items.title: Tus santos y tus demonios
items.description: Un elenco de estrellas que incluye a Robert Downey Jr., Shia LaBeouf y Dianne Wiest, este aclamado drama sigue a un joven que crece en el Nueva York de los años 80 y cree que ha sido salvado de la violencia y las drogas por varios llamados santos.

items.title: Shadrach
items.description: In 1935, 99-year-old former slave Shadrach asks to be buried where he was born, but the land is owned by another family and it's a violation of strict Virginia law to bury a Black man on the property. With Harvey Keitel and Andie MacDowell.

items.title: Marionette
items.description: A grieving psychiatrist moves to Scotland for a fresh start but discovers her young patient's eerie drawings predict real disasters.

items.title: This World, Then the Fireworks
items.description: In 1950s, two incestuous lovers, a depraved suave journalist and his equally depraved prostitute sister, plan to get rich through seduction and murder. Things complicate when their feeble-minded mother begins to suspect something.

items.title: Asesinatos accidentales
items.description: Mike Fallon es un sicario experimentado conocido por hacer que la muerte de sus objetivos parezca un accidente. Cuando su novia aparece muerta, él va tras sus antiguos colegas para encontrar al responsable.

items.title: Epic Adventure Of A Hedgehog
items.description: Today threatened with extinction, this small animal, more than 60 million years old, is undergoing a real rural exodus.

items.title: Una chica divertida
items.description: En esta comedia alocada, Parker Posey (Scream 3) interpreta a una chica fiestera de los clubes de Nueva York que consigue un trabajo como bibliotecaria.

items.title: Aventuras en Dinotopia
items.description: David Scott y su hermano Karl se encuentran en la aventura de su vida cuando se encuentran atrapados en Dinotopia.

items.title: Stagecoach
items.description: Dallas is a woman with a past who has been driven out of town by the high-minded ladies of the community. Lucy Mallory is the wife of a cavalry officer stationed in Lordsburg, and she's determined to be with him.

items.title: Legacy Of Rage [English-Language Version]
items.description: Brandon Ma is an average Joe, but his best friend, Michael, is a sinister drug dealer with a crush on Brandon's girlfriend, May. When Michael murders a dirty cop and frames his friend, sending him to jail, Brandon returns for vengeance.

items.title: Anaconda - Silent Killer
items.description: Few snakes are feared more and understood less than the anaconda. The film shows the journey into remote and uncharted parts of the Amazon rainforest to find the truth behind the mythical beast.

items.title: Surprising World Of Rabbits
items.description: From natural-born prey to public enemy number 1. Is there a more inoffensive creature than the rabbit? And yet this herbivorous animal, an easy prey for all manner of predators, has developed a range of astonishing faculties to survive.

items.title: Justicia verdadera
items.description: Un fantasma del pasado de Kane reaparece y la CIA cree que está aquí para proteger al blanqueador de dinero del fantasma, que viene a la ciudad.

items.title: Repeat
items.description: The the truth about Ryans missing daughter is just be beginning.

items.title: Emmet Otter's Jug Band Christmas
items.description: Ma and Emmet Otter are a family that have little more than each other. When a talent show is held in town, a fifty-dollar prize gives them each hope of buying the other a real present this year, but they face stiff competition from a fierce rock group.

items.title: Fairest of Them All
items.description: The Mad Hatter has hunted down princesses from fairy tale lands.

items.title: Screwballs
items.description: Frolicking youth comedy about zany high school students set in the 1960s.

items.title: Hook
items.description: Fueled by "pixie dust," James Hook murders Wendy's brother, loses his hand to Peter Pan and is presumed dead after a fight

items.title: Stars Fell Again
items.description: Sequel to Stars Fell on Alabama. Bryce is ready to propose to Madison while they visit her family for Christmas. However, the spontaneous wedding of Madison’s sister, Harper, throws Bryce’s perfect proposal plans into a tailspin.

items.title: Dot.Kill
items.description: A detective tries to hunt down a serial killer who broadcasts his murders live on the internet.

items.title: Foxhole
items.description: Unfolding over the span of 36 hours in three separate wars - The American Civil War, World War I, and Iraq - Foxhole follows five soldiers confined in a foxhole as they grapple with Morality, futility, and an increasingly volatile combat situation.

items.title: Rampage
items.description: A man with a thirst for revenge builds a full body armor from Kevlar and goes on a killing spree.

items.title: Manifest West
items.description: A coming of age story told through the eyes of a young girl whose family spirals out of control after they decide to live off the grid.

items.title: Postal
items.description: In the ironically named city of Paradise, a loser teams up with his cult-leading uncle to steal a peculiar bounty of riches from their local amusement park. The recently arrived Taliban have a similar focus, but a far more sinister intent.

items.title: Shockwave: Surviving North America's Biggest Disaster
items.description: A powerful earthquake and tsunami will some day devastate the Pacific Northwest. What are cities from Vancouver to Sacramento doing to prepare?

items.title: In The Name Of The King: Two Worlds
items.description: An ex-Special Forces soldier gets thrown back to medieval times to fulfill an ancient prophecy and ends up finding redemption for his own battlefield experiences.

items.title: In The Name Of The King: A Dungeon Siege Tale
items.description: A man named Farmer sets out to rescue his kidnapped wife and avenge the death of his son, two acts committed by the Krugs, a race of animal-warriors who are controlled by the evil Gallian.

items.title: Shadow Fighter
items.description: Reggie, an inner-city teen struggling with the murder of his brother and the drug dealers who pulled the trigger, forms an unexpected bond with a homeless ex-boxer, "Lightning" Rhodes.

items.title: Assault On Wall Street
items.description: Jim, an average New Yorker, lives with a sick but loving wife. Suddenly, everything changes when the economy crashes and causes him to lose everything. Filled with anger and rage, Jim goes to seek revenge for the life taken from him.

items.title: Bloodrayne
items.description: In the eighteenth century, a vampire escapes from the freak show, in which she once participated, and teams up with a group of vampire slayers to kill the man who raped her mother.

items.title: Bloodrayne: The Third Reich
items.description: Rayne joins a resistance group to fight against the Nazis during World War II.

items.title: Passion Of Mind
items.description: When Marie, a widow in Provence with two daughters, locks her bedroom door and goes to sleep, she dreams about Marty, a literary agent in Manhattan who dreams equally vividly about Marie.

items.title: Perrier's Bounty
items.description: A gangster named Perrier looks to exact his revenge on a trio of fugitives responsible for the accidental death of one of his cronies.

items.title: Xia Ri Fu Xing aka Twinkle Twinkle Lucky Stars
items.description: The do-gooder Lucky Stars gang takes a well-deserved break in Thailand where they are told to contact an informant. Their vacation is cut short when the informant is murdered sending them back to Hong Kong to protect his girlfriend.

items.title: Deck the Heart
items.description: A city executive inherits a manor, obligated to host Christmas. Lacking time and spirit, he hires Merry. Through her planning and decor, she rekindles his love for Christmas, creating a festive transformation.

items.title: Minamata
items.description: Following his celebrated days as a revered photojournalist of World War II, W. Eugene Smith has become reclusive, disconnected from society and his career. But a secret commission from Life Magazine sends him to the Japanese coastal city of Minamata

items.title: La Mujer X
items.description: Una madre es separada injustamente de su hijo y hará hasta lo imposible por encontrarlo. Las circunstancias del reencuentro la llevarán a cometer un crimen.

items.title: Secret Agents
items.description: Georges and Lisa are top field agents with the French secret service. But, while Georges is addicted to the work, Lisa is weary of it. So when they are sent to Morocco to thwart an arms smuggler, Lisa insists it's her last mission.

items.title: She Paradise
items.description: A film about sisterhood and dance, SHE PARADISE is an engaging coming-of-age tale set in the World of Soca dance in Trinidad. Sparkle spends her days taking care of her grandfather when she discovers a free-spirited dance troupe.

items.title: The Evil That Men Do
items.description: A professional killer comes out of retirement to investigate and avenge the brutal murder of an old friend.

items.title: One Love
items.description: A rasta musician meets a gospel singer when they both enter a music contest in Kingston, Jamaica. They fall for each other but are kept apart by the Girl's father, the Pastor, who wants her to marry into the church.

items.title: Return of the Living Dead: Necropolis
items.description: A group of teenagers inadvertently end up releasing a horde of blood thirsty zombies.

items.title: Rescate en el tiempo
items.description: Basado en la novela de Michael Crichton. Rescate en el tiempo, cuenta la historia de un profesor que, sin darse cuenta, se catapulta de vuelta a la Francia del siglo XIV, en medio de la Guerra de los 100 años.

items.title: Dioses del Abismo
items.description: Cuando una misión audaz lleva a un equipo de submarinismo de aguas profundas a una misteriosa apertura en el fondo oceánico, descubren un mundo submarino perdido y despiertan a su antigua raza de seres de otro mundo.

items.title: Monkey Up
items.description: A family comedy about a talking capuchin monkey seeking to gain fame and fortune as a movie star.

items.title: Uncovered
items.description: A woman finds a hidden message in a restored painting questioning a knight's death. When her friend is murdered investigating it, a chess game's moves in the painting link to killings from the past that she must solve.

items.title: Silent Night
items.description: Mark, a low end South London hitman recently released from prison, tries to go straight for his daughter, but gets drawn back in by Alan, his former cellmate, to do one final job.

items.title: The Death Artist
items.description: Walter Paisley, a busboy at a cappuccino bar called the Jabberjaw, is praised as a genius after he kills his landlady's cat and covers it in plaster. Pressured to produce more work, he goes after bigger subjects.

items.title: Stripped To Kill II
items.description: A stripper (Maria Ford) thinks she is killing other strippers, her roommate (Karen Mayo-Chandler) and a policeman (Eb Lottimer) do not.

items.title: The Waterboyz
items.description: In Atlanta's tough streets, two waterboys hustle for a better future. Caught between local gangs and the law, they face a critical choice: the streets that raised them or the dreams that could save them.

items.title: The Sand
items.description: After an all-night graduation beach party, a group of hung-over twenty-somethings awake to a beating sun, and a seemingly carnivorous beach that devours anything with a heartbeat that touches the sand.

items.title: Cryptic
items.description: Eight members from various London crime families meet in a Crypt to guard a coffin. Nobody seems to know what the contents of said coffin are, but one by one they start winding up dead, and the word "vampire" comes to mind.

items.title: Krispr
items.description: A family's holiday turns deadly when a genetically enhanced clone exposes their darkest secrets—and seeks revenge.

items.title: Agora
items.description: A historical drama set in Roman Egypt, concerning a slave who turns to the rising tide of Christianity in the hope of pursuing freedom while falling in love with his mistress, the renowned philosopher and mathematician Hypatia of Alexandria.

items.title: Big Gold Brick
items.description: The story of fledgling writer Samuel Liston and his experiences with Floyd Deveraux, the enigmatic father of two who enlists Samuel to write his biography. But the circumstances that led up to this arrangement in the first place are quite astonishing.

items.title: Dam 999
items.description: After many years, two mariners return to their homeland with the hope of a new beginning, little did they know about a disaster that would change their destiny.

items.title: The Secret Life Of Words
items.description: A hearing impaired factory worker gives up her first holiday in years and instead travels out to an oil rig, where she cares for a man suffering from severe burns.

items.title: Stateside
items.description: The film follows a rebellious teenager on leave from the Marines who falls in love with a female musician. The relationship is threatened when she develops a mental illness...

items.title: El hombre del presidente
items.description: Un agente secreto altamente clasificado del presidente de Estados Unidos debe encontrar a un intrépido sustituto que se haga cargo de sus peligrosísimas misiones militares.

items.title: La captura de Pelham 1-2-3
items.description: Tres hombres secuestran un vagón del metro neoyorquino y piden un rescate millonario por los pasajeros a bordo. Walter Matthau, Robert Shaw, Martin Balsam, Hector Elizondo, Earl Hindman, Jerry Stiller, Tony Roberts, Lee Wallace, James Broderick.

items.title: Goebbels And The Führer
items.description: Follows Nazi propaganda Minister Joseph Goebbels' efforts to maintain public support after Stalingrad defeat. Depicts his final days in Hitler's bunker, where he orchestrates murder of his children before committing suicide with his wife.

items.title: The Last Rifleman
items.description: Haunted by the death of his friend on D-Day, Arty Crawford escapes from his care home and battles his way back to France to reconcile the ghosts of his past.

items.title: The Steam Experiment
items.description: A deranged scientist locks 6 people in a steam room and threatens to turn up the heat if the local paper doesn't publish his story about global warming.

items.title: Even Mice Belong In Heaven
items.description: Two enemies - a little Mouse and a Fox, who after an accident, meet in animal heaven. They lose their natural instincts and become best friends. Their wish to stay together after they return to earth comes true, but they are reborn into opposite roles.

items.title: Where The Truth Lies
items.description: Karen O'Connor, a young journalist known for her celebrity profiles, is consumed with discovering the truth behind a long-buried incident that affected the lives and careers of showbiz team Vince Collins and Lanny Morris.

items.title: Killer Fish: Deadly Treasure Of The Piranha
items.description: Jewel thieves attempt to recover treasure from piranha infested waters. Mistrust and betrayals happen amongst the gang in the quest for gold.

items.title: The Funhouse Massacre
items.description: Six of the world's scariest psychopaths escape from a local Asylum and proceed to unleash terror on the unsuspecting crowd of a Halloween Funhouse.

items.title: Cosmopolis
items.description: Riding across Manhattan in a stretch limousine to get a haircut, a 28-year-old billionaire asset manager's day devolves into an odyssey with a cast of characters that start to tear his world apart.

items.title: Blood Money
items.description: Years After A Robbery, Four Friends reunite to split the hidden money when they encounter a psychotic killer who compels them to confront their past.

items.title: Exit Strategy
items.description: James gets evicted from his apartment and has no choice but to move in with his girlfriend Kim. He quickly discovers that she is not what he wants and needs an exit strategy fast. But for Kim, breaking up just isn't an option.

items.title: Jesus' Son
items.description: Based on the critically acclaimed book by Denis Johnson, a man (Billy Crudup), high on drugs, alcohol and careens through life and makes his way toward recovery and redemption.

items.title: Killing Time
items.description: A police detective hires an Italian hit woman to kill a deadly criminal and his cohorts.

items.title: Kiss Me for Christmas
items.description: This Christmas, an unnoticed personal assistant has an unexpected encounter with her dream man, who's in a relationship with her boss. They're assigned to a project, growing closer, but their feelings risk her career.

items.title: Use of Force: The Policing of Black America
items.description: A documentary that delves into the fatal encounters between police and people of color in America.

items.title: Morgan’s Ferry
items.description: A spinster develops a growing attraction for one of three escaped convicts who are holding her hostage in her own home.

items.title: VANish
items.description: A kidnapped young woman is a force to be reckoned with on a unplanned road trip full of murder and mayhem.

items.title: Miranda (2002)
items.description: A librarian begins a passionate affair with a mysterious woman who walks into his library. When she suddenly disappears, he travels down to London to search for her, only to discover that she has three identities, dancer, dominatrix, and con woman.

items.title: Attack On Darfur
items.description: American journalists in Sudan are confronted with the dilemma of whether to return home to report on the atrocities they have seen, or to stay behind and help some of the victims they have encountered.

items.title: Boris Karloff: The Man Behind The Monster
items.description: Karloff, examining his illustrious 60-year career in the entertainment industry and his enduring legacy as one of the icons of 20th century popular culture.

items.title: Gypsy (2015)
items.description: Loosely based on the memoirs of world-renowned striptease artist Gypsy Rose Lee, Gypsy follows the journey of the irrepressible Rose, the mother to end all stage mothers.

items.title: Dr. Jekyll And Sister Hyde
items.description: A Victorian scientist tests a serum that transforms him into a sensuous murderess.

items.title: B-Side: For Taylor
items.description: Grieving the death of her mother, a 14-year-old Korean-American adoptee grows desperate to find her birth parents. But when she befriends a Korean family who moves in next door, they expose an unforeseen truth about her birth family.

items.title: Tai Chi Master [English Subtitled]
items.description: Two friends, ex Shaolin monks, part ways as they brush with the ongoing rebellion against the government. The ambitious one rises up to be a powerful military commander, while his betrayed friend resorts to learn the calm ways of Tai Chi.

items.title: Critical Condition
items.description: Con man Kevin Lennihan, framed in a jewel smuggling, tries for an insanity plea, and is sent to a hospital for review, where he is confused for a doctor and takes over the hospital when a major storm hits.

items.title: Redemption: For Robbing The Dead
items.description: Henry Heath, a grieving lawman whose daughter has recently died, is assigned custody of the ghoulish Jean Baptiste, a notorious robber of 300 graves. Against the perilous Utah desert terrain Heath must somehow keep a marked man alive.

items.title: Samurai Reincarnation
items.description: The villain is called Amakusa Shiro Tokaisada. He is actually based on a real christian samurai. The movie was one of the inspirations for the game called 'Samurai Shodown' (actual spelling)

items.title: The Atomic Submarine
items.description: Ships mysteriously disappear on route across the Arctic Sea, and a specially-equipped submarine is sent to investigate.

items.title: Avengement
items.description: While released on furlough from prison, a lowly criminal evades his guards and returns to his old haunts to take revenge on the people that made him a cold-hearted killer.

items.title: The Young Poisoner's Handbook
items.description: This film is based on a true story about a British teenager who allegedly poisoned family, friends, and co-workers.

items.title: The Unborn
items.description: A couple struggling to conceive visit a miracle doctor as a last hope for having a child. The wife gets pregnant, but after the initial joy comes horror, as she slowly discovers the nightmarish truth behind the doctor's success.

items.title: Navidad con los Maxwells
items.description: Con una carrera exitosa, dos hijos adorables y el hecho de haberse casado con su novia de la secundaria, Andrew Austin lo tenía todo. Pero un diagnóstico de cáncer y secretos del pasado rápidamente ponen sus vidas patas arriba.

items.title: The Culling
items.description: A group of college-age friends en route to a music festival stop to help a lost girl at a diner. Invited to her family’s remote farmhouse, they’re offered beers and BBQ—but sinister forces soon emerge, and the girl may not be as innocent as she seems.

items.title: El tren de la muerte
items.description: Jon Voight y Eric Roberts interpretan a un par de presos que en su fuga suben a un tren de mercancías, pero cuando el maquinista muere de un ataque al corazón, se encuentran atrapados, solos y a toda velocidad hacia un desastre seguro.

items.title: Love Jacked
items.description: Maya has artistic ambitions - her father wants a dutiful daughter to run the family store. Taking her independence a step further, Maya decides to travel to Africa for inspiration and returns with a fiancé.

items.title: Operation Blood Hunt
items.description: A group of US Army misfits travel to a remote South Pacific Island to investigate the disappearance of Marine units stationed there in 1944. They discover the Marines were mysteriously massacred by a group of Werewolves.

items.title: Phil
items.description: A depressed dentist in mid life crisis tries to learn why one of his happiest patients suddenly commits suicide, and a dark comedic adventure ensues.

items.title: Castigando el mal
items.description: Un detective debe correr contra el tiempo para acabar con una banda de ladrones bien organizada que están llevando a cabo atracos violentos en la ciudad.

items.title: The Summer of Violence
items.description: In the heat of Denver's 1993 Summer of Violence, Naomi ditches law school for poetry, navigating a city awash in crime. Struggling for survival, she finds her voice in the chaos, where her poetry becomes a lifeline in a world teetering on the edge.

items.title: The Delivered
items.description: Fanny Lye lives a quiet Puritan life with her husband John and young son Arthur, but her simple world is shaken to its core by the unexpected arrival of a mysterious young couple in need, causing events to escalate, changing Fanny's life forever.

items.title: Lost Girls and Love Hotels
items.description: In Tokyo’s neon-lit nights, Margaret seeks escape from her past. A passionate, dangerous affair with a Yakuza enforcer pulls her deeper into the city's shadows. Will she find herself—or lose everything?

items.title: Playing Through
items.description: Late in her career, Ann Gregory finds the courage to be the first woman of color to enter the USGA Women's Amateur. She collides with Babs Whatling, a privileged white woman from the south who is searching for her own identity.

items.title: Tsunami de tiburones
items.description: Un tsunami golpea una ciudad y provoca un frenesí de tiburones que atacan a los ciudadanos conmocionados.

items.title: Below Her Mouth
items.description: An unexpected affair quickly escalates into a heart-stopping reality for two women whose passionate connection changes their lives forever.

items.title: Faster & Faster
items.description: Faster & Faster brilliantly captures the events which made the 2003 and 2004 MotoGP seasons so extraordinary.

items.title: A Storybook Christmas
items.description: When Celeste hires a nanny for her niece, the man who arrives may just be the perfect Christmas love.

items.title: The Doctor, The Tornado & The Kentucky Kid
items.description: The rivalry between; Valentino Rossi, Colin Edwards and Nicky Hayden in the 2006 MotoGP World Championship.

items.title: The Passion Live
items.description: The Passion tells the 2000-year-old story of the last hours of Jesus Christ's life on Earth through passages from the Bible and a variety of popular music.

items.title: El Escapulario
items.description: Una mujer que está a punto de morir llama al cura del pueblo y le entrega un escapulario, diciéndole que conoce sus grandes poderes. Cualquiera que no crea en ellos acabará muerto.

items.title: Victimas del divorcio
items.description: Un hombre que tiene una aventura hace caso a su amante y comienza el proceso de divorciarse de su esposa.

items.title: Spiritwalker
items.description: A man with amnesia suddenly begins regaining consciousness in a new body every 12 hours. But with no memory—and no allies—his time is running out.

items.title: Ring of Fire
items.description: Los Angeles Chinatown is disrupted by the cross-town rivalry between two kickboxing clubs as the competitive sport is catapulted from the ring of a gymnasium to a ring of fire.

items.title: The Humbling
items.description: Based on a Phillip Roth novel, this is the story of an over-the-hill stage actor (Al Pacino, The Godfather) and his controversially invigorating relationship with a young and lustful lesbian (Greta Gerwig, Frances Ha).

items.title: Believer
items.description: A young writer is attacked by a notorious cult leader and mass murderer, a man who exerts an inexplicable control over his followers. When she claims no memory of the attack, her family begins to question her motives.

items.title: The End Of Us
items.description: Nick and Leah are on the verge of breakup, but then came the worldwide COVID-19 pandemic and emergency lockdown. As they navigate the new normal together, the couple discovers that breaking up may actually be harder than staying together.

items.title: The Captain
items.description: Director Andrew Lau's cinematic portrayal of the most miraculous emergency landing in the contemporary history of Chinese aviation.

items.title: The Seasoning House
items.description: Angel is a slave in the Seasoning House - where young girls are prostituted to the military. When her closest friend is murdered, she plots an ingenious and brutal revenge

items.title: Absolon
items.description: In a future society, the only hope for survival from a deadly virus is a drug called Absolon.

items.title: Dreamgirls
items.description: With showstopping performances by a star-studded cast, Dreamgirls soars with the amazing story of three female singers who learn that anything is possible when you hold on to your dreams.

items.title: Vivir y morir en Los Ángeles
items.description: En esta habilidosa y retorcida película, dos policías de Los Ángeles intentan atrapar a un despiadado criminal llamado Eric Masters (Willem Dafoe). Cuando Masters asesina a uno de ellos, el otro jura vengarse sin importar las consecuencias.

items.title: Sword Master
items.description: In this visually stunning wuxia tale, a skilled swordsman seeks redemption from his violent past by living as a vagrant, but must confront his demons when chaos disrupts his quest for peace.

items.title: Saving General Yang
items.description: Seven sons must take on an army of thousands, brave treacherous mountain terrain, face their nemesis, and find a way home alive - all to rescue their beloved patriarch.

items.title: Take The Night
items.description: When a resentful brother organizes a prank kidnapping, he unwittingly hires career criminals who have plans of their own.

items.title: The Acid House
items.description: Three twisted tales of abuse, drugs, displaced personalities, and insect life by Scottish writer Irvine Welsh.

items.title: Kane
items.description: As an old school crime boss with multiple personalities, Abe lives a life where each identity is deadlier than the last. But when conflict with his archnemesis boils over, Kane—the deadliest of Abe’s personalities—finally reveals himself.

items.title: King Jack
items.description: Jack (Charlie Plummer) is a 15-year-old kid stuck in a small town. Between summer school, a feud with a violent older bully, and now stuck with caring for his runty younger cousin for the weekend, he's got more problems than he can handle.

items.title: Let's Kill Ward's Wife
items.description: Everyone wants Ward’s wife dead. But when murderous fantasies get real, Ward and his pals (Donald Faison, Scott Foley, Patrick Wilson, Amy Acker, Nicolette Sheridan)have new problems, like dumping a body and getting away with murder.

items.title: Emergency Declaration
items.description: After a terror incident occurs mid-flight, a passenger jet declares an emergency.

items.title: Robodoc
items.description: A robotic doctor thwarts the plans of a greedy lawyer.

items.title: Hatchet II
items.description: HATCHET II serves up a ferocious and exceptionally gory dose of splatterific entertainment with groundbreaking make-up effects, a wildly twisted sense of humor, and an even darker and bloodier ride than the first film.

items.title: How to Kill Monsters
items.description: The sole survivor of a blood-drenched massacre must team up with a rag-tag bunch of rookie cops and lawbreakers to fight off an invasion of monsters from another dimension.

items.title: Bangkok Dog
items.description: Special agent Andrew Kang intercepts a drug shipment and goes undercover in Bangkok's criminal underworld. Posing as a cartel operative, he must gain the gang's trust, but as the lines blur, he risks losing himself—and his way out.

items.title: Cavemen
items.description: Inspired by his best friend Tess, LA playboy Dean seeks true love, but navigating relationships proves harder than expected.

items.title: Child Of God
items.description: Based on the acclaimed Cormac McCarthy novel, director James Franco’s CHILD OF GOD follows Lester Ballard, a dispossessed, violent man in 1960s Tennessee. Deprived of family and home, Ballard collapses into a life of crime and degradation.

items.title: Due Justice
items.description: After the murder of his wife and kidnapping of his daughter, an attorney with a rigorous military background seeks revenge on the gang responsible.

items.title: Harold Risks It All
items.description: Harold Buttleman, a small-town tuxedo salesman, thinks he's the next great daredevil. He is on the brink of TV stardom, a 3am spot on the late night cable access, but the life of a daredevil stuntman is harder than it looks.

items.title: The Legend 2 [English-Language Version]
items.description: The Cantonese hero Fong Sai Yuk becomes involved in the secret brotherhood "The Red Flower", who are trying to overthrow the Manchurian emperor and re-establishing the Ming dynasty.

items.title: Enter The Dangerous Mind
items.description: A reclusive American composer with an online following has a tentative romance with a beautiful social worker. This offers a glimmer of hope, but his mind fractures as the voices in his head grow louder and more destructive.

items.title: Hunted
items.description: After being hired to rob a stately home, a group of friends are caught by the homeowners and hunted across the estate. To survive the homeowners’ sick brand of entertainment, the group must band together and fight for their survival.

items.title: Jiang Ziya
items.description: To earn his place with the gods, commander Jiang Ziya must vanquish the fox demon behind a brutal clan war. Upon learning the creature’s fate is tied to that of a young girl, he faces an impossible choice: can he sacrifice one to save many?

items.title: Con el corazón en la mano
items.description: Una mujer que busca mejorar su posición social no puede encontrar la felicidad. Ella vive atrapada en un falso mundo de lujo, pero pronto conocerá a un hombre que le cambiará su vida por completo.

items.title: She is King
items.description: Khanyisile is a talented performer who wants to be a star. She travels from her home in Nongoma in Zululand, to audition for a new musical to be staged at the Joburg Theatre. After a couple of detours, she lands a role in the chorus.

items.title: Fist Of Legend [English-Language Version]
items.description: In 1937, a Chinese martial artist returns to Shanghai to find his teacher dead and his school harassed by the Japanese.

items.title: Guns Of Redemption
items.description: A scarred gunslinger tries leaving violence behind, but his past catches up. Near death from an ambush, he straps on his guns for one final mission: to save two captives and avenge a murdered priest before time runs out.

items.title: Jiminy Glick In Lalawood
items.description: Culture critic Jiminy Glick gets tied up in a murder case at the Toronto Film Festival.

items.title: The Chef, The Actor, And The Scoundrel
items.description: World War II: a cholera epidemic ravages the streets of Beijing. A crack team of Chinese intelligence agents kidnap a Japanese general and biochemist who may hold the antidote.

items.title: The Last Days Of Frank And Jesse James
items.description: The various fortunes and misfortunes of the outlaws and bank robbers Frank and Jesse James.

items.title: My Sassy Girl
items.description: A sweet Midwestern guy with his life planned out for himself is wooed, groomed, and ultimately dumped by a complicated, elusive gal.

items.title: Fade To Black
items.description: A shy, lonely film buff embarks on a killing spree against those who browbeat and betray him, all the while stalking his idol, a Marilyn Monroe lookalike.

items.title: Halloween Ball 2024
items.description: Get ready for a fierce competition of performances at Halloween Ball, sponsored by göt2b!

items.title: Deadly Hero
items.description: A crazed New York policeman kills a creep to save a cellist, then terrorizes the cellist.

items.title: The Canterville Ghost
items.description: An American family moves in to Canterville Chase, a stately countryside mansion that has been haunted by the ghost Sir Simon De Canterville for 300 years.

items.title: A Dog's Courage
items.description: Jacob, a feisty and playful dog abandoned by his owners joins a pack of strays and embarks on a journey filled with fun adventures and life lessons in their pursuit to find a new and loving home.

items.title: Moon Shots: Inside the Lost Apollo Archive
items.description: Climb aboard NASA's 17 moon missions as seen using astronauts' 4K and HD footage. See those who conquered the impossible, from giant leaps to tragedy.

items.title: The Grey Zone
items.description: Steve Buscemi (Fargo) and Michael Stuhlbarg (Call Me by Your Name) star in this harrowing true story of the Jewish prisoners who staged the only armed revolt at Auschwitz.

items.title: May It Last: A Portrait of the Avett Brothers
items.description: An intimate portrait of the acclaimed North Carolina band The Avett Brothers depicting a lifelong bond and unique creative partnership, as band members undergo marriage, divorce, parenthood, illness, and the challenges of the music business.

items.title: Wishin' And Hopin'
items.description: The ups and downs of life at a parochial school for 10-year-old Felix as the Christmas nativity pageant approaches.

items.title: Howling IV: The Original Nightmare
items.description: A successful author moves to a small town after suffering a mental breakdown and is tormented by demons and werewolves.

items.title: Deus Irae
items.description: El padre Javier vive una existencia fracturada. Por un lado, ayuda a las familias que afirman haber presenciado milagros y, por otro, forma parte de un trío de sacerdotes excomulgados que cazan a los poseídos para exorcizarlos.

items.title: Breathing In
items.description: On a dark and stormy night during the last bitter days of the Anglo-Boer War, a gravely wounded General is nursed by Anna, a herbalist with mysterious powers.

items.title: Body Parts
items.description: An examination of how the nude female body is hypersexualized, under attack, and exploited on- and offscreen in Hollywood.

items.title: Evilspeak
items.description: An outcast military cadet taps into a way to summon demons and cast spells on his tormentors through his computer.

items.title: Fear X
items.description: When his wife is killed in a seemingly random incident Harry (Turturro), prompted by mysterious visions, journeys to discover the true circumstances surrounding her murder.

items.title: Hush
items.description: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

items.title: Hush [B&W Shush Cut]
items.description: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

items.title: Picking Up The Pieces
items.description: A small New Mexican village discovers a severed hand that is considered a miracle of God, when it actually belongs to a murdered spouse with a husband in search of it.

items.title: Ultraman R/B Movie - The Crystal of Bond
items.description: After peace is restored in Ayaka-shi, Isami and Asahi both move forward to acheive their dreams. On Earth, monster Snake Darkness appears! Katsumi will have to find his way back to Earth and reunite with his family...

items.title: Code Of The Assassins
items.description: After completing his training, an elite young assassin embarks on his first mission and is quickly ensnared in an intricate plot by powerful people, forcing him to go on the run from the government and rival assassin groups alike.

items.title: Detective K: Secret Of The Living Dead
items.description: When a series of unusual murders occurs, Detective K (KIM Myung-min) and his partner (OH Dal-soo) are once again called into action as they discover a trail of bodies with mysterious bite marks.

items.title: Dr. Cheon And The Lost Talisman
items.description: Dr. Cheon makes a living performing fake exorcisms on camera, but when a mysterious client arrives at his door, he is drawn into a series of strange events that challenge his skepticism—and resurface childhood horrors he’s tried to forget.

items.title: Hansan: Rising Dragon
items.description: In 1592, Korea is facing the threat of the powerful Japanese navy. As defending admiral Yin Sun-sin’s forces fall into crisis, they resort to a secret weapon—the dragon head ships known as geobukseon—to change the tide of the war.

items.title: Ichi The Killer
items.description: A notoriously sadistic yakuza enforcer's search for his boss’ killer brings him into the orbit of a demented costumed assassin known as Ichi.

items.title: Iron Protector
items.description: After his clan master's death, Wu-Lin guards a wealthy family's daughter in the City of Stone-cold. When she's targeted by a gang, he fights back, uncovering a darker plot.

items.title: Kundo: Age Of The Rampant
items.description: In the last days of the Joseon Dynasty, a band of fighters called KUNDO steal from the rich and give to the poor. They risk their lives for honor– and for one man, a debt of revenge owed to the aristocrat that stole his family and his name.

items.title: Kung Fu Stuntmen
items.description: The documentary gathers several best Chinese Kung Fu masters living in film industry, gives a full display of Hong Kong Kung Fu people in more than sixty years and shows their derring-do lives.

items.title: Matchless Mulan
items.description: To perform the duty for her father, Hua Mulan disguised herself as a man and came to battlefield.

items.title: Memoir Of A Murderer
items.description: A former serial killer with Alzheimers fights to protect his daughter from her psychotic boyfriend

items.title: Mojin: The Lost Legend
items.description: Starring Shu Qi and Based on the #1 Bestselling novels, MOJIN: THE LOST LEGEND pits a trio of grave robbers against rivals and the law, until a mysterious stranger tempts them into one last heist.

items.title: Columbus
items.description: Casey lives with her mother in a little-known town haunted by the promise of modernism. Jin, a visitor from the other side, attends to his dying father. Burdened by the future, they find respite in one another and the architecture that surrounds them.

items.title: The Vourdalak
items.description: Lost in a hostile forest, the Marquis d'Urfé, a noble emissary of the King of France, finds refuge in the home of a strange family.

items.title: The Thousand Faces Of Dunjia
items.description: In this martial arts action-packed journey, when an ancient creature with the power to destroy the world arises, a naive young constable discovers a secret society with supernatural abilities.

items.title: El verano de los peces voladores
items.description: Manena va de vacaciones con su padre, Francisco, a una parte del sur de Chile. Ella descubre que la obsesión de su padre por atrapar todos los peces carpa en su laguna artificial está haciendo enojar a la tribu Mapuche local, así que tiene que detenerlo.

items.title: Ultraman Zearth 2
items.description: Ultraman Shadow, Ultraman Zearth's most terrifying adversary yet, is brought to Earth by the murderous alien, Lady Benzen to be Ultraman Zearth's assassin.

items.title: How Long Will I Love U
items.description: In this rollicking romantic comedy, a man and a woman living in the same apartment nearly twenty years apart wake one day to find their timelines have merged.

items.title: Hydra
items.description: Retired assassin Takashi leads a quiet life as a chef at a sushi bar, where he secretly watches over the daughter of a former associate. However, his peace is short-lived: soon, he is recruited for a final job that he simply can’t refuse.

items.title: Ultraman: the Next
items.description: Will Maki prevail or will the reptilian beast destroy him? And even if Maki does win, can he retain his humanity?

items.title: Ultraman Zearth
items.description: All over the world gold mysteriously vanishes without a trace. MYDO (the Mysterious Yonder Defense Organization) is called in to investigate.

items.title: Valley Of The Gods
items.description: Starring Josh Hartnett and John Malkovich, Valley of the Gods juxtaposes abundance and poverty through the eyes of an anguished writer, a bizarre trillionaire, and a struggling Navajo community armed with only a now-imminent ancient legend.

items.title: Tunnel
items.description: When a tunnel collapses on Jung-soo, his ensuing rescue operation becomes the subject of widespread media coverage and frenzy.

items.title: Ultraman Zero Side Story: Killer The Beatstar
items.description: Inside the Planet Bram, members of the Ulimate Force Zero encouter robot monsters under the control of Beatstar on a mission to destroy all organic life.

items.title: The Taking Of Tiger Mountain
items.description: Tsui Hark's adaptation of Qu Bo's novel pits a Liberation Army captain against a ruthless bandit ruling Northeast China, aided by an undercover investigator.

items.title: Tormented
items.description: Daigo's silence hides a dark secret. When he disappears, his sister Kiriko must brave nightmares to find him. A chilling tale of family and horror.

items.title: The Bodyguard From Beijing [English-Language Version]
items.description: A corrupt businessman commits a murder and the only witness is the girlfriend of another businessman with close connections to the Chinese government, so a bodyguard from Beijing is dispatched to help two Hong Kong cops protect the witness.

items.title: Daniel's Gotta Die
items.description: After his father's death, Daniel's plan to reconnect with his family hits a snag when he discovers they all want to kill him to claim the inheritance.

items.title: Every Other Holiday
items.description: Two sisters' only wish is to spend the holidays as a family, forcing their divorced parents to work out their issues and find love again.

items.title: Dead Reckoning
items.description: A thriller inspired by the Boston Marathon bombing in 2013.

items.title: Moonlight and Valentino
items.description: Insecurities are exposed when a friend, a sister and an ex-stepmother help a widow get on with life.

items.title: Impulse
items.description: William Shatner stars as Matt Stone, a deranged gigolo who preys on rich women, unable to control his murderous psychosexual urges.

items.title: Tunnel Vision
items.description: "Tunnel Vision" is a riotous satire of TV, packed with outrageous sketches & biting humor that mercilessly skewers the absurdities of TV culture.

items.title: Boss Up
items.description: A musical about a sartorially complicated woman on a wild mission to discover her true purpose.

items.title: Beside Bowie: The Mick Ronson Story
items.description: David Bowie narrates this unprecedented celebration of the life and works of guitar virtuoso Mick Ronson

items.title: The Emperor Jones
items.description: The murderous Brutus Jones escapes from jail and bluffs his way to becoming emperor of a small island, but will the power be too much to handle?

items.title: El Ultimo Tren Al Rock'n Roll
