items.description: The Last Call, una vieja banda de rock, es finalista en una batalla de bandas por primera vez en su carrera. Sin embargo, el día de la final, el cantante y el técnico de sonido desaparecen misteriosamente.

items.title: A Better Tomorrow [English Subtitled]
items.description: A reforming ex-gangster tries to reconcile with his estranged policeman brother, but the ties to his former gang are difficult to break.

items.title: A Better Tomorrow II [English Subtitled]
items.description: A restauranteur teams up with a police officer and his ex-con brother to avenge the death of a friend's daughter.

items.title: A Better Tomorrow III [English Subtitled]
items.description: A man travels from China to Vietnam, on the brink of war with America, to retrieve his uncle and cousin but find complications when he falls in love with a female gangster with a dangerous ex.

items.title: A Chinese Ghost Story [English Subtitled]
items.description: After a string of bad luck, a debt collector has no other choice than to spend the night in a haunted temple, where he encounters a ravishing female ghost and later battles to save her soul from the control of a wicked tree demon.

items.title: El Niño Gato
items.description: En la Galicia de los años 50, un enigmático ser con aspecto felino siembra temor en un pequeño pueblo. Extraños sucesos y muertes inexplicables darán vida a la leyenda del Niño Gato.

items.title: Ramona
items.description: Ramona acaba de mudarse a Madrid con su novio, esperando tener un nuevo comienzo.

items.title: El bebé de Rosemary
items.description: La historia de una joven pareja que espera su primer bebé. Como casi todas las primerizas, Rosemary se siente confundida. Su marido, un actor ambicioso pero sin éxito, hace un pacto con el diablo que promete llevar su carrera a la fama.

items.title: The Four
items.description: In a world of spies and secret organizations, four kung fu superheroes must stop an army of the undead from reaching the capital. Based on Wen Ruian's novel.

items.title: Hard Boiled [English Subtitled]
items.description: A tough-as-nails cop teams up with an undercover agent to shut down a sinister mobster and his crew.

items.title: Peking Opera Blues [English Subtitled]
items.description: The movie is set in chaotic 1920's China, when warlords fought each other for power while Sun Yat-Sen's underground movement tried to establish a democratic republic.

items.title: Coming Soon
items.description: Three girlfriends discover that one of them has never had a genuine orgasm, so the others quickly decide that they are going to make sure she has one.

items.title: The Ghost Writer
items.description: Filmmaker Roman Polanski ramps up the suspense in a thriller about a writer (Ewan McGregor) penning the memoir of an ex-prime minister (Pierce Brosnan).

items.title: Inbred
items.description: Four young offenders and their care workers visit the remote Yorkshire village of Mortlake, which prides on keeping itself to itself. A minor incident with locals rapidly escalates into a blood-soaked, deliriously warped nightmare.

items.title: Song of Love
items.description: Through emotional highs and lows, Solomon and Sheba discover love is more than just chemistry or passion. Their choices could lead to true love or separate them forever.

items.title: Drugstore June
items.description: After the pharmacy in her small town is robbed, a girl who still lives at home with her parents takes matters into her own hands to solve the crime, while at the same time trying to get over her ex-boyfriend and become more of an adult.

items.title: Alalá
items.description: El barrio de las “Tres mil viviendas” es conocido por su historial de marginación y decadencia. Pero desde hace años, la esperanza revive con una escuela de flamenco para niños.

items.title: Love Unexpected
items.description: Chase is a young and confident college student, who is a self-proclaimed "ladies man" but also feels that love is for suckers. That is until he meets his match Kary, the fiercely independent student who isn't interested in wasting time on anything casual.

items.title: Shotlanta
items.description: Mozzy, driven by a desire to lift his family out of poverty in Jamaica, emigrates to Atlanta. He quickly rises in the ranks of the city's drug trade, determined to achieve wealth and security for his mother and sister.

items.title: The Kitty Hallow Killer
items.description: A serial killer is on the loose in Houston killing pedophiles and rapists.

items.title: Princess Caraboo
items.description: Dressed in strange clothes and speaking no English, a mysterious woman is arrested in the English countryside. But a sympathetic aristocrat welcomes the young woman into her home, believing that she is actually a foreign princess.

items.title: A Chinese Ghost Story III
items.description: The Swordsman Yen and Leslie Cheung characters are replaced by a Buddhist Abbot and disciple (Tony Leung). Jacky Cheung also pops up again, this time as a money-grabbing swordsman with a neat bag of tricks.

items.title: Shade
items.description: A group of hustlers encounter "The Dean" and pull off a successful sting that results in their pursuit by a vengeful gangster.

items.title: The Quick and the Dead (1987)
items.description: A mysterious stranger rides into a homesteading family's life when they are attacked by a ruthless gang.

items.title: A Chinese Ghost Story II
items.description: A Chinese Ghost Story II is a 1990 Hong Kong romantic comedy-horror film directed by Ching Siu-tung and produced by Tsui Hark.

items.title: Bullet In The Head
items.description: When three close friends escape from Hong Kong to war-time Saigon to start a criminal's life, they all go through a harrowing experience which totally shatters their lives and their friendship forever.

items.title: Mojin: The Worm Valley
items.description: Hu Bayi embarks on a perilous quest to find the Tomb of Emperor Xian, battling monstrous creatures on an island, in this mystical action-adventure.

items.title: Night Of The Assassin
items.description: In the final days of the Joseon Dynasty, a renowned assassin faces an inescapable fate when he crosses paths with a former swordsman and village leader. Amidst the chaos, their encounter sets in motion an epic tale of irreversible destiny.

items.title: Operation Red Sea
items.description: When a terrorist plot to obtain nuclear materials is hidden under the cover of a violent coup, only the Chinese Navy’s elite Jiaolong Assault Team have the deadly skill and precision needed to take on the situation.

items.title: Once Upon A Time
items.description: ONCE UPON A TIME is a fantasy epic based on a best-selling novel, weaving a tale of epic battles, passion, and the eternal struggle between mortals and gods.

items.title: J-Lo:  una mujer hecha por sí misma
items.description: Jennifer Lopez, mejor conocida como "J.Lo", estaba destinada a ser una "artista de triple amenaza" en el ámbito de la actuación, la música y el baile.

items.title: Camila Cabello Solo Salta
items.description: Karla Camila Cabello, nacida en Cuba, pasó de concursante en X Factor a estrella solista, ganando importantes premios musicales. Ahora radica en Miami, apoya causas solidarias y brilla en la música y el cine, incluyendo su papel en "Cenicienta".

items.title: Bad Bunny Control Mundial
items.description: Bad Bunny destaca como estrella del pop, luchador y activista, llevando el reggaetón a nivel mundial e inspirándose en figuras como El General, Ivy Queen, Daddy Yankee y Karol G.

items.title: Charge
items.description: Extreme-action story of the first-ever international race for zero-emissions motorcycles. It came on June 12th 2009, the race took place on the Isle of Man TT course, the most demanding and deadly circuit on the planet.

items.title: Faster
items.description: Filmed around the world in 2001 and 2002, Faster captures the rise of MotoGP superstar Valentino Rossi amid ferocious competition, especially from his bitter rival Max Biaggi.

items.title: Hitting the Apex
items.description: Hitting the Apex' is the story of six fighters - six of the fastest motorcycle racers the world has ever seen - and of the fates that awaited them at the peak of the sport.

items.title: Repeater
items.description: A botched job in Colombia forces a burned-out assassin to take a high-stakes open contract.

items.title: The Killer [English Subtitled]
items.description: A disillusioned assassin accepts one last hit in hopes of using his earnings to restore vision to a singer he accidentally blinded.

items.title: A Christmas Kiss
items.description: High-end interior designer Priscilla Hall and her assistant Wendy vie for the attentions of Priscilla's socialite boyfriend while decorating his home for the holidays.

items.title: Some Other Woman
items.description: Eve sees a strange woman watching her and her husband from outside their home. As the stranger slowly intrudes further into their lives, Eve begins to question if she's losing her mind or her husband's loyalty.

items.title: El castigo
items.description: Dos padres castigan a su hijo a quedarse solo durante unos minutos en el bosque por haberse portado mal. Cuando regresan a por él, no está. Se inicia entonces una búsqueda frenética cargada de sentimientos de culpa, rabia y frustración.

items.title: Los Amores Cobardes
items.description: Eva regresa a su ciudad natal para pasar las vacaciones de verano. Allí la esperan su madre y Gema, su incondicional amiga. Lo que Eva no esperaba es encontrarse con Rubén, quién solía ser su mejor amigo hasta que perdieron el contacto.

items.title: Menese
items.description: Un viaje para descubrir la vida y la carrera de José Menese, un artista flamenco transgresor que vivió durante el franquismo y exportó su arte a todo el mundo.

items.title: Moz and I
items.description: Documental que describe el fenómeno fan a través de la vida del Dj Luis "Le Nuit", el admirador más incondicional y entrañable de Morrissey. A partir de esta relación, se explora la evolución personal de Le Nuit com Dj y de la escena indie nacional.

items.title: City On Fire
items.description: An undercover cop infiltrates a gang of thieves who plan to rob a jewelry store.

items.title: Más allá de las estrellas. Fotografiando un agujero negro
items.description: El 10 de abril de 2019 la obtención de la primera imagen de un agujero negro. Una fotografía que convulsionó al mundo ya que confirmaba la teoría de la relatividad de Einstein.

items.title: Deer Camp '86
items.description: Six friends travel to Northern Michigan to hunt deer. But something horrific has been awakened, and the hunters soon become the hunted.

items.title: Frankenstein Legacy
items.description: William's search for his father's stolen body unveils horrors at home as his mother descends into madness, driven by Frankenstein's journals.

items.title: God of Pain
items.description: A man wakes up in the middle of the street with no idea how he ended up there. Soon he is forced to confront Algea the God of Pain.

items.title: Red Snow
items.description: A struggling vampire romance novelist must defend herself against real-life vampires during Christmas in Lake Tahoe.

items.title: Essex Boys Retribution
items.description: The next generation of Essex Boys vie for control 20 years after Britain's most infamous gangland murders as revenge is sought by all sides.

items.title: Iona
items.description: Having left an island community as a damaged teenager, a woman returns home with a secret and her own troubled adolescent son.

items.title: The Contemplation of Noise
items.description: Documental rodado en Nueva York que retrata el proceso creativo del artista sevillano Miguel Ángel Mayal a su paso por la gran ciudad.

items.title: Aftersun
items.description: Years after their last vacation, Sophie reflects on the rare time spent with her loving, idealistic father and tries to reconcile the father she knew with the man she didn't.

items.title: 20th Century Women
items.description: A strong-willed single mother (Annette Bening) raises her teenage son with the help of two unconventional younger women (Elle Fanning, Greta Gerwig) in this look at a makeshift family's comic adventures in Santa Barbara during the summer of 1979.

items.title: 47 Hours To Live
items.description: Two teenage girls dabble with an online game claiming you can use your phone to summon the supernatural, and soon find out if you lose the game you lose your life.

items.title: 2149: The Aftermath
items.description: In an oppressive future, a young man lives in isolation in a life-sustaining pod until a lightning strike prompts him to venture into a post-apocalyptic earth in search of life.

items.title: Along With The Gods: The Two Worlds
items.description: After his death, firefighter Ja-hong must pass seven trials in the afterlife to prove he lived nobly and reincarnate. Based on a popular webcomic, it's an action-packed fantasy about life, death, and rebirth.

items.title: A Perfect Valentine
items.description: Chika, a 35-year-old entrepreneur, is desperate for the perfect Valentine. After chasing bouquets and seeking spiritual help, she overlooks her devoted driver Daniel, fixated instead on finding a flawless man—until love surprises her in an unexpected way.

items.title: Swordsman II [English Subtitled]
items.description: Ling Wu Chung decides to hide from the chaotic world. Before leaving, he visits his friends, a tribe of snake-wielding women warriors. However, he finds that the tribe have been attacked, and their leader Yam Ying Ying has been abducted.

items.title: Stars at Noon
items.description: A young American journalist (Margaret Qualley) stranded in Nicaragua seduces an enigmatic Englishman (Joe Alwyn) who seems like her best chance of escape. She soon realizes, though, that their torrid affair has only put her in more danger.

items.title: Alice in Terrorland
items.description: Alice is sent to live at her grandma's estate 'Wonderland' where she falls into a waking, terror filled nightmare.

items.title: Cachita: "La esclavitud borrada"
items.description: La película profundiza en la existencia de la esclavitud negra en España, persigue el rastro que deja en nuestra cultura, en nuestra genética y en nuestra sociedad.

items.title: Dos a la carta
items.description: Dos hombres, Óscar, un exitoso financiero casado con una mujer muy ambiciosa, y Dani, un campesino, acaban de descubrir que son hermanos. Ahora se ven obligados a trabajar juntos en un restaurante que les tocó en herencia en un maravilloso entorno rural.

items.title: El bucle de Latham
items.description: Marcos hereda una casa de un padre que nunca conoció. Esta herencia le hará conocer un pasado que ignora por completo. A medida que descubre problemas familiares no resueltos, todo comienza a volverse confuso.

items.title: You Hurt My Feelings
items.description: A novelist's (Julia Louis-Dreyfus) longstanding marriage is suddenly upended when she overhears her husband give his honest reaction to her latest book. A film about trust, lies, and the things we say to the people we love most.

items.title: Reservoir Dogs
items.description: After a seemingly perfectly planned robbery goes awry, a group of criminals begins to suspect a traitor in their ranks, and back at their headquarters, they try to suss out the culprit.

items.title: The Swordsman [English Subtitled]
items.description: A kung-fu manual known as the sacred scroll is stolen from the Emperor's library. An army detachment is sent to recover it. Meanwhile, a young swordsman and his fellow disciple are accidentally drawn into the chaos.

items.title: Jaime Urrutia: "La fuerza de la costumbre"
items.description: El gran cantante del pop español y exlíder de Gabinete Caligari destripa su mundo interior con voz propia. Jaime Urrutia abre sus archivos con la ayuda de Loquillo, Alaska y otros grandes de España.

items.title: Juan Sebastián Bollaín: "La eficacia de la utopía"
items.description: El director Raúl Arteaga nos trae un documental en el que el director Juan Sebastián Bollaín repasa su obra a través de sus títulos más emblemáticos.

items.title: The Corsican Brothers
items.description: After their parents are killed, co-joined twin boys are separated, with one raised as a gentleman in Paris and the other in the mountains, becoming a bandit.

items.title: Blood Shot
items.description: A handsome man (Danny Dyer) falls for a beautiful, mysterious model after a chance encounter. But as their whirlwind romance deepens, her dark side emerges. Is it true love—or a deadly mistake he'll regret forever?

items.title: Street Trash
items.description: STREET TRASH follows a group of homeless misfits as they fight for survival when they discover a plot to exterminate every homeless person in the city.

items.title: Mujeres, de Coque Malla
items.description: Tras varios discos en solitario, el músico y actor Coque Malla decide realizar "Mujeres", un álbum de duetos solo con mujeres, donde repasa algunos de sus temas más conocidos.

items.title: Ramoncín. Una vida en el filo
items.description: Un repaso de la carrera profesional de Ramoncín, desde sus inicios en el mundo de la música, su ascenso como cantante y salto a la fama, hasta la actualidad, sus éxitos y su lucha por los derechos de autor, sin olvidar sus orígenes.

items.title: Y Dios creó a la mujer
items.description: De Mornay interpreta a una mujer presa por error, que está decidida a recuperar su libertad.

items.title: Ultra Galaxy Legend Side Story: Ultraman Zero VS Darklops Zero
items.description: Ultraman Zero, Rei, and Captain Hyuga of the spaceship Pendragon enter a strange pocket dimension and battle evil imitation Ultramen and Zero's own doppelganger, Darklops Zero, in the action-packed lead up to "Ultraman Zero the Movie".

items.title: Contragolpe a la vida
items.description: Emilio, un joven boxeador que anda en malos pasos, tiene el gran sueño de ganar el campeonato de los Guantes Dorados. Pronto se halla en una encrucijada, luego de ir a prisión.

items.title: Ultraman Cosmos: The First Contact
items.description: Musashi is a 10 year old boy with big dreams. He wants to grow up to be an astronaut so he can fly through the stars and meet his hero, Ultraman.

items.title: La maldición de Hollow Glen
items.description: Hace doscientos años, los habitantes de Hollow Glen sacrificaron a un niño deforme en una hoguera, y del humo surgió algo tan malvado y monstruoso que maldijo al pueblo para siempre.

items.title: Ocho días de terror
items.description: Un misterioso cometa pasa por la Tierra, dando a las máquinas de todo el mundo una mente asesina propia.

items.title: Ultraman Dyna Return of Hanejiro
items.description: Hanejiro was a little alien creature who was the friend of the Super GUTS team when they battled together with Ultraman Dyna against aliens and monsters who wanted to conquer the Earth. After many successful battles, Hanejiro returned to his home planet.

items.title: Ultraman Gaia Once Again Gaia
items.description: In the years following Ultraman Gaia and Ultraman Agul's battle with the super giant monster Zog, the Earth seems to be once again at peace. But the Expanded Interceptive Guardians (XIG) team picks up strange message from the sea.

items.title: Ultraman Gaia: Battle In Hyperspace
items.description: Tsutomu's greatest wish is to meet his hero: Agent Gam of the XIG Team, the human alter ego of the mighty ULTRAMAN GAIA. Of course, Tsutomu knows that ULTRAMAN GAIA and the monsters he battles aren't real, they're just characters on a TV show. Right?

items.title: Ultraman Cosmos 2: The Blue Planet
items.description: When he returns to earth to attend the wedding of his friend in Saipan, Musashi meets a beautiful girl named Shau who claims to come from the bottom of the sea.

items.title: San Valentín sangriento (2009)
items.description: Una nueva versión de la clásica película de terror de 1981 de George Mihalka, San Valentín sangriento tiene lugar diez años después de un devastador accidente en una mina de carbón con una serie de horribles asesinatos que atormentan a una pequeña ciudad.

items.title: Ultraman Mebius and Ultraman Brothers
items.description: Ultraman, Ultra Seven, Ultraman Ace and Ultraman Jack battle U-Killer Saurus, a monster that threatens to overwhelm their combined might!

items.title: Ultraman Mebius Side Story: Armored Darkness
items.description: Peace returned to the earth after the fierce battle with the Alien Emperor. But one day Kaijus commenced the aggression again!

items.title: Along With The Gods: The Last 49 Days
items.description: As the deceased soul Su-hong and his three afterlife guardians face the remaining trials to obtain their reincarnation, the guardians come face to face with the buried truth of their tragic time on earth.

items.title: Ultraman Mebius Side Story: Ghost Rebirth
items.description: An emergency signal for the Ultra Heroes flashes in the sky. What awaits has threatened the Ultra Heroes before, and a mysterious shadow watches the fighting

items.title: Chronicles Of The Ghostly Tribe
items.description: In 1979, a young soldier is working in China's snowcapped mountains when an explosion reveals bizarre fossils hidden deep in the mountain caverns. What they discover next will change his life and human history forever.

items.title: Only A Few Fans
items.description: "Only a Few Fans" exposes the struggles and exploitation of OnlyFans creators, urging empathy, better support, and alternatives to protect the vulnerable.

items.title: Switched
items.description: Tired of being bullied, Cassandra Evans prays that her nemesis, Katie Sharp, the queen bee of social media, would know what it's like to walk a day in her shoes. Her prayer is answered in an unexpected way when they get "Switched."

items.title: Popeye's Revenge
items.description: The legend of Popeye haunts a group of councillors as they intend to open a summer camp.

items.title: Ultraman Cosmos vs Ultraman Justice: The Final Battle
items.description: Once again, Musashi has encounterd Ultraman Cosmos. Now Ultraman Cosmos has gained some new modes to defeat Scropis. Musashi has joined Team Sea to save the Blue Area.

items.title: Birth of Ultraman Special
items.description: Airing in Japan on July 10th, 1966, one week before the original series premiere, this stage show was filmed before a live studio audience and introduced viewers to the story, cast, and characters of Ultraman.

items.title: Ruta 666
items.description: Route 666 is the thrilling story of a Federal agent whose pursuit of an escaped witness brings him directly in contact with a highway haunted by a treacherous past.

items.title: Negra Navidad
items.description: Una reversión escalofriante de la clásica película de terror. Un maníaco fugitivo aterroriza a las jóvenes de una fraternidad en su propia casa en Nochebuena. ¿Quién sobrevivirá a la noche?

items.title: The Barrens
items.description: A weekend getaway turns murderous at the Wharton State Pine Barrens, as a family starts to believe they’ve encountered the legendary Jersey Devil. Starring Stephen Moyer (TV’s TRUE BLOOD).

items.title: Ataque a la embajada
items.description: El experto en eliminación de bombas Steve Mitchell es enviado a la embajada de Estados Unidos en Bucarest para desarmar una bomba nuclear, pero su misión se interrumpe cuando un grupo de terroristas asaltan el edificio y toman rehenes.

items.title: Por humor a la musica
items.description: A partir de un concierto de aniversario del grupo musical ''No me pises que llevo chanclas'', Álvaro Begines celebra los veinticinco años del conjunto andaluz, que ha introducido la comedia en la música española.

items.title: Héroes
items.description: Dos jóvenes estadounidenses con habilidades especiales deben apurarse para encontrar a una chica en Hong Kong antes de que lo haga una sombría organización gubernamental llamada División.

items.title: Chained
items.description: A serial-killer cabbie (Vincent D’Onofrio of TV’s LAW & ORDER: CI) kidnaps a boy and makes him his servant. Years later, will the boy follow in his captor's footsteps or escape?

items.title: El escritor fantasma
items.description: El cineasta Roman Polanski eleva la tensión en este thriller sobre un escritor (Ewan McGregor) encargado de redactar las vivencias de un ex primer ministro (Pierce Brosnan).

items.title: Squealer
items.description: Tyrese Gibson protagoniza una historia aterradora basada en hechos reales. A medida que crece la lista de personas desaparecidas en una pequeña ciudad, los actos de un asesino en serie se descubren en una granja de cerdos local.

items.title: Tú eres el próximo
items.description: La reunión familiar de los Davis se tuerce cuando su casa es asediada por un equipo de asaltantes con máscaras y ballestas.

items.title: Til Death Do Us Part
items.description: From the creator of Final Destination, a runaway bride must fight for survival against her vengeful former fiancé and his seven deadly groomsmen.

items.title: Ultra Galaxy Fight: New Generation Heroes
items.description: Ultra Warriors Ginga, Victory, X, Orb, Geed, Rosso, Blu and Ribut unite as the "New Generation Heroes"!

items.title: American Horror House
items.description: Three sorority hopefuls must survive the night after ghosts take over the sorority house, and the housemother goes on a killing spree.

items.title: Bad Detectives
items.description: Two young women inherit their grandfather's detective agency and reluctantly team up to solve their murders.

items.title: Cut Bank
items.description: Things go from bad to worse when a murder witness (Liam Hemsworth) in small-town Montana tries to leverage the crime into a get-rich-quick scheme.

items.title: Ultra Galaxy Fight: The Destined Crossroad
items.description: The New Generation Heroes gather once again! And just who is the mysterious Ultraman Regulos?! The decisive battle draws near!

items.title: Men
items.description: In the aftermath of a tragedy, Harper retreats to the English countryside hoping to heal.

items.title: A Royal Christmas Ballet
items.description: A retired ballerina is pressed into service working with a visiting team of royal ambassadors to put on the season's performance of The Nutcracker and finds herself center stage in an unexpected Christmas romance.

items.title: Ultra Galaxy Fight: The Absolute Conspiracy
items.description: A conspiracy is underway. Stories are intersecting. What is the aim of the golden giant?! A new history of Ultra begins!

items.title: Ultraman Zero: The Revenge of Belial
items.description: Ultraman Zero builds up of a new band of comrades, both human and alien, to defeat the Menacing Belial.

items.title: Superior 8 Ultraman Brothers
items.description: Ultraman Moebius is joined once again by Ultraman, Ultra Seven, Ultraman Jack, and Ultraman Ace, as well as three later Ultramen (Tiga, Dyna, and Gaia) to fight more powerful versions of familiar Ultra Monsters.

items.title: Bite The Dust
items.description: Two infamous bounty hunters searching for missing orphan children face off against a cruel baron and his small army that control the town.

items.title: Field Of Lost Shoes
items.description: A group of teenage cadets sheltered from war at the Virginia Military Institute must confront the horrors of an adult world when they are called upon to defend the Shenandoah Valley.

items.title: Sica
items.description: Sica está obsesionada con que el mar le devuelva el cuerpo de su padre tras un naufragio. Mientras se adentra en un viaje de descubrimiento conoce a Suso, un chico que espera una tormenta.

items.title: Beyond Wasteland
items.description: Transporting us into the world of Mad Max, we explore the eccentric world of the fans, these unique fans find their place amongst the Mad Max society.

items.title: Here To Be heard: The Story Of The Slits
items.description: The tale of the formation, journey and end of the seminal Punk/Reggae band The Slits.

items.title: Ultra Fight Victory
items.description: In order to prevent this disaster from happening, and to save the Galaxy, Earth's amazing superhero, Ultraman Victory must use a new secret weapon, a combination sword and flute called the Knight Timbre!

items.title: Ultraman Mebius Side Story: Hikari Saga
items.description: Under the order of the Father of Ultra, Ultraman Hikari came back to earth as a member of the Inter Galactic Defense Force.

items.title: Ultraman Blazar the Movie: Tokyo Kaiju Showdown
items.description: When a powerful substance gives birth to a terrifying new kaiju, Ultraman Blazar and SKaRD clash with the monster in the middle of Tokyo.

items.title: Normal
items.description: A deadly car accident brings together a group of previously unrelated people, each of whom is forced to deal with the emotional fallout.

items.title: Standing Up For Sunny
items.description: A reclusive man with cerebral palsy helps a timid comic and discovers love and belonging through stand-up comedy.

items.title: Autores anónimas
items.description: Cuando un grupo disfuncional de escritores inéditos acepta a Hannah en su grupo, lo último que esperan es que triunfe de la noche a la mañana. ¿Podrán estos adorables inadaptados lograr sus sueños artísticos y evitar matarse entre ellos en el proceso?

items.title: The 4:30 Movie
items.description: In Kevin Smith's most personal film to date, a teenage cinephile tries to woo the girl of his dreams while dealing with a hilarious mix of friends and enemies at his local cinema.

items.title: Gothic
items.description: Lord Byron promises his guests a night of horror only a mad poet can deliver and after partaking in hallucinogens, the guests tell ghost stories while exploring the dark corridors of his home – and of their minds.

items.title: Hatchet
items.description: A boat ride of the haunted Louisiana bayous takes a turn for the worse when the tourists learn the terrifying tale of local legend who accidentally killed with a hatchet by the hands of his own father.

items.title: Incident At Loch Ness
items.description: A fictional account of a crew that is filming a documentary about the Loch Ness monster.

items.title: Kickboxer III (The Art Of War)
items.description: David Sloan (Mitchell ) travels to Rio de Janeiro where the action is hotter, the women sexier, and the competition deadlier than ever before.

items.title: Letters At Christmas
items.description: A couple on the verge of divorce are given a new lease on love when their family renovates a historic hotel and their two children uncover old letters from a couple who never met.

items.title: El vengador anónimo III
items.description: El arquitecto y justiciero Paul Kersey vuelve a Nueva York, donde un deshonesto detective de la policía le obligará a combatir el crimen callejero causado por una importante pandilla que aterroriza los vecindarios.

items.title: El vengador 4: yo soy la justicia
items.description: Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) tiene una misión: acabar con el tráfico de drogas de Los Ángeles. Y es que la hija adolescente de su novia ha muerto trágicamente de una sobredosis. Está armado, es peligroso... y está loco de remate.

items.title: El justiciero de la ciudad V
items.description: Ahora que finalmente había conseguido tener un estilo de vida más tranquilo como profesor de arquitectura, el exjusticiero Paul Kersey debe retomar sus viejas costumbres cuando un capo de la mafia amenaza a su nueva familia.

items.title: Kill Bill: Vol 1
items.description: The Bride wakes up after a long coma. The baby that she carried before entering the coma is gone. The only thing on her mind is to take revenge on the assassination team that betrayed her - a team she was once part of.

items.title: Durmiendo fuera de casa
items.description: Desesperadas por mejorar su estatus social, cuatro mejores amigas se embarcan en una búsqueda del tesoro que dura toda la noche contra el grupo más popular de su escuela.

items.title: Bloodline
items.description: Two brothers, Marcus and Nate have chosen opposite sides of the law. Marcus, a police officer confronts Nate, the city's biggest drug lord. Marcus is then faced with having to choose between his blood and his duty to protect and serve.

items.title: Ladrón
items.description: Michael Mann (Hunter) dirige este elegante drama cargado de acción protagonizado por James Caan (Misery), un ladrón de cajas fuertes que planea su último golpe por el bien de una mujer, Tuesday Weld (Nieve que quema), y para empezar de cero.

items.title: Harry Tracy
items.description: By the year 1900, Butch Cassidy, the Sundance Kid, John Wesley Hardin, and virtually all of the West's legendary outlaws are either dead or in jail pending execution-all of them, that is, except train robber and escape artist extraordinaire, Harry Tracy.

items.title: El mundo está loco, loco, loco
items.description: ¡En una interminable autopista del desierto, ocho automovilistas que van de vacaciones comparten una experiencia ¡que cambiará sus planes y sus vidas!

items.title: Dracula 3000
items.description: A salvage ship on a routine mission discovers a transporter vessel that had been reported missing 100 years earlier. When the salvage crew boards the vessel, they discover 50 long black coffins.

items.title: La Pantera Rosa
items.description: En esta divertidísima comedia, Peter Sellers presentó al mundo al más torpe de los inspectores, Jacques Clouseau, quien pretende impedir que Fantasma (David Niven), un famoso ladrón, robe un diamante de valor inestimable llamado la Pantera Rosa.

items.title: The Dentist
items.description: It's Been Six Months. Time for your Check-Up!

items.title: Navidad en vivo
items.description: Cuando los compañeros de trabajo deciden organizar una fiesta navideña en la oficina, su diversión se convierte en un completo desastre para todos los involucrados.

items.title: Max
items.description: Un perro que ayudó a los soldados en Afganistán vuelve a los EUA, donde lo adopta la familia de su adiestrador tras sufrir una experiencia traumática.

items.title: Alone In The Dark
items.description: Christian Slater and Tara Reid star in this thriller about a private investigator who specializes in unexplainable supernatural phenomena.

items.title: American Dreamer
items.description: A down-on-his-luck ride-share driver, who makes extra cash chauffeuring a drug dealer around town, finds himself in a financial bind and decides to kidnap the dealer's child.

items.title: Dreamkatcher
items.description: In this terrifying horror-thriller starring Radha Mitchell, Lin Shaye, and Henry Thomas, an evil spirit escapes from an ancient relic and commands a boy to murder his newly married stepmother.

items.title: The Assignment
items.description: Michelle Rodriguez is a hit man out for revenge against her former captor and rogue surgeon, Sigourney Weaver, in this action packed thriller from legendary director Walter Hill.

items.title: Fear of Rain
items.description: FEAR OF RAIN dives into the terrifying inner workings of a young woman (Madison Iseman) who desperately wants to believe the world that she sees and feels is real…but instead she is forced to question everything, and everyone, around her.

items.title: Ginger Snaps
items.description: The Craft meets The Howling in this edgy, modern werewolf tale in which a teenage girl must choose between saving herself and joining her sister in an otherworldly existence.

items.title: Jayne Mansfield's Car
items.description: From Academy Award(r)-winner Billy Bob Thornton. Two families - one southern, one British - try to make amends over heartfelt, and at times hilarious, struggles after a family member dies.

items.title: Like Minds
items.description: A forensic psychologist is tasked with determining whether or not a minor should face murder charges for killing his schoolmate.

items.title: Rise: Blood Hunter
items.description: Horror starring Lucy Liu. When she is turned into a vampire by a gang of the walking undead, journalist Sadie Blake embarks on a mission to take them down. That is, if she can control her own blood-thirst in the meantime…

items.title: Night Of The Living Dead: Resurrection
items.description: Based on George A. Romero’s classic NIGHT OF THE LIVING DEAD. The deceased have risen with the instinct to feed on the living as a family is trapped during a zombie apocalypse.

items.title: El cementerio de esperanza negra
items.description: Basado supuestamente en un hecho de la vida real, este thriller supernatural detalla las experiencias de una familia que se muda a su nuevo hogar y descubren que está embrujado.

items.title: Lo perdido
items.description: Tras la muerte de su madre, Santiago Solera y su hermano Raúl deciden buscar recuerdos familiares comunes y, de alguna forma, redescubrir una parte de la historia de España.

items.title: De Prada a la nada
items.description: Nora y Mary son hermanas mimadas que viven la buena vida en Beverly Hills hasta que su amoroso padre muere inesperadamente.

items.title: 10 años
items.description: Un grupo de amigos se reencuentran en la reunión de alumnos de su secundaria. Cada uno tiene una historia increíble para contar.

items.title: Cook Off
items.description: Amateur chefs from around the country compete for a million-dollar prize in the ultimate food fight.

items.title: Deadly Ruphoria
items.description: A rare night out for college student Shana Jones turns deadly when the head of a human trafficking ring sets his sights on her.

items.title: Match Made
items.description: Rich, successful, and handsome, Mike thinks he has it all... until he meets Monica. Will Monica's pursuit of fame change Mike's pursuit of her?

items.title: Fling
items.description: Two friends will have to survive debt-collecting Gang Members, and suspect RideShare drivers and each other if they want to make it to their Fling.

items.title: Amenaza virtual
items.description: En este emocionante y trepidante thriller, el genio de la informática Milo Hoffman (Ryan Phillippe) consigue el trabajo de sus sueños solo para descubrir que el director ejecutivo (Tim Robbins) puede emplear prácticas comerciales muy poco ortodoxas.

items.title: La Pantera Rosa 2
items.description: Steve Martin vuelve a divertirnos encarnando al torpe Inspector Jacques Clouseau. Esta vez debe descubrir quién ha robado la Pantera Rosa, un diamante de valor inestimable, y otros tesoros del mundo. Coprotagonizada por Jean Reno y John Cleese.

items.title: Day Of The Dead: Bloodline
items.description: A small group of military personnel and survivalists dwells in an underground bunker as they seek to find a cure in a world overrun by zombies.

items.title: Escaneando las pirámides
items.description: Los científicos trabajan para resolver el misterio de 4.500 años de antigüedad sobre lo que se encuentra dentro de la Gran Pirámide de Giza.

items.title: The Dentist 2
items.description: Dr. Caine has escaped from the mental hospital to set up a regular life for himself. But when he finds his girlfriend is cheating on him, he goes on another teeth-gnashing rampage.

items.title: Hellbenders 3D
items.description: When a demon escapes into New York intent on cracking open the gates of Hell, a group of elite, highly-trained exorcists must save the planet from eternal damnation!

items.title: Dementia 13: The Director's Cut
items.description: In the high-definition director’s cut of Francis Ford Coppola’s cult classic Dementia 13, a family’s Irish estate hosts dark secrets, marital deception…and a roving axe murderer.

items.description: When an alluring widow asks a journalist to solve the mysterious death of her filmmaker husband, the inquiry draws him into a dangerous world of adultery, blackmail, and murder.
