items.description: Tras una brutal masacre de narcos, Felipe, Rosa y su hermano Pedro parten en busca de venganza desde su pacífico pueblo hasta México.

items.title: A Christmas Winter Song
items.description: A woman strikes up a friendship with a homeless man and, through music, the two help each other reconcile with their families just in time for Christmas.

items.title: East of the Mountains
items.description: A dying widower returns to his childhood home with his dog, but a violent encounter sparks a journey of survival, memory, and unexpected hope.

items.title: Mindreader
items.description: A prestigious magician's association is baffled by an up and coming mentalist, The Great Dexter, in the early 1970's who can apparently read minds.

items.title: Grace and Grit
items.description: In 1980s California, a couple’s whirlwind romance is shaken by a cancer diagnosis in this powerful true story of love, loss, and resilience.

items.title: Lies We Tell
items.description: In an isolated manor, an orphaned heiress must fight her guardian for her inheritance - and her life.

items.title: Meet Cute in Manhattan
items.description: When a charming actor unexpectedly falls for his co-star during a dating app commercial that goes viral, he finds himself living the romantic comedy of his dreams. But as their on-screen romance spills into real life, can love survive the spotlight?

items.title: Rooftop Christmas Tree
items.description: Every Christmas, Dale Landis fastens a tree to his roof and decorates it for the season; and every year he's arrested for it. Determined to keep Dale out of jail, a judge orders attorney Sarah and prosecutor John to work together to defend Dale.

items.title: Christmas Lucky Charm
items.description: Each December, it seems like one of Jessica's exes is getting married to someone else. So she's reasonably wary of the handsome new gallery owner next door.

items.title: Christmas on 5th Ave
items.description: Decorating a spectacular Manhattan penthouse for Christmas, bubbly Eva Jordan brings writer Lucas Blade some joy for the holidays.

items.title: Fruits of the Heart
items.description: The epic tale of a mother and her daughter.

items.title: Ella está encantada
items.description: Anne Hathaway, ganadora de un Oscar, protagoniza un inolvidable cuento de hadas moderno en el que una muchacha recibe el don de la obediencia de su hada madrina. Una asombrosa aventura mágica repleta de coloridos personajes, música, ingenio y fantasía.

items.title: Chance
items.description: A talented young baseball player's bright future is undone by the silent pressures of teen romance.

items.title: I Believe
items.description: A 9-year-old boy experiences God's power in a supernatural way.

items.title: X (2022)
items.description: A group of actors set out to make an adult film in rural Texas under the noses of their reclusive hosts, but when the elderly couple catches their young guests in the act, the cast finds themselves in a desperate fight for their lives.

items.title: Werewolf Game
items.description: Based on the highly popular game, Werewolf Game is a horror mystery film where twelve kidnapped strangers vote on whom to murder, while hidden werewolves kill a villager each night until one group remains.

items.title: Get Him Back for Christmas
items.description: A Hollywood musician returns to her hometown at Christmas after a public breakup to rediscover herself, her voice, and potentially a romance with the writing partner she left behind.

items.title: Los valientes
items.description: Gene Hackman hace el papel del coronel Jason Rhodes, un hombre obsesionado, en esta aventura llena de acción.

items.title: La Española, la de Torres
items.description: Contamos la historia del desconocido inventor de la guitarra actual, Antonio de Torres Jurado. Carpintero almeriense y humilde en 1817, logró fama universal cambiando el modelo de construcción para las escuelas nacionales de guitarra de todo el mundo.

items.title: A Christmas Frequency
items.description: A young radio show producer sets her recently-separated boss up on live-on air blind dates to save their dying show, but she accidentally falls for one of the contenders and must choose her head or her heart in time for Christmas.

items.title: Refugio
items.description: Cuando la política y las amenazas de muerte obligan a John a huir de su país, encuentra refugio en México y se propone encontrar a su esposa e hijo varados en Chile.

items.title: Reporting for Christmas
items.description: When an idealistic reporter is assigned a puff piece about a Christmas toy manufacturer over the holidays, a charming toymaker inspires her to search her heart to find true happiness.

items.title: Christmas on the Ranch
items.description: When a talk show relationship expert with her own romantic hang-ups gets stranded at a ranch before Christmas, the charming rancher reminds her that love is always worth the risk.

items.title: A Dash of Christmas
items.description: To apply for her dream job at a foodie startup, an successful marketing executive must learn to bake. When she recruits a handsome baker to help her, she inadvertently ends up entered in a smalltown Christmas Bakeoff.

items.title: A Harvest Homecoming
items.description: A teacher returns home to help at the family cider mill, where he meets the property's new marketing manager and finds a new class of students to mentor.

items.title: A Hot Cocoa Christmas
items.description: When the owner of a local charity organization meets a graphic designer at a Christmas party, she hides the fact that she is the daughter of a wealthy executive who he is about to pitch. Can their budding romance overcome this major secret?

items.title: Los exiliados románticos
items.description: Tres amigos viajan en auto de Madrid hasta París sin ningún motivo, tan solo para buscar un amor idílico y efímero. La única misión es sorprenderse, sentirse vivos de nuevo y alargar su juventud.

items.title: Christmas on Windmill Way
items.description: To save her family's legacy windmill, a woman must remind her ex-boyfriend, now a real estate developer, of the best of their hometown.

items.title: Sugar Daddies
items.description: Struggling college student Kara is introduced into the world of sugar daddies and is taken by this dream-like world of money, power and success until her two worlds collide.

items.title: Crown Prince of Christmas
items.description: Madison, a musician, jokingly says she is dating the prince of a small European nation. Her friend Sebastian is roped into impersonating the prince when her visiting family expects the royal beau.

items.title: Christmas Under the Northern Lights
items.description: A historian seeks inspiration for her next project in her family's hometown, famous for the Northern Lights. While there, she bonds with a local tour guide who gives her a new outlook on life.

items.title: Meet Me Under The Mistletoe
items.description: Two rival realtors are forced to work together to sell one special house, owned by a renowned botanist and mistletoe grower, before Christmas.

items.title: My Christmas Hero (US)
items.description: US Army reservist and orthopedic physician Nicole Ramsey serves military members at a base in Lacey, Washington. This Christmas, with the help of dedicated heroes, she's on a mission to honor a fallen soldier and bring healing to her own family.

items.title: Royally Wrapped For Christmas
items.description: One Christmas, the director of an international charity organization is called to the Kingdom of Valdonia by the royal family, where she grows close to the prince.

items.title: A Brush with Christmas
items.description: While Charlotte spends most of her time helping at her family restaurant, her dream is to be in the art world. Fearing she is not good enough, she throws out the painting she planned to submit to the local Christmas art festival.

items.title: A Christmas for the Ages
items.description: Prompted by their youngest granddaughter (Natasha Bure), four generations of women celebrate Christmas and family in the style of the 40s, 60s, 90s, and today.

items.title: Christmas on Candy Cane Lane
items.description: Ivy Donaldson struggles with living in her famous mom's shadow. This Christmas, she tries to live up to the expectations set, despite dealing with her own family challenges.

items.title: Cruel Intentions
items.description: Two vicious step-siblings of an elite Manhattan prep school make a wager: to deflower the new headmaster's daughter before the start of term.

items.title: B&B Merry (aka Stay for Christmas)
items.description: Tracey, a travel blogger, is invited by Graham to a Christmas getaway at his family's small bed and breakfast. It is facing tough competition from a new resort that has been stealing guests, threatening the survival of the family business.

items.title: 12 Games of Christmas
items.description: A group of friends are magically transported inside a Christmas-themed board game during a holiday party. They must play through the game's levels to return home. They work together to survive and escape back to reality.

items.title: The Christmas Ticket
items.description: After inheriting her late grandfather's old winter home one week before Christmas, a young woman discovers that he may have hidden a winning lottery ticket somewhere in the house.

items.title: A Christmas…Present
items.description: Busy real-estate agent and mom Maggie Larson takes her family to spend Christmas with her brother and his daughter, who have different expectations for their holidays. Along the way, the Larsons learn to reconnect with each other, and with their faith.

items.title: A Cinderella Christmas Ball (aka Royal Christmas Ball)
items.description: Hoping to find her birth family, dance instructor Chelsea travels to the royal kingdom of Havenshire at Christmas. Along the way, she teaches a stubborn prince how to dance and gets looped into a centuries old Christmas tradition.

items.title: A Royal Date for Christmas
items.description: When a European Duke arrives in the US, he realizes that his bags have been lost in transit. He has no choice but to be styled, and ultimately inspired, by Bella, the owner of a local boutique.

items.title: One More Round
items.description: A decade after he backed out of the fight of his life, Jake's trainers get him back in the ring. With his life and marriage falling apart, he needs this one last shot at redemption to win his family back and get his future on track.

items.title: Christmas Time Is Here
items.description: Local realtor Nia helps an upscale developer find a property for a new resort. Sparks begin to fly between the two during the Christmas season until Nia realizes he has his eyes set on one property that's not for sale... her family's inn.

items.title: Aisle Be Home for Christmas
items.description: Two exes finally reconnect when a snowstorm leaves them stranded in a superstore (without mobile service or Wi-Fi) just before Christmas.

items.title: The 13th Cross
items.description: A man with a troubled past seeks to atone for his sins by acting as a hitman for a religious organization by killing those who have committed the unforgivable sin of harming innocents.

items.title: The Mad Whale
items.description: Inmates at a women's mental asylum stage a theatrical production of Herman Melville's 'Moby Dick.'

items.title: The Great Christmas Switch
items.description: Sophia, a single girl in the city with a demanding boss, and her twin, a single mother of two in the Midwest, decided to switch places for Christmas in an effort to get away from their problems during the season.

items.title: A Deadly Ride
items.description: A young woman finds herself in a fight for survival after her ride share driver accidentally hits a cyclist.

items.title: Peace River
items.description: Champion Rodeo cowboy and special forces soldier is crushed by war and personal loss and must draw on faith to reclaim his will to live and the love of his life.

items.title: A Witches Ball
items.description: A Witches' Ball is about a young witch who is ready to jump in feet first into the witching world but not before leaping over some magical hurdles along the way.

items.title: Baby in a Manger
items.description: Christmas is about a miracle baby, but when CPS agent Alison and police officer Brock find a lost baby lying in a nativity scene, it'll take a miracle for them just to stop bickering.

items.title: Princess Cut 2: Hearts on Fire
items.description: Two expectant couples that are best friends face crushing upheavals in their lives which force them to make life-altering choices.

items.title: Evil Takes Root: The Curse of the Batibat
items.description: Felix must battle the forces of evil and unravel the mystery of the Batibat in order to save Amanda's daughter, Sarah, from its hellish grip.

items.title: Flu Birds
items.description: A tight-knit group of teens find themselves fighting for their lives when unexpected visitors a flock of flesh-eating birds infected by a malicious virus crash their carefree camping trip in the woods.

items.title: Rango (ESP)
items.description: Un camaleón que aspira a ser un héroe audaz se encuentra en una ciudad occidental llena de bandidos y se ve obligado a desempeñar literalmente el papel con el fin de protegerlo.

items.title: Running With the Devil
items.description: The CEO of an international conglomerate sends two of his most regarded executives to investigate why shipments of cocaine are being hijacked and over cut somewhere on the supply chain.

items.title: Beatles: John Lennon, The Messenger
items.description: Moving documentary about John Lennon's prior life to and beyond the disintegration of The Beatles

items.title: American Cowslip
items.description: An eccentric, agoraphobic druggie tries to win the $10,000 first prize in the "Garden of the Year" contest so he can pay his delinquent rent and fix the life that he has screwed up so badly.

items.title: Ballad of Davy Crockett, The
items.description: In 1815, Davy Crockett battles the wild frontier to return to his sick wife and children left to survive.

items.title: Defining Moments
items.description: Defining Moments is a highly comedic film about that one single moment in time that changes you from who you were to who you'll be.

items.title: Double Threat
items.description: A girl skims money from the mob while a man, just trying to scatter ashes, becomes entangled in this tawdry affair.

items.title: God's Best Friend
items.description: After losing her beloved dog, Tara cancels her wedding—until a little help from above and a caring town unite to give her the celebration of her dreams.

items.title: Dolphin Kick
items.description: On a tropical island vacation, a young boy's friendship with a playful and friendly dolphin helps him find the courage to get back in the water after the sudden loss of his mother.

items.title: Enter the Clones of Bruce
items.description: After Bruce Lee's death in 1974, movie studios began to produce hundreds of unauthorized biopics, sequels, prequels, spinoffs, and rip-offs starring Lee lookalikes.

items.title: The Folks
items.description: After her husband's funeral, Mary meets his strange family, unaware of the deadly threat they pose to her son.

items.title: El ahorcado
items.description: Durante un viaje de campamento infernal, un padre lucha contra un culto asesino y un demonio sangriento para rescatar a su hijo secuestrado.

items.title: ¡Átame!
items.description: Un desequilibrado pero seductor ex-paciente con problemas mentales toma a una estrella porno prisionera con la esperanza de convencerla de que se case con él.

items.title: Spookley and the Christmas Kittens
items.description: Spookley the Square Pumpkin helps a special green cat and three stray kittens find a home and teaches us that it’s never wrong to do the right thing.

items.title: Montana Amazon Redux
items.description: A quirky Montana family flees their home when the troubled grandson accidentally kills his friend. On their journey, family secrets are revealed in this funny and poignant fable.

items.title: Sex Ed
items.description: Eddie lands his first teaching gig at an inner city middle school and finds his highly pubescent pupils are receiving no form of sexual education. Eddie isn't really equipped to teach them...he's not exactly experienced romantically.

items.title: Frank Sinatra: A Reflection
items.description: This Frank Sinatra television special looks at the man and his music

items.title: The Last Champion
items.description: A disgraced ex-wrestler returns home after 20 years to face his past and reclaim the hero he once was.

items.title: Sisters
items.description: After losing their mothers at a young age, Diamond and her closest cousins, Tia and Tara, known as Sisters, are willing to do anything to keep their grandmother from dying of cancer and save their family.

items.title: Liar's All
items.description: On New Year's Eve in London, a provocative game spins out of control and ends in murder, the true killer elusive amid conflicting testimony and hidden motives.

items.title: Spookley: The Square Pumpkin
items.description: Poor Spookley is a pumpkin who's shape is square rather than round. He's teased and taunted by other mean round pumpkins. But he receives help from a Scarecrow and his 2 bat side-kicks and 3 very funny spiders.

items.title: My Own Love Song
items.description: A paralyzed singer and her friend meet colorful Southerners while taking a road trip to Louisiana.

items.title: Sister
items.description: Sister brings the timely topic of youth and psychotropic drug prescription to the forefront with insight and grace. Reid Scott delivers a nuanced performance as the estranged brother forced into caring for his troubled adolescent sister (Grace Kaufman).

items.title: Naughty or Nice
items.description: A down-on-her-luck advertising executive becomes the custodian of Santa's famous Naughty or Nice list, but she soon learns that its magic should not be abused.

items.title: Love and Action in Chicago
items.description: Government hitman Eddie Jones falls for Lois, but quitting the job makes him the target of his own employers.

items.title: Road to Christmas
items.description: Hallmark Original Movie. TV Producer Maggie brings her boss' three sons home for the holidays.

items.title: Six Ways to Sunday
items.description: Reedus plays Harry, an 18-year-old Ohio boy with a very close relationship to his mother (Deborah Harry). When he gets in with the local mob, though, his mother will stop at nothing to keep him close to her.

items.title: Superbob
items.description: When a meteor crashes into earth, regular guy BOB appears to be the one guy affected. Previously clumsy and awkward, Bob now possesses super strength and speed and the ability to fly and has reluctantly become the world's only superhero.

items.title: Afghan Luke
items.description: Journalist Luke Benning's buried story drives him on a surreal, perilous quest through Afghanistan for truth.

items.title: Sands Of Oblivion
items.description: A replica of ancient Egypt was rebuilt in 1923 for a movie and then mysteriously burried when the filming stopped. Now a soon-to-be-divorced archaeologist couple and an Iraq War combat veteran have uncovered the secret DeMille could not keep hidden...

items.title: Saving Faith
items.description: After years of struggle to keep the doors of the Ritz Theater open, Faith Scott and her Uncle Donny look to put together a big Christmas show as a last effort to keep the theater alive…in June.

items.title: Shattered
items.description: In this thriller starring Academy Award® nominee John Malkovich (RED) and Frank Grillo (AVENGERS: ENDGAME), a millionaire (Cameron Monaghan) falls for a woman (Lilly Krug) he meets by chance—but soon suspects her of dangerous motives.

items.title: Dead Man's Hand
items.description: In this intense Western starring Jack Kilmer, Stephen Dorff, and Cole Hauser, a gunslinger must fight for his life after killing the brother of a corrupt mayor.

items.title: The Truth About Love
items.description: As part of a drunken bet with her sister, a happily married woman sends an anonymous Valentine's card to her husband to see if he hides it. When he does, what was a prank leads to a series of events and revelations that puts her marriage at risk.

items.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
items.description: When a criminal mastermind (Gene Simmons) blows up a number of buildings in downtown Los Angeles, the authorities turn to a former CIA agent (Rutger Hauer), who now makes his living working as a bounty hunter.

items.title: Western Jamboree
items.description: Ranch foreman Gene Autry, with the help of Frog Millhouse, turns the Circle J Ranch into a dude ranch to help an old friend fool his daughter's rich fiance into believing he is a wealthy rancher.

items.title: Sixgun
items.description: When three cowboys show up dead, Tommy, a retired bounty hunter whose ranch is on the brink for foreclosure, must saddle up one more time to stop the bandit and collect a ransom.

items.title: The Desperate Riders
items.description: In this Western starring country western star Trace Adkins, Tom Berenger, and Drew Waters, a loner hero and a pretty sharpshooter help a boy rescue his mother, who’s been taken by an outlaw.

items.title: 18 Again!
items.description: In this fantasy comedy, an outcast teenager (Charlie Schlatter) accidentally switches bodies with his 81-year-old bachelor grandfather (George Burns).

items.title: Arlington Road
items.description: Academy Award winner Jeff Bridges stars in this suspenseful thriller as a widower who begins to suspect his neighbors are not who they appear to be — and their secrets could be deadly. Co-starring Tim Robbins, Joan Cusack and Hope Davis.

items.title: Certain Fury
items.description: In this remake of The Defiant Ones, sex worker Scarlet (Tatum O'Neal, Paper Moon) and petty criminal Tracy (Irene Cara, Fame) escape incarceration, fleeing both cops and drug dealers in the process. Featuring Peter Fonda.

items.title: Creepshow 2
items.description: Three gruesome tales of brutality, vengeance and the uncanny are unveiled in this anthology horror movie based on Old Chief Wood'nhead, The Raft and The Hitchhiker by Stephen King.

items.title: The Nest
items.description: As a mother becomes suspicious that her daughter may be infected by a parasitic creature, she is thrust into a nightmare as the people she trusts most push her into a chasm of drug addiction, self-destruction, and devastating sacrifice.

items.title: The Red Book Ritual
items.description: Three friends decide to play The Red Book game. What they don't know is that in the house, evil is waiting to be released.

items.title: Assassin Club
items.description: Henry Golding, Sam Neill, and Noomi Rapace star in this action-packed thriller. An elite assassin is given his final contract to kill six people around the world - only to discover the targets are equally skilled assassins hired to kill him.

items.title: Eye for an Eye
items.description: A slain girl's mother (Sally Field) considers vigilantism after police and the courts botch the case against the killer (Kiefer Sutherland).

items.title: 13 ASESINOS
items.description: Un ingenuo joven adopta la identidad de un hombre muerto para unirse a un juego de mafiosos de ruleta rusa. Con Mickey Rourke, Jason Statham y Michael Shannon.

items.title: Por las plumas
items.description: Una comedia negra sobre Chalo, un solitario guardia jurado que se compra su primer gallo de pelea y descubre el agridulce sabor de la amistad.

items.title: Cuenta pendiente
items.description: Veinte años después de un robo fallido, tres estafadores secuestran a un paciente con amnesia para refrescar su memoria y encontrar el dinero que se perdió hace tanto tiempo.

items.title: 12 horas
items.description: Amanda Seyfried (El precio del mañana, La chica de la capa roja) interpreta este intenso thriller acerca de una joven desesperada que, tras ser ignorada por la policía, debe salir a buscar al asesino serial que ella cree secuestró a su hermana menor.

items.title: El asesinato de la familia Borden
items.description: Un thriller psicológico basado en los infames asesinatos de la familia Borden en 1892.

items.title: Bajo anestesia
items.description: Mientras se somete a una cirugía, un joven adinerado experimenta una conciencia intraoperatoria y descubre que el equipo quirúrgico tenía la intención de asesinarlo.

items.title: Asesinos internacionales
items.description: Asesinos disfuncionales intentan matar a Gunther (Arnold Schwarzenegger), el asesino a sueldo más infame de todos los tiempos, en esta divertida comedia de persecución entre aspirantes a criminales.

items.title: Mátalos suavemente
items.description: Durante la crisis económica de 2008, Jackie Cogan (Brad Pitt), un sicario, es contratado para restablecer el orden después de que tres idiotas roban una partida de póquer protegida por la mafia.

items.title: planet e.: Living with Waste Water
items.description: Access to clean water and sanitation is a human right, according to the United Nations. Empty words for the people living in the slums of Dar Es Salaam. They have neither. Itís a vicious circle of poverty and disease.

items.title: planet e.: Toxic Tankers for Bangladesh
items.description: Bangladesh - the final destination for freighters from all over the world.

items.title: Rebel: Director's Cut
items.description: Sylvester Stallone is torn between love and violence in his first starring role in the 1973 thriller REBEL. Radical anti-war activist Jerry Savage flees a terror cell to be with the woman he loves, but his decision may cost him everything.

items.title: Stealing Pulp Fiction
items.description: A group of enterprising wannabes and their eccentric therapist as they concoct a plot to steal Quentin Tarantino's personal 35mm print of his famous 1994 film.

items.title: planet e.: UN Millennium Goals - Along the Poverty Line
items.description: In September 2000 the UN enunciated the Millennium Development Goals to free people around the world from extreme poverty.

items.title: Hombres de élite
items.description: En este tenso thriller protagonizado por John Travolta y Kate Bosworth, un equipo de trabajadores de líneas eléctricas de Texas se apresura a instalar kilómetros de cable antes de que una mortal tormenta eléctrica destruya la red eléctrica.

items.title: Off The Record
items.description: Astor Grey, a rising singer-songwriter, falls for washed-up rock star Brandyn Verge. Their whirlwind romance spirals into a dark tale of manipulation, forcing Astor to fight for her independence and reclaim her music and identity.

items.title: Match Point
items.description: At a turning point in his life, a former tennis pro falls for an actress who happens to be dating his friend and soon-to-be brother-in-law.

items.title: Hotel
items.description: In a crumbling Venetian hotel, a film crew’s shoot spirals into chaos as murder, betrayal, and a vampire cult blur reality and fiction. Nothing - and no one - is what it seems.

items.title: Home in Wyomin'
items.description: Radio star Gene Autry must solve a murder mystery at the Frontier Days pageant in Wyoming that involves a newspaper photographer, Chicago gangsters, a deserted mine, and a surprise ending.

items.title: 22 Bullets
items.description: A retired mobster goes on a revenge spree after being left for dead with 22 bullets in his body by his former childhood friend.

items.title: A Symphony For A Common Man
items.description: Brazilian ambassador José Bustani, the first director of the Organization for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons, tried to avoid the destruction of Iraq, but was forced out under pressure from the USA.

items.title: Badland
items.description: Gunslinging detective Matthias Breecher (Kevin Makely) is hired to track down 3 dangerous Civil War criminals (Trace Adkins, Bruce Dern and Jeff Fahey) and bring them to justice.

items.title: Bleeding
items.description: Two desperate teenagers on the run from a vicious dealer break into an empty house and find a sleeping girl locked inside.

items.title: Escape from the 21st Century
items.description: The story follows three friends who discover they have the power to travel back and forth 20 years with a sneeze. However, the future is not as good as they hoped, and they need to take on the responsibility of saving the world.

items.title: Meko
items.description: Meko is a feature-length documentary told through the lens of acclaimed fly fishing guide, Meko Glinton. Meko is a story about climate change, human displacement, resilience, hope, and connectivity to our planet.

items.title: Home on the Prairie
items.description: Livestock inspectors Gene Autry and Frog Millhouse are accused of favoritism when they try to help an old rancher and his attractive daughter whose cattle appear have hoof and mouth disease and are doomed to be destroyed.

items.title: Sunset in Wyoming
items.description: Conscientious rancher Gene Autry must save his valley from flooding caused by a lumber company that is stripping the land. Gene hatches a plan to declare the mountain a state park and wildlife shrine.

items.title: Butterflies - Messengers of God
items.description: Approximately 160.000 different species of butterflies exist on earth.

items.title: El duelo
items.description: Un ranger de Texas investiga una serie de muertes inexplicables en un pueblo llamado Helena.

items.title: Caffeinated
items.description: Learn the story behind coffee, and the process by which it's created, and has shaped the lives of thousands.

items.title: Thank You Very Much
items.description: Andy Kaufman's provocative comedy outraged audiences, challenging their assumptions. Rare footage and personal recollections explore Kaufman's brief, impactful career, highlighting his lasting influence in today's blurred reality.

items.title: Cannibal Comedian
items.description: By day, Charlie serves killer meatball subs made from unsuspecting travelers. By night, he turns his victims into dark comedy bits at the local club. But when the owner tries to steal the twisted shtick, he becomes Charlie’s next bloody punchline.

items.title: Just Swipe
items.description: Vanessa has always had trouble in the dating world, never mind now being confined to her home. She soon discovers just how much you can get away with dating via webcam, but is the love she feels true or only a distorted version of reality?

items.title: Me Three
items.description: In this teen body-sharing comedy, a humorously self-destructive 17 year old girl’s bickering, divorced parents are killed and their spirits end up inside her body. She has one week to release them or they'll take over and hers will go away.

items.title: The Great Dictator
items.description: Dictator Adenoid Hynkel tries to expand his empire while a poor Jewish barber tries to avoid persecution from Hynkel's regime.

items.title: Blades of Glory
items.description: Two figure skating rivals are banned from the sport after a brawl over the gold medal. Joining forces, they find a loophole in the rules that allows them to skate again... as a pair!

items.title: Inland Empire
items.description: As an actress begins to adopt the persona of her character in a film, her world becomes nightmarish and surreal.

items.title: The Initiation
items.description: After breaking into a department store for a hazing ritual, sorority sisters and their boyfriends are hunted by a deranged killer. Starring Vera Miles (Psycho).

items.title: Jaguar Lives!
items.description: The world's new Karate hero (Joe Lewis) is out to stop drug dealers, gangs, and help save the world from an evil con (Sir Christopher Lee).

items.title: Rootin' Tootin' Rhythm
items.description: Ranch owner Gene Autry and his pal Frog Millhouse are after cattle rustlers and become mixed up in a comedy of errors when they don the clothes of two dead outlaws, only to learn that the outlaws are really dead sheriffs, dressed in outlaw's clothes!

items.title: Before I Go To Sleep
items.description: A woman wakes up every day, remembering nothing as a result of a traumatic accident in her past. One day, new terrifying truths emerge that force her to question everyone around her.

items.title: Ride, Ranger, Ride
items.description: Former Texas Ranger Gene Autry receives a commission as lieutenant in the U.S. Cavalry and, along with troopers Frog Millhouse and Rufe Jones, reports to Colonel Summeral at Fort Adobe.

items.title: Our Italian Christmas Memories
items.description: Hallmark Original Movie. The Colucci siblings set out to recreate their grandmother's pasta sauce.

items.title: Homicide
items.description: A Jewish homicide detective investigates a seemingly minor murder and falls in with a Zionist group as a result.

items.title: Undisputed 4: Boyka
items.description: In the fourth installment of the fighting franchise, Boyka is shooting for the big leagues when an accidental death in the ring makes him question everything he stands for.

items.title: Dead Heat
items.description: In this offbeat comedy thriller, Treat Williams stars as a good cop who will do anything to nail the bad guys — even if that means he's got to die.

items.title: Save The Last Dance 2
items.description: Continuing the story of the original film, Sara follows her dream and becomes a student at Juilliard. As she becomes a star pupil, Sara becomes torn between her love for traditional ballet and her passion for the urban street rhythms of hip-hop.

items.title: Mountain Rhythm
items.description: Unscrupulous Pueblo Springs Valley resort owners wreak havoc for Frogís Aunt Mathilda and neighboring ranchers in an effort to scare them off land recently placed for sale by the US Government.

items.title: The Killing Time
items.description: A murderer who assumes the identity of a new deputy is unbeknownst to the sheriff planning to pin a separate murder on him.

items.title: The Prank
items.description: Overachiever Ben is dedicated to graduating top of his class. When his stern, mean physics teacher Mrs. Wheeler discovers a cheater, she fails his entire class. Tanner, his best friend helps him hatch a plan to ruin her life by framing her for murder.

items.title: The Silent Planet
items.description: Theodore, a lone miner and prisoner on planet #384 in the Capillian Star System, extracts alien minerals for Earth in an experimental colonization project. Sick and half-sane, he fills his days with journaling, TV reruns, and memories of life on Earth.

items.title: The Retreat
items.description: A queer couple heads to a remote cabin for a peaceful escape- only to be hunted by a sadistic group of extremists who broadcast their kills online. But the hunters quickly become the hunted.

items.title: Wings
items.description: Two World War I pilots (Charles Buddy Rogers, Richard Arlen) woo a young woman (Clara Bow) and fight the Germans.

items.title: El matador
items.description: Un asesino a sueldo que recorre el mundo entabla una inesperada amistad con un vendedor tras encontrarse en un bar de hotel en la Ciudad de México.

items.title: La competencia
items.description: Una competencia de 24 horas a matar o morir se desarrolla en una ciudad inglesa. El ganador podrá reclamar un premio de diez millones en efectivo.

items.title: 1 Hour to Kill
items.description: After becoming TV celebrities, a team of ghost hunters are assigned a TV gig checking out a house haunted by the evil spirit of a serial killer. What starts as fake turns into a real haunting by a demon trying to possess them.

items.title: The Red Shoes: Next Step
items.description: When Sam's world begins to spiral following a life-changing event, she must confront her emotions and fear to reignite her love for dance.

items.title: The Brood
items.description: A man tries to uncover an unconventional psychologist's therapy techniques on his institutionalized wife, amidst a series of brutal murders.

items.title: Mystery of the Northern Lights
items.description: Mystery of the Northern Lights explores the greatest mysteries of the aurora borealis. Using pioneering scientific experiments, experts uncover the secrets of this awe-inspiring phenomena.

items.title: Golden Years
items.description: Retired couple Arthur and Martha take up bank robbery after their pensions are cut, refusing to accept the injustice of their circumstances.

items.title: Peligro en la montaña
items.description: Jason Momoa protagoniza este intenso thriller de acción sobre un leñador que lucha por sobrevivir contra los traficantes de drogas que han escondido heroína en su cabaña de caza.

items.title: Elvira: Mistress of the Dark
items.description: When wise-cracking vamp Elvira learns that her wealthy Aunt Morgana has just died, she rushes off for the reading of the will. She can't help but stir things up when she makes her appearance in the old-fashioned, conservative town.

items.title: Escape 2000
items.description: In a dystopian future, enemies of the state are sentenced to a secluded, nightmarish prison where the guards set the inmates loose and hunt them down like animals. Starring Steve Railsback and Olivia Hussey.

items.title: Fraternity Vacation
items.description: Despite being saddled with a nerdy pledge during a Palm Springs weekend, two frat brothers vie for a poolside blonde in this hilarious comedy. Starring Academy Award winner Tim Robbins (The Shawshank Redemption).

items.title: Mistletoe Mixup
items.description: A workaholic with no time for romance, or the holidays, meets two potential suitors on the same day, who turn out to be brothers. A sibling squabble commences in this holiday romance.

items.title: Model By Day
items.description: Lady X is a woman who works during the day as a model but turns into a fighter for justice at night with the help of her karate master Chang.

items.title: The Long Good Friday
items.description: An up-and-coming gangster is tested by the insurgence of an unknown, very powerful threat.

items.title: The Old Barn Dance
items.description: Gene Autry and Frog Millhouse are horse traders who run into trouble when an unscrupulous tractor company starts selling the modern machines to farmers.

items.title: The Philadelphia Experiment
items.description: In this classic sci-fi thriller, a US Navy destroyer escort participates in an invisibility experiment that inadvertently sends two sailors forty years into the future. Starring Michael Paré, Nancy Allen and Stephen Tobolowsky.

items.title: El Castigador: zona de guerra
items.description: Frank Castle, alias Punisher, regresa con su estilo de justiciero solitario. Cuando Frank hiere al despiadado mafioso Billy Russoti, este jura vengarse y recluta un ejército de hombres tan peligrosos como él.

items.title: Asesinato justo
items.description: Dos detectives veteranos de la ciudad de Nueva York (ganadores del Premio de la Academia® Robert De Niro y Al Pacino) buscan a un justiciero que puede ser uno de los suyos.

items.title: Solomon Kane (ESP)
items.description: El capitán Solomon Kane (James Purefoy) es una máquina de matar brutalmente eficiente del siglo XVI.

items.title: Thine Ears Shall Bleed
items.description: A minister's family in a covered wagon hears a mysterious sound from the woods, mistaking it for God until they realize its sinister nature.

items.title: Tim Travers and The Time Traveler's Paradox
items.description: A genius invents a time machine to find out what happens if you kill your younger self. The results change not only the world, but himself.

items.title: On the Come Up
items.description: The story 16-year-old Bri, who wants to be one of the greatest rappers of all time. Facing controversies and with an eviction notice staring down her family, Bri doesn't just want to make it, she has to.

items.title: Samson and Delilah
items.description: The glorious epic style of Cecil B. DeMille is exemplified in this story of the Bible's legendary strongman and the woman who seduces, then betrays him.

items.title: Grace Unplugged
items.description: AJ Michalka stars in this heartwarming movie about an 18-year-old girl whose dreams of stardom strain her relationship with her religious father, and force her to examine her faith.

items.title: Sunray: Fallen Soldier
items.description: A war veteran calls on friends from his past to hunt down those responsible for the death of his daughter. Along the way, he learns more about himself than he anticipated as a violent crime syndicate unravels in his wake.

items.title: Kenya
items.description: Después de ser testigo del asesinato de su amiga, Kenya, una trabajadora sexual transgénero, emprende un camino de lucha y búsqueda de justicia que la lleva a afrontar el miedo con el dolor de verse reflejada en ese trágico final.

items.title: La guardia blanca
items.description: México, un país en manos de la necropolítica: La película documenta la relación simbiótica entre el cartel, el gobierno y las grandes corporaciones que cada vez cobra más vidas de los activistas.

items.title: Regresión
items.description: Ethan Hawke y Emma Watson estelarizan este thriller sobre un crimen en un pueblo pequeño que desenmascara un terrible misterio nacional.

items.title: Infinite
items.description: Evan McCauley has skills he never learned and memories of places he has never visited. Self-medicated and on the brink of a mental breakdown, a secret group that call themselves Infinites come to his rescue, revealing that his memories are real.

items.title: Monster Black Hole
items.description: Black holes are the universe at its most extreme: matter and energy crunched so small they literally exit the known universe.

items.title: Holy Night!
items.description: Two holiday traditions come together in this yuletide adventure. When Santa's sleigh is stolen and Baby Jesus is kidnapped from the nativity scene, Christmas Eve is on the brink of disaster.

items.title: planet e.: Operation Earth Climate
items.description: Humankind is heating up the planet. In nature, volcanoes can create cooling blankets. Should we copy something like that artificially and cool the climate with technology?

items.title: Escobar: paraíso perdido
items.description: Nick, un joven surfista, cree que todos sus sueños se han hecho realidad cuando va a Colombia a visitar a su hermano. Nick se enamora perdidamente de la bella María. Todo parece perfecto hasta que Nick conoce al tío de la joven, un tal Pablo Escobar.

items.title: The Ten Commandments (1956)
items.description: Raised as an Egyptian prince, Moses (Charlton Heston) discovers his Hebrew heritage, hears God's call, and engages in a bitter battle with the Pharaoh Ramses (Yul Brynner) to free the Jews from slavery, leading them to the Promised Land.

items.title: The Kite Runner
items.description: Amir is a young Afghani from a well-to-do Kabul family; his best friend Hassan is the son of a family servant. Together the two boys form a bond of friendship that breaks tragically on one fateful day.

items.title: Undercover Lover (a.k.a. Undercover Christmas)
items.description: In this unlikely love story, an uptight FBI agent is assigned to protect a cocktail waitress after she turns her billionaire boyfriend in to the authorities for tax fraud. Starring Jami Gertz and Shawn Christian.

items.title: 13 Minutes
items.description: As a massive tornado devastates a small town, four families are forced to confront their darkest secrets and personal struggles while fighting to survive the life-threatening chaos left in its wake.

items.title: Close
items.description: Leo and Remi are two thirteen-year-old best friends whose seemingly unbreakable bond is suddenly, tragically torn apart in this emotionally transformative and unforgettable portrait of the intersection of friendship and love.

items.title: A Mistake
items.description: When an elite surgeon entrusts a junior during a critical operation, the patient dies. As public scrutiny and hospital politics swirl, she must face the fallout—professionally and personally—amid a fight for accountability and redemption.

items.title: City Lights
items.description: With the aid of a wealthy erratic tippler, a dewy-eyed tramp who has fallen in love with a sightless flower girl accumulates money to be able to help her medically.

items.title: Tell Me That You Love Me, Junie Moon
items.description: The story of three wildly neurotic characters: A facially disfigured girl, a homosexual paraplegic and an introvert epileptic who, after leaving the hospital, set up housekeeping together in a cottage where they support each other.

items.title: Al filo del abismo
items.description: En un pasado desvanecido de su juventud, patrullar era un trabajo importante, pero ahora el sargento Jack Grimaldi ve que la vida al otro lado de los prismáticos tiene algo más: sexo, dinero y emoción. Cine negro protagonizado Gary Oldman.

items.title: Attack Of The Gryphon
items.description: In a mystical land torn apart by civil war, a warrior princess must team up with a rival warrior prince to hunt down an evil sorcerer who has summoned a giant flying demon which is terrorizing their land.

items.title: planet e.: Rockfall in the Mountains
items.description: In recent years, especially in the Mont Blanc area and others under surveillance, we have seen a significant increase in rockfalls at certain altitudes.

items.title: The Umbrellas Of Cherbourg
items.description: A young woman separated from her lover by war faces a life-altering decision.

items.title: La celda olvidada
items.description: Burt Lancaster protagoniza la historia real del asesino Robert Stroud que, tras 43 años en régimen de aislamiento en Alcatraz, se convierte en una autoridad en aves siendo autodidacta. Coprotagonizada por Thelma Ritter, Telly Savalas y Karl Malden.

items.title: 1984 (ESP)
items.description: Adaptación del clásico de George Orwell sobre el totalitarismo en un mundo futurista atroz donde el gobierno regula y monitorea todo, hasta el último detalle. John Hurt, Richard Burton, Suzanna Hamilton, Cyril Cusack, Gregor Fisher, James Walker

items.title: Conflictos de amor
items.description: Michelle Pfeiffer y Dennis Haybert interpretan a dos desconocidos cuyas vidas se entrelazan cuando viajan a Washington para asistir al funeral del presidente John F. Kennedy. Coprotagonizada por Stephanie McFadden y Brian Kerwin.

items.title: Coffee And Cigarettes
items.description: A series of vignettes that all have coffee and cigarettes in common.

items.title: Texans Never Cry
items.description: Gene Autry learns that a familyís money was used to buy counterfeit Mexican lottery tickets, and he has to track down the counterfeiters. Gene faces long odds when a killer comes to do away with him.

items.title: Black Site
items.description: An elite military unit encounters a supernatural entity, known as The Elder Gods, that forces them into battle against an army from another world.

items.title: Extremity
items.description: A young woman obsessed with horror subjects herself to hours of grueling torment inside an extreme haunt in an attempt to confront her fears and conquer the tragic past that haunts her.

items.title: Escape a la libertad
items.description: Tres mujeres escapan de sus desgraciadas vidas. Cada una lucha por escapar del hombre que restringe su libertad.

items.title: El oro de ulises
items.description: Cuando su familia y su sustento se ven amenazados por un secreto escondido desde hace tiempo, el veterano de Vietnam y apicultor Ulee Jackson (Peter Fonda) se enfrenta a su pasado, rompiendo su barrera emocional y buscando fuerzas para cambiar.

items.title: Aves nocturnas
items.description: Cuando una aventura casual revela que ella es la ex amante de su jefe y toma pastillas para dormir, Kevin debe mantenerla despierta toda la noche. Lo que empieza como un desastre incómodo se transforma en un romance inesperado al amanecer.

items.title: Cita misteriosa
items.description: Cuando un adolescente tímido quiere invitar a salir a la chica de sus sueños, su hermano lo ayuda con un auto, una tarjeta de crédito y un traje. Pero la cita da un giro hilarante y una confusión de identidad amenaza con arruinar mucho más que el romance.

items.title: Polaris
items.description: Set in the frozen world of a post-apocalyptic 2144, a young warrior girl raised by a polar bear must fight to survive after she is captured and escapes from a brutal rival tribe.

items.title: La diabla
items.description: Una mujer traicionada por su marido busca vengarse de él y de su amante, una escritora romántica. La mujer trabaja en varios sitios hasta que monta su propia agencia (solo con mujeres) y la utiliza como instrumento para destruir a su marido.

items.title: Queen of Spades
items.description: According to legend, an ominous entity known as the Queen of Spades can be summoned by performing an ancient ritual.

items.title: Never Heard
items.description: Aaron Davis is accused of murder for a crime he didnt commit. His son Jalen gets entangled with dangerous drug dealers. Will Aaron find a way to prove his innocence and save his sons life before it is too late?

items.title: Nosferatu - A Symphony of Horror
items.description: Summoned to a bloodthirsty vampire's faraway castle, a young land clerk embarks on a harrowing journey into the unknown as his innocent wife falls under the spell of a terrifying shadow in her dreams.

items.title: Paper Angels
items.description: An abused wife leaves her alcoholic husband and moves with her children to another town, where their lives become entwined with that of another family in trouble.

items.title: Bill y Ted salvan el universo
items.description: Aún para cumplir su destino, el riesgo aumenta más que nunca para Bill y Ted, ahora de mediana edad, se embarcan en una nueva aventura cuando un visitante del futuro les avisa de que solo su canción salvará la vida como la conocemos.

items.title: Búfalo americano
items.description: Un par de ladrones y su joven aprendiz conspiran para robar una valiosa cabeza de búfalo de níquel. Gran parte de la historia transcurre en la tienda de segunda mano del drogadicto Don Dubrow.

items.title: El juego del halcón
items.description: Dos amigos, un estudiante americano desilusionado (Timothy Hutton) y un drogadicto, venden secretos del gobierno a los rusos. Basada en una historia real. Sean Penn, David Suchet, Lori Singer, Pat Hingle. Dirigida por John Schlesinger.

items.title: Inolvidable
items.description: David Krane (Ray Liotta), acusado del asesinato de su esposa en un ataque de ira ciega y alcohólica, toma una droga experimental y se embarca en una increíble búsqueda de la verdad…

items.title: Nunca tendremos París
items.description: Un hombre se equivoca a nivel transcontinental en un noble esfuerzo para recuperar su amor.

items.title: Descalza
items.description: La "oveja negra" de una prominente familia lleva a casa a una ingenua y encantadora paciente psiquiátrico para que conozca a su familia. Protagonizada por Evan Rachel Wood y Scott Speedman.

items.title: Return to Zero
items.description: The true story of a couple who discover just before their due date that their son has died in the womb and will be stillborn. Lives are forever altered; nothing can save their marriage. Then they learn they're again pregnant, and must face it together.

items.title: Death of a Ladies' Man
items.description: A hard-drinking professor's life unravels as he hallucinates, facing his past, lost loves, and regrets in a surreal, Leonard Cohen-scored tale.

items.title: The Accident
items.description: After being fired, Marcella, a gentle hearted mother going through separation, buys a tow truck; she gets trapped deeper and deeper in a cynical and aggressive world until a terrible opportunity shines in front of her.

items.title: Beggarman
items.description: A homeless Iraq War vet finds a 1970s suitcase of cash. Chasing a second chance, he turns to a local gangster but danger lurks at every turn.

items.title: Redbad
items.description: During a time of epic battles and bloodshed, the legend of pagan warrior king Redbad is born, but so is a new weapon against his people: Christianity.

items.title: Redcon-1
items.description: After a deadly viral outbreak, an elite squad of special forces soldiers must infiltrate a quarantine zone to rescue a scientist who holds the only cure to save mankind.

items.title: Ruben Guthrie
items.description: Ruben Guthrie is the story of a man not only battling the bottle, but the city that won't let him put it down.

items.title: Holiday in the Hamptons
items.description: Neither time nor distance truly extinguish the sparks of first love. When Jade Lewis returns to her grandfather's home in the Hamptons, she reconnects with her childhood love.

items.title: Estado de gracia
items.description: En esta película neo-noir, un policía encubierto (Sean Penn) regresa a su antiguo barrio de Hell's Kitchen, Nueva York, para derrotar a la mafia irlandesa, que ahora dirigen dos de sus amigos de la infancia (Gary Oldman y Ed Harris).

items.title: Mission: JOY Finding Happiness in Troubled Times
items.description: A laugh-out-loud, moving film about how the Dalai Lama and his dear friend, Archbishop Desmond Tutu lived with joy in troubled times.

items.title: planet e.: Refugees from Climate Change
items.description: Climate change is disproportionately affecting the worldís poorest countries.

items.title: Luke Combs: Dive Bars to Country Star
items.description: They told him he wasn't TV-worthy. Now he's a country icon. See how Luke Combs turned rejection into a record-shattering rise.

items.title: The Bible Collection: The Apocalypse
items.description: Detailing John's visions against the backdrop of the severe persecution of Christians in the first century, this biblically-based film will inspire viewers.

items.title: Knights Of Valour
items.description: During Lu Meng's invasion of the Jing Province, the mighty Guan Yu was slain, and his Green Dragon Crescent Blade was snatched away. Guan Xing survived the battle and attempts to avenge his father, and retrieve the legendary weapon.

items.title: The Domino Principle
items.description: A Vietnam War veteran, imprisoned for murder, is offered his freedom if he accepts to undertake a contract killing for a shady organization.

items.title: A Knight's War
items.description: A fearless knight enters a treacherous realm to save the Chosen One, but his mission risks unleashing a catastrophic force that could destroy humanity.

items.title: Avarice
items.description: Kate, a gifted archer, on vacation with her family is attacked by a team of mercenaries during a vicious home invasion. She must rely on her archery skills to rescue her husband and daughter after they are abducted.

items.title: Deslizando a la gloria
items.description: Dos rivales del patinaje artístico son expulsados tras una pelea por la medalla de oro. Al unir fuerzas, descubren una laguna en las reglas que les permite competir de nuevo… ¡como pareja!

items.title: Die'ced: Reloaded
items.description: When notorious killer Benny escapes an asylum on Halloween night, his scarecrow-masked rampage turns 1980s Seattle into a blood-soaked nightmare - with one young woman in his sights.

items.title: Tai Chi Master [English-Language Version]
items.description: Two friends, ex Shaolin monks, part ways as they brush with the ongoing rebellion against the government. The ambitious one rises up to be a powerful military commander, while his betrayed friend resorts to learn the calm ways of Tai Chi.

items.title: Don't Log Off
items.description: When Sam vanishes mid-video call, her friends race to uncover what happened. As they dig online, they vanish one by one. A sinister force is at play - can they solve the mystery before they're next?

items.title: Signs Of Life
items.description: A wounded German paratrooper named Stroszek is sent to the quiet island of Kos with his wife Nora, a Greek nurse, and two other soldiers recovering from minor wounds. Billeted in a decaying fortress, they guard a munitions depot.

items.title: Atrápame si puedes
items.description: Dirigida por Steven Spielberg y protagonizada por Leonardo DiCaprio y Tom Hanks, narra la historia real de Frank Abagnale Jr., quien antes de los 19 años estafó millones haciéndose pasar por piloto, médico y fiscal.

items.title: For Sale by Exorcist
items.description: After years of exorcising haunted houses, realtor Susan Price finally finds her dream home – until the spirits she's evicted return, threatening to make it her final resting place. Now, she must banish them for good.

items.title: The Old Corral
items.description: Nightclub singer Eleanor Spencer flees Chicago after witnessing a murder committed by her boss, gangster Mike Scarlotti. Fearing for her safety, Eleanor heads West and is soon recognized by a crooked saloon owner Martin Simms.

items.title: The Singing Cowboy
items.description: When Gene Autry's boss is murdered, Gene becomes the guardian of his little girl. The child is seriously injured in a stable fire and needs a lifesaving brain operation!

items.title: Acusados
items.description: Violada en un bar, una mujer (Jodie Foster) contrata a una fiscal (Kelly McGillis) que persigue a los clientes que alentaron a sus atacantes.

items.title: El vuelo
items.description: Un piloto logra evitar que un vuelo se estrelle, pero la investigación del fallo revela algo inquietante.

items.title: The Penitent Man
items.description: When a mysterious client reveals he is from the future, a psychologist heeds the man's warning and sets out to change the course of his life.

items.title: Como un jefe
items.description: Las mejores amigas Mia y Mel dirigen su propia marca de cosméticos hasta que una poderosa magnate de la belleza trama arrebatársela, poniendo su amistad en peligro.

items.title: Gente como uno
items.description: Ordinary People muestra cómo la tragedia destruye a una familia de clase media alta, con Donald Sutherland y Mary Tyler Moore como el matrimonio afectado.

items.title: Disaster Zone: Volcano In NY
items.description: Illegal experimentation accidentally rips open a previously unknown hidden magma reserve directly under Manhattan!

items.title: The River Thief
items.description: A self-reliant teenage drifter takes his thieving act to a small town where he recklessly falls for a strong-willed waitress and robs a drug dealer.

items.title: I Hate Kids
items.description: A successful author's life is turned upside down when a psychic turns up with a boy he claims is his son.

items.title: Ferrari: Race to Immortality
items.description: The 1950s. Emergence of the iconic Scuderia Ferrari in the Formula One World Championship and deadliest decade in motor racing history. As cars pushed the limits of human ingenuity, drivers lived on a knife edge between life and death.

items.title: Inappropriate Comedy
items.description: In the sketch comedy film InAPPropriate Comedy, the most hilariously offensive apps stir up cultural anarchy, with stars including Adrien Brody, Rob Schneider, Michelle Rodriguez and Lindsay Lohan making sure no taboo is left untouched!

items.title: Follower
items.description: Three friends on a backpacking trip find themselves stalked by a mysterious individual recording their every move.

items.title: Freedom of North Carolina
items.description: 14-year-old Sarah Jones (Vinetrice Reynolds) portrays the daily struggles of a little slave girl until she sees the light!. Sarah will be compared to all the greatest female abolitionists of our time!

items.title: Heightened
items.description: Following a mental breakdown, an anxious young woman must return home for treatment. After she is unwillingly thrust into nature, she finds unexpected solace in the company of a neurotic park ranger, who is dealing with crippling issues of his own.

items.title: The Final Contestant
items.description: After her family business is robbed, Norah Jeffries plans a city-wide talent show to recover from it. News of the show attracts talented performers who, like Norah, face the harsh reality of bullying.

items.title: Highway To Havasu
items.description: Dylan, a brokenhearted high school senior from Bend, Oregon, is kidnapped by his two friends in a stolen RV as they embark on an epic road trip adventure to Lake Havasu, Arizona, for their last spring break together.

items.title: Six Days In August
items.description: The Prophet Joseph Smith is dead, killed by a mob. Enemies of the LDS Church think the church will die with Joseph. In fact that danger is a real possibility. The crisis is undeniable, and the saints in Nauvoo are in chaos.

items.title: Holden On
items.description: Holden, a small-town football player, fights to keep his mental illness a secret at all costs. Based on a true story.

items.title: The Canyonlands
items.description: 5 contest winners and their troubled guide struggle to survive their rafting trip in The Canyonlands.

items.title: Chompy And The Girls
items.description: A troubled young woman meets her father for the first time only to be interrupted when a man in the park opens his mouth four feet wide and swallow a 10-year-old whole.

items.title: Island Zero
items.description: A fishing community on an island are suddenly cut off from the rest of the world. The terrified survivors realize that something is hunting them.

items.title: Kendra And Beth
items.description: A dark comedy about the only female employee in the warehouse of a sausage company who forms an unlikely bond with a stranger that throws their lives into disarray, leaving them forever changed.

items.title: Exceptional Beings
items.description: Two Immortal Gods, Athena and Hermes, who have lived on earth for over 4000 years, find out that there is much to the planet than they have always believed, when then come into contact with Mina, a woman who makes them question their own reality.

items.title: The Desiring
items.description: Richard leads a simple life until one day he discovers his wife is having an affair, which unlocks a hidden desire in him. As he secretly watches the affair, he is haunted by memories of his father.

items.title: Lady Like
items.description: The fairy-tale life of RuPaul's Drag Race star, Lady Camden, shines in Luke Willis' intimate and joyous documentary. As she soars to international fame, the filmmakers dive into the dark past that drove her to seek the fantasy of the performing arts.

items.title: The Hyperborean
items.description: A whiskey magnate summons his contentious family to sample his legacy product: casks of Scotch aged 170 years, recovered from a ghost ship in the Canadian Arctic.

items.title: The Queen's Corgi
items.description: The British monarch's favorite dog gets lost from the palace and finds himself at a dogfight club.

items.title: Love Birds
items.description: Sometimes the best things in life happen on the fly.

items.title: The Recall
items.description: Five friends vacation at a remote lake house, unaware that planet Earth is under an alien invasion and mass-abduction.

items.title: The Redneg
items.description: A former teacher meets a group of women, led by their ruthless leader "Tamara". This is the beginning of a brutal chase and fight for survival.

items.title: The Reunion
items.description: The Reunion follows 3 friends from high school who reunite ten years later for a weekend getaway. 2 of the friends, Paul and Jacob, have kept in close touch since graduating.

items.title: Donner Pass
items.description: Donner Pass has a well-known and macabre history - the place where George Donner and his party got stuck in the winter of 1846 and were forced to resort to cannibalism to keep from starving. But what if it wasn't just history?

items.title: The Revenant
items.description: A fallen soldier who has joined the ranks of the living dead reunites with his best friend in order to figure out why he has returned and how to sustain himself, wreaks havoc upon his friends, family, and victims, before facing his unavoidable fate.

items.title: Day Labor
items.description: A Latino American veteran day laborer iis mistakenly dropped off at a private ranch in Texas to be hunted for sport.

items.title: Dear Zoe
items.description: A year after her family suffers an unimaginable loss, teenage Tess pens a heartfelt letter to her dead little sister Zoe, reflecting on what was lost, her resistance to traveling with her family down recovery road.

items.title: Demon House

items.description: Becks, columnista romántica, decide ayudar a su mejor amigo Casey en la búsqueda de su primer amor. En este viaje, ambos se conocen mejor, y Becks se enfrenta a un dilema: ayudar a Casey o arriesgarse a abrirle el corazón.

items.title: La prueba de atracción
items.description: Mientras una profesora universitaria se prepara para revelar su estudio sobre el amor entre desconocidos, el lanzamiento se ve amenazado cuando la critican por no haber hecho ella misma "La prueba de citas". Acepta hacer la prueba con su mayor crítico.

items.title: La belleza del amor
items.description: Emma ha creado un sitio web, pero cuando sus cifras empiezan a bajar, cree que podría haber encontrado su solución asociándose con una ambiciosa millennial llamada Jill que tiene sus propios sueños.

items.title: Lady Jane en español
items.description: Basada en la historia real de la chica que se convirtió en reina de Inglaterra por nueve días a los 16 años, Lady Jane es un romance histórico en su versión más agridulce.

items.title: SX_Tape
items.description: A couple's (Caitlyn Folley, Ian Duncan) hookup in a haunted building awakens something with a lust for more than flesh.

items.title: Sin aliento
items.description: Un fugitivo (Richard Gere) viaja a Los Ángeles para encontrar a Monica, una bella estudiante francesa. Seducida por el atractivo y oscuro mundo de Jesse, Monica no puede evitar enamorarse de él y pronto se ve enredada en su huida de las autoridades.

items.title: Teacher's Pet
items.description: Clark Gable plays Jim Gannon, a school-of-hard-knocks newspaperman who despises journalism schools, until he sees who's doing the teaching.

items.title: Old 37
items.description: Disguised as paramedics, two psychopaths intercept 911 calls and hunt down unsuspecting teenage accident victims in a stolen ambulance known as Old 37.

items.title: Separation
items.description: A young girl finds solace in her artist father and the ghost of her dead mother.

items.title: Santa's Squad
items.description: Unemployed art teacher Allie (Rebecca Dalton) accepts a job with the Santa Squad to help lift the spirits of a wealthy widower (Aaron Ashmore) and his two adorable daughters.

items.title: Scheme Queens
items.description: When four girlfriends — bad girl Sam, influencer Lauryn, trophy fiancée Zoe and the devout Audra — find themselves down on their luck, they decide to rob a ruthless Rastafarian jewel thief by conning his second-in-command.

items.title: Defining Moments Of WWII In Colour: The Fall Of The Third Reich
items.description: World War II's pivotal events are revisited, highlighting dramatic battles between Hitler and the Allies, now in color.

items.title: The Triumph Of Love
items.description: A Princess has fallen head over heels in love with her sworn enemy, Agis, the rightful heir to her kingdom. Driven into exile, Agis now lives with a philosopher and his spinster sister who have taught Agis to hate the Princess.

items.title: A Season For Love
items.description: When an awkward yet charming director meets a beautiful driven doctor, their romance blossoms until life's realities force them to see if their love is strong enough to bridge the gap between who they were and who they're becoming.

items.title: Las delicias de la vida
items.description: Cuando un chef obstinado se hace cargo de su igualmente testaruda sobrina de 8 años, las tensiones entre ellas aumentan hasta que llega un chef italiano para aliviar el ambiente.

items.title: A Rocky Mountain Affair
items.description: After a minor car accident, an event planner from the city gets lost in the Rocky Mountains and is rescued by a handsome guide on horseback. At first they clash, but as an attraction grows, they learn that together, anything is possible.

items.title: A Nashville Wish
items.description: A young country singer dreams of making it big in Nashville and begins dating a popular cheerleader, but she doesn't share his love of music. When his career takes off, he must choose between love and following your destiny no matter what.

items.title: A Year And Change
items.description: After falling off a roof, Owen decides that it's time to make wholesale changes in his life. He quits drinking, reconnects with his son, reignites old friendships and falls in love… Sometimes in life, you just need a little change.

items.title: 48 horas: segunda vuelta
items.description: Los tiempos cambian, ¡pero estos tipos no! Eddie Murphy (Shrek, Dr. Dolittle) y Nick Nolte (Hotel Ruanda, Cabo de miedo) vuelven a la acción en esta exitosa secuela.

items.title: Cold Spring
items.description: Determined to mend their fractured marriage, Sara and Roy move to Cold Spring, a small town in upstate New York. But then, one of Roy's former lovers turns up to resurrect their affair.

items.title: Mass
items.description: Years after an unspeakable tragedy tore their lives apart, two sets of parents agree to talk privately in an attempt to move forward.

items.title: Nostalgia
items.description: Follow the lives of people connected through loss while examining the human process of finding love and solace in the artifacts and memories we share.

items.title: Hell Fest: Juegos diabólicos
items.description: En un parque temático de Noche de Brujas; un asesino serial disfrazado mata a los visitantes mientras los transeúntes creen que es parte de la diversión.

items.title: Boy Bye
items.description: Veronica Love seems to have it all...she's smart, sassy and sexy and has a career as one of the most successful real estate entrepreneurs in California.

items.title: Uncle Peckerhead
items.description: When a punk band scores their first tour, life on the road proves tough when they are joined by a man-eating demon as a roadie.

items.title: Blood Pageant
items.description: A million-dollar talent competition between seven women turns into a battle for life itself when an ancient curse is unleashed and the contest becomes a blood pageant of death and evil forces. Forget about who will win - who will survive?

items.title: Michael Jackson: History, King of Pop
items.description: Archival footage tells the story of a reclusive and brilliant world-famous showman as he navigated his life, career, and personal relationships

items.title: Accidental Family
items.description: A shy lonely girl finds the perfect family and love of her life. But they think she's a lost relative and he is engaged. As sparks start to fly, she must warn him of his deceptive fiancé and find a way to tell him the truth about herself.

items.title: Swag Inc.
items.description: Two best friends, who are experts in dating, find themselves a unique opportunity to cash in on their "Swag". Will this opportunity finally give them the lifestyle they've always wanted?

items.title: Stardust on the Sage
items.description: When a radio commentator fakes Gene Autry's voice on her show telling cattlemen to invest their money in a hydraulic mining venture rather than in cattle, Gene must correct the error of her ways.

items.title: Hope Ranch
items.description: A young girl and her mother are in danger of losing their ranch after the death of her military father. With a little help from their majestic white horse, they hatch a plan to save the ranch and learn to never lose hope.

items.title: Apart
items.description: Linked by a rare psychological disorder, Noah Greene and Emily Gates must uncover the mystery of a tragic past in order to find hope for the future.

items.title: We Belong Together
items.description: A recovering alcoholic professor trying to put his life back together is offered an escape from his reality by a seductive new student with a secret.

items.title: Being Considered
items.description: Struggling artist Jake faces chaos after thief Jojo steals his screenplay, sparking success that reshapes his path.

items.title: Spotlight on Christmas
items.description: Dumped right before Christmas, famous actress Olivia (Tori Anderson, NCIS: Hawai'i) returns to her hometown, where she unexpectedly meets someone new.

items.title: I.S.S.
items.description: When a world war event occurs on Earth, America and Russia, both nations secretly contact their astronauts aboard the ISS and give them instructions to take control of the station by any means necessary.

items.title: Jules
items.description: Follows Milton who lives a quiet life in a small Pennsylvania town, but finds his day upended when a UFO crash lands in his backyard. Before long, Milton develops a close relationship with the extra-terrestrial he calls "Jules."

items.title: Ezra
items.description: Both an unpredictable family dramedy and a road movie that runs on mischief, the latest from director Tony Goldwyn.

items.title: Exquisite Corpse
items.description: A gifted med student revives his dead girlfriend, but each day she lives demands another life in return.

items.title: JeruZalem
items.description: Two American girls on vacation follow a mysterious anthropology student on a trip to Jerusalem. The party is cut short when the trio is caught in the middle of a biblical apocalypse.

items.title: Shadow of the Sword
items.description: The story of time-tested loyalty of two friends during Europe's 16th-century Inquisition. Orphans Martin and Georg bond as children, but walk very different paths as adults.

items.title: Buddy Games: Spring Awakening
items.description: After the death of one of their own, Bobfather and the boys steal the urn and go on a trip to commemorate his life at the place where the Buddy Games began, but everything goes wrong when they find themselves in the middle of spring break.

items.title: Kumiko, The Treasure Hunter
items.description: Frustrated with her mundane life, a Tokyo office worker (Rinko Kikuchi) becomes obsessed with a fictional movie that she mistakes for a documentary.

items.title: Bruce Lee: The Way of the Warrior
items.description: Bruce Lee, an iconic figure in Hollywood cinema, a pioneer of martial arts but most importantly, a friend.

items.title: Mister Organ
items.description: Intrepid journalist and filmmaker David Farrier (Tickled) faces off against his greatest foe yet in MISTER ORGAN, a bizarre tale that finds Farrier in a dangerous game of cat and mouse with a mysterious con man.

items.title: Midnight
items.description: A ruthless serial killer, (Squid Game star, Wi Ha-Joon), is hunting for victims on the streets of South Korea. A witness is caught in a life-threatening chase in deadly silence. Will she survive or become his prey?

items.title: Butter
items.description: A young man fights to avenge the death of his sister, a recording artist killed by her manager to hide secrets she threatened to expose. Deceit, body heat and pulsing street beats converge in this explosive story about the music industry.

items.title: I'm Your Man
items.description: In order to obtain research funds for her studies, a scientist accepts an offer to participate in an extraordinary experiment: for three weeks, she is to live with a humanoid robot, created to make her happy.

items.title: My First Horror Film
items.description: An aspiring influencer documents her journey to booking her first horror film but receives a bloody surprise when a real-life killer begins murdering her cast mates on set.

items.title: The Roads Not Taken
items.description: A day in the life of Leo and his daughter, Molly, as he floats through alternate lives he could have lived.

items.title: Breathe
items.description: When Robin is struck down by polio, he and Diana dare to escape the hospital ward to seek out a full and passionate life together, raising their young son, travelling, and devoting their lives to helping other polio patients.

items.title: A Love Song
items.description: At a campground in the rural West, a woman waits alone for an old flame from her past to arrive, uncertain of his intentions while bashful about her own.

items.title: Eye In The Sky
items.description: When a child enters the kill zone of a drone operation targeting terrorists in Kenya, an international dispute is triggered that reaches the highest levels of British and US governments. A thrilling portrayal of the moral implications of modern warfare.

items.title: Golda
items.description: A thrilling war drama focusing on the intensely dramatic and high-stakes responsibilities and decisions that Golda Meir, also known as the 'Iron Lady of Israel', faced during the Yom Kippur War.

items.title: What Lies Ahead
items.description: When two young women are thrown togetheron an unexpected road trip, a surprising and aggressive peril emerges between them that grows stronger with each passing mile.

items.title: The Lesson
items.description: An aspiring author takes a tutoring position at the estate of a legendary writer.

items.title: Rumours
items.description: World leaders meet at the G7 but get lost in the woods whilst trying to compose a joint statement on an unspecified global crisis. Beset by thick fog and menaced by undead bog bodies and a giant brain, they navigate the tortured passions between them.

items.title: White Sky
items.description: Survivors of an alien insurrection are chased deep into the forest by "Altered" human beings. When one of them becomes infected, they realize there's nowhere to hide from the horde that seems intent upon finding and assimilating them.

items.title: Teen Spirit
items.description: Violet dreams of becoming a popstar to escape her small-town life, entering a singing competition that will test her integrity, talent, and ambition.

items.title: One Life
items.description: A British stockbroker, deeply troubled by the emerging threat of the Third Reich, travels to Czechoslovakia on the eve of WWII, and against all odds, rescues hundreds of Jewish children.

items.title: The Assistant
items.description: A searing look at a day in the life of an assistant to a powerful executive. As Jane follows her daily routine, she grows increasingly aware of the insidious abuse that threatens every aspect of her position.

items.title: Boonie Bears: Homeward Journey
items.description: Briar Bear, Bramble Bear & friends enjoy life in the woods when Logger Vick begins chopping down trees to get money to go home for the holidays. As Logger Vick is homesick they hatch a plan to get Vick home in time for the holidays.

items.title: Boonie Bears: To The Rescue
items.description: The Brother Bears and Logger Vick discover a baby girl lost in their sprawling forest and undergo a chaotic crash course in infant care. But bad guys are on the trail of this mystery baby so the trio must team up to get her home safely.

items.title: Camp Cool Kids
items.description: At their summer campgames, Spence and his big brother Zach find themselves on opposing teams: it's the dweebs against the bullies.Can Spence make new friends, overcome his fears, stand up to the bullies and win a trophy in the process?

items.title: Caralique
