items.description: A young, aspiring fashion designer wants to bring more sparkle to the world and brighten it for those around her. Despite being told no on her initial ideas, she learns to stick to her instincts and to never give up on her dreams. (231)

items.title: Run Tiger Run
items.description: A young boy dreams of joining the ancient Chinese "Travelguard," elite warriors that protect deliveries. When offered membership if he can successfully guard an important package, he partners with a mysterious stranger on the mission.

items.title: Crescent Gang
items.description: When seven foster kids learn they are to be separated again, their search for a solution brings them to the home of an attorney, herself a product of the system, finding that there's always help and hope for those daring enough to seek it.

items.title: I'll See You In My Dreams
items.description: A widow who's settled into her life and her age is propelled into a renewed engagement with the people and the world around her.

items.title: Sasquatch Sunset
items.description: Acclaimed directors David and Nathan Zellner take you on absurdist, strange, hilarious, and ultimately poignant journey through four seasons with family of Sasquatches.

items.title: Accident
items.description: A group of teenagers suffer a terrible accident during a joy ride. If only getting trapped at the bottom of ravine was the only thing they had to worry about.

items.title: Save Yourselves!
items.description: A young Brooklyn couple heads to an upstate cabin to unplug from their phones and reconnect with each other. Blissfully unaware of their surroundings, they are left to their own devices as the planet falls under attack.

items.title: Blind War
items.description: After being blinded during a courthouse siege, a disgraced SWAT captain must join forces with an unlikely ally to rescue his kidnapped daughter from the shadows.

items.title: Summering
items.description: The weekend prior to the beginning of middle school, which are the last days of their childhood and summer.

items.title: Howling VI: The Freaks
items.description: A villainous carnival owner traps a young werewolf to include in his growing menagerie of inhuman exhibits.

items.title: Gangnam Zombie
items.description: In the center of Seoul, previously normal people begin attacking other citizens, leading a former athlete to play one final match against the zombies.

items.title: The Secrets We Keep
items.description: In post-WWII America, a woman, rebuilding her life in the suburbs with her husband, kidnaps her neighbor and seeks vengeance for the heinous war crimes she believes he committed against her.

items.title: Iron Mask
items.description: For the first time ever, screen legends Arnold Schwarzenegger and Jackie Chan face off against each other in battle in this globe-trotting fantasy adventure! Also starring screen icon Rutger Hauer, in one of his final performances.

items.title: Together
items.description: The story of a family that, like so many, found a way to survive—together.

items.title: Fact or Fiction: The Life & Times of Ping Pong Hustler Marty Reisman
items.description: Former table tennis champion Marty Reisman (the real-life inspiration for "Marty Supreme") faces mortality while pursuing fame in his final years, in this fascinating documentary.

items.title: Control
items.description: While locked in a strange room, Eileen must complete specific tasks in order to save her daughter’s life. As the tasks progress from difficult to virtually impossible, Eileen is forced to unlock dormant kinetic powers out of desperation.

items.title: Duchess
items.description: Duchess, a small-time crook, enters the treacherous underworld of diamond trafficking and ends up left for dead when a deal goes wrong. Determined to seek retribution she launches into an unwavering pursuit for vengeance.

items.title: The Assassins
items.description: While battling the Dark Spirit, a young doctor accidentally ruins his island and is banished from Kunlun Hospital. But when a young boy comes to him for healing, he may have one more chance to redeem himself—and restore his home.

items.title: Mafia Wars
items.description: Terry Jacobs is a recently paroled felon forced to go undercover to bring down the head of the most infamous mob syndicate in Italy.

items.title: The Bling Ring
items.description: A teenager and his gang of fame-obsessed youths use the Internet to track the whereabouts of celebrities, then rob their homes.

items.title: Aespa: World Tour In Cinemas
items.description: Experience aespa’s first concert film, WORLD TOUR, now available digitally! Witness their electrifying London O2 Arena show, powerful performances, and exclusive behind-the-scenes moments.

items.title: The Outlaws
items.description: In the Wild West, outlaws wake to find their loot stolen, sparking a deadly showdown of accusations. Trust is scarce as they race to unmask the true thief before bullets fly and there's hell to pay.

items.title: Give Me Five
items.description: A former cop rejoins the police department to investigate a drug ring that employs ghosts and vampires.

items.title: City Of Rock
items.description: In this zany musical comedy from acclaimed director Da Peng, a small-town musician plans a benefit concert to save his town’s beloved Rock Park from redevelopment by a corporate real estate agent.

items.title: God Of War: Battle Of The Three Kingdoms
items.description: Starring Shu Qi and Based on the #1 Bestselling novels, MOJIN: THE LOST LEGEND pits a trio of grave robbers against rivals and the law, until a mysterious stranger tempts them into one last heist. In Chinese with English Subtitles.

items.title: Detective Dee: Demon Chonchon
items.description: Detective Dee investigates strange incidents at Tang's demon building, uncovering family secrets. Despite deception, eldest daughter Tang shares her unusual behavior, leading Dee to uncover the truth.

items.title: The Dragon Family
items.description: When a new family moves in next door to Laura and her family, their young daughter, Megan, quickly captivates her, stirring up painful memories of her own daughter, Josie, who died several years previously.

items.title: Girls vs Gangsters
items.description: In this uproarious sequel to 'Girls,' a bachelorette weekend turns chaotic after a drinking contest, leaving three friends to piece together a wild night while evading local gangsters.

items.title: Gundala
items.description: Based on the hit classic comic, Gundala is a poignant reminder that anyone can be a hero (though a superpower never hurts). When greed and violence reach a fever pitch, orphan-turned-badass Sancaka becomes the people’s only hope for peace.

items.title: Hell Hath No Fury
items.description: When a powerful crime ring starts construction on the largest casino in all of Asia, the group is challenged by a young, vicious gangster (Jang Hyuk) from Seoul who will stop at nothing to gain power.

items.title: Here Before
items.description: Xia Tian is on the verge of a major discovery: time travel. When her son is kidnapped and killed, she desperately sends herself back in time, where she discovers multiple versions of her future self.

items.title: Tastes Of Horror
items.description: After stopping a robbery, a sheriff jails a stranger linked to outlaws. As he hunts the gang, ghosts of murdered townspeople appear, leaving him to wonder if they're warning him or seeking revenge.

items.title: Born To Fly
items.description: After an unforeseen threat arises mid-air, a talented young air force test pilot (WANG Yibo) is forced to test not only the capabilities of his top-secret aircraft, but also his own physical and psychological limits, in order to survive.

items.title: Herstory
items.description: 10 plaintiffs who suffered as comfort woman during World War II and their 13 lawyers stand in a courtroom in Japan. They have gone through 23 difficult trials from 1992 to 1998.

items.title: Hostile Territory
items.description: When several flight passengers suddenly suffer gruesome, unexplained deaths, a young doctor on board begins to suspect that the shadowy, terrifying force behind her own worst childhood nightmare may be responsible.

items.title: I Did It My Way
items.description: A former special agent is called in for a secret mission: safely escort the world’s first human clone, whose body may hold the key to defeating death itself. But as the enemy closes in, the pair is forced to make an impossible choice.

items.title: Invincible Dragon
items.description: Fantasy adventure about the legendary hero Zhong Kui, a fabled warrior with mysterious powers who is forced to conquer the realms of Heaven and Hell to save his people.

items.title: Emily
items.description: Emily imagines the transformative, exhilarating, and uplifting journey to womanhood of Emily Brontë.

items.title: IP Man 4: The Finale
items.description: Set during the Korean War, a band of prisoners at a POW camp find distraction from the hardships of war and a new sense of freedom in dancing.

items.title: Betrayal
items.description: Three desperate brothers return to the remote Scottish woodland where they killed their abusive father only to discover his shallow grave is now empty, forcing them to question each another's loyalty with consequences as fear and paranoia set in.

items.title: Kung Fu Monster
items.description: A reckless police officer is dead set on bringing a world renown gold smuggler to justice, even if he has to go to the ends of the Earth to find him.

items.title: Last Man Down
items.description: After his wife’s murder, an elite soldier goes AWOL and begins a solitary life in the wilderness. When a wounded woman arrives unannounced, he avoids getting involved—until discovering that her pursuer is the same man who killed his wife.

items.title: Legend Of The Demon Seal
items.description: When the leader of a group of 4 triad families decides they should go straight and stop dealing in drugs, 3 of the 4 follow suit, but the 4th decides to continue with their illegal dealings and frame the son of the boss.

items.title: Legend Of The Naga Pearls
items.description: After hiding a deadly sword that bestows great power upon its wielder, the emperor dies and a deranged rebel seizes power. Now, the young daughter of a great general is all that stands between a tyrant and his quest for domination.

items.title: Lost In Hong Kong
items.description: A revered Asian leader needs a rare blood transfusion. His disciple, aided by a courageous cop, hunts three potential donors as they battle terrorists and uncover police traitors, racing to save Lama amidst escalating danger

items.title: Lost In Thailand
items.description: Jiang Ziya is banished to the mortal realm after violating the code of the gods.

items.title: Días de perros
items.description: Días de perros es una divertida y emocionante comedia con un elenco diverso de personajes humanos y perrunos.

items.title: Against The Spread
items.description: In the rural South, a down-and-out gambling addict reignites a deep-rooted rivalry with a ruthless loan shark to finance his dimwitted nephew's half-baked scheme.

items.title: Men Of Sacrifice
items.description: Elite bomb squad partners Ma Jin and Zhu Jiang uncover a revenge plot involving 200 kg of explosives and race against time to stop a catastrophic attack.

items.title: 11 Rebels
items.description: In the final days of the samurai, 11 condemned warriors are offered redemption—defend a mountain pass or die forgotten. Led by ex-samurai, Tatsukoro (Takayuki Yamada), they face a brutal siege in a last stand of steel, honor, and blood.

items.title: Abigail
items.description: When a mysterious illness strikes, Abigail's town isolates itself, taking her father. Ten years later, she discovers he may be alive, embarking on a perilous journey of discovery.

items.title: Disobedience
items.description: A woman (Rachel Weisz) returns to her Orthodox Jewish community after the death of her rabbi father and stirs up controversy when she shows an interest in an old childhood friend (Rachel McAdams).

items.title: El juego del amor
items.description: Después de un desacuerdo entre su hijo y otro estudiante, Piper, una madre soltera competitiva, se ve obligada a formar equipo con el testarudo padre soltero de ese estudiante para montar la producción escolar de "Romeo y Julieta".

items.title: Nico, 1988
items.description: NICO, 1988 is the story of an artist, a mother, and the woman behind the icon. Approaching 50, Nico's life and career are on the ropes, a far cry from her glamorous days as a Warhol superstar and celebrated vocalist for The Velvet Underground.

items.title: Un amor que no tiene precio
items.description: Rose McGovern descubre que una tetera de su tienda de segunda mano vale 80,000 dólares. Joe Burnside, un ambicioso corredor de antigüedades, quiere comprársela, pero Rose se niega hasta hallar al dueño original.

items.title: Alienoid: Return To The Future
items.description: After locating the Divine Blade, a shaman and a modern-day woman race through time to battle a powerful alien commander intent on destroying mankind in ALIENOID: RETURN TO THE FUTURE, Part II of Choi Dong-hoon’s epic sci-fi action series.

items.title: Amor a la pizza
items.description: En un suburbio de Chicago, dos pizzerías han competido por el negocio de la ciudad durante años, pero cuando una nueva cadena de pizzerías se muda a la ciudad, los jefes luchan por continuar la rivalidad después de que comienzan a enamorarse uno del otro.

items.title: Blackwood
items.description: After a gang of violent outlaws forces a Native American woman to lead them through a treacherous forest in search of gold, they unknowingly awaken an ancient, bloodthirsty beast that will stop at nothing to annihilate them all.

items.title: Bone Cold
items.description: After bad intel from headquarters results in a tragic civilian death, an elite sniper duo attempts to flee the area but can’t seem to shake a mysterious, inhuman creature stalking them from the shadows.

items.title: Una porcion de romance
items.description: Cuando la ejecutiva de relaciones públicas Mikayla conoce al dueño de un café y aspirante a chef pastelero Austin, la pareja llega a un acuerdo: ella probará sus creaciones y cambiará el nombre de su café a cambio de consejos sobre citas.

items.title: The Brink
items.description: Reckless police inspector Tung is on a mission to crack down on criminal Shing's gold smuggling scheme. As Tung continues his manhunt, he discovers Shing's involvement with triad boss Blackie, who hides on a casino cruise ship on the high seas.

items.title: Una foto para siempre
items.description: Después de dejar atrás su vida en la gran ciudad, la fotógrafa de bodas Jessie está más feliz que nunca. Cuando el famoso actor Nate aparece en el viñedo de sus padres para la boda de su hermana, ella se da cuenta de que hay más en él de lo que parece.

items.title: Un pueblo llamado amor
items.description: Emma necesita demostrar lo que vale a su jefa Jenna, de Los viajes de Jenna, la famosa serie de libros de viajes. Al enfrentarse a Riley, hijo del alcalde, finge ser Jenna para explorar el pueblo Amor y desmentir sus mitos.

items.title: Reds
items.description: El periodista estadounidense John Reed (Warren Beatty) y su esposa Louise Bryant (Diane Keaton) son testigos de la Revolución Rusa.

items.title: The Emperor's Sword
items.description: A sword that bestows power upon its wielder was divided and hidden. A rebel seizes power and stages a massacre, leaving only one survivor. Now, the daughter of a great general is all that stands between a tyrant and his domination.

items.title: The Korean War: No Longer Forgotten Part I
items.description: The Korean War, a 'Forgotten War', reshaped military tactics amid a fierce ideological battle.

items.title: Savage
items.description: Buried by treacherous conditions at the top of Mt. Baekdu, a policeman must brave the extreme weather until his transfer comes through. When a group of thieves stumbles into the station, both sides must fight for survival.

items.title: Schemes In Antiques
items.description: Adapted from Ma Boyong's novel of the same name, the film tells the story of a series of adventures that occurred when the descendants of the five veins made a wish to find out the truth about the Buddha head of Wu Zetian Mingtang in the Tang Dynasty.

items.title: Extreme Movie (ESP)
items.description: Muchos sketches ilustran las diversas dichas y vergüenzas involucradas en el sexo entre adolescentes.

items.title: Seobok: Project Clone
items.description: Ex intelligence agent Ki Heon is tasked with safely transporting Seo Bok, the first ever human clone, who holds the secret of eternal life. Several forces try to take control of Seo Bok to serve their own agendas.

items.title: Shepherd
items.description: A young Scottish shepherd, following the death of his unfaithful wife, fights to maintain his own sanity when the past catches up to him.

items.title: Shocking Kung Fu Of Huo's
items.description: 20 years after the Revolution of 1911, Huo Zhenshan opens a school to promote Chinese martial arts. But a new challenge in the black market emerges.

items.title: Snow Girl And The Dark Crystal
items.description: Legendary Chinese anti-hero Zhong Kui, a young man endowed with mysterious powers who is forced into a battle among the realms of Heaven, Earth and Hell in the course of his attempt to save his countrymen and the woman he loves.

items.title: El legado
items.description: Un exconvicto recientemente liberado y su hermano menor adoptivo se ven obligados a huir. Perseguidos por un criminal vengativo, los federales y un grupo de soldados de otro mundo, su única protección es un arma encontrada de ascendencia misteriosa.

items.title: Striking Rescue
items.description: Tony Jaa is in top form as Bai An, a muay thai expert seeking revenge against the men who brutally murdered his wife and child. Jaa dominates the screen with powerful flying knees and elbows, proving he’s still one of the best there is.

items.title: So Cold The River
items.description: A documentary filmmaker's research on a town's mysterious benefactor unearths an unexplained evil while staying at a local resort.

items.title: Swing Kids
items.description: The story of Ro Gi Soo, a tap dancing North Korean soldier who was held captive in the Geoje prison camp during the Korean War.

items.title: Vladimir Putin: Power, Greed, Obsession
items.description: Vladimir Putin rises from obscurity to power, aiming to revive the Soviet Union at any cost.

items.title: Un hombre solitario
items.description: Un magnate automotriz ve derrumbarse su vida personal y profesional por sus indiscreciones amorosas y de negocios.

items.title: American Muscle
items.description: John Falcon has been locked away doing hard time for 10 years. Now released he’s got 24 hours to get revenge for all those responsible for putting him in prison.

items.title: Cannibal Mukbang
items.description: Shy and looking for love, Mark quickly becomes smitten with the outgoing and mysterious Ash, who somehow, much to his surprise, reciprocates the attraction.

items.title: The Eagle Has Landed
items.description: A German plot to kidnap Winston Churchill unfolds at the height of World War II.

items.title: Eye For An Eye 2: Blind Vengeance
items.description: Blind Cheng (Tse Miao) runs into young orphan Xiaoyu (Yang Enyou) while both are run from the authorities. He reluctantly agrees to shelter her, leading to a series of violent battles featuring some of China’s finest martial arts in years.

items.title: The Game Changer
items.description: In Shanghai, two escaped prisoners rise to power in the Green Gang under boss Mr. Tang. But betrayal threatens to upend their alliance and control over the city's underworld.

items.title: The Island
items.description: A cataclysmic event causes a man, who dreams of winning the lottery, to become stranded on an island with his co-workers.

items.title: The Guillotines
items.description: A secret brotherhood of assassins, once favored by the Emperor, is exiled and hunted with firearms that challenge the power of their cold steel.

items.title: The Great War Of Archimedes
items.description: Pre-WWII, the Japanese Navy commissions the creation of impressive super-ship Yamato, opposed by an admiral insisting on more battle-ready warships. Once ignored, Admiral Yamamoto recruits a math genius to uncover a suspected conspiracy.

items.title: The House That Never Dies: Reawakening
items.description: A century after the Zhisheng household murders, relic restorer Song Teng unravels eerie events in the mansion, unveiling a haunting quest for justice from the restless dead.

items.title: Creation Of The Gods I: Kingdom Of Storms
items.description: To save the mortal world, the gods intervene by investing in a champion brave enough to challenge the evil king—even if it may cost him everything.

items.title: The First King
items.description: Romulus and Remus, two shepherds and loyal brothers, end up taking part to a journey that will lead one of them to be the founder of the greatest nation ever seen. However, the fate of the chosen one will pass from killing his own brother.

items.title: The Resurrection Of Jake The Snake
items.description: A fallen pro wrestling superstar battles past demons to reclaim his life and family that has given up on him.

items.title: The Last Blood
items.description: A revered Asian leader needs a rare blood transfusion. His disciple, aided by a courageous cop, hunts three potential donors as they battle terrorists and uncover police traitors, racing to save Lama amidst escalating danger.

items.title: Maten al irlandés
items.description: El ganador del Oscar Christopher Walken, junto con Val Kilmer y Ray Stevenson, protagonizan Maten al irlandés, la verdadera historia de un rudo matón irlandés que trabajaba para la mafia en Cleveland en los años setenta.

items.title: Asesina en fuga
items.description: Maya es objeto de la mafia rusa tras la muerte de su esposo. Al negarse a cooperar, es incriminada y enviada a prisión.

items.title: Desayuno en Tiffany's
items.description: Holly es una excéntrica y encantadora joven de Nueva York decidida a casarse con un millonario brasileño. George Peppard interpreta a su vecino, un escritor mantenido por una adinerada mujer. Adivinar quién es el hombre indicado para Holly no es difícil.

items.title: The Loneliest Boy In The World
items.description: The Loneliest Boy in the World' is a modern fairytale - with zombies. A satire and a celebration of family values, of the imagery of horror films, of suburban life, of the American Dream and of the ultimate taboo; death.

items.title: El gran asalto
items.description: En una patrulla, un policía veterano y su compañero quedan atrapados con un pasajero en un enfrentamiento con exmercenarios que roban un banco.

items.title: Ghosts Of Red Ridge
items.description: After stopping a robbery, a sheriff jails a stranger linked to outlaws. As he hunts the gang, ghosts of murdered townspeople appear, leaving him to wonder if they're warning him or seeking revenge.

items.title: Night Train
items.description: In this tightly crafted action adventure, a single mom struggling to survive agrees to run black market medical supplies in her legendary pick-up Night Train. The only problem now is that she must stay one step ahead of the FBI.

items.title: Sakra
items.description: Starring & directed by international action star Donnie Yen—When a respected martial artist is accused of murder, he goes on the run in search of answers about his own mysterious origin story and the unknown enemies working to destroy him.

items.title: The Long Night
items.description: While searching for her parents, a New York transplant returns to her childhood southern stomping grounds to investigate a lead, but the weekend takes a bizarre turn when a nightmarish cult arrives to fulfill a twisted apocalyptic prophecy.

items.title: Mine
items.description: An American soldier (Armie Hammer), stranded in the desert for 52 hours after his mission falls apart, must fight for survival against his enemies, the elements, and the creeping psychological toll of his treacherous situation.

items.title: Customs Frontline
items.description: Hong Kong stars Nicolas Tse and Jacky Cheung team up in Herman Yau’s latest action spectacle. Customs finds illegal arms in Hong Kong waters, their quest to take down the dealers leads to some of the most incredible action in recent memory.

items.title: The Comeback
items.description: Uncle Hua, an esteemed antique dealer, stands against the Green Dragon Gang to protect his neighborhood from forced demolition.

items.title: Devils Stay
items.description: So-mi’s death during a violent exorcism sets her father Seung-do spinning. A cardiologist by trade, he senses a faint heartbeat even as the funeral progresses. As the days pass, Seung-do must prove she is still alive or lose her forever.

items.title: The Childe
items.description: A boxer with Korean-Filipino roots returns to Korea to find his father, only to be drawn into a dangerous underworld.

items.title: Taeyong: Ty Track In Cinemas
items.description: After debuting in 2016 under the K-Pop group NCT, Lee Taeyong finally prepares for his first concert as soloist.

items.title: The Mannequin
items.description: A stylist assistant investigates her sister's death in a historic LA building, only to face a vengeful ghost of a serial killer who dismembered victims decades ago. She must escape before she's next.

items.title: The Ming Dynasty Assassin
items.description: In the waning years of the Ming Dynasty, influential eunuch Wei Zhongxian extends his corrupt control over state affairs for selfish gain.

items.title: Tiger Woods: Icon
items.description: Tiger Woods is one of golf’s most iconic players, captivating a generation with his dynamic highs and lows.

items.title: The Monkey King 3
items.description: In this action-packed fantasy, the Monkey King and his companions are captured by the Queen of an all-female land, triggering a prophecy of destruction they must prevent.

items.title: Trumbo (2015)
items.description: Screenwriter Dalton Trumbo's career comes to a crushing halt in the 1940s when he and other Hollywood figures are blacklisted for their political beliefs as he goes to war with the U.S. government and studio bosses over words and freedom.

items.title: Dark Nuns
items.description: Sister Junia is convinced that the demon possessing Hee-jun is one of the darkest there is. So when the church refuses to act, she teams up with another rogue nun to exorcise the entity in this exciting new take on the exorcism thriller.

items.title: The Monkey King: Reborn
items.description: When Monkey King is insulted at a temple, he destroys a magical tree and accidentally releases the King of Demons, who kidnaps his master. Now, Monkey King must rescue Tang Monk before the demon king regains power and destroys the earth.

items.title: People I Know
items.description: Eli Wurman is a powerful press agent who finds himself skidding into a very public scandal.

items.title: Dark Figure Of Crime
items.description: A criminal thriller about the fierce psychological confrontation between a detective and a killer who confessed to multiple murders.

items.title: The Moon
items.description: After a spaceship is damaged mid-mission and leaves an astronaut stranded with rapidly decreasing oxygen stores, Korea's Naro Space Center turns to a former director to avert a catastrophe and possibly redeem his own tarnished legacy.

items.title: 6:45 (Film)
items.description: A couple embarks on a weekend getaway only to find the island curiously deserted. After stumbling upon the town’s dark secret, they trigger a time loop, forcing them to relive a demented cycle of terror with seemingly no means of escape.

items.title: Bad Company
items.description: A group of mismatched young robbers attempts to make it as outlaws on the frontier, but their ill-fated heists quickly reveal just how unprepared they are for life in the Wild West.

items.title: The Mysterious Story Of Longyun Town
items.description: In early Republic-era Longyun Town, strange events and murders follow the discovery of a treasure. Captain Lin teams up with martial artist Ji Lianying and a death row inmate to catch the killer and protect the town from further danger.

items.title: The Sparring Partner
items.description: Based on a shocking case in real life, a young man partners with his friend to murder and dismember his parents. Pleading not guilty to the crime, defense attorneys face each other as nine jurors grapple with the truth.

items.title: The Stool Pigeon
items.description: Policeman Don Lee often works with informants but numerous too-close calls and failed missions cause him to see the world as one betrayal after another - then he meets Guy, and is given a new chance to change his views.

items.title: The Tai Chi Master
items.description: In 13th century China, a martial arts prodigy named Zhang Sanfeng faces personal tragedy and political turmoil. Caught between warring factions, he develops the revolutionary art of Tai Chi amid chaos and conspiracy.

items.title: The Wrath Of Vajra
items.description: Before WWII, Japan’s Temple of Hades abducts children to create assassins. Vajra, their deadliest killer, escapes after his brother’s death and flees to China, vowing revenge on those who turned him into a weapon while protecting the innocent.

items.title: Too Cool To Kill
items.description: In order to fully realize his dream of being a comedian, Wei Chenggong accidentally broke into a dangerous scam under the "persuasion" of actress Milan. But Wei Chenggong didn't know he was already involved in another real and ridiculous plot.

items.title: Triple Tap
items.description: Champion marksman Ken stops an armored van robbery, killing four and saving a hostage cop. Cleared in court, he’s hunted by the escaped robber, Pang Tao, as buried secrets surface and Ken clashes with investigator Jerry Chang in a deadly game of wits.

items.title: Two Deaths Of Henry Baker
items.description: After 25 years in prison, outlaw Henry Baker is freed to face old allies and enemies—a scarred gunman, a drunken deputy, and a vengeful hustler—who follow him to a rundown hotel where he plans to reunite with his son and hidden gold.

items.title: Warhorse One
items.description: A gunned down Navy SEAL Master Chief must guide a child to safety through a gauntlet of hostile Taliban insurgents and survive the brutal Afghanistan wilderness.

items.title: Black Noise
items.description: When an elite security team is sent to a remote island to rescue a VIP, their mission takes a turn as they are confronted by masked gunmen. To keep hold of their lives, the team must act fast to assess the situation and escape the island.

items.title: Captain Fantastic
items.description: A single father living in the forests of the Pacific Northwest with his six young kids tries to assimilate back into society. Academy Award nominee for Best Actor.

items.title: White Haired Devil Lady
items.description: The Wudang Sect is tasked to bring the Emperor a red pill to treat his illness, but all might be lost when a shadow group presents themselves and attacks.

items.title: 1st Strike
items.description: Juan Garcia is a typical teenager living in a gang-infested barrio of East LA. When his movie star, uncle Manny invites him out on a joy ride in his new Cadillac, the situation goes bad. Juan is then accused of a crime he did not commit.

items.title: A Different Loyalty
items.description: British war reporter Leo and American journalist Sally meet on assignment in Beirut. When Leo disappears, Sally begins to uncover his secret life, which leads her behind the Iron Curtain and into the clutches of the KGB.

items.title: Nightworld
items.description: Jason London and icon Robert Englund star in this thriller about an afterlife darker than you ever imagined. A former cop takes a job in Security at an old building in Bulgaria and begins to experience inexplicable, terrifying events.

items.title: Dolly Parton: Here I Am
items.description: Explore the extraordinary life and music of the Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, with exclusive interviews and archive footage.

items.title: My Life as Roger Moore
items.description: Friends, family, and co-stars take part in this revealing and entertaining look at a stylish and very British actor. With one eyebrow raised, follow his journey from shy London schoolboy to global superstar.

items.title: Zombiology: Enjoy Yourself Tonight
items.description: When a monster from a popular animated show appears and starts a zombie outbreak, it's up to eccentric duo Lung and Chi-Yeung to stand up and fight the horde of the recently deceased, and save their friends from all around chaos!

items.title: A Very Country Christmas: Homecoming
items.description: Zane and Jeannette return from their honeymoon for Christmas but face an unexpected guest and paparazzi chaos, making their first family holiday more complicated than planned.

items.title: A Warriors Heart
items.description: In shock and denial over his Marine father's death, star lacrosse player Conor Sullivan starts acting out self-destructively, leaving his mom, Claire, at her wit's end. He trains at a wilderness lacrosse camp with his dad's old combat buddy.

items.title: Agoraphobia
items.description: An agoraphobic inherits her father's house in a remote part of the Florida Keys. Afraid to go outside, she discovers that there's something far more terrifying trapped inside the house with her.

items.title: Barefoot
items.description: The underachieving black sheep son of a wealthy family meets a young psychiatric patient and takes her home for his brothers wedding.

items.title: Caroline and Jackie
items.description: A birthday celebration exposes the fragile bond between two sisters. Dark secrets surface, unraveling the intricacies of their relationship and the profound impact of hidden truths on their lives.

items.title: Christmas with a Prince: Becoming Royal
items.description: Dr. Tasha is off to St. Savarre to spend Christmas with Prince Alex. He proposes, and they immediately begin making plans. Princess Miranda, unhappy about the news, concocts a plan to halt the nuptials.

items.title: Christmas Catch
items.description: Detective Bennett is on the trail of a thief and goes undercover to find where hes hiding the loot. Could he have been framed? Or are feelings clouding her judgment?

items.title: Mccanick
items.description: A harried narcotics detective and his reluctant partner frantically track down a recently released convict from their past.

items.title: Afflicted (CBS Films)
items.description: A horror story about best friends on the trip of a lifetime that takes a dark turn after they encounter a mysterious woman in Paris.

items.title: Fighter
items.description: A woman's self-salvation, a fighter's journey of revenge, a well-planned conspiracy, an ultimate contest between life and death...

items.title: I'm Dancing As Fast As I Can
items.description: A true story about Emmy-winning filmmaker Barbara Gordon and her struggle to overcome a dangerous Valium addiction.

items.title: Mob Town
items.description: The FBI and a local cop track various members of organized crime families as they gather for a huge meeting in upstate New York in 1957.

items.title: The Advocate
items.description: A 15th-century lawyer flees the corruption of Paris for the countryside, where he soon becomes involved in a bizarre court case.

items.title: Boda en apuros
items.description: Tras una ruptura, Gwen, meticulosa planificadora, prepara la boda de su mejor amiga. Pero al colaborar con Josh, un guía naturalista de espíritu libre, descubre que organizar el gran día puede ser complicado… y que el amor puede sorprenderla.

items.title: La regla del matrimonio
items.description: Gemma y Max, antiguos amigos de la infancia, reciben un querido restaurante con una condición: deben estar casados para reclamar la herencia. La carrera para encontrar el "indicado" ha comenzado, ¿lo conseguirán?

items.title: El deseo de boda
items.description: Una romántica empedernida fija la fecha de su boda a pesar de seguir soltera. Mientras busca a su prometido, no sabe que el amor verdadero podría estar justo delante de sus narices.

items.title: Una conexión perdida
items.description: Después de sentir una chispa con una mujer en una plataforma de tren, un fotógrafo publica una conexión perdida, sin respuesta. Cinco años después, el destino los reúne en un avión rumbo a una boda: la de ella.

items.title: El novio perfecto y yo
items.description: Nikki dirige un podcast muy conocido sobre relaciones. Cuando una importante editorial la contacta para un posible contrato editorial, se ve en apuros, ya que el podcast se basa en su novio ideal imaginario. Necesita un sustituto, ¡y rápido!

items.title: Moldeado con amor
items.description: Cuando el padre de Olivia, una maquetista, se prepara para jubilarse de su empresa, ella cree que es la persona ideal para tomar las riendas. Entra en escena Simon, cuya visión de futuro amenaza con perturbar la burbuja de Olivia y su papel como sucesora.

items.title: Proyecto bebé
items.description: Cuando un matrimonio debe viajar de último minuto, les piden a sus mejores amigos que cuiden a su hijo y organicen su primera fiesta de cumpleaños. Pero para esta peculiar pareja, cuidar de un bebé es más complicado de lo que imaginaron...

items.title: Cambio de citas
items.description: Cuando dos hermanas están hartas de su vida amorosa y laboral, acuerdan intercambiar casas durante dos semanas para cambiar de aires. Lo que empieza como unas vacaciones se convierte en nuevas perspectivas sobre sus carreras, su vida y su romance.

items.title: Trampa para novios
items.description: Alice y Lacey, gemelas idénticas, son confundidas por el jefe de una y el socio de la otra en un viaje a Trinidad y Tobago. Mantienen la farsa, pero los romances inesperados les revelan lo que realmente necesitaban en sus vidas.

items.title: El pacto de bodas
items.description: Charlotte y Rory son mejores amigos, y para su 30 cumpleaños, él viaja por el mundo. Un año después, Charlotte visita a una vidente que le dice que está destinada a estar con Rory cuando él regrese a casa. Rory regresa a casa... pero comprometido.

items.title: Taoist Master: Kylin
items.description: A land filled with poisonous magic, a sorcerer hoodwinked the public and the Taoist Master involved in a shocking conspiracy. Is it true that no one can really overcome their desire?

items.title: Wind Blast
items.description: Zhang Ning, a hitman and underground boxer fleeing through the Gobi with his pregnant girlfriend, Sun Jing. Several nemeses are hot on their trail, including a pair of ruthless killers and a cadre of lawmen headed by Detective Leopard.

items.title: Alpha Code
items.description: After losing his family in a series of disappearances, a man seeing strange symbols is being hunted by armed agents. He encounters a woman and her off-grid community with knowledge of a larger conspiracy involving alien-human hybrids.

items.title: Amor en Whitbrooke
items.description: Una ambiciosa directora de proyectos recibe la oportunidad laboral de su vida en Londres. Pero cuando regresa a su ciudad natal para ayudar en el negocio familiar y conoce al hombre perfecto, adquiere una nueva perspectiva sobre la vida y el amor.

items.title: El mapa del amor
items.description: Cuando una marca de belleza cierra su tienda física y apuesta por lo ecológico, Jenny afronta la reacción en redes durante un retiro en Miami, donde su ambición choca con la vibra relajada de Nate.

items.title: Momma Said Come Home For Christmas
items.description: A handsome NFL star agrees to give a tabloid reporter a much needed exclusive story announcing his retirement, only of she accompanies him to meet his zany family for Christmas.
A historical drama based on the founding of the Republic of China when nationalist forces led by Sun Yat-sen overthrew the Qing Dynasty.

items.title: Along Came the Devil II
items.description: After receiving an unsettling voicemail, Jordan returns home, looking for answers, only to find her estranged father and even more questions. The only one who seems to know anything is the small town's Reverend, and no one is safe.

items.title: Possession
items.description: While the Spanish flu epidemic is sweeping across the continent, a priest and his son return home to their family in rural Norway.

items.title: One Hard Hit
items.description: Detective McClure goes undercover to investigate the brutal murder of a young Latina student.

items.title: Williams Sisters
items.description: The Williams Sisters. Never before has a surname rang so synonymously with the sport of tennis.

items.title: Amor en el camino
items.description: Abby, presentadora de renovaciones, debe transformar un rústico restaurante de pueblo. Al trabajar con Tom, su dueño, descubre el placer de la buena comida, un posible hogar y un amor inesperado.

items.title: Historias de amor en Sunflower valley
items.description: Kate Francis, asistente de periódico, regresa a su pueblo natal para un reportaje junto al guapo escritor Drew Hutton. Mientras descubren historias de amor en Sunflower Valley, podrían encontrar la suya propia.

items.title: Priest of Love
items.description: Author DH Lawrence (Ian McKellen) travels with his wife, Frieda (Janet Suzman), from his native England to the US to escape the outrage it has caused.

items.title: Tazza: One-Eyed Jack
items.description: After losing big, a poker player joins a team led by One-Eyed Jack to win big. But a mistake puts them in a life-or-death situation.

items.title: Ashley Jones is Perfectly Normal
items.description: Ace reporter Ashley Jones has a perfectly normal life until she meets a 500,000-year-old woman and strange things start happening to her. Can she make sense of her new upside-down world and is being "different" her new normal?

items.title: Secret Games II: The Escort
items.description: A performance artist has an affair with a call girl and then starts having a crisis over the adultery. Instead of ending the affair he undergoes a mass of self-analysis in the style of Woody Allen's psychoanalytic panic attacks.

items.title: Phase IV (1974)
items.description: Two scientists who install themselves in an ant-proof dome full of computer equipment that interprets the ants' communications. When they spread yellow poison over the area, annihilating millions of ants, the surviving ants strike back.

items.title: Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson: No Pain No Gain
items.description: The Great One, The People’s Champion, The Rock is an icon in both professional wrestling and Hollywood.

items.title: Made In Heaven
items.description: Richard, a hopelessly awkward romantic, gets a second chance at life and love with only limited time after a tragic end.

items.title: Moms at War
items.description: Moms at War follows two feuding neighbors, one scorned as a village girl turned rich, whose rivalry explodes when their top-performing kids compete for the same school prize. Amid chaotic antics, an unexpected bond of friendship and sisterhood emerges.

items.title: Rocketman (ESP)
items.description: Esta película biográfica musical única emprende el espectacular viaje de Elton John a la fama.

items.title: The Longest Night
items.description: In 1980, a team of five commandos affiliated with the PFLP attempt to seize Kibbutz members as hostages. Targeting a small house, they realize too late that it is actually a dormitory for children.

items.title: When She Was Bad
items.description: Stressed by a recent move and being a stay-at-home mom, Teeny takes her bottled-up rage out on her daughter Robbie. Only the help of her friends, family, and counselors can stop her.

items.title: Secret Games III
items.description: A bored housewife feels neglected by her physician husband so she starts spending her afternoons working at an exclusive brothel. Unfortunately, she becomes the obsession of a handsome, but very unpleasant customer.

items.title: Jack Reacher: bajo la mira
items.description: Un investigador de homicidios se adentra en un caso que involucra a un francotirador militar capacitado que disparó a cinco víctimas al azar.

items.title: Wong Fei-Hung: Return Of The King
items.description: Huang Feihong has to get involve in an Martial Arts competition held by a British businessman in order to save Liang Kuan, who knew that behind this Martial Arts competition there is a conspiracy for bigger evil plot.

items.title: The Audrey Hepburn Story
items.description: The biography of one of Hollywood's most famous actresses, Audrey Hepburn. Her story spans from her early childhood living in Nazi-occupied Holland, to making it big in the USA as a movie star.

items.title: Wolf Pack
items.description: While seeking answers about his father’s suspicious death, a tactically trained physician infiltrates a mercenary group and soon uncovers a dangerous international conspiracy that could threaten the lives of millions of civilians.

items.title: Time Runner
items.description: During the unstoppable alien invasion of 2022, one man flees through a wormhole to 1992 in hope of changing the future.

items.title: Valley of the Sun
items.description: Andy Taggert (Johnny Whitworth) set out for Hollywood to become a star. Years later he finds himself as a star actor, but not the kind of star he can tell his parents about. He has become Vick Velour, the biggest adult film star on the planet.

items.title: War Pigs
items.description: Disgraced WWII Captain Jack Wosick leads misfit “War Pigs” on a mission to stop a Nazi superweapon behind enemy lines.

items.title: Grey Gardens
items.description: Meet a mother and daughter, high-society dropouts, reclusive cousins of Jackie O., managing to thrive together amid the decay and disorder of their East Hampton, NY, mansion, making for an eerily ramshackle echo of the American Camelot.

items.title: Cristiano Ronaldo - The One and Only
items.description: Cristiano Ronaldo isn't just a great footballer- he's an icon and role model for millions around the world.

items.title: Bring Him To Me
items.description: Under orders from a ruthless crime boss, a getaway driver must battle his conscience and drive an unsuspecting crew member to an ambush execution. There is a long drive ahead.

items.title: How To Be
items.description: A young man having an existential crisis convinces a Canadian self-help guru to come to London and become his personal life coach.

items.title: In The Name Of The King 3: The Last Mission
items.description: A modern day assassin, wanting out, is hired for one final job: to kidnap the kids of a local businessman. Things go haywire when it turns out he's chosen to return to the Middle Ages and bring back order to a kingdom in chaos.

items.title: Jinn
items.description: A man turns to a mysterious pair and a shackled mental patient for help in combating an ancient family curse.

items.title: Fittest on Earth: A Decade of Fitness
items.description: Forty of the world's top athletes battle through 15 events and five grueling days of competition for the title of Fittest on Earth. Who will rise to the top and prove the fittest?

items.title: Modern Folklore
items.description: Modern Folklore is a horror anthology touching on native American folklore and modern day terrors, which will leave you questioning whether it's myth or reality.

items.title: Your Host
items.description: Four friends get trapped in a sadistic game show, forced to outwit a twisted serial killer while racing against time. Every move brings them closer to freedom or a gruesome fate.

items.title: El cuartel secreto
items.description: Charlie Kincaid descubre un cuartel general secreto debajo de su casa que parece pertenecer a un super héroe. Lo comparte con sus amigos, y ellos empiezan a creer que su padre separado podría tener una doble vida secreta.

items.title: Bumblebee
items.description: On a mission to protect Earth, the battle-scarred and broken Bumblebee is found and repaired by a teenager named Charlie. They must work together to save the planet from the evil Decepticons in this action-packed adventure for the whole family.

items.title: Reset
items.description: Xia Tian is on the verge of a major discovery: time travel. When her son is kidnapped and killed, she desperately sends herself back in time, where she discovers multiple versions of her future self.

items.title: Running Forever
items.description: After her mother's death in the 9/11 attacks, both daughter and father must work together to re-establish their relationship with the help of a beautiful horse, the community, and from above. They learn to stop running, forever.

items.title: RV: Resurrected Victims
items.description: In this chilling supernatural thriller, when a prosecutor's mother returns from the dead intent on killing him, he quickly becomes the lead suspect in her murder.

items.title: The Chumscrubber
items.description: The suicide of a teenage drug dealer sets off an unusual chain of events involving a kidnapping, mistaken identity and a rescue mission in this darkly comic satire starring Jamie Bell, Glenn Close and Allison Janney.

items.title: Chariot
items.description: John Malkovich stars as Dr. Karn, an eccentric specialist who must guide his patient with mysterious recurring dreams through the reincarnation transition before his future is permanently derailed.

items.title: Girl in the Garage: The Laura Cowan Story
items.description: After her husband's arrest, Laura's family finds shelter with a friend, but it becomes a trap of abuse. Despite discovering other victims, Laura remains hopeful, documenting everything until she can alert authorities and escape.

items.title: Mahogany
items.description: Tracy, a young ghetto woman, puts herself through fashion school in the hopes of becoming one of the world's top designers. Her ambition leads her into the lives of people who are determined to get a piece of her long before she can realize her dream.

items.title: Paid In Blood
items.description: When a powerful crime ring starts construction on the largest casino in all of Asia, the group is challenged by a young, vicious gangster (Jang Hyuk) from Seoul who will stop at nothing to gain power.

items.title: Revolver
items.description: When Su-young stepped out of prison after serving two years to cover up corruption by her fellow cops, she expected the life she was promised as payment. However, she soon realizes that the reward was a lie, and she is not going to let it go.

items.title: Saving Christmas
items.description: Tired of family chores, a teen's wish for Christmas to disappear is accidentally granted. He must now save the holiday for his family and the world by discovering the true meaning and spirit of Christmas.

items.title: Rigor Mortis
items.description: Writer-director-producer Juno Mak makes his feature directorial debut with Rigor Mortis, an eerie and chilling, contemporary, action/special effect-laden homage to the classic Chinese vampire movies of the 1980s.

items.title: Hope's Legacy
items.description: When a young woman inherits her family's ranch, she is inspired to enter the world of competitive horse sports. With the support of her fiancée, family, and neighbors, she learns to grab life by the reins to make her dreams come true.

items.title: Dating My Past
items.description: A couples therapy expert thinks back on what she's learned from her relationships with three exes. As she considers her past, she finds that true love means not only being with the right person, but also being your best self.

items.title: Call of the Void
items.description: After the death of her brother, Moray tries to escape to a cabin in the woods when her retreat is derailed by a college band and their suspicious professor. They encounter a mysterious hum that, once heard, there is no return.

items.title: A Father for Brittany
items.description: Keith and Kim Lussier are a childless couple who are given custody of a three-month-old foster child. However, tragedy strikes when Kim dies of cancer in the middle of the adoption process.

items.title: Buena Vista Social Club
items.description: Aging Cuban musicians whose talents had been virtually forgotten following Castro's takeover of Cuba, are brought out of retirement by Ry Cooder, who travelled to Havana in order to bring the musicians together.

items.title: Railroad Tigers
items.description: This action-comedy caper harkens back to Jackie Chan’s classic Hong Kong films, starring Chan as a railroad worker who leads a ragtag band of freedom fighters in an ambush on a heavily armed military train.

items.title: Angel Flight Down
items.description: A medical emergency aircraft crashes in the snowy Rockies. While the pilot, two paramedics, a two-year-old patient, and her father all manage to survive, the situation worsens by the minute.

items.title: Chasing Secrets
items.description: A young white girl abused by her grandfather finds happiness when she's taken under the wing of an older black couple. The girl's mother struggles to overcome the family's problems.

items.title: Inhabitants
items.description: A young woman moves in with her lapsed Catholic boyfriend, only to discover that they're being haunted by the vengeful ghost of his childhood youth minister.

items.title: Disappearance
items.description: While traveling through Nevada on a road trip, a family stumbles upon a ghost town called Weaver. As they investigate the town, they make a series of grisly discoveries.

items.title: The Fix
items.description: When a troubled model takes a new drug at a party, she suffers a shocking transformation. Pursued by authorities and a dangerous gang, she hunts for a "fix" to reverse these effects, only to discover her mutations could save the human race.

items.title: Chloe & Theo
items.description: Based on true events, a young woman looking for something to believe in meets an Inuit Eskimo who was sent by his elders to provide a message of change. With the help of a kind lawyer, they present his story to the United Nations.

items.title: American Justice
items.description: When the reckless actions of an out-of-control LAPD officer get his partner killed in a deadly hostage situation, he gets suspended from the police force and heads to Mexico to face off against corrupt cops.

items.title: Wake Of The Red Witch
items.description: In the 1800's, an East Indies shipping tycoon and the swash-buckling captain of a trading vessel, The Red Witch, battle for gold, priceless pearls, and the love of a beautiful woman.

items.title: The Set Up
items.description: Personal vendettas collide when a down-on-his-luck businessman hires a young female conartist to help with his scheme to marry a wealthy heiress.

items.title: Running Out Of Time
items.description: A grieving widow must protect her family when masked intruders invade her home, searching for a secret file that exposes the dangerous life her late husband left behind.

items.title: Sarah
items.description: Sarah loves school, but traditional Maasai culture and a long drought cause disruption. A generous dowry offer means her family must decide whether to conduct traditional circumcision and accept, or miss a rare chance to rebuild their wealth.

items.title: The Silent Intruder
items.description: Zaki, the master of desire, in ‘Silent Intruder.’ Uncover the tumultuous journey of a sex therapist who has an insatiable hunger for pleasure.

items.title: Kobe Bryant - A Tribute
items.description: Kobe's dedication to his career, family and charity work led to him being adored the world over.

items.title: Lebron James - King of The Court
items.description: The NBA star showed promise in high school, before going on to make a name for himself as an all time great.

items.title: Seven Samurai
items.description: Farmers from a village exploited by bandits hire a veteran samurai for protection, and he gathers six other samurai to join him.

items.title: Children of the Corn
items.description: A young couple is trapped in a remote town where a dangerous religious cult of children believes that everyone over age 18 must be killed.

items.title: Buffalo Soldiers
items.description: A criminal subculture operates among U.S. soldiers stationed in West Germany just before the fall of the Berlin wall in this comedy starring Joaquin Phoenix, Anna Paquin, and Ed Harris.

items.title: Blind Horizon
items.description: At the hospital, Frank comes out of a coma with amnesia. The sheriff wants to know who shot him. Later Frank remembers that something's happening to the president. Who is Frank?

items.title: Cyborg Cop 2
items.description: A police officer comes up against the psychopathic brother of a man he killed. When the brother is captured in a shoot-out, a government agency turns him into a cyborg who soon escapes and concocts a plan to destroy the human race.

items.title: River
items.description: In the south of Laos, an American doctor (Rossif Sutherland) becomes a fugitive after he intervenes in the sexual assault of a young woman. When the assailant's body is pulled from the Mekong River, things quickly spiral out of control.

items.title: The Big Bus
items.description: A massive bus is the setting for this spoof of disaster movies starring Joseph Bologna, Stockard Channing and John Beck.

items.title: The Legend of Lake Hollow
items.description: A group of friends goes to a remote cabin where cameras flash in the night as a sinister creature stalks them, and strange people appear and then vanish without a trace. The truth reveals itself and is more terrifying than they imagine.

items.title: The Magdalene Sisters
items.description: Three young Irish women struggle to maintain their spirits while they endure dehumanizing abuse as inmates of the Magdalene Sisters Asylum.

items.title: Cyborg Cop 3
items.description: A cop tries to stop a scientist's experiments to turn students into cyborg-mercenaries.

items.title: Derailed
items.description: On an out of control train holding hostages and high-tech bio-weapons agent Kristoff (Van Damme) becomes a one man army to derail the terrorists and save the lives of everyone on board!

items.title: Freefall (1994)
items.description: A mystery man (Eric Roberts) she met in Africa brings danger to a wildlife photographer (Pamela Gidley) and her fiance (Jeff Fahey).

items.title: The Magician's Raincoat
items.description: Three siblings discover an old raincoat that transforms them into its previous owner: a cursed magician. With a scorned witch hot on their trail, they must solve the mystery of the raincoat and break its curse before it's too late.

items.title: Gemini Man
items.description: Will Smith stars in the nonstop action thrill-ride from Academy Award®-winning director Ang Lee. Retired hitman (Smith) is forced on the run and finds himself hunted by his ultimate adversary - a younger clone of himself.

items.title: I Love You, Man
items.description: A friendless groom-to-be meets the ultimate dude and the two begin a "bro-mance" which takes male-bonding to hilarious new heights that will keep you laughing to the end.

items.title: Journey To The End Of The Night
items.description: The tale of a son and his father separately plotting to escape the desolation of their lives in the lurid underworld of Brazil's sex industry.

items.title: Nobody's Fool (2018)
items.description: Tiffany Haddish is hysterical in Tyler Perry's most outrageous comedy yet. Wild child Tanya looks to her buttoned-up sister Danica to get back on her feet. As these opposites collide, Tanya learns that Danica's perfect life may not be what it seems.

items.title: El principito
items.description: Un piloto se estrella en el desierto del Sahara y encuentra a un niño que dice ser un príncipe caído a la Tierra desde su hogar en el asteroide.

items.title: Treasure
items.description: As the Iron Curtain lifts in 1991, a second- generation Holocaust survivor and her father travel to his homeland in Poland.

items.title: Golden Job
items.description: Former mercenaries plan to steal medicine for refugees but find gold instead. Betrayed by one of their own, they wage all-out war for justice.

items.title: Spirit of Friendship
items.description: A young boy, grieving the recent loss of his mother, attempts to contact her with his friends. A mysterious man then appears, seemingly only visible to him, and teaches the boy how to navigate loss, love, and eternal connections.

items.title: Midnight Diner
items.description: A cook opens a restaurant that only serves from midnight till dawn. One day, he discovers an obituary urn. Follow the stories of his regulars tangled around this urn.

items.title: A Cool Fish 2
items.description: The scumbag Chen Sanjin and the ruthless woman Xue Fangmei, who broke up on the streets of Bangkok, unexpectedly became involved in a kidnapping activity by a criminal group.

items.title: Dorothea
items.description: Serial killer granny Dorothea Puente hides death behind a smile, turning her boarding house into a graveyard. True crime meets pure horror.

items.title: A Legend
items.description: In this action-packed sequel to The Myth, Jackie Chan stars as an archaeologist who uncovers ancient relics linked to his dreams. His daring glacier expedition leads to thrilling stunts, humor, and secrets that could change history forever.

items.title: Lenny the Wonder Dog
items.description: A dog with special powers, a local police officer, and a young boy go on a quest to save the world by undoing the insidious plot of an evil scientist to turn all kids into mindless robots

items.title: Lost Horizon
items.description: A hardened soldier for hire risks everything to save lives, expose betrayal, and reclaim his humanity in a land torn by war.

items.title: Romance en el viñedo
items.description: Cuando Samantha, una escritora de una revista de Seattle, es enviada a casa para escribir un artículo sobre Hawthorne Vineyards como lugar para bodas, descubre que el ex que le rompió el corazón administra el viñedo y está a punto de casarse allí.

items.title: The Island of Lost Girls
items.description: When a riptide sweeps three young sisters away, they wash up on an island of sea caves, sea lions, and giant elephant seals and head to a distant lighthouse, learning the importance of never giving up and sticking together along the way.

items.title: Robotropolis
items.description: On-site for an exclusive interview with the tycoon responsible for a city full of service robots, a reporter and her team are caught in the middle of the carnage when the machines stage a violent revolt.

items.title: Baby Assassins 3
items.description: They laugh, they cry, they kill; but Chisato and Mahiro have never faced an enemy this dangerous. A brutal freelance killer has got them in his sights and he’s not giving up until someone dies. The latest chapter in the Baby Assassins saga.

items.title: The Furry Fortune
items.description: When a family's dog starts shedding cash, their nosy neighbor dognaps the money-making canine. Now the kids must work together to save their pet and each other from all sorts of trouble, learning that family is the greatest fortune of all.

items.title: Bull
items.description: In this relentless revenge thriller, ex-mob enforcer Bull, portrayed by Neil Maskell, hunts down those who betrayed him, risking all to reunite with his son. A blood-soaked journey culminates in a savage showdown with his wife's mob boss father.

items.title: The Evil Fairy Queen
items.description: Lured to a remote farmhouse, a family decides to move in, not knowing it's in the middle of a dying fairy kingdom and the only way they can live is by sacrificing their young daughter, forcing her mother to fight for her survival.

items.title: The Miracle Of Morgan's Creek
items.description: After marrying a soldier during a wild night on the town, a small-town girl suffers amnesia and can't remember anything about the man she married.

items.title: The Adventures of Snow White and Rose Red
items.description: Snow White and Rose Red begin to cross paths with characters from their fairy tale book! On their adventures, learn the importance of sisterhood, friendship, and kindness. Life can be far from ordinary if you just believe in a little magic.

items.title: Cold Wallet
items.description: An intense thriller set in the world of cryptocurrency, Cold Wallet stars Raúl Castillo (Smile 2) whose life is ruined by crypto grifter Josh Brener (Silicon Valley). When he tracks down the man who ruined him, all hell breaks loose.

items.title: Cut Throat City
items.description: After Hurricane Katrina, four boyhood friends return to NOLA’s Lower Ninth. As FEMA fails to provide aid, they reluctantly turn to a local gangster for help. When the job tanks, they must outrun, and outsmart, a system rife with corruption.

items.title: Escape
items.description: After completing his required decade of military service and being honored as a hero, a North Korean sergeant makes a sudden shocking attempt to defect to the South, risking life and limb for the chance to finally determine his own destiny.

items.title: Get Fast
items.description: After a heist goes wrong, a thief and a troubled orphan must rescue his kidnapped partner from a ruthless drug lord and her charming hitman. With guns, cars, and explosions, their escape is a high-stakes race against time.

items.title: Ghost Killer
items.description: When hitman Kudo suffers an unjust death, his wrathful spirit possesses the body of college student Fumika and the two of them embark on a mission of revenge. From the action director of Baby Assassins, One-Percent Warrior, and Bad City.

items.title: Sundown
items.description: Alice and Neil Bennett are the core of a wealthy British family on vacation in Acapulco until a distant emergency cuts their trip short. When one relative disrupts the family's tight-knit order, surprising tensions rise to the fore.

items.title: Harbin
items.description: Layered with explosive visceral action and complex political intrigue, Woo Min-ho’s Harbin is a gripping tale of a nation on the edge of conquest. As Japan marches toward Korean annexation, heroic freedom fighters formulate a deadly plan.

items.title: Hidden Face
items.description: When cellist Su-yeon vanishes, her fiancé Sung-jin finds solace in Mi-ju, her replacement. As their forbidden passion intensifies, they commit an unforgivable act—unaware that Su-yeon is trapped within the walls, watching every betrayal.

items.title: Under the Influencer
items.description: After a decade as a top YouTube star, a 25-year-old influencer finds herself "aging out." Forced to separate her online persona from her authentic self, she will discover sometimes you have to disconnect to find true connection.

items.title: Murder Mansion (aka Killer Dream Home)
items.description: When happy couple Jules and Josh buy their dream house on a magnificent estate, they recruit beautiful Morgan to help them with the interior design, unaware Morgan has history with the house and will stop at nothing to make it her own.

items.title: Net Games
items.description: A married man gets drawn into a voyeuristic Internet affair.

items.title: Out California Way
items.description: Unemployed Monte Hale meets Gloria and Danny, who want Danny's horse Pardner in films. Monte discovers Pardner can dance while he sings, landing roles. When rival Rod Mason sabotages them, Monte and his friends fight back to keep their chance in showbiz.

items.title: Personal Effects
items.description: Unemployed Monte Hale meets Gloria and Danny, who want Danny's horse Pardner in films. Monte discovers Pardner can dance while he sings, landing roles. When rival Rod Mason sabotages them, Monte and his friends fight back to keep their chance in showbiz.

items.title: Ruby's Choice
items.description: An aging woman with dementia moves in with her daughter's family when she can no longer live by herself. Her teen granddaughter must care for her, and her resentment turns to love as she gains a new understanding of her grandmother's past.

items.title: The Keepers of the 5 Kingdoms
items.description: Patsy Lee and her friends are transported to a mystical world of vampires, goblin witches, and an evil sorceress who wants to destroy the 5 Kingdoms. Now their only chance of returning home is to stop her before it's too late.

items.title: Pretty Crazy
items.description: A handsome, eligible bachelor is ready to find the one to settle down with in an overwhelming dating climate - soon he meets the perfect girl. Will his past come back to ruin their future? Dating as a millennial can be... Pretty Crazy!

items.title: Falls Around Her
items.description: Mary Birchbark (Tantoo Cardinal), a legendary singer, returns to the vast wilderness of her reservation to reconnect with the land and her community.

items.title: Root of the Problem
items.description: When a suburban family inherits a real-life money tree, they have a one-way ticket to easy street. As they lose sight of the things that matter most, the family will be tested to discover that it is better to give than receive.

items.title: Black Moon Rising
items.description: A thief named Quint is hired by the Justice Department to steal incriminating tapes from a corrupt corporation. The tapes vanish when Quint hides them in the back of a hydrodynamic powered racing car that is stolen by a hot car ring.

items.title: Day of Reckoning
items.description: For 24 hours demons rise to purge the population. One family battles to save themselves and seal the breach. Who will survive this "Day Of Reckoning"?

items.title: Space/Time
items.description: A disgraced team of scientists turn to crime to rebuild a space-bending engine that could save humanity’s future or destroy it.

items.title: Rovin' Tumbleweeds
items.description: Rancher Autry takes a job singing on the radio to aid farmers whose lands were destroyed by floods. Blaming crooked politicians, he goes to Washington and tries to put through a flood control bill.

items.title: The Bouncer
items.description: A bouncer at an upscale nightclub and a woman he saves from being abused go on the run as a vengeful mob boss pursues them. With nobody to trust and merciless killers closing in, they'll have to use their fists, guns, and wits to survive.

items.title: C.H.U.D.
items.description: A bizarre series of sudden disappearances on the streets of New York City seems to point toward something unsavory living in the sewers.

items.title: Stowaway
items.description: A tenacious party girl (Ruby Rose) fights to survive after three thieves commandeer her luxury yacht. Unable to escape and trapped on the yacht at high seas, she turns the tables on the intruders and takes matters into her own hands.

items.title: The Hyperions
items.description: In this inventive superhero thriller, Professor Mandulbaum grants three kids superpowers, creating the legendary Hyperions. Years later, a high-stakes heist threatens their legacy, forcing the fractured heroes to reunite and battle to save the world.

items.title: The Harvesting
items.description: A young family travels from the city to spend the summer in Amish Country where a malevolent presence threatens to tear them apart by exposing their dark secrets.

items.title: Ride Above
items.description: A teenager is raised with horses at her parent's racehorse stable who has a deep exceptional bond with young horse. An accident threatens to bring racing careers to an end but they battle together to achieve victory.

items.title: Today You Die
items.description: A former thief who is trying to go straight seeks vengeance on those who framed him.

items.title: Wes Craven Presents: They
items.description: Lifelong friends begin experiencing the "night terrors" that plagued them as children, convincing them that a supernatural force is pursuing them.

items.title: Until Death
items.description: Stowe is a dirty cop who is hooked on heroin, and everyone dislikes him. Because of an accident he is put into a coma, and comes out of it a better person. He wakes up wanting to put things right.

items.title: Mr. Malcolm's List
items.description: The Honorable Mr. Malcolm is searching for a wife, but not just any wife. As the target of matchmakers and fortune hunters, he's determined to find his perfect match, who meets the qualifications on his well-crafted list of requirements.

items.title: Our (almost completely true) Love Story
items.description: When a beautiful, tall, aging Hollywood star meets a short, funny Jewish man, he is immediately smitten, but she is not so much. As he pursues her, his charm and humor win her over in their heartwarming (almost completely true) love story.

items.title: Shooting High
items.description: A Hollywood company arrives to film the story of Gene Autryís grandfather, the town hero, and hires Gene to work on the film. When the star suddenly abandons the film, Gene steps in to save the day.

items.title: A Smile Like Yours
items.description: A romantic comedy about a young San Francisco couple trying to have a child -- he's not thrilled; she's obsessed.

items.title: Sierra Sue
items.description: State Inspector Gene Autry helps ranchers rid their ranches of poisonous devil weed threatening cattle. The ranchers want to burn the area, but Gene thinks chemical spraying via airplane is in order.

items.title: South of the Border
items.description: On the eve of World War II, Federal agents Gene Autry and Frog Millhouse journey to Mexico to help foil the plans of foreign spies attempting to gain control of Mexican oil fields.

items.title: The Big Show
items.description: Movie stunt-double Gene Autry must take the place of temperamental Western star Tom Ford at the Texas Centennial. Gene's singing soon leads to complications with girlfriends, studio executives, and gangsters.

items.title: A Common Man
items.description: A terrorist plants several bombs throughout the city of Colombo, Sri Lanka and threatens to detonate them unless prisoners are released.

items.title: My Favorite Girlfriend
items.description: Conrad’s meticulously organized lifestyle is upended when he meets Molly, an enigmatic woman who seems to share headspace with multiple other women with distinct identities—each with traits that Conrad finds loveable.

items.title: Becky
items.description: When a newly married couple moves into their home in the suburbs, they are welcomed by their neighbors, but one of them takes a dangerous interest in the husband and inserts herself into every aspect of the couple's life, wreaking havoc.

items.title: Planetarium
items.description: In the 1930s, two sisters are able to connect with ghosts. A producer hires them to shoot a film that ends up testing human limits and social values.

items.title: Delicious
items.description: Recently released from prison, French chef Jacques pursues an obsession to leave his past behind and work for the great British chef Victor Ellwood. He knows Victor had an affair with his mother and may even be his dad.

items.title: Tell Me I Love You
items.description: Three best friends and ex-lovers hatch a plan to get married and inherit money to make a hit album. But new lovers, old flames, and their parents have other ideas for them as they discover that family is actually who you choose.

items.title: The Mummy Murders
items.description: A lot of people have recently gone missing in Alexis' hometown of San Antonio, Texas. Alexis is a top reporter for the local news station, and there have been rumors that a serial killer is responsible for those missing.

items.title: Daydream Believers: The Monkees' Story
items.description: The true story of four hopeful young singers who are brought together by NBC as a singing group, a group manufactured to be the American alternative to the Beatles.

items.title: Cortez
items.description: When a struggling musician tracks down his ex in a small town in New Mexico, the consequences of his past decisions force him to evaluate his choices.

items.title: Donovan's Echo
items.description: After he discovers events from his past are repeating, Donovan is convinced his young neighbor and her mother will die on the same day his wife and daughter were killed 30 years ago.

items.title: Cbeebies Christmas Show 2019: Hansel & Gretel
items.description: Inspired by the classic Brothers Grimm tale, this exciting adventure follows brother and sister Hansel and Gretel as they journey deep into the magical woods to rescue their lost parents.

items.title: El concurso reposteria real
items.description: Allie y Marilyn, rivales en Meadow Ridge por sus pastelerías, compiten cuando un príncipe busca la repostera perfecta. Allie conecta con él, pero Marilyn hará todo lo posible para impedir que consiga el trabajo… y el corazón del príncipe.

items.title: There's a Zombie Outside
items.description: A man whose identity is intertwined with cult cinema finds that he is having problems distinguishing fact from fiction and believes that the monster he is seeing from his movie is real.

items.title: She Freak
items.description: A waitress leaves the greasy-diner business for the carnival and quickly discovers that she despises freaks and human oddities.

items.title: Stand On It
items.description: John Schneider's Stand On It: A tribute to throwback southern race movies, where The Duke, played by Schneider, bets half a million dollars in a race against the clock to bring microbrew from Austin to Holden in less than 24 hours.

items.title: The AGFA Horror Trailer Show
items.description: A senses-shattering compilation of the most spine-ripping, slime-slinging, soul-shredding horror trailers that you've never seen.

items.title: Raiders! The Story of the Greatest Fan Film Ever Made
items.description: Some say Bigfoot is just a hoax, but when a group of hikers goes deep into the woods after being warned by a guide that has encountered a Sasquatch, they begin to realize that they are not alone.

items.title: Rockfield: The Studio on the Farm
items.description: Documentary celebrating the legendary Rockfield Studios with appearances from those who have recorded within its hallowed walls.

items.title: Limones y limas
items.description: Beck Waterford viaja a Serenity para un concurso de fotografía y se aloja en la Granja de Limoneros, donde conoce a Joshua Sweeting. Entre acuerdos y descubrimientos, surgen chispas, pero un secreto podría poner a prueba su romance.

items.title: Dashing Home for Christmas
items.description: Trying to get home for Christmas, Emily encounters problem after problem until she meets fellow traveler Simon, who helps her. They eventually team up to get to Seattle.

items.title: La corriente del amor
items.description: La autora Charlotte, una chica de la ciudad de Chicago, se dirige al desierto de Minnesota para escribir su nuevo libro. Su guía, Rob, duda de las habilidades de Charlotte. Sin embargo, se dan cuenta de que tienen más en común y se enamoran.

items.title: La subscripción del amor
items.description: Lillian es una empresaria que apoya a las pequeñas empresas. Se deja seducir por Grant, el fundador de la nueva empresa con la que trabaja.

items.title: For Love or Money
