items.description: A single girl in NYC is seeking the perfect tenant for her townhouse when she meets a handsome real estate mogul. As sparks fly, she has to determine if he's in love with her, or just needs her home as part of his latest investment project.

items.title: For Prophet
items.description: A struggling entrepreneur is visited by an archangel, who explains that he has been chosen as a prophet to save his hometown from corruption, pushing his marriage, business, and sanity to the limit in this spiritual quest to find faith.

items.title: Amor, moda y acción
items.description: Lisa Holt vuelve a su ciudad natal para inspirarse en su nueva línea de moda y ayudar a su amiga con el bebé. Al conocer a Colin, un escritor encargado de su biografía, el amor surge cuando menos lo espera.

items.title: Forbidden Tango
items.description: When a Tango dancer and a Rabbi plan to enter a dance competition, there's one big problem—due to his Orthodox beliefs, he's not allowed to touch her! Family, tolerance, and community are tested one dazzling dance step at a time.

items.title: Desafortunada en el amor
items.description: Winnie, bloguera de citas anónima, se vuelve viral por una cita desastrosa con Holden, un soltero empedernido. Para su nueva columna, debe seguir saliendo con él, pero los sentimientos y un hijo adolescente complican todo.

items.title: The Complex: Lockdown
items.description: After a bio-weapon attack on London, two scientists on lockdown fight over whether to save the suspected terrorist's life. Soon, assassins have infiltrated the building, and our scientists find themselves with time and options running out.

items.title: If I Could Ride Again
items.description: A former equestrian champion finds that her best friend is taking her place in an upcoming competition. As the tension mounts, their trainer encourages them to lean on each other, and their love of horses, to find strength and hope.

items.title: Jurassic Pet 3
items.description: When a shy girl and her outgoing brother discover a mysterious egg, they are shocked when a dinosaur hatches from it! But when it gets loose, they must find it and return it to its home before an ambitious crew can lock it away forever.

items.title: Lethal Virus
items.description: In a post-apocalyptic world, a new super virus infects the remaining population and threatens to destroy what's left of humankind. A special forces team transports a young scientist, their last hope, to her lab against all odds of survival.

items.title: Corazones con suerte
items.description: Una fabricante de maquillaje encuentra su gran oportunidad al asociarse con un ejecutivo de inversiones para mejorar la comercialización de sus productos. ¿Podrá conservar la magia que hizo de su maquillaje un éxito?

items.title: MEAD
items.description: A sentient AI starship (MEAD) and his Captain evade bounty hunters and military forces utilizing their ability to create and project illusions so real that they fool their pursuers as they are chased across the solar system.

items.title: Casi un ángel
items.description: En una experiencia cercana a la muerte, un ladronzuelo tiene un encuentro con Dios y recobra la conciencia creyendo que es un ángel de prueba, que debe realizar buenas obras para conservar su lugar en el cielo.

items.title: The Wandering Earth II
items.description: Humans built huge engines on the surface of the earth to find a new home. But the road to the universe is perilous. In order to save earth, young people once again have to step forward to start a race against time for life and death.

items.title: The Eden Theory
items.description: After his best friend disappears, Tom Edwards is investigated by a relentless detective, but then weird and strange events take place…

items.title: Un amor en Manhattan
items.description: Cuando Celeste pierde su trabajo de maestra, acepta ser niñera de Richard Trapp, un magnate de Nueva York. Entre niños rebeldes y la novia de Richard, Celeste podría ganarse su corazón… y quizás encontrar el amor.

items.title: IP Man: The Final Fight
items.description: In postwar Hong Kong, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man is drawn into the Triad underworld, forced to fight one last time to defend life and honor.

items.title: Planeando para siempre
items.description: Emma, organizadora de eventos sin tiempo para el amor, debe planear la boda de su hermana con la ayuda de Liam, su desastroso ex cita a ciegas. Mientras crean el día perfecto, podrían descubrir un romance inesperado entre ellos.

items.title: Amor y rodeo
items.description: Cuando la actriz Isabella consigue un papel como ranchera, el estudio la envía a vivir a un rancho para aprender los trucos del oficio, pero pronto descubre que el ranchero, Hunter, está demasiado ocupado intentando salvar su rancho de la ruina.

items.title: Desacuerdo romántico
items.description: La artista de portadas de libros Lea se hace pasar por la elusiva autora de una exitosa novela romántica escrita en secreto por el esnob novelista literario Michael. Ella no espera encontrar el amor por sí misma.

items.title: Edge of Madness
items.description: A woman staggers into a fort in the wilderness confessing to have murdered her husband. But as the murder is investigated, the truth comes out and she is innocent. Why would she lie and say she is guilty?

items.title: Reescribiendo el amor
items.description: Una editora de novelas románticas tiene la tarea de ayudar a un escritor a incorporar el romance en su próximo libro. Él se ofrece como voluntario para ser su cita falsa para la boda en la playa de su hermana a cambio de sus habilidades de edición.

items.title: Caminando hacia el amor
items.description: Cuando su museo de arte enfrenta problemas económicos, una curadora convencional trabaja con un artista de vanguardia para desarrollar una exhibición poco convencional. ¿Podrán encontrar una manera de trabajar juntos y encontrar el amor?

items.title: The Yank
items.description: A clueless Irish-American travels to Ireland for his best friend's wedding and to find the girl of his dreams. But when he falls for a Greek beauty instead of an Irish-born lass, he must choose between his family's expectations and true love.

items.title: Dulce como pastel
items.description: Tamara, enfrentando la caída de su empresa y su relación, visita el manzanar familiar y se enamora de su amigo de infancia, Will Lewis. Juntos luchan por el huerto y su amor, mientras ella persigue su idea del millón de dólares.

items.title: Un equipo para la novia
items.description: Hannah McKenzie, costurera dedicada, dirige un negocio de vestidos de novia mientras trabaja en Millington. Su marca se ve amenazada por Will Millington, pero al colaborar, podrían resolver sus diferencias… y enamorarse.

items.title: Everything is Both
items.description: This thriller follows a girl who runs for her life and depends on a mysterious stranger to escape danger and pull off the biggest score of her life.

items.title: The Ambassador
items.description: This darkly comic, genre-bending piece of gonzo journalism rips the lid off the scheme of political corruption. Armed with a phalanx of hidden cameras, Brügger transforms himself into an outlandish caricature of a European consul.

items.title: Enséñame a querer
items.description: Clark Gable interpreta a Jim Gannon, un periodista experimentado que detesta las escuelas de periodismo, hasta que ve quién enseña las clases.

items.title: Gregoire
items.description: Four young adults in Fort McMurray, AB, struggle to deal with the consequences of their actions and how it affects their friends and families.

items.title: Westside vs. The World
items.description: Fights. Injuries. Death. Westside Barbell took powerlifting to the absolute limit and changed the world of strength forever. But are world records worth the price of the pain? How far would you go for a number?

items.title: Tinker
items.description: Grady, a reclusive savant farmer, discovers his father's hidden journal, which holds the secrets to a machine that could change the world. However, his biggest challenge is becoming guardian to his gifted 6 year old curious nephew, Kai.

items.title: Wild Eyed and Wicked
items.description: Lily Pierce is sick of being haunted. She decides to reconnect with her estranged father, a disgraced history professor, and learn how to draw upon a time of steel and blade when armor-clad knights rode out and dueled their monsters to the death.

items.title: A Desert
items.description: A photographer on a road trip across the American Southwest is thrust into the nihilistic underbelly of America and drags his wife and a shady private detective down into this nightmare world with him.

items.title: In My Father's Den
items.description: A disillusioned war journalist's return home is blighted when he becomes implicated in the mysterious disappearance of a teenage girl he has befriended.

items.title: The Roundup: Punishment
items.description: Detective Ma Seok-do joins the Cyber Investigation Team to take down Baek Chang-ki, a former mercenary and the head of an online gambling organization.

items.title: Visions
items.description: An experienced airline pilot, Estelle leads a perfect life between long-haul flights with her loving and protective husband Guillaume.

items.title: An Invisible Sign
items.description: Mona Gray is a 20-year-old loner who turned to math for salvation as a child after her father became ill. As an adult she now teaches the subject and helps her students through their own crises.

items.title: Angels Fall
items.description: A chef moves to a small town in Wyoming after her Boston restaurant is shut down because of a fatal shooting.

items.title: Battle For Haditha
items.description: An investigation of the massacre of 24 men, women and children in Haditha, Iraq allegedly shot by 4 U.S. Marines in retaliation for the death of a U.S. Marine killed by a roadside bomb.

items.title: Birds Of America
items.description: A regular guy struggles with a repressive home and professional life, as well as making amends for the trouble his free-spirited brother and sister cause around town.

items.title: Blue Smoke
items.description: Detective Reena Hale is revisited by the stalker who traumatized her years ago by offing any man she fell in love with.

items.title: Candy Stripers
items.description: After a car crash, Tammy and injured basketball players are hospitalized. When a nurse kisses dying Tammy, an alien infection spreads through the hospital staff and patients. The facility is quarantined as infected people seek sugar.

items.title: Carnal Innocence
items.description: World famous violinist Caroline Waverly returns to her home town of Innocence to retreat from the world. But a serial slayer is stalking the streets of Innocence, and Caroline may be a prime target for murder.

items.title: Carolina Moon
items.description: A woman who has psychic visions returns to her hometown to exorcise her demons, and finds both danger and love.

items.title: Chuck Norris: Private Lesson
items.description: Six-time World Karate Champion Chuck Norris takes you through the ultimate in martial arts instruction, workout and demonstration.

items.title: Dead Money
items.description: When a home poker game is robbed by armed men, pro poker Andy and his girlfriend Chloe get caught in the middle. Now, Andy must play the best poker of is life at the biggest game in town to save his and Chloe's lives.

items.title: Eichmann
items.description: Based upon the final confession of Adolf Eichmann, made before his execution in Israel as he accounts to Captain Avner Less, a young Israeli police officer, of his past as the architect of Hitler's plan for the Final Solution.

items.title: Finally Dawn
items.description: A young Roman woman during the 1950s is on the verge of becoming engaged to a man. She goes to Cinecittà to do an audition as an extra and is thrust into this almost infinite night during which she discovers herself.

items.title: Forgive Us All
items.description: In a post-apocalyptic world, a virus has transformed humans into violently deranged cannibals. A bereaved mother has lost everything and takes refuge in an isolated mountain cabin, until a desperate wounded stranger arrives with a story of hope.

items.title: Gladiator Underground
items.description: Two brothers compete in the world’s deadliest underground fighting tournament where they must decide whether to play by the rules or to cast their honor aside and team up to bring down the dark syndicate running the tournament.

items.title: Between The Darkness (aka Come Said The Night)
items.description: Thirteen-year-old Sprout Grady grows convinced that a monster is haunting the nearby woods. Embarking on a mission to vanquish it, she uncovers horrifying secrets that rock the core of everything she thought she knew.

items.title: Colorado Sunset
items.description: When Smiley purchases a dairy farm instead of a cattle ranch for Gene Autry, they wind up in a milk war. A crooked protective association sends men to raid any farmer who fails to pay dues to join it.

items.title: A Inglaterra, con amor
items.description: Ali lo tiene todo. Hasta que una misteriosa búsqueda la lleva de Los Ángeles a Inglaterra en una búsqueda del tesoro a través de la historia, donde se encuentra reabriendo a viejos y nuevos amores.

items.title: Comin' Round the Mountain
items.description: Gene Autry is a Pony Express rider in the old west who befriends the lovely Dolores Moreno, whose ranch is about to be sold due to non-payment of taxes.

items.title: Romance de sabor
items.description: La crítica anónima Alison se vuelve viral por destrozar un restaurante. Su editor insiste en que trabaja de incógnito como cocinera del chef al que difamó, pero a medida que se unen, corre el riesgo de que se revele su identidad

items.title: Wildlife
items.description: A 14-year-old boy watches his parents' marriage fall apart.

items.title: Cowboy Serenade
items.description: When a young man is sent to sell cattle to a packing plant, he is soon swindled by card sharks. Gene Autry is sent to investigate and recover the cattle, find the young man, and clear his name.

items.title: Zoe va a tener un bebé
items.description: Zoe quiere un bebé. Soltera y cansada del ambiente de citas neoyorquino, decide vivir sola. Con la ayuda de un donante anónimo, Zoe queda embarazada. Pero las cosas se complican cuando dos solteros entraban en su vida...

items.title: Blood Honey
items.description: Tortured by the memory of a childhood trauma, a woman returns after a decade to her family's fly-in hunting lodge to assist her siblings with their dying father, only to find herself stuck in a life threatening nightmare.

items.title: No se puede enseñar el amor
items.description: Cuando la publicista Elizabeth se encuentra inesperadamente a cargo del cuidado de su sobrina durante un par de semanas, lucha por encontrar un equilibrio entre todo y encuentra un apoyo inesperado en la maestra de jardín de infantes de su sobrina, Jamie.

items.title: Happy Gilmore
items.description: A bad-tempered hockey player takes his talent to the golf course to win a tournament prize and save his grandmother's house from the IRS.

items.title: Forty Winks
items.description: A struggling hypnotist in New York city is blackmailed into being the worlds first hypnotist hitman after a mysterious woman finds out his degree is fake.

items.title: Down Mexico Way
items.description: Gene Autry and Smiley chase crooked film producers to Mexico where they must prevent the evil producers from swindling a Mexican rancher and his daughter, and expose them for the schemers they are.

items.title: Forbidden Fruits
items.description: A college student faces the wrath of a violent cousin who disapproves of his interracial romance.

items.title: La canción para mi corazón
items.description: Bonnie Highstreet, dueña de una tienda de té, evita la música tras crecer con su padre cantautor. Pero al ayudar a Ryder Jamison con su nuevo álbum, reaviva viejos sueños y descubre el amor.

items.title: Colin Hay: Waiting For My Real Life
items.description: From his early days in Scotland to worldwide success and addiction, witness the Men at Work frontman’s slow climb back up the ladder to transcendence.

items.title: Courtney Gets Possessed
items.description: A bumbling wedding party must battle the forces of hell when a bride becomes possessed by the Devil the night before her wedding.

items.title: The Man Who Changed His Mind
items.description: Dr. Laurience, a brilliant but unstable scientist experimenting with transferring minds, becomes vengeful when his magnate patron withdraws his support.

items.title: Everybody Loves Sunshine
items.description: Two cousins lead a Manchester street gang against rising Triad power. While one seeks to leave crime behind for love, the other's obsession threatens their lifelong bond. An aging gangster tries to prevent all-out war.

items.title: Cosplay Universe
items.description: Cosplay Universe follows the journey of the world's top cosplayers while addressing the psychology behind this transformative art form.

items.title: The Price of Desire
items.description: This compelling portrayal focuses on the love triangle between brilliant 20th century designer Eileen Gray and her lovers in her long-running feud with the Father of Modernism, Le Corbusier.

items.title: It All Begins with a Song
items.description: Visit the world of Nashville songwriters, whose melodies and lyrics reach millions of fans.

items.title: Legend Of The Muse (aka Muse)
items.description: A painter's life is changed forever when a mythical and deadly spirit becomes his muse and lover.

items.title: Let Her Out
items.description: After a traumatic accident, a bike courier begins to experience blackouts and hallucinations. She discovers that she's being dangerously influenced by her unborn twin.

items.title: The Sagebrush Troubadour
items.description: Rangers Gene Autry and Frog Millhouse travel undercover as Western troubadours to find the killer of old, half-blind Frank Martin. Their only clues are a guitar string and a swayback horse that is the key to finding the dead man's lost goldmine.

items.title: In the Crosshairs: The Killing That Changed America
items.description: Black Panthers leader Huey Newton is charged in the Capital Crime of murdering a white cop. Will systemic racism in the judicial system prevent him from getting a fair trial? The shocking verdict becomes a Landmark Case.

items.title: Una historia de amor
items.description: Ruby, aspirante a escritora romántica, asiste a un retiro en Tahoe con su ídolo Marcus Harlow, pero al conocer a Woody, el dueño del hotel, empieza a cuestionar si ha estado persiguiendo las historias equivocadas.

items.title: The Seventh Seal
items.description: A knight returning to Sweden after the Crusades seeks answers about life, death, and the existence of God as he plays chess against the Grim Reaper during the Black Plague.

items.title: Amor con estilo
items.description: Tras mudarse de Iowa a Chicago, una estilista ambiciosa contrata a un fotógrafo para impulsar su negocio y descubre que, en amor y éxito, lo clave es seguir el estilo del corazón.

items.title: The Scottish Play
items.description: An actress accepts the role of Lady Macbeth at a small New England theater, where she finds herself haunted by William Shakespeare's ghost.

items.title: American Warrior
items.description: An amateur MMA fighter is thrust into the spotlight after stopping a violent robbery. Hailed as a hero, he enters a high-stakes MMA tournament, battling brutal opponents—and his troubled past—for one last shot at redemption.

items.title: Freaky Deaky
items.description: Set in 1974, a pair of 60s radicals rely on their bomb-making skills to become capitalists.

items.title: Guy X
items.description: A young corporal is mistakenly posted to a base in Greenland, where no one believes his protests. Forced into the role of Public Information Officer, he befriends an injured soldier and stumbles on a conspiracy, with his blunders turning it into comedy.

items.title: Un ramo de amor
items.description: Cuando la botánica Violet pide ayuda a Jack, un apuesto fotógrafo que dirige el cobertizo de flores de su abuelo, descubren su pasión compartida por la esquiva flor Youtan. ¿Lograrán que la boda sea un éxito y florecer también el amor?

items.title: Dangerous Men
items.description: A rampaging gutter epic of crime, revenge, cop sex and raw power.

items.title: Forgiveness
items.description: Three women mysteriously wake up in a hospital and discover they are physically impaired, together they have to figure out how to escape.

items.title: Harper
items.description: Recently orphaned, Harper must choose between the troubled aunt she loves and the mother she's never met.

items.title: The Lost Treasure
items.description: When a treasure hunter discovers his family ties to an ancient Hawaiian secret that's been lost for generations, he embarks on a quest to find and protect this mystical staff which, in the wrong hands, could lead to the island's doom.

items.title: Homecoming
items.description: A jilted ex-girlfriend plots revenge after her former beau comes back to their hometown with a new lover.

items.title: Together Together
items.description: When a young loner becomes the gestational surrogate for a single man in his 40s, the two strangers come to realize this unexpected relationship will challenge their perceptions of connection, boundaries and the particulars of love.

items.title: Altered Reality
items.description: A man is given a mysterious undiscovered miracle drug, selling it for billions. When his young daughter unexpectedly vanishes, he learns that his family vacation spot allows time travel, offering him the chance to save her.

items.title: La Banda de la Sotana Negra
items.description: Un asesinato ligado a la banda del Fantasma Negro apunta a un plan para apoderarse de una hacienda con un tesoro oculto.

items.title: Johnny Chicano
items.description: Un campesino se enamora de su jefe estadounidense, provocando conflictos con su novia mexicana y su familia.

items.title: McQueen
items.description: McQueen's life and work demand a bold, compelling and cinematic narrative structure. He would have hated nothing more than the conventional, episodic style of so many biopics.

items.title: Hermoso Ideal
items.description: Unidos desde niños, Rafael y Pablo aman a Isabel. Ya adultos, Rafael parte a rescatar a Pablo de la Legión Extranjera.

items.title: Prison On Fire II
items.description: Ching escapes from prison to see his young son, who he has been put in an orphanage. And that puts him in great danger.

items.title: Hay un niño en su futuro
items.description: Un matrimonio celebra su aniversario y su próximo divorcio, pues ella confunde su vida con las novelas que lee.

items.title: Yo, Frankenstein
items.description: Adam, un monstruo creado por Frankenstein, se da cuenta de que su verdadera misión es salvar a la humanidad después de encontrarse en medio de una guerra entre dos clanes inmortales de demonios y gárgolas.

items.title: Prison On Fire
items.description: Inside a Chinese prison two inmates form a friendship and face the difficulty of life on the inside.

items.title: Hunting Grounds
items.description: Fleeing her Mafia-tied husband, Chloe seeks refuge in a cabin with a mysterious drifter, Jake. But as danger closes in, Jake reveals himself as her greatest threat.

items.title: The Marijuana Conspiracy
items.description: In 1972, young women looking for a fresh start in life endure isolated captivity in a true 98-day human experiment studying the effects of marijuana on females.

items.title: Let It Bleed
items.description: An ordinary man takes revenge only to find it's made him the target of a major crime lord and his army of killers.

items.title: The Cousin
items.description: A well-intentioned Arabic-Muslim handyman upends the day-to-day lives of the locals in a small Israeli village.

items.title: Vera y el placer de los otros
items.description: Vera, de diecisiete años, gana dinero alquilando en secreto un departamento a adolescentes que buscan privacidad, mientras espía detrás de una puerta cerrada. A medida que escucha, sus propios deseos comienzan a despertar.

items.title: The Score
items.description: From the producers of Yesterday, The Score boldly combines real time heist-thriller suspense with offbeat romance and a killer soundtrack; starring and featuring the music of Johnny Flynn, alongside Naomi Ackie and Will Poulter.

items.title: Hannah
items.description: Hannah is the intimate portrait of a woman's loss of identity as she teeters between denial and reality. Left alone grappling with the consequences of her husband's imprisonment, Hannah begins to unravel.

items.title: The Heat: A Kitchen Revolution
items.description: It takes a brazen personality to excel in the competitive sport of professional cooking. Meet seven women chefs at the forefront of a "revolution."

items.title: Grave Intentions
items.description: In this anthology of chills, thrills, and kills, a practitioner of the magical arts teaches the basics of her craft. The most important lesson? You must be mindful of your intention. Five of her customers are about to learn this the hard way.

items.title: Exit Speed
items.description: Strangers use improvised weapons, adrenaline and sheer guts to mount a defense against murderous bikers and their survival depends on doing the unthinkable - fighting for their lives!

items.title: Saving Grace
items.description: A small-town English widow, facing financial troubles after her husband's suicide, turns to agriculture of an illegal kind.

items.title: Oldhead
items.description: After his rival’s death, LA faces a choice: leave the streets for Sonya or seek revenge after learning his father’s killer’s identity. A cop offers him a way out, but his godfather, Philly’s mayor, must stop him before revenge destroys everything.

items.title: Samson & Delilah
items.description: A glue-sniffing boy and his girlfriend escape the government-controlled no-hope Aboriginal community they live in and go to the city, Alice Springs, looking for a better life.

items.title: The Restraint (Director's Cut)
items.description: A young couple on the run hole up in a country estate with a hostage in tow.

items.title: Tracker (2010)
items.description: An Afrikaner Boer War veteran immigrates to New Zealand. Hired to track a fugitive accused of killing a soldier, he captures him but learns he's innocent. Faced with turning him in or freeing him, only one will survive

items.title: Motherhood
items.description: In Manhattan, a mother of two preparing for her daughter's sixth birthday party has no idea of the challenges she's about to face in order to pull off the event.

items.title: Paperback Hero
items.description: Australian truck driver Jack has written a successful romance novel under the name of his best friend's girlfriend - Ruby Vale. When a publisher arrives to sign up 'Ruby', complications arise.

items.title: Restless
items.description: Nicky, a solitary care worker, is forced into paranoia when loud, party‑obsessed neighbors invade her peace. As sleepless nights wear on, her descent into obsession becomes a pulse‑pounding showdown of sanity vs. noise.

items.title: Gold
items.description: An estranged father returns to his hometown after a decade long absence with hopes to rekindle relations with his daughter and ex-wife but unwittingly unravels the family life they've created.

items.title: Guitarras Lloren Guitarras
items.description: Juan, guitarrista provinciano, llega a la capital en busca de éxito y se enamora de Susana mientras conoce personajes pintorescos.

items.title: Forever's End
items.description: Six years after an apocalyptic event killed her family and seemingly everyone else on earth, a lone girl on the verge of insanity is forced to question everything when a strange man suddenly appears at her door. The last girl on earth is not alone.

items.title: Shaolin And Wu Tang
items.description: Two friends from rival schools are turned against one another by a jealous chief who wants to eliminate those whose fighting styles may rival his own.

items.title: The Skulls
items.description: A senior at an ivy league college, who depends on scholarships and working on the side, gets accepted into the secret society The Skulls. He hopes it betters chances at Harvard but The Skulls is not what he thought and comes at a price.

items.title: Say A Little Prayer
items.description: Three best friends recite an ancient prayer to the patron saint of all things lost to find their true loves. This unleashes an unexpected turn of events that puts their friendship to the test.

items.title: Heaven's Burning
items.description: After a botched bank job, a gang takes hostage a Japanese girl on the run from an arranged marriage. Their wheelman saves the girl from them and the two go on the run with cops, the gang, and her psycho husband on their tail.
At 2:37, someone commits suicide in the school lavatory. The day is told up to that point from the viewpoint of six different students.

items.title: Legion of Honor
items.description: Rebuffed in love and uncertain of life, Simon is the story of a young Englishman's physical and spiritual journey during Algeria's battle for independence from France.

items.title: Hard Breakers
items.description: Driven by a history of dating pitfalls and frustration, Alexis and Lindsay decide to turn the tables and devise a plan to lure unsuspecting men to their lair.

items.title: Home
items.description: Carrie, a young religious fundamentalist, must learn to overcome her own fears and believes to save her little sister from a haunted house.

items.title: Lucky Day
items.description: Red, a safe cracker who has just been released from prison, is trying to hold his family together as his past catches up with him in the form of Luc, a psychopathic contract killer who's seeking revenge for the death of his brother.

items.title: In Football We Trust
items.description: IN FOOTBALL WE TRUST intimately follows four young Polynesian high school football players pursung their dreams of making it in the NFL.

items.title: Kaye Ballard: The Show Goes On
items.description: The greatest star you never knew, Kaye Ballard did it all as a superb singer, actor, and comedian over eight decades, from big bands to Broadway, radio to recordings, television to the big screen.

items.title: Bezos: The Beginning
items.description: The story of Jeff Bezos, a successful Wall Street executive with plans to change the world. During the internet's infancy, code development and finances were early struggles on his way to create one of the world's most recognized retailers.

items.title: Beauty Water
items.description: Beauty Water seems like a normal cosmetic, but it lets people sculpt their skin and change their looks. Ordinary girl Yaeji discovers it, but her obsession with beauty soon leads her into unimaginable disaster.

items.title: Lovers in a Dangerous Time
items.description: A man attempts to break off an affair with an unstable woman as his fiancée prepares to return home after being away with family.

items.title: Brahmin Bulls
items.description: Sid Sharma's life is unraveling—his marriage is ending, his career's stalled, and his estranged father, Ashok, has shown up unannounced. Old grudges and new secrets collide in a heartfelt and humorous story of family and forgiveness.

items.title: Cesium Fallout
items.description: A deadly fire triggers a radiation leak in Hong Kong, forcing scientist Simon Fan and Acting Chief Executive Cecilia to lead a high-stakes mission to save seven million lives.

items.title: Mackintosh and TJ
items.description: Roy Rogers stars as cowboy Mackintosh, who is exploring the west and working odd jobs. While passing through Dickens, Texas, Mackintosh's car troubles lead him to spend a little time in town, where he meets TJ. The two soon become fast friends.

items.title: The Hunters
items.description: A group of friends spend a weekend in the woods and find themselves trapped with no way out. They will soon become prey to The Hunters!

items.title: The Kane Files
items.description: Scott Kane, a man with a checkered past is trying to live a clean life. When his son Owen falls ill, Kane finds his only option is to turn to Daniel Morgan, the local kingpin of the criminal underworld.

items.title: The Light of the Moon
items.description: Bonnie, a young, successful Brooklyn architect, is assaulted while walking home from an evening out with friends. She struggles to regain intimacy and control in her life until an encounter with an at-risk woman forces her to confront her own self-blame.

items.title: Mankiller
items.description: MANKILLER tells the powerful and uplifting story of Wilma Mankiller, the first woman elected Principal Chief of the Cherokee Nation.

items.title: The Never List
items.description: After the sudden death of her best friend, a strait-laced teen sets out to fulfill their secret list of naughty acts called The Never List.

items.title: The Selling
items.description: A too-honest-for-his-own-good real estate agent has to sell a haunted house before its ghostly inhabitants ruin his life.

items.title: The Trouble with the Truth
items.description: Musician and starving artist Robert reconsiders his own failed marriage to Emily after his daughter announces that she's engaged.

items.title: To Kill A Wolf
items.description: In a modern re-imagining of Little Red Riding Hood, a social pariah discovers a teenage runaway in the Oregon Wilderness and does his best to help her find a way home - a troubling exploration of trauma and redemption.

items.title: Two Men Went To War
items.description: Two British Army dentists, eager to see action amid World War II, go A.W.O.L. to invade occupied France alone.

items.title: Misery Loves Comedy
items.description: Are all comedians miserable? Kevin Pollak sits down with some of the most successful comics working today, including Tom Hanks, Jimmy Fallon, Amy Schumer and Judd Apatow, to learn about what drives comedians to be funny.

items.title: Under My Skin
items.description: Denny, a free spirit and artist falls for Ryan, a strait-laced lawyer. When Denny questions gender their love is tested. Denny is played by four different actors, exploring four chapters in their story.

items.title: Wait Till Helen Comes
items.description: When a reconstructed family moves to a converted church in the country, 14-year-old Molly, must save her new troubled step-sister from a dangerous relationship with the desperate ghost of a young girl.

items.title: Where Hearts Lie
items.description: A young Brooklyn real estate mogul in the making gambles his success, sanity, and the safety of his young son when falling for the wrong woman.

items.title: Missed Connections
items.description: Love is not luck...it's strategy. This charming romantic comedy examines the lengths New Yorkers will go to find love.

items.title: Mood Indigo
items.description: Set in a surreal Paris, a visionary and romantic love story starring Audrey Tautou (Amélie) and Romain Duris.

items.title: 10 Days In a Madhouse
items.description: In 1887, 23-year-old reporter Nellie Bly, working for Joseph Pulitzer, feigns mental illness to go undercover in notorious Blackwell's Island, a mental institution for women, to expose corruption, abuse, and murder.

items.title: Ms. 45
items.description: Ms. 45 follows a mute garment-district seamstress who ignites her one-woman rampage against NYC's entire male population.

items.title: Killing Zelda Sparks
items.description: Two old high-school buddies, Craig Blackshear and Terry Seville decide to pull a vicious prank on Craig's meddling former girlfriend Zelda, but Terry is appalled to learn that the prank may have taken a deadly turn.

items.title: Olympia
items.description: This intimate doc tells the story of a woman finding her own voice on her own terms to assert a gigantic creative force into the world. Through her brutal honesty and sincerity, Olympia Dukakis models how to live life with blazing courage.

items.title: Holiday Engagement
items.description: Afraid to tell her family she's been dumped, Hillary hires an actor to play her fiancé during a four-day Thanksgiving weekend at her parents' house.

items.title: Pot Luck: The Altered State of Colorado
items.description: The war on drugs has failed but is legalization of cannabis the answer? Pot Luck takes a trip across pioneering state Colorado five years after full legalization to see how it's all playing out and what this blazed new world looks like.

items.title: Fighting for Freedom
items.description: A Mexican couple have two children in the US, but when they return to Mexico and have another child there, they are denied re-entry. They decide to return illegally, but the authorities eventually seek to deport their Mexican-born child.

items.title: The Starling Girl
items.description: 17-year-old Jem Starling struggles with her place within her Christian fundamentalist community. But everything changes when her magnetic youth pastor Owen returns to their church.

items.title: Drop Zone Everest
items.description: Drop Zone Everest follows retired Navy SEAL Mike Sarraille and a team of former special operators skydiving onto Mt. Everest to honor the fallen heroes of Extortion 17, captured by filmmaker Dan Myrick ("The Blair Witch Project").

items.title: A Very Country Christmas
items.description: A chance meeting between a busy single mom and a country star whos hiding out has them both letting down their guard and opening up their hearts.

items.title: Ebony & Ivory
items.description: Two musical legends gather at a Scottish Cottage on The Mull of Kintyre for a tense summit to discuss a potential collaboration that will ultimately result in a global Number One smash hit single.

items.title: Failan (Restoration)
items.description: After losing her parents, Failan moves to Korea in search of relatives, only to learn they've emigrated to Canada. To survive and stay, she enters an arranged marriage through a matchmaking agency.

items.title: Full River Red
items.description: From Oscar-nominated director Zhang Yimou comes a suspenseful whodunnit set in imperial China, where a murder before a key summit sparks a conspiracy, and a lowly pawn dares to change the fate of a nation.

items.title: Go for Broke
items.description: After drug dealers destroy his family, Zhang Yao joins anti-drug leader An Du to take down kingpins Mukun and Anpei's criminal empire.

items.title: God Help the Girl
items.description: A feel-good comedy musical romance written and directed by Stuart Murdoch of Belle and Sebastian which tells the story of Eve (Emily Browning) who is low on self-esteem but high on fantasy, especially when it comes to music.

items.title: Hoard
items.description: When Maria meets Michael, a former resident of her foster home, the pair develop an intense and animalistic bond which opens a door to Maria's past.

items.title: Last Swim
items.description: It's a sweltering A-Level results day in London. While secretly grappling with a life-changing decision, Ziba, a promising British-Iranian teen, leads her friends on an eventful journey across the city on their final day of freedom.

items.title: Mutual Appreciation
items.description: Aspiring musician Alan crash-lands in town following the breakup of his band in Boston, immediately taking up with his old friends Ellie and Lawrence while negotiating the affections of a local radio DJ.

items.title: A Christmas To Remember
items.description: A heartwarming tale unfolds as Lauren and Reid strive to unite their warring families for Christmas. Amidst holiday chaos, they orchestrate a plan to bring everyone together. Will Christmas cheer be enough to end this family feud?

items.title: Anchor Baby
items.description: Anchor Baby is a tale of an illegal immigrant couple from Nigeria on a quest to create a better life for their unborn child. Their dream is to have their baby in the United States in order for the baby to become a US citizen.

items.title: Bikini Moon
items.description: A charismatic but mentally unstable vet captures the attention of a documentary film crew who are ready to exploit her story for their own shot at independent movie fame in this very modern, urban fairy tale set amidst a fractured ideal of family.

items.title: Hav Faith
items.description: Hamilton A. Vaughn, aka HAV, is catapulted as leader of prominent Mission Church where issues arise among him, the son of the retiring bishop, and a money-hungry real-estate broker.

items.title: A Beautiful Soul
items.description: R & B superstar Andre Stephens is on top of the world. He has success, fame, and fortune but spiritually he has lost his way.

items.title: Automation
items.description: A workplace robot, AUTO, transforms into a killing machine when he discovers he will be replaced by a more efficient model.

items.title: Assassinaut
items.description: A team of four teenage astronauts brave the alien wilderness of a distant planet to save the Earth's President from a deadly assassin.

items.title: All American Bikini Car Wash
items.description: An enterprising college student agrees to run his professor's Las Vegas car wash to avoid flunking out of school.

items.title: Hoax
items.description: An investigative team travels deep into the remote Colorado wilderness after a group of young campers are viciously murdered by what may be Bigfoot.

items.title: A Haunting At Preston Castle
items.description: A dare turns into a horrifying nightmare when three friends become trapped within the mazelike halls of California's infamous haunted castle.

items.title: Midnight Bayou
items.description: While restoring Manet Hall, a dilapidated mansion in New Orleans, Declan Fitzgerald uncovers hidden mysteries that are attached to the space and those who once lived there.

items.title: Recen una pequeña oración
items.description: Tres mejores amigas rezan una antigua oración al santo patrón de todas las cosas perdidas para encontrar sus verdaderos amores. Esto desencadena un inesperado cambio de eventos que ponen a prueba su amistad.

items.title: Northern Lights
items.description: Nate Burns accepts a job as chief of police in Lunacy, Alaska, hoping to to get away from the traumatic death of his partner back in Baltimore. He meets Meg, an independent bush pilot, whose father is found dead in a mountain cave.

items.title: Hatched
items.description: When a spaceship crashes into their barn, animal friends set out on an incredible adventure

items.title: Flowers In The Attic
items.description: Children are hidden away up in an attic by their conspiring mother and grandmother.

items.title: Tomorrow
items.description: Uplifting and inspiring, Tomorrow follows a veteran on the brink of despair when he bonds with a spirited young man. As they share laughter and pain, friendship rekindles his will to live. A heartfelt tale of resilience, kindness and human connection.

items.title: Faultline
items.description: A driven lawyer returns to her hometown and stumbles across new information that her mother's suicide may have been murder. She and her estranged sister will have to work together to stay alive long enough to uncover the truth.

items.title: Little Deaths
items.description: Faced with plague and political revolution, a disillusioned young American couple escape to a remote jungle village where they vow to seek ultimate pleasure before taking their fate into their own hands.

items.title: Parasomnia
items.description: Unable to wake due to a rare sleep disorder, Laura Baxter resides in a psychiatric hospital. When a manipulative serial killer begins to take an interest in her, Danny Sloan attempts to save the sleeping beauty from falling into the murderer's clutches.

items.title: The Man From Rome
items.description: Vatican intelligence officer Father Quart investigates a message sent to the pope about a crumbling Spanish church that kills to defend itself. A deep conspiracy unfolds that challenges the Father's loyalty and faith.

items.title: The Odyssey
items.description: Jacques-Yves Cousteau's aquatic adventure covers roughly thirty years of an inarguably rich in achievements life.

items.title: A Second Chance
items.description: A conscientious police officer who investigates a violent case of domestic dispute in the squalid apartment of a drug addict has to make the most contemptible decision in his life. Just how far would a parent go to get a second chance?

items.title: Don't Sleep
items.description: In Bangkok, teens awaken a deadly spirit game. To survive, they must stay awake‚ or die in their sleep.

items.title: 17 And Life Doesn't Wait
items.description: 17 And Life Doesn't Wait follows three teen girls through senior year, capturing laughter, struggles, and triumphs as they face family, school, identity, and unexpected challenges.

items.title: In Dreams
items.description: A sexy thriller about a husband and wife who are taking a much needed weekend away to her family’s cabin to repair their troubled marriage. A mysterious couple shows up and things steadily spiral out of control until only one person survives the weekend.

items.title: Holy Lands
items.description: A Jewish American doctor leaves everything behind to become a pig farmer in Israel, a move that deeply shocks his family and puts him at odds with the local community there.

items.title: Monster
items.description: In the Ming Dynasty, three Imperial Guards battle a river monster and uncover a corrupt scam behind the legend.

items.title: Scary Movie
items.description: A paranoid teenage nerd comes to believe that an escaped lunatic may be hiding in the neighborhood Halloween house of horrors.

items.title: Jesse James
items.description: Jesse James and his brother Frank race to secure the family's buried gold as members of the James-Younger gang attempt to steal it.

items.title: Christmas Snowed in with a Prince
items.description: When a driven event planner finds herself snowed in at a remote European lodge with a charming stranger, she soon discovers he's not just her unexpected guest‚ but a reluctant prince hiding from royal duties.

items.title: Coast
items.description: At 16, Abby feels trapped in her coastal town. Her world changes when she falls for a rock band’s lead singer, forcing her to choose between her life and a new future. As she struggles to leave her family behind, Abby begins a journey of self-discovery.

items.title: The Christmas Princess Switch
items.description: When a royal princess vanishes days before her coronation, a down-on-her-luck barista who's her exact lookalike is recruited to stand in.

items.title: Conspiracy of Fear
items.description: In a chilling dystopian future, a terrifying virus turns humans into "hybrids," hunted for their very existence. A brave journalist stands against a sinister pharmaceutical giant intent on using public fear to enforce a life-altering drug.

items.title: Snake Manor
items.description: An exotic man-eating snake is unleashed when a break-in goes awry, trapping both the intruders and an affluent (yet dysfunctional) family in their high security mansion.

items.title: Christmas Cowboy
items.description: A savvy but overlooked real estate developer goes to her small hometown to close the deal of a lifetime. Once there, she competes with a ruthless rival, reconnects with her estranged family and childhood sweetheart, and finds true love.

items.title: Silver Lake
items.description: A drifting writer searches for purpose in Silver Lake, balancing love, art, and eccentric friends in this funny and heartfelt story about growing up at any age.

items.title: Two Days
items.description: Paul Miller has struggled as an actor in Hollywood for years, and now he's had enough. In two days, he's going to kill himself. But in true Hollywood style, he's hired a film crew to chronicle his last moments.

items.title: Rise and Fight: The Battle of Hobkirk's Hill
items.description: In April 1781, Patriot forces rally in Camden under Gen. Greene, using militias to fight the British in a sprawling town-wide battle.

items.title: Schmelvis: Searching For the King’s Jewish Roots
items.description: After learning Elvis had Jewish roots, filmmakers follow Hasidic impersonator Schmelvis to the Holy Land and Graceland, planting a tree and saying Kaddish at the King's grave.

items.title: Fiddler: Miracle Of Miracles
items.description: Fiddler is the first in-depth documentary film that chronicles the life and themes of this iconic offering of American culture.

items.title: Almighty Zeus
items.description: When an old Asian man is attacked, a young boxer knocks out the aggressor. This turns him into a viral star which gets the attention of the Middleweight champion who decides to challenge the young boxer in the ring to an unorthodox boxing match.

items.title: Among Ravens
items.description: The story of a group of friends who reunite for their annual 4th of July weekend only to be confronted by Chad, a strange and beautiful nature photographer who begins to change their lives one by one.

items.title: August Falls
items.description: Struggling to find the truth behind her son's mysterious death, an estranged mother must confront her own hidden guilt.

items.title: One Big Snake
items.description: A family plans to renovate a rundown farmhouse during the summer but uncovers a nest of giant snake eggs and an unusual squatter on the property... Soon the eggs hatch, releasing deadly killer snakes and the family must begin a deadly fight to survive.

items.title: Better Criminal
items.description: A police officer is forced to work for two warring crime syndicates while under an internal investigation.

items.title: Pinkerton
items.description: Allan Pinkerton starts America's first detective agency to catch Jesse James. In Clay County, they meet his mother, Zerelda, and pose as oil men to lure the outlaw back to Missouri.

items.title: The Wrong Obsession
items.description: Lisa tries to save her marriage with Mark, but her ex Jake’s obsession grows dangerously unstable, forcing her to navigate love, loyalty, and escalating threats to her safety.

items.title: Modern Times
items.description: The Tramp struggles to live in modern industrial society with the help of a young homeless woman.

items.title: The Wrong Prince Charming
items.description: A successful entrepreneur scores a meeting with a famed prince about a possible multimillion dollar investment in one of her properties. But the perfect partnership soon turns into a nightmare when she discovers he's not what he seems.

items.title: The Wrong Marriage
items.description: Carrie escapes an abusive marriage, starts fresh, and meets a mysterious stranger. As sparks fly, her dark past resurfaces, threatening her new life and a passionate romance.

items.title: Cheat
items.description: To escape her lonely, isolated marriage, a woman becomes involved with another man. She must fight to survive the consequences of her affair when she is abducted and soon learns that the truth is deadlier than she could have ever imagined.

items.title: The Wrong Valentine
items.description: After losing her father, Emily tries to open up during her senior year with the help of one of her teachers. But when a new boy at school gives her a candy cupid on Valentine's Day, she wonders if he’s the one — or hiding darker motives.

items.title: Lawless Range
items.description: When his troubled brother falls into debt with a dangerous gang, a Texas rancher must fight to protect his family and hold onto the bond that could destroy them both.

items.title: MST3K: Wizards Of The Lost Kingdom
items.description: A boy magician, a boozy hero and a furry - something-or-other team up to save a kingdom from a nefarious sorcerer in this 1985 cheesefest.

items.title: Sniper: Special Ops
items.description: When a mission to rescue a kidnapped U.S. Congressman goes wrong, an Army sniper and his partner are stranded in enemy territory, forced to survive and evade the Taliban while awaiting rescue.

items.title: The Push
items.description: Grant Korgan broke his back snowmobiling and was told he would never walk again. Despite his prognosis, Grant focused on full recovery. 2 years later, he became the first spinal cord injured athlete to PUSH himself to the South Pole.

items.title: 7 Days
items.description: Set-up on a pre-arranged date, Ravi and Rita seemingly have nothing in common. The situation turns both awkward and enlightening when they find themselves trapped inside together for a week.

items.title: The Last Man on the Moon
items.description: When Apollo astronaut Gene Cernan stepped on the moon in December 1972 he left his footprints and his daughter's initials in the lunar dust. Now forty years later, he is ready to share his personal story of fulfillment, love and loss.

items.title: The Reagan Show
items.description: Told solely through archival footage and set against the backdrop of the Cold War, THE REAGAN SHOW presents the pageantry, absurdity and charisma of a prolific actor's defining role: Leader of the Free World.

items.title: The Butterfly Tree
items.description: Evelyn, a burlesque queen bewitches single dad, Al and his teenage son, Fin. As they compete for her affections, old wounds are reopened over the death of Fin's mother.

items.title: Pretty Red Dress
items.description: Pretty Red Dress tells the story of Travis, Candice and their daughter Kenisha and their relationships with the same red dress. Pretty Red Dress is a poignant, funny look at society's boxes and all the things we do to be loved.

items.title: A Bond Unbroken
items.description: A Bond Unbroken has been in the works for three years and is a rare positive story to come out of the anguish of the Vietnam War. The film spans a period of war and culminates in the moving reunion of the Navy SEALS and their Vietnamese interpreter.

items.title: MK Ultra
items.description: Based on the infamous CIA drug experiments from the early 1960s, this psychological thriller follows a brilliant psychiatrist (Anson Mount) who unknowingly becomes entangled with a dangerous government entity fixated on mind control.

items.title: The Unwilling
items.description: A will reading takes a twisted turn when a mysterious box arrives, tempting each heir with their deepest, darkest desires. They turn on each other as they struggle to overcome the evil entity, looking for a new host on which to feed.

items.title: The Integrity of Joseph Chambers
items.description: Desperate to acquire the skills necessary to provide for his family in case of an apocalypse, insurance salesman Joseph Chambers goes deer hunting for the first time ever, alone, when his experienced buddy is too sick to join him.

items.title: Dos chefs y un pastel de bodas
items.description: Cuando una crítica gastronómica en la cima de su carrera se topa cara a cara en la boda de su hermana con un chef famoso por rechazar a los críticos gastronómicos, ellos deben encontrar la manera de superar sus diferencias antes del gran día.

items.title: Saul And Ruby's Holocaust Survivor Band
items.description: Like many survivors of the Holocaust, after World War II, Saul and Ruby moved to America, started families and careers, grew old, and retired to South Florida.

items.title: Iron Cowboy: the Story of the 50-50-50
items.description: James Lawrence attempts to complete 50 Ironman distances in 50 consecutive days in all 50 United States. With a team of volunteers and his family in tow, James races across the United States to test the edge of human endurance.

items.title: MST3K: Lords Of The Deep
items.description: In part three of a Gauntlet six-movie binge, Jonah and the bots take on the 1989 film Lords of the Deep.

items.title: Bumblebee (ESP)
items.description: Bumblebee, un robot herido y destrozado, es encontrado y reparado por una adolescente llamada Charlie. Ambos deberán unir fuerzas para salvar el planeta de los malvados Decepticons en esta aventura llena de acción para toda la familia.

items.title: Battle of the Bulge: Wunderland
items.description: Winter 1944, Army Lt. Robert Cappa and his platoon of 2nd Infantry Division soldiers have been ordered to hold a vital road junction against the first stages of an attacking German Army in the epic Battle of the War known as The Battle of the Bulge.

items.title: Don Quixote: The Ingenious Gentleman of La Mancha
items.description: With his noble squire by his side, a retired country gentleman sets out on an adventure to right the wrongs of the world.

items.title: #Manhole
items.description: On the day before Shunsuke Kawamura's wedding, his colleagues hold a surprise party for him. On his way home from the party, Shunsuke falls into a deep manhole. Can the groom get out of the hole intact and get married to continue with his successful life?

items.title: A Bit of Light
items.description: Ella, at almost forty, is forced to move back in with her father Alan. She's trying to stay sober having temporarily given up custody of her young daughters to her ex-husband Joseph and his new partner Bethan.

items.title: Softness Of Bodies
items.description: An American poet hopes to win a prestigious grant while dealing with her former lovers, a rival poet, and her own penchant for stealing things.

items.title: Shrapnel
items.description: A former Marine and his old war buddy face off against the Mexican cartel behind the disappearance of his daughter.

items.title: Crossfire
items.description: After a former FBI agent's wife is killed by a member of a crime syndicate, he learns that they are targeting his daughter, stopping at nothing to get to her, and they must team together to prepare for the final showdown.

items.title: Project Legion
items.description: Against all odds, a former marine must survive after waking up in apocalyptic chaos. Unsure of his reality and surrounded by demonic creatures that toy with his mind, he barricades himself away from the evils lurking outside his door.

items.title: Noryang: Deadly Sea
items.description: In the final chapter of Kim Han-Min's epic trilogy, legendary Korean admiral Yi Sun-Sin faces his final fight in a naval battle that changed history.

items.title: Locked In
items.description: After a car accident leaves a successful advertising man's daughter in a strange coma, she starts communicating telepathically with him. Or is he going mad?

items.title: Deep Fear
items.description: Three students celebrate their graduation by visiting the Paris catacombs. When they discover a bunker formerly occupied by the Nazis, little do they know it’s not the only thing that was left behind. Something, someone, is now hunting them.

items.title: Project Wolf Hunting
items.description: During transport, a group of hardened criminals stages a jailbreak that quickly escalates into a bloody, all-out riot. As the fugitives exact their brutal terror campaign onboard the ship, something even more terrifying emerges from below.

items.title: Twas the Night
items.description: On Christmas Eve, Mya tells chilling tales of Jack Frost, The Gingerbread Man, and Krampus, revealing their terrifying, brutal sides instead of heartwarming stories.

items.title: She Wants Me
items.description: A neurotic writer working on his new film gets into a tricky situation when an A-list actress shows interest in the role intended for his girlfriend.

items.title: Paul Mooney: A Piece of My Mind
items.description: The venomous, no holds, barred style of standup comedy legend Paul Mooney is on full display in this concert special.

items.title: She Belongs To Me
items.description: As Pete's machinations unfold, the lives of Lorraine and Jelly are irrevocably altered, forcing them to confront uncomfortable truths about their relationship and the secrets that lurk beneath the surface.

items.title: Rodney Perry: Nothing But The Truth
items.description: Rodney Perry's high-energy brand of funny is on full display during this OUTRAGEOUS stand-up filmed in the heart of Birmingham, Alabama.

items.title: Fallaste Corazón
items.description: Un hombre desafortunado promete lo imposible para conquistar a la mujer que lo rechaza.

items.title: The Secret of Karma
items.description: A dying man gets a look at his previous and future lives and is given insight on how all his actions affect him in his other incarnations, culminating in what could destroy the lives of thousands of innocent people on a peaceful planet.

items.title: Shark Island
items.description: A tropical island photo shoot turns deadly when swimsuit models are trapped with a killer and their only escape is through shark-infested waters.

items.title: Jamie Foxx Unleashed: Lost, Stolen and Leaked!
items.description: Jamie Foxx performs live in Texas.

items.title: Soul Reaper
items.description: When the deaths in his dreams begin to come true in real life, it’s up to young Respati and his friends to discover the secret behind them and end the carnage. Soul Reaper is the latest in Indonesian horror, it’ll haunt your dreams.

items.title: The Homecoming
items.description: A professor returns home after a long absence to introduce his wife, but the family reunion has unexpected consequences in Harold Pinter's play.

items.title: ¡Ay, qué hijo!
items.description: El jugador más grande en la historia de Ridgefield College usa su influencia y reputación para conseguir que su único hijo; un enfermizo y descoordinado nerd, forme parte del equipo universitario de fútbol con resultados cómicos.

items.title: Ruthless
items.description: After one of his students is kidnapped, a high school coach—whose own teenage daughter had been murdered—takes matters into his own hands by hunting down the men responsible for a dark underground human trafficking operation.

items.title: Panda Plan
items.description: After legendary kung fu star Jackie Chan adopts a zoo panda, an international crime ring plots to kidnap his furry friend, leaving Chan to team up with his agent and the panda’s caretaker to outsmart—and outkick—the bad guys at every turn.

items.title: The Shadow People
items.description: A radio talk show host unravels a conspiracy about encounters with mysterious beings known as The Shadow People and their role in the unexplained deaths of several hundred victims in the 1980s.

items.title: Earth Mama
items.description: With two children in foster care, Gia, a pregnant single mother pitted against the system, fights to reclaim her family. In her close-knit Bay Area community, she works to make a life for herself and her kids.

items.title: Priscilla
items.description: The unseen side of a great American myth in Priscilla Presley's turbulent relationship with Elvis. Sofia Coppola (The Virgin Suicides) tells a deeply felt and ravishingly detailed portrait of love, fantasy, and fame through her eyes.

items.title: The Headmistress
items.description: A group of investors visit a lakefront property where a dark, sinister demon threatens them all.

items.title: MST3K: The Beast Of Hollow Mountain
items.description: Saddle up for a trip to a Mexican ranch with a nasty secret in this part-Western, part-monster movie that's all torture for Jonah and the bots.

items.title: MST3K: The Loves Of Hercules
items.description: The Far-fetched flight scenes and tangled plot lines of this breathy 1960 Jayne Mansfield saga nudge Jonah and friends one step closer to the edge.

items.title: El Ultimo Pistolero
items.description: Una familia campesina enfrenta un desalojo injusto que desata rabia, resistencia y tensión en toda la comunidad.

items.title: MST3K: Carnival Magic
items.description: Kinga, drops a bombshell on Jonah before plunging him into a world of bare-chested carnies, talking chimps, brooding magicians and young love.

items.title: MST3K: The Christmas That Almost Wasn't
items.description: The gang gets in the holiday spirit with the tale of a plucky lawyer who sets out to save Santa Claus from the clutches of a spoilsport zillionaire.

items.title: El Vampiro y el Sexo
items.description: Santo prueba su máquina del tiempo enviando a una joven al siglo XIX, donde enfrenta el peligro del Conde Drácula.

items.title: Tuesday
items.description: A mother (Julia Louis-Dreyfus) and her daughter must confront Death when it arrives in the form of an astonishing talking bird. A heart-rending fairy tale about the echoes of loss and finding resilience in the unexpected.

items.title: MST3K: The Time Travelers
items.description: A botched experiment hurls a group of scientists into a bleak future full of mutants, androids and catty humans in this 1964 sci-fi romp.

items.title: Janet Planet
items.description: 11-year-old Lacy spends the long summer at home with her mother and three strangers, in Pulitzer Prize winner Annie Baker's sublime debut film, capturing a child's experience of time and her vivid interior world.

items.title: A Breath Away
items.description: An earthquake in Paris releases a toxic mist, killing 2/3 of the population. A man, his wife and their daughter must find a way to survive.

items.title: The DUST Files: Black Voices in Sci-Fi
items.description: Journey through worlds where Black visionaries reimagine the future, from alien encounters to dystopian survival, in a collection of bold, thought-provoking sci-fi tales that challenge reality and ignite the imagination.

items.title: The Education Of Charlie Banks
items.description: College student Charlie Banks has to face old problems when the bully he had an unpleasant encounter with back in high school shows up on his campus.

items.title: MST3K: The Day Time Ended
items.description: In part four of a Gauntlet six-movie binge, Jonah and the bots take on the 1979 film The Day Time Ended.

items.title: MST3K: StarCrash
items.description: Perms, skimpy battle outfits and cheap effects abound in this 1978 "Star Wars" knockoff with David Hasselhoff and Christopher Plummer.

items.title: MST3K: Reptilicus
items.description: In Jonah Ray's first experiment, he, and his robot friends Tom Servo and Crow T. Robot are subjected by Kinga Forrester and Max, to a terrible Danish made monster movie.

items.title: MST3K: The Land The Time Forgot
items.description: A motley group aboard a German U-boat discovers an island full of ancient beasts and evolutionary mysteries in the blustery 1974 adventure.

items.title: The Pirate
items.description: An epic tale about Ioannis Varvakis, who sided with the Russians in their war with the Turks, befriended Catherine the Great, built a fortune out of sturgeon eggs – and then gave it all away to help his motherland fight the Ottoman empire.

items.title: MST3K: Yongary, Monster From The Deep
items.description: Rockets, earthquakes and reptiles, oh may. Jonah and the bots dive into a South Korean monster film that's long on rampages ad short on sensible behavior.

items.title: The Alphabet Killer
items.description: A detective investigates a series of murders of young girls, grappling with paranoia and a deteriorating mental state in this gripping thriller.

items.title: La princesa y el guardespaldas
items.description: En su 35º cumpleaños, Lexi descubre que debe asumir su verdadera identidad como princesa. Tiene dos semanas para prepararse para la gala real, contarle a su amiga y lidiar con Noah, su apuesto y exasperante guardaespaldas.

items.title: So Fades The Light
items.description: As a child, Sun was worshipped by an extremist gun cult. Fifteen years later, she travels back to the compound for closure. But little does she know, the cult's former leader has been released from prison and is headed the same direction.

items.title: MST3K: Killer Fish
items.description: In part five of a Gauntlet six-movie binge, Jonah and the bots take on the 1979 film Killer Fish.

items.title: MST3K: Mac And Me
items.description: In part one of a Gauntlet six-movie binge, Jonah and the bots take on the 1988 film Mac and Me: an alien is befriended by a wheelchair-bound boy while trying to escape from NASA.

items.title: Oh! What A Lovely War
items.description: The working-class Smiths change their initially sunny views on World War I after the three boys of the family witness the harsh reality of trench warfare.

items.title: Paris, Texas
items.description: Travis Henderson, an aimless drifter who has been missing for four years, wanders out of the desert and must reconnect with society, himself, his life, and his family.

items.title: MST3K: At The Earth's Core
items.description: While gearing up for his big day, Jonah joins Doug McClure for a wild ride down to a lava-licked world ruled by tyrannical, telepathic beasts.

items.title: MST3K: Atlantic Rim
items.description: In part two of a Gauntlet six-movie binge, Jonah and the bots take on the 2013 originally-titled film Atlantic Rim.

items.title: MST3K: Wizards Of The Lost Kingdom II
items.description: The Mads turn up the heat with a sequel. This time, a has-been wizard and his gawky apprentice embark on their own mind-bending quest to quash evil.

items.title: MST3K: Cry Wilderness
items.description: Follows the adventures of a young boy, Paul Cooper, who gets a vision from old pal Bigfoot while he's at boarding school.

items.title: NEDS
items.description: Encompassed by violent street gangs, neglectful parents, bullying teachers and a dearth of positive role models, a studious but emotionally abandoned kid turns thug.

items.title: Kitty the Killer
items.description: A highly trained teenage assassin, Dina, and her mentor, Charlie, form an unlikely duo as they unexpectedly join forces to stop a sinister plot and save millions of lives.

items.title: Scissors
items.description: In this intense thriller, after a brutal attack, an emotionally fragile woman is terrified that her assailant will return. She soon finds herself standing on the verge of madness...and someone is more than willing to push her over the edge!

items.title: Soldier Boyz
items.description: An ex-special ops marine runs a high-security youth detention center in L.A. But when a millionaire’s daughter is kidnapped by a vicious militant group, the soldier must go back into action...but only if he can take his deadliest detainees with him!

items.title: MST3K: Ator, The Fighting Eagle
items.description: In part six of a Gauntlet six-movie binge, Jonah and the bots take on the 1982 film Ator, the Fighting Eagle.

items.title: Control Room (ESP)
items.description: Una lejana colonia espacial en la que Olivia y su colega Arlo están a cargo de la sala de control de la colonia, velando por la seguridad y el bienestar de la comunidad. Pero la colonia se ve asediada por criaturas alienígenas.

items.title: Gilbert
items.description: Gilbert Gottfried rose to fame in the 1980's thanks to his brash stand-up act and personality. Now, after decades of flying solo in both his work and in his personal life, Gilbert has shockingly reinvented himself as a family man.

items.title: A Night in the Woods
items.description: A camping trip turns into a night of jealousy, sexual tension and terror, as dark forces descend upon a group of friends.

items.title: Cabaret Maxime
items.description: A cabaret owner tries to keep his club from being taken over by the powers that be.

items.title: Repay it in Blood
items.description: Ten years after a robbery left their sister dead and their father broken, prosecutor Larissa and her sister Maritza, a top trauma nurse, are done waiting for justice.

items.title: 20,000 Days on Earth
items.description: 20,000 Days On Earth is an inventive, lyrical ode to creativity and an intimate examination of the artistic process of musician and cultural icon Nick Cave.

items.title: Charm City
items.description: As a step toward a brighter future, Jay, Rodney, and Sean now own a popular nightclub in Baltimore, Maryland. When the city threatens to put them out of business, the long-time friends revert back to their old ways.

items.title: A Secret Lie in Love
items.description: Clarice and Chase Scott have the perfect suburban life on the outside. However, their marriage that was built on passion has become a battlefield of deceit, infidelity, and betrayal.

items.title: Burn X
items.description: The follow-up to the firefighting movie BURN. 12 years in the making, BURN X explores stories and introduces characters never seen before...and continues the journey for many of the Detroit firefighters audiences met in the first film.

items.title: Animen: The Galactic Battle
items.description: Like wildfire, the Swarm has enslaved nearly every civilization in the known Universe. The few survivors brave enough to fight back rose from the ashes. This is their story.

items.title: 3 Days of Normal
items.description: A lonely small town cop and a troubled Hollywood starlet fall for each other during a weekend stuck together in rural New Hampshire.

items.title: Devotion
items.description: Jonathan Majors (Creed III) and Glen Powell (Top Gun: Maverick) star in the epic and inspirational true story of two elite US fighter pilots during the Korean War. Their heroic sacrifices would ultimately make them the Navy's most celebrated wingmen.

items.title: Oh, Susanna!
items.description: An escaped convict knocks out radio star Gene Autry and swaps clothes with him, making the authorities believe that Gene is the criminal. A pair of traveling troubadours, Frog Millhouse and Professor Daniels, help Gene when he is branded a killer!

items.title: Cardboard Gangsters
items.description: A group of young Cardboard Gangsters attempt to gain control of the drug trade in Darndale, Ireland, chasing the glorified lifestyle of money, power and sex.

items.title: Burn
items.description: From executive producer Denis Leary, BURN is an action-packed documentary about Detroit told through the eyes of firefighters charged with the task of saving a city that many have written off as dead.

items.title: Let's Start a Cult
items.description: After missing out on a long-awaited mass suicide, an obnoxious cult member teams up with his former leader to rebuild their group, gathering a gang of awkward outcasts determined to fulfill their transcendent destiny.

items.title: Mother Teresa
items.description: The life and mission of Mother Teresa, devoted to serving the poor and sick in Calcutta.

items.title: The G
items.description: A mysterious older woman seeks revenge on the corrupt legal guardian who destroyed her life.

items.title: MST3K: Avalanche
items.description: While Jonah and crew dig into a schlocky ski-resort disaster flick starring Rock Hudson and Mia Farrow, Kinga Forrester connects with her long-distance lover.

items.title: El precio de la libertad
items.description: Esta película es sobre una joven que está casada con un judío devoto y los problemas que afectan su matrimonio debido a que ella quiere algo más de su vida.

items.title: Super Bowl Champions - 1990 New York Giants
items.description: The NY Giants hold the Buffalo Bills at 20-19 to win their 2nd Super Bowl title.

items.title: El niño con el pijama de rayas
items.description: Se forma una amistad prohibida entre Bruno, el hijo de un comandante nazi, y Schmuel, un niño judío y cautivo en un campo de concentración. Aunque físicamente separados por una cerca de alambre de púas, sus vidas se entrelazan inevitablemente.

items.title: Super Bowl Champions - 1992 Dallas Cowboys
items.description: The Dallas Cowboys begin their title run with a convincing 52-17 win over the Buffalo Bills.

items.title: Super Bowl Champions - 1991 Washington Redskins
items.description: Joe Gibbs becomes the third head coach to win three Super Bowls.

items.title: Super Bowl Champions - 1993 Dallas Cowboys
items.description: The Dallas Cowboys join the SF 49ers and the Pittsburgh Steelers as the only franchises to win 4 Super Bowls.

items.title: Super Bowl Champions - 1994 San Francisco 49ers
items.description: MVP Steve Young throws a Super Bowl record 6 td passes in SF 49's win over the San Diego Chargers 49-26.

items.title: Runt
items.description: Follows ten-year-old Annie and Runt, her stray dog, as they attempt to win the Agility Course Championship

items.title: Pawn Sacrifice
items.description: The gripping true story of American chess prodigy Bobby Fischer who found himself caught between two superpowers, and his own personal struggles, as he challenged the Soviet Empire.

items.title: Pídeme lo que quieras
items.description: Tras la muerte de su padre, Eric Zimmerman viaja a España para supervisar las sucursales de su empresa. En Madrid, se enamora de Judith y entabla una relación erótica llena de exploración. Eric teme que su secreto acabe con su aventura.

items.title: Ride On
items.description: When debt collectors repeatedly try—and fail—to seize a horse from a stuntman, video of the attempt goes viral. Furious, the debt collectors return, leading to hilarious, action-packed antics that outdo even the pair’s most daring acts.

items.title: The Wraith Within
items.description: When a group of friends return to their home town for a high school reunion, a tragic curse of the town's history emerges to terrorize them after horrifying revelations put all of their lives in peril for a shocking night they may not all survive.

items.title: They Turned Us Into Killers
items.description: A girl's best friend hunts down those responsible for an assault leading to a tragic suicide.

items.title: Wetlands
items.description: As a major storm approaches the outskirts of Atlantic City, a newly sober police detective goes to extreme measures to make sure that his estranged family does not fall victim to the vengeance of a local crime lord.

items.title: White Rabbit
items.description: A dramatic comedy following a Korean American performance artist who struggles to be authentically heard and seen through her multiple identities in modern Los Angeles.

items.title: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari
items.description: Robert Wiene's visionary film crafts a nightmare world in which a demented doctor and a carnival sleepwalker perpetrate a series of ghastly murders.

items.title: The Reports on Sarah and Saleem
items.description: An extramarital affair between an Israeli and a Palestinian in the divided city of Jerusalem ignites a dangerous game of deceit between those who hold power and those who don't. Based on true events.

items.title: Anthropoid
items.description: Two Czech soldiers parachute into their occupied homeland to assassinate Nazi General Reinhard Heydrich, Hitler's second in command.

items.title: The Stoning Of Soraya M.
items.description: A story told by Zahra to a French journalist of her niece Soraya Manutchehri, a 35-year-old married woman, who received capital punishment and stoned to death because of false accusations in the remote village of Kuhpayeh, Iran, in 1986.

items.title: A Faith Under Siege
items.description: In a region once celebrated as the post-Soviet "Bible Belt," A Faith Under Siege shines a bright light on the large community of Ukrainian Evangelical believers, which has become a prime target under Russia's expanding occupation.

items.title: Trailer War
items.description: From the vaults of the Alamo Drafthouse, a meticulous selection of the best, strangest and most amazing coming attraction trailers in the world!

items.title: All Is Calm
