items.description: In a last ditch effort to save their failing marriage, a young couple venture to a remote mountain cabin where they are taken hostage by an escaped convict and his merciless younger brother.

items.title: The Tomorrow Man
items.description: Ed Hemsler spends his life preparing for a disaster that may never come. Ronnie Meisner spends her life shopping for things she may never use.

items.title: The Iron Orchard
items.description: "The Iron Orchard" is the story of Jim McNeely, a young man thrust into the vibrant and brutal West Texas oilfields in 1939, who works his way through the ranks to ultimately become a formidable wildcatter.

items.title: Man vs Snake
items.description: A middle-aged man, Tim McVey, attempts to reclaim his 1984 world record on Nibbler, the first billion-point video game.

items.title: To What Remains
items.description: A team of scientists, historians and military veterans, scour the depths of the ocean to recover the remains of Americans missing in action.

items.title: On Chesil Beach
items.description: In 1962 England, a young couple find their idyllic romance colliding with issues of sexual freedom and societal pressure, leading to an awkward and fateful wedding night.

items.title: Montana Story
items.description: Two estranged siblings return home to the sprawling ranch they once knew and loved, confronting a deep and bitter family legacy against a mythic American backdrop.

items.title: Battle for Sevastopol
items.description: In 1941, as war is tearing her country apart, a Soviet student named Lyudmila Pavlichenko becomes the most successful female sniper in history.

items.title: Citizen Jane Fonda
items.description: Through her portrait, the film tells a social and political story while drawing the picture of a typically American phenomenon.

items.title: Earthquake
items.description: Two men arrive in their home town only to be caught up in the terrible events and must work together to rescue as many people as they can before the aftershocks hit.

items.title: Emoji Nation
items.description: Everyday, 6 billion emojis punctuate our virtual messages! This investigation into the world of emojis questions the evolution of language and the growing influence of Big Tech.

items.title: Misión imposible 4: Protocolo fantasma
items.description: El FMI se cierra cuando participa en el bombardeo del Kremlin, lo que provoca que Ethan Hunt y su nuevo equipo se conviertan en rebeldes para limpiar el nombre de su organización.

items.title: Misión imposible 5:  Nación secreta
items.description: Ethan y su equipo se embarcan en su misión más imposible hasta ahora, erradicando el Sindicato, una organización internacional ilegal tan altamente capacitada como ellos, comprometida con la destrucción del FMI.

items.title: 388 Arletta Avenue
items.description: A faceless voyeur's twisted manipulation of a young couple escalates into a deadly cat-and-mouse game, as seen from the perspective of hidden cameras concealed throughout their house.

items.title: Christmas in July
items.description: In this small town, a grandson throws Christmas early for his dying grandmother in the middle of summer with the help of his family and friends all while overcoming obstacles, finding love, and his passion for music again along the way.

items.title: Ageless Love
items.description: The incredible true story of an odd Jewish couple who fought against the social norms of the late 1960's in order to find true happiness.

items.title: Animen 2
items.description: The Animen Team is back and this time they're headed to new hi-tech boot camp with a brand new kind of Drill Sergeant, TOP-X8, a high-strung robot with fists of iron.

items.title: Black Site Delta
items.description: A group of military prisoners must fight off a terrorist attack on their prison which, unbeknownst to them, is a cover for a secret drone control facility.

items.title: Are You Proud?
items.description: From legal victories to corporate rainbow colors, Ashley Joiner's documentary tracks half a century of campaigning against prejudice.

items.title: Acid Test
items.description: A coming-of-age rebellion story fueled by Riot Grrrl music, a dysfunctional family, and LSD.

items.title: Amira & Sam
items.description: Adjusting after coming home from the war with stand-up comedy in NYC, Sam (Silicon Valley's Martin Star) falls for Iraqi refugee Amira.

items.title: Apostasy
items.description: Devout Jehovah's Witnesses, Alex, Luisa and their mother are united in The Truth. But as Luisa starts to question the advice of the Elders, she makes a life-altering transgression that leaves the whole family in fear of God's wrath.

items.title: Arena Wars
items.description: In 2045, convicted criminals are given the opportunity to compete on the world's #1 televised sporting event, Arena Wars. They must survive 7 rooms and 7 of the most vicious killers in the country. If they win, they regain their freedom.

items.title: Madhouse (1990)
items.description: Meet Mark (John Larroquette) and Jessie (Kirstie Alley) Bannister. Once they had it all. A happy marriage. Glamorous jobs. A house to call their own. It was the perfect life. Until a problem came along that was impossible to live with: houseguests!

items.title: Misión: Imposible III
items.description: Ethan Hunt se enfrenta cara a cara con un traficante de armas peligroso y sádico al tratar de mantener su identidad en secreto para proteger a su novia.

items.title: Computer Chess
items.description: This nostalgic Sundance winner is set over the course of a weekend tournament for software programmers in the 1980s.

items.title: At First Light
items.description: Alex (Stefanie Scott, Insidious: The Last Key) goes on the run after she encounters mysterious orbs of light, leaving her with extraordinary powers. She soon finds herself engulfed in an unprecedented event in human history. First contact.

items.title: Damaged Lives
items.description: A young couple's happiness is overshadowed by the specter of disease in this 1930s sex hygiene film. Adapted from Upton Sinclair's novel.

items.title: Dawson City: Frozen Time
items.description: The bizarre true story of some 533 silent film reels, buried for almost 50 years in a sub-arctic swimming pool, deep in the Yukon permafrost.

items.title: Bad Behaviour
items.description: Lucy, a former child actor, seeks enlightenment at a retreat led by spiritual leader Elon while she navigates her close yet turbulent relationship with her stunt-performer daughter, Dylan.

items.title: Dead Dicks
items.description: Becca receives a call from her brother and rushes over to find him with copies of his own dead body.

items.title: Bad Match
items.description: An internet-dating playboy's life spirals out of control after meeting a woman online.

items.title: G.I. Joe: El origen de Cobra
items.description: Son los G.I. Joe, una fuerza de intervención de élite de alto secreto formada por los mejores agentes de todo el mundo. Después de que la malvada Cobra haya robado un arma secreta, los G.I. Joe deben impedir que Cobra sumerja al mundo en el caos.

items.title: Proyecto Géminis
items.description: Will Smith protagoniza esta trepidante película de acción del director ganador de un Óscar Ang Lee. Un asesino a sueldo retirado (Smith) se ve obligado a huir y acaba siendo perseguido por su mayor adversario: un clon más joven de sí mismo.

items.title: Eden
items.description: Set in 1940s Palestine, Samantha and her husband Dov, both of American descent, have immigrated due to their Zionist convictions.

items.title: Being Rose
items.description: A widowed ex-cop (Cybill Shepherd) discovers that she may have a life-threatening illness, and decides to go on a solo road trip. On her journey, Rose meets Max (James Brolin), an old cowboy, who comes to a crossroads of his own.

items.title: Fiddler's Journey to the Big Screen
items.description: Narrated by Jeff Goldblum, "Fiddler's Journey to the Big Screen" explores Norman Jewison's quest to recreate Jewish life in Tsarist Russia and transform the beloved stage hit into a wide-screen cinematic epic.

items.title: The Idolmaker (1980)
items.description: Vinnie Vacarri (Ray Sharkey) has the songs and the voice. He just doesn’t have the face of a teen idol. But Vinnie has a plan: if he can’t be an idol...he’ll create them! Peter Gallagher and Paul Land also star in this parable of ambition and fame.

items.title: Film, The Living Record of Our Memory
items.description: This documentary argues for the importance of film preservation through the voices of archivists, curators, technicians, and filmmakers.

items.title: Full Grown Men
items.description: A man stuck in the reveries of his youth tracks down the boyhood friend he once tormented, only to find that simpler times were more complicated than he thought.

items.title: Finding Fela
items.description: Academy Award-winning director Alex Gibney, tells the remarkable story of Fela Kuti's life, his music, and his social and political importance.

items.title: Frightmare
items.description: A former mental asylum patient lives in a remote farmhouse where she tells fortunes, but the kind, maternal exterior conceals a dreadful monster.

items.title: The Favor
items.description: On the eve of her high school reunion, Harley Jane Kozak convinces best friend Elizabeth McGovern to seduce an old flame, Ken Wahl, so she can get all the juicy details. But when McGovern falls for Wahl, it's like high school all over again!

items.title: Still Breathing
items.description: When artist and street performer Fletcher (Brendan Fraser) thinks con-artist Roz (Joanna Going) is the woman he has seen in a vision, he has no idea she sees him as her next victim.

items.title: Benched
items.description: Local baseball coaching legend Don (John C. McGinley) gets inexperienced Michael (Garret Dillahunt) as his new assistant coach. Over the season, Don knocks heads with Michael and a bunch of mismatched kids come together as a team.

items.title: Grand Slam
items.description: A quiet schoolteacher recruits an elite team of international criminals for the ultimate diamond caper at the frenzied peak of Carnival.

items.title: Hercules in the Haunted World
items.description: Hercules must journey to the bowels of Hell to recover a magical plant to save a dying princess.

items.title: Cbeebies Christmas Show: The Night Before Christmas
items.description: Audiences will follow the adventures of Holly and her brother, Jack on Christmas Eve, as they send their wishes to Father Christmas.

items.title: Bundles
items.description: After successfully seeing through the perfect plot for revenge, four young ladies find a lucrative business venture to be made of what was supposed to be a one-time payback to put a bully in her place.

items.title: The Taking Of Deborah Logan
items.description: Deborah Logan, a woman battling Alzheimer's, allows a film crew to document her condition. As filming progresses, the crew notes that whatever is within her is trying to get out, and it threatens to consume anyone who tries to stop it.

items.title: Jugando con fuego
items.description: Cuando el bombero Jake Carson (John Cena) y su equipo (Keegan-Michael Key y John Leguizamo) rescatan a tres hermanos que se encontraban en la trayectoria de un incendio forestal.

items.title: The Big Black Comedy Show, Vol. 1
items.description: Two-time Image Award-winning comedian/actress Mo'Nique hosts this 2004 comedy show with the outrageously funny Rodney Perry as her co-host. The all-star lineup features Esau, Doug Williams, DeRay Davis, and Chris Spencer.

items.title: BAB
items.description: In a dying 1950's town, a mysterious traveler propositions a young farmhand, Donnie, to help take down the town's tyrannical leader in exchange for the release of Donnie's mother from a primitive mind rehabilitation center.

items.title: Absolute Killers
items.description: Johnny Graham, raised by a crime family, betrays them to save a prosecutor and enters witness protection. When the vengeful heir escapes, Johnny must protect other targets—and himself—while confronting his past and finding unexpected allies.

items.title: Screamboat
items.description: On the last ferry of the night in New York, passengers and crew are hunted by a merciless rat, and what should have been a peaceful crossing turns into a bloody massacre.

items.title: A Girl Like Him
items.description: A Girl Like Him is a coming-of-age drama centered around a small-town teen who makes a surprising life change, spiraling their lifelong best friend into a dark place when he realizes things will never be the same between them.

items.title: Battle of The Bulge: Winter War
items.description: Lt. Robert Cappa and his platoon of 2nd Infantry Division soldiers must defend a vital supply depot from being captured by attacking German soldiers.

items.title: 700 Feet Down
items.description: The Tacoma Narrows Bridge garnered fame from its 1940 demise. The story of Galloping Gertie is told through intrepid divers exploring a reef of wreckage and witnesses of the bridge’s collapse, ultimately reflecting on how history influences the present.

items.title: Big Kill
items.description: A tenderfoot from Philadelphia, two misfit gamblers on the run, and a deadly preacher have a date with destiny in a boom town gone bust called Big Kill.

items.title: Awake
items.description: A man wakes in a hospital bed with no recollection of who he is, and learns that he's wanted by the police for a committing a series of murders.

items.title: Breathing Happy
items.description: In this mind-bending drama, a recovering addict is ready to celebrate a year of sobriety on Christmas Day. But his past demons tempt him to fail, including a talking golden door, his ex-drug dealer, and magic tricks. Will he experience relapse or rebirth?

items.title: Dawning
items.description: A trauma therapist is forced to face her family's dark past when she returns to her childhood countryside farm to console her heartbroken younger sister.

items.title: Built to Kill
items.description: Built to Kill is an edgy, hyper-stylish horror anthology about people pushed, pulled, and driven to kill...

items.title: Distancing Socially
items.description: A series of comical vignettes that share a telecommunications app as a common thread weave loosely connected human interactions – from food delivery to family drama – taking place virtually across a world in lockdown.

items.title: Family Dinner
items.description: An overweight teenager spends the holidays at her aunt's farm in the hope of getting help to lose weight, but soon after her arrival, she begins to suspect that something is very wrong at this place.

items.title: GILT
items.description: An entrepreneur has his philanthropic startup acquired in a hostile takeover. Now he must successfully pilot the launch of an app for the 1% in order to save his company.

items.title: Gothic Harvest
items.description: When a young woman disappears during Mardi Gras, her friends race to find her before she falls victim to a sadistic Southern family plagued by a centuries old voodoo curse.

items.title: I'm In Love With A Church Girl
items.description: Miles Montego was king of the streets as a high-level drug trafficker. When Miles meets Vanessa, he’s drawn to her beauty and her spirituality. As their connection grows, both are tested to their last ounce of faith in God in each other.

items.title: Kill-Fist
items.description: A struggling middle-aged insurance salesman and failed family man joins an underground fight club to redeem himself. As he progresses through the fights, he finds his true potential and faces his dark past that he has forgotten.

items.title: Killing Beef
items.description: After recovering from a near fatal shooting, former drug dealer and award-winning journalist Samson Styles searches to find meaning in his life and reconciliation with his shooter, in this journey that takes the form of a life-lesson told to a young boy.

items.title: Mission of Honor
items.description: Mission of Honor is the story of Hurricane Squadron 303, a group of brave pilots who fought in the skies over England in WW2 during the Battle of Britain.

items.title: Onyx the Fortuitous and the Talisman of Souls
items.description: Amateur occultist Onyx the Fortuitous lands a coveted invitation to the mansion of Bartok the Great. As he and a fellow group of devotees join Bartok to take part in a mysterious ritual, the getaway of Onyx's dreams soon takes a nightmarish turn.

items.title: Spy Intervention
items.description: When the world's greatest spy meets the woman of his dreams, he abandons his adventurous existence and settles into the security of suburbia.

items.title: Red 11
items.description: This thriller is based on the research hospital where Robert Rodriguez sold his body to finance his first film, El Mariachi, for $7,000. 'Red 11' is the shirt color and number he was assigned.

items.title: When the Screaming Starts
items.description: Aidan Mendle has a dream; he aspires to be an infamous serial killer. When struggling journalist Norman is invited to follow Aidan on his journey, he believes he has found the subject for the documentary that will transform his failing career.

items.title: Country Gold
items.description: In this fantasy comedy, two country-music legends meet for one wild night in Nashville, 1994: Troyal, an up-and-comer from Oklahoma who likes his steaks well done, and the washed-up, viper-tongued George Jones, who will be cryogenically frozen tomorrow.

items.title: Little Dead Rotting Hood
items.description: The residents of a small town discover that something more sinister than killer wolves is lurking in the backwoods: first the wolves start turning up dead...then people.

items.title: The Toughest Gun In Tombstone
items.description: In lawless 1880s Arizona, an undercover captain infiltrates the West's most notorious outlaw gang. Building a ruthless reputation while hiding his true identity, he plays a deadly game of deception to bring down the brutal crew of killers.

items.title: Valmont
items.description: Based on the classic novel Les Liaisons Dangereuses, this delectable thriller stars Colin Firth and Annette Bening as embittered aristocrats who weave a wicked web of cruel intentions and savage seductions. Directed by the great Milos Forman.

items.title: The Assassin's Code
items.description: A rookie detective, son of a dead disgraced cop, works to solve his first major case while under the watchful eye of a ghost-like assassin.

items.title: To Be Free The Lion's Den
items.description: A troubled divorce' grappling with depression must confront his inner demons and navigate complex relationships to find meaning in life and be free.

items.title: The Dallas Connection
items.description: Scientists are being assassinated by a deadly team of stunning beauties. A team of federal agents are sent to protect the last surviving scientist.

items.title: Story of Woo Viet
items.description: Wu Viet is a Vietnamese refugee who wants to leave his country behind and start over in the United States. First, he must make his way to Hong Kong, but as he passes through Thailand, he meets a beautiful woman who travels with him.

items.title: Galileo
items.description: Bertolt Brecht's famous interpretation of the troubled life and anxious times of 17th century physicist and astronomer Galileo Galilei (Topol).

items.title: George: The Story of George Maciunas & Fluxus
items.description: A rich portrait of artist George Maciunas that features fascinatingly contradictory interviews with artists Yoko Ono, Jonas Mekas, and Nam June Paik.

items.title: Guest of Honour
items.description: Jim and his daughter Veronica, a high school music teacher, attempt to unravel their complicated histories and intertwined secrets.

items.title: Grace Jones: Bloodlight and Bami
items.description: An electrifying journey through the public and private worlds of mega-icon Grace Jones, brimming with the glam-pop diva's bold aesthetic.

items.title: Home Before Midnight
items.description: A rockstar becomes romantically involved with a teenage girl. Her parents take action against him.

items.title: House of Mortal Sin (The Confessional)
items.description: A deranged priest takes it upon himself to punish his parishioners for their moral transgressions.

items.title: House of Whipcord
items.description: A model is sent to a reform school to stifle her sexual liberation.

items.title: I've Heard the Mermaids Singing
items.description: Patricia Rozema's charming, whimsical story about a waifish daydreamer with artistic aspirations is structured around a video-recorded confession.

items.title: Museum Town
items.description: With narration by Meryl Streep, this documentary uncovers the history of how MASS MoCA became the largest museum for contemporary art in the world.

items.title: Nationtime
items.description: Narrated by Sidney Poitier and Harry Belafonte, "Nationtime" is a report on the National Black Political Convention held in Gary, Indiana in 1972.

items.title: On Broadway
items.description: An all-star cast, including Hugh Jackman and Viola Davis, tell the story of the last time Broadway came back from the brink, reviving New York City.

items.title: Out of My Head
items.description: A filmmaker seeking treatment for her daughter's migraine attacks discovers a confounding neurological disease afflicting nearly a billion worldwide.

items.title: Philadelphia, Here I Come!
items.description: The American Film Theatre presents an ingenious glimpse into the stock-taking of young Gar O'Donnell on the eve of his emigration to America.

items.title: Playdurizm
items.description: A teenager finds himself caught in a glitchy-glitzy reality with his on-screen male idol.

items.title: Rhinoceros
items.description: Gene Wilder and Zero Mostel star in Eugene Ionesco's absurdist play about a French city where citizens begin to mysteriously turn into rhinoceroses.

items.title: In Case of Emergency
items.description: Follow emergency nurses and their patients across the U.S., from urban to rural, on some of the biggest health care crises facing Americans today.

items.title: Rude Boy
items.description: Merging documentary and fiction, "Rude Boy" follows a roadie for The Clash, seen in this film at the dizzying peak of their rock 'n' roll powers.

items.title: In Celebration

items.title: Bonneville

items.title: Born to Fly: Elizabeth Streb vs. Gravity
items.description: Trace the evolution of Elizabeth Streb's movement philosophy as she pushes herself and her performers from the ground to the sky.

items.description: A musician dreams of fame, but schmoozing a girl he can’t stand to land a record deal may be his toughest gig yet.

items.description: "Can You Bring It" follows the creation of Bill T. Jones's tour de force ballet D-Man in the Waters, a landmark of the AIDS crisis.

items.title: Chef Flynn
items.description: A teen chef sets out to challenge the hierarchy of the culinary world after he transforms his living room into a supper club.

items.title: Code of the Freaks
items.description: In an unprecedented look inside the disabled community, “Code of the Freaks” gives the mic to some of Hollywood's most incensed and ignored critics.

items.title: Affair in Monte Carlo
items.description: A writer tells a crowd in a café about a woman he knows who once fell deeply in love with a desperate, compulsive gambler.

items.title: Beyond
items.description: A veteran investigator teams up with a TV psychic who claims to see visions of a missing child.

items.title: Coming Apart
items.description: Rip Torn gives one of his greatest performances as a psychiatrist secretly filming his own mental breakdown in Milton Moses Ginsberg's classic.

items.title: Dark Whispers: Volume 1
items.description: Five intertwined stories, connected by themes of love and redemption, play out at a local bar.

items.title: Driven to Kill
items.description: An ex-Russian mobster who is now a crime novelist must confront his past when his family is targeted by violence.

items.title: Amanda and the Fox

items.title: Lavender Men
items.description: A tiny theater's stage manager daydreams about Abraham Lincoln's gay love affair to escape their own loneliness.

items.title: The Queens: Quest for the Crown
items.description: Female impersonators and transgender women compete in the world's most famous pageant of its kind, the Miss Continental.

items.title: Julia Child's Kitchen Wisdom
items.description: Julia Child's Kitchen Wisdom is a heartfelt tribute to Julia Child's culinary legacy, featuring her favorite recipes and techniques through personal anecdotes and television clips.

items.title: We Forgot to Break Up
items.description: A band of misfits ditches their small town to chase their dreams as indie rock gods in the big city.

items.title: National Lampoon's - The Don's Analyst
items.description: A harried mobster seeks psychiatric help when his family--and the family business--begin driving him crazy.

items.title: Blow-Ins
items.description: A study of the 'blow-ins' of Dingle, Ireland - people from different towns, cities and countries who have relocated to the area.

items.description: After their father leaves his estate to the Indigenous community of Bird, Adam and Ryan head north to reclaim it - only to face challenges that lead them toward unexpected truths.

items.title: City Of Joel
items.description: A land dispute between an ultra-orthodox Hassidic sect and their secular neighbors erupts into a turf war in the town of Monroe.

items.description: Comedian/actress Mo'Nique returns to host this all-star lineup which includes Sexy Mario, Rodman, Vince Morris, and Ralphie May. Once again her Co-host is the one and only Rodney Perry.

items.title: Container Ship XXL
items.description: Witness how technological visions become reality with the largest container ship the world has ever seen.

items.title: Daniel Day-Lewis: The Hollywood Genius
items.description: Uncover the story of the 3-time Oscar winner and actor, Daniel Day-Lewis, who decided to quit the industry after intense roles directed by legends such as Scorsese and Spielberg.

items.title: Denzel Washington: An American Model
items.description: In 30 years of a committed career and 50 roles, Denzel Washington, double-Oscar winner, placed the figure of the Black man at the heart of the American paradoxes.

items.title: Onlyfangs
items.description: An aspiring monster hunter joins forces with vampire women to launch a predatory app.

items.title: Bitter Harvest
items.description: After burying his father, Travis is pursued by two beautiful women: hitchhiker Kelly and the mysterious Jolene. However, both women have hidden agendas, and their interest in Travis masks a secret, ulterior motive.

items.title: The Quiet Ones
items.description: A broke girl joins a wild social media crew to make cash fast, but clashing egos turn success into deadly chaos.

items.title: Walter, Grace & The Submarine
items.description: Walter is new in town. Grace is leaving town. After sparking an untimely connection, two artists dive a bit too deep.

items.title: Suck It Up Buttercup
items.description: A former honor student, newly addicted to prescription pills, triggers a chain of events that devastates her friends and threatens to tear her family apart.

items.title: D-Day Assassins
items.description: In 1944, a rebellious group of American soldiers known as "The Filthy Thirteen" are selected to be the first unit to parachute behind German lines during the invasion of Normandy.

items.title: Crow
items.description: A wealthy Developer tries to remove settlers from his newly acquired land, which leads to dire consequences.

items.title: Wing Chun
items.description: Wing Chun, a talented martial artist, decides to fight against horse thieves in the village to receive respect from the villagers.

items.title: 12-Round Gun
items.description: A washed up, alcoholic ex-prizefighter makes a comeback to boxing after his top heavyweight contender son is wrongfully blinded in the ring.

items.title: Charlie's Ghost Story
items.description: Archaeologist Dave unearths Coronado's skeleton, but the explorer's ghost begins haunting Dave's son, Charlie. To find peace, the spirit recruits a terrified Charlie to help steal his remains from the museum and bury them on holy ground.

items.title: Adventures in Public School
items.description: A socially awkward home-schooled kid forces his way into public-school when he falls for the popular one-legged girl (Siobhan Williams). Much to his mother's (Judy Greer) chagrin, he gets a crash course in sex, drugs, and social mayhem.

items.description: When Valerie returns home from prison years after killing her neighbor in an apparent drunk driving accident, she wants nothing more than to move on- until the victim's son shows up at her door. It becomes clear that the past is not easily forgotten.

items.title: Dark Space
items.description: After a shuttle crash strands six friends on a mysterious planet, they face a double threat: ferocious alien predators and a heavily-armed military force. To survive, the group must navigate the hostile terrain and find a way to escape.

items.title: Deserted
items.description: Ex-con Jae returns home after serving time for matricide. Seeking escape, she joins her brother on a road trip into Death Valley, but the pair becomes hopelessly lost in the beautiful yet lethal desert terrain.

items.title: Respect The Jux
items.description: A corrupted young man ventures to the United States in quest of the American Dream and forms a band of robbers to obtain it.

items.title: Fleshtone
items.description: A painter plays erotic games by phone and finds himself involved in a complex conspiracy.

items.title: The Manifestation
items.description: A desperate day trader manifests a twin version of his wife to help him build a fortune on the stock market but discovers that she may have a much darker agenda as she threatens to take everything from him, even his life.

items.title: Jamie Lee Curtis: Hollywood Call Of Freedom
items.description: Heroine of the Halloween film series, or accomplice of a crazy scam in A Fish Called Wanda, Jamie Lee Curtis is, at 62, still as credible, funny, and a wildly free pop actress.

items.title: Johnny Depp: Wild Child
items.description: From Edward Scissorhands to Jack Sparrow, Johnny Depp is known for his eclectic and unconventional film choices. Discover the man behind the Hollywood icon.

items.title: Kate Winslet: A Quest For Authenticity
items.description: Internationally acclaimed at only 22 thanks to her role in Titanic, Kate Winslet has forged her own path by choosing roles of complex women.

items.title: Sharon Stone: Survival Instinct
items.description: She embodies the independent woman of the 21st century, who refuses to be invisibilized and a passive object, subjected only to the male gaze.

items.title: Crown of Shadows
items.description: Exiled Prince Elderon joins a rebellion and summons a dragon to defeat the Evil Queen and the Dark Gods she serves.

items.title: Red Flag
items.description: A newly single filmmaker hits the road with an old friend to promote one of his films, but romantic chaos ensues when an adoring fan decides to come along for the ride.

items.title: Curse Of Robert The Doll
items.description: Cash-strapped student Emily Barker takes a night cleaning job at the East Falls Museum, only to learn a vintage doll comes alive after hours. As bodies pile up and suspicion turns on her, she may be the doll's next victim.

items.title: Deep Hatred
items.description: Upon returning home after the death of her father, Cindy soon realises that the house hides a terrible secret that puts her and her friends in danger.

items.title: Doe
items.description: A man wakes up with no memory of his past but the ability to speak dozens of languages fluently.

items.title: Don't Say Its Name
items.description: A vengeful creature, connected to a controversial mining operation, creates a wave of fear across an indigenous reservation.

items.title: Gravity
items.description: On a seemingly routine spacewalk, disaster strikes, leaving two astronauts completely alone. As the deafening silence tells them they have lost any link to Earth, the only way home may be to go further into the terrifying expanse of space.

items.title: River's End: California's Latest Water War
items.description: River's End reveals California's complex struggle over who gets fresh water, and how moneyed interests game the system. Constant battling over uncertain water supplies heralds an impending crisis—not just in California, but around the world.

items.title: Tell Me No Lies
items.description: In a small town, the police chief’s son and his friends exploit local girls and silence anyone who threatens to expose them—until one victim’s mother fights back, forcing the chief to choose between justice and his own son.

items.title: Dragon Knight
items.description: When a evil force takes hold in the Kingdom of Agonos, a knight must embark on a perilous quest to find the last dragon and save the world.

items.title: Dream Story
items.description: A jealous husband dives into Berlin's erotic underworld after his wife's confession, blurring fantasy, desire, and reality.

items.title: Family Possessions
items.description: After moving into the home of a deceased relative, a family discovers they may have inherited more than just the house.

items.title: White Lie
items.description: A popular undergrad faking cancer struggles to maintain her secret.

items.title: Deconstructing Harry
items.description: Suffering from writer's block and eagerly awaiting his writing award, Harry Block remembers events from his past and scenes from his best-selling books as characters, real and fictional, come back to haunt him.

items.title: Die Alone
items.description: In a world overrun by plant-infested undead, amnesiac Ethan joins survivalist Mae to find his missing girlfriend. As memories and truths collide, their bond deepens amidst chilling revelations and a haunting twist.

items.title: Illusions
items.description: Greg helps his wife Jan recover from a breakdown, but their peace is shattered by his mysterious sister, Laura. Jan suspects their siblings bond is physical, and her descent into paranoia deepens when the landlord reacts strangely to her.

items.title: Everyone Says I Love You
items.description: D.J. has to contend with her extended family after her parents' divorce. The entire clan is abuzz about the impending wedding of her half-sister and fiance. Gruff former criminal Charlie enters the picture and things take a turn.

items.title: Anaconda: Blood Coil
items.description: A group of friends are terrorized by an anaconda during their vacation.

items.title: Hazard
items.description: In a struggling Appalachian town ravaged by opioids, a former addict-turned-dealer risks everything to keep his family together. As the crisis escalates, he's forced to choose between survival and redemption.

items.title: Daphne
items.description: Hectic days and late nights. Daphne is caught in the daily rush of her restaurant job and a nightlife kaleidoscope of new faces. She is witty, funny and the life of the party.

items.title: The Other
items.description: Robin and Daniel, desperate to build a family, foster mute Kathelia, whose terrifying past resurfaces with paranormal force. Their loving home spirals into a psychological nightmare of grief, guilt, and survival.

items.title: Safeguard: An Electoral College Story
items.description: A nonpartisan documentary exploring how the U.S. Electoral College works, what could change, and how democracy can balance majority rule with minority rights.

items.title: Warrior King
items.description: In this epic true story, a young man grows up in exile in a world overrun by demons and monsters. When evil forces threaten his home, he returns to save his people and fulfill his destiny as a great hero and ruler.

items.title: Just Jim

items.title: Easy Living
items.description: Sherry Graham, a self-destructive makeup saleswoman, hopes a new man and business venture will provide her a fresh start. When her plains are foiled, she takes control of her life in a dramatic turn of events.

items.description: An instance of violence catapults a young woman into a comedic misfit journey of redemptive makeover via Mixed Martial Arts while stumbling into true love.

items.title: Viking

items.title: Peter Five Eight
items.description: A seemingly glamorous real estate agent in a small mountain community is revealed to be an unhinged alcoholic with a dark secret when a charismatic man in black shows up one day at the behest of his shadowy boss.

items.title: 47 Bombs
items.description: When an explosion kills a cop, the investigation leads homicide officer Gebels to a bomb maker, initiating a confrontation and all-out war.

items.title: A Sunday Horse
items.description: After a near-fatal accident, a determined rider defies all the odds, to pursue her dreams of winning a national horse jumping championship.

items.title: La venganza de la niñera
items.description: Cuando una pareja con dos hijos recibe a una niñera que parece dulce y capaz, no imaginan que su llegada destapará planes ocultos y secretos siniestros, arrastrando a la familia a una aterradora pesadilla.

items.title: Aladdin's Revenge
items.description: The cursed lamp returns at a retreat, and Rachel must save new friends from its deadly wishes.

items.title: Amityvillenado
items.description: A storm destroys the DeFeo house, unleashing a paranormal tornado that terrorizes Amityville.

items.title: The Remake
items.description: Two veteran actors try to rekindle their romance when hired to act in an updated remake of their original 70s cult film only to discover their on-screen chemistry needs an upgrade if there is going to be any off-screen romance.

items.title: Aladdin
items.description: Four friends dream getaway unravels when a wish-granting lamp reveals its dark curse.

items.title: Alcatraz
items.description: A group of prisoners, led by an armed robber and a gangster, attempt to escape from the infamous Alcatraz Island.

items.title: Alien: Battlefield Earth
items.description: Aliens invade Earth after the U.S. military shoot down one of their ships. Seeking to rescue their comrades, the Aliens instead encounter an aggressive American administration who will stop at nothing to obliterate the inter-galactic threat.

items.description: Sergeant Peckham investigates a prostitute killing her clients. Her boyfriend, psychologist David, begins treating Felicity, an amnesiac who dreams of murdering her lovers. Blinded by lust, David fails to see she is the prime suspect.

items.title: Apparitions
items.description: A woman, with only fleeting and terrifying childhood memories, returns to her family home to uncover what happened to her parents.

items.title: La última ubicación conocida
items.description: Tres mujeres de mundos distintos desaparecen misteriosamente. Mientras los detectives luchan por encontrar una conexión, ellas forman un vínculo inesperado que se convierte en la clave para su supervivencia.

items.title: Spaghetti Junction
items.description: A recently disabled teenager encounters a cosmic traveler who needs her help.

items.title: Skydancers
items.description: Female pilots perform aerial stunts during the 27th World Aerobatics Championships in Texas, one of the world's most prestigious aerobatic competitions.

items.title: Alien Paranormal: Ufos and Bizarre Encounters
items.description: Learn new information from alien occultists to shocking alien encounters, from reverse engineering to military deals with grey aliens and Project Sigma.

items.title: Alien Portals: Time Travel, Prophecy and Missing People
items.description: Explore other dimensions and the methods that Ancient Man used them, including real ancient time machines that were constructed based on Egyptian secret knowledge.

items.title: Age Of Kill
items.description: A black ops sniper is blackmailed into killing 6 unrelated people in 6 hours by a psychotic international terrorist, but there is more to the victims than meets the eye.

items.title: Alien Top 20: Mind Bending UFO Encounters
items.description: Prepare for a series of stunning accounts of UFO and alien encounters across vast regions, times, and cultures that present an astonishing truth.

items.title: Aliens and the New World Order: The Cosmic Conspiracy
items.description: Did Ancient Aliens come to Earth, create humans, and control us throughout history? Jim Marrs explores our occulted history, discovering how ancient aliens may still be in control today.

items.title: Marc Jacobs & Louis Vuitton

items.title: Purgatory
items.description: Two female Peace Corps volunteers in Africa are wrongfully sent to prison where one dies and the other has to escape.

items.title: Mother Teresa: No Greater Love

items.title: Mimesis

items.title: Spirit
items.description: With the help of a spirit who departed the earth years earlier, a teenage girl learns compassion and self-forgiveness while she tries to deal with her mother's tragic death, and the unexplained events that surround her family in their new town.

items.title: Sorority
items.description: Sorority explores the lives and relationships of two sisters; Sarah, a talented writer on the verge of attending Oxford University; and Harriet, who dreams of escaping the confines of her upbringing.

items.title: Minotaur
items.description: When the villagers offer their brethren as a sacrifice to the Minotaur, Theo sets off on a harrowing quest to the labyrinth to kill the evil bull-god.

items.title: The Creepy Line
items.description: A behind the scenes look at free media services, like Google and Facebook, whose manipulative effects are undermining democracy with user's free will.

items.title: Point Man
items.description: A trio of soldiers vow revenge on their platoon when they are left behind enemy lines. When they come across a missing contingent in a Vietnamese village, alliances dissolve and each step forward will come with a price.

items.title: Mischief Night
items.description: The night before Halloween, a teenage babysitter is stalked by a masked killer, but in an unusual turn of events, victim and victimizer begin to develop romantic feelings for each other.

items.title: Morning
items.description: Overwhelming grief threatens to tear a man and his wife apart as they try to come to grips with the loss of their child.

items.title: Blind Revenge
items.description: Sir Paul, a distinguished author, blinded in a horrific accident, advertises for an amanuensis, an assistant to help him with his writing.

items.title: Shiner
items.description: Aspiring MMA fighter Matt teams up with flashy ex-champ Happy McBride. Despite clashing agendas, they confront personal struggles, with Happy's daughter, Matt's girlfriend, acting as their unlikely mediator.

items.title: Not Since You
items.description: A romantic drama about a tight-knit group of college friends who graduated from NYU and reunite years later for a weekend wedding in Georgia.

items.title: Fail State

items.title: Last Fist of Fury
items.description: Dae-dong has recently been appointed as the leader of the Ching Wu Martial Arts gym. He faces a challenge from the Japanese and ultimately meets his demise.

items.title: Master of Death
items.description: After training for 18 years with a shaolin monk, Chow sets off to take revenge on the men that killed his family.

items.title: Folk Hero & Funny Guy
items.description: Struggling stand-up comedian Paul hits the road to open for his successful rocker buddy Jason in this music-infused spin on the road-trip comedy. Bonds are tested when songbird, Bryn, joins the tour and Jason's ulterior motive is revealed.

items.title: Daughter of the Bride
items.description: A daughter tries to sabotage her mother's wedding while navigating her own love life and career woes.

items.title: Tierra Dulce
items.description: Tras huir de una secta religiosa, Remy es acogida por trabajadoras sexuales en paradas de camiones. Cuando un asesino enmascarado las ataca, la supervivencia se vuelve una lucha desesperada en la oscuridad.

items.title: Gacy: El vecino asesino
items.description: Una historia suburbana de terror sobre un adolescente, Bobby, que se vuelve demasiado curioso cuando el infame asesino en serie John Wayne Gacy se muda frente a su casa.

items.title: Project MKHEXE
items.description: In this found-footage thriller, an amateur filmmaker uncovers his dead brother’s obsession with an Internet urban legend, Project MKHEXE. But as his grief begins to blur reality, he discovers the horrific truth behind What We Fear, We Create.

items.title: Sleep Stalker
items.description: An influencer couple's dream remodel turns nightmarish when the husband's violent sleepwalking reveals a dark past tied to the haunted home.

items.title: The Worst Crime
items.description: Johnny Johnson was charged with the abduction and murder of 6-year-old Cassandra Williamson. During the capital murder trial, a juror described the killing as the worst possible crime. Does the worst possible crime warrant the worst possible punishment?

items.title: Rusty
items.description: After being released from prison, Rusty McCaan struggles to find work in a rural American town. While trying to be a father to his four-year-old daughter, he finds solace in the arms of a free-spirited truck stop sex worker.

items.title: Safe Corridor
items.description: Based on real events that occurred during the Russian military intervention in Georgia in 2008. Shindisi is the name of the location where Russian occupation forces besieged Georgian military after a peace corridor was promised.

items.title: Saltwater: The Battle of Ramree Island
items.description: During the last months of WWII, an Allied mission to regain Ramree Island off the coast of Burma ends in horror when a group of soldiers find themselves trapped in dense swampland infested with deadly saltwater crocodiles. Inspired by actual events.

items.title: Nine Venoms
items.description: After selling his soul to the devil, Joey is given the power to control 9 demons. With their help, Joey must save his childhood friend Gary from a bloody massacre.

items.title: Secret Weapon
items.description: A small group of WWII soldiers is on a mission to prevent the secret weapon "Katyusha" from getting into the hands of the Germans.

items.title: Return of the Chinese Boxer
items.description: In wake of the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), a group of Japanese warlords calculate the best way to prepare an invasion of the rest of China is from their southern Manchuria staging ground.

items.title: Ship of the Damned
items.description: A 400-year-old pirate ship appears off the coast, and the ship's cursed pirate crew has horrific plans for any intruders.

items.title: The Pages of My Heart
items.description: Struggling actress Aaliyah finds love with a charming writer, but secrets and tragedy force her to choose between playing it safe or risking it all for a fresh start.

items.title: This Is Our Everything
items.description: The Guajajara people decide not to stand idly by while their land and that of the uncontacted Awá people is being destroyed. They create a group of forest guardians who are determined to defend the Amazon rainforest - if necessary with their own lives.

items.title: Uncontained
items.description: A mysterious drifter struggles to protect an abandoned boy and his little sister from an infection that turns people into a feral-like state and a ruthless militia leader searching for his missing daughter.

items.title: AC/DC: Back in Black
items.description: AC/DC had just lost legendary frontman Bon Scott. This would have been the end of the line

items.title: Apocalypse Clown
items.description: Jean DuCoque's death unites Bobo, Pepe, and Funzo, a trio of misfit clowns. After a brawl that lands them in jail, they face nationwide anarchy triggered by a solar flare.

items.title: The Queen (1968)
items.description: The 1967 Miss All-American Camp Beauty Pageant introduced audiences to competitive drag.

items.title: Pitching Tents
items.description: A mysterious goddess, a vulgar guidance counselor and a no-nonsense father all want to help Danny figure out his future while he sneaks off to the woods with his buddies for a weekend of girls, beer and THE party of 1984.

items.title: The Southerner
items.description: In Jean Renor's portrait of American rural life, an idealistic farmer struggles to raise a family and a crop of cotton in the face of many challenges.

items.title: Play It Cool
items.description: With a record player in his hand and a price on his head, he wasn't looking for trouble...but trouble came looking for him.

items.title: Blood Orange

items.title: The Problem with People
items.description: When dying wishes reunite distant cousins Barry (NYC) and Ciáran (Ireland), they face decades of family grudges—with laughs, sheep, scenic landscapes, and hopeful steps toward peace.

items.description: Dans been HIV positive for 22 years. Hes got his $3,000-a-month pill regimen down, but when he deposits a $100 birthday check and suddenly doesnt qualify for his assisted healthcare plan, hes got to scramble to get his life together or risk losing it.
