items.title: Everything Went Fine
items.description: Andre Dussollier and Sophie Marceau star in François Ozon's powerful family drama about a daughter forced to reconcile her past with her father after he suffers a debilitating stroke and contacts her with a devastating final wish.

items.title: Bad Men Must Bleed
items.description: When a young girl's family is murdered by a gang of outlaws, a reluctant fugitive becomes her unlikely protector and sets out to track down the men who destroyed her life.

items.title: Grindhouse: Planet Terror/Death Proof
items.description: In this Robert Rodriguez/Quentin Tarantino tribute to ’70s exploitation films, a go-go dancer kills zombies in Planet Terror, and a stuntman stalks and kills women in Death Proof.

items.title: XXX: Return of Xander Cage
items.description: Xander Cage is left for dead after an incident, though he secretly returns to action for a new, tough assignment with his handler Augustus Gibbons.

items.title: Escobank
items.description: A notorious group of criminals, each with a haunting past, found themselves in desperate need of cash for their own reasons.

items.title: The Prey
items.description: A convicted bank robber breaks out of prison to protect his family after confiding sensitive information to a fellow cellmate, only to realize he's actually a madman who will stop at nothing to get what he wants.

items.title: The Insult
items.description: In today's Beirut, an insult blown out of proportion finds Tony (Adel Karam), a Lebanese Christian, and Yasser (Kamel El Basha), a Palestinian refugee in court.

items.title: Expresso Bongo
items.description: New restoration of this Fifties British rock and roll classic, a fast-paced story about a cheap, opportunistic Soho talent agent who always looks for the quick buck.

items.title: Baby Geniuses and the Treasures of Egypt
items.description: A group of baby-detectives travel to Egypt to track down the criminal mastermind known as Big Baby.

items.title: The Last Movie
items.description: Dennis Hopper's radical, much-mythologized follow up to Easy Rider follows a stuntman named Kansas (played by Hopper) who remains in Peru after a Hollywood movie wraps, attempting to find redemption in the arms of a former prostitute.

items.title: The Gang of Four
items.description: This Jacques Rivette classic follows the lives and experiences of four young women in school for acting.

items.title: The Europeans
items.description: The lives and routines of the puritanical Wentworth family are upended by the not-so-welcome arrival of their European cousins to New England one particularly golden autumn.

items.title: Faces Places
items.description: Agnes Varda and artist, JR, travel around the villages of France in a photo truck meeting locals, learning their stories and producing epic-size portraits of them.

items.title: Farewell, My Queen
items.description: Farewell, My Queen marks the return of acclaimed director Benoît Jacquot and brilliantly captures the chaos that engulfed the court of Marie Antoinette before the outbreak of Revolution.

items.title: Inglourious Basterds (2009)
items.description: An American officer is in charge of an all-Jewish squad known as The Basterds and is tasked with the mission of killing as many Nazi troops as possible.

items.title: Maserati: A Hundred Years Against All Odds
items.description: This fast-paced documentary chronicles the origins, history, and unique evolution of the Maserati automobile brand over the past century, from a small garage in Italy, to prestigious car shows and races around the world.

items.title: The Day The Earth Caught Fire
items.description: A London journalist (Edward Judd) investigates the world's increasingly ferocious weather conditions and discovers that the Earth has been knocked off its axis by extensive nuclear testing. Is the Earth doomed?

items.title: Fire Over England
items.description: During the reign of England's Queen Elizabeth I, a naval officer spies on the Spanish and discovers their plans to send the Armada against England. This wins him the love of the Queen's lady-in-waiting as he takes the British fleet into battle.

items.title: Monsieur Hire
items.description: Cohen Film Collection presents a new 4K restoration of this erotic thriller. A young girl is brutally murdered. The prime suspect is a cold, reclusive man obsessed with his beautiful neighbor.

items.title: Manny Pacquiao: Unstoppable Force
items.description: While the sport of boxing requires sacrifice, discipline, concentration, and determination for Manny Pacquiao, it was survival.

items.title: Year of the Jellyfish
items.description: In this Eurotrash cult classic, a young woman (Valérie Kaprisky) vacations in an upscale beach resort with her mother, where it becomes clear that a layer of secrets and jealousy lay beneath the sun-drenched paradise.

items.title: A Bad Idea Gone Wrong
items.description: A comedy about two would-be thieves who arm the alarm system and have to break out of the house they just broke into. The discovery of a housesitter makes their escape more difficult.

items.title: A Boy Called Po
items.description: A Boy Called Po is the story of a recently widowed, now single father struggling to raise his sixth-grade son with autism. The pressure of his job and coping with the loss of his wife proves to push him nearly to the breaking point.

items.title: For Ever Mozart
items.description: A film is planned but is stymied by casting problems; a play is produced in Sarajevo, but the actors are swept away by war; the Director is frustrated in completing the film that initially couldn't get off the ground; and the magnificence of Mozart

items.title: A Place Called Home
items.description: Arriving home from his work at a steel fabrication plant, Levi finds his pregnant wife dead in their room; his newborn daughter, Allie, survives the incident.

items.title: Gagarine
items.description: Yuri fights to save his home town - which he shares with his namesake, Yuri Gagarin - from demolition.

items.title: Gross Misconduct
items.description: A female student falsely accuses a male professor of rape.

items.title: Gaughin: Voyage to Tahiti
items.description: Painter Paul Gauguin ventures alone to Tahiti. Impoverished and solitary, he settles deep into the Tahitian jungle, where he meets the Tehura, his muse, who will inspire his most iconic works of art.

items.title: Meet the Blacks
items.description: As Carl Black gets the opportunity to move his family out of Chicago in hope of a better life, their arrival in Beverly Hills is timed with that city's annual purge, where all crime is legal for twelve hours.

items.title: My Journey Through French Cinema
items.description: Bertrand Tavernier's personal journey through French cinema, from films he enjoyed as a boy to his own early career, is told through portraits of key creative figures.

items.title: Night Of The Shooting Stars
items.description: It is the Night of San Lorenzo, the night when dreams come true. While watching shooting stars, Cecilia tells her son about a similar night in 1944, when she was six years old, and the residents of San Martino defied their Nazi occupiers.

items.title: Girls of the Sun
items.description: A French journalist, Mathilde, comes to cover the attack in Kurdistan and bears witness to the story of these exceptional “Girls of the Sun” warriors.

items.title: Godard Mon Amour
items.description: During the making of one of his films, French film director Jean-Luc Godard falls in love with 19-year old actress Anne Wiazemsky and later marries her.

items.title: Nurse Edith Cavell
items.description: Anna Neagle stars in the gripping story of the martyrdom of World War I Nurse Cavell, whose Brussels hospital becomes the focal point in an underground system assisting refugees and escaped POWs.

items.title: Nowhere Special
items.description: When John, a 35-year-old window cleaner, is given only a few months left to live, he attempts to find a new, perfect family for his 4-year-old son Michael, determined to shield him from the terrible reality of

items.title: Joan the Maid I
items.description: The first installment of Jacques Rivette's ambitious yet restrained two-part study of the life of Joan of Arc.

items.title: Going Away
items.description: A teacher in France can't land a job, but one day he finds himself the guardian of a student.

items.title: On Guard
items.description: The swordplay never ends in this dazzling, Dumas-like adventure of conspiracy and revenge, set around 1700 and presented here in its seventh filmed incarnation, directed by French New Wave titan Philippe de Broca.

items.title: Going Places
items.description: In this controversial and notorious buddy film, director Bertrand Blier (GET OUT YOUR HANDKERCHIEFS) created what critic Pauline Kael described as “an explosively funny erotic farce – both a celebration and a satire of men's daydreams.”

items.title: Hangmen Also Die
items.description: Prague 1942. Following the assassination of Nazi “Reich Protector”, a professor's daughter hides the culprit in her parents' apartment. The Gestapo proceed to take 400 people hostage in retaliation.

items.title: Heat and Dust
items.description: Cross-cutting between two generations, James Ivory's sprawling epic of self-discovery is also a lush evocation of the prismatic and sensuous beauty of India.

items.title: Paulette
items.description: Paulette lives alone on the outskirts of Paris. Upon observing some dealings outside her building, she discovers a way to supplement her pension: an unlikely career selling cannabis.

items.title: Outside The Law
items.description: A drama about the Algerian struggle for independence from France after WWII.

items.title: Pandora and the Flying Dutchman
items.description: At a Costa Brava port in the 1930s, singer Pandora (Ava Gardner) meets the dashing but doomed yachtsman Captain Hendrik van der Zee (James Mason), who falls under her spell and pushes her to commit an ultimate act of love.

items.title: Moon: Man of Violence
items.description: "Moon (Man of Violence)" is an international heist film starring Michael Latimer as a James Bond-like gun for hire.

items.title: The New Girlfriend
items.description: After the death of her best friend, Claire falls in to a deep depression, but a surprising discovery about her friend's husband gives her a new taste for life.

items.title: Lifeline: Clyfford Still
items.description: A portrait of the fiercely independent, irascible, and iconic American painter Clyfford Still, who through his life and art defied classification.

items.title: Timur (Indonesian Language)
items.description: Iko Uwais stars alongside Aufa Assagaf and Jimmy Kobogau in this action drama where three childhood brothers are torn apart—until a hostage crisis reunites them on opposing sides, forcing a deadly clash between duty and brotherhood.

items.title: Hotel Sahara
items.description: This witty World War II comedy centers on a luxury hotel in North Africa owned by Emad (Ustinov), who wants to flee, but his fiancée, the luscious Yasmin (Yvonne de Carlo), insists they stay.

items.title: Birdcage Inn
items.description: Streetwise Jin-a moves into a boarding house run by a small, close-knit family. But her unacceptable behavior threatens to destroy them all.

items.title: Persian Lessons
items.description: From Vadim Perelman, director of the Oscar-nominated House of Sand and Fog. A Jewish concentration camp prisoner avoids death by claiming he is Persian and teaching the Commandant invented Farsi, but to survive, he must remember every word.

items.title: In Custody
items.description: A university scholar is tasked to interview the greatest living Urdu poet.The unlikely pair eventually form a bond over their mutual appreciation for the beauty and power of words, and those elusive things that touch the human heart.

items.title: In The Courtyard
items.description: Middle-aged musician Antoine is hired as caretaker of a residential building in Paris. Mathilde is a retired resident. Through a confusion of misfires and anxiety, the two develop a friendship.

items.title: In the House
items.description: A high school French teacher is drawn into a precocious student's increasingly transgressive story about his relationship with a friend's family.

items.title: In The Name of my Daughter
items.description: Agnès Le Roux, a young independent woman, returns to Nice in 1976 to have a new start in her life after a failed marriage. All while falling in love with an older lawyer.

items.title: Io Capitano
items.description: In "IO CAPITANO", a 2024 Academy Award nominee for Best International Film, writer-director Matteo Garrone presents a “reverse shot” of the immigration experience while unfurling an epic odyssey from West Africa to Italy.

items.title: Operation Finale
items.description: Operation Finale follows the 1960 mission of Peter Malkin (Oscar Isaac) as he infiltrates Argentina and captures Adolf Eichmann (Ben Kingsley), the Nazi officer who masterminded the logistics that sent millions of innocent Jews to their deaths.

items.title: It Happened Tomorrow
items.description: Acclaimed French director René Clair's famous whimsical style is evident in this cautionary tale: be careful - what you wish for might come true. This sparkling black and white film was restored from a 4K scan.

items.title: Jigsaw
items.description: After discovering a woman's body in a lonely beach house, a pair of Brighton detectives painstakingly assemble a jigsaw puzzle of clues as they attempt to track down her murderer.

items.title: Dead & Breakfast
items.description: A night at a local bed and breakfast turns into a bloody supernatural fight to the death.

items.title: Illegal Aliens
items.description: Three bombshell aliens crash-land on Earth to stop an intergalactic evil, using brains, beauty, and B-movie flair — with a little help from their holographic guide and a lot of campy chaos.

items.title: Johnny Cash: The Line
items.description: Johnny Cash's life and iconic hits, like "Ring of Fire," are told through vintage footage and interviews.

items.title: Noobz
items.description: Four friends hit the road to LA to compete in the Cyberbowl Video Game Championship, but will they be able to compete with the worst hangovers of their lives?

items.title: Just Like a Woman
items.description: The poignant tale of two women, barely more than casual acquaintances, who escape the prisons of their unhappy marriages and embark on a revealing journey of self discovery.

items.title: The Last Of The Unjust
items.description: Benjamin Murmelstein, the last Jewish elder of Theresienstadt (the so-called "model" ghetto), is despised by many of the ghetto's surviving inhabitants.

items.title: Life Is a Bed of Roses
items.description: Alain Resnais pays tribute to three influential French filmmakers Georges Melies, Marcel L Herbier and Eric Rohmer with this lighthearted film about happiness and the power of the imagination.

items.title: Black Jack
items.description: When honest young Tolly is forced on the run with 'Black Jack' adventure and mishap are never far away. Based on Leon Garfield's popular novel, Ken Loach's Black Jack is a dark and complex adventure film set in the 18th Century.

items.title: Albert R.N.
items.description: In this World War II drama based on true events, a group of British POWs suspects that there is a German spy in its midst after several escape attempts are foiled.

items.title: The Sea Shall Not Have Them
items.description: In Lewis Gilbert's memorable and gripping WWII saga, four Allied men struggle to survive in a lifeboat on the North Sea after their plane is shot down.

items.title: 3 Hearts
items.description: Instantly drawn to one another, Marc meets Sylvie after missing his train to Paris. A thwarted plan for a second meeting sends them in separate directions, until Sylvie return to France.

items.title: Michael Jackson: Al Descubierto (LAS)
items.description: Descubre la extraordinaria historia de Michael Jackson: su música revolucionaria, su fama sin precedentes, sus luchas personales y el legado perdurable del Rey del Pop.

items.title: Love Unto Death
items.description: In Uzès, a mysterious, austere town, four characters live in seclusion, and have a simple yet superb life.

items.title: Lured
items.description: A serial killer is on the loose in London, luring young women into his web through ads placed in the personal column. Scotland Yard's bait to ensnare the villain is a young American dance hall girl.

items.title: Never Better
items.description: A recent college grad with cystic fibrosis is stuck quarantining alone in the summer of 2020. When her self-interested roommate returns home and fails to practice safe social distancing, she finds that boredom may be the least of her worries.

items.title: Wings of the Morning
items.description: Set amidst the exciting world of horse racing and shot in beautiful Technicolor, a young noblewoman must marry a Duke to fulfill the prophecy of her Romany ancestors.

items.title: Matewan
items.description: When good meets evil, violence is inevitable. Set in the coal-mining town of Matewan, West Virginia, in 1920, this powerful historical drama depicts the tense, violent struggle between exploited coal miners and the mine-owning companies.

items.title: Shooting The Mafia
items.description: Sicilian Letizia Battaglia began a lifelong battle with the Mafia when she first dared to point her camera at a brutally slain victim, exposing the Cosa Nostra's barbaric reign.

items.title: A Zed and Two Noughts
items.description: Two widowers, twin zoologists, fixate on decay in Peter Greenaway's beautifully disturbing and darkly humorous take on erotic obsession and death.

items.title: Shakespeare Wallah
items.description: Starring a young Felicity Kendal, the film is inspired by the real-life adventures of Ms. Kendal's family as a traveling theater group in India during the final days of English colonial rule.

items.title: Scene of The Crime
items.description: Escaped convicts threaten a 13-year-old boy; a murder follows. Over four days around his First Communion, family tensions and criminal chaos collide.

items.title: A Very Married Christmas
items.description: A man’s quiet life unravels when he discovers his wife is having an affair and wants a divorce. A chance meeting with a volunteer Santa helps him rediscover hope, joy, and the magic of a true Christmas miracle.

items.title: The Return of Martin Guerre
items.description: During the middle of the 16th century, Martin Guerre returns to his village in southwestern France, after being away in the war for almost a decade. The villagers who knew him as a young man suspect he is not really Martin.

items.title: The Hitch-Hiker
items.description: The essential road trip noir, from director Ida Lupino.

items.title: Le Chef
items.description: Self-taught aspiring chef Jacky has the talent, but not the luck. Star chef Alexandre Lagarde is in danger of losing his reputation, along with his beloved restaurant. Fate brings the two together.

items.title: About Fate
items.description: This romantic comedy is a tale of two strangers who believe in love but seem never to find its true meaning. In a wild twist of events, fate puts each in the other's path on a stormy New Year's Eve, and comedy and chaos ensue.

items.title: The Devil's Playground
items.description: A period drama detailing a young boy's coming-of-age in a strict Catholic seminary in the 1950s.

items.title: The Force
items.description: A deep look inside the embattled Oakland Police Department as it struggles to confront demands for reform during a powderkeg moment in policing.

items.title: A Royal Christmas Manor
items.description: Prince Alexander of Fredonia escapes his royal life for Christmas in America, staying at a struggling inn under a false identity. He falls for Katie, the owner, but when his secret is revealed, their love is tested.

items.title: The Flesh and the Fiends
items.description: Irish immigrants hit upon the idea of selling the bodies of the recently deceased to a surgeon.

items.title: Slava Ukraini
items.description: A film in the form of a travel journal by filmmaker Bernard-Henry Lévy from his more than ten trips to Ukraine over the last half of 2022, crisscrossing the country with Ukrainian special forces on the front lines from Kharkiv to Kherson.

items.title: Standing Tall
items.description: A juvenile judge and a special educator are convinced that they can save the young delinquent Malony from himself and his violent ways.

items.title: The Artist and the Model
items.description: In summer 1943, in occupied France, a famous sculptor feels the urge to work on his last masterpiece when a beautiful Spanish girl comes knocking after escaping from a refugee camp in the South of France.

items.title: The Attack
items.description: Dr. Amin Jaafari is an Israeli Palestinian surgeon, fully assimilated into Tel Aviv society. His picture-perfect life is turned upside down when a suicide bombing in a restaurant leaves nineteen dead.

items.title: The Ballad of the Sad Cafe
items.description: Cohen Film Collection presents a new restoration of a Merchant Ivory classic. Oscar winners Vanessa Redgrave, Keith Carradine, and Rod Steiger star in this adaptation of Carson McCullers's novella and the Edward Albee play based on it.

items.title: Hester Street
items.description: A new 4K restoration of this beloved indie classic about what it is to become an American. Starring Carol Kane in her Academy Award nominated role as a young immigrant woman coming to a new country.

items.title: Hitchcock Truffaut
items.description: The film journeys through the extensive series of conversations between Hitchcock and Truffaut, illustrating their love for filmmaking and demonstrating their impact on modern world cinema.

items.title: Sunny Bunnies - The Best Of (Part 1)
items.description: Five playful bunnies fly from the Sun to Earth, where Turbo, Big Boo, Shiny, Iris, and Hopper share laughs, mischief, and teamwork. Through squabbles and adventures, these Sunny Bunnies always make up and help each other out.

items.title: Howards End
items.description: One of Merchant Ivory's undisputed masterpieces, this adaptation of E.M. Forster's classic 1910 novel is a saga of class relations and changing times in Edwardian England.

items.title: Last Passenger
items.description: A small group of everyday passengers on a speeding London commuter train battle the sociopathic driver who has a dark plan for everyone on-board.

items.title: A Fish In The Bathtub
items.description: Legendary comedy duo (and real-life husband and wife) Jerry Stiller and Anne Meara star as the constantly bickering couple at the center of this sprightly comedy from writer-director Joan Micklin Silver (Hester Street, Crossing Delancey).

items.title: Perfect Understanding
items.description: A comedy of manners in which Gloria Swanson and Laurence Olivier marry on the condition that each retain their individual sexual freedom. But when each flaunts extra-marital escapades, an amusing battle of the sexes ensues.

items.title: Symphony For A Massacre
items.description: This rediscovered crime thriller is sure to please fans of classic film noir.

items.title: Super Simple Bedtime Songs
items.description: Snuggle up for a starry night of sweet lullabies. These gentle, soothing songs are the perfect way to help your little one drift off to a peaceful sleep.

items.title: Legend of the Christmas Witch
items.description: Six brave students embark on a rescue mission to save the Christmas Witch.

items.title: Between the Lines
items.description: At the offices of a Boston alternative newspaper, the staff members enjoy a positive and open-minded work environment.

items.title: Autobiography of a Princess
items.description: At their annual tea party reunion, an Indian princess (Madhur Jaffrey), long divorced and living in self-exile in London, and her father's ex-tutor, Cyril Sahib (James Mason) view home-movie footage of their former life in Royal India.

items.title: The Green Cockatoo
items.description: A new 2K restoration of this classic Brit Noir. Based on a story by Graham Greene, Jim Connor (John Mills) and Eileen (Rene Ray) track down and wreak vengeance on the gangsters who killed Jim's brother, Dave (Robert Newton).

items.title: A Royal Christmas Hope
items.description: At Christmas, a charitable non-profit founder and a mysterious prince from St. Monica cross paths in NYC. As sparks fly and secrets build, love may be the greatest gift of all, if truth doesn’t ruin it.

items.title: Ash Tuesday
items.description: A group of residents in New York struggle to find meaning in the wake of the 9/11 attacks.

items.title: The Christmas Campaign
items.description: A driven ad exec and a laid-back creative are forced to team up on a festive campaign, but as their rivalry turns to romance, they discover the best holiday pitch might just be love itself.

items.title: RiffTrax Live: The Return of Swamp Thing
items.description: Join us as we chase down a hoodoo in front of a live audience! This feature is a parody with the original movie & funny commentary with Mike, Kevin, and Bill of MST3K.

items.title: RiffTrax Presents: Woman Who Came Back
items.description: Spoiler alert! In this mysterious thriller, a woman comes back! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mary Jo and Bridget from RiffTrax.

items.title: The Beautiful Troublemaker
items.description: The former famous painter Frenhofer revisits an abandoned project using the girlfriend of a young visiting artist. Questions about truth, life, and artistic limits are explored.

items.title: My Christmas Inn
items.description: On the verge of a big promotion, Jen inherits a cozy Alaska inn and meets a charming local attorney. Surrounded by festive traditions, she begins to wonder if she's finally found where she belongs.

items.title: The Bostonians
items.description: Boston, 1876: At a Women's Movement meeting, fiercely independent Olive becomes mentor to gifted young orator Verena, who soon attracts the amorous attentions of Olive's Southern cousin Basil.

items.title: Beatles: Lennon/Harrison, Guitars Gently Weep
items.description: In this fascinating account of one half of the worlds' most famous band we explore the sides of two great personalities: John Lennon and George Harrison through interviews.

items.title: Beatles: The Journey
items.description: Utilizing rare archive footage, news reels and unique interviews, this program follows the formation and rise of the worldís first supergroup.

items.title: Between the Canals
items.description: Follows three small time criminals from Dublin's North Inner City as they each aspire to be somebody in a fast changing society.

items.title: Woodland
items.description: On an island in the Pacific Northwest, a junkie photojournalist's disturbing future is revealed to him through the images he shoots.

items.title: A Christmas Murder Mystery
items.description: Every Christmas, the wealthy Sterlings reunite at their remote estate. But when Harold is poisoned after hinting at a new will, puzzle editor Vera Vexley and Deputy Neal must unmask a killer among greedy heirs and secretive guests.

items.title: A Christmas to Remember
items.description: As Christmas dinner brings four friends together, heartfelt stories of love, family, forgiveness, and second chances remind them that the greatest gifts come from the heart.

items.title: Joan the Maid II
items.description: "Joan the Maid: The Prisons,” the second part of Rivette's diptych, brought leading lady Bonnaire a César Award nomination for her powerful performance, as she plays out windows in the final two years of Joan's life.

items.title: Black Creek
items.description: A sheriff's sister hunts down the ruthless outlaws who murdered her family.

items.title: The Damned
items.description: In 1945, a submarine leaves Oslo for South America with German leaders and several pro-Nazi officials aboard, hoping to escape their fate in Europe. A French doctor is forced to join them, setting the stage for scheming, intrigue, and mutiny.

items.title: Busted Up
items.description: A Canadian boxer (Paul Coufos) can keep his daughter, reunite with her mother (Irene Cara) and save his neighborhood with a fight.

items.title: City of Shadows
items.description: A police sergeant (John P. Ryan) and his brother, separated at birth, become pawns in a game of good vs. evil.

items.title: Crazy Eights
items.description: Circumstances bring six childhood friends together to face their past, and a secret they share.

items.title: Killing Moon
items.description: A scientist and a dishonest agent work toward different ends as a mysterious virus afflicts passengers on a flight to Hawaii.

items.title: Dan Aykroyd Unplugged on UFOs
items.description: A UFO enthusiast interviews Dan Aykroyd on the subject of extraterrestrials visiting Earth.

items.title: Nail In the Coffin: The Fall & Rise of Vampiro
items.description: A rare glimpse into the legendary career of wrestling icon, Vampiro, as he grapples with his demons and life after fame. Straight from one of wrestling's most outspoken characters, this is a candid look beyond the ring.

items.title: Devil in the Flesh
items.description: Debbie, new in town, targets her teacher, leading to peril.

items.title: UFO Dossier - Ecuador
items.description: In recent months, some major governments have begun to de-classify documents regarding cases of UFO's, making the information public.

items.title: Dark Around the Stars
items.description: On a drunken road trip to end his life, a man finds hope through the strangers he meets.

items.title: Day Zero
items.description: The military draft is back, and three best friends are drafted and given 30 days to report for duty. In that time, they're forced to confront everything they believe about courage, duty, love, friendship, and honor.

items.title: UFO Dossier - South America
items.description: A wave of ufo sightings have been increasing consistently in certain countries, especially Mexico.

items.title: Echoes of War
items.description: A Civil War veteran returns home to protect his family from a brutal, harassing cattle rancher.

items.title: Goldenrod
items.description: Former rodeo champion Jesse Gifford must take responsibility for raising his two sons after his wife leaves the family.

items.title: Voice in the Wind
items.description: In this gritty noir, a Czech pianist, driven half-mad by Nazi oppression, flees Europe to the island of Guadalupe. He finds a lost love there who is also a refugee waiting to enter the U.S. They fall in with crooked smugglers.

items.title: Jackals
items.description: An estranged family and a deprogrammer fight off a murderous cult to save their teenage son.

items.title: Lover's Knot
items.description: Cupid's caseworker tries to unite two souls who have eluded his matchmaking for many lifetimes.

items.title: The Hit
items.description: Ten years after Willie Parker ratted on his old mobster friends in exchange for personal immunity, two hit men kidnap him and drive him to Paris for his planned execution. However, they encounter many mishaps along the way.

items.title: True Crime Files: A Deadly Obsession
items.description: A toxic relationship turns fatal - the disturbing case of Chance Donohoe and the murder of his girlfriend.

items.title: Monsters of California
items.description: Teenager Dallas Edwards and his derelict friends go on a quest for the meaning behind a series of mysterious, paranormal events in Southern California.

items.title: True Crime FIles: A Father's Crime
items.description: A rural town reels as bodycam and interrogation footage expose a father accused of abusing his daughter.

items.title: True Crime Files: The Family Massacre
items.description: Adlai Mestre, 24, slaughtered his family and dog, mopped the blood, and hid the bodies in a ravine.

items.title: Transformers
items.description: Una antigua guerra entre Autobots y Decepticons toma la Tierra como escenario, donde un adolescente tiene la clave para el poder definitivo.

items.title: Wanted For Murder
items.description: As the son of a Victorian hangman is driven insane by thoughts of his father's profession, the young man emulates his father by strangling young women.

items.title: The Deceivers
items.description: A pre-Bond Pierce Brosnan stars as an East India Company administrator who infiltrates the ranks of bloodthirsty cult the Thugees (infamous as the origins of the term “thug”).

items.title: True Crime Files: The Missing Child Cover-up
items.description: A chilling look at the disappearance of Taylor Williams and the cover-up that unraveled around her mother, Brianna Williams.

items.title: My Father Muhammad Ali
items.description: The story of boxing champ Muhammad Ali through the eyes of his son, Jr., who overcame a life of pain.

items.title: True Crime Files: The Shocking Case Of Brian Cohee Jr
items.description: Brian Cohee Jr. was a 19-year-old from Grand Junction, Colorado, who gained national attention in 2021 after being arrested for murder.

items.title: Déjà Vu
items.description: DOUBLE FEATURE FRIDAY: If you thought it was just a trick of the mind, prepare yourself for the truth.

items.title: Nocturnal
items.description: Laurie, a cynical schoolgirl, builds and nurtures a secret friendship with Pete, an older man who's apparently obsessed with her.

items.title: Norfolk

items.description: When a couple decides to be in an open relationship while still living together, tension builds as boundaries are crossed and secrets are discovered.

items.title: Los mensajeros 2: el espantapájaros
items.description: Un granjero con mala suerte nota que sus suerte comienza a cambiar después de poner un espantapájaros misterioso en su campo de maíz. Sin embargo, parece que hay fuerzas siniestras en acción.
